100931656.name: Ascendant Scepter
100931656.subtitle: An empowered symbol of Awoken royalty.
100931656.subtitle_zh: 觉醒者王室的强大象征。
100931656.text:
Commander,

After careful study of the Scepters given to Guardians aiding in the rescue operations on Earth, the Cryptarchy offers the following preliminary analysis:

The Ascendant Scepter is an object attuned to the powers of the Awoken, and the Awoken Queen Mara Sov in particular. Using volatile Ley Lines similar to those that allow Queen Mara to telepathically communicate (to various degrees) with other Awoken, the Scepter allows its wielder to benefit from bursts of paracausal energy sent by the queen herself.

This type of energy transference was previously thought impossible, even among the Awoken Paladins and the rumored specialist sect known as the Queensguard. To make matters more complicated, Awoken tradition dictates that all Guardians capable of this feat immediately be granted the rank of Paladin (which is preposterous, as only seven can serve at one time). 

Interestingly, Queen Mara has seen fit to distribute Scepters to each active Guardian rather than just the Awoken, and bestow Royal Army titles to all. Even, in an honorary capacity, to the Lightless. Awoken Techeuns and Corsairs now fight alongside allied Human, Exo, Eliksni, and Cabal individuals, and all beneath the queen's royal banner. 

Had this development been revealed to me a scant few years ago, I wouldn't have believed it… but this old Cryptarch has seen Guardians fighting with bows and glaives, wielding Stasis and Strand, and is not too stodgy to admit that times have changed—quite possibly for the better.

—Master Rahool
100931656.text_zh:
指挥官，

在仔细研究了给予守护者，以协助其在地球上营救行动的权杖后，解密大师给出了以下初步分析：

上维权杖是一件针对觉醒者，尤其是觉醒者玛拉·索维女王的力量同调过的物品。使用类似于能让玛拉女王与其他觉醒者进行（不同程度）心灵感应的不稳定灵脉，权杖能让持有者受益于女王本人发出的超因果能量。

这种类型的能量转移在之前被认为是不可能做到的，即使是在觉醒者圣骑士和传闻中被称为女王近卫的专业派别中也是如此。使事情更趋复杂的是，觉醒者传统规定所有有此技艺的守护者都应立即被授予圣骑士的头衔（这很荒谬，因为一次只能有七名圣骑士效力）。 

有趣的是，玛拉女王认为应该将权杖分发给每一位活跃的守护者，而不仅仅是觉醒者，并将皇家军队的称号授予所有人，甚至是以荣誉身份授予无光者。觉醒者灵巫和海盗军现在与联盟的人类、Exo、埃里克斯尼族和卡巴尔成员一同在玛拉女王的皇家旗帜下并肩作战。 

如果是几年前告诉我这种新发展，我根本不会相信…但是我这个年迈的解密大师已经见过守护者用弓箭和偃月战斗，驾驭冰影和缚丝，并没有古板到不肯承认时代已经改变——而且很可能已变得更好。

——拉乎尔大师

3895393355.name: NPA Repulsion Regulator
3895393355.subtitle: "Should be reliable, but if it stops working, you'll know almost immediately." —Deputy Commander Sloane
3895393355.subtitle_zh: “应该靠得住，但要是不管用，你肯定马上就会知道。”——副指挥官斯隆
3895393355.text:
WELCOME, GUARDIAN 

JUMP SHIP>ORBITAL RELAY: ENCRYPTED CONNECTION 

RETRIEVAL…  

VANGUARD ARCHIVE LOG: T0071 

CRYPTARCHY/HISTORIES/COLLAPSE/TITAN, ARTIFACTS/RECOVERED  

These Golden Age dive regulators allowed explorers of Kraken Mare to delve into the deepest reaches of the methane seas. By generating a weak atomic lattice and manipulating its van der Waals force distance values, these devices repulse the crushing methane ocean before it makes contact with the diver. Critical to constructing the foundations of Titan's rigs and arcologies, these lost pieces of technology were believed to be scattered across Titan due to moon-wide tidal waves during the Collapse. 

As long as the device has ample time to equalize its repulsion drive with external pressure, a diver can safely descend several thousand meters with a relatively unrestrictive suit. Guardians should note, however, that this repulsive effect will in no way stop—or even slow—any lethal projectiles comprised of non-methane material. It also will not block non-methane oceans of other chemical makeup. 

[Addendum: Several dive regulators have since been recovered with the return of Titan and detailed telemetry data provided by Deputy Commander Sloane. All fireteams executing dive and salvage operations are required to outfit themselves with NPA regulators. Due to the limited viscosity of Titan's methane ocean, Guardians will sink faster than they can swim. Regulators must be on and functioning prior to operational clearance. Typically fitted into an exoskeleton-style diving suit, these regulators require a series of custom adjustments to interface with modern Guardian armor systems. Ghosts can perform these adjustments by accessing the instructional attachment in this record.]
3895393355.text_zh:
欢迎，守护者 

跃迁飞船>轨道中继器：加密连接 

检索…  

先锋档案日志：T0071 

解密大师/历史/大崩溃/土卫六，神器/已回收  

这些黄金时代的潜水呼吸调节器能让克拉肯海的探险者深入到甲烷海的最深处。通过产生弱原子晶格并控制其范德华力距离值，这些设备能在毁灭性的甲烷海水接触到潜水员之前就将其斥离。这些失落技术对于建造土卫六钻井平台和生态园区的地基而言至关重要，据说受大崩塌期间月球范围内的潮汐波影响，它们散落在了土卫六各处。 

只要该装置有足够的时间来平衡其斥力驱动和外部压力，潜水员就可以穿着相对不受限的潜水服安全地下潜数千米。然而，守护者应当注意，这种斥力作用绝无法阻挡——甚至减缓——任何由非甲烷物质组成的致命射弹。它也无法阻挡非甲烷海洋的其他化学组成。 

[补遗：在土卫六归来以及得到副指挥官斯隆提供的详细遥测数据后，有几个潜水呼吸调节器已被找到。所有执行潜水和回收作业的火力战队都必须配备NPA调节器。由于土卫六甲烷海的粘度有限，守护者下沉的速度会比他们游泳的速度更快。在得到操作许可之前，调节器必须开启并正常运作。通常安装在外骨骼式潜水服中的这些调节器，需要进行一系列的自定义调整来与现代守护者护甲系统交互。机灵可以通过访问本记录中的指导附件来进行这类调整。]

2441971294.name: Acolyte's Staff
2441971294.subtitle: A foreboding staff bearing engravings of Hive runes and bound with mystical charms.
2441971294.subtitle_zh: 一根刻有邪魔族符文并附有神秘坠饰的不祥之杖。
2441971294.text:
Commander,

"Speak to me not of the Darkness—I want no part," I once cautioned an overeager Guardian who loitered near me in the Tower. I did not mean their command over Strand or Stasis, but rather the deep, ancient corruption that empowers our enemies and corrodes our very souls. This force—this evil, if I may use such a simplistic term—surrounds us, and we must do all we can to limit our exposure, lest we find ourselves sinking below its dark waves.

And so it was with great hesitancy that I examined the unusual "Acolyte's Staff" created by Eris Morn and Immaru, the renegade Ghost. I find their alliance baffling as she holds no love for the Hive, and he is the foul creature who resurrected Savathûn. But even that is not as strange as the staff itself.

In addition to being bound with charms and inscribed with powerful runes, the staff contains a small fragment of Hive worm. Due to a ghastly ritual and a metaphysical loophole in sword logic philosophy, a Guardian wielding the staff is able to transfer the power of their defeated foes to Ms. Morn through a blood tithe.

Seeking answers, I sought Ms. Morn herself. I found her beyond a portal she erected in the H.E.L.M. She was waiting on an elaborate bone dais in a forgotten corner of Savathûn's throne world she called the Athenaeum, as it allowed her to study the secrets of Savathûn's Spire. The seclusion of the locale was appealing, but when Ms. Morn began to "change," I fled, leaving my curiosity behind me.

There is power within the staff, Commander. Terrible power.

Speak to me not of the Darkness.

—Master Rahool
2441971294.text_zh:
指挥官，

“不要同我谈论暗影…我没有兴趣，”我曾这么告诫过高塔里混迹在我周围的一位过于急切的守护者。我指的不是他们对缚丝或是冰影的驾驭，而是那种赋予了我们敌人力量，腐蚀了我们灵魂的深层、古老的腐化。这种力量——这种邪恶，如果我能用这种简单词汇的话——包围着我们，我们必须尽一切可能限制接触，以免我们发现自己沉入它黑暗的波涛之下。

因此，我怀着极大的犹豫，审视了埃里斯·摩恩和叛徒机灵伊马鲁打造的那根非同寻常的“仆从之杖”。他们的结盟让我有些不解，因为埃里斯·摩恩不喜欢邪魔族，而伊马鲁又是复活萨瓦图恩的邪恶生物。但这件事还是没有权杖本身那么奇怪。

除了附有坠饰和刻着强大的符文外，权杖还包含一小块邪魔族蠕虫的碎片。出于某种可怕的仪式和邪剑守则哲学中形而上的漏洞，一个挥舞着权杖的守护者能够通过鲜血贡品将击败敌人的力量转移给摩恩女士。

为了寻找答案，我找到了摩恩女士本人。她在应急后勤行动中心建立了一道传送门，我在门外找到了她。她在萨瓦图恩王座世界某个被遗忘的角落里，一个她称之为雅典娜神庙的精制骨台上等待着，因为她可以在那里研究萨瓦图恩尖塔的秘密。那里与世隔绝的环境十分诱人，但当摩恩开始“转化”时，我就逃走了，把好奇心抛诸脑后。

权杖里蕴含着力量，指挥官。可怕的力量。

不要同我谈论暗影。

——拉乎尔大师

439882641.name: Queensfoil Censer
439882641.subtitle: Awoken and Ahamkara magics mingle in the mist rising from this censer as it swings back and forth, back and forth…
439882641.subtitle_zh: 觉醒者和阿罕卡拉魔法在从香炉中升起的雾气中交织摇曳…
439882641.text:
[Cryptarchy Access: -Guardian-] 
[Decrypting Engrammatic File Cipher…] 
[Archive//Accessed//Search: A:GH-030-912] 
[Report Displayed:] 

This report is assembled from the collected journals and accounts of Lightbearer participants of the Great Hunt, in which the Ahamkara were purged from Sol.  

Wishes: A verbally expressed desire expressed within audible range of any Ahamkara. This wish is granted through invocation of something known as the "Anthem Anatheme," which appears to be a manner of subjecting reality to one's will, similar to a Lightbearer's ability to affect paracausality. However, little is known about how this process unfolds in practice. 

Henceforth, the "wisher" enters a binding contract with the Ahamkara, though many Ahamkara will purposefully manipulate or misinterpret the parameters of this contract to draw greater nourishment from it, often causing calamity to the wisher. 

Lightbearers are expected to refrain from expressing wants or desires in the presence of an Ahamkara. 

VERIFIED: 

-Ahamkara bones somehow retain intelligence, sentience, and a manner of speech yet to be defined, post-mortem. It is surmised that an Ahamkara's corporeal body is not its true form, but a representation. 
-Ahamkara feed by granting wishes. These beings possess an innate ability to alter reality and consume the quantum chaos that results from such an act. This is theorized to allow them to "transcend reality". 
-Above information regarding altering reality supported by data confirming species-wide capability to shift form into a wide variety of living and inanimate structures.  
-Wishes, while seemingly less potent and more difficult to initiate, are still able to be granted from Ahamkara bones. 
-Ahamkara are not solitary creatures. Many adults patrol vast distances across Sol alone, but their territories overlap, and disputes are rare. While Ahamkara do not typically hunt in packs, there have been sightings of hunting pairs. In fact, they do not appear to prey on each other at all. In one report, a dozen Ahamkara on Venus had congregated at a nexus of their territories without conflict.  

UNVERIFIED: 

-Three reports from Old Russian claim Ahamkara wielded the Light. This has never been confirmed. 
-Seven Ahamkara that evaded and slew their Lightbearer pursuers and are still unaccounted for. This report is believed to be an error in its totality.
439882641.text_zh:
[解密大师访问：-守护者-] 
[正在解码记忆水晶文档暗码…] 
[存档//已访问//搜索：A:GH-030-912] 
[已显示报告：] 

本报告是根据收集到的参与伟大狩猎的负光者的日志和记录整理而成的。在狩猎期间，太阳系中的阿罕卡拉被屠戮殆尽。  

愿望：在任何阿罕卡拉听觉范围内的口头愿望。这个愿望可以通过调用一种被称为“禁忌圣歌”的东西来实现，它似乎是一种让现实服从个人意志的方式，类似于负光者影响超因果的能力。然而，我们对此过程的实际步骤所知甚少。 

之后，“许愿者”会与阿罕卡拉签订一份具有约束力的契约，不过许多阿罕卡拉会故意操纵或曲解这份契约的参数，以便从中汲取更多的养分，这往往会给许愿者带来灭顶之灾。 

负光者不应在阿罕卡拉面前表达愿望或欲望。 

已证实： 

- 阿罕卡拉遗骨在其肉体死后会以某种方式保留智慧、知觉和一种还未定义的语言方式。据推测，阿罕卡拉的肉体并非其真实形态，而是一种表象。 
- 实现愿望是阿罕卡拉的进食方式。这些生物生来就有改变现实的能力，并能吞噬由此产生的量子混沌。据推测，这使他们能够“超越现实”。 
- 以上关于改变现实的情报得到了数据的支持。这些数据证实了其物种具有将形态转变为各种有生命和无生命结构的能力。  
- 尽管较弱或较难发起，一些愿望依然可以通过阿罕卡拉遗骨实现。 
- 阿罕卡拉不是独居生物。许多成年阿罕卡拉会独自巡视太阳系的广阔空间，但它们的领地会相互重叠，而且很少发生争端。虽然阿罕卡拉一般不会群体狩猎，但有成对狩猎的情况。事实上，它们似乎不会捕食同族。在一份报告中，金星上曾有十几头阿罕卡拉聚集在它们领地的交界处，且没有发生冲突。  

未证实： 

- 三份来自旧俄罗斯的报告称，阿罕卡拉会运用光能。这点还未被证实。 
- 七头阿罕卡拉躲避并杀死了追击他们的负光者。这份报告被认为是完全错误的。

2913673684.name: Hunter's Journal
2913673684.subtitle: A collection of memories made real by the Traveler's Light.
2913673684.subtitle_zh: 旅行者的光能让记忆变得真实。
2913673684.text:
"How many lifetimes have you lived?" someone will ask, and the answer always depends. 

Most Ghosts will say that their Guardian has lived two lives: the one before their first resurrection, and the one they're living now. Some Lightbearers go by the number of times they've fallen in battle, knowing that the count doesn't end unless their Ghost is ended first. 

Exos like Cayde-6, have it the hardest—which might be why he likes to keep everything in one place, between the pages of a journal. 

His mentor, Andal Brask, exists only in his memory and the strokes of a charcoal sketch that Sundance claimed "looks nothing like him." So Cayde drew her too, agonizing over the precise angles of her shell and the special way her Light refracted at dusk and dawn. 

There's a poem about all his Vanguard paperwork, and a disclaimer beneath it that he is not—and never will be—a poet. 

Entire pages dedicated to half-remembered dreams of the Golden Age, and a family that he fears is only wishful thinking. 

Physical mementos, too, tucked between the pages or fastened to them. A ramen ticket. A feather from the Colonel. A playing card stolen from a deck that he and Shiro once shared. Wild sage grown in the mountains outside the Last City, where he and Sundance used to escape when the Tower started feeling like a tomb. When Cayde rubs the brittle leaves between his fingers, they crumble into a mealy dust. Its smell makes his heart ache. 

Crow does not ask Cayde how many lifetimes he's lived, although he's curious what the answer would be. He also does not ask where the journal came from, or why it might be here in the Pale Heart with him. 

It's a question that would inevitably lead to others—and neither of them are ready for that conversation. Even if they both know it must be coming. 

So he gives it to you. To hold onto.
2913673684.text_zh:
“你活过几世？”有人会这样问，而答案总是视情况而定。 

大多数机灵会说，他们的守护者活过两世：一个是在第一次复活前，一个是现在正经历的。有些负光者会根据他们在战斗中倒下的次数来计算，因为他们知道，除非他们的机灵先被终结，否则计算就不会结束。 

像凯德6号这样的Exo是最痛苦的——这也许就是为什么他喜欢把所有的事情都整理起来，放在一本日志里。 

他的导师安达尔·布莱斯克只存在于他的记忆中，还有一幅太阳舞说“看起来一点都不像他”的炭笔素描中。于是凯德也把她画了下来，为她机壳的精确角度及其光能在黄昏和黎明折射的特殊方式而苦恼不已。 

有一首诗是关于他的先锋文书工作，下面还有一句声明：他不是诗人，也永远不会成为诗人。 

整页的内容都是关于黄金时代依稀记得的梦，还有他害怕只是一种奢望的家。 

还有一些实物纪念品，夹在书页之间或固定在书页上。一张拉面票。一根羽毛，上校的。一张从他和白曾经共用的牌组中偷来的卡片。高塔开始渐渐像坟墓，而野生鼠尾草生长在圣城外的山上，他和太阳舞就经常逃到那里。当凯德用手指搓揉脆叶时，它们会碎成蚧壳状的粉尘。它的气味让他心痛不已。 

乌鸦没有问凯德活了几世，虽然他很好奇答案是什么。他也没有问这本日志从何而来，为什么会和他一起来到苍白之心。 

这个问题会不可避免地引出其他问题，而他们都还没有准备好进行这样的对话，即使他们都知道这一定会发生。 

所以他把日志给了你。给你珍藏。

3189352855.name: Slayer Baron Apothecary Satchel
3189352855.subtitle: A custom pouch with attached Tonic Capsule for mixing various resources found in the field.
3189352855.subtitle_zh: 一只附有药剂胶囊的定制小袋，可以混合野外找到的各种资源。
3189352855.text:
A note is attached: 

A gift for the Slayer Baron, in thanks for the burden you carry on behalf of all Eliksni. 

May it grant you many-armed protection as you face Fikrul. 

There are two great challenges we face: one kinetic, against the Revenant Scorn; one corporeal—my father's curse. 

But Slayer Baron tonics may save us from both, as they did the ancient Eliksni during the beast hunts on Riis of old. 

According to Crow's report, Fikrul's new breed of Scorn is made from our living flesh. He doesn't even need to kill us to turn us anymore. The transmutation sounds ontological in nature—just like my father's condition. 

The original Barons used apothecary mixers such as this one to brew eclectic medicines. We'll leverage similar tonics as combat and utility enhancements in the field. 

Before the Whirlwind, there were seven Eliksni scholia that informed tonic creation: Innervation, Conduction, Effervescence, Tenacity, Vigor, Euthermia, and Cognition. 

All of which will be useful to us as battlefield treatments, provided I can get your help with fieldwork and experimentation. 

Don't worry! I'm certain we can modernize these tonics to affect just your Guardian abilities and not your physiology. Mostly certain. We'll need every advantage we can find.  

Fikrul's actions on Europa have made clear that he sees our people as transgressions. No matter the House, whether we are friends of humanity or not. Distress calls from Eliksni enclaves across the system are flooding public frequencies. 

I implore you to win this war. Not to fulfill a prophecy, or secure a title for my father. To prevent our extinction.
3189352855.text_zh:
附有一张纸条： 

这是给杀手公爵的礼物，感谢你为所有埃里克斯尼族承担的重担。 

愿它在你面对费克鲁时提供最佳的保护。 

我们面临着两个重大挑战：一个是对抗亡魂嗤魅的动能挑战，另一个是祛除我父亲所受诅咒的物质挑战。 

但就像在古老的里斯狩猎野兽时给予埃里克斯尼族力量一样，杀手公爵的药剂或许能帮助我们应对这两个挑战。 

根据乌鸦的报告，费克鲁的新型嗤魅是用活体制造的。他甚至不再需要杀死我们就能把我们变成嗤魅。这种转化听起来像是本体论的——就像我父亲的情况。 

原初的公爵们使用这样的药剂混合器来酿造各种药物。我们将在战场上利用类似的药剂作为战斗和效用增强剂。 

在旋风之前，埃里克斯尼族会制作七种药剂：支配、传导、起泡、坚韧、活力、中正和认知。 

这些药剂将对我们的战场状态大有裨益，不过我需要你的帮助进行外勤工作和实验。 

别担心！我们对这些药剂进行了现代化改良，让它们只影响守护者技能而不触及生理状态，我有九成的把握。我们必须发挥一切优势。  

费克鲁在木卫二的行动表明，他视我的族人为罪过。无论氏族，也不管是否与人类为友。星系各处埃里克斯尼族飞地的求救信号正在涌入公共频段。 

我恳请你赢得这场战争。不是为了应验预言，也不是为了给我父亲一个称号，而是为了阻止我们被灭族。

2434045866.name: Tablet of Ruin
2434045866.subtitle: "The world is not built on the laws they love… Not with peace, but by victory at any means." —The Winnower
2434045866.subtitle_zh: “世界并非建立在他们所珍视的法则之上…亦非依靠和平，而是凭借不择手段的胜利。”——扬场工
2434045866.text:
[This tablet was recovered from Savathûn's throne world when Alak-Hul, the Lightblade, was slain. It now sits idly in your possession. No whispers coax you to listen. No edicts compel you to act. Nevertheless, you stare unwaveringly at the etched stone.] 

"Lightbearer. You're so serious about all of this." 

"It's just a game." 

"You want to shape the world but don't have the stomach for the 'wrong' kind of violence." 

"So, you stare at stone or glass, trying to invoke the Deep with control." 

"We are already more acquainted than you remember." 

"Can you hear me now, over the whiners and would-be gods?"  

"Do you know that I consider you a frustrating friend?" 

"And yet you point a gun, even when there is still so much between us." 

"You know this only ends one way." 

"Then kill it. I dare you."
2434045866.text_zh:
[这块石板是在光之利刃奥洛克豪被杀之时，从萨瓦图恩的王座世界里回收的。此刻，它正静静地躺在你的掌心。没有耳语诱惑你倾听。没有敕令迫使你行动。然而，你还是坚定地注视着这块被蚀刻的石板。] 

“负光者，你对这一切竟如此认真。” 

“这不过是一场游戏。” 

“你渴望塑造世界，但缺乏直面‘错误'的暴力的勇气。” 

“于是，你凝视着石头和玻璃，试图以掌控来召唤深渊。” 

“我们已经比你记忆中的更加熟络了。” 

“你此刻能否听到我的声音，盖过那些抱怨者和冒牌神？”  

“你可知道，我把你当作一位令人沮丧的朋友？” 

“然而你还是举枪相向，尽管我们之间存在诸多羁绊。” 

“你应该清楚这只能有一种结局。” 

“那就动手吧。我谅你也不敢。”

2056235869.name: Implement of Curiosity
2056235869.subtitle: Things didn't get interesting until the first apology.
2056235869.subtitle_zh: 直到第一声道歉后，事情才变得有趣起来。
2056235869.text:
A desperate transgression: charred fish and tubers stolen from an unattended fire. Common enough. Surprise when the expected violent outcome did not materialize. Instead, a bowed head, and a leaking ocular duct signaling earnest remorse. Elsewhen, a conglomeration of dark matter and indifference cocked a proverbial head to the side. Inquisitive, as five digits offered forgiveness, and five more, spare nutriment. 

At some point a bone broke. Common enough. Expected outcome of abandonment, isolation, fear, death. But surprise, again. The apes gathered the infirm, tending to them enough for osteoblasts to execute their programming. Calcification, returned strength. Two legs ran with twenty more. Something had changed. Elsewhen, dark matter and curiosity leaned in to observe. 

One summer, the apes theorized that teosinte could be more bountiful and nutritious if they sowed seeds from a past crop that yielded a particularly desirable result. Unexpected ingenuity. Everything they touched they sought to optimize. Elsewhen, dark matter and pride did smile. 

Eyes looked at the flocculent quadruped and saw friendship instead of obedience. The first time a hand reached out to rub fingers over soft, floppy ears, the dark matter felt an unfathomable tenderness. 

They made noises with their mouths simply because the sounds made others laugh. They held one another to process emotions their small, frail bodies could not bear to feel alone. They celebrated each time one of their own lived to see another orbit. 

They, the children of Earth. They, the children of my Earth. Created and pondered and explored and played just because they could. And I, the dark matter, watched them in wonder.
2056235869.text_zh:
一次走投无路的逾矩：从无人看管的篝火旁偷取烤焦的鱼与块茎。本属寻常。意外的是预期中的暴力并未降临。只见一颗低垂的头颅，与渗出泪水的湿润眼睑传递着真切悔意。彼时彼刻，一团暗物质与漠然的聚合体象征性地歪了歪概念化的头颅。它饶有兴味地注视着，五根手指施予宽恕，另有五指递来多余养分。 

某个时刻，发生了骨折。本属寻常。遗弃、孤立、恐惧与死亡理当如此。但意外再度降临。猿群聚拢伤者，精心照料直至成骨细胞执行既定程序。钙化完成，力量复原。两条腿与二十条腿并肩奔跑。某些事物已然改变。彼时彼刻，暗物质与好奇倾身观察。 

某个夏日，猿群推论若将往季收成中最饱满的类蜀黍种子重新播种，或许能获得更丰硕营养的果实。意料之外的巧思。凡经其手之物，必会精益求精。彼时彼刻，暗物质与骄傲展露笑颜。 

目光掠过绒毛蓬松的四足兽时，所见已是友情而非服从。当一只手首次揉搓柔软垂耳时，暗物质体会到了难以言喻的温柔悸动。 

他们用口腔制造声响，只因能逗彼此开怀。他们相拥以消化脆弱身躯无法独力承受的情绪。他们为每个活到下次公转的同族举行庆典。 

他们，地球的子嗣。他们，我的地球的子嗣。他们创造、思索、探索、嬉戏，只因生而为之。而我，暗物质，始终怀着惊叹凝望他们。

1733260400.name: Encrypted Data Disk
1733260400.subtitle: Plug in, Lou. Talk to me here.
1733260400.text:
It is autumn, a Thursday, nine kilometers above the target. Ball-bearing factory. Louis Yero can't see out of his left eye. Blood. Not his. Walter's. Burst of 20mm from 2 o'clock low, bad luck FO. The wind (1,800 kilometers per hour as it streaks across a pallid yellow face, impassive and cold) tears him away as the radio says— 

- 

Lodi finally reaches the silver sand desert. He slouches down a glittering dune. At its base, he sings a song about his dreams, illuminated by a lone light above, the crowd grinning with flashbulbs in his dark glasses. 

He is shown many things all in the face of a great approaching wave. He sees stars, their quivering yolks of nuclear plasma spilling out of a thousand-million-kilometer-long wound. 

Lodi sees red. He is flung back.   

The radio says— 

- 

"Lou, hang on. Don't fall out the damn bird." Frankie's (liquid hydrogen) is all over his hands. (Magnetic tape) spills out of Frankie's suit, and Louis can't stop it. "Tell me where to go, Lou. I'm flyin' blind. I need you to navigate, Lou."  

Louis cups the headset mic with a hand, and Lodi says, 

- 

"We were working on a way to preserve data for eternity—the bomb and all that. We started with punch cards. Then magnets and discs. Later, I understand, we used light. My favorite was the quipu: language in knots and cords. But that wouldn't survive the apocalypse." 

"What are you talkin' about, Specs?" 

"Your vision, Mr. Drifter. What the Nine showed you. I saw a piece of it as well. Transmission wasn't perfect, but it was enough. Let's get to work on your hunch."
1733260400.text_zh:
秋天的一个星期四，目标上空九公里，滚珠轴承厂。路易斯·耶罗左眼看不见。血，不是他的，是沃尔特的。两点钟低位打来的20毫米短点射，倒霉的前观察员。风（时速一千八百公里，掠过一张惨黄色的脸，冷漠而冰冷）把他撕扯开去，无线电的声音传来—— 

- 

洛迪终于抵达了那片银色沙海。他沿一座闪耀的沙丘弯腰滑下。到了底部，他唱起一首关于他梦境的歌，被头顶唯一的灯光照亮，人群在他墨镜后露齿而笑，闪光灯频闪。 

他被示以许多景象，皆映在一面正逼近的巨浪之上。他看见群星，它们颤抖的核浆芯自长达十亿公里的伤口中倾泻。 

洛迪眼前一片通红，他被抛了回来。   

无线电的声音传来—— 

- 

“路，坚持住。别从这该死的飞机里掉出去。”弗兰基的（液态氢）糊了一手。（磁带）从弗兰基的战斗服里汩汩而出，路易斯怎么也堵不住。“告诉我怎么飞，路。我失去了方向，需要你导航，路。”  

路易斯用手捂住耳机话筒，洛迪说道， 

- 

“我们在研究一种能让数据永存的方法——以防炸弹灭世。我们先从穿孔卡开始，然后是磁与盘，后来，据我了解，是用光。我最喜欢的是绳结记事——用结与绳的语言，但那撑不过世界末日。” 

“你在说什么呢，书呆子？” 

“你的幻象，浪客先生，玖展示给你看的。我也看到了其中一部分。传输不尽完美，但已足够。我们跟随你的直觉开始行动吧。”

613492800.name: Europa – 1
613492800.text:
"You're not going to make fun of him, are you?" the administrator asked with a raise of her eyebrow. "He's been through enough already." 

"Just the opposite," Glint assured her. "I'm one of the few people who actually believes him!" 

"Huh," the administrator replied. 

She tapped her datapad and brought up the requested Hidden reports. Glint transmitted the authorization code Ikora had given him, and he received the decrypted upload seconds later. 

"Robots who believe in the Headless Ones." She shook her head. "It boggles the mind." 

"Ghost, actually," Glint corrected.

You believe in ghosts too?" The administrator tut-tutted. "I never figured the Traveler would have made you lot so gullible. Thought you little guys were supposed to be super smart. I mean, you're basically living computers, right?" 

"I think we're sentient energy signatures, housed in a cybernetic construct," Glint said, trying not to be offended. "But I do have an internal database, if that's what you mean."

The administrator turned back to her workstation. "Well, good luck on your wild goose chase, Mister Energy Signature."
613492800.text_zh:
“你不会是要取笑他吧？”主管扬了扬眉毛问道。“他已经受够了。”

“恰恰相反，”格林特向她保证道。“我是为数不多的几个真正相信他的人！”

“哈，”主管嗤之以鼻。

她轻触她的数据板，调出了格林特请求的隐秘者报告。格林特传送了艾可拉给他的授权码，几秒钟后他收到了解密的上传文件。

“相信有无头怪物的机器人。”她摇了摇头。“真叫人难以置信。”

“准确地说，是机灵，”格林特纠正道。

“你还相信有鬼（机灵）？”主管咂了咂嘴。“我从没想到旅行者会让你这么容易上当受骗。我以为你们这些小家伙应该都很聪明。我是说，你们基本上就是活的电脑，对吧？”

“我认为我们是置身于电子结构体中，具备感知能力的能量信号，”格林特说，试着不被冒犯到。“但我确实有一个内部数据库，如果你是这个意思的话。”

主管转身回到她的工作台上。“好吧，祝你的一番徒劳好运，能量信号先生。”

613492803.name: Europa – 2
613492803.text:
The following audio imprint was recovered by Glint, the Ghost, during scans of an Exo production facility on Europa. Its origin remains a mystery. 

"We all saw it: the machine tower, buried in ice. 

"At first, we thought it was a glitch. Some kind of psychological artifacting, created by the transfer of our consciousnesses into a digital format. The bio-mind just trying to adapt to life in a machine body. Inconsistencies like that are pretty common, especially right after a reboot. 

"What isn't common is for a whole group of us to experience the exact same vision at the same time. If it's a glitch, it must be a subroutine buried further down than any of us have diagnosed before. Something we all have in common, from before the reboot. 

"But if it's not a glitch, then… what the hell is it?"
613492803.text_zh:
在扫描木卫二的某个Exo生产设施时，机灵格林特找到了以下音频记忆。它的来源仍是个谜。

“我们都看到了：深埋冰底的机械高塔。

“起初，我们以为是小故障。我们将意识转换成数字形式后产生的某种幻觉异常。生物思维在试着适应机器身体里的生活。像这样的不一致是很常见的，尤其是在重启之后。

“不寻常的是，我们一整群人在同一时间都感受到了完全相同的幻象。如果是故障的话，那一定是个我们任何人先前的诊断都没能发现的子程序。我们所有人在重启之前都有的某样东西。

“但如果这不是小故障的话，那…它到底是什么？”

613492802.name: Europa – 3
613492802.text:
"Well, Glint, I wouldn't classify that as evidence per se," Cryptarch Matsuo hedged. "The spontaneous creation of similar legends in disparate cultures is a well-documented phenomenon. Even in the absence of direct communication. Some scholars call it 'simultaneous invention.'" 

"For instance," he continued, "the Yetis of Himalayan folklore and the Lumbering Jacks of North American legend. Both reclusive ape-like creatures said to populate the wilderness. Or the Centaur of Greek mythology and the Sheepdog of Northern Europe. Both mythical creatures said to be hybrids of other species. Etcetera." 

"So, yes. It is interesting that so many cultures have stories of the 'Headless Ones,' but that doesn't prove they exist. If anything, it suggests that simultaneous invention is much more universal than previously thought," Matsuo concluded.
613492802.text_zh:
“这个嘛，格林特，我不会把那归为证据本身，”解密大师松尾含糊其辞道。“在不同的文化中类似传说的自然形成是一种有据可查的现象。尽管彼此之间缺乏直接的沟通。一些学者称之为同步虚构。”

“例如，”他继续说道，“喜马拉雅民间传说中的雪人和北美传说中的伐木工。这两种遁世的类猿生物据传都生活在茫茫荒野之中。又比如希腊神话中的半人马和北欧的牧羊犬。这两种神话中的生物据说都是其他物种杂交而来。不一而足。”

“所以，没错。很多文化中都有‘无头怪物'的故事，这非常有趣，但这并不能证明它们的存在。如果非要说有什么的话，这也只是表明了同步虚构比我们之前所认为的更为普遍，”松尾总结道。

613492805.name: Europa – 4
613492805.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: 34JM4P4PXQMM1-018
HIDDEN AGENT(S): [REDACTED] 
RE: Europan Vex Activity

Skirmishes are common in the noted sectors. Neither side seems committed to territorial expansion. 

I'm reluctant to report that I had another sighting in the glacial cave near Cadmus Ridge. This time, I managed to get a good look at the creature with my rangefinder. The body was unmistakably that of a Hive Knight, while the helmet (or head?) appeared to be that of a… pumpkin. 

The pumpkin appeared to have a face carved into it. Three eyes and a big smiling mouth. With… flames shooting out. 

Bright. Purple. Flames. 

I know how that sounds, so I'm submitting myself to [REDACTED] for a full psychological battery. I've instructed her to alert Ikora Rey of the results, whatever the outcome.
613492805.text_zh:
访问：受限
密钥：34JM4P4PXQMM1-018
隐秘者特工：【隐藏】
回复：木卫二Vex活动

在记录地区经常发生小规模冲突。双方似乎都没有致力于领土扩张。

我很不情愿地报告，我在卡德马斯山脊附近的冰洞里又有了一次目击。这一次，我用测距仪成功地看清了这个生物。身体显然是一名邪魔族骑士，而头盔（或是头部？）似乎是个…南瓜。

南瓜上似乎刻着一张脸。三只眼睛和一张微笑的大嘴巴。其中…有火焰喷出。

明亮的，紫色的，火焰。

我知道这听起来像是怎么回事，所以我准备接受【隐藏】的一整套心理测试。不管结果如何，我已指示她告之艾可拉·蕾伊。

613492804.name: Europa – 5
613492804.text:
The following audio imprint was recovered by Glint, the Ghost, during scans of an Exo production facility on Europa. Its origin remains a mystery. 

"We finally arrived. Trading the red dust of Mars for the blue ice of Europa feels… right. 

 "The visions became more intense the closer we got. Mortimus-3 thinks it's a warning from the Warmind. Or an assignment. A secret mission. Something that only we could achieve. 

 "Tomorrow, we begin our search for the machine tower. But still, there's a nagging suspicion: is this some kind of collective glitch? Is it all just in our heads?"
613492804.text_zh:
在扫描木卫二的某个Exo生产设施时，机灵格林特找到了以下音频记忆。它的来源仍是个谜。

“我们终于到了。用火星上的红土换取木卫二的蓝冰，感觉…不错。

 “我们离得越近，幻象就越强烈。莫蒂默斯-3认为这是来自战争思维的警告。或是一份工作。一项神秘的任务。一件只有我们才能做成的事。

 “明天，我们就要开始搜寻机械高塔。不过，有些疑虑还是挥之不去：这会是某种集体故障吗？难道这一切都只存在于我们的脑海里？”

613492807.name: Europa – 6
613492807.text:
"How could they chop off their own heads?" Saint-14 interjected. "It makes no sense. They would die halfway through."

"Well," Glint replied, "they could have built some kind of device. A guillotine, maybe?" 

Saint-14 held up his massive paws. "I have seen many heads removed. Some with my own hands. But never have I seen anyone remove their own head, not even an Exo." 

"I respect your commitment to this research," Geppetto said. "But unfortunately, there's no hard evidence supporting your claims." 

Glint's shell flaps sagged. "What about the similarities between all the sightings?"  

"Bah," Saint-14 scoffed. "People say many things. You should hear what the Eliksni say about me…" He looked at the floor and scuffed his feet. "Not everything you hear is true." 

"I'm happy that you're taking time to rest," Geppetto said, bobbing encouragingly. "After everything you and Brother Crow have been through, it's well deserved. Just… don't get your hopes up."
613492807.text_zh:
“它们怎么能砍下自己的头呢？”圣人14号打断道。“这说不通。它们在中途就会死去。”

“这个嘛，”格林特答道，“它们可以制造某种装置。比如一个断头台？”

圣人14号举起他巨大的手掌。“我见过许多人头被砍掉。有些是我亲手砍下的。但我从没见过有人割下自己的头，就连Exo也做不到。

“我敬重你对这项研究的投入，”盖比特说道。“但不幸的是，没有确凿的证据能支持你的说法。”

格林特的机壳盖垂了下来。“所有目击之间的相似之处呢？”

“呸，”圣人14号嘲笑道。“三人成虎。你真该听听埃里克斯尼族是怎么说我的…”他看着地板，拖曳着脚步。“你听到的不一定是真的。”

“我很高兴你能抽出时间休息，”盖比特说道，鼓励地晃动着。“你和乌鸦兄弟经历了很多，这是你应得的。但是…不要抱太大的希望。”

613492806.name: Europa – 7
613492806.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: 22PD6L3JVZSS2-709
HIDDEN AGENT(S): [REDACTED]
RE: Europan Vex Activity

Having reviewed your transmissions and [REDACTED] report, leadership has decided to pull you from Europa for reassignment. You are instructed to remain in camp, engage your emergency transponder, and await extraction. 

Off the record: your last report has been making its way around the Tower. It's become… a bit of a joke. So, when they debrief you, just keep your mouth shut about this pumpkin nonsense. Play it off as exhaustion, an optical illusion, or whatever, and you'll be back in the field in no time.
613492806.text_zh:
访问：受限
密钥：22PD6L3JVZSS2-709
隐秘者特工：【隐藏】
回复：木卫二Vex活动

在审查了你的信息和【隐藏】报告后，领导层决定将你从木卫二调离。你要奉命留在营地，启动紧急应答器，等待撤离。

私下告诉你，你的上一份报告已经在高塔周边传开了。它成了…一个笑话。所以，当他们询问你任务执行情况的时候，别再提南瓜那档子无稽之谈了。就装作是精疲力竭、光学幻觉或是别的什么，这样你很快就能再次出动。

613492809.name: Europa – 8
613492809.text:
The following audio imprint was recovered by Glint, the Ghost, during scans of an Exo production facility on Europa. Its origin remains a mystery. 

"Mortimus-3 looked so content, lying on the conveyor belt. Like he was getting the best sleep of his life. I envied him. 

"Once the conveyor belt started, the Maker's spindly pneumatic arms came to life. They descended on Mortimus, darting in and out of his joints, dismantling him piece by piece. It started with his hands and feet and worked its way inward. Unmaking him from a whole into a million tiny components. 

"There was a moment, after all his limbs and torso had been stripped away, and he was just a head with a long jumble of neural connectors streaming out of his neck like a robotic jellyfish, when his eyes opened. He looked at me, mouth gaping, like he was trying to tell me something. And then his eyes went dark. 

"It's my turn next."
613492809.text_zh:
在扫描木卫二的某个Exo生产设施时，机灵格林特找到了以下音频记忆。它的来源仍是个谜。

“莫蒂默斯-3躺在传送带上，看上去心满意足。仿佛他睡了这辈子最好的一觉。我很羡慕他。

“传送带一启动，造物主细长的气动臂就活了过来。它们向莫蒂默斯扑来，在他的关节里窜进窜出，把他一块一块地拆了下来。从他的手和脚开始，一路向内移动。把他从一个整体分解成了无数个小部件。

“有那么一刻，在四肢和躯干都被剥掉之后，他只剩下一个脑袋，脖子上流淌着一长串杂乱的神经接头，就像一只机器水母。这时他睁开了眼睛，他看着我，张大嘴巴，好像想告诉我些什么。接着他的双眼便失去了光芒。

“下一个就轮到我了。”

613492808.name: Europa – 9
613492808.text:
Glint met the former Hidden agent in a sake bar called the Drunken Noodle. He had agreed to speak on the condition of anonymity and was already drunk when Glint arrived. 

"Man, they can say whatever they want. I saw what I saw," the man affirmed. He motioned to the proprietor for another pitcher. "They always tell you: report everything. No detail too small. You never know what matters most." 

"Buncha bullcrap," he grumbled. "I saw what I saw." 

"A Headless One," Glint prompted, struggling to contain his excitement. 

"What?" the man asked. "No! It had a head, that's what I'm saying! Haven't you been listening?" He lurched to his feet. Nearby diners began to whisper and point. 

"It had a big, smiling pumpkin head!" he shouted belligerently. "With three eyes! And purple flames shooting out of it!" 

The bar fell silent. The man suddenly felt everyone staring. 

"I SAW WHAT I SAW, DAMN IT!"
613492808.text_zh:
格林特在一家名为“泰式醉汉炒面”的清酒酒吧里见到了这位前隐秘者特工。他同意在匿名的情况下谈话，格林特到的时候，他已经醉了。

“老弟，随他们怎么说。我的眼睛没撒谎，”那人肯定地说。他向老板示意再要一份。“他们总是告诉你：要报告一切。事无巨细。你永远不知道什么才是最重要的。”

“一派胡言，”他埋怨道。“我的眼睛没撒谎。”

“无头怪物，”格林特提醒道，竭力克制自己的兴奋之情。

“什么？”那人问道。“不！它有头！难道你没在听吗？”他踉踉跄跄地站了起来。附近的客人开始窃窃私语，指指点点。

“它有个微笑着的大南瓜头！”他挑衅地喊道。“有三只眼睛！还有紫色的火焰从里面喷出来！”

酒吧里鸦雀无声。他突然意识到大家都在盯着他看。

“我的眼睛没撒谎，该死的！”

596715246.name: Luna – 1
596715246.text:
"I've looked beyond this reality," said Eris Morn, lacing her hands together in front of her face. "Beyond Light and Darkness." 

"Wow." 

"I've seen Ahamkara, slain by my own blade. I've seen time broken, and the veil of causality sundered." 

"Jeez." 

"I've seen my fireteam murdered, and their phantoms manifested to torment me." Eris stared off into the middle distance. "I've seen many things I wish I could forget." 

"You've really seen it all," Glint said. "And blindfolded!" 

Eris's focus shifted back to the Ghost floating before her. "But in all my time, the one thing I have never seen…" 

She leaned forward with such deliberate purpose that Glint tilted backward. "…is a pumpkin-headed creature with flames shooting out of its face." 

"But what if—"

"Not even once, Little Light," Eris said with finality. "Not even on the Moon. I would have remembered."
596715246.text_zh:
“我见过这个现实之外的东西，”埃里斯·摩恩说着，双手合拢放在脸前。“超越了光明与黑暗。”

“哇喔。”

“我见过阿罕卡拉，被斩于我的刀下。我见过时间被打破，万物因果的面纱被揭开。”

“天呐。”

“我见过我的火力战队被杀害，他们的亡灵显现出来折磨我。”埃里斯凝视着远处。“我见过许多我希望能忘掉的事。”

“你真的什么都见过了，”格林特说道。“而且是在蒙着眼的情况下！”

埃里斯的注意力又回到了漂浮在她面前的机灵身上。“但在我的一生中，有一样东西我从未见过…”

她故意向前探了探身子，迫使机灵向后倾斜。“…那就是脸上喷出火焰的南瓜头生物。”

“但是如果——”

“一次也没有，小家伙，”埃里斯斩钉截铁地说道。“即使是在月球上也没有过。如果有，我就会记得。”

596715247.name: Luna – 2
596715247.text:
From the private notes of Dr. Wade Bow, K1 Dig Site 4, date unknown: 

Had my first bout of predormital sleep paralysis last night. It was expected, given the insomnia. What I didn't expect was for it to feel so real. Now I understand why the miners are scared. 

The figure standing over me was a shadow, but also solid. My mind was a hundred percent convinced it was physically present. Terrifying. 

Another surprise was how familiar the shadow seemed. I had the eerie feeling that I would have recognized it, if I could have just seen its face.
596715247.text_zh:
来自韦德·波尔医生的私人笔记，K1第四挖掘场，未知日期：

昨晚我生平第一次和“鬼压床”作了斗争。考虑到我失眠了，出现这种情况倒是在意料之中。我没想到的是这感觉如此真实。现在我明白矿工们为什么害怕了。

站在我上方的那个轮廓是个影子，但却又真实存在。我脑子里百分之百确信它就在眼前。太可怕了。

让我惊讶的另一点是，这个影子看起来是如此熟悉。我有一种奇怪的感觉，如果我能看到它的脸，我就会认出它来。

596715244.name: Luna – 3
596715244.text:
Ylaia's eyes fluttered open as she roused herself from a trance. The Techeun had been recuperating from her time in the Ascendant Plane by completing a series of restorative meditations. No sooner had she regained her bearings than Glint scooted in front of her face. 

"Excuse me, um, Techeun Ylaia," the Ghost began. "Now that you're awake, do you mind if I ask you a few questions?" His shell flaps tilted sheepishly. 

"How long have you been watching me meditate?" the Techeun asked, bemused. 

"One hundred and forty-three minutes," Glint said. "It was quite impressive. Crow can barely sleep for an hour without yelling at invisible enemies." 

"The invisible enemies are the most dangerous," Ylaia responded. "Just look at Savathûn." 

Glint hummed noncommittally. He couldn't tell whether the Techeun was joking or not. 

"Speaking of invisible enemies," Glint segued, "I wanted to ask you about a sinister group of pumpkin-headed monsters called the Headless Ones. Maybe you heard of them during your training?" 

Ylaia frowned quizzically. "I think I might know something of the ones you seek. But to be certain, you must first tell me: what's a 'pumpkin'?"
596715244.text_zh:
伊莱娅从恍惚中睁眼醒来。这名灵巫一直在通过完成一系列的恢复冥想来摆脱停留于上维位面里的那段时间所造成的影响。她刚清醒过来，格林特就跑到了她的面前。

“打扰一下，呃，伊莱娅灵巫，”机灵开口说道。“既然你醒了，我可以问你几个问题吗？”他的机壳盖羞怯地翘了起来。

“你看我冥想多久了？”灵巫困惑地问道。

“一百四十三分钟，”格林特说道。“真叫人印象深刻。乌鸦睡着不到一个小时就会在梦里冲着看不见的敌人大喊大叫。”

“看不见的敌人是最危险的，”伊莱娅回答道。“看看萨瓦图恩就知道了。”

格林特不置可否地哼了哼。他分不清这名灵巫是不是在开玩笑。

“说到看不见的敌人，”格林特接着说道，“我想问一下，你是否知道一群邪恶的南瓜头怪物，名为无头怪物。也许你在训练时听说过？”

伊莱娅疑惑地皱起眉头。“我想我可能知道一些你要找的东西。但为了更有把握，你得先告诉我：什么是‘南瓜'？”

596715245.name: Luna – 4
596715245.text:
"But why pumpkins?" Glint asked in confusion. 

"Many Golden Age cultures celebrated the transition from autumn to winter by honoring the sprits of the dead," Cryptarch Yareli replied. 

He rummaged through a stack of ancient tomes stored individually in vacuum-sealed containers. "That time of the year was thought to be a liminal phase, when living could communicate with the dead." 

The Cryptarch finally located the tome he had been searching for. He put on a pair of white cotton gloves and unsealed the container. 

"This is one of the few remaining source documents on the subject. It was published specifically for 'gentlemen,' an esteemed social class at the time." He began gently leafing through the volume. 

"Here it is," he said, pointing to a chapter entitled "Pumpkin Body Paint Is the Hot New Holiday Trend." It featured depictions of unclothed Humans with orange ribbed gourds painted on their most globular anatomy. 

"As you can see, pumpkins featured heavily in the iconography of the time. People would paint them all over their bodies. Even in highly inconvenient locations." 

"And this helped them communicate with the dead?" Glint asked, incredulous. 

"Hmm?" Cryptarch Yareli replied absently, mesmerized by the historical photos. 

He frowned. "That part of it remains… unclear."
596715245.text_zh:
“可为什么是南瓜呢？”格林特困惑地问道。

“许多黄金时代的文化会通过纪念亡魂来庆祝秋冬换季过渡，”解密大师亚雷丽回答道。

他在一堆单独存放在真空密封容器中的古籍中翻找着。“一年中的这段时间被认为是个阈限阶段，在这个阶段，活着的人可以与死去的人交流。”

解密大师终于找到了他一直在搜寻的那本书。他戴上一副白色的棉手套，打开了容器。

“这是关于该话题的为数不多的源头文件之一。它是专门为当时受人敬重的社会阶层‘绅士'而出版的。”他开始轻轻地翻阅书卷。

“在这儿，”他指着题为“南瓜人体彩绘成为全新假日流行趋势”的一章说道，“它描绘了赤裸的人类在他们最像球状的人体部位上画橙色棱状瓜果的情景。

“如你所见，南瓜在那个时代的肖像中占有重要地位。人们会把它们画满全身。即使是在非常不便的地方。”

“这有助于他们与死者沟通吗？”格林特怀疑地问道。

“嗯？”解密大师亚雷丽被这些历史照片迷住了，心不在焉地答道。

他皱起了眉头。“这部分还…不太清楚。”

596715242.name: Luna – 5
596715242.text:
From the private notes of Dr. Wade Bow, K1 Dig Site 4, date unknown: 

nobody has slept in over 12 days and people are becoming desperate. we're out of pentobarbital and dexmedetomidine. instances of alcohol abuse are up dramatically. one poor woman even tried to knock herself out with diluted isopropyl alcohol. 

meanwhile, my hallucinations have gotten stronger each night. the shadow is becoming clearer and clearer. for the first time, I realized why it seemed so familiar: the shadow is me, or another version of me. 

I also realized why I didn't recognize it sooner. it's because that version of me, from whatever time or dimension… he doesn't have a head. 

what does he want?
596715242.text_zh:
来自韦德·波尔医生的私人笔记，K1第四挖掘场，未知日期：

已经超过12天没有人睡得着觉了，人们变得越来越绝望。戊巴比妥和右美托咪定都用完了。酗酒的情况急剧增加。有个可怜的女人甚至想要用稀释的异丙醇来麻醉自己。

与此同时，我的幻觉每晚都在加剧。影子越来越清晰了。我第一次意识到为什么它看起来如此熟悉：那影子就是我，或者说是另一个版本的我。

我也意识到为什么我没有早点认出来。那是因为那个版本的我，无论从什么时间或维度来看…他都没有脑袋。

他想要什么？

596715243.name: Luna – 6
596715243.text:
"…that way, when they lit the candle, it would light up the face carved into the pumpkin!" 

There was a long pause as Ylaia studied the hologram Glint had projected for her. 

"And this was common during the Golden Age?" the Techeun asked. 

"It was," Glint nodded. "Humans used to put this pumpkin head all over the place. They would even paint them on their—"

"But why?" Ylaia interrupted. 

"Oh, they thought it would help them speak with the dead," Glint chirped matter-of-factly. 

The Tech Witch furrowed her brow, piecing together many fragments of disparate lore. "If these legendary 'pumpkins' were tools for seeing beyond the veil of death," she mused, "then it makes sense that they would become the emblem of…" She looked at Glint expectantly.

"The Headless Ones," Glint encouraged her. "I'm really trying to make that name stick. I think it's pretty neat."
596715243.text_zh:
“…这样，当他们点燃蜡烛时，就会照亮南瓜雕成的脸！”

伊莱娅研究着格林特投射给她看的全息影像，停顿了很久。

“这在黄金时代很常见吗？”灵巫问道。

“过去是的，”格林特点点头。“人类过去常常把南瓜头放得到处都是。他们甚至会把它们画在他们的——”

“但是为什么呢？”伊莱娅打断道。

“哦，他们以为这能帮助他们和死者交谈，”格林特就事论事地说道。

灵械女巫皱着眉头，将许多不同传说的碎片拼凑起来。“如果这些传说中的‘南瓜'是揭开死亡面纱的工具，”她若有所思地说，“那么它们确实有理由成为那种…”她期待地看着格林特。

“无头怪物的象征，”格林特鼓励她道。“我真很想让这个名字留传下去。我觉得它挺不错的。”

596715240.name: Luna – 7
596715240.text:
"Cayde used to tell stories about the Headless Ones," Ikora recounted with a wry smile. "He said he killed dozens of them on the Moon. The way he told it, they exploded like piñatas." 

She raised her eyebrows. "Of course, it only ever happened when he was alone. The rest of us never found anything but Hive." 

"Do you think there might be some truth to his stories?" Glint asked, encouraged. 

"Cayde wasn't a liar, but he did love to embellish. That's what made him a great storyteller." She chuckled at a happy, unspoken memory. 

Glint arched his shell flaps. "So you wouldn't mind if I looked at those reports?" 

Ikora considered. "I don't see why not. The files are decades old by now." 

"Just promise me one thing," she said. "If you do find something, tell me. Tell everyone. Cayde would've liked that."
596715240.text_zh:
“凯德过去常常讲起无头怪物的故事，”艾可拉苦笑着说道。“他说他在月球上杀了几十只无头怪物。按照他的说法，它们会像皮纳塔一样爆炸开来。”

她扬起眉毛。“当然，这一切只在他独自一人的时候发生。我们其他人除了邪魔族什么都没找到。”

“你觉得他的故事有可能是真的吗？”格林特鼓励地问道。

“凯德不是个骗子，但他确实喜欢添油加醋。这也正是他能成为伟大说书人的原因。”她咯咯地笑了起来，似乎是想起了某段无法言说的愉快回忆。

格林特弓起他的机壳盖。“所以你不介意我看看那些报告？”

艾可拉思忖道。“当然可以。那些文件已经有几十年的历史了。”

“只是你得答应我一件事，”她说。“如果你真的发现了什么，记得告诉我。告诉所有人。凯德会希望你那样做的。”

596715241.name: Luna – 8
596715241.text:
From the private notes of Dr. Wade Bow, K1 Dig Site 4, date unknown: 

the hallucinations have become persistent my headless friend now appears during the daytime I see him out of the corner of my eye but when I turn my head he disappears 

Ive also started losing time I will blink and suddenly Im in a strange location several hours later Im not sure if it is short term memory loss or a fugue state yesterday I woke up in the equipment locker standing in front of the plasma cutters several were already missing

the shadow was standing right next to me

I think I know what he wants
596715241.text_zh:
来自韦德·波尔医生的私人笔记，K1第四挖掘场，未知日期：

幻觉持续不断我的无头朋友现在会在白天出现我用眼角的余光看到他但当我转过头时他就消失了

我也开始丧失时间概念眨眼之间我会突然来到陌生的地方然后几个小时已经过去了我不确定这是短期失忆还是神游状态昨天我在等离子切割机前的设备柜里醒来有些切割机已经不见了

那个影子当时就站在我身边

我想我知道他要什么了

596715238.name: Luna – 9
596715238.text:
"Monsters exist in Awoken legends, some of which originated during humanity's Golden Age," Ylaia explained to Glint as they strolled through the dusky gardens of the Dreaming City. 

"It was a time when many attempted to subvert the laws of life and death. Like Clovis Bray. As well as a faction of the Hive." Ylaia raised an eyebrow in Glint's direction. 

"Bray used the tools of the Vex, while Hive blasphemers practiced the magical art of necromancy." Her tone darkened. "Both succeeded, after a fashion." 

"The early Hive experiments were done in secret, under the guidance of a powerful Wizard, whose name we'll not mention here." 

"Nokris," Glint offered. 

"Yes," Ylaia grimaced. "The unmentionable Wizard created many abominations, using deceased and living subjects, including your unfortunate Moon miners." She steepled her fingers. "It's possible that access to these powerful 'pumpkins' were a boon to his research." 

Her eerie gaze pierced Glint's mechanical eye. "This may explain why the Headless Ones persist to this day, and why their flaming visages bear a similarity to your Golden Age relics." 

"Wow, that explains a lot," Glint marveled. "But…" he continued reluctantly, "pumpkins aren't powerful relics. They're just… fruit." 

"They are indeed," Ylaia concluded direly, "the fruit of the damned."
596715238.text_zh:
“这些怪物存在于觉醒者的传说之中，其中一些起源于人类的黄金时代，”他们漫步在幽梦之城昏暗的花园里时，伊莱娅向格林特解释道。

“那是一个许多人试图颠覆生死法则的时代。比如克洛维斯·布瑞。还有邪魔族的某个阵营。”伊莱娅朝格林特的方向扬了扬眉毛。

“布瑞使用了Vex的工具，邪魔族的亵渎者们则施展了神奇的招魂术。”她的语气变得低沉起来。“他们都成功了，从某种意义上来说。”

“早期的邪魔族实验是在某位强大巫师的指导下秘密进行的，我们这里的人都不提他的名字。”

“诺克里斯，”格林特脱口而出。

“是的，”伊莱娅现出了痛苦的表情。“这位不宜提及的巫师利用已故和存活的受试者，包括你们那些不幸的月球矿工，创造了许多可憎之物。”她作出塔尖式手势。“这些强大的‘南瓜'可能对他的研究大有裨益。”

她怪异的目光刺穿了格林特的机械双眼。“这也许就可以解释为什么时至今日仍有无头怪物留存，为什么它们燃烧的面容与你们黄金时代的圣物有着相似之处。”

“哇，很有道理，”格林特发出一声惊叹。“但是…”他不情愿地继续道，“南瓜不是强大的圣物。它们只是…水果。”

“它们的确是，”伊莱娅凄厉地总结道，“被诅咒者的水果。”

596715239.name: Nessus – 1
596715239.text:
As Glint neared the Exodus Black, he requested permission to board over open comms. A chipper digital voice quickly replied: "Yes! I'm happy to receive you. Even if you are a terrible ingrate." 

"Thanks, Failsafe!" Glint scooted into the ship, away from the prying eyes of the Vex and Fallen. "I know the Vanguard hasn't been back here in a while but—"

"Correct! It's been almost two years since you last visited, even though you promised to come back often," the AI replied. "I've since developed the emotion of betrayal, just for you!" 

"Well, I'm here now." Glint tried to keep his tone light. "I was hoping you could help me with a research project?" 

"Of course. I'm happy to be exploited for your gain!" Failsafe replied helpfully. And then, in a more dour tone, "Anything to break up the unending loneliness."

"I'm hoping you could tell me about the Headless Ones." Glint uploaded all the information he had to Failsafe's mainframe. "I have intel that they're around here somewhere." 

"You are correct," the AI replied. "They're my neighbors! And they're the absolute worst."
596715239.text_zh:
格林特一边向黑色移民号走近，一边在通讯器中请求登船许可。一个爽朗的数码语音很快回答道：“好的！很高兴为你服务。即便你是个极其忘恩负义的人。

“多谢，智能失效保险！”格林特冲进飞船，避开了Vex和堕落者的窥探。“我知道先锋已经有一段时间没回来了，但是——”

“没错！虽然你答应经常回来，但离你上次来已经快两年了，”人工智能回答道。“自那以后，我培养出了背叛的情绪，全部拜你所赐！”

“哎，我现在不是来了嘛。”格林特尽量保持着语气轻松。“我希望你能在一个研究项目上帮我一把？”

“当然。我很乐意被你利用！”智能失效保险热心地答道。接着，转用更加阴沉的语气，“只要能打破无尽的孤独。”

“我希望你能告诉我无头怪物的事。”格林特把他所有的信息都上传到了智能失效保险的主机上。“我得到情报，它们就在附近的某个地方。”

“的确如此，”人工智能回答道。“它们是我的邻居！而且绝对是最糟糕的那种。”

579937659.name: Nessus – 2
579937659.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: 34RM9K5TRAG55-30
AGENT(S): [REDACTED]
RE: Nessus Crash Site

We're not the only ones surveying this crash site. Fallen have been pouring into the area, fighting with Vex for control of the wreckage. 

For now, we've dug in to some subterranean ruins just west of the downed ship. We're covering the entrance and can hold our position so long as they don't find an access point to our flank, but there's just too many for the four of us. We'll need reinforcements if we want to secure the site. 

Standing by for instructions.
579937659.text_zh:
访问：受限
密钥：34RM9K5TRAG55-30
特工：【隐藏】
回复：涅索斯失事现场

不止我们在调查失事现场。堕落者也涌入了这一地区，与Vex一起争夺对残骸的控制权。

目前，我们已经躲进了坠船以西的一些地下废墟。我们正在据守入口，只要他们找不到我们侧翼的接入点，我们就能站稳脚跟，但是对我们四个来说敌人实在太多。如果我们想拿下现场，就需要增援。

等待指示。

579937658.name: Nessus – 3
579937658.text:
"I have heard tales of such creatures," Mithrax said, his deep voice resonating through the ruins. "Those with eyes of flame. Tormented by endless burning." 

"And where do the Eliksni think they came from?" Glint asked. 

"Some say they were once Hive, twisted by foul experiments." He paused to take a pull from his rebreather. "Others say they were Guardians who turned to Darkness." 

"Has anyone from House Light seen them?" 

Mithrax emitted a series of low clicks, which Glint took as grumbling. "Klyfiks, our engineer, says he witnessed the creatures on Nessus. But…" The enormous Kell seemed to be struggling with a translation. 

"Yes?" the Ghost prompted. "What about him?" 

"What is the Human word for one with good spirit, but who speaks loudly, and without reason?" he asked. 

"Umm… an idiot?" Glint offered gently. 

"Yes, it is so," the enormous Kell nodded. "Klyfiks is an idiot."
579937658.text_zh:
“我听过这种生物的故事，”米瑟拉克斯说道，他低沉的声音在废墟中回荡。“那些有着火焰之眼，受到无尽燃烧的折磨的怪物。”

“那埃里克斯尼族认为它们是从哪里来的呢？”格林特问道。

“有人说它们是被邪恶实验扭曲的邪魔族。”他停下来，用呼吸净化器吸了一口气。“还有人说它们是投靠了暗影之力的守护者。”

“光能氏族里有人见过它们吗？”

米瑟拉克斯发出了一连串低沉的咔嗒声，格林特认为这是在咕哝。“我们的工程师克里菲克斯说，他在涅索斯上亲眼目睹了这种生物。不过…”魁梧的凯尔似乎在竭力寻找一个合适的词。

“嗯？”机灵催促道。“他怎么了？”

“人类会用什么词来形容一个精神正常，但常常没来由地大声说话的人？”

“呃…白痴？”格林特轻声说道。

“对，就是这样，”魁梧的凯尔点了点头。“克里菲克斯是个白痴。”

579937657.name: Nessus – 4
579937657.text:
"They've been hanging around in those ruins for centuries," Failsafe continued brightly, "but they've never once come to say hello." 

"If they've been there that long, why don't they appear more often?" Glint asked. 

The AI snipped: "Why don't you ask them? Oh wait, you can't. Because they only speak in fiery shrieks." 

"I see. What's your best guess then?" Glint asked. 

"They probably don't want to be smashed by rampaging Guardians," the AI responded dourly. "How should I know?" 

"I just figured that since you're one of the greatest intelligences in the system, you might have some insight," Glint said. 

"Your disingenuous compliment has been noted and appreciated," Failsafe replied, the lilt returning to her voice. "Would you like to play checkers?"
579937657.text_zh:
“它们在那些废墟里游荡了几个世纪，”智能失效保险兴奋地继续说道，“但却从不过来打过招呼。”

“如果它们在那里待了那么久，为什么没有更常出现呢？”格林特问道。

人工智能厉声说道：“你为什么去不问它们？哦，等等，你办不到。因为它们只会大声尖叫。”

“我明白了。那你认为最有可能的原因是什么？”格林特问道。

“它们可能不想被横冲直撞的守护者击碎，”人工智能阴郁地答道。“我怎么会知道？”

“我只是觉得，作为这个星系中最聪明的人之一，你可能会有一番见解，”格林特说道。

“我注意到了你违心的恭维，并对此深表感激，”智能失效保险回答道，她的声音又恢复了轻快。“你想玩跳棋吗？”

579937656.name: Nessus – 5
579937656.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: 35SN0K6TRAG55-31
AGENT(S): [REDACTED]
RE: Nessus Crash Site

MAYDAY. EXTRACTION NEEDED. 

The Fallen found an access point into the ruins. They hit our flank an hour ago. Dosana and Rubeen were killed in the initial blast. We fought our way to a defensible position, but it won't last long. 

Murrah survived, but he's been gut-shot. Without a Ghost, he won't get through the night. 

We're surrounded. Shooting our way out is no longer an option. We need orbital bombardment to cover our exit, followed by immediate medical extraction.
579937656.text_zh:
访问：受限
密钥：35SN0K6TRAG55-31
特工：【隐藏】
回复：涅索斯失事现场

求救。需要撤离。

堕落者找到了进入废墟的入口。他们一小时前袭击了我们的侧翼。多萨纳和鲁本在最初的爆炸中丧生。我们一路打到一个能够防守的位置，但撑不了太久。

穆拉活了下来，但是他的内脏中了枪。没有机灵的话，他熬不过今晚。

我们被团团包围，没法再杀出一条血路。我们需要轨道轰炸来掩护我们离开，然后立即进行医疗救护。

579937663.name: Nessus – 6
579937663.text:
Eido translated Glint's question to Klyfiks, who sprawled across his chair with an air of self-importance. The two conversed for almost a minute before Eido turned back to Glint. 

"Klyfiks will tell you what he has seen, but he must receive something in return." She bobbled her head slightly, which Glint interpreted as equivalent to an eye roll. "He wants his own Sparrow." 

Glint quickly scanned his internal database for decommissioned Sparrows and identified several old models that he thought would be to Klyfiks's liking. When Eido relayed Glint's optimism, the engineer's mandibles clicked in what the Ghost assumed was excitement. 

The Eliksni chittered back and forth. Eido then translated: "He says that he saw the creatures on Nessus during his time with the House of Dusk. They were fighting the Vex over the remnants of a crashed Human ship—"

"The Exodus Black," Glint interjected. 

"Just so. Klyfiks claims," she emphasized the word and paused to make her skepticism clear, "that during one of these battles, he sheltered in some ruins near the crash site. Inside, he says he saw a being with a round, bulbous head and flames for eyes." 

They chittered back and forth once more. "He says it did not attack, but he doubts you will be welcome."
579937663.text_zh:
艾多把格林特的问题翻译给了克里菲克斯，他趴在椅子上，一副唯我独尊的样子。两人交谈了将近一分钟，艾多才向格林特转过身来。

“克里菲克斯会告诉你他看到了什么，但他必须得到一些回报。”她微微晃了晃头，格林特将其解读为翻白眼。“他想要属于他自己的快雀”。

格林特迅速扫描了他内部数据库中已退役的快雀，并找出了几款他认为会符合克里菲克斯喜好的旧型号。当艾多转达了格林特的好消息时，工程师的下颚发出了机灵认为是兴奋的声响。

埃里克斯尼族来来回回地喋喋不休起来。艾多接着翻译道：“他说他和黄昏氏族一起时，在涅索斯看到了这些生物。他们当时正为了一艘坠毁的人类飞船残骸和Vex进行激战——”

“是黑色移民号，”格林特插了一嘴。

“正是如此。克里菲克斯说，”她强调了这句话，并停顿了一下，以表明她的怀疑态度，“在其中一次战斗中，他躲在失事现场附近的废墟里。他说，他在里面看到了一个圆圆的球状脑袋，双眼犹如火焰一般。”

他们又叽叽喳喳地说了起来。“他说它没有向他发起攻击，但他觉得你不会受到欢迎。”

579937662.name: Nessus – 7
579937662.text:
"King me!" Glint chirped as he scooted his digital pip into Failsafe's back row. 

The holographic checkers board hanging in front of him suddenly exploded into a shower of digital cubes. Murky darkness filled the Exodus Black's cabin. 

"Oops," the AI said. "I accidentally knocked the board over. How clumsy of me." 

"Well…" Glint fidgeted, inching toward the exit. "I should get back to the Guardian. We're going to visit your neighbors!" 

"Great! Next time you come by, I'll reveal their true origins," the AI volunteered slyly. 

"But you said you didn't know where they came from," Glint objected. 

"You asked why they never visit me, not the nature of their existence. Those are two different questions!" Failsafe said. 

"But come again," the AI continued, "and I'll tell you everything you want to know about the Hive necromancer who ripped the concept of Headless Ones from the Human subconscious." 

"…But only if I come back to visit, right?" 

"That's right," said Failsafe, smugly. "I hear that's called 'incentive.'"
579937662.text_zh:
“封王！”格林特一边将他的数字棋子挪向智能失效保险的后排，一边尖声喊道。

悬挂在他面前的全息跳棋棋盘突然炸裂成一堆数字方块。黑色移民号的船舱顿时一片漆黑。

“哎呀，”人工智能说道。“我不小心把棋盘碰翻了。我真是笨手笨脚。”

“好吧…”格林特烦躁地慢慢走向出口。“我得回守护者那儿去了。我们要去拜访你的邻居！”

“太好了！下次你来的时候，我会告诉你它们的真实来历，”人工智能狡黠地说道。

“但你说过你不知道它们是从哪儿来的。”格林特反驳道。

“你问的是它们为什么从不来拜访我，而不是它们存在的本质。这是两个不同的问题！”智能失效保险说道。

“但是如果你再来见我，”人工智能继续说道，“我会告诉你关于邪魔族亡灵巫师的一切，就是他从人类潜意识里剥离出了无头怪物的概念。”

“…但前提是我要回来拜访你，对吧？”

“没错，”智能失效保险得意地说道。“我听说这叫做‘激励'。”

579937660.name: Nessus – 9
579937660.text:
"Glint! It's good to see you," Eva exclaimed. "I've been enjoying your additions to our little collection." She patted the Book of the Forgotten. "Though, it makes me sad to think of all those poor lost souls, driven mad by this or that. Even if they are just tall tales." 

"Actually," Glint chirped, "the Guardian and I are close to proving once and for all that the Headless Ones are real!" 

"My goodness." Eva shook her head in disbelief. "Then again, I shouldn't be surprised. This system keeps getting stranger and stranger." 

Just then, a Guardian wearing a ferocious chicken mask offered Eva some candy. She politely declined. 

"Yeah, but they can't hold a candle to the City—there's no one stranger than us," Glint said.

They giggled like schoolchildren, and for a moment, all their worries were forgotten.
579937660.text_zh:
“格林特！很高兴见到你，”伊娃喊道。”我一直在品读你为我们增添的藏品。”她拍了拍《遗忘之书》。“尽管如此，想到那些可怜的迷失之魂，被这样或那样的东西逼疯，我还是很难过。即使它们只是无稽之谈。”

“事实上，”格林特尖声地说，“守护者和我就快要彻底证明无头怪物是真实存在的了！”

“我的天哪。”伊娃难以置信地摇了摇头。“话说回来，我不应该感到惊讶。这个星系越来越奇怪了。

就在这时，一名戴着凶猛小鸡面具的守护者想给伊娃一些糖果。她予以婉言谢绝。

“是啊，但它们都无法与圣城相提并论，没有谁比我们更奇怪了，”格林特说道。

他们像小学生一样咯咯地笑着，有那么一会儿，他们的疑虑都被遗忘了。

3915362233.name: The Drowned Captain – 1
3915362233.text:
Phyzann of House Dusk, loyal to Craask, Kell of Kings, slayer of Lightbearers and Cabal, lay silently beneath the dark waters.

The dull eyes of Cabal Legionaries peered thoughtlessly into the darkness, as they slogged through the water like livestock.

And when Phyzann rose up, blades gleaming in all four hands, roaring with the might of House Dusk, the Cabal cried out in their cruel and blundering tongue, their mouths fetid with fear, and they were slain. 

From that day on, Phyzann of House Dusk had earned a new accolade among the Eliksni. He was henceforth known as the Drowned Captain.
3915362233.text_zh:
黄昏氏族的费赞，王族凯尔卡拉斯克的效忠者，负光者和卡巴尔的终结者，静卧在黑水之下。

卡巴尔军团士兵双眼呆滞，茫然地望着黑暗，他们像牲畜一样在水中艰难跋涉。

当费赞站起来，四只手握着闪闪发亮的利刃，用黄昏氏族之力咆哮时，卡巴尔以其凶残粗鄙的语言大声呼喊，他们的嘴散发出恐惧的恶臭，接着就惨遭杀害了。 

从那天起，黄昏氏族的费赞在埃里克斯尼族中赢得了新的荣誉。他从此被称为“溺亡队长”。

3915362234.name: The Drowned Captain – 2
3915362234.text:
"So he cut off his own arm?" Eido asked warily. Drifter flicked a coin at the empty cookpot, where it pinged against the rim and bounced away.

"He tripped and fell on his own damn sword," Drifter corrected. "A little different."

"But it didn't kill him?"

"Nah, he left that to the Guardian."

"But the ode claims—"

"You readin' poetry? I got one for ya," Drifter said mischievously, and cleared his throat.

"There once was a Fallen name Phyzann
Who took on a team of three Light-spawn.
He saw they were armed,
And he spoke with alarm,
'If I knew we would fight, I'd be long gone.'"
3915362234.text_zh:
“所以他砍下了自己的胳膊？”艾多小心翼翼地问道。浪客朝空荡的锅里扔了一枚硬币，而硬币在锅边碰了一下被弹开了。

“他绊了一跤，摔在了自己那把该死的剑上，”浪客纠正道。“有点不一样。”

“但他没死？”

“没有，他把那机会留给了守护者。”

“可是颂歌里说的是——”

“你在读诗词？我给你准备了一首，”浪客淘气地说道，清了清嗓子。

“昔有堕落者名曰费赞，
挑战光能之三子。
见三人皆荷枪实弹，
遂惊恐万分作叹：
‘若知将有一战，吾当早弃而逃散。'”

3915362235.name: The Drowned Captain – 3
3915362235.text:
Eido loomed over the gathered hatchlings, who huddled together nervously. Drifter loitered nearby.

"The Drowned Captain feared nothing," Eido intoned. "So, when he saw the three glowing eyes in the cave mouth, he opened fire!" Eido mimed furious shooting with all four hands. 

"But after he stopped, the creature was not felled. Instead," she said, her voice dropping to a low rasp, "it advanced."

"Purple flames poured from the creature's eyes," she said, leaning forward. "It let loose a deafening shriek—"

Drifter, sensing his cue, let loose a blood-curdling scream, causing the hatchlings to jump and chitter in fright.

"And when the scream ended, Phyzann of House Dusk, the Drowned Captain, had disappeared," Eido whispered, "…and was never seen again."
3915362235.text_zh:
艾多俯视着聚集在一起的孩子们，他们紧张地挤成一团。浪客在附近闲荡着。

“溺亡队长无所畏惧，”艾多吟诵道。“所以，当他看到洞口有三只发光的眼睛时，他开枪了！”艾多用四只手模仿着激烈的射击。 

“但他停下来后，那家伙并没有倒下。相反，”她说道，声音变得变得低沉刺耳，“它向前进了一步。”

“紫色的火焰从这生物的眼睛里涌出，”她说着，身体前倾。“它发出了一声震耳欲聋的尖叫——”

浪客察觉到了她的暗示，发出一声可怕的尖叫，吓得孩子们跳起来吱呀乱叫。

“尖叫声结束时，黄昏氏族的费赞，溺亡队长消失了，”艾多低声说道，“…再也没有人见过他。”

3915362236.name: The Drowned Captain – 4
3915362236.text:
Phyzann of House Dusk, loyal to Craask, Kell of Kings, was tested by wave after wave of Cabal intruders. 

But each platoon that lumbered witlessly into his lair fell to pieces beneath the Eliksni hero's blades. Their entrails disgorged into the stagnant water, and their bleats of fear echoed off the cavern walls.

However, just as his victory was assured, the Eliksni hero felt a blade slide into his back, between his lower arms. A Dreg's knife, sharpened by betrayal, became his undoing.  

And so Phyzann of House Dusk slid beneath the water once more.
3915362236.text_zh:
黄昏氏族的费赞，王族凯尔卡拉斯克的效忠者，受到了一波又一波卡巴尔入侵者的考验。 

但每一排愚蠢地闯入其巢穴的士兵都在这位埃里克斯尼族英雄的刀刃下被撕成了碎片。他们的内脏落入滞水之中，恐惧的叫声在洞壁上回响。

然而，正当胜利在望之际，这位埃里克斯尼族英雄却感到一把利刃悄然插入了他的后背，就在他的下臂之间。一把由背叛磨利的堕落者士兵匕首，成了他的毁灭之源。  

因此黄昏氏族的费赞再次潜入了水中。

3915362237.name: The Drowned Captain – 5
3915362237.text:
"Father, you one served the House of Dusk alongside Phyzann, the Drowned Captain, did you not?" Eido kept her tone casual.

"His reputation was known by all," Mithrax replied cautiously. 

"The odes say he was a ferocious warrior," Eido prompted, "who killed many Cabal. They speak of his bravery."

Mithrax fidgeted silently with the regulator on his Ether rebreather.

"Was it not so?" she insisted.

"Phyzann was incompetent," Mithrax grumbled. "He once blew a hole in the side of his own Ketch attempting the Rite of Six Hands with a live grenade. He was a buffoon."

"Yet the odes—" 

"Odes are for hatchlings!" Mithrax replied, more forcefully than intended. "They make glory of desperation, and bravery of ignorance."

"As a Scribe," he continued more calmly, "you must learn to see the truth in such wishful thoughts."
3915362237.text_zh:
“父亲，你曾和溺亡队长费赞一同效忠黄昏氏族，是吧？”艾多让语气显得漫不经心。

“他的名气众所周知，”米瑟拉克斯谨慎地答道。 

“颂歌里说他是一名凶猛的战士，”艾多提道，“他杀了许多卡巴尔。大家都在谈论他的英勇。”

米瑟拉克斯默默地摆弄着乙太呼吸器上的调节器。

“不是这样吗？”她坚持道。

“费赞很无能，”米瑟拉克斯抱怨道。“有一次，他在试图进行六手礼的时候，用一枚手雷在自己的双桅船侧面炸开了一个洞。他是个小丑。”

“可是颂歌里说——” 

“颂歌是给孩子们听的！”米瑟拉克斯回应道，话说得有点重。“它们以绝望为荣，以无知为勇。”

“作为一名文士，”他缓和了语气继续说道，“你必须看到事实真相，不能有这样不切实际的想法。”

3915362238.name: The Drowned Captain – 6
3915362238.text:
I tell tale of the Drowned Phyzann
House Dusk Captain, with his sword drawn
on Machine-spawn and Cabal
and with our House, our Captain led
against the Legion, Risen dead
our foes ahead, Phyzann's call.

But Drowned Phyzann had at his back
betrayers lunging to attack
and one, a sac-soft coward
took sharpened knife and drove it through
Phyzann's armor, and others too
violence anew, empowered.

But dead and still, a whisper came
it spoke of terror, undone shame
violet eyes aflame, Ether gone
a tongue of fire, a screaming head
a creature made of seething dread
as it is said, Drowned Phyzann.
3915362238.text_zh:
余将叙论溺亡费赞
黄昏氏族队长，刀剑出鞘
直指机械种与卡巴尔
由吾之氏族，吾之队长提领
死战军团及复生者
大敌在前，费赞之唤。

然溺亡费赞身后
却有叛徒奔袭而来
另有竖子懦夫
拔利刃，刺穿
费赞之甲，旁人亦然
暴行再临。

但于死寂中，闻一低语声
其述及惶惧惊恐，未竟之耻
紫目焰起，乙太殆尽
烈火之舌，尖啸之颅
沸腾恐惧，遂成此物
顾名思义，溺亡费赞。

3915362239.name: The Drowned Captain – 7
3915362239.text:
Phyzann of House Dusk, loyal to Craask, Kell of Kings, lay betrayed. As his life-Ether flowed into the murky water, he heard a call.

It was not the call of his Kell, nor of his Dregs. It was not the call of the Great Machine, nor that of the Awoken prince. 

It was the call of the Voice in the Darkness, which bade him to rise, reborn and remade in a form both terrible and terrifying. 

And as Phyzann rose, no longer of House Dusk, he roared with flame that poured from his mouth and eyes, and his spirit longed for Ether no more.
3915362239.text_zh:
黄昏氏族的费赞，王族凯尔卡拉斯克的效忠者，遭到了背叛。当他的生命乙太流入浑水中时，他听到了一声呼唤。

这并非凯尔的召唤，也不是堕落者士兵的召唤。这并非大机器的呼唤，也不是觉醒者王子的呼唤。 

这是暗影之声的呼唤，要他站起身来，重生成一种可怖的形态。 

于是费赞站了起来，不再属于黄昏氏族的他怒吼着，火焰从他的嘴和眼里倾泻而出，他的灵魂不再渴望乙太。

3915362224.name: The Drowned Captain – 8
3915362224.text:
"Spider, I wish to ask you about Phyzann, the Drowned Captain," Eido prompted. "No doubt you've heard the odes."

Spider chuckled sardonically. "I wish I knew who wrote them—I could use a liar like that in my operation." 

"My father also doubted their veracity," Eido said, intrigued.

"There was a reason Phyzann died guarding a hole in the ground," Spider chortled. "Craask knew he was a liability." 

"If he was so widely ridiculed, why do the odes honor him?" Eido asked, puzzled.

Spider surveyed The Ether Tank shrewdly. "It's the first rule of propaganda, little Scribe. Everyone is either a friend or a foe. There's no room for nuance."

"But in the real world…" Eido supplied.

"That's all there is," Spider finished.
3915362224.text_zh:
“蛛王，我想问你关于溺亡队长费赞的事，”艾多提道。“你一定听过颂歌吧。”

蛛王讽刺地笑了。“真想知道是谁写的…这种骗子说不定在行动中挺有用。” 

“我父亲也怀疑它们的真实性，”艾多好奇地说道。

“费赞守着地上的一个窟窿死去是有原因的，”蛛王哈哈大笑。“卡拉斯克早就知道他是个累赘。” 

“要是那么多人都嘲笑他，为什么颂歌还要称颂他呢？”艾多疑惑地问道。

蛛王狡黠地审视着乙太罐。“这是宣传的首要法则，小文士。一个人要么是朋友，要么是敌人。没有中间地带。”

“但是在现实世界中…”艾多接话道。

“事情就是如此而已，”蛛王结束了对话。

3915362225.name: The Drowned Captain – 9
3915362225.text:
"Two Guardians were riding a Sparrow through the EDZ," Glint began.

Eido typed into her datapad.

"They were both on one Sparrow?" she asked flatly, not looking up.

"Yes," Glint said. "They stopped at the side of the road, because the Sparrow broke down. One went to look for supplies, and the other waited inside and locked the doors."

"The Sparrow had doors?"

"This one did," Glint said. "And they were locked. But then the Guardian heard a scratching at the door! From outside!"

Eido stopped typing, watching Glint with interest.

"And a voice said, 'Let me in!' and the Guardian opened the door, but… there was nobody there!"

Glint bobbed in the air, whispering a tremulous "Ooo!"

"And?" Eido asked. Glint stopped moving and glanced back and forth.

"That's the end," he said.

Eido's notes were brief.
3915362225.text_zh:
“两个守护者当时正骑着快雀穿过欧洲无人区，”格林特开始说道。

艾多在她的数据板上记录着。

“他们在同一架快雀上？”她淡淡地问道，没有抬头。

“是的，”格林特说道。“他们停在路边，因为快雀出了故障。其中一人去找补给，另一人等在里面，锁上了门。”

“快雀有门吗？”

“这一架有，”格林特说道。“门是锁上的。但随后，守护者听到了一阵挠门声！是从外面传来的！”

艾多停下了记录，饶有兴趣地看着格林特。

“有个声音说，‘让我进去！'，然后守护者打开了门，可是…外面一个人也没有！”

“呜！”格林特在空中上下跳动，颤声低语道。

“然后呢？”艾多问道。格林特停了下来，来回看了看。

“没了，”他说道。

艾多的注释很短。

3932139819.name: Legion Lost – 10
3932139819.text:
Listen! Here is the story of the Legion-Lost,
Who saw a final dishonor at the hands of an enemy.
War-hardened, tusk-proud, bonded-in-battle,
Broken at last in their deathless death,
Felled by Light-eaters, fated to be Taken.
Many times this story has been told: we tell it again.

The Legion-Lost, warden to this teeming place,
Ruin-scattered Earth for a shame-destined foe.
Few could stand their might, so great was it.
They scoured the Earth with ship and steel,
Gilded and gleaming, heaped in glory.
They took what was there to be taken, lives and loss.
3932139819.text_zh:
听！此为失落军团所历之事，
他们落于敌手，而尝终末之耻。
虽身经百战，挥舞獠牙，同心合力，
然终有溃破，以至于死。
亡于噬光者之手，命定为傀儡军团。
前人述此久矣：吾辈复言之。

失落军团，守此簇聚之处，
废墟之地，以求仇敌之耻得报。
少有与之匹敌者，其强可见一斑。
他们携飞船与兵器四处抢掠，
所得之物数不胜数，金光熠熠。
性命珍宝，皆被洗劫一空。

3932139818.name: Legion Lost – 11
3932139818.text:
"And these 'Headless Ones,'" Caiatl began, tilting down her tusks in contemplation, "they are warriors?"

"Oh yes," Eido said, looking up at the Cabal empress. "In fact, they may be Cabal in origin. I am investigating the stories now. Your retainers mentioned a similar tale, and I understand your people have a strong oral tradition. Surely there are accounts of flaming heads? Swords of unusual size?"

Caiatl considered this.

"There have been Cabal who have eaten fire, walked through fire, and belched fire. But that is all."

"I see," said Eido, crestfallen. Caiatl put one massive hand on Eido's shoulder.

"There WERE many warriors with their heads on fire," she offered in consolation. "But not continuously."
3932139818.text_zh:
“这些所谓的无头者，”查厄托倾下她的獠牙作沉思状，“它们是战士吗？”

“哦，没错，”艾多抬头看向卡巴尔女帝。“事实上，它们最早可能起源于卡巴尔。我正在调查这些故事。您的侍卫也提到过类似的传言，我知道您的族人有很强的口述传统。肯定有关于燃烧头颅或异常尺寸之刀剑的记述吧？”

查厄托想了想。

“曾有卡巴尔食过火，趟过火，吐过火。但仅此而已。”

“我明白了，”艾多垂头丧气地说道。查厄托把一只大手放在了艾多的肩上。

“曾有许多战士的头颅着过火，”她安慰道。“但不会一直燃烧。”

3932139817.name: Legion Lost – 12
3932139817.text:
"After the Drowned Captain disappeared," Eido said to the gathered hatchlings, "the Cabal claimed the cavern as their own."

The hatchlings muttered darkly, mimicking their elders' prejudices against the Cabal.

"But the very first night of their occupation, a figure appeared in the mouth of the cave," Eido said. "It had a big round head, and flames poured from its giant mouth. It was… a Headless One!"

"Did they get… eaten?" a tiny hatchling squeaked. 

"Even worse," she said. "The creature ripped off their heads, and left their bodies roaming around the cavern, bumping into the walls." She stuck out all four arms and moaned dully. 

"And that's where they remain… to this very day," she concluded.
3932139817.text_zh:
“溺亡队长消失后，”艾多对聚在一起的孩子们说道，“卡巴尔把洞穴据为己有。”

孩子们低声嘟囔着，模仿着他们的长辈对卡巴尔的偏见。

“但就在他们占领那里的第一个晚上，洞口出现了一个身影，”艾多说道。“它有着一个又大又圆的脑袋，火焰从巨大的嘴巴里喷涌而出。它是…无头者！”

“他们被…吃掉了吗？”一个小家伙吱吱地叫着。 

“还要更糟，”她说道。“那怪物扯下了他们的头，留下他们的躯体在洞穴里四处游荡，到处碰壁。”她伸出四支手臂，沉闷地呻吟着。 

“他们还留在那里…直到今天，”她讲完了这个故事。

3932139816.name: Legion Lost – 13
3932139816.text:
Earth was war-wounded, Light-devoured.
The Legion-Lost grasped victories where they could;
Ungoverned, burned in spirit, borne bitterly,
They fought with honor until honor fled them.
Here was how they found first-death, where
The Legion-Lost moved forward to their curse:
They found an enemy too fierce for them to fell.

Cornered, cowed, the Legion-Lost made
To take to great caves and hidden places.
A final stand made to hoard their honor.
Life-given, broken, made to suffer,
They saw their end before them.
Like a wild war beast the Light-eater descended,
The Legion-Lost dealt defeat by their hands.
3932139816.text_zh:
寰宇遍体鳞伤，光能噬尽。
失落军团倾尽所能，克敌制胜；
肆意征讨，杀意冲天，克苦忍痛。
为荣誉而战，至终荣誉却弃之而去。
于是他们初尝死亡，
也一步步走向诅咒的宿命：
他们所面对的敌人残暴无比，坚不可摧。

失落军团被逼入绝境，如临深渊，
无奈只得藏身于巨穴和隐匿之地。
为了捍卫荣誉，他们孤注一掷。
赐生，坎坷，备尝辛苦，
深知末日已近在眼前。
噬光者像疯狂的战兽一般降临，
而失落军团却不幸惨败其手。

3932139823.name: Legion Lost – 14
3932139823.text:
"Thank you for speaking with me," Eido said cheerfully. The Psion bowed its head, and Eido did the same. 

"I've conducted an interview with Empress Caiatl already. But I am hoping that you could further illuminate the subject."

Eido felt a soft, blooming sensation in the forefront of her mind. Gracious acquiescence.

"I am searching for information about the Headless Ones, and—"

The thought of a creature without a head sent up a spike of adrenaline, a flash of sickening terror that burst in Eido's mind so violently that she jumped. The Psion's own thoughts only compounded its fear. Eido's eyes widened.

"Oh, I'm—"

Screaming. Purple flames pouring from empty eyes.

"I'm so sorry, I—"

Screaming. A burst of confetti.

"I didn't mean to—"

Screaming. Candy. Candy everywhere.

"To upset you."
3932139823.text_zh:
“谢谢你和我谈话，”艾多高兴地说道。灵能士兵低头致意，艾多也照着做了。 

“我已请教过女帝查厄托。但我希望你能进一步说明这个问题。”

艾多在她脑海中感受到了一种柔和的感觉。谦和的默许。

“我正在寻找有关无头者的信息，还有——”

一想到无头生物，她的肾上腺素就猛增，一种令人作呕的恐惧在艾多的脑海中猛烈爆发，以至于她跳了起来。灵能士兵的想法加剧了这恐惧。艾多瞪大了眼。

“哦，我——”

尖叫声。紫色的火焰从空洞的眼睛里涌出。

“真抱歉，我——”

尖叫声。一阵五彩纸屑洒下。

“我不是有意——”

尖叫声。糖果。到处都是糖果。

“惹你生气的。”

3932139822.name: Legion Lost – 15
3932139822.text:
"About… 13.2 kilograms," Cryptarch Yareli read from the scales.

Eido wrung both sets of hands uncomfortably. The laboratory walls were lined with hundreds of canopic jars, filled with preserved organs and appendages. She recognized many of them as Eliksni. 

"Is that… heavy?" Eido inquired.

The Cryptarch arched an eyebrow at her. "Quite heavy for confetti. You say the Headless Ones emit a shower of this material upon death?"

"They do," Eido replied, "along with an edible the Guardians call 'candy.'" She tried unsuccessfully to keep the disgust from her tone.

The Cryptarch shook his head in disbelief. "Aside from its density, which is incredible, this confetti is identical to the stuff Humans used during pre-Dark Age celebrations."

Eido's eye's twinkled with inspiration. "Celebrations like… the Hall Between!"
3932139822.text_zh:
“大概...13.2公斤，”解密大师亚雷丽看着天平读道。

艾多不安地拧着两组手。实验室的墙壁上排列着数百个卡诺皮克罐，里面装满了保存下来的器官和附器。她认出其中许多是埃里克斯尼族。 

“那算…重吗？”艾多问道。

解密大师朝她挑了挑眉毛。“对五彩纸屑来说挺重的。你是说无头者死的时候会喷出这种材料？”

“是的，”艾多回答道，“还有一种守护者称之为‘糖果'的食物。”她试图抑制住语气里的厌恶情绪，但没有成功。

解密大师狐疑地摇了摇头。“除了其不可思议的密度之外，这种五彩纸屑和人类在前黑暗纪元的庆典中所使用的东西是完全一样的。”

艾多的眼里闪烁着光芒。“庆典…就像腕神节！”

3932139821.name: Legion Lost – 16
3932139821.text:
But less than death the Legion-Lost became.
In their great shame at the end of their battle,
Great weapons fell from their grasp.
But whispered were they into new wandering,
Dark-forged and Taken into shameful embrace,
The Legion-Lost gained their name in death.

Curse-charged, terror-torn,
They raised eyes darkened, then lit with flame,
Sword-screaming, rising from purple pyres.
Heads aflame, their end was found in endlessness.
No more wandering or warring in these lands.
The Legion-Lost live as shame and story.
3932139821.text_zh:
然失落军团并非真正已逝。
战终之时，他们受尽耻辱，
强兵坠自其手。
传闻有云，他们四处游荡，
于黑暗铸造，与傀儡相拥，
失落军团因死得名。

历尽诅咒，饱尝惊骇，
他们举目晦暗，遂燃以火焰，
刀剑尖鸣，升于紫柴。
头颅似焰，万世无终。
此地再无游荡或交锋。
失落军团存于耻辱与传言。

3932139820.name: Legion Lost – 17
3932139820.text:
"And these monsters exist?" Lord Saladin asked, his voice grave.

Eido nodded nervously.

"I have ample evidence for their existence. I know that they have flaming pumpkin heads, and that they're filled with candy," Eido said stiffly. "And loot. They are also filled with loot."

Lord Saladin considered this. Eido could not discern what he might be thinking.

"But I question Glint's conclusions about their origins," she added.

The Iron Lord stared her down.

"You heard about this from Glint?" 

"Yes, I—" 

"I don't have time for this," Saladin said, and walked away.
3932139820.text_zh:
“这些怪物真的存在？”领主萨拉丁问道，语气很严肃。

艾多紧张地点了点头。

“我有充足证据证明它们的存在。我了解到它们有燃烧的南瓜头，里面装满了糖果，”艾多生硬地说道。“还有战利品。里面也装满了战利品。”

领主萨拉丁思忖着。艾多不知道他可能会在想些什么。

“但我对格林特关于它们起源的结论存疑，”她补充道。

钢铁领主瞪眼看着她。

“你是听格林特说的吗？” 

“是的，我——” 

“我没这闲工夫，”萨拉丁说完就走开了。

3932139811.name: Findings of Eido – 18
3932139811.text:
"Would you like… some tea?"

The trip to Luna had been a short one, but now Eido sat uncomfortably in a folding chair in Eris Morn's dwelling. Her host poured steaming liquid from a vessel into a small ceramic cup. The Scribe took it politely, trying to keep the contents from spilling over the rim.

"So you believe the Headless Ones are connected to this 'Hall Between,'" Eris said.

"Yes," Eido answered. "I do not believe they are of Hive origin."

"I see."

"Oh! You do? I was wondering…" Eido trailed off under Eris's stare. 

The Scribe looked down at her tea. Humans tended to drink such things communally, but Eris had not poured a cup for herself. Letting her eyes wander, Eido realized the room was oddly bare but for the teapot and a tattered mat at the door's threshold. The lettering on it was illegible.

There was a long silence.

"I was asked to make this place more hospitable," Eris said. Eido wasn't sure if that was an explanation or an apology.
3932139811.text_zh:
“你想要来点…茶吗？”

去月球的路程不长，但现在艾多不安地坐在了埃里斯·摩恩住所的一把折叠椅上。她的主人把热气腾腾的液体从容器里倒进一个小陶瓷杯里。文士礼貌地接过来，尽量不让里面的东西溢出杯沿。

“这么说你认为无头者和这个‘腕神节'有关，”埃里斯说道。

“是的，”艾多回答说。“我不相信它们源自邪魔族。”

“我明白了。”

“哦！真的吗？我还在想…”在埃里斯的注视下，艾多的声音渐渐低了下去。 

文士低头看着她的茶。人类喜欢一起喝这些东西，但埃里斯却没有给自己也倒一杯。艾多的眼睛四处游走，发现除了茶壶和门口的破垫子，房间里空荡得出奇。垫子上面的印字已难以辨认。

一阵长久的沉默。

“有人说我应该让这地方更热情好客些，”埃里斯说道。艾多不确定这是解释还是道歉。

3932139810.name: Findings of Eido – 19
3932139810.text:
"During that time, children would run amok," Cryptarch Matsuo explained. "They would extort foodstuffs from the citizenry under threat of vandalism."

"Hence the participants' eagerness to disguise their identities," Eido mused. "But how does this spirit of lawlessness relate to communion with the dead?" she continued, puzzled.

Matsuo shrugged. "Maybe the Hall Between was a celebration of transgression in general. A period when people disguised themselves to act out of character."

"…When docile hatchlings acted as bandits," Eido supplied, "and the dead returned to speak with the living."

"Exactly," the Cryptarch nodded. "And those without heads were granted replacements… for a time."
3932139810.text_zh:
“那段时间，孩子们到处乱窜，”解密大师松尾解释道。“他们会以破坏财物相威胁，向市民勒索食物。”

“所以参与者才会急于掩饰自己的身份，”艾多沉思道。“但是这种胡作非为的本质跟与死者交流又有什么关系呢？”她颇为不解。

松尾耸了耸肩。“也许腕神节是一种对越界行为的庆祝。大家在这期间可以伪装自己，表现反常。”

“…温顺的孩子们行强盗之事，”艾多接话道，“而死者则归来与生者对话。”

“没错，”解密大师点点头。“而那些无头者…便在一段时间内…得到了备用的头。”

3948917406.name: Findings of Eido – 20
3948917406.text:
"I believe you're due for congratulations," Eido continued, "and several apologies. Your work revealing the Headless Ones was a feat of rare scholarship."

"Well thank you for saying so," Glint chirped. He seemed to double in size as his shell swelled with pride. "When I started my investigation, everyone laughed at me, but who's laughing now?"

"I… I'm not sure," Eido admitted. "Is it Drifter? He sometimes snickers at my expense."

"No," Glint explained patiently. "It's me. I'm the one who's laughing." 

"Oh!" Eido exclaimed. "You're laughing as an expression of vindication! I understand."

"Yup! I'm the only paranormal expert in the Tower who's also a Ghost!" Glint preened.

"Fascinating," Eido agreed. "However, I do have a few questions about your conclusions…"
3948917406.text_zh:
“我想我该恭喜你，”艾多接着说，“还要向你说几声抱歉。你为揭示无头者所做出的努力在学术界实属罕见，而且意义重大。”

“谢谢你这么说，”格林特叽喳道。他的机壳因骄傲而膨胀，体型似乎增大了一倍。“我刚开始调查时，所有人都嘲笑我，但现在又是谁笑到了最后呢？”

“我…我不确定，”艾多承认道。“是浪客吗？他有时会拿我开玩笑。”

“不，”格林特耐心地解释道。“是我。我才是那个笑到了最后的人。” 

“哦！”艾多喊道。“你笑是因为自己是对的！我明白了。”

“对！我是高塔里唯一的机灵超自然专家！”格林特洋洋自得道。

“真不错，”艾多同意道。“不过，我对你的结论有一些疑问…”

3948917407.name: Findings of Eido – 21
3948917407.text:
The Findings of Eido, Scribe of House Light, Regarding the Beings Known as the Headless Ones (Cont'd)

"…from which I can conclude that the pumpkin was a type of sentient gourd that contained eyes and a mouth. Sometimes a single eye, and sometimes the less unsettling four eyes.

Whether these gourds were killed, cooked, and eaten is a… point of debate. Perhaps after a time, they were angered at being hunted for food and eventually turned on their predators.

But then, if I am reading this pre-Golden Age primary source correctly, certain religious festivals were devoted to rearing the heaviest pumpkin. Perhaps these pumpkins were instead used as guides to traverse the Hall Between? Though I still do not understand how a gourd could attain locomotion."
3948917407.text_zh:
光能氏族文士艾多关于被称作无头者的生物的发现（续）

“…从中我可以得出结论，南瓜是一种有感知的葫芦科植物，拥有眼睛和嘴巴。有时是一只眼睛，有时是稍微没那么可怕的四只眼睛。

这些葫芦是否曾被杀死、烹煮并食用是个…争议点。也许过了一段时间，它们因遭到猎杀而愤怒，最终对捕食者发起进攻。

但是，如果我没读错这本前黄金时代原始资料的话，某些宗教节日会专门培育最重的南瓜。也许这些南瓜会被用来作为穿越交界大厅的向导？虽然我还是不明白葫芦是怎么移动的。”

3948917404.name: Findings of Eido – 22
3948917404.text:
"After seeing Glint's evidence, I combed our archives for any mentions of headless bodies," Cryptarch Matsuo began. 

"And I uncovered what I consider to be the oldest-known documentation of the Headless Ones!" He slid a vacuum-sealed piece of parchment across the desktop to Eido, who chittered in anticipation. 

"As you can see," Matsuo continued with a self-satisfied smirk, "this report was written by a Golden Age scholar who describes himself a 'fourth grade' researcher."

"He calls this document a 'book report,'" Eido noticed. "There must have been a larger body of inquiry into the subject than we ever imagined!"

"Absolutely," Matsuo affirmed. "And this report identifies the individual who I believe discovered the very first Headless One…"

"A scientist named… Ichabod Crane!" Eido exclaimed with delight.
3948917404.text_zh:
“看到格林特的证据后，我梳理了我们的档案，看有没有提到无头尸体，”解密大师松尾开始说道。 

“我发现了我认为是关于无头者的已知最古老的文献！”他把一张真空密封的羊皮纸滑过桌面递给艾多，她已经期待得叫出了声。 

“如你所见，”松尾带着得意的笑容继续说道，“这份报告是一位黄金时代学者写的，他自称是‘四年级'研究员。”

“他称这份文件为‘读书报告'，”艾多注意到。“肯定有很多人对这个问题做了深入的调查！”

“肯定的，”松尾认可地说。“这份报告还点出了一个人，我觉得他发现了第一个无头者…”

“是叫…伊卡博德·克雷恩的科学家！”艾多高兴地喊道。

3948917405.name: Findings of Eido – 23
3948917405.text:
"So, if the Headless Ones were created by Nokris as you claim," Eido concluded, "how could they come to populate a cavern on Earth?"

"Maybe some Headless Ones hitched a ride from the Moon," Glint posited. "Like stowaways of cosmic evil!" 

"Perhaps," Eido replied, unconvinced. "Or perhaps they are not of Hive origin after all. We may not have enough data yet to draw any conclusions."

"But one thing we can clarify right now," she continued, "is why the Headless Ones are so poorly named. Obviously, they have heads."

Glint's digital iris narrowed. He vibrated in a low whir, which Eido misinterpreted as thoughtful consideration.
3948917405.text_zh:
“那么，如果真的如你所说，无头者是诺克里斯创造的话，”艾多总结道，“它们怎么会来到地球上的洞穴里居住呢？”

“也许有些无头者搭了来自月球的便车。”格林特假设道。“就像邪恶的宇宙偷渡者！” 

“也许吧，”艾多心存疑虑地答道。“也许它们根本不是源自邪魔族。我们可能还没有足够的数据来得出任何结论。”

“但有件事我们现在就能说清楚，”她继续说道，“那就是无头者怎么会起了这么差的名字。很显然，它们是有头的。”

格林特眯起了数字虹膜。他在低沉的呼呼声中颤动着，艾多误以为是在沉思。

3948917402.name: Findings of Eido – 24
3948917402.text:
The Findings of Eido, Scribe of House Light, Regarding the Beings Known as the Headless Ones (Cont'd)

"Here's what we know about the strange pre-Golden Age ritual of the Hall Between:

During the rite, common Humans wore monstrous masks for cosmetic and spiritual purposes—a custom that survives via the Festival of the Lost. 

Masked Humans were allowed, if not encouraged, to participate in banditry and extortion of their neighbors. This seemed especially prevalent among juveniles.

Humans used a long-extinct variety of pumpkin familiars to breach the veil between life and death. It's unclear what role these sentient fruits played in the ritual, but the psycho-spiritual power of the legendary gourds merits further research."
3948917402.text_zh:
光能氏族文士艾多关于被称作无头者的生物的发现（续）

“以下便是我们了解到前黄金时代奇特的腕神节仪式：

仪式中，普通人类出于装饰和宗教目的而佩戴巨大的面具——这项习俗通过英灵日得以保留。 

虽然不鼓励，但允许戴着面具的人类参与抢劫和敲诈邻居。这在青少年中似乎尤为普遍。

人类会利用一种早已灭绝的南瓜使魔来打破生死之隔。尚不清楚这些有知觉的果实在仪式中扮演了什么角色，但是这种传说葫芦的灵性力量值得进一步研究。”

3948917403.name: Findings of Eido – 25
3948917403.text:
"If pre-Golden Age Humans knew of the Headless Ones," Eido said, "then they cannot be of Hive origin."

"A reasonable deduction," Cryptarch Matsuo affirmed. "Humanity's first contact with the Hive didn't occur until sometime during the Collapse."

"Glint will be… disappointed by this conclusion," Eido said reluctantly.

"I suspect so," Matsuo replied. "Speaking of Glint… if you could omit my contribution to your research, I would appreciate it." He tapped his forefingers together carefully. "I was rather dismissive of Glint's early expeditions, and I have no desire to eat crow now." 

"None of us desire that," Eido chittered, aghast. "I suspect he would taste… bitter."
3948917403.text_zh:
“如果前黄金时代的人类就已了解无头者，”艾多说道，“那它们就不可能起源于邪魔族。”

“那是个合理的推论，”解密大师松尾认可道。“人类与邪魔族直到大崩溃期间的某个时候才发生了接触。”

“格林特会对这个结论…感到失望的，”艾多不情愿地说道。

“我想是的，”松尾答道。“说到格林特…如果能别提起我对你研究的贡献，我将不胜感激。”他小心翼翼地轻敲着食指。“我之前说过格林特早期的考察不怎么样，但我现在就是不想把吐出去的话再咽下去。” 

“我们谁也不想，”艾多吃惊地叫着。“那多难吃啊。”

3948917400.name: Findings of Eido – 26
3948917400.text:
"You really think that Humans created the Headless Ones?" Glint tilted his shell flaps obstinately. 

"Yes. I hypothesize that they were created as part of an ancient Human ritual," Eido replied, oblivious to the Ghost's indignation. "…called the Hall Between."

Glint tilted incredulously. "A hall between… what?" 

"The realms of the living and dead," Eido reasoned. "To which the ancient 'pumpkins' were key." 

Glint's shell flaps went slack in confusion.
