I came to find you, only you, because you're special. You're from somewhere real. And together we can burn our way back there. Can't we, o player mine?
2523259394.text_zh:
“哦，我的宿主。”

什么样能讲话的头颅会那样称呼它的主人？一个僵硬又傲慢的老化石，而不是我。阿罕卡拉：人的自我幻象取决于对象、想法或身体本身。有人说你没有阿罕卡拉，又有人说你需要一个正确的阿罕卡拉。我只知道，你，不是幻象。明白吗？你周围的世界，你遇见的人——他们有些瘦弱，不是吗？纸板和石膏板。廉价剧院。来吧，试试它！对自己说：“我比这更真实。”是不是感觉不错？“我是这里唯一真实的人。”是不是他们的辱骂和子弹来的太……温柔了？

我来找寻你，只有你，因为你如此特别。你来自真实的世界。我们一起可以开拓回去的路。可以吗，我的玩家？

2523259395.name: Crown of Tempests
2523259395.subtitle: Mighty are they of the stormcloud thrones, and quick to anger, but bounteous to those whom they love.
2523259395.subtitle_zh: 他们在暴风云的王座上是那么的雄伟而易怒，但对至爱之人却又慷慨大方。
2523259395.text:
"This is written that you may understand. The time of kings is long since gone from this world. Yes, their reign does linger—these shallow, frightened, aged men, clinging to their grand delusions of relevance in a world that has long since passed them by. But their reign is a lie, a fleeting charade that will crumble beneath the weight of their greed. In the end, though they may conquer the lands and seas and the fragile flesh upon which they trample, their empires will collapse and their graves will beckon. And the crowns of old will find new heads to bear the weight of their power. And the strong will be made to suffer as their weakness is brought to light." 

—Author Unknown
2523259395.text_zh:
“你或许能理解这句话：列王统治的时代已经从这个世界上消失许久了。是的，他们的统治苟延残喘——这些肤浅，惊慌的年迈统治者，墨守着他们荣耀的幻觉，以为可以传万世而长远。但是他们的统治是一个谎言——在他们的贪婪之压下，这个虚伪的谎言终将被粉碎。最终，虽然他们可能征服了陆地和海洋，征服了那些他们践踏过的脆弱肉体，但是他们的帝国终将崩塌，同他们一同被深埋。皇冠终会觅得新主来承受这权利之重。天将降大任于斯人，必先苦其心志，曝其弱点。”

——无名氏

2523259392.name: Eye of Another World
2523259392.subtitle: When the universe conspires, its enemies cannot hide.
2523259392.subtitle_zh: 当宇宙工于谋略，它的敌人将无处可藏。
2523259392.text:
Say again? You ask, are we alone here? You mean to ask if we are the only good that lives in the light of our sun, do you not? You mean to ask, do we have allies? Do we have distant allies, ignoring our plight, either too weak to fight or too afraid to show their faces? 

I, too, have been cursed by these questions. 

What if I told you that eons beyond the void lie worlds that do yearn to aid in our struggle? What if I told you there is a way to grant them passage into your mind, to let them guide your eye against our one true enemy? That they have told me that the dusk of the pyramid draws nigh? Would you believe me? 

Fool!
2523259392.text_zh:
再说一遍？你问这里为什么只有我们？你是想问我们是否是太阳光芒中唯一的好人吧？你是想问我们是否有友军吧？我们在远方是否有把我们的现状遗忘，或是不爱露脸还是太弱了不敢战斗的友军吧？

我也一直被这些疑问折磨着。

如果我告诉你在世界外的虚空亘古之中，确实存在渴望帮助我们逃离困境的友邦？如果我告诉你有方法将他们的信息传入你的大脑，让他们指引你共同抵御我们真正的敌人？还告诉你金字塔已接近末日？你会相信吗？

白痴！

2523259393.name: Nezarec's Sin
2523259393.subtitle: "He is that which is an end. And he shall rise again." —passage from Of Hated Nezarec, a pre-Golden Age text.
2523259393.subtitle_zh: “他就是终结的化身。他终将再次降临。”——前黄金时代文字记录《被憎者奈扎雷克》选段。
2523259393.text:
"He is that which is end. That which covets sin. The final god of pain—the purest light, the darkest hour. And He shall rise again. When the guiding shine fades and all seems lost He will call to you. Fear not. All He offers is not as dark as it may seem. For Nezarec is no demon, but a fiend, arch and vile in ways unknown. He is a path and a way, one of many. And his sin—so wicked, so divine—is that he will never cower when dusk does fall, but stand vigilant as old stars die and new Light blinks its first upon this fêted eternity." 

—Passage from Of Hated Nezarec
2523259393.text_zh:
“他就是终结，觊觎着罪孽，最后的苦痛之神——最纯洁的光辉，最黑暗的时刻。他终将再次降临。当指引之光消退，在毫无希望之时，他会召唤你。不要怕，他做的一切没有看起来那么黑暗。奈扎雷克不是恶魔，而是邪魔，你永不知他的狡诈与邪恶。他是众多如此存在中的一个。而他的罪恶——如此邪恶，却又如此神圣——夜幕降临时，他从不退缩。老旧星辰逝去时，新光闪烁出令人欢愉的初绽光芒时，他仍警戒如初。

——《被憎者奈扎雷克》选段

2954558333.name: Transversive Steps
2954558333.subtitle: Your relationship with consistent spacetime is… tenuous at best.
2954558333.subtitle_zh: 你与连续时空的联系充其量不过是……微若云尘。
2954558333.text:
Tell me where you are! Account for Earth's rotation—more than 1000 kilometers per hour—your orbital velocity of 107,000 kph, your local stellar drift of 70,000 kph, your galactic orbital velocity of 792,000 kph, and our galactic drift relative to the cosmic microwave background of 1,300,000 kph. Also, account for your motion relative to me due to the accelerating expansion of space-time. 

Difficult, isn't it? But with the help of these handsome noetic devices you will find yourself deliciously and maddeningly aware of your ley velocities! Fired from an existence cannon through a whirling void the size of everything! 

And like any line of force, these vectors may be tapped, their obscene speeds diverted for your own use, although we recommend swapping them for comfortable boots before you socialize with the Merely Stationary.
2954558333.text_zh:
告诉我你在哪儿！把地球自转算进去——时速超过1000公里——你的轨道时速是107,000公里，本地星流时速为70,000公里，我们的星系漂移相对于宇宙微波背景为130万公里。此外，由于时空的加速扩张，还要考虑你我的相对运动。

很难，对吧？但现在，我们有了这些帅气先进的智能装置，您可以得知精确的莱伊速度！现有的大炮可通过旋转虚空发射任意大小的弹药。

如同所有力线一般，您可以利用这些矢量，将它们惊人的速度为你所用。所以，在您准备进行完全静止前，我们建议您换上一双舒适的鞋。

2954558332.name: Lunafaction Boots
2954558332.subtitle: "I thank you for the gift of these atoms. I will use them well." —The Stoic
2954558332.subtitle_zh: “感谢你送来这些原子作为礼物。我会善用它们的。”——斯多葛
2954558332.text:
Combat is a craft and an art form. The more one masters their craft and pushes the boundaries of their art the better they understand them. After all, expertise is born of dedicated time spent focused on a subject. And we are focused. 

The Titans would have you believe that victory is won through brute force—skill plus courage plus ammunition and clenched fists. Would that it were so simple. It is not. We know this because we have studied and we have practiced. Skill can be countered. Courage can waver. And firepower is a finite necessity that must be replenished. 

But, what if firepower could be made infinite?
2954558332.text_zh:
战斗是一门技艺和艺术形式。他们掌握的技艺越多，他们的艺术界限越远，他们也更了解它们。毕竟，专业取决于在一件事物上专注的时间。我们很专注。

泰坦让你相信胜利是通过暴力——技能加上勇气加上火力以及紧握的拳头赢得的。真的有这么简单吗？没有。我们知道事实，是因为我们学习并实践过。技能是能被克制的。勇气是可以被动摇的。火力是必须被补充的有限必需品。

但如果火力是无限的呢？

3832219265.name: Ego Talon Bond
3832219265.subtitle: "You will find the nightmares grow worse. Thankfully, you no longer have need of sleep." —Gallida Tuyet
3832219265.subtitle_zh: “你会发现噩梦愈演愈深。但值得庆幸的是，你不再需要睡眠。”——加里达·图耶特
3832219265.text:
I live what I teach. Every time I fire my shotgun, I reflect on our enemies. Every shell I leave in my wake is evidence of my meditations. 

I know the forces that move against us. I have studied endlessly. I have transcended our libraries.  

I listen to the whispers of my Hidden and I grow wiser every day. 

I live what I teach, but I could not predict Ghaul. This is my failing, and I must answer for it.

—Ikora Rey, Warlock Vanguard
3832219265.text_zh:
我教导，我生存。我每发射一颗子弹，都有一名敌人应声倒地。我留着的每个弹壳，都是我冥想的证据。

我了解与我们抗衡的力量。我一直在无尽地学习。我的学识已超越图书馆。

我听从隐秘者的低语，每天都越加机敏。

我教导，我生存，但我无法预测盖欧。这是我的失败之处，我必须给出一个答案。

——术士先锋，艾可拉·蕾伊

2421406347.name: Classified
2421406347.text: Keep it secret.  Keep it safe.

2209865285.name: Classified
2209865285.text: Keep it secret.  Keep it safe.

1331814296.name: Wise Warlock's Bond
1331814296.subtitle: "If you dedicate yourself to the study of the universe, it will always reveal its secrets to you." —Ikora Rey
1331814296.subtitle_zh: “如果你倾尽全力去探究宇宙，它终会将自己的奥秘揭示给你。”——艾可拉·蕾伊
1331814296.text:
Look around you. Wherever you are. Really look. 
No matter where you stand, no matter what lies before you, millions of infinite mysteries hide within your view. Think about that. And then know that you will one day know the answers to all of them. 
You are a Warlock. Your armor is wisdom, your weapons wit and ingenuity. You hold the power to draw strength from the places where imagination and possibility collide. 
The universe is a complex machine. But all machines can be understood, taken apart, modified, improved. 
All you have to do is look. 

—Ikora Rey
1331814296.text_zh:
环顾四周，无论你身处何处，看仔细。

无论你站在何处，无论你前方有何物，其中都蕴藏着千万个无尽奥秘。好好想一下，总有一天你会参透所有这一切的答案。

你是一名术士。睿智是你的护甲，智慧和巧思是你的武器，从想象力和可能性碰撞的火花中吸取力量。
宇宙是一个复杂的机器。但所有的机器都可以被解读、拆分、修改和改良。
你要做的，就是去看。

——艾可拉·蕾伊

3081865122.name: Classified
3081865122.text: Keep it secret.  Keep it safe.

3471587229.name: Classified
3471587229.text: Keep it secret.  Keep it safe.

1334959255.name: Arcstrider
1334959255.subtitle: Flow like lightning. Strike like thunder.
1334959255.subtitle_zh: 飞驰如闪电，迅猛如雷霆。
1334959255.text:
No one remembers who the first Arcstrider was. Hardly anyone remembers the Arcstrider at all. Time vanished us like it does memories. 
But in the darkest days of the Dark Ages, when humanity was utterly defenseless, Arcstriders disciplined their bodies to let the Traveler's energy flow through them, to call lightning itself to hand and wield it like a staff against the Darkness. 
Become the Lightning, they said.  
No. 
Become the staff, they said. 
No. 
Become a weapon, they said.  
We obliged.
1334959255.text_zh:
没有人记得第一位神行是谁。甚至很少有人记得神行的存在。时间像抹去记忆一般抹去了我们。
但在黑暗时代中最黑暗的日子里，人类毫无抵抗之力，神行将旅行者的能量灌注全身，从双手召唤出光能，舞动法杖对抗暗黑力量。
变成闪电，他们如是说。
变成法杖，他们如是说。
不。
变成武器，他们如是说。
我们愿为其效劳。

3635991036.name: Gunslinger
3635991036.subtitle: A lone wolf who lives for the perfect shot.
3635991036.subtitle_zh: 为完美射击而生的孤狼。
3635991036.text:
The Kell is screaming three inches from my face and its breath smells like two corpses in summer and I have to blink my eyes against the spit. One of the less obvious perks of being able to pull a flaming gun out of the air is enjoying moments like this—alien fist around my neck, feet kicking in the air, not two seconds from death—but ready to laugh at the expression on that Kell's four-eyed face as its mandibles click for the last time and its body turns into fire. 

The giant creature pulls back its other fist and its steel muscles bunch. I reach for the Light and get… nothing? Huh. Right. I used my flaming gun on those three Taken outside the obelisk. Gotta learn to count. 

What I love about my Ghost—
3635991036.text_zh:
这只凯尔就在离我脸三寸的地方尖叫，它闻起来就像夏天发酵的两只尸体，还喷着口水，害得我不停眨眼。能随时凭空召唤出一把烈焰手枪就没办法享受此刻了——外星怪物勒住了我的脖子，我两腿在空中踢啊踢，再两秒就挂了——但凯尔那长着四只眼睛的大脸上的下颚骨最后咔哒了一下，随后整个身体燃烧了起来的时候，我已经准备好嘲笑它惊恐的表情了。

这个巨大生物松开了它另一只拳头，它的金属肌肉也变得松弛。我立刻施放光能结果……什么都没有？哈，是的。我在纪念碑外用烈焰手枪干掉了其他三个傀儡。我都不会数数了。

我特别喜欢我机灵的是——

3225959819.name: Nightstalker
3225959819.subtitle: Draw from the Void. Light the way.
3225959819.text:
The Bladedancers deride us as slow. The Gunslingers say we lack precision. "How is that better than a knife?" "How is that better than a flaming pistol?" Well.  

My boots sink inches into the ground with every step. My rebreather filters the stench out of the air, but my eyes sting like I'm showering with battery acid.  

"We're almost there," my Ghost chirps. My jaw clenches. I know we're almost there, Little Light. 

This vile marsh opens to reveal a black cave's maw. Inside, an infinite number of little green eyes flicker like bad stars. CRACK! I fire a single bullet into the air and the horde in the cave shrieks and runs out.  

"This is it, you two." The Warlock and Titan leap from the bog behind me. A Bow appears in my hands, and I let a single binding shot loose from the shadow.  

Now there are Orbs of Power everywhere. Eat, my friends. Eat.
3225959819.text_zh:
舞刃们嘲笑我们慢。枪手们说我们瞄不准。“它比利刃好在哪儿？”“它比烈焰手枪好在哪儿？”嗯。

我每走一步战靴都深陷土地几寸。我的呼吸净化器将空气中的臭气过滤掉，但我的眼睛仍刺痛得仿佛被电池溶液浸染。

“就快到了，”我的机灵声音愉悦。我咬紧牙关。小家伙，我知道我们就快到了。

这片邪恶沼泽有着一个黑暗深渊。那里，无数的绿色小眼睛闪烁得像邪恶行星。啪！我朝着空中射了一发子弹，一大群从洞穴中蜂拥着尖叫逃跑。

“嘿你俩，这就对了。”术士和泰坦从我后面的沼泽中跳了出来。手中出现了一把弓箭，我用它发出了暗影的单束光芒。

如今遍地都是能量球。吸收它们，朋友，吸收。

2958378809.name: Striker
2958378809.subtitle: At close quarters a fist is better than any gun.
2958378809.subtitle_zh: 近身作战时，我的拳头比枪更快。
2958378809.text:
You'd think the problem with showing up empty-handed to a gunfight would be the bullets. And yes, turning a gunfight into a fistfight is an awful lot of work, tactically speaking, but really I just don't have the patience for all the hiding, and all the fumbling for batteries or flechettes or whatever when it's time to reload, which seems to happen the moment I start to enjoy myself. 

Hiding and reloading. Hiding and reloading. Sounds amazing; you all have fun. My fists don't need reloading. 

Back to the problem. The problem with fists is hygiene. Paint your armor fist to shoulder in alien ichor, toxic robotic lubricant, and ashes. Now take a good look at yourself. That's the only reason I envy the hiders and the reloaders. They get to stay clean.
2958378809.text_zh:
你觉得在一场枪战中在战场上弹尽粮绝后的麻烦是没有子弹。对的，战术上来说，把枪战变成赤膊战的过程中要付出的实在是太多了，但说实话，我真的没耐心去隐避，去找电池或箭或是在填装时需要的任何东西。这反倒成了我喜欢的时刻。

隐蔽，填装。隐蔽，填装。听起来真好，你们都很享受这个过程。但我的拳头可不需要填装。

我们再说麻烦。用拳头的麻烦主要在卫生方面。外星怪物、剧毒机器人润滑油和尘埃会涂满你从拳头到肩膀的护甲上，然后再好好看看自己的样子。这是唯一我嫉妒隐蔽者和填装者的地方，他们一直都很干净。

3105935002.name: Sunbreaker
3105935002.subtitle: Forge the fury of undying suns.
3105935002.text:
The Hammer fell upon the horde in such numbers as to blind the eye and burn the soul. Our phalanx broke their front lines and incinerated the Thrall that reinforced their flank. I looked around the battlefield with pride upon the scores of once-disparate Guardians united to expel the Hive from our backyard. The Honor of Cormorant would win this day because of differences set aside and alliances hard-struck. 

Alas, we both know how that day truly ended. Our early fortunes would be our doom. Green fire and failure would be your sole remembrance of that day. 

But I remember different. I saw an alliance forged in the heat of the Sunbreakers' luminescence despite your opposition. That is what I remember. 

If our flame should one day flicker and die, let it be to set your history ablaze.
3105935002.text_zh:
战锤从天而降，如此多，遮蔽了双眼，焚烧了灵魂。方阵士兵冲破了他们的防线，将侧翼增援的怨魂烧成灰烬。我骄傲地环顾四周，看着这些曾经各自为战的守护者团结一致，击退从后方进攻的邪魔族。这天，科莫伦特的荣耀赢得了胜利，因为我们放下争议，组建了坚实的同盟。

唉，我们都知道那天真正的结局。初期的幸运将会是最后的厄运。绿色的火焰和败亡将是你对那日唯一的记忆。

但我记得的却不同。我看到的，是在你极力反对的情况下，炎阳的炙热能量缔结的同盟。这才是我的记忆。

如果有一天我们的火焰终将摇曳熄灭，请让它点燃你的生命。

3382391785.name: Sentinel
3382391785.subtitle: Valiant heart, unwavering resolve.
3382391785.subtitle_zh: 勇敢的初衷，毫不动摇的决心。
3382391785.text:
I'm shaking, hands on my knees, panting. Let the monsters come. Let them come forever. Let them climb the piled bodies of their dead. I don't care. That's the thing I do better than anyone. Not care. Let them come in their hundreds and every one will die at my feet. I don't care about their homing rockets, their exotic matter slugs, their blades from another dimension. 

I don't care because I cannot be moved. I am the wall against which the Darkness breaks. 

Malphur can turn his gun to fire and Shinobu can dance with lightning, but when the horrors run out of the dark, I am the one who does not move.  

I am a wall. And walls don't move. Because walls don't care.
3382391785.text_zh:
双手搭在膝盖上，我在颤抖，在喘息。怪兽尽管来吧，让他们有去无回，让他们尸横遍野。我不在乎。我比所有人都擅长的就是漠不关心。让他们成百上千蜂拥而来，反正他们都会死在我的脚下。我不在乎他们的自引导火箭、异域物质弹药还是来自另一维度的利刃。

我不在乎因为我无可撼动。我就是抵抗暗黑力量的高墙。

马福尔化枪为火，忍野与闪电共舞，但面对从黑暗中奔出的那些恐怖，我才是无可撼动的那个人。

我是一堵墙，一堵不可撼动的墙。因为高墙不会在乎。

1751782730.name: Stormcaller
1751782730.subtitle: Harmony within, hurricane without.
1751782730.text:
The hurricane battered me with a ferocity beyond any foe I had met, battered harder than the roiling chaos in my mind that drove me here, to the ends of the system, in search of— 

"Calm," whispered the Voidwalker. "Burn!" roared the Dawnblade. All I could hear was the impassive voices of my teachers, encouraging me (ordering me?) to find my path, find it soon, no matter the risk, because we can never know when it will all be taken away again, when the storm will overtake us. Words, buffeting me like the hail that pelted my face as I pushed through the howling winds, forced my way through to the eye of— 

Peace. 

The stillness of the hurricane's eye prickled my skin and brought with it realization. We don't have to choose between the calm and the storm. In fact, to have either, we must have both. 

That was the day I first called the storm.
1751782730.text_zh:
飓风肆虐，比我见过的任何一个敌人都要狂恶，比驱使我到此的脑中滚滚混乱还要严峻。我来到这星系的尽头，是为了寻找——

“平静，”虚行小声说道。“炽灼！”破晓喊道。而我听见的只有老师们冷漠的声音，鼓励我（命令我？）找寻我自己的路，尽早找到，无论有多艰险。因为我们永远不会知道什么时候它会被别人再次抢夺，而我们什么时候又会被风暴卷走。当我在呼啸的狂风中前进时，这些话仿佛砸在我脸上的冰雹一般打击着我，伴随我挣扎着前往——

安宁。

飓风眼的沉寂刺痛我皮肤，让我幡然醒悟。我们不需要从平静和狂风中做出选择。事实上，无论我们想要哪一个，都必须接受二者。

就是在那一天，我第一次召唤了风暴。

3481861797.name: Dawnblade
3481861797.subtitle: Spread your wings and set the sky ablaze.
3481861797.text:
A young—by Warlock standards—apprentice holds out a hand and reaches for flame. Nothing. The wizened teacher laughs. “You're supposed to be teaching me. Not laughing.” 

The teacher's arm extends as one word hangs in the air, “Sword.” As quickly as it appeared, the blade vanishes. “That doesn't help.” 

“Sword.” In a flash, the blade appears again, this time at the student's throat. Both pairs of eyes widened. One aghast, one aglow. “Say it with me.” 

Two voices ring: “Sword.” 

A blade appears in each outstretched hand. A pair of wings form on each Warlock's back. Two Warlocks take flight and vow to never again look down.
3481861797.text_zh:
一个年轻——按照术士的标准来说——的学徒将手伸向火焰。什么都没有发生。干瘦的老师大笑起来。“你应该教我怎么做，而不是笑。”

老师伸出胳膊，缓慢地说出一个字，“剑”。这把利刃消失的速度就像出现时一样快。“这毫无帮助啊。”

“剑。”刹那间，利刃再次出现，这次剑锋直指学徒的喉咙。两双眼睛同时瞪大，一双惊恐，一双发亮。“跟我一起说。”

两个声音同时响起：“剑”。

两个术士伸出的手上都出现了一把利刃，各自也展开了一对翅膀。术士飞入空中，立誓永不低头下望。

3887892656.name: Voidwalker
3887892656.subtitle: Those who have stared into the Void are not bound by the laws of space and time.
3887892656.subtitle_zh: 那些盯着虚空的人不受空间和时间法则的束缚。
3887892656.text:
The streets were chaos. We fell under Cabal bullets and blades; red was the color of the day. Everywhere, red. Darkness found me three times that day and each time Ghost woke me, I woke to ever more red. I looked to the sky, but even there I saw nothing but the red reflection of a civilization burning to ash. Hope faded with the last of my Light; this was where I would meet my final death. 

A flash of violet pulled my eyes from down sight. A Cabal ship careened out of the smoke, burning black-indigo. And I saw her, riding the wing, but she was gone in a blink as the ship smashed into the earth. She reappeared in the middle of a legion, and in a second half-heartbeat, rose into the air and dropped an explosion of void the likes of which I'd never seen. 

I had believed I was a Voidwalker… until I beheld Ikora Rey.
3887892656.text_zh:
街道混乱不堪。我们倒在卡巴尔的子弹和利刃之下；那日的天空一片猩红。猩红，成为了世界的主色调。那天我被暗影军团发现了三次，机灵每复活我一次，眼前的血色就深一层。我望向天空，但连天空映射的都是一个文明被燃为灰烬时的红光。希望随着我体内最后的光能一同消逝；这里就是我的藏身之地吧。

从瞄准镜中我看到一道蓝紫色的光闪过。一艘卡巴尔飞船拖着黑靛色的尾焰在烟雾中消失。我看到了她，挥着翅膀，随着飞船撞向地面瞬间消失。她重新出现在军团中间，在心跳的那一秒，冲向高空投下了虚空炸弹，我从未见过如此威力的爆炸。

我曾经坚信自己是一名虚行……直到我见到了艾可拉·蕾伊。

1079922995.name: Eriana's Vengeance
1079922995.subtitle: "Wei… I will see you again. But first… I have work to do." —Eriana-3, before entering the Hellmouth
1079922995.subtitle_zh: “卫……再会。不过首先……我有工作要做。”——爱莲娜-3在进入地狱入口前说
1079922995.text:
To Wei Ning— 
More than anything, I hate the idea that we will be remembered as a tragedy. That's not true. I reserve that distinction for the monster that took you from me. But I know it's what you would hate the most. You, who were always so full of laughter. 

So now, in this moment, as the ship named for my vengeance flies me and five others to Luna, I will remember the happy times. 

Our first meeting, in the Tower saloon. Your laugh made the glasses clatter. You bought three rounds for the entire room. Pahanin introduced us. You sat me down next to you and plied me with questions about Stormtrances. All things that on any other night would have annoyed me. But that night—because it was you—I knew then and there that I never wanted to be without you.
1079922995.text_zh:
致韦宁——
一想到我们将被当做悲剧遗留世间，我就万般不爽，因为那不是事实啊。我保留了那个你从我身边带走的怪兽身上的特点。但我知道你最讨厌这事了。你啊，总是那么开心。

所以现在，就是现在，我和其他五位船员，乘着这艘以我的复仇为名的飞船驶向月球。我会记住那些欢乐时光。

我们的第一次见面，是在高塔沙龙。你的笑声震得玻璃杯相互碰撞，清脆得嘎哒嘎哒响。你请在场所有人喝了三轮。帕哈宁介绍我们认识。你让我坐在你旁边，缠着问我关于雷霆万钧的问题。你知道吗，我曾度过的每个夜晚，每一件事都令我烦心不已。只有那夜——因为有你——我知道从那以后我不愿度过没有你的夜晚。

2306463325.name: Symmetry Flight
2306463325.subtitle: "To have Light, we must have Dark. This is the symmetry of the Universe." —Controversial Warlock Ulan-Tan
2306463325.subtitle_zh: “想要有光，就必须先有黑暗。这就是宇宙的对称性。”——争议术士，乌兰-坦
2306463325.text:
I propose a simple experiment—look around. You see light. You see darkness. There could not be one without the other. They are two sides of the same coin. 

If it is true for these Newtonian echoes, why would it not be true of the purest, paracausal forms? 

Therefore, I conclude: the reason you persecute me is not because of the symmetry. It's because of the truth beyond this truth, the truth which you most dread: if we could destroy darkness, but we had to give up our Light to do so, how many of us would make that trade?
2306463325.text_zh: 我提出一个简单的实验——环顾四周。你看光，你看阴影。它们无法独立存在而没有彼此。它们是硬币的正反面。如果这些牛顿尼亚回声是真的，那为什么不是最纯粹的简单的形式呢？因此，我得出结论是：你迫害我的原因不是因为对称性。而是因为超越这个真相的真理，你最害怕的真理：如果我们能够摧毁黑暗，但我们不得不放弃光能，有多少人会做这个交易？

2107143042.name: Takanome Wings
2107143042.subtitle: "Follow the blue flowers to the City. And know that even if the planter is dead, they still watch over you." —Ayane Takanome
2107143042.subtitle_zh: “跟随蓝色花朵前往圣城。即便种花者已经死去，他们仍然指引着你。”——鹰目彩音
2107143042.text:
The City's first protectors were Ayane Takanome and her Rangers. 

In the darkest days, we didn't have many Guardians. And those who Ghosts had revived were scattered across the solar system, far from the people who needed protection as they made their way to the City in the Traveler's shadow. 

From their perches high up in the mountains, the Takanome Rangers guarded the refugee roads to the City. Their rifles brought down many Fallen, as well as human bandits and murderers. 

But Rangers only had one life to give. When they died, they were gone forever. So the Takanome Rangers took to planting blue flowers along the roads they watched. That way, when they fell, a piece of them would live on to guide weary travelers home.
—Chiyoko Mey, Daito President
2107143042.text_zh:
圣城的第一位保护者是鹰目彩音和她的游骑兵。

在最黑暗的日子里，我们没有那么多的守护者。被机灵复活的人分散在太阳系中，和在旅行者阴影下圣城中需要保护的人们相隔甚远。

鹰目游骑兵守卫着从山上栖息地前往圣城的逃亡道路。他们手中的步枪放倒了那么多堕落者，以及人类的强盗和凶手。

但游骑兵只有一次生命。当他们倒下，就无法复生。因此鹰目游骑兵在他们行进的沿路种满了蓝色的花朵。这样，当他们陨落时，这些美丽的花朵依然能够指引疲惫的旅行者回家。
——Daito总裁，梅千代子

1006492270.name: Ego and Squid
1006492270.subtitle: Pahanin was a Hunter, satirist, travel writer, and renowned cephalopod enthusiast.
1006492270.subtitle_zh: 帕哈宁是一位猎人、讽刺作家、旅行作家和著名的头足类生物爱好者。
1006492270.text:
Why “Ego and Squid”? Chiefly because puns annoy Kabr, and I enjoy annoying Kabr. 
You know, the pun is an underrated art form. Historically speaking— 
Oh. You mean, why squids? What's my “thing” with squids? 
Why, because cephalopods are the most perfect organisms ever to evolve in this solar system! 
Have you ever heard a cephalopod sneer dismissively at a clever pun? 
No, you have not! 
I rest my case!
1006492270.text_zh:
为什么是“自我与鱿鱼”？主要是因为卡布尔讨厌双关语，而我喜欢捉弄卡布尔。
你知道，双关语是种被低估的艺术。从历史上来说——
哦，你是问，为什么是鱿鱼？我喜欢鱿鱼的什么吗？
为什么，因为头足类动物是在这个太阳系中进化最完美的生物！
你听说过哪个头足类对巧妙的双关语嗤之以鼻吗？
没有，没有过吧！
以上！

2109464173.name: The Bandwagon
2109464173.subtitle:
"Because a group of coyotes is a band!" —Therin Vai
"I refuse to call it that."—Nadiya
2109464173.subtitle_zh:
“因为一群丛林狼也可以算是一个队伍！”——索林·怀依
“我可不这么认为。”——纳迪亚
2109464173.text:
Well, Micah-10 and Conar found three more Guardians willing to come to Coyote. None of them look thrilled to be here. I wonder what Micah's paying them. When I asked her if five Guardians would be enough to protect us from the Kings, she launched into a speech about how being a Guardian means protecting people no matter what. 

I know what that means: “Five is not enough. Everyone here is going to die.” 

I could run. Same fantasy I've been nursing for years: rappel down from the eastern tallwalk, make for the coast. Conar says that tunnel I can see from the tallwalk—it's full of Fallen. Open spaces like the road are safer. With this information I could probably make it ten whole kilometers from the village before I'm killed.  

That's four more than I could have otherwise. Maybe it's worth a shot. 

—Diary of Himura Shinobu
2109464173.text_zh:
好吧，米迦-10和康纳又找到了三名愿意加入丛林狼队伍的守护者。他们看起来都不怎么高兴。我不知道米迦答应了他们什么。我问她五名守护者够不够保护我们免受国王的侵害时，她开始长篇大论，说作为守护者就应该无条件保护人民。

我知道她什么意思：“五个不够。在这儿的每个人都死定了。”

我可以逃跑啦。我多年一直演练着这个幻想：从东边的高道绳降而下，那里可以直接通到海岸。康纳说的可以从高道上看到的隧道——那里面全都是堕落者。反而像马路那样的开阔空间更安全。这样的话，我至少可以在被干掉之前逃出村子十公里。

比我想象的多出四公里。或许值得试一试。

——忍野绯村的日记

1488920815.name: Rose and Bone
1488920815.subtitle: In his strong hand the man held a Rose. And his aura burned bright.
1488920815.subtitle_zh: 他强壮的手中紧握着一支玫瑰。而他的气场亮得发烫。
1488920815.text:
Dredgen Yor. Shin Malphur. The showdown at Dwindler's Ridge. Every Gunslinger knows the legend, and if they say they don't, they're lying. Two men go up the ridge to settle their differences. Day and night. Right and wrong. Dredgen Yor's got the black gun Thorn which I ain't of a mind to talk about, except how that gun took everything from Shin. So Shin draws on Yor. Shin draws quicker and he gets the last word. 

See? Shin Malphur got the first shot. It's not the second or third or fourth that counts; it's that first shot. Now I am a Gunslinger, and my heart's more or less a cannon, and my purpose is to land that first shot. One shot. You take it and you don't get a second.
1488920815.text_zh:
德瑞捷·侑。骏·马尔福。决战温德乐之巅。每个枪手都知道这个传说，如果他们否认，那就是在说谎。两个男人在城墙之上为纷争画个句号。黑与白，对与错。德瑞捷·侑用的是一把黑色的荆棘，不必介绍太多，但那把枪曾经带走了骏的一切。骏出枪指向侑。骏扳机扣动得更快，笑到了最后。 

明白了吗？骏·马尔福开的第一枪，不是第二第三第四；是第一枪。我现在是名枪手，我的心或多或少也是个手炮，我追求的就是第一枪。只要第一枪就不需要第二枪的第一枪。

2819070276.name: Vanishing Point
2819070276.subtitle: "Definition: the point at which you're so far behind, you can't even see me anymore." —Cron-8
2819070276.subtitle_zh: “定义：你已如此落后，以至于根本看不见我。”——科隆8号
2819070276.text:
Hi Cron, 
Got your mail about the new Sparrow engine idea. I gotta say, I've seen engines that manipulate space-time to make parallel lines converge. It's not too different from how NLS drives work. But what you might notice about an NLS drive is that the jumpship it's affixed to is usually activating it OUTSIDE a planetary gravity well. Sparrows don't exactly have that luxury. Not yet, anyway. 

Now that's not me saying no. All I'm saying is, we're gonna have to get creative. Stop by the hangar when you get the chance. I've got a few ideas I think you'll like. 
—Amanda
2819070276.text_zh:
嗨科隆，
我收到你关于快雀引擎想法的邮件了。我得说，我见过操纵时空、能让平行线相交的引擎。和空载启动工作的方式差不多。但有关空载启动值得注意的一点是，附着的跃迁飞船通常是从行星重力井的外侧激活的。快雀并没有那种奢侈的配件。至少目前还没有。

但这不代表我否决了这个点子。我的意思是，我们要更有创意一些。有机会的话来机库一下。我有几个你应该会喜欢的点子。
——阿曼达

2819070277.name: Dinas Emrys
2819070277.subtitle: "Watch for the red dragon. Here's a hint: it'll be ahead of you." —Ariadne Gris
2819070277.subtitle_zh: “小心红龙。给你个提示：它会出现在你前方。”——阿里阿德涅·格里斯
2819070277.text:
Consensus Meeting 3234.43 
Zavala: “Guardian Ariadne Gris. Have you had contact with an Ahamkara?” 
Ariadne Gris: “No!” 
New Monarchy: “Then why does your Sparrow bear a dragon logo?” 
AG: “Because dragons are cool.” 
NM: “If Ms. Gris won't take this seriously—” 
Cayde-6: “Play nice, Ari. Hideo's knickers are real tight today.”  
AG: “I thought a dragon'd look cool on my Sparrow. Not all dragons are Ahamkaras!” 
Z: “Ikora? Your perspective?” 
Ikora Rey: “I'm sorry, I wasn't paying attention. Are we really still talking about this?” 
Dead Orbit: *muffled laughter* 
IR: “Obviously Gris has not had contact with an Ahamkara.” 
FWC: “How do you know?” 
IR: “If she had, she'd win SRL more often.” 
C6: *whistle* 
AG: “Harsh, Rey.” 
Z: “Then let the record show: the Consensus's official stance on the Dinas Emrys dragon symbol is: cool.”
2819070277.text_zh:
元老院会议3234.43
萨瓦拉：“守护者阿里阿德涅·格里斯。你与阿罕卡拉有任何联系吗？”
格里斯：“没有！”
新王派：“那为什么你的快雀上面会有龙的标志？”
格里斯：“因为龙很酷。”
新王派：“如果格里斯女士不认真对待这件事的话……”
凯德6号：“配合点儿吧，阿里。秀夫的神经今天绷得很紧。”
格里斯：“我觉得在我的快雀上印一只龙看起来会很酷。不是所有的龙都是阿罕卡拉！”
萨瓦拉：“艾可拉？你什么意见？”
艾可拉·蕾伊：“不好意思，我走神儿了。我们还在讨论这个问题？”
死亡轨道：（低沉的笑声）
蕾伊：“很明显格里斯和阿罕卡拉没有联系。”
狂热者：“你怎么知道？”
蕾伊：“如果有联系的话，她肯定会多赢几次赛雀联赛的。”
凯德：（口哨声）
格里斯：“过分了啊，蕾伊。”
萨瓦拉：“记录就这么写吧：元老院对于蒂娜丝·艾姆瑞斯龙形标志的官方立场是：很酷。”

2819070278.name: Hastilude
2819070278.subtitle:
"Two words. Sparrow jousting." —Marcus Ren
"Two words. Why not?" —Amanda Holliday
2819070278.subtitle_zh:
“四个字。快雀比武。”——马库斯·伦
“两个字。来吧。”——阿曼达·霍利迪
2819070278.text:
To Ikora Rey: 
One of my undergraduate Cryptarchs has recently decrypted an engram containing twenty-second-century research on fourteenth-century European athletic pastimes—specifically, a group of mock-combat activities referred to as “hastiludes.” The engram was, of course, quite degraded, but with more intact sequences than are usually present in Golden Age specimens. Thus my undergraduate was able to extract long passages of rules and records pertaining to several types of hastiludes, including the joust, behourd, and tupinaire.  

I may be spending too much time with Guardians, because my first thoughts upon seeing these extraordinary findings were that, if the Sparrow Racing League crowd ever got their hands on them, the results would be disastrous. Imagine Guardians jousting on Sparrows! I shudder to think. 

Yours, 
Cryptarch Rahool
2819070278.text_zh:
致艾可拉·蕾伊：
我手下一位还没毕业的解密大师最近破译了一份记忆痕迹，其中包含着二十二世纪对于十四世纪欧洲体育娱乐活动的研究，其中还专门有被称为“枪术”的模拟战斗活动。当然，那份记忆痕迹被降解的已经相当严重，但有着许多常见于黄金时代样本中的完整序列。因此我的人能够提取出大段有关多种枪术对决规则和记录的文章，包括枪术比赛，野战对抗和马术比赛。

我可能是和守护者在一起的时间太久了，因为我看到这些非凡发现的第一反应是，如果赛雀联赛的观众知道这些信息，结局一定很灾难。想象一下，守护者们驾驶快雀进行快雀枪术比武！想想就令人发抖。

你的，
解密大师拉乎尔

2505533224.name: Ghost Primus
2505533224.subtitle: The Ghost Primus was strong because of his disfigurement, not in spite of it. He alone had the vision to share my dream of a new, perfect world. Ghaul was a creature of singular beauty, and I loved him.
2505533224.subtitle_zh: 幽灵军团长的毁容相貌正是他强大的原因。他会和我分享我梦想中的全新完美的世界。盖欧是一个奇特尤物，我曾爱他。
2505533224.text:
Ghaul was an unexpected gift to my coliseum—a disfigured albino from the outer wastes who defeated opponents three times his weight. How could I resist such a unique creature? 

He fought with terrible discipline and patience. Most gladiators wanted to stand in the center of the arena and trade blows until the weaker one died. Not Ghaul. He never attacked from the front, never stood in one place. Frustrated and exhausted, his opponent would make a mistake. 

I used to play a game with those puffed-up aristocrats that would gamble at my arena. I bet on Ghaul, and anyone who had displeased me had to bet against him. It was fun for a time, but his talent was too valuable to risk in the coliseum. I appointed him Primus of the Red Legion and instead, set him loose upon my enemies.
2505533224.text_zh:
盖欧是我大竞技场里的一个意外收获——一位来自外太空垃圾堆的、毁容了的白化病病人，却击败了三倍于他体重的敌人。我怎么能拒绝一个如此独特的生物呢？

他战斗起来毫无纪律和耐心。大部分角斗士想要站在竞技场的中心和对手厮杀，直到弱的一方死掉为止。但盖欧不是。他从不从正面进攻，也从不在同一个位置停留。对手因此感到疲惫且受挫，从而犯下错误。

我曾经和那些自负的贵族们在我的竞技场玩一种赌博游戏。我把筹码押在盖欧身上，所有让我不爽的人都必须押在他对手身上。来上这么一次还是挺有趣的，但他的才华太珍贵了，不应该在大竞技场里冒险。我任命他为猩红军团的军团长，让他自由屠杀我的敌人。

1128225405.name: Midnight Coup
1128225405.subtitle: The conspirators were too afraid to kill me—rightly so. I am the beloved father of the people, and the glorious mob would not suffer my death. My sentence was exile.
1128225405.subtitle_zh: 阴谋家们太害怕杀死我了——当然如此。我是人们爱戴的家长，荣耀暴民不会判我死刑的。我的判决是流放。
1128225405.text:
The conspirators came late in the night, skulking into my court while we caroused. Ghaul himself led the coup, and it was by his own Red Legion that we were arrested. 

Imagine my surprise to see the Consul stride into my court so puffed up with pride. He took cheap pleasure hurling spittle in my face. We were frog marched to the Leviathan under cover of darkness. 

There was to be no execution; Ghaul and the Consul feared the mob. They knew how tenuous their grip on power would be, and how the people adored their god-emperor. 

Ghaul dared not look me in the eye. What was the emotion on his face? Was it shame? How could he bear such hate for one who had been as a father to him? 

We were sealed inside the Leviathan and ejected into the furthest reaches of space, left to the same fate I had determined for the Consul so long ago. We were left to die.
1128225405.text_zh:
阴谋家们在深夜前来，在我们饮酒作乐时潜入我的宫殿。领导政变的是盖欧本人，我们就是被他手下的猩红军团抓捕的。

你能想象当我看到领事大步踱入宫殿时有多惊讶吗？他粗鲁地朝我脸上猛啐一口。我们是在黑暗笼罩下向利维坦挺进的青蛙。

没有处决；盖欧和领事对暴民心存忌惮。他们知道他们对权力的掌控有多么不稳定，而人民又是如此崇拜他们如神的帝王。

盖欧不敢直视我的眼睛。他脸上那是什么表情？是羞愧吗？他是如何忍受对这个曾经像父亲一样的人的恨？

我们被关在利维坦中，被弹射到太空的最边缘，落得个很久以前我为领事决定的相同命运。我们被抛弃，等待死亡。

3325744914.name: Inaugural Address
3325744914.subtitle: My first act as emperor was to send the Consul into the wasteland. The golden sun would burn away his corrupt form—a fitting symbol for the revolution that was to be my reign.
3325744914.subtitle_zh: 我成为帝王后的第一个决定就是把领事发配到荒原去。金黄的太阳会燃尽他的腐败外表——这是我统治变革的象征。
3325744914.text:
I wanted a desert of pure white sand to stage my celebration. It took them three days to clear the wasteland of any stone or plant of offending color, but when they were done, it was a perfect canvas for the violet pavilion. We recreated my court in nearly every detail beneath the glinting sun. 

 The first act of my coronation was to have the Consul kneel at my feet. He was a pathetic figure, stripped of title, rank, and clothing. He would never wield power again, and would beget no heir. I made sure of that personally. 

I had only a single word for him: "Run."
3325744914.text_zh:
我想要一片纯白色沙砾构成的沙漠来作为典礼舞台。他们花了三天的时间清理了荒原上各种异色的石头或植物。他们完成时，那洁白的砂砾和紫罗兰的阁楼简直是绝配。我们将宫殿建在了闪耀的阳光下，还原了几乎每一个细节。

我加冕仪式后做的第一件事，就是让领事跪在我的面前。他真可怜，被罢免、被剥夺军衔，甚至被扒光了衣服。他将永远不会再操纵权力，也不能再诞下子嗣。这一点是我亲手处理的。

我只送了他一个字：“滚。”

3691881271.name: Sins of the Past
3691881271.subtitle: What once was old shall be knew again, and history will have its revenge.
3691881271.subtitle_zh: 古老的东西将被重新认知，历史将会为自己复仇。
3691881271.text:
I weep for what the Cabal have become—a war machine forged in Ghaul's own image. His obsession with the ideal form has produced a hollow people devoid of culture, robbed of their history. 

The Leviathan is now home to the last of us true Cabal. We will remember the old ways, for I am the wellspring from which our great civilization flows. 

And when my empire returns, the traitors will see us as through a dark mirror. We will be a terrifying reminder of their former selves. In that moment, they will feel the shame of their betrayal. They will know I have come for my revenge. 

The Red Legion will not escape the sins of their past. They shall be consumed by them.
3691881271.text_zh:
我为卡巴尔的下场感到伤悲——盖欧用自己的形象将他们打造成了战争机器。那份对理想形式的痴迷打造出了一个没有文化，没有历史的族群。

利维坦现在是我们这些仅剩的真正的卡巴尔家园。我们不会遗忘古老之道，因为我就是我们伟大文明传承的源泉。

当我的帝国回归时，我们将是他们的黑镜子，是对过去他们所作所为的可怕提醒者。在那一刻，他们将感受到背叛的耻辱。他们将看到我的复仇。

猩红军团将永远逃脱不了过去罪孽的牢笼。他们会被罪孽吞噬。

3906942101.name: Conspirator
3906942101.subtitle: Did Ghaul always dream of a republic? What terrible worm burrowed into his heart that he would betray my love and plot against me?
3906942101.subtitle_zh: 盖欧一直梦想着建立共和国吗？到底是什么可怕的蛀虫钻进了他的心里，让他背叛了我的爱的同时还密谋对付我？
3906942101.text:
Ghaul spent too much time in too close communion with those I had humbled. No good would come of those hushed tones and sidelong glances. Did he think I would not notice? 

I dispatched a spy to follow him. To think that I felt guilt in that moment; one should never doubt their gut when it comes to trust in another.  

I realize now what I should have realized then. As I am like no other, then no other is alone as I. What a curse it is to be a god that loves!
3906942101.text_zh:
盖欧花了太多时间在与我的手下败将近距离交流上。那些轻语和斜窥能代表什么好结果。他以为我会注意不到吗？

我派了一个间谍跟踪他。你可以认为我在那一刻其实产生了某种负罪感；但当需要将信任交给别人时，也不能怀疑自己的直觉。

我现在意识到了当时就应该意识到的事。既然我与他人不同，他人也不会如我一般孤独。成为爱世人的神真的是种诅咒！

3380742308.name: Alone as a God
3380742308.subtitle: I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me.
3380742308.subtitle_zh: 每个谈论起我的人都激动到发抖，我就是至善爱神。
3380742308.text:
My imperial guard marched into the temple where the senate convened. They formed a protective circle from which I might bestow the gift of my address. 

"From this day forward, I shall take up all the empire in my embrace. For I am father of the empire, as I am father to all creation. I will suffer no tired institution nor petty bureaucrat to stand between me and my children. I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me." 

The imperial guard charged their rail guns in perfect unison.
3380742308.text_zh:
我的帝国守卫步入了议会召开的神庙。他们形成了一个保护圈以便我可以开始我的演讲。

“从今天开始，我会欣然接管帝国之土。我是帝国的主人，我是世间万物的主人。在我和我的子民之间，将不会再有令人生厌的组织和琐碎的官僚主义。每个谈论起我的人都激动到发抖，我就是至善爱神。”

帝国守卫以完美步调为磁道炮上了膛。

3954531357.name: Mob Justice
3954531357.subtitle: Life offers few greater pleasures than to humiliate the venal aristocracy before a crowd. I am father to the people, and they shall adore me above all others.
3954531357.subtitle_zh: 人生中没有什么是比在大众面前羞辱腐败贵族更令人享受的事了。我是人民的家长，他们应该最为崇拜我。
3954531357.text:
I never thought of my palace as the true court. The only throne that mattered to me looked down upon the public commons. From that seat, there was no barrier between me and the glorious, adoring mob. I was their father; they were my children. 

It was there that I brought the corrupt to suffer the people's justice. How they cried as I threw their riches to the crowd. It amused me to see the dawning of realization in their eyes—there would be no safety for them, as there had been no safety for those they had made to suffer. 

One by one, I tossed those weeping fools to the people. The mob let out a great cry of joy and stripped them of their robes, tore the jewelry from their bodies.
3954531357.text_zh:
我从未把我的宫殿看做真正的宫廷。对我来说，真正的王位是那个俯瞰普罗大众的王座。在那王座上，我与那些充满荣耀和爱慕的暴民之间毫无隔阂。我是他们的家长，他们是我的子民。

在那里，我将腐朽暴露于天下，接受人民的审判。当我将他们的财富扔向人群时，我听到了他们的哭喊和人群的雀跃。看到腐朽们的眼中开始出现现实的曙光时，我感到愉悦——他们不再安全，就像被他们折磨过的人一样不安全。

一个接着一个，我把那些擦着眼泪的傻瓜丢入人群。暴民们爆发出喜悦的呐喊，剥下了他们的袍子，扯下了他们身上的珠宝。

1018072983.name: It Stared Back
1018072983.subtitle: At the edge of the universe, I stared into the infinite deep. It stared back, and was pleased. I would become the herald of its victory, and bear witness for all creation.
1018072983.subtitle_zh: 在宇宙的边缘，我凝视着无尽的深空。它也反过来注视我，我感到了它的愉悦。我会成为它胜利的使者，见证万物生长。
1018072983.text:
The Leviathan came to a halt before a wall of infinite void. It could go no further, as the navigation system had suffered a cataclysmic failure. The course that the conspirators had set crossed a space that simply didn't exist. 

I don't know how long we traveled. Years? Millennia? Time had ceased to have meaning as I wallowed in the despair of my exile. But this event shook me out of my stupor. At the edge of the universe, we had found something. No—we had found a nothing. 

From the seat of my observation chamber, I stared into the perfect void. Only I, a god, could understand what I witnessed. It was a thing greater than myself. And if such a thing exists, then I, too, can become more.
1018072983.text_zh:
利维坦在一堵无尽虚空之墙前停了下来。导航系统彻底崩溃，无法再继续前进了。阴谋家们设定的路线穿过了一个根本不存在的空间。

我不知道我们走了多久。几年？一千年？在沉溺于被放逐的绝望后，时间变得不再有意义。但这件事让我从恍惚中惊醒。在宇宙的边缘，我们找到了某个存在。不——我们找到了“不存在”。

坐在观察室的座位上，我凝视着完美虚空。只有，我，一位神祇，才能懂得我目睹了什么。一个比我自己更伟大的存在。若此物存在，那么，我，也将变得更强大。

1909527967.name: Prosecutor
1909527967.subtitle: "All this in service of one purpose. You have their attention. Let us see if you can keep it." —Emissary of the Nine
1909527967.subtitle_zh: “所有这些都是为了一个目的。你引起他们的注意了。看看你能不能保持住。”——玖的使者
1909527967.text:
A COURT 
A  V A U L T 
A Maelstrom. 
a cauldron 
A realm. 
A VOID 
A N  E Q U I N O X 
A meridian. 
A  S H I F T 
certainly 
Trials no more. Not like they were. 
A KEEP 
A  P A R A L L A X 
An apex. 
a plane 
A COURT 
A  V A U L T 
A Maelstrom. 
a cauldron. 
Of what? 
OF STARS 
O F  N I N E
1909527967.text_zh:
一座宫廷

2850415208.name: Judgment
2850415208.subtitle: "The greatest threat to a Guardian is another Guardian." —Emissary of the Nine
2850415208.subtitle_zh: “对一名守护者来说，最大的威胁是其他守护者。”——玖的使者
2850415208.text:
You sought us out. 
IN SOME SMALL WAY, YOU FOUND US. 
But discovery always has a price. With curiosity comes consequence. 
S H E I S N O T R E A D Y 
SEEK JUDGMENT. GROW.
2850415208.text_zh:
你找到我们了。
某种程度上来说，你找到了我们。
发现总是有代价的。好奇心导致结果。
她 还 没 有 准 备 好
寻求审判。成长。

1187594591.name: Relentless
1187594591.subtitle: "Embrace your fate." —Emissary of the Nine
1187594591.text:
do you hear us 
YOU WANTED POWER 
It is not for you. 
W E H A V E A T A S K F O R  Y O U 
FIND THE WORTHY. BRING THEM. 
three keys 
THREE ARE REQUIRED 
Show them. 
E M P H A S I Z E I T 
EVERYTHING DIES. THEY ARE NO EXCEPTION. 
we're immortals, they'll say 
C O R R E C T.  
And yet, who dies more than they do? 
N O N E 
only when they accept this can they be born anew 
BE RELENTLESS.
1187594591.text_zh:
你听得到吗
你想要的力量
并不属于你。
有 个 任 务 要 交 给 你
找到有价值的人。把他们带回来。
三把钥匙
需要三把
证明给他们看
重 点
万物皆会逝去。没有例外。
我们是不死之身，他们会这么说
没 错 。
然而，谁又比他们死得多？
没 有 人
只有当他们接受死亡时他们才能重生
要冷酷无情。

1825472716.name: The End
1825472716.subtitle: "Show them that safe harbor is very far away." —Emissary of the Nine
1825472716.subtitle_zh: “告诉他们，避风港很遥远。”——玖的使者
1825472716.text:
THE RED SHIPS ENTER 
THE AIR IS HEAVY. 
Now, when you move, you can actually FEEL the weight of the world. 
This weight is a gift. 
you finally have our attention
1825472716.text_zh:
红色飞船进入视线
空气沉重
如今，你每移动一步，都能真实感知到世界的重量。
那重量是一份礼物。
你终于引起了我们的注意

1879212553.name: A Sudden Death
1879212553.subtitle: "Everything dies. This is proof." —Emissary of the Nine
1879212553.subtitle_zh: “万物终有一死。此为证据。”——玖的使者
1879212553.text:
You spoke with the deep-orbit minds. 
we heard what you asked 
BUT THEY HAD QUESTIONS TOO 
The lying robot no longer lies with others. Where is he?
1879212553.text_zh:
你和深轨思维交谈的时候。
我们听到你的疑问
但他们也有疑问
那个说谎的机器人不再说谎了。他去哪儿了？

3854037060.name: A Swift Verdict
3854037060.subtitle: "Judgment is final." —Emissary of the Nine
3854037060.text:
we were young once 
YOU WENT MAD TRYING TO UNDERSTAND 
W E W E N T M A D T R Y I N G T O S P E A K 
This doesn't matter. 
when you are ready we will take it from you 
AND YOU WILL BE GLAD OF IT
3854037060.text_zh:
我们都曾年轻过
你为了尝试理解而愤怒
我 们 为 了 尝 试 表 达 而 愤 怒
不过没关系。
当你准备好的时候，我们将把这份愤怒从你心中带走
而你，将会倍感愉悦

174804903.name: The Long Walk
174804903.subtitle: "There is an end to everything." —Emissary of the Nine
174804903.text:
[Eight sparks. A ninth, dim in the corner. And Orin in the middle.] 
ORIN: Are we all here? Come into the light, please. 
G-9: I like where I am. 
ORIN: They said you all went to the deep without a ship. How? 
G-7: Our charges are gone, but we're still creatures of Light. No different from the one you carry in your pocket. 
ORIN: You're all either very brave or very foolish. 
G-6: You sound like Shaxx. 
G-5: She does. I'm glad my charge is gone. 
G-4: Don't say that. 
G-5: It's true. 
G-4: Don't say it out loud. Some of us go our whole lives without finding one. Show some respect. 
G-5: Don't talk like you're better than me. You're in here, too. 
ORIN: Please. I'm sorry to call you all here, but— 
G-2: You're not sorry. 
ORIN: I need to know what you found out there. 
G-9: Nothing. 
ORIN: At least give me the coordinates.
174804903.text_zh:
[八个火花。还有第九个，在角落发着微弱的光。奥琳站在它们中间。]
奥琳：都到齐了吗？请进到光里面。
机-9：我就想待在这儿。
奥琳：他们说你们在没有飞船的情况下就前往了深空。怎么办到的？
机-7：我们无法充能，但我们依然是光能的产物。和你带在口袋里的那个没有区别。
奥琳：你们如果不是非常勇敢，就是非常愚蠢。
机-6：这口气听起来像沙克斯。
机-5：确实像。很高兴我无法充能。
机-4：别那么说。
机-5：是真的。
机-4：那也别说那么大声。我们之中有些人穷极一生也无法充一次能。给点儿面子。
机-5：别说的好像你比我强一样。你不是也在这里。
奥琳：拜托。不好意思把你们都叫过来，但——
机-2：没什么不好意思的。
奥琳：我想知道你们在那里找到了什么。
机-9：没什么。
奥琳：至少把坐标给我吧。

2094938672.name: Adjudicator
2094938672.subtitle: "Hesitation kills." —Emissary of the Nine
2094938672.text:
You sought us out in the deep black. 
meditation wasn't enough for you 
GO AND TOUCH THE HISSING SILENCE 
Do not fear being submerged. 
Not many ships go that far, these days. 
you went through hell to get one, and then again to get out there 
YOU FOUND THE DEVIL HIMSELF. 
A G O L D E N S N A K E A D E V I L W H O P O S E S A S G O D 
No more a god than you. 
YOU DIDN'T FIGHT HIM. 
Y O U T U R N E D A R O U N D S M A R T 
Others did. 
while we watched
2094938672.text_zh:
你从深邃的黑暗中找到了我们。
冥想对你来说并不足够
去触摸那嘶嘶作响的沉默吧
不要惧怕被淹没。
如今没有几艘飞船能够到那么远的地方。
你穿过地狱，再逃出那里
你 找 到 了 恶 魔 本 身 。
一 条 金 色 的 蛇 一 个 假 扮 神 祇 的 恶 魔 
你更像是神。
你没有和他作战。
你 很 聪 明 地 回 头 了
其他人也是。
在我们看着的时候

2683682446.name: Traitor's Fate
2683682446.subtitle: Let the emperor's gratitude end your foes as swiftly as you have ended his.
2683682446.subtitle_zh: 让帝国的感激之情如你结束他一样迅速了结你的敌人。
2683682446.text:
Know that I am Calus, the last and greatest emperor of the Cabal. Know that the Ghost Primus was false and that your place in my court was secured when he met the Traitor's Fate. Finally, my champion, little else stands between us.

Look to the heavens and you will see me with my arms spread wide. Fly to me and I will bathe you in gold, share the fruits of my gardens, and watch you grow dizzy on libations.

Know that my heart swells with love. I yearn to find those who can accept my gifts, who can take my hand, and share in my mirth.

Together we shall rebuild an empire.
2683682446.text_zh:
要知道，我是卡鲁斯，是卡巴尔最后也是最伟大的帝王。要知道，幽灵军团长是虚假的；他终迎来了自己的叛徒命运，而我也为你在帝国中留存了一席之地。我的勇士，你我之间终于再无阻碍了。

抬头看看天堂，你将看到翅膀伸展至天际的我。飞向我，我将用黄金沐浴你，用园中鲜果滋润你，用奠酒微醺你。

要知道，我心中满满的都是爱。我渴望寻求到有能力接受我礼物、握紧我的手、与我分享欢笑的人。

你我合作，重建帝国。

208791829.name: Midnight Coup
208791829.subtitle: The conspirators were too afraid to kill me—rightly so. I am the beloved father of the people, and the glorious mob would not suffer my death. My sentence was exile.
208791829.subtitle_zh: 阴谋家们太害怕杀死我了——当然如此。我是人们爱戴的家长，荣耀暴民不会判我死刑的。我的判决是流放。
208791829.text:
The conspirators came late in the night, skulking into my court while we caroused. Ghaul himself led the coup, and it was by his own Red Legion that we were arrested. 

Imagine my surprise to see the Consul stride into my court so puffed up with pride. He took cheap pleasure hurling spittle in my face. We were frog marched to the Leviathan under cover of darkness. 

There was to be no execution; Ghaul and the Consul feared the mob. They knew how tenuous their grip on power would be, and how the people adored their god-emperor. 

Ghaul dared not look me in the eye. What was the emotion on his face? Was it shame? How could he bear such hate for one who had been as a father to him? 

We were sealed inside the Leviathan and ejected into the furthest reaches of space, left to the same fate I had determined for the Consul so long ago. We were left to die.
208791829.text_zh:
阴谋家们在深夜前来，在我们饮酒作乐时潜入我的宫殿。领导政变的是盖欧本人，我们就是被他手下的猩红军团抓捕的。

你能想象当我看到领事大步踱入宫殿时有多惊讶吗？他粗鲁地朝我脸上猛啐一口。我们是在黑暗笼罩下向利维坦挺进的青蛙。

没有处决；盖欧和领事对暴民心存忌惮。他们知道他们对权力的掌控有多么不稳定，而人民又是如此崇拜他们如神的帝王。

盖欧不敢直视我的眼睛。他脸上那是什么表情？是羞愧吗？他是如何忍受对这个曾经像父亲一样的人的恨？

我们被关在利维坦中，被弹射到太空的最边缘，落得个很久以前我为领事决定的相同命运。我们被抛弃，等待死亡。

525018074.name: Inaugural Address
525018074.subtitle: My first act as emperor was to send the Consul into the wasteland. The golden sun would burn away his corrupt form—a fitting symbol for the revolution that was to be my reign.
525018074.subtitle_zh: 我成为帝王后的第一个决定就是把领事发配到荒原去。金黄的太阳会燃尽他的腐败外表——这是我统治变革的象征。
525018074.text:
I wanted a desert of pure white sand to stage my celebration. It took them three days to clear the wasteland of any stone or plant of offending color, but when they were done, it was a perfect canvas for the violet pavilion. We recreated my court in nearly every detail beneath the glinting sun. 

 The first act of my coronation was to have the Consul kneel at my feet. He was a pathetic figure, stripped of title, rank, and clothing. He would never wield power again, and would beget no heir. I made sure of that personally. 

I had only a single word for him: "Run."
525018074.text_zh:
我想要一片纯白色沙砾构成的沙漠来作为典礼舞台。他们花了三天的时间清理了荒原上各种异色的石头或植物。他们完成时，那洁白的砂砾和紫罗兰的阁楼简直是绝配。我们将宫殿建在了闪耀的阳光下，还原了几乎每一个细节。

我加冕仪式后做的第一件事，就是让领事跪在我的面前。他真可怜，被罢免、被剥夺军衔，甚至被扒光了衣服。他将永远不会再操纵权力，也不能再诞下子嗣。这一点是我亲手处理的。

我只送了他一个字：“滚。”

607924863.name: Sins of the Past
607924863.subtitle: What once was old shall be knew again, and history will have its revenge.
607924863.subtitle_zh: 古老的东西将被重新认知，历史将会为自己复仇。
607924863.text:
I weep for what the Cabal have become—a war machine forged in Ghaul's own image. His obsession with the ideal form has produced a hollow people devoid of culture, robbed of their history. 

The Leviathan is now home to the last of us true Cabal. We will remember the old ways, for I am the wellspring from which our great civilization flows. 

And when my empire returns, the traitors will see us as through a dark mirror. We will be a terrifying reminder of their former selves. In that moment, they will feel the shame of their betrayal. They will know I have come for my revenge. 

The Red Legion will not escape the sins of their past. They shall be consumed by them.
607924863.text_zh:
我为卡巴尔的下场感到伤悲——盖欧用自己的形象将他们打造成了战争机器。那份对理想形式的痴迷打造出了一个没有文化，没有历史的族群。

利维坦现在是我们这些仅剩的真正的卡巴尔家园。我们不会遗忘古老之道，因为我就是我们伟大文明传承的源泉。

当我的帝国回归时，我们将是他们的黑镜子，是对过去他们所作所为的可怕提醒者。在那一刻，他们将感受到背叛的耻辱。他们将看到我的复仇。

猩红军团将永远逃脱不了过去罪孽的牢笼。他们会被罪孽吞噬。

2204544573.name: Conspirator
2204544573.subtitle: Did Ghaul always dream of a republic? What terrible worm burrowed into his heart that he would betray my love and plot against me?
2204544573.subtitle_zh: 盖欧一直梦想着建立共和国吗？到底是什么可怕的蛀虫钻进了他的心里，让他背叛了我的爱的同时还密谋对付我？
2204544573.text:
Ghaul spent too much time in too close communion with those I had humbled. No good would come of those hushed tones and sidelong glances. Did he think I would not notice? 

I dispatched a spy to follow him. To think that I felt guilt in that moment; one should never doubt their gut when it comes to trust in another.  

I realize now what I should have realized then. As I am like no other, then no other is alone as I. What a curse it is to be a god that loves!
2204544573.text_zh:
盖欧花了太多时间在与我的手下败将近距离交流上。那些轻语和斜窥能代表什么好结果。他以为我会注意不到吗？

我派了一个间谍跟踪他。你可以认为我在那一刻其实产生了某种负罪感；但当需要将信任交给别人时，也不能怀疑自己的直觉。

我现在意识到了当时就应该意识到的事。既然我与他人不同，他人也不会如我一般孤独。成为爱世人的神真的是种诅咒！

2847612117.name: Mob Justice
2847612117.subtitle: Life offers few greater pleasures than to humiliate the venal aristocracy before a crowd. I am father to the people, and they shall adore me above all others.
2847612117.subtitle_zh: 人生中没有什么是比在大众面前羞辱腐败贵族更令人享受的事了。我是人民的家长，他们应该最为崇拜我。
2847612117.text:
I never thought of my palace as the true court. The only throne that mattered to me looked down upon the public commons. From that seat, there was no barrier between me and the glorious, adoring mob. I was their father; they were my children. 

It was there that I brought the corrupt to suffer the people's justice. How they cried as I threw their riches to the crowd. It amused me to see the dawning of realization in their eyes—there would be no safety for them, as there had been no safety for those they had made to suffer. 

One by one, I tossed those weeping fools to the people. The mob let out a great cry of joy and stripped them of their robes, tore the jewelry from their bodies.
2847612117.text_zh:
我从未把我的宫殿看做真正的宫廷。对我来说，真正的王位是那个俯瞰普罗大众的王座。在那王座上，我与那些充满荣耀和爱慕的暴民之间毫无隔阂。我是他们的家长，他们是我的子民。

在那里，我将腐朽暴露于天下，接受人民的审判。当我将他们的财富扔向人群时，我听到了他们的哭喊和人群的雀跃。看到腐朽们的眼中开始出现现实的曙光时，我感到愉悦——他们不再安全，就像被他们折磨过的人一样不安全。

一个接着一个，我把那些擦着眼泪的傻瓜丢入人群。暴民们爆发出喜悦的呐喊，剥下了他们的袍子，扯下了他们身上的珠宝。

2683682447.name: It Stared Back
2683682447.subtitle: At the edge of the universe, I stared into the infinite deep. It stared back, and was pleased. I would become the herald of its victory, and bear witness for all creation.
2683682447.subtitle_zh: 在宇宙的边缘，我凝视着无尽的深空。它也反过来注视我，我感到了它的愉悦。我会成为它胜利的使者，见证万物生长。
2683682447.text:
The Leviathan came to a halt before a wall of infinite void. It could go no further, as the navigation system had suffered a cataclysmic failure. The course that the conspirators had set crossed a space that simply didn't exist. 

I don't know how long we traveled. Years? Millennia? Time had ceased to have meaning as I wallowed in the despair of my exile. But this event shook me out of my stupor. At the edge of the universe, we had found something. No—we had found a nothing. 

From the seat of my observation chamber, I stared into the perfect void. Only I, a god, could understand what I witnessed. It was a thing greater than myself. And if such a thing exists, then I, too, can become more.
2683682447.text_zh:
利维坦在一堵无尽虚空之墙前停了下来。导航系统彻底崩溃，无法再继续前进了。阴谋家们设定的路线穿过了一个根本不存在的空间。

我不知道我们走了多久。几年？一千年？在沉溺于被放逐的绝望后，时间变得不再有意义。但这件事让我从恍惚中惊醒。在宇宙的边缘，我们找到了某个存在。不——我们找到了“不存在”。

坐在观察室的座位上，我凝视着完美虚空。只有，我，一位神祇，才能懂得我目睹了什么。一个比我自己更伟大的存在。若此物存在，那么，我，也将变得更强大。

1345867571.name: Coldheart
1345867571.subtitle: Leverages liquid fuel veins as self-coolant to keep onboard projection generator at biting sub-zero temperatures.
1345867571.subtitle_zh: 利用液体燃料静脉作为自冷却剂，保持板载投影发生器处于零度以下的。
1345867571.text:
The Golden Age. Our shining history. The height from which we fell. Once, everything we had was borrowed from the past. Since the Collapse we have struggled to reclaim even a scrap of what our ancestors once took for granted. Over the years, Omolon has perfected the art of salvaging Golden Age technologies and repurposing them into effective Guardian weaponry. 

But Coldheart is something new. 

We didn't find Coldheart. We didn't adapt it or recycle it. We created it. Its liquid ammo, which doubles as its coolant, is a game-changer on its own—never mind Coldheart's first-of-its-kind laser-powered trace weaponry.  

With Coldheart, we at Omolon are saying: we want more than to simply reclaim the Golden Age. We want to surpass it.
1345867571.text_zh:
黄金时代。我们闪耀的历史。也是从那时我们开始衰落。曾经，我们拥有的一切都是过去留下的。在大崩溃后，我们开始努力找寻祖先们一度认为理所当然的哪怕一块碎片。多年过去，Omolon将回收的黄金时代科技打磨完善，并将其重新应用在现有守护者武器库中。

但寒冰核心的出现是一场革新。

寒冰核心不是我们找到的，也不是我们改造或回收的。它是我们创造的。同所配置的冷却液一样，它所装填的液体子弹也是双倍数量，游戏规则就此改写——更不用提寒冰核心是第一款激光追踪武器。

我们Omolon带着寒冰核心一同保证：我们的梦想不单单局限于回收黄金时代技术，我们要超越它的辉煌。

1345867570.name: Sweet Business
1345867570.subtitle: "…I love my job."
1345867570.text:
"Hope you're happy!" That's all I remember hearin' afore she ran out in front of us. It was like somethin' out of a pre-Golden Age war flick, you know, where the hero's bud goes out in a blaze of glory so their death can be rightly avenged. Only she didn't die. They did. The weapon reeled like it was bein' held by a child doin' a pee-pee dance, aimin' at nothin' and hittin' everythin'. Dem spiders skittered for their lives. When she stopped, nothin' was moving. She saved us. 

I sidled up to her, real slow, checking out the piece and all I could do was sputter, "That there, that's some… sweet business." She looked me over cold, lowered the gun and said, "You ain't gotta tell me."
1345867570.text_zh:
“希望这样子你们能感觉好点儿！”在她跑到我们面前时我记得的只有这句。就像一些前黄金时代战争的片段闪过眼前。你知道的，就是那场战亡者都得到了应有的复仇的战争，因为英雄主义的萌芽在荣耀中绽放。其他人都死了，只有她没有。她拔出武器的动作就像小孩子在跳撒尿舞，从不瞄准，什么都打。蜘蛛都飞起来逃命。她停止射击时，万物寂静。她救了我们。

我在一旁看着她慢慢检查着那些碎尸，而我被吓得言语混乱，“那这里，那有一些……你会喜欢的东西。”她的眼睛穿过压低的冰冷的枪，盯着我，对我说，“用不着提醒我。”

4190156464.name: Merciless
4190156464.subtitle: Entropy is inevitable.
4190156464.text:
"The thought was simple enough—sync a weapon's firing and targeting systems to a caged onboard artificial intelligence programmed to actively seek fulfillment of the weapon's base driving function. Simply put, give the weapon an awareness of its purpose. 

"If the machine is meant to destroy, what would happen if we made it aware of its intended goal? 

"What would happen if it reacted to any failure to achieve that goal by focusing more intently on defining the parameters of said goal and adjusting its function to more aggressively seek out the successful execution of its purpose? 

"These are the questions we asked ourselves while engineering the initial prototype. The answers we found—I think you'll agree—were encouraging." 

– Incomplete record, author unknown
4190156464.text_zh:
“想法很简单——将武器的射击和瞄准系统同步到一个盒状机载智能程序，来主动实现武器的基础驾驭功能。简而言之，我们想为武器添加自我意识系统。

“武器机械的目的是摧毁，如果我们让它意识到这个目的，会发生什么？

“如果它更加专注于确定所述目标参数并为了成功达到预期目的将功能设置的更加激进后，对目标失败做出反应，又会发生什么？

“这些问题在我们设计原型机时已经考虑过了。我们的答案是——我想你也会同意——不要阻碍科技的进步。”

——无名氏，不完整记录

3549153978.name: Fighting Lion
3549153978.subtitle: "I call it the Zhang Fei. It hits almost as hard as I do." —Wei Ning
3549153978.subtitle_zh: “我给它起名叫张飞。它出手跟我一样狠。”—韦宁
3549153978.text:
Wei Ning punched the mountain. It moved.  A microscopic shudder, but enough to make her punch it again. "They're just angry that you keep winning without a gun." Her Ghost danced fretfully around her fist. "That's why they say these things. Jealousy." 

"I tell you," Ning grunted, shattering granite, "someday they'll lose their smart guns and fancy ships, and then they'll wish they'd listened! There's one weapon you can always count on, and it's your strong hand." 

"Eriana would be sad to hear you dismissing machines." Her Ghost bobbed slyly up to her shoulder. "Eriana would ask if those mighty hands could build a machine in the image of your strength. Just like she was made in the image of a woman." 

Wei Ning tapped her fists together. "Huh," she said.
3549153978.text_zh:
韦宁猛锤山峰。它动了。小小的颤动，但给了她再次猛击的理由。“他们只是生气你没用枪却还一直胜利而已。”她的机灵绕着她的拳头不安地跳着舞。“所以他们才这么说的啊，都是因为嫉妒。”

“我告诉你，”宁打碎了花岗岩，嘟囔着说，“总有一天，他们会失去他们所有漂亮的枪支和精美的飞船，然后他们就会后悔当初没有听从我的建议！你永远靠得住的武器，只有你强劲的拳头。”

“爱莲娜要是听说你在反对机械可是会很伤心的。”机灵调皮地跳上她的肩膀。“爱莲娜会问这些强壮的人们会不会制造一个以你的力量为形象的机器。就像她是以一个女人的形象被制造出来的一样。”

韦宁撞着双拳。“呵，”她说。

3549153979.name: The Prospector
3549153979.subtitle: "Some things should stay buried."
3549153979.text:
"Get your axe and your pick and your shovel and your spine. We're goin' prospectin'." 
"What?" 
"That. The quote. I don't get it." 
"It's an old saying. It's about puttin' in a hard day's work." 
"Seems… antiquated." 
"How so?"
"My grenade launcher's full auto and goes boom on command. What do I need hand tools for?" 
"It's a metaphor. It ain't literal. At least not anymore. Your launcher is your hand tool." 
"Ahh. Got it. Good to know."
3549153979.text_zh:
“拿起斧子，拾起铁铲，挺起腰杆。我们去挖矿。”
“什么？”
“那句，顺口溜，我没听明白。”
“是句老话。就是搬一天砖。”
“貌似……需要改一下。”
“哪有？”
“我的发射器正全自动运作，随叫随炸。那我需要手动工具做什么？”
“这是个比喻。不是字面意思。至少现在不是了。你的发射器就是你的手动工具。”
“啊，明白。这样就对了。”

2907129556.name: Sturm
2907129556.subtitle: These ancient ceremonial pistols can be dated back to the early Golden Age. A faded inscription reads "To Sigrun, from Victor."
2907129556.subtitle_zh: 这些上古纪念手枪可以追溯到黄金时代的早期。销蚀的铭文依稀可见：“致西格伦，维克托上。”
2907129556.text:
"Please! You don't understand. I'm supposed to be on that ship." 

The guard smiled at Sigrun with gentle condescension. "That's not possible, ma'am." 

She understood why he would believe that; all of the colonists had entered cryo two weeks ago, but she could see the crew waving for pictures. They were awake! She could be awake, too. "I'm supposed to be on that ship," she insisted, leaning around the guard. There was still time. She could find whatever horrible cryo-coffin they'd loaded Victor into; she could kneel before it and beg him to forgive her. He wouldn't hear her but he wasn't gone yet— 

"I need you to take a step back, ma'am." 

"Captain Jacobson!" Sigrun darted past the guard. "I'm a colonist! You can't leave without me!"
2907129556.text_zh:
“求求你！你不知道，我应该在那艘船上的。”

守卫向西格伦露出一抹同情的微笑。“这不可能，女士。”
她知道为什么他会这么想；所有移民者在两周前就进入了冬眠，但她依然可以看到船员们在相机前面招手合照。他们还醒着！她也可以醒着啊。“我应该在那艘船上的，”她在守卫旁坚持着。还有时间。她可以找到像他们装维克托那样的低温恐怖棺材；她可以双膝跪地祈求他原谅她。他听不到她说话，但他还活着——

“女士，请靠后一些。”

“雅各布森船长！”西格伦冲过守卫。“我也是移民者！你不能丢下我！”

2907129557.name: Sunshot
2907129557.subtitle: "Can't outrun the sunrise." —Liu Feng
2907129557.subtitle_zh: “步履再快，也快不过日出之势。”——刘枫
2907129557.text:
She bowed her head, heat shimmering from her fist. A silent salute to the Hive closing around her, their eyes forming a glowing jade ring. 

She was a Sunbreaker. A mercenary from days before the City. Not like the new Lights from the Tower. She was weary. But there was no rest out here, where the City Lights didn't reach. She and her allies were committed to their arduous, solitary task. But they could always use more numbers. 

Sometimes, they left trinkets for the City. Meant as challenge and bribe at once—we offer you this. Come find us. 

She had forged the Warlock gauntlets herself. Ouros laughed in her face when she told her their name. She wasn't very good at names. 

A gun. She would forge a gun, next. It would speak like her Hammer. And burn like fire. The ring of jade eyes closed on her. Liu Feng laughed, her arms open for a fiery embrace.
2907129557.text_zh:
她低下了头，拳头渐渐发热。对拢向她的邪魔族无声致意，它们的眼睛连成了一轮翡翠绿环。

她曾是一名炎阳。和高塔中新的光能者不一样的是，她在圣城时代之前就是一名雇佣兵。她觉得有些累，但在圣城光芒照不到的地方，战争从未停歇。她和她的盟军奋力去完成那些艰难又孤独的任务。但人手总是不够。

有时，他们为圣城留下些小的战利品，作为一种挑战和贿赂——我们能拿到这个，来加入我们。

她独自制造了术士臂铠。当她告诉大家这个名字时，奥罗斯当着她的面笑出来了。她不太擅长取名字。

一把枪，下次她可以造一把枪。像她的战锤一样铿锵有力，像烈焰一样熊熊燃烧。翡翠绿环更近了。刘枫失笑，张开双臂，迎接面前这惨烈的拥抱。

3628991659.name: Vigilance Wing
3628991659.subtitle: "The eye remains open. The Lighthouse remains lit." —Brother Vance
3628991659.subtitle_zh: “眼睛依然睁开。灯塔依然明亮。”——万斯修士
3628991659.text:
"What you hold was once a beacon. We came out of the shadows seeking those willing to join our search. We staged the trials in his name. It was once a reward for the chosen few— the ones who persevered when all seemed lost." 

 "It was forged as a testament to his resolve, to seek answers where no one else cared to look and to continue down the path so many fell blazing. In your hands is proof that those who earned its firepower never gave up and never lost their way. You may not know the legend of Osiris or ever dared our trials, but should we call on you, will you honor the heralds who earned this weapon's honor and continue the hunt?" 

 – Brother Vance, Disciple of Osiris
3628991659.text_zh:
“你拿着的曾经是个信标。我们从暗影中出来，寻找那些想要加入搜寻的人。我们以他的名义举行了试炼。这曾经是给被选中的几个人的奖励——那几个看起来失去了一切依然坚持着的人。”

“那是一个对他的决心，对那些其他人并未留意寻找和继续而燃烧的答案的证明。你的手中是那些永不言败且永不迷失的战士的证明。你或许不了解奥斯里斯的传奇，或许没有勇气接受试炼，但我们在此号召。你是那个会获得赢得这把武器荣耀并继续狩猎的人吗？”

——奥斯里斯门徒，万斯修士

3628991658.name: Graviton Lance
3628991658.subtitle: Think of space-time as a tapestry on a loom. This weapon is the needle.
3628991658.subtitle_zh: 将时空想象成织机上的锦缎。武器是针。
3628991658.text:
"So wait, that thing you found does… what?" 
"It fires black holes." 
"No it doesn't." 
"Oh yeah. It does. Actual, tiny, bullet-sized black holes." 
 "Did you tell the others?" 
"Only that I found some weird gun in some overgrown tunnel back on Old Chicago. And that my Ghost was all, "THIS is why we were led here…'" 
"Yours talks that way too?" 
"What do you think?" 
"OK, OK, but the gun—are you going to tell them?" 
"Yeah, definitely." 
"When?" 
"Crucible." 
"Oh no." 
"Oh, yes."
3628991658.text_zh:
“稍等，你找到的这东西干了……什么？”
“它能发射黑洞。”
“不，它不能的。”
“哦，它可以的。准确来说，是子弹大小的黑洞。”
“你告诉其他人了吗？”
“我在旧芝加哥的一些杂草丛生的隧道里找到了一些诡异的枪，我的机灵只会说，‘就是这些把我们召唤来的……'”
“你的机灵也这么说话啊？”
“那你以为呢？”
“好吧好吧，但关于这把枪——你打算告诉他们吗？”
“对呀，肯定的。”
“什么时候？”
“在熔炉竞技场的时候。”
“哦，不会吧。”
“哈，会的。”

1508896098.name: The Wardcliff Coil
1508896098.subtitle: Ingenuity. Desperation. A haphazard prototype of terrible power. Such were the factors at play in the Wardcliff Incident.
1508896098.subtitle_zh: 巧思。绝望。偶然诞生，威力骇人的原型。这件武器在沃德克里夫事变中被使用过。
1508896098.text: HAMIT'S LOG. The lead is good, but so are the Fallen tracking me. I swear on my Ghost there's a hundred camped outside. I'm cornered in the lab and they're using Shanks to run me out of ammunition. War cultist, arm thyself; at least it's a weapons lab. This, er, rustic device was once an experimental axion emitter, which sprays weird particles to light up the basement of the universe. Right here I've coupled the emitter to some catacaustic quark-gluon coils, which will not, due to my scrupulous safety checking, create a strangelet that devours the Earth. I cook up some pain in there, the microverse decays, and the result comes out here. If it doesn't work, well, please name the crater after me.
1508896098.text_zh: 哈米特的日志。线索很有用，但是跟踪我的那些堕落者也很厉害。我以我的机灵发誓，他们在外面至少有上百人驻扎。我被堵在实验室里，他们利用侦察机耗光了我的子弹。战争狂热者，拿起武器来；这里好歹是个武器实验室。这个，呃，生锈的装置曾经是一个实验性量子发射器，它能发射奇怪的粒子照亮整个宇宙的地下室。在这里我把发射器跟一些焦散夸克氢氨乙酸进行结合。经过我严谨的安全检查，它并不能制造出什么吞噬地球的奇异物质。在那里我遭受了苦痛，微宇宙消散了，但得出了结果。如果它没能成功，请用我的名字为那个坑命名。

4255268456.name: Skyburner's Oath
4255268456.subtitle: The inscription, written in a Cabal dialect, reads: "Inexorable victory."
4255268456.subtitle_zh: 这句卡巴尔语铭文意为：“不可阻挡的胜利”。
4255268456.text:
Some grunts are born to fight the war. Yes, they're loyal and true, and when the call comes "hot drop in five," well, they're always first in the queue. But I'm not one of them. I'm no hero, I'm in no hurry to die. I shot my own squad on Phobos, when death came to wear us like armor. I rode the Primus's ship that rammed the Hive Dreadnaught. Second wave out the hatch. We won that fight. We're not dead, so we won. 

Now this is the end, brothers, our final fight. Ghaul's here to finish it. Mars taught us how to fight Guardians. The Hive taught us how to eat their Light. Remember that we made it possible. The Red Legion ends it. But we held the line, and we didn't die. That's victory. It says so on the gun.
4255268456.text_zh:
有些战士生而为战。是的，他们忠诚又真实，而当"五人一组伞降"的命令传来时，对的，他们总是站在队列最前面。我不是那些战士。我不是英雄，不想死那么早。当死亡犹如我们身着的护甲一样如影随形时，我在火卫一上朝自己的小队开了枪。我驾驶着军团长的飞船猛冲向虫群的无畏战舰。我们赢了那场战斗。我们没死，所以我们赢了。

兄弟们，就要结束了，这是我们的最后一战。盖欧想在这里结束一切。火星教会了我们如何与守护者作战。虫群教会了我们如何吞噬他们的光能。记住，是我们让这一切变为可能。是猩红军团终结一切。但只要我们守住战线，保住性命，就是胜利。枪上是这么写的。

3580904581.name: Tractor Cannon
3580904581.subtitle: Property of Ishtar Collective. WARNING: Gravity propulsor beam can cause serious injury or even death.
3580904581.subtitle_zh: 伊什塔集团财产。警告：引力推进器光束可能造成重伤，甚至死亡。
3580904581.text:
Chioma Esi met Maya in their undergraduate gym. They got into an argument about deadlifting: was it necessary, was it practical, why was Chioma making so much noise? Maya Sundaresh just couldn't stand the notion that some things were done for their own sake, not because they had any use. 

Decades later they joined the Ishtar Collective on Venus to study the enigmatic ruins unearthed by the Traveler's terraforming. The first time it happened—Vex code leaping across an airgap, surfing the quantum vacuum from simulation to reality, infecting a utility frame—Chioma pulled an alarm while Maya tried to grab the precious frame with a cargo-grade gravity grapple. She couldn't lift the grapple. Chioma grabbed it, pinned the frame to the wall, and won the argument.
3580904581.text_zh:
希欧玛在大学体育馆里见到了玛雅。他们关于硬拉的问题吵了起来：它必要吗，实用吗，希欧玛怎么这么吵？玛雅·桑戴尔什根本无法容忍一些东西的存在是没有原因、没有用处的这种观念。

几十年后，他们加入了金星的伊什塔集团，研究旅行者地球化后的神秘废墟。他们第一次吵架——是Vex代码从空气隙中泄露出来了，在模拟现实的量子真空中游走，感染了一处功能框架。在玛雅试着用一个货物等级的重力钩抓住珍贵的框架时，希欧玛拉响了警报。她拿不动那个钩子。希欧玛抓住了它，把框架钉在墙上，赢得了争吵的胜利。

3580904580.name: Legend of Acrius
3580904580.subtitle: "In the Cabal legend, a hero seeks to possess the sun. He succeeds. Then, he becomes Emperor. The Cabal… are not a subtle people." —Tyra Karn
3580904580.subtitle_zh: “在卡巴尔传说中，一名英雄试图占有太阳。他成功了。接着，他就加冕成为皇帝。卡巴尔们……并不拘小节。”——泰拉·卡恩
3580904580.text:
That really is the entire myth. A Cabal named Acrius desires the sun, and he takes it and becomes the first Emperor of the Cabal. Other scholars have already noted the parallels and differences with our own ancient Earth myth of Icarus, which famously has a far more humbling ending. I am more interested in how Cabal leaders throughout history have deployed this legend as a rhetorical and political justification for conquest. Among the most relevant such figures is Dominus Ghaul himself, who appears to have a personal affinity for the Acrius myth. 

I must also note here that, while linguistic analysis of the Cabal language and its many dialects is incomplete, they do not appear to have a word for the concept of "hubris." 
—Research notes of Tyra Karn
3580904580.text_zh:
完整的神话真的是这样的。一个叫做阿克瑞斯的卡巴尔想要太阳，他就夺取了太阳并成为了卡巴尔的第一任皇帝。其他学者指出这与我们古老地球的伊卡洛斯神话的相似与不同，后者以一个更为谦逊的结局而著名。我更感兴趣的是历史上所有的卡巴尔领导人是如何利用这个神话作为征服正当性的修饰和政治理由的。这些人物中被影响最大的就是尊主盖欧本人，他个人似乎和阿克瑞斯神话有着密切关系。

在这里我必须指出，虽然针对卡巴尔语言及其诸多方言的语言学分析尚未完成，但是他们似乎没有一个表达“骄傲自大”概念的词。
——泰拉·卡恩的研究记录

2362471600.name: Drang
2362471600.subtitle: Since the Collapse these pistols were retooled several times to boost their firepower. A worn inscription reads "To Victor, from Sigrun."
2362471600.subtitle_zh: 自大崩溃以来，这些手枪经过多次改进以增强火力。磨损的铭文依稀可见：“致维克托，西格伦上。”
