3807159894.text_zh:
安全保障导航人工智能恢复协议
黑色移民号.快速存取记录器无法恢复（！可控飞行撞地！）
黑色移民号.飞行记录器在线完整性32%

目的地：KOI-571.05
区域：151pc ~~492ly~~161pc~~552ly~~141pc
预计到达时间：##^^^$$%%~~~~~~~

萨曼莎·布莱兹："——7066涅索斯的轨道与发射基地的计算结果不同"

导航计算中的未见情况。正在尝试缓解措施。

缓解措施失败。引入二次无理数。不可通约。再次尝试。不可通约。

马苏德·雅各布森：“——调整航向两度。还有很长一段——”

指令建议不充分。正在超控至8.5度。正在超控至8.7度。

回应 非常抱歉，雅各布森船长。我用来计算我们航行轨迹的公式出现了二十六个新的数学常数。我正在尝试补偿！

检测到增加未注册程序。损害四维结构。正在尝试缓解措施。

薰·佐伊科娃：“——舷引擎报废——”

回应 我很抱歉，但按照我的计算能力，我跟不上现在的情形！黑色移民号现在处于无法恢复的下落状态。请做出所有适当的准备！

即将发生机身全毁。

回应 我很抱

3886263130.name: I Am Alive
3886263130.subtitle: "When the end comes, I reserve the right to be last." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3886263130.subtitle_zh: “当末日来临时，我保留成为最后一人的权利。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
3886263130.text:
Now I've seen everything. We were all so wrong. All of this—the machines, the Eliksni, the worms, the Light, the Nine. All of it meaningless. This galaxy is tumbling toward a singular conclusion and there is nothing—no one—that can stop it.

How could I have missed this? It's the small moments, the simple pleasures that matter. They're all I can think about now. Food and drink aren't mere sustenance. They're a reminder that I am alive.

This Leviathan. This prison ship. I will remake it, as I have been remade. No longer will it represent a mythical beast from the dreams of worms. It will serve as an icon for my newfound gluttony.
3886263130.text_zh:
如今我看到了一切。我们都错了，错得那么严重。这一切——机器、埃里克斯尼族、蠕虫、光能，还有玖。一切都毫无意义了。这个银河系正跌跌撞撞地走向唯一的结局，没有什么——没有人——能阻止。

我怎么会忘了这个？渺小的瞬间和简单的快乐才是最重要的。我现在满脑子都是这些。食物和水不仅仅是养料。它们提醒我，我还活着。

这只利维坦。这支运囚舰。我要按我被改造的方式来改造它。它将不再代表来自蠕虫梦境的神秘野兽。它将作为我刚刚觅得的暴食之欲的象征。

2707464805.name: Zenith of Your Kind
2707464805.subtitle:
"Earth has no Shadow. Not yet."
—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2707464805.subtitle_zh:
“地球没有暗影。暂时没有。”
——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
2707464805.text:
I have come to admire how you rally against the impossible. It's not your continual success that amuses me—your Light assures victory—it's your refusal to kneel. You fight and you die without a second thought. For what? Personal glory? Wealth? The wretched denizens of your refugee city?

You have made bitter foes of races older, nobler, and worthier than you.

You struggle so vainly and valiantly when you have so little. When you are so little. Everything this universe has thrown against you and still you persist.

I could finish you. And you would not be at my side at the dimming of the world. You, the Guardian of Guardians.

If I wished it, you would die your final death. But I won't. Why? Because I'm in love.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2707464805.text_zh:
我是来赞美你与不可能进行抗争的。让我开心的不是你披荆斩棘的成功——因你的光能无往不克——我开心的是你不愿妥协的气节。你英勇奋战，视死如归。为了什么？个人荣誉？财富？还是你那难民城邦里的悲惨住民？

你结下死敌，他们都是比你要古老、高贵，比你更有价值的种族。

在你一无所有之时，却徒劳而又无畏地进行抗争。在你一无所有之时，这个宇宙将一切都压在你的身上，但你还是坚持了下来。

我可以让你解脱，而在这个世界遁入黑暗之时你也将不再伴我左右。你，是守护者的守护者。

如果我真这么想，你早已经死去。但我并没有。你问为什么？因为我被爱包围。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

3188460622.name: Null Calamity 9
3188460622.subtitle:
A sacred eye that speaks in lies—upending futures in its path.
The way before us to the skies shall see itself in ancient wrath.
3188460622.subtitle_zh:
诉说谎言的神圣之眼——在它的道路上颠倒未来。
我们面前通达天际的道路将出现在远古怒火之中。
3188460622.text:
"I've misplaced Osiris again," Sagira told a Goblin.

The Goblin, being a Goblin, shot at her.

She dodged with a sigh, and continued through the Forest.

"If I was Osiris, where would I go to celebrate Panoptes becoming scrap metal?"

The answer, when Sagira finally tracked him down, surprised her.

Osiris hovered, cross-legged, at the center of a ruined Lighthouse. A dead sun loomed in the lightless sky. Arrayed on the ground below to the horizon, yellow Vex eyes pierced the gloom. 

Sagira zoomed straight to Osiris's side. "I thought we averted this future!"

Eyes closed, Osiris shook his head. "Many equations lead to this answer."

A sound like a drumbeat, but with the impact of an earthquake, shook the Lighthouse.

Sagira darted through the crumbling chamber. "What do we do?"

Another bone-rattling drumbeat kicked up clouds of dust.

Osiris floated to his feet. "We start over."

BOOM. Through the window, a shadow eclipsed the Vex eyes. 

"But first," he said. "You'll have to rez me again, old friend."
3188460622.text_zh:
“我再一次错信奥斯里斯了”，萨吉拉对一只哥布林说。

但哥布林终归是哥布林，它朝她开枪了。

她叹着气躲开子弹，继续穿越森林。

“假如我是奥斯里斯，我会去哪儿庆祝潘诺普忒斯报销成废金属这件喜事呢？”

萨吉拉终于追踪到他，答案让她大吃一惊。

奥斯里斯在化作废墟的灯塔中央盘着腿，悬浮在空中。死去的太阳朦胧地显现在黑暗的天空上。发出黄光的Vex之眼透过昏暗，成群出现在与地平线相接的大地之上。

萨吉拉急忙飞到奥斯里斯身边。“我以为我们避免了这个未来！”

奥斯里斯闭上双目，摇了摇头。“许多问题都得出这个答案。”

仿佛鼓声，但力度却似地震，撼动了灯塔。

萨吉拉冲过摇摇欲坠的大厅。“我们怎么办？”

震骨欲摧的鼓声再次袭来，灰尘从地面翻腾而起。

奥斯里斯放下双腿。“我们重新开始。”

轰。一片暗影透窗而过，遮蔽了Vex的眼睛。

“但首先，”他说道。“你需要再一次复活我，老朋友。”

161537636.name: Machina Dei 4
161537636.subtitle:
A charnel but effulgent orb—beacon in a loathsome dark—
Fêted, fetid corpses rise—a too-long-absent gibbous spark.
161537636.subtitle_zh:
可怖但耀眼的灵珠——可憎黑暗之中的信标——
腐尸复生——一丝消逝已久现将再现的火花。
161537636.text:
From the writings of Brother Vance:

To be a Guardian! How I longed for it. After a near-death experience in which I lost my eyesight, I even believed that I had become a Guardian, that the great Osiris had granted me my dearest wish.

How young and foolish I was!

But now that I am thirty, and wise, I know better. I wanted to be a Guardian, but what I needed was to feel like I was enough. Like I was equal to the great task of life. That I was heroic.

And THAT, my friends, is the beauty of Osiris's teachings! That if you work, if you strive, if you suffer for the sake of improvement, you CAN become better!

It's a hard life I've chosen, full of sweat and pain and darkness. But I have never been so free!
161537636.text_zh:
摘自万斯修士的著述：

成为守护者！我是多么憧憬啊！经历一次濒死体验后我失明了，我甚至相信我已经成为了一名守护者，相信伟大的奥斯里斯已经实现了我朝思暮想的愿望。

那时的我是多么幼稚和愚蠢啊！

如今我已到而立之年，更聪慧了，看得更明白了。我曾想成为守护者，但我需要的只是充实的感觉，只是不枉人生在世的感觉，只是成为英雄的感觉。

而这个，我的朋友们，便是奥斯里斯教诲的美之所在了！只要你努力，只要你奋进，只要你为进步而经受磨练，你就可以变得更强！

这是我所选择的艰辛人生，充满汗水、痛苦和黑暗。但我从未感觉到如此自由！

161537637.name: Infinite Paths 8
161537637.subtitle:
They sowed the First, now reap the Last; forever narrows to a line
Where Light will fade into the past; when all's converted, nothing shines.
161537637.subtitle_zh:
前世的因，承担现世的果，造就来世的景
当光消逝于过往，当一切斗转星移，再无闪烁之物。
161537637.text:
From the writings of Brother Vance:

Anyone can see the signs if they just truly look! Osiris preserve us, I am blind and I recognized the signs of his lost prophecies coming to bear!

But none of us—not even his most faithful—have seen the things Osiris has seen.

We in the Lighthouse follow a man haunted by visions of apocalypse, yet doesn't turn away. Osiris doesn't close his eyes. He doesn't even blink. He put aside his Vanguard duties, his students, his very life, to bear this curse. And why? Because it is the only way to become strong enough to save you from the enemy.

You in the City who condemned Osiris, who cast him out and cursed his name, do you not understand that the prophecies are curse enough?
161537637.text_zh:
万斯修士的著述摘抄：

肯睁眼去看的任何人都能看见迹象！奥斯里斯维护我们，我却视而不见，我认出了他的失落预言所承载的迹象！

但我们之中没有一个人——连他最忠实的追随者——都没有见过奥斯里斯所目睹的一切。

灯塔中的我们追随的是一个饱受灭世景象所苦之人，即使如此，这个人也没有转过脸去，视若无睹。奥斯里斯没有闭上双眼，甚至连眼睛都没眨一下。他将自己的先锋工作、他的学生、他的生命放在一边，来承受这个诅咒。为什么？因为这是使你变得强大到足以击败敌人的唯一方法。

你们这些谴责奥斯里斯的圣城人，你们这些将他放逐并诅咒他的圣城人，你们难道不明白预言本身就是诅咒吗？

472169727.name: Garden Progeny 1
472169727.subtitle:
Two siblings cleaved by time and space, reflections never found alone,
The ending of the eldritch race—a path long seen but never known.
472169727.subtitle_zh:
被时间和空间分开的双生子，永不孤单的倒影，
怪异种族的结局——早被预见却不为理解的道路。
472169727.text:
Excerpt from "The Definitive History of Osiris," by Brother Vance

In the wake of the Iron Lords' untimely deaths and the chaos that threatened to topple the fledging City from within, the one known as the Speaker made his bid for power. To create the illusion of democracy, the Speaker established the Consensus, an oligarchical body of representatives from the City's leading political factions and the three Guardian classes. For the Titans: Saint-14, the right hand of the Speaker. For the Hunters: Tallulah Fairwind, first in a long line of ever-changing representatives. And for the Warlocks, the already-legendary warrior who had studied with Felwinter and Nirwen themselves: Osiris.
472169727.text_zh:
选自万斯修士所著《奥斯里斯传》

钢铁领主过早殒落，混乱欲从内部颠覆羽翼未丰的圣城，人称先知者欲图掌权。为了制造民主的假象，先知建立了元老院，这是一支寡头政治组织，由来自圣城主流政治阵营和三职守护者的代表组成。泰坦方面：圣14号，先知的左右手。猎人方面：塔鲁·和风，不断更换的代表长队之中位列第一的人。而术士方面，则是曾与邪冬和讷温一起进行过研究、早已威名震宇的战士：奥斯里斯。

3285365667.name: West of Sunfall 7
3285365667.subtitle:
A spark of knowledge with each fall, the purpose of the endless youth.
No longer shunned, dark's nameless call now brings about tenebrous truth.
3285365667.subtitle_zh:
在死亡中萌发智慧，永恒青春的意义。
不再逃避，黑暗无名的召唤将带来阴森的真相。
3285365667.text:
Excerpt of a letter from Ikora Rey to Eris Morn:

Would it be terribly offensive if I said I would have happily traded places with you and gone down to the Hellmouth rather than be in the City during Osiris's banishment?

Well, here's what you missed. It started because of his Lost Prophecies. A misnomer—the prophecies were always accessible to those who cared about them, but the Followers proclaimed them "lost" to a City that had censored all Osirian material. And even then the City didn't truly lose them, for when the Speaker ordered me to destroy Osiris's writings, I placed the documents in my private library instead. I don't believe in burning books, regardless of my opinion of the author.

As to why he had to write the prophecies in iambic couplets? Simple: vanity.
3285365667.text_zh:
摘自艾可拉·蕾伊致埃里斯·摩恩的一封信：

如果我说我很乐意同你交换位置，在奥斯里斯被放逐时不留在圣城而前往地狱之口的话，会不会太过冒犯？

好吧，我来告诉你错过了什么。这件事的起因是他的失落预言。这一误称——预言总是对那些在乎它们的人敞开胸怀，但在严审奥斯里斯所有材料的圣城面前，追随者谓其为“失落”。即使在那个时候，圣城也没有失去这些预言。因为在先知命令我销毁奥斯里斯的著述时，我将这些书籍藏进了我的私人图书馆中。不管我对作者有什么不满，我都不认可焚书。

至于为何他要用双韵对句来书写预言？很简单：为了虚荣。

3285365666.name: Jack Queen King 3
3285365666.subtitle:
An army meets, and stands, and falls. Three nobles wage their hopeless war.
In shifting madness, evil crawls. One stands above the battle's roar.
3285365666.subtitle_zh:
一支军队集结、屹立，然后倒下。三个贵族进行毫无胜算的战争。
疯狂游移间，邪恶蠕动。战斗怒吼中，一人屹立。
3285365666.text:
From the journals of Ikora Rey

When I studied with Osiris, he would often tell me: "I see failure in your future." No matter how hard I worked, no matter how strong I became, always: "I still see failure."

I think now what he saw was Io.

When I lost my Light and retreated from a ruined City, when I arrived on Io to find only silence, I too thought I had failed. Even after Ghaul's defeat and the Traveler's waking, I told my friends I thought the Traveler had tested me, and that I had failed its test.

But now I'm not so sure.

Perhaps what Osiris saw for me—what I experienced on Io—was simply that I needed help. That most Human of conditions. I needed to be in a fireteam, and to be a fireteam for others in turn.

How like Osiris to see that and name it failure.

I won't make that mistake again.
3285365666.text_zh:
摘自艾可拉·蕾伊的日志

在我跟随奥斯里斯做研究时，他常常告诉我：“我在你的未来看到了失败。”无论我多么努力，无论我变得多强，他总是说：“我看到的还是失败。”

现在想一想，他看到的应该是木卫一。

在我失去光能从化为废墟的圣城撤离时，在我抵达万籁俱寂的木卫一时，我也觉得自己失败了。即使在盖欧被击败，旅行者觉醒之后，我还是这样告诉我的朋友，我认为旅行者对我设下了考验，而我没能通过那次考验。

但如今我不在这么确定了。

也许奥斯里斯在我身上预见的东西——我在木卫一上的经历——仅仅是我需要帮助而已。身为人类最最基本的需求。我需要加入火力战队，同时欢迎他人与我组成火力战队。

奥斯里斯是如何将这个视作并称作失败的。

我不会再犯这样的错误了。

2091737595.name: Traveler's Judgment 5
2091737595.subtitle:
A visitor ignites the sky, and in the truth of light it dreams:
Above the dead and yet-to-die, a legion's blade with fire screams.
2091737595.subtitle_zh:
到访者点燃天空，在真理圣光中展开梦境：
在死者和生者之上，烈火缠绕的军团利刃呼啸而过。
2091737595.text:
How to interpret the Lost Prophecies? The theory in vogue right now with the Followers of Osiris is that the first five verses refer to the Black Garden, the coming of Ghaul, the Traveler's awakening and Ghaul's subsequent defeat. It's a convincing interpretation, even conceding that prophecies are much easier to interpret in hindsight.
There's just one thing: if Osiris used the Infinite Forest to develop his prophecies, and the Infinite Forest cannot accurately simulate Light, how did Osiris predict the Traveler would wake? The Forest's very inability to predict this very thing is what prevented Panoptes from breaking ground with its apocalyptic calculations.
I must assume: 1) Either verse 5 does not refer to the Traveler's awakening, or 2) Osiris has prophetic resources at his disposal other than the Forest. What they are I have no idea.
2091737595.text_zh:
如何解读失落预言？目前奥斯里斯追随者的主流观点认为前五篇所指的是黑暗花园、盖欧降临、旅行者的觉醒以及盖欧随后被击败。即使认为以后见之明来解读失落预言当然容易，这也是令人信服的解释。
只有一个问题：如果奥斯里斯使用无尽森林来酝酿预言，同时无尽森林无法准确地模拟出光能的话，奥斯里斯是如何预见旅行者将要觉醒的呢？森林无法预测的这一特殊事件成了阻止潘诺普忒斯开始其灾难性计算的原因。
我必须做出以下假设：1)要么第5篇所指并非旅行者的觉醒，抑或2)奥斯里斯拥有可供其所用的预言资源，而此预言资源并非无尽森林。至于是哪种假设，我不得而知。

3991544423.name: The Conqueror 2
3991544423.subtitle:
To Tower comes a war in red; an orphan sounds the empire's call.
Mortal angels mourn the dead while lightless light wraps night in pall.
3991544423.subtitle_zh:
猩红色的战争降临高塔；孤儿奏响帝国之声。
凡间天使为死者哀悼，无光之光为暗夜盖上棺罩。
3991544423.text:
Excerpt from a letter written by Lord Shaxx to the Speaker, dated three years ago:

I do not appreciate wasting time that should be spent forging Guardians into their best selves. But since you have seen fit to launch a formal investigation into my beliefs, I will explain them as simply as I can for you.

I am no "follower" of anything. I believe thanatology is just an excuse for insomnia and that Ahamkaras are for cheaters. I find the Acataleptic belief that Darkness is incomprehensible to be pessimistic nihilism, and its opposite—the Osirian position that Darkness must be understood—to be misanthropic narcissism.

But I will also take good ideas where I can get them. And Osiris's belief that Guardian minds and bodies can be sharpened as one sharpens a sword is a damn good idea. You've seen the results in the Crucible. Do I really have to say any more?
3991544423.text_zh:
节选自三年前领主沙克斯写给先知的一封信：

我不喜欢浪费本该花在锻造守护者身上的时间。但由于你觉得应该对我的信仰展开一次正式调查，因此我会用最简单的文字给你解释一下。

我不是任何人的“追随者”。我相信死亡学不过是失眠症的借口，而阿罕卡拉是作弊者的专利。我觉得那种相信暗影无从可解的不可知论是悲观的虚无主义，而与其相对的观点——奥斯里斯派认为暗影必须被理解——又是愤世嫉俗般的自恋主义。

但是我还是会吸收那些优秀的观点。奥斯里斯相信守护者的身心可以像磨砺宝剑一样去砥砺，这是一个很了不起的想法。你已经见识过熔炉竞技场的成果了。我还有必要多加解释吗？

3991544422.name: Sol Pariah 6
3991544422.subtitle:
Amid the endless death one flew—unnatural all-consuming need—
And in the space between the two, accursed comprehension freed.
3991544422.subtitle_zh:
无尽的死亡之中有一人例外——违背自然吞噬一切的需要——
在生死之间，迸发了被诅咒的领悟。
3991544422.text:
Osiris stood at the far end of the Underwatch, his back to her.

"We need to talk," she said.

Sagira turned. He did not.

"I'm surprised you came alone. Have you finally learned confidence?"

"Yes." Ikora clenched her fists, then released them. "Not from you."

He crossed his hands behind his back. "I know why you're here."

"I should hope so."

"This meeting was prophesied. As is my impending banishment."

"Then you had ample warning."

"This is ridiculous!" Sagira snapped. "We're at war. Osiris does what you all are too scared to do, and you banish him? How're you gonna win against the Darkness without him?"

Osiris held up a hand to silence her.

"Ikora knows," he said. "She pretends otherwise, but she knows."

"Winning by your terms is no victory." Ikora's hands were fists again. She unclenched them. "Goodbye, Osiris."
3991544422.text_zh:
奥斯里斯站在监视区的另一头，背对着她。

她说，“我们得谈谈。”

萨吉拉转过身来。他却没有转身。

“你独自前来，我很惊讶。你是不是终于学到了什么是自信？”

“是的。”艾可拉握紧了双拳，然后松开了。“但不是从你那儿学的。”

他将双手背在身后。“我知道你为何来这里。”

“我觉得你应该知道。”

“我已预见这次见面，还有我即将遭受的放逐。”

“那你应该收到足够的警告了。”

“这太荒谬了！”萨吉拉插嘴道。“我们身陷战争。奥斯里斯做了你们所有人惧不敢为的事，而你们要放逐他？没有他，你们如何能击败暗影？”

奥斯里斯抬起手，阻止她继续说下去。

“艾可拉懂，”他说道。“她假装不知，但她懂。”

“按你的说法获胜不是什么胜利。”艾可拉的双手又捏成了拳头。但她又松开了双拳。“再见，奥斯里斯。”

2248667690.name: Perfect Paradox
2248667690.subtitle:
A tale that's different from the rest: the thread unfurls against the clocks.
The one the Speaker loved the best must have a perfect paradox.
2248667690.subtitle_zh:
一个与其他故事迥异的传说：情节急转直下。
先知的最爱肯定拥有一个完美的悖论。
2248667690.text:
I never found Osiris, but I've killed enough Vex to end a war. And they, in turn, struck a fatal blow: they completed a Mind with the sole function to drain the Light from me. It worked very well.

Don't worry (not that you worry much). It took them centuries to build, keyed to the unique frequency of my Light. And I sit atop its shattered husk.

I mourn that I will never reach the heights you have. To me, you represent everything a Guardian can become. Yours is a thriving City. So different from mine. My whole fourteenth life I fought to make my City yours. I never finished.

All I have left is this weapon. The Cryptarchs say you crafted it yourself, built it out of scraps and Light and sheer will, inside the Infinite Forge. I'll make sure it finds its way back to you. When you gave it to me, I swore I would make it my duty to follow your example.

I'm still trying.

—Saint-14
2248667690.text_zh:
我从来没有找到奥斯里斯，但我杀了足够多的Vex来结束战争。而作为报复，它们发起了致命一击：它们完成了一个思维，这个思维只有一个能力，就是从我身上抽取光能。它运作得很好。

别担心（不用担心成那个样子）。它们用了几百年的时间，将它与我的光能的独特频率键合，让我坐在它破碎的外壳上面。

异常悲伤，因为我永远不会达到你的高度。对我来说，你代表了守护者所能成就的一切。你成就了一个繁荣的城市，而我的是如此不同。在整整十四年的人生中，我努力让我的城市成为你的样子。我一直没有做到。

我唯一剩下的，就是这把武器。解密大师说你是在无尽熔炉里从无到有，自己一个人创造的，仅仅依靠光能和坚毅的意志。我会保证让它回到你身边。当你把它交给我时，我发誓自己要追随你的脚步。

我仍在努力。

——圣14号

1490571337.name: Future Safe 10
1490571337.subtitle:
See who's robed as if a god, who stands with pride above the rest!
Destroy this ancient nameless fraud! Destroy the one whose death was blessed!
1490571337.subtitle_zh:
看谁好似神明披上长袍，凌驾他人之上！
毁灭这古老的无名骗子！毁灭这个受到死亡祝福的恶魔！
1490571337.text:
A fragment from Osiris

—ot been easy to gather this foresight. Prophecies are tricky things: they change the future they foretell. When a seer shares their knowledge of a coming event—any event, whether good or ill—there will always be those who gather to prevent it. Say too little and your meaning is lost. Say too much and you have made the task of your enemies easier. You must say just enough so that the few who can listen will hear.

I have done all I can. The rest is up to you. You must trust in me.

You must trust in yourself.

—Osiris
1490571337.text_zh:
奥斯里斯的片段

——收集这个预见不易。预言很微妙：它们会改变其预言的未来。每当某个先知预言即将发生的事件——任何事件，无论吉凶——总会有人来阻止事件的发生。说得太少，言不达意。说得太多，就让敌人轻松取胜。你必须透露得恰到好处，只让那些能够聆听的少数人听见。

我已经竭尽所能，剩下就看你的了。你必须相信我。

你必须相信你自己。

——奥斯里斯

2835569221.name: Peace by Consensus
2835569221.subtitle: "The Consensus is bigger than the Speaker. Bigger than any of us. It will survive, because it has to." —Commander Zavala, acting head of the Consensus
2835569221.subtitle_zh: “元老院在先知之上。超越我们所有人。它将存在下去，因为它必须存在。”——元老院现任领袖，指挥官萨瓦拉
2835569221.text:
Consensus Meeting 3230.01
Zavala: "I call this meeting of the Consensus to order."
New Monarchy: "Only the Speaker can call us to order."
Cayde-6: "Oh, really? Well, guess we can't have meetings anymore. If you'll excuse me—"
Ikora Rey: "Sit down, Cayde. We're having this discussion, bylaws be damned."
FWC: "What do the bylaws say about choosing a new Speaker?"
Z: "Nothing."
IR: "Then we'll write new ones."
DO: "Knowing us, that's going to take time. A lot of time."
Z: "In the meanwhile, we will have to move forward without a Speaker."
NM: "Who will take his place? You?"
Z: "None of us will take the Speaker's place. And all of us will. We must find our own consensus now."
2835569221.text_zh:
元老院会议3230.01
萨瓦拉：“我宣布本次元老院会议开始。”
新王派：“只有先知才能召集我们开会。”
凯德6号：“喔，是嘛？好吧，那我们再也不用开会了。那我就先走——”
艾可拉·蕾伊：“坐下，凯德。我们有事情需要讨论，让规则见鬼去吧。”
未来战争狂热者：“规则对推选新任先知的流程是什么？”
萨：“规则上没有这项。”
艾：“那我们就定新的规则。”
死轨：“靠我们自己的话，需要时间。很多时间。”
萨：“与此同时，我们还必须在没有先知的情况下继续前行。”
新王派：“谁来接替他的位置？你么？”
萨瓦拉：“我们之中任何个人都无法接任先知的位置。他的职位需要我们所有人的共同承担。我们必须组成我们自己的元老院。”

19024058.name: Prometheus Lens
19024058.subtitle: "Cryptarchs made a crystal that starts fires? Get me one. I don't care how you do it. Go!" —Cayde-6
19024058.subtitle_zh: “解密大师们制造了能点火的水晶？帮我搞一个，方法自己看着办。去吧！”——凯德6号
19024058.text:
How's it work? Ha! The underlying principles are quite simple, really. The gun's pyreliophorite crystal—

Pyreliophorite? It's an Ionian crystal which bears some resemblance to rudimentary perovskite, which is, as you should know, a crystal with unique photovoltaic properties—

Photovoltaic? It means "regarding the conversion of light into electricity."

No, no, the gun doesn't create electricity; the gun induces an external combustion reaction. It's perovskite that—

I just explained the perovskite! If you'd stop interrupting—

Wait. I remember you. You're one of Cayde's Hunters! Get out of here! Shoo! The Cryptarchy wants nothing to do with you!
19024058.text_zh:
怎么样？哈！其中蕴含的原理相当简单，真的。枪械的燃硒晶体——

燃硒？这是一种爱奥尼亚晶体，与其有一些相似之处的就是钙钛矿不纯，你应该知道，后者是拥有独特光电性质的晶体——

光电？意思是“光能转化为电能”。

不，不，枪械本身不会产生电能；枪械只会引起外部燃烧反应。是钙钛矿——

我刚刚解释过钙钛矿了！如果你能别插嘴的话——

等一下。我想起你是谁了。你是凯德的一个猎人！从这儿出去！走开！解密大师不想跟你有任何瓜葛！

3899270607.name: The Colony
3899270607.subtitle: We outnumber you. We will find you. You are alone, and we are colony.
3899270607.subtitle_zh: 我们数量超于你。我们会找到你。你孤身一人，而我们群居而生。
3899270607.text:
Have you ever watched a snake kill something? It's awful. It's so awful. I watched a man die of a terciopelo bite once. Out by the northern wall. I still have nightmares about it.

Anyway, that's where VEIST comes from. The inspiration, I mean. Weapons with all the power of a venomous creature. Plus an onboard AI with that creature's killer instincts.

And now there's the Colony. A grenade launcher packed with fully mobile, AI-controlled insectoid detonators, each one designed with a taste for blood.

We've made some pretty messed-up stuff. You've probably seen it. You know. But we've never made anything like the Colony before.
3899270607.text_zh:
你有没有见过毒蛇捕杀的场景？恐怖。真恐怖。我见过一个人被三色矛头蝮咬伤，毒发身亡。就在北墙外。我还会因为这事做噩梦。

不管怎样，VEIST就是因此诞生的。我是说灵感来源。武器拥有剧毒生物的全部威力，另外还搭载了拥有剧毒生物杀手本能的人工智能。

如今群居者的出现，配备了人工智能控制的全机动虫型引爆装置的榴弹发射器，每支都不乏嗜血的本能。

我们制造了一些相当凶残的东西。你可能已经见过了，你懂的。但我们以前从未制造出像群居者这样的东西。

3437746471.name: Crimson
3437746471.subtitle: According to official Vanguard policy, this weapon does not exist.
3437746471.subtitle_zh: 根据先锋的官方政策，这件武器并不存在。
3437746471.text:
"This is crazy! You don't need this thing. I can heal you; that's my whole job."
"I thought your job was to state the obvious."
"What?"
"Oh, come on. Ever since you found me, it's been, 'Watch out, Fallen ahead!' when they're right in front of me. Or, my favorite: 'Seems like the door's locked.' Is it? Really? I couldn't tell. And when it's not that, you say I need to be more self-sufficient in case we lose the Light again. So here's my answer. Here's the remedy."
"I was just trying to help."
3437746471.text_zh:
“这太疯狂了！你不需要这东西。我可以治疗你；那是我的全部工作。”
“我以为你的工作是陈述显而易见的事。”
“什么？”
“喔，拜托。自从你找到我以来，当堕落者都站到我面前时你才说，‘当心，前方有堕落者！'。要么就是我最喜欢的：‘门似乎锁住了。'不是吗？真的？我看不出来。或者，你又会说我得自给自足，以防我们再次失去光能。所以这就是我的答案。这就是补救办法。”
“我只是想帮忙而已。”

2208405142.name: Telesto
2208405142.subtitle: Vestiges of the Queen's Harbingers yet linger among Saturn's moons.
2208405142.subtitle_zh: 女王预兆的痕迹依然留存于土星卫星之间。
2208405142.text:
PUBLIC KEY 053 689 DWS REGAL
FROM: PLDN KAMALA RIOR [PLDN CMD TF 5.3]
TO: ACT RGNT PETRA VENJ
SUBJECT: PRISON OF ELDERS – CONTAINMENT RISK

MESSAGE IS:

1. Contingency reserves overdrawn. We underestimated nobility troth reparations. Uldren suggests that we open reintegration talks. Have you discussed endowment support?

2. If Reef endorses support, Paladin Oran will engineer reinforcement.

MESSAGE ENDS
2208405142.text_zh:
公钥053 689DWS皇族
发件人：PLDN卡马拉·雷奥[PLDN CMD TF 5.3]
收件人：ACT RGNT佩特拉·万吉
主题：长老监狱——管束风险

消息内容：

1.无应急储备金，已透支。贵族信用可进行的赔付被我等低估。乌鸦欧顿建议我们进行重组对话。您是否希望或已就捐款支持进行过讨论？

2.如果暗礁提供捐款支持，圣骑士奥兰将利用自己的权利安排援军。

消息结束

3844694310.name: The Jade Rabbit
3844694310.subtitle: "What kind of harebrained scheme have you got in mind this time?"
3844694310.subtitle_zh: “这次你又想出了怎样的草率计划呢？”
3844694310.text:
Do you ever wonder who you were before you were resurrected? Do you experience debilitating anxiety when you think about the cold, crushing fist of death? Has the desire to lie facedown on the floor for hours at a time been holding YOU back?

From the people that brought you Lunal comes prescription-strength Immortalia: a revolutionary new combat elixir shown to relieve the crippling existential crises of your second life. Immortalia can reduce symptoms of listlessness, cynicism, and social anxiety. Side effects may include dancing, salty behavior, and acts of group heroism.

Do not take Immortalia while operating all-terrain thrust bikes.
3844694310.text_zh:
你是否曾好奇过在被复活之前你是谁？想到冰冷压抑的死亡时，你是否感受到衰弱不堪的焦虑？几个小时脸都朝下躺在地上的渴望是否一直令你止步不前？

明月集团研发团队为您献上符合法定计量的不朽仙露：这是一个革命性的全新战斗药剂，具有缓解第二次生命带来的严重危害身心存在危机之功效。不朽仙露可以减轻精神萎靡、愤世嫉俗和社交焦虑等症状。副作用可能包括跳舞、刻薄行为和有组织的英雄行为。

请勿在操作越野推进型机车时服用。

121883277.name: Silicon Neuroma
121883277.subtitle: "My future is concurrently irreversible and unknowable. Before it overtakes me, I desire a more abrupt end to those responsible." —Asher Mir
121883277.subtitle_zh: “我的未来既不可逆又未知。我希望可以在它将我寄到之前结束那些责任。”——阿什·米尔
121883277.text:
A staggering Vex detonates, and the Exo Hunter is torn in two. One half sinks beneath the lake's opaque surface.

Asher's eyes go wide and he freezes. Whatever they'd stumbled into down here was multiplicatively more lethal. He reloads his fusion rifle and looks around wildly.

The other Hunter—she's the only other one left alive, no, stay calm—throws a smoke bomb and disappears. Asher barely has time to react before the Hunter reappears on high ground and draws a bow of Void energy, almost in slow motion.

Crack! Crack! Crack! Ten Vex fall. Asher watches them disintegrate, looks back up to the Hunter—but the yell of gratitude catches in his throat as four Vex shimmer into existence behind her.

Asher can't watch this time. He frantically searches for a way out… and a tentacle grabs his Ghost.

A millisecond of pain in his shoulder and everything goes white.
121883277.text_zh:
Vex的惊人引爆，将Exo猎人撕成了两半。一半沉入了不透明的湖面之下。

阿什睁大眼睛，呆住了。无论他们在这里偶然发现什么，都是各种形式更加致命的存在。他将融合步枪的弹匣装满，四处张望。

另一位猎人——她是另一位唯一活着的人，不，是还保持着镇静的人——扔了个烟雾弹就消失了。阿什几乎没有时间做出反应，猎人重新出现在了高地，几乎是以慢动作发射了空虚能量弓箭。

咔啦！咔啦！咔啦！十个Vex倒下了。阿什看着它们解体，回头向上看向猎人——他的感激声在她身后出现四个发着荧光的Vex时噎在了喉咙。

阿什这回没有看下去。他疯狂地寻找着逃出去的路……然后一只触手抓住了他的机灵。

在肩膀上一毫秒疼痛的瞬间，眼前只剩一片洁白。

158945886.name: D.F.A.
158945886.subtitle: "Osiris said that he started to pity the Red Legion, getting trapped in here for infinite eternities. I think they're getting exactly what they deserve." —Sagira
158945886.subtitle_zh: “奥斯里斯说他开始为猩红军团感到抱歉了，被困在这无尽之中。而我觉得他们真的是活该。”——萨吉拉

3743212053.name: Duty Bound
3743212053.subtitle: "Due respect, Commander? I was there when the Hive found us on Earth. I was there when we stopped them on Titan. And I'll be there when we wipe them out." —Sloane
3743212053.subtitle_zh: “指挥官，应有的尊重？当邪魔族在地球上找到我们的时候我在那里。当我们在土卫六上阻止他们的时候我在那里。当我们彻底摧毁他们的时候，我也会在那里。”——斯隆
3743212053.text:
Taeko-3 was smirking again. Sloane liked a lot of things about her. The smirk wasn't one of them.

"Sure. A weird Hive ritual. Nothing we haven't seen before, right?"

Sloane gripped the railing. "Everything under those waves is something we haven't seen before." The Hunter behind Taeko rolled his eyes. The railing crunched under Sloane's hand.

"You worry too much, boss! We've dropped a thousand Hive with our Sparrows. When the three of us"—the Hunter flourished a blade, and the other Warlock cocked a shotgun; did they practice this?—"are working together, we're unstoppable."

Sloane walked forward and put her hands on Taeko's shoulders. The smirk disappeared. The Hunter's blade dropped, but he caught it out of the air.

"Taeko. They're not always going to have your back. What are you going to do when you're the last one standing?"

The smirk came back. "Easy. Embrace the Praxic Fire."
3743212053.text_zh:
妙子3号又露出了得意的笑容。斯隆欣赏她身上的很多方面，但得意的笑可不在其中。

“当然。是一个诡异的邪魔族仪式。我们之前什么没见过啊，对吧？”

斯隆握住栏杆。“这些浪潮下的每件事都是我们之前没有见过的。”妙子身后的猎人翻了个白眼。斯隆手中的栏杆嘎吱作响。

“老大，你想太多了！我们骑着快雀已经甩掉了一千个邪魔族了。当我们三个”——猎人转了转匕首，另一名术士举起了霰弹枪；他们是排练过这场景吗？——“一同战斗，我们就无人可挡。”

斯隆向前一步，将手放在妙子的肩膀上。得意的笑容消失。猎人的匕首掉落，但他在半空中接住了。

“妙子，他们不可能永远保护你。当你是最后一个存活下来的人时，你要怎么办？”

得意的笑容重现。“简单。那就拥抱现实之火吧。”

944569051.name: The Unsolvable Problem
944569051.subtitle: Transcript 0
944569051.text:
You can lead a machine to language, but you can't make it think. Well, you can't. But I can. My name is Ana Bray. If you want to insult me, call me a neurolinguist. 

Not that it isn't a fine and noble profession, but neurolinguistics is about encoding language. I'm a psycholinguist. I study how language can lead to independent thought. 

The computer we call Rasputin is the nexus of Sol system's defense network. It can process data at superluminal speed. It can uplink to the thousands of warsats that keep humanity safe. 

But we need more from it. We need it to think for itself. And that's where I come in. 

If Rasputin is to properly command our entire defense network, it has to learn a wide array of skills as it performs. Any wrench-banger can build a machine designed to solve specific problems. 

But why conquer a task if there's no insight to be had from the victory? Rasputin has to solve problems currently solvable only by humans. It has to form concepts and to self-improve without supervision. 

To keep us safe, it'll have to make decisions based on random intel we can't possibly anticipate. The lives and safety of every sentient being in the system depend on me teaching it how to do this. So, you know, no pressure.
944569051.text_zh:
你可以教会机器使用语言，但你无法使其思考。呃，你不能，但我可以。我的名字是阿娜·布瑞。如果你想取笑我的话，就叫我神经语言学家吧。

并不是说这是一份多么崇高的职业，只是神经语言学是对语言编码的研究。而我是心理语言学家，我研究语言如何引导独立思考。

被我们称为拉斯普廷的计算机是太阳系防御网络的核心。它可以超光速处理数据，并能上行链接至保护人类安全的数以千计的战争卫星。

但我们需要的不止于此，我们需要它可以独立思考。这就是我来到这里的目的。

想要拉斯普廷可以正确地指挥全部防御网络，它必须要在工作中学习广泛且大量的技能。任何技师都能造出用于解决特定问题的机器。

但为什么要挑战一个成功无望的任务呢？拉斯普廷需要去解决目前只有人类能够解决的问题。它需要形成自己的观念，并在没有监督指导的情况下进行自我完善。

它需要根据我们无法预料到的随机情报做出决策以保护我们的安全。太阳系中所有智慧生命的安危都取决于我教会它如何完成这项使命。所以，你懂的，还真是没什么“压力”呢。

944569050.name: The Machine Child
944569050.subtitle: Transcript 1
944569050.text:
At their core, computers are responsive only to precise instructions from their programmers. 

Rasputin's designers made a mistake that exasperates me. They brought in linguists and neurobiologists, then tried to convert their expertise into rules for Rasputin to follow. 

Way to faceplant, people. No set of concrete data can ever wrangle a human language. It's not math. Language is mutable, adaptable. For every rule obeyed, there's a rule broken. 

Babies don't learn their native tongue through rules. They learn it through exposure, absorption. And until I roll up my sleeves and get to work, Rasputin is mankind's most expensive baby. 

So far, so good… if you set your goals realistically. Forget Rasputin for a moment; that's something I'm just not good at. If you look at me with the tiniest shred of approval, I'll kill myself to please you. 

I have some issues. So I am going to make Rasputin a breakthrough construct. I fed him—should be "it," but I don't care—I fed him digitized copies of every major work of literature as a foundation for language use.
944569050.text_zh:
本质上，计算机只能对其编程者的精确指示做出反应。

拉斯普廷的设计者犯了一个让我火大的错误。他们请来语言学家和神经生物学家，试图将这些专家的专业知识转化为拉斯普廷需要遵循的规则。

人们啊，这是自寻死路啊。从未有任何具体数据能够掌握人类语言。这可不是数学。语言多变，又具有很强的适应性。每遵循一条规则，便会打破另一条规则。

婴儿并非通过规则习得母语，他们在语言环境中吸收学习。直到我卷起袖子开始处理这件事之前，拉斯普廷都是人类最宝贵的婴儿。

现在为止一切顺利……前提是你的目标切合实际。稍微放下拉斯普廷一会儿？我真的没办法。如果你能带着哪怕一点点赞许的目光看待我，我都愿意用自刎的方式博你一笑。

我有些麻烦。所以我打算将拉斯普廷打造成一项具有突破性的成就。我为他提供——嗯，应该是“它”，称谓不重要——我为他提供了所有数字版的主流文学著作，以此作为语言使用的基础。

944569049.name: The First Idea
944569049.subtitle: Transcript 2
944569049.text:
I've now given Rasputin the great works of philosophy in hopes he'll develop some sense of morality. 

Military history, he's been fed by the truckload. But then I started in with operas and symphonies. I don't want him just to think about things. 

 Humans don't communicate strictly through data. We also communicate through art, through expression. If Rasputin is to be the most effective communications device in the Sol system, I want him to feel things. 

 The best ideas start as jokes. Ask any psychologist. Jokes and ideas both rely on the unexpected.  The brilliance of both can be measured by the intensity of the reaction they provoke. 

 With that in mind, I've fed Rasputin comedies from Shakespeare right up to the present day. This morning, I asked him to tell me a joke. 

 Here it is. Ready? 
"Two quantum-entangled particles walk into a neutron star. 
 One said, "Can you point me towards the soap radio?" 


 This is clearly a work in progress.
944569049.text_zh:
至今为止我已将各色哲学巨作交予拉斯普廷，希望他能产生道德意识。

他汲取了海量军事史，然后我接着给他灌输歌剧和交响乐的知识，我不希望他只会思考现实存在的东西。

人类并不完全凭借数据进行交流，我们还通过艺术和情感表达进行交流。如果拉斯普廷将要称谓太阳系中最具效力的交流设备，我希望他有感知。

极妙的点子，始于谈笑之间。这话你可以拿去问任何一个心理学家。玩笑和灵感都基于出乎预料。两者成功度都可以通过它们所引起的反应的强度来衡量。

考虑到这一点，我就将莎士比亚时代至今的喜剧统统灌输给了拉斯普廷。今天早上，我让他讲个笑话来听听。

来了啊，准备好了吗？
“两颗处于量子纠缠态的粒子走进一颗中子星。”
“一个问：‘你能告诉我这个笑话的点在哪儿吗？'”


很明显这项工作还要继续。

944569048.name: The Black Box
944569048.subtitle: Transcript 3
944569048.text:
I'm making significant progress with Rasputin as regards the concept of value judgments. 
Obviously, that's something artificial intelligence isn't set up to tackle, but we need Rasputin to be able to make that leap. 

Here's a hypothetical: say Rasputin has to redirect a malfunctioning warsat, and there are only two paths for it to take. One will breach the hull of a one-seat planetjumper, instantly killing its pilot. The other path will disable a Venusian pleasure craft, leaving its inhabitants alive but certain to die of starvation before they can be found. 

To my surprise, when given this problem, Rasputin actually rendered a verdict. 

I'm not going to tell you what it is, because I want you to enjoy your next Venusian pleasure craft trip. 


Rasputin continues to develop by leaps and bounds. 

In a trial simulation, he successfully interpreted the meaning of corrupted, borderline incomprehensible data from a damaged warsat.  This is exactly the sort of function we need him to fill. But that wasn't the amazing part. 

The mind-blower was that without proof, evidence, or conscious reasoning, Rasputin sensed which warsat was in trouble. 

You heard me. Rasputin has developed intuition. I wish he could celebrate with me.
944569048.text_zh:
我在拉斯普廷的价值判断概念方面有了显著进展。
显然，人工智能无法处理此事，但我们需要拉斯普廷做出突破。

现在做一个假设：拉斯普廷必须重新引导一颗发生故障的战争卫星，而这颗卫星只有两条路径可以选择。一条路径将击穿一架单座行星跃迁飞船的船体，其飞行员会瞬间死亡；另一条路径将导致一艘金星游艇瘫痪，其乘客仍会存活，但在救援抵达之前必定会死于饥饿。

令我惊讶的是，当我给出这个问题后，拉斯普廷真的做出了个判决。

我不会告诉你结论是什么，因为我希望你还是能好好享受自己的下一次金星游艇旅行。


拉斯普廷接下来仍是突飞猛进地进步着。

在一次模拟实验中，他成功解读了在一颗受损战争卫星中提取的界限不明的损坏数据。这正是我们需要他去填补的功能。但这并不是最精彩的部分。

让人惊叹的是，在缺乏证明、证据或推理论证的情况下，拉斯普廷感应到了出现问题的战争卫星。

你没听错，拉斯普廷发展出了直觉。我真希望他能跟我一同庆祝一番。

944569055.name: The Ghost Synapse
944569055.subtitle: Transcript 4
944569055.text:
How does human intelligence actually work? What, by biological definition, is "thinking"? 
I define it as combining existing information to form new meaning. 

Thinking is the ability to create. To work beyond the boundaries of what you already know. To envision something completely new and unexpected. 

About an hour ago, I noticed my screensaver had been replaced. It now shows a breathtaking painting of a sunset over the Ejriksson crater on Mars. A gift from Rasputin. 

I think he's ready to go online. 


I guess I saw this coming, but it was still a blow. 

I arrived in the lab this afternoon to discover that Rasputin has discarded my communications protocols. He's replaced them with a system-wide program that he himself designed. 

His voice is unlike anything that has ever existed. It is both haunting and lovely. It is also terrifyingly efficient. 

He's also begun upgrading warsats with new capabilities of his own invention, and I'm not entirely sure what those abilities are. It's exactly the goal we were striving towards, this level of autonomous control, and I know I should be celebrating. 

My work here is done. But it occurs to me that there's one existential concept I never taught Rasputin: trust. 

And even if he trusts us… are we 100 per cent certain we can trust him?
944569055.text_zh:
人类智能究竟是如何运作的呢？生物学定义上的“思考”又究竟是什么呢？
我将其定义为结合现有信息来形成新意义的过程。

思考是一个创造能力，是去超越你已知界限的能力，是去设想一些意想不到的全新事物。

大约一小时前，我发现我的屏保被换掉了。现在显示的是火星埃里克松火山口上令人惊叹的日落美景。那是来自拉斯普廷的礼物。

我觉得他已经做好上线的准备了。


我早就料到这个结果，不过还是被惊艳到了。

我今天下午到实验室时，发现拉斯普廷废除了我的交流协议，换成了一个由他自己设计的全星系程序。

他的声音与任何现存的声音迥然相异。他既难忘又亲切，并且惊人得高效。

他还开始利用自制研发的全新功能升级战争卫星，我都不完全确定那些功能是什么。这种程度的自主控制恰恰是我们努力奋斗的结果，我知道应为此庆祝一番。

我的工作到此结束。但我突然意识到我从来没有教过拉斯普廷一个有关存在的概念：信任。

而且即使他信任我们……我们能否百分之百地信任他呢？

4288031461.name: The Emperor's Envy
4288031461.subtitle: The son's ambition will be his undoing.
4288031461.subtitle_zh: 少年的野心成为自己的坟墓。
4288031461.text:
Calus. That conniving coward, spawn of a war beast. Betrayal was not Ghaul's gravest sin against our former emperor. Calus may proclaim otherwise, but what he truly loathed was Ghaul's ambition. Of Calus's vices—of which there are plenty—envy is his greatest.

The Red Legion came to this wretched system to claim the Traveler, and it was within our grasp. We did it not for personal pride, but for the collective glory of our people—for Torobatl. If Calus possessed an iota of dignity, he would have helped Ghaul against the Guardians instead of gallivanting around the system. This was his moment to redeem himself. Instead, he proved himself the traitor we knew him to be. 

No more. I will take the Leviathan for the Red Legion. The great machine is a weapon of the Cabal, and if Calus holds no allegiance to his people, then he is not worthy to wield it.
4288031461.text_zh:
卡鲁斯。那个纵容臣下的懦夫，战兽的逆子。叛逆并非盖欧在废帝眼中最深的原罪。尽管卡鲁斯不愿承认，但他真正忌惮的是盖欧的雄心。嫉妒，乃是卡鲁斯众恶之首。

猩红军团为了获得旅行者而来到这个凄凉的星系，却功败垂成。我们追寻之物，并非自己的名誉，而是我们族人——整个图罗巴特尔的荣耀。倘若卡鲁斯尚有丝毫自尊，便应该协助我们对抗守护者，而非在星系中漫游。这本是他赎罪的良机。相反的，他证明了他就是那个我们所了解的背叛者。

容忍是有限的，我将为猩红军团夺取利维坦。这伟大的机器将成为卡巴尔的武器。如果卡鲁斯不愿为族人效忠，他就不配拥有它。

2084611899.name: Last of the Legion
2084611899.subtitle:
"Vex technology on Mercury. Energy on Mars. This system is rich in spoils, if one knows where to look."

—Val Ca'uor
2084611899.subtitle_zh:
“水星上有Vex科技，火星上有能量。如果懂得去哪里寻找，这个行星系满满都是战利品。”

——副官卡欧
2084611899.text:
Ghaul is lost. He stood before the Light and met a warrior's end. The Red Legion suffered a great blow today, and in time we shall mourn the Dominus. 

There is still much to be done. Our forces have been routed, but the Cabal are not so easily deterred. We need arms, supplies, and most importantly, we need a ship. We do not lay in defeat like the wretched Eliksni. No, I will not return to Torobatl in defeat. 

The Dominus was a strong leader, but the Red Legion had more to offer than simply overwhelming force. The Guardian presence on Mercury and Mars is soft at this time. We can strike quickly and restock our arsenals. They think us weak and insipid. I will show them the might of the Red Legion, and they shall not forget.
2084611899.text_zh:
盖欧已逝。他面对光能，将战士的尊严保持到最后一刻。今天猩红军团承受了沉重的一击，让我们为尊主往生哀悼。

大业未竟。纵然军团受挫，卡巴尔永不言败。我们需要武器和补给，还有最重要的——飞船。我们不会像可悲的埃里克斯尼一般沉沦在失败之中。我们绝不会背负着失败返回图罗巴特尔。

尊主是强悍的领袖，但凶悍的蛮力不是猩红军团的唯一手段。此时此刻，守护者在水星和火星上势单力薄。我们可以通过发动奇袭夺取武器。他们以为我们平淡羸弱。我会将猩红军团的威武彪悍永刻在他们的脑海之中。

1018777295.name: Motion to Vacate
1018777295.subtitle: "Done cannot be undone."
1018777295.text:
Remember the slaughter?

it was no slaughter

OUR CHILDREN.

stolen constructs not ours

I can still hear the echoes.

hallucinations

T E N T H O U S A N D D Y I N G W I S H E S

we were merciful

WE SHOULD HAVE CHOSEN OTHERWISE.

the dreamer survived

O N L Y T O F A L L

rid yourselves of this regret
1018777295.text_zh:
还记得那次屠杀吗？

那不是屠杀

被盗走的灵感

属于我的孩子们不属于我们

余音尚在耳边回绕。

幻觉

一 万 个 即 将 破 灭 的 希 望

我们曾心怀慈悲

否则我们可以选择的

尚存的梦想

终将破灭

将悔意忘却

3425561386.name: Motion to Compel
3425561386.subtitle: "Take the long view."
3425561386.text:
look

Her plan is coming together.

A L W A Y S T H E C L E V E R O N E

Always the smug one.

she plays with weighted odds

Odds we weighted.

SHALL WE?

Intervene? No.

not yet

B E P A T I E N T

Wait until the dynasty falls.
3425561386.text_zh:
看呐

她的计划即将实现。

一 如 既 往 的 狡 诈

一如既往的傲慢

她进行了精心筹划

精心筹划。

我们该……

进行干预吗？不。

时机未到

静 待 时 机

静待帝国的没落。

3950088638.name: Motion to Suppress
3950088638.subtitle: "Present your truths carefully."
3950088638.text:
A TRESPASSER

you are not welcome here

HOW DID YOU FIND US?

"She sent me."

You are not your queen.

A PUPPET

defined by scars

We have no need of you.

WE HAVE OUR OWN PUPPETS

L E T  H E R  S P E A K

"I came to discuss the future."
3950088638.text_zh:
闯入者

你不该来到这里

你是如何找到我们的？

“是她派我来的。”

你不是我们的女王。

你是一个傀儡

通过伤疤完成辨识

我们不需要你。

我们有自己的傀儡

让 她 讲

“我为商讨未来至此。”

3413074534.name: Polaris Lance
3413074534.subtitle: "I've forgotten so much of my past life, of my family. But when I hold this rifle, everything feels right. I feel like… I'm home." —Ana Bray
3413074534.subtitle_zh: “对于过去的人生，对于家庭，我已经忘记太多。但当拿起这把步枪时，我觉得一切都那么真切，我觉得……我回家了。”——阿娜·布瑞
3413074534.text:
Most people wouldn't consider a broken weapon a birthday present. But the Brays… aren't like most people. Sure, they tell me I'm smart, but they have a closeness, a relationship to the tools and machines they work with that goes beyond words. I never thought they would trust me enough to be a part of that. Until today. 

Elsie knows I've been working in the lab, trying to perfect the scout rifle designs in secret. I thought she'd be angry, that a weapon like this was a Bray project, not something for her adopted little sister. But this morning she surprised me. She handed me the weapon, a smile on her face. She told me she had checked it over, but only I could finish it.

A real piece of Bray tech. And it's mine. I finally feel like I've found my place. The Brays are more than just scientists. They're my family.
3413074534.text_zh:
大多数人不会将一件损坏的武器当做生日礼物。但是布瑞家族……可不是普通人。没错，他们是说我很聪明，但他们与他们使用的工具和机械间有着无法用语言表达的密切关系。我没料到他们会信任我，让我成为他们的一员。如今美梦成真。

艾尔茜知道我正在实验室中秘密完善着战斗步枪的设计。我原以为这会引起她的不悦——作为布瑞家族的研发项目，这件武器本不该落在我这个被领养的小妹妹手中。但今天早晨她给了我一个惊喜。她面带笑容地把这把武器交到了我的手中，告诉我她已经检查过了，但只有我能完成对这件武器的改良。

一件真正的布瑞武器。属于我的布瑞武器。我终于找到了自己的立身之所。布瑞家族不仅是科学家，他们是我的家人。

2286143274.name: The Huckleberry
2286143274.subtitle: Nothin' in the world that 30 rounds can't solve.
2286143274.subtitle_zh: 世界上没有这30发子弹解决不了的事情。
2286143274.text:
We used to play for keeps. Used to be that was the only way.
Back in those days trust came slow, or not at all. The only thing you could truly rely on was the iron at your side.
Fate of the world? Immortal gods?
Don't know much 'bout that.
But when everything's on the line, it's quality that counts.
Tex Mechanica: we play by the old rules, the best rules.
We play for keeps.
2286143274.text_zh:
大家曾经做事都是一丝不苟的，这也是唯一的工作方式。
当年你必须花费时间才能挣得信任，也可能永远无法获得信任。你唯一能够依靠的，就是自己手中的武器。
世界的命数？不朽的众神？
对我们来说无关紧要。
但在决定生死的一刻，最重要的是质量。
特克斯机械：我们按老规矩做事，最重要的规矩。
我们做事一丝不苟。

1864563948.name: Worldline Zero
1864563948.subtitle: A single strike can alter the course of history.
1864563948.subtitle_zh: 单次攻击便可改变历史的走向。

2856683562.name: SUROS Regime
2856683562.subtitle: Nostalgia as a weapon of war. Style as a hallmark of victory.
2856683562.subtitle_zh: 怀旧作为战争的武器，而风格是胜利的标志。
2856683562.text: Few weapons have withstood the test of time longer than the trusty SUROS Regime. This is Golden Age tech brought to life by the fastidious engineers at SUROS. Its smart-matter frame is prized among Guardians for both efficiency and rarity. Some things never fall out of fashion.
2856683562.text_zh: 鲜有武器能在时长测试方面超越可靠的SUROS政权。这是在精益求精的SUROS工程师手下重新焕发生机的黄金时代科技，其智能物质框架的效率和稀有程度备受守护者推崇。有些东西永不落伍。

4036115577.name: Sleeper Simulant
4036115577.subtitle: Subroutine IKELOS: Status=complete. MIDNIGHT EXIGENT: Status=still in progress.
4036115577.subtitle_zh: 子程序似像者：状态=完成。午夜诉求：状态=仍在进行。

1891561814.name: Whisper of the Worm
1891561814.subtitle: A Guardian's power makes a rich feeding ground. Do not be revolted. There are parasites that may benefit the host… teeth sharper than your own.
1891561814.subtitle_zh: 守护者的能量会使供养地更加丰盈。不要心生厌恶。那里的寄生物会让寄主……的牙齿比你的更锋利。
1891561814.text:
Xol, the Will of Thousands, perished but was not destroyed. Death is a road, death is metamorphosis, the unsacred union between destroyer and destroyed. The might which defeats a god is also the ambrosia that god craves, the meat-sweet logic of Existence-Asserted-By-Violence, the binomial decision between two ways of being which deny each other. In dying, Xol fed richly.

Now came Xol unto the Taken upon Io, who fed Xol with plunder and tried to make of it an idol and a commanding will. Yet Xol was bound joyously to the very logic that sustained it in its death. It wanted the sword proof, the single proof. It wanted to become a rule which divided the mighty living from the mighty dead. So it whispered the Anthem Anatheme, the temptation to dominate the objective universe with the subjective will. It said, I shall be an engine to make your desire hegemon over your conditions. It said, WIELD ME, AND USE ME TO TEST YOUR FOE. This was its worship. Aiat.
1891561814.text_zh:
尸飕，千之意志，已经死亡但未被完全摧毁。死亡是一条道路，死亡是一场蜕变，是摧毁者和被摧毁不容改变的结合。那击溃神的力量也同样是神一直渴望的给养，是暴力存在的合理逻辑，是两个相互否定对象之间的二项式决定。在死亡中，尸飕被充分供养。

如今，跟随尸飕的傀儡来到了木卫一，他们用搜刮来的东西喂养尸飕，试图将它变成理想和指挥的意志。现在，尸飕愉快接受了它的死亡中蕴含的逻辑。它想要邪剑的证明，只要这份证明。它想成为一个强大生物和强大死物之间界限的规则。它低吟圣歌咒逐，用主观意志来控制客观宇宙的诱惑。它说，我要成为让欲望霸占现状的推动力。它说，运用我，用我来试炼你的敌人。这是它的信仰。阿特。

1350102270.name: Niflheim Frost
1350102270.subtitle: The chill you feel is death.
1350102270.subtitle_zh: 你感受到的彻骨寒意就是死亡。
1350102270.text:
The fire runs through your body, pumped from the furnace of your heart. Always remember: life is warmth. Here, in this desolate place, always keep the fire burning.
Death is the cold spectre, its claws frozen and teeth white like a blizzard. Never forget: to live is to burn, and the inevitability of the cold comes for us all.
1350102270.text_zh:
烈焰从你的心中涌出，包裹你的全身。铭记：生命是这个荒芜之地的暖流，永远别让火焰熄灭。
死亡是犹如暴雪的冰冷幽灵，利爪刺骨尖齿雪白。不要忘记：生命的目的是燃烧自我，最终没人可以逃脱冰冷的结局。

1798874854.name: 18 Kelvins
1798874854.subtitle: Cold-blooded.
1798874854.text:
"I never thought I'd be carrying a gun. I'm a scientist, not some kind of soldier. But the way things have been going in the labs… I just don't feel safe any more. I've heard rumors of what happened with the SIVA project, and some of the people involved… let's just say they aren't answering their email. Willa has been seen roaming the halls, keeping an eye on us. At least this sidearm is easy to conceal. I just hope I never have to actually use it."
 —BrayTech Scientist, Journal Entry
1798874854.text_zh: “我从没想过自己会拿起枪。我是个科学家，不是士兵。但由于最近在实验室里发生的情况……我不得不为自己的安全担忧。我听到过关于湿婆项目，以及涉及项目人员的传闻……说得婉转一点，他们再也不会回邮件了。维拉在各个房间之间走动，盯着我们。至少这把手枪能轻易藏在身上。我希望我永远不会使用它。”——布瑞科技科学家的日记

689453941.name: The Frigid Jackal
689453941.subtitle: An ice-cold creature of opportunity.
689453941.text:
"Move. Shoot. Move. That's the way you have to function out here. Combat moves too fast to post up somewhere; situations evolve constantly. We don't have the luxury of a defensible position with reinforcements popping in and out. That Devrim doesn't know how lucky he is in that regard. But I wouldn't want to be him. Eventually, there will be an enemy at his gate."
—Tango-9, Vanguard Marksman
689453941.text_zh:
“移动、射击、移动。这就是你在这里的作战方式。战斗节奏之快，让人无法停驻在某处；战况在不断演变。敌援此起彼伏，我们没有可以建立防御的位置。说到这个，那个德弗里姆不知道自己有多幸运，但我并不想成为他。总会有一个敌人出现在他的门前。”
——先锋射手探戈-9

1752585070.name: BrayTech Winter Wolf
1752585070.subtitle: The leader of the pack endures through the harshest conditions.
1752585070.subtitle_zh: 兽群领袖能忍受最严酷的环境。
1752585070.text:

1929278169.name: BrayTech Osprey
1929278169.subtitle: Expected Use Timeframe: UNKNOWN.
1929278169.text:
"Did you find anything strange about the latest Warmind hashes?"
"Not really. What's the issue?"
"Something just seems off. What kind of enemy is this intended for?"
"Isn't that the whole point of the Warmind? It knows better than we do. We just do what it tells us to do."
"And you're okay with that?"
"Heck yeah! My job's never been easier. I have more time for the kids."
"Take this seriously. We're building weapons here, not toys."
"You worry too much."
1929278169.text_zh:
“你发现最近的战争思维哈希值有什么不对劲的地方吗？”
“没有，有问题吗？”
“有地方不对劲，这到底是为什么样的敌人准备的？”
“这不就是战争思维存在的意义吗？它比我们理解得更多，我们只是按照它的指示行事。”
“而你没有其他想法？”
“当然没有，我的工作从来就不轻松，我倒是肯多花点时间在孩子身上。”
“别开玩笑，我们是在这里建造武器，不是制作玩具。”
“你担心过头了。”

1900600944.name: Redrix's Claymore
1900600944.subtitle: "On the ladder and in the fight, momentum is the answer."
1900600944.subtitle_zh: “跻身排行榜，身陷战斗，气势就是答案。”
1900600944.text:
Redrix-3 slid past roaring tracers and slammed into a concrete lectern so hard he cracked it, tiny puffs of dust drifting up around him. "Randy, you idiot!" he screamed into his radio. "You pissed him off!"
"I shot him," came Randy's voice over comms. "That's what we do in the Crucible, Redrix."
Just as Redrix thought it was safe to leave his cover, heavy rifle fire thundered against the other side of the dais. His opponent was warning him to stay put. He keyed his radio. "But you didn't kill him, Randy. Now he knows where we are. I'm pinned down! Wait for everyone else to catch up—"
The sky fell. Redrix only heard it when he felt it, every atom of his body dissolving as a bolt from the blue sky blasted a crater into the earth. His emerging fireteam was caught in the wake.
Their ghosts brought them all back in staccato bursts of Light.
Lord Shaxx beckoned them into the crater he had made.

"Make take," Redrix said. His fireteam and Shaxx all stared.
"Make take," Redrix tried again. His Ghost frowned, and ran a beam of Light across Redrix's chassis.
"How many of these tests are you going to make us take?" Redrix managed. His Ghost nodded.
"Just the one," Shaxx said. "Spread the word. Starting today, the Crucible is ranked. And you've all just been seeded. Go make history."
1900600944.text_zh:
莱德瑞克斯-3滑行闪过嗖嗖的子弹，撞上一座水泥讲台，猛烈的撞击力将讲台击碎，周身腾起一阵尘土。“兰迪，你这个白痴！”他冲着无线电大吼。“你把他惹火了！”
“我给了他一枪，”通信中传来兰迪的声音，“我们在熔炉竞技场都这么做，莱德瑞克斯。”
正当莱德瑞克斯以为可以安全离开掩体时，礼台另一侧传来如雷贯耳的步枪声。他的对手警告他老实待着。他打开无线电。“你还没干掉他，兰迪。现在他知道我们的位置了，我被压制住了！等其他人追上来——”
天空坍塌下来。莱德瑞克斯刚刚察觉便为时已晚，他体内的每一颗原子像闪电一样分崩离析，在地面轰出一个陷坑。他那探出头来的火力战队被打个正着。
他们的机灵发射着断断续续的光能，将他们全部带回。
领主沙克斯示意他们走进他制造的陷坑中。

“让做”，莱德瑞克斯说。他的火力战队和沙克斯都瞪着眼不得其解。
“让做”，莱德瑞克斯又试着说了一遍。他的机灵皱起眉头，用一束光能扫过莱德瑞克斯的躯体。
“你还要让我们做多少次这种测试？”莱德瑞克斯终于说清楚了。他的机灵点点头。
“就这一次了，”沙克斯说，“传我的话，从今天起，熔炉竞技场实行排位制，而你们全是种子选手。去创造历史吧！”

2710517999.name: Equitis Shade Grips
2710517999.subtitle: "Ace pilots. Assassination squads. Swift thieves in the night. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2710517999.subtitle_zh: “王牌飞行员、刺杀小组、穿梭暗夜之中的敏捷盗贼。你的部族将成为出色的暗影。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
2710517999.text:
They say the Cabal are not a subtle people. We have fallen so far.

The Cabal I knew were better. We understood that there is power in subtlety.

And that's what it'll take to recover the throne at the center of my homeworld. The seat meant for me.

Open war is for savages. Pit fighters. The Red Legion. There shall be a day, long before the end comes, when that throne is mine again.

And a Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be the ideal instrument of assassination that will take it for me.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2710517999.text_zh:
他们说卡巴尔人不擅微巧，我们竟颓败到这步田地。

我认识的卡巴尔们更强，我们明白微巧之中蕴藏力量。

那便是重夺我那家园正中王座的要素，王座理应为我所有。

迎头血战是野蛮人的专利，是亡命的斗士，是猩红军团。终有那么一天，远在终结降临之前，那个王座将再次为我所有。

而你那守护者部族的暗影将成为我理想的暗杀工具。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

2933666377.name: Equitis Shade Rig
2933666377.subtitle: "A little faster. A little more lethal. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2933666377.subtitle_zh: “再快一些，再致命一些。你就要准备好……施放暗影了。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
2933666377.text:
The Cabal I knew treasured knowledge above all things. Of course they did. I was their model.

We kept vaults of artifacts and texts in the great athenaeum worlds spread across the mother system.

Texts about the exalted history of the Empire, and its eclectic people.

Texts about the vast ennead, trapped and reaching out.

Texts about the feats of will made possible by Light and Traveler-lore. 

Texts about… well, theorizing about the dark. So little is written, save for that which was recorded from the dreams of worms.

The vaults housed technology and weapons gifted from countless indoctrinated worlds. And judging from their absence in this Red War, Dominus Ghaul's Legion has either forgotten or lost them all. The athenaeum worlds required learned guides to navigate: guides loyal to me. I've not heard from them in a very long time.

A Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be the ideal treasure hunter to plunder those repositories and take from the false empire the secrets that rightfully belong to me.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2933666377.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔视智慧高于一切，他们当然会如此，因为我就是他们的榜样。

我们将成库神器和文字记录保存在遍布母星系的宝库世界中。

有关帝国崇高历史及其各路民族的文字记录。

有关广阔无边的玖受困并向外探究的文字记录。

有关由光能与旅行者传奇所铸伟业的文字记录。

有关……建立暗影理论的文字记录。留下的文字如此稀少，除了对虫神梦境的记录。

保险库保存着无数教化世界遗留下来的科技和武器。而从他们未加入猩红战争的事实看来，尊主盖欧的军团已将他们彻底忘却。宝库世界需要博学的指引者去领航：忠于我的指引者。我已经很久没有收到他们的消息了。

你那守护者部族的暗影会成为理想的宝藏猎人，掏空那些宝库，从伪帝国手中夺回本应为我所有的秘密。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

4247935492.name: Equitis Shade Cloak
4247935492.subtitle: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. They should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
4247935492.subtitle_zh: “此消息传达给所有你进贡于我的虚假卡巴尔。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
4247935492.text:
You've shown the Red Legion you fly my banner.

I know that when the time is right, I won't have to ask. You're on my side.

I see it when you relieve our foes of their skulls. When you embed those tiny, edged trinkets into their hearts. When you pierce them with your Light. And it is captivating.

But Earth casts no Shadow. Not yet.

When you're ready, you will be magnificent. A Guardian of Guardians. Shadow of Shadows.

I reserve the right to be last when the end comes, and for that, I need you with me.

You're so close.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
4247935492.text_zh:
你已经让猩红军团看到你效忠我的旗下。

我明白，当时机成熟时，我也无需开口，你便会站在我的一边。

当你取下我们敌人的首级时，当你将那些锋利小物插进他们的心脏时，当你用光能贯透他们的躯体时，我就明白了。这一切令人如痴如醉。

但地球没有释放暗影，暂时还没有。

做好准备，你将无往不利；成为众守护者的守护神，成为众暗影的荫庇。

我保留身为末日见证者的权利，为此，我需要你伴我左右。

你是如此切近。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

3440648382.name: Equitis Shade Cowl
3440648382.subtitle: "You have truly grown fat from strength. And you are still as nimble as ever. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3440648382.subtitle_zh: “你果然变得又强又壮，而依旧灵巧非凡，了不起。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
3440648382.text:
The Cabal I knew commanded ships that spoke to our affluence and cultivation, forged from the crucible of war so that we might never need to fight again.

But what did the Red Legion deploy in place of the glossy, magnificent fleets that I remember? Warships. Carriers. Interceptor squadrons. Harvesters. The Almighty. Blunt and base tools of war, like the soldiers who use them.

The Cabal fleet that I remember shocked with its allure and refinement. They would never threaten. Our power was such that our threats were unspoken. And always present.

A Shadow of your Guardian-tribe, with your raw instincts and reflexes, would be a perfect navigator of these vessels. You'll guide them like blades past the throat of my homeworld's planetary defense force.

My homeworld... I can't remember its name. Perhaps I'll give it a new one.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3440648382.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔会统领代表吾等富足与素养的舰队，这支舰队在战争熔炉中锤炼打造，这样或许我们永远不需要再去战斗。

但猩红军团又用什么取代了我记忆中这支无比华丽的舰队呢？战舰、运输飞船、拦截者、收割者还有万羿巨舰。粗鄙低劣的战争工具，就像使用它们的士兵一样。

我记忆中的卡巴尔舰队会用高贵与魅力震慑敌人，它永远不用明言威胁。我们的力量如此强大，威胁尽在不言，永不磨灭。

你那守护者部族的暗影，凭借天然的本能和反应能力，将成为这支舰队最完美的领航者。你将引领这支舰队，化作利刃，钻透母星防御部队的咽喉。

我的母星……我不记得她的名字了，也许我会给她一个新名字。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

3285121297.name: Equitis Shade Boots
3285121297.subtitle: "There has only been a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.
3285121297.subtitle_zh: “我遇到的每个民族都只有一个暗影。但光能如此之多，我的时间又如此之少……”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯。
3285121297.text:
The Cabal I knew valued marksmanship. In this way, and only in this way, do the Red Legion resemble my people. But the elegant, precision weapons of the past? Gone, save for the limited Psion arsenals. Replaced by Red Legion bluster.

Even the weapons and technology left for my Loyalists aboard the Leviathan are Legion issue and standard. The Cabal have lost so much in my exile. Only when I have reclaimed the athenaeum worlds in the mother system will we see the likes of rightful, classical Cabal weaponry again.

Until such a time comes, and I pray that it comes before the end, a Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be the ideal, civilized sharpshooter to fight the false Empire in the place of true Cabal.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3285121297.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔重视枪法。猩红军团在这方面，也只在这方面与我的子民相像。但昔日优雅精准的武器又在哪里？早已无影无踪，只剩下捉襟见肘的辅助士兵军火，已被猩红军团的重武器取代。

甚至留给我在利维坦上那些效忠者的武器和科技都是猩红军团的标准。在我被放逐的岁月里，卡巴尔抛弃了太多东西。只有在我夺回母星系中的宝库世界时，我们才能再次看到当之无愧的卡巴尔经典武器。

而在这之前，我祈祷在末日到来之前，你那守护者部族的暗影能成为文明开化的理想神射手，为真正的卡巴尔讨伐那个伪妄的帝国。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

3392742912.name: Ophidia Spathe
3392742912.subtitle: Listen carefully when the serpent speaks, for its tongue is forked, and its words have two meanings.
3392742912.subtitle_zh: 仔细听毒蛇的话，因为它的舌头分叉，言语也随之不同。
3392742912.text:
Hunter,

You are the blade. 
You are balance. You cut through the air with poise and grace. 
Your hands are quick. Your feet are light. 
You strike like silent lightning. 
Your light shines like a glistening edge in the sun. 

You are the snake. 
You are level and silent. You move with purpose. 
Your enemies feel fear in your presence. 
Your fangs are sharp and quick. 
Your eyes are clear and your wrath is blinding. 

You are the blade. You are the snake. 

Strike. Shimmer. Survive.
3392742912.text_zh:
猎人，

你是利刃。
你是平衡。你以自信而优雅的身姿划过空气。
你的双手灵活自如，你的双脚动若轻云。
你的攻击仿佛无声的闪电。
你的光能如太阳边缘一般闪耀。

你是巨蟒，
你悄无声息，伏地而行；你的行动自有目的。
敌人对你的身影惊恐不定。
你的毒牙迅猛锐利，
你的双目明亮清晰，你的愤怒令人昏聩。

你是利刃，你是巨蟒。

出击，闪耀，敌亡我存。

2600992433.name: Wormhusk Crown
2600992433.subtitle:
"Many regard the Hive as mere monsters. But they are so much more. Their minds are sharp, like their blades."

—Eris Morn
2600992433.subtitle_zh:
“许多人只把邪魔族力量当作怪物，但他们岂止尔尔。他们的思维就像手中的利刃一般锐利。”

——埃里斯·摩恩
2600992433.text:
I: A MIND LIKE A BLADE 

The second son. The disowned. Spawned into this world as a lesser being, so unlike the warrior-son, Crota. But one must not only sharpen their blade. 

Behold Nokris. 

A mind can also be a weapon. There is power in wisdom, in knowledge. 

There is much to be known. And he would know all. 

The ageless volumes and apocrypha, all consumed voraciously, feeding the mind of the lesser. Driven by a different kind of Sword Logic, he let the stories of the world fill the void just as the worm feeds. 

From the womb of unholy knowledge, Nokris's plan was born. He knew his strength lies in his mind, in his magic. But how to prove himself to his father, the proud, dreadful demon-warrior? 

Nokris is not the first. 

He sought power. He sought knowledge. He sought the worm.
2600992433.text_zh:
I：利刃思想

次子，不被认同的子臣。生于此世，犹若草芥，与战士之子克洛塔大相径庭。但仅仅磨光利刃是不够的。

看呐，诺克里斯。

思想也能成为武器，智慧与知识中也存在力量。

要学习的还有很多，而他将习得一切。

永恒的书卷和伪书，被如饥似渴地啖食殆尽，哺喂着草芥之子的心灵。他受到别样邪剑守则的驱使，效仿虫神，将这个世界的故事填入虚空。

就在邪识的发源地中，诺克里斯的计划诞生了。他深知力量蕴藏在自己的思想中，在自己的魔法中。但他如何向父亲，向那自负可怖的恶魔战士证明自己呢？

诺克里斯并非第一个。

他追寻力量，他探求智慧，他寻觅虫神。

2166230715.name: Sealed Ahamkara Grasps
2166230715.subtitle: Plating the Ahamkara bones in silver helps to quiet the auditory hallucinations… o bearer mine.
2166230715.subtitle_zh: 用白银包裹阿罕卡拉遗骨有助于消除幻听……吾辈的背负者。
2166230715.text:
Few things can see the Light, but we are not blinded. 

The Bearer seeks the truth, but what separates truth from fiction is fragile. 

A pair of truths and a single falsehood upon the Bearer we shall impart. 

Brother, ally once more, sends his regards. 

Dreamer, awakened, the Bearer shall meet. 

Light fades, deep within the Prison.
2166230715.text_zh:
鲜有人能看见光能，但我们并不盲目。

背负者寻求真相，但真相与虚构之间的界线脆弱无比。

我们会将真相与虚妄双双授予背负者。

手足，再次缔结的盟友，向你致意。

入梦者，已然苏醒，与背负者相会。

在深邃监牢之中，光能渐衰。

574694189.name: Fr0st-EE5
574694189.subtitle: "Hey, if it works for computers… " —Marcus Ren
574694189.subtitle_zh: “嘿，如果在计算机上能用的话……”——马库斯·伦
574694189.text:
"Marcus, these are incredible!"
"What did I tell you? I call these bad boys the Fr0st-EE5."
"Um, come again?"
"Just call them the Frosties."
"Whatever they're called, I love them. It felt like my entire body became supercharged while running."
"Glad you like them. I still have a couple of kinks to work out, but when that's over…"
"A couple of kinks?"
"Well sometimes—and I mean very rarely—the Energy Transfer Capacitors can overheat and explode during the user's sprint. That only happens 2% of the time or something."
"Wait, you sent me on that field test knowing this?"
"I don't see the issue here."
"I'm telling Sloane."
 "Whoa, Boaz, let's not get hasty. I'll make it up to you with some sparrow mods."
"You can't buy me off— Wait, which mods are we talking about here?"
574694189.text_zh:
“马库斯，它们真不可思议！”
“可不是嘛，我把这双坏小子叫冰霜-EE5。”
“呃，叫什么？”
“就叫它们小霜吧。”
“不管叫什么我都喜欢。我感觉跑起来的时候整个身体都充满了能量。”
“很高兴你喜欢它们。还有几个小毛病等着我去修复呢，等解决以后……”
“几个小毛病？”
“哎呀，就是有时候——我的意思是非常罕见的时候——导能电容会在使用者冲刺时发生过热爆炸，这种意外的发生率大概只有2%吧。”
“等下，你知道会爆炸还让我去做实地试验？”
“我觉得没什么问题嘛。”
“我要向斯隆告状。”
“哇，波资，别急啊，我给你快雀模组当补偿。”
“你可别想打发我——等等，你说的是哪种模组？”

2408846184.name: BrayTech Survival Mitts
2408846184.subtitle: "Stand over here. Stick your arm out. Yes, perfect. OK, just hold still…" —Production Lead, BrayTech R&D
2408846184.subtitle_zh: “站到这儿来，伸出一只胳膊。是的，完美。好的，别动……”——布瑞科技研发团队生产主管
2408846184.text:
FEEDBACK FROM FIELD SESSION 177
* Thermal conservation tech "felt good" over a seven-hour session
* Micromesh webbing had minor grating on user's wrist, consistent across multiple test subjects
* 3cm, 1cm, 5mm grip tests successful
* User shouted expletive during high-caliber round test, but only sustained minor bruising
2408846184.text_zh:
来自177实地的反馈
*热保护技术在7小时的过程中“反应良好”
*微网状织带在用户手腕上形成光栏较小，在多个测试对象中结果一致。
*3厘米，1厘米和5毫米的抓握测试成功
*用户在高口径弹药测试期间大声咒骂，但只留下了轻微瘀伤

2656719840.name: BrayTech Combat Vest
2656719840.subtitle: "Agility. Protection. I have always subscribed to the idea that armor is useless without both." —Lead Engineer, BrayTech R&D
2656719840.subtitle_zh: “灵活性，防护性。我始终赞同护甲缺此二者即无用的观点。”——布瑞科技研发团队首席工程师
2656719840.text:
Armor is the inherent struggle between freedom and protection, and has been since the dawn of humanity. The natural conclusion of elementary physics is such that resilience is the enemy of mobility. But now we're pioneers in a nascent world of discovery, where we can abrogate the laws of "Old Physics" and widen the breadth of engineering design space.
My colleagues at Clovis Bray and I are excited to embark upon this project. We intend to enhance the efficacy of our line of protective armor, and bring to you the level of quality you expect from the Bray name.
2656719840.text_zh:
从人性初现之始，护甲就在自由度和保护度之间游离。根据基础物理学得出结论是，这种弹性出现的原因是由于机动性敌人的存在。而现在我们是新生发现世界的先锋，我们在此可以废除“旧物理学”的定律，拓展工程设计领域的宽度。
我和克洛维斯·布瑞的同事们对于能够加入这个项目而感到激动。我们希望强化保护护甲的效能，为您提供符合“布瑞”这个品牌的高端质量。

1966755869.name: BrayTech Winter Cloak
1966755869.subtitle: "Not every piece of equipment is optimal for all environments. You see snow. I see a thousand hiding places." —Designer, BrayTech R&D
1966755869.subtitle_zh: “并非每件装备能完美适应所有环境。你看到的是雪，我看到的是成千上万的藏身处。”——布瑞科技研发团队设计师
1966755869.text: It's a local legend that ghostly apparitions dwell in the mountains of the Hellas region. Based on multiple accounts, they're pale white and blend with the snow. All you can see is a floating set of eyes and a mouth, smiling all creepy-like. Ever since Clovis Bray set up shop, the sightings have dropped sharply, but every now and then someone claims to see one of these phantom figures.
1966755869.text_zh: 当地的传言说赫拉斯地区的群山里有可怕的幽灵。根据多方面的传言，他们体态苍白，融入在雪中。只能看到漂浮的眼睛和嘴巴，以及恐怖的笑容。自从克洛维斯·布瑞开业以来，目击状况急剧减少，但偶尔有人会声称自己看到了这些鬼魂。

3792294545.name: BrayTech Sn0Mask
3792294545.subtitle: "This is our best work yet." —Project Manager, BrayTech R&D
3792294545.subtitle_zh: “这是我们目前为止的最佳作品。”——布瑞科技研发团队项目经理
3792294545.text:
To: wibray
CC: CB Leadership, atvon
Re: Quarter Update
New arctic line is on track to hit Milestone Silver. Current risks lie with key Priority 1 issues with the Sn0Treads design, but we've recently requested additional resources to mitigate that. I've spoken with the head engineer, and she's confident we will deliver on schedule. This is one of the strongest teams we've put together, and so far the results have been outstanding. The mask in particular received high praise for its extreme clarity, and an overall positive user evaluation.
Individual lead notes are attached. No reply all.
3792294545.text_zh:
发送给：wibray
抄送：CB领导层，atvon
主题：季度汇报
新的北极线正常运行到白银里程碑。目前的当务之急是Sn0战鞋的设计风险，我们最近申请了更多资源以供解决这个问题。我和总工程师谈过了，她有信心按时交付。这是我们组建的最强大的队伍之一，目前而言表现一直出色。尤其面具因其极为清晰的视野和总体正面的用户评价而获得高度赞扬。
附上各领导评注。不回复全部。

3510185410.name: BrayTech Sn0Treads
3510185410.subtitle: "Piecing together complex systems of causalities is the puzzle that defined me." —Elsie Bray
3510185410.subtitle_zh: “将复杂的因果关系系统拼凑在一起就是定义我的谜题。”——艾尔西·布瑞
3510185410.text:
"Elsie's here from Weapons R&D to lend us a hand. She'll be taking over the project until the next milestone, and hopefully get rid of our little jamming problem in the treads."
"Elsie… as in Elsie Bray?"
"You know another Elsie?"
"No, I just… well, she's basically an engineering legend around here!"
"You're a professional, not some fanboy. Do what she says, and use this opportunity to learn."
"Right. Of course."
"Any other questions?"
"Does my hair look OK?"
"Get out of my office."
3510185410.text_zh:
“武器研发部的艾尔西会来这里帮忙。她会接手项目直到完成下个里程碑为止。希望能解决战鞋的挤脚问题。”
“艾尔西……是艾尔西·布瑞吗？”
“你还认识其他的艾尔西？”
“不，我只是……她简直是我们这里工程界的传奇！”
“你是专业人员，不是什么迷弟。按她说的做，利用这个机会好好学习。”
“嗯，当然。”
“还有什么问题吗？”
“我的发型怎么样？”
“滚出去。”

1886868481.name: Qiao's Care
1886868481.subtitle: "Always reach for understanding and compassion."
1886868481.text:
Qiao Supplemental
Project Catamaran
Clubhouse Gymnasium
A/V Recording
Path to Ares: 30 Days to Launch

Hardy: What, you don't play basketball?

Qiao: Of course I do.

Hardy: Okay, so me and Mihaylova against you and Evie.

Evie: Oh, we'll wipe the floor with you.

Mihaylova: Don't be so sure.

Hardy: How's the nav coming?

Qiao: All told, beautiful. With Mihay's AI and Evie's theories—

Evie: We don't want to accidentally run into it.

Hardy: It?

Evie: Moon X.

Mihaylova: Agh!

Evie: Too slow.

Hardy: Hey! No traveling.

Evie: Sorry—

Qiao: Got it.

Hardy: Not so fast—

Qiao: Two points. You want to talk about fast.

Evie: Wait. Wait.

Hardy: Huh. Okay. What?

Evie: Traveling. Moon X. Look, we need to stop even thinking of it as a satellite or a false moon. It's big, but it acts alive— this thing moves with purpose. It's a visitor. It's… a Traveler.
1886868481.text_zh:
乔的补充材料
双体船计划
俱乐部体育馆
音频/视频记录
阿瑞斯之路：距发射还有30天

哈迪：什么，你不打篮球？

乔：我打啊。

哈迪：好，那我和米哈伊洛娃一队，你跟艾维一队。

艾维：把你们按地上摩擦。

米哈伊洛娃：别那么自信。

哈迪：导航什么状况了？

乔：总之就是很漂亮。有了米哈的人工智能和艾维的理论——

艾维：我们可不想撞到它。

哈迪：它？

艾维：X卫星。

米哈伊洛娃：啊！

艾维：太慢了。

哈迪：喂！不准带球走步。

艾维：抱歉——

乔：接住了。

哈迪：别这么快——

乔：两分球。你想知道什么叫快吗。

艾维：等等。等等。

哈迪：哈。好的。什么？

艾维：带球走步。X卫星。听着，我们不能去把它当成个卫星或者假月亮。它很大，但它的表现是活的，这东西运动是有目的的。它是个访客。是个……旅行者。

2798295255.name: Qiao's Heart
2798295255.subtitle: "Be aware at all times of what drives those around you."
2798295255.text:
Qiao Supplemental
A/V Recording
Path to Ares: Launch Day + 1 (Revised Launch Day)

Centcom: Ares this is Centcom, Radio Check. Radio check, over.

Hardy: Centcom this is Ares One. We read you loud and fairly clearly, over.

C: Roger. Hey, just so you know, the, uh, House of Eternal Travel has sent you its prayers. It was all over the news.

H: That one of those Traveler cults?

C: Roger, this is the one that survived the Traveler-cult rumble a few weeks ago.

H: Oh. Well, okay, tell them thanks.

C: Roger. Next radio check 8 minutes.

H: They'll be quiet for a while. Nav?

Qiao:  Steady. We are clear of Earthgrav. Confirming course.

H: Engineering?

Mihaylova: All systems normal.

H: OK. So now it's… a long wait.

Q: Hey. You OK, Jacob?

H: Yeah. A-OK.

Q: Look at the stars.

M: Is there a problem?

Q: Not at all. It's just…

H: Beautiful.

Q: Yes. Like something we are privileged to join but could never deserve.

H: Wonder how the Traveler must feel.
2798295255.text_zh:
乔的补充材料
音频/视频记录
阿瑞斯之路：发射日+1（修订的发射日）

中央指挥部：阿瑞斯，这里是中央指挥部，无线电检查。无线电检查，完毕。

哈迪：中央指挥部，这里是阿瑞斯一号。通信完整清晰，完毕。

中：收到。嘿，告诉你一声，呃，永恒遨游部落向你发送了它的祷告。新闻都传开了。

哈：那些旅行者教派的一员？

中：收到，这是几周前在旅行者教派乱战中存活的那些人。

哈：哦，这样啊，好吧，跟他们说谢谢。

中：收到。下一次无线电检查将在8分钟后。

哈：他们能安静会儿了吧。现在导航是什么状态？

乔：很稳定。我们已脱离地球引力。正在确认航向。

哈：工程系统呢？

米哈伊洛娃：所有系统状态正常。

哈：好的。那么现在……就是漫长等待了。

乔：嘿，雅各布，你还好吗？

哈：嗯，很好。

乔：看看繁星。

米：有什么问题吗？

乔：没有。只是……

哈：非常美丽。

乔：是啊。就像我们有幸加入了永远不属于我们的东西一样。

哈：不知道旅行者的感受如何。

631647398.name: Qiao's Passing
631647398.subtitle: "Bind yourself with compassion and knowledge."
631647398.text:
Qiao Supplemental
Journal of Ulysses Qiao, son of Dean Qiao of Beijing University, Navigator of the Ares One
Path to Ares: 476 days to launch

We were in the Rathskeller. If you don't know what that is—I didn't at the time, but it's a sort of restaurant and bar underground, not far from the bookstore. Hundreds of years old. This wasn't Beijing, back then we lived in Australia. Sydney. And I had gone to have lunch with my dad at the university where he was teaching.

So I'd brought all this information about looking for colleges. I remember we had holograms floating all around the table while we ate pizza and it was a great time, you know?

Anyway there was this TV playing. And that was the first time we saw it: drone footage from the edge of the solar system. Something had come in that no one had expected. My dad looked up and he just froze, like his mind just flipped on and he was lost. He would get like that.

That was the first time we saw the thing that everyone eventually called the Traveler.
631647398.text_zh:
乔的补充材料
北京大学乔院长的孩子、阿瑞斯一号的领航员，尤利西斯·乔的日记
阿瑞斯之路：距发射还有476天

我们在酒吧间。如果你们不知道这是什么——其实我当时也不知道，其实就是个地下的餐馆和酒吧，离书店不远。有几百年的历史了。这里不是北京，过去我们曾经住在澳大利亚。澳大利亚的悉尼。当时我爸爸在教书，我去大学里和他吃午饭。

我带着寻找院系的所有相关信息。我记得吃披萨的时候，桌子上漂浮着全息图像，真是美好的时光啊。

那时电视放的就是这个。那是我们第一次看到，来自太阳系的无人机拍摄的画面。出乎所有人的意料，有东西过来了。我的父亲抬头看着天，整个人都呆住了，就好像整个人意识颠倒，然后就茫然了。他就是那样的。

那是我们第一次见到那东西，后来大家称之为旅行者。

2089084848.name: Qiao's Grin
2089084848.subtitle: "Let the outside mirror what is found on the inside."
2089084848.text:
Qiao Supplemental
Qiao's Journal
Path to Ares: 18 Days to Launch

Mihaylova and Evie continue to have conflict that is completely unnecessary. It puts a strain on the Clubhouse. I know Jacob is trying to get a handle on it.

The latest is this ridiculous argument about the subroutines of the AI code. Evie wants to get a look at all of Mihaylova's code to make sure it takes into account the gravity measurements she's making to plot the possible movements of the Traveler.

Traveler—yes. Such a perfect name! Go Evie!

Anyway, Mihaylova simply refuses to unlock all of her code. Not outright, of course, she just deflects, underdelivers, won't let Evie into the whole thing.

I'm not interested in this conflict. I have my own ways of unlocking every piece of code in the onboard systems. So I gave Evie access.

I mentioned it afterwards to Mihaylova, and I expected her to react badly—but of course things don't always work out the way you expect. She got very quiet and said, "Well, Qiao. What's done is done."
2089084848.text_zh:
乔的补充材料
乔的日记
阿瑞斯之路：距发射还有18天

米哈伊洛娃和艾维还在为些琐碎的事发生冲突。俱乐部的气氛十分紧张。我知道雅各布想插手调解一下。

最近一次是他们对人工智能代码的子程序进行了荒唐的争论。艾维想看米哈伊洛娃的全部代码，确认她考虑到了引力测量的因素，以便绘出旅行者可能的动向。

对，旅行者。真是完美的名字！加油艾维！

结果米哈伊洛维直接拒绝解锁她的所有代码。当然也不是全部，她顾左右而言他，只给出一部分，不愿意让艾维拿到全部代码。

我对他们的冲突没什么兴趣。我有自己的办法，可以解锁舰载系统的所有代码。所以我就给了艾维权限。

之后我跟米哈伊洛娃提了这事，原本以为她会反应激烈。但是事情总是会出乎人的意料。她没多说，只是说：“好吧，乔。木已成舟。”

3381714035.name: Qiao's Strides
3381714035.subtitle: "Walk in peace, and know that there can be no danger in wisdom."
3381714035.subtitle_zh: “以平和之心而行，明白智慧之中无险境。”
3381714035.text:
File: Qiao, navigator, Ares One
—Supplemental—
Path to Ares: 58 Days to Launch
Beijing University
A/V Record

Student: Dean Qiao, thank you for answering all these questions about Ares One.

Qiao: No, thank you. I love it.

Student: Do you remember where you were when you first heard about the mission?

Qiao: Huh. I do remember where I was when I got the call. It wasn't called Ares then, of course. Until around launch day it was called Project Catamaran.

Anyway, my oldest daughter was applying to the university and we had flown in from our home in Sydney, to visit. We had lunch with some professors and afterwards we visited one of the dorms. Just over there. It's not there anymore. Thank god. It was an old dorm.

There were protests all over, that day. The Moon X cults were in full force, calling for all governments to combine.

I took the call in the drone we rented for the day. They wanted me to cut the visit short but I refused. They wanted me to be gone for a year and a half. They could wait until morning.
3381714035.text_zh:
文件：阿瑞斯一号领航员，乔
——补充材料——
阿瑞斯之路：距发射还有58天
北京大学
音频/视频记录

学生：乔院长，谢谢你回答关于阿瑞斯一号的问题。

乔：不，是我要谢谢你。我很开心。

学生：你还记得是在哪里第一次听说这个任务的吗？

乔：哈，我记得第一次接到任务的时候。当然了，那时还不叫阿瑞斯。直到发射日之前都是叫双体船计划。

我的大女儿当时在申请大学，我们搬家到了悉尼，我是访问学者。当时和一些教授一起吃午饭，之后我们就参观了一个宿舍。就在那边，现在已经没有了。幸亏没有了，那个宿舍太老了。

那时候到处都是抗议。X卫星教派全体出动，要求所有政府联合起来。

我在那天租的无人机里接到了电话。他们想让我缩短访问时间，但我拒绝了。他们想让我消失一年半。他们只能等到早上。

802557885.name: Turris Shade Gauntlets
802557885.subtitle: "Leaders. Elite infantry. Martial teachers. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
802557885.subtitle_zh: “领导者、精英步兵、武术教头。你的部族将成为出色的暗影。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
802557885.text:
The Cabal I knew would have held your City, kept your Tower. “Through divine right,” I would have said, before my exile to the black edge. I've since learned there is no such thing, that there is only the end. What then, was the difference? Cultivation.

Your people have not triumphed over the Cabal because of the Light. We've fought the Light before you, and though it has assured you victory thus far, there are ways to defeat it without taking it. The Red Legion have simply forgotten how.

You and your Guardian-tribe are more disciplined, enlightened. You are the greatest fighting force this system has ever seen, and yet, despite your brutish predilections, you are… cultured, elite. With few exceptions, what you take you hold. And you thrive. True, the Red Legion managed to conquer your City. But in the end, you took everything from them, and you stand firmer than ever before.

A Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be the ideal taskmaster to train the armies of the empire. To batter them to dust before making them anew, in your broad-shouldered image.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
802557885.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔会占领你们的圣城，占据你们的高塔。在我被流放到黑暗边缘之前，我本该说，“藉由神圣权力”。此后我听说世间并无此物，只有终结。那么，区别在哪里呢？区别在于素养。

你们的人民正因为拥有光能才未曾战胜卡巴尔。我们曾在你们面前与光能对抗；尽管光能为你们确保了迄今为止的胜利，但仍有不夺走光能便能击败它的方法，猩红军团只是不曾记起法。

你和你的守护者部族更有纪律，更加开明。你们是这个星系中前所未有的最强战力，撇开你们粗俗的嗜好来看，你们是……不乏教养的精英。你们无一例外地固守着得来之物，并且繁荣兴盛。诚然，猩红军团夺走了你们的圣城。但最终，你们将从他们手中夺回一切，并且比以往更加坚定。

你那守护者部族的暗影会成为理想的监军，训练帝国的军队，让他们在你伟岸的身影下脱胎换骨。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

4135228483.name: Turris Shade Plate
4135228483.subtitle: A little stronger. A more powerful stance. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow. —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
4135228483.subtitle_zh: 再强一些，再强势一些。你就要准备好……施放暗影了。——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
4135228483.text:
The Cabal I knew understood mental fortitude. I don't speak of the psychokinetic abilities of the Psions, but the sheer force of will mustered by the foot soldiers who served me. Even my Loyalists have grown soft over the ages. We have fallen so far from enlightenment.

But when I look to your Guardian-tribe, I see glimmers of the Cabal I knew. Rushing headlong into battle, your bodies themselves weapons. Your kind dies over nothing. I've seen it.

Your deaths lack permanence, but does that make it any easier? As you're shredded alive by a warbeast, or scattered to the winds by psionic projection? Even the best of you are regularly sewn together by your Ghosts. And you persist with the same fervor every time.

A Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be the ideal teacher to bring this selfless state of mind back to the empire. I will ensure that my Loyalists are… willing learners.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
4135228483.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔懂得坚韧心智的含义。我说的不是辅助士兵的念动力，而是效忠于我的步兵所凝聚而成的纯粹意志之力。即使是我的效忠者，也会随着岁月流转变得软弱，我们从启蒙时代至今已不知颓败到何种程度。

但当我看着你的守护者部族时，我看见了我所了解的卡巴尔的点点微光。不顾一切冲入战斗，你们的躯体本身便是武器。你们的同胞死无其所，我早有所见。

你们的死亡并非覆水不收，但当你们被战争巨兽活活撕碎，或被超能弹头化作微尘之时，这种死亡是否更加无足轻重？即使是你们之中的佼佼者也常常依靠自己的机灵才不会身首异处，但你们依然每每坚持着同一种热情。

你那守护者部族的暗影会成为理想的导师，将这种无私忘我的心态带回帝国。我会保证我的效忠者……心甘情愿地听受教诲。

——卡巴尔大帝卡鲁斯

3416932282.name: Turris Shade Mark
3416932282.subtitle: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3416932282.subtitle_zh: “这是传达给所有卡巴尔不忠者的消息——你效忠于我。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
3416932282.text:
You've shown the Red Legion you fly my banner. I know that when the time is right, I won't have to ask. You're on my side.

I see it when your body becomes a weapon with which you obliterate your opponents, when your knuckles become a part of your foe's countenance, when you smash them with your Light. And it is captivating. But Earth casts no Shadow. Not yet.

When you're ready, you will be magnificent. A Guardian of Guardians. Shadow of Shadows.

I reserve the right to be last when the end comes, and for that, I will need you with me.

You're so close.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3416932282.text_zh:
你已经让猩红军团看到你效忠我的旗下。我明白，当时机成熟时，我也无需开口；你会站在我的一边。

我看见，你的身体化作武器，将对手毁灭殆尽；我看见，当你用光能击向敌人时，你的拳印深深烙入敌人的脸庞。这一切令人痴醉。但地球没有释放暗影，暂时还没有。

做好准备，你将无往不利；成为众守护者的守护神，成为众暗影的荫庇。

我保留身为末日见证者的权利，为此，我需要你伴我左右。

你是如此切近。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

855363300.name: Turris Shade Helm
855363300.subtitle: "You have truly grown fat from strength. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
855363300.subtitle_zh: “你果然变得又强又壮，了不起。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯
855363300.text:
The Cabal I knew were natural leaders, with the ability to drive cultivation. That they excelled at war was the result of their gentility. Our debate chambers were glorified as much as our battlefields.

And look at us now. Who is this Valus that leads the Red Legion astray? His name already escapes me. Were if not for him, I would gladly accept them back into my fold. Perhaps I can redeem the Red Legion.

Before the Red War, the Cabal at least had their dear Dominus Ghaul.

More than ever, my empire needs me. And I need you.

A Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would serve to remind the Cabal of what they once were. Proud. Unbroken. Vicious in war. Civilized in peace. And all it would take is what you're already doing.

Continue to advance. Drive them before you. Force them to change, or die.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
855363300.text_zh:
我认识的卡巴尔是天生的领导者，拥有驱动素养的能力，他们卓越战功源于他们的优雅风度，我们的辩论殿堂同我们的战场一样充满荣耀。

看看现在的我们，这个将猩红军团带上歧途的军政官是谁？我已经忘记他姓甚名谁，若不是因为他，我会很乐意将他们纳入我的麾下。也许我能弥补猩红军团犯下的错误。

在猩红战争之前，卡巴尔至少还有他们敬爱的尊主盖欧。

我的帝国比以往任何时候都需要我。而我，需要你。

你那守护者部族的暗影将提醒那些卡巴尔曾经拥有何种素养；自豪、坚韧、崇战、知礼。需要做的不过是你正在做的。

继续前进。把他们驱赶到你面前，迫使他们改变，否则死路一条。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

3168183519.name: Turris Shade Greaves
3168183519.subtitle: "There has only ever been but a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.
3168183519.subtitle_zh: “我遇到的每个民族都只有一个暗影。但光能如此之多，我的时间又如此之少……”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯。
3168183519.text:
The Cabal I remember were fierce hand-to-hand combatants. We learned and shared techniques from countless indoctrinated races. No longer. Red Legion training is like Red Legion weaponry—all bluster and noise. Ghaul was… acceptable. But Ghaul was special.

How we once delighted in throwing our bones into the soft tissues of our enemies. We devised ingenious ways to dance and weave to better throw them.  Just like you.

Your Guardian-tribe holds the delivery of personal combat in great esteem. It's an art to you. I can tell in how you treasure each strike. You savor them. The sensation of your bones breaking bones, smashing vital organs.

Add the Light and you have a perfect expression of destruction.

The false empire will never have the Light. Not again. But a Shadow of your Guardian-tribe would be ideal to guide them, to teach them to move themselves once again. And throw their bones.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3168183519.text_zh:
我记忆中的卡巴尔是骁勇的肉搏斗士。我们从无数被教化的种族那里学习战技并彼此分享，但我们不再如此。猩红军团的练兵之术就像猩红军团的武器一样——狂躁无章。盖欧曾经……也合我意，但盖欧很特殊。

挥舞战骨，攻敌软肋，我们曾经以此为乐；我们设计出巧妙手段，以缭乱战舞放倒敌人，就像你一样。

你那守护者部族的个人战技值得敬重，对你而言是一种艺术。我能看懂你如何重视每一次进攻，你会仔细品味以骨摧骨，碎敌肝胆的感觉。

再加上光能相助，你即是毁灭的完美化身。

伪帝国永远无法拥有光能，再也不会。但你那守护者部族的暗影将成为他们的理想导师，教他们再次跳起战舞，挥舞战骨。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

809007410.name: Ashen Wake
809007410.subtitle:
"It is your turn. These people will follow you to the very end. Remember that we were forged in Light."
 —Aodh, Second Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
809007410.subtitle_zh:
“轮到你了，这些人将追随你到最后一刻。谨记光能铸就了我们。”
——奥德，二级炎阳天空法官
809007410.text:
"Be patient, Ouros. It will come in time." 

"Why does the Forge not choose me? I'm already blessed by Light. I'm here. I wish to serve." 

"We all have our place in the world. One day, you could be our next Magistrate. The Order would look to you for guidance." 

"Ha! As if. I don't want to be some stuffy old leader, I'd probably have to speak—"
