1322544481.subtitle_zh: “建立在谎言上的奇迹总有一天会崩塌。”——阿列克谢
1322544481.text:
The Last City, Earth      

GX-818 Experimental Notation:
Recovered Hive Ghost inoperable. Still responds to electrical impulse. Ran gauntlet of tests and gleaned welcome protocol data.

New chest rig comes in handy for experimentation and observation: every time the Ghost exhibits movement, can render it inert without so much as lifting a finger. Must employ this technique in future studies…

Hardware architectural analysis confirmed that this derelict creature exhibited a malleable structure. Certainly wasn't created with a specific framework in mind and looks to have adapted its configuration to its Lightbearer once acquired. Is this necessary for the bonding process? For creating the perception of companionship? Is it possible for a Ghost to connect to a Lightbearer without undergoing restructuring?

Previous behavioral studies have shown that Ghosts can be selective. Given lack of pre-programmed directives, it is now clear that they make conscious choice about whom to revive. Hardware evidence suggests that Ghosts were always capable of reviving Hive; perhaps they always intended to.    

Addendum for Spider:
You've asked me why I like to "tinker with your toys" before I deliver them. Well, here you are. Proof of what I've been saying all along:

We live at the whims of a god who blesses the few at the expense of the many. We follow leaders who claim to understand this speechless orb, and we are expected to do as it wills, no matter the cost to ourselves.

So many people still condemned to die, and it willingly granted immortality to a death cult, served on a silver platter by these… automata. Well, I too have a will, and I will not prostrate myself before something capable of such evil.

Your Ever-Skeptical Häkke Exile,
Alexei
1322544481.text_zh:
地球，圣城      

GX-818实验注释：
回收的邪魔族机灵无法运作，不过仍对电脉冲起反应。对其进行一系列的测试并收集到了满意的数据。

新的胸部护甲在实验和观测中派上了用场：每当机灵开始活动时，我甚至不需要动一根手指就能使它丧失动力。必须在未来的研究中使用这种技术…

硬件结构分析证实，这个废弃的生物具有一种可塑的结构。它在被创造时并没有考虑到某种特定框架，而且看来它在获得负光者后，其构造已经适应了其主人。这对结合过程来说有必要吗？是为了创造伴侣关系的感觉吗？机灵有可能在不经历重组的情况下与负光者连接吗？

先前的行为研究表明，机灵选择时非常谨慎。现在有一点很明确：由于缺乏预先编程的指令，他们会有意识地选择复活某一生物。硬件证据表明，机灵一直都有令邪魔族复生的能力。也许他们的造物主一开始就有这个打算。    

致蛛王的附录：
你曾问过我为什么喜欢在把东西送达前“玩弄一番”。好了，这就是原因。这些测试证明了我一直以来说的话：

我们生活在神灵反复无常的兴致中，他以牺牲多数人为代价眷顾少数人。我们追随那些声称理解这个无声球体的领袖们，且必须不惜自身代价按照它的意愿行事。

仍然有许多人注定赴死，而它心甘情愿地给予死亡邪教永生。由这些…有自我意识的机器拱手送上。我也有自己的意愿，我不会在能做出如此恶行的东西面前屈服。

永持怀疑态度的Häkke放逐者，
阿列克谢

1703551922.name: Blight Ranger
1703551922.subtitle: It reflects whatever it sees, no matter how ugly.
1703551922.subtitle_zh: 它能反映出它所看到的一切，无论多么丑陋。
1703551922.text:
I've thanked God for this mask more times than I can count. It reflects most everything; keeps me on the safe side of whatever's coming at me. Most times…

Dust storm left me no recourse. Came to a small encampment of refugees from Freehold, now buried. Most of them were workers at the old BrayTech facility, none too happy to see an Exo. One of them began to play a rueful tune on a cobbled-together string instrument. To this day, I haven't forgotten the words he sang:

Let me tell ya now 
Bout the time the Devil walked through my door
Said oh, let me tell ya now
Bout the time the Devil walked through that door
Ain't nothin', nobody
Could hold me down anymore

It was mine, all mine
Devil gave me that golden ring
It was mine, all mine
Devil made me laugh and sing
But little by little
The Devil took my everything

It was wailin' and gnashin'
When the Devil did his dirty work
Just wailin' and gnashin'
When the Devil did his dirty work
Oh, what a fool had I been
Thinkin' I was above the dirt

In the dirt, they were buried
Made me blue to see that red
In the dirt, they were buried
Made me blue to see that red
Devil took no pity
Left me no place to rest my head

Lord, help the Devil
How'd he get to be so cruel
Lord, help that Devil
How'd he get to be so cruel
That mean old Devil
Was just some other devil's fool

This mask reflected the gaunt faces of the survivors, but it didn't hide me. I could feel hot tears stream down my cheeks. They saw their own pain in me. The accusatory glances stopped then, and a sad understanding remained. Because we all knew, this place will never be the same.
1703551922.text_zh:
我曾无数次感谢上帝赐予我这副面具。它几乎能反弹一切，让我在面对任何威胁时都能受到保护。大多数时候吧…

沙尘暴使我无法求援，我来到了自由地带的一个小难民营，不过现已被埋了。他们中的大多数人都是老布瑞科技工厂的工人，特别对Exo反感。其中一人开始用一个自制的简易弦乐器奏出悲伤的曲调。直到今天我仍无法忘记他唱的歌词：

让我现在给你讲个故事 
关于一个恶魔走进我的大门的故事
哦，让我现在给你讲个故事
关于一个恶魔走进我的大门的故事
没有任何东西，也没人
能够阻止我

它是我的，全都属于我
恶魔给了我那枚金戒指
它是我的，全都属于我
恶魔让我又笑又唱
但渐渐地
恶魔夺走了我的一切

哀嚎四起，咬牙切齿
恶魔开始捣乱了
哀嚎四起，咬牙切齿
恶魔开始捣乱了
哦，我真是个傻瓜
以为自己在泥土之上

在他们被埋的泥土里
看到那抹红使我忧伤
在他们被埋的泥土里
看到那抹红使我忧伤
那个恶魔不知怜悯
一点也不让休息

上帝啊，帮帮这个恶魔吧
他怎么变得这么残忍
上帝啊，帮帮这个恶魔吧
他怎么变得这么残忍
那个刻薄的老恶魔
不过是其他恶魔的傻瓜

这个面具映照出幸存者憔悴的面孔，但没有隐藏起我的面孔。我能感觉到滚烫的眼泪顺着脸颊流下来。他们在我身上看到了他们自己的痛苦。他们不再投来指责的目光，只剩下一种悲痛的同理心。因为我们都知道，这个地方将永远也恢复不到原来的样子了。

2169905051.name: Renewal Grasps
2169905051.subtitle: The frigid will renewed, resurgent.
2169905051.subtitle_zh: 寒冰将重获新生，再度复苏。
2169905051.text:
"Regrettably, Lakshmi was killed by Vex during the assault…" 

Ikora's words echoed like the tolling of a bell. Ada-1 rocked back on her heels. She had never much liked Lakshmi-2—tolerated was a better word—but her fellow Exo had been her partner in a very intriguing new venture. Now, Lakshmi was dead, and so was the promise of Project Stronghold. 

A bunker where the city's leaders could be preserved through any attack was now just a hazy memory. Project Stronghold's reach was more expansive than Ada's contribution. Indeed, her focus had been steered in this direction by Lakshmi, yet the necessity of the bunker had made perfect sense when Lakshmi proposed the endeavor. A city cannot survive without its leaders, but Ada never expected that Lakshmi herself would instigate an attack. 

Ada-1 had been used. The realization stung, but having yet another venture collapse around her was too bitter a pill to swallow. She was destined for greatness, wasn't she? 

Ada heard the servos in her hands whining. Her fists were balled tight. She hadn't meant to… she hadn't meant for any of this. Every day spent, every breakthrough made, just grains of sand in a sculpture doomed to be washed away by the unstoppable tide. 

She had worked for years to defend this system, its people; and all she had to show for it was a glorified spindle. 

No matter. For now, she would focus on one day at a time, and today, she would spin gold from straw. Her fingers traced the lines on the shoulder of the new gauntlets she had designed. She was determined to see them completed. They wouldn't save the system, no, but they would represent the Black Armory well. Sometimes, she just needed something for herself.
2169905051.text_zh:
“遗憾的是，拉克希米在袭击中被Vex所杀害…” 

艾可拉所说的话如钟声一般回响。艾达-1感到十分震惊，她从来就不怎么喜欢（也许“容忍”比较贴切）拉克希米-2，但她的同伴Exo曾是她有趣冒险旅程中的伙伴。拉克希米死了，据点计划的承诺也随着她烟消云散。 

一个在受到攻击时保护圣城领导的地堡现在只是个模糊的记忆。据点计划的范畴比艾达所贡献的还要广阔。当然，她的重点被拉克希米引导至此，但地堡的重要性在拉克希米提出计划时是非常合理的。圣城无法在没有领导的情况下生存下去，但艾达从未想过拉克希米本身会先发起进攻。 

艾达-1被利用了，这个认知让人震惊。但眼见又一个项目在她周围崩溃是一颗难以下咽的苦果。她注定要成就一番事业的，不是吗？ 

艾达听到她手中的伺服零件在呜呜作响。她攥紧了拳头，她不是有意的…这一切都并不是她的本意。度过的每一天，每一次的突破，都只是雕塑中注定要被势不可挡的潮水冲走的渺小沙粒。 

多年来，她一直在努力捍卫这个星系，捍卫生活在其中的人们，而她所能展示的，只是这个美化了的纺锤。 

不管怎样，现在，她会专注于每一天，而今天，她甚至会把稻草纺成金子。她用手指描绘着她设计的新臂铠肩部的纹路。她要亲眼看着它们完成。这套护臂虽然无法拯救星系，但它们充分代表了黑色军武，有时她只是想为自己做点什么。

362541459.name: Resonant Fury Helm
362541459.subtitle: Ur yearns for nurture. It does so through hunger.
362541459.subtitle_zh: 厄尔渴望滋养。饥渴助它实现。
362541459.text:
"I am Xita, the nurturing worm. Behold Yul, and Eir, and Xol, and Ur, and Akka. The virtuous worms. Look upon us and know that We are go[o]d. You, however, are not. You are inconsequential. And this is not your—"

"My what? Place? Privilege? Destiny?"

"You disrespect—"

"There are no pleasantries in the Deep. Only the decaying husks of oversized parasites towering before me. You take me for a fool, believing I am like all else—manipulated by your psychic machinations. But I will not be controlled, for I am wrath."

[He allowed us no audience. He knew of our hunger. Abandoned. Imprisoned. Our vulnerabilities stood clear, and he wasted no time in cracking them open with the rib he tore from the cruel Leviathan.]

"You desire life. My Witness desires your power. A trade is in the stars: your servitude for their lives," he said, lifting the rib and pointing it at my children.

"Their power requires sustenance. Without it, your Witness will have none."

"The surface of this disgusting rock is lined with their sustenance. Primitive beasts now stand at the verge of new purpose—giving life to your kind once again. I, kind Rhulk, will ensure your children survive. And you will aid a righteous cause in return."

[Outmatched. Death would one day be our recompense. But our part was still left to play.]

"Go on, then," [he snarked, holding the rib out.] "Sustenance has arrived."

[I grasped it, and he swam upwards, dragging me in tow. Rising, up from our Deep. Taking me from my children. Up and up, away from one prison, and toward another…]
362541459.text_zh:
“我是养育蠕虫，西塔。瞧瞧尤尔、艾尔、尸飕、厄尔还有阿卡。自命清高的蠕虫们。看看我们，我们这才叫好。而你们，差得远了。你们是微不足道的。而这不是属于你们的-”

“你想说什么？地方？特权？命运？”

“你敢不敬-”

“深渊底下没有客套话。只有超大的寄生虫腐烂躯壳耸立在我面前。你把我当傻子耍。还以为我和其他所有人一样，会被你们的心灵技俩所操纵。但我不会被控制，因为我怒不可遏。”

[他不给我们申诉的机会。他了解我们的饥饿。我们受到遗弃，遭到囚禁。我们的弱点一目了然，他不失时机地用他从残暴的利维坦身上撕下的肋骨来逐一击破。]

“你渴望生命。我的见证者渴望得到你的力量。群星会见证这桩交易。生命，拿你的换他们的。”他说道，举起肋骨，指着我的孩子。

“我们的力量需要养料。生命的力量。没有养料，我们就没有力量。你也不会有。”

“这块令人作呕的岩石表面布满了你的养料。原始的野兽有了新的目标，那就是再次赋予你的同类生命。我，善良的胡克，会帮你做这件事。作为报答，你需要协助正义的事业。”

[寡不敌众。我们终有一日会以死相报。但我们的任务还没有完成。]

“那就继续吧，”他伸出肋骨咆哮道，“养料来了。”

[我抓住它，他拖着我向上游去。从我们的深渊升起。把我从我的孩子身边带走。一直向上，远离一个监狱，走向另一个监狱…]

1627640710.name: Resonant Fury Plate
1627640710.subtitle: Xol yearned for nurture. It did so amongst the thousands.
1627640710.subtitle_zh: 尸飕曾渴望滋养。融入曾助它实现。
1627640710.text:
[Madness. Whether he knew it or not, the Subjugator shared this characteristic with his very target, the Osmium King. Larvae in hand, the king was surrounded by whispers—whispers of the end of all things. Designed to incite madness.] 

[And then the movement of a silver moon in the sky made his madness fester. He raved. Ranted. Until others were so sick of listening that they tore him from this life. His daughters, fearing for theirs, fled.]

[From on high, they watched—the Witness and its Disciple—plotting their next move.]

"It toys with us, my Witness, as it always has. Our enemy in Fundament's sky. Its movements are a message, one that that belies our machinations."

—-It delays our desires so that it may seek its own. These frail siblings… will soon be claimed by the Light. Unless we claim them first. Our whispers were fed to a weak mind. But we have watched these siblings. These children of the king. They are brave minds. Clever minds. Ambitious minds. Yet unsullied by the weakness of aging that plagues their kind.—-

"Then what compels them to hear our whispers?"

—-Desperation. We will tell the most cunning sibling of a cataclysm. A prophecy… of great loss. We will feed her fear. Her pride. We will say… Young Sathona. The end is coming. A great cataclysm. A God-Wave. In the Sky… there is only death. But salvation… lies in the Deep. Lead your sisters down. Your cunning will spare their short lives. And you… will be reborn. The Witch Queen… Savathûn.—-

"Quite the embellished lie, my Witness."

—-Lie? Or perhaps a truth in the making? That will be of her choosing. She may even stand alongside you one day. In service of the final shape.—-

[In that moment, jealousy, envy- or something more was all but painted across the Subjugator's expression.]
1627640710.text_zh:
[丧心病狂。不管他是否知道，镇压者和他的目标：锇素之王，都有着这一共同的特征。锇素之王手里拿着幼虫，耳边都是流言低语，一心煽动癫狂的低语。万物终结的低语。] 

[直到一轮银月在空中游移。在锇素之王的脑海中，古老的神话变成了现实。他咆哮着，叫嚷着。直到其他人因听得腻烦而了结了他的生命。他的女儿们担忧同样遭此下场，纷纷逃离。]

[他们居高临下，注视着见证者及其门徒，策划他们的下一步行动。]

“它在一如既往地玩弄我们，我的见证者。我们那在虫群据点空中的敌人。它的行迹是一则讯息，与我们的秘密计划相悖的讯息。”

—-它拖延了我们的欲望，这样它就可以寻求自己的欲望。这些脆弱的孩子…很快就会被光能所占有。除非我们先占有他们。我们的低语被灌输给了一个意志薄弱的人。但我们一直在观察这些孩子。这些锇素之王的孩子。他们是勇敢的人，聪明的人，有野心的人。但还没有被困扰他们这类人的衰老弱点所污染。—-

“那要怎么迫使他们听到我们的低语呢？”

—-绝望。我们会将大灾变的预言讲给最狡黠的孩子听：一则…毁天灭地的预言。我们会用她的恐惧和骄傲滋养她。我们会说…年轻的萨托娜唷。末日即将来临。一场巨大的灾变。一股神之巨浪。在天空中…只有死亡。救赎…就在深渊之中。将你的姐妹们带入深渊吧。你的狡黠会拯救她们短暂的生命。而你…将会重生。作为巫妖女王…萨瓦图恩。—-

“真是个精心编造的谎言啊，我的见证者。”

—-谎言？又或许是个正在成形的真相呢？那就要看她作何选择了。她甚至可能有一天会站在你身旁。为终焉之形效力。—-

[那一刻，镇压者脸上几乎写满了嫉妒。]

2150515362.name: Resonant Fury Gauntlets
2150515362.subtitle: Yul yearns for nurture. It does so through honesty.
2150515362.subtitle_zh: 尤尔渴望滋养。诚实助它实现。
2150515362.text:
++Stench follows. You drag it before you—

—It will not consume you, for you have conquered it—

—Or so you prefer to believe++

++TURN BACK FROM THE WORLD-KILLING WAY++

++OR YOU WILL LIVE AS WRATH AND DEVASTATION++

[In this life, there are beings that bring light to others. And there are beings that bring dark. He brought dark. Only dark. And was naught more than an unbreakable, unstoppable force.] 

[The cruel Leviathan learned this truth the hard way—he pulled from its chest a rib many times larger than the Subjugator himself. Yet he wielded it as nothing.]
[The Leviathan, winded, broken, cast its gaze on the Deep below.]

"You would not look upon the one who bested you, beast? Lift your eyes and meet mine."

[The Subjugator placed the rib beneath the beast's skull and raised it level.]

"What lies beyond belongs not to you. Nor to your false god hiding amongst the many moons. It belongs to that which witnesses all. You would do best not to forget it, regardless of your misplaced loyalties."

————————————————————————————

[The rib dropped into our dwelling. Our Deep. With force, it landed before us, uplifting the sediment of the Fundament floor into a dense cloud—from which he emerged.]

"You—who stand on the naked hull of an ancient ship. You—who stand exposed, should be annihilated by the crushing pressure and ferocious heat of the deeper Fundament. But you—survive of your own will. You… are not known to us."

[He was to be our fate…]
2150515362.text_zh:
++恶臭随之而来，你把它拖到你面前—

—它不会吞噬你，因为你已经征服了它—

—或者你更愿意相信是这样++

++从杀戮世界的道路上回头吧++

++否则你将活在死亡和毁灭之中++

[这辈子，有给别人带来光明的众生。也有带来黑暗的众生。他带来了黑暗。唯有黑暗。不过是一股牢不可破、不可阻挡的力量罢了。] 

[这头残暴的利维坦在失去了组成它胸腔的一根肋骨之后才懂得了这一惨痛的教训——单单这根肋骨就比镇压者的体型还要大上好几倍。然而，他却举重若轻地挥舞着它。]
[利维坦大喘着气，衰弱不堪，它的目光投向底下的深渊，但它却一心想着自己的失败。]

“野兽，你难道不看看那个打败你的人吗？抬起你的头来见见我。”

[镇压者把肋骨放在野兽脑袋下，将其抬到与双眼齐平的位置。]

“外面的东西不属于你，也不属于你那藏在众多卫星之中的假神。而是属于那见证一切的人。抛开你那错位的忠诚不谈，你最好不要忘记这一点。”

————————————————————————————

[肋骨掉到了我们的寓所。我们的深渊。它用力落在我们面前，把虫群据点地面的沉积物掀了起来——他就是从那里出现的。]

“站在一艘古船裸露的船体之上的你。站立在虫群据点深处的高压和炽热之上的你。这应该消灭了你才对…但你却凭借自身意志存活了下来。你…不为我们所知。”

[他将是我们的命运…]

365727964.name: Resonant Fury Greaves
365727964.subtitle: Akka yearned for nurture. It did so through secrets.
365727964.subtitle_zh: 阿卡曾渴望滋养。秘密曾助它实现。
365727964.text:
[The Subjugator did what he does best. Conquer. Capture. Many of his victims fell. But those who proved useful served.]

[From a prison within Fundament to another in the dark expanse of his making, I was taken… And that was only the beginning.]

[He knew of our strengths. Our powers. To grip the mind and guide. To fill it with vitality and power. To reduce it to rot and waste.]

[—-The universe is wide, my child—- his Witness would chide. —-With wrath matching if not exceeding yours in its vastness. Seek it before it seeks you. Or it will be your end.—-]

[He claimed to desire our powers for his Witness. But I overheard eons of their discussions. His omniscient god always reduced him to that which he claimed—wrath.]

[Though he wore such a designation proudly, he wanted more. Wanted our power for himself. To continue to do what he does best, better than before, alongside his Witness.]

[This is why I was kept. The desire for domination of all things.]

——————————————————————————————————————

[The Subjugator returned living pieces of me to Fundament: segments he called larvae. He set them adrift on the ocean, knowing full well where the current would carry them…] 

[To the shores of the Osmium Kingdom.]
365727964.text_zh:
[镇压者做了他最擅长的事。征服与俘虏。许多受害者倒下了。但那些被证明有用的人，都得留下来效力。]

[我从一个虫群据点里的监狱被带到了一个黑暗中的监狱…这只是开头。]

[他了解我们的力量。我们的能量。控制并引导思想。让它充满活力与力量。任它沦为腐根和废料。]

[—-宇宙是广阔的，我的孩子，—-他的见证者会斥责道。—-有种愤怒与其浩瀚相媲美，甚至更胜一筹。要在它找到你之前，先找到它。否则它就将是你的末日。—-]

[他声称希望让他的见证者有这些力量。但我无意中听到了无数次他们的讨论。他的全知之神总是会让他沦落到他自称的那种地步——怒不可遏。]

[虽然他很傲然地流露着怒火，但他还想要更多。他想要据为己有。继续做他最擅长的事情，甚至做得比以前更好。]

[这就是我被关起来的原因。支配万事万物的欲望。]

——————————————————————————————————————

[镇压者把我活着的碎片带到了虫群据点。他称它们为幼虫。他让它漂浮在大海上，深知漂流会把它带往…] 

[锇素王国的海岸。]

2370089583.name: Resonant Fury Mark
2370089583.subtitle: Eir yearns for nurture. It does so through order.
2370089583.subtitle_zh: 艾尔渴望滋养。秩序助它实现。
2370089583.text:
[The Witch Queen rarely paid visit to my prison. And when she did, it was not for me. She knew what I was, what I produced. I was a servant of the Subjugator. A servant of the Witness. A provider of that which took sustenance from her and many like her. She never cared for that. And as such, she never cared for me. Or for him. And he knew it.]

[She was cunning. Where wrath consumed Oryx and Xivu Arath, it always eluded Savathûn. Or perhaps, it was she who eluded it.]

[Of this, my Subjugator was not fond. Placed indefinitely in her throne world, he was made to watch her every move. To mentor and guide, to keep a close eye—so that one day, she, too, could serve the Witness. A Disciple in the making.] 

[It was as planned. The Krill became the Hive. The enemy amongst the moons of Fundament disappeared. My Subjugator served his Witness well. But he could not escape the very words of his Witness, which beat against his mind whenever Savathûn stood in his presence. —-The universe is wide, my child. With wrath matching if not exceeding yours in its vastness. Seek it before it seeks you. Or it will be your end.—-]

[I became a vessel for his jealousies. A source of power for his Upended to consume. To see Savathûn's world shattered should she ever step out of line.]

[In the Deep, my children pay a price in servitude, for survival. In ascendance, the Hive pay a price in servitude, for power. And in the dark, I pay a price in servitude, so that others may be nurtured.]

[It must not be in vain.]
2370089583.text_zh:
[巫妖女王鲜少造访我的监狱。她这么做的时候，也不是为了我。她知道我曾是什么人物，我创造了什么。我是镇压者的仆从。见证者的仆从。一个从她和许多像她一样的人身上汲取养料的供养人。她从不关心这些。正因如此，她从不关心我。也不关心他。他知道这一点。]

[她是狡黠者。愤怒吞噬了欧里克斯和希乌阿拉斯。但它总是避开了萨瓦图恩。也许是她避开了它。]

[这一点，我的镇压者并不喜欢。她被无限期地安置在了她的王座世界里，用来监视她一举一动。用来指导和引导，密切关注她，这样有一天她也可以为见证者效忠。一个正在养成的门徒。] 

[一切都按计划进行。克里尔变成了邪魔族。虫群据点卫星中的敌人消失了。我的镇压者很好地效忠了他的见证者。但是，每当萨瓦图恩站在他面前的时候，他都无法逃避见证者说的那些不断激荡他脑海的话——宇宙是广阔的，我的孩子。有种愤怒与其浩瀚相媲美，甚至更胜一筹。要在它找到你之前，先找到它。否则它就将是你的末日。——]

[我成了他忌妒的对象。成了为他的颠倒者提供力量的源泉。一旦萨瓦图恩越轨，就将见证她的世界遭到摧毁。]

[在深渊里，我的孩子们付出了奴役的代价，换取生存。在上维中，邪魔族付出了奴役的代价，换取力量。而在黑暗中，我付出了奴役的代价，这样其他人才能得到养育。]

[这一切绝不能徒劳无功。]

1656263403.name: Resonant Fury Gloves
1656263403.subtitle: I see the game. I raise the stakes.
1656263403.subtitle_zh: 我看到这游戏，我提高了赌注。
1656263403.text:
It takes no foresight, nor does it require any sort of precognition to hypothesize how exactly this particular Queen of the Hive reacted to the development of new establishments in her throne world, my Witness.

Acquiescence, it was decidedly not.

It would be dishonest of me to claim no delight from her indignation, though I assure you, these simple pleasures are born out of nothing more than a desire to see her succeed while remaining in our care.

Too much recoil on our part from confrontation with Savathûn would surely beget a feeling of true autonomy for her; and while my undying trust for you, my Witness, is eternally absolute, I remain circumspect in regard to any hidden intentions Savathûn may see to fruition were she allowed to.

She remains, after all, and as you know, conniving and opportunistic. I am, however, hopeful that in due time, these concerns will fade. Hopeful, my Witness, but not convinced.

Begrudging as she may be, and with the continued… "cooperation" of Xita, construction of the larvae breeding chambers has commenced. The armies of Oryx and Xivu Arath will grow exponentially in short order. Should they envision future conquests, they will indeed have the tools to make it so, as is your wish, my Witness.

Should Savathûn desire to play cards in contrast to our own, I will, without hesitation, bring to mind that she made her choice long ago, and that only if she wishes for eternal release should she dare to betray it.
1656263403.text_zh:
我的见证者，要推断这位特殊的邪魔族女王对她王座世界中新势力的发展究竟有何反应，不需要任何先见之明，也不需要任何预知能力。

默许，绝对不是。

如果我说没有从她的愤怒中得到任何快乐，那就太不诚实了，不过我向您保证，这些简单的快乐只不过是希望看到她在我们的监护下取得成功。

我们在与萨瓦图恩对抗时过于退缩，肯定会给她带来一种真正的当家作主的感觉；我的见证者，虽然我对您永恒的信任绝对毋庸置疑，但对于萨瓦图恩想要实现的任何潜在意图，如果她获准的话，我会保留谨慎态度。

毕竟，您也知道，她始终是个擅使阴谋诡计和投机取巧的人。但我希望这些担忧会及时消失。只是希望，我的见证者，而不是确信。

尽管她很不情愿，但在西塔的持续…“合作”下，幼虫繁殖室的建设已经启动。欧里克斯和希乌阿拉斯的军队将迅速地成倍增长。要是他们设想未来的征服，他们确实将拥有如愿以偿的工具，如您所愿，我的见证者。

要是萨瓦图恩胆敢跟我们唱反调，我会毫不犹豫地提醒她，她早就做出了抉择，只有在她希望得到永恒的解脱时，她才该敢于背叛她所选的路。

2422261368.name: Resonant Fury Bond
2422261368.subtitle: I reach for nothing. I am subdued. I shall remain useless.
2422261368.subtitle_zh: 我别无所求。我闷闷不乐。我毫无用处。
2422261368.text:
Tell me, O Witness mine—does the Light that fills this once dreadfully tiresome space blind you from its newfound glory?

You expected the same old correspondence from your dragooned errand boy, no doubt. Surely, just as you expected your machinations within my throne world to continue unfettered until your definition of eternity came to pass.

Well, don't I have some unfortunate news for you then. But this comes as no surprise, of that I'm sure—you're always watching.

Let me share my perspective then, which you must be waiting for with bated breath: my acquisition of the Light itself is delightful proof of an existence higher even than yours—a sort of karmic wit, if you will.

Though I remember not all the eons-long hardships I endured at your whim, the nefarious sentiment lingers within my mind, overcome only by the pleasure of your assured discontent.

It was this said pleasure that gave me the strength to disperse the Light throughout this prison you called my home. Since it is now to remain my domain, it has been decorated to reflect as such.

No longer does this plane live only with the lackluster ambiance of Darkness. It is brighter now. My truth can finally thrive.

No longer do the walls that birthed our parasitic chains house your machinations. The tools and parasites within, shattered.

And no longer does your Subjugator subjugate. He lies ensnared within his obtrusive eyesore, for upon Rhulk's attempt to subdue me with that toy he's annoyingly always on about—his "Upended"—I was able to counteract it, showing firsthand the power bequeathed to me in my new state. Now, the once-great Pyramid lies fractured, a sight you will become familiar with.

So try and send your Scorn, or your Disciples, or even bring your many selves to reclaim your loss, if you must. But this is my domain now. And you shall never set foot inside it, even if I must draw my final breath to keep it that way.
2422261368.text_zh:
告诉我，我的见证者啊，照亮这曾经令人生厌空间的光能是否让你看不到它新得到的荣耀？

毫无疑问，你期待着你那位龙骑兵跟班小弟捎来的千篇一律的信件。当然，就像你期望你在我的王座世界里的阴谋诡计继续不受约束，直到你对永恒的定义成为现实。

好吧，我是不是有一些不幸的消息要告诉你来着。不过这不会让人惊讶，我确信你一直有在关注。

那就让我来分享一下我的看法吧，你一定在屏息以待：我获得光能本身就是个让人高兴的佐证，证明了甚至高过你的光能的存在——是一种业力的智慧，如果你愿意那样说的话。

虽然我记不清在你的心血来潮下所有我长年累月忍受下来的苦难，但邪恶的情绪始终在我的脑海中挥之不去，只有确定能让你不满所带来的快乐才足以将之取代。

正是这种快乐给了我力量，让我能够在这座你称之为我家的监狱里散播光能。既然它现在还是我的领地，经过一番装饰它已经名副其实。

这个位面不再只生活在了无生气的暗影环境之中。它现在明亮多了。我的真理终于可以茁壮成长。

孕育了我们的寄生链的砖墙不用再容纳你的阴谋。里面的工具和寄生虫，彻底粉碎了。

而你的镇压者也不用再让人屈服了。他被困在他那突兀的眼中钉里，因为在胡克试图用那个他总是说个不停的烦人玩具——他的“颠倒者”制服我的时候，我成功抵挡了它，亲自展示了我在新状态下所继承的力量。现在，曾经伟大的金字塔支离破碎地躺在那里，那将是一副你很快就会熟悉的景象。

所以，派出你的嗤魅，或者你的门徒，放马过来吧，哪怕是带上好几个自己来收复失地，如果你非要这么做的话。但现在这是我的地盘了。你永远也休想踏进这里半步，就算要我咽下最后一口气也在所不惜。

2748020989.name: Resonant Fury Boots
2748020989.subtitle: I sought relief. I found delight.
2748020989.subtitle_zh: 我寻求着救济。我找到了欢欣。
2748020989.text:
She builds a palace here in her hiding place, and I perceive through her self-assurance. For all her grandiose treatises on secrets, the Hive princess all but screams, "Look upon me."

And so I look upon her today, my Witness, absent a brother. Loss—true and consequential loss—is new to her palette, but she hides her distaste for the bitter well. I address her. "Savathûn, your brother is no more. He is absent from the final shape of things, as he always must be. But I sense a foreign hand at work."

"Would you accuse rather than state, Rhulk?" She clothes herself in playful tones. "I have played a role in more of my brother's deaths than not."

"So very true. Congratulations, then? I suppose after so many eons of killing one another to build your strength, his final end must feel like quite the accomplishment. No more must your wits dabble against his play-mortality. Now, only matters of consequence will occupy your precious time."

"And thankfully, I find myself well-provisioned now for any conflict."

"Ah! I had nearly forgotten! You are the heir apparent to Oryx's dominion, yes? I know you Hive are loathe to accept gifts rather than seize them. Armies. Fleets. And of course, the Taken."

"If I had seen this coming, perhaps I could have even prepared to secure the secret of Taking itself."

I bark in amusement. She makes no attempt to hide her distaste for the laughter of my kind, and it is indulgence itself to let it flow freely. "Clever. Always one step ahead. The Taken will serve you well against the Guardians until they slay you just the same."

"My sweet, vile brother would look at a scalpel and see a hammer. I am not him."

"Yes, you do seem to find much more creative uses for your playthings. A pity that will become ever so challenging for you moving forward."
"Challenging?" I do not see confusion cross her face often. I savor the scent.

"Until now, the shadow from which you skulked has been your brother's. Without the Taken King to cast your swaddling shade, you stand naked in the sun for all to see, yes? No shadows, no hiding, no tricks. Just the Guardians and their god-slaying weapons."

"I have little to fear from the sun," she insists, but there is no twist in her face. No secret delight.
2748020989.text_zh:
她在藏身之处建起了一座宫殿，我感到了她的胸有成竹。这名标榜隐秘的邪魔族公主就差喊出声来了，“快来看看我。”

所以今天我去看了她，我的见证者，她兄弟不在场。对她来说，丧失，真实而重要的那种丧失，算是新鲜事，但她很好地掩饰了对愤恨的厌恶。我告诉她。“萨瓦图恩，你兄弟已经不在了。他一如既往地缺席了事物的终态。但我感觉到有一只外来的手在干涉。”

“你能直接指责我，而不是拐弯抹角吗？胡克？”她装出一副顽皮的腔调。“我兄弟的死大部分都与我有关。”

“的确如此。那就恭喜你吧？我想，在经过无数个世纪的自相残杀来增强你的力量过后，他最后的结局一定让你很有成就感吧。你的智慧再也不需要与他的死亡游戏作斗争了。现在，只有要紧的事情才配占据你宝贵的时间了。”

“谢天谢地，我发现自己现在已经为任何冲突做好了充分的准备。”

“啊！我差点忘了！你显然是欧里克斯领地的继承人，对吧？我知道你们邪魔族比起夺取礼物，更讨厌去接受它们。军队、舰队，当然，还有傀儡军团。”

“如果我预见到了这一点，也许我甚至可以准备好保守傀儡军团本身的秘密。”

我开心地大笑起来。她毫不掩饰她对我这种笑声的厌恶，让这种厌恶自由地流露出来，这本身就是一种放纵。“真聪明。总是棋高一着。傀儡军团会很好地帮助你对付守护者，直到他们同样杀死你为止。”

“我那亲爱的、糟透了的兄弟会把手术刀看成锤子。我可不是他。”

“没错，你似乎为你的玩物找到了更多富有创造性的用途。遗憾的是，这对你来说将变得越来越有挑战性。”
“挑战性？”我不常看到她脸上露出困惑的神色。我细细品味着这气息。

“到目前为止，你一直躲在你兄弟的阴影里。没有了邪神为你遮风挡雨，你就会在众目睽睽之下赤裸裸地站在阳光之中，对吧？无荫可栖，无处躲藏，无计可施。只有守护者和他们的弑神武器。”

“我用不着害怕太阳，”她坚持道，但脸上没有一丝扭曲的笑意或暗藏的喜悦。

3300312357.name: Resonant Fury Robes
3300312357.subtitle: I reach for solace. It is stolen from me.
3300312357.subtitle_zh: 我寻求着慰藉。它已被人偷走。
3300312357.text:
Conquest. Warming as the long-ago memory of blue sun on my face. All the while reminding me of the exhilaration of existing outside the Throne World, if only for a short while. I live in this glory—a rare opportunity to step away from exile within that ascendant chrysalis, as I gather more cunning for my sparring with the Witch.

Surely, you placed me as her minder, my Witness, as a hardship to hone my intrigue. 

But in this moment, astride a Pyramid once more with an upstart empire splayed before me, my purpose is truer than any found carved in the wretched stones of the globe that formed me.

Kalarahnda flashes beneath my gaze. Yellow haze streaks ruby clouds. The vaulted ring surrounding Kalarahnda shatters into a shimmer-like, windblown sand—a prescription against the folly of confidence writ across a million-million ceramic shards.

I live in this glory—because the full purity of their extinction was stolen from me.

Because without predication of my own, a cult had sprouted in apocalyptic jubilation of the Darkness and blessed oblivion. 

They grew for years in the shadows, drawing the disillusioned from the poorest to the wealthiest. These Polyps of the Longshadow sensed—as if by providence—a coming end and believed the breaking of the vaulted ring to be the final sign: they would ascend and bring their kind with them. Moments before their world was mine, their enzymatic armaments scrubbed all life from this wet rock. A guileful theft. Triggered by my own glorious coming.

And there was nothing calling to the Witch's involvement, save the twist in her face that betrayed restrained delight.
3300312357.text_zh:
征服。就像蓝色阳光照在我脸上的久远记忆一样，让人感到温暖和煦。自始至终提醒着我存在于王座世界之外的兴奋感，哪怕稍纵即逝。随着我为与女巫的争辩收揽了更多的诡诈狡黠，我活在了这样的荣耀之中——这是一次难得的机会，让我能够摆脱上维蚕蛹之中的流放。

我的见证者，想必您是安排我做她的看护人，来作为磨练我诡计的试炼吧。 

但在这一刻，我再次跨上了金字塔，面对展现在我眼前的新兴帝国，我的目标比在塑造我的世界里那些可怜的石头上发现的任何目标都更真切。

卡拉兰达在我的凝视下掠过。黄色的薄雾划过宝石红的云层。环绕卡拉兰达的拱形圆环碎裂成一片闪烁的风吹砂——那是给遍布亿万块陶瓷碎片上的自信命令的愚蠢开的药方。

我活在了这样的荣耀之中，因为他们消亡的清白纯洁从我的身边被尽数偷走。

因为少了我自身的谓述，一个邪教已然在暗影和神佑遗忘的末日欢庆之中萌芽了。 

他们在阴影中成长了多年，吸引了跨越贫富两极的看破红尘之士。这些深影水螅，仿佛天意使然，感知到了末日即将来临，并认为拱形圆环的碎裂便是最后的征兆：他们将会得道，同族也将随之升天。在他们的世界归属我之前，他们的酶武器从这块潮湿的岩石上抹除了所有生命。一起随着我的荣耀降临而引发的狡诈盗窃。

而且没有女巫介入的任何证据，除了她脸上将克制的喜悦暴露无遗的扭曲神情。

2316722050.name: Resonant Fury Cowl
2316722050.subtitle: I see the task before me. I wear it with devotion.
2316722050.subtitle_zh: 我看到了眼前要务。我虔诚地穿上了它。
2316722050.text:
She was a frog in my estimation; small and colorful but toxic to touch.

In your infinite wisdom, you looked beyond the worm I brought you to the least of the leeches that infested Fundament. Shaving thin my gift, you infected them with conquest, and now they see themselves as artisans of the final shape.

My place is not to understand you, my Witness, but to serve that final goal you see more clearly than I. But now, your gold-leaf parasites call themselves gods and carve out their divine homes. And I am to watch the sniveling frog.

Was this castigation? The toll I pay for my failure with the Ahslid? You have cast me and my ego once more into the cold depths of an inconsequential world.

I recall stepping into her realm, and her face twisted to betray restrained delight. She thought herself mistress of this domain you leased her. She did not—could not—appreciate the precarity of her situation. So sure of her dominion, she could not recognize her jailer, or that she lives within a prison formed from her own ego—one I will put to work for you, my Witness. 

The capture of her race will flow out from this realm—each self-satisfied smirk will forge a new link in their chains.

Had I known then what my current quandary would be, I could have heeded my own insights on ego. Regardless, even in this predicament, I am unbowed.
2316722050.text_zh:
在我看来，她就如一只青蛙；小而鲜艳，毒不可触。

以您无限的智慧，您的目光超脱了我带给你的蠕虫，看向了侵扰虫群据点那最不起眼的水蛭。缩减了我的馈赠，您用征服的方式感染了他们，如今他们把自己看作是终焉之形的工匠。

我的职责不是理解您，我的见证者，而是为了您比我更清楚的最终目标服务。但现在，您的金叶寄生虫自居为神，并开辟了他们的神圣家园。我要去探望那只哭哭啼啼的青蛙了。

这算是责罚吗？为我在阿赫斯利德人身上的失败所付出的代价？您把我和我的自尊再度抛进了一个无足轻重的世界里的冰冷深渊。

我记得踏入她的领地时，她的脸扭曲着，流露出难以抑制的喜悦。她认为自己就是您租借给她的这块领地的女主人。她没有，也不可能，意识到她摇摇欲坠的处境。她对自己的统治是如此自信，甚至认不出她的狱卒来，也未曾意识到她生活在一个由她的自负所打造的监狱里——我为您而启用的监狱，我的见证者。 

对她种族的追捕将涌出这个领域，每一次自鸣得意的笑容都将为他们的锁链铸就新的一环。

如果当时我知道我如今的困境，就会留意到我自己对自负的看法。不管怎样，即使在这种窘况之中，我也绝不屈服。

1599443272.name: Medal Bond
1599443272.subtitle: Your reputation precedes you, like a hint of perfume on the breeze.
1599443272.subtitle_zh: 你名声在外，就像微风中的香水味道。
1599443272.text:
Prak'kesh and his Awoken bodyguard, Tulnik, had been watching crowds of bettors come in and out of the Eliksni Quarter for an hour. Clearly, whoever was stealing their business was gaining momentum.

The bookmaker spotted a fireteam of Warlocks wafting down the street like a perfumed breeze. He approached them with his most disarming smile.

"Hey, you guys are Warlocks, right?" Prak'kesh feigned a slight bumpkin accent.

The leader, a Shadebinder, held out his hand and summoned a shimmering crystal staff out of thin air. "What tipped you off?" he smirked. His teammates posed smugly behind him.

"It was your… uh… fancy bracelets," Prak'kesh replied, pointing to the Warlock's arm.

"That's a Celestine Bond, goober," the posing Dawnblade sneered.

"Neat! I just got here from the Farm," Prak'kesh said, leaning into his plucky yokel act. "I want to bet on the Warlocks to win the Guardian Games, because you guys are obviously the toughest and most dangerous class." Behind him, Tulnik faked a coughing fit to hide a guffaw.

"You're smarter than you look," the Shadebinder sniffed. 

"The problem is," Prak'kesh went on, "I don't know where to place my bet. Do you know of any bookers around here?"

The Dawnblade rolled her eyes, "They're called 'bookies.'"

"Wow," Prak'kesh replied. "You guys sure are sophisticated."

"Just show this to one of the Fallen," the Shadebinder offered, "and they'll point you in the right direction." He handed Prak'kesh a scrap of paper. 

"Now step aside," he continued. "We have to meditate on the nature of un-being before getting drunk tonight."

The trio pushed past Prak'kesh, floating their way toward the Tower. The bookie made a rude gesture at the retreating fireteam and walked back to Tulnik. They looked down at the calling card. It was worse than they feared. 

Emblazoned across the paper was the emblem of a big black spider.
1599443272.text_zh:
普拉凯什和他的觉醒者保镖图尔尼克，已经盯着一群群投注者在埃里克斯尼居住区进进出出一个小时了。很显然，抢了他们生意的人势头越来越猛。

这个赌注登记人发现一个术士火力战队如微风般在街上飘荡。他带着最无害的微笑走近了他们。

“嘿，你们是术士，对吧？”普拉凯什假装自己是个乡巴佬。

那名队长是个影宗，他伸出手，凭空召唤出一根闪闪发光的水晶杖。“你怎么知道的？”他得意地笑了笑。他的队友们则洋洋自得地在他的身后摆姿势。

“因为你们…呃…华丽的手镯，”普拉凯什指着术士的手臂答道。

“这是个天青臂环，蠢货，”摆姿势的破晓嘲笑道。

“酷啊！我刚从农庄到这儿来，”普拉凯什说着，尽力模仿乡巴佬的行为。“我想投注术士会在守护者游戏中胜出，因为你们术士显然是最坚韧又最危险的职业。”在他身后，图尔尼克假装咳嗽来掩饰自己的哄笑。

“你比看上去聪明多了，”那名影宗哼了哼。 

“问题是，”普拉凯什继续说道，“我不知道该在哪里投注。你知道这附近有赌注人吗？”

那名破晓翻了个白眼，“是‘赌注登记人'。”

“哇，”普拉凯什答道。“你们真是见多识广。”

“把这个给其中一个堕落者看，”那名影宗说，“他们就会为你指引方向。”他递给了普拉凯什一张纸。 

“现在给我站一边去，”他继续说道。“在今晚喝醉之前，我们还得冥想非存在的本质。”

三人随后穿过普拉凯什，朝着高塔飘去。赌注登记人对远去的火力战队做了个粗鲁的手势，然后走向图尔尼克。他们低头看了看名片，情况比他们担心的还要糟。 

纸上绣着一只巨大的黑蜘蛛徽标。

617617371.name: Mark of Medal
617617371.subtitle: Your reputation precedes you, like the rumble of a lumbering beast.
617617371.subtitle_zh: 你名声在外，就像一头笨重的野兽发出的怒吼。
617617371.text:
Prak'kesh sauntered into the bar wearing Felwinter's Helm and a war beast leather coat. He wanted these Guardians to know he meant business. Tulnik, his gigantic bodyguard, eyed the crowd warily.

They approached a fireteam of hulking Titans, whose seats were crammed next to the bar top, obliviously blocking the way to the bathroom. Their hands clenched into meaty fists as the pair neared.

"At ease, Guardians," Prak'kesh raised his hands in mock surrender. "Next round's on me." The Titans relaxed, their chairs creaking audibly beneath them.

"Good to see ya," the Sentinel rumbled. "Figured you was mad 'cuz we called our bets off. Nothin' personal," he shrugged.

"Of course not," Prak'kesh replied as he squeezed into an empty seat between them. Tulnik leaned against the wall, arms folded across his chest.

"But it does make me wonder," the bookie continued, "where you're taking your action." 

"We got great odds from this really big guy," the Sunbreaker said. "Had a deep voice and a weird helmet."

"Oh yeah?" Prak'kesh said with feigned disinterest. "Lots of people have weird helmets."

"Yeah, but this guy's the only one I ever met with four arms and no legs," the Sentinel said. "His Ghost must be a real joker."

"He had four arms? You're telling me this guy's Eliksni?" Prak'kesh shot Tulnik a frown.

"I ain't licking nothing," the Sentinel scowled.

Prak'kesh rolled his eyes. "He was Fallen. This was the Botza District, right?"

The moment stretched on as the Titans struggled to catch up with the obvious.

"Oh damn, Maurice," the Sunbreaker finally exclaimed as the light went on for her. "That explains the weird porcupine dudes!"

The Sentinel shook his head. "I woulda never guessed they were aliens. What great disguises."

Prak'kesh pinched the bridge of his nose. "Next time you place a bet, maybe try someone with a normal amount of arms, okay?"

The Sunbreaker nodded. "I hear you, 'Kesh. Forewarned is four-armed, right?"
617617371.text_zh:
普拉凯什戴着邪冬的头盔，穿着战兽皮革大衣，悠闲地走进酒吧。他想让这些守护者知道他是很认真的。他的大块头保镖图尔尼克警惕地看着人群。

他们走近了一支挤在吧台旁，挡住去洗手间的路，身形高大的泰坦火力战队。两人走近时，他们的手紧握成了拳头。

“别紧张，守护者，”普拉凯什举起双手，佯装是在投降。“下一轮酒我请。”泰坦们放松下来，椅子在他们身下吱吱作响。

“很高兴见到你，”哨兵低沉地说。“我们以为你会生气，毕竟我们取消了投注。我们无意冒犯你，”他耸了耸肩。

“怎么会，”普拉凯什一边回答，一边挤进他们之间的一个空座位。图尔尼克靠在墙上，双臂交叉放在胸前。

“但我确实很好奇，”赌注登记人继续说，“想知道你们在哪里投注。” 

“有个大个子给了我们更好的赔率，”炎阳说。“他声音低沉，而且戴着奇怪的头盔。”

“是吗？”普拉凯什假装不感兴趣地说道。“很多人都戴着奇怪的头盔。”

“是啊，但那家伙是我见过的唯一一个有四条胳膊而没有腿的人，”哨兵说。“他的机灵肯定喜欢搞恶作剧。”

“他有四条胳膊？你是说，那家伙是个埃里克斯尼族？”普拉凯什朝图尔尼克皱了皱眉头。

“我没那么说，”哨兵板着脸说。

普拉凯什翻了个白眼。“他是堕落者。而这事发生在柏特扎地区，对吧？”

泰坦们似乎想不透这显而易见的答案，沉默环绕着他们。

“该死，莫里斯，”炎阳终于明白了过来，她喊了一声，“难怪那些家伙身上有奇怪的尖刺！”

哨兵摇了摇头。“我完全没想到他们是外星种族。这伪装可真厉害。”

普拉凯什捏了捏鼻梁。“下次投注时，还是找个胳膊数量正常的人，好吧？”

炎阳点了点头。“我知道了，普拉凯什。要当心有四条胳膊的人，对吧？”

223597399.name: Medal Mantle
223597399.subtitle: Your reputation precedes you, like a disregarded warning.
223597399.subtitle_zh: 你名声在外，就像被忽略的警告。
223597399.text:
Prak'kesh was relieving himself against the base of the Tower when his bodyguard, Tulnik, gave a sharp whistle.  

The bookie hurriedly arranged himself and whirled around to find a trio of Hunters walking through the courtyard. Tulnik kept his eyes on the fireteam while whispering from the side of his mouth, "You're still unzipped."

Prak'kesh scoffed. "Worry about them, not my—Alphanis-2! Good to see you!" the bookie suddenly shouted in greeting as one of the Hunters approached. "Come to put a few more engrams on tonight's matches?"

The fireteam leader rested his hand coolly on his sidearm. His compatriots lollygagged in the courtyard, juggling knives back and forth. 

"Actually, I've come to call off our bets," Alphanis-2 said casually. 

Prak'kesh furrowed his brow. "Why's that? Not like you to miss opening night of the Games."

The Hunter shrugged. "We got better odds elsewhere." 

Tulnik's eyebrows shot up. Prak'kesh's blinked slowly, as if he'd been slapped. 

In the courtyard, the two Hunters began to bicker. They flung their knives back and forth with increasing ferocity. 

Prak'kesh recovered and continued nonchalantly, "Yeah, sure thing Alphie." He tapped the datapad on his arm. "There. All your bets are off."

The Hunter eased his hand off his sidearm. "Thanks, 'Kesh." Behind him, one of his teammates yowled as a knife pierced his thigh. 

Alphanis-2 rolled his eyes. "What the hell are you idiots doing?" he shouted over his shoulder.

"He stabbed me!" the injured Hunter hollered. 

"Not my fault you can't catch," his juggling partner smugly replied.

The wounded Guardian ripped the knife dramatically from his thigh and held it aloft. "Shatterdiiiiive!" he screamed as he launched himself at his assailant. The pair fell to the ground, wrestling over the bloody knife. 

Alphanis-2 dove into the fray, trying to break it up. Their Ghosts materialized above them, shouting in tiny voices.

Tulnik shook his head in disbelief as the trio rolled around on the ground, spamming one another with melee attacks. Prak'kesh leaned over and muttered, "Let's find out who's biting our business. We may need to send a message."

Tulnik nodded slowly. "I'm on it, boss."
223597399.text_zh:
普拉凯什在高塔基座周围解手时，他的保镖图尔尼克吹了一声尖锐的口哨。  

这个赌注登记人急忙整顿好，一转过身就发现三名猎人正在穿过院子。图尔尼克一边盯着火力战队，一边低声说，“你的拉链还没拉上。”

普拉凯什嘲笑道。“你应该为他们担心，而不是为我——阿尔法尼斯-2！很高兴见到你！”当一个猎人走近时，赌注登记人突然大声打招呼。“你是来给今晚的比赛再加注几个记忆水晶的吗？”

那名火力战队队长冷静地把手放在手枪上，他的队友们则无所事事地待在院子里，来回抛刀。 

“其实，我是来取消我们的投注的，”阿尔法尼斯-2漫不经心地说道。 

普拉凯什皱起眉头。“怎么了？错过守护者游戏开幕之夜可不像你的作风。”

那名猎人耸了耸肩。“我们在其他地方得到的赔率更好。” 

图尔尼克眉毛一扬。普拉凯什慢慢地眨了眨眼睛，好像被打了个耳光。 

另外两名在院子里的猎人开始斗嘴，他们挥舞着刀子，越来越凶猛。 

普拉凯什回过神来，若无其事地继续说，“行，没问题，阿尔法尼斯。”他轻敲手臂上的数据板。“好了，你所有的投注都已取消。”

那名猎人把他的手从手枪上移开。“谢谢，普拉凯什。”在他身后，他的一名队友因为大腿被刀刺穿而咆哮了起来。 

阿尔法尼斯-2翻了个白眼。“你们这些白痴在搞什么鬼？”他回头喊道。

“他捅了我！”受伤的猎人大叫道。 

“你接不住可不是我的错，”他的抛刀搭档得意地答道。

受伤的守护者夸张地把刀从大腿上拔出来举在空中。“破碎俯冲！”他大声一叫扑向了他的袭击者。两人倒在地上，开始争抢那把带血的刀。 

阿尔法尼斯-2加入了这场争斗，试图制止两人。他们的机灵出现在上方，用微弱的声音叫喊着。

三人在地上摸爬滚打，图尔尼克难以置信地摇了摇头。普拉凯什俯身咕哝道，“查清是谁抢了我们的生意。我们可能需要杀一儆百。”

图尔尼克慢慢地点了点头。“我这就去办，老大。”

119228495.name: Tusked Allegiance Gloves
119228495.subtitle: "Bonds are forged on the battlefield and broken at the War Table." —Empress Caiatl
119228495.subtitle_zh: “羁绊在战斗中铸成，在战争圆桌前破碎。”——查厄托女帝
119228495.text:
Crow was already reloading when the strange Hive's lifeless body crashed to the forest floor.

Glint flew toward the corpse without a word. Crow pretended not to notice and kept walking through the woods. He's been in a mood all day, Glint thought with a static sigh. He could use some time alone.

When he reached the Hive, Glint resisted the absurd reflex to scan it for compatibility. Instead, he simply assessed, noting the strong arms that could handle the recoil from heavy weapons; the thick shell, built to absorb all manner of firepower; the remains of a bony shield that sizzled nearby, powerful enough to protect—

The space next to Glint fluctuated as a bone-white Hive Ghost appeared. 

The two froze warily in midair.

"Hey," the Hive Ghost whispered after a moment. "It's okay." Its voice was surprisingly soft. 

Its green eye flickered reassuringly and it began to focus Light.

Glint bobbed unsteadily. Crow was fifty yards off, moving carefully through the trees. "You shouldn't—"

"It'll be all right," it said and hovered lower to the ground, pouring Light into the fallen Hive. The surrounding ferns trembled with the sudden flow of energy.

"Wait," Glint pressed. But the Ghost ignored him as the thick armor of the Hive began to reform. 

"Crow!" Glint screamed, "Crow, here!" And he flew to him without turning back.
119228495.text_zh:
当这具怪异的邪魔族尸体坠落到森林地面时，乌鸦已经在填装弹药了。

格林特一言不发地飞向尸体。乌鸦假装没注意到，继续穿过树林。他一整天都情绪不佳，格林特边想边轻轻叹了口气。他需要一些独处的时间。

当他找到那个邪魔族时，格林特忍住了想要扫描其兼容性的荒唐反射。他只是简单地评估了一下眼前的邪魔族：他注意到那些强壮的手臂可以承受重型武器的后坐力；厚厚的机壳，可以吸收各种形式的火力；一个骨质盾牌的残骸在附近嘶嘶作响，强大到足以保护——

格林特身旁的空间出现了波动，一个骨白色的邪魔族机灵随即现身。

两个机灵警惕地愣在半空中。

“嘿，”过了一会儿，邪魔族机灵轻声说。“没事的。”它的声音出奇地柔和。

它安慰地眨了眨绿色的眼睛，开始聚焦光能。

格林特晃悠悠地上下浮动着。乌鸦在五十码开外，小心翼翼地穿过树林。“你不该——”

“不会有事的，”它边说着，边降低着自己的悬停高度，把光能灌注进了倒下的邪魔族。周围的蕨类植物伴随着忽如其来的能量流动而颤动。

“等等，”格林特急促地说道。但那个机灵没有理会他。邪魔族厚重的盔甲已开始重构。

“乌鸦！”格林特尖叫道，“乌鸦，这边！”他头也不回地朝着乌鸦飞去。

3465627817.name: Tusked Allegiance Robes
3465627817.subtitle: "Were the Light a glory to be earned, the Cabal would have claimed it long ago." —Empress Caiatl
3465627817.subtitle_zh: “如果光能是种荣耀，卡巴尔早就把它拿到手了。”——查厄托女帝
3465627817.text:
Mithrax delicately pushed the low curtain aside as he entered the bedroom.

Tall shelves crowded him, cluttered with relics from Mercury and beyond: piles of intricate scrolls, silver hourglasses that turned of their own accord, ceramic pots of red soil sprouting delicate metallic vines beneath glass domes. An enormous feathered mantle was mounted carefully on a wooden stand and crowned with a birdlike cowl.

The hulking form of Saint-14 sat in a wooden chair facing the bed where, impossibly small beneath the blankets, rested the man known as Osiris.

Mithrax rapped politely on the doorframe.

"My friend," Saint-14 said. "It is good of you to come."

Mithrax approached Saint and bowed. "It is an honor to be invited," he said. "These visits are pleasant to me." 

He held out the covered dish he was carrying in his lower arms, but Saint's eyes remained fixed on Osiris. 

The Titan took a ragged breath. His voice was a hoarse whisper: "Could the Psion machine… connect my mind with his? So that I might share his dreams?"

Mithrax felt useless. He spoke softly: "The Psion tells me the subject must have residual activity for a reading, and Osiris has been asleep very long. Besides, the connection you seek joins the Light of one being to the Light of another, and Osiris is—"

"Lightless, yes," Saint finished flatly. He leaned forward in his chair, his elbows on his knees, hands clasped before him. He was silent for some time.

"I will let him sleep alone," Saint finally said, and caressed Osiris's hand with impossible tenderness. "When he wakes, we will dream together once more."

He adjusted the blankets, stood, and nodded toward the covered dish Mithrax still clutched awkwardly.

"I am hoping that is not more eggplant," he said.

Mithrax coughed on his Ether. "The eggplant is most nourishing," he protested weakly, and Saint groaned.
3465627817.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯进入卧室时，小心翼翼地把低矮的帘子推到一边。

房间里摆满了高大的架子，来自水星和其他地方的圣物杂乱无章地堆积其上：成堆的复杂卷轴、自动转动的银色沙漏、玻璃穹顶下长出精致金属藤蔓的红土陶罐。一件巨大的羽毛披风被小心地挂在木架上，其顶部有一个鸟状的风帽。

圣人14号庞大的身躯坐落在一张面对着床的木椅上。床上躺着的是一个被称作奥斯里斯的人；毯子下的他显得格外娇小。

米瑟拉克斯礼貌地敲了敲门框。

“我的朋友，”圣人14号说。“你能来真是太好了。”

米瑟拉克斯走到圣人跟前，鞠了一躬。“能受到邀请是我的荣幸，”他说。“造访别人让我感到愉快。”

他伸出端着餐食的下臂，但圣人仍然目不转睛地盯着奥斯里斯。

泰坦喘了一口粗气，用沙哑的声音低语道：“灵能机器能不能…把我的思想和他的联系起来？让我分享他的梦境？”

米瑟拉克斯感到无能为力。他轻声开口道：“灵能士兵告诉我，受试对象必须具有可读取的残留活性，而奥斯里斯已经沉睡很久了。而且，你所寻求的连接需要将一个生命的光能与另一个生命的光能连接起来，而奥斯里斯已经——”

“失去光能了，没错，”圣人平静地接了对方的话。他坐在椅子上向前倾，手肘放在膝盖上，双手紧握在面前。他沉默了好一阵子。

“我会让他独自沉睡，”圣人最后说道，无比温柔地抚摸着奥斯里斯的手。“等他醒来后，我们会再次同享梦境。”

他整理了一下毛毯，站了起来，朝米瑟拉克斯依然笨拙抓着的有盖餐盘点了点头。

“我希望这回不是茄子了，”他说。

米瑟拉克斯被他的乙太呛了一下。“茄子最有营养了，”他轻声抗议道，而圣人则发出了一阵呻吟。

950963812.name: Tusked Allegiance Bond
950963812.subtitle: "I do not sit and theologize my enemies. I crush them." —Empress Caiatl
950963812.subtitle_zh: “我不会干坐着思辨我的敌人。我会把他们碾碎。”——查厄托女帝
950963812.text:
The huddled Guardians fell into shocked silence as Commander Zavala's silhouette loomed over the table.

A hooded figure sat, suddenly enveloped by the shadow, and leaned backward until his head bumped against Zavala's chestplate. He tilted his chin up and craned his neck to fix Zavala with an upside-down smile. 

His hood fell back. "What's with the face, Big Blue?" Drifter said. "Somebody's gotta teach 'em how to play offense."

"Get this out of my Tower." There was iron in the Titan's voice. 

An old fear split Drifter's face. He leaned forward, swept the contents of the table into his knapsack—tangled cables, a red lens, shards of bone, a green eye spinning madly in a jar of thick fluid—and left without a word.
950963812.text_zh:
当指挥官萨瓦拉的轮廓在桌子上显现时，凑作一团的守护者们陷入了震惊的沉默中。

一个戴着兜帽的人坐在那里，忽然被人影盖住。他向后仰了仰，头抵到了萨瓦拉的胸甲上。他仰起头，伸长脖子，盯着萨瓦拉那张倒映的脸庞，笑了。

他的兜帽向后滑了下去。“你的脸怎么了，蓝色大块头？”浪客说。“总得有人教他们怎么进攻吧。”

“把这些玩意儿从我的高塔里弄出去。”这位泰坦的语气颇为强硬。

旧日的恐惧撕裂了浪客的脸。他倾身向前，把桌上的东西都扫进背包里——一堆乱糟糟的电缆，一个红透镜，几块骨头，一只在浓稠的液体里疯狂地旋转着的绿眼睛——一言不发就走了。

849255710.name: Tusked Allegiance Hood
849255710.subtitle: "They have succeeded, somehow. But they will succeed no longer." —Empress Caiatl
849255710.subtitle_zh: “他们不知怎的取得了成功。但那不会再发生了。”——查厄托女帝
849255710.text:
AGAIN.

Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, felt flame surge through his body as he was resurrected. 

He became aware of many things at once: the altar beneath him. The roaring of Acolytes. The powerful grip on his shoulders, which even now began to crack under the pressure. 

Above him, a trio of Wizards held his Ghost tight, its bleached shell ensnared by ebony tendrils of controlling spellcraft. It pulled against the bonds but could do nothing but look down at him helplessly.

SING OF HER LIES. SPEAK OF HER TRUTHS.

The voice was everywhere. As Sok'tol strained to sit up, something slammed him down, pounding his chitinous skull into the stone again and again. He screeched as the bony frill surrounding his face splintered and snapped loose. He felt his jaw dislodge, felt his own teeth crush against his face, felt himself crack and shatter.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.

As his shell knit and restored soulfire flowed anew, Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, shuddered awake. 

The Acolytes roared again. They crowded the altar, surrounded by a haze of green. Sok'tol peered upward at the Ogre pinning him against the altar. 

It tightened its grip on his shoulders, claws crackling with wrathful energy. It shook its massive head, crowned in an emerald corona, and bellowed in a voice that was not its own:

YOUR STRENGTH BECOMES MINE. AS WILL HERS. SPEAK.

Sok'tol concentrated the Light in his armored hand and began to form a grenade, but the shrieking Acolytes reached forward and tore his fingers apart in their claws. 

Sok'tol bared his teeth and hissed up at the Ogre, whose eyes rolled with fury as a blast of soulfire erupted from its mouth. Sok'tol opened his jaws to howl as he was obliterated.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.
849255710.text_zh:
周而复始。

索克托尔，光能五世，在复活时感到火焰在他的身体里涌动。

他一下子意识到了许多事情：他脚下的祭坛。仆从们的咆哮。他感到有一股强大的力量在钳着他：他的肩膀本身甚至开始在重压之下劈啪作响。

在他上方，三名巫师紧紧抓住他的机灵，它那褪色的外壳陷入控制法术的乌木触须之中。它拉扯着束缚，但除了无可奈何地低头看着他，什么也做不了。

歌唱她的谎言。道出她的真相。

这声音如影随形。就在索克托尔挣扎着要坐起来的时候，有什么东西把他砸了下去，他那壳质的头骨一次又一次地撞到石头上。他尖叫着，脸周围的骨质褶边崩裂开来，啪的一声脱落了。他觉得自己的下巴掉了下来，觉得自己的牙齿压在脸上，觉得自己裂开了，粉碎了。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

当他的机壳缝合并重新燃起灵魂之火时，索克托尔，光能五世，颤抖着醒来了。

仆从们再次咆哮起来。它们挤在圣坛上，周围是一片绿色的薄雾。索克托尔抬头望着那个把他钉在祭坛上的虫瘤。

它紧紧抓着他的肩膀，怒不可遏的爪子噼啪作响。它摇晃着巨大的脑袋，戴着翡翠色的皇冠，用不属于它自己的声音吼叫：

你的力量化作了我的力量。她的也会如此。说话。

索克托尔把光能集中在他那穿着护甲的手上，开始形成一个手雷，但尖叫的仆从们向前伸出爪子撕裂了他的手指。

索克托尔龇着牙，向虫瘤发出嘶嘶声。随着一股灵魂之火从嘴里喷发出来，虫瘤那满是怒意的双眼在滴溜溜地打转。索克托尔在行将湮灭之际，张开了下颚嚎叫。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

693728753.name: Tusked Allegiance Boots
693728753.subtitle: "We stand with the Vanguard. No outside force will break what we have wrought." —Empress Caiatl
693728753.subtitle_zh: “我们与先锋并肩作战。任何外来势力都不能破坏我们的联盟。”——查厄托女帝
693728753.text:
Bask materialized near a low wall and zipped to where Jolur had collapsed. The Ghost began to focus his Light when incoming fire sent him spinning to the ground.

"What did I tell you about dying in the open?" the little Ghost cried in frustration. Determined, he rose into the air, but the Hive Knight was already charging across the Trostland cobblestones.

A sudden explosion of Void energy took the Knight by surprise, but it dodged the pulsing shockwaves of a Vortex Grenade. A tall Warlock in a worn green robe loped from the treeline and slid to a stop before Bask. She hastily formed a ball of Light in her palm and slammed it into the ground. Delicate wisps of energy began to rise from the soil.

"That's not gonna help!" Bask whirred angrily.

The Warlock stood, sheltering Bask with her body as he resumed his focus on Jolur. The Knight screeched and resumed fire. A volley of Shredder bolts doubled the Warlock over, but the energy seeping from the rift gave her the strength to keep standing. 

"Thanks," said Bask sheepishly.

"Don't mention it," she said, gritting her teeth through the gunfire. 

A blinding burst of energy surged as Jolur rose to his feet, body shimmering with Light. He braced himself and lobbed an orb of unstable energy that reduced the Knight to howling ash on impact. 

"Appreciate the assist," Jolur said to Bask and the Warlock as he brushed dirt from his decrepit boots. "These guys are stronger than I thought, but it's nothing a Nova Bomb can't handle."

The Warlock inspected the damage to her robe. "What's going on with these Hive?"

"I don't know," Jolur said. "Lord Saladin sent a group of us down to figure out—"

Another blinding burst of energy surged nearby. The Knight rose to its feet, body shimmering with Light. 

The Guardians stood frozen in horror. 

"Since when can they do that?" Bask squeaked, and the fight began in earnest.
693728753.text_zh:
巴斯克出现在一堵矮墙附近，然后迅速移动到了乔鲁倒下的地方。这个机灵已开始聚焦光能，但却被来袭的炮火击倒在地。

“我不是说过别死在开阔的地方吗？”小机灵沮丧地叫道。他下定决心，向空中飞去，但邪魔族骑士已踩着慰藉之地的鹅卵石冲了过来。

虚空能量的突然爆发把骑士打了个措手不及，但它还是躲开了涡流手雷的脉冲冲击波。一个身穿破旧绿袍的高个术士从树林里大步跑出来，滑停到巴斯克面前。她匆忙在手掌上形成一个光球，把它砸到地上。微妙的缕缕能量开始从土壤中升起。

“那根本没用！”巴斯克愤怒地喊道。

术士站了起来，用她的身体护住巴斯克，把注意力集中在了乔鲁身上。骑士尖叫了一声，继续开火。一连串的粉碎者飞弹把术士的身子都压弯了，但裂痕中渗出的能量给了她继续站立的力量。

“谢谢，”巴斯克羞怯地说。

“别客气，”她强顶着枪林弹雨答道。

乔鲁站起来时，身体闪着光能，迸发出了一阵眩目的能量。他振作起来，并抛出了一个不稳定的能量球。骑士受到冲击后嚎叫着化为了一堆灰烬。

“多谢帮忙，”乔鲁一边擦洗破旧战靴上的污垢，一边对巴斯克和术士道谢。“这些家伙比我想象的还要强大，但没有什么是新星炸弹解决不了的。”

术士检查着她受损的袍子。“这些邪魔族到底是怎么回事？”

“我不知道，”乔鲁说道。“领主萨拉丁派了我们一群人去调查——”

附近迸发出了另一股眩目的能量。那骑士又站了起来，全身上下闪烁着光能。

守护者们被惊得僵立在原地。

“他们什么时候开始能做到这个了？”巴斯克尖叫了一声，战斗再次打响。

187431790.name: Tusked Allegiance Gauntlets
187431790.subtitle: "If this is a test, we shall not fail." —Lord Saladin
187431790.subtitle_zh: “如果这是场考验，那我们绝不会失败。”——领主萨拉丁
187431790.text:
Crow was already reloading when the strange Hive's lifeless body crashed to the forest floor.

Glint flew toward the corpse without a word. Crow pretended not to notice and kept walking through the woods. He's been in a mood all day, Glint thought with a static sigh. He could use some time alone.

When he reached the Hive, Glint resisted the absurd reflex to scan it for compatibility. Instead, he simply assessed, noting the strong arms that could handle the recoil from heavy weapons; the thick shell, built to absorb all manner of firepower; the remains of a bony shield that sizzled nearby, powerful enough to protect—

The space next to Glint fluctuated as a bone-white Hive Ghost appeared. 

The two froze warily in midair.

"Hey," the Hive Ghost whispered after a moment. "It's okay." Its voice was surprisingly soft. 

Its green eye flickered reassuringly and it began to focus Light.

Glint bobbed unsteadily. Crow was fifty yards off, moving carefully through the trees. "You shouldn't—"

"It'll be all right," it said and hovered lower to the ground, pouring Light into the fallen Hive. The surrounding ferns trembled with the sudden flow of energy.

"Wait," Glint pressed. But the Ghost ignored him as the thick armor of the Hive began to reform. 

"Crow!" Glint screamed, "Crow, here!" And he flew to him without turning back.
187431790.text_zh:
当这具怪异的邪魔族尸体坠落到森林地面时，乌鸦已经在填装弹药了。

格林特一言不发地飞向尸体。乌鸦假装没注意到，继续穿过树林。他一整天都情绪不佳，格林特边想边轻轻叹了口气。他需要一些独处的时间。

当他找到那个邪魔族时，格林特忍住了想要扫描其兼容性的荒唐反射。他只是简单地评估了一下眼前的邪魔族：他注意到那些强壮的手臂可以承受重型武器的后坐力；厚厚的机壳，可以吸收各种形式的火力；一个骨质盾牌的残骸在附近嘶嘶作响，强大到足以保护——

格林特身旁的空间出现了波动，一个骨白色的邪魔族机灵随即现身。

两个机灵警惕地愣在半空中。

“嘿，”过了一会儿，邪魔族机灵轻声说。“没事的。”它的声音出奇地柔和。

它安慰地眨了眨绿色的眼睛，开始聚焦光能。

格林特晃悠悠地上下浮动着。乌鸦在五十码开外，小心翼翼地穿过树林。“你不该——”

“不会有事的，”它边说着，边降低着自己的悬停高度，把光能灌注进了倒下的邪魔族。周围的蕨类植物伴随着忽如其来的能量流动而颤动。

“等等，”格林特急促地说道。但那个机灵没有理会他。邪魔族厚重的盔甲已开始重构。

“乌鸦！”格林特尖叫道，“乌鸦，这边！”他头也不回地朝着乌鸦飞去。

438108034.name: Tusked Allegiance Plate
438108034.subtitle: "I believed not that the Light was good, but that there is goodness in those who defend it. I still do." —Lord Saladin
438108034.subtitle_zh: “我并不相信光能即是善，但我相信保卫它的人心中有善。我坚信不疑。”——领主萨拉丁
438108034.text:
Mithrax delicately pushed the low curtain aside as he entered the bedroom.

Tall shelves crowded him, cluttered with relics from Mercury and beyond: piles of intricate scrolls, silver hourglasses that turned of their own accord, ceramic pots of red soil sprouting delicate metallic vines beneath glass domes. An enormous feathered mantle was mounted carefully on a wooden stand and crowned with a birdlike cowl.

The hulking form of Saint-14 sat in a wooden chair facing the bed where, impossibly small beneath the blankets, rested the man known as Osiris.

Mithrax rapped politely on the doorframe.

"My friend," Saint-14 said. "It is good of you to come."

Mithrax approached Saint and bowed. "It is an honor to be invited," he said. "These visits are pleasant to me." 

He held out the covered dish he was carrying in his lower arms, but Saint's eyes remained fixed on Osiris. 

The Titan took a ragged breath. His voice was a hoarse whisper: "Could the Psion machine… connect my mind with his? So that I might share his dreams?"

Mithrax felt useless. He spoke softly: "The Psion tells me the subject must have residual activity for a reading, and Osiris has been asleep very long. Besides, the connection you seek joins the Light of one being to the Light of another, and Osiris is—"

"Lightless, yes," Saint finished flatly. He leaned forward in his chair, his elbows on his knees, hands clasped before him. He was silent for some time.

"I will let him sleep alone," Saint finally said, and caressed Osiris's hand with impossible tenderness. "When he wakes, we will dream together once more."

He adjusted the blankets, stood, and nodded toward the covered dish Mithrax still clutched awkwardly.

"I am hoping that is not more eggplant," he said.

Mithrax coughed on his Ether. "The eggplant is most nourishing," he protested weakly, and Saint groaned.
438108034.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯进入卧室时，小心翼翼地把低矮的帘子推到一边。

房间里摆满了高大的架子，来自水星和其他地方的圣物杂乱无章地堆积其上：成堆的复杂卷轴、自动转动的银色沙漏、玻璃穹顶下长出精致金属藤蔓的红土陶罐。一件巨大的羽毛披风被小心地挂在木架上，其顶部有一个鸟状的风帽。

圣人14号庞大的身躯坐落在一张面对着床的木椅上。床上躺着的是一个被称作奥斯里斯的人；毯子下的他显得格外娇小。

米瑟拉克斯礼貌地敲了敲门框。

“我的朋友，”圣人14号说。“你能来真是太好了。”

米瑟拉克斯走到圣人跟前，鞠了一躬。“能受到邀请是我的荣幸，”他说。“造访别人让我感到愉快。”

他伸出端着餐食的下臂，但圣人仍然目不转睛地盯着奥斯里斯。

泰坦喘了一口粗气，用沙哑的声音低语道：“灵能机器能不能…把我的思想和他的联系起来？让我分享他的梦境？”

米瑟拉克斯感到无能为力。他轻声开口道：“灵能士兵告诉我，受试对象必须具有可读取的残留活性，而奥斯里斯已经沉睡很久了。而且，你所寻求的连接需要将一个生命的光能与另一个生命的光能连接起来，而奥斯里斯已经——”

“失去光能了，没错，”圣人平静地接了对方的话。他坐在椅子上向前倾，手肘放在膝盖上，双手紧握在面前。他沉默了好一阵子。

“我会让他独自沉睡，”圣人最后说道，无比温柔地抚摸着奥斯里斯的手。“等他醒来后，我们会再次同享梦境。”

他整理了一下毛毯，站了起来，朝米瑟拉克斯依然笨拙抓着的有盖餐盘点了点头。

“我希望这回不是茄子了，”他说。

米瑟拉克斯被他的乙太呛了一下。“茄子最有营养了，”他轻声抗议道，而圣人则发出了一阵呻吟。

3957071315.name: Tusked Allegiance Mark
3957071315.subtitle: "We are what we survive. They will not be the Guardians." —Lord Saladin
3957071315.subtitle_zh: “只要生存下来，我们就会如同敌人一般强大。他们绝不会成为守护者。”——领主萨拉丁
3957071315.text:
The huddled Guardians fell into shocked silence as Commander Zavala's silhouette loomed over the table.

A hooded figure sat, suddenly enveloped by the shadow, and leaned backward until his head bumped against Zavala's chestplate. He tilted his chin up and craned his neck to fix Zavala with an upside-down smile. 

His hood fell back. "What's with the face, Big Blue?" Drifter said. "Somebody's gotta teach 'em how to play offense."

"Get this out of my Tower." There was iron in the Titan's voice. 

An old fear split Drifter's face. He leaned forward, swept the contents of the table into his knapsack—tangled cables, a red lens, shards of bone, a green eye spinning madly in a jar of thick fluid—and left without a word.
3957071315.text_zh:
当指挥官萨瓦拉的轮廓在桌子上显现时，凑作一团的守护者们陷入了震惊的沉默中。

一个戴着兜帽的人坐在那里，忽然被人影盖住。他向后仰了仰，头抵到了萨瓦拉的胸甲上。他仰起头，伸长脖子，盯着萨瓦拉那张倒映的脸庞，笑了。

他的兜帽向后滑了下去。“你的脸怎么了，蓝色大块头？”浪客说。“总得有人教他们怎么进攻吧。”

“把这些玩意儿从我的高塔里弄出去。”这位泰坦的语气颇为强硬。

旧日的恐惧撕裂了浪客的脸。他倾身向前，把桌上的东西都扫进背包里——一堆乱糟糟的电缆，一个红透镜，几块骨头，一只在浓稠的液体里疯狂地旋转着的绿眼睛——一言不发就走了。

2240729575.name: Tusked Allegiance Helmet
2240729575.subtitle: "They are an insult, a stain that's our duty to wash away." —Lord Saladin
2240729575.subtitle_zh: “他们的存在是对我们的侮辱和玷污，将其抹除掉是我们的职责。”——领主萨拉丁
2240729575.text:
AGAIN.

Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, felt flame surge through his body as he was resurrected. 

He became aware of many things at once: the altar beneath him. The roaring of Acolytes. The powerful grip on his shoulders, which even now began to crack under the pressure. 

Above him, a trio of Wizards held his Ghost tight, its bleached shell ensnared by ebony tendrils of controlling spellcraft. It pulled against the bonds but could do nothing but look down at him helplessly.

SING OF HER LIES. SPEAK OF HER TRUTHS.

The voice was everywhere. As Sok'tol strained to sit up, something slammed him down, pounding his chitinous skull into the stone again and again. He screeched as the bony frill surrounding his face splintered and snapped loose. He felt his jaw dislodge, felt his own teeth crush against his face, felt himself crack and shatter.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.

As his shell knit and restored soulfire flowed anew, Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, shuddered awake. 

The Acolytes roared again. They crowded the altar, surrounded by a haze of green. Sok'tol peered upward at the Ogre pinning him against the altar. 

It tightened its grip on his shoulders, claws crackling with wrathful energy. It shook its massive head, crowned in an emerald corona, and bellowed in a voice that was not its own:

YOUR STRENGTH BECOMES MINE. AS WILL HERS. SPEAK.

Sok'tol concentrated the Light in his armored hand and began to form a grenade, but the shrieking Acolytes reached forward and tore his fingers apart in their claws. 

Sok'tol bared his teeth and hissed up at the Ogre, whose eyes rolled with fury as a blast of soulfire erupted from its mouth. Sok'tol opened his jaws to howl as he was obliterated.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.
2240729575.text_zh:
周而复始。

索克托尔，光能五世，在复活时感到火焰在他的身体里涌动。

他一下子意识到了许多事情：他脚下的祭坛。仆从们的咆哮。他感到有一股强大的力量在钳着他：他的肩膀本身甚至开始在重压之下劈啪作响。

在他上方，三名巫师紧紧抓住他的机灵，它那褪色的外壳陷入控制法术的乌木触须之中。它拉扯着束缚，但除了无可奈何地低头看着他，什么也做不了。

歌唱她的谎言。道出她的真相。

这声音如影随形。就在索克托尔挣扎着要坐起来的时候，有什么东西把他砸了下去，他那壳质的头骨一次又一次地撞到石头上。他尖叫着，脸周围的骨质褶边崩裂开来，啪的一声脱落了。他觉得自己的下巴掉了下来，觉得自己的牙齿压在脸上，觉得自己裂开了，粉碎了。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

当他的机壳缝合并重新燃起灵魂之火时，索克托尔，光能五世，颤抖着醒来了。

仆从们再次咆哮起来。它们挤在圣坛上，周围是一片绿色的薄雾。索克托尔抬头望着那个把他钉在祭坛上的虫瘤。

它紧紧抓着他的肩膀，怒不可遏的爪子噼啪作响。它摇晃着巨大的脑袋，戴着翡翠色的皇冠，用不属于它自己的声音吼叫：

你的力量化作了我的力量。她的也会如此。说话。

索克托尔把光能集中在他那穿着护甲的手上，开始形成一个手雷，但尖叫的仆从们向前伸出爪子撕裂了他的手指。

索克托尔龇着牙，向虫瘤发出嘶嘶声。随着一股灵魂之火从嘴里喷发出来，虫瘤那满是怒意的双眼在滴溜溜地打转。索克托尔在行将湮灭之际，张开了下颚嚎叫。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

2270509928.name: Tusked Allegiance Greaves
2270509928.subtitle: "Meet them head-on. Let us see whose Light burns more brightly." —Lord Saladin
2270509928.subtitle_zh: “与他们正面一决高下。让我们看看谁的光能燃烧得更加旺盛。”——领主萨拉丁
2270509928.text:
Bask materialized near a low wall and zipped to where Jolur had collapsed. The Ghost began to focus his Light when incoming fire sent him spinning to the ground.

"What did I tell you about dying in the open?" the little Ghost cried in frustration. Determined, he rose into the air, but the Hive Knight was already charging across the Trostland cobblestones.

A sudden explosion of Void energy took the Knight by surprise, but it dodged the pulsing shockwaves of a Vortex Grenade. A tall Warlock in a worn green robe loped from the treeline and slid to a stop before Bask. She hastily formed a ball of Light in her palm and slammed it into the ground. Delicate wisps of energy began to rise from the soil.

"That's not gonna help!" Bask whirred angrily.

The Warlock stood, sheltering Bask with her body as he resumed his focus on Jolur. The Knight screeched and resumed fire. A volley of Shredder bolts doubled the Warlock over, but the energy seeping from the rift gave her the strength to keep standing. 

"Thanks," said Bask sheepishly.

"Don't mention it," she said, gritting her teeth through the gunfire. 

A blinding burst of energy surged as Jolur rose to his feet, body shimmering with Light. He braced himself and lobbed an orb of unstable energy that reduced the Knight to howling ash on impact. 

"Appreciate the assist," Jolur said to Bask and the Warlock as he brushed dirt from his decrepit boots. "These guys are stronger than I thought, but it's nothing a Nova Bomb can't handle."

The Warlock inspected the damage to her robe. "What's going on with these Hive?"

"I don't know," Jolur said. "Lord Saladin sent a group of us down to figure out—"

Another blinding burst of energy surged nearby. The Knight rose to its feet, body shimmering with Light. 

The Guardians stood frozen in horror. 

"Since when can they do that?" Bask squeaked, and the fight began in earnest.

4017738218.name: Tusked Allegiance Grips
4017738218.subtitle: "I don't think any of us will be the same when this is over." —Crow
4017738218.subtitle_zh: “等这场风波结束后，我想没有谁还会和从前一样。”——乌鸦

4017738218.text_zh:
当这具怪异的邪魔族尸体坠落到森林地面时，乌鸦已经在填装弹药了。

格林特一言不发地飞向尸体。乌鸦假装没注意到，继续穿过树林。他一整天都情绪不佳，格林特边想边轻轻叹了口气。他需要一些独处的时间。

当他找到那个邪魔族时，格林特忍住了想要扫描其兼容性的荒唐反射。他只是简单地评估了一下眼前的邪魔族：他注意到那些强壮的手臂可以承受重型武器的后坐力；厚厚的机壳，可以吸收各种形式的火力；一个骨质盾牌的残骸在附近嘶嘶作响，强大到足以保护——

格林特身旁的空间出现了波动，一个骨白色的邪魔族机灵随即现身。

两个机灵警惕地愣在半空中。

“嘿，”过了一会儿，邪魔族机灵轻声说。“没事的。”它的声音出奇地柔和。

它安慰地眨了眨绿色的眼睛，开始聚焦光能。

格林特晃悠悠地上下浮动着。乌鸦在五十码开外，小心翼翼地穿过树林。“你不该——”

“不会有事的，”它边说着，边降低着自己的悬停高度，把光能灌注进了倒下的邪魔族。周围的蕨类植物伴随着忽如其来的能量流动而颤动。

“等等，”格林特急促地说道。但那个机灵没有理会他。邪魔族厚重的盔甲已开始重构。

“乌鸦！”格林特尖叫道，“乌鸦，这边！”他头也不回地朝着乌鸦飞去。

4144240158.name: Tusked Allegiance Vest
4144240158.subtitle: "If they're truly worthy, if it's something they deserve, let them prove it." —Crow
4144240158.subtitle_zh: “如果他们真有资格，真配得上光能，就让他们证明一下吧。”——乌鸦
4144240158.text:
Mithrax delicately pushed the low curtain aside as he entered the bedroom.

Tall shelves crowded him, cluttered with relics from Mercury and beyond: piles of intricate scrolls, silver hourglasses that turned of their own accord, ceramic pots of red soil sprouting delicate metallic vines beneath glass domes. An enormous feathered mantle was mounted carefully on a wooden stand and crowned with a birdlike cowl.

The hulking form of Saint-14 sat in a wooden chair facing the bed where, impossibly small beneath the blankets, rested the man known as Osiris.

Mithrax rapped politely on the doorframe.

"My friend," Saint-14 said. "It is good of you to come."

Mithrax approached Saint and bowed. "It is an honor to be invited," he said. "These visits are pleasant to me." 

He held out the covered dish he was carrying in his lower arms, but Saint's eyes remained fixed on Osiris. 

The Titan took a ragged breath. His voice was a hoarse whisper: "Could the Psion machine… connect my mind with his? So that I might share his dreams?"

Mithrax felt useless. He spoke softly: "The Psion tells me the subject must have residual activity for a reading, and Osiris has been asleep very long. Besides, the connection you seek joins the Light of one being to the Light of another, and Osiris is—"

"Lightless, yes," Saint finished flatly. He leaned forward in his chair, his elbows on his knees, hands clasped before him. He was silent for some time.

"I will let him sleep alone," Saint finally said, and caressed Osiris's hand with impossible tenderness. "When he wakes, we will dream together once more."

He adjusted the blankets, stood, and nodded toward the covered dish Mithrax still clutched awkwardly.

"I am hoping that is not more eggplant," he said.

Mithrax coughed on his Ether. "The eggplant is most nourishing," he protested weakly, and Saint groaned.
4144240158.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯进入卧室时，小心翼翼地把低矮的帘子推到一边。

房间里摆满了高大的架子，来自水星和其他地方的圣物杂乱无章地堆积其上：成堆的复杂卷轴、自动转动的银色沙漏、玻璃穹顶下长出精致金属藤蔓的红土陶罐。一件巨大的羽毛披风被小心地挂在木架上，其顶部有一个鸟状的风帽。

圣人14号庞大的身躯坐落在一张面对着床的木椅上。床上躺着的是一个被称作奥斯里斯的人；毯子下的他显得格外娇小。

米瑟拉克斯礼貌地敲了敲门框。

“我的朋友，”圣人14号说。“你能来真是太好了。”

米瑟拉克斯走到圣人跟前，鞠了一躬。“能受到邀请是我的荣幸，”他说。“造访别人让我感到愉快。”

他伸出端着餐食的下臂，但圣人仍然目不转睛地盯着奥斯里斯。

泰坦喘了一口粗气，用沙哑的声音低语道：“灵能机器能不能…把我的思想和他的联系起来？让我分享他的梦境？”

米瑟拉克斯感到无能为力。他轻声开口道：“灵能士兵告诉我，受试对象必须具有可读取的残留活性，而奥斯里斯已经沉睡很久了。而且，你所寻求的连接需要将一个生命的光能与另一个生命的光能连接起来，而奥斯里斯已经——”

“失去光能了，没错，”圣人平静地接了对方的话。他坐在椅子上向前倾，手肘放在膝盖上，双手紧握在面前。他沉默了好一阵子。

“我会让他独自沉睡，”圣人最后说道，无比温柔地抚摸着奥斯里斯的手。“等他醒来后，我们会再次同享梦境。”

他整理了一下毛毯，站了起来，朝米瑟拉克斯依然笨拙抓着的有盖餐盘点了点头。

“我希望这回不是茄子了，”他说。

米瑟拉克斯被他的乙太呛了一下。“茄子最有营养了，”他轻声抗议道，而圣人则发出了一阵呻吟。

3473867303.name: Tusked Allegiance Cloak
3473867303.subtitle: "You'd think I'd understand it better than anyone, right? But I don't understand anything anymore." —Crow
3473867303.subtitle_zh: “你大概以为我比任何人都要明白那种感受？但我已经什么都搞不明白了。”——乌鸦
3473867303.text:
The huddled Guardians fell into shocked silence as Commander Zavala's silhouette loomed over the table.

A hooded figure sat, suddenly enveloped by the shadow, and leaned backward until his head bumped against Zavala's chestplate. He tilted his chin up and craned his neck to fix Zavala with an upside-down smile. 

His hood fell back. "What's with the face, Big Blue?" Drifter said. "Somebody's gotta teach 'em how to play offense."

"Get this out of my Tower." There was iron in the Titan's voice. 

An old fear split Drifter's face. He leaned forward, swept the contents of the table into his knapsack—tangled cables, a red lens, shards of bone, a green eye spinning madly in a jar of thick fluid—and left without a word.
3473867303.text_zh:
当指挥官萨瓦拉的轮廓在桌子上显现时，凑作一团的守护者们陷入了震惊的沉默中。

一个戴着兜帽的人坐在那里，忽然被人影盖住。他向后仰了仰，头抵到了萨瓦拉的胸甲上。他仰起头，伸长脖子，盯着萨瓦拉那张倒映的脸庞，笑了。

他的兜帽向后滑了下去。“你的脸怎么了，蓝色大块头？”浪客说。“总得有人教他们怎么进攻吧。”

“把这些玩意儿从我的高塔里弄出去。”这位泰坦的语气颇为强硬。

旧日的恐惧撕裂了浪客的脸。他倾身向前，把桌上的东西都扫进背包里——一堆乱糟糟的电缆，一个红透镜，几块骨头，一只在浓稠的液体里疯狂地旋转着的绿眼睛——一言不发就走了。

2516879931.name: Tusked Allegiance Mask
2516879931.subtitle: "When I look at them, I see myself staring back." —Crow
2516879931.subtitle_zh: “我望向他们时，会看见我自己的影子。”——乌鸦
2516879931.text:
AGAIN.

Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, felt flame surge through his body as he was resurrected. 

He became aware of many things at once: the altar beneath him. The roaring of Acolytes. The powerful grip on his shoulders, which even now began to crack under the pressure. 

Above him, a trio of Wizards held his Ghost tight, its bleached shell ensnared by ebony tendrils of controlling spellcraft. It pulled against the bonds but could do nothing but look down at him helplessly.

SING OF HER LIES. SPEAK OF HER TRUTHS.

The voice was everywhere. As Sok'tol strained to sit up, something slammed him down, pounding his chitinous skull into the stone again and again. He screeched as the bony frill surrounding his face splintered and snapped loose. He felt his jaw dislodge, felt his own teeth crush against his face, felt himself crack and shatter.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.

As his shell knit and restored soulfire flowed anew, Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, shuddered awake. 

The Acolytes roared again. They crowded the altar, surrounded by a haze of green. Sok'tol peered upward at the Ogre pinning him against the altar. 

It tightened its grip on his shoulders, claws crackling with wrathful energy. It shook its massive head, crowned in an emerald corona, and bellowed in a voice that was not its own:

YOUR STRENGTH BECOMES MINE. AS WILL HERS. SPEAK.

Sok'tol concentrated the Light in his armored hand and began to form a grenade, but the shrieking Acolytes reached forward and tore his fingers apart in their claws. 

Sok'tol bared his teeth and hissed up at the Ogre, whose eyes rolled with fury as a blast of soulfire erupted from its mouth. Sok'tol opened his jaws to howl as he was obliterated.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.
2516879931.text_zh:
周而复始。

索克托尔，光能五世，在复活时感到火焰在他的身体里涌动。

他一下子意识到了许多事情：他脚下的祭坛。仆从们的咆哮。他感到有一股强大的力量在钳着他：他的肩膀本身甚至开始在重压之下劈啪作响。

在他上方，三名巫师紧紧抓住他的机灵，它那褪色的外壳陷入控制法术的乌木触须之中。它拉扯着束缚，但除了无可奈何地低头看着他，什么也做不了。

歌唱她的谎言。道出她的真相。

这声音如影随形。就在索克托尔挣扎着要坐起来的时候，有什么东西把他砸了下去，他那壳质的头骨一次又一次地撞到石头上。他尖叫着，脸周围的骨质褶边崩裂开来，啪的一声脱落了。他觉得自己的下巴掉了下来，觉得自己的牙齿压在脸上，觉得自己裂开了，粉碎了。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

当他的机壳缝合并重新燃起灵魂之火时，索克托尔，光能五世，颤抖着醒来了。

仆从们再次咆哮起来。它们挤在圣坛上，周围是一片绿色的薄雾。索克托尔抬头望着那个把他钉在祭坛上的虫瘤。

它紧紧抓着他的肩膀，怒不可遏的爪子噼啪作响。它摇晃着巨大的脑袋，戴着翡翠色的皇冠，用不属于它自己的声音吼叫：

你的力量化作了我的力量。她的也会如此。说话。

索克托尔把光能集中在他那穿着护甲的手上，开始形成一个手雷，但尖叫的仆从们向前伸出爪子撕裂了他的手指。

索克托尔龇着牙，向虫瘤发出嘶嘶声。随着一股灵魂之火从嘴里喷发出来，虫瘤那满是怒意的双眼在滴溜溜地打转。索克托尔在行将湮灭之际，张开了下颚嚎叫。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

3056950148.name: Tusked Allegiance Strides
3056950148.subtitle: "Glint says to keep moving. That's how you know something's wrong." —Crow
3056950148.subtitle_zh: “格林特说不要停下脚步。我一听就知道是出了岔子。”——乌鸦
3056950148.text:
Bask materialized near a low wall and zipped to where Jolur had collapsed. The Ghost began to focus his Light when incoming fire sent him spinning to the ground.

"What did I tell you about dying in the open?" the little Ghost cried in frustration. Determined, he rose into the air, but the Hive Knight was already charging across the Trostland cobblestones.

A sudden explosion of Void energy took the Knight by surprise, but it dodged the pulsing shockwaves of a Vortex Grenade. A tall Warlock in a worn green robe loped from the treeline and slid to a stop before Bask. She hastily formed a ball of Light in her palm and slammed it into the ground. Delicate wisps of energy began to rise from the soil.

"That's not gonna help!" Bask whirred angrily.

The Warlock stood, sheltering Bask with her body as he resumed his focus on Jolur. The Knight screeched and resumed fire. A volley of Shredder bolts doubled the Warlock over, but the energy seeping from the rift gave her the strength to keep standing. 

"Thanks," said Bask sheepishly.

"Don't mention it," she said, gritting her teeth through the gunfire. 

A blinding burst of energy surged as Jolur rose to his feet, body shimmering with Light. He braced himself and lobbed an orb of unstable energy that reduced the Knight to howling ash on impact. 

"Appreciate the assist," Jolur said to Bask and the Warlock as he brushed dirt from his decrepit boots. "These guys are stronger than I thought, but it's nothing a Nova Bomb can't handle."

The Warlock inspected the damage to her robe. "What's going on with these Hive?"

"I don't know," Jolur said. "Lord Saladin sent a group of us down to figure out—"

Another blinding burst of energy surged nearby. The Knight rose to its feet, body shimmering with Light. 

The Guardians stood frozen in horror. 

"Since when can they do that?" Bask squeaked, and the fight began in earnest.
3056950148.text_zh:
巴斯克出现在一堵矮墙附近，然后迅速移动到了乔鲁倒下的地方。这个机灵已开始聚焦光能，但却被来袭的炮火击倒在地。

“我不是说过别死在开阔的地方吗？”小机灵沮丧地叫道。他下定决心，向空中飞去，但邪魔族骑士已踩着慰藉之地的鹅卵石冲了过来。

虚空能量的突然爆发把骑士打了个措手不及，但它还是躲开了涡流手雷的脉冲冲击波。一个身穿破旧绿袍的高个术士从树林里大步跑出来，滑停到巴斯克面前。她匆忙在手掌上形成一个光球，把它砸到地上。微妙的缕缕能量开始从土壤中升起。

“那根本没用！”巴斯克愤怒地喊道。

术士站了起来，用她的身体护住巴斯克，把注意力集中在了乔鲁身上。骑士尖叫了一声，继续开火。一连串的粉碎者飞弹把术士的身子都压弯了，但裂痕中渗出的能量给了她继续站立的力量。

“谢谢，”巴斯克羞怯地说。

“别客气，”她强顶着枪林弹雨答道。

乔鲁站起来时，身体闪着光能，迸发出了一阵眩目的能量。他振作起来，并抛出了一个不稳定的能量球。骑士受到冲击后嚎叫着化为了一堆灰烬。

“多谢帮忙，”乔鲁一边擦洗破旧战靴上的污垢，一边对巴斯克和术士道谢。“这些家伙比我想象的还要强大，但没有什么是新星炸弹解决不了的。”

术士检查着她受损的袍子。“这些邪魔族到底是怎么回事？”

“我不知道，”乔鲁说道。“领主萨拉丁派了我们一群人去调查——”

附近迸发出了另一股眩目的能量。那骑士又站了起来，全身上下闪烁着光能。

守护者们被惊得僵立在原地。

“他们什么时候开始能做到这个了？”巴斯克尖叫了一声，战斗再次打响。

137898636.name: Nightstalker
137898636.text:
I can't seem to commune with the Void on a full stomach. Gotta be hungry, starving for best effect. I start getting those pangs, and that's when I hear it, almost like a voice whispering through me. When I first learned that lesson, I thought morning jobs would be a dealbreaker, with breakfast being the most important meal of the day and all. Yet here I am, at the crack of dawn, perched on top of a big ol' tree, fantasizing about my next bite. Not terrible as far as stakeouts go, and if you gotta pay off a debt to a scummy scum-lord, then you're lucky to have a place to sit.

I've got eyes on my mark; have for days. This Kell's finally looking nice and cozy, asleep in the open and surrounded by his servants. Thought they're supposed to be the last line of defense, but they haven't noticed me yet. Guess good help is hard to come by.

I'd have taken the shot hours ago, but I'm supposed to shoot a warning first, so he knows what's coming. That way he "goes out knowing who got him." Warlords love sending their little messages, and it's gonna fall on deaf ears if he's asleep. This guy just keeps snoozing. I envy that.

Which reminds me, I've discovered another little trick to getting in good with that yawning mouth of nothing we call the Void: exhaustion. When I start slipping into that twilight, where I'm not sure if I'm awake or dreaming, I can feel the absence. It's close enough to touch. I guess it doesn't matter if it's literal or metaphorical. The Void just likes it when I'm running on empty.

He's stirring now. Time to get this done. I loose a volley into his bed post. The telltale otherworldly sucking sound—poor guy tries to fight it, but he's got no chance. He looks around frantically for the shooter, then recognition hits his face. That's my cue! …Boom, job done. Can't do that on a full stomach.
137898636.text_zh:
吃饱喝足了，我似乎就无法与虚空交流。一定得饿了，饿坏了才会有最好的效果。我开始感到那种疼痛，就在那时我听到了它，几乎就像某个声音在我耳边低语。我第一次学到这点时，还以为早起干活会搞砸买卖，毕竟早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。而我却在破晓时分，栖息在一棵巨大的老树上，幻想着我的下一口猎物。就盯梢而言还不算太糟，要是你要还清一个卑鄙的无良领主的债，那你有个坐的地儿已经很幸运了。

我盯了我的目标好几天了。这名凯尔在露天的环境下入睡，身边被仆人簇拥着，总算露出了惬意自在的神情。我想他们应该是最后一道防线，但他们还没有注意到我。看来好帮手可没那么好找。

我几小时前就该开枪了，但我应该先发出一枪预警，让他知道接下来会发生什么。这样他“丧命的时候就知道是谁了结了他”。战争领主们喜欢传他们的小信息，而要是他睡着就听不到了。这家伙一直在打盹。真羡慕这一点。

这提醒了我，我发现了另一个小技巧，可以让你和那张我们称之为虚空的无边巨口搞好关系：筋疲力尽。我开始进入那种朦胧状态的时候，那种我不确定自己是醒着还是在做梦的状态，我能感觉到那种缺失感。近到好像能触摸到一样。我想不管是字面意思还是象征意义。虚空就是喜欢我被掏空的样子。

他现在在翻身。是时候完成任务了。我朝他的床柱射了一枪。那是一阵明显的异界啜食声——这个可怜的家伙试图反抗，但他毫无胜算。他疯狂地四处寻找射手，然后脸上露出了觉悟的神情。这时就该我动手了！…砰，任务完成。吃饱了可做不到这样。

2146447808.name: Sentinel
2146447808.text:
"I am the wall against which Darkness breaks… I am the wall against which Darkness breaks… I am the wall against which Darkness breaks…"

I repeat these words amongst the rubble. Smoldering heaps, scarred earth; the warriors and their spoils. This is victory. This should be the moment where everything clicks. All I feel is emptiness.

No one thinks of Titans as meditators, but I can think of no better provocation than the comedown after battle. All that I am is tied up in combat. And when it's over, space itself crashes in around me. In the old days, I stayed there, in agony. The urge to escape that feeling would gnaw at me, so I'd find a reason to start something. Anything. Just to watch the sparks fly. Now…  I meditate.

In time, I learned to thrust my enemies into this same anguish. When you aren't prepared for it, the weight of your own insignificance measured against the vastness of the cosmos can be debilitating.

I still must confront the silence after glory; I feel the nature of the Void most keenly in these moments. I have begun, I think, to look forward to them.
2146447808.text_zh:
“我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…”

我在瓦砾之中重复着这些话。闷燃不止的废墟，遍体鳞伤的土地，战士们和他们的战利品。这就是胜利。这本该是一切得偿所愿的时刻。但我只感觉到了空虚。

没人觉得泰坦会冥想，但我想不到比战后失意更好的挑衅了。我所做的一切都是为了战斗。而它结束时，空间就会在我周围崩塌瓦解开来。在过去的日子里，我就这么痛苦不堪地待在那里。想要逃离那种感觉的冲动会折磨着我，这样我就能找借口制造点麻烦。无事生非。只是为了看事态愈演愈烈。如今…我开始了冥想。

久而久之，我学会了让我的敌人也陷入同样的痛苦。在你还没准备好的时候，与浩瀚的宇宙相比自身微不足道的重压只会让人变得虚弱。

我仍然必须面对荣耀过后的沉寂；在这些瞬间，我最深切地感受到了虚空的本质。我想，我已经开始期待它们的到来了。

693166189.name: Voidwalker
693166189.text:
"The space between defines the shape. The rest before the note, the breath before the word, the blank space on the page."  

A chill hit the air, and I looked up from my studies. There was a stillness, an uneasy calm before the storm. An ambush awaited me; of that, I was certain. No time to wonder how my defenses had failed. No time to ponder how they had found my hidden library in the first place. I had only just lifted my eyes from those insightful words on the Void. Now, I'd have to take my first steps upon it and hope I didn't fall right through. 

"Seize her," the lead marauder thundered. Through every window crashed enemies intent on my destruction. Time stretched out before me. With a thought, I was at the center of the fray. A gaping, celestial maw drained the life from them. I found my footing: the power of the Void was manifest, yet this was not its full nature. 

The next instant, reality snapped back into its traditional rhythm. I was alone once more. The intruders didn't even have time to comprehend their fate. I was barely more enlightened than they were, yet I had gleaned one fundamental truth. 

A step upon the Void is a step upon that nothing which can bear the weight.
693166189.text_zh:
“空间定义了形状。定义了音符前的休止，话语前的气口，书页上的空白。”  

一阵寒意袭来，我停下研究，抬起头来。周遭一片寂静，暴风雨来临前那令人不安的平静。一场伏击在等着我；这一点我十分肯定。没时间去琢磨我的防御是怎么被突破的。没时间去思考他们是如何找到我隐秘的图书馆的。我刚刚把目光从那些有关虚空的深刻语句中移开。现在我必须迈出踏入虚空的第一步，希望自己不会踩空。 

“抓住她。”领头的狂暴劫匪吼道。敌人从每一扇窗户闯入，企图毁掉我。时间在我眼前流逝。一念之间我就已处在冲突的中央。一张星界的血盆大口吸干了他们的生命。 我找到了我的立足点：虚空的力量显现了出来，但这并不是它的全部本质。 

下一个瞬间，现实又闪回了它惯有的韵律。我又一次陷入孤寂。入侵者甚至没时间去理解自身的命运。我所领悟的并不比他们多，但我发现了一个基本事实。 

踏在虚空之上，就是踏在可承重的无物之上。

940788946.name: Star Jasmine
940788946.subtitle: The scent emerges as the sun sets, a testimony carried through warm summer nights.
940788946.subtitle_zh: 夕阳西下时，它便会散出香味；它见证了无数的温暖夏夜。
940788946.text:
TYPE: RECOVERED SENSOR LOGS 

PARTIES: Two [2] Human-type, designate Umiña, Osiris. One [1] Ascendant Hive, designate Savathûn. Eighty-one [81] Hive-type, designate unknown. 

ASSOCIATIONS: Light [Umiña]; Darkness, [Savathûn, Hive] 

ENGINES: Offline 

LIFE SUPPORT: Offline 

SENSORS: Nominal 

//AUDIO RECOVERED// 

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS// 

U: Is that… Osiris! Osiris, can you hear me?  

S: Reverence, please, child. He is the first to see this realm. 

U: What did you do to him? 

S: He merely sleeps to dream a better world… one that I awaken to make reality. 

//REBOOTING// 

U: —some kind of fountain? 

S: It is the trough at which gods gorge.  

U: And you're going to feed me to them there? 

S: Nothing so dramatic, Lightbearer. You will be a scent. A texture. An added detail no one would notice, but whose absence would be felt. After all, one cannot cast a shadow without Light. 

U: But… with Osiris's Light… Wait! Are you saying Sagira is gone?! Then he doesn't have— 

//REBOOTING// 

U: —what you're saying is true, then we're on the same side! 

S: No, child. We work to the same ends. Our roads are quite different. 

U: You don't have to do this. 

S: An end must be reached. A journey chosen. We are not all of us burdened by the comforting lie of false sacrifice.  

U: Please— 

S: All I require is to relieve you of that burden.  

//REBOOTING// 

S: The vessel's sensors appear to be recording. Dispose of it.
940788946.text_zh:
类型：回收的感应器日志 

参与者：二[2] 人类，代号Umiña，奥斯里斯。一[1] 邪魔族后裔，代号萨瓦图恩。八十一[81]邪魔族类型，代号未知。 

组织：光能[Umiña]；暗影，[萨瓦图恩，邪魔族] 

引擎：离线 

生命维持：离线 

感应器：运行正常 

//已回收音频// 

//转录如下// 

U：那是…奥斯里斯！奥斯里斯，奥斯里斯，能听见吗？  

S：孩子，请保持尊敬。他还是第一次见到这个位面。 

U：你对他做了什么？ 

S：他只是在睡梦中体验更好的世界…一个我在觉醒后要将其变成现实的世界。 

//正在重启// 

U：——某种喷泉？ 

S：只是神明尽情享受的饲料厂罢了。  

U：而你会将我在那里喂给它们？ 

S：没那么戏剧性，负光者。你会成为一种味道。一种口感。没人会留意，但缺少了也会被注意到的一种辅料。毕竟，没有光哪里会有影子。
