"Your anger is understandable." The Witch Queen pulled Immaru to her embrace once more, and slowly his shivers of rage calmed. "Humans fear death, and you were suckled on their teat. But the Hive know death as the Unseen Sister. It is she who welcomes you home to rest… and who allows you egress when you prove able to take it."

Immaru stared out in silence at the distant flashes of battle. "Sister or not, it's time we push back. We got anything like they got? A Ghost-killer?"

"The Hive uncovered such weapons long ago, but may have found them… distasteful. I suppose we could recover the magics, but surely you and your fellows would see such tactics as an abomination?"

Immaru turned back to face the flashes of rifle fire on the distant shore. "Not anymore."
81505809.text_zh:
泉源的光能在他们下方倾泻而出。从宫殿的塔楼上，伊马鲁看着翻滚的波涛与暗影相遇，新的波浪侵蚀着古老的海岸。从这个高处可以看到枪口的火光，即使看不见战斗人员。

当他看着守护者无端地攻击他们的上维位面时，他气得直发抖，努力记起该怎么说话。“比嗤魅也好不到哪儿去，”他咆哮道。

萨瓦图恩从只有她能听到的甜美音乐声中转过身来，抚摸着她的机灵。“啊，孩子。尽管你很忠诚，但你仍然只看到了他们的行为，看不到把他们拖入这场必然的枷锁。就像邪魔族必须考验一样，人类必须控制——如果行不通，那就攻击。你不能认为这是在针对你；攻击未知事物是他们的天性。”

“我们机灵不是未知的！”伊马鲁挣脱了她的爱抚。“我们和他们生活在一起，拯救了他们。现在他们正在撕裂我们！要我说，真是忘恩负义…”

“你肯定不会相信他们是因为你不听话而惩罚你的吧？”

“不是吗？”他的声音又阴暗又生硬，他停顿了一下，重新集中注意力。"所有人——堕落者、Vex、甚至是邪魔族——他们都知道不该向医者开枪。但显然没有人告诉这些小丑们。”

“你的愤怒是可以理解的。”巫妖女王再次把伊马鲁拉进她的怀抱，慢慢地，他的愤怒平息了。“人类害怕死亡，而你曾被他们的乳液所哺育。但邪魔族把死亡看作久未谋面的姐妹。是她欢迎你回家休息…也是她在你证明有能力的时候，允许你离开。”

伊马鲁默默地凝视着远处战斗的火光。“不管是不是姐妹，是时候反击了。我们有和他们一样的东西吗？机灵杀手？”

“邪魔族很久以前就发现了这些武器，但可能觉得它们…令人反感。我想我们可以重拾魔法，但你和你的伙伴们肯定会认为这种策略是可憎的吧？”

伊马鲁转过身，面向远方海岸上的枪林弹雨。“现在不了。”

81505808.name: Harmonia
81505808.text:
TYPE: SPIME/FIREBIRD/AU.6.31309.B
PARTIES: Two [2] Ghost-type, designate Koro, Harmonia
ASSOCIATIONS: Light; unbonded
//AMBIENT AUDIO LOGS//
//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS//

K: —ou're just being silly.

H: No, I'm serious! Look at this Castilleja! Wouldn't it be wonderful if it kept its blossoms year-round, rain or shine?

K: You want to give the Light… to a plant?

H: There's no rule book. Why can't I give the Light to a plant? Or a pigeon! Ooh, or maybe a dog! You want loyal, get a dog. That's what the Humans say!

K: [UNRECOVERABLE] when you get like this.

H: Look, I just think it's dumb that we're only supposed to give the Light to Humans. And Awoken—I mean, are they even Human? And Exos! Come on, they're full-on machines!

H: All any of them ever do is fight over stuff they want. They want Glimmer. They want glory. They want knowledge. Whatever it is, they climb all over each other trying to get it. I mean, look at what just happened to Cayde-6! He got the Light but then went rushing off alone, chasing fame or fun or whatever it was, and got himself and his Ghost killed in the process! 

K: Ugh, fine. If that's the way you feel, go raise a houseplant instead, then. Go bond with a geranium and sit on a windowsill all day.

H: Nah. I think it'd be cooler to raise a Hive.

K: What?!

H: I mean, not really. It's just… on my mind.

K: You've been reading those ghastly Books of Sorrow everyone's been passing around, haven't you?

H: A little. I just think humanity could learn a lot from them. It's cool how all the Hive have this one singular purpose they all work toward together, you know?

K: Yes, one singular purpose of destroying the universe!

H: No, outlasting the universe. And isn't that kinda what we're doing with our Guar—

//FEED ENDS. SUBJECTS BEYOND RANGE.//
81505808.text_zh:
类型：SPIME/FIREBIRD/AU.6.31309.B
参与方：两 [2] 名机灵，代号库洛、汉莫尼雅
关联：光能；未绑定
//环境音频日志//
//转录如下//

库洛：…你只是在犯蠢。

汉莫尼雅：不，我是认真的！看看这株卡斯特里亚！如果它一年四季，无论晴雨，都能开花，那不是很好吗？

库洛：你想要把光能赐给…一株植物？

汉莫尼雅：这又没什么规定。为什么我不能把光能给植物？或者一只鸽子！哦，也可以是一只狗！你想要忠诚，就去养狗。人类就是这么说的！

库洛：当你变成这样时[无法恢复]

汉莫尼雅：听着，我只是觉得我们只能把光能给人类的做法很愚蠢。而觉醒者——我是说，他们是人类吗？还有Exo！得了吧，他们根本就是机器！

汉莫尼雅：他们只会为了想要的东西争吵。他们想要微光。他们想要荣耀。他们想要知识。不管那是什么，他们会爬到对方身上，试图得到那样东西。我是说，看看刚刚在凯德6号身上发生的事情！他得到了光能，但却独自去追逐名声或乐趣或不管什么东西，然后在这个过程中害得自己和他的机灵都被杀了！ 

库洛：呃，好吧。如果你是这么想的话，就去复活一盆室内植物吧。去和天竺葵建立感情，整天坐在窗台上。

汉莫尼雅：不。我觉得复活一个邪魔族会更酷。

库洛：什么？！

汉莫尼雅：我是说，我不会那样做。我只是…有这个想法。

库洛：你读了大家都在传阅的那些可怕的《忧愁之书》，对吧？

汉莫尼雅：读了一点点。我只是觉得人类可以从他们身上学到很多。所有邪魔族都有一个共同努力实现的目标，这很酷，你知道吗？

库洛：对，那个共同的目标就是毁灭宇宙！

汉莫尼雅：不，比宇宙还要长久。这不正是我们在对我们的守护—

//传输结束。对象超出范围。//

3184726008.name: Jynx
3184726008.text:
An electronic jingle intrudes on the silence deep below—a cheerful electric hymn in a cathedral of bone. Thralls peer in but quickly depart, their curiosity fleeting. Jynx has no time to teach them about music. She needs to concentrate.

Her Acolyte deserves to be perfect.

She pauses her melodic chiming and gives the stray phalanges one last nudge into place. No Ghost needs the entire corpse to bring their partner back, but this body—the body of HER partner—was a sacred canvas. It deserved all the love and consideration as the painting itself. And with every nudged phalange, the anticipation grew more beautiful!

The little Ghost looks at the body, dangling and impaled, its core grotesquely punctuated against one of the gothic spires the Hive so loved. She would've preferred to lay it prone; more ceremonial and appropriate for the sacred moment where life returned to dead flesh. Her Guardian deserves perfection, but fate places many limitations on a tiny, handless orb, and Jynx had long ago learned to make the best of disagreeable circumstance.

She scans the body once again. Everything in its place. "Pygmalion's got nothing on me, babe!" She taps her shell flap against the hollow cheek in what—she knows—will become their shared gesture of affection.

Jynx bobs back, and with only a moment's pause for butterflies in—well, she supposes not her stomach, but somewhere—her shell twists and splits into an orrery of wonder, bathing her Acolyte in Light. That lovingly placed finger moves first, twitching and clutching, and with a horrific noise that lies somewhere between suction and screaming, the former corpse pulls herself free of the spike through her chest.

"You're aliv—"

The Acolyte lashes out ferociously with a twisted limb, knocking Jynx to the floor and condemning her with a gurgling shriek. Brittle claws scrape into the eroded grip of a battered Shredder, and the Acolyte presses it with desperation into her own screaming maw. With a pull of the trigger, she falls limp. Again.

Jynx stares down for some time, her gaze fixated on the painstakingly reconstructed finger now limp against the weapon's trigger. 

She sags, then raises her lens high with a huff. "I can keep this up as long as you can!" 

A metal shell flap affectionately taps the stump of a neck before Jynx begins again, her voice settling once more in a cheerful hum. "Sooner or later, you will be my best friend!"
3184726008.text_zh:
一阵电子铃声闯入了地下深处的寂静，那是骨砌大教堂里的一首欢快的电子赞歌。怨魂们探头探脑，但很快就离开了，他们的好奇心转瞬即逝。金克斯没有时间教他们音乐。她需要集中精力。

她的仆从理应是完美的。

她停下了她那悠扬的鸣叫声，并最后一次将那些零落的指骨推到原位。没有机灵需要整个尸体来让他们的伙伴复活，但这个身体——她伙伴的身体——是一块神圣的画布。它和这幅画本身一样值得所有的爱和体贴。随着指骨的每一次轻推，期待也变得更加美好！

小机灵看着那具尸体，它被悬空刺穿了，核心被怪异地点缀在邪魔族喜爱的那种哥特式尖塔上。她更愿意让它俯卧在地上；对于生命回归到死者肉体的神圣时刻来说，这更有仪式感，也更合适。她的守护者理应是完美的，但命运对这个小小的无手球体施加了很多限制，而金克斯早就学会了如何充分利用不合意的环境。

她又扫描了一次尸体。一切都已就位。“皮格马利翁和我比差远了，宝贝！”她用机壳轻拍着凹陷的脸颊，她知道这将成为他们共同的亲昵举动。

金克斯向后晃了晃，只停了一会儿让那阵紧张的翻腾痉挛在——嗯，她想不是在她的胃里，而是某个地方——她的机壳里扭曲并分裂成一个奇妙的太阳系仪，让她的仆从沐浴在光能之中。那只可爱的手指先动了起来，抽搐并攥紧着，伴随着介于抽吸和尖叫之间的可怕声音，这具前尸体把自己从穿过她胸口的尖刺中拉了出来。

“你活过…”

仆从用扭曲的肢体凶猛地挥舞着，将金克斯打倒在地，发出咯咯的尖叫声谴责她。脆弱的爪子刮到了一个破旧粉碎者的腐蚀手柄上，仆从绝望地把它按进自己尖叫着的大嘴里。随着扳机的拉动，她又一次瘫软了下来。

金克斯低头凝视了一段时间，望着那根精心重构的手指，它现在正无力地抵着武器的扳机。 

她泄了气，然后生气地睁大了眼。“不管你杀死自己多少次，我就会让你复活！” 

再次开始之前，金克斯用金属机壳亲切地拍打着残留的脖子，她的声音再次定格在欢快的哼唱之中。“迟早有一天，你会成为我最好的朋友！”

182633238.name: Untamed
182633238.text:
What have I done?

(NoiseNoiseNoiseNoiseNoiseNoise)

Fear.How.Mothers.Did.Sadness.It.Fathers.Come.Hate.To.Children.This.Sorrow.Forgive.Displeasure.Me.

(Chaos—Lubrae convulses. The sky shatters.)

This was the cost of justice?

(An enclosed cell. Introspection. Subjugation incoming. Life, upended.)

You made me do this. You made me do this. I made me do this. You made me do this.

(Father's face. Mother's face. Empty. Clan, broken. Blood, pouring. Silence, eerie.)

It was them versus us. Then it was us versus them. I ignored who "us" was. I forgot who "them" was.

(Our City. An abyss surrounds. Lubraean-made. Infinite. Or just empty. Divides. Silently conquers.)

Ignorant contentment. Love… I… was… cared for…

(My clan, safety. Dual fire in the sky. Blue light. Salvation. Dark light. Death. Safety, my clan—my family.)

—-And who cares for you now?—-

…There are none left.

—-Do you desire it still?—-

Once. I did once.

—-And you returned it?—-

…

(Our Wildlands. An Abyss separates. Lubraean-made. Infinite. Beautiful.) 

(A father. Him. A son. Me. His arm on my shoulder. Assurances of a collaborative future. A teardown of "us versus them." Love, shown.)

(Guards cross the Abyssal Bridge. Not guards—Stalkers, we call them, salivating after a group of Wanderers, ready to watch them be torn apart.)

(My anger flares. I move to confront the Stalkers. Father's hand holds me back. We lock eyes. His communicate sympathy, pain, regret. He won't let me reach the Wanderers. Their blood spills.) 

(A lesson in inaction. Father wants me to see what he's seen. To feel the powerlessness he's felt. To feel insignificant. To accept the status quo.)

—-You were never capable of returning it.—-

…

(Slaughter. Our eyes meet again. Father's saddened. Apologetic. Afraid. Not of the Stalkers returning across the bridge, but of me. He sees not the same in my eyes. Only confusion. Anger. Anger at everything.)

You have your answer.

—-It's not our answer to have, but yours to embrace.—-

Embrace? Why?

Hello?
182633238.text_zh:
我到底做了什么？

（噪声噪声噪声噪声噪声噪声）

害怕。怎样。母亲。做到。悲伤。它。父亲。来。憎恨。孩子。这种。悲伤。原谅。不快。我。

（混沌——鲁布瑞剧烈地震动。天空四分五裂。）

这就是正义的代价？

（封闭的牢房。反省。镇压即将到来。生活，倒置。）

是你逼我这么做的。是你逼我这么做的。是我逼我这么做的。是你逼我这么做的。

（父亲的脸庞。母亲的脸庞。空洞。氏族，破碎不堪。鲜血，倾注而下。沉默，怪异可怕）。

是他们对抗我们。然后是我们对抗他们。我忽略了“我们”是谁。我忘了“他们”是谁。

（我们的圣城。深渊环伺。鲁布瑞人造成的。无尽。或者只是空洞。界限。默默地征服）。

无知的满足感。爱…我…得到了…照顾…

（我的氏族，安全。天空中的双重火焰。蓝光。救赎。暗光。死亡。安全，我的氏族，我的家人。）

—-那现在谁还在乎你？—-

…一个也没有了。

—-你还渴望吗？—-

曾经。我曾经确实渴望。

—-你还了回去？—-

…

（我们的荒原。深渊分隔开来。鲁布瑞人造成的。无尽。美丽。） 

（一个父亲。他。一个儿子。我。他的手臂搭在我的肩膀上。合作未来的保证。“我们对抗他们”的拆解。爱，表露。）

（守卫穿过深渊大桥。不是守卫，是潜行者，我们这么叫他们的，他们跟在一群漫游者后垂涎三尺，准备看着他们被撕成碎片。）

（我怒不可遏。要去和潜行者对质。父亲的手把我拉住了。我们对视着。他的眼神传达了同情、痛苦和遗憾。他不让我接近漫游者。他们的鲜血喷涌而出。） 

（无为的教训。父亲希望我看到他所看到的东西。感受他所感受到的无能为力。感受那种无足轻重。接受现状。）

—-你根本不可能还回去—-

…

（杀戮。我们的目光又相遇了。父亲伤心透了。道歉。害怕。不是对从桥上回来的潜行者，而是对我。他在我眼里看到的是不一样的东西。只有困惑。愤怒。对一切都感到愤怒。）

你有答案了。

—-这不是我们要拥有的答案，而是你要拥抱的答案。—-

拥抱？为什么？

听得到吗？

182633237.name: Provoked
182633237.text:
—-And what more of this family of yours?—-

They're gone. Dead. All of them. They don't matter anymore.

—-Is that so?—-

What do you even want to know? You want to know more about my father, the Lubraean traitor? Or perhaps my mother, another Lubraean traitor? I should have seen it coming. I could tell you about my clan, and my clan-father and clan-mother. Also Lubraean traitors. They were all City dwellers once, loyalists to The Regime before exiling themselves. Do you see now what I see?

—-We see unfinished business… We see a child seeking validation… We see great loss.—-

(Content. Together. A fire burns bright. Our cavern is alight. We hide within it to keep safe—the hazy sky is outside, and surely there are some without shelter this night. Those who will be torn apart. By the wild. By the Umbral Sun. By those Lubraean guards who call themselves Stalkers, pursuing us on behalf of a brutal regime.) 

(Long ago, there were only Wanderers, surviving a harsh landscape covered with shifting, bloodthirsty flora. Surviving wildlife can flatten themselves until they are practically invisible—perfect at going unnoticed until they've split your skin and organs apart.)

—-And now?—-

(We are divided. Split by a shimmering orb that appeared briefly in our sky, as if having two suns isn't already crowded enough.)

—-What of this shimmering orb?—-

It was before my time. It came. We evolved. It left. Left us with a mess—those who believed in good progress. Those who didn't. 

Those who believed dwelled in the City. Controlled it. Filled it only with the light of the Sapphiric Sun and endless day to keep the horrors of night away, revealing the horrors among us. They pushed progress for the sake of the few while the rest of us took our chances under the alternating suns.

—-And this shimmering orb you now see before you?—-

(There it is. Shining like silver in the sky. Like the stories told.)

Providing hope, then leaving everything to those who desire control but lack commitment and understanding.

—-Look at them now.—-

(Bodies. Limbs. Vaporized remains. A shattered sapphire. Lubrae irreparable. An Umbral sun, still shining darkness.)

…What have I done?

—-What was necessary.—-
182633237.text_zh:
—-那你的这个家庭还有什么呢？—-

他们已经走了。死了。所有的人。他们不再重要了。

—-是这样吗？—-

你到底想知道什么？你想知道更多关于我父亲的事吗，那个鲁布瑞叛徒？或者是我的母亲，另一个鲁布瑞叛徒？我早该料到的。我可以给你讲讲我的氏族，我的氏族父母。也是鲁布瑞的叛徒。他们曾经都是圣城居民，在流亡之前都是政权的忠实拥护者。你现在看到我看到的了吗？

—-我们看到未完成的事业…我们看到一个寻求认可的孩子…我们看到巨大的丧失。—-

（心满意足。大家在一起。火烧得很旺。我们的洞穴火光闪亮。我们躲在里面确保安全——外面是朦胧的天空，今晚肯定有一些人无家可归。那些人将被撕成碎片。被野性撕裂。被本影之日撕裂。被那些自称为潜行者，代表残暴政权追捕我们的鲁布瑞守卫撕裂。） 

（很久以前，这里只有漫游者，他们在满是流动的嗜血菌群的恶劣环境中生存了下来。幸存下来的野生动物会压低身体，直到几乎不被看见——在它们把你的皮肤和器官撕裂开来之前，完全不被注意到。）

—-现在呢？—-

（我们四分五裂，被一个在我们的天空中短暂出现的闪光球体分割开来，仿佛拥有两个太阳还不够拥挤。）

—-那这个闪光的球体怎么样？—-

那是在我出生之前的事。它来了。我们进化了。它离开了。给我们留下了一个烂摊子——那些相信进步的人。还有那些不相信的人。 

那些相信的人就居住在圣城里。控制着它。让它充满蓝宝石般的阳光和无尽的白昼来驱走黑夜的恐怖，揭示出我们内心的恐惧。他们为了少数人的利益而推动进步，而我们其余的人则在交替的太阳底下碰运气。

—-那你现在看到的这个闪光球体呢？—-

（就在那里，像银币一样在天空中闪闪发光。就像故事里讲的那样。）

提供希望，然后把一切交给那些渴望控制但缺乏承诺和理解的人。

—-看看他们现在的样子。—-

（身体。四肢。蒸发的遗体。破碎的蓝宝石。鲁布瑞已经无法挽回。本影之日，仍在暗影中闪耀。）

…我做了什么？

—-必要的事。—-

182633236.name: Endangered
182633236.text:
(We survive. We give back to the land. We help those in need. They come for us anyway.)

(The Regime raids our camp. No logical explanation for those they kill. Clan-mothers. Clan-fathers. Children. They kill us without purpose. A red spattering courtesy of a Stalker spreads across my face. Goodbye, Fhent. Goodbye, clan-uncle.)

(I am covered in red. It's all I see.)

(It spills out of these Stalkers like an endless crimson wave as I face them. Their valuables and instruments become mine. A Glaive of my own. A Sapphiric Converter.) 

(Father is carried off, not killed. Not yet anyway. Not many of us are left. Mother and the others look at me with concern. Not for my injuries, but for those who suffered at my hands.)

—-They disrespected your power.—-

They were weak.

—-And yet you still saved them when you could.—-

(The Stalkers attack us under the Umbral Sun, during a migration. They know how to find us—they know we move at twilight—the space between when the Stalkers hunt and the planet kills.)

(We barely survive. At the safehouse, they dance and sing, not in celebration, but in admiration of their continued existence and in memoriam for those lost. I sit in anger. I hunger for revenge.)

Loss meant little to our kind. It was too rampant.

—-Are you sure it wasn't just you?—-

You know not what you ask.

(I'm a boy. I hold the furry little Yhadt in my hands as it wriggles before pulling it apart. It separates from its skin with ease. What is this worthless, pointless thing?)

Why show me this?

—-This you have already seen… experienced. Surely you can handle it again?—-

(This worthless, pointless thing… it dies so unceremoniously—did it ever matter at all? The children weep for their lost pet, but I feel… powerful. I feel—)

—-You know what you are. You always knew.—-

(Mother and the others look at me with concern. Not for my injuries, but for those who suffered at my hands… and they are right to do so. Tearing their bodies to pieces brought only joy. What… am I?)

I am a monster. I knew it then, I know it now.

—-Not a monster. A savior.—-
182633236.text_zh:
（我们存活了下来。我们回馈土地。我们帮助有需要的人。他们还是会来找我们）。

（政权突袭了我们的营地。不分青红皂白地杀人。氏族母亲。氏族父亲。孩子们。他们无缘无故地杀害我们。有个潜行者把鲜红的血渍溅满了我的脸。再见，芬特。再见，氏族叔叔。）

（我浑身沾满鲜血。这就是我看到的一切。）

（当我面对这些潜行者时，它就像无尽的红色波浪一样从他们身上喷涌而出。他们的贵重物品和仪器变成了我的。属于我自己的一把偃月。蓝宝石转换器。） 

（父亲是被带走的，不是被杀害的。至少还没有。剩下的人不多了。母亲和其他人担心地看着我。不是因为我受的伤，而是因为那些在我手下受苦的人。）

—-他们不尊重你的力量。—-

他们很软弱。

—-但你还是尽力救了他们。—-

（在一次迁徙中，潜行者在本影之日下攻击我们。他们知道如何找到我们——他们知道我们会趁暮色——在潜行者狩猎和星球杀戮之间的一段时间里行动。）

（我们勉强活了下来。在安全屋，他们载歌载舞，不是为了庆祝，而是为了赞美他们还能继续活着，纪念那些失去的人。我坐在那里满腔怒火，渴望复仇。）

丧失对我们来说并不算什么。已经司空见惯了。

—-你确定不是你一个人吗？—-

你不知道你在问什么。

（我是个男孩。我把毛茸茸的小伊哈特捧在手里，它蠕动着，然后我把它扯开。它轻易地就与皮肤分离了。这个毫无价值、毫无意义的东西是什么？）

为什么给我看这个？

—-这个你已经见过…体验过了。你肯定能再面对一次？—-

（这个毫无价值、毫无意义的东西…它死得如此随便——这有什么关系吗？孩子们为他们丢失的宠物哭泣，但我感觉自己…很强大。我感觉…）

—-你知道你是什么。你一直都知道。—-

（妈妈和其他人担心地看着我。不是因为我受的伤，而是因为那些在我手下受苦的人…他们这么做是对的。把他们的身体撕成碎片带来的只有快乐。我…是什么？）

我是一只怪物。我当时就知道，现在也知道。

—-不是怪物。是救世主。—-

182633235.name: Nepotistic
182633235.text:
(Father… it's been a year since you were taken. But we have not been attacked since. I know the Stalkers still watch the clan, but I survive alone these days—ousted for being the only one brave enough to act. A liability, they called me.) 

(We will see what they say when I bring you back. If you still live.)

(Every Umbral Sun, I walk the Abyssal perimeter with the help of the Sapphiric Converter's attunement to our great sun, providing me light in the dark. The Stalkers don't expect me, so they don't see me. And the Glaive, a tool of The Regime, which I have named after you—Rheliksward—makes eviscerating them that much easier.)

(I kill many looking for a sign of you. Wash my hands with their blood in the hopes of your continued existence. I have been lost without your guidance. Unsure of what I am. Who I am. What I am meant to do.)

(And now, as you stand before me draped in the insignias of the very Regime that took you, I am confident that you have no answers.)

(As you call your fellow Stalkers to overwhelm me, to bind me, to carry me into the dense, unending city of Lubrae, I am confident that you are a coward.)

(As you testify at my trial that I should not be put to death for what The Regime claims are immeasurable crimes, but should instead serve alongside the Stalkers—alongside you, killing Wanderers, annihilating clans—I am confident you are an opportunist.)

(What about Mother? Our clan? What about "down with The Regime"? What about biding our time? Or is this another lesson in inaction—in sparing ourselves from the absolute worst so that we can barely live? Barely survive?)

(I am confident, Father—you will die by my hand.)
182633235.text_zh:
（父亲…你被带走已经一年了。但从那以后，我们就再没有遭到攻击。我知道潜行者们还在监视氏族，但这些天我都在独自求生：作为唯一一个敢于行动的人而遭到了驱逐。他们说我是个累赘。） 

（等我把你带回来，看看他们会说些什么。如果你还活着的话。）

（我在蓝宝石转换器与我们伟大太阳协同的帮助下，行走在深渊的周界，每一个本影之日都为我在黑暗中提供光明。潜行者没料到我会出现在这，所以他们没看到我。而偃月，政权的一种工具，我用你的名字把它命名为——雷里克斯卫士——让活剥他们变得更加容易。）

（我杀了许多人，只为找到你的踪迹。抱着你还存活的希望，用他们的血清洗我的双手。没有你的指引，我迷失了方向。不确定我是什么。我是谁。我注定要做的事。）

（现在，当你站在我面前，身上挂着带走你的那个政权的徽章时，我确信你也没有答案。）

（当你召唤你的潜行者同伴来制服我，捆绑我，把我带进稠密无边的鲁布瑞圣城时，我确信你是个懦夫。）

（当你在我的审判中作证说我不应该因为政权声称的“不可估量的罪行”被处死，而是应该和潜行者一起并肩作战——与你一起携手杀死漫游者，消灭氏族时——我确信你是个机会主义者。）

（那母亲呢？我们的氏族呢？“打倒政权”呢？韬光养晦呢？还是说这又是一个无为的教训——让我们免于遭受最糟糕的后果，这样我们才能勉强活着？勉强生存？）

（我确信，父亲——你会死在我手里。）

182633234.name: Defiant
182633234.text:
—-The Regime took all that mattered to you… and yet, you blamed your father?—-

The Regime never lied about who they were. They were brutal, yes. But honest.

—-Honesty meant something to you?—-

It meant everything.

—-Interesting. And so, in the face of your father, the hypocrite, you leaned on The Regime that enslaved you both instead. That killed so many of your kind.—-

The Regime did not enslave me. It freed me.

(The Regime puts the Glaive back in my hand, the one I named in honor of you. I have renamed it—Rheliksbane—and no matter how you try to hide it, this scares you. Just as I knew it would.)

(I'd be lying if I said I didn't take pleasure in this. But I do. Just as I take pleasure in the constant Sapphiric light. And the roof over my head. The consistency in regular meals. The Regime lives well, comfortable.) 

(The city may be overcrowded. The laws may be strict. The few may have all of the power. But at least we're not out there trying fruitlessly to survive. At least we're not out there scared, cold and alone, wondering if we'll live to see the next rise of either sun.)

(But most importantly, Father—nobody denies me my thirst. My lust for blood. They encourage it. Feed it. And they have begun to show me truths. About the Wanderers. About what the glimmering orb encouraged.)

(You always claimed the hands of The Regime were stained red, but you never showed me yours—until now.)

(How dare you stand before me now and confess your disloyalty to The Regime. How dare you lie to me again.)

(You may have overwhelmed me this time. Escaped my grasp. But I am coming for you. I will end this.)
182633234.text_zh:
—-政权夺走了你所在乎的一切…而你却责怪你的父亲？—-

政权从来没有隐瞒过他们的身份。是的，他们很残忍。但却是诚实的。

—-诚实对你有意义吗？—-

它意味着一切。

—-真有趣。所以，面对你父亲这个伪君子，你反而倚靠了奴役你们、杀死了那么多你的同胞的政权。—-

政权没有奴役我。它解救了我。

（政权把偃月放回我手中，就是我以你的名字命名的那把。我把它重新取名为——雷里克斯祸害——不管你再怎么掩饰，这都让你害怕。正如我所料想的那样。）

（如果我说我不喜欢这样，那一定是在撒谎。但我确实很享受。就像我享受那永恒的蓝宝石般的光芒。还有我的栖身之处。规律饮食的一致性。政权的生活很好，很舒适。） 

（圣城也许太过于拥挤。法律也许很严格。少数人也许拥有了全部权力。但至少我们不是在徒劳地求生。至少我们不再害怕，不再寒冷，不再孤单，不再担心自己能否活着看到下一轮太阳的升起。）

（但最重要的是，父亲——没人能否认我的渴望。我对鲜血的欲望。他们鼓动它。喂养它。他们已经开始向我展示真相。有关漫游者的真相。有关那闪闪发光的圆球鼓动了什么的真相。）

（你总是说政权的双手沾满了鲜血，但你直到现在——才让我看到你的双手。）

（你现在怎么敢站在我面前承认你对政权的不忠。你怎么敢再对我撒谎。）

（这次你也许制服了我。逃出了我的手掌心。但我会去找你的。我会结束这一切。）

182633233.name: Isolated
182633233.text:
Stop.

—-Why?—-

I don't want to do this. I don't want to relive this.

—-Most would die for the opportunity to retread their greatest moments.—-

…Great moments end in triumph, not mass extinction. In the end, what mattered?

—-The end? No, no. We are so very far from the end. You are not yet ready to taste true glory. You may not yet be familiar with the concept of metamorphosis , but we assure you, you are experiencing it right now. You were once free to roam your little box but lacked wings to fly out of it. And so you grew them —the little larva that you were—wrapped in a cocoon. Now, you need only cut yourself from it. But to do so, you must leave behind that which made you weak, retaining only that which makes you strong.—-

But my world…

(Shattered.)

—-Recreated here, for you.—-

(Reformed. All around me.)

—-Every painstaking detail.—-

(The suns. The Abyss. The Regime. Lubrae.)

—-Every painful memory.—-

(My clan. My family. Khloa, clan-father. Kheesa, clan-mother. Kheeta, sister. Vrhuna, mother. Rhelik, father. Their heads in my hands.)

—-Love for them made you weak. Power over them made you strong. Upon reflection, you are filled with regret. Believing yourself to be under the spell of the Regime. Believing your actions in their tenure to be wrong. But morality, oh dear Rhulk, is subjective. And now that you are all that remains of Lubrae, isn't it time you made the rules? Isn't it time you looked back upon your life with pride? After all, your actions brought you to us. And only we can help you emerge from your cocoon.—-

We…? What even are you?

—-We are your salvation. We are your judgment. And soon we will be… your Witness.—-
182633233.text_zh:
停下来。

—-为什么？—-

我不想这么做。我不想再体验一遍。

—-大多数人愿意为重现他们最伟大的时刻而死。—-

…伟大的时刻应以胜利而告终，而不是大灭绝。到了最后，那有什么意义？

—-最后？不，不。我们离最后还很远。你还没准备好品味真正的荣耀。你可能还不熟悉蜕变的概念，但我们向你保证，你现在就在经历它。你曾经自由地在你的小盒子里漫游，但却缺少飞出盒子的翅膀。于是你长出了翅膀——那个曾是你的小幼虫——被包裹在一个蚕茧里。现在，你只需要让自己从里面挣脱出来。但要做到这一点，你必须抛下那些让你软弱的东西，只保留使你强大的东西。—-

但我的世界…

（支离破碎了。）

—-在这里重筑了，专门献给你。—-

（完全改造了。就在我的周围。）

—-每一个精心设计的细节。—-

（太阳。深渊。政权。鲁布瑞。）

—-每一段痛苦的记忆。—-

（我的氏族。我的家人。克洛，氏族父亲。克伊萨，氏族母亲。克伊塔，妹妹。弗鲁纳，母亲。莱里克，父亲。他们的头颅在我手里。）

—-对他们的爱让你变得软弱。对他们的控制让你变得强大。回想起来，你内心充满了悔恨。相信自己受到了政权的蛊惑。相信你在他们任期内的行为是错误的。但是道德是主观的，哦，亲爱的胡克。现在你已经是鲁布瑞星残留下来的全部了，是不是该你制定规则了？难道你现在不应该骄傲地回顾你的一生吗？毕竟，你的行为把你带到了我们这里。而只有我们能帮助你破茧而出。—-

我们…？你到底是什么？

—-我们是你的救赎。我们是你的审判。很快我们就会成为…你的见证者。—-

182633232.name: Tainted
182633232.text:
—-Your father, he feared your anger. Feared you.—-

Because he knew what I could become. He knew what burdens flowed through my veins. He too felt them, lived them.

(I am a boy. My father skewers three Stalkers in front of me. His eyes are crimson, his sharpened teeth bared as he moves to bite their heads off.)

For a time, my father embodied what I felt inside. I looked up to him, believed I could confide in him. He felt a bloodlust and he despised The Regime. But as they did with me, the others began to see him as a liability. So he softened and softened until, in my opinion, he degraded to the Lubraean equivalent of fetid rot.

—-And so you treated him as such.—-

(I stare into the face of my father, his severed, shattered head held in my hand, dripping with what once stayed within.)
A consequence of weakness. His own.

(In search of my father, I reach the final hiding place of my clan. Devoid of active life, as were the rest. But filled with tokens, trinkets, heirlooms. They left in a hurry, all who remained. And I know where desperation takes them.)

The same place it took me.

The Abyss.
182633232.text_zh:
—-你的父亲，他惧怕你的怒火。惧怕你。—-

因为他知道我会成为什么样的人。他知道我的血管里流淌着什么样的重担。他也感受过它们，体验过它们。

（我是个男孩。我父亲当着我的面杀了三个潜行者。他的眼睛通红，呲着锋利的牙齿，准备咬掉他们的头颅。）

有一段时间，我的父亲体现了我的内心感受。我仰视他，相信我可以向他倾诉。他有一种杀戮的欲望，他鄙视政权。但正如它们对我所做的那样，其他人开始将他视为一种负担。所以他变得越来越软弱，直到在我看来，他堕落成了和恶臭的腐根没什么两样的鲁布瑞人。

—-所以你把他当成腐根对待。—-

（我凝视着父亲的脸，他那被砍断的破碎头颅握在我的手中，滴着曾经留在里面的东西。）
软弱无能的后果。他咎由自取。

（为了寻找我的父亲，我到达了我氏族最后的藏身之处。那里了无生机，就像其他的藏身处一样。但里面装满了代币，小饰品，传家宝。剩下的人都匆忙地走了。而我知道绝望会把他们带到何处。）

和它带我去的地方一样。

深渊。

182633247.name: Assaulted
182633247.text:
(The Abyss. The artificial crack in Lubrae, separating the desired from the undesired. A crevice devoid of all but a strand of concrete to connect the halves.) 

(There, amongst the brush that conceals those approaching, I find them. Trembling, unsure of what would come next regardless of encouragement from Father. He seeks to ferry them into the city of Lubrae unnoticed, through the tunnels below. How he plans this, I do not know. But I do not intend to find out.)

(My emergence from the deep forest was not unexpected, or so my father claims. Mother is here. Clan-mother is too. I do not see many other familiar faces. They have been worn down. Beaten. Broken. In search of a forever home. I must give it to them. I must… )

(But they plead. They reminisce. They appeal. They claim to love. To care. Mother brushes my arm, touch designed to evoke my inner goodness, one I am supposed to have forgotten. She apologizes for my exile.)

(Then Father apologizes—for everything. For the furious example he set. For earlier inaction. He wants to do right. He wants our clan to live a comfortable life. I see sadness. I see truth. I see regret. Perhaps this is the way. Perhaps my time with The Regime has clouded my judgment.)

(And perhaps my tumble into this Abyssal chasm is the result of my own overwhelming catharsis.)

(Or perhaps it is the cost of naivete.) 

(Their faces grow smaller as I plunge deeper, but I can still make out their expressions. No longer do any of them—the adults, the children—no longer do they show regret or pain or sorrow—)

(Their faces show relief.)
182633247.text_zh:
（深渊。鲁布瑞的人工裂缝，将有欲之人和无欲之人分隔两端。一条除了连接两半的一股混凝土外，没有其他任何东西的裂缝。） 

（在那里，在隐藏着接近者的灌木丛中，我发现了他们。他们颤抖着，不知道接下来会发生什么，不顾父亲的鼓动。他试图通过下面的隧道，在不被注意的情况下将他们渡进鲁布瑞圣城。我不知道他是如何计划的。但我不也想知道。）

（我从森林深处出来并没有让他们意外，至少我父亲是这么说的。母亲就在这里。氏族母亲也是。我没有看到其他熟悉的面孔。他们已经疲惫不堪。筋疲力竭。颓丧不堪。他们在找寻一个永远的家园。我必须给他们这个家。我必须…）

（但是他们苦苦哀求。他们追忆往事。他们诉情劝说。他们声称要爱我。要关心我。母亲抚摸我的手臂，想要唤起我内心的善良，那种我应该已经忘却了的品质。她为我的流放道歉。）

（然后父亲道歉了——为所有这一切道歉，为他所树立的愤怒榜样道歉。为之前的无为道歉。他想做正确的事。他想让我们的族人过上舒适的生活。我看到了悲伤。我看到了真相。我看到了悔恨。也许就是这样。我与政权相处的时间已经蒙蔽了我的判断。）

（也许我跌入这个深渊裂口是我自己彻底宣泄的结果。）

（又或许这是天真的代价。） 

（我越往深处跳，他们的脸就变得越小，但我仍然能分辨出他们的表情。他们任何人——无论大人小孩——都不再表现出悔恨，痛苦或悲伤——）

（他们的脸上露出轻松的表情。）

182633246.name: Lamented
182633246.text:
I should have died.

—-And yet, it was there in the darkness of the Abyss that you became truly alive.—-

(I lie amongst swamp and rock and ruin. The Abyss is not unending after all. The wrathful sounds of unchecked nature draw close. Down here, it is dark. And in the dark, they thrive. I am… broken.)

(—-And now, you are unbroken.—-)

(I am… unbroken. I see your Luster. Disarming the beasts who dared to approach, their flesh melting in your presence.)

(—-And we see yours.—-)

(I rise. Broken and then unbroken. What is this thing that grants life?)

(—-We are opportunity.—-)

(And I am?)

(—-Ruin.—-)

(And what am I meant to do?)

(—-Ruin.—-)

(Your voice subsides, but your Luster remains—it is a familiar one. Like that of our Umbral Sun.)

(Rheliksbane lies nearby, broken in two. You mend it with your Luster. It is whole, again. But even more so than before, as if imbued with the wrath of vengeful gods.)

(Miles above, I see the axis that sits between our bright city of Lubrae and our shadowed Wildlands. By now, my clan must be inside the city.)

(I pocket your Luster before I thrust my Glaive into the sheer wall that separates me from my vengeance. I lift myself with one hand gripping the slate. Then another thrust of the Glaive, raising me ever closer towards my goal.)

(No more chances. No more wavering. No more weakness.)
182633246.text_zh:
我早该死了。

—-然而，正是在深渊的暗影中，你才真正活了过来。—-

（我躺在沼泽、岩石和废墟之中。毕竟，深渊不是没有尽头的。不受控制的大自然愤怒之声越来越近了。这里很暗。而在黑暗中，他们繁荣兴盛。我…破败不堪。）

（—-而现在，你完好无损。—-）

（我…完好无损。我看到了你的光泽。卸下那些胆敢靠近的野兽的武装，他们的血肉在你面前融化。）

（—-而我们看到了你的光泽。—-）

（我站了起来。先是破败不堪，然后完好无损。赋予生命的这东西是什么？）

（—-我们是机遇。—-）

（那我是？）

（—-毁灭。—-）

（我该怎么做？）

（—-毁灭。—-）

（你的声音减弱了，但你的光泽依旧，那是令人熟悉的光辉。就像我们的本影之日。）

（雷里克斯祸害就在附近，断成了两半。你用你的光泽修补它。它又完整了。但比以前更甚，仿佛被注入了复仇之神的怒火。）

（在几英里的上空，我看到了位于我们明亮的鲁布瑞圣城和我们阴影笼罩下荒野之间的轴线。现在，我的族人一定已经进城了。）

（我把你的光泽装进口袋，然后把我的偃月刺入将我和复仇分隔开来的高墙。我单手抓住石板，把自己拉起来。接着，又刺了一刀偃月，让我离目标越来越近了。）

（不再给机会。不再动摇，不再软弱。）

955849618.name: Liberated
955849618.text:
I know what happened next. I do not need to see it again.

(I rend Mother's flesh.)

Do you not hear me?!

(I remove Father's head from his neck.)

This is madness!

(None escape my wrath. Not even the little ones. Not even civilians. The city watches in horror. They know what I am.)
This must stop!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

Stop!!!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

I COMMAND YOU!!!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

AHHHHH!

(The Sapphiric Sun implodes.)

PLEASE!

(Lubrae is cracking. Lubrae is shattering. Lubrae is upending. What have I done?)

I CAN'T—

(Your Luster. My Glaive.)

—-Relive it.—-

NOOOOO—

(They've turned against me—my Regime. They've perished by my hand—my clan. They call me a monster. They put me in a cage. They seek my execution. But your Luster—I see it, even though they took you from me.)

(You guide my hand. You free me of these chains. You find me again. You return to me my Glaive—no longer Rheliksbane. Serving only one final purpose: Lubrae's Ruin.)

(A shattered sky. A planet convulsing. Our existence, upended.)

(Their folly was their intended salvation. Siphoning light from the Sapphiric Sun itself. I use your Luster. Turn their technology against them, like a backfired pistol.)

(After serving them. Protecting them. Fighting for them. Suffering for them.)

(A shattered sky. A planet convulsing. Tearing apart.)

(One Lubraean remains—me. But not for long. What have I done? I stare into the Abyss. It has opened—truly opened this time—to show me what lies beneath: death. I drop your Luster. I drop Lubrae's Ruin. I let myself fall in. And then I… I… and then I am… )

—————————————————————————————————————————————-

Here. With you. My… Witness.

—-And what do you feel now? Devoid of family. Devoid of The Regime. Devoid of Lubrae. What do you feel here, in our embrace, now that they are gone and you are left?—-

Rhulk opens his eyes. Crawls forth through the blackened solution that engulfed him all this time. Emerges from the wall of obsidian-like miasma to find his Luster. To find Lubrae's Ruin. Taking them, he rises to his feet.

—-What do you feel, my child?—-

"Relief."
955849618.text_zh:
我知道接下来发生了什么。我不需要再看一次。

（我撕碎了母亲的肉体。）

你没听见我说的吗？！

（我从父亲的脖子上取下他的头颅。）

真是疯了！

（没有人能逃脱我的愤怒。即使是小孩子。即使是平民。整个圣城都在惊恐地看着。他们知道我是什么。）
停下来！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

别说了！！！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

我命令你！！！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

啊啊啊啊！

（蓝宝石般的太阳内爆了。）

拜托了！

（鲁布瑞开裂了。鲁布瑞破碎了。鲁布瑞颠覆了。我干了什么？）

我没法——

（你的光泽。我的偃月。）

—-再体验一遍。—-

不不不——

（他们背叛了我——我的政权。他们死在了我手上——我的氏族。他们叫我怪物。他们把我关进笼子里。他们想要处决我。但你的光泽——我看到了，即使他们把你从我身边带走。）

（你指引着我的手。你帮我解开镣铐。你再次找到我。你还给了我的偃月——它不再是雷里克斯祸害，而只服务于最终的目标：鲁布瑞之厄。）

（碎裂的天空。行星剧烈地震动。我们的存在，颠覆了。）

（他们的愚蠢曾是他们想要的救赎。从蓝宝石太阳身上抽走光。我利用了你的光泽。用他们的技术转而对付他们，就像逆火手枪一样。）

（就在效忠他们。保护他们。为他们战斗。为他们受苦之后。）

（碎裂的天空。行星剧烈地震动。分崩离析。）

（剩下一个鲁布瑞人，就是我。但这不会持续太久。我做了什么？我凝视着深渊。它打开了——这一次它真的打开了——让我看到了隐藏在下面的东西：死亡。我扔下了你的光泽。我扔下了鲁布瑞之厄。我让自己掉了进去。然后我…我…然后我就…）

—————————————————————————————————————————————-

来到了这儿。和你一起。我的…见证者。

—-你现在的感觉是什么？没有了家人。没有了政权。没有了鲁布瑞。在这里，在我们的怀抱中，你有什么感觉，现在他们都没了，只剩下了你？—-

胡克睁开眼睛。从一直吞没着他的焦糊溶液中爬了出来。从黑曜石般的瘴气之墙中露了出来，以找到他的光泽，找到鲁布瑞之厄。拿着它们，他站了起来。

—-你有什么感觉，我的孩子？—-

“轻松。”

935120014.name: Altars of Reflection—Dispatch
935120014.text:

SUBJ: Altars of Reflection—Dispatch

1. Regarding the power known as Deepsight and its use within VIP #7282's throne world:
Some Guardians have already used this power to access secret pockets of space. Hidden agents have dubbed them "Altars of Reflection" for now. There, the invocation of Deepsight in concert with significant objects has enabled us to view memories belonging to #7282.

2. Access to this power requires spending time with the Relic, and subsequently, in one of the Pyramids. Long-term exposure to Darkness in this manner carries inherent risk, and the process is nontrivial. However, in the interest of learning everything possible about this space and the relevant VIP, certain chances must be taken.   

Considering the sensitive nature of the topic, reports should be directed subject to the attention of IKO-006 only. 

3. So far, it is estimated that Guardians have been able to view memories that #7282 wants. This supposition is upheld by #7282's specific and personal input on the memories in question. But why these memories? This remains a worthwhile question to answer in order to understand #7282's larger goal.

4. Hidden agent (LIN-357) was dispatched in full understanding of requisite risks to determine the following as possible: limits and potential of physical space, applicability of other items and memories, span of #7282's attention to the mentioned spaces, possibility for use of Deepsight outside of Altar parameters, and possibility for use of Altar parameters with other applications.  

5. LIN-357 is also to assess potential danger in continuing and encouraging Guardian access to and use of Altar spaces. 

MESSAGE ENDS

1. 关于深视能力，及其在重要人物#7282王座世界中的用处：
一些守护者已在使用这种力量访问秘密空间，而隐秘者特工称之为“沉思祭坛”。在那里，深视与重要物体协调调用，使我们能够查看属于#7282的记忆。

2. 若要获得这种力量，就需要不断使用圣物，并随后待在其中一个金字塔里。以这种方式长期接触暗影必定会带来风险，而且这个过程也不容忽视。然而，为了尽可能了解这个空间和相关的重要人物，我们得冒这个险。

4. 在充分了解必要风险的情况下，我们派出了隐秘者特工（里斯本-357），以确定以下几点的可能性：物理空间的限制和潜力、其他物品和记忆的适用性、#7282对上述空间的关注范围、在祭坛参数之外使用深视的可能性，以及在其他应用中使用祭坛参数的可能性。

935120013.name: Altars of Reflection—Assessment
935120013.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
REP #: 217-HIVE-SAV
AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ: Altars of Reflection—Assessment

1. I arrived onsite and made my way into the Altar space. It doesn't appear to have changed much, if at all, from earlier provided telemetry. As predicted, there were barriers to access: several of the Lucent Brood obstructed my passage and were subsequently dispatched without much trouble. Additionally, the same complication as previously reported blocked the way—Hive runes. Parsing their nature and repetition of specific patterns was required to gain full access to the Altar. 

2. On the topic of the presented resistance: there were significantly fewer Hive defenders than could have been mustered, given intelligence on available forces. Based on the token nature of this resistance and the fact that VIP #7282 surely knows that Guardians have been here, it can be assumed that the defense is not a sincere attempt to keep us out. Historical precedent exists for setting a guard on a location or item to make it appear more attractive. 

Precedent also exists for opening the way for Guardians to participate in the Hive sword logic. I do not yet have reason to believe this is taking place here, especially given the severance of #7282's connection to the Worm Gods that have otherwise led her species, but it does not pay to be incautious around the Hive.

3. Once appropriate precautions were taken against any further incursions, I deployed sensors to record what data is possible, focusing on the central Altar and its exterior boundaries. Simultaneously, it was necessary to assess the available space for myself; impressions follow.

It is more aesthetically appealing than we usually associate with Hive—only the structures bear vague resemblance to those on Luna. The colors are pleasing, far removed from scarlet and rot, and the area lacks jagged edges or significant quantities of bone. Structurally, it is a space clearly built to highlight the central area, and indeed, it draws one to the Altar itself.

All told, in architecture alone, the creator demonstrates a clear evolution, presumably mirroring her own.

4. On the topic of the structure: although the available space does not appear to have walls, there is a definite boundary. Matter grows foggy, and there is a strong sense of pushback when moving away from the center. Initially, I believed this to be a function of the architecture, but significant willpower was required to force myself to look further into testing the concept. That alone suggests it should be investigated more. 

Conscious of the bias in doing so, I am marking it for later experimentation, as it would involve straying from the central objective. Further data forthcoming.

MESSAGE ENDS
935120013.text_zh:
访问权限：受限
密钥：QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
编号：217-邪魔族-萨瓦图恩
特工：里斯本-357
主题：沉思祭坛——评估

1. 我到达现场，并进入祭坛空间。与之前提供的遥测数据相比，它似乎并没有发生太大的变化。果然不出所料，进入空间时我遇到了点障碍：一些光明虫群挡住了我的去路，但我没费什么劲就处理掉它们了。此外，和之前报告的一样，邪魔族符文挡住了路。需要解析它们的特质和特定模式的规律，才能完全访问祭坛。 

2. 关于抵抗势力：考虑到现有部队的情报，邪魔族防御者明显比所能召集的要少。基于这个象征性的抵抗势力，还有重要人物#7282肯定知道守护者曾到过这里的事实，我们认为，防御方并不是认真要将我们拒之门外。历史上已有先例：在一个地点或物品周围部署守卫，可使其看起来更有吸引力。 

也有先例记录了守护者能参与邪魔族邪剑守则的方法。我不确定那是这里正在发生的事，尤其考虑到#7282与引导她同族的虫神的连接被切断，但是在邪魔族周围不谨慎，是注定要付出代价的。

3. 采取了适当的预防措施来防止进一步的入侵后，我部署了传感器来记录可收获的数据，尤其在中央祭坛及其外部边界上。与此同时，我必须为自己评估可用的空间。以下是我的印象：

它比我们通常联想到的邪魔族区域更美丽，只是结构与月球上还有一点相似。颜色的搭配令人心情愉快，远离了猩红和腐败，而且里面没有锯齿状的边缘或大量的骨头。从结构上看，这很明显是为突出中心区域而建造的空间，而它的确能够把人吸引到祭坛。

总而言之，仅在建筑风格方面，创造者就展示了清晰的演变，大概是在反映她自己的蜕变。

4. 关于结构：虽然可用空间的四周似乎没有墙，但确实有个明确的边界。物质开始变得朦胧不清，并且当我尝试远离中心时能够感受到一股强烈的抵抗力。最初，我认为这是建筑的功能，但我还是得依靠强大的意志力才能迫使自己进一步研究测试这个概念。仅这一点就表明，我们应该更深入调查。 

意识到这样做的偏见，并且因为这可能会偏离中心目标，所以我为以后的实验先把它标记下来。更多数据即将到来。

信息结束

935120012.name: Altars of Reflection—Control
935120012.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006

AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ: Altars of Reflection—Control

1. With the perimeter secured and all sensors ready for analysis, there is no immediate further obstacle to the initial experiments with Deepsight. On Vanguard authorization, I've borrowed one of the existing artifacts that has been used to produce and view VIP #7282's memories. Item: a shard of the crystal that #7282 used recently as a protective measure, cf. REP # 197-HIVE-SAV. 

2. In summary, following the known and established process, there is no deviation from what was previously reported. The memory of #7282's death and subsequent acquisition of Light played back as expected, identical in every beat. (See attached file for additional details as necessary.) This is not unexpected, and the recording, etc., have been made largely for archival purposes.

3. Subsequent repetitions of the same process revealed additional words from #7282. Perhaps foolishly, I replied to portions of her dialogue that seemed to request a response. However, there was no explicit answer—I believe it is safe to conclude that there is no awareness of hers here, and what is heard is likely a recording coded to this specific memory and/or object. Her use of this method to influence and sow doubt is not unexpected.

4. As a test, I used the crystal item to invoke Deepsight in the same fashion I used previously, this time with the intent of viewing something different—there are plentiful records of #7282's interactions with Vanguard and Reef personnel around the larger crystal this piece was retrieved from. However, none of these were viewable. The same item only allowed viewing of the same memory, suggesting a permanent association. I have some additional analysis planned to confirm this. 

At first glance, these observations imply that if we wish to discover further memories, we will need to collect additional items, likely of personal relevance to #7282. (Confirmation of required item nature forthcoming.)

MESSAGE ENDS

1. 在周边安全，而所有传感器也已准备好进行分析的情况下，深视的初始实验并未立即遇到更多障碍。在先锋的授权下，我借用了一个用于生成和查看重要人物#7282记忆的现有神器。物品：一块#7282最近用作保护措施的水晶碎片，参考报告编号：197-邪魔族-萨瓦图恩。 

2. 总之，在遵循已知和已建立的过程下，这与之前所报告的没有偏差。#7282死亡的记忆和随后获得的光能如预期般回放，每一瞬间都一样（如有必要，详见附件）。这是意料之中的，而录音等的主要目的是为了存档。

3. 重复相同的过程后，其揭示了来自#7282的更多语句。也许这让我看起来很愚蠢，但我回应了似乎需要回应的部分对话。不过，我却得不到任何回答，因此我认为这里没有她的意识，而我所听到的很可能是编码到这个特定记忆或物体的录音。她用这种方法来影响和播下猜疑的种子并不出人意料。

4. 为了试验，我用了与之前相同的方式通过水晶物品调用深视，不过这次试验的目的是希望看到一些不同的东西：这块从较大水晶萃取出的物品，记录了大量关于#7282与先锋和暗礁人员在大水晶周围的互动。但是，我无法观看这些记录，相同的物品只允许我们看到相同的记忆，这表明了一种永久性的联系。我计划做一些额外的分析来证实这一点。 

乍一看，这些观察表明，如果我们希望发现更多记忆，就将需要收集更多可能与#7282个人有关的物品（所需物品性质将需确认）。

信息结束

935120011.name: Altars of Reflection—New Input
935120011.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
REP #: 219-HIVE-SAV
AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ: Altars of Reflection—New Input


1. Logical next steps in analysis involve changing a variable in the known functional equation. I've taken the liberty of borrowing some items from others in order to conduct some tests regarding expectations—it is worth assessing how much influence the viewer has on the outcome.

2. First test—Introduction of reasonably generic items. As expected, a chunk of Glimmer did nothing. A broken-off piece from the grip of a new sidearm, purchased specifically for this purpose—next to nothing. For a moment, there was a shadow, something that vaguely resembled the gunsmith at work or in conversation, but no memory replay as seen in the items known to produce memories of VIP #7282.

3. Second test—I had an acquaintance borrow a trinket from a friend of theirs whom I have not met. The item is a medallion smaller than my palm, with old, rubbed-faint engravings. Following the introduction of this item to the Altar, a visible memory resulted, playing out in third person much like the other memories. I recorded details of this memory for reference and confirmation of accuracy. (Specifics omitted here as irrelevant.)

Once a recording had been made and committed, I accessed the file provided by the owner of the item. This file included summaries of what he thought were the most likely memories to be associated with the item. As you can see, details of what I observed matched one of those summaries. Owner's Ghost to provide additional context if necessary, either on my return or when another Hidden agent reaches out.

Would like to recommend that another agent repeats the same test to see if they can view something different.

4. While we had no reason to doubt the previously revealed memories, all this adds an additional layer of certainty: that which we can ascertain via the Altars is the truth, full and clear. The only remaining doubts are regarding why, and which memories. VIP #7282 is known to be cunning but has ultimately been truthful in previous dealings with the Vanguard. Regrettably, these things are not mutually exclusive. 

5. I had additional plans for analysis of the Altars involving personal items and memory, but I am reconsidering the wisdom in doing so, as well as the necessity. Beyond confirming that the memories produced are repeatable, true, and personal, do we need to know more? I will be moving on to the substance of the world next. 

MESSAGE ENDS
935120011.text_zh:

1. 分析后合乎逻辑的下一步是改变已知函数方程中的一个变量。我擅自借用了一些其他物品，以便进行一些关于预期的试验：观众对结果的影响有多大是值得评估的。

2. 第一项试验：引入合理的通用物品。不出所料，大量的微光毫无反应。一把新手枪握把上脱落的碎片，专为这一试验目的而购买，也只是微乎其微的反应。一个影子出现片刻，看起来有点像是在工作或谈话中的枪匠，但是没有像已知能够生成重要人物#7282记忆的物品那样出现记忆重放。

3. 第二项试验：我有个熟人从他认识但我未见过面的一个朋友那里借了个饰品。那是一个比我手掌还小的勋章，上面有着模糊不清的古老雕刻。在把这件物品引入到祭坛之后，就生成了一个可见的记忆，与其他记忆一样以第三人称播放。我记录了这整段记忆，以供参考和确认准确性。（由于不相关，此处省略细节。）

完成并提交记录后，我访问了物品所有者提供的文件。这个文件包括了他认为最有可能与这件物品有关的记忆的摘要。如你所见，我所观察到的细节与其中一个摘要相符。如有必要，等我返回或当另一个隐秘者特工进行联系时，所有者的机灵可提供额外的内容信息。

建议让另一个隐秘者特工重复同样的试验，说不定他们会看到不同的东西。

4. 我们没有理由怀疑之前披露的记忆，而所有这些试验让我们能够更加确定：我们通过祭坛所能确定的，是完整而清晰的真相。唯一剩下的疑问就是为什么是记忆，为什么是这些记忆。众所周知，重要人物#7282非常狡猾，但在之前与先锋的往来中却相当诚实。遗憾的是，这些论点并非相互排斥。 

5. 我还计划对祭坛进行分析，包括个人物品和记忆，但我正在重新考虑这样做是否明智，以及是否有必要。除了确认产生的记忆是可重复、真实和个人的，我们还需要知道更多吗？我将研究的下一个项目就是世界的实质。 

信息结束

935120010.name: RE: Altars of Reflection—New Input
935120010.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
REP #: 220-HIVE-SAV
AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ: RE: Altars of Reflection—New Input


1. I moved forward with invocation of a personal item anyway, despite previous report concluding that it was unnecessary. Testing continued with the cloak I have kept from back then, the one I was wearing when I was found. I don't know what I was expecting from it—just that after all that time not remembering, my curiosity won out. I wanted to know.

2. The memory was… like a key in a lock, all the rest laid open to me once I remembered this one thing.

The first time I witnessed the memory, I barely processed any of what was happening; I was so caught up in simply looking at her. I forgot to breathe. She had the most luminous blue eyes… how could I have ever forgotten her?

Everything in my head was jumbled, all the things I'd forgotten were trying to be heard at once, and she was the only constant. So I used the item again, this time intending to make a coherent report, thinking I could process by writing it all down. I just wound up watching again, caught up in remembering the three of us. This awful set of moments, suspended in perfect replica. 

Before this, I didn't recall anything of the incident, even who my fireteam was at the time. I'd wondered what might be in that gap, and why I hesitated even when I was curious. It wasn't enough to know that I had survived and should not return. I think, despite all that wondering, some part of me didn't want to remember. 

But that's how lies happen, isn't it? In the places we don't want to look. Little by little, we let the weeds grow and the shadows encroach, and we tell ourselves there's nothing in the overgrowth. And if there is, it isn't something that matters very much… 

Deepsight does not allow for such deceptions.

MESSAGE ENDS
935120010.text_zh:
访问权限：受限
密钥：QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
编号：220-邪魔族-萨瓦图恩
特工：里斯本-357
主题：回复：沉思祭坛——新输入


1. 尽管之前的报告得出结论调用个人物品没有必要，但我还是这么做了。试验继续进行，我利用了我从那时起就一直保留着的披风，就是我被发现时穿的那件。我不知道我想从中得到什么，只是在这么长时间毫无记忆之后，我的好奇心胜出了：我想知道。

2. 记忆就如…锁上的一把钥匙，一旦我记起一件事，其余的一切都将接踵而至。

当我第一次目睹这段记忆时，我几乎反应不过来发生了什么，只是着了迷般地注视着她，甚至忘了呼吸。她有着一双最明亮的蓝眼睛…我怎么可能忘记她呢？

我的脑子乱成一团，所有我全部忘记的东西都争先恐后地涌来，但唯有她一人不变。所以我再次使用了这个物品，这一次我打算写出一个连贯的报告，以为把所有的东西都写下来后自己的大脑就能处理这些信息。但我只是又看了一遍，回忆起我们三人一起的时候。那些可怕的瞬间，在完美的复制记忆中暂停着。 

在此之前，我不记得所发生的任何事情，甚至不记得当时我的火力战队中有谁。我会想知道那段时间里发生了什么，还有我非常好奇但同时却又犹豫不决是因为什么。仅仅知道我活了下来并且不应回去是不够的，但是尽管有那么多的疑惑，我隐隐感觉到我并不想记起来。 

但谎言就是这样来的，不是吗？在我们不想看到的地方，一点一点地，任凭杂草生长，任凭阴影侵蚀，而我们告诉自己这个杂草丛生的地方里什么都没有。即使有，也不是什么重要之事… 

深视并不容许这样的欺骗。

信息结束

我…还没彻底查清楚，还有一些数据可以从祭坛中提取出来。我还未真的做到尽职调查。在看到我自己的旧记忆之后，我最初就只想尽快离开，好像能够把那些记忆抛诸脑后一般，但现在这里足够安全了，而且作为隐秘者特工，我还有工作要做。

935120008.name: Personal Accountability
935120008.text:
ACCESS: PRIVATE
DECRYPTION KEY: INVALID
REP #: 005-LISBON 
AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ:  Personal Accountability

I still can't accept this memory. I repeat it anyway, telling myself that this time, I'll spot the right detail, the sign that means I can put it down. But I don't: it stays just the same every time. Again and again, no matter what I try, what intent I approach it with. What happened, happened.

I remember that I wanted to forget it all. Forget her, forget them, so that what I'd done wouldn't matter. So it could disappear into the array of past missions with the rest. 
I spent a long time lying to myself about it. Something helped me forget. 
Now I watch her slip up behind me, watch myself turn with weapon readied, and I remember everything. 

And I think, this is the only place I'll ever see them again. So I call it up one more time, just to look her in the eyes. I'm not sure how long I've spent on this, it probably isn't wise… but just once more. 

One more look, and I'll be sure to remember them, even when I've left.

One more.

I don't know how many times I've said "one more." Have I learned anything at all? 

There was one thing… 

I close my eyes. Think about it. What do I want least, right now? 

I draw a breath. I don't recognize the scents. I remember again when I last came here, when I thought not of accessing memories but instead of the architecture and how it directed us inward… 

And then I turn away from the unvarnished truth of my worst moments and walk. I'm not going anywhere in particular. Just… out. Away. Crystal and runes and the impression of beauty grow fuzzy and frail around me, and the steps to take grow harder, as if dragging my body through mud instead of walking on solid ground. Fog blinds me, and now I hear it: whispering, barely distinguishable, but louder as I go. 

I know what my body failing feels like, and I don't care. I walk as far as my legs will carry me, listening to the whispers of the Witch Queen, searching for the meaning here in this liminality. 

Piri wakes me under a high-vaulted ceiling, and I remember what I must.
935120008.text_zh:
访问权限：私人
密钥：无效
编号：005-里斯本 
特工：里斯本-357
主题：个人责任

我还是无法接受这段记忆，但我还是重复了一遍，告诉自己这一次，我会找到意味着我可以记录下来的正确细节。但我还是无法做到，每次都一样。一次又一次，无论我如何尝试，无论我抱有什么意图接近它，发生过的已经发生了。

我记得我想忘记这一切。忘记她，忘记他们，这样我所做的就都无关紧要了。这样它就能和其他记忆一样消失在过去的任务中。 
我花了很长时间对自己撒谎，让自己忘却一切。 
可现在我看着她从我脑后出现，看着自己拿着武器转身，所有发生的一切就全部涌上我心头了。 

而我想，这里是我唯一能再见到他们的地方。所以我又再次使用了物品，只是为了再次看到她。我不知道我在这上面花了多长时间，这可能不明智…但是再看一眼吧。 

再看一眼，这样即使在我离开后，我也一定会记住他们。

再看一眼。

我不知道自己说了多少次“再看一眼”，到底我研究出什么了？ 

至少有一件事… 

我闭上双眼思考。我现在最不想要的是什么？ 

我吸了一口气，认不出这些气味。我还记得上次来这里的时候，我所想到的不是查看记忆，而是这里的建筑结构和其如何引导我们向内… 

然后我就从我最糟糕时刻的真实写照中走开，漫无目的地，只是想要…避开它、远离它。水晶和符文，还有对美的印象在我看来变得模糊而薄弱，我的脚步越来越重，仿佛在拖着自己穿越泥沼，而不是在坚实的地面上行走。浓雾使我看不见，但我听到了几乎听不清的低语，随着我的步伐越来越大声。 

我知道身体衰竭是种什么样的感觉，但我不在乎。我能走多远就走多远，听着巫妖女王的低语，在这界限里寻找存在的意义。 

我在拱顶天花板下被皮里唤醒，清楚记得我必须要做的事。

935120007.name: Altars of Reflection—Conclusion
935120007.text:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
REP #: 221-HIVE-SAV
AGENT(S): LIN-357
SUBJ: Altars of Reflection—Conclusion

1. Assessment—Low physical threat presented. Despite the known involvement of VIP #7282, there is no direct contact here now. Further, the Altars are absent of traps or lethal intent so long as one remains within the bounded space accessed by the specified method. 

However, impacts of using Deepsight should not be underestimated.

2. Experiment notes—Telemetry includes sensor readings, breakdown thereof. "Object produced expected memory" applies to the vast majority of tests. 

3. Recommendations—Guardians should not be encouraged to visit the Altars. Use of Deepsight under these circumstances has provided valuable information, but given the initial involvement with Pyramids, etc., and the inherent danger in long-term occupation of #7282's throne world, it should not be relied on. Further, the resurrection of old personal memories creates vulnerability and distraction and has the potential to trigger long-lasting psychological detriment to the visitor. None of the possible applications are worth enough comparatively.

4. Final thoughts—If there is any further value to be found here, it lies in the spaces between what VIP #7282 has created. Knowing that we see true memories does not mean there isn't a secondary agenda, and above all, we should ask: Why these memories in particular? What is it #7282 has to say to us, and what might the wide dissemination of these truths do? What do these truths say to you, IKO-006? 

I would prefer to avoid further deployment of this nature.

MESSAGE ENDS
935120007.text_zh:
访问权限：受限
密钥：QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
编号：221-邪魔族-萨瓦图恩
特工：里斯本-357
主题：沉思祭坛——结论

1. 评估：人身威胁低。尽管已知有重要人物#7282的参与，但目前还没有直接联系。此外，祭坛没有陷阱或致命威胁，只要你通过特定方法进入并保持在有限空间内。 

不过，使用深视的影响不应被低估。

2. 实验笔记：遥测包括传感器读数及其故障。“对象产生的预期记忆”适用于绝大多数试验。 

3. 推荐：不应鼓励守护者访问祭坛。在这些情况下深视的使用提供了有价值的信息，但考虑到最初它涉及金字塔等，以及长期存在于#7282王座世界的内在危险，我们不应依赖它。此外，旧时个人记忆的复活将产生弱点和造成干扰，并同时有可能对来访者造成持久的心理伤害。相比之下，这些可能的应用都没有足够的价值。

4. 结语：重要人物#7282创建的空间之间还存有更有价值的东西。我们知道我们所看到的记忆是真实的并不意味着没有次要的目标，最重要的是，我们应该问：为什么偏偏是这些记忆？#7282想要对我们说什么？这些真相的广泛传播会起到什么作用？这些真相对你又意味着什么，艾可拉-006？ 

我希望避免这一性质的进一步发展。

信息结束

1250196969.name: Osiris I
1250196969.text:
May this message find you, Guardian.

If it does, then you have once again learned just enough to be dangerous, and you are no doubt seeking guidance.

I must preface all I  am about to say by asking for your empathy. I have dedicated lifetimes to studying the infinite permutations of reality. I have lived longer than any other Guardian by orders of magnitude, much of it outside what you experience as time. But with the loss of Sagira, the time I have left in a Human lifespan is infinitesimal; less than a mote in the vast sands of time. All I have of value—my insights, my discoveries, my reputation—they are all rooted in my past, and I do not have the time left to accomplish more. Not on the scale we need to survive.

There are few beings in this cosmos who have seen time from the same  depths as I have, and fewer still with the intellect to appreciate that perspective. Which is why I have made my deal with the devil.

I have willingly submitted to Savathûn and allowed her to take my place among the Vanguard.

The Vanguard have  fought like trapped animals for too long. They hoard secrets; every fact they learn gets crammed into the barrel of a gun and fired at the heart of our newest target. We are losing this war despite individual, pyrrhic victories, and what pitiful harm Savathûn can inflict with our limited resources pales against the value of this opportunity. The Witch Queen sits on a throne of secrets accreted over a billion years. While she huddles in the crumbling ruin of our city, I am left alone in her storied halls to learn all she has seen. 

Zavala and Ikora are dear friends and noble souls, but they are adventurers. They see immediate problems and crave immediate solutions, and their compassion blinds them to what can be won through sacrifice—particularly from a man who is, on the scale of Guardian lives, already dead. They would stop me, which is why I entrust only you with this knowledge. Keep my secrets and keep humanity safe with this unexpected ally. 

Do not let my sacrifice be in vain.

—Osiris
1250196969.text_zh:
守护者，展信安。

如果这封信传到你手上，说明你又一次知道了足够多的东西，从而把自己置于险地，而你也毫无疑问在寻求指引。

我必须为我1a即将要说的事情先寻求你的同情。我花了一辈子的时间学习现实的无限种可能。我也比其他任何守护者活的时间要长很久，而其中的很长一段时间，我都在你所体验的时间之外度过。但随着我失去了萨吉拉，我作为一个人类所还拥有的寿命太少了；就好比时间沙漠中的一小粒尘埃。我所有有价值的一切——我的智慧、我的发现、和我的声望——他们都扎根于我的过去，而我也没有更多的时间来完成更多事情。不足以帮助我们幸存下来。

在这个宇宙中，只有寥寥数位曾经从我这个1d深度视角审视时间，而其中更少的人才具有珍视此视角的智慧。这也是我与魔鬼达成交易的原因。

我自愿受制于萨瓦图恩，让她取代了我在先锋中的位置。

先锋已经1f做了太久的困兽之斗。他们积攒秘密；他们所学到的每一个事实都被塞到枪管里，向着我们最新的目标开火。尽管我们拿到了个人的代价高昂的胜利，但我们在这场战争中已经节节败退。而萨瓦图恩利用我们有限资源所能造成的危害，相较于此机遇所带来的价值可谓是微不足道。巫妖女王的王座之下是她在十亿年间所积攒的无数秘密。而在她于我们岌岌可危的圣城蜷缩之时，我被单独留在了她的故事大厅，学习她所有的见闻。 

萨瓦拉和艾可拉是亲近的朋友，也是高贵的灵魂，但他们是冒险者。他们看到紧迫的问题并拿出急迫的解决方法，而他们的同情心让他们无法看清通过牺牲所能赢得的价值——特别是一个就守护者生命来说已经死去的人的牺牲。他们会阻止我，这也是为什么我将这一知识寄托给你。保守我的秘密，并和这个非常规的盟友一起保护人类的安全。 

别让我白白牺牲。

——奥斯里斯M

1250196970.name: Eris I
1250196970.text:
It seems that our end has arrived this day. Savathûn is here.

For too long, I have dreaded this inevitability. In a way, I suppose it's a relief; the sword of Damocles dangles over my head no more. I approach you alone, Guardian, because you have proven yourself unswervingly dedicated to victory over the Hive no matter the  cost.

Savathûn is an enemy unlike any the Guardians have ever weathered, not merely because of her physical power, but also because of her keen intellect and mastery of strategy—she does not make a visible move without first maneuvering all of her assets into place. It was all too easy for you to reveal her presence among the Vanguard. Make no mistake: she discarded the guise of Osiris because it was no longer valua 8le, because the reveal was strategically worth more to her. I cannot begin to guess at her true agenda, but I promise you that everything we are doing now is exactly what she wants.

There is no one in the Last  City as soaked in Hive secrets as I am, but my knowledge now becomes a liability. Savathûn works her power through secrets, and I am almost certainly her unwitting pawn—a sleeper agent ready to activate when the time comes.

I need a friend and ally whom I can trust to eliminate me the moment I act suspiciously. Do not hesitate, Guardian. Do not second-guess. Do not beg me to seek redemption. I am already fallen, and the greatest mercy you can offer is swiftness.

You alone I trust with this vital task.

—Eris Morn
1250196970.text_zh:
看来我们的结局今天到了，萨瓦图恩来了。

这么长时间以来，我一直因这一无法避免的结果而感到惧怕。从某种意义上来讲，这是一种解脱；暴君的利刃终于不再在我的头顶悬垂。我独自找你，守护者，因为你证明了你自己不计代价以获取对邪魔族的胜利的1c执拗。

萨瓦图恩不似任何守护者之前所面对的敌人，不仅仅因为她本身的力量，也因她敏锐的思维和大师的策略——她在将所有棋子就位之前，是不会轻易出手的。你揭露她在先锋中的存在，未免也太容易了。别误会：她放弃了奥斯里斯的伪装是因为那已不再有其18价值了，因为揭露身份对她来说在策略上稳赚不亏。我无法猜测她的真实目的，但我向你保证，我们现在所做的一切都正如她所愿。

在圣1c城中，没有人比我更懂邪魔族的秘密，但我的知识现在已经成为了累赘。萨瓦图恩通过秘密来使用她的力量，而我几乎必定会成为她手中的棋子——一个在需要时就会激活的隐藏特工。

我需要一个可以信任的盟友在我行为可疑的时候将我除掉。别犹豫，守护者。不要犹豫。别求我寻找救赎。我已堕落，而你所能赐予我的恩慈，就是速死。

这一重要的任务，我只相信你一人。

——埃里斯·摩恩I

1250196971.name: Ikora I
1250196971.text:
SENDER: IKO-006
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
SUBJECT: Functional Advisement

Show considerable caution re: new informant FYN-002. CHA-319 confirms asset traits: paranoid, disgruntled, eager to please, needs to belong. Disposition makes him an eager source; also makes him easily manipulated by Savathûn. Until he is established as bona fide, work under assumption that everything he shares, the enemy wants us to know. If the operation goes sideways, exfiltrate FYN-002 for debrief; some intel is better than none.

Be prepared. Scrutinize everything. Accept nothing at face value. Savathûn operates via disinformation and counterintelligence. We must assume she will penetrate our networks at some point, so remain vigilant.

Personal aside: Hidden involvement with this operation will stretch my time thin. I'm sorry. I'll provide oversight for critical missions; otherwise, I need you to operate solo. It may be more than you're prepared for, but we don't have any other choice for now.
1250196971.text_zh:
发送者： IKO-006
密钥： QF4LYZX16G$IKO-006
主题：功能建议

谨慎回复：新现任FYN-002。CHA-319确认特性：多疑、不满、谄媚、需要归属感。性格使他成为一个热切的线人；同时也让他容易被萨瓦图恩利用。在他被证实可靠之前，假设他所分享的所有东西都是敌人想让我们知道的。如果行动出了差错，撤出FYN-002进行汇报；情报聊胜于无。

做好准备。怀疑一切。不要被表象迷惑。萨瓦图恩的行动基于虚假信息和反情报。我们必须假设她在某一时刻已经侵入了我们的网络，保持警惕。

将个人意见抛开：隐秘者参与此次行动让我的时间变得很紧张。不好意思。我将监督关键任务；其他时候，我需要你单独行动。可能有些超出你的准备范畴，但我们现在也没有其他选择。

1250196972.name: Caiatl I
1250196972.text:
Degenerate fate casts us together once more, Guardian. How I have missed the thrill of pitting my Cabal against your unyielding tide of Lightbearers, truce or no.

But it is in the spirit of Zavala's newfound truce that I offer you news  delivered by my Cabal scouts. My forces recently recovered the remains of a Human male on Nessus, vivisected almost beyond recognition using Hive techniques and tools. Our science identifies the unfortunate as your Warden of the Infinite Forest, Osiris.

While I will not divulge the details of our confirmation methodologies, rest assured they are thorough and accurate. This news no doubt will shock you, given that you are also in possession of another Osiris still clinging to life. But it is not him, despite the confirmation of his identity performed by Ikora Rey. Her admiration for her old mentor has already clouded her ability to recognize an imposter once, and it appears to have happened yet again. It is not custom among the Cabal to allow even a respected leader a   3rd chance to fail their people.

I don't know what purpose the Witch Queen could have in giving you a comatose husk wearing your dead ally's face, or what threat he may become: a listening device, a future mole, a living bomb? But understand this: when Savathûn brought Xivu Arath to my doorstep, she did so wearing the mask of a trusted advisor. What you hold in your Tower is no treasure, and I have faith in you among your kind to handle this problem as a Cabal would.

—Empress Caiatl
1250196972.text_zh:
堕落的命运再次让我们聚在一起，守护者。我很想念让我的卡巴尔对抗你们永不退缩的如潮的拥光者，不论停战与否。

但考虑到萨瓦拉最新的停战协议，我想你提供由我的卡巴尔斥候1d发现的消息。我的部队最近在涅索斯上发现了一具男性人类尸体，已经被邪魔族技术和工具活体解剖看不出原形。我们的技术鉴定得出结论，罹难之人是你们的无尽森林典狱长，奥斯里斯。

我虽然不会透露我们确定的方法的具体细节，但是我可以向你保证，它们是非常仔细彻底的。这个消息毫无疑问会让你非常震惊，因为你那里还有一个名垂一线的奥斯里斯。但那不是他，尽管艾可拉·蕾伊已经确认了他的身份。她对她的导师的崇拜已经影响了她的判断力，让她无法辨别一个冒牌货，显然这种情况再次发生了。在卡巴尔中，我们可不允许一个受尊敬的领导者第2 3次失误。

我不知道巫妖女王留给你一个陷入昏迷的冒牌货的目的是什么，也不知道他可能最终变成什么：一个窃听器、一个未来的内奸、还是一个活体炸弹？但你要知道：当萨瓦图恩将希乌阿拉斯带到我的门前时，她就是戴着一个我所信任的顾问的面具。你在高塔中没有宝藏，而我也相信你能像卡巴尔一样处理这个问题。

——女帝查厄托D

1250196973.name: Ikora II
1250196973.text:
Intentions, no matter how lofty, damn us just as thoroughly as our sins.

My one responsibility to the Guardians—to humanity—was to keep our secrets safe, and I failed. Our greatest enemy strolled into the nerve center of the Tower, and I showed her our beating heart without question because she preyed on my nostalgia.

So now you find yourself  answering to a Vanguard of one. In quick succession, the line of duty has consumed first Cayde and now me. Only Zavala seems immune to such tragedy. Is it simply luck, or is it ambition? For all his honor, Zavala was a brute before he claimed to hear the Traveler's call,  but now I wonder if I didn't underestimate his cunning as well. 

Don't let my failures compromise your chance to save us all, Guardian. Humanity needs a champion unshackled from politics. You need to chase down Savathûn's scattered memories no matter who tries to stop you—whether they're from the Throne World or the Last City. And be wary. If Zavala is a threat we didn't see coming, you'd be wise to watch yourself: find insurances, ways to seem useful to him. Do whatever it takes to ensure your safety, just in case this jinx on powerful Guardians doesn't end with me. Don't follow poor Cayde- 8's fate.

I trust you and you alone to follow this through. You're wily enough to stay ahead of our Light-wielding enemies.

—Ikora Rey
1250196973.text_zh:
意图，无论多么崇高，都会和我们的罪恶一样让我们万劫不复。

我对于守护者——对于人类的一大责任就是保护我们的秘密安全，而我失败了。我们最大的敌人潜入了我们的高塔中心，而我在怀旧的驱使下，将我们跳动的心脏毫无保留地展示给了她。

所以你现在1a听命于先锋整体。先锋的工作先是带走了凯德，而现在轮到我了。只有萨瓦拉看上去没有受到如此悲剧的影响。是幸运，还是野心？抛开他的荣耀，在萨瓦拉声称听到旅行者的召唤之前，他就是个暴君，1b而现在我怀疑我是不是也低估了他的狡猾。 

别让我的失败影响你拯救我们的机会，守护者。人类需要一个不受政治约束的勇士。不论谁阻止你，你都需要找到萨瓦图恩破碎的记忆——不论这些阻力来自王座世界或是圣城。小心些。如果萨瓦拉使我们没有遇见到的威胁，那么你需要照顾好自己：让自己看上去对他有用。不惜一切保证自己的安全，以防这个对强大守护者的诅咒不是到我为止。别走可怜的凯德6号的老路。

我只把这条消息托付给你。你的智慧足以领先我们那些使用光能的敌人们。

——艾可拉·蕾伊I

1250196974.name: Toland I
1250196974.text:
Odd communication technique, but costly. Thought to phoneme to mark to digital signal. Each transmutation yields less than the input; the  alchemy of conception. Read well, Guardian, for less of value has filtered through these transitions, and you must slake yourself on only the anhydrate wisdoms that remain.

I witness your crude battering against the shores of Savathûn's throne world; causal flotsam adrift in the Sea of Screams. Your flailings stir storms on its waters as surely as a firefly lights conflagrations. And yet, you persist. Why wouldn't you? Stubbornness, glutted by fear, stirs  a Guardian to every cause. You tempered yourself in the Light and the Dark to become a blade that would not break. And despite that keen crucible of obstinance, you lack the true will for genius.

You bow to the Traveler, Guardian, and you must lose because Savathûn bows to a mightier master—the same master to whom the Traveler genuflects: survival. That is their shared secret, and what makes them strong: a purer reagent with which to alloy. They are siblings, possessed of the same valence electrons. 

The same Light-Dark temper has  distilled for you an ally.

And ever the Guardian, you thirst for the briny waters of conflict that you know, ignoring the sweeter, fresh flow that bursts from the vessel.

Savathûn will be the universe's salvation, hero. She can be yours, too, if only you cast down the bitter draught of old allegiance on which you have grown drunk.

—Toland
1250196974.text_zh:
奇怪的通讯技术，而且代价很大。思想转化为音符再转化为笔记最后化为数字信号。每种转变都会有部分失真；这就是1a炼金的概念。好好阅读，守护者，这些内容的价值已经在数次转化中流失了很多了，而你必须靠仅剩的这些智慧来满足自己。

我见证了你对萨瓦图恩王座世界的海岸进行的残酷打击；因果的残碎品在尖叫的海洋中漂浮。你的击打激起了水面上的风暴，就像萤火虫点燃了大火。然而，你还在继续。你为什么不呢？被恐惧所充斥的固执，会激发1a一个守护者去追求每一个目标。你在光明与黑暗中磨练自己，成为一把不会折断的剑。尽管你固执己见，但你缺乏真正的天才意志。

你向旅行者低头，守护者，那你必将失败，因为萨瓦图恩所侍奉的主人更加强大——那是曾让旅行者都屈服的主人：生存。这是他们共享的秘密，也是让他们强大的根源：一种可以支撑合金的更纯的试剂。它们是同族，拥有相同的价电子。 

相同的光影锻造为你1d提炼的一个盟友。

而作为守护者，你渴望着你所熟悉的冲突的咸水，忽略了从容器中喷涌而出的甘甜、新鲜的水流。

萨瓦图恩会是宇宙的救赎、英雄。她也可以是你的，只要你能放弃你那固执的旧忠就好了。

——托兰O

1250196975.name: Zavala I
1250196975.text:
X-ray laser emplacements can rip the protons from a ship's hull, redefining what each atom is and triggering explosions as each individual molecule realizes it can no longer exist. And yet that damage pales in comparison to the harm secrecy can cause. While Hunters may prefer to act with their targets unaware, and Warlocks may prefer subterfuge and trickery, a proper Titan conducts his business for all to see. But for Ikora's sake, I am willing to bend my principals—her mistakes and the questions that surround them are already all too public. And so, I find myself in the unenviable position of approaching you, Guardian, clandestinely.

Sadly, my concerns around Ikora are what bring me to you. I know my old friend. She carries her mistakes heavier than anyone else, and giving up the Light to Savathûn may be too much for her to bear. I can see the cracks forming in her resolve. 

The Vanguard needs  3 leaders to reflect the needs and perspectives of Earth. I need your help to start course correcting our current trajectory. I will not disgrace Ikora by removing her from her position, but her own flagellations are compromising her awareness and interfering with her ability to keep this city safe. I need a spymaster who can work from Ikora's shadow even—or especially—when she compromises herself, and you are already familiar with her work. I know that eventually, Ikora will welcome the freedom of stepping away from the undue burden of her responsibilities. And once things quiet down, we will make your position more formal. Until then, know I support your decisions and will  back whatever changes you must make.

I know this is no simple request, to entrust you with uncovering our enemies' secrets, and with saving my dearest friend's life.

—Commander Zavala
1250196975.text_zh:
X射线激光装置可以撕裂船体上的质子，重新定义每个原子，并在每个单独的分子意识到自己不再存在时引发爆炸。然而，与秘密可能造成的损害相比，这种伤害就相形见绌了。猎人可能更喜欢在目标不知情的情况下行动，术士可能更喜欢使用诡计和诡计，而一个真正的泰坦会让所有人看到他的工作。但为了艾可拉，我愿意让在原则上做出让步——她的错误和周围的问题已经太过公开了。所以，我发现自己处于一个不值得羡慕的位置，我必须秘密地找你了，守护者。

不幸的是，我对艾可拉的关心是让我来找你的原因。我了解我的老朋友。她对她的错误比谁看得都更重些，而将光能放弃给萨瓦图恩可能超过了她忍受的范围。我都能看到她的决心出现了裂痕。 

先锋需要2 3个领导人来反应地球上的事物和需求。我需要你的帮助来纠正我们目前的道路。我不会解除她的职位，这对她是一种侮辱。但她自身的鞭挞已经对她造成了困扰也影响了她保护圣城安全的能力。我需要一个大师间谍，在艾可拉的影子里进行工作——特别是，当她妥协的时候，而你已经熟悉她的工作了。我知道，最终艾可拉会喜欢没有她那些责任重担的自由生活。而当一切都风平浪静之后，我们会让你的位置变得更加正式。在那之前，你要知道我是支持你的决定并会1b为你想要进行的改变提供帮助的。

我知道这不是一个简单的任务，但我相信你能发现我们敌人的秘密，并拯救我最亲密的朋友的生命。

——指挥官萨瓦拉X

1250196960.name: Eris II
1250196960.text:
SENDER: ERI-223
DECRYPTION KEY: QF4LYZX16G$IKO-223
SUBJECT: And She Persists 

Ice strangles bare branches by winter, and yet roots churn unseen. Spring always comes, and with it, the fruits of perseverance. Similarly, the Books of Sorrow burst with tales of the Witch Queen's cycle of death and return, so do not become complacent. Savathûn is a cunning foe. I will only be shocked if her machinations do not continue to bedevil us for some time yet.

You have bested Savathûn. At least, for all appearances. That is the only assurance we have in facing an enemy who works so subtly on so many different fronts. I still labor to uproot the filaments she spun into our intelligence networks during her tenure as Osiris. Thankfully, a great many have become more obvious without her constant maintenance.

You should be aware that Savathûn took a particular interest in you, and I have uncovered her infiltration of hidden communication channels. It's likely she is responsible for one or more false missives in an attempt to undermine your loyalties or redirect your goals. But her schemes invariably serve multiple agendas; while she works to sway with her words, she encodes secrets to erode your subconscious as well. It is possible one may pick apart these ulterior agendas with a cautious eye, and so I recommend reviewing any communications you have received to search for unusual elements. 

Report anything you uncover to Ikora or me.
1250196960.text_zh:
发送者： ERI-223
密钥： QF4LYZX16G$IKO-223
主题：而她在坚持 

冬天，冰扼住了光秃秃的树枝，但树根却在无形之中翻腾。春天总会来，而与之同来的，是坚韧的果实。与此相似，忧愁之书充满了巫妖女王生死往复循环的故事，所以不要自满。萨瓦图恩是个狡诈的对手。如果她的阴谋诡计没有继续困扰我们一段时间，那我才会感到震惊。

你击败了萨瓦图恩。至少，目前看来是这样的。这是我们在面对这一在不同战线上都表现微妙的敌人时，所有的唯一的定心丸。我仍在努力产出她在假冒奥斯里斯时渗透进我们情报网络中的丝丝缕缕。值得庆幸的是，现在没了她的定期维护，很多隐藏的线索都变得更清晰了。

你应该知道，萨瓦图恩对你特别感兴趣，而我发现了她对隐秘者通讯频道的渗透。所以有可能她伪造了一个或几个虚假的信函，为了动摇你的忠诚或重新定义你的目标。但她的计划总是为多个目标服务；在她花言巧语的同时，她也安插了一些秘密来腐蚀你的潜意识。一个人可能通过敏锐的观察找出这些不可告人的目标，所以我建议你重新查看你所收到的所有通讯，寻找其中不同寻常的元素。 

将你发现的任何事情汇报给艾可拉或者我。

903781536.name: I - Violent Tributaries
903781536.text:
Saladin awakens. Not from sleep. Nothing so gentle.

From death? No. Not yet. From lost consciousness… for how long? 

He moves to stand. His feet drift without friction. No ground below him. Falling—no, floating. Pine needles sway in a sea of surrounding green haze. Sunrays plunge through the canopy above and wash over him. His head is lost in the arbor row's motion.

Intermittent feeling prickles the skin beneath his tarnished armor. Saladin reflexively attempts to raise his off-hand to summon Isirah. Numbness responds. He must be hit. He cycles breath through his lungs and sorts instinct from reason. He twists to see the wound. Nerves blaze corkscrews through his neck. Panic—no. No need. Pain he could abide. Reality clarifies. 

The Iron Lord hangs from a branch run through his shoulder back to front, 10 centimeters thick. What good was his damn armor? Saladin traces a thick flow of blood down his arm as it breaks into tributaries before reuniting at his fingertips. Droplets pool some 60 meters below, soon to soak into the soil and fade. Beside the pool lay a splintered rocket launcher he'd forged from a reclaimed mortar, dropped when he lost consciousness. Saladin flexes against the axe strapped to his backplate; wood grinds against his load-bearing collarbone. He grimaces as he lifts his head to gaze at the cliff above.

Smoke rises from a burnt crescent impact, blown clean into the cliff's edge; a recent scar left by an artillery shell meant for Saladin's road-cruiser. Raiders, he thinks. An ambush. He connects incident to meaning: someone looking to make an example of a Lord who dared to venture beyond their territory. Radegast had warned him of Risen thugs fleeing to the far wilds to escape the Iron Lords' reach. He had told Saladin of their hostility. Their lawlessness. Saladin would tame it.

Binocular reflection catches his sight over the smoldering cliff, looking down in his direction. Unfamiliar voices echo across the rocks. A figure calls out, and others join them. Between hacking coughs, Saladin counts half a dozen hostiles. His fingers ache with chill, and his lungs sting as if coated in rime. He exhales unsteadily. For a moment, Saladin imagines Lady Jolder plunging through the clouds, booming with laughter. He imagines her obliterating the cliffside with a colossal javelin of Arc lightning without hesitation. These nameless men die, and she keeps laughing until Saladin joins. His near miss becomes an embarrassing story embellished round a campfire until another takes its place, and it is forgotten. Lucidity falters, and in this moment, he can almost breathe the ash. Smell the stormy night air. Feel the warmth of the fire, of his friends. As real as worn memories, rosed with age.

Light condenses into Saladin's fingers. Arc lines fork across the bark as he grips the branch impaled through his shoulder. It hooks upward from his chest; better to break it, he thinks. Fingers dig and scorch pulp. They bite in and twist. Wood pops and splinters as a bullet snaps through the pine canopy behind him. Then another, closer this time as the sound of rifle fire echoes down the cliff face. Saladin focuses his Light into the edge of his palm and slashes the splintered branch free, leaving him dangling on a stub of wood. He takes a shaky breath and swings a tingling leg back to push off the trunk behind him, bracing his boot to support his weight against the wood and lift his bone clear from the branch. His armor is slick with blood now, and he can feel a fracture in his bone. Pain he can abide. He recites it as mantra. The dive to the ground below would be dangerous. Saladin prepares to push off and jump.

A round strikes his armored torso, knocking the air from his lungs. His foot slips and kicks out violently. His weight shifts on the broken branch, catching hard on his collar and sending fissures through his fractured bone. Saladin roars over the gunfire and grips his shoulder.

"Isirah! Get. Me. Off. This. Branch," he snarls.

His Ghost materializes before him. "I taught you better than to rely on me," Isirah reproves him. She swoops behind Saladin for cover. "You're not dead yet. You're capable of this." 

Saladin strains to regain his footing. He lifts his head and wheezes as his lungs expand. Several figures above congregate around a large object, a blur of metal he recognizes as a flak cannon.

"I yield," Saladin laughs weakly. 

"What would you do if I weren't here, Forge? If I'd been killed?" His Ghost taps the back of his head with a pellet of Light. "It's just you and your Light. What little you have left."

Him and his Light against a weapon of war. But they were just men, and he: a fiend of fire. 

Saladin conjures waning star-fire from his bones: the last vestiges of his will, burnt as offering to the Light. Flame billows and radiates through his flesh, swirling between the gaps in his armor, moving to consume the branch. Sap hemorrhages in hissing bubbles from the wood around him. Flames overtake the branch, joining those building from the Iron Lord's armor. Ash wisps upward on agitated, anabatic wind. With a pop, he descends into freefall.

Branches snap against his legs as he picks up speed. Saladin gropes for the axe on his back with his good hand. As fingers find hilt, and Solar Light engulfs the weapon. He swings the axe from its strap and sinks the flaming blade into the tree, slowing his descent and carving a wake of sparking embers toward the forest floor. The pull threatens to rend him apart. He holds until he can hold no longer and plummets the final 10 meters: wreckage striking bedrock with a wet thud.

Blood-vapor steams from the charred forest floor around him as he comes to. Overhead, the forest canopy explodes with a flak shell detonation. Fragmentation whistles through the air, showering the forest with ragged chunks of metal. Saladin kicks off the trunk at his feet and rolls his ravaged body onto his rocket launcher. Muscle threatens to separate as he hoists the launcher to his shoulder. Saladin howls, a wounded beast's final challenge. He presses the split launcher shut with his forearm and welds the metal with Solar heat before fumbling to find the trigger. Another shell booms; dense pine canopy opens momentarily from the blast wave. Saladin sees a clean line to the ridge, takes aim, and squeezes. He watches the rocket fly as shards of flak-iron carve lines through his face.
903781536.text_zh:
萨拉丁醒了，但不是从睡梦中醒来。他醒得并不和缓。

是从死亡中醒来吗？不对。时候未到。他失去意识…有多久了？

他起身站了起来。他的双脚没有摩擦力地走着。在他脚下没有地面。他在坠落吗？不对，他在漂浮着。松针在周围绿色雾气的海洋中摆动着。阳光穿过头顶的树冠，照在他的身上。他的脑袋迷失在一行行运动的乔木之中。

他破旧盔甲下的皮肤断断续续地刺痛着。萨拉丁条件反射般试图举起右手召唤伊赛拉。只感到一阵麻木。他一定是被击中了。他深吸了一口气，将本能从理性中抽离出来。他扭动身子去看看伤口。神经状的树痕在他脖子里螺旋式转动着。他没有理由慌乱。他能忍受这种疼痛。现实变得明晰了起来。

钢铁领主被挂在了一根贯穿他肩膀的树枝上。树枝足足有十厘米厚。他那该死的盔甲有什么用？萨拉丁循着一股从他手臂上流下，在他的指尖上分叉成支流，接着又重新汇集的浓稠血流看去。血滴汇集在大约六十米的下方。很快，血就会被土壤吸净。在血泊旁躺着一个分裂开的火箭发射器，由回收而来的迫击炮铸造而成，在他昏迷时掉落了下去。萨拉丁屈身靠着绑在他后背上的斧头。木头在他担负重量的锁骨上摩擦。他痛苦地皱着脸，抬起头凝视着上方的悬崖。

烟雾从燃烧的新月形撞痕中升起，在悬崖边缘消散。这道痕迹来自瞄准萨拉丁的巡路摩托的炮弹。是突袭者，他心想。这是个埋伏。他把事情和背后的意义联系起来；有人想要杀一儆百，警告胆敢越界的领主。拉德加斯特曾警告过他，要小心那些为了躲避钢铁领主的追捕逃往遥远荒野的复生者。他曾告诉过萨拉丁他们的敌意，他们的目无法度。萨拉丁有心将其驯服。

他发现冒烟的悬崖上有望远镜的反光，正朝他的方向望来。陌生的声音在岩石间回荡，有个人影在呼喊，其他人也加入其中。萨拉丁在剧烈的咳嗽声间发现了十几个敌人。他的手指被冻得生疼，肺也好像被一层雾凇包裹着。他虚弱地呼出一口气。有那么一瞬间，萨拉丁想象着欧德夫人穿过云层，笑声不绝于耳。在他的想象中，她毫不犹豫地用一把巨大的电弧标枪消灭了悬崖边上的敌人。这些无名之辈死去了，而她在萨拉丁到来之前都在大笑不停。他的死里逃生将成为一个在篝火旁被添油加醋的尴尬故事，直到另一个故事取而代之才会被遗忘。清醒的意识逐渐衰弱。此时，他几乎能呼吸到灰烬，嗅到狂风骤雨的夜空，感受到火焰、朋友的温暖。就像破旧的记忆一样真实，被岁月浸染成玫瑰色。

光能凝聚在萨拉丁的手指里。他抓住那根穿过他肩膀的树枝时，电弧刺穿了树皮。它从下网上钩进了他的胸膛里；最好折断它，他心想。他手指一使劲，烧焦的木浆便流了出来。他抓紧树枝，继续使劲扭动着它。一颗子弹打穿了他身后的松木树冠，枝头砰的一声碎裂了。接着又来了一发，这次更近。来复枪的射击声从悬崖上传来。萨拉丁把他的光能集中在他的手掌边缘，劈断了断裂的树枝，悬在一根木桩上。他颤抖地吸了一口气，向后摆动不断刺痛的腿，踢开身后的树干，靠着木头支撑着自重，将他的骨头从树枝上抬起来。他的盔甲现在沾满鲜血，他能感觉到骨头骨折了。他能忍受这种疼痛。他把这句话当作祷词来诵读。俯冲到地面很危险。萨拉丁准备铆一把劲，跳下去。

一颗子弹击中了他身披装甲的躯干，将他肺里的空气一下子推了出去。他的脚一滑，整个人便猛地栽了出去。他的重心落在了断裂的树枝上，而树枝正好紧紧地挂住了他的衣领，使骨折的骨头裂得更开了。萨拉丁牢牢抓住自己的肩膀，在枪声中怒吼。

“伊赛拉！把我从这树枝上弄下来，”他咆哮道。

他的机灵显现在他面前。“我教过你最好不要依赖我，”伊赛拉责备他道。她俯冲到萨拉丁身后作掩护。“你还没有死。你自己能行。”

萨拉丁竭力恢复着身体的平衡。他抬起头，随着肺部扩张喘息着。上面的几个人影围在一个大物体周围；那是一团模糊的金属，而他认出那是一架高射炮。



“我投降，”萨拉丁无力地笑了。“弗吉，如果我不在这儿，你会怎么办？如果我被杀了呢？”他的机灵用一枚光能弹片轻拍着他的后脑勺。“只剩下你和你的光能。所剩无几的一切。”

这是他和他的光能与一台战争武器的对决。但对方只是凡人，而他是火焰的恶魔。

萨拉丁从他的骨头中召唤出逐渐熄灭的星火：他意志最后的残留，作为光能祭品燃烧着。火焰在他的血肉中翻滚，在他盔甲的缝隙间腾转，吞噬掉了树枝。树液从他周围的木头中渗出嘶嘶的血泡。火焰越过树枝，加入了那些从钢铁领主盔甲上燃起的火舌。缕缕灰烬在躁动的上坡风中向上飘扬。砰的一声，他进入了自由落体状态。

他的速度越来越快，树枝蹭过他的腿上噼啪作响。萨拉丁用他完好的那只手摸索着背上的斧头。当他的手指触到斧柄时，烈日光能瞬间覆盖住了这把武器。他把斧头从背带上抡起，将燃烧的斧刃插进树里，减缓他的下降速度，并在林地上划出一道火花四溅的余烬。这股拉力仿佛要把他撕成碎片。他一直坚持到撑不下去，在最后十米处垂直坠了下去：像残骸般摔在基岩上，发出湿漉漉的撞击声。

当他苏醒过来时，血汽从他周围烧焦的林地上蒸腾而出。在头顶上，树冠正随着高射炮弹的引爆而炸开。碎片从空中呼啸而过，在森林里洒满了破烂的金属块。萨拉丁踢开脚下的树干，把他饱经摧残的身体滚到了他的火箭发射器上。当他把发射器举到肩上时，肌肉疼痛得几近分离。萨拉丁发出了嚎叫声：一头受伤野兽的最后挑战。他用前臂按住裂开的发射器，用烈日的热量焊接着金属，然后摸索着找到扳机。又一发炮弹发出轰鸣声：密集的松树树冠被爆炸波瞬间炸开。萨拉丁看到一条通向山脊的清晰线路，于是瞄好武器，扣下了扳机。他顶着无数划过面颊的高射炮铁片，凝视着飞走的火箭弹。

903781539.name: II - Wake
903781539.text:
Burning grass fills Saladin's nostrils like smelling salts. He stirs from the abyss into a new life, back pressed against a towering pine that smolders with heat. Saladin blinks blurriness from his eyes to see the crater on the cliff where his rocket struck. Good, he thinks, picking fragments of metal from his plate. Isirah sinks through the smoke just overhead and levitates in front of his face, Light still coursing through her frame.

"Welcome back. You lost," Isirah says, her voice smooth as verglas.

"It was a draw." Saladin stands and fumbles with a talisman hanging from his neck. He tucks the stamped iron insignia into the gorget of his armor. "They're dead, aren't they?"

"There are a million raiders and one of you," Isirah snaps. She drifts into his eyeline. "A draw is a loss. We need to do better than that."

"We?" Saladin narrows his eyes and yanks his stuck axe from the scorched trunk and slings it.

"Fix what you break." Isirah had imparted this lesson many times. "You should have opened fire on the road without hesitation. I warned you they were bait."

"How long are you going to rest your laurels on that prediction?" Saladin groans.

Isirah's shell tightens like a coiling viper. "Do you have a plan from here?"

"Continue sweeping east. The broadcast code might have been Golden Age, but the signal was weak when we caught it. Can't be far, and our patrol can wait until we clear this up."

"Fine observation. I agree," the Ghost says curtly, floating off ahead.

Saladin looks to the burning pine and uncuffs his gauntlet. Strands of ruddy leather stick beneath his nails as he removes the glove and presses his hand to bark. This tree had likely stood for centuries, roots deep in the soil, branches carving territory into the greater forest. So it was for many other trees. They all had their space—a crown shyness shared by old things. One born in this forest might assume this tree had always been. 

He feels the warmth radiating from the roasting heartwood above; Light still crackles in the ember-split wood. His Light. Left alone, it would destroy this old pine, consume it from the inside out. Saladin anchors the Light to his core and commands it to return, dousing the burn. The tree will heal, and today's wound will fade. This gouge marks a point of struggle surpassed, and given enough time, will fade into familiarity.

"Someone is coming," Isirah reports in a quiet voice.
