OWL-7-CaDu: It concerns me, that's for sure. There's almost a direct 1:1 transaction correlation between data leaving the Leviathan—a great deal of it, mind you—and the psychoactive Pyramid projections we're seeing flood INTO the Leviathan.
 
OWL-3-RaGo: If that's true, then the material destabilizations we're seeing from the Leviathan… the Pyramid may be the source for all of it. 

OWL-7-CaDu: Do we have an updated ETA on the Leviathan spectral analysis from the H.E.L.M.? That might give us some additional answers.

OWL-3-RaGo: Forty-five percent of the analysis remains… not surprising, though—the Leviathan is quite large. In the meantime, we should contact Lab-C for updates on Eg-999. I'm curious to see what, if any, connection exists to the Pyramid.

OWL-1-ShLi: I've got some bad news there. The analysis can't be completed.

OWL-3-RaGo: What? Why?

OWL-1-ShLi: Safety protocols, repeated containment breaches. All Earth-side lab samples of the egregore fungus were incinerated.

OWL-3-RaGo: …

OWL-1-ShLi: BUT a certain Hidden contact, Eris Morn, has informed me that the fungus is similar to a synapse within a nervous system. She claims it is a physical manifestation of the Darkness, like Stasis. But unlike Stasis, it appears to be an "impure" manifestation—her words, not mine.

OWL-7-CaDu: There are a lot of implications there.

OWL-1-ShLi: Morn never delivers a lack of implications with her theories. In any case, I suggest we make a note and move on for now. Our best path to understanding is still a spectral analysis of the signals the Leviathan is throwing out and deciphering their meaning.
623842790.text_zh:
//OWL通讯聊天4：行动，日志，迈达斯-003//
//档案权限指定：VG-GREEN//

OWL-3-RaGo：卡姆林，我看了你发来的关于利维坦和月球金字塔之间联系的报告。其中有些细节让人十分警觉。

OWL-7-CaDu：确实很让我担忧。离开利维坦的数据——请注意，这可是大量的数据——和我们看到涌入利维坦的金字塔灵能投影之间几乎存在着1:1的影响关联。
 
OWL-3-RaGo：如果这是真的，那我们从利维坦上看到的实体扰动…金字塔可能就是这一切的源头。 

OWL-7-CaDu：来自应急后勤行动中心的利维坦光谱分析有最新的预计抵达时间吗？那也许能给我们带来更多的答案。

OWL-3-RaGo：还剩下45%的分析…不过这也不奇怪——利维坦相当庞大。与此同时，我们应该联系Lab-C获取Eg-999的更新信息。我很好奇这和金字塔之间有什么样的联系，如果有的话。

OWL-1-ShLi：我带来了坏消息。分析工作无法完成。

OWL-3-RaGo：什么？为什么？

OWL-1-ShLi：安全协议，反复的遏制失效。所有地球实验室的守望者真菌样本都被焚化了。

OWL-3-RaGo：…

OWL-1-ShLi：但是某个隐秘者线人，埃里斯·摩恩，告诉过我这种真菌类似于神经系统里的突触。她说这是暗影的实体具象，就像冰影一样。但与冰影不同，这似乎是一种“不纯”的具象——她的原话，不是我说的。

OWL-7-CaDu：这里头有很多暗示。

OWL-1-ShLi：摩恩的理论从来不缺暗示。无论如何，我建议我们先做个记录，然后继续下去。我们想获得了解的最佳途径，仍然是对利维坦发出的信号进行光谱分析并破译其含义。

611615675.name: Horus Shell
611615675.subtitle: One day you will be whole again. No matter how many pieces you have shattered into.
611615675.subtitle_zh: 总有一天你会再度完整。无论你分裂成了多少块碎片。
611615675.text:
Electric lights recessed above the airstair of Saint-14's jumpship buzz, punctuated by the occasional plink from a loose ballast. The mechanical din is reminiscent of insects, a subtlety normally lost to the noise of the Tower's Hangar. But the area is quiet at this hour, long before dawn, the absence of activity felt deeper. Lonelier. 

Saint sits on the steps beneath his ship, a dog-eared journal clasped in his large hands. The bronze eye embossed on the cover marks it as belonging to Osiris. A delicate lock conceals the contents; Saint's thumb teases the corner of the clasp. It would take insignificant effort to break it—a significant violation of Osiris's privacy. Still, the temptation pulls at his fingers.

Geppetto, Saint's Ghost, transmats in over his shoulder. "Call for you," she says with a glance down to the journal and then affixes a firm eye of judgment on him. The Titan shrinks away from her stare.

"Put it through," Saint says. He welcomes a distraction.

"Saint." Mithrax's voice comes loud and clear through Geppetto. "I… did not expect you to answer. It seems we are both unable to find proper rest."

"Yes," Saint agrees in a small voice, his attention wavering. "What… was it you needed, Mithrax?"

"We have a supply shipment that just came in," Mithrax says with a hint of hope in his voice. "We could use another set of hands." 

Saint does not immediately reply as he runs one hand over the journal. Geppetto nudges him, and he sighs, setting the journal aside. "I can help," he says. "You point, I lift, right?" His weary laugh is telling.

"That's good to hear. Eido has been looking forward to seeing you again," Mithrax says, gently. Saint nods to himself, slowly rising from the steps. Geppetto zips over and transmats the journal back to Saint's home in a crackling stream of light.

"Thank you for thinking of me, friend," Saint says over his shoulder. Geppetto looks to him, unsure if his words were directed at her or Mithrax. But then, she realizes:

It was both.
611615675.text_zh:
内嵌在圣人-14号跃迁飞船舷梯上方的电灯所发出的嗡鸣声，偶尔会被松动的压舱物发出的叮当声打断。机械的喧闹声让人不禁想起了昆虫，这种微妙的声音常常会被高塔机库的噪音所掩盖。但这个时候这块地方很安静，离破晓还早，一片死寂的感觉更加深刻。更加孤独。 

圣人坐在飞船下的台阶上，大手里紧握着一本折了角的日记。封面上的青铜眼浮雕表明着它属于奥斯里斯。一把精致的锁将里面的东西隐藏起来；圣人的拇指拨弄着扣环的一角。破解它花不了多少功夫，这是对奥斯里斯隐私的严重侵犯。尽管如此，诱惑仍在拉扯着他的手指。

圣人的机灵盖比特，越过他的肩膀传送了进来。“你的电话，”她说着瞥了一眼日记，然后坚定地审视着他。这名泰坦顿时畏缩了起来。

“接进来，”圣人说道。他正需要分散一下注意力。

“圣人。”透过盖比特，米瑟拉克斯的声音响亮而清晰。“我…没想到你会接。看来我们俩都没法好好休息。”

“没错，”圣人小声表示同意，他的注意力摇摆不定。“需要我做什么吗，米瑟拉克斯？”

“我们刚刚收到一批补给，”米瑟拉克斯的声音中透着一丝希望。“需要人搭把手。” 

圣人没有立即回应，他用一只手翻着日记。盖比特推了推他，他叹了口气，把日记放在一边。“我可以帮忙，”他说。“你来指，我来搬，是吧？”他发出了疲倦的笑声。

“那太好了。艾多一直期待再次见到你，”米瑟拉克斯轻声说道。圣人暗自点点头，慢慢从台阶上站起来。盖比特拉上锁，在一道噼啪作响的光流中把日记传送回了圣人的家。

“谢谢你能想到我，朋友，”圣人回过头说道。盖比特看着他，不确定他是在跟谁说话，她还是米瑟拉克斯。但随后，她意识到：

那是对他们俩说的。

3715419678.name: Tymbal Lucidae
3715419678.subtitle: I've retraced my steps a hundred times searching for a memory.
3715419678.subtitle_zh: 我回顾足迹上百次，只为寻得一段记忆。
3715419678.text:
Zavala hums to himself in the dead of night to keep his eyes from sliding shut. His office window is tinted in opaque digitization, leaving the commander's face awash in shimmering variance. He fiddles with a data pad headlining a lengthy and dense report from Eris Morn entitled, "The Imminent Threat." 

He sighs. He has read many reports just like this one. He recognizes the importance, but his urgency has eroded after yet another call to action.

"Targe." Zavala sees the Ghost perk up.

"Zavala?"

"Would you play ambient-SH9?"

"I can do that," Targe acknowledges. There is a brief delay before the Ghost emits a peaceful rustling, reminiscent of torch fire nestled in starlit wilderness. Soon, cicadas sing. Zavala places the data pad face down on his desk and sinks into his chair; his eyelids set under heavy night. He drifts in liminal consciousness—once removed—thoughts blend into dreams.

Zavala could smell the wildflowers. Burning wood from a fire, warming the air. A perfect, timeless mundanity. There is honey tea and the dull vanilla-musk of Safiyah's tomes. She was with him, beside him, vibrant and striking and deep in the study of her book. He loved her most when he could watch her mind work. 

His hands moved absentmindedly as knitting needles clacked, yarn weaving between them. Early evening stretched out before him; his son's infant silhouette traced into the violet sky. The air thrummed with the cicada's song. Hakim traipsed through the meadow as a child, stood a boy, and flickered forward through adolescence in rotoscoped evolution until, when he stepped in front of his father, he was almost a man. Zavala laughed to himself with prideful disbelief at the sight of his son.

Hakim beckoned him; Zavala set aside his needles and stood. He turned to Safiyah and kissed her. They followed their son into the meadow, and as they walk, lucidity smears back into the shimmering night, where the air is calm but the cicadas still sing.
3715419678.text_zh:
夜深人静，萨瓦拉自己哼着小曲儿，不让眼皮闭上。他办公室的窗户经过了不透光的数字化染色处理，让这名指挥官的脸上布满了闪闪发光的色彩变化。他摆弄着一块数据板，上面写着埃里斯·摩恩的一份冗长而难懂的报告，题为《迫在眉睫的威胁》。 

他叹了口气。他读过很多类似的报告。他意识到这一问题的重要性，但在又一次呼吁采取行动过后，他的紧迫感已经减弱。

“塔格。”萨瓦拉看到机灵活跃了起来。

“萨瓦拉？”

“你能放下环境音乐-SH9吗？”

“好的，”塔格答应道。一阵短暂的延迟过后，机灵发出了平静的沙沙声，让人想起星光照耀的荒野中燃烧的火把。很快，蝉声鸣叫起来。萨瓦拉将数据板面朝下盖在桌子上，陷进椅子里；他的眼皮在浓重的夜色下耷拉着。他游离于边缘意识——一经消除——思绪就会融入梦境。

萨瓦拉能嗅到野花的香味。火堆里燃烧的木头，温暖着空气。完美而永恒的尘俗。既有蜂蜜茶，也有萨菲亚的书卷隐隐的香草麝香。她和他在一起，就在他身边，神采奕奕、引人注目，正埋头研究着她的书。他最喜欢看她思考的样子。 

他的双手心不在焉地移动着，织针咔哒作响，纱线在它们之间编织着。黄昏在他面前铺展开来；他儿子的孩童侧影映入紫罗兰色的天空。空气中回荡着蝉鸣。哈基姆在草地上蹒跚学步时还是个孩子，站在身来已是个年轻小伙子，青春期在转描成长中一闪而过，直到他站在父亲面前，几乎长大成人。看到儿子如此出类拔萃，萨瓦拉骄傲地笑了起来。

哈基姆向他招手；萨瓦拉把针放在一边，站了起来。他转向萨菲亚，吻了吻她。他们跟着儿子来到草地上，走着走着，清醒的神志一阵模糊，又回到了这个闪闪发光的夜晚，这儿空气很平静，但蝉鸣依然不止。

477192673.name: Hushed Syrinx
477192673.subtitle: "I'm glad you're staying."
477192673.text:
Out of his armor, laid in a sterile bed and clothed in linen, Osiris looks thin and frail. Age wears lines into his face deeper than the trenches of Mercury. His chest rises and falls with slow breaths, and the ambient light provided by the surrounding medical equipment casts him in a pale blue shade, darkening the hollows beneath his eyes. He is a threadbare remnant of a man.

In contrast, Saint-14 is a mountain. Even seated at Osiris's bedside, the Titan looms over him like a gargoyle keeping watch. He looks at Osiris's hand, seemingly tiny, cradled within his own. There is so much fear in Saint's heart, so much doubt, and so much unspoken love. Too unspoken. Never again. Saint lifts Osiris's hand to his mouth and kisses his knuckles.

"I'm glad you're staying," Crow says, appearing in the doorway of the medical bay. Saint stands and only offers a silent nod in response, looking back at Osiris in a moment of uncertainty. Crow gives him a look of sympathy. "I understand."

"You do not." Saint's voice is tight, and Crow feels the shift in Saint's emotion. Not anger, but defensiveness. "Tell me something. Up there…" He points skyward, indicating the Leviathan in orbit over the Earth. "Your doubts, your shame—they come alive?"

Crow looks away for a moment, distracted by turbulent memories. "Yeah," he replies.

"That is why I do not go to help," Saint states in a firm tone. "Because—because I know Osiris will be waiting for me. Up there. And I… I cannot bear seeing another thing wearing his face."

Crow avoids Saint's gaze. He can feel the uneasy tension, palpable between them. Still, Crow steps forward and gently places a hand on Saint's arm. When he looks up into the Exo's eyes, it is not with judgment, but empathy.

Saint considers Crow's hand for a moment before drawing the Hunter into a tight embrace. 

"You are good bird. Thank you."
477192673.text_zh:
脱下盔甲，躺在无菌病床上，穿着亚麻布，奥斯里斯看起来非常瘦弱。岁月在他脸上留下的印迹比水星纹路还深。他的胸部随着缓慢的呼吸起起伏伏，附近医疗设备发出的光线将他投射在淡蓝色的阴影之中，映衬出他双眼底下凹陷的晦暗。他是个行将就木的人。

相比之下，圣人14号就是一座高山。即使是坐在奥斯里斯床边，这名泰坦依然在他上方像个石像鬼一样巍然屹立。他看着奥斯里斯的手，看上去十分小巧，握在他的手中。圣人的心中有如此多的恐惧，如此多的疑虑，如此多未曾说出口的爱。太多话未曾开口。再也不会了。圣人举起奥斯里斯的手放到嘴边，亲吻了他的指关节。

“我很高兴你留下来。”乌鸦说道，出现在医疗舱的门口。圣人站起身，只是默默地点头回应，带着片刻的犹豫回头看了眼奥斯里斯。乌鸦同情地回望着他。“我能理解。”

“你不能。”圣人的声音绷紧了，乌鸦感觉到了圣人情绪的转变。不是愤怒，而是自我防卫。“给我讲讲，在上面......”他指向天空，指着地球上空轨道上的利维坦。“你的疑虑，你的羞耻——它们活了过来？”

乌鸦移开视线，被混乱的记忆分散了注意力。“是的，”他回答道。

“这就是为什么我不去帮忙。”圣人用坚定的语气说道。“因为——因为我知道奥斯里斯会等着我。就在上头。而我…我不能眼睁睁看着另一个玩意顶着他的脸庞。”

乌鸦回避着圣人的注视。他能明显感觉到他们之间的剑拔弩张。尽管如此，乌鸦还是走上前去，轻轻地将一只手放在圣人的手臂上。当他抬头望向这名Exo的眼睛时，眼神里不是评判，而是共情。

圣人端详了片刻乌鸦的手，然后把猎人紧紧地搂在怀里。 

“你是一只好鸟。谢谢。”

3154754188.name: Mandate of Strength
3154754188.subtitle: "Might makes right."
3154754188.text:
Amanda Holliday cursed as she readjusted the jumpship's exhaust system. The Häkke foundry knew how to make a mean gun, but their aerospace engineering needed some improvement.

"Is this one of the new fighters?" The question came from a deep voice that rumbled across the H.E.L.M.'s hangar bay.

With a sigh, Amanda wheeled her creeper out from under the ship and rose to her feet. "Just a prototype, but—"

She dropped her wrench as she found herself face-to-face with Empress Caiatl. 

"I mean, yes, your… uh… majesty." Amanda wiped the grease off her palms.

Caiatl laid a hand on the jumpship's hull, fingers delicately brushing the metallic surface. "Crude," she said musingly, "but it evokes power and efficiency."

"Häkke's specialty," Amanda replied. "Function over form."

"I can appreciate that," said Caiatl. "In a war fought with Hive magic and Darkness, I welcome the simplicity of heavy ordnance."

Amanda chuckled, despite herself. "Yeah… I can drink to that."

Amanda's shoulders relaxed. She leaned against her workbench and waited for the empress to finish her inspection.

"I used to be a pilot," Caiatl said suddenly. "As I soared across the skies of Torobatl, I felt a freedom that eluded me on the ground. As if…" she trailed off, unable to find the words.

"As if you were leaving all your troubles behind," Amanda offered softly. Knowingly.

"Yes," Caiatl said and turned to leave. "I look forward to seeing the prototype in action. You will be the one to fly it?"

"Wouldn't trust it with anyone else."

Caiatl made a sound that Amanda thought could have been a laugh. "Nor I, Shipwright. The Vanguard is fortunate to have you."

She nodded a farewell, leaving Amanda to her work.
3154754188.text_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪一边咒骂着，一边重新调整跃迁飞船的排气系统。Häkke铸造厂知道如何制造一门好枪，但他们的航天工程还需要一些改进。

“这是一台新型战斗机吗？”这发问来自一个低沉的声音，在应急后勤行动中心的机库里隆隆作响。

阿曼达叹了口气，把她的机械爬行座椅从飞船下推了出来，站起身。“只是个原型机，不过——”

她发现自己面对着的是女帝查厄托，失手掉落了扳手。 

“我的意思是，是的，陛…呃…陛下。”阿曼达擦拭着手掌上的油脂。

查厄托将一只手放在跃迁飞船的船体上，手指轻轻地擦过金属表面。“很粗糙，”她若有所思地说，“但它带来了力量和效率。”

“Häkke就擅长这个”，阿曼达答道。“功能高于外形。”

“我能理解，”查厄托说道。“在一场与邪魔族魔法和暗影对抗的战争中，我乐于接受重型军械的简朴之处。”

阿曼达不由自主地笑了起来。“是啊…我完全同意。”

阿曼达放松了肩膀。她靠在工作台上，等待女帝完成检视。

“我曾经是一名飞行员，”查厄托突然说道。“当我飞过图罗巴特尔的天空时，我感到了一种在地面上无法获得的自由。就好像…”她的声音慢慢低了下来，找不到合适的词汇。

“就好像你把所有的烦恼都抛在脑后了，”阿曼达会意地轻声说道。

“没错，”查厄托说着，转身离开。“我期待看到这个原型机投入使用。会是你来开它吧？”

“我可不放心把它交给其他人。”

查厄托发出了一种阿曼达认为也许是笑声的声音。“我也一样，船匠。先锋有你在真是太幸运了。”

她点头告别，让阿曼达继续工作。

2373687413.name: Pale Steed
2373687413.subtitle: "It's the thrill of the chase."
2373687413.text:
"Eyes on the road," Marcus Ren told himself. "And don't look back."

It was a motto he lived by, both on and off the track. 

His Sparrow screamed across Luna's surface, kicking up clouds of moondust in its wake. Out here, he was free to push prototype engines to their limits. To open the throttle wide and really cut loose.

But that wasn't why he was riding so fast tonight.

He didn't notice anything strange at first. Not until he stopped to check the Sparrow's instruments. And then, he felt it: eyes on his back, a chill on his neck.

Marcus immediately hit the ignition and boosted the Sparrow to its top speed. But still the feeling followed him, and he knew what it was.

A Nightmare.

He'd heard the term on Vanguard channels. Phantoms wearing the faces of the lost, tormenting those who remembered them. And Marcus Ren remembered a lot of people.

He switched off the fuel regulator and kicked the Sparrow into overdrive. He didn't know who was chasing him, and he sure as hell wasn't looking over his shoulder to find out. 

"Eyes on the road," he repeated aloud, gripping the handlebars until his knuckles were as pale as death.

"And never look back."
2373687413.text_zh:
“眼睛看路，”马库斯·伦告诉自己。“别回头。”

这是他的处世之道，无论在赛道上还是赛道外。 

他的快雀尖啸着掠过月球地表，身后扬起了一团团月尘。在这里，他可以自由自在地将原型引擎推至极限。大开油门，真正地无拘无束。

但这不是他今晚开得这么快的原因。

起初他没有注意到有什么异常。直到他停下来检查快雀的仪表。然后，他感觉到了：有双眼睛直盯着他的后背，一丝寒意在脖颈上作祟。

马库斯立即打火，把快雀加快到最高速度。但那种感觉仍然追随着他，他知道那是什么。

梦魇。

他在先锋频道里听到过这个词。那是以逝者面孔示人的鬼灵，折磨着那些记得他们的人。而马库斯·伦还记得很多人。

他关掉燃料调节器，让快雀全速行驶。他不知道是谁在追他，他肯定不会回头去找答案。 

“眼睛看路，”他大声重复着，紧握着车把，直到指关节惨白。

“千万别回头。”

2259079242.name: Trauermarsch
2259079242.subtitle: "The dead do not often speak. But I always listen."
2259079242.subtitle_zh: “亡灵并不经常说话。但我总是倾听。”
2259079242.text:
Vell Tarlowe. Sai Mota. Omar Agah. Eriana-3.

The scarlet phantoms hang in the air beside Eris as she stares across the Enduring Abyss, her eyes fixed upon the Lunar Pyramid. 

Suspended between Nightmare and Memory, her old friends remain forever silent, offering neither torment nor guidance. They listen, and nothing more.

And sometimes, that is enough.

"Long has it been since I walked the Pyramid's protean halls," Eris muses. "Would it welcome me back, now that I meddle in its affairs by severing its growing bond with the Leviathan?" 

Her fireteam does not respond. 

"It does not matter," she concludes. "Regardless of the Pyramid's agenda, Calus must not succeed."

Her thoughts turn to the others aboard the Leviathan, confronting Nightmares of their own. She wonders—as she has done many times since binding the Crown of Sorrow —whether she should perform her own severance ritual.

Eris looks upon the apparitions that were once her fireteam, and her gaze softens.

For better or worse, she has grown accustomed to her grief. Let the others shed their burdens. She keeps hers close, heavy and held dear.

Without them, the silence would be deafening.
2259079242.text_zh:
维尔·塔罗。赛·莫塔。奥马尔·阿加。爱莲娜-3。

猩红的鬼灵在埃里斯身旁悬在空中，她的目光越过永恒深渊，直盯着月球金字塔。 

她的老朋友在梦魇和回忆之间悬浮着，永远默不作声，既不折磨也不指引。他们只会倾听，仅此而已。

有些时候，这样就够了。

“我很久没有走进金字塔那千变万化的大厅了，”埃里斯若有所思地说道，“如今我插手切断了它和利维坦日益增长的纽带，它还会欢迎我回来吗？” 

她的火力战队没有回应。 

“这不重要，”她总结道。“不管金字塔的目的是什么，都不能让卡鲁斯得逞。”

她的思绪转向了利维坦上的其他人，他们还在直面着自身的梦魇。她不禁好奇，在束缚了那么多次忧愁王冠之后，她是不是应该进行自己的断舍仪式。

埃里斯看着曾是她火力战队一员的那些幽灵，她的目光柔和了。

不管是好是坏，她已经习惯了悲伤。让别人卸下身上的重担吧。她要把自己的负担，紧紧地抱在怀里。

没有这些，那将会是死寂般的沉默。

1878178775.name: Falcon's Chase
1878178775.subtitle: "A shadow of a man. A glimpse of a dream."
1878178775.text:
Darkness floods me like breath, expanding with each thought. For a time, it flowed out as often as in, giving me space to surface above the pressing sea and glimpse the cruel storm above, the distant hope of shore. But now there is only the sea, and nothing true remains…

I shut all three of my eyes; I curl in on myself, offering the world my exoskeleton as a shield. I—

No. I am Human. Soft and vulnerable, shell-less. And… Lightless. Waves crash over me: heavy, choking, inexorable. No choice but to drown, no point in swimming. Even the armored succumb to the depths; what chance have I?

I wash up on a shattered stone breakwater. I do not know my limbs. I want, I want, I WANT—what? This craving pit echoing deep within me, what does it seek? I would crawl inland if I owned myself, if only to make the hungering stop.

The world erupts beneath me; stone becomes quicksand in an instant. I struggle, fear before thought, and it swallows me all the faster. I reach for aid—my hand is held—

Saint?

My fingers brush through open air, met instead by gripping claws. They tear at flesh and mind, wearing a grim intimacy, dripping in the sacrifice of thousands. I know these lie-sharpened talons. Would I could tear that understanding from the synaptic heart of me.

I am a hundred shards of myself, shimmering, broken in free fall, glimpsing my own infinite reflections. Some shine gold—some burn sickly green—and some fade as soon as they are witnessed. I cannot guess which one is real. Perhaps one is her. Perhaps I am her. My senses lie.

A familiar voice calls out, sonorous against the abyss, incomprehensible but sweet. I think I hear the fluttering of wings, but the hum of the Sundial gives no direction.

How long has it been?
1878178775.text_zh:
暗影像呼吸一样淹没着我，随着每一个念头而扩张。有一段时间，它流出和流入的频率一致，给了我机会在汹涌的海面上浮出水面，瞥见水上残酷的风暴，那彼岸的渺茫希望。但如今只有大海，没剩下什么真实的东西…

我闭上了我的三只眼睛；我蜷缩在自己身上，用我的外骨骼作为保护世界的盾牌。我——

不。我是人类。柔软脆弱，无壳保护。而且…失去了光能。波涛冲击着我：沉重、窒息、无情。除了溺死别无选择，游泳毫无意义。就连全副武装之人也屈服于深渊；我又有什么机会？

我被冲到了一个破碎的石头防浪堤上。我的四肢毫无知觉。我想要，我想要，我想要——什么？这个渴望的深渊在我内心深处回响，它在寻求些什么？要是我能控制自己，就会爬向内陆，哪怕只是为了止住饥饿。

世界在我底下爆发；石头瞬间化作流沙。我挣扎着，恐惧先于思考，它更快地吞噬了我。我伸出手求援——我的手被握住了——

圣人？

我的手指在空中划过，却碰到了紧握的爪子。它们撕扯着血肉和心灵，带着一种可怖的亲密，滴落在成千上万的牺牲者身上。我知道这些谎言磨利的尖爪。我真想把这种想法从突触心脏上撕下。

我是上百个自我的碎片，在自由落体中闪闪发光，支离破碎，闪烁着自己无限的倒影。有些碎片闪着金色——有些烧成病态的绿色——有些一被看到就会褪色。我猜不出哪块碎片是真的。也许其中一块就是她。也许我就是她。我的感官在说谎。

有个熟悉的声音在呼唤着我，在深渊中显得铿锵有力。难以理解但却悦耳动听。我想我听到了展翼振翅的声音，但日晷的嗡鸣却没有指明方向。

过去多久了？

598769350.name: Hyperborean Pinion
598769350.subtitle: Soar together, under an eternal sun.
598769350.subtitle_zh: 在永恒烈日下，一齐高飞。
598769350.text:
"In a land of endless sun,
amidst the mountains tall and old,
the noble king of beasts and air
guards a treasure trove of gold.

With lion's pride and eagle's eye,
he soars above the fields of strife,
with his companion, sharp and bold,
bound by sacred oath for life.

And when he meets his end too soon,
his loving mate is left alone
to guard a hoard of little worth
and a cold and empty throne."

—Penned by Osiris, in memory of Saint-14, lost in the Infinite Forest
598769350.text_zh:
“在无尽的烈日之境，
高耸古老的群山之间，
高贵的野兽和制空之王
守卫着一座黄金宝库。

凭借着雄狮之傲和鹰隼之视，
他翱翔在纷争领域之上，
与他的伴侣一道，尖锐而勇敢，
终身被神圣的誓言所约束。

而在他英年早逝之后，
徒留下他心爱的伴侣
守护着一处毫无价值的宝藏
和一个冰冷空荡的王座。”

——由奥斯里斯所著，纪念迷失在无尽森林中的圣人14号

486861531.name: Atavistic Idol Helmet
486861531.subtitle: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
486861531.subtitle_zh: “她的飞船上全是死去的机灵。有些只剩下碎片。我们尚未确定有多少机灵死亡。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
486861531.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

The Warlock Shayura kneels on a pillow, eyes closed and head bowed, hands folded in her lap. The soundscape of city noise punctuated by the melody of birds and the whistling wind surrounds her. But there is no grass beneath her pillow, only cold concrete. Four holographic screens encircle Shayura, providing a semi-realistic depiction of the gardens at the center of the Last City; a place of calm serenity situated in the shadow of the Traveler.

"I exalt our forebearers," Shayura says softly.

"I exalt my fireteam."

"I exalt my truth."

"I exalt my heart."

"I exalt humanity's capacity for love."

"This above all else, I hold true."

The words feel like thick syrup in her mouth. Guilt makes it taste bitter. Her jaw trembles and throat tightens, her mouth too dry to swallow.

"I exalt our forebearers."

Her voice wavers, just a little.

"I exalt my fireteam."

Her jaw trembles.

"I exalt my truth."

She can feel the warmth of tears on her cheeks.

"I exalt my heart."

Her voice cracks.

"I exalt h-hu-human—" She breaks. Recitations turn into sobs, and Shayura slides from pillow to floor. Her shoulders heave, and she pulls her knees to her chest, crying against her legs. Dead Guardians stare with hollow eye sockets when she closes her eyes.

They beg for their lives.

She trains a gun on them.

And exalts her truth.
486861531.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

术士沙玉拉跪在枕头上，闭着眼睛，低着头，双手叠放在腿上。城市的音景，不时夹杂着鸟儿的鸣唱和呼啸的风声在她耳边环绕。但是她跪着的枕头底下没有草地，只有冰冷的混凝土。四块全息屏幕环绕着沙玉拉，提供了一幅圣城中心的花园的半写实景象；坐落于旅行者阴影之中的一个平静祥和的地方。

“我赞美我们的祖先，”沙玉拉轻声说道。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

“我赞美我的真理。”

“我赞美我的内心。”

“我赞美人类爱的能力。”

“这是我最深信不疑的一点。”

这些话在她嘴里感觉像浓稠的糖浆。内疚让它变得苦涩。她的下巴在颤抖，喉咙开始发紧，她的嘴太干了无法吞咽。

“我赞美我们的祖先。”

她的声音有一点点颤抖。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

她的下巴颤抖着。

“我赞美我的真理。”

她能感觉到脸颊上泪水的温热。

“我赞美我的内心。”

她的声音沙哑了。

“我赞美人…人类…”她开始崩溃。诵读变成了抽泣，沙玉拉从枕头滑到地板上。她耸动着肩膀，把自己缩成一团，靠着腿哭了起来。当她闭上双眼，死去的守护者就用空洞的眼窝望着她。

他们乞求着活命。

她用枪对准他们。

并赞美她的真理。

2627533758.name: Atavistic Idol Plate
2627533758.subtitle: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2627533758.subtitle_zh: “飞船日志显示她去过金星、月球、暗礁和地球上的几个地方。她投降前的最后所在位置是火星。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2627533758.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

A Fallen Vandal collapses to the ground, Ether vapor rising from a glowing hole where his face once was. Dark-blue blood sizzles around the wound.

"Clear," Reed-7 calls out from the top of a flight of metal stairs, the barrel of his fusion rifle still crackling with energy from the last bolt it fired. As he descends, Aisha follows and shoulders her scout rifle.

"Looks like they were pulling the wiring out of the walls," she observes, lifting up her hand and alighting her Ghost, Dunya, into the air. "Check the systems here; make sure they weren't doing anything else."

"Affirmative," Dunya chirps, zipping off through the air toward a computer terminal.

Aisha notices that Reed's glowing eyes are fixed on the Ether wafting from the Vandal's body. She spares a glance at Dunya before crossing the floor to Reed's side. "Hey," she says with a hand on his arm, jostling him from his thoughts.

"I'm good," he lies, gingerly pulling away. "Just—thinking."

Aisha looks down at the corpse, then back up to Reed. "This isn't like what Shay did on Venus." She tries to be reassuring, but it comes off as dismissive.

"How's it any different?" He asks with a dagger's sharpness in his voice. "These—they were stripping wires from the walls, Aisha. They weren't trying to hurt anyone!"

"They opened fire on us first."

"We didn't even try to talk to them!" Reed yells.

"Aisha?" Dunya chirps, across the room. Neither Guardian hears the Ghost.

"I'm sorry," Aisha says as she throws her arms up. "Was I supposed to do that before or after they threw a grenade at me?"

"Aisha?" Dunya says again, more alarm in his voice.

"We could have tried something! Anything!" Reed screams, getting in Aisha's face. "We could have—"

"AISHA!"
2627533758.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

一名堕落者暴徒倒在地上，乙太烟雾从曾是他脸部的发光洞里冒出来。深蓝色的血液在伤口周围发出嘶嘶声。

“安全了。”里德-7从一段金属楼梯顶上发出了一声呼喊，他的融合步枪枪管伴着射出的最后一颗子弹的能量还在噼啪作响。他走下楼来，艾莎扛着斥候步枪跟着。

“看起来他们在把接线从墙上拔出来，”她评述道，她抬起手，让她的机灵杜妮亚落到空中。“检查这里的系统，确保他们没有做任何其他事情。”

“收到。”杜妮亚说道，掠过空中朝电脑终端移动。

艾莎注意到里德炽热的眼睛盯着暴徒尸体身上飘出的乙太。她瞥了一眼杜妮亚，然后走过地面来到里德身边。“嘿，”她说着，一只手搭在他的胳膊上，把他从思绪中唤醒。

“我很好，”他撒谎道，轻轻地拉开了距离。“只是…在思考。”

艾莎低头看着尸体，然后回头看着里德。“这与沙在金星上干的不同。”她试着安抚，但听起来却很不屑一顾。

“有什么不同？”他问道，声音像匕首一样尖锐。“它——他们只是在扯墙上的接线，艾莎。他们并不想伤害任何人！”

“是他们先向我们开火的。”

“我们甚至没有试着和他们交谈！”里德喊道。

“艾莎？”房间对面的杜妮亚说道。两位守护者都没听到机灵的声音。

“对不起，”艾莎边说边举起胳膊，“我是应该在他们向我扔手雷之前还是之后那样做呢？"

“艾莎？”杜妮亚又说了一遍，声音里多了一些惊慌。

“我们本可以尝试些什么的！什么都行！”里德冲着艾莎的脸尖叫道。“我们本可以——”

“艾莎！”

1987616650.name: Atavistic Idol Gauntlets
1987616650.subtitle: "We believe she's also responsible for the dead Guardian and Eliksni we found on Venus. We haven't identified which dead Ghost belongs to the Guardian." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1987616650.subtitle_zh: “我们相信她也是我们在金星上发现的死去的守护者和埃里克斯尼族的元凶。我们还没确定哪个死去的机灵属于那位守护者。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
1987616650.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
1987616650.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

1026828708.name: Atavistic Idol Greaves
1026828708.subtitle: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1026828708.subtitle_zh: “我们在确认机灵遗体身份的同时，正在通知火力战队成员和生活伴侣。这需要一段时间。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
1026828708.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
1026828708.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

艾莎和里德听到杜妮亚示警的声音，转过身来拔出了枪。但是当他们瞄准面前闪烁的长袍梦魇时，谁也下不了手。艾莎看到这一幕，率先发出了震惊的低声咒骂。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

2381515079.name: Atavistic Idol Mark
2381515079.subtitle: "With the Consensus disbanded, there's no telling how long this could take to go to trial. Given the current… situation? We might all be dead before that happens."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2381515079.subtitle_zh: “随着共识组织的解散，不知道这要多久才能受审。考虑到目前的…情况？在那之前，我们可能都已经死了。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2381515079.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

"The first steps to healing are learning to forgive yourself. That's a hard one, I know."

Doctor Syeda Uzair sets her datapad aside, then sits forward in her chair. She folds her hands in front of herself. A tiny, beaded chain is wrapped around one hand, and a small bone charm of the Traveler is pressed into her right palm. "Shayura, whether or not a court of law finds you guilty of your actions in any measure, you are still held accountable to the court of your own conscience."

Across from Doctor Uzair, Shayura is slouched in her chair. She stares past her doctor, out the narrow windows, and looks to the looming figure of the Traveler hanging in the sky. It seems so much bigger compared to the projections she chooses to display in her cell.

"Who judges them?" Shayura asks, motioning to the window with her chin. To the Traveler.

Doctor Uzair turns, glancing over her shoulder at the Traveler. Her grip on the charm tightens. "I don't know," is her immediate answer, but the question will burrow its way through her mind, surfacing again when she lies down in bed tonight. "I understand the Human condition far better than a god's."

"Maybe the Traveler abandoned us because it's ashamed of us. Of what we've done in its name." Shayura's voice is small, weary. An alert flickers on Dr. Uzair's datapad, momentarily drawing her attention away. Shayura fills the silence with a sigh. 

"Maybe," Doctor Uzair says, though she doesn't believe it. "But, maybe we're all just short on hope these days. I'd like to extend our session a little longer, if you're willing. Would you mind if we did so with some guests?"

Concern flashes across Shayura's face; defensiveness, shame. She sits up slightly in her seat. Doctor Uzair can see the tension.

"When we speak of forgiveness, sometimes it helps to first be forgiven," Doctor Uzair says with a tempered smile. Shayura glances to the datapad, then back to her doctor.

"Reed-7 and Aisha would like to see you."

Tears well in Shayura's eyes. Her voice of dissent evaporates.

Shayura realizes there is one thing she can still have faith in: her family.
2381515079.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

“疗伤的第一步就是学会原谅自己。我知道这很难。”

医生西达·乌泽尔把她的数据板放在一边，然后坐在椅子上。她双手交叉放在身前。她的一只手上缠着一条小小的串珠链，右手掌里压着一个旅行者的骨质小护符。“沙玉拉，不管法庭是否判定你的行为有罪，你都会被自己良心的法庭追究责任。”

在乌泽尔医生的对面，沙玉拉无精打采地耷拉在椅子上。她的目光越过她的医生，从狭小的窗户望出去，看到了悬挂在天空中若隐若现的旅行者的身影。它看起来比她选择在牢房里显示的投影要大得多。

“谁来审判那家伙？”沙玉拉问道，用她的下巴示意着窗口。指向旅行者。

乌泽尔医生转过身，回头瞥了一眼旅行者。她把护符抓得更紧了。“我不知道，”她立即答道，但这个问题还会在她的脑海里钻来钻去，等她今晚躺在床上的时候再次浮现。“比起神灵，我更了解人类的处境。”

“也许旅行者抛弃我们是因为它为我们感到羞耻。为我们以它的名义所做的一切感到羞耻。”沙玉拉的声音微弱而疲惫。乌泽尔医生的数据板上闪烁着一则警示，暂时转移了她的注意力。沙玉拉以一声叹息填补了沉默。 

“也许吧，”乌泽尔医生说道，尽管她并不相信。“但也许我们只不过是近来都缺少希望。如果你愿意，我想把我们的谈话再延长一点。你介意我们邀请两位客人吗？”

忧虑掠过沙玉拉的脸庞；自我防备，羞愧难当。她从座位上微微起身。乌泽尔医生能看出这种紧张。

“当我们谈及宽恕时，有时先被宽恕会有所帮助。”乌泽尔医生带着温和的微笑说。沙玉拉瞥了一眼数据板，然后又看向她的医生。

"里德-7和艾莎想见你。"

沙玉拉的眼里噙满了泪水。她不服从的想法消失了。

沙玉拉意识到有一件事她依然可以相信：她的家人。

2612856746.name: Atavistic Idol Hood
2612856746.subtitle: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2612856746.subtitle_zh: “她的飞船上全是死去的机灵。有些只剩下碎片。我们尚未确定有多少机灵死亡。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2612856746.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

The Warlock Shayura kneels on a pillow, eyes closed and head bowed, hands folded in her lap. The soundscape of city noise punctuated by the melody of birds and the whistling wind surrounds her. But there is no grass beneath her pillow, only cold concrete. Four holographic screens encircle Shayura, providing a semi-realistic depiction of the gardens at the center of the Last City; a place of calm serenity situated in the shadow of the Traveler.

"I exalt our forebearers," Shayura says softly.

"I exalt my fireteam."

"I exalt my truth."

"I exalt my heart."

"I exalt humanity's capacity for love."

"This above all else, I hold true."

The words feel like thick syrup in her mouth. Guilt makes it taste bitter. Her jaw trembles and throat tightens, her mouth too dry to swallow.

"I exalt our forebearers."

Her voice wavers, just a little.

"I exalt my fireteam."

Her jaw trembles.

"I exalt my truth."

She can feel the warmth of tears on her cheeks.

"I exalt my heart."

Her voice cracks.

"I exalt h-hu-human—" She breaks. Recitations turn into sobs, and Shayura slides from pillow to floor. Her shoulders heave, and she pulls her knees to her chest, crying against her legs. Dead Guardians stare with hollow eye sockets when she closes her eyes.

They beg for their lives.

She trains a gun on them.

And exalts her truth.
2612856746.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

术士沙玉拉跪在枕头上，闭着眼睛，低着头，双手叠放在腿上。城市的音景，不时夹杂着鸟儿的鸣唱和呼啸的风声在她耳边环绕。但是她跪着的枕头底下没有草地，只有冰冷的混凝土。四块全息屏幕环绕着沙玉拉，提供了一幅圣城中心的花园的半写实景象；坐落于旅行者阴影之中的一个平静祥和的地方。

“我赞美我们的祖先，”沙玉拉轻声说道。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

“我赞美我的真理。”

“我赞美我的内心。”

“我赞美人类爱的能力。”

“这是我最深信不疑的一点。”

这些话在她嘴里感觉像浓稠的糖浆。内疚让它变得苦涩。她的下巴在颤抖，喉咙开始发紧，她的嘴太干了无法吞咽。

“我赞美我们的祖先。”

她的声音有一点点颤抖。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

她的下巴颤抖着。

“我赞美我的真理。”

她能感觉到脸颊上泪水的温热。

“我赞美我的内心。”

她的声音沙哑了。

“我赞美人…人类…”她开始崩溃。诵读变成了抽泣，沙玉拉从枕头滑到地板上。她耸动着肩膀，把自己缩成一团，靠着腿哭了起来。当她闭上双眼，死去的守护者就用空洞的眼窝望着她。

他们乞求着活命。

她用枪对准他们。

并赞美她的真理。

124944413.name: Atavistic Idol Vestments
124944413.subtitle: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
124944413.subtitle_zh: “飞船日志显示她去过金星、月球、暗礁和地球上的几个地方。她投降前的最后所在位置是火星。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
124944413.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

A Fallen Vandal collapses to the ground, Ether vapor rising from a glowing hole where his face once was. Dark-blue blood sizzles around the wound.

"Clear," Reed-7 calls out from the top of a flight of metal stairs, the barrel of his fusion rifle still crackling with energy from the last bolt it fired. As he descends, Aisha follows and shoulders her scout rifle.

"Looks like they were pulling the wiring out of the walls," she observes, lifting up her hand and alighting her Ghost, Dunya, into the air. "Check the systems here; make sure they weren't doing anything else."

"Affirmative," Dunya chirps, zipping off through the air toward a computer terminal.

Aisha notices that Reed's glowing eyes are fixed on the Ether wafting from the Vandal's body. She spares a glance at Dunya before crossing the floor to Reed's side. "Hey," she says with a hand on his arm, jostling him from his thoughts.

"I'm good," he lies, gingerly pulling away. "Just—thinking."

Aisha looks down at the corpse, then back up to Reed. "This isn't like what Shay did on Venus." She tries to be reassuring, but it comes off as dismissive.

"How's it any different?" He asks with a dagger's sharpness in his voice. "These—they were stripping wires from the walls, Aisha. They weren't trying to hurt anyone!"

"They opened fire on us first."

"We didn't even try to talk to them!" Reed yells.

"Aisha?" Dunya chirps, across the room. Neither Guardian hears the Ghost.

"I'm sorry," Aisha says as she throws her arms up. "Was I supposed to do that before or after they threw a grenade at me?"

"Aisha?" Dunya says again, more alarm in his voice.

"We could have tried something! Anything!" Reed screams, getting in Aisha's face. "We could have—"

"AISHA!"
124944413.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

一名堕落者暴徒倒在地上，乙太烟雾从曾是他脸部的发光洞里冒出来。深蓝色的血液在伤口周围发出嘶嘶声。

“安全了。”里德-7从一段金属楼梯顶上发出了一声呼喊，他的融合步枪枪管伴着射出的最后一颗子弹的能量还在噼啪作响。他走下楼来，艾莎扛着斥候步枪跟着。

“看起来他们在把接线从墙上拔出来，”她评述道，她抬起手，让她的机灵杜妮亚落到空中。“检查这里的系统，确保他们没有做任何其他事情。”

“收到。”杜妮亚说道，掠过空中朝电脑终端移动。

艾莎注意到里德炽热的眼睛盯着暴徒尸体身上飘出的乙太。她瞥了一眼杜妮亚，然后走过地面来到里德身边。“嘿，”她说着，一只手搭在他的胳膊上，把他从思绪中唤醒。

“我很好，”他撒谎道，轻轻地拉开了距离。“只是…在思考。”

艾莎低头看着尸体，然后回头看着里德。“这与沙在金星上干的不同。”她试着安抚，但听起来却很不屑一顾。

“有什么不同？”他问道，声音像匕首一样尖锐。“它——他们只是在扯墙上的接线，艾莎。他们并不想伤害任何人！”

“是他们先向我们开火的。”

“我们甚至没有试着和他们交谈！”里德喊道。

“艾莎？”房间对面的杜妮亚说道。两位守护者都没听到机灵的声音。

“对不起，”艾莎边说边举起胳膊，“我是应该在他们向我扔手雷之前还是之后那样做呢？"

“艾莎？”杜妮亚又说了一遍，声音里多了一些惊慌。

“我们本可以尝试些什么的！什么都行！”里德冲着艾莎的脸尖叫道。“我们本可以——”

“艾莎！”

2618417907.name: Atavistic Idol Gloves
2618417907.subtitle: "We believe she's also responsible for the dead Guardian and Eliksni we found on Venus. We haven't identified which dead Ghost belongs to the Guardian." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2618417907.subtitle_zh: “我们相信她也是我们在金星上发现的死去的守护者和埃里克斯尼族的元凶。我们还没确定哪个死去的机灵属于那位守护者。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2618417907.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
2618417907.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

2353371845.name: Atavistic Idol Boots
2353371845.subtitle: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2353371845.subtitle_zh: “我们在确认机灵遗体身份的同时，正在通知火力战队成员和生活伴侣。这需要一段时间。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2353371845.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
2353371845.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

艾莎和里德听到杜妮亚示警的声音，转过身来拔出了枪。但是当他们瞄准面前闪烁的长袍梦魇时，谁也下不了手。艾莎看到这一幕，率先发出了震惊的低声咒骂。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

1586932304.name: Atavistic Idol Bond
1586932304.subtitle: "With the Consensus disbanded, there's no telling how long this could take to go to trial. Given the current… situation? We might all be dead before that happens."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1586932304.subtitle_zh: “随着共识组织的解散，不知道这要多久才能受审。考虑到目前的…情况？在那之前，我们可能都已经死了。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
1586932304.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

"The first steps to healing are learning to forgive yourself. That's a hard one, I know."

Doctor Syeda Uzair sets her datapad aside, then sits forward in her chair. She folds her hands in front of herself. A tiny, beaded chain is wrapped around one hand, and a small bone charm of the Traveler is pressed into her right palm. "Shayura, whether or not a court of law finds you guilty of your actions in any measure, you are still held accountable to the court of your own conscience."

Across from Doctor Uzair, Shayura is slouched in her chair. She stares past her doctor, out the narrow windows, and looks to the looming figure of the Traveler hanging in the sky. It seems so much bigger compared to the projections she chooses to display in her cell.

"Who judges them?" Shayura asks, motioning to the window with her chin. To the Traveler.

Doctor Uzair turns, glancing over her shoulder at the Traveler. Her grip on the charm tightens. "I don't know," is her immediate answer, but the question will burrow its way through her mind, surfacing again when she lies down in bed tonight. "I understand the Human condition far better than a god's."

"Maybe the Traveler abandoned us because it's ashamed of us. Of what we've done in its name." Shayura's voice is small, weary. An alert flickers on Dr. Uzair's datapad, momentarily drawing her attention away. Shayura fills the silence with a sigh. 

"Maybe," Doctor Uzair says, though she doesn't believe it. "But, maybe we're all just short on hope these days. I'd like to extend our session a little longer, if you're willing. Would you mind if we did so with some guests?"

Concern flashes across Shayura's face; defensiveness, shame. She sits up slightly in her seat. Doctor Uzair can see the tension.

"When we speak of forgiveness, sometimes it helps to first be forgiven," Doctor Uzair says with a tempered smile. Shayura glances to the datapad, then back to her doctor.

"Reed-7 and Aisha would like to see you."

Tears well in Shayura's eyes. Her voice of dissent evaporates.

Shayura realizes there is one thing she can still have faith in: her family.
1586932304.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

“疗伤的第一步就是学会原谅自己。我知道这很难。”

医生西达·乌泽尔把她的数据板放在一边，然后坐在椅子上。她双手交叉放在身前。她的一只手上缠着一条小小的串珠链，右手掌里压着一个旅行者的骨质小护符。“沙玉拉，不管法庭是否判定你的行为有罪，你都会被自己良心的法庭追究责任。”

在乌泽尔医生的对面，沙玉拉无精打采地耷拉在椅子上。她的目光越过她的医生，从狭小的窗户望出去，看到了悬挂在天空中若隐若现的旅行者的身影。它看起来比她选择在牢房里显示的投影要大得多。

“谁来审判那家伙？”沙玉拉问道，用她的下巴示意着窗口。指向旅行者。

乌泽尔医生转过身，回头瞥了一眼旅行者。她把护符抓得更紧了。“我不知道，”她立即答道，但这个问题还会在她的脑海里钻来钻去，等她今晚躺在床上的时候再次浮现。“比起神灵，我更了解人类的处境。”

“也许旅行者抛弃我们是因为它为我们感到羞耻。为我们以它的名义所做的一切感到羞耻。”沙玉拉的声音微弱而疲惫。乌泽尔医生的数据板上闪烁着一则警示，暂时转移了她的注意力。沙玉拉以一声叹息填补了沉默。 

“也许吧，”乌泽尔医生说道，尽管她并不相信。“但也许我们只不过是近来都缺少希望。如果你愿意，我想把我们的谈话再延长一点。你介意我们邀请两位客人吗？”

忧虑掠过沙玉拉的脸庞；自我防备，羞愧难当。她从座位上微微起身。乌泽尔医生能看出这种紧张。

“当我们谈及宽恕时，有时先被宽恕会有所帮助。”乌泽尔医生带着温和的微笑说。沙玉拉瞥了一眼数据板，然后又看向她的医生。

"里德-7和艾莎想见你。"

沙玉拉的眼里噙满了泪水。她不服从的想法消失了。

沙玉拉意识到有一件事她依然可以相信：她的家人。

868732497.name: Atavistic Idol Mask
868732497.subtitle: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
868732497.subtitle_zh: “她的飞船上全是死去的机灵。有些只剩下碎片。我们尚未确定有多少机灵死亡。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
868732497.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

The Warlock Shayura kneels on a pillow, eyes closed and head bowed, hands folded in her lap. The soundscape of city noise punctuated by the melody of birds and the whistling wind surrounds her. But there is no grass beneath her pillow, only cold concrete. Four holographic screens encircle Shayura, providing a semi-realistic depiction of the gardens at the center of the Last City; a place of calm serenity situated in the shadow of the Traveler.

"I exalt our forebearers," Shayura says softly.

"I exalt my fireteam."

"I exalt my truth."

"I exalt my heart."

"I exalt humanity's capacity for love."

"This above all else, I hold true."

The words feel like thick syrup in her mouth. Guilt makes it taste bitter. Her jaw trembles and throat tightens, her mouth too dry to swallow.

"I exalt our forebearers."

Her voice wavers, just a little.

"I exalt my fireteam."

Her jaw trembles.

"I exalt my truth."

She can feel the warmth of tears on her cheeks.

"I exalt my heart."

Her voice cracks.

"I exalt h-hu-human—" She breaks. Recitations turn into sobs, and Shayura slides from pillow to floor. Her shoulders heave, and she pulls her knees to her chest, crying against her legs. Dead Guardians stare with hollow eye sockets when she closes her eyes.

They beg for their lives.

She trains a gun on them.

And exalts her truth.
868732497.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

术士沙玉拉跪在枕头上，闭着眼睛，低着头，双手双手叠放在腿上。城市的音景，不时夹杂着鸟儿的鸣唱和呼啸的风声在她耳边环绕。但是她跪着的枕头底下没有草地，只有冰冷的混凝土。四块全息屏幕环绕着沙玉拉，提供了一幅圣城中心的花园的半写实景象；坐落于旅行者阴影之中的一个平静祥和的地方。

“我赞美我们的祖先，”沙玉拉轻声说道。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

“我赞美我的真理。”

“我赞美我的内心。”

“我赞美人类爱的能力。”

“这是我最深信不疑的一点。”

这些话在她嘴里感觉像浓稠的糖浆。内疚让它变得苦涩。她的下巴在颤抖，喉咙开始发紧，她的嘴太干了无法吞咽。

“我赞美我们的祖先。”

她的声音有一点点颤抖。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

她的下巴颤抖着。

“我赞美我的真理。”

她能感觉到脸颊上泪水的温热。

“我赞美我的内心。”

她的声音沙哑了。

“我赞美人…人类…”她开始崩溃。诵读变成了抽泣，沙玉拉从枕头滑到地板上。她耸动着肩膀，把自己缩成一团，靠着腿哭了起来。当她闭上双眼，死去的守护者就用空洞的眼窝望着她。

他们乞求着活命。

她用枪对准他们。

并赞美她的真理。

2355943840.name: Atavistic Idol Vest
2355943840.subtitle: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2355943840.subtitle_zh: “飞船日志显示她去过金星、月球、暗礁和地球上的几个地方。她投降前的最后所在位置是火星。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
2355943840.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

A Fallen Vandal collapses to the ground, Ether vapor rising from a glowing hole where his face once was. Dark-blue blood sizzles around the wound.

"Clear," Reed-7 calls out from the top of a flight of metal stairs, the barrel of his fusion rifle still crackling with energy from the last bolt it fired. As he descends, Aisha follows and shoulders her scout rifle.

"Looks like they were pulling the wiring out of the walls," she observes, lifting up her hand and alighting her Ghost, Dunya, into the air. "Check the systems here; make sure they weren't doing anything else."

"Affirmative," Dunya chirps, zipping off through the air toward a computer terminal.

Aisha notices that Reed's glowing eyes are fixed on the Ether wafting from the Vandal's body. She spares a glance at Dunya before crossing the floor to Reed's side. "Hey," she says with a hand on his arm, jostling him from his thoughts.

"I'm good," he lies, gingerly pulling away. "Just—thinking."

Aisha looks down at the corpse, then back up to Reed. "This isn't like what Shay did on Venus." She tries to be reassuring, but it comes off as dismissive.

"How's it any different?" He asks with a dagger's sharpness in his voice. "These—they were stripping wires from the walls, Aisha. They weren't trying to hurt anyone!"

"They opened fire on us first."

"We didn't even try to talk to them!" Reed yells.

"Aisha?" Dunya chirps, across the room. Neither Guardian hears the Ghost.

"I'm sorry," Aisha says as she throws her arms up. "Was I supposed to do that before or after they threw a grenade at me?"

"Aisha?" Dunya says again, more alarm in his voice.

"We could have tried something! Anything!" Reed screams, getting in Aisha's face. "We could have—"

"AISHA!"

“艾莎？”房间对面的杜妮亚说道。两位守护者都没听到机灵的声音。

“对不起，”艾莎边说边举起胳膊，“我是应该在他们向我扔手雷之前还是之后那样做呢？"

“艾莎？”杜妮亚又说了一遍，声音里多了一些惊慌。

“我们本可以尝试些什么的！什么都行！”里德冲着艾莎的脸尖叫道。“我们本可以——”

“艾莎！”

3821828136.name: Atavistic Idol Grips
3821828136.subtitle: "We believe she's also responsible for the dead Guardian and Eliksni we found on Venus. We haven't identified which dead Ghost belongs to the Guardian." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
3821828136.subtitle_zh: “我们相信她也是我们在金星上发现的死去的守护者和埃里克斯尼族的元凶。我们还没确定哪个死去的机灵属于那位守护者。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
3821828136.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
3821828136.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

162269058.name: Atavistic Idol Strides
162269058.subtitle: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
162269058.subtitle_zh: “我们在确认机灵遗体身份的同时，正在通知火力战队成员和生活伴侣。这需要一段时间。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
162269058.text:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
162269058.text_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

艾莎和里德听到杜妮亚示警的声音，转过身来拔出了枪。但是当他们瞄准面前闪烁的长袍梦魇时，谁也下不了手。艾莎看到这一幕，率先发出了震惊的低声咒骂。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

1283202269.name: Atavistic Idol Cloak
1283202269.subtitle: "With the Consensus disbanded, there's no telling how long this could take to go to trial. Given the current… situation? We might all be dead before that happens."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1283202269.subtitle_zh: “随着共识组织的解散，不知道这要多久才能受审。考虑到目前的…情况？在那之前，我们可能都已经死了。”——《先锋安全报告》节选
1283202269.text:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

"The first steps to healing are learning to forgive yourself. That's a hard one, I know."

Doctor Syeda Uzair sets her datapad aside, then sits forward in her chair. She folds her hands in front of herself. A tiny, beaded chain is wrapped around one hand, and a small bone charm of the Traveler is pressed into her right palm. "Shayura, whether or not a court of law finds you guilty of your actions in any measure, you are still held accountable to the court of your own conscience."

Across from Doctor Uzair, Shayura is slouched in her chair. She stares past her doctor, out the narrow windows, and looks to the looming figure of the Traveler hanging in the sky. It seems so much bigger compared to the projections she chooses to display in her cell.

"Who judges them?" Shayura asks, motioning to the window with her chin. To the Traveler.

Doctor Uzair turns, glancing over her shoulder at the Traveler. Her grip on the charm tightens. "I don't know," is her immediate answer, but the question will burrow its way through her mind, surfacing again when she lies down in bed tonight. "I understand the Human condition far better than a god's."

"Maybe the Traveler abandoned us because it's ashamed of us. Of what we've done in its name." Shayura's voice is small, weary. An alert flickers on Dr. Uzair's datapad, momentarily drawing her attention away. Shayura fills the silence with a sigh. 

"Maybe," Doctor Uzair says, though she doesn't believe it. "But, maybe we're all just short on hope these days. I'd like to extend our session a little longer, if you're willing. Would you mind if we did so with some guests?"

Concern flashes across Shayura's face; defensiveness, shame. She sits up slightly in her seat. Doctor Uzair can see the tension.

"When we speak of forgiveness, sometimes it helps to first be forgiven," Doctor Uzair says with a tempered smile. Shayura glances to the datapad, then back to her doctor.

"Reed-7 and Aisha would like to see you."

Tears well in Shayura's eyes. Her voice of dissent evaporates.

Shayura realizes there is one thing she can still have faith in: her family.
1283202269.text_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

“疗伤的第一步就是学会原谅自己。我知道这很难。”

医生西达·乌泽尔把她的数据板放在一边，然后坐在椅子上。她双手交叉放在身前。她的一只手上缠着一条小小的串珠链，右手掌里压着一个旅行者的骨质小护符。“沙玉拉，不管法庭是否判定你的行为有罪，你都会被自己良心的法庭追究责任。”

在乌泽尔医生的对面，沙玉拉无精打采地耷拉在椅子上。她的目光越过她的医生，从狭小的窗户望出去，看到了悬挂在天空中若隐若现的旅行者的身影。它看起来比她选择在牢房里显示的投影要大得多。

“谁来审判那家伙？”沙玉拉问道，用她的下巴示意着窗口。指向旅行者。

乌泽尔医生转过身，回头瞥了一眼旅行者。她把护符抓得更紧了。“我不知道，”她立即答道，但这个问题还会在她的脑海里钻来钻去，等她今晚躺在床上的时候再次浮现。“比起神灵，我更了解人类的处境。”

“也许旅行者抛弃我们是因为它为我们感到羞耻。为我们以它的名义所做的一切感到羞耻。”沙玉拉的声音微弱而疲惫。乌泽尔医生的数据板上闪烁着一则警示，暂时转移了她的注意力。沙玉拉以一声叹息填补了沉默。 

“也许吧，”乌泽尔医生说道，尽管她并不相信。“但也许我们只不过是近来都缺少希望。如果你愿意，我想把我们的谈话再延长一点。你介意我们邀请两位客人吗？”

忧虑掠过沙玉拉的脸庞；自我防备，羞愧难当。她从座位上微微起身。乌泽尔医生能看出这种紧张。

“当我们谈及宽恕时，有时先被宽恕会有所帮助。”乌泽尔医生带着温和的微笑说。沙玉拉瞥了一眼数据板，然后又看向她的医生。

"里德-7和艾莎想见你。"

沙玉拉的眼里噙满了泪水。她不服从的想法消失了。

沙玉拉意识到有一件事她依然可以相信：她的家人。
