[警告：检测到网内外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷]
___________________________________________________________________________

阿娜浏览着读数。她注意到了外来实体的警告。

“网络里依然有太阳系分支的信号。信号很微弱，没有连接，但处于活跃状态。”她的手指输入一连串的指令。“它把几十个文件引用分组，用于一个叫做‘占卜思维'的东西。” 

“占卜思维看起来像是个用于指导太阳系外殖民地的扩张的预测引擎。玛雅·桑戴尔什用Vex科技创造了一个拥有预知能力的人工智能…所以太阳系分支想要得到它，或者想要从中得到些什么，”阿娜说道。“我敢打赌，我们未受攻击是因为这个联网的Vex信号并没有受到威胁…但它最终会意识到它已被切断，并开始复制。”

“这么说，我们要打一架了？”科格本用无线电说道，提高了嗓门。

“站点协议是要炸毁电磁脉冲。所以那就是我们要做的事，”阿娜说道。“但你讲得对，很有可能要打架。”

“电磁脉冲会…对我有什么影响？”莫斯2号用无线电说道，声音中带着迟疑。

“你不会有事的。”

“太好了。但我们就这么空手而归？”莫斯2号抗议道。

“当然不，”阿娜反驳道，仔细查看了控制台的目录。“我可以在几分钟内将整个站点的数据，包括这些‘前沿军备'图纸压缩成几个记忆水晶。然后我们启动电磁脉冲，确保太阳系分支再也不能使用这个地方。”

科格本在频道里咯咯笑着。“好了。你可以换掉你用来射子弹的那块烂木头了。”

“也许你终于可以不再用拳头了，”莫斯2号打趣道。

阿娜插嘴道。“在开始压缩之前，我必须隔离太阳系分支的信号…而它不会喜欢那样的。”

“枪手。”埃普的声音打断了他们。“你需要我们做什么？”

2599025960.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Cover
2599025960.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made armored cover. Headstrong, perfect for a charging bull.
2599025960.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制护甲面罩。铜头铁额，非常适合一头冲锋的公牛。
2599025960.text:
Ana Bray stands from behind her workshop monitor, followed by her Ghost, Jinju. "The Vex did what?"

Niik peeks over an adjacent monitor.

"The Guardian thwarted their attempt," Osiris responds.

Ana sits back down with a sigh. "Here I thought we only had to deal with one robot."

Osiris raises a finger in protest, "The Vex aren't robo—"

Ana cuts in. "We need to make sure they can't try it again. A while back I found a Pillory bunker. Made sure only Rasputin could access them. Clearly the Sol Divisive didn't get the memo," Ana says, collecting equipment around the workshop. "They'll try again."

Osiris nods, the potential of adventure drawing his lips into a smirk. "Then I'll go—"

"No!" Ana dashes passed Osiris, "It's your night to watch the Colonel. I'll outsource a posse."

***

Three rugged Guardians crowd a wooden table in the Ether Tank. Ana spots their Tex Mechanica gear in the crowd. She sends Niik through the mingling bustle of Eliksni and Human patronage to order refreshments from the barkeep.

Ana saddles up to the table, slaps her hand down. "Wasn't sure you'd show after our talk."

"No one likes dealing with Vex, Gunslinger," the Awoken Hunter, Earp, grumbles from below the brim of his hat.

Ana smiles and tilts her head. " Which is why I'm paying you for the trouble."

"We accepted before some of us knew we were dealing with robots that delete you from existin'." A leather-robed, Exo Warlock, Moss-2, leans forward, followed by a Ghost hovering close to his head. 

"They're not actually robots," Ana grumbles.

"Nonetheless, hazard like that costs extra." Moss-2's eyes blink independently, followed by his Ghost's iris, as if in a sequence.

Ana looks to Earp quizzically, who shrugs, then back to Moss-2. "What is this, a shakedown?"

A grizzled Human Titan at the table, Cogburn, stands. His mountainous frame towers over the seated Guardians. "Moss wants claims to weapons, loot, or patterns we find. Boy's still fresh, grave dirt on his boots. Needs all the help he can get," he booms, then turns to his partners. "Why are we muddying this water, dancing around? Just ask her for it."

Ana laughs, leans back to meet Cogburn's gaze, then stares down Moss-2. "I'm going to assume you shot that offer so high because you're hoping to get something in the middle. Here it goes: you get your normal payment, plus first print of any weapon schematics we find that Tex can fabricate. They'll fit those custom threads."

"Sound good to you, Moss?" Cogburn barks with a gruff chuckle, sitting. "If things get too hot your Ghost can just do it for you."

Niik arrives, distributes drinks, and sits as Ana pulls a free chair next to her.

Ana studies Moss-2 and his Ghost as they silently consider her offer; a cranial implant embedded in Moss-2's skull flashes a light in sequence with his Ghost's iris. "What do you mean by that?"

"I don't have a firm grasp on the Light," Moss-2's illuminated mouth forms a frown. "But No Name does, so we share." The Ghost, settles into his open palm.

"Share what?"

Moss-2 taps the blinking implant on his cranial-plate. "Everything. And we find your offer agreeable."

The party share agreeing glances, then return a simple, silent nod before draining their cups.
2599025960.text_zh:
阿娜·布瑞从作坊显示器前站起身，她的机灵金桔紧随其后。“Vex干了什么？”

妮可望了望旁边的显示器。

“守护者挫败了他们的企图，”奥斯里斯回应道。

阿娜叹了口气，坐了下来。“我还以为我们只需要对付一个机器人。”

奥斯里斯抬起手指抗议，“Vex可不是机器——”

阿娜打断了他。“我们得确保它们没法再这样来一次。不久前，我袭击了每个枷锁地堡，确保只有拉斯普廷可以访问它们。很明显太阳系分支并不知情，”阿娜一边说，一边在作坊周围收集设备。“它们绝对还会再来一次。”

奥斯里斯点了点头，冒险的可能性让他不禁露出了笑容。“那就让我去…”

“不！”阿娜飞身挡住奥斯里斯，喊道，“今晚该你监视上校了。我会派其他人去…”

***

三个外表粗犷的守护者挤在乙太罐里一张木桌旁。阿娜在人群中认出了他们的特克斯机械装备。她让妮可穿过混杂的埃里克斯尼族和人类顾客，跟酒保点些酒水。

阿娜跨坐在桌边，往桌子上拍了一掌。“我原本还不确定我们谈话后你们是否会出现。”

“没人喜欢和Vex打交道，枪手，”帽檐下传来了觉醒者猎人埃普的嘟囔声。

阿娜笑了笑，歪着头。“这正是我付钱给你们的原因。”

“这活是在我们知道要去对付能把你直接‘删除'掉的机器人之前接下的。”一位穿着皮大衣的Exo术士向前倾身。他叫莫斯-2。他脑袋旁边还悬浮着一只机灵。 

“他们其实不是机器人，”阿娜咕哝道。

“无论如何，去对付那种危险对手得加价。”莫斯-2依次眨了眨眼，然后他的机灵也跟着眨了一下，像是有顺序似的。

阿娜疑惑地看向埃普，后者耸了耸肩。她的目光又回到了莫斯-2身上。“你们想敲诈我？”

桌旁发色灰白的人类泰坦科格本站了起来。他庞大的身躯让坐着的守护者显得格外渺小。“莫斯想得到我们发现的任何武器、战利品或模式。他是个新人，靴子上还沾着坟土呢。他需要能得到的所有帮助。”他用低沉的声音说道。“我们干嘛要绕圈子？直接问她要吧。”

阿娜笑着靠在椅背上，与科格本的目光相迎，然后盯着莫斯2号。“你刚刚开这么高的要求只是为了抬高我的价吧。这样如何，你们能拿到正常的报酬，再加上我们发现特克斯能制造的任何武器图纸的首个印本。它们会适合那些定制纱线的。”

“你觉得怎样，莫斯？”科格本坐下，粗声粗气地笑道。“如果事情太棘手，就交给你的机灵做呗。”

妮可拿着一堆酒水来到桌旁，坐在了阿娜拉过来的椅子上。

阿娜打量着正在考虑提案的莫斯-2和他的机灵；嵌入Moss-2颅骨的植入物与他机灵的虹膜依次闪烁着光芒。“那是什么意思？”

“我还没能完全掌握光能，”莫斯-2发光的嘴唇皱了皱。“不过我的机灵无名掌握了，所以我们会共享。”机灵落到了他的手心里。

“共享什么？”

莫斯2号敲了敲他颅骨上闪烁的植入物。“所有的一切。我们同意你的提案。”

一行人交换了同意的眼神，然后简单而沉默地点了点头，喝干了杯子里的酒。

506181039.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Mark
506181039.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made mark, warning vagabonds that you mean business.
506181039.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制印记，警告那些闲汉你说到做到。
506181039.text:
[Earp: T-4:59…]
Earp is the first to see the Sol Divisive materializing.

          Naylor: Hobgoblins marked. The Sol Divisive belong to the Witness, I hear.

Earp draws and sends shots singing from his Vulpecula through Hobgoblins until expending his cylinder. He takes to the edges of the deck, reloads mid-dodge over a searing line rifle beam, and flicks a Skip grenade into their ranks.

          Naylor: More snipers marked. I wonder if their Radiolaria is different from the main Collective.

Jolting Arc breaks the Hobgoblin formation. The remaining Vex pivot their attention to him. Arc amplification surges through Earp, shortening the span between him and his enemies. He hits their formation like a bolt jumping through open receivers, weaving chains of electricity through the outer ring of the deck, dancing between Sol Divisive frames with knife, cannon, and striking bolt.

          Naylor: Cogburn is about to die.

Earp covers the distance to Cogburn's attacker in a flash. He slides, rolls between the Minotaur's legs, and delivers a thunderous counter-blow uppercut that leaves the Vex blind open. The Hunter levels his cannon with his target's vulnerable radiolarian globe  and fires, leaving a frigid headstone in its place, which Cogburn pulverizes into shards with a backhand.

[Cogburn: T-3:42…]
          Bo: You have contact, straight ahead.

Cogburn lunges forward as enemies swarm the deck, shattering Goblin after Goblin with Behemoth fists like Stasis-encrusted pistons. He looks over his shoulder to Ana and Moss-2 clipping targets out of the sky, Earp drawing a circuit through the Vex at his flanks— 

          Bo: Minotaurs, phasing on your left.

Three newly materialized Minotaurs open fire. Cogburn is already in motion and slides under the blasts on Stasis sleet before hurling a Glacial grenade to cover his advance. Stasis crystals encase the closest Minotaur, and Cogburn crashes through it with shattering force, destroying them all.

Bo: Damn fine work. That's why I raised you. You're the closest I could get to a Cabal—Gunfire incoming, right!

Cogburn draws his Barricade through a Dark sieve; a wall of Stasis erupts to his right against the barrage. He dashes through it and into the Vex attackers, wrapped in hoarfrost mimicry and destruction. His fists rain on the Sol Divisive, an avalanche to bury them under the Darkness they claim to serve. 

Cogburn stands in a heap of twisted frames; radiolarian pools freeze solid at the lips of his boots.

A shot flies over his shoulder, downing a Harpy. He tracks it to Ana at the southern deck edge.

[Ana Bray: T-1:59…] 
Ana Bray skewers a fifth Harpy, causing it to combust in a Solar blast that scatters the Vex descending on the Southern deck. She hears Moss's gun running low when a Cyclops phases into being below the deck. Ana flings a Gunpowder bomb high into the air and sparks it with a shot from her rifle, demolishing a dozen Vex with a booming explosion to open a firing window on the Cyclops.
          
          Jinju: Ana! They're targeting the support structures.

As more Cyclopses  phase in around her, Ana slings Polaris Lance  and thrusts her empty gun hand forward; Solar flame ignites in her palm, forged into a Golden Gun. The heat of her shots leaves a molten trench and pools of simmering Light that drip over the observation deck. Her Golden rounds combust the air and sear holes through the eye of each Cyclops aiming to topple the Spire from under beneath the fireteam.

"How long, Jinju?"

          Jinju: Under a minute. Get ready, I'm starting my run.

[Moss-2: T-45]
Moss-2 braces his left arm and opens the barrels of his LMG to unleash a deluge of Void into the darkening sky. Harpies take evasive action, but many succumb to the hail of heavy munitions before they can align firing solutions on the Warlock. 

          No Name: From Moss-2's right hand, an Empowering 
          Rift flows, coaxing a Child of the Old Gods from 
          non-existence into the descending Vex, detonating 
          built-up volatility into a chain of violet consumption.

Moss-2/No Name takes cover to reload, and the Vex rain laser-fire upon them. A host of Minotaurs push his position.

          No Name: His right eye juts to the advancing Minotaurs.
          His right hand snaps toward them, palm open, and
          discharges a Handheld Supernova that deletes all but
          one Minotaur. It phases to his backside.

Moss-2 drops his machine gun to draw a sidearm, but the Minotaur is too fast and drives a metallic arm through the Warlock's gut, pinning him to the deck.

          

Moss gasps. "Take over. Now!"

          No Name: Moss-2's body shutters, his eyes sync, then  he 
          unleashes a shockwave of Nova Warp erasure, detonating the 
          shield of the Minotaur pinning him and devouring it entirely
          to stitch his wound. The Warlock rises like a marionette, floating in a violet singularity.

          No Name: "Jinju is nearing the deck. Moss-2 will cover the
          retreat." Moss-2 speaks as Light stiches their wound, eyes moving independently of each
          other, his voice layered with another, unfamiliar and frying with interference.

[Jinju: T-0:00]
Jinju brings the jump-ship down through a screen of laser fire, breaking speed just long enough to stabilize near the observation deck. Ana leaps aboard and lays down covering fire for Cogburn to slide in and shield the ship from harm with glacial walls.

Earp boards with a flourish, hurling an Arcstaff into the sky to stick a Harpy like a lightning rod and clear the air for takeoff. Moss-2 is the last to board, Void volatility flittering off his body as Jinju punches the engines. 

The fireteam blasts off toward the safety of the sun, followed by a wave of electrical distortion that leaves the complex dark and littered with fried Sol Divisive frames.
506181039.text_zh:
[埃普：倒计时-4:59…]
埃普是第一个看到太阳系分支在显现的人。

          内勒：已标记高等哥布林。我听说，太阳系分支听命于见证者。

埃普抽出他的星狐座来击穿这些高等哥布林，直到耗尽他的旋转弹膛。他走到平台的边缘，重新填装的同时闪身躲过灼热的线性步枪光束，朝他们的队伍中投掷出一枚弹跳手雷。

          内勒：已标记更多的狙击手。不知道他们的活性放射体液和主集合体有什么区别。

震颤电弧破坏了高等哥布林的队形。剩下的Vex将注意力转移到了他身上。电弧强化在埃普身上涌动，缩短了他与敌人之间的跨距。他像一道闪电穿过敞开的接收器一样击穿了Vex阵型，通过平台的外环编织出了一条电力锁链，在拿着刀、大炮和打击弩箭的太阳系分支框架之间跃动着。

          内勒：科格本快要死了。

埃普瞬间闪现到科格本的攻击者那里。他滑过身子，滚到米诺陶的两腿之间，发出一记强有力的上勾拳反击，打得Vex睁不开眼。猎人将他的大炮对准目标脆弱的放射体液球体并开了火，在原地留下一块墓碑，科格本反手抽击将其击成碎片。

[科格本：倒计时-3:42…]
          波：你正前方有敌人。

就在敌人涌向平台时，科格本向前猛冲，像覆有冰影外壳的活塞一样，用巨兽般的拳头击碎了一个又一个哥布林。他回头看了看拦截空中目标的阿娜和莫斯2号，以及在Vex中划出一道电路的埃普—— 

          波：米诺陶传送到了你左侧。

三个新出现的米诺陶开火了。已处于移动过程中的科格本在冰影冻雨的猛击下滑行，然后投掷出一枚冰川手雷来掩护前进。冰影水晶包裹住最近的米诺陶，而科格本则用粉碎性的力量撞穿它，将它们全部消灭。

波：干得漂亮。没白复活你。你是我能找到的最接近卡巴尔的人——有火力来袭，右侧！

科格本穿过一道黑色滤网抽出他的屏障；一堵冰影之墙在他的右手边突然冒出来抵挡炮火。他冲了过去，撞向Vex袭击者，包裹在白霜伪装和毁灭之中。他的拳头像雨点一样落在太阳系分支身上，如雪崩一般将他们埋葬在他们声称效忠的暗影之中。 

科格本站在一堆扭曲的框架里——放射体液池在他的战靴边冻结了起来。

一颗子弹越过他的肩膀，击落了一个机甲女妖。他循着它看到了南边平台边缘的阿娜。

[阿娜·布瑞：倒计时-1:59…] 
阿娜·布瑞刺穿了第五个机甲女妖。Vex降落在南部平台上时，机甲女妖的烈日爆炸冲散了他们的队伍。她能听到莫斯的枪快耗尽了，这时她发现一个独眼巨人正在平台下面不远的地方显现。阿娜将一枚火药炸弹高高地抛向空中，并用她的步枪射出一枚烈日子弹将其点燃，轰隆的爆炸消灭了十几个Vex，创造出射击独眼巨人的良机。
          
          金桔：阿娜！他们的目标是支撑结构。

随着更多的独眼巨人在她周围显现，阿娜放开极星长枪，向前伸出她的持枪手。烈日火焰在她的手掌中点燃，锻造成一把黄金枪。她射击的热量在她面前留下了一条熔化的沟渠，一滩滩沸腾的光能滴落在了观景平台上。她的金色子弹燃烧着空气，在每个想要把尖塔从火力战队的脚下掀翻的独眼巨人的眼睛上烧出了一个洞。

“还有多久，金桔？”

          金桔：不到一分钟。做好准备，我要开始试飞了。

[莫斯2号：倒计时-45]
莫斯2号撑起左臂，打开他的轻机枪枪筒，朝昏暗的天空射出大量的虚空弹药。机甲女妖们采取了规避行动，但很多女妖还没来得及对术士调整射击方案，就在密集如雨的重型弹药中落败。 

          无名：莫斯2号的右手边，一条强能 
          裂痕流动着，诱使着旧神之子从 
          无存化作突袭的Vex，引爆 
          累积的波动转化为紫色消耗链。

莫斯2号与无名机灵找了个掩体填装弹药，而Vex则用激光炮火朝他猛烈开火。一群米诺陶朝着他的位置推进。

          无名：他的右眼朝前进的米诺陶群探去。
          他的右手猛地朝向他们，手掌张开，
          扔出一颗手持超新星，消灭掉了所有的米诺陶，
          只留下一个。它瞬移到了他的背后。

莫斯2号放下机枪，想拔出一把手枪，但米诺陶速度太快，一只金属手臂穿过术士的内脏，将他钉在了平台上。

          

莫斯喘息道。“换你来，快！”

          无名：莫斯2号的身体颤动着，他的眼睛同步着，然后 
          释放出一个新星折跃的消除冲击波，引爆了 
          压在他身上的米诺陶护盾，将其完全吞噬，缝合他的伤口。
          术士像个木偶一般复活了过来，在紫色的奇点中飘动。

          无名：“金桔就在平台附近。莫斯2号会
          掩护撤退。”莫斯2号说。光能缝合着他的伤口。
          他的眼睛独立地游移着，声音因干扰而变得嘈杂起来。

[金桔：倒计时-0:00]
金桔穿过激光火力网降下跃迁飞船，刚好够在观景平台附近刹住。阿娜跳上飞船，开火掩护科格本滑进来，并用冰川护墙保护飞船免受伤害。

埃普动作潇洒地登上飞船，将一根电弧标杆抛向天空，像避雷针一样固定住一个机甲女妖，为起飞扫清障碍。莫斯2号是最后一个登船的，身上的虚空波动随着金桔按下引擎消散在空中。 

火力战队朝着太阳的安全方向升空，留下一股电气失真波，让那座设施变得一片昏暗，到处都是烧焦的太阳系分支框架。

119121066.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Legguards
119121066.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made legguards, to keep you moving under fire.
119121066.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制护腿，让你能冒着炮火继续前进。
119121066.text:
TERMINAL-0 LINK – ACTIVE, flashes across Ana's wrist display.

"It'll be about five minutes from the beginning of the quarantine to the EMP detonation," she says, striding back out onto the Observation Deck. "Jinju, you ready for the transfer uplink?"

          Jinju: Whenever you are.

"We'll need to hold the observation deck and keep it clear for Jinju to bring the ship down. Once the EMP starts spinning up… transmats can get a little squirrely. Moss, you, that big gun of yours, and I keep the skies clear. Earp and Cog sweep the deck."

Moss-2 takes a deep breath and racks his machine gun.

Earp pauses from loading cylinders, charge running from his fingertips, to grunt acknowledgement.

"Five minutes shouldn't be a problem," Cogburn states with confidence, his eyes noting points of cover terrain.

"We'll need about 30 seconds to clear the effective range and break atmo… or, you know, we crash. So, account for that." Ana loosens 18 Kelvins in its holster, then unslings Polaris Lance. "Ghosts, I want you calling out contacts from up there. Take away their element of surprise."

          Jinju: Will do.

          No Name:
          Moss-2 blinks unevenly. "No Name on overwatch."

          Naylor: Keeping an eye on the situation.

          Bo: Targets will be marked.

Ana sets into a position and looks to her wrist display. "Here we go."

TERMINAL-0 LINK – ACTIVE//INITIATE AI-SEC, EMP FIRE//ALL

T-5:00…
119121066.text_zh:
阿娜的腕部显示器上闪烁着：终端-0连接 – 活跃。

“从隔离开始到电磁脉冲爆炸，大约需要五分钟，”她说着，大步走回观景平台。“金桔，你准备好上行传输了吗？”

          金桔：随时准备着。

“我们需要守住观景平台，让它保持畅通，以便金桔能够把飞船降下。一旦启动电磁脉冲…传送就可能会有点不受控制。莫斯，你和你那门大炮，还有我来负责保持空域畅通。埃普和科格负责扫清平台。”

莫斯2号深吸了一口气，架上他的机枪。

正在装填旋转弹膛的埃普停了下来，咕哝着示意，电荷从他的指尖流过。

“五分钟应该不成问题，”科格本自信地说道，四下打量着掩体的地形。

“我们需要大约30秒来扫清有效范围并冲破大气层…不然的话，你们懂的，我们会坠毁。所以，考虑清楚。”阿娜把18开氏度放进枪套，然后取下极星长枪。“机灵们，我要你们从上面喊出敌袭方位。别让他们出奇制胜。”

          金桔：遵命。

          无名：
          莫斯2号不规则地眨着眼。“无名守望。”

          内勒：密切关注形势。

          波：我会标记目标。

阿娜准备就位，看了看她的腕部显示器。“我们开始吧。”

终端-0连接 – 活跃//启动人工智能安保，电磁脉冲点火//全部

倒计时-5:00…

1480429240.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Gauntlets
1480429240.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made gauntlets, protecting your most valuable assets.
1480429240.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制臂铠，保护你最宝贵的资产。
1480429240.text:
Rust-dirt expanse races beneath Ana's jumpship as it soars across the Martian desert. They drop in before the setting sun.

The Ghosts—Jinju, Bo, Naylor, and No Name—stay with the ship, keeping it level as Ana, Cogburn, Earp, and Moss-2 check weapons and leap to the observation deck of the Watcher's Spire.

Grit rasps against their helmets as engine-burn takes the jumpship to a holding pattern.

Rasp settles into eerie stillness, punctuated by exhalation.

The sights of Ana's Polaris Lance find no targets. Earp holsters a polished Vulpecula cannon, looks to Ana, and squints.

She squints back. "What are you thinking?"

"Easy. Odd," Earp grumbles, chewing the words like an acrid root.

Moss-2 peers out over the sand-sunken Complex, eyes independently scanning the ruin. "Nothing moving out there," the Warlock drones, shouldering a beaten Exitus LMG. "Good."

Ana walks past them. "I trust Earp's nose. Let's not count our blessings yet."

Cogburn cracks his Rime-plated knuckles and begins walking forward. "If there IS something to fight up here, I might as well find it now."

"If you start something, just keep it outside, Cogburn." Ana swipes her badge across a wall panel. It juts forward, spews compressed air that kicks up a tuft of orange dust, and slides into the floor revealing an unlit elevator shaft. The wall opposite of her is stamped with white lettering:

PILLORY CORE ANCHOR – SPIRE LIFT
EXECUTIVE PARAGON HARDSITE

"Seen that before?" Earp asks, reaching out and tugging on the frayed lift cabling.

"Yeah. We're in the right spot," Ana confirms.

"Follow you down…"
1480429240.text_zh:
阿娜的跃迁飞船飞过火星沙漠，辽阔的锈蚀尘土在它的底下飞驰。他们赶在了日落前抵达。

金桔、波、内勒和无名等机灵留在飞船上，让它保持水平，阿娜、科格本、埃普和莫斯2号则检查了下武器并跳到了守望者尖塔的观景平台上。

引擎燃烧让跃迁飞船进入了等待状态，沙砾擦刮着他们的头盔。

刮擦声化为诡异的寂静，不时被呼气声打断。

阿娜极星长枪的瞄准镜没有找到目标。埃普收起一门星狐座大炮，看向阿娜，斜起了眼。

她斜视了回去。“你在想什么？”

“轻松。奇怪，”埃普嘟囔着，像嚼苦根一样吐出这些字眼。

莫斯2号凝视着沉沙设施，每只眼睛独立地扫视着废墟。“外面什么动静也没有，”术士说道，扛着一架破败的艾斯特斯轻机枪。“很好。”

阿娜从他们身边走过。“我相信埃普的直觉。我们先别忙着庆祝。”

科格本掰着他那镀了白霜的指关节，开始向前走。“要是这里有敌人，我希望现在就看到。”

“要是你去惹是生非，就在外头解决，科格本。”阿娜用她的证章划过墙板。它向前伸出，喷出压缩空气，扬起一簇橙色的灰尘，滑入地板，露出一个没有照明的电梯井。她对面的墙上印着白字：

枷锁核心锚 - 尖塔电梯
主管典范地下场

“之前见过那个？”埃普问道，伸出手来拉动磨损的电梯缆绳。

“嗯。我们来对地方了，”阿娜证实道。

“跟你下去…”

3088058654.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Plate
3088058654.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made chestplate. Stay standing after any showdown.
3088058654.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制胸甲。任何较量后都屹立不倒。
3088058654.text:
Ana swipes her badge at a lone terminal illuminating an abandoned panic room deep within the complex.
___________________________________________________________________________

Welcome to Pillory [TERMINAL 0]. Input query, or select command.

[!WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY!] 

This Terminal is currently in [OVERRIDE CONDITION] following a [REACTOR MELTDOWN] incident, triggering an automatic REDLINE PROTOCOL CHECK.  

[EXECUTIVE PARAGON-LEVEL MEMBERS] Pillory system network: core anchor node.

o  ACCESS POINT: Pillory-0, "Spire"
o In the event of a catastrophic failure, neural degeneration, or loss of containment, herein collectively referred to as a [ROGUE MIND] incident, initiates [A.I. CEREBRAL PARTITIONING] and [QUARANTINE INTEGRATION] into twelve offsite CLOVIS station(s) within [NEURAL WEB-WAY].

REDLINE PROTOCOL:
o Check [PURGE] for [!LOCK LOST!].
        System reads [Locked] when in use
      System reads [No Target] when in standby
      IF: [!LOCK LOST!], consult "Containment Failure…", notify AI-Sec. immediately.

o Fire: Test Pillory
      Must read [Ready]

o Fire: Initiate Pillory

o Fire: [ECHO] Project, Alert: NavForward-Koranthin-Network 
      IF: [FAILURE], Activate: [ECHO CONTINGENCY – ARES>KORANTHIN-NETWORK]

o Sever connection to [ECHO LINK] for [REDLINE PROTOCOL QUARANTINE] in the event of a [ROGUE MIND] incident.
      IF: [AUGURMIND SELECT] = Compromised and [WARMIND SELECT] = Stable, [CANNIBALIZE]

o Containment Failure…
      CONTAINMENT INTERRUPTION: REACTOR OFFLINE!
      [WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY]
      AI-SEC [EMP-01-04]: Ready, Ready, No Signal, Ready
      [FIRE 1], [FIRE 2], No Signal, [FIRE 4]

o [AUGURMIND] Predictive Matrix
      Potential Colony Sites
      Chronoscopic Analysis
      MIND FORK II PROTOTYPE INTERLACING
      PROJECT FILE: Ishtar-Joint, Sundaresh
      Pillory Protocol Inclusion: Augurmind - CLEARED
      Working Agreement – Status: Terminated
      Anomalous Report(s), Catalogued - LOCKED

o KORINATH NETWORK ECHO PODS (0/712)
      STRONGHOLD(S): C, Q, N, B, F
      Caster-7 "Nomad Beacon" Weapons Platform Receiver
      Frontier Armament Schematics
      [ECHO CONNECTION SEVERED – MANUAL OVERRIDE REQUIRED]

[WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY]
___________________________________________________________________________

Ana skims the readout and eyes the warnings of a foreign entity.

"There's still a Sol Divisive signature in the network. It's weak and disconnected, but it's active." Her fingers enter a flurry of commands. "It's grouping dozens of file references for something called the Augurmind." 

"The Augurmind looks like a predictive engine directing expansion of extrasolar colonies. Maya Sundaresh made a clairvoyant AI using Vex tech… and the Sol Divisive want it, or want something from it," Ana informs. "I bet we've been left alone because this networked Vex signature hasn't been threatened… but it'll eventually realize it's been cut off and start replicating."

"So, we're in for a fight?" radios Cogburn, his voice lifting.

"Site protocol is to blow the EMPs. So that's what we do," Ana says. "But yeah, probably."

"How does an EMP… affect me?" Moss-2 radios, voice uncertain.

"You'll be fine."

"Great. But we're leaving empty handed?" Moss-2 protests.

"Like hell," Ana retorts, sifting through the console's directory. "I can compress this entire site's data, including these 'Frontier Armaments' schematics into a few engrams within minutes. Then we spin up the EMPs and make sure the Sol Divisive can never use this place again."

Cogburn chuckles over the channel. "There. You can replace that rotten piece of wood you shoot bullets out of."

"Maybe you can finally stop using your fists," quips Moss-2.

Ana cuts in. "Before we start the compression, I'll have to quarantine the Sol Divisive signature… and it is not going to like that."

"Gunslinger." Earp's voice cuts through the chatter. "What do you need from us?"
3088058654.text_zh:
阿娜在一个孤零零的终端上刷了一下她的证章，点亮了设施深处的一个废弃密室。
___________________________________________________________________________

欢迎来到枷锁[终端0]。输入问询，或选择指令。

[警告：网内检测到外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷] 

继[反应堆熔毁]事件后，此终端目前处于[超控状态]，触发自动红线协议检查。  

[主管典范级成员]枷锁系统网络：核心锚节点。

o 接入点：枷锁-0，“尖塔”
o 如果发生灾难性故障、神经退化或物料泄露，此处统称为[失控思维]事件，则会启动[人工智能大脑分区]和[隔离整合]，进入[神经网络通道]内的十二个场外克洛维斯站点。

红线协议：
o 检查[清除]寻找[!锁定丢失!]。
      使用时系统读取[已锁定]
      待机时系统读取[无目标]
      如果：[!锁定丢失!]，则查询“遏制失效…”，立即通知人工智能安保。

o 点火：测试枷锁
      必读[就绪]

o 点火：启动枷锁

o 点火：[回声]项目，警报：向前导航-可兰辛-网络 
      如果：[失效]，则激活：[回声应急措施 – 阿瑞斯>可兰辛-网络]

o 在发生[失控思维]事件时，切断[红线协议隔离]的[回声链接]连接。
      如果：[占卜思维选择] = 已受损以及[战争思维选择] = 稳定，[调拨]

o 遏制失效…
      遏制中断：反应堆下线！
      [警告：检测到网内外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷]
      人工智能安保[电磁脉冲-01-04]：就绪，就绪，无信号，就绪
      [点火1]，[点火2]，无信号，[点火4]

o [占卜思维]预测矩阵
      潜在殖民地点
      瞬时分析
      思维分岔II原型隔行扫描
      项目文件：伊什塔联合，桑戴尔什
      枷锁协议内含：占卜思维 - 已核准
      工作协议 – 状态：已终止
      异常报告，编目 - 已锁定

o 科林塔赫网络回声舱 (0/712)
      据点：C，Q，N，B，F
      卡斯特-7“游牧信标”武器平台接收器
      前沿军备图纸
      [回声连接已切断 – 需要手动超控]

[警告：检测到网内外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷]
___________________________________________________________________________

阿娜浏览着读数。她注意到了外来实体的警告。

“网络里依然有太阳系分支的信号。信号很微弱，没有连接，但处于活跃状态。”她的手指输入一连串的指令。“它把几十个文件引用分组，用于一个叫做‘占卜思维'的东西。” 

“占卜思维看起来像是个用于指导太阳系外殖民地的扩张的预测引擎。玛雅·桑戴尔什用Vex科技创造了一个拥有预知能力的人工智能…所以太阳系分支想要得到它，或者想要从中得到些什么，”阿娜说道。“我敢打赌，我们未受攻击是因为这个联网的Vex信号并没有受到威胁…但它最终会意识到它已被切断，并开始复制。”

“这么说，我们要打一架了？”科格本用无线电说道，提高了嗓门。

“站点协议是要炸毁电磁脉冲。所以那就是我们要做的事，”阿娜说道。“但你讲得对，很有可能要打架。”

“电磁脉冲会…对我有什么影响？”莫斯2号用无线电说道，声音中带着迟疑。

“你不会有事的。”

“太好了。但我们就这么空手而归？”莫斯2号抗议道。

“当然不，”阿娜反驳道，仔细查看了控制台的目录。“我可以在几分钟内将整个站点的数据，包括这些‘前沿军备'图纸压缩成几个记忆水晶。然后我们启动电磁脉冲，确保太阳系分支再也不能使用这个地方。”

科格本在频道里咯咯笑着。“好了。你可以换掉你用来射子弹的那块烂木头了。”

“也许你终于可以不再用拳头了，”莫斯2号打趣道。

阿娜插嘴道。“在开始压缩之前，我必须隔离太阳系分支的信号…而它不会喜欢那样的。”

“枪手。”埃普的声音打断了他们。“你需要我们做什么？”

2599025961.name: TM-Cogburn Custom Cover
2599025961.subtitle: Tex Mechanica custom-made armored cover. Headstrong, perfect for a charging bull.
2599025961.subtitle_zh: 特克斯机械定制护甲面罩。铜头铁额，非常适合一头冲锋的公牛。
2599025961.text:
Ana Bray stands from behind her workshop monitor, followed by her Ghost, Jinju. "The Vex did what?"

Niik peeks over an adjacent monitor.

"The Guardian thwarted their attempt," Osiris responds.

Ana sits back down with a sigh. "Here I thought we only had to deal with one robot."

Osiris raises a finger in protest, "The Vex aren't robo—"

Ana cuts in. "We need to make sure they can't try it again. A while back I found a Pillory bunker. Made sure only Rasputin could access them. Clearly the Sol Divisive didn't get the memo," Ana says, collecting equipment around the workshop. "They'll try again."

Osiris nods, the potential of adventure drawing his lips into a smirk. "Then I'll go—"

"No!" Ana dashes passed Osiris, "It's your night to watch the Colonel. I'll outsource a posse."

***

Three rugged Guardians crowd a wooden table in the Ether Tank. Ana spots their Tex Mechanica gear in the crowd. She sends Niik through the mingling bustle of Eliksni and Human patronage to order refreshments from the barkeep.

Ana saddles up to the table, slaps her hand down. "Wasn't sure you'd show after our talk."

"No one likes dealing with Vex, Gunslinger," the Awoken Hunter, Earp, grumbles from below the brim of his hat.

Ana smiles and tilts her head. " Which is why I'm paying you for the trouble."

"We accepted before some of us knew we were dealing with robots that delete you from existin'." A leather-robed, Exo Warlock, Moss-2, leans forward, followed by a Ghost hovering close to his head. 

"They're not actually robots," Ana grumbles.

"Nonetheless, hazard like that costs extra." Moss-2's eyes blink independently, followed by his Ghost's iris, as if in a sequence.

Ana looks to Earp quizzically, who shrugs, then back to Moss-2. "What is this, a shakedown?"

A grizzled Human Titan at the table, Cogburn, stands. His mountainous frame towers over the seated Guardians. "Moss wants claims to weapons, loot, or patterns we find. Boy's still fresh, grave dirt on his boots. Needs all the help he can get," he booms, then turns to his partners. "Why are we muddying this water, dancing around? Just ask her for it."

Ana laughs, leans back to meet Cogburn's gaze, then stares down Moss-2. "I'm going to assume you shot that offer so high because you're hoping to get something in the middle. Here it goes: you get your normal payment, plus first print of any weapon schematics we find that Tex can fabricate. They'll fit those custom threads."

"Sound good to you, Moss?" Cogburn barks with a gruff chuckle, sitting. "If things get too hot your Ghost can just do it for you."

Niik arrives, distributes drinks, and sits as Ana pulls a free chair next to her.

Ana studies Moss-2 and his Ghost as they silently consider her offer; a cranial implant embedded in Moss-2's skull flashes a light in sequence with his Ghost's iris. "What do you mean by that?"

"I don't have a firm grasp on the Light," Moss-2's illuminated mouth forms a frown. "But No Name does, so we share." The Ghost, settles into his open palm.

"Share what?"

Moss-2 taps the blinking implant on his cranial-plate. "Everything. And we find your offer agreeable."

The party share agreeing glances, then return a simple, silent nod before draining their cups.
2599025961.text_zh:
阿娜·布瑞从作坊显示器前站起身，她的机灵金桔紧随其后。“Vex干了什么？”

妮可望了望旁边的显示器。

“守护者挫败了他们的企图，”奥斯里斯回应道。

阿娜叹了口气，坐了下来。“我还以为我们只需要对付一个机器人。”

奥斯里斯抬起手指抗议，“Vex可不是机器——”

阿娜打断了他。“我们得确保它们没法再这样来一次。不久前，我袭击了每个枷锁地堡，确保只有拉斯普廷可以访问它们。很明显太阳系分支并不知情，”阿娜一边说，一边在作坊周围收集设备。“它们绝对还会再来一次。”

奥斯里斯点了点头，冒险的可能性让他不禁露出了笑容。“那就让我去…”

“不！”阿娜飞身挡住奥斯里斯，喊道，“今晚该你监视上校了。我会派其他人去…”

***

三个外表粗犷的守护者挤在乙太罐里一张木桌旁。阿娜在人群中认出了他们的特克斯机械装备。她让妮可穿过混杂的埃里克斯尼族和人类顾客，跟酒保点些酒水。

阿娜跨坐在桌边，往桌子上拍了一掌。“我原本还不确定我们谈话后你们是否会出现。”

“没人喜欢和Vex打交道，枪手，”帽檐下传来了觉醒者猎人埃普的嘟囔声。

阿娜笑了笑，歪着头。“这正是我付钱给你们的原因。”

“这活是在我们知道要去对付能把你直接‘删除'掉的机器人之前接下的。”一位穿着皮大衣的Exo术士向前倾身。他叫莫斯-2。他脑袋旁边还悬浮着一只机灵。 

“他们其实不是机器人，”阿娜咕哝道。

“无论如何，去对付那种危险对手得加价。”莫斯-2依次眨了眨眼，然后他的机灵也跟着眨了一下，像是有顺序似的。

阿娜疑惑地看向埃普，后者耸了耸肩。她的目光又回到了莫斯-2身上。“你们想敲诈我？”

桌旁发色灰白的人类泰坦科格本站了起来。他庞大的身躯让坐着的守护者显得格外渺小。“莫斯想得到我们发现的任何武器、战利品或模式。他是个新人，靴子上还沾着坟土呢。他需要能得到的所有帮助。”他用低沉的声音说道。“我们干嘛要绕圈子？直接问她要吧。”

阿娜笑着靠在椅背上，与科格本的目光相迎，然后盯着莫斯2号。“你刚刚开这么高的要求只是为了抬高我的价吧。这样如何，你们能拿到正常的报酬，再加上我们发现特克斯能制造的任何武器图纸的首个印本。它们会适合那些定制纱线的。”

“你觉得怎样，莫斯？”科格本坐下，粗声粗气地笑道。“如果事情太棘手，就交给你的机灵做呗。”

妮可拿着一堆酒水来到桌旁，坐在了阿娜拉过来的椅子上。

阿娜打量着正在考虑提案的莫斯-2和他的机灵；嵌入Moss-2颅骨的植入物与他机灵的虹膜依次闪烁着光芒。“那是什么意思？”

“我还没能完全掌握光能，”莫斯-2发光的嘴唇皱了皱。“不过我的机灵无名掌握了，所以我们会共享。”机灵落到了他的手心里。

“共享什么？”

莫斯2号敲了敲他颅骨上闪烁的植入物。“所有的一切。我们同意你的提案。”

一行人交换了同意的眼神，然后简单而沉默地点了点头，喝干了杯子里的酒。

4174431791.name: Hierarchy of Needs
4174431791.subtitle: "I have peered through the eye of Chronos to divine humanity's path into the future." —Soteria, the Augurmind
4174431791.subtitle_zh: “我已透过克罗诺斯之眼预见了人类通向未来的道路。”——占卜思维索特里亚
4174431791.text:
//VanNet Voice-COMM, Received: Osiris//
//VOICE TRANSCRIPT RUNNING…// 
//FROM: ANA BRAY//
//RECORD FOLLOWS://

Osiris, exciting news! You're going to love this. Rogue A.I. imprisoned in a Bray cell block from now, all the way back to the Collapse. Guess what?

The Guardian—you know the one—they bust open her cell, and she—the A.I.—pulls herself together and escapes while the Vex  are trying to organize a defense! The kicker is, the only networked A.I. host nearby was an old survivalist's caster bow from the colony missions. Might sound primitive, but Seraphs would link those things to orbital weapons platforms and bring wild planets to heel. Now swap weapon platforms for paracausal power, and an A.I. running flight trajectories on your arrows.

I swear anything sentient has a chance to wind up as a weapon around that Guardian…

Anyway, seems that being partitioned for so long, and not coming back together with all her parts, has left that A.I. with more than a few quirks. She's borderline non-functional, won't or can't communicate, but a lot of her subconscious sub-routines are still firing. Trajectory predictors still seem to work just fine; the few firing tests I ran produced… explosive results.

I guess terminal velocity translates across mediums.

There's still another part of her rogue A.I. out there. Who knows what happened to the one ship that got away. Maybe it could've drifted off for centuries; a little piece of her aboard like a good luck charm. 
I mean, it probably didn't make it. If the Exodus programs are any indication, pretty much nothing survived the Collapse.

So, anyway, that's the lowdown bow-down. Great. I vocalized that. 

Oh, we also downloaded everything. I'll send you a copy sometime.

Another thought: might be good for Banshee to take a look or…after reading some of these logs, maybe it'd be really bad. Opinions?
4174431791.text_zh:
//VanNet语音通讯，接收者：奥斯里斯//
//正在抄录语音…// 
//发信人：阿娜·布瑞//
//记录如下：//

奥斯里斯，有个激动人心的消息！包你喜欢。有个失控人工智能自从大崩溃就被囚禁在布瑞的牢房里。然后你猜怎么着？

那个守护者，就是你知道的那个人…打开了她的牢房。然后…那个人工智能竟然振作起来，趁Vex还没组织好防御，逃了出来！更精彩的是，附近唯一连接到网络的人工智能载体是个来自殖民任务的生存者施法弓。也许这东西听起来很原始，但曾几何时，炽天使会把这种东西连接至轨道武器平台，征服荒蛮的星球。现在想象一下，用超因果能量替代那些武器平台，再加上一个给你的弓箭计算弹道的人工智能…

我发誓，任何有智慧的东西到了那守护者附近都有可能变成一件武器…

总而言之，由于被分隔了这么久，而且缺了些部件，那个人工智能有些怪异。她几乎无法正常运行，而且不会或者不能交流，但有很多潜意识的子程序仍在运行。轨迹预测器似乎仍能正常工作。我进行的几次射击测试产生了一些…爆炸性的结果。

看来，终极速率能跨媒介转换。

她的失控人工智能还有一部分在外面。谁知道逃走的那艘飞船现在怎样了。也许它把那个人工智能的一部分当做护身符，载着它漂流了几百年。 
我的意思是，那艘飞船…大概…也没能幸存。就像移民号计划一样，基本没什么东西能从大崩溃时代残存下来。

好了，我就简短总结到这里。真好，我总算说了。 

哦，我们把所有东西都下载了。我改天给你发个副本过去。

我还有个想法：那件武器也许应该让班西瞧瞧…读过这些日志之后，我觉得它有点不妙啊。你觉得呢？

219145368.name: The Manticore
219145368.subtitle: Let fly my sting.
219145368.text:
Across the Ascendant Plane, in the theater of the mind, a Queen and a War God do battle. Within their arena, elocution becomes a spear, and conviction a shield.

YOU ARE SMALL-MINDED, stabs the War God. SHORTSIGHTED. YOU VALUE LIFE OVER VICTORY.

Her words are sharp, her thoughts malicious. The Queen parries and counters.

"You are single-minded," she thrusts back at her opponent. "Myopic. You are war, and nothing else."

A glancing blow. The War God retorts.

WAR IS ETERNAL. YOU ARE NOT. YOU WITHER AND DIE LIKE YOUR ARMIES. YOUR SUBJECTS.

The War God's spearhead finds purchase. The Queen is struck—but not felled. She adjusts her tactics and attempts once more to puncture her foe's armor.

"War is ever hungry," she answers. "You must fight forever, or it will consume you instead of your enemies. In truth, you are not war. Merely its avatar."

A deft maneuver. The War God is surprised and pleased. In response, she pivots to a new angle of attack.

YOUR BROTHER SHUNS YOU.

The Queen falters. It is an opening in her defenses she failed to cover adequately. Psychic blood seeps from a mental wound.

But she rallies.

"Your sister plotted against you," she lunges forward. "She freed herself from the bondage you still endure. And she did so at MY hand."

The Queen feels the spear pierce the War God's hide. Something akin to a gasp echoes throughout the Ascendant Plane as the War God takes a step back.

And then the War God laughs.

YOU ARE A WORTHY FOE, she says as she sheathes her spear. I LOOK FORWARD TO OUR NEXT BATTLE.

She departs the field. The Queen is alone, bleeding and spent.

The war has begun.
219145368.text_zh:
跨越上维位面的思维战场中，女王和战神在战斗。在这个竞技场当中，雄辩成了长矛；信念化作护盾。

“你思维狭隘，”战神一记戳刺。“目光短浅。看重生命多过胜利。”

她言语犀利，思想恶毒。女王招架并展开反击。

“你一意孤行，”她回击对手。“鼠目寸光。除了战争，你什么也不是。”

旁敲侧击。战神予以反驳。

“战争永恒。而你不是。你终将衰老死去，就像你的军队，你的臣民。”

战神的矛头找到了支点。女王被击中，但没有倒下。她改变了战术，再次试图刺穿对手的盔甲。

“战争从不知满足，”她回答道。“你必须永远战斗，否则它就会吞噬你而非你的敌人。实际上，你不是战争，只是它的化身。”

巧妙花招。战神又惊又喜。作为回应，她转向了新的攻击角度。

“你的兄弟对你避之不及。”

女王一阵畏缩。这是她没能完全守住的防御漏洞。心灵之血从精神创伤中渗了出来。

但她重新振作起来。

“你的姐妹密谋害你，”她向前猛戳。“她已从你仍在忍受的束缚中解脱。假我之手。”

女王感觉到长矛刺穿了战神的皮肤。战神往后踉跄了一步，某种类似喘息的声音在上维位面里回荡。

然后战神笑了。

“你是个劲敌，”她收起长矛，说道。“我期待我们的下一场战斗。”

她离开了战场。留下女王孤身一人，血流不止，精疲力竭。

战争开始了。

3849444474.text:
ACSENDANT ANCHOR-LOCK-LL-Origin
SOC5: Encrypted Thread: Outgoing…
REPORT ISSUED DIRECT: DC-Q: Actual
FW: EMB-COPY-LINK: COALITION; VG; EligosLex-V

Special Outfit Five and Techeun Ylaia at Beacon 1. Anchorage established in the Ascendant Plane. Ylaia is finding a way through the Ley Lines. Threat assessment of Hive forces within Sol's Ascendant borders in progress. Will continue realignment to this thread for correspondence…

Special Outfit Five has reached Beacon 2. Patrol reports 11 Hive sightings: 1 Wizard, 10 Knights. Not scavenging Thrall or Acolyte delvers. They're establishing a perimeter on our borders, but we slipped through. Ylaia says the Plane is degrading again. We're getting closer to a corruptive presence. Her ward is holding, and we've gone undetected. Team is dark for six.

Beacon 3 is compromised! They brought in a Shrieker over us, blaring some horrid noise. Ylaia's ward kept it from pinpointing us, but it knew we were there. Two Corsairs injured in contact—Hive pursuing—thread falling out of beacon range. Expect late realignment—

REALIGNMENT-LOCK-LL-Luna

Special Outfit Five reporting. The landscape distorted into a climb to Beacon 4. Ylaia bridged a connection to send our injured home. I worried it would draw attention, but planar activity in the vicinity is so turbulent that it was more like shouting into the wind.

Forward patrol notes an interior perimeter upwards of 70 Shriekers, dozens of cryptoliths, and incoming battle caravans numbering tens of thousands. My queen… Wizards conjure the Black Terrace. Xivu Arath's voice bends the Plane. 

The War-god is calling an army to her banner. 

Luna is in danger.

2272041093.name: Fire and Forget
2272041093.subtitle: Remove what brings you pain.
2272041093.subtitle_zh: 除掉给你带来痛苦的东西。
2272041093.text:
Banshee-44 emits a low whistle as he watches Stasis energy course through the rifle's internal conduits.

"Ninety-seven percent efficiency," he mutters to himself in wonder. "This thing's state of the art."

"It certainly is," replies another Exo voice beside him. Ada-1 peers over the gunsmith's shoulder, equally fascinated by the BrayTech weapon.

"The Black Armory never developed a linear fusion rifle," she continues. "Our forges lacked the necessary precision."

"LFRs are a special breed of gun," Banshee says. He turns his head and notices Ada focusing on the weapon. "You ever want to take a crack at making one?"

Ada folds her hands in front of her, taking a moment to consider. 

"No," she answers quietly. "The forges were built out of fear. We thought that even in a Golden Age, humanity needed an arsenal to defend itself. But they created more conflict than they ever prevented."

"Weapons tend to do that," Banshee remarks knowingly. 

He meets Ada's eyes. "You've never been reset? Remember everything after you first woke up?"

"I do," she replies in a haunted voice. "Every Fallen raid. Every Warlord grasping for more power."

Banshee nods to himself and runs his hand over the contours of the rifle. "I've been reset 44 times," he says. "I forget about most of the guns I make. Don't know who uses them or what for."

"That sounds awful," Ada replies.

"Sometimes," Banshee admits. "But between the two of us… maybe that makes me the lucky one."
2272041093.text_zh:
班西-44通过步枪的内部管道观察着冰影能量的轨迹，发出了一声低沉的口哨声。

“97%的效率，”他惊讶地自语道。“这玩意儿真先进。”

“确实如此，”他身旁的另一个Exo声音回答道。艾达-1越过枪匠的肩膀望过去，同样被布瑞科技的武器迷住了。

“黑色军械库从没开发过线性融合步枪，”她继续说道。“我们的锻造厂缺少必要的精准度。”

“线性融合步枪是种特殊的枪，”班西说道。他转过头，注意到艾达正专注于那件武器。“你想过试着做一把吗？”

艾达双手交叉在面前，考虑了一下。 

“不，”她平静地答道。“锻造厂是出于恐惧才建的。我们以为就算在黄金时代，人类也需要军械库来自卫。但它们更多的是带来冲突，而不是阻止纷争。”

“毕竟是武器嘛，”班西心神意会地说道。 

他与艾达四目相对。“你从来没有被重置过？还记得你第一次醒来后的一切？”

“是的，”她怅惘地答道。“我记得每一次堕落者突袭，每一个攫取更多权力的战争领主。”

班西点点头，用手抚摸着步枪。“我被重置了44次，”他说道。“我造的大多数枪都忘记了。不知道是谁在用，也不知道被用来干什么。”

“听起来很糟糕，”艾达回应道。

“有时吧，”班西承认道。“但老实说…也许那也是一种福分。”

1751893422.name: Disparity
1751893422.subtitle: "Identify yourself, or be destroyed." —Clovis Bray I
1751893422.subtitle_zh: “表明身份，否则格杀勿论。”——克洛维斯·布瑞一世
1751893422.text:
Cadmus Ridge rests within the grip of a storm. Wind-whipped frazil ice scours the exposed superstructure of bygone ambition. Steel crumbles, slowly, to the howling blind; sleet swarms like locusts pecking rust on skeletal decay. A patient war. Inevitable, like entropy.

The storm halts as if detecting a predator on the wind—quiet settles in the moment. A cloaked Vandal stands, and the silhouette of their camouflage breaks against the stillness. 

A cloudburst splits the sky, turning the storm and sleet to a surge of needling rain that perforates the Vandal. Soulfire rifts tear open to expel three gargantuan Hive Tomb Ships. They slowly drift into formation, unthreatened, positioning themselves above Riis-Reborn.

From their hulls spew runes of black fire that meet between the ships and ignite into the projection of a bladed terrace, casting House Salvation's new home in shadow. 

It is as night. The distant light of the Sun is choked from the sky.

A voice booms like thunder. 

HEAR THE DIN OF RAPTURE. WELCOME ME IN YOUR ARMS. CELEBRATE MY ARRIVAL, AND KNOW ME AGAIN. FOR THIS WORLD HAS ALWAYS BEEN MINE.

Deep within Bray Exoscience Creation, Clovis Bray I rouses from infernal calculous; a maintenance coordination AI has signaled an emergency.

"What is it?" Clovis demands.

A monotone version of his own voice responds. "Unknown craft have entered Europan airspace. How shall I respond?"

"Broadcast my voice… and arm the perimeter," Clovis orders.

"Affirmative. Ready upon speaking," the AI informs.

"Alien vessel, this is Clovis Bray. Identify yourself or be destroyed."

The thunder, distant, though no quieter, responds…

"I AM WAR."
1751893422.text_zh:
卡德马斯山脊被风暴席卷。狂风夹杂着碎冰击打着暴露的雄伟上层建筑。钢架随着风声缓慢地崩塌；雨淞就像蝗虫一样在腐烂的骨骼上啄食锈迹。一场耐心的战争。不可避免，如同熵变。

风暴停止了，仿佛是发现了风中的捕食者…万籁无声。一个戴着披风的暴徒站在那里，他的伪装轮廓凸显在静谧之中。 

一片暴雨劈开了天空，风暴和雨雪夹杂在一起，变成针刺的风暴，穿透了暴徒的身体。灵魂之火的裂缝撕裂开来，三艘巨大的邪魔族棺舰从中飞出。它们不紧不慢地组成队形，在重生的里斯上空停了下来。

它们的船身中喷出的黑色火焰符文汇聚在一起，形成了一个尖锐平台的投影。这就是救赎氏族新家的影子。 

这个平台漆黑如夜。远处的阳光被拦在了它身后。

一个雷鸣般的嗓音响彻云霄。 

听听狂欢的喧嚣。将我纳入你的怀抱。庆祝我的到来，重新认识我。因为这个世界一直都是我的。

在布瑞Exo科学所创世所的深处，克洛维斯·布瑞从地狱般的计算中苏醒过来；有个维护协调人工智能发出了一个紧急信号。

“怎么了？”克洛维斯逼问道。

一个与他自己相同的单调声音回应道：“未知飞行器已进入木卫二领空。我应该如何回应？”

“广播我的声音…并在周边设防，”克洛维斯下令。

“明白。已经准备就绪，”人工智能回答道。

“外星舰船，我是克洛维斯·布瑞。表明身份，否则格杀勿论。”

那雷声，虽然在远方，用更响亮的声音回答道…

“我是战争。”

2827764482.name: Path of Least Resistance
2827764482.subtitle: No charge greater.
2827764482.text:
Eramis always looks Scorn in their eyes.

"She does it to assert dominance," she once heard one of her subordinates say. Rather than correct them, she let the rumor take root, and grow wild and fierce.
 
There is no one left that she trusts enough to share the truth: Eramis always looks Scorn in their eyes because she's desperate to see some faint flicker of the Eliksni they were before.

The first time the Witness presents her with Phyris—with whom Eramis fought alongside in life—she wills her expression into something that resembles Human steel.
 
"A gift," claims the Witness, but Eramis cannot find her voice—not even to feign gratitude. She reaches up, grazes claws against the side of the Eliksni's face, and searches for any sign of her friend.

Yet all she sees in Phyris's eyes is her own reflection, glassy and alien.

Eramis wants to scream; part of her is grateful when Phyris sinks teeth into the flesh of her forearm, giving her an excuse.

One that doesn't make her appear weak.
2827764482.text_zh:
伊拉莫斯直视着嗤魅的眼睛。

“她这样做是为了表明权威。”她曾听到属下这样说。不过她并没有纠正，反而是让这句谣言传得众人皆知。
 
她没有一个信任到能告诉真相的人：伊拉莫斯总是直视着嗤魅的眼睛，因为她想在其中找到之前那些埃里克斯尼族的影子。

见证者第一次让她见到菲利斯…那个在世时与伊拉莫斯并肩作战的人的时候…她显出了比人类的钢铁还要坚毅的表情。
 
“这是个礼物，”见证者声称，但伊拉莫斯却没法开口…她连假意道谢都做不到。她伸出爪子，抚着那名埃里克斯尼族的脸颊，试图找到故友的影子。

然而她只能在菲利斯的眼里看到自己的倒影，呆滞而陌生。

伊拉莫斯想要尖叫；当菲利斯的牙齿扎进她的手臂时，她甚至感到了些许感激。因为这给了她一个借口。

一个用来掩盖她软弱的借口。

3103325054.name: Retrofit Escapade

3103325054.text:
"This is it! This is where legends are made!" Ana bellows into an enormous, empty room lined with gloss-paneled walls. A single console plinth rises from the floor. 

She turns to an underwhelmed Elsie. "Shaxx would yell that whenever we stepped into a new Crucible arena. Now they're all simulated here."

"What else can it simulate?" Elsie asks, hands at the console, mind opening to possibilities.

"A lot of things, I guess. You have to tell it what to make, and the directions need to be pretty clear, like a blueprint," Ana explains.

"Do you remember—" Elsie catches herself. "Here, let me show you something." She pulls a thin cable from her wrist plate and inserts it into the console, uploading her own blueprint.

The room digitizes briefly before solidifying into a small, nondescript sporting court. In place of the console is a countertop fitted with an oval disk of brass, etched with grooves forming orbital paths around a loose brass orb.

"This is a game called 'Sacra,'" Elsie says, fingers deftly running along the grooves. She taps the orb, which ascends and floats into the middle of the court. Red lines fizzle into the air around it, each one tracing a different path. Elsie swipes a brass groove, and a holographic pebble appears at her fingertips.

"That orb has its own gravity. You get five stones to throw into orbit. The goal is to align all five in a stack at an intersection point; then they'll fuse together. If they survive an orbit like that, you win."

Ana taps her chin. "Seems pretty math heavy."

"Math is one winning strategy. Rhythm is another," Elsie says. "Striking an opponent's stone head on destroys both. Anything else is just a nudge."

"All right, sis. Buckle up… because I'm gonna kick your custom-made butt."

Elsie cringes. "Thinking you have some instinctual skills locked away?"

"I fly a spaceship every day. I can do orbits."

They play over and over, becoming increasingly competitive, increasingly matched. 

Still, each game ends in Elsie's favor. And each grates on Ana more than the last. She howls in frustration.

"We can stop," Elsie offers.

"One more."

They reset.

The sisters trace orbital paths and send their pebbles along them. On her fifth, Ana spots an opening and throws. Her stones' orbits align into a Sacra stack.

"I WON!" Ana bursts into the air amid the swirls of red.

Elsie eyes her own slow-moving stone approaching Ana's stack. "Have you?" 

She points as it gently drifts onto a collision course, hitting and scattering Ana's pebbles.

"Damn it!" Ana sinks to the ground, pressing her face into her palms before lying flat on her back. "Am I at least better at this than I used to be?" she grumbles.

Elsie steps beside Ana, then slowly lies down by her side. "No. You're exactly as bad as you used to be."

Elsie's smile breaks first. Then Ana's, reluctantly.

Quiet contentment. Spontaneous… and genuine.

"But… this is better than it was before."
3103325054.text_zh:
“就是这里！这就是传奇的诞生之地！”阿娜咆哮着走进一个巨大而空旷的房间，四周是光面的镶板墙。一个单独的控制台基座从地板上升起。 

她转向无动于衷的艾尔西。“每次我们踏入一个新的熔炉竞技场，沙克斯都会这样大喊。现在它们都会在这儿被模拟。”

“它还能模拟些什么？”艾尔西问道，双手放在控制台上，脑子里思考着各种可能性。

“很多东西吧，我猜。你必须告诉它要制作什么，而且指示必须很清晰，就像蓝图一样，”阿娜解释道。

“你还记得——”艾尔西及时住嘴。“来，我给你看样东西。”她从手腕板上拔出一根细缆，将其插入控制台，上传了她自己的蓝图。

房间经过简单的数字化处理后，变成了一个难以形容的小运动场。控制台被替换成了一个装有椭圆形黄铜圆盘的台面，上面刻有凹槽，围绕着一个松动的黄铜球体形成轨道。

“这是一种叫做‘萨克拉'的游戏，”艾尔西说道，手指灵巧地沿着凹槽移动。她轻敲球体，让铜球上升并漂浮至球场中央。红色的线条在它周围的空气中嘶嘶作响，每一条都沿着不同的路径。艾尔西擦了擦黄铜凹槽，一块全息石子出现在她的指尖上。

“那个球体有自己的重力。你要把五枚石子扔进轨道。目标是在交叉点把所有五枚石子排成栈；然后它们就会融合。如果它们像那样在轨道上留下来，你就赢了。”

阿娜轻拍下巴。“看来要用到很多数学知识。”

“数学是一种获胜策略，而节奏则是另一种。”艾尔西说道。“直接撞到对手的石子会同归于尽。否则就只是轻推。”

“好了，姐姐。做好准备吧…因为我要让你瞧瞧我的厉害。”

艾尔西感到一阵局促。“你觉得自己有未被发掘的天分吗？”

“我每天都驾驶太空飞船。我懂轨道的事。”

她们玩了一遍又一遍，竞争越来越激烈，越来越势均力敌。 

但每一次都以艾尔西获胜而告终。每一次都让阿娜更加恼火。她沮丧地叫喊起来。

“我们可以到此为止，”艾尔西说道。

“再来一次。”

她们又重新开始。

姐妹俩跟踪轨道路径，沿着它们发送石子。在她第五回时，阿娜发现了一个机会并投了出去。她石子的轨道排列成了萨克拉栈。

“我赢了！”阿娜在红色的漩涡中腾空而起。

艾尔西看着她自己缓慢移动的石子靠近阿娜的石栈。“你确定？” 

她指向那石子，它轻轻飘移，撞散了阿娜的石栈。

“该死！”阿娜颓然倒在地面，把脸埋在手心里，然后平躺了下来。“至少我比以前好点了吧？”她嘟囔道。

艾尔西走到阿娜身边，然后慢慢地躺在她的侧旁。“不，你和以前一样糟。”

艾尔西先笑了起来。然后阿娜也不情愿地笑了。

平静的满足感。自然…而真诚。

“但…这次比以前更好。”

2978226043.name: Judgment of Kelgorath
2978226043.subtitle: "CARVE UNTO ME A TRIBUTE OF WAILING PRAYERS" —Xivu Arath, Hive God of War
2978226043.subtitle_zh: “为我刻下一段哀嚎恸哭的祷文。”——希乌阿拉斯，邪魔族战神
2978226043.text:
*****

Häkke Foundry Rebuild-001 

Designation: Experimental Project–Vanguard Clearance Approved 

Work: New haft, bound in dampening weave. Blade reset with reinforced tang, sharpening not needed. Emitter fitted and recalibrated, grip and housing reconstructed to meet Human anatomy.

"Darkblade core - 1" retrieved from onsite by Guardian operator.

Hive inscriptions decoded by operator, Osiris. Translation of experiential record imprint as follows:

*****

The black-flame projection of Xivu Arath fills the Martian cavern. Below her, Kelgorath's broken blade rests atop a ritual altar—both are inlaid with runes caked in dried blood layered like stratum.  

An ornately adorned Wizard presides over the communal ceremony. They motion to the blade.

"This one has failed you many times."

The cavern quakes with Xivu's whispered reply.

RUIN BIRTHS RENEWAL

She reaches through her projection and coaxes the blade into the air, then cleaves hefts of the heavy Hive metal from the weapon. What remains is a dark sliver. An imitation of Xivu's black edge.

AS VICTORY'S HAMMER SHAPES, SO DOES FAILURE'S CHISEL

The blade is reforged, a razor of painless edge and subtle ends.
WORTH SHALL BE MEASURED…

Xivu Arath twists her claws. A haft condenses from swirling soulfire into solid stone and bonds to the blade. By her voice, the weapon is anointed. 

…AND JUDGMENT PASSED

At her command, a tear into the Ascendant Plane bursts open before her. Kelgorath steps from the portal. 

"What can this humble servant offer Death?"

The cavern fills with her answer.

CLAIM MARS; POSSESS THE WARMIND

Kelgorath barely recognizes the blade he once pledged to Savathûn, now remade as he has been. He grips it, and in his grasp, it sprouts into a wicked axe, cored by a sliver of Xivu Arath's might.

RISE, KELGORATH, DARKBLADE
2978226043.text_zh:
*****

Häkke铸造厂重铸-001 

名称：实验项目–先锋许可已批准 

作品：新刀柄，以抑制织法捆系。刀片复位附带强化柄脚，无需磨利。发射器已安装并重新校准，手柄和外壳已经过改造以符合人类解剖学要求。

“黑刃核心-1”已由守护者操作员现场取回。

邪魔族铭文已由操作员奥斯里斯解码。体验记录印记的翻译如下：

*****

希乌阿拉斯的黑焰投影充满了整个火星洞穴。在她的下方，克尔格拉斯的破碎之刃躺在一个仪式祭坛上…上面都镶嵌着符文，符文上凝结着错落地层般的干血。  

一名装扮华丽的巫师主持着公共典礼。他朝刀刃示意。

“这个让你失望很多次了。”

希乌的低声回答震动了洞窟。

毁灭孕育新生

她从她的投影中伸出手来，将刀刃抛向空中，然后从武器上劈下沉重的邪魔族金属。剩下的是一道暗银。恰似希乌的黑色刀锋。

胜利之锤塑成之时，失败之斧也已定型

刀刃被重新锻造成了一把刀锋无痛、末端精细的剃刀。
应衡量价值…

希乌阿拉斯扭动着她的爪子。一个由打旋的灵魂之火凝结成坚硬石头，并与刀刃结合的刀柄。借由她的声音，为武器施以膏油。 

…下达决断

在她的命令下，一道进入上维位面的裂痕在她面前迸发开来。克尔格拉斯走出了传送门。 

“我这卑微的仆从要如何为死神效力？”

她的答复在洞穴里回荡着。

夺取火星；占有战争思维

克尔格拉斯几乎认不出那把他曾许诺给萨瓦图恩的刀刃，它现在就像他一样被重制了。他将其攥紧，而在他紧握的手中中，它以希乌阿拉斯的一丝力量为核心，生长为一把邪恶之斧。

复生，黑刃克尔格拉斯
