449318888.name: Deterministic Chaos
449318888.subtitle: "So all being is a one and only being; and that it continues to be when someone dies, tells you, that he did not cease to be." —Schrodinger's epitaph
449318888.subtitle_zh: “所有的存在都是独一无二的；当一个人死去时，它依然会存在，告诉着你，他并没有离开。”——薛定谔的墓志铭
449318888.text:
He is fleeing the Vex across a verdant cliff He is standing guard on the CloudArk-Nexus border on Tramontane's orders He is sitting next to Nimbus on the watchtower ledge He is

[In the Garden, of the Garden: both descriptions are approximately correct but technically inaccurate, in the same way you can say Schrodinger's cat is at once dead and alive. You and I are both and neither, in and of, extinct and perpetual. So, there isn't much point in] 

trying to find a way out of this daedal maze He is trying to make sense of what he's looking at He is trying to place the familiar voice echoing across the network 

[wondering what might have been if we had stayed in our familiar prism-prison or kept tightrope-walking across the quantum wilds. Instead, ask yourself]

"Would you like to dance?"

[is disincorporated immortality really so bad compared to the others' ends? Would you have preferred an attack by vitreous helicoprion or stumbling over the edge of unreality? Imagine]

His foot crosses the quantum threshold before he's aware of it His grip slackens and his gun falls into a bed of red flowers His stomach churns with fear regret sudden doubt as to what

[if we didn't have each other; at least we're not cut off, like the Sol Divisive are from the rest of the Vex. Nor are we beholden to another's purpose. They chose that lonelier path all for a chance to create not simulate, not remake in their image—something truly paracausal.]

he is witnessing: the birth of a god a false idol a reproduction that is both like the Veil and not at all built up by the same Vex who bowed down to it

[Well, they tried to anyway. Either the blueprint was imperfect or the task impossible or both or neither, but their efforts fell short, so now they're stuck waiting for a resurrection]

He is racing for the door that is at once opening and closing He is coming around to the city council's decision to ignore the unknown threat He is reaching for an answer to Nimbus's question 

[they know will never come.]

"Do you think you'll have any regrets?"

[I could be wrong. Is it possible the Black Heart will beat again?]

He stares into the white-hot glow of a conflux, speculating on the secrets that lie within He squints down the barrel of his gun at a row of glowing red eyes advancing on his city He looks away from Nimbus's keen curious expression to reckon with his uncertain certainty before he says 

[Of course. The same as everything else, everything that has been and is and will be. And what will become of us then?]

"I don't know."
449318888.text_zh:
他正穿过翠绿的悬崖逃离Vex，他正奉特拉蒙特之命，站着守卫云端方舟-纳克斯枢纽边界，他正坐在宁博思身边的瞭望塔窗台上，他

[身处花园，身属花园：两种描述大抵上都正确，但严格地讲并不够准确，就像你可以说薛定谔的猫既是死的又是活的。你和我本质上，都是，也都不是，消亡和永恒的。所以，也没有什么意义去] 

试图逃出这一错综复杂的迷宫。他正试图弄懂他所看到的东西，他正试图认出在网络中回响的熟悉声音 

[好奇着如果我们呆在熟悉的棱镜囚狱里，或者继续在量子的荒野中钢丝行走，会发生什么。倒不如，问问自己]

“你想跳支舞吗？”

[与其他人的结局相比，解体的不朽真有那么糟糕吗？你会喜欢遭到玻璃旋齿鲨的袭击，还是在非现实的悬崖边缘跌撞前行？想象一下]

他还没意识到，他的脚就跨过了量子门槛。他的手松开了，他的枪掉在了一床红花上。他的胃翻腾着恐惧、悔恨与突如其来的疑虑，只因他

[要是我们没有了彼此会怎样；至少我们没有像太阳系分支那样与其余的Vex隔绝开来。我们也不受制于他人的目的。他们选择了这条更孤独的道路，都是为了有机会去创造——不是模拟，也不是按照他们的形象重塑——一些真正的超因果关系。]

正在见证的：一个虚假偶像，伪神的诞生，这个复制品既像面纱，又完全不像，由向它俯首称臣的同一个Vex塑造而成。

[不管怎样，他们尽力了。要么是蓝图不完美，要么是任务不可能完成，或者两者皆是，抑或都不是，但他们的努力白费了，所以他们现在只能等待着死而复生]

他正向那扇同时打开和关闭的门跑去，他正转而接受城市议会的无视未知威胁的决定，他正在寻找宁博思问题的答案 

[他们知道永远不会有答案。]

“你觉得你会后悔吗？”

[或许是我错了。黑暗之心有可能再次跳动吗？]

他凝视着汇流炽热的光芒，揣摩着隐藏在其中的秘密。他斜睨着枪管，看着一排朝着他的城市前进的发光红眼。他避开了宁博思敏锐而又好奇的表情，然后说 

[“当然”之前先思忖他不确定的确定性。和其他所有事情一样，所有曾经是，现在是，将来也会是的事情。那我们到时又会怎么样呢？]

“我不知道。”

3118061004.name: Winterbite
3118061004.subtitle: Don't slip or you'll hurt yourself. A lot.
3118061004.subtitle_zh: 别滑倒，否则会伤到你自己。很疼的。
3118061004.text:
NEOMUNA HISTORICAL ARCHIVE

ARTIFACT REF X0003; EXO-IND4b0082.log 090260163

TYPE: bridge audio recorder

PARTIES: M. Sundaresh [IC-3612], C. Esi [IC-3977], L. Tse [IC-6055], C. Sanchez [IC-5438], A. Murib (IC-xxxx)

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS…//

ESI: What was that?

MURIB: We got hit. Engine 7 is down.

SUNDARESH: We can't take another one of those! This is a colony ship!

ESI: Hard aport. Put Hyperion between us and that—

MURIB: Sir, the r—

ESI: And flood the EM spectrum with—

MURIB: CHIOMA! The round—the one that hit us—it's moving!

ESI: What?

SYSTEM WARNING//STRUCTURAL IMPACT

SUNDARESH: He's right. I'm reading… arms and legs? It's attacking engine 6.

SANCHEZ: I'll scramble a squad of Cloud Walkers. They can suit up and—

MURIB: The maneuvers I'm pulling'll fling them into space, even with mag boots.

TSE: Bringing point-defense cannons about. 

ESI: It's only three meters across. Sure you can hit that without peeling us open?

SYSTEM WARNING//STRUCTURAL IMPACT

TSE: Kinda have to, Cap'n. Firing.

MURIB: Buset! That thing just took a fifteen-millimeter burst to the chest!

ESI: Again.

TSE: Firing. It's clear!

MURIB: Mostly. Looks like it left a… is that a spear through our bulkhead?

SUNDARESH: Not sure. It's some kind of exotic matter, spitting all my sensor pings back at me, amplified, like a…

ESI: We can figure it out later, dear. Sanchez, how's the ECM?

SANCHEZ: Not great. Whatever they're using to coordinate, it's not electromagnetic. Getting something weird, though.

MURIB: Weirder than the three-meter hitchhiker knocking on the hull?

SANCHEZ: Maybe. You remember those Vex signals you discovered?

SUNDARESH: On occasion, Carlo.

SANCHEZ: There's a big one! Recurring. Coming from the outer system. Think it's a distress signal.

ESI: Ignore it and get me—

SUNDARESH: No! Bring us back around into the moon's shadow!

ESI: Maya!

SUNDARESH: We need to break line of sight. I can feed that Vex signal into that thing skewering us—use it like an amplifier. It might trick these attackers into thinking we're a Vex ship.

MURIB: It's a tightbeam transmission. We'll have to ride it back to the source to keep that up. You sure you want to meet whatever makes a Vex cry for help?

ESI: Enemy of my enemy, Arief. We might just find a safe port in this storm.
3118061004.text_zh:
内欧姆那历史档案

神器REF X0003；EXO-IND4b0082.记录 090260163

类型：桥式音频录音机

参与方：M. 桑戴尔什[IC-3612]，C. 艾西[IC-3977]，L.谢[IC-6055]，C. 桑切斯[IC-5438]，A. 穆里布(IC-xxxx)

//转录如下…//

艾西：什么情况？

穆里布：我们被击中了。7号引擎已损坏。

桑戴尔什：我们可不能再挨一下了！这是一艘移民飞船！

艾西：左满舵。朝着许珀里翁进发然后——

穆里布：长官，那发——

艾西：然后电磁频谱上满——

穆里布：希欧玛！那发弹药——击中我们的那发——它在移动！

艾西：什么？

系统警告//结构撞击

桑戴尔什：他说得对。我正在读取…居然有四肢？它正在攻击6号引擎。

桑切斯：我去召集一队云端行者。他们可以带上装备——

穆里布：就算他们穿着磁力靴，我进行的飞行动作也会把他们都甩到太空里去。

谢：调用点防御大炮。 

艾西：它只有三米宽。你确定你能在不把我们撕成碎片的情况下击中它？

系统警告//结构撞击

谢：看来必须这样了，船长。开火。

穆里布：正中靶心！那东西刚被十五毫米的点射击中胸口！

艾西：再来。

谢：开火。除掉它了！

穆里布：大部分吧。看来它留下了…刺穿我们舱壁的是一支矛吗？

桑戴尔什：不太确定。它是某种异域物质，把我所有的传感器信号都吐还回来，进行了增幅，就像…

艾西：这个我们以后再研究，亲爱的。桑切斯，电子反制怎么样了？

桑切斯：不太好。不管他们是用什么东西来协调，反正都不是电磁。不过，发现了一些奇怪的东西。

穆里布：比三米宽的搭车人敲打船身还奇怪？

桑切斯：有可能。还记得你发现的那些Vex信号吗？

桑戴尔什：时不时吧，卡洛。

桑切斯：这有个大的！反复出现。来自外部星系。我想这是一个求救信号。

艾西：别管它，带我——

桑戴尔什：不！带我们回到月球阴影里！

艾西：玛雅！

桑戴尔什：我们得躲开敌人的视线。我可以把那个Vex信号输入那个刺穿我们的东西——把它当成增幅器。这也许能骗过那些攻击者，让他们以为我们是Vex飞船。

穆里布：这是个紧束式信号。我们必须沿着它回到源头。你确定要去见让Vex大声求救的东西？

艾西：敌人的敌人是朋友，阿利夫。我们也许能在这场风暴中找到个安全港。

3121540812.name: Final Warning
3121540812.subtitle: The flit of tiny wings; the pull of a trigger.
3121540812.text:
My Esteemed Colleagues,

While enjoying my afternoon cup of Psamathe Silver Tip (a gift from Dr. Dewan after his sabbatical—thank you again, dear friend) and ruminating on our planet's orbital corrections and the orbital corrections we ourselves make throughout our own lives, a completely unrelated revelation came to me. 

I realized, often in times of rest, how my mind wanders its own furthermost reaches, and how the answers to my most vexing questions present themselves at that time with absolutely no fanfare. (This phenomenon is worth studying in its own right by people much smarter than I, but I digress.) My most recent revelation comes in regard to our current pursuits with Atmospheric Spectrometer #003a, a.k.a. Final Warning, as I have heard it being called around the lab. 

The odd capabilities this "Final Warning" harbors have long been suspected by Dr. Sundaresh to be a byproduct of the Veil, replicating energy signatures we most often observe in fluid dynamics. With that in mind, I propose we begin testing the ability to engage that energy using both the Magnus and gyroscopic effects. We attempt to create a "paracausal skipping stone," if you will. 

How we accomplish this remains to be seen, but I encourage you to not spend the next few days thinking about it, as we will discuss it at the next staff meeting. 

Enjoy your weekends,

Dr. Esi
3121540812.text_zh:
尊敬的各位同事，

我在享受海卫十的银针下午茶（德万博士休假后送的礼物——再次感谢你，亲爱的朋友），沉思着我们的星球轨道修正和我们自己在一生中所做的轨道修正时，一个完全无关的启示出现在了我的脑海中。 

我经常意识到在休息的时候，我的思维如何游荡到最远处，我最烦恼的问题的答案会在那时如何毫无声息地呈现出来。（这种现象本身就值得比我聪明得多的人去研究，但我有点跑题了。）我最近的启示是关于我们目前对#003a大气光谱仪的研究，我在实验室听到它被称为最终警告。 

桑戴尔什博士长期以来一直怀疑这个“最终警告”所具有的奇怪能力是面纱的副产品，能够复制我们在流体动力学中最常观察到的能量特征。考虑到这一点，我建议我们开始测试同时使用马格努斯效应和陀螺仪效应与那种能量相结合的能力。你们可以理解为我们在尝试打造一种“超因果水漂石”。 

我们如何实现这一目标尚未确定，但是我建议你们不要在接下来的几天里费心考虑这个问题，我们将在下次员工会议上进行讨论。 

祝你们周末愉快，

艾西博士

3659414143.name: Verglas Curve
3659414143.subtitle: A volley of solutions to any disruption.
3659414143.subtitle_zh: 应对任何干扰的一系列解决方案。
3659414143.text:
I crouch, my knees in the dirt. My world has become pain, heat, erratic movement, ugly noise. I shield my eyes from the shrapnel, press my ear to my shoulder to quiet the baying of my foes. 

There is too much—it is all too much. My shaking fingers fumble for an arrow. I nock one, trailing blue, and close myself off from the world.

I take a sharp breath and stand. 

If the bullets hit me, I do not feel them. I pull the drawstring until it is taut across my body, and, for a moment…

I create peace. 

My fingers, my arm, the limbs of the bow, the string—all locked in unity. Equal parts forming a perfect whole. 

Stillness. 

The illusion shatters as I release.

My fingers fly open. My arm shudders. The bow limbs flex wildly, the string twangs, the arrows fly. Everything in motion, surging with chaotic momentum.

And on the battlefield, there is only stillness—beautiful, tranquil stillness—where my enemies once stood.
3659414143.text_zh:
我蹲伏着，双膝埋进土里。我的世界充斥着痛苦、燥热、飘忽不定的移动、刺耳的噪音。我掩住眼睛，不让它被弹片击中，用肩膀抵住耳朵，让敌人的咆哮声安静下来。 

太多了，这一切都太难承受了。我颤抖的手指摸索着找箭。我把一支拖着蓝尾的箭搭在弦上，随后便让自己与世界隔绝。

我深吸一口气，站了起来。 

就算子弹击中我，我也感觉不到。我拉着弓弦，直到它在我身上绷得紧紧的，接着，有那么一瞬间...

我缔造了安宁。 

我的手指，我的手臂，弓臂，弓弦——全都统一地固定在一起，形成一个完美的整体。 

寂静。 

我松了手，幻象随之粉碎。

我的手指张开着。我的手臂在发抖。弓臂疯狂地弯曲，弦发出响声，箭飞了起来。一切都在运动，涌动着混乱的冲力。

而在战场上，我的敌人曾经站过的地方，唯有寂静——美妙、安宁的寂静。

3371017761.name: Conditional Finality
3371017761.subtitle: You will dream of me… I will never leave you…
3371017761.subtitle_zh: 你会梦见我…我永远不会离开你…
3371017761.text:
The sound that escaped me resembled a roar.

A psychic echo.

It soared through the air and pierced every corner of my ship.

Anger coursed through me as I toppled the ground in a heap.

I wheezed with each breath and clutched at my chest.

I watched that witch saunter out…

Like she'd won.

My ship rumbled as she wrested her primordial prize from it.

I felt hatred—

Deep, unchallenged hatred.

My claws punctured the floor, etched new patterns into it. 

I dragged myself forward. 

Whispers danced around me, trillions of voices melded together in my favorite symphony.

I had always welcomed death, and this time would be no different.

An agonizing sensation shot through me. 

It was as if an arrow had bored its way through my chest.

It burned, and I collapsed among the rubble. 

A green hue enveloped me.

I was unfamiliar with this—her magic festering within me. Shackling me.

My body twisted.

My breaths grew thin.

My limbs became heavy. 

Torturous.

No… she could not hold me. I would not allow it.

This would not be my end.

"My Witness," I whispered as the void I once commanded claimed me.
3371017761.text_zh:
我发出的那声音就像是咆哮一样。

心灵的回声。

它在空中飞翔，穿透了我飞船的每一个角落。

我把地面掀翻成一堆，愤怒贯穿了我的全身。

我大喘着每一口气，攥紧了胸口。

我看着那个女巫大摇大摆地离开…

就像她赢了一样。

她从我的飞船上夺走她的原始战利品时，它发出了轰鸣声。

我感到了仇恨——

深重无比，无可辩驳的仇恨。

我的爪子刺破了地板，在上面蚀刻了新的图案。 

我拖着身子向前。 

低语声在我四周此起彼伏，数万亿个声音在我最喜欢的交响乐中融为一体。

我一向欢迎死亡，这一次也不例外。

一种痛苦的感觉击穿了我。 

就像是一支箭穿过了我的胸膛。

那感觉灼热难耐，我瘫倒在瓦砾中。 

一片绿色笼罩着我。

我对此并不熟悉——她的魔力在我体内郁积。桎梏着我。

我的身体扭曲了。

我的呼吸变得稀薄。

我的四肢变得沉重。 

痛苦无比。

不…她不能控制我。我不会允许的。

这不是我的终点。

“我的见证者，”我低声说道，屈服于曾被我统御的虚空。

3001205424.name: Ecliptic Distaff
3001205424.subtitle: "We Awoken spin our paths from Light and Darkness." —Mara Sov
3001205424.subtitle_zh: “我们觉醒者利用光能与暗影来编织我们的道路。”——玛拉·索维
3001205424.text:
Mara stood at the Farm, her body a glowing conduit of energy. Power streamed ceaselessly from her palms, upward and outward. 

She gradually became aware of the bleary figure standing before her.

"Yes, Petra?" she croaked. Her throat was hoarse.

The figure shook its head. "I'm afraid you can't keep this up forever," said Devrim gently. 

Devrim, Mara thought, of course. She had sent Petra back to the Dreaming City hours ago… no, yesterday. Had it been yesterday?

"Do not presume to—" Mara began, but somewhere in the EDZ, a Titan lowered her armored shoulder and charged into a group of Shadow Legion, and Mara sent her the power she needed.

Elsewhere, a Hunter teased a fistful of emerald strings from the nothing that surrounded him and swung across a gap in the Ascendant Plane, and Mara strained to guide his feet firmly to the other side.

Mara felt something brush against her mouth and opened her eyes. A Techeun attendant stood on her tiptoes, holding a canteen to the queen's lips. She drank. 

"If I may, ma'am," Devrim said. "I know what pushing yourself too hard looks like. And right now, it looks like you."

Something in Devrim's voice touched Mara, and the flow of power faded as she let her hands drop to her sides. She accepted the canteen, took another long drink, and handed it back to the Techeun with a grateful nod.

She met Devrim's concerned gaze and took a deep breath.

"I said I would assist," she said.

Mara closed her eyes, spread her shaking hands, and sent her energy streaking skyward once again.
3001205424.text_zh:
玛拉站在农庄里，她的身体成了发光的能量导管。力量从她的掌心源源不断地向上向外流出。 

她渐渐注意到站在她面前的朦胧身影。

“什么事，佩特拉？”她的喉咙有些沙哑。

那身影摇了摇头。“恐怕您不能永远这样下去，”德弗里姆温和地说道。 

德弗里姆，玛拉心想，当然啊。她几个小时前已经把佩特拉送回了幽梦之城…不，是昨天。已经是昨天的事了吗？

“别以为你——”玛拉刚开口说话，但在欧洲无人区的某处，一名泰坦压低她披甲的肩膀，冲进了一群暗影军团，而玛拉给了她所需的能量。

在别处，一名猎人从他周围的虚无中拨弄出一撮翠绿细绳，然后荡过上维位面的一个缺口，玛拉竭力把他的双脚牢牢地引导到另一边。

玛拉感到有什么东西触碰到她的嘴，她睁开了眼睛。一名灵巫侍从踮起脚尖，把水壶举到女王的唇边。她喝了。 

“如我直言，夫人，”德弗里姆说道。“我知道把自己逼得太紧是什么样子。就是您现在看上去的样子。”

德弗里姆声音中的某种东西触动了玛拉，她把双手放到身体两侧，力量的流动逐渐消失。她接过水壶，又喝了一大口，感激地点点头，把它递回给了灵巫。

她迎着德弗里姆关切的目光，深吸了一口气。

“我说过我会帮忙，”她说道。

玛拉闭上眼睛，摊开颤抖的双手，再次把她的能量射向天空。

392008588.name: Perpetualis
392008588.subtitle: For soldiers of the eternal war.
392008588.subtitle_zh: 为永恒战争的士兵而准备的。
392008588.text:
Devrim Kay sat at a dingy workbench, tucked away in a corner of the Farm. He stripped and cleaned his rifle with practiced efficiency, his fingers moving on their own as his mind wandered.

The sniper recalled a conversation he'd had with Eido, Mithrax-kell's daughter. Devrim had found the Scribe charming, both wise and guileless. They'd spoken at length about her vision for the House of Light as a peace broker between Eliksni and humanity. 

In the moment, he'd been convinced by her youthful optimism. It stirred something in him long dormant—a vision for the future beyond the day-to-day violence of his life in Trostland. He left their conversation confident that a brighter future awaited the Eliksni. 

But now, in the cold light of day, his cynicism reasserted itself. Even if the House of Light remained a staunch ally, he doubted the other Eliksni throughout the system would follow suit. After all, the average Vandal wasn't fighting for politics, ethics, or philosophy. They were fighting a zero-sum game of territorial control… just like he was.

Besides, war was all he'd ever known. He'd grown up in this conflict; been raised by it. Without it… what was he?

Devrim looked down and realized with surprise that his rifle was already reassembled. He'd completed the task without even noticing. What could anyone do against such deeply ingrained violence?

He shook his head, frowned, and started again.
392008588.text_zh:
德弗里姆·卡伊坐在一个被存放于农庄角落里的肮脏工作台前，熟练地拆解和清洁他的步枪。虽然他的手指仍在灵活地工作，他的思绪早已不在这里。

这位狙击手想起了他与艾多，也就是米瑟拉克斯凯尔的女儿之间的对话。德弗里姆认为那位文士很有魅力，既睿智又诚实。她努力维护埃里克斯尼族和人类之间的和平，他们二人详细谈论了她对于光能氏族未来的愿景。 

那时，他被她年轻的乐观精神所折服。这激起了他心中沉睡已久的东西——在慰藉之地的暴力生活结束后，他对未来抱有憧憬。对话结束时，他深信埃里克斯尼族会有一个更光明的未来。 

但现在，在这昏暗的日光下，他的犬儒主义再次抬头。就算光能氏族以后还是一个可靠的盟友，星系内的其他埃里克斯尼族也未必会追随他们的脚步。毕竟，普通的暴徒并不是在为政治、种族、理念而战。他们只是在玩一场占领领土的零和游戏…就像他自己那样。

其次，战争是他唯一了解的东西。他在冲突中长大；在战争中成人。没有了战争…他还算什么？

德弗里姆低头一看，吃惊地发现他的步枪已经被组装好了。他已在不知不觉中完成了这项任务。这种根深蒂固的暴力有解药吗？

他摇摇头，皱起眉，再次从头开始。

268260373.name: Prodigal Return
268260373.subtitle: Pain persists in memory.
268260373.subtitle_zh: 痛楚在记忆中挥之不去。

268260372.name: Regnant
268260372.subtitle: "No one is hatched a Kell." —Mithrax
268260372.subtitle_zh: “没人一生下来就是凯尔。”——米瑟拉克斯
268260372.text:
The House of Light had no Barons, no Archons, no other Eliksni in any position of authority. Thus, it had fallen to Scribe Eido to assume a Kell's duties in Misraaks's absence.

She was forced to abandon her books. After all, there were supply lines to oversee, Ether stores to maintain, negotiations to conduct. She spent her mornings distributing Ether to the hatchlings and the afternoons brokering deals with Spider. The rest of the day had been spent listening to the concerns of her father's people. Her people.

Now, Eido was greeting a lone Eliksni who had come to her among the civilians Devrim sent from the EDZ. He was trembling so nervously she was worried he would fall apart. Even as they sat together in the Botza District, surrounded by fellow Eliksni, he kept glancing upward at the Great Machine. Eido didn't know if it was with wonder or terror.

"I act on behalf of my father, Misraakskel of House Light." She spoke gently and in their shared language, trying to ease his fear. "I am Eido, Scribe of our House."

"Aa-ee-doh," the Dreg repeated. He practiced her Awoken name a few times until he could pronounce it. "My name is Thrysiks. Houseless."

"Thrysiks. You've done a very brave thing," she assured him. "There are many like you who have defected from House Salvation. We will care for you here. You are safe with us."

Eido told him how they had come to live in the City. How they were welcomed and protected. How the Light had provided for them. When she had finished the story of her House, Thrysiks raised his two arms and bowed his head. He had stopped shaking, but he still spoke with a tremor in his voice.

"Thank you, Eidokel."

Eido lowered her head. She could not stop herself from chittering quietly in delight.
268260372.text_zh:
光能氏族没有公爵，没有执政官，没有任何权威职位的其他埃里克斯尼族。所以，米斯拉阿克斯不在的时候，文士艾多就得接替凯尔的职责。

她被迫抛下她的书卷。毕竟，有供应线要监督，有乙太商店要维护，有谈判要进行。那天早上她给孩子们分发乙太，下午和蛛王进行交涉。这一天剩下的时间里，她都在倾听她父亲族人的担忧。她的族人。

现在，艾多迎来了一位孤身一人的埃里克斯尼族。他是德弗里姆从欧洲无人区安排到这里的平民中的一员；他紧张到发抖，她甚至担心他随时会崩溃。他在她面前既害怕又困惑。即使他们一起坐在柏特扎地区，周围都是其他埃里克斯尼族，他还是不停地抬头看向大机器。艾多不知道这是惊奇还是恐惧。

“我代表我的父亲——光能氏族的米斯拉阿克斯凯尔行事，”她以他们之间共同的语言温和地说道，努力安抚着他。“我叫艾多，是我们氏族的文士。”

“哎-呃-哆，”这名堕落者士兵重复道。他练习了好几次她的觉醒者名字才发对了音。“我的名字是特里希克斯。我没有氏族。”

“特里希克斯。你做了一件非常勇敢的事，”她安抚他道。“许多人都叛离了救赎氏族。我们会在这里照顾你。你和我们在一起很安全。”

艾多把他们移居到圣城的来龙去脉给他讲了一遍：她讲了他们在圣城里是如何被欢迎、被保护，以及光能如何提供他们的所需。在她讲完自己氏族的故事后，特里希克斯举起了两只手臂，低下了头。他停止了颤抖，但他的声音里依然透着颤动。

“谢谢你，艾多凯尔。”

艾多低下了头。她高兴地忍不住小声嘀咕起来。

2508948099.name: Caretaker
2508948099.subtitle: All it takes is a little trust.
2508948099.text:
Drifter leaned against the bar in The Ether Tank and watched the morning's bustle. Days started slowly now that the Kell was out of town, and the deposed Baron of the Tangled Shore preferred the night shift. Spider did not want to be awake this early.

"So," Spider said hoarsely, addressing a scrawny Eliksni who stood beneath his overbearing gaze. "With Misraaks so busy saving prisoners from the Shadow Legion, it's become my business to find you all a little gainful employment. Do you understand?"

The Eliksni hissed and chittered in response.

"Let's not be rude, Thrysiks," Spider said while gesturing to Drifter. "We don't want to exclude our friend from the conversation."

The Dreg responded before Drifter could voice his indifference, "Thrysiks speak Human. What does Spider want?"

His voice was filled with derision. A look of surprise crossed Spider's face for one bare moment.

"You speak it well," Spider responded in an oily tone. "Wonder where you picked that up." 

Thrysiks said nothing. Spider continued.

"As for what I 'want'… I hear you left Eramis's House. There's good Glimmer for secrets. Even more for spying."

Thrysiks pressed his two fists together over his chest and then pulled his arms back sharply. 

"Thrysiks knows you, Spider from the Tangled Shore. Thrysiks has nothing for Spider."

Drifter laughed. Spider leaned forward, his rebreather emitting a low, guttural hiss.

"Say that again."

Thrysiks did not flinch or look away. There was a moment of tense silence.

"You heard him," Drifter said at last. "He ain't interested."

Spider huffed and sat back in his chair as Drifter led Thrysiks outside and into the streets.

"As you just saw," Drifter said in a low voice, "Spider's tryin' to use this little charity to bring more people into his crew. Eido told me to keep an eye on him. And she told me another thing, too—you're good with kids."

Drifter paused at Thrysiks's silent confusion.

"Hatchlings! All swaddled up and smiling. So cute I could eat 'em up." 

Confusion turned into apprehension. 

"Ah, just an expression. Old Earth phrase," Drifter explained. "Anyway, lotta orphans comin' in from the EDZ, and your Scribe's a bit preoccupied. Eido said you looked after them the other day. Even led them in a little song. That true?"

"Yes. Thrysiks likes hatchlings," the Eliksni buzzed. Drifter grinned.

"Good. Let's hope they like you too, Teach."
2508948099.text_zh:
浪客靠在乙太罐的吧台上，心不在焉地看着早上的各种活动。由于凯尔不在镇上，日子开始变慢了，被废黜的纷争海岸公爵更喜欢上夜班。蛛王可不喜欢这么早醒来。

“所以，”蛛王声音嘶哑，对站在他傲慢目光下瘦骨嶙峋的埃里克斯尼族说道。“由于米斯拉阿克斯忙着从暗影军团手中解救俘虏，我得负责给你们所有人找一份有报酬的工作。你明白吗？”

这名埃里克斯尼族嘶鸣嘀咕着以示回应。

“别无礼，特里希克斯，”蛛王说着向浪客做了个手势。“我们可不想把我们的朋友排除在谈话之外。”

浪客还没来得及表达自己漠不关心，这名堕落者士兵就开口了。“特里希克斯会说人类的语言。蛛王想要什么？”

他的声音充满不屑。蛛王的脸上闪过一丝惊讶的神情。

“你说得不错，”蛛王油滑地答道。“你在哪学的？” 

特里希克斯一言不发。蛛王接着往下说。

“至于我想要什么…我听说你离开了伊拉莫斯的氏族。秘密能值不少微光。打探情报赚得更多。”

特里希克斯在胸前握紧双拳，然后猛地把胳膊往后一拉。 

“特里希克斯知道你，来自纷争海岸的蛛王。特里希克斯没东西给蛛王。”

浪客笑了。蛛王身体前倾，呼吸器里发出低沉而刺耳的嘶嘶声。

“再说一遍。”

特里希克斯没有退缩，也没有转移视线。一阵紧张的沉默。

“你听到了，”浪客终于说道。“他不感兴趣。”

蛛王怒气冲冲地坐回到他的椅子上，浪客则领着特里希克斯走到外面的大街上。

“你刚才也看到了，”浪客低声说，“蛛王正试图利用这次小小的慈善活动拉人入伙。艾多让我盯着他。她还告诉了我另一件事。你很擅长和小鬼打交道。”

特里希克斯有些困惑，但没有作声。浪客停顿了一下。

“就是孩子们啊！在襁褓里笑容满面。可爱到我想咬一口。” 

困惑变成了畏惧。 

“啊，只是个说法啦。地球的一种老话，”浪客解释道。“不管怎么说，欧洲无人区来了很多孤儿，你们的文士有点忙不过来。艾多说你前几天照顾过他们。甚至还带他们唱了首小曲。是真的吗？”

“是的。特里希克斯喜欢孩子们，”这名埃里克斯尼族的呼吸器嗡嗡作响。浪客咧嘴笑了。

“很好。希望他们也喜欢你，老师。”

1720503118.name: Royal Executioner
1720503118.subtitle: "I get dirty so my queen doesn't have to. Sometimes it's a sacrifice… but most times, I enjoy it." —Petra Venj
1720503118.subtitle_zh: “弄脏我的手，为的是不让我的女王弄脏她的手。有时这是一种牺牲…但通常，我都很享受。”——佩特拉·万吉
1720503118.text:
Petra Venj looked down at the weapons range, where the Corsairs practiced advanced infantry tactics. The pop and sizzle of live ammunition filled the air. It was only a matter of time before the Awoken were pressed into battle once more, now that the eternal war had taken Queen Mara to Earth. 

The queen planned to stem the Witness's advance by imbuing the Guardians with her powers, allowing them to stage counterattacks via the Ascendant Plane. She dubbed them her "Queensguard."  

Petra frowned.

The Vanguard had proven to be staunch allies, most recently during Xivu Arath's siege of the Ley Line network. Nevertheless, Petra had reservations about allowing Guardians to wield Queen Mara's power. Though they appeared civilized, the Lightbearers were not far removed from the utter barbarism of their Dark Age. She sensed that same savagery still seething just below the surface.

Petra wondered if the Vanguard would ever be worthy of Mara's beneficence. But if the Witness achieved its aims, all else would be irrelevant. 

She turned her attention back to the Corsairs' infantry drills. Whatever the outcomes on Earth or Neptune, the Awoken would be ready. The Queen's Wrath would guarantee it.
1720503118.text_zh:
佩特拉·万吉俯视着武器靶场。海盗军正在那里演练高级步兵战术。实弹的枪声与火花充斥着这里的空气。永恒战争已将玛拉女王带到了地球上，觉醒者早晚会被迫接战。 

女王计划通过将她的能力赋予守护者来阻滞见证者的前进，给他们在上维位面准备反击的机会。她授予了他们“女王近卫”的称号。  

佩特拉皱起了眉头。

先锋证明了自身是个可靠的盟友，特别是在最近希乌阿拉斯围攻灵脉网络期间。但佩特拉依然对让守护者使用玛拉女王的能力有所保留。虽然他们表面上很文明，但是负光者没有完全脱离黑暗纪元的极度野蛮。她能感到守护者表面下仍藏着同样的兽性。

佩特拉也不确定先锋是否配得上玛拉的恩赐。但要是让见证者达成了它的目的，一切都会变得毫无意义。 

她将注意力转回海盗军的步兵训练上。无论地球和海王星胜利与否，觉醒者都会做好准备。女王之怒会确保这一点。

45643573.name: Raconteur
45643573.subtitle: Who doesn't like to spin a good yarn?
45643573.subtitle_zh: 谁不喜欢编织好丝线呢？
45643573.text:
"Scribe Eido?"

Eido looked up from her datapad—from the endless, repetitive reports and documentation that were normally part of a Kell's duty—and was surprised to see Crow standing at her threshold.

"Velask," he said. Eido jumped to her feet and returned the greeting.

"Is there something I can do for you?" Eido asked.

"He just wanted to say hi," Glint said, bobbing up from behind Crow's shoulder.

"Oh! …Hi!" 

"Hi!" Glint replied, his voice bright.

Crow smirked sheepishly. "We… met in another life. I used to tell you stories with the other children when they were about this high," he gestured to his knee. "And you were about this high," he gestured to his shoulder.

"Yes!" Eido said, delighted. "Prince Uldren told us many stories. They were very informative."

She remembered the voices he put on, the gestures, the flourishes. Warm memories.

"Our hatchlings would be delighted if you came to tell these stories again," Eido continued. "It would be very educational—we share an oral tradition, as I am sure you know."

Eido's four eyes twinkled. "And I would like to hear your impression of Misraakskel. I am certain it is impeccable."

Crow nodded, smiling. "Consider it a cultural exchange," he said. Eido nodded vigorously, then froze.

"Oh! How rude of me," she exclaimed, embarrassed. "Would you like some refreshment? I have several teas from Eris Morn. Some of them are not so odorous." 

Before she could reach for her kettle, Eido's datapad chirped. It was a sound she had come to despise.

"I am very sorry," she said, hoping he would understand.

"I'll leave you to it," Crow said, turning to leave. 

"It was a long time ago," Eido called after him. "So much has happened since then, but I am pleased you remember." She tensed for a moment but relaxed when Crow grinned and shrugged his shoulders.

"How could I forget?"
45643573.text_zh:
“文士艾多？”

艾多从她的数据板——没完没了、重复乏味的报告和文件（那本是凯尔的职责）上抬起头来，惊讶地看到乌鸦正站在她的门口。

“维拉斯克，”他说。艾多噌的一下站了起来，回敬了他的问候。

“有什么我能为你做的吗？”艾多问。

“他只是想打声招呼，”格林特说着，从乌鸦的肩膀后面冒了出来。

“哦！…嗨！” 

“嗨！”格林特欢快地回应。

乌鸦腼腆地笑了笑。“我们在前世见过面。我之前给你和其他孩子讲过故事。他们大概有这么高的时候，”他指了指自己的膝盖，“而你大概有这么高。”他指了指自己的肩膀。

“没错！”艾多高兴地说道。“欧顿王子给我们讲了许多故事。那些故事很精彩。”

她还记得他的嗓音，那些手势，那些华丽的辞藻。温馨的回忆。

“如果你还能来讲故事，孩子们会很高兴的，”艾多继续道。“听你讲故事很有教育意义…你也知道，我们的传统是口头传下来的。”

艾多眨巴着四只眼睛。“而且我也想听听你对米斯拉阿克斯凯尔的看法。我很确定你已经把他看明白了。”

乌鸦微笑着点了点头。“就当是文化交流吧，”他说。艾多热情地点着头，然后猛地愣住了。

“哦！我真是失礼，”她尴尬地说道。“你想喝点什么吗？埃里斯·摩恩给了我好几种茶叶。有一些的气味没那么重。” 

艾多的手尚未够到水壶，她的数据板便发出了鸣叫。她已经开始厌恶这种声音了。

“不好意思，”她说道，希望他能谅解。

“你忙吧，”乌鸦说着，转身离去。 

“那是很久以前的事了，”艾多追喊道。“自那以后发生了很多。但我很高兴你还记得。”她有点紧张，但看到乌鸦咧嘴笑着耸了耸肩，她放松了下来。

“我怎么会忘呢？”

996109059.name: Nameless Midnight
996109059.subtitle: Strange things wake at the stroke of twelve.
996109059.text:
"This is incredible work. I've barely had to make any adjustments." The Warlock flexes her gloved fingers, staring intently at her hand. 

Standing silently by the Loom, Namrask wonders what it is the Machine-spawn sees. He wonders if he is making another mistake. 

The Humans are on the cusp of a second Whirlwind. It may be that the Guardians he armors today are only tomorrow's Ketchkillers. Light-starved, desperate… powerful.
Will it be Namrask's turn to be abandoned alongside the hatchlings, the sick, and the frail?

Beside him, Ada-1 nods placidly at the Guardian. "An interesting commission." 

The Warlock grins at Ada, baring her blunt teeth. "Couple of heat sinks in here and I can rig up a stealth generator. Nothing fancy, but it'll be easier to keep the civvies safe if I can get in close without the Legion spotting me." 

Namrask stares and does not realize it until the Guardian looks up at him. Anxiety locks his breath in his chest. 

"Hey, uh, what's that word, again?" The Warlock seems uncomfortable. It takes a moment for him to realize she is embarrassed. "Velask?" 

He nods, mutely. 

"Couple of Eliksni on the last run. They seemed a little rattled, and I thought… you know, maybe if I say—" 

"You will… bring them back?"
 
"Of course." The Warlock nods at Ada-1, at Namrask. "Thanks again."

"Wait," Namrask says. He turns and moves toward the materials stored in orderly piles by his workstation. Digs through a month's worth of excess fabric and small woven experiments. Clothing, not armor. Cloaks and shawls. For Eliksni, for Humans.

He presses these into the Warlock's hands. 
"For… those you find."
996109059.text_zh:
“技艺真是精湛。我几乎不需要做任何调整。”术士凝视着她的手，活动了一下戴着手套的手指。 

拿姆拉斯克静静地站在纺织机旁，好奇机械种看到了什么。他不知自己是否又犯了一个错误。 

人类正处于第二次旋风的风口浪尖。也许他今天提供护甲的守护者不过是明天的双桅船杀手。渴求着光能，绝望而…强大。
该轮到拿姆拉斯克被遗弃在老弱病残的身旁了吗？

在他身边，艾达-1平静地向守护者点点头。“真有趣。” 

术士对艾达咧嘴一笑，露出了她钝钝的牙齿。“这里有几块散热片，我可以组装一个隐形生成器。没什么特别的，但要是我能在不被军团发现的情况下靠近，保护平民安全就更容易了。” 

拿姆拉斯克凝视着，直到守护者抬头看向他，才意识到了这一点。焦虑让他喘不过气来。 

“嘿，呃，那个词是什么来着？”术士似乎不太自在。过了一会儿，他才意识到她很尴尬。“维拉斯克？” 

他默默地点了点头。 

“上一趟遇到了几个埃里克斯尼族。他们好像有点惊慌，我想…你懂的，也许我说——” 

“你愿意…把他们带回来吗？”
 
“当然。”术士对着艾达-1和拿姆拉斯克点点头。“再次感谢。”

“等等，”拿姆拉斯克说道。他转过身，走向他的工作台旁边整齐堆放的材料。在一堆能用上一个月的多余面料和小试验织品里翻找。衣服，不是护甲。披风和披肩。是给埃里克斯尼族和人类的。

他把这些东西塞到术士的手里。 
“你找到后…就给他们。”

213264394.name: Buzzard
213264394.subtitle: Circle 'round, great harbinger of death.
213264394.subtitle_zh: 螺旋子弹，死亡的最佳预言者。
213264394.text:
"This is foolish," Mithrax says, empty hands spread.

The Trostland forest had been quiet until three Eliksni jumped from their hiding places with weapons sparking with Arc energy. Two Dregs and a Vandal. They bear House Salvation's sigil.

"Misraaks, the Forsaken," one Dreg clicks, brandishing a spear. "Come to kill us?"

"No," he says, staring them down. "I will not harm you."

"You lie like a Human."

Mithrax sees the shift of the spear in the Dreg's hands the moment before he lunges. The Kell avoids its thrust and grips the Dreg by his head, slamming it into the ground with a hard crack. The Vandal draws a sidearm. Mithrax rushes him, grabs him by the wrist, and wrenches the gun upward. The Vandal's lower hand jabs a knife in the soft flesh between Mithrax's carapace. He barely feels it—the Kell of Light puts a hand around his attacker's throat and squeezes the life from him.

The third flees. Mithrax lets him.

The Kell pulls the knife from his side and drops it among the pine needles, pressing a hand to his wound.

Perhaps, when all the violence was done, the future he could give the Eliksni would be worth it. Would justify everything he had done. Every death, every act of cruelty… or kindness. Or love.

He knows that Eramis hoped for the same.

For now, Mithrax can only leave the two Eliksni where they lie. He will come back later for their funeral rites.
213264394.text_zh:
“这太蠢了，”米瑟拉克斯说道，摊开空空的双手。

慰藉之地森林一片寂静，直到三个埃里克斯尼族从藏身处跳了出来，手里拿着闪动着电弧能量的武器。两个堕落者士兵和一个暴徒。他们身上有着救赎氏族的印记。

“遗落之族的米斯拉阿克斯，”一个堕落者士兵尖声说道，挥舞着长矛。“要来杀我们？”

“不，”他凝视着他们说。“我不会伤害你们。”

“你撒起谎来就像人类一样。”

就在堕落者士兵刺过去的那一刻，米瑟拉克斯看到了他手中长矛的移动。凯尔避开了它的突刺，夹住堕落者士兵的头，砰的一声重重地将其摔在地上。暴徒拔出了一支手枪。米瑟拉克斯冲向他，抓住他的手腕，把枪往上扳。暴徒下方的手将一把刀刺进了米瑟拉克斯外壳之间柔软的血肉。光能凯尔掐住袭击者的喉咙，剥夺了他的生命。

第三个对手逃跑了。米瑟拉克斯没有去追。

凯尔从身侧拔出刀来，让它落在松针之间，一只手按着他的伤口。

也许，当所有暴行都结束后，他带给埃里克斯尼族的未来会是值得的。会证明他所做的一切都是正确的。每一次死亡，每一次残忍…善良或爱意之举。

他知道伊拉莫斯也有过同样的期望。

米瑟拉克斯只得把两个埃里克斯尼族暂时留在原地。他稍后会回来完成他们的葬礼。

927835311.name: Buzzard (Adept)
927835311.subtitle: Circle 'round, great harbinger of death.

192896783.name: Cyrtarachne's Facade
192896783.subtitle: The perfect disguise.
192896783.text:
Dumpster diving wasn't the classiest of hobbies, but it gave her insight she couldn't get anywhere else. At least, that's what she reminded her Ghost as the two scoured the alleyways of Neomuna.

The helmet had a lovely heft in her hands as she pulled it from a pile of expired tech and half-melted Vex. This was a rare find. Turns out people who live in a highly advanced virtual society also have an almost perfect waste disposal system. Almost.

As she examined her prize, she spied something poking out from inside. She retrieved five yellowed sheets of actual paper, covered in barely legible writing:

Expedition #17: Thalassa. Unsatisfied with excursions on Neptune, I've begun to take my trips a bit further to its surrounding moons—

Boring, she skipped ahead.

—appears to be a conglomeration of space junk long fused together. Deep blue, green, and yellow hues ripple across amalgamate hills—

Too many big words.

—I do not appear to be its first visitor—

She continued to skim.

—ship wreckage—

—old pieces of armor, coloring unlike anything I've ever seen—

—not made for a Human—

Huh. The helm sure looked like it would fit.

—large creatures, MANY legs—

Her eyes widened. Finally, it was getting good. She turned the page over… nothing. Blank. 

With a scoff, she crumpled up the papers, tossed them over her shoulder, and stalked off with the helmet.

Expedition Log #17: 

Neptune's Second Closest Satellite, Thalassa: Neptune's wilderness proved unsatisfying, so I've begun to take trips further out to surrounding moons. Equipment detected several chemical signatures; samples should be plentiful. If readings are accurate, collected resources will help Neomuna greatly.

Touchdown Evaluation: Initial readings detect nominal quantities of phosphates and bountiful networks of framework silicates. Networks are jutting out from nearby caverns and visible to the naked eye. 

I cite novice oil painting skills to describe the networks' hues as such: deep blue, green, and yellow. [NOTE: cross-reference hue interpretation with paint tubes]. 

I cite minimal creative writing knowledge to describe the landscape: the hues ripple across amalgamate hills that roll as far as the eye can see. 

Initial Exploration: Came upon a shipwreck, very old, parts burnt out beyond recognition. Found items in nearby area:

- 1 armored glove: unusable, built for three digits, one of which appears opposable

- 2 armored shin guards: simple design, both cracked

- 1 helmet: visor intact

Observations: The armor is painted. Markings unrecognizable but appear intentional. 

Hazard[!]: Fauna observed at nearest cavern—large creatures, MANY legs, pincers. Having no experience in zoology, I conclude: probably unfriendly. Discovered the unique pattern on the found helmet matches the coloring of the creatures. n attempted disguise?

Sample Collected: framework silicate, 2.2 kilos.

Continued Observation: Creatures are unfriendly. Attempted to collect more samples, unknowingly encroached on territory. 

Theory: Helmet was indeed an attempted disguise, perhaps I will utilize it as well.

[End documentation]
192896783.text_zh:
翻垃圾箱并不是最时髦的爱好，但它能让她获得她在其他任何地方都得不到的认知。至少，当他们在内欧姆那的小巷里搜寻时，她是这样提醒她的机灵的。

她从一堆过期科技和半融化的Vex中拽出它时，那头盔在她手中显得小巧可爱。这可是个难得的发现。事实证明，生活在高度发达的虚拟社会中的人也有一个近乎完美的废物处理系统。近乎完美。

在检视自己的奖品时，她发现有什么东西从里面露了出来。她找到了五张泛黄的实体纸片，上面写着难以辨认的字迹：

第17次远征：海卫四。由于不满足于海王星上的短途旅行，我开始到更远的地方去看看它周围的卫星…

有点无聊，她略过了一些内容。

…似乎是一堆长期凝聚在一起的太空垃圾。深蓝色、绿色和黄色的色调在混合的山丘上起伏…

太多难懂的词汇了。

…我似乎不是它的第一位访客…

她继续略读着。

…飞船残骸…

…旧护甲碎片，着色和我所见过的任何东西都不一样…

…不是为人类而造的…

哈。这头盔看起来倒是挺合适。

…大型生物，有多条腿…

她睁大了眼睛。终于，内容开始有趣了。她把纸页翻过来…什么也没有。一片空白。 

她嘲弄地笑了笑，把纸片揉成一团，甩过肩后，带着头盔扬长而去。

远征日志#17： 

海王星第二近的卫星，海卫四：海王星的荒野不尽如人意，所以我开始前往更远的地方：周围的卫星。设备检测到多种化学信号；样本应该相当充足。如果读数准确的话，采集到的资源将对内欧姆那大有帮助。

触地评估：初始读数检测到标称量的磷酸盐和丰富的架状硅酸盐网簇。网簇从附近洞穴中突出，肉眼可见。 

我引用初级的油画技巧来描述网簇的色彩：深蓝色、绿色和黄色。[注：使用涂料管进行比对色彩阐释]。 

我引用极少的创意写作知识来描述眼前的景象：混合的山丘间荡漾的色彩一望无际。 

初步探索：发现了一艘沉船，非常古老，零部件已烧得面目全非。在附近地区发现的物品有：

- 1只装甲手套：无法使用，专为三根手指而造，其中一根似乎与其他手指相对

- 2件装甲护胫：设计简单，都有裂缝

- 1个头盔：面罩完好无损

观察：护甲上有喷漆。印记已无法辨认，但似乎是有意的。 

危险[!]：在最近的洞穴中观察到的动物群——大型生物，有多条腿，带有钳肢。虽然没有动物学经验，我还是得出结论：大概率不友好。发现找到的头盔上的独特图案与这些生物的颜色相吻合。是想要伪装？

采集到的样本：架状硅酸盐，2.2公斤。

继续观察：这些生物不友好。试图采集更多的样本时，不知不觉侵占了领土。 

理论：头盔确实是一种伪装，也许我也会加以利用。

[文档结束]

3637722482.name: Abeyant Leap
3637722482.subtitle: After each ascent, the fall.
3637722482.subtitle_zh: 每次飞升后，下落紧相随。
3637722482.text:
What Rohan wants to remember, more than anything, is her laughter. That booming, firmament-shaking, bone-rattling laugh.

It rings out now, as she leans down to deposit her core into the Chief Archivist's hands. Nothing discourages Cloud Strider Tramontane from laughing at her own retirement ceremony—not the Chief Archivist's attempts to hush her, and not the way her breath rasps in her chest afterwards.

The Chief Archivist slots Tramontane's core into the plinth. Nanites swarm up from the core, layering themselves systematically into the shape of her monument. The attendees burst into thunderous applause.

That moment is suspended in Rohan's memory: Tramontane, larger-than-life, head thrown back in laughter in front of her own memorial.

But so, too, is this: Tramontane, cradled in a nest of wires and tubing. As her implants break down, her body follows suit, each failure cascading into the next. She is withering to nothing in front of his eyes.

There is no crowd here; Rohan's only companion in his vigil is a single pouka, hovering over his shoulder. The doctors overseeing her palliative care duck in and out, without a word. Rohan listens to the beeping monitors and hissing machines pump blood through a faltering heart, but the room is unnaturally quiet. 

Tramontane had stopped laughing when her lungs would no longer inflate on their own.

Her hand, shriveled to bone, is barely strong enough to twitch. Rohan takes it in his own and leans close. If she mouths words, he can still make them out by the shape of her breath.

But at the end, there is only silence.
3637722482.text_zh:
洛汗最想记住的，是她的笑声。那高亢洪亮、震撼苍穹、颤动筋骨的笑声。

她俯下身，把她的核心放在首席档案管理员手中之时，那声音响了起来。没有什么能阻拦云端行者特拉蒙特在她自己的退休仪式上大笑——档案管理员根本无法让她安静下来，随后她的呼吸在胸前发出刺耳的声音。

首席档案管理员将特拉蒙特的核心嵌入了基座。纳米蜂群从核心中成群而出，井然有序地叠成她纪念碑的形状。与会者爆发出了雷鸣般的掌声。

那一刻烙在了洛汗的记忆中：特拉蒙特，传奇千古，在她自己的纪念碑前笑得前仰后合。

但这一幕也同样挥之不去：躺在一堆导线和管子里的特拉蒙特。随着植入物的损坏，她的身体也将步其后尘，一次又一次的衰竭接踵而至。她在他的眼前渐渐化作虚无。

这里没有人群；洛汗守夜时唯一的伙伴是一只孤单的普卡，盘旋在他的肩旁。负责她安宁疗护的医生们，进进出出一言不发。洛汗听着往那颗颤巍巍的心脏里泵血时，那些监视器的哔鸣和机器的嘶声，但房间安静得很不自然。 

当她的肺没法再自行充气时，特拉蒙特就不再笑了。

她的手已经枯瘦得只剩骨头，几乎无力颤动。洛汗把它放到自己手里，靠得更近了些。要是她开口说话，他仍然可以通过她的呼吸来辨别。

但直到最后，都只有沉默。

2463947681.name: Swarmers
2463947681.subtitle: Beware the promise of a wanderer.
2463947681.text:
Listen my child, and come to behold,

Of what came to pass in our histories of old.

Before Neomuna was the city you know,

Our defenses were weak, our security mere show.

The Vex they did plague us, though we knew not,

Filled our CloudArk with viruses and carnage they wrought.

In the depths of our suffering, a Trojan did come,

The Axis Mind, Aesop, promised us but a crumb.

"Of course, I will lead these vermin away,

I will heal your network, keep the viruses at bay.

In exchange, you will give me one simple thing, 

I ask only for loyalty; think of me as your king."

Aesop the Sovereign, as he called himself then,

Made his promise of refuge, we'd be safe once again.

The people refused; Aesop's bargain precluded,

"Think of your dear children," a threat was alluded.

The people held fast, Aesop's menace ignored,

And upon them he unleashed his digital horde.

The children went dark, their connection was severed,

We knew then we had lost Neomuna's most treasured.

Aesop withdrew and left us to mourn,

"I'll return one day," to us he did warn.

Since then, we have labored each day and each night,

To keep our CloudArk safe, locked up good and tight.

Should Aesop return, he'll be met with a wall,

The most powerful, vigilant, and mighty of all.
2463947681.text_zh:
听着孩子，来看看吧，

我们过去历史中发生过的事情。

在内欧姆那还没成为现在这座城的时候，

我们的防御薄弱落后，我们的安防只是作秀。

Vex侵扰不断，但我们却不知晓，

云端方舟里病毒泛滥，它们屠杀诛戮无恶不作。

苦难深重之时，特洛伊木马登门到访。

轴心思维伊索，只许诺我们小恩小惠。

“当然了，我会引走这些害虫，

我会治愈你们的网络，不让病毒靠近。

作为交换，你们得给我一样简单的东西， 

我只要你们效忠于我；尊我为王。”

伊索王，他当时这样自称于人前，

许下庇护的诺言，称我们会再次安全。

人民严词拒绝；伊索的交易受挫遇阻，

“想想你们的孩子，”威胁的意味呼之欲出。

人民坚定不移，伊索的恐吓无人买账，

于是他释出他的数字族群兴风作浪。

孩子们人间蒸发，他们的联系被切断，

我们这才知道失去了内欧姆那的至宝。

伊索抽身而退，留下我们独自哀悼，

“我必归来，”他向我们发出警告。

自那以后，我们日夜劳作，

力保云端方舟安全无虞，牢不可破。

要是伊索胆敢回来，定将遇到，

最为强大、警觉而有力的坚实城堡。

537041732.name: Lion's Reign Mark
537041732.subtitle: When the world begins to crumble, they will look to you to hold up the sky.
537041732.subtitle_zh: 当世界开始崩塌的时候，他们会指望你独臂擎天。
537041732.text:
"Remember who this is all for," Vasara-5 said, rapping her knuckles against the railing of the ruined balcony where she stood. "All the old orders and heroes. Radegast. Jolder. Wei Ning. Ouros."

Sledge looked up at her from the training course, shoulders hunched. "O-okay."

"Everyone is counting on us, Sledge," Vasara said. "So get that speed up. Ladrillo will be firing at you to simulate a high-pressure environment."

Sledge raised a hand. "You mean 'near' me, right? Right, Ladrillo?"

Ladrillo chuckled.

"Get this done, and we'll celebrate at the Blustery Brew." Vasara tapped the screen, starting the timer. "Okay, go!"

Sledge yelped and took off across the makeshift obstacle course. 
They watched him scamper from cover to cover, leaping across the gaps they'd filled with white paint to represent Vex milk, clambering up the walls they'd covered with electrified rods. Ladrillo fired a few shots lazily into the air, and Sledge surged forward in a desperate charge, tackling the final target dummy through the bounding wall of the next building over. They heard more crashing from inside.

Ladrillo grunted. "Does that count?"

Vasara-5 checked the time. "Sure does."
537041732.text_zh:
“记住这一切都是为了谁，”瓦萨拉-5说着，用指关节敲打着她所站着的破败阳台的栏杆。“所有的旧教团。泰坦英雄。拉德加斯特。欧德。韦宁。奥罗斯。”

斯莱奇从训练赛道上抬起头来，弯腰驼背地看着他们。“那好吧。”

“大家都指望着我们呢，斯莱奇，”瓦萨拉说道。“所以要加快速度。拉德里罗会朝你射击，来模拟高压环境。”

斯莱奇举起一只手。“你的意思是朝我‘附近'射击吧？对吧，拉德里罗？”

拉德里罗笑了。

“把这事搞定，我们就去劲风酒吧庆祝一番。”瓦萨拉轻敲屏幕，启动计时器。“好了，开始吧！”

斯莱奇大叫一声，开始穿过临时搭建的障碍赛道。
他们看着他在各个掩体间惊惶蹦跳，跃过他们用白漆替代Vex奶白色液体填满的缝隙，爬上他们铺满电棒的墙壁。拉德里罗懒洋洋地朝空中开了几枪，斯莱奇奋不顾身地向前冲去，撞穿下个建筑的围墙，擒住了最后的目标假人。他们听到里面传来了更多的巨响。

拉德里罗咕哝道。“那算数吗？”

瓦萨拉-5看了看时间。“当然算了。”

1013401891.name: Phoenix's Ascent Bond
1013401891.subtitle: Fate will sweep away everything in its current. But you will divert its flow.
1013401891.subtitle_zh: 命运的洪流会冲走一切。但是你能改变它的流向。
1013401891.text:
They found Calogero in one of the Hangar's storage rooms, seated in a lotus position and surrounded by inert cargo loaders.

Basira and Hex exchanged glances. The two of them shuffled into the room and looked down at their fellow Warlock.

"Hey, Cal," Basira said gently. "What are you doing?"

"Through my Light I impose my will upon the universe," Calogero replied. "If I concentrate hard enough, I can reach out to the Traveler itself. It will whisper the underlying truth of existence directly into my brain, and I will sweep away the Black Fleet with a single well-aimed thought."

"Cal, are you crying?"

"No," he lied.

Hex elbowed Basira in the side and lowered her voice. "Be nice. Ikora revoked his Thanatonaut's license."

Basira sighed. "Okay, well, we're pooling our Glimmer to put down a bet for the Guardian Games this year. Are you in, Cal?"

"I gave my Glimmer to House Light," Cal said. "Currency isn't real. Light and Darkness are real." 

"So are food and equipment." Basira paused. "…Cal, do you know how Glimmer works?"

"Don't worry about it," Hex said. "We'll offer Spider one of those old paintings you found. He loves junk like that. You know, art."

"How are we supposed to compete if Cal is busy going through… whatever this is?"

"I'm sure he's got his priorities in order." Hex set a hand on Basira's shoulder, urging patience. "Hey, Cal—what does the Traveler say about letting the Titans and Hunters win the Guardian Games this year?"

Calogero's eyes flew open. "The Traveler says to kick their asses."
1013401891.text_zh:
他们在机库的一间储藏室里找到了卡洛杰罗，他盘腿坐着，周围都是静止的货物装载机。

巴西拉和黑克斯交换了一下眼神。他们两人拖着脚步走进房间，低头看着他们的术士同伴。

“嘿，卡尔，”巴西拉轻声说道。“你在干嘛？”

“通过我的光能，把我的意志施加给宇宙，”卡洛杰罗回答道。“如果我足够集中，就能联系上旅行者。它会直接向我的大脑低声诉说存在的隐含真相，我会用目标明确的意念来扫除黑暗舰队。”

“卡尔，你在哭吗？”

“没有，”他撒谎道。

黑克斯用手肘顶了顶巴西拉，压低了声音。“态度好点儿。艾可拉吊销了他的探灵人执照。”

巴西拉叹了口气。“嗯，那好吧，我们在汇集我们的微光给今年的守护者游戏下注。你要加入吗，卡尔？”

“我把我的微光都给了光能氏族，”卡尔说。“货币不是真实的。光能和暗影才是真实的。” 

“食物和装备也是真实的。”巴西拉停顿了一下。“…卡尔，你知道微光是怎么用的吗？”

“别担心，”黑克斯说。“我们会给蛛王一幅你找到的旧画。他喜欢那样的垃圾。你懂的，所谓的艺术。”

“如果卡尔在忙着经历…不管是啥，我们还怎么去竞争？”

“我相信他明白轻重缓急。”黑克斯把手放在巴西拉的肩上，敦促他耐心点。“嘿，卡尔——关于让泰坦和猎人赢得今年的守护者游戏，旅行者怎么看？”

卡洛杰罗猛地睁开眼。“旅行者说要狠狠地揍他们。”

366019830.name: Serpent's Glory Mantle
366019830.subtitle: At the far edge of everything they know, only you will recognize what awaits.
366019830.subtitle_zh: 远超他们所认知的范围，只有你知晓等待之物。
366019830.text:
Tashi raced nimbly across the surface of the crashed vessel, tracing a familiar route across its warped and broken beams. He made a graceful somersault into the alcove nestled behind the ruined propulsion systems. 

The laser grid inside decapitated him instantly. One by one, the charges lining the entrance exploded into plumes of flame and smoke. 

When all the noise had died down, Tashi's Ghost floated inside the wreck, made a careful scan of the vicinity, and rezzed him. 

"I set new traps," Shrike said over the comms. "They're on a timer."  

Tashi threw his hands up. "That's not fair! I had it that time," he grumbled.

Tashi perched on a creaking railing and looked down at his companions far below. Shrike was lying on his back in the grass, hugging an Exotic engram to his chest. Notriks, the Eliksni standing beside Shrike, waved up at Tashi in greeting. 

"Good!" Notriks clapped two pairs of hands together. "We talk to Prak'kesh and Spider. We bet twice! We buy a ship—"

"Sure. But he didn't finish the course," Shrike said. "No Exotic engram for Tashi."

Tashi lobbed a loose piece of scrap metal off the edge. "I've had enough practice! I'm gonna win the Games single-handedly. You know, for all the Hunters."   

"And honorary Hunters," Shrike mumbled, pointing a finger at Notriks. 

Notriks gave a hesitant nod. "Yes… okay. So, now you two work together, keep focused—-" 

Tashi stood. "I could beat this dumb course, no problem! If I wanted to!"  

Notriks watched Tashi storm away across the wreckage. He heard the shrill whine of the laser grid coming back online, and the thump of a body hitting the hull.

"It's a safe bet, Notriks," Shrike said, closing his eyes. "Don't you worry."
366019830.text_zh:
扎西身手矫健地跑过失事船舰的表面，沿着熟悉的路线穿过扭曲破碎的横梁。他优雅地翻了个筋斗，走进了坐落在毁坏的推进系统后面的凹室。 

里面的激光网瞬间就将他斩杀了。排列在入口的炸药接连爆炸成团团火焰和烟雾。 

所有声响平息下来后，扎西的机灵漂浮在残骸里，仔细地扫视了一下附近区域，然后复活了他。 

“我安装了新的陷阱，”伯劳在通讯器中说道。“它们有计时器。”  

扎西举起双手。“这不公平！我本来赢了的，”他抱怨道。

扎西靠在吱吱作响的栏杆上，俯视着他的同伴们。伯劳躺在草地上，胸前抱着一块异域记忆水晶。埃里克斯尼族的诺崔克斯站在伯劳旁边，向扎西挥手致意。 

“很好！”诺崔克斯拍打着两双手。“我们去和普拉凯什还有蛛王谈谈。我们赌两次！我们买一艘飞船——”

“当然可以。但他没有完成赛道，”伯劳说道。“扎西得不到异域记忆水晶。”

扎西从边上扯下一块松动的废金属。“我已经练得够多了！我要凭一己之力赢下游戏。为了所有的猎人。”   

“还有荣誉猎人，”伯劳咕哝着，用手指了指诺崔克斯。 

诺崔克斯迟疑地点了点头。“嗯…好吧。那，现在你们两个一起努力，保持专注——” 

扎西站了起来。“我可以完成这个愚蠢的赛道，没问题！如果我想那样的话！”  

诺崔克斯看着扎西在残骸上怒骂。他听到了激光网重新上线的刺耳鸣响，以及身体倒在船体上的声音。

“这个赌赢定了，诺崔克斯，”伯劳闭眼说道。“你放心吧。”

1089162050.name: Techeun's Regalia Helmet
1089162050.subtitle: "The absence of fear in the face of danger is not bravery. It's either foolishness… or insanity." —Lord Saladin
1089162050.subtitle_zh: “在危险面前毫无畏惧不是勇敢。那要么是愚蠢…要么是疯狂。”——领主萨拉丁
1089162050.text:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."
1089162050.text_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊眯着眼朝天看去。温暖的阳光与各处传来的鸟鸣反而使笼罩农庄的不祥之感更强烈了。一位年轻的飞行员坐在这位先锋领导人的对面，紧张地摆弄着飞行服的拉链。

“他们给你东西吃了吗？”艾可拉用从容平和的语气问道。

“给了，女士，”飞行员点头道。“他们给了我们一大碗褐色的粥。其实更像是个食槽。闻起来像是猫粮。他们大概是想让我们用手抓着吃吧？不过也没人相信那东西能吃。”

“那些狱卒是什么样的？”这位术士追问道。“他们是粗暴，温和，还是吵闹…？他们互相说话吗？”

“都不是，女士。他们…没什么特征。”女飞行员皱了皱眉头，努力寻找着合适的表达方式。“我以前接触过卡巴尔，友方的和敌对的都接触过。他们一般都很吵，喜欢打闹、打嘴炮…你知道的，就像普通士兵那样。” 

艾可拉点头表示理解。她也发现查厄托女帝的底层士兵在女帝不在时相当闹腾。
 
“但暗影军团感觉很…空虚，”飞行员继续说道。“有时，军官会大声喝令，但除那之外，监狱里总是一片寂静。我们的狱卒只会站在那里，一动不动，直视前方，沉重地呼吸着。几乎可以算是…喘息。就个性而言，他们和空壳无异。” 

她沉默了一会儿。“我也不知道原因，”她总结道，“但没什么比那种空虚感更可怕。”

428806571.name: Techeun's Regalia Gauntlets
428806571.subtitle: "Help when you can. This is best, most simple way to become hero." —Saint-14
428806571.subtitle_zh: “尽力帮忙。这是最好的，也是最容易成为英雄的方式。”——圣人14号
428806571.text:
Saint-14 followed the trajectory of the Hawk as it plummeted. He reached the crash site several miles out.  

The Legion patrol that arrived soon afterwards had come prepared to confront a few injured civilians. Not Saint-14. While the crew huddled under his Ward of Dawn, Saint hurled his shield at the field commander's rifle, then charged. 

Even battle couldn't silence his thoughts entirely. It was unkind of him, to wish for Osiris to be here beside him, trading blows with the enemy. Osiris was no longer helpless, but neither was he unchanged. If he were here, Saint would have asked that he stay inside the Ward's shield with the others. 

But Osiris had run off to Neptune, where Saint could do nothing for him but wait. 

Saint punched through a Phalanx shield, tore it from the Shadow Legionary's grip, and brought it down repeatedly onto the Legionary's head. 

When Saint was finished, he extended a hand toward the nearest civilian. 

"Come. Geppetto and I will lead you back to the Farm." 

The woman was focused on cutting at her scarf with her knife, working with the determined focus of someone performing a ritual. He looked at the faded violet cloth in her hand, and the familiarity of the moment washed over him.  

Saint sank to one knee and waited patiently as she tied the strip of material to his armor. 

Things had not changed so much. He could be patient. He would tell Osiris this story, too, when they were face to face once more.
428806571.text_zh:
圣人14号跟着鹰隼的坠落轨迹跟了过去，到达了几英里外的失事地点。  

随后到来的军团巡逻队也许能对付几个受伤的平民，但绝不是圣人14号的对手。机组成员蜷缩在他的黎明护罩之下，圣人则将他的护盾朝战地指挥官的步枪扔去，然后发起了冲锋。 

就连战斗也无法停止他的思绪。希望奥斯里斯在这里与他并肩作战不是很体贴的想法。奥斯里斯虽然能够战斗，但他已经变了。就算他在这里，圣人也会让他和其他人一起留在护罩之下。 

但奥斯里斯已前往了海王星。圣人除了等待之外什么也做不了。 

圣人打穿了一个方阵士兵的护盾，将它从暗影军团士兵的手里夺了过来，然后不断地用它敲打着士兵的头。 

解决掉敌人之后，圣人朝最近的平民伸出了手。 

“来吧。盖比特和我会将你们带回农庄。” 

那名女飞行员以仪式般的执着专心用刀砍自己的围巾。他盯着她手上那块褪色的紫布，猛地感到似曾相识。  

圣人单膝跪下，耐心地等着她把这块布绑在他的护甲上。 

其实变化也没那么多。他可以耐心一点。与奥斯里斯重逢时，他还会把这件事讲给他听。

3312368357.name: Techeun's Regalia Plate
3312368357.subtitle: "Normally, I would say nothing is beyond us with Queen Mara's assistance… but things are far from normal." —Commander Zavala
3312368357.subtitle_zh: “一般来说，有了玛拉女王的帮助，我们就能势如破竹…但这次的情况很不一般。”——指挥官萨瓦拉
3312368357.text:
While Devrim and the Guardian discussed strategy around a table littered with maps and steaming mugs of tea, Ghost glided silently away through one of the gaps in the roof. 

Once outside, he kept low, following the creek bed toward the outlying buildings. He looked at the broken waterwheel that lay toppled across the stones and tried to remember the Farm as he had last seen it. 

Survivors had flocked here during the Red War, banding together to gather supplies and resources. They built water purification equipment and planted crops. They built new homes for themselves. Even under the shadow of Ghaul's ambitions, there had been laughter here, and defiant joy. 

Now the Farm was still and quiet, frozen in the aftermath of the Shadow Legion's attack. The soldiers, technicians, and medics posted here tonight were grim-faced and focused. No one was fishing off the dock. No one was laughing by a fire. 

The soccer field had been bombarded past recognition. Most of the surviving buildings could barely accommodate field equipment. The Farm wasn't much of a farm.

But then, it wasn't that long ago that there hadn't been anything here at all. 

Whether they faced Ghaul or the Shadow Legion, the task ahead remained the same. Gather survivors. Help them reach safety. 

So long as there were people to rebuild it, there would be a Farm. There would be joy here again. 

Ghost took one final look at the stars. Then he turned and floated back around toward the outpost and his Guardian. 

Time to get to work.
3312368357.text_zh:
德弗里姆和守护者在一张布满地图和热茶的桌子旁讨论策略时，机灵悄悄地从屋顶上的缝隙里溜了出去。 

出去后，他压低高度，沿着溪床朝外围的建筑飞去。他看看翻倒在石头上的水车，试图回想起农庄以前的模样。 

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边欢笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们眼前的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

1903444925.name: Techeun's Regalia Greaves
1903444925.subtitle: "Though we go where none have walked before, we do not tread lightly." —Commander Zavala
1903444925.subtitle_zh: “我们走在没有人走过的地方，但我们不会畏手畏脚。”——指挥官萨瓦拉
1903444925.text:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
1903444925.text_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

1968283192.name: Techeun's Regalia Mark
1968283192.subtitle: "What stories will they tell of you when this is over?" —Saint-14
1968283192.subtitle_zh: “等这一切结束后，人们会如何传颂你的事迹？”——圣人14号
1968283192.text:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to hear the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riskor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying. 

"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
1968283192.text_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者听到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

3056490591.name: Techeun's Regalia Hood
3056490591.subtitle: "Mara, if you can, find a way to get me inside. I'll handle the rest." —Ikora Rey
3056490591.subtitle_zh: “玛拉，如果可以，想办法让我进去。剩下的事交给我。”——艾可拉·蕾伊
3056490591.text:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."

3031934630.name: Techeun's Regalia Gloves
3031934630.subtitle: "Tell him… I risk my life only because I have so much to live for." —Osiris
3031934630.subtitle_zh: “告诉他…我豁出性命是因为我珍视生命。”——奥斯里斯

随后到来的军团巡逻队也许能对付几个受伤的平民，但绝不是圣人14号的对手。机组成员蜷缩在他的黎明护罩之下，圣人则将他的护盾朝战地指挥官的步枪扔去，然后发起了冲锋。 

就连战斗也无法停止他的思绪。希望奥斯里斯在这里与他并肩作战不是很体贴的想法。奥斯里斯虽然能够战斗，但他已经变了。就算他在这里，圣人也会让他和其他人一起留在护罩之下。 

但奥斯里斯已前往了海王星。圣人除了等待之外什么也做不了。 

圣人打穿了一个方阵士兵的护盾，将它从暗影军团士兵的手里夺了过来，然后不断地用它敲打着士兵的头。 

解决掉敌人之后，圣人朝最近的平民伸出了手。 

“来吧。盖比特和我会将你们带回农庄。” 

那名女飞行员以仪式般的执着专心用刀砍自己的围巾。他盯着她手上那块褪色的紫布，猛地感到似曾相识。  

圣人单膝跪下，耐心地等着她把这块布绑在他的护甲上。 

其实变化也没那么多。他可以耐心一点。与奥斯里斯重逢时，他还会把这件事讲给他听。

988330314.name: Techeun's Regalia Robes
988330314.subtitle: "I did not think I would see the Farm again. It seems smaller now." —Mithrax
988330314.subtitle_zh: “没想到我还会看到农庄。它现在看起来好像小了点。”——米瑟拉克斯
988330314.text:
While Devrim and the Guardian discussed strategy around a table littered with maps and steaming mugs of tea, Ghost glided silently away through one of the gaps in the roof. 

Once outside, he kept low, following the creek bed toward the outlying buildings. He looked at the broken waterwheel that lay toppled across the stones and tried to remember the Farm as he had last seen it. 

Survivors had flocked here during the Red War, banding together to collect supplies and resources. They built water purification equipment and planted crops. They built new homes for themselves. Even under the shadow of Ghaul's ambitions, there had been laughter here, and defiant joy. 

Now the Farm was still and quiet, frozen in the aftermath of the Shadow Legion's attack. The soldiers, technicians, and medics posted here tonight were all grim-faced and focused. No one was fishing off the dock. No one was laughing by a fire. 

The soccer field had been bombarded past recognition. Most of the surviving buildings could barely accommodate field equipment. The Farm wasn't much of a farm.

But then, it wasn't that long ago that there hadn't been anything here at all. 

Whether they faced Ghaul or the Shadow Legion, the task remained the same. Gather survivors. Help them reach safety. 

So long as there were people to rebuild it, there would be a Farm. There would be joy here again. 

Ghost took one final look at the stars. Then he turned and floated back toward the outpost and his Guardian. 

Time to get to work.
988330314.text_zh:
德弗里姆和守护者在一张布满地图和热茶的桌子旁讨论策略时，机灵悄悄地从屋顶上的缝隙里溜了出去。 

出去后，他压低高度，沿着溪床朝外围的建筑飞去。他看看翻倒在石头上的水车，试图回想起农庄以前的模样。 

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

2549387168.name: Techeun's Regalia Boots
2549387168.subtitle: "I am with you every step of your journey. All of you." —Mara Sov
2549387168.subtitle_zh: “我会自始至终与你们一同前行。与你们所有人一起。”——玛拉·索维
2549387168.text:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
2549387168.text_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

1159113819.name: Techeun's Regalia Bond
1159113819.subtitle: "This conflict is about more than people. Never lose sight of that." —Ikora Rey
1159113819.subtitle_zh: “这场冲突关系到的不止是民众。要时刻认清这一点。”——艾可拉·蕾伊
1159113819.text:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to see the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riksor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying. 

"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
1159113819.text_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者看到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

2598029856.name: Techeun's Regalia Mask
2598029856.subtitle: "We can't be predictable or we'll never find a good place to stick a knife." —Crow
2598029856.subtitle_zh: “我们必须出其不意，否则永远无从下手。”——乌鸦
2598029856.text:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."
2598029856.text_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊眯着眼朝天看去。温暖的阳光与各处传来的鸟鸣反而使笼罩农庄的不祥之感更强烈了。一位年轻的飞行员坐在这位先锋领导人的对面，紧张地摆弄着飞行服的拉链。

“他们给你东西吃了吗？”艾可拉用从容平和的语气问道。

“给了，女士，”飞行员点头道。“他们给了我们一大碗褐色的粥。其实更像是个食槽。闻起来像是猫粮。他们大概是想让我们用手抓着吃吧？不过也没人相信那东西能吃。”

“那些狱卒是什么样的？”这位术士追问道。“是粗暴、温和，还是…吵闹？他们互相说话吗？”

“都不是，女士。他们…没什么特征。”女飞行员皱了皱眉头，努力寻找着合适的表达方式。“我以前接触过卡巴尔，友方的和敌对的都接触过。他们一般都很吵，喜欢打闹、打嘴炮…你知道的，就像普通士兵那样。” 

艾可拉点头表示理解。她也发现查厄托女帝的底层士兵在女帝不在时相当闹腾。
 
“但暗影军团感觉很…空虚，”飞行员继续说道。“有时，军官会大声喝令，但除那之外，监狱里总是一片寂静。我们的狱卒只会站在那里，一动不动，直视前方，沉重地呼吸着。几乎可以算是…喘息。就个性而言，他们和空壳无异。” 

她沉默了一会儿。“我也不知道原因，”她总结道，“但没什么比那种空虚感更可怕。”

164103153.name: Techeun's Regalia Grips
164103153.subtitle: "Look after the people. The Traveler can take care of itself… I hope." —Amanda Holliday
164103153.subtitle_zh: “照顾好民众。旅行者可以照顾好自己…我希望如此。”——阿曼达·霍利迪
164103153.text:
Saint-14 followed the trajectory of the Hawk as it plummeted. He reached the crash site several miles out.  

The Legion patrol that arrived soon afterwards had come prepared to confront a few injured civilians. Not Saint-14. While the crew huddled under his Ward of Dawn, Saint hurled his shield at the field commander's rifle, then charged. 

Even battle couldn't silence his thoughts entirely. It was unkind of him, to wish for Osiris to be here beside him, trading blows with the enemy. Osiris was no longer helpless, but neither was he unchanged. If he were here, Saint would have asked that he stay inside the Ward's shield with the others. 

But Osiris had run off to Neptune, where Saint could do nothing for him but wait. 

Saint punched through a Phalanx shield, tore it from the Shadow Legionary's grip, and brought it down repeatedly onto the Legionary's head. 

When Saint was finished, he extended a hand toward the nearest civilian. 

"Come. Geppetto and I will lead you back to the Farm." 

The woman was focused on cutting at her scarf with her knife, working with the determined focus of someone performing a ritual. He looked at the faded violet cloth in her hand, and the familiarity of the moment washed over him.  

Saint sank to one knee and waited patiently as she tied the strip of material to his armor. 

Things had not changed so much. He could be patient. He would tell Osiris this story, too, when they were face to face once more.

3995603239.name: Techeun's Regalia Vest
3995603239.subtitle: "I think I would have liked the Farm back before all this. Well, before a lot of things." —Crow
3995603239.subtitle_zh: “在这一切发生前，我应该会喜欢这个农庄。嗯，确实发生了很多事。”——乌鸦

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边欢笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

4290220099.name: Techeun's Regalia Strides
4290220099.subtitle: "You've got your Light and your Dark, but I've got a couple of shells, and that's enough." —Amanda Holliday
4290220099.subtitle_zh: “你有光能和暗影之力，而我只有几发炮弹，但那已经足够了。”——阿曼达·霍利迪
4290220099.text:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
4290220099.text_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

840487990.name: Techeun's Regalia Cloak
840487990.subtitle: "The same challenge rises before us, and all we can do is survive." —Eris Morn
840487990.subtitle_zh: “同样的挑战再次出现在了我们的面前，我们只能拼命活下去。”——埃里斯·摩恩
840487990.text:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to see the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riksor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying.
