"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
840487990.text_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者看到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

3608027009.name: Grips of Trepidation
3608027009.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - II
3608027009.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - II
3608027009.text:
The slow drag of Koraxis's injured leg made the trek back to his empty ship longer than it had been before. Persistent exhaustion made itself known between each pang of pain that jolted through him. He was thankful the captain's beating had been interrupted by another patron's fist long enough for him to skitter away, but the paranoia of being tracked lingered.

It felt as if an unseen force hovered behind him.

Koraxis pushed onward and kept his gaze forward.

When he finally made it to his ship, the airlock hissed open and revealed a dark space within. He ignored his usual precautions, too focused on the unbearable pain in his limbs.

The hammock he'd fashioned for himself called to him. He collapsed into it and didn't exhale until he found a comfortable enough position.

Sleep found him as soon as he'd closed his eyes; the fastest he'd achieved it in days. Forced insomnia and a surprise beating had taken its toll.

Then there was a knock on the door.

The moment Koraxis heard the rap on the metal, he reached for the gun on the shelf beside his hammock.

He approached the door with the most delicate footsteps he could manage; a heaviness weighed down on every part of him.

He hesitated, eyes fixed on the rusted metal. Rap, tap, tap, went the door…

The door creaked open, and he immediately aimed down his sights at—

Nothing.

Confusion crept into his mind, as something hit him—hard. Koraxis scrunched his four eyes shut. He was flung backwards and braced for impact.

But it never came. 

Koraxis opened his eyes, expecting to see the walls of his Ketch. Instead, he saw the lunar Pyramid. Sleek and dark.
3608027009.text_zh:
科拉西斯缓慢地拖动着伤腿，回到空船的路程比以前更加漫长。传遍全身的每一阵剧痛中都透着持续的疲惫。他很庆幸另一位顾客出手拦下了船长的殴打，让他得以溜走，但他一直笼罩在被追踪的阴影之下。

感觉好像有一股看不见的力量在他身后徘徊。

科拉西斯继续前进，眼睛一直盯着前方。

当他终于到达他的飞船时，气闸嘶嘶地打开了，露出里面的一个黑暗空间。他的四肢疼得难以忍受，以至于忽略了惯常的防范措施。

他为自己打造的吊床在召唤他。他倒在上面，直到找到了一个舒适的姿势，才大口呼气。

他闭上眼睛，很快就睡着了；这是几天内最快的一次。被迫的失眠和突如其来的殴打对他的影响很大。

这时响起了敲门声。

一听到金属上的敲击声，科拉西斯就伸手去拿吊床旁边架子上的枪。

他尽量用最轻柔的脚步向门口走去；一种沉重的感觉压在他身上的每个部位。

他犹豫着，眼睛一直盯着那块生锈的金属。一阵敲门声传来，咚，咚，咚…

门嘎吱一声开了，他立刻举枪瞄准——

什么也没有。

有什么东西狠狠地击中了他，他的脑海顿时一片混乱。科拉西斯闭上了四只眼睛。他被向后抛去，准备承受冲击。

但没撞上任何东西。 

科拉西斯睁开眼睛，想着能看到他双桅船的墙壁。相反，他看到了月球金字塔。光滑而黑暗。

2787963735.name: Vest of Trepidation
2787963735.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - III
2787963735.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - III
2787963735.text:
Koraxis instinctively moved toward the Pyramid, an echo of a journey he wanted desperately to forget.

The Pyramid peaked over the edge of the chasm, a foreboding sight. It was complimented by a stillness that filled the area and made him feel as if he were on the edge of suffocating. He remembered how he carefully traversed the jagged paths. It seemed as if the Pyramid was pulling him in.

Everything felt familiar… including the paranoia. But something was off.

The architecture wobbled and shifted with every step he took. Statues felt as though their heads turned to watch him. Faint whispers danced around the rooms and faded before they could be comprehended. The air was thick with anxious anticipation, with fear.

Koraxis retread familiar hallways and staircases until suddenly, without realizing, he stepped into the innermost chamber… his chamber.

The whispers grew louder as he approached the body, slumped over, and shrouded in shadow at the center of the room. Hisses, yells, and fervent but unintelligible phrases all blended as Koraxis moved closer.

The corpse had been picked clean, barely anything left outside the vague shape of a body underneath the cloak.

Be it the threat of curses or sheer fear, his head remained untouched…

The whispers grew louder the closer Koraxis got to the entity's face. His entire body shook as he stared down at the darkened helmet, a ring of eyes pronounced even in the low light.

Despite the same dread that filled him, Koraxis followed through with the familiar actions and carefully removed one of the eyes. The room shook violently, and before he could safely stow the piece away, Koraxis toppled over. He closed his eyes and braced for impact.
2787963735.text_zh:
科拉西斯本能地朝着金字塔移动，这是他极力忘记的一段旅程的回响。

金字塔耸立在峡谷的边缘，一幅不祥的景象。伴随而来的是四周的一片寂静，让他感到仿佛快要窒息了。他还记得自己是如何小心翼翼地走过那些崎岖不平的小路。那感觉就像是金字塔在牵引着他。

一切感觉起来都很熟悉…包括这种疑虑。但有些事情不太对劲。

那建筑随着他走出的每一步而摇摆和移动。雕像们似乎都转过头来看着他。微弱的低语声在房间里舞动着，还没来得及让人听懂就消失了。空气中弥漫着急切的期待，还有恐惧。

科拉西斯重新走过熟悉的走廊和楼梯，直到突然间，他不自觉地走进了最深处的房间…他的房间。

当他走近这个空间中心的那具尸体时，低语声越来越大，那尸体倒在地上，被房间中央的阴影笼罩着。嘶嘶声、叫喊声、热烈但难以理解的话语，随着科拉西斯的靠近，全都混在了一起。

那具尸体被扒得干干净净，除了披风下模糊的身体轮廓外，几乎什么都没留下。

不知是源于诅咒的威胁还是纯粹的恐惧，他的头颅没有被碰过…

科拉西斯越靠近那怪物的脸，那低语声就越大。他全身都在颤抖，低头盯着那顶乌黑的头盔，即使在昏暗的光线下也能看到一圈眼睛。

尽管心中充满了同样的恐惧，科拉西斯还是完成了熟悉的动作，小心翼翼地摘下了其中一只眼睛。声音越来越大，房间剧烈摇晃着，还没等他把那眼睛安全收起，科拉西斯就翻倒在地。他闭上眼睛，准备承受冲击。

621315878.name: Cloak of Trepidation
621315878.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - V
621315878.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - V
621315878.text:
The whispers and screams drilled into Koraxis's mind. He lifted his hands to his face. Whimpers and pitiful chitters were the only sounds that escaped him.

Again, the scenery around him had shifted, and he stood on the edge of a meteorite. Though the Reef was vast, he recognized the ship debris flowing past him, but it was different than he remembered, twisted in horrifying shapes. The deep purples and blues were dimmed. It was quiet, save for his own personal audience.

Koraxis held up the eye in his deteriorated hands. It still pulsed with energy.

…Free me…

He heard the allure, a voice seducing his soul to do its bidding, but the distortion that followed it reminded Koraxis why he'd come to this place. An untraceable end for this cursed relic.

He balled his fist around the eye. The screams pierced his ears as they grew louder. A dark hand reached out to him, fingers inches from his arm. Koraxis flung the eye into the Reef with all the strength he could muster.

He collapsed.

And then a knock on the door.

Koraxis jolted awake, hand already outstretched to grab his gun. The whispers were gone, his quarters were quiet. He gazed around the room, dazed.

Koraxis stumbled out of bed and delicately approached the door. He aimed down his sights.

The metal creaked open.

Outside was a Human, dressed in a dark, ornate cloak, one hand raised in greeting, the other tightly holding a tome. It gave off the same nightmarish energy as the eye… as Nezarec.

"Apologies for disturbing your sleep," said the man in a tongue Koraxis loosely understood. "But would you happen to be Koraxis?"
621315878.text_zh:
低语声和尖叫声钻进了科拉西斯的脑海。他把手举到面前，只能发出呜咽声和可怜的鸣叫声。

他周围的景色再次改变，他站在一块陨石的边缘。虽然暗礁十分辽阔，他还是认出了从他身边流过的船只残骸，但与他记忆中的不同，它们扭曲成了可怕的形状，深邃的紫色和蓝色黯淡无光。除了他自己这唯一的听众，一切都很安静。

科拉西斯用他变质了的手举起那只眼睛。它仍然在随着能量脉动。

…让我自由…

他听到了诱惑，一个引诱着他的灵魂服从的声音，但随后的扭曲提醒了科拉西斯自己为什么会来到这个地方。这受到诅咒的圣物应在这里迎来无迹可寻的终局。

他握拳攥紧着那只眼睛。尖叫声越来越大，刺穿了他的耳朵。一只黑手伸向他，手指离他的手臂只有几厘米。科拉西斯用尽全身力气把眼睛扔进了暗礁。

他瘫倒在地。

随后一阵敲门声响起。

科拉西斯猛然醒来，他的手已伸出去拿枪。低语声消失，他的住处安静了下来。他茫然地环视着房间。

科拉西斯踉跄地下了床，小心翼翼地走到门口。他举枪瞄准。

金属门嘎吱地打开了。

外面是个穿着黑色华丽披风的人类。一只手举起来问候，另一只手紧紧抓住一本书册。它散发出与那眼睛…与奈扎雷克一样噩梦般的能量。

“抱歉搅了你的睡梦，”那人用科拉西斯听不太懂的语言说道。“你不会刚好是科拉西斯吧？”

3810243376.name: Mask of Trepidation
3810243376.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - I
3810243376.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - I
3810243376.text:
The Reef's labyrinth of asteroids and debris provided many a hideout for those who wished to be lost… and a potential gathering place for those that partook in less savory acts.

A large Ketch had set up among the debris, on a random asteroid of its captain's choosing and had opened for business. Supposedly, as a "bar."

The music bumped, and the clientele—Eliksni pirates—were as rowdy as they were ruthless.

Koraxis sat at a table with his head resting in his upper hands, his cup held in the lower. Exhausted, he hadn't taken a sip since he'd sat down. And he hadn't noticed that an imposing captain, flanked by two smaller Dregs, had entered the bar. The captain started toward his table.

"Where's the relic?" the captain, now towering over the table, chittered in their shared tongue.

Koraxis visibly tensed and gripped his cup so tightly that the cloth woven around his palms strained.

"I don't have it," he responded.

Before Koraxis could register what happened, the captain snatched him from his seat. Despite being loosely labeled "Captain" by his crew, Koraxis was nowhere near the size of the Eliksni before him. His feet dangled in the air.

"Pathetic. Not worthy of your crew."

"You're right," Koraxis agreed, defeat evident in his tone.

The captain's words were venomous, but not as impactful as the fist that collided with Koraxis's face. The other patrons scattered. A blur of fists and insults erupted, a faint chorus of ethereal laughter swelled beneath the violent chaos.
3810243376.text_zh:
暗礁迷宫般的小行星和碎片为那些希望迷失的人提供了许多藏身之处…也是那些行迹不光彩之徒的潜在聚集地。

一艘大双桅船在其船长选择的一颗随机小行星上的废墟中开张营业，做起了一门所谓“酒吧”的生意。

音乐震耳欲聋，而那群埃里克斯尼族海盗客人既吵闹又冷酷。

科拉西斯坐在桌旁，上面一双手托着自己的头，下面那双举着酒杯。筋疲力竭的他坐下来后还没喝过一口。他也没注意到一位气势汹汹的船长，在两个身材较矮小的堕落者士兵的簇拥下，走进了酒吧。船长开始朝他的桌子走来。

“圣物在哪里？”船长在桌旁显得十分高大，用他们共同的语言唧喳叫道。

科拉西斯明显地紧张起来，紧紧握着杯子，连手掌上的布都绷紧了。

“不在我手上，”他答道。

还没等科拉西斯反应过来，船长就把他从座位上抓了起来。尽管被船员们随意地冠以“船长”的称号，但科拉西斯的体型依然远不及他面前的埃里克斯尼族。他的双脚在空中悬着。

“真是可悲。你配不上你的船员。”

“你说得对，”科拉西斯表示同意，语气中透着挫败感。

船长的话固然恶毒，打在科拉西斯脸上的拳头却更有力。其他顾客纷纷散开。一片模糊的拳打脚踢和辱骂声随即爆发，剧烈的混乱之中还夹杂着轻飘的笑声。

807905267.name: Boots of Trepidation
807905267.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - IV
807905267.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - IV
807905267.text:
The energy of the crew bustled. Koraxis opened his eyes, revealing the vastness of space beyond the nearby porthole and a dozen or so Eliksni partaking in various activities. The air was heavy with tension, hushed tones, and cautious movements as they maneuvered around the decks.

Koraxis was quiet, as he had been the first time, the weight and power of the item he'd liberated heavy in his palm. It pulsed.

The world had changed. Another familiar moment.

"Things aren't looking well, Captain," a Dreg whispered to Koraxis. He remembered this conversation but did not recognize the Dreg's deep tone. It sounded out of place. The Dreg leaned a bit closer, eyes darting between his shipmates. "Our food is low, the ship needs repairs, and the crew is… worried it might be cursed."

"Then they can leave," Koraxis snapped. It was automatic, much like his trek through the Pyramid. The Dreg hesitated in surprise.

Koraxis blinked, no longer surrounded by his crew or their voices of discontent. He suddenly found himself in his quarters.

It was dark, the type of darkness that felt as if it would devour him.

Koraxis sat at the table by his hammock. Just him and the eye. He stared at it, and it stared back.

A book of magic lay beside it. A frantic solution to an unexpected problem. The ritual was simple—or so he thought. He was barely able to translate the text on his own but was too stubborn, too scared to ask for help. He grasped a pointed crystal in his hands. Words left his mouth, but he couldn't hear them over the incessant whispers.

The crystal glowed, and Koraxis was met with an energy blast that propelled him backwards. This time, he felt the impact.
807905267.text_zh:
船员的精力都很旺盛。科拉西斯睁开眼睛，看到了附近舷窗外的浩瀚太空和十几个参加各种活动的埃里克斯尼族。空气中弥漫着紧张的气氛，他们压低声音，小心翼翼地在甲板上移动。

科拉西斯很安静，就像第一次时那样，感受着他解救出的那东西在手心里沉甸甸的重量和力量。它在脉动。

世界已经改变了。这是另一个熟悉的时刻。

“情况不太妙，船长，”堕落者士兵低声对科拉西斯说道。他记得这段对话，但堕落者士兵说话的深沉语气很陌生。听起来不对劲。堕落者士兵靠得更近了，目光在他的船员同伴之间飞快扫视。“我们的食物不多了，飞船需要修理，而船员们…担心它可能被诅咒了。”

“那他们可以离开，”科拉西斯厉声说道。这话说得不假思索，就像他在金字塔中的跋涉一样。堕落者士兵惊讶地迟疑了。

科拉西斯眨了眨眼，周围没有了船员和他们不满的声音。他突然发现自己身处自己的营舍里。

四下一片漆黑，是那种感觉快要吞噬他的黑暗。

科拉西斯坐在吊床旁的桌子前。只有他和那只眼睛。他盯着它看，它也回瞪着他。

眼睛的旁边放着一本魔法书。针对意料之外问题的疯狂解决方案。仪式很简单…至少他是这么认为的。他太过固执，太过害怕，不敢寻求帮助，只是勉强自行翻译了文本。他手里攥着一块尖尖的水晶。但在不停的低语声中，他听不见他嘴里说出的话。

水晶发出光芒，科拉西斯遇到了一股能量将他向后推去。这一次，他感受到了冲击。

630432767.name: Gauntlets of Agony
630432767.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - II
630432767.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：蔷薇 - II
630432767.text:
The cycle remained the same, but my actions were not my own. My blade felt heavier with each battle.

I did not recognize the shadow attached to me.

I did not recognize myself.

Did I even know who I was to begin with?

The shouts and pleas of my enemies reverberated in the air. My skin burned, and my heart pounded harder than a hammer striking an anvil. My head… my head was filled with a dense fog. I was present but lost.

My adversary fell to the ground gasping for air.

I fixed my eyes on their face, and a breathy, animalistic snarl escaped my lips. It lingered in the air like a haunting song.

Beneath it, was that laugh. His laugh.

I fell to my knees, staining them in the crimson that had pooled beneath my boots. I dropped my sword and lifted my shaky hands up to my eyes.

The fresh blood ran down my fingers, forming a tapestry in the palm lines. I saw his face in the pattern, felt the weight of his hands on my shoulders. On my mind.

I screamed.
630432767.text_zh:
循环依旧，但我的行为却不属于我自己。每一次战斗，我的刀刃都变得更加沉重。

我认不出附着在我身上的影子。

我认不出我自己。

我原本知道自己是谁吗？

敌人的呼喊和哀求在空气中回荡。我的皮肤在燃烧，我的心怦怦直跳，比锤子敲击铁砧还要用力。我的脑袋…我的脑袋里充满了浓雾。我仍然存在，但却迷失了方向。

我的对手倒在地上大口喘着气。

我盯着那张脸，嘴里发出气喘吁吁、动物般的咆哮。那声音像一首萦回的歌曲，在空中久久不能散去。

在那底下，是那笑声。他的笑声。

我跪倒在地，双膝沾染成猩红色，那颜色在我的战靴下汇集。我松开刀刃时，它在我身旁轻轻地发出砰砰声。我放下剑，把颤抖的双手举到眼前。

鲜血顺着我的手指流下，在我的手掌纹路上形成了一幅挂毯。我在图案中看到了他的脸，感觉到了他的双手在我的肩上，在我的脑海里的重量。

我尖叫起来。

824228793.name: Plate of Agony
824228793.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - III
824228793.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：蔷薇 - III
824228793.text:
…You are mine…

My threaded silk sheets were no longer a comfort. Instead, they felt like gravel against my skin. Every twist and turn yielded pain.

The lit candle beside my bed did not ease my mind. I turned onto my back, eyes trained on the ceiling to avoid the shadows dancing in the candlelight's orange glow.

As I sunk into my pillow, I felt as though it would eventually suffocate me. It could not grant me solace from the whispers.

They were always present—like white noise. At least until he required my attention.

…Bring me more…

Groans of pain and agony poured into my room. Each corner shifted and warped in ways I could only attribute to that fateful day in the woods.

I was paralyzed by the weight of it all.

The flame at the tip of the wick flickered weakly as it neared the bottom of the holder where the wax pooled. Numerous claws and black tendrils inched their way toward my bed.

…You will never be free…

I cried out as Solar energy burst forth. The hammer was warm in my grasp. I leapt from my bed, slammed the fiery weapon down into the floorboards. I felt the heat intensify, as flames licked at every surface they could find.

The shadows still danced. Still reached for me.

I tried to burn them away. Wood splintered and cracked as everything fell apart.

My screams drowned in the destruction of my home.
824228793.text_zh:
…你是我的…

我的床单丝线不再舒适。相反，它感觉就像是我皮肤上的碎石。每一次扭动和翻身，都会带来痛苦。

床边点燃的蜡烛并没有让我安心。我转过身去，眼睛盯着天花板，避开那些在橙色光芒中舞动着的阴影。

我陷入枕头，感觉就好像它终究会令我窒息。我没法因此摆脱窃窃私语。

它们如影随形，就像白噪音一样。至少在他需要我注意前是如此。

…带给我更多…

痛苦和折磨的呻吟声涌入我的房间。每个角落都在移动和扭曲，我只能将这一切归因于在树林里那个决定性的日子。

我被这一切的重量弄得不知所措。

灯芯顶端的火焰接近着烛台底部的蜡池，微弱地闪烁着。无数的爪子和黑色卷须在缓慢地朝我的床挪动。

…你永远不会自由…

烈日能量爆发时，我大叫起来。锤子在我手里是温热的。我从床上跳起来，将熊熊燃烧的武器砸向地板。我感到热量加剧，火焰舔舐着它们能找到的每一个表面。

那些阴影还在舞动。还在靠近着我。

我试图把它们烧掉。木头分崩离析，一切都四散开来。

我的尖叫声淹没在家园的毁灭之中。

2138394740.name: Mark of Agony
2138394740.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - V
2138394740.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：蔷薇 - V
2138394740.text:
The campfire crackled and echoed throughout the cave. I reached toward it, allowing the warmth to guide me. The man across from me had remained silent throughout my recollection.

"You carry the scent of him… of Nezarec."

"As do you, Briar of the Wild Brambles," the man said. The title felt unfamiliar as it left his lips. Was I still deserving of that moniker? It felt long gone. "It's faint… but still there."

"What is the true reason you've sought me out?"

There was a long pause. Then I heard him shuffle around for something in his bag.

"My family has been in Nezarec's favor for generations," he said. 

I defensively gripped my walking stick, ready to draw my blade if necessary. Then I heard the thud of a heavy object, and, after a few seconds, the sound of pages turning. He spoke again.

"Our experiences will not be the last." The pages continued to turn, just loud enough for me to hear over the crackle of the fire. "Do you wish to feel his full power again?" the man asked.

Deep down, I felt an instantaneous "yes" ring loud and true. I'd spent so long fearing his influence, the sheer terror he amplified within me. But when he was gone, all that remained was a void—an all-consuming vacuum of terror.

"What do you need me to do?" I asked.

I had no way of definitively knowing, but something told me the man was smiling.
2138394740.text_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，在整个洞穴中回荡。我把手伸向它，让暖意指引我，告诉我该在哪里停下来。在我回忆时，我对面的那个人一直保持沉默。

“你身上带着他…奈扎雷克的气味。”

“你也一样，野荆棘蔷薇。”那人说道。这称号从他嘴里说出来时的感觉很陌生。我还配得上这绰号吗？感觉早就失去它了。“很微弱…但还在那儿。”

“你找我的真正原因是什么？”

一阵长久的沉默。然后我听到他在包里翻找些什么。

“我家几代人都得到了奈扎雷克的青睐，”他说道。 

我防备性地抓住手杖，准备在必要时拔出我的刀刃。然后我听到一件重物发出砰的一声，还有几秒钟后翻页的声音。他又说话了。

“我们的经历不会是最后一次，”他说道。书页继续翻动着，刚好能盖过炉火的噼啪声。“你想再次感受他的全部力量吗？”那人问道。

在内心深处，我感受到那一声瞬间的“是的”响亮而真实。我花了这么长时间来畏惧他的影响，他在我体内放大的恐怖。但当他走后，只剩下虚空…一片吞噬一切的恐怖真空地带。

“你需要我做什么？”我问道。

我没有办法确切地知道，但直觉告诉我那人露出了笑容。

3475635982.name: Helm of Agony
3475635982.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - I
3475635982.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：蔷薇 - I
3475635982.text:
The weight of the forest's darkness pressed down on me. 

Adrenaline pumped through me as I watched my opponent fall. I listened for the thud as their body collided with the ground.

Deep crimson painted a nearby tree, sliding down through bark and seeping into sapwood, the excess pooling on the ground to soak in the dead pine needles.

I don't remember who it was or why I had chosen to slay them.

In the past, I had seen my fair share of bloodshed. Killed indiscriminately. If you saw another day on my lands, it was because I willed it.

But this felt different.

Up ahead, shadows shifted in the sea of trees. I braced myself, sword held steady. Shivers traveled up my fingertips, electrified my arms, and settled as a chill on the back of my neck.

"Who's there?"

I could hear whispers all around me, from behind every tree. It was overwhelming, all-encompassing, indecipherable.

The shadow swiftly closed the distance between us until it towered over me.

It reached for me, and I stepped back.

I remember the sinister laugh, the way it touched a primal fear deep within me.

I was paralyzed. My mind flooded with whispers.

Its wispy body lurched forward and slammed through me. I felt myself fall. The wind left my lungs, and for a moment, there was nothing… an emptiness the likes of which I had never felt before.
3475635982.text_zh:
森林暗影的重量压迫着我。 

我看着我的对手倒下，肾上腺素在我身上涌动。我听着他们的身体与地面碰撞时发出的砰砰声。

附近一棵树被喷溅成了深深的猩红色，它从树皮上滑落，渗入边材，多余的量在地上堆积，浸泡在枯死的松针中。

我不记得那是谁，也不记得我为什么要杀他。

过去，我也进行过不少杀戮。肆意地杀害。如果你在我的领地多活了一天，那只是因为我本意如此。

但这次感觉不一样。

前方，那些阴影在树木的海洋中移动。我打起精神，握紧刀刃。一阵寒颤从我的指尖传来，我的手臂一阵电击的麻木，在我的脖颈后形成了一股寒意。

“谁在那儿？”

我能听到四周每棵树后面传来的低语声。那声音让人不知所措，无处不在，难以辨别。

阴影迅速拉近了我们之间的距离，直到耸立在我面前。

它向我伸出手来，我后退了几步。

我记得那阴险的笑声，它触动我内心深处的那种原始恐惧的方式。

我动弹不得。我的脑海里充斥着窃窃私语。

它纤细的身体猛地向前冲，撞穿了我的身体。我感到自己摔倒了。我的肺无法呼吸，有那么一会儿，里头空无一物…一种我从未有过的空虚感。

3846650177.name: Greaves of Agony
3846650177.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - IV
3846650177.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：蔷薇 - IV
3846650177.text:
"I did not ask for your help!" I shouted.

Rage coursed through me.

My knife was stained red. I shouldn't have been able to see it. Any of it. But here I was, staring back at my Ghost.

"You need your sight!" Firethorn returned. His voice was laced with concern, something I ignored in the moment, but would remember for years to come.

"That is not up to you! He preys upon my vision!"

I stepped forward, and Firethorn floated up to meet my gaze.

The blade in my hand shook as a faint whisper tickled the back of my mind.

…Do it…

I shouted, covered my ears. I could see shapes forming in the darkness of the tree line again. I couldn't take it anymore, but I knew Firethorn would only continue to heal me.

"You need to snap out of this," Firethorn pushed. "You're losing control! Where is the great Briar of the Wild Brambles?"

…Dead…

"The thorn that pierced the heart of would-be gods?"

…A puppet…

"Pain and terror were your symphony!"

…MY symphony…

"What's become of—"

I remember how easily my hand wrapped around him; how I forced him to the ground and pierced his lens with my knife. I hadn't realized what I'd done until I saw the light flicker out of his eye.

Firethorn's pieces were the last things I saw before succumbing to permanent darkness.
3846650177.text_zh:
“我没有向你求助！”我叫道。

愤怒在我心中蔓延。

我的刀被染成了红色。我本该见不到它的。任何一丝血红。但我却身在此处，盯着我的机灵。

“你需要你的视力！”火棘回应道。他的声音中带着关切，我当时忽略了这一点，但多年以后都仍会记得。

“这不是你能决定的！他以我的视觉为食！”

我上前一步，火棘漂浮起来，与我的目光相遇。

我手中的刀刃在颤抖，微弱的低语声搔动着我的后颈。

…动手吧…

我大叫着，捂住了耳朵。我能再次看到形状在林木线的暗影中形成。我再也受不了了，但我知道火棘只会继续治愈我。

“你得振作起来。”火棘催促道。“你在失去控制！伟大的野荆棘蔷薇哪儿去了？”

…死了…

“那个刺穿了那些所谓众神的心脏的荆棘？”

…傀儡罢了…

“苦痛和恐惧曾是你的乐章！”

…我的乐章…

“那个曾经——”

我还记得我的手是多么轻易地抓住了他；记得我把他打倒在地还用刀刺穿了他的透镜。我几乎没有意识到我做了什么，直至我看到他眼中闪烁的微光。

火棘的碎片是我在屈服于永久的暗影之前看到的最后一样东西。

2445962586.name: Wraps of Detestation
2445962586.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - II
2445962586.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：阿卡西娅 - II
2445962586.text:
I waited until I heard her troubled breathing and whimpers before I got up.

As I approached, my eyes settled on her sleeping face. It was difficult to get a good look in the dark; moonlight barely trickled into the cave. She writhed. It was a nightmare. One of his… it had to be.

I reached out to her, and my fingers found the flesh of her arm.

In an instant I was wrapped in a whirlwind. The overwhelming screams, the voices, the haunting imagery of his face, the very essence of fear…

I couldn't rip myself from it. I was right—it was him.

A purple blast from her hand hit me. I landed with a rough thud and before I knew it, she was standing over me. Her breaths were loud, and her body language read angry with the way the energy from her hands radiated up her arms. I gazed up wide-eyed.

"I'm sorry," I managed, hands up again. "I am looking for him—for Nezarec—and you are the first being I've found that has come into contact with him outside my family."

She remained defensive.

"I simply want to see his power. To see what your experience was like with him."

At this her demeanor softened, but only slightly. We had come to an understanding. She backed up and sat on the log. I cautiously got to my feet and joined her.

"Please," I begged.

After a long pause, she looked at me. I held her gaze until my vision was suddenly warped.
2445962586.text_zh:
我一直等到听见了她呼吸困难和呜咽的声音，才站起身来。

当我走近时，我的目光落在她熟睡的脸上。在黑暗中很难看清；月光几乎无法洒入洞穴。她扭动着身子。那是个梦魇。毫无疑问…是他的。

我向她伸出手，手指碰到了她胳膊上的肉。

霎时间，我被卷入了一阵旋风。铺天盖地的尖叫声、各种声音、他脸上难以忘怀的神情、恐惧的本质…

我无法摆脱。我是对的…是他没错。

她手上一道紫色的冲击波击中了我。我砰的一声落地，还没等我反应过来，她就站在了我面前。她的呼吸声很大，从她双手能量辐射到手臂的样子来看，肢体语言无不显示出愤怒。我睁大眼睛望着她。

“我很抱歉，”我勉强说道，再次举起了手。“我在找他…奈扎雷克…除了我家人以外，你是我发现的第一个和他有过接触的人。”

她依然戒心十足。

“我只是想看看他的力量。看看你和他在一起的经历是什么样的。”

听了这话，她的态度有所缓和，但只是稍微温和了点。我们达成了共识。她往后退，坐在圆木上。我小心翼翼地站起来，坐到了她旁边。

“拜托，”我恳求道。

过了好一会儿，她看着我。我迎着她的目光，直到我的视线突然变得扭曲。

2597227950.name: Robes of Detestation
2597227950.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - III
2597227950.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：阿卡西娅 - III
2597227950.text:
The structure I find myself in resembles a simple, quaint home. It's small, filled with decorations donning symbols I do not recognize.

At the center of the room, two Psions sleep peacefully among a stack of blankets and pillows. I watch the memory unfold from one of the corners.

ACASIA.

The name echoes in my mind—her name.

From behind me, a sinister presence stirs. Goose bumps dart over my skin, and familiar whispers, ones I heard plenty of times in my life, increase in volume.

I turn to look at the home's entrance, and it is consumed in darkness, windows and all. I wait with bated breath.

A ring of eyes materializes in the window.

NEZAREC.

At the sound of his name, the shadows from the window expand and devour all the light in the room. Acasia and the other Psion are the only figures that I can see.

Darkness oozes down toward them. I watch intently, unable to take my eyes off the spectacle.

A hand forms, claws outstretch… his arm… then his face. The shape of his two-horned headpiece. The ring of eyes. The cacophony of hisses and screams fills the void while the two remain fast asleep.

Nezarec reaches for the Psion sleeping beside Acasia. The tips of his claws drag down across the skin, only to stop at his closed eye.

The darkness swirls then Nezarec vanishes, leaving nothing but moonlight.
2597227950.text_zh:
我发现自己所在的建筑就像一个简单古朴的家。它很小，摆满了装饰品，上面有我不认识的符号。

在房间的中央，两个灵能士兵在一堆毯子和枕头上面平静地睡觉。我看着记忆从其中一个角落缓缓展开。

阿卡西娅。

这个名字在我脑海中回响…就是她的名字。

在我身后，一股邪恶的力量在颤动。我皮肤上起满了鸡皮疙瘩，熟悉的低语声，我一生中听过许多次的声音，越来越响亮。

我转身看着家门口，窗户等东西全都被暗影所吞噬。我屏住呼吸等待着。

一圈眼睛在窗中显现出来。

奈扎雷克。

一听到他的名字，窗户旁的阴影就延伸进来，吞噬了房间里所有光线。我能看到的轮廓就只有阿卡西娅和另一个灵能士兵。

暗影向他们倾泻而下。我目不转睛地看着，无法将目光从这奇特的画面上移开。

一只手形成了，爪子伸了出来…他的手臂…接着是他的脸。他那双角头饰的形状。那一圈眼睛。刺耳的嘶嘶声和尖叫声充斥着整个空间，而那两人依然睡得很熟。

奈扎雷克把手伸向睡在阿卡西娅旁边的灵能士兵。他的爪尖划过皮肤，停在他闭着的眼睛上方。

暗影盘旋着，然后奈扎雷克消失了，只留下月光。

2915322487.name: Bond of Detestation
2915322487.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - V
2915322487.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：阿卡西娅 - V
2915322487.text:
The hatred Acasia felt for her people and Nezarec permeated every inch of the cave. 

I didn't know what to say. She knew what it meant to be touched by Nezarec. Though I would have preferred her partner, Acasia would have to suffice.

"I understand your pain," I said and reached out to touch her shoulder. She flinched, and her eye snapped to my face. "I know you feel hatred toward him… but that's good."

Acasia got to her feet. The purple glow covered her hands once more.

"He rewards those that survive his torment. You know his power. His nightmare needs to live on," I said gently and stood to gaze up at her.

Acasia looked agitated, impatient. I reached for my bag, and she extended her hand defensively. We held each other's gaze for a moment. I slowly pulled a tome from my bag and placed it gently on the log. I flipped the pages until I found an image of a familiar two-horned being.

"My family has worshipped him for a long time," I told her. Acasia looked down at the pages. "Keep that hatred alive—that's what he wants."

I sensed her apprehension.

"If you help me bring him back to this plane, show him you're willing to serve him, he might just let your partner go," I added.

It was difficult to tell what she was feeling, but after placing her hand on the tome, eye affixed to the cover's image, I knew she would be desperate enough to try anything.
2915322487.text_zh:
阿卡西娅对她的族人和奈扎雷克的仇恨渗透进了洞穴的每一寸土地。 

我不知道该说什么。她知道被奈扎雷克触碰意味着什么。虽然我更看好她的伴侣，但阿卡西娅也足够了。

“我能理解你的痛苦，”我说着，伸出手去碰她的肩膀。她畏缩了一下，目光猛盯着我的脸。“我知道你对他恨之入骨…但这很好。”

阿卡西娅站了起来。紫色的光芒再次笼罩了她的双手。

“他会奖赏那些在他的折磨下幸存下来的人。你知道他的力量。他的梦魇需要活下去，”我轻声说，站起来抬头看着她。

阿卡西娅看起来焦躁不安。我伸手去拿包，她伸手防备地阻止。我们互相注视了对方好一会儿。我慢慢从包里拿出一本书册，轻轻地放在圆木上。我翻着书页，直到发现一张熟悉的双角生物的图像。

“我的家人敬奉他已经有很长一段时间了，”我告诉她。阿卡西娅低头看着这些书页。“让那仇恨继续下去…那正是他想要的。”

我感觉到了她的忧虑。

“如果你帮我把他带回这个位面，让他知道你愿意为他效力，他也许就会放了你的伴侣。”我补充道。

很难去判断她此刻的感受，但在她把手放在那本书上后，她的眼睛就紧紧盯着封面的图示。我知道她已经绝望到什么都想尝试。

4123705451.name: Mask of Detestation
4123705451.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - I
4123705451.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：阿卡西娅 - I
4123705451.text:
The jungle density was oppressive and threatened to keep inexperienced explorers from traversing it. Though I had never navigated such a biome, I did not let it deter me.

The humidity, the bugs, the overgrowth—I endured them all. I knew she was here… her trail was almost impossible to find, let alone follow, but she was close.

A few days passed before I stumbled on a cave hidden by wild and unwieldy bushes. Even in the cover of night, I could see her there, collecting berries.

I snapped a twig under my foot. She spun, palm alight in a purple aura, her singular eye trained on me. I raised my hands immediately.

"I—I mean no harm! I'm just a traveler looking for a place to lay my head for the night. I'm unarmed."

I waited patiently, careful not to move an inch as she searched my body for anything that could cause her harm. When she found nothing but a tome in my bag, she considered me with a cautious pause, one hand still bright purple. Then she gave a quick nod and walked toward her camp within the cave.

The fire she kept was small but warm, and once we finished eating, she smothered it with some dry dirt. I leaned my head against a wooden log and closed my eyes.

Some time passed before I finally heard her shift. She had turned to lie on her back. I fixed my eyes on the Psion before me and waited.
4123705451.text_zh:
密密麻麻的丛林有一种压迫感，让那些经验不足的探险者们难以穿行。虽然我从未走过这样的生物群落，但我没有因此退缩。

潮湿、臭虫、杂草，我都忍了下来。我知道她就在这里…她的踪迹几乎找不到，更别说跟踪了，但她就在附近。

几天后，我无意中发现了一个隐藏在笨重的野生灌木丛中的洞穴。即使是在夜幕的笼罩下，我也能看见她在那里采浆果。

我脚下折断了一根树枝。她转过身来，手掌在紫色的光环中闪耀，用她那只奇特的眼睛盯着我。我立即举起了手。

“我，我没有恶意！我只是个找地方过夜的旅行者。我没有武器。”

我耐心地等待着，在她搜查我的身体，寻找可能对她造成伤害的东西时，我小心翼翼地一动不动。除了一本书册，她在我的包里什么也没找到，她谨慎地停下来打量我，一只手依然闪耀着紫光。然后她点了点头，走回了她洞穴里的营地。

她留的火虽小却很温暖，我们吃完后，她用了一些干土把火熄灭。我把头靠在一根圆木上，闭上了眼睛。

过了一段时间后，我终于听到她动了。她转过身仰面躺下。我盯着面前的灵能士兵，等待着。

3702434452.name: Boots of Detestation
3702434452.subtitle: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - IV
3702434452.subtitle_zh: 奈扎雷克的仆从：阿卡西娅 - IV
3702434452.text:
HE WAS CHOSEN.

The phrase repeats throughout the rest of Acasia's memory. 

The words bounce around the walls of my mind; it becomes hard to focus.

Different voices flood in, mixing with hers.

Different inflections.

All different Psions.

He had been chosen…

I watch a group of large, ornately dressed Psions enter Acasia's home in the dead of night. They exchange loud, indiscernible words and restrain her. Anguished sounds leave her as she watches them take her partner away.

HE IS POWERFUL.

HE WILL SATE NEZAREC FOR A LONG TIME.

BE THANKFUL HE WAS CHOSEN.

The different phrases blend haphazardly.

The memory slowly fades and the images bleed into one another until I see a group of Psions at the center of the chaos. Seated among them is Acasia's partner. I feel the weight of her pain on my chest… but darkness creeps in. Hundreds of claws rip and shred the edges of the memory.

Acasia's pained wails join Nezarec's symphony.

Her partner jolts in different directions, as if his body is ripping apart. A purple hue envelops him. He rises from his seat, levitating off the ground, and dark tendrils attach themselves to his shadow to siphon his power. 

He lets out a pained shout.

Suddenly, my reality warps again, and I'm thrust back into the real world. The dizziness hits me like a crashing wave. I lean over the log and throw up.
3702434452.text_zh:
他被选中了。

这句话在阿卡西娅的记忆中不断重复着。 

这些话在我的脑海里回荡；很难保持专注。

不同的声音涌进来，夹杂着她的声音。

不同的音调。

全然不同的灵能士兵。

他已经被选中了…

我看到一群身材高大、衣着华丽的灵能士兵在夜深人静的时候进入了阿卡西娅的家。只听里面传出一阵吵闹却无法听清的话语声，他们把她按住。她看着自己的伴侣被带走，发出了痛苦的声音。

他很强大。

他将在很长一段时间内让奈扎雷克满足。

他被选中了，要对此心怀感激。

不同的话语杂乱地混合在一起。

记忆慢慢消失，画面相互渗透着，直到我看见一群灵能士兵正处于混乱的中心。坐在他们中间的是阿卡西娅的伴侣。我感到她的痛苦压在我的胸口上…但暗影悄悄袭来。数百只爪子撕扯着记忆的边缘。

阿卡西娅痛苦的哀嚎伴着奈扎雷克的交响乐。

她的伴侣朝不同的方向颤动着，就好像他的身体要撕裂开来。一片紫色的色调笼罩着他。他从座位上站起来，悬浮到空中，黑色的卷须附着在他的影子上吸取他的力量。 

他发出痛苦的呼喊。

突然，我的现实再次扭曲，我被推回到了现实世界。眩晕感就像海浪一样冲击着我。我靠在圆木上，呕吐起来。

1871947245.name: What It Means…
1871947245.text:
You are a Guardian, a warrior forged in the Traveler's Light who has chosen to defend humanity. A beacon of hope in a universe constantly threatened by forces that would see it destroyed, or worse…

Chosen by the Traveler and raised from the dead by Ghosts, Guardians are part of the rare few able to wield paracausal abilities to manipulate the world around them. For centuries they have defended the City, but now they have extended their reach to Sol, protecting all who call this solar system home. 

Retake our lost worlds, forge unexpected alliances, and harness the power within yourself. The Guardians who lead the way will save humanity—and become legend.
1871947245.text_zh:
你是一名守护者，被旅行者的光能所选中、铸造出的人类卫士。一道在危机四伏的宇宙中四面受敌的希望之光…

被旅行者选中，被机灵复活，守护者是能够运用超因果能力，操纵周围世界的少数人群之一。几个世纪以来，他们一直在保卫圣城，但现在他们已经把影响延伸至整个太阳系，保护所有把这个星系当作家的人。 

夺回我们业已失去的世界，建立出乎意料的联盟，并运用藏在自己心中的力量。一马当先的守护者会拯救人类，成为传奇。

1871947246.name: A Guardian's Best Friend
1871947246.text:
Created by the Traveler's Light, Ghosts seek out their Guardian companions among the dead. The Ghost can be scout, librarian, and mechanic; ancient machinery guiding their Guardians forward. In the right situations, your Ghost can even save you from death.

But Ghosts are not immortal. As far as Guardians know, every loss is irreplaceable.
1871947246.text_zh:
机灵由旅行者的光能创造而生，它们会在死者当中寻找自己的守护者搭档。机灵可以充当斥候、文案管理员、机械师；指引守护者前行的古老机械。在某些情况下，机灵甚至能救你一命。

但机灵不是永生不灭的存在。据守护者们所知，每次失去都无可替代。

1871947247.name: The Traveler
1871947247.text:
Everything changed when the Traveler arrived in Sol.

It gave us gifts that transformed the solar system and the nature of human life. Moreover, it ushered in the Golden Age, a renaissance of scientific and cultural achievement. Despite all the good it has done for us, we still know nothing of the Traveler's origin or the reason it gifted Lightbearers with paracausal powers.
 
Unbeknownst to us, each of those miracles came at a price. Threats greater than we could have ever fathomed have found their way to our doorstep in pursuit of the Traveler.
1871947247.text_zh:
旅行者抵达太阳系时改变了一切。

它赠予了我们改变太阳系和人类生命本质的礼物。而且，它开启了黄金时代，一个科学和文化成就的复兴纪元。不过在它为我们贡献这么多之后，我们仍不知道旅行者的来源，以及它为何会赋予负光者超因果力量。
 
我们当时不知道，这些奇迹都是有代价的。为了追逐旅行者，远超我们想象的威胁已经近在咫尺。

962579774.name: The Threats We Face
962579774.text:
The arrival of the Traveler, for all the good it brought to Sol, painted a target on the entire system. Humanity has faced enemies from all corners of the universe: the Fallen, the Hive, the Scorn, the Vex, the Cabal, and the Taken, to name a few. 

While Guardians successfully fought off each onslaught, a greater enemy was revealed: the Witness. A mysterious voice in the Darkness that led our enemies to our solar system and the Traveler. Though the Witness was cloaked in mystery, one thing was clear: it sought the destruction of the Traveler.
962579774.text_zh:
旅行者的到来造福了太阳系，但也让整个星系成为了一个标靶。人类已经面对过来自宇宙各个角落的敌人：堕落者、邪魔族、嗤魅、Vex、卡巴尔、傀儡军团等等。 

虽然守护者一次次地击退了猛攻，现在又有一个更强大的敌人现身了：见证者。一个将先前所有的敌人引到太阳系和旅行者的、来自黑暗中的神秘声音。虽然见证者的真身仍不明确，但有一件事可以确定：它要摧毁旅行者。

4024394434.name: The Leaders Who Guide Us
4024394434.text:
The Vanguard is the Last City's greatest defense and first line of offense when a threat presents itself. The organization is comprised of a long, storied line of elite Guardians with a leader chosen for each of the classes: Hunter, Titan, and Warlock.

Commander Zavala serves as Titan Vanguard. A force of nature, as unyielding as he is deadly. He has led the Guardians to victory in countless battles, and the moment a threat presents itself, the Last City looks to him as both a leader and a protector.
 
Ikora Rey serves as the Warlock Vanguard. An unmatched scholar, and one of the most formidable Warlocks in the history of the Last City. She oversees the Vanguard's intelligence network known as The Hidden.

Currently, the Hunter Vanguard position remains open. The title once belonged to Cayde-6, a Guardian as quick with a gun as he was with a joke. He met his final death after his Ghost was killed—a sobering reminder that even Guardians can be slain. A statue of him stands in the Tower to keep his memory alive.
4024394434.text_zh:
先锋是圣城最强大的防御力量，也是在威胁出现时的进攻矛头。该组织由一群具有传奇色彩的精英守护者组成，且三种职业（猎人，泰坦，术士）各选出一位领袖。

指挥官萨瓦拉是泰坦先锋。他犹如一股自然之力，永不退缩，无人能挡。他带领守护者们在无数次战斗中取得了胜利，当威胁出现之际，圣城仰赖他为领袖和卫士。
 
艾可拉·蕾伊是术士先锋。她是一位无与伦比的学者，也是“圣城”历史上最强大的术士之一。她还掌管着名为“隐秘者”的先锋情报网络。

当前，猎人先锋的位置仍然空着。这个位置原来属于一位名为凯德6号的守护者，他的枪法和他讲段子的水平一样精湛。在机灵被杀后，他也随之阵亡——他的遭遇警示着一个事实：就连守护者也不是无敌的。高塔中有一座为纪念他而立的雕像。

3408724267.name: The Friends We Made
3408724267.text:
Over the years, our relationship to both Light and Darkness has changed. The nuance of the universe has often been ignored by Humanity in favor of black-and-white boxes that make existence easier to grasp. Just as we have begun to open ourselves up to that nuance, so, too, have we begun to understand our former enemies and even forge alliances with them.

Most recently, both Empress Caiatl of the Cabal and Commander Zavala saw the threat of the Hive as larger than the differences between her people and ours. Similarly, a group of Fallen, known in their own language as Eliksni, have put aside the bad blood between our peoples to form the House of Light under the leadership of Mithrax, Kell of Light. They now live alongside us in the City and have become trusted allies.
3408724267.text_zh:
这些年来，我们与光能和暗影的关系都发生了转变。宇宙的细微变化常常被人类忽视；人类更倾向于容易掌握的，非黑即白的东西。我们已经开始接受这些细微变化，也已经开始理解我们曾经的敌人，甚至与他们结成联盟。

最近，卡巴尔的女帝查厄托和指挥官萨瓦拉就邪魔族的威胁达成了共识，决定既往不咎，结成盟友。同样，一群自称“埃里克斯尼族”的堕落者也决定不计前嫌，在光之凯尔米瑟拉克斯的领导下组成光能氏族。他们现在与我们一同居住在圣城里，是一群可以信赖的盟友。

3007800923.name: The Golden Age
3007800923.text:
The Traveler changed everything. It reshaped our solar system as decisively as it shattered our scientific and philosophical frameworks. To our ancestors it must have been a hammerblow—a glimpse beyond the horizon of expected possibility.

The Traveler kindled the Golden Age. But we built it. We remember this with pride, even after so much else has been lost. 

Today, Cryptarchs and scholars work to distill the legends of the Golden Age into truth. We know now that Humans lived longer, flew further, and learned faster. We know that countless ancient diseases and hatreds were extinguished forever. Human aspiration gave birth to vast engineering projects, sweeping social movements, and even new forms of life.

The Golden Age was not without challenges. But humanity and its machine children tackled these problems with pride, vigor, and a contagious sense of pluralist compassion.
3007800923.text_zh:
旅行者改变了一切。它完全重塑了我们的太阳系，就像它完全粉碎了我们的科学和哲学框架一样。对于我们的祖先来说，这件事肯定是当头一棒——这让他们瞥见了在预料可能性之外的东西。

旅行者开启了黄金时代。但建立这个时代的人是我们自己。虽然已经失去了许多，我们仍自豪地珍惜着这段历史。 

今天，解密大师和学者们在不懈地验证黄金时代传说的真伪。我们现在知道那时的人类寿命更长，走得更远，学习得也更快。我们知道无数的古代疾病和仇恨都永远消失了。人类的愿望催生了巨大的工程项目，席卷全球的社会运动，甚至是新的生命形式。

黄金时代并非毫无挑战。但人类及其机器子嗣以自豪、活力和具有感染力的多元主义仁爱解决了这些问题。

3007800920.name: The Collapse and The Dark Age
3007800920.text:
The Golden Age burned bright—and the night that overtook us after the Collapse was swift and total.

Incalculable waves of destruction ripped through Sol, decimating populations all around the system. If the stories are to be believed, this event marks the arrival of the Witness and its forces in their first attack on the Traveler. That day, the Traveler saved us from certain extinction.

The tally of suffering may be beyond comprehension. But in the following decades, the City lifted itself from the ash, gathering survivors. Guardians rose to challenge alien hordes. The Dark Age swallowed so much of our history… but hope never died.
3007800920.text_zh:
黄金时代光芒四射——而在大崩溃后，黑夜迅速而彻底地席卷了一切。

整个太阳系遭到了不可估量的破坏，人口急剧减少。如果传闻是真的，这一事件标志着“见证者”及其军队的到来，以及他们对旅行者发起的第一次攻击。那一天，旅行者将我们从被灭绝的命运中救了出来。

这种痛苦可能超越了理解的范围。但在接下来的几十年里，圣城从灰烬中振作起来，不断招揽幸存者。守护者死而复生，对抗外星入侵者。黑暗纪元吞噬了太多历史…但希望从未熄灭。

3007800921.name: The City Age
3007800921.text:
The Last City did not rise without struggle. Lightbearers, styling themselves as Warlords, and wilderness fiefdoms clung to power. Starvation, disease, and anarchy menaced. But this struggle brought about the rise of the Guardians and the formation of the Vanguard. The organization fought tirelessly to return some semblance of order to the people remaining on Earth. 

As the City learned to walk again, it found a world overrun by alien menace. It faced disaster and defeat in the Taken War and the Red War, outlasted multiple invasions, and was plunged into an Endless Night. If not for the work and sacrifice of the Vanguard, we would have lost it many times over.

The Last City is both a reminder of all that remains of Earth's civilization, and a commitment to our future. Repairs may come in small bursts, progress may feel slow, but humanity is nothing if not resilient.
3007800921.text_zh:
圣城的崛起并非一帆风顺。自立为战争领主的负光者，为了掌控权利而战的割据势力都是其阻碍。饥荒、疾病、无政府主义威胁着所有人。但这段斗争催生了守护者的崛起以及先锋的组建。这个组织为了将些许秩序带回给地球上的幸存者而不倦地战斗着。 

在圣城蹒跚学步的同时，人们发现这个世界已经被外星威胁占领了。这座城市挺过了在傀儡战争和猩红战争中的各种灾难和落败，撑过了数次入侵，还被施下了永夜的恶咒。要不是有先锋的努力和牺牲，我们早就失去这座城市不知多少次了。

圣城不仅代表着残留的地球文明，也是对我们未来的承诺。缺陷或许得一点点改，进展也许有些缓慢，但人类是坚韧不拨的。

3030405822.name: The Tower
3030405822.text:
As every Guardian knows, there are few dull moments in Sol, but any precious downtime is most often spent in the hangars and hallways of the Tower. Operating as a base of operations for the Vanguard, the Tower overlooks the Last City and the Traveler, serving as a watchful eye should any threats arise. 

As the seasons change, so, too, does the Tower. Guardians looking to partake in holiday events and festivals like, Guardian Games, Solstice, Festival of the Lost, and the Dawning, will find Eva Levante leading the celebrations with special activities and decorations galore!
3030405822.text_zh:
所有守护者都知道，太阳系里每天都有许多事发生，但珍贵的闲暇时间一般都是在高塔的机库和长廊里度过的。作为先锋的行动基地，高塔俯瞰着圣城和旅行者，时刻警惕着威胁。 

随着季节的更替，高塔也会随之变化。想参加各种节日活动和庆典，如守护者游戏、至日、英灵日和曙光节的守护者，会发现伊娃·莱万特正带着特殊活动和大量装饰品主持庆祝！

2839921974.name: Raids and Dungeons
2839921974.text:
As they grow into their powers and skills, Guardians often find themselves in need of a challenge. Should you wish to take your adventures to the next level, treacherous dungeons and powerful foes are the perfect way to test your mettle. 

A well-equipped fireteam of three may face difficult combatants and precarious environments as they make their way through a dungeon. Should they wish for an even bigger challenge, a fireteam of six Guardians can work together to take on Sol's biggest threats in a raid.
2839921974.text_zh:
随着力量和技巧不断提升，守护者经常发现自己需要更多挑战。如果你想让你的冒险更上一层楼，险恶的地牢和强力敌人是考验自身能力的最佳方式。 

在勇闯地牢时，一支装备精良的三人火力战队会面对强大的战斗人员和凶险的环境。如果希望体验更难的挑战，一支由六名守护者组成的火力战队可以在突袭中协力对抗太阳系的最大威胁。

1459720646.name: Unanswered Questions
1459720646.text:
There are many entities whose motivations remain shrouded by time and space and some that exist beyond our comprehension of reality. 

Perhaps the most well-known of these are the Hive gods: Savathûn, the Witch Queen; Xivu Arath, the God of War; and Oryx, the Taken King. While we defeated Oryx when he sought to destroy the Light, and Savathûn when she sought to take it from us, the Witch Queen's true fate remains uncertain. 

The Nine are another group of entities who inhabit this solar system. Very little is known about them outside of their unique writing styles. A mysterious agent of theirs, Xûr, visits well-known locations around Sol offering rare goods for sale.
1459720646.text_zh:
有许多动机仍然被时间和空间所掩藏的实体，还有一些存在于我们对现实的理解之外。 

这些实体里最广为人知的大概是这几位邪魔族之神：巫妖女王萨瓦图恩、战神希乌阿拉斯、邪神欧里克斯。虽然我们击败了试图摧毁光能的欧里克斯，也挫败了萨瓦图恩尝试偷走光能的企图，但巫妖女王的真实命运仍不为人知。 

“玖”则是另一群栖息在这个太阳系内的实体。除了他们独特的书写方式之外，我们对其一无所知。他们的代理人，仄，会前往太阳系各处的著名地点，贩卖各种珍品。

2286676114.name: Guiding Light
2286676114.text:
It takes considerable skill to master the greatest challenges in Sol, but it takes a very dedicated and patient Guardian to step up and lead others through these daunting tests. Every experienced Guardian was once a New Light. You may reminisce on your own first time in the deepest pits of the Moon; what advice would you give to yourself from those early days? Those who take the time to share their expertise are an invaluable part of the Guardian community. 

Becoming a leader isn't just about being "the best," it's about dedicating the time and effort to helping others become their best.
2286676114.text_zh:
克服太阳系中最艰险的挑战需要拥有精湛的技艺，只有无私奉献、富有耐心的守护者才会站出来，帮助他人通过这些艰巨的考验。每位身经百战的守护者都曾经是个新兵。你可能会回忆起你自己第一次落入月球深坑的经历；你会给刚刚踏入《命运》时的自己提供什么建议？正是有了这些肯花时间分享专长知识的人，才组成了弥足珍贵的守护者社区。 

成为领袖不只意味着成为“最强”，它还意味着付出时间和心血，帮助他人成为最优秀的自己。

2859797930.name: A Humble Thank You
2859797930.text:
Though the threats to our solar system may seem never-ending, know that your skill and power in defeating the greatest enemies in Sol, your experience in leading and mentoring others, and your efforts in creating a safer, kinder Sol haven't gone unnoticed. Congratulations, Guardian. May the songs of your deeds go down in history, and may the stars forever light your path.

Per Audacia Ad Astra!
2859797930.text_zh:
尽管太阳系面临的威胁看似永无止境，我们希望让你知道，你为击败恶敌、带领他人前行、创造一个更安全温良的太阳系所作出的努力并没有被忽视。恭喜你，守护者。愿你的事迹被载入史册，愿星光永远照亮你的道路。

无畏征途，终抵星辰！

3935354265.name: The Stargazer
3935354265.text:
One, two, three! Eyes on me, niños!

It's Thursday, and you know what that means! That's right—it is Cloud Strider Day! What do the Cloud Striders do? Right again! They keep us all safe. And how do we tell them "Thank you?" By remembering them!

Today, we will learn about Stargazer. A stargazer is someone who looks into the sky and studies the stars. The Cloud Strider who picked Stargazer as their call sign was very smart.

Our planet, Neptune, is a hidden world. It is very large, but with our thick atmosphere and powerful magnetic field, it is very hard to see anything on the surface. This hides our city and keeps us safe, but it also hides the universe from us. We could see the stars but not study them.

Stargazer was the first person to learn how to use math to see the sky!

And Stargazer didn't just see stars. They also saw Earth. Do you know about Earth, children? That's right! Earth is a planet closer to the Sun, and it's where humans came from a long time ago. We thought there were no humans left on the Earth, and we could not see to check.

But when Stargazer looked to Earth, they saw more humans!

But Earth is a very dangerous place now. The people there do not go to school, and they do not go to market. Instead, they are bullied by the warlords, who force them to do things instead of asking nicely.

Stargazer worried what would happen if the warlords ever found Neptune. They might bully us, too! Our world is very hard to find, and the people of Earth had forgotten about our tiny colony ship. But on Earth, they have computers, too, and the warlords might learn of us just like we learn about the stars.

Stargazer traveled to Earth and used a special computer called a Warmind to make all the other computers on Earth forget about Neptune.

Today, we still watch Earth, and when the warlords are gone, we will go back and help the people there clean up their world. Just like when you help your parents clean up! And doesn't everyone like having a clean home?

That's all for today, niños. Three, two, one! Now, have fun! And remember: Thank you, Cloud Striders!

—Carlita Capybara, Capybara Corner, s43, ep19
3935354265.text_zh:
一，二，三！看我这边，孩子们！

今天是星期四，你们知道这意味着什么！没错——今天是云端行者日！云端行者是做什么的？又对了！他们保护我们所有人的安全。我们要怎么才能向他们说“谢谢你们”呢？通过铭记他们！

今天，我们要学习观星者。观星者是指观察天空并研究星空的人。这位选择观星者作为呼号的云端行者非常聪明。

我们的星球，海王星，是一个隐秘的世界。它非常的大，但由于我们厚厚的大气层和强大的磁场，很难看到地表上的任何东西。这让我们的城市得以隐藏，保护了我们的安全，但也把宇宙从我们眼前藏了起来。我们可以看到星星，但没法研究它们。

观星者就是第一个学习如何用数学来看天空的人！

而且观星者不仅看到了星星。他还看到了地球。孩子们，你们了解地球吗？没错！地球是一颗离太阳更近的行星，很久以前人类就是从那里来的。我们认为地球上已经没有人类了，但我们无法亲眼核实。

但是当观星者看向地球时，他看到了更多的人类！

不过地球现在是一个非常危险的地方。那里的人们不上学，也不去市场。相反，他们受到战争领主的欺凌，那些家伙强迫他们去做各种事，而不是友好地请求。

观星者担心如果战争领主们发现海王星会发生些什么。他们也可能会欺凌我们！我们的世界很难被找到，地球上的人们已经忘记了我们这艘小小的殖民飞船。但在地球上，他们也有计算机，战争领主们可能会像我们研究星星一样研究我们。

观星者去了地球，使用一种叫做战争思维的特殊计算机，让地球上的所有其他计算机忘记了海王星。

今天，我们依然观察着地球，等战争领主们不复存在了，我们就会回去帮助那里的人们清理整顿他们的世界。就像你们帮爸爸妈妈打扫卫生一样！大家不都喜欢有个干净的家吗？

今天就到这里了，孩子们。三，二，一！现在，好好去玩吧！记住这句话：谢谢你们，云端行者！

——卡莉塔·卡比巴拉，卡比巴拉角，s43，ep19

3935354266.name: Laminak Li

3935354267.name: The Bluejay
3935354267.text:
One, two, three! Eyes on me, niños!

It's Thursday, and you know what that means! That's right—it is Cloud Strider Day! What do the Cloud Striders do? Right again! They keep us all safe. And how do we tell them "Thank you?" By remembering them!

Today, we will learn about Bluejay. The blue jay is a very clever bird. You might have seen one in the parklands. Some can even talk! The Cloud Strider who picked Bluejay as his call sign was very clever.

Many Cloud Striders are soldiers or engineers, but Bluejay was a game designer. Do you know what a game designer is, children?

That's right! A game designer makes vidgames! Maybe you have played a vidgame with your parents in the CloudArk. Bluejay was the very first person to make a vidgame in the CloudArk! Before that, we did not know it was a whole world. We could not use it to make art or visit friends. We just put things in it to save them for later, like the closet. And the closet seems scary at first, doesn't it, niños? But if you are brave, you can find lots of fun things inside!

So Bluejay helped us expand how we use the CloudArk—he made it a place we could play or even live, if we needed to. And when he made his game in there, he also learned that the Vex used the CloudArk, too. They could not get in, but the CloudArk was so strong they could use it to do their work for them even from outside, using the force of the Veil to turn their own machines, like when the wind turns a turbine.

Bluejay learned he could jump from the CloudArk to the Vex network, and he sabotaged their machines from the inside. The Vex were very confident and did not think he could find them, so they were careless. And so Bluejay scared them, and they ran away! And what we learned is that being careless with the CloudArk is dangerous, isn't it? That's why you always close your open ports and keep your passcode secret, because the Vex remember being scared, and they'll frighten you to get us back.

That's all for today, niños. Three, two, one! Now, have fun! And remember: Thank you, Cloud Striders!

—Carlita Capybara, Capybara Corner, s44, ep23
3935354267.text_zh:
一，二，三！看我这边，孩子们！

今天是星期四，你们知道这意味着什么！没错——今天是云端行者日！云端行者是做什么的？又对了！他们保护我们所有人的安全。我们要怎么才能向他们说“谢谢你们”呢？通过铭记他们！

今天，我们要学习冠蓝鸦。冠蓝鸦是一种非常聪明的鸟。你们可能在公园里见到过。有些甚至能说话！这位选择冠蓝鸦作为呼号的云端行者非常聪明。

许多云端行者都是士兵或工程师，但冠蓝鸦是一名游戏设计师。孩子们，你们知道什么是游戏设计师吗？

没错！游戏设计师是制作电子游戏的！也许你们已经和爸爸妈妈在云端方舟里玩过电子游戏了。冠蓝鸦是第一个在云端方舟里制作电子游戏的人！在那之前，我们并不知道这是一个完整的世界。我们没法用它来制作艺术品或是拜访朋友。我们只是把东西放进去，留着以后再用，就像是壁橱。壁橱一开始看起来很吓人，不是吗，孩子们？但如果你们够勇敢的话，就可以在里面找到很多有趣的东西！

所以说冠蓝鸦帮助我们扩展了使用云端方舟的方式——他把它变成了一个我们可以玩耍甚至生活的地方，如果我们有这需要。当他在那里面做游戏时，他还发现Vex也在利用云端方舟。它们进不去，但云端方舟强大到它们甚至可以从外部利用面纱的力量来转动它们自己的机器，就像风转动涡轮机一样。

冠蓝鸦了解到他可以从云端方舟跳到Vex网络里去，他从内部破坏了它们的机器。Vex非常自信，没想到他会找到它们，所以它们大意了。因此冠蓝鸦吓坏了它们，它们就逃了！我们从中学到的就是，对待云端方舟粗心大意是十分危险的，不是吗？这就是为什么你们总是要关闭你们的开放端口，将密码保密，因为Vex记得被吓坏的感觉，它们会吓唬你们来扳回一城。

今天就到这里了，孩子们。三，二，一！现在，好好去玩吧！记住这句话：谢谢你们，云端行者！

——卡莉塔·卡比巴拉，卡比巴拉角，s44，ep23

3935354268.name: Conrad Jain
3935354268.text:
NEOMUNA DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY 

CASE NO. PUBEND6067111-CJain-7

TRANSCRIPT | DO NOT DISTRIBUTE

COUNCILPERSON SANGHA: Sentencing case PUBEND 6067111-CJain -7, Councilwoman Martella Sangha presiding. The accused has been found guilty of trespassing in the civic data architecture colloquially known as the "Cloud Ark," illegal simulation, and public endangerment.

COUNCILPERSON BOUDAN: It has been a very long week, Mr. Jain, but again: This council will show you leniency if you assist us by disclosing your coconspirators.

CONRAD JAIN (ACCUSED): The only criminals I've worked with to date are the ones handing down this sentence.

C. BOUDAN: Mr. Jain, these charges are—

JAIN: They're generational trauma with pomp!

C. BOUDAN: Mr. Jain—

JAIN: We're the last of humanity, trapped in a bubble. Simulation is an entire frontier we can explore to re-define what it means to be human. And you outlaw it just because we fear others' bad experiences from hundreds of years ago!

C. SANGHA: Laws exist by the public consensus. It is not your decision alone when and how our society evolves.

C. BOUDAN: There are approved channels for simulation research.

JAIN: "Approved channels." Is that what's under all that red tape?

C. BOUDAN: Mr. Jain—

JAIN: The CloudArk is an nth dimensional paracausal fold, and we use it to store library books.

C. BOUDAN: We use it to support the public need. Not as some playground.

JAIN: Play?! You bastard, I lost friends shutting down the Vex Isometry! You wouldn't be sitting there i—

C. BOUDAN: That's enough, Conrad!

C. SANGHA: Your actions are on trial, not your results. Only one person in this city gets to make decisions that affect us all, and you would do well to learn from the Cloud Strider what a dire burden that is.

JAIN: Is it such a heavy burden to be this council's lapdog?

C. BOUDAN: Heavier than anything you've proven yourself capable of.

C. SANGHA: Let the record show the accused exhibits no remorse for his actions and displays a disregard for the public consensus. Considering the good you accomplished as part of your illegal research, we offer some small mercy: three years' house arrest and 4,000 hours of community service, to be served concurrently.

JAIN: I've never wanted anything but to protect this city and help it grow. You can't punish me to make me stop.

C. BOUDAN: Fortunately, some members of this council feel your arguments have merit. If you consent, you will be allowed to work off your debt to society by continuing your simulation research. Under "lap dog" oversight, as you called her. 
  
TRANSCRIPT ENDS.
3935354268.text_zh:
内欧姆那公共安全部 

案件编号：PUBEND6067111-CJain-7

转录 | 请勿外传

议员桑哈：判决案件公开终审6067111-康杰恩-7，由女议员玛贝拉·桑哈主持。被告被判犯有非法侵入俗称“云端方舟”的公民数据架构、非法模拟和危害公共安全罪。

议员布丹：这真是非常漫长的一周，杰恩先生，容我重申：如果你协助我们揭露你的同谋，议会将会对你宽大处理。

康拉德·杰恩（被告）：迄今为止，我唯一共事过的罪犯就是宣布这一判决的人。

议员布丹：杰恩先生，这些指控是——

杰恩：它们是一代人的浮夸创伤！

议员布丹：杰恩先生——

杰恩：我们是被困在一个泡泡中的最后一批人类。模拟是个全新的领域，我们可以对其进行探索来重新定义它对人类意味着什么。而你们宣布它非法，仅仅是因为我们害怕别人几百年前的糟糕经历！

议员桑哈：法律因公众的共识而存在。我们的社会何时以及如何发展，不是你一个人的决定。

议员布丹：模拟研究是有经过批准的渠道的。

杰恩：“经过批准的渠道。”那些繁文缛节底下就是这个吗？

议员布丹：杰恩先生——

杰恩：云端方舟是一个n维的超因果褶皱，而我们却用它来储存图书馆的书。

议员布丹：我们用它来支持公众所需。而不是作为某种游乐场。

杰恩：游乐？！你个王八蛋，我在关闭Vex等距时可是失去了朋友！你根本没机会坐在那里，要是——

议员布丹：够了，康拉德！

议员桑哈：受审的是你的行为，而不是你的结果。在这座城市里，只有一个人能够做出影响我们所有人的决定，你最好向云端行者学习一下这是种多么可怕的负担。

杰恩：做议会的走狗是很重的负担吗？

议员布丹：比你已经证明自己能力的任何事情都要重。

议员桑哈：请记录在案，被告对自己的行为毫无悔意，并且无视公众共识。鉴于你在非法研究中所取得的部分成就，我们就手下留情一点：三年软禁外加4000小时的社区服务，同时执行。

杰恩：除了保护这座城市，帮助它发展，我别无所求。你不能通过惩罚我来阻止我。

议员布丹：幸运的是，本议会有些议员认为你的论点有其价值。如果你同意，你将获准通过继续你的模拟研究来偿还你欠社会的债务。在你所谓的“走狗”的监督之下。 
  
转录结束。

3935354269.name: The Maelstrom
3935354269.text:
One, two, three! Eyes on me, niños!

It's Thursday, and you know what that means! That's right—it is Cloud Strider Day! What do the Cloud Striders do? Right again! They keep us all safe. And how do we tell them "Thank you?" By remembering them!

Today, we will learn about Maelstrom. That's a new word, isn't it? Do you know what it means?

A maelstrom is a big storm. A maelstrom is loud and scary, and it can cause a lot of damage. The Cloud Strider who picked Maelstrom as her call sign was also loud and scary. But she wasn't scary to us. She was scary to the Vex. She was a strong warrior who could fight as well as any of the Vex, but she was also a very smart leader who taught all the other people on Neptune how to defend ourselves.

And do you know what she did? She started a special school called the Assur Academy. And you can go there today, if you study hard and you want to learn to be a good leader like Maelstrom. They even train new Cloud Striders!

But, today, we mostly remember Maelstrom because she saved the whole city from the Uplift Coven. The Uplift Coven were humans, like you, but they were selfish and mean. Good people talk out their differences and find ways to fix their problems that help everyone. But the Uplift Coven hurt people and stole from people, and they all wanted to be Cloud Striders.

Why shouldn't more people be Cloud Striders?

That's right. Because the Cloud Strider sacrifices. A Cloud Strider must have affinity, awareness, and altruism. You cannot be a Cloud Strider if you demand things from other people.

Maelstrom made the Uplift Coven stop, and now we are very careful to teach everyone to be better citizens when they are young. Because good children grow up into good adults, and even good Cloud Striders!

That's all for today, niños. Three, two, one! Now, have fun! And remember: Thank you, Cloud Striders!

—Carlita Capybara, Capybara Corner, s44, ep2
3935354269.text_zh:
一，二，三！看我这边，孩子们！

今天是星期四，你们知道这意味着什么！没错——今天是云端行者日！云端行者是做什么的？又对了！他们保护我们所有人的安全。我们要怎么才能向他们说“谢谢你们”呢？通过铭记他们！

今天，我们要来了解漩涡。这是个新词，对吧？你们知道它是什么意思吗？

漩涡就是大的风暴。漩涡既吵闹又吓人，而且会造成很大的伤害。这位选择漩涡作为呼号的云端行者也既吵闹又吓人。但她对我们来说并不可怕。她会让Vex感到害怕。她是一名强壮的战士，能像任何Vex一样战斗，但她也是一位非常聪明的领袖，教会了海王星上其他所有人如何保护自己。

你们知道她做了什么吗？她创办了一所名为娅舒尔学院的特殊学校。如果你们努力学习，而且想成为像漩涡那样的优秀领袖，你们就可以去那里进修。他们甚至还会训练新的云端行者！

不过，时至今日，我们大多记得漩涡，是因为她从振奋灵巫会手中拯救了整座城市。振奋灵巫会是一群人类，和你们一样，但是他们自私而卑鄙。好人会说出他们的分歧，并找到解决问题的方法，这对每个人都有帮助。但振奋灵巫会却伤害别人，偷走别人的东西，而且他们都想成为云端行者。

为什么不能让更多的人成为云端行者？

没错。因为云端行者会牺牲。一名云端行者必须具有亲和力、自我意识和利他精神。如果你对别人有所要求，你就不能成为一名云端行者。

漩涡阻止了振奋灵巫会，现在我们非常小心地教每个人在年轻时成为更好的公民。因为好孩子会成长为好大人，甚至是好云端行者！

今天就到这里了，孩子们。三，二，一！现在，好好去玩吧！记住这句话：谢谢你们，云端行者！

——卡莉塔·卡比巴拉，卡比巴拉角，s44，ep2

3935354270.name: Sedderik Assur

3935354271.name: The Strider
3935354271.text:
One, two, three! Eyes on me, niños!

It's Thursday, and you know what that means! That's right, it is Cloud Strider Day! What do the Cloud Striders do? Right again! They keep us all safe. And how do we tell them "Thank you?" By remembering them!

Today we will learn about the Strider. She was the very first Cloud Strider, and the one they named themselves after!

Before the Strider, we did not have a special protector for the city, and that meant we all had to fight every day. We had many weapons and implants to make ourselves strong, but not the special synthesis that makes the Cloud Striders special. And many more Neomuni had to be soldiers and transform their bodies to protect the city and get hurt.

The Strider saw us suffering. She worried that fighting so much would hurt our hearts, and she knew that one person can make all the difference. So, she took her courage and her wits and her strength and created the Sidereal.

Do you know what the Sidereal is, niños?

That's right! The Sidereal is a special place where one person gives up their normal life to become a Cloud Strider and live for us all!

The Strider gave us the Sidereal. The Cloud Strider fights so we can have peace so we could be more than just soldiers.

That's all for today, niños. Three, two, one! Now have fun! And remember: Thank you, Cloud Striders!

—Carlita Capybara, Capybara Corner, s45, ep51
3935354271.text_zh:
一，二，三！看我这边，孩子们！

今天是星期四，你们知道这意味着什么！没错，今天是云端行者日！云端行者是做什么的？又对了！他们保护我们所有人的安全。我们要怎么才能向他们说“谢谢你们”呢？通过铭记他们！

今天我们要学习行者。她是第一位云端行者，也是后辈以之为名的人！

在行者之前，我们还没有一位专门的城市保护者，这意味着我们每天都要战斗。我们有许多武器和植入物来让自己变得强大，但没有让云端行者变得特别的特殊合成物。越来越多的内欧姆那人被迫成为士兵，转化他们的身体来保护城市继而光荣负伤。

行者看到我们一直在受苦。她担心这么多的战斗会伤害我们的内心，她也知道一个人就能有所作为。所以，她拿出她的勇气、智慧和力量创造了群星。

你们知道什么是群星吗，孩子们？

没错！群星是一个特殊的地方，在那里会有人放弃正常的生活，成为一位云端行者，为我们所有人而活！

行者给了我们群星。云端行者的战斗是为了让我们拥有和平，让我们除了士兵外还可以成为别的。

今天就到这里了，孩子们。三，二，一！现在，好好去玩吧！记住这句话：谢谢你们，云端行者！

——卡莉塔·卡比巴拉，卡比巴拉角，s45，ep51

3935354256.name: Mikaela Julaha
3935354256.text:
NEOMUNA DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH

PATIENT ID. MLJULAHA00027.1395

DATED //ERROR/

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT | CONFIDENTIAL

AMMA JULAHA: Mom!

MIKAELA JULAHA: Hey, baby. Oof!

AMMA J.: We saw you on the feed. You were amazing! Does your arm hurt?

MIKAELA J.: This thing? Nah, Doc says this one should grow back. Maybe a couple of days.

DR. SOFIA GUO: Closer to twenty-four hours, actually. Your abnormal nanite colony seems to coordinate repairs better every cycle.

S. GUO: And I asked Nurse Chakwas to not let anyone in here.

MIKAELA J.: After seven years, you still haven't figured out no nurse can keep this girl out of anything?

S. GUO: Well, nice as it is to see you, Amma, please wait in the lounge. I'd like to speak to your mother alone.

MIKAELA J.: I want her here for this.

S. GUO: You're sure?

//INAUDIBLE

S. GUO: Mikaela, there's a lot we still don't understand after the accident. Your nanite colony and the cultures we've taken are all going strong. Your CloudArk nodes are still doing whatever it is they do. Even your original assistive socket is pristine, and we should be swapping that every five years.

MIKAELA J.: But?

S. GUO: But this is all a lot of strain for your organic parts. The human body was never meant to heal this fast or push this hard—

AMMA J.: No…

S. GUO: There's extensive microscarring across your liver, heart, kidneys, spleen, and brain—

MIKAELA J.: The big five.

S. GUO: If I can figure out how to suppress your nanite colony long enough to operate, we can start replacing—

MIKAELA J.: Assume you can't.

//INAUDIBLE

S. GUO: Eight months. Maybe ten if we keep you off the front lines.

AMMA J.: Mom, no.

MIKAELA J.: Hey, you come here, little one.

AMMA J.: You can't die.

MIKAELA J.: Dying's just the part of life everyone does. It's boring. I should have died a long time ago. But I got just a few more years to watch you grow up, and love your daddy, and, honey, I got to save people.

AMMA J.: I need you.

MIKAELA J.: You don't need me. You got a better mama inside you made from all those good memories. That mama will always be there when you need her.

AMMA J.: Can I—

AMMA J.: Can I just stay with you here a little while?

MIKAELA J.: I don't want anything else in the whole world, Babygirl.
3935354256.text_zh:
内欧姆那卫生部

患者ID. MLJULAHA00027.1395

日期//错误/

音频转录 | 机密

阿玛·尤拉哈：妈！

米凯拉·尤拉哈：嘿，宝贝。哎哟！

阿玛·尤：我们在视频上看到你了。你太棒了！你的胳膊疼吗？

米凯拉·尤：这玩意儿？不疼，医生说这个应该会长回来。也许几天吧。

索菲亚·郭医生：其实差不多24小时就行。你的异常纳米群似乎在每个周期都能更好地协调修复。

索·郭：我告诉过查克瓦斯护士不要让任何人进来。

米凯拉·尤：七年了，你还是没搞懂没有护士能拦住这姑娘吗？

索·郭：很高兴见到你，阿玛，请在休息室等候。我想和你母亲单独谈谈。

米凯拉·尤：我希望她能在场。

索·郭：你确定吗？

//无法辨识

索·郭：米凯拉，事故发生后，我们还有很多不明白的地方。你的纳米群和我们采集的培养物都状况良好。你的云端方舟节点也在照旧运转。甚至你原来的辅助插槽也都是完好的，我们本该每五年更换一次。

米凯拉·尤：但是？

索·郭：但是这对于你的器官来说是很大的压力。人类的身体从来不该愈合得这么快或这么极端——

阿玛·尤：不…

索·郭：你的肝脏、心脏、肾脏、脾脏和大脑都有大量的微小瘢痕——

米凯拉·尤：五脏六腑。

索·郭：如果我能解决怎么压制你的纳米群足够长的时间来动手术，我们就可以开始替换——

米凯拉·尤：我想你做不到。

//无法辨识

索·郭：八个月。如果我们不让你上前线，也许还能撑十个月。

阿玛·尤：妈，不。

米凯拉·尤：嘿，过来，小家伙。

阿玛·尤：你不能死。

米凯拉·尤：每个人都会在生命之末死去。它很无聊。我早就该死了。但我还多活了几年去看着你长大，去爱你的爸爸，而且，亲爱的，我还能拯救别人。

阿玛·尤：我需要你。

米凯拉·尤：你不需要我。你脑海里那些美好的回忆让你有了一个更好的妈妈。当你需要妈妈的时候，她总会陪在你身边。

阿玛·尤：我能——

阿玛·尤：我能在这里陪你一会儿吗？

米凯拉·尤：这世上我已别无他求，乖女儿。

2164211400.name: Mr. Che
2164211400.text:
"Well, that's the end of another day." Arter smiled at his students. "Remember, everyone, this is the last day we meet here in the school. Starting next week, all our classes will be in the CloudArk. We'll start learning digital sculpting for art time! Won't that be exciting?"

"I don't like art time, Mr. Che!" Suza stamped her foot. "Why do we need to go into the computer? I like our playground."

Arter set himself heavily onto the stool. His class ranged from four to seven years old, and some of them were smarter than he ever remembered being at that age, but none of them were ready to confront the idea of extinction. "I know you've all heard that the Pyramid Fleet is coming back." Blank stares… They knew the fact, but not the emotional weight it carried. "The Pyramid Fleet are very bad people who might hurt us. So, we're all going to go deep underground, where we'll be very hard to find. But there isn't a lot of room underground, and not a lot to do, so we'll all go to sleep and spend time in the CloudArk, so we can still learn and play with our friends."

"Will it hurt?"

"No, Keiji. It'll be just like when we go into the CloudArk for story time. You've all done this lots of times before."

"Can we get up to use the bathroom?" Arter didn't catch who spoke up, but it sounded like Kachela.

"No, we'll have to stay asleep," he reminded them.

"But then we'll poop the bed!" Absolute scandal dripped from Kachela's voice, and Arter had to stifle a laugh.

"We'll be just fine. Everyone is going to get their own special sleeping pod just like the Founders used!" He lowered his voice to a faux-conspiratorial whisper. "It will do all the pooping for you."

The classroom shouted "Ewwwww" as one chorus. Arter could always count on certain things to distract kids from their fear.
2164211400.text_zh:
“好，又一天结束了。”阿尔特对他的学生微笑着说。“大家记住，这是我们在学校里见面的最后一天。下周开始，我们将在云端方舟里上所有的课。我们要在艺术课上开始学习数字雕塑了！是不是很让人兴奋？”

“我不喜欢艺术课，车先生！”苏萨跺了跺她的脚。“我们为什么要进计算机里去？我喜欢我们的操场。”

阿尔特重重地坐到凳子上。他班里的孩子年纪从四岁到七岁不等，其中一些人比他记忆中那个年龄段的人还要聪明，但他们都没有准备好面对灭绝的想法。“我知道你们都听说金字塔舰队要回来了。”茫然的目光…他们知道这个事实，但不知道它所承载的情感重量。“金字塔舰队是很坏的人，他们可能会伤害我们。所以，我们都要去地下深处，在那里他们就很难找到我们。但是地下没有太多的空间，也没有太多的事情可做，所以我们都会去睡觉，在云端方舟里消磨时光，这样我们依然可以和朋友一起学习和玩耍。”

“会痛吗？”

“不会的，启治。就和我们在云端方舟里上故事课时一样。你们以前都去过很多次了。”

“我们能起床用洗手间吗？”阿尔特没听清是谁在说话，但听起来像是卡切拉。

“不，我们必须一直睡，”他提醒他们。

“但那样我们就会拉在床上了！”卡切拉的声音里流露出十足的反感，阿尔特不得不忍住笑。

“我们会没事的。每个人都会得到自己的特殊睡眠舱，就像创建者用的那种！”他压低了声音，装出一副阴谋论的口吻。“它会帮你排便。”

教室里齐声叫喊着“呃啊啊”。阿尔特总能指望某些东西来转移孩子们的恐惧。

2164211403.name: Sehrish
2164211403.text:
"Hiro, what did I say? Get this family portrait hung," Sehrish chided her husband. "And, daughter, I need you to go to the market—"

"Mom," Valla interrupted, "our appointment is in two hours."

"To the market," she continued, shaking a nearly empty tin. "And bring back cumin and cardamum. I don't like how low we are on garam masala."

"We're going into lockdown. We don't need more spices!"

"Oh no? What about that hallway panel where something's always breaking?" The service panel in the Tanaka residence had inexplicably been ground zero for 90% of the block's brownouts. "What if the Cloud Strider comes to fix it, hm? And then wants to make himself a nice lunch for his trouble. Don't we owe Rohan a nicely stocked kitchen?"

Valla stared, dumbfounded by the logic. "If he wants a lunch, he can get a chana masala from the food printer. It's fine!"

"It is not fine," her voice cracked. "That machine has no soul. Cooking is love. You've got to put something of yourself into it."

"You know how important this is for the community. For the whole city!" Valla dropped her bag by the door. "You voted for this lockdown!" She expected another of her mother's twists of logic but, instead, Sehrish slumped her shoulders and shuddered softly. It took the young woman too long to realize her mother was crying.

"Your father and I applied for this larger apartment when I was pregnant with you." The older woman wiped away a tear. "And we were always so busy raising you we never had time to finish all the things we wanted to do with it. How can I move on when I'm not done here?"

"Aw, Mom." She pulled her mother tight, then felt larger arms pull them both together and smelled her father's aftershave.

"That life in the computer. It doesn't feel like our home," she admitted, looking surprised.

"Of course, it doesn't feel like home yet, Sehrish," Hiro rumbled softly. "You have to put something of yourself into it."
2164211403.text_zh:
“小宏，我说什么来着？把这张全家福挂起来，”瑟里西责备她的丈夫道。“还有，女儿，我需要你去趟市场——”

“妈，”瓦拉打断道，“我们的预约还有两个小时。”

“去市场，”她继续说道，摇晃着一个几乎空了的罐子。“把孜然和豆蔻带回来。我可不想看到我们的葛拉姆马萨拉居然这么少。”

“我们要封锁了。不需要太多香料！”

“不需要？那块总是坏掉的走廊控制板呢？”这街区90%的停电莫名都是田中家的服务面板引发的。“如果云端行者来修呢，嗯？然后想为自己的辛苦劳顿犒劳一顿美味的午餐。难道我们不应该给洛汗准备一个储备充足的厨房吗？”

瓦拉两眼茫然，被这种逻辑惊呆了。“要是他想吃午餐，他可以从食品打印机那里买一份鹰嘴豆咖喱。那也挺好的！”

“一点也不好，”她的声音沙哑。“那台机器没有灵魂。做饭就是一种爱。你必须把属于自己的一些东西投入其中。”

“你知道这对社区，对整座城市有多重要！”瓦拉把她的包丢在了门边。“你可是给封锁投了赞成票的！”她等待着母亲又一个歪曲的逻辑，但相反，瑟里西垂下她的肩膀，轻轻地颤抖着。这个年轻女人过了很久才意识到她妈妈在哭。

“我怀你的时候，你爸和我申请了这个更大的公寓。”年长的女人擦去了一滴眼泪。“我们一直忙着抚养你，从来没有时间去完成我们想在这里做的事。我还没做完这里的事，怎么能继续前进呢？”

“噢，妈。”她紧紧地抱着母亲，然后感觉到更大的手臂将她们俩抱在一起，并闻到了父亲须后水的味道。

“计算机里的那种生活。感觉不像我们的家，”她承认道，看上去很惊讶。

“当然，它还没有家的感觉，瑟里西，”小宏轻轻地低声说道。“你必须把属于自己的一些东西投入其中。”

2164211402.name: Tino
2164211402.text:
"Founders' tits, Tino," Callie snorted in disgust. The virtual briefing room was just as drab as their physical one had been—by design—and it heightened the outlandishness of his avatar choice. "I'm not going to talk to you if you're going to be a mandala. It gives me a headache."

"This is the future! And you're not my supervisor." She waved him off and turned back to the schedule with the other medtechs.

"How do they expect us to receive this many people in one shift?" Tammiya pulled a copy of the schedule file and integrated it into her arm—half the staff were already taking advantage of the transience of "virtual tattoos" to keep important notes accessible.

Tino perked up at the chance to gossip. "You didn't hear? Over on Wakeside, they had an anaphylaxis event last shift. Some chucklehead forgot to tell them about his shellfish allergy."

"But the new cathepsin inhibitors are oyster-derived."

"Exactly," Miku confirmed. Her avatar hung slack. "They pumped him full of deepsleep, and he puffed up like a fugu. Puked everywhere! Glad I was only there on drone duty because the smell must have been a nightmare." Tino brought up the video feed.

"Why do people think we even ask all these questions?"

"That's enough!" Bijan settled into a virtual chair at the briefing table. The supervisor's cold glare survived CloudArk transition unaffected. "People get scared, and they forget things. It's part of being human. Do your jobs like professionals."

"But we were already behind, chief. And then people like this slow it down for everyone else."

"I get the frustration, Tammiya." Bijan pulled the schedule apart into their respective assignments. "But we're medical technicians. We're the stability they need. You wear your empathy first."

"Good call, chief," Tino piped in.

"Speaking of… Tino, you can be math on your own time. But while we have five million scared patients looking for reassurance, keep your damn face on."
2164211402.text_zh:
“天啊，蒂诺，”卡莉厌恶地哼了一声。虚拟简报室和他们曾经的实体简报室一样单调——是故意设计的——这更凸显了他的虚拟形象选得古怪。“如果你要当曼陀罗，我就不和你说话了。看到它我就头疼。”

“这可是未来！而你不是我的主管。”她冲他摆摆手，和其他医疗技术人员重回到了工作日程上。

“他们怎么能指望我们在一个班次接待这么多人？”田宫拿出一份日程文件的副本，将其集成到她的手臂上——一半的员工已经在利用“虚拟纹身”的瞬时性以便随时查阅重要的笔记。

蒂诺一有机会八卦就兴奋起来。“你没听说吗？在韦克赛德，他们上一轮班发生了一起过敏事件。有个笨蛋忘了告诉他们自己对贝类过敏。”

“但新的组织蛋白酶抑制剂是从牡蛎中提取的。”

“没错，”三玖确认道。她的虚拟形象懒散地垂着。“他们给他注射了大量的深度睡眠剂，他就像河豚一样膨胀起来。吐得到处都是！很高兴我只是在那里执行无人机任务，不然那种气味一定很恶心。”蒂诺调出了视频。

“他们知道我们为什么要问那些问题吗？”

“够了！”比詹坐在简报桌旁的虚拟椅子上。主管冷酷的目光没有受到云端方舟过渡的影响。“人们会害怕，他们会忘记事情。这是人性的一部分。像专业人士一样干好自己的工作。”

“但我们已经落后了，头儿。还会遇到这样的人拖累其他的人。”

“我懂你的沮丧，田宫。”比詹把工作日程安排成了各自的任务。“但我们是医疗技术人员。我们是他们需要的定心丸。你首先要有同理心。”

“说得好，头儿，”蒂诺插嘴道。

“说到这…蒂诺，你用私下的时间怎么八卦我都不管。但是，我们还有五百万惊恐的病人在寻求安慰，你给我严肃一点。”

2164211405.name: Cais
2164211405.text:
"And then Marco looks up at me with eyes the size of durian and says, 'No, Grandpa, I'm adrift'!" It was too stupid a joke not to laugh. Mr. Mendoza's body language changed after that. He settled into the chair and leaned back, no longer eyeing Cais like she was a harpy in disguise. She made a mental note to thank her boss: the easiest way to put seniors at ease was to ask about family.

He wiped a tear from his eye, then clapped his hands on her desk. "So. You need to freeze me?"

"That's a common misconception." She had tried for weeks to dispel this one, but the term "cryo" had caught on and was too easy. "It's more like a hibernation. We'll lower your body temperature and metabolic activity, but your mind will remain active in the CloudArk."

"Oh? I used to do some arking back in my day. Been a while, though. Mostly just use the AV stuff to visit the great-grandkids." He made a point of shifting in the chair. "The monorail's not great for the old scoliosis."

"I don't think anyone calls it 'arking' anymore, Mr. Mendoza, but you'll be able to see the grandkids just like an in-person visit."

She kicked on the viewing wall and displayed an image of Neomuna, except…

"No clouds?" He whistled appreciatively.

"We call it the Landing Zone. It's an exact replica of the city. Same laws of physics. Just nicer weather. You'll start out here while you get used to CloudArk living. We generate a body that's an exact replica of the one you have now. Once you get settled in, we have classes for customizing your avatar, building new spaces, even exploring the deep CloudArk if you feel adventurous."

"Sounds good, I suppose. But this, uh… this perfect replica of my body?"

"Down to the neuron."

"Can you make me one without the scoliosis?"
2164211405.text_zh:
“然后马可抬起榴莲般大的眼睛看着我，说，‘不，爷爷，我在漂流'！”这笑话太蠢了，让人不得不笑。随后门多萨先生的肢体语言发生了改变。他在椅子上坐下，靠在椅背上，不再像盯着个乔装的机甲女妖那样盯着凯丝。她心里记下了要感谢她的老板：让长辈安心最简单的方法就是询问其家人。

他擦去眼角的泪水，然后拍了拍她的桌子。“所以。你需要冻住我？”

“这是种常见的误解。”几个星期以来，她一直试图消除这种观念，但是“冷冻”这个术语已经流行起来，过于容易理解。“这更像是冬眠。我们会降低你的体温和代谢活动，但你的大脑在云端方舟里还会保持活跃。”

“哦？我过去曾做过一些方舟活动。不过，有段时间了。主要是用音视频一类的东西去看看我的曾孙们。”他特意在椅子上挪动着。“单轨铁路对老年脊柱侧凸患者来说不是很友好。”

“门多萨先生，我想没有人再把它叫做‘方舟活动'了，但你可以像亲自到访一样看望孙子孙女们。”

她踢了一脚观景墙，展示出一张内欧姆那的图像，除了…

“没有云？”他赞赏地吹了个口哨。

“我们称之为着陆区。它是这座城市的精准复刻。有同样的物理规律。只是天气会更好一些。你会从这里开始，逐渐习惯云端方舟的生活。我们会生成一个和你现在的身体一模一样的复刻。等你安顿下来，我们这有可以定制你的虚拟形象、建造新空间的课程，如果你喜欢冒险，甚至可以去探索云端方舟的深处。”

“我觉得，听起来不错。但是这个，呃…我身体的完美复刻？”

“精确到神经元。”

“你能给我整个没有脊柱侧凸的吗？”

2164211404.name: Adinew
2164211404.text:
Adinew's spoon scraped the corners of the ramekin, pulling up the remnants of purin and popping the last half-bite of custard into his mouth. His tongue satisfied but his heart still yearning, he eyed the last bowl sitting on the counter.

"Don't even." Paolo didn't look up from his novel. "I get at least one out of this batch."

"You'll never find a better husband with that attitude."

At this, Paolo set his book down and walked across the room, wrapping his arms around his spouse from behind. "Hey, first the stress-eating, now the self-deprecation. What's going on?"

"Worried about my approval rating." Adinew relaxed a little under the attention. "City Council elections are next year, and lockdown's a big change to drop on everyone beforehand. And with me in charge of administering the upload…"

"You did good. Your public referendum proved people want to protect their families and their community. Everyone's excited to do their part. So, what's really going on?"

Adinew watched the poukas outside the window, lazily floating in the wind. He dropped his ramekin and spoon into the scrubber, and the noise seemed to snap him back.

"It's… it's all this." He waved over the plateaus and spires and canyons of the city, limned with neon light. "We're going to give up our whole lives, five million times over." He choked down a lump in his throat. "What if the Pyramids never come back? What if we're making the wrong choice? If I made the wrong choice?"

"Then we made the wrong choice." Paolo laughed and cupped Adinew's chin. "And everyone's still alive. But if we do nothing, and THAT's the wrong choice…"

After a long moment, Adinew finally nodded. He returned his husband's embrace, and they looked out at the poukas a while longer.
2164211404.text_zh:
阿迪纽用勺子刮了刮烤罐的四角，盛起剩下的布丁，把最后半口蛋奶糕塞进嘴里。他的味蕾满足了，但他的内心依然渴望，他看着放在柜台上的最后一碗。

“想都别想。”保罗没有从他的小说中抬起头来。“这批中至少有我的一份。”

“你这样的态度永远也找不到更好的丈夫。”

听到这话，保罗放下书，穿过房间，从后面搂着他的配偶。“嘿，先是暴饮暴食，现在又是自嘲。这是怎么了？”

“我在担心我的支持率。”阿迪纽在关注之下放松了一些。“明年是市议会选举，封锁对每个人来说都是一次很大的转变。而我还负责管理上传…”

“你做得很好。你们的公投证明了大家想要保护他们的家庭和社区。每个人都很激动能尽自己的一份力。那么，到底发生了什么？”

阿迪纽望着窗外的普卡，懒洋洋地在风中漂浮着。他把他的烤罐和勺子丢进了洗涤器，那声音似乎把他猛地拉了回来。

“是…是这一切。”他朝着被霓虹灯包围的城市高原、尖塔和峡谷挥了挥手。“我们马上要放弃我们的全部生活，超过五百万次。”他哽住了喉咙。“如果金字塔最后没回来呢？如果我们做了错误的选择呢？如果我做了错误的选择呢？”

“那我们就做错误的选择呗。”保罗笑了，托着阿迪纽的下巴。“而且大家都还活着。但是如果我们什么都不做，那才是错误的选择…”

过了好一会儿，阿迪纽终于点了点头。他还给他丈夫一个拥抱，他们又看了一会儿外面的普卡。

2164211407.name: Magnolia
2164211407.text:
"Can you not be here virtually?" Ava couldn't make eye contact with the digital projection—she wasn't sure she could with a real, live person either, but it was such a stark reminder.

"I can't," Maggie admitted. "But I can get another crisis responder who hasn't uploaded yet to come over. It'll take a few minutes. Can I sit with you until then?"

Decisions were hard. "I guess."

Magnolia sat—settled her virtual projection in at Ava's eye level and above the couch—and looked around the apartment. Her eyes fell on a familiar artwork.

"Wow, is that a vintage Raid Invader poster?"

Ava shifted a little. After a long moment, she nodded. "Yeah. Was my granddad's. It was the preorder promo for the very first game."

"That's awesome. You excited about the new series they're making? Purnadi Hassan is going to be the perfect Durandal!"

"The Thrilladrome arcade's sponsoring a watch party for it after we're all…" She didn't add "in the CloudArk."

There was a sigh and another silence.

Minutes ticked by.

Ava took a deep breath. "It's just scary, you know?"

"It is." Maggie nodded.

"The whole world is going to end, and we're going to hide online."

"It's not on you to save the world." Maggie placed a digital hand on Ava's. The charge particles tingled her skin.

"But the world's going to end. Why can't I just choose to go a little sooner?"

Maggie shrugged. "Because then you'd miss a great Raid Invader series."

"Holding out to watch a new show? That's so…" Ava shook her head. "Dumb."

"So what? Life's dumb." Maggie waved around with the vague suggestion of everything. "It's okay to coast. If you'd get lost without little steppingstones of happiness, then use the stones."

Ava cautioned a look at her virtual companion. "And if you're good," Maggie assured her, "you can save the world next week."
2164211407.text_zh:
“你能不要虚拟地出现在这里吗？”艾娃无法与数字投影进行眼神交流——她也不确定自己能否与一个活生生的真人进行眼神交流，但这是句态度鲜明的提醒。

“不行，”玛姬承认道。“但我可以让另一个还没上传的危机响应者过来。这需要几分钟的时间。我可以和你坐着等吗？”

做出决定十分艰难。“那好吧。”

玛格诺利娅坐下——将她的虚拟投影定在艾娃的视线水平和沙发上方——环视着公寓。她的目光落在一件熟悉的艺术品上。

“哇，那是突袭入侵者的旧海报吗？”

艾娃稍稍动了一下。过了很久，她点点头。“对。是我爷爷的。这是游戏首款作品的预购宣传海报。”

“太棒了。你期待他们制作的新系列吗？普纳迪·哈桑会成为完美的杜兰德尔！”

“惊颤竞速街机赞助了一场观看派对，在我们都…”她没有说完那句“来到云端方舟里之后”。

一声叹息传来，接着又是一阵沉默。

时间一分一秒地过去。

艾娃深吸了一口气。“太吓人了，你懂吗？”

“确实。”玛姬点点头。

“整个世界都要毁灭了，而我们要躲在网上。”

“拯救世界不是你的责任。”玛姬把一双数字化的手放在艾娃的手上。带电粒子刮擦着她的皮肤。

“但是世界都要毁灭了。我为什么不能选择早点毁灭呢？”

玛姬耸耸肩。“因为那样你就会错过一款伟大的突袭入侵者系列游戏。”

“撑下去就为了看一场新的表演？那可…”艾娃摇摇头。“太蠢了。”

“那又怎样呢？生活就是很蠢。”玛姬挥挥手，含糊地暗示着一切。“得过且过没什么不好。如果找不到幸福的方向，就走一步看一步吧。”

艾娃谨慎地看了一眼她的虚拟同伴。“要是你表现好，”玛姬向她保证，“下周你就能拯救世界了。”

2164211406.name: Rihk
2164211406.text:
Rihk guided his hand forward and caught the club, then pushed back with all the frame's strength and watched the suspect topple backwards. "Settle down!" It was strange to have physical hands again—even if they were borrowed from a security frame he piloted from the CloudArk—and he wasn't sure he wanted to use them again.

With the assailants down, the investigation VCs entered alongside the frame team, ready to inventory the stolen supplies. Commander Jingye walked in, still wearing her skin, and Rihk snapped to attention.

"Didn't realize you'd be coming down in person, ma'am."

"I'm here to see what can be salvaged, Constable." He expected her to wander over to the lashed shelves stuffed with nanite slurry, nutrient goo, batteries, and assemblers—enough for the dozen holdouts to live off the grid for years—but, instead, Tse stopped in front of his prone suspect. "Been a day, huh?"

"We won't go under!" His eyes burned with contempt as he sat firm in front of a fortune in supplies looted from the public stores.

Jingye offered a hand to help him stand. He slapped it away—a simple conversation between hope and hatred. But behind it, the man radiated terror.

The Commander sighed, turning back to Rihk's frame. "He's just scared, ma'am," he offered.

"We're all scared, Constable. But these holdout cults… they'd rather die living like they knew instead of surviving in a new normal." Her patient expression folded into a scowl. "And they don't care if they get the rest of us killed, too."

"My sister works in Mental Health Services. Says they're stretched thin, especially without the poukas. What do we do with them?"

"Counciler Adinew's authorized deep cryo as an option for anyone who doesn't want to upload."

"Sleep through all this instead of help out?" Rihk scoffed as he lifted the suspect. The felon's bravado melted as he listened to the exchange. "You seriously think anyone will take it?"

"Probably." She moved to leave. "And we're out of time to find better solutions."
2164211406.text_zh:
里赫引导着他的手向前抓住棍棒，然后用整个框架的力量推了回去，看着嫌疑人向后倒下。“别乱动！”再次拥有自己实体的手感觉很奇怪——即使它们是他从云端方舟驾驶的安全框架身上借来的——他不确定自己是否想再次使用它们。

袭击者倒下后，调查VC与框架小组一起入场，准备清点被盗物资。指挥官静叶走进来，仍披着自己的皮肤，里赫迅速立正。

“没想到你会亲自下来，女士。”

“我是来看看还能挽回点什么，警官。”他以为她会走向堆满纳米泥浆、营养胶、电池和组装器的扎捆货架——足够十几个钉子户隐居生活多年——但是，与之相反，谢在俯卧的嫌疑人面前停了下来。“已经一天了吧？”

“我们不会下去的！”他坚定地坐在从公共商店抢来的大量物资面前，眼睛里满是轻蔑。

静叶伸手想拉他起来。他拍掉了那只手——希望与仇恨之间的简单对话。但在这背后，男人流露着恐惧之情。

指挥官叹了口气，转身回到里赫的框架旁。“他只是吓坏了，女士，”他主动说道。

“我们都被吓坏了，警官。但这些顽固的钉子户…他们宁可遵循老路死去，也不愿在新的常态下生存。”她耐心的表情化作了愁容。“他们也不在乎会不会害我们其他人死去。”

“我姐姐在心理健康服务机构工作。她说他们已经分身乏术了，尤其是因为没有普卡。我们该拿他们怎么办？”

“议员阿迪纽已授权，任何不想上传的人可以被深度冷冻。”

“就这么睡过去都不来帮忙？”里赫嘲笑道，架起了嫌疑人。这位犯人听到这段对话后，渐渐失去了底气。“你真的认为有人会接受吗？”

“大概吧。”她动身准备离开。“我们没有时间去寻找更好的解决方案了。”
