2324998093.name: Helm of the Taken King
2324998093.subtitle: "What will happen if I die?"
2324998093.text:
"Keep this talisman on you at all times." 

Black, glossy, and in the right light, the talisman has a rainbow iridescence. It reminds Fenchurch of hematite pearls from the Bay of Drowned Wishes. He rolls it in his hand, looking up at Chalco to see the creases of worry in her brow. 

Fenchurch clips the talisman to his jacket as the rest of his fireteam has. "What's it do?" 

"If it glows white, stay where you are and call out," Chalco explains, choosing her words carefully all while avoiding Fenchurch's gaze. "If you experience any memory loss or sense of déjà vu, call out." A silence falls over her fireteam. Palpable tension fills the cabin as they feel the craft begin to descend. 

"If you see anyone at the operation site that you do not recognize, call out." Chalco continues, occasionally steadying herself with a hand on the cabin ceiling as the submersible pitches and yaws in the disruptive currents. "If you experience any out-of-body sensations or missing time, call out." 

"Ma'am?" Lisbon-13 is not afraid to interrupt Chalco. His eyes glow bright from the back of the submersible. "Where are we going?" 

Chalco stares for a moment, squares her shoulders, and continues. "If you hear a voice that you think is your own…"
2324998093.text_zh:
“把这个护身符一直带在身上。” 

护身符是黑色带有光泽的，而在适当的光线下，会呈现出斑斓的彩虹色。这让芬丘奇想起了溺亡之愿海湾的赤铁矿珍珠。他把它卷起放在手里，抬头望向卡尔科，看到她眉头紧锁。 

芬丘奇和其他火力战队队员一样，把护身符固定在了他的夹克上。“它是干什么用的？” 

“要是它发出白光，就呆在原地，大声呼救，”卡尔科解释道，她一边小心地说着，一遍避开了芬丘奇的目光。“如果你出现任何记忆丧失或既视感，就大声呼救。”她的火力战队陷入一片沉默。当他们感知到潜水器开始下潜时，明显有一种紧张感充满了机舱。 

“如果你在操作现场看到不认识的人，就大声呼救。”卡尔科继续说道，她偶尔会在潜水器遇到扰乱水流发生倾斜和偏航时，把手放在船舱天花板上稳住身体。“如果你遇到任何体外感知或迷失的情况，就大声呼救。” 

“女士？”里斯本-13插嘴打断了卡尔科。他的双眼从潜水器后部发出明亮的光。“我们要去哪里？” 

卡尔科凝视了一会儿，挺起肩膀，继续说道。“如果你听到了一种声音，以为是自己发出来的…”

2363472582.name: Greaves of the Taken King
2363472582.subtitle: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."
2363472582.subtitle_zh: “如果我在王座上被击败，那我便会死去。我的伟业将终结。”
2363472582.text:
What appeared to be a silhouette of coral growths in the dark is revealed to be the mountainous remains of Oryx, the Taken King. The Hive god's immense carcass lays strewn across Titan's seafloor. Both Lisbon-13 and Fenchurch are taken aback by the sight, but Chalco advances toward it. 

"The Lucent Brood performed a ritual here." Chalco motions to the shattered remnants of a Hive Ghost on the ground. "We believe they were trying to forcibly resurrect Oryx by combining heretical Hive necromancy with the powers of that Ghost. They were disrupted." 

Lisbon steps forward, unable to look away from Oryx's cadaverous face. "Is that possible?" 

"Officially: no. Unofficially…" Chalco glances at Lisbon. "That's what we're here to investigate. The body is still… active. With Taken energy and Darkness. The Guardians who intercepted this ritual reported finding free-floating fragments of consciousness on the way to this site. Memories from the corpse." 

"It's alive?" Fenchurch whispers, hesitant to approach Oryx's remains.  

Chalco shakes her head. "That's unclear. We need to bring back samples for further analysis. Ikora wants this entire site quarantined and the body exhumed, pending transport to a secure location for further analysis." 

Fenchurch checks his talisman. Still black. He glances between Chalco and the corpse. "Are we the first team to come down here?" 

Chalco looks at Fenchurch, then down to the ground. Her gaze lingers there for a moment in tense silence. Finally, she fixes her gaze ahead to the corpse. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to have visited this site."
2363472582.text_zh:
黑暗中形似珊瑚生长物的轮廓，原来是邪神欧里克斯的高大遗骸。邪魔族之神巨大的尸体散落在土卫六的海底。里斯本13号和芬丘奇都对眼前的景象大吃一惊，卡尔科却朝着它径直走去。 

“光明虫群在这里举行了一场仪式。”卡尔科向地面上散落的邪魔族机灵残骸示意。“我们认为，他们原本试图通过将异端邪魔族巫术与那个机灵的力量结合起来，强行复活欧里克斯。但他们被打断了。” 

里斯本走上前去，无法将视线从欧里克斯苍白的脸上移开。“那可能吗？” 

“正常情况下不可能。不过…”卡尔科瞥了一眼里斯本。“我们就是来调查这个的。尸体…还在，带有傀儡能量和暗影。打断这场仪式的守护者报告说，他们在来这里的路上发现了自由漂浮的意识碎片。那是来自尸体的记忆。” 

“它还活着？”芬丘奇低声道，犹豫着要不要靠近欧里克斯的遗骸。  

卡尔科摇摇头。“还不清楚。我们需要带样本回去做进一步分析。艾可拉希望对整个现场进行隔离，把尸体掘出来，等待运送到安全地点进行进一步分析。” 

芬丘奇查了查他的护身符。它还是黑色的。他的视线在卡尔科和尸体之间来回跳动。“我们是第一支下到这里来的队伍吗？” 

卡尔科望着芬丘奇，然后看向地面。她的目光在紧张的沉默中停滞了一会。最后，她将目光投向前方的尸体。“我们是现存唯一造访过这个地点的隐秘者小队。”

90009855.name: Arbor Warden
90009855.subtitle: Tend the gardens of your heart.
90009855.text:
Emreth is tangling with the last Hive Acolyte when he sees the canister, wedged between two unidentifiable heaps of machinery. He can only read some of the letters stamped into its surface: H Y D R O P.  

And there it is, barely visible under the glass: a small, leafy plant. Preserved, somehow, and perfectly out of place in the flooded wreckage of the Arcology.  

Emreth has a clean shot if he pushes forward, but when the Acolyte lumbers unwittingly in the plant's direction, it makes the decision for him. He feels a shot impact against his pauldron as he runs, hears hissing as the slug starts eating into the relic iron.  

He gets to the canister first. Emreth summons his Light in the form of a shimmering barrier. The Acolyte reels back, firing blindly. Emreth puts his back to the barrier and brings up his sword. 

It's messy fighting. If he takes a little satisfaction in cleaving the Acolyte's head from its shoulders, he hopes it's beneath the War God's notice.   

Emreth surveys the room: quiet now, save for his breathing.  

Killswitch patches him through to the commander.  

"Transmat site is secure," Emreth says.  

"Acknowledged." 

He bends down to retrieve the canister—heavy, but fragile in his gauntleted hands.  

Emreth holds the tinted glass to the sunlight. "I bet you're good luck."
90009855.text_zh:
与最后一个邪魔族仆从缠斗时，埃姆瑞斯看到了被卡在两堆无法辨认的机械之间的罐子。他只能读出印在它表面上的一些字母：H Y D R O P。  

它就在那里，玻璃底下几乎看不见：一种小型的多叶植物。不知怎的保存了下来，并出现在生态园区的浸没残骸中，显得有些违和。  

要是向前推进，埃姆瑞斯就可以干净利落地开枪，但当仆从不经意间朝植物的方向挪动时，情况替他做出了抉择。他奔跑起来，感到子弹击中了他的肩甲，听到了重弹开始侵蚀圣物金属的嘶嘶声。  

他率先抵达了罐子处。埃姆瑞斯以闪光屏障的形式召唤他的光能。仆从踉跄着后退，一顿乱射。埃姆瑞斯背对着屏障，拿出他的刀剑。 

这是一场混战。他可能从砍下仆从肩上的头中得到了一丝满足感，但愿这不会引起战神的注意。   

埃姆瑞斯扫视了一下房间：这下安静了，只剩他的呼吸声。  

杀戮开关帮他接通了指挥官。  

“传送站点安全了，”埃姆瑞斯说道。  

“了解。” 

他弯下腰去收回罐子——很重，但在他戴着臂铠的手里却十分脆弱。  

埃姆瑞斯在阳光下欣赏着它的有色玻璃。“你肯定会带来好运的。”

2966283697.name: NPA "Weir-Walker" Gloves
2966283697.subtitle: [DAY 3] The Ghost of Titan walks on through sunless seas, having died long ago.
2966283697.subtitle_zh: [第3天]泰坦机灵继续行走在暗无天日的海洋中，早已死去。
2966283697.text:
REPULSION LATTICE INTEGRITY… NOMINAL 
OXYGEN SIEVE… NOMINAL 
DEPTH… 106m 

The lettering on Sloane's HUD clarified into vision. She dragged a hand through methane fluid to her faceplate, absentmindedly trying to rub the grogginess from her eyes.  

Motion in the dark surrounding her kicked up clouds of fine grit.  

Her headlights flared as her fingertips clinked against her helmet—a Thrall came screaming into the beam of light, bubbles spewing from its jaws. Sloane's eyes went wide before she reflexively flipped the Thrall over her shoulder and kicked its jaw through its skull. Her power suit spooled and pushed stimulants reactively. 

She pivoted and caught the sword of a Knight mid-swing, snapping the weapon in two between the fingers of her gauntlet and driving a shard of broken blade into its chest. Another Thrall crossed her headlights just before a silver streak whistled through its throat. Sloane eyed a selection in her visor, which hi-lighted over thirty dead Hive, slowly deteriorating in boils of tiny, rumbling ignitions that sent nerve-spasms through their husks. Her visor cleared the readings and snapped onto a friendly.  

Síocháin drifted forward, Hive viscera gently wafting into the sea from the slender razors protruding from her shell. "You were out for days." 

Sloane's face wrinkled in confusion. "I remember the Pyramid wave. Falling… dreams. Are you okay?" 

"Hive found us, like you said," Síocháin said, retracting her blades. 

Sloane grabbed the Ghost and hugged her to her power suit chassis for a moment. "Little killer. Really gave 'em the business." 

Síocháin chirped. "Pyramid wave swept over Titan, bounced around a bit and centralized where the Pyramid stopped. Gravity went crazy, then the ocean. I think we're a few miles from where we were when all this started." 

"The Pyramid stopped? Then that's where we're headed… after we grab some gear," Sloane said. 

Síocháin dipped forward. "One more thing. Something's out there circling us. Not Hive. Can't quite pin it down, but it's big." 

"Yeah?" Sloane said, thinking of what went through her mind before she lost consciousness. "Then let's not waste any time getting out of here." 

*** 

Sloane lifted herself from the ocean onto a half-submerged Arcology platform where she'd stowed a variety of rations and munitions since Titan's skies went dark. Her power suit clattered against the steel-mesh floor; she waited for the echoes to die down before taking a moment to exhale in silence. In that quiet moment, she made out a faint voice.  

Síocháin rose into view. "Do you hear that?" 

"Was about to ask you…" Sloane said, standing. She snatched First In, Last Out from a stow locker, racked the foregrip, then followed the voice down a barnacle-crusted causeway to an old research lab with Síocháin in tow. 

Fluid trickled down cracked walls surrounding rows of dead monitors. Glass reflected prismatic color from a gnarled tear in reality at the lab's center—as if it had been carved from another epoch and affixed to this one.  

A Human that didn't seem to notice them paced within the tear—standing in a fully functioning mirage of the Arcology. Once he turned toward them, the tear spasmed and lurched forward and backward in time at erratic durations and speed. He was ripped both ways into non-existence as the tear flittered through events like a fourth-dimensional montage. 

The tear held steady again, returning the man and his moment to existence. Síocháin took note of the badge on his coat that read "Gideon Tepin—NPA—Senior Marine Biologist." 

Tepin looked upset and turned away before speaking. "She's afraid. That's why we're all having them. Something's wrong. She's showing us what's coming in plain view!" The man angrily swiped his hand through the air in Sloane's direction. "It's like she's screaming it into my head. I know I'm not the only one hearing it."  

"It chose us." He stepped forward and placed his hand on the border between then and now. "I'm dreaming my own memories, but with little differences. Little omens. Black ships in the sky." 

Sloane leaned forward, hand nearly pressed to that of the living memory playing out before her on the other side of the tear. 

"She's trying to warn us. We should evacuate. We have to get her—" 

The tear lurched again, ripped away; lost to the rushing passage of time and blinked into non-existence. Gone. 

Sloane dropped her hand. Jaw clenched. "See if you can dig up any Arcology records on this." 

*** 

"That marine biologist… Tepin… was he in some sort of captured time fluctuation? Is that… even possible?" Sloane asked. 

"I've never seen anything like it," Síocháin said. "I'm not really sure." 

Síocháin skimmed archived reports. "It's under 'TLev-01.' Looks like a psychic space whale some biologists were studying out in the ocean. They never got accurate measurements, but this estimate can't be correct. Over 150 meters? Report says it wasn't from here though, and refers to a lot of visions that personnel were having… which is… odd? Not a lot of alien species in Sol until after the Golden Age." 

"I was having dreams while I was out, Síocháin. Of some other world, the Pyramid on Titan… the Tower. Like I remembered being there for each one." 

"Well, I guess it could be an ancient space whale… or sometimes the Traveler gives people dreams. But are we going to ignore the obvious 'you were rendered unconscious by a Pyramid wave' explanation?" 

"No… but we've seen enough weird not to knock it," Sloane sighed.  

"Sure. I'll log that away," Síocháin said. "You know… the readings coming from inside that field Tepin was in were consistent with atmospheric records on Titan during the Collapse." 

"What does that mean?" Sloane looked back to the spot of warped space-time. "Was he… real?" 

"I don't know. I just know it wasn't a simulation."
2966283697.text_zh:
斥力晶格完整度…正常 
氧气滤网…正常 
深度…106米 

斯隆HUD上的印字显现了。她从甲烷液体中费力地拖出一只手到面罩前，心不在焉地试图抹去眼里的目眩景象。  

她周围黑暗中的动静扬起了一团团细小的沙砾。  

当她的指尖与头盔相碰时，她的头灯亮了起来——一个怨魂尖叫着冲进了光束，气泡从它的下颚喷出。斯隆睁大双眼，然后条件反射地把怨魂翻过肩膀，用脚把它的下巴踢穿头骨。她的动力服随即发动，开始释放兴奋剂。 

她转过身，抓住骑士挥来的刀剑，用臂铠的手指将武器折断成两半，把破碎的刀刃碎片刺进其胸膛。另一个怨魂掠过她的前灯，很快就有一道银色的亮光呼啸着穿过它的喉咙。斯隆盯着面甲上的选取目标，上面标示出了三十多个死去的邪魔族，在微小低沉的火中慢慢消亡，外壳出现神经痉挛。她的面甲清除了读数，转而显示出一个友好的对象。  

西奥昌漂上前来，邪魔族的内脏被她机壳伸出的细长刀片切断，轻轻飘进海里。“你昏迷了好几天了。” 

斯隆困惑地皱起了脸。“我记得金字塔波。下坠的…梦。你没事吧？” 

“邪魔族找到了我们，就像你说的那样，”西奥昌说道，收回了她的刀刃。 

斯隆抓住机灵，把她抱在自己的动力服底盘上好一会儿。“小杀手，干得不错。” 

西奥昌啾鸣着。“金字塔波席卷土卫六，反弹了一下，集中在金字塔停下的地方。重力失控，接着是海洋。我想这离最初我们所在的地方有几英里远。” 

“金字塔停下来了？那我们就去那儿吧…不过得先拿到一些装备，”斯隆说道。 

西奥昌向前游着。“还有一件事。外面有什么东西在围着我们转。不是邪魔族。还不能确定是什么，但很大。” 

“是吗？”斯隆说着，想起了她失去意识前的念头。“那就别浪费时间了，赶紧离开这里吧。” 

*** 

斯隆将自已从海洋中抬到了半浸没的生态园区平台上，自从土卫六的天空变暗后，她就在这里存放了各种储粮和弹药。她的动力服在钢网地板上哗啦作响；她等待着回声逐渐平息，然后默默呼了一口气。在那安静的片刻，她听见了一个微弱的声音。  

西奥昌映入眼帘。“你听到了吗？” 

“我正想问你呢…”斯隆说着，站起身来。她从一个储物柜里抓起“先进后出”霰弹枪，架起前握把，然后循着声音走下一条长满藤壶的长堤，来到了一间旧研究实验室，西奥昌紧跟其后。 

液体顺着环绕一排排损坏显示器的裂墙流下。实验室中心有个撕裂现实的粗糙裂缝，玻璃反射着其棱镜色彩，仿佛是雕刻自另一个纪元，贴附在这个时代上。  

在功能完备的生态园区幻象中，一个似乎没有注意到她们的人类在裂缝中踱着步。当他转向她们时，裂缝抽搐起来，以不稳定的时间和速度前后摇晃。随着裂缝像第四维度的蒙太奇一样掠过一幕幕场景，他在时间和速度上都被撕裂了。 

裂缝再次平稳下来，那人和他的瞬间恢复了存在。西奥昌注意到他外套的徽章上写着“吉迪恩·特平NPA高级海洋生物学家”。 

特平看起来很沮丧，转过身开始说话。“她很害怕。这就是为什么我们都会这样。有点不对劲。她显然是在告诉我们即将发生的事情！”那人愤怒地向斯隆的方向挥舞着他的手。“就像她在朝我脑海里尖叫一样。我知道不只是我能听到。”  

“它选择了我们。”他走上前，把手放在当时和现在的边界上。“我梦见了自己的记忆，但是有一些不同。有一些征兆。天空中有黑色的飞船。” 

斯隆面前上演着裂痕另一侧的鲜活记忆，她身体前倾，手几乎都可以触碰到它。 

“她是在警告我们。我们应该撤离。我们必须找到她——” 

裂缝又摇晃了一下，迅速撕裂了；迷失在匆匆流逝的时间里，转眼就不复存在。消失殆尽。 

斯隆放下了手。紧咬牙关。“看看你能不能找到跟这件事有关的生态园区记录。” 

*** 

“那个海洋生物学家…特平…他是位于某个时间波动的片段里吗？这…可能吗？”斯隆问道。 

“我从没见过那样的东西，”西奥昌说道。“我不太确定。” 

西奥昌浏览着归档报告。“它在‘TLev-01'栏里。看起来像是一些生物学家们在海洋里研究的通灵太空鲸。他们从未得到过准确的测量，但这个预估值不可能是对的。超过150米？报告说它不是来自这里，还提到了很多人员看到的幻象…而这…很奇怪？黄金时代之前，太阳系里可没有多少外来物种。” 

“我之前昏迷时做了一些梦，西奥昌。梦到另一个世界，土卫六上的金字塔…还有高塔。我好像记得自己曾经都去过那些地方。” 

“嗯，我猜它可能是一只古老的太空鲸…或者有时旅行者会给人们托梦。但别忘了，你明显是被金字塔波击晕的好吧？” 

“嗯…但我们看到了太多怪事，没法不去推敲，”斯隆叹了口气。  

“当然，我会把它记录下来，”西奥昌说。“知道么…特平那里检测到的读数与土卫六大崩溃期间的大气记录一致。” 

“那意味着什么？”斯隆回头看了看那个扭曲的时空。“他…是真实存在的吗？” 

“不知道。我只知道那不是模拟。”

1685051367.name: NPA "Weir-Walker" Robes
1685051367.subtitle: [DAY 92] Take and live.
1685051367.text:
Sloane deftly maneuvered across the open ocean floor. Together with her Ghost, she'd chased the Pyramid's signals across Titan, but arrived too late at each coordinate site. They'd encountered nothing more than further wounds in the fabric of reality; slivered glimpses into moments held in Titan's memory. Occasionally, discarded Shrieker cores littered a site—evidence of a ritual gone cold, but not so cold that Síocháin couldn't detect figments of resonant residue that drove her scanners haywire. 

More than once, Sloane had found a clutch of disoriented Fallen scattered around these wounds, some in a stupor, most driven violently mad. Síocháin said their brain patterns were fractured—synapses burnt into conflicting circuited loops—as if their collection of experiences had been dissected and left disparate and apart.  

But Sloane felt drawn, across the barren seafloor, to each new site shrouded in sunless shadow. Something cut through that Dark. Guided her. As if she drafted behind a rogue wave. 

"We're almost to the next site," Síocháin said. 

"Let's pick it up." The methane flowed over Sloane's armor in a slick, slipstream current that left a long tail of particulate floating in her wake, agitated by oxygen bubbles spurting from her mask. Síocháin followed close behind, sweeping the area with light beams that dissipated over vast, featureless depths. 

"Resonant Pyramid energy, neutrino dispersals, and some kind of… quantum entangling? That's the best I can make of it," Síocháin said, razor blades deployed. "The Pyramid's moving again."  

*** 

The site seemed quiet on the surface. Sloane glanced over a sea cliff and tapped Síocháin, who had been leering out at the expansive of dark ocean as if she was tracking something.  

"You ready?"  

The Ghost turned to Sloane and hesitantly tilted her shell into a nod. 

They killed their lights, allowing the bio-luminescent coral around them to illuminate the path down to a newly split-open gorge infested with Taken corruption. Sloane swapped her visor to a thermal targeting overlay and slipped over the edge of the chasm. Tendrils of Taken malignance flowed from the split ground beneath her, dancing in the methane like noxious filaments. The fissure looked large enough for her to finagle her suit through safely.  

Sloane glanced over her shoulder and held up a hand to Síocháin. "Watch my back… from a distance." 

"Uh, no. I can fight," she bit back defiantly. "Fallen, Hive, and Taken are all over this sector." 

"Lie low on this one. If something goes wrong, it can't go wrong with you. Get me?" 

She landed in a small cavern where a tangle of Taken threads writhed around a decrepit Hive sigil of resilient witchcraft. Whispers spewed from the sigil, wrapped around her mind, coaxed her forward. She reached a hand toward the sigil, and methane burst around her like depth charges as Taken blights manifested a small detachment of soldiers. 

Sloane spun, her fists crackling with lightning—her fingers weaving her Arc Light safely through the methane around her. She charged the first of three blights, thruster-dodging incoming fire pinged by her HUD. She broke through the blight screen, planted her feet, and threw a lightning punch like a gauss cannon, atomizing the Taken and the blight itself. Her power suit carried her fulgurate fists from hostile to hostile in rising, truculent battle-fervor. 

When the cavern quieted, Sloane turned back to the sigil and called Síocháin down. "I can… hear the Taken through this sigil… thing. It's like they're broadcasting out loud. Not in words but… their proximity, like sonar. Can you tap into it?" 

Síocháin's concerned response was muffled by an intrusive thought echoing from somewhere far off, circling the sea around her and draining off into her mind. 

|Take| 

|Live| 

Sloane thought of the ocean shelves crawling with the Pyramid's minions, their rituals and corruption sinking deeper into Titan's mantle by the day. Of the armies they threatened to summon, of what they searched for in the deep. 

She thought of the Fallen who had no way to flee, shocked into madness by the reality-wounding waves that swept over Titan like a grey-matter line. A terminator of experience, via suspension within it. With this foreknowledge of her enemies' plans, maybe she could be a step ahead of dusk. 

|Take| 

 |Live| 

Sloane stepped forward, dazed—her mind drowning in the ocean's dangers—and gripped the sigil. The rippling Taken energy immediately backfired in a blinding burst of energy. 

"No!" Síocháin dove forward in horror as Taken tendrils twisted around Sloane's armor and dragged her to the ground.  

"SLOANE!" 

As tendrils buried themselves into her flesh, Sloane heard a new voice, clear as sirens in a storm. 
 
WARRIOR OF THE SKY.  

YOU ARE KNOWN TO ME.  

I ACCEPT YOUR CHALLENGE.
1685051367.text_zh:
斯隆熟练地在开阔的海底移动。她和机灵一起追踪着金字塔的信号跑遍了土卫六，但每次到达坐标点都太迟了。她们遇到的只不过是现实构造里更深的伤口；土卫六记忆中的稀松片段。废弃的死灵核心会时不时散落在某个地点，这证明仪式逐渐荒废了，但西奥昌还是可以去探测使她扫描仪失控的共振残留幻象。 

斯隆不止一次地发现一群迷失方向的堕落者散落在这些伤口的周围，有些昏迷了，大多数则已经彻底疯狂。西奥昌说他们的大脑模式断裂了——突触烧成相互冲突的回路——就好像他们的经验集合被解剖和分离开来。  

但斯隆觉得自己受到了吸引，穿过贫瘠的海底，来到每一个笼罩在无光阴影下的新地点。有什么东西穿透了黑暗。指引着她。就好像她尾随在一阵巨浪后面。 

“我们快到下一个地点了，”西奥昌说道。 

“我们加快速度吧。”甲烷以光滑的水流划过斯隆的护甲，在她的身后留下一条长长的微粒尾迹，被她面具上喷射出的氧气气泡搅动着。西奥昌紧随其后，用光束扫过这片区域，接着那光便消散在广阔无垠、毫无特色的深处。 

“共振金字塔能量，中微子扩散，还有某种…量子纠缠？我只能这样去理解它，”西奥昌说着，展开了锋利刀刃。“金字塔又在动了。”  

*** 

这个地方表面上似乎很平静。斯隆瞥了一眼海崖，然后拍了拍西奥昌，她一直盯着广阔的黑暗海洋，好像在追踪着什么东西。  

“你准备好了吗？”  

机灵转向斯隆，迟疑地斜着机壳点了点头。 

她们关掉了灯，周围发光的珊瑚照亮通往底下新裂开的峡谷的道路，峡谷里长满了傀儡军团腐菌。斯隆把她的面甲切换成了热瞄准罩，从峡谷边缘滑了下去。恶毒的傀儡卷须从她脚下裂开的地面上流淌出来，像有毒的花丝一样在甲烷中舞动。裂沟看起来很大，足够她穿着动力服安全地穿行。  

斯隆扭头看了看，对西奥昌伸手示意。“掩护我…离远一点。” 

“呃，不。我可以战斗，”她抗拒地回嘴。“这片区域里到处都是堕落者、邪魔族还有傀儡军团。” 

“这次低调点。如果出了什么问题，你可不能出问题。明白吗？” 

她降落在一个小洞穴内，里面有一团缠绕在破旧的邪魔族印记上的傀儡军团丝线，上面施过可复原的巫术。密语声从印记里喷涌而出，环绕着她的思绪，欺哄着她向前走去。她把手伸向印记，甲烷像深水炸弹一样在她周围爆炸，而傀儡凋零阴影则唤出了一小队士兵。 

斯隆急忙转身，拳头上裹着噼啪的闪电——她的手指安稳地在她周围的甲烷中编织着电弧光能。她冲向三个凋零阴影中的第一个，借助推进器躲避她的HUD标示的来袭火力。她突破了凋零阴影屏障，站稳脚跟，像高斯大炮一样掷出闪电一拳，粉碎了傀儡军团以及凋零阴影。她的动力服带着她发光的拳头以高涨而好斗的激情，将敌人一个个击倒。 

洞穴安静下来后，斯隆转过身去对着符文，叫西奥昌下来。“我能…从这个印记…之类的东西里听到傀儡军团的声音。就像他们在大声广播一样。不是言语上的，而是…他们的邻近，就像声纳。你能接入吗？” 

西奥昌关切的回应被一个从远处回响的侵入想法所掩盖，这个想法在她周围的海面上盘旋，并在她的脑海中渐渐流逝。 

|拿走| 

|活下去| 

斯隆想到了爬满海底陆架的金字塔爪牙，他们的仪式和腐化一天天地深入土卫六的地幔。想到了他们威胁要召集的军队，想到了他们在深海中寻找的东西。 

她想到了那个无处可逃的堕落者，金字塔波像灰质线一样席卷土卫六，对他造成了真实的伤害，让其陷入癫狂。他通过悬停终结了这次体验。预知了敌人的计划，也许她就能抢先黄昏一步。 

|拿走| 

 |活下去| 

斯隆茫然地走上前去，她的思绪淹没在海洋的险境之中——然后抓住了那个印记。泛起涟漪的傀儡能量立即产生了反作用，引发了致盲的能量爆发。 

“不！”随着傀儡军团的卷须缠绕斯隆的护甲并将她拖倒在地，西奥昌惊恐地向前扑去。  

“斯隆！” 

卷须扎进斯隆的肉里时，她听到了一个新的声音，清晰得如同风暴中的海妖之歌。 
 
苍穹战士。  

我知道你。  

我接受你的挑战。

2400549110.name: NPA "Weir-Walker" Bond
2400549110.subtitle: [DAY 402] YOU WEAR MY BANNER. —Xivu Arath, Hive God of War
2400549110.subtitle_zh: [第402天]你身披我的旗帜。——邪魔族战神，希乌阿拉斯
2400549110.text:
Sloane knelt, unable to stand. All the weight of Titan's ocean around her was nothing compared to the pressure of Xivu Arath's will pinning her down.  

A horde of gnashing Hive bore lipless smiles around a single Taken Knight. He stood tall before her, brandishing a gleaming blade that anchored an oppressive terrace of sharpened obsidian. The terrace loomed over their heads. A voice cut through the gnashing—eager-toned, like running blood.   

SOLDIER OF THE SKY, YOUR STRENGTH WANES, YOUR STRATEGY TOO OBVIOUS.  

YOU TOOK WITHOUT CLAIM, AND NOW I CLAIM YOU.  

THE SKY, DRAWN TO FALL ONCE MORE, PINNED BY NIGHT'S BLADE.  

SUMMON YOUR MEAGER LIGHT, YOUR SKY TETHER, YOU ARE DEFEATED.  

Xivu's voice rose from her projection, booming from the Black Terrace with laughter like screaming fear.  

YOUR BEARER NEEDS YOU, GHOST.  

BE BRAVE.  

Sloane felt needles of intent thread between the gaps in her armor, hook into her muscles, and slowly peel away the power suit's deep-set rivets from inset bone. A violent unraveling to a slow and painful end.  

Síocháin watched the torture from rocky concealment, razors extended, waiting for an opportunity to strike. Minutes felt like hours, but Sloane clung to life in a cloud of crimson-tinged mist.   

Delirium and agony fogged Sloane's mind, but an offer pierced through the cacophony of War. She heard it in her mind as if she had thought it herself. A broken promise:  

|Bond|  

|Live|  

She considered the offer.  

Síocháin rushed forward, unwilling to watch any longer, and whirled through a swarm of Thrall with her blades. If she could reach Sloane, if she could just cut her free—  

Xivu Arath shrieked with whetted laughter.  

THIS MORSEL IS MINE TO CONSUME.  

Lances of pure onyx thrust through the sea to impale the little Light. The Terrace bulged and surged forward, swelling, as if to burst. For a moment, Síocháin believed Xivu Arath would burst through the Black Terrace herself, wielding a blade in corporeal hand; War's presence emanated with such strength.   

Instead, a gargantuan serpent crashed through the projection and snatched the Knight into its cavernous jaws as it surged by, shattering the Terrace's connection to the Knight. Eruptions of soulfire swallowed the Terrace and branched through the methane as the projection imploded on itself. The serpent dove, its enormous form overtaking and dwarfing the crumbling Terrace projection. It twisted above them, unfurling a portion of its tail to sweep aside scores of Hive with ease and sending plumes of sediment into a thick, obfuscating fog.  

Sloane collapsed, and Síocháin rushed to her side, cutting through an Acolyte before it could raise its shredder. "We need to go! Get up!" Síocháin exclaimed and began stitching Sloane's gushing wounds and mending bones where she could. All around them, the Hive fired wildly into the sea, the soulfire pops of their deaths spurring tiny, muted explosions as it reacted with liquid methane.  

Before Síocháin could get Sloane to her feet, the serpent slammed down in front of them, belly first, and shielded them from retaliatory Hive salvos. Síocháin darted in front of Sloane, razors ready against this giant beast, but the serpent simply looked at the Titan, its massive eye spanning more than three of her, shoulder to shoulder. Once more, Sloane heard the promise in her mind.  

|Bond|  

|Live|  

And so, they struck an accord.
2400549110.text_zh:
斯隆跪了下来，无法起身。她被希乌阿拉斯的意志按在地上，四周土卫六海洋的所有重量都无法与之比拟。 

一大群咬牙切齿的邪魔族围着一名傀儡骑士露出无齿的笑容。他高高站在她面前，挥舞着一把闪闪发光的刀刃，固定着一个由磨利的黑曜岩制成的压迫平台。平台在他们头顶上若隐若现。有个声音划破了他们咬牙切齿的杂响，那口气急切得好似奔腾的血液。 

苍穹战士，你的力量衰落，你的战略太过浅显。 

你没有索求就夺取，而现在我索求你。 

苍穹，再一次坠落，被夜之刀刃压制。 

召唤你微弱的光能，你的苍穹系链，你已被击败了。 

希乌的声音从其投影里传出，自黑色平台上爆发出恐惧尖叫般的笑声。 

你的主人需要你，机灵。 

勇敢一点。 

斯隆在她护甲的缝隙间感觉到恶意丝线的针头钩进她的肌肉，慢慢从嵌入的骨头上剥开动力服深深的铆钉。一种通向缓慢而痛苦之死的剧烈瓦解。 

西奥昌在岩石隐匿处看着这番折磨，伸出刀片，伺机而动。几分钟仿佛几个小时一般漫长，而斯隆在一团猩红薄雾中拼命硬撑了下来。 

狂热和痛苦模糊了斯隆的头脑，但有个声音穿透了战争的嘈杂。她在脑海里听到了这个提议，仿佛是她自己想到的一样。那是一个破碎的承诺： 

|联系| 

|活下去| 

她思忖着这提议。 

西奥昌冲上前，不愿再看下去，挥舞着利刃在一群怨魂中旋转。如果她能去到斯隆的面前，如果她能解救她—— 

希乌阿拉斯尖声大笑起来。 

这一口归我吞噬。 

纯净的缟玛瑙长矛刺穿大海，要钉住那小小的光能。平台隆起，向前涌动，膨胀着，仿佛要爆裂开来。有那么一瞬间，西奥昌以为希乌阿拉斯会亲自冲出黑色平台，用肉体之手挥舞刀刃；战争的存在散发着如此的力量。 

但有一条巨蟒穿过投影，猛冲过时把骑士叼进了它的深渊巨口中，击碎了平台与骑士的连接。灵魂之火的爆发吞噬了平台，在投影内爆之时分叉着穿过甲烷海。巨蟒向下俯冲，它巨大的身躯压在摇摇欲坠的平台投影上，令其相形见绌。它在上方扭曲着，展开一部分尾巴扫开几十个邪魔族，把一缕缕沉沙搅成了模糊厚雾。 

斯隆瘫倒在地，西奥昌冲到她的身边，在一名仆从举起粉碎者之前将其切成两半。“我们得走了！起来！”西奥昌喊道，并开始缝合斯隆喷涌的伤口，尽可能地弥合骨头。在她们四周，邪魔族疯狂地朝海里开火，他们死时迸出的灵魂之火与液态甲烷发生反应，引发着微小而无声的爆炸。 

西奥昌没来得及让斯隆站起来，巨蟒就砰地一声砸在她们面前，腹部朝前，为她们挡住了邪魔族的报复打击。西奥昌冲到斯隆面前，准备用刀片对付这头巨兽，但巨蟒只是看着这名泰坦，它的巨眼比三个她肩并肩排在一起还要大。斯隆又一次在脑海中听到了承诺。 

|联系| 

|活下去| 

于是，她们达成了一致。

1063769568.name: NPA "Weir-Walker" Visor
1063769568.subtitle: [DAY 0] Black skies quell storms as if they were fleeing omens.
1063769568.subtitle_zh: [第0天]黑色的天空平息了风暴，仿佛它们在逃避征兆。
1063769568.text:
Titan's Pyramid dragged hurricanes across the sky like chained gods. 

Deputy Commander Sloane had seen faint lightning flash from deep beneath the Arcology dome—timed prior strikes and their thunder to judge the storm's movement. But as she walked outside to a flash, this time there was no thunder. 

It had taken Sloane most of the morning after the Guardian had left to reach the surface. Waves were overtaking the rig platform, sloshing methane across the battle-marred power suit woven into Sloane's body. 

"Hell…" She straightened her spine within the suit and stared at the Pyramid through her HUD, watching it displace existence around it as it clawed a distorted path through the sky.   

Síocháin zoomed toward her through a blur of flickering neon. "Moving away from us." 

"Shouldn't be moving at all." Sloane turned to her Ghost. "Let's get that perimeter set. The Hive'll come again tonight." 

Before she could move, the Pyramid began shedding Scales from its hull. They hovered for a moment over where they'd detached and peeled away, revealing opalescent flesh. 

Suddenly, the Pyramid emitted a wave that struck Titan, and a half-remembered tone resonated through Sloane's mind. With it, a lifetime: every experienced moment in a slurry of vivid flashes, condensed into simultaneous chaotic anarchy, grasping at grief, joy, anger, love. Seen from where she stood, past experiences gained new perspectives; memories best left dusted with rosy haze shrank under harsh light. Warmth, too fleeting, cold, still, ever frigid in its isolation…  

And something else, sifting through it all, drawing it to order, as if rearranging fractured collagic panes into a new image.  

She struggled to breathe, and her suit flexed against the weight of her years, splayed out across time in violating fashion. Then just as suddenly, they were gone, faded into dreams.  

The sky turned black and orange like a fire-screen, and thunder resonated. 

Sloane's body pitched forward over the platform, sinking through air, then sea. Heavy metal was swallowed whole; consciousness faded into the black. 

Her experience tumbled through sharded eras of reality like an astral projection, even as she felt her feet still firmly planted in the present. A cascade of timeless scenes whirled by, like panes of life captured in glass, in an indefinite stream of consciousness. Scenes of Titan, of a vibrant seascape installation. Too familiar not to be memories. 

Not hers, but no less real. 

Their point of focus left Titan, dragged backwards across the lonely expanse of space to a world she'd never seen.  

Its seas full of vivacious promise. Its moons conceal a Watcher in the sky. Its waves breed insidious appetite in the deep. 

There is a temptation there she craves but does not understand. Unnatural and cursed. 

She fell again, guided. Through a song, a memory, an image of a dream bent into perception like a focusing lens. Unreality coated in familiar skin. An attempt at understanding. 

The Tower. Friends and comrades. Shine and grime, all. A heralded return. A shadow drawn overhead. A battle delayed, returning. 

The Tower, a time yet lived. Black shadows that would fill an empty void in the sky, extending impaling blades down into the streets. Pinning life in paralytic mockeries of contentment. A display that strangles agency. 

A serpent winds a path beneath the shadow and offers to guide.  

She remembered this happening, and that it had not yet happened.
1063769568.text_zh:
土卫六金字塔像被束缚住的神一样将飓风拖拽过天空。 

副指挥官斯隆看着微弱的闪电从生态园区穹顶下的深处闪过，算好之前电击和雷声的间隔来预判风暴的动向。但当她抓住一道闪电的时机走到外面时，这一次却并无雷声。 

守护者离开后，斯隆花了大半个早上才回到地面。海浪淹没了钻井平台，在战痕累累、织入斯隆体内的动力服上晃动着甲烷。 

“见鬼…”她在动力服里挺直脊柱，通过HUD凝视着金字塔，看着它在天空中划出一条扭曲的道路，取代周围的存在。   

西奥昌穿过闪烁的霓虹向她飞来。“远离我们了。” 

“根本不应该移动才对。”斯隆转向她的机灵。“我们设置警戒线吧。邪魔族今晚还会来。” 

她还没来得及行动，金字塔就开始从外壳脱落鳞片。它们在分离剥落的地方盘旋了一会儿，露出了乳白色的血肉。 

突然间，金字塔发出一道波，击中了这名泰坦，一个隐约记得的音调在斯隆的脑海中共鸣着。伴着它，一生的光景，每个经历过的时刻都在生动的闪光中，浓缩成同时发生的混乱无序状态，捕捉着悲欢爱恨。从她所站立的位置看去，过去的经历有了新的视角；本该留在积尘的玫瑰色薄雾里的记忆在刺眼的光线下萎缩。温暖，太过稍纵即逝，寒冷，依然凛冽隔绝…  

还有其他什么东西，穿过所有这一切，使之井然有序，仿佛在把破碎的拼贴窗格重列成一幅新的图像。  

她挣扎着呼吸，动力服在岁月的重压下弯曲着，以违逆的方式在时间上展开着。然后，就和之前猛然出现一样，它们突然不复存在，消失在了梦境中。  

天空变成了黑色和橙色，就像是一道火障，雷声在回响。 

斯隆的身体向前倾过平台，在空中坠下去，然后沉到海里。重金属被整个吞下；意识逐渐消失在黑暗中。 

她的经历像星体投影一样在破碎的现实时代中翻滚着，尽管她觉得自己的脚仍然牢牢地扎根在当下。一连串永恒的场景在不确定的意识流中旋转而过，仿如玻璃中捕捉到的生命窗格。土卫六的场景，醒目的海景设施。太过熟悉了，不可能不是记忆。 

不是她的记忆，但同样真实。 

它们的焦点离开土卫六，被拖着向后穿过孤独的广阔空间，来到一个她从未见过的世界。  

海洋充满了生机勃勃的应许。卫星隐匿着一名天空中的观察者。波浪在深海中孕育着阴险欲望。 

那里有一种她渴望但又不明白的诱惑。非自然且受到了诅咒。 

她再次跌倒，被引导。经过一首歌，一段记忆，一个梦境的图像，像聚焦的镜头一样被弯曲成感知。披着熟悉外衣的虚幻。一种理解的尝试。 

高塔。朋友和同志们。阳光和污垢，所有的一切。一次有预兆的回归。一个头顶上的影子。一场重返的延后之战。 

高塔，尚未经历过的时代。黑色的阴影将会填满天空的空洞，将刺痛的刀片延伸到了街道上。把生活置于对满足的麻痹嘲弄之中。令人窒息的展示。 

一条巨蟒在阴影下蜿蜒前行，提出要给予指引。  

她记得这件事的发生，也记得它还没有发生。

2797536515.name: NPA "Weir-Walker" Pants
2797536515.subtitle: [DAY 287] A rising pressure, signaling imminent danger.
2797536515.subtitle_zh: [第287天]压力上升，预示着危险迫在眉睫。
2797536515.text:
"There's nothing to hide behind!" Sloane laughed sardonically over comms, annoyance building in her voice. She made a point of spinning in the empty, expansive ocean, exoskeleton-encased arms out wide, before turning to her Ghost. They'd been walking through desolate nothingness for days, tracking the next site. "We need to keep hitting them." 

"It's been over a year of chasing Pyramid waves, of the blight. You're getting worse." Síocháin's shell cut like fins through the methane, "And there IS something out there. It's been trailing us, or ahead of us…" 

"I know. It's something old." Sloane's voice was flat. "I told you; I think it's been talking to me. Or… more like thinking at me." Silence hung over them for a moment before being swept away by the current. 

"Oh… is it now? Care to share more about that?" the Ghost asked with restrained frustration. 

"Whatever's out there… I think it's guiding us. Or trying to see if it can trust us. If we're… compatible?" 

"Oh, that's good and vague," Síocháin hissed. "You're sure that's what it wants? Because we have a HIVE GOD chasing us. We don't have the luxury of guessing wrong." 

"It's just a feeling—not really my thing—but my gut tells me it's well-intentioned. Xivu Arath, on the other hand—" 

Síocháin dropped onto the seafloor sand. "THAT'S what we've been following? Your gut? You think you can charge into fight after fight on a 'feeling' and keep walking away?"   

"Isn't that the idea? I'm effectively immortal." Sloane stopped, turned, and shook her head. "The suit's wearing. Rations are… look, we need to finish the mission while I'm still in fighting condition." 

"Titan's gone, Sloane." Síocháin rose and drifted past her. "What happens if you die somewhere too dark to drag you back? Have you considered that?" 

"This coming from the gung-ho Ghost, taking on the whole Hive army with a set of shaving razors." Sloane chuckled to herself. "Seriously, are you expecting to live through… whatever this is?" 

"No," Síocháin said meekly. "I hoped you would." 

The firm lines of Sloane's expression crumbled for an instant. 

This was unlike them. 

She shut her visor, cleared her throat, and turned to continue marching. "No more fighting, for you. That's an order." 

"But that's—I was saying that to you!" The Ghost zipped forward. "Hey! Don't walk away from me!" 

Sloane stopped. The heavy metal around her boots sank into the silty sea floor. "I'm not—there's NOWHERE to walk away TO! That's MY point!" Sloane jabbed a finger at her Ghost.  

"I'm not starving to death for an eternity just to turn out like the psycho that runs Gambit… if I even make it that far. But you don't have to worry about that. Let me be useful while I can. Then move on when it's over." 

Síocháin whirred in thought for a moment. "I don't want to make it without you." 

"We don't get to choose that." Sloane straightened her stance. "If you can't take it when it hits you, you go out and hit it before it gets started." Sloane raised her visor and met Síocháin's stare. "That's the best plan I have while I'm still walking. You have a better one?" 

"…No." 

"Then let's get to work."
2797536515.text_zh:
“无处可躲！”斯隆在通讯里讥讽地笑着，声音越来越不耐烦。在转向她的机灵之前，她有意在空旷而广阔的海洋中旋转着，外骨骼包裹的手臂伸展开来。她们已经在荒凉的虚无中走了几天，追踪着下一个地点。“我们要继续抗击他们。” 

“我们已经花了一年多的时间追逐金字塔波和凋零阴影。你的情况越来越糟了。”西奥昌的外壳像鱼鳍一样穿过甲烷，“而且确实有东西一直跟在我们后面，或者说是我们前面…” 

“我知道。那是个古老的东西。”斯隆的声音很平淡。“我告诉过你；我觉得它一直在跟我说话。或者说…更像是在对我思考。”沉默笼罩了她们一会儿，然后被水流席卷而走。 

“哦…是吗？能多分享一点吗？”机灵带着克制的沮丧问道。 

“不管那是什么…我觉得它在指引我们。或是在试图弄清你我是否值得信任。它和我是否…兼容？” 

“哦，很好，就是有点模糊，”西奥昌发出嘶嘶声。“你确定这是它想要的吗？因为有个邪魔族之神在追捕我们。我们要是猜错了就全完了。” 

“这只是一种感觉…我不擅长这方面…但我的直觉告诉我，它是友善的。而希乌阿拉斯嘛——” 

西奥昌落在海底的沙子上。“这就是我们一直在跟随的东西？你的直觉？你以为你能凭着一种‘感觉'接连冲进战斗，每次都全身而退吗？”   

“那难道不对吗？我又不会死。”斯隆停下来，转过身，摇了摇头。“动力服磨损了。储粮…听着，我们必须趁我还能战斗的时候完成任务。” 

“土卫六没了，斯隆。”西奥昌升起来，从她身边飘过。“如果你死在太黑暗的地方，我没法把你救回来怎么办？你想过吗？” 

“这句话居然会是出自一个用刀片对付整支邪魔族军队的狂热机灵之口。”斯隆暗自笑道。“说真的，不管这是什么…你觉得能挺过去吗？” 

“不，”西奥昌温顺地说道。“我希望你能。” 

斯隆坚定的表情瞬间消失了。 

这不像她们的风格。 

她合上面甲，清了清喉咙，转身继续行进。“不准你再战斗。这是命令。” 

“可是——那是我跟你说的话！”机灵疾驰向前。“嘿！别甩下我走开！” 

斯隆停了下来。战靴周围的重金属沉入了淤泥质的海底。“我没有——根本无处可去！这才是我要说的！”斯隆用手指戳了戳她的机灵。  

“我不想永远饿着肚子，变成掌管智谋的那个疯子那样…如果我能走到那一步的话。但你不用担心。让我在有能力的时候发挥作用吧。等一切都结束了，再继续前进。” 

西奥昌嗡嗡地沉思了一会儿。“我不想独自挺过去。” 

“这可由不得我们选择。”斯隆挺直了身子。“如果你不能在打击来临时承受它，你就在它出手之前打击它。”斯隆抬起面甲，迎着西奥昌的注视。“这是我还走得动时的最好计划了。你有更好的吗？” 

“…没有。” 

“那就开始这么干吧。”

587762963.name: Gloves of the Taken King
587762963.subtitle: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
587762963.subtitle_zh: “我的伟业便是死亡，并活在那死亡之中。”
587762963.text:
A compact submersible of Eliksni design finishes its descent through the hazy depths of Titan's methane ocean. The craft's seafloor landing kicks up a cloud of dark silt and microbial life shimmering like stars. The submersible's dorsal airlock cracks open with a rush of bubbles, then slowly folds down into a ramp, allowing a trio of figures armored in deep diving gear to emerge. The submersible's single floodlight sweeps across the ocean floor, revealing the alien landscape of twisting coral. 

Fenchurch approaches one of the coral growths, running a gloved hand over its surface. "These polyps…" he mutters. "Is this—" He stops suddenly at the sound of a mechanical snap, and turns to see Chalco and Lisbon-13 plant a large, mechanical spire in the ground. Internal lights flicker on as the spire whirrs to life, creating a regulated field of water pressure around the submersible. 

Fenchurch steps away from the coral, rubbing his fingers together. He looks to the spire as its sides open like a flower and release several drones, each outfitted with floodlights. The drones swim out ahead, revealing the disorienting flicker of what looks like the water's surface but at an impossibly vertical angle. 

"This way," Chalco directs as she turns to follow the drones. Fenchurch and Lisbon look at one another, steady themselves, and fall in line behind their fireteam leader. 

"Stop me if you've heard this one before," Fenchurch says, anxiously checking the talisman clipped to his armor. "Two Hunters and a Warlock walk into the deep…"
587762963.text_zh:
在土卫六甲烷海的模糊深度，一艘埃里克斯尼族设计的小型潜水器完成了下潜。潜水器在海底着陆时掀起一片黑色淤沙云，微生物生命像群星一样闪闪发光。潜水器的背部气闸随着气泡的喷涌而打开，然后慢慢折叠成一个斜坡，让穿着深潜装备的三个身影走了出来。潜水器唯一的泛光灯扫过海底，展现出缠绕珊瑚的奇异景观。 

芬丘奇走近其中一处珊瑚生长物，用戴着手套的手抚摸着它的表面。“这些珊瑚虫…”他嘟囔道。“这是——”他突然在一声机械咔嚓声中停了下来，转身看到卡尔科和里斯本-13在地上放置了一个巨大的机械尖塔。随着尖塔的旋转，内部的灯光闪烁着，在潜水器周围形成了一个受控的水压场。 

芬丘奇离开珊瑚，搓着手指。他看着尖塔，它的两侧像花瓣一样打开，几架无人机被放了出来，每架无人机都配备了泛光灯。无人机游到前方，闪着令人迷惑的光芒，看起来像是在水面，但角度却异常垂直。 

“这边，”卡尔科一边指挥，一边转身跟随无人机。芬丘奇和里斯本面面相觑，稳定了一下情绪，在火力战队队长身后排成队形。 

“要是你们之前听过这个就叫停我，”芬丘奇说着，焦急地检查着固定在他护甲上的护身符。“两个猎人和一个术士走进深渊…”

457617725.name: Vestment of the Taken King
457617725.subtitle: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."
457617725.subtitle_zh: “我死过许多次，但那些死都只是暂时的。”
457617725.text:
Chalco Yong disappears behind the shimmering curtain of surface tension. Lisbon-13 follows without hesitation, leaving Fenchurch to stare at the vertigo-inducing, vertical plane of water. He reaches out, hesitantly touching the surface, only for Lisbon to reach back, grab him by the wrist, and yank him through. 

"Everis," Lisbon mutters once he pulls Fenchurch to the other side. The Warlock doesn't even realize he's hyperventilating. "Get it together." He gives Fenchurch a warning look, then nods at Chalco walking ahead across the maddeningly dry ground.  

It takes Fenchurch a moment to realize that he is not underwater anymore. Liquid methane drips off his suit and turns to ice when it hits the compacted silt. The cavernous space is suffocatingly dark. It will be hours yet before the sun rises on this section of Titan, yet the lambent shades of starlight twinkling in the void beyond fill Fenchurch with a lurching sense of dread. 

He wants to ask, 'Where are we?,' but the words fail to get past his lips. Instead, Fenchurch gathers himself and joins Chalco at her side. 

Chalco raises her hand, and three drones come to heel behind her. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to visit this site." She sends the drones up into the air with a wave. "What you are about to see is not to be discussed outside of official reports." 

Fenchurch takes a step forward, squinting against the dark, until the drones sweep the terrain with their floodlights. Then, as the alien landscape comes into sharp focus, one word finally escapes his lips: 

"Oryx."
457617725.text_zh:
卡尔科·杨消失在表面闪闪发光的帘幕后面。里斯本-13毫不犹豫地跟着，留下芬丘奇盯着让人晕眩的垂直水面。他伸出手，犹豫地触碰表面，不料里斯本回头伸出手，抓住他的手腕，把他拽了过去。 

“艾夫瑞斯，”里斯本在把芬丘奇拉到另一边时喃喃地说道。这位术士甚至没意识到他换气过度了。“振作起来。”他告诫地看了芬丘奇一眼，然后朝正走在干燥地面上的卡尔科点点头。  

芬丘奇过了一会儿才意识到他已经不在水下了。液态甲烷从他的潜水服上滴下来，一碰到夯实的淤沙就化作了冰。空洞的空间黑得令人窒息。距离太阳在土卫六的这片区域升起还有几个小时，远处虚空中摇曳的点点星光却让芬丘奇充满了一种突如其来的恐惧感。 

他想要问，‘我们在哪儿？'，但话没能说出口。相反，芬丘奇平静下来，站到了卡尔科身旁。 

卡尔科举起手，三架无人机转而跟在她身后。“我们是现存唯一造访这个地点的隐秘者小队。”她挥手让无人机飞向空中。“你们即将看到的东西，不能在官方报告以外的地方进行讨论。” 

芬丘奇向前走了一步，在黑暗中眯着眼睛，直到无人机用泛光灯扫视着地形。然后，随着怪异的景观逐渐清晰起来，他的嘴里终于吐出了一个词： 

“欧里克斯。”

1961182320.name: Bond of the Taken King
1961182320.subtitle: "If I fail, let me be worm food."
1961182320.subtitle_zh: “如果我失败了，就让我成为蠕虫的养料吧。”

针对样本与受试者WQS-030遗体的对比分析不匹配。WQS-030不存在有丝分裂迹象。可能是蠕虫分离和光能暴露的复合效应。 

尸检显示TKO-300的遗骸中不存在蠕虫尸体。状态未知。 

长期接触TKO-300会因暴露在傀儡军团和暗影能量中而导致强烈的视听幻觉。ERI-223与目标对象COS-030存在相仿性。 

来自最初接触现场的守护者火力战队的编目回忆表明WGX-003频繁造访遗骸进行哀悼。TKO-300能够吸收知识和事件，但无法对其做出反应。  

我的专业建议是，销毁TKO-300的残骸。它对人类安全的威胁远远超过其潜在的知识价值。

540625098.name: Hood of the Taken King
540625098.subtitle: "What will happen if I die?"
540625098.text:
"Keep this talisman on you at all times." 

Black, glossy, and in the right light, the talisman has a rainbow iridescence. It reminds Fenchurch of hematite pearls from the Bay of Drowned Wishes. He rolls it in his hand, looking up at Chalco to see the creases of worry in her brow. 

Fenchurch clips the talisman to his jacket as the rest of his fireteam has. "What's it do?" 

"If it glows white, stay where you are and call out," Chalco explains, choosing her words carefully all while avoiding Fenchurch's gaze. "If you experience any memory loss or sense of déjà vu, call out." A silence falls over her fireteam. Palpable tension fills the cabin as they feel the craft begin to descend. 

"If you see anyone at the operation site that you do not recognize, call out." Chalco continues, occasionally steadying herself with a hand on the cabin ceiling as the submersible pitches and yaws in the disruptive currents. "If you experience any out-of-body sensations or missing time, call out." 

"Ma'am?" Lisbon-13 is not afraid to interrupt Chalco. His eyes glow bright from the back of the submersible. "Where are we going?" 

Chalco stares for a moment, squares her shoulders, and continues. "If you hear a voice that you think is your own…"
540625098.text_zh:
“把这个护身符一直带在身上。” 

护身符是黑色带有光泽的，而在适当的光线下，会呈现出斑斓的彩虹色。这让芬丘奇想起了溺亡之愿海湾的赤铁矿珍珠。他把它卷起放在手里，抬头望向卡尔科，看到她眉头紧锁。 

芬丘奇和其他火力战队队员一样，把护身符固定在了他的夹克上。“它是干什么用的？” 

“要是它发出白光，就呆在原地，大声呼救，”卡尔科解释道，她一边小心地说着，一遍避开了芬丘奇的目光。“如果你出现任何记忆丧失或既视感，就大声呼救。”她的火力战队陷入一片沉默。当他们感知到潜水器开始下潜时，明显有一种紧张感充满了机舱。 

“如果你在操作现场看到不认识的人，就大声呼救。”卡尔科继续说道，她偶尔会在潜水器遇到扰乱水流发生倾斜和偏航时，把手放在船舱天花板上稳住身体。“如果你遇到任何体外感知或迷失的情况，就大声呼救。” 

“女士？”里斯本-13插嘴打断了卡尔科。他的双眼从潜水器后部发出明亮的光。“我们要去哪里？” 

卡尔科凝视了一会儿，挺起肩膀，继续说道。“如果你听到了一种声音，以为是自己发出来的…”

322717029.name: Boots of the Taken King
322717029.subtitle: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."
322717029.subtitle_zh: “如果我在王座上被击败，那我便会死去。我的伟业将终结。”
322717029.text:
What appeared to be a silhouette of coral growths in the dark is revealed to be the mountainous remains of Oryx, the Taken King. The Hive god's immense carcass lays strewn across Titan's seafloor. Both Lisbon-13 and Fenchurch are taken aback by the sight, but Chalco advances toward it. 

"The Lucent Brood performed a ritual here." Chalco motions to the shattered remnants of a Hive Ghost on the ground. "We believe they were trying to forcibly resurrect Oryx by combining heretical Hive necromancy with the powers of that Ghost. They were disrupted." 

Lisbon steps forward, unable to look away from Oryx's cadaverous face. "Is that possible?" 

"Officially: no. Unofficially…" Chalco glances at Lisbon. "That's what we're here to investigate. The body is still… active. With Taken energy and Darkness. The Guardians who intercepted this ritual reported finding free-floating fragments of consciousness on the way to this site. Memories from the corpse." 

"It's alive?" Fenchurch whispers, hesitant to approach Oryx's remains.  

Chalco shakes her head. "That's unclear. We need to bring back samples for further analysis. Ikora wants this entire site quarantined and the body exhumed, pending transport to a secure location for further analysis." 

Fenchurch checks his talisman. Still black. He glances between Chalco and the corpse. "Are we the first team to come down here?" 

Chalco looks at Fenchurch, then down to the ground. Her gaze lingers there for a moment in tense silence. Finally, she fixes her gaze ahead to the corpse. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to have visited this site."
322717029.text_zh:
黑暗中形似珊瑚生长物的轮廓，原来是邪神欧里克斯的高大遗骸。邪魔族之神巨大的尸体散落在土卫六的海底。里斯本13号和芬丘奇都对眼前的景象大吃一惊，卡尔科却朝着它径直走去。 

“光明虫群在这里举行了一场仪式。”卡尔科向地面上散落的邪魔族机灵残骸示意。“我们认为，他们原本试图通过将异端邪魔族巫术与那个机灵的力量结合起来，强行复活欧里克斯。但他们被打断了。” 

里斯本走上前去，无法将视线从欧里克斯苍白的脸上移开。“那可能吗？” 

“正常情况下不可能。不过…”卡尔科瞥了一眼里斯本。“我们就是来调查这个的。尸体…还在，带有傀儡能量和暗影。打断这场仪式的守护者报告说，他们在来这里的路上发现了自由漂浮的意识碎片。那是来自尸体的记忆。” 

“它还活着？”芬丘奇低声道，犹豫着要不要靠近欧里克斯的遗骸。  

卡尔科摇摇头。“还不清楚。我们需要带样本回去做进一步分析。艾可拉希望对整个现场进行隔离，把尸体掘出来，等待运送到安全地点进行进一步分析。” 

芬丘奇查了查他的护身符。它还是黑色的。他的视线在卡尔科和尸体之间来回跳动。“我们是第一支下到这里来的队伍吗？” 

卡尔科望着芬丘奇，然后看向地面。她的目光在紧张的沉默中停滞了一会。最后，她将目光投向前方的尸体。“我们是现存唯一造访过这个地点的隐秘者小队。”

2374129871.name: Cenotaph Mask
2374129871.subtitle: You carry the names of the dead.
2374129871.text:

3561203890.name: Tessellation
3561203890.subtitle: The monolith is hewn; the monument is built.
3561203890.subtitle_zh: 巨石就此凿开；纪念碑随即建成。
3561203890.text:
Once, nothing became something.

There was a game of possibilities. Patterns emerged that could—would—flourish or fail, wax or wane. And in the gaps between, there was nothing.
 
But nothing is an absence, defined by all the things that might one day be and yet never find fruition. It is an entropy of existence. For nothing to become something is as simple as a flipped bit, a chance mutation, a fallen leaf. Once it has become, it has always become, for castles are less fragile when built by something than nothing.

Something grows; and grown, it is seen.

Once, something became something else.

There were a people of potential and promise, of galvanizing growth. By their tools, their grand intention, the happenstance alignment of infinite years and atoms were as sculptor's clay, that which becomes the finest of statuary. Purpose carved from meaninglessness; the chance generation of the universe crafted into beauty, intentionality. That which served no reason ceased, randomness elided by the sculptor's art.

Something changes; and changed, it continues.

Once, something will become nothing.

There are beings who plant their intention and say, so far, no further. The bulwarks and the bastions, the stubborn flower that will defy even stone. In these hands, possibility is a single-minded tool. Resolution, pursuit, obliteration. What potential lies in empty space?

All that dies is only ever transformed, abscised and swallowed by wilderness, returned to infinite metamorphosis. To excise from that rich loam of transformation requires no less than perfect certainty.
 
Here is the secret: a ploughshare and a sword have never truly differed.
3561203890.text_zh:
曾经，“无”化为了“有”。

过去有一种概率游戏。出现的图案可能会决定某件事的成败。而在其间的空隙里，什么都没有，即“无”。
 
但“无”是种缺失，它的定义是可能有天会出现但却永远不会出现的所有东西。它是一种存在的熵。化“无”为“有”，就像一次位翻转、一次偶然的突变、一片落叶一样简单。一旦出现，它便会一直存在，因为“有”所筑成的堡垒比由“无”更牢固。

这个“有”会成长；长成后即会被看见。

曾经，“有”发生了变化。

他们曾是一个具有潜力和希望的民族，一个不断成长的民族。通过他们的工具和宏图伟业，还有无限的岁月和原子的偶然排列，他们就像雕塑家手中的泥土，被塑造成了最精美的雕像。存在目的是从无意义中雕刻出来的；宇宙的偶然生成之物被加工成了刻意的美。那些没有理由的东西消失了，随机性被雕塑家的艺术所掩盖。

“有”改变了；改变之后的它，继续存在着。

曾经，“有”归于“无”。

有生命种下了他们的意图，并说，到此为止。他们是坚固的壁垒，是能在坚石上生根的顽强花朵。在这些生命手中，可能性是一种单一的工具。决断、追求、抹去。空旷之处会蕴含着什么潜力？

所有死亡的东西都只是被转化、切除并被荒野所吞噬，回到了无限的蜕变中。而要从那片蜕变的沃土中离开，需要的正是完美的确定性。
 
告诉你一个秘密：犁铧与刀剑其实并没有不同。

1034055198.name: Necrochasm
1034055198.subtitle: Is your Light bright enough to stand in full gaze of the Hive's abyss?
1034055198.subtitle_zh: 你的光能是否足以承受邪魔族深渊的凝视？
1034055198.text:
Arise for Crota, Son of Oryx, the Hope-Eater! 

He who has seized the Sky lair above Ceres, 
which peers into other planes, 
now vassal to the might of the Worldbreaker! 

Within these keyholes  
our brood communes with unheard voices. 
They who whisper that the 
curse of our Thralls 
is a blessing granted by the Deep. 

Now, in honor of the God-Knight,  
we fashion these gluttonous whispers into death. 
His Hellmouth becomes home to the profane: 
the corpse of the Sky, reborn in the abyss. 

— Enkaar, the Anointed
1034055198.text_zh:
为了欧里克斯之子和希望吞噬者克洛塔而崛起吧！ 

他曾夺取谷神星上的苍穹巢穴， 
它窥视其他位面， 
如今依附于世界破坏者的力量！ 

在这些锁眼中，  
我们的虫群与从未听过的声音交流。 
它们低声地说， 
我们怨魂的诅咒 
是深渊赐予的祝福。 

现在，为了向神骑士致敬，  
我们将这些贪婪低语变为死亡。 
其地狱深渊成了亵渎之家： 
苍穹之尸，自深渊中重生。 

——被指定的恩卡尔

3821409356.name: Ex Diris
3821409356.subtitle: "I have heralded disaster so often that my mere presence is an omen. So be it." —Eris Morn
3821409356.subtitle_zh: “我经常预示着灾难，以至于我的出现就是一种噩兆。那就这样吧。”——埃里斯·摩恩
3821409356.text:
The cards gleamed in Eris Morn's hands, each one a taut web of meanings pinned down in place so that its signifier, in all its instability, could be held and comprehended.

She lay the first card on the table. Blades. Of course, she thought. The Hive's childish logic. But, like all childish things, it was persistent. They were all ensnared in its thesis. For now, it was their purpose as much as the Hive's.

The second card over the first. The Adherent. Xivu Arath. The greatest and most committed proponent of her brother's grand theory. Xivu Arath guarded the Blades card with her life. It held her with all the great lies she told herself.

Eris placed the third card below the others. The Sisters. Aurash, Sathona, Xi Ro. The Hive Gods' first names and first selves.

But the fourth card made her hesitate. She looked at it, and it stared back. The Harbinger. It could be no one but herself. She placed it to the left of the others. Perhaps now she counted among those sisters. Savathûn, Xivu Arath, and Eris Morn. A game between siblings. A love that sharpens.

Another card to the right of the first two. The Lie. Eris furrowed her brow. The cards had manifested through Hive magic; perhaps it denoted how the Hive see the Guardians. Liars denying the all-edged truth of the sword logic. Or was it the lie of that logic itself? The lie of the Deep, the lie of worms?

Three cards above the rest, one beside the other. Liminal. Ascension. Lacuna. All the aspects of a Guardian's Light. She had not held it for centuries. The Hive sisters below beckoned more loudly than the Light did.

Eris made a column of the remaining cards. At the bottom, The Witch. Above that, The Truth. Then Lament. Then The Wish.

Who was the Witch? Savathûn, or herself? The thought gave her pause. From whom did the Truth flow? There were too many truths for any one to triumph. But Lament, she knew: the slaying of Oryx, Xivu Arath's greatest loss.

Would the truth lead to another Hive sibling's death?

Eris looked to the last card. The Wish puzzled her. A wish is desire, the greatest power in this universe. Eris had wished before. It had led her here. Would she be asked to wish again? What else would her desire wrought?

Turning away, Eris left the cards on the table and took her questions with her.
3821409356.text_zh:
卡牌在埃里斯·摩恩的手中闪闪发光，每张都是一个绷紧的意义之网，固定到位使其所指的不稳定性可以被掌握和理解。

埃里斯把第一张卡牌放在桌上。利刃。不出所料，她想。邪魔族幼稚的守则。但正如其他幼稚的东西，它会一直续存下去。他们都身陷于其理论。现在，这不仅是邪魔族的使命，也是他们的使命。

第二张卡牌盖过第一张。拥护者。希乌阿拉斯。她是她兄弟伟大理论最强大和最坚定的拥趸。希乌阿拉斯用她的生命守护着利刃卡牌。它用她对自己说的所有弥天大谎控制她。

埃里斯把第三张卡牌放在其他几张卡牌的下面。姐妹。奥拉什、萨托娜、希罗。邪魔族众神的本名与本我。

但第四张卡牌让她犹豫了。她看着它，它也盯着她。先知。那只能是她自己。她把它放在其他卡牌的左侧。也许现在她也算是那些姐妹中的一员了。萨瓦图恩、希乌阿拉斯，还有埃里斯·摩恩。一场同胞间的游戏。一场磨砺的爱恋。

前两张卡牌右边的另一张卡牌。谎言。埃里斯皱起眉头。这些卡牌是由邪魔族的魔法生成的；也许这就是邪魔族看待守护者的方式。否认邪剑守则剑刃真相的说谎者。还是说，守则本身才是谎言？深渊的谎言，蠕虫的谎言？

有三张卡牌在其他卡牌的上面，一张挨着一张。阈限、飞升、缺漏。守护者光能的所有星相。她已经好几个世纪没有持有它了。底下的邪魔族姐妹召唤的声音比光能更加响亮。

埃里斯把剩下的卡牌排成一列。最下面的是女巫。在那之上，是真相。然后是挽歌。接着是心愿。

女巫指的是谁？萨瓦图恩，还是她自己？这个想法让她迟疑了。真相来自于谁？真相太多，以至于任何人都无法知晓所有。不过她知道挽歌是什么：欧里克斯的死。希乌阿拉斯最大的丧失。

真相会使邪魔族兄弟姐妹中又出现一名死者吗？

埃里斯看向最后一张卡牌。“心愿”使她困惑。心愿是欲望，是这个宇宙中最伟大的力量。埃里斯曾经许过愿。它把她带到了这里。她会被要求再许一个愿吗？她的愿望还会带来什么？

埃里斯把卡牌留在桌子上，带着疑问转身离开了。

3337727085.name: Malediction
3337727085.subtitle: The price of power.
3337727085.text:
"I understand that getting through the portal is important—" Crow began. 

"It's more than important," Osiris interrupted. "It's our best chance to prevent the final shape, however the Witness conceives of it. Beyond that, it's a chance to study paracausality at a level we've never had access to before." 

"I get it, I get it," Crow interjected.  

The Hunter was overseeing the unloading of Spider's ship in the Eliksni Quarter. House of Light workers ferried crates into warehouses on ingenious Eliksni-made trollies. Normally, such a task would be outside of Crow's purview, but Spider couldn't be trusted to stick to his manifests, so here he was. Osiris stood back and watched the bustle with detachment. 

"I've heard all the reasons," Crow continued. "And they all make sense. It's just…" He paused, trying to find a delicate way of broaching the subject. 

"Savathûn," Osiris provided, his voice tinged with foreboding.  

"Yeah," Crow replied. He shook his head in dismay. "We worked so hard to put her away. And after everything we went through—what YOU went through—we're just going to… bring her back?"  

Under his mask, Osiris's lips pressed into a thin, tense line. In truth, the situation pained him greatly, but he would not allow his gnawing doubt to infect the young Hunter.  

When he spoke, his voice came out as smooth and measured as always. "Guardians sacrifice more than their lives in defense of humanity. More than their friends. Or their Ghosts."  

"We sacrifice our peace of mind. In many ways, it's our greatest loss," Osiris said, imagining Saint's concern. "But it's the price we pay for the knowledge we bear. For the power we wield." 

"I know," Crow sighed, recalling Amanda's empty spot in the Hangar. "I know."
3337727085.text_zh:
“我知道通过传送门很重要——”乌鸦开口说。 

“不止是重要，”奥斯里斯打断道。“不管见证者如何构想终焉之形，这是我们阻止它的最好机会。其次，这也是我们难得能深度研究超因果的机会。” 

“我懂的，我懂的，”乌鸦插嘴道。  

这名猎人正在埃里克斯尼居住区监督蛛王的飞船卸货。光能氏族的工人们会用埃里克斯尼族制造的精巧手推车将板条箱运送到仓库。通常这样的任务不属于乌鸦的职责范围，但蛛王可能会对载货清单动些手脚，所以他来了。奥斯里斯站在后面冷眼旁观着这片喧闹。 

“我听过各种理由，”乌鸦继续说。“它们都说得通。只是…”他停顿了一下，试图找到一种巧妙的方式来谈论这话题。 

“萨瓦图恩，”奥斯里斯接上了他的话，声音中带着不祥的预感。  

“是的，”乌鸦答道。他沮丧地摇摇头。“我们好不容易才除掉她。但在我们经历了那些事…在你经历了那些事之后…我们还要再复活她？”  

在他的面具之下，奥斯里斯的嘴唇抿成了一条紧绷的细线。事实上，这种情况让他非常痛苦，但他不会容许自己的疑虑影响到这位年轻的猎人。  

他开口说话时，声音像往常一样流畅而慎重。“守护者为捍卫人类而牺牲的不仅仅是生命。不仅仅是朋友。或是机灵。”  

“我们牺牲了内心的安宁。从许多方面来讲，这都是我们最大的损失。”奥斯里斯说道，想象着圣人的担忧。“但为了我们获得知识、掌握力量，这是必须付出的代价。” 

“我知道，”乌鸦叹了口气，回想起阿曼达在机库里留下的空位。“我知道。”

3347946548.name: The Eremite
3347946548.subtitle: Retreat to the mind.
3347946548.text:
My Queen,

Undoubtedly you have read the reports. I make no apology for the ritual I have performed, or what I become when under its effects. You too have done many things in your own life that revealed who you are.

The Guardians see me unrestrained. I do not control my emotions when I enter the oubliette and embrace my transformation. I warned you of this many years ago, when I was afraid of what I might do. But I am no longer afraid. The time for warnings has passed. We have the knowledge we need.

Long ago I warned you of the threat Oryx posed and the imminence of his arrival. I spoke of his sword logic and his throne world, of his insatiable worm and the power of his Dreadnaught.

With this insight, you did something marvelous. Your throne world, your Eleusinia, is a testament to your will, to your Techeuns' skills, and to Riven's delight. Sadly, its desecration is, to our knowledge, irreparable. I am certain it was once beautiful.

But I believe it was also the sole exception in a process of creation that is uniquely Hive. If only the slaying of a powerful being was required, then every Guardian would be reveling in their own creation.

Recall that it was only with Hive magic that the Scorned Baron Hiraks—the Mindbender, as he wished to be styled—created a throne through Cayde-6's murder. So, too, did Crota affect his own throne in the same way.

Of course, Oryx and Savathûn's thrones are well-known to us. A worm-husk of bone; a lush garden of Light. Others have seen brief and terrible glimpses of Xivu Arath's throne. It gapes like a maw, following her wherever there is war.

Theirs were inadvertent. Upon their first true deaths, they did not know what they had made. With their strength and the power of their worms, they created something dire, and found themselves there upon their deaths. Imagine the Hive gods' first glimpses of their realms. To retreat to one's throne is to retreat into the variances of one's mind. It is a stark confrontation.

You were well prepared for yours. Such was the consequence of my warning. I could well imagine my surprise at the variances of my own, as my own emotions surprise me now. But Imagining must be enough for me.

Eris Morn
3347946548.text_zh:
我的女王，

你一定已经看过报告了。我进行了仪式，而且受其影响我发生了很大的转变，但我对此并不感到抱歉。你在人生中也做过很多事，让你明白自己是谁。

守护者们认为我无法控制。我进入地下密牢接受转化时，我不会控制自己的情绪。多年前我就警告过你此事，那时我害怕自己会做出什么事来。但我不再害怕了。警报已经解除，我们所需要的已经知晓。

很久之前，我曾警告过你，欧里克斯会造成很大威胁，而且他即将到来。我提到他的邪剑守则、王座世界，还有他那贪得无厌的蠕虫以及无畏战舰的力量。

知道了这些，你建立了千秋伟业。你的王座世界，你的厄琉息斯，就是你的意志、灵巫技能和魅痕的证明。可悲的是，据我们所知，它遭到了可无法挽回的亵渎。它曾经一定很美丽吧。

但我相信除它以外，这种创造过程是邪魔族独有的。如果所需要的只是杀死一个强大的生物，那么每个守护者都会陶醉在自己的造物之中。

回想一下，只有依靠邪魔族魔法，嗤魅公爵赫拉克斯——他更希望被称为心灵操纵者——才通过谋杀凯德6号创造了一个王座。克洛塔也是如此去影响他自己的王座的。

当然，欧里克斯和萨瓦图恩的王座，我们都很了解。骨质的蠕虫外壳，繁茂的光能花园。其他人则短暂地瞥见了希乌阿拉斯的可怕王座。它张开血盆大口，哪里有战争，它就跟随她前去。

他们在无意中建造了王座。当他们初尝死亡时，并不知道自己造了什么。他们用自己和蠕虫的力量创造了一件可怕的东西，而死后发现自己竟然身处那里。想象一下，邪魔族诸神第一次看到自己领域的情景。退至自己的王座，就是退至自己变化的心灵当中。这是一种严酷的对峙。

你为面对你的王座世界做了充分的准备。这就是我的警告带来的结果。我能想象面对那些变化时我会多么惊讶，就像我现在对自己的情感也很惊讶一样。光是想象一下就够了。

埃里斯·摩恩

2779821308.name: Brya's Love
2779821308.subtitle: "Just promise me one thing… Don't look back." —Brya
2779821308.subtitle_zh: “答应我一件事…别回头。”——布瑞亚
2779821308.text:
"What was Brya like?"

The assembled Ghosts—Targe, Peach, and Ophiuchus—ceased their gossip. They turned to Glint, who bobbed back a half-step.

"I never met her," Glint admitted.

"But you know what happened to her, right?" Peach asked. Glint nodded.

"She was…" Peach thought for a moment, searching for the word. "Cheerful."

Glint contracted his shell in confusion. "That's a little hard to imagine."

"It's true!" Peach chimed.

"You saying that makes it even harder to imagine," Glint replied, but Targe and Ophiuchus bobbed in affirmation.

"I mean, Eris was never cheerful," Peach continued. "But Brya could bring out a different side of her. It was impressive. I was impressed."

"She used to make up rhymes with Eris," Targe added.

"It was… endearing," Ophiuchus said.

"Huh," Glint mused. "It sounds like she was pretty special."

"She was," Targe said. They fell into a moment's silence until Peach spoke again.

"What she did in the Hellmouth… it wasn't for nothing. Eris made it out."

The assembled Ghosts nodded.

"I think I'd do the same, if Crow was in danger," Glint said softly. "If that was the only way to keep him safe. But Crow would be very sad. Very, very sad."

"Eris is 'very, very sad' too. It wasn't just losing the Light or her friends," Targe replied.

"We know our Guardians better than anyone," Ophiuchus said. "We see them at their lowest moments."

Targe glanced away, lost in thought.

Peach hummed. "I wonder what she'd think about Eris's plan?"

Her question hung in the air for a moment. Glint bobbed in consideration.

"I think she'd be proud," he said, and the others agreed.
2779821308.text_zh:
“布瑞亚是什么样的？”

聚集在一起的机灵们——塔格、桃子和蛇夫座——停下了闲聊。他们投来的目光让格林特不禁向后退去。

“我从没见过她，”格林特承认道。

“但你知道她发生了什么事，对吧？”桃子问道。格林特点了点头。

“她很…”桃子想了一会儿，寻找合适的措辞。“欢快。”

格林特迷惑地缩紧了他的机壳。“有点难以想象。”

“是真的！”桃子鸣叫道。

“你这么说，就更难想象了，”格林特答道，但塔格和蛇夫座都上下摆动，表示肯定。

“我的意思是，埃里斯从来都不欢快，”桃子继续说道。“但布瑞亚可以让她展现出不同的一面。很神奇。我印象很深。”

“她过去曾和埃里斯一起编写歌谣，”塔格补充道。

“真…可爱，”蛇夫座说道。

“哈，”格林特思忖道。“听起来她很特别。”

“她是很特别，”塔格说。他们陷入了一阵沉默，然后桃子重新开口。

“她在地狱深渊里所做的一切…不是没有意义的。埃里斯逃了出来。”

机灵们点了点头。

“如果乌鸦有危险，我想我也会这么做的，”格林特轻声说道。“如果那是保证他安全的唯一办法。但乌鸦会很难过。非常，非常难过。”

“埃里斯也‘非常，非常难过'。她不只是失去了光能和她的朋友。”塔格答道。

“我们比任何人都更了解我们的守护者，”蛇夫座说道。“我们是在他们最落魄的时刻遇到他们的。”

塔格把目光移开，陷入了沉思。

桃子嗡鸣着。“她会怎么看待埃里斯的计划呢？”

她的问题让大家陷入了沉思。格林特若有所思地上下摆动起来。

“我想她会感到骄傲的，”他说道，其他机灵也表示同意。

1875512595.name: Kept Confidence
1875512595.subtitle: "One way or the other, I'll be there." —Drifter
1875512595.text:
Drifter wiped the sweat off his brow and the grin off his face. His shoulders slumped as he stepped down from the platform in the Derelict. The Gambit match had ended in a hard-earned win. The next match would be in a few minutes. That's all he had.

He cleared his throat. His voice was hoarse.

Drifter looked up at the swirling mass of egregore and his thoughts shifted back to Eris Morn. They'd found a little comfort with each other. A little understanding. But what did it look like, he wondered, when all that chitin burst out of her? What did it feel like to eat up all those tithes the Guardians were taking for her in the field? In the Crucible? In Gambit?

He'd read the reports. He saw the theories on VanNet. He didn't trust them. He trusted her.

Drifter nodded to himself and took a breath as he heard the Guardians assemble behind him. He stepped up on the platform, flicking his jade coin. It spun in the air, catching the light, before falling back into the Drifter's waiting palm.

"You ever eat Hive eyes?" he asked with a smile, twisting his wrist around and slipping the coin back into his sleeve.

"Real juicy. They go pop in your mouth, and a shiver runs all the way through… Heh. I'll tell you when you're older."

He winked. The assembled Guardians watched him in silence. 

"Transmat firing!" he called out, and they disappeared in a burst of light.
1875512595.text_zh:
浪客拭去额头上的汗水，褪去脸上的笑容。他从遗落飞船的平台上走下来，耷拉着肩膀。智谋比赛以一场来之不易的胜利告终。下一场比赛将在几分钟后进行。这就是他所拥有的一切。

他清了清嗓子。声音很嘶哑。

浪客抬头看了看那一团旋转的守望者，思绪又回到了埃里斯·摩恩身上。他们在彼此身上找到了一丝安慰。一点理解。但他不禁好奇，当她体内所有的壳质迸发出来时会是什么样子？把守护者在战场上为她收取的贡品全部吸收是什么感觉？在熔炉竞技场里呢？在智谋里呢？

他读过报告，也在VanNet上看过各种猜测，但这些他都不相信。只相信她。

听到守护者们在他身后集合，浪客暗自点点头，吸了一口气。他走上平台，轻弹起他的玉币。它在空中旋转，反射光线，然后又落回到浪客等待着的手掌里。

“你们吃过邪魔族的眼睛吗？”他笑着问，扭动手腕，把硬币塞回袖子里。

“非常多汁。它们会在嘴里爆开，然后一阵寒颤贯穿全身…呵呵。等你们长大点再告诉你们。”

他挤了下眼。集合在一起的守护者们默默地看着他。 

“开始传送！”他喊道，接着他们便在一阵亮光中消失了。

105306149.name: Eleatic Principle
105306149.subtitle: Explanation leads to contradiction.
105306149.text:
SENDER: IKO-006
DECRYPTION KEY: SE7SYZP17A$IKO-006
SUBJ: Understanding

Savathûn didn't construct her Spire for Light and logic alone. There is more to this than meets the eye. That's the crux of it.

What is imbaru? Asking the question yields an ounce of tribute by itself; failing to answer it yields more. It's impossible to engage with the concept without falling into the web of cunning devised by the Witch Queen, even after her death.

It's elegant. And irritating.

We are familiar with the sword logic: the need to endure and force the universe to endure you. It's a contest. When there is nothing left standing but you, then you've won. Your prize is existence.

But imbaru is tribute from the failure to understand. When Savathûn ensnared us with her cunning, she fed her worm. Every false step or mistake in our attempts to unravel Savathûn's plans gave her exactly what she wanted. Whenever someone believed a lie or doubted a truth, she became that much more powerful.

We might think we know what we're doing here, but in many ways, I doubt we do. There will be ripples from Eris's actions. We can't predict what waves she'll make.

MESSAGE ENDS
105306149.text_zh:
发送者：IKO-006
解码密钥：SE7SYZP17A$IKO-006
主题：理解

萨瓦图恩建造她的尖塔并不仅仅是为了光能和守则。事情远不止我们所看到的，这就是一切的症结所在。

什么是薄雾？提出这个问题本身就是在进贡。如果回答不了，进贡得就更多了。若不能陷入巫妖女王所设计的狡诈之网，就根本不可能理解这个概念。即使是在她死后。

这招很妙，令人头疼。

我们都熟悉邪剑守则：对忍受的需求，以及迫使宇宙忍受你。这是一场比赛。活到最后，你就赢了。你的奖品是生存。

但薄雾是来自理解失败的贡品。当萨瓦图恩用她的狡诈捕获我们时，她喂养了她的蠕虫。我们试图揭示萨瓦图恩计划时的每一步失误都正中其下怀。每当有人相信了一个谎言或对某一真相产生怀疑时，她就会变得更加强大。

我们也许认为自己知道在做什么，但在很多方面，我都深表怀疑。埃里斯的举动会激起浪花。我们无法预测她会掀起什么样的波涛。

信息结束

2922749929.name: Semiotician
2922749929.subtitle: Interpret the signs.
2922749929.text:
Eido of the House of Light, Scribe log Epsilon-2-12A

I have received a gift from Eris Morn! It is a collection of Hive tomes on the nature of their runes and the rituals that they compose.

I delved into the tomes immediately. They were very useful once I was able to decipher her notes, neaten the pages, and remove her blank bookmarks—which I hope were not placed there for some purpose. I could not find a pattern to their insertion, even when they had arrows pointing to underlined passages.

At this point in my studies, I believe I have some insight into the way that these runes affect their magic. As Eris has explained to me, each rune is a logogram that encompasses many, and at times, contradictory meanings.  Curiously, some denote the particular Light energies used by Guardians and predate the acquisition of the Light by Savathûn's brood.

The style employed in inscribing the runes is unique to their practitioner. For instance, the runes that Eris writes follow concentric circles, while Savathûn composes long, tangential strings of runes. Runes also adorn many Hive weapons in long columns.

I understand that Eris is now devising a ritual that requires the composition and empowerment of many Hive runes. I must remember to wish her luck.
2922749929.text_zh:
光能氏族的艾多，文士日志E-2-12A

我收到了埃里斯·摩恩的礼物。这是一套邪魔族藏书，里面描述了他们的符文性质和相关仪式。

我马上开始研究这些藏书。等我破译完她的笔记，整理好书页，移掉她的空白书签（希望不是故意放在那里的）之后，它们变得非常实用。我找不到那些书签的摆放规律，即使它们有箭头指向划线的段落。

我相信在当前的研究阶段，我已对这些符文影响其魔法的方式有了一些了解。正如埃里斯向我解释的那样，每个符文都是一个词符，包含了许多有时相互矛盾的含义。有趣的是，一些符文表示了守护者所使用的特定光能能量，且早于萨瓦图恩的虫群获得光能的时间。

这些符文的施法者有着独特的书写风格。例如，埃里斯的符文是沿着同心圆写的，而萨瓦图恩的则是长而相切的符文串。符文呈长柱状，装饰在许多邪魔族武器上。

我知道埃里斯现在正在设计一个仪式，需要许多邪魔族符文的成分和赋能。我一定要记得去祝她好运。

4132072834.name: Locus Locutus
4132072834.subtitle: Speak to remember, speak to forget.
4132072834.subtitle_zh: 言语有时是为了铭记，有时是为了遗忘。
4132072834.text:
"The cards cannot truly predict the future. They only offer perspective," Eris said. She stood with Eido at the Lectern of Divination, laying each card with purpose. "Your thoughts on their meanings will be appreciated."

Eido didn't reply; she was looking over her shoulder and towards the ritual circle at the center of the Athenaeum. Eris continued.

"Your insight into Xivu Arath's motivations avoided disaster," Eris said, trying to catch her attention. "We were able to warn Queen Mara and convince Rasputin of his error."

Eido nodded, looking down at the table. With the tip of one claw, she aligned the edge of The Adherent card with the edge of its neighbor.

"You want to ask me something," Eris said after a long pause. She had never known Eido to refrain from asking any question that came to mind, and the Scribe's new hesitance was surprising.

"Yes," Eido said, then paused. When she spoke again, it was in a whisper. "This is where it… happens? Your… transformations."

Her voice strained at the last word.

"Yes. Where the runes are most powerful," Eris answered coolly. "Here, and in the Witch Queen's oubliette."

Eido nodded.

"That word is from an old Human language," Eido said, her voice regaining a little of the cheer that Eris recognized. "Its root means 'to forget,' I believe."

"Yes, you are correct."
 
"And, ah…" Eido paused again, the question tangling in her throat. "Do you… forget? Who you are?"

Eris took a breath. In their research together, Eido had learned to be blunt.

"No," Eris said. "I am myself. Always."

Eido's eyes widened. There was silence. No questions, no curiosity. Only the unblinking stare of someone too afraid to speak.

"There is nothing to fear," Eris said, and she did not know if that was comforting. Eido nodded and looked away.

"Of course not," the Scribe answered. "I didn't think there would be."

Eris wondered if others had lied more convincingly.
4132072834.text_zh:
“这些卡牌不能真正预测未来。它们只能提供一些线索，”埃里斯说。她和艾多站在占卜台前，意味深长地铺上每张卡牌。“说一说你对其中含义的看法吧。”

艾多没有回答。她一直回头盯着雅典娜神庙中心的仪式环。

“你对希乌阿拉斯动机的见解避免了灾难的发生，”埃里斯继续说道，试图吸引艾多的注意力。“我们得以警告玛拉女王，并说服拉斯普廷认识到自己的错误。”

艾多点了点头，看向台上的卡牌。她用爪尖将“拥护者”卡牌的边缘与其相邻卡牌的边缘对齐。

“你想要问我些事，”埃里斯停顿了很久后说道。她所认识的艾多不会克制自己询问任何想到的问题；这名文士的犹豫让她很吃惊。

“是的，”艾多说道，然后停顿了一下。当她再次开口时，声音变得非常小。“这里就是…那里了吧？就是你…转化的地方。”

她说到后面时声音有些紧张。

“是的。这里是符文最强大的地方，”埃里斯冷淡地答道。“在这里，还有巫妖女王的地下密牢里。”

艾多点了点头。

“这个词来自一种古老的人类语言，”艾多说道，声音又恢复了一丝埃里斯所熟悉的欢快。“如果我没弄错，它的词根是‘忘记'的意思。”

“是的，你说得对。”
 
“那么，呃…”艾多又停顿了一下。这问题在她的喉中有些纠结。“你会…忘记吗？自己是谁？”

埃里斯吸了一口气。在她们共同研究的过程中，艾多学会了直言不讳。

“不，”埃里斯说道。“我是我自己。永远都是。”

艾多睁大了眼睛。随后是一阵沉默。没有问题，没有好奇。只是目不转睛地看着她，不敢开口。

“没什么好害怕的，”埃里斯说，她不知道这是不是一种安慰。艾多点点头，移开了目光。

“当然没有，”文士回答道。“我觉得没什么好害怕的。”

埃里斯心想，恐怕没人撒谎时还这么笃定吧。

413901114.name: Acosmic
413901114.subtitle: How may we endure the desolation of the absolute?
413901114.subtitle_zh: 我们要怎样才能忍受绝对的荒芜？
413901114.text:
The noise of the Bazaar was a background hum, the seemingly electric energy pulsating all around Sloane as she wandered among the Festival of the Lost vendors. A Human sold delicate pottery beside Eliksni weavers showcasing their intricate fabrics. There were platters of stuffed figs and mugs of Ether Fizz. A Bracus tended a flame below a spit. The charring meat sizzled with each turn, and war beasts lapped at the fat that trickled to the ground. Two Awoken Corsairs shared a roasted artichoke, both warming their fingers on the coal-blistered petals. Human and Eliksni children darted past, their laughter and chittering carried on the wind.

Everything here struck Sloane's senses as ruefully foreign and strangely dissonant. She'd missed so much. Her grief caught in her throat as the spiny shell of a Hive Ghost glided into view, and Sloane felt her jaw drop. She mentally noted even more questions for Zavala.

Rehnpeir's Drunken Noodle caught her eye up ahead, the sign blissfully familiar, and she sighed with relief for a moment.

Aisha and Shayura waved her over to a table. "You made it," Shayura said, affection laced into the edge of her voice.

"I'm glad you're here too," Sloane said. "Both of you." Aisha handed a steaming bowl to Sloane and put another in front of an empty chair.

Aisha's gaze followed Sloane's. "Reed will always have a seat at our table," Aisha said. Shayura nodded and offered a supportive but strained smile, and Aisha gave her hand a reassuring squeeze.

Sloane looked down again at the bowl in front of her. Swirls of noodles and slices of meat soaked in the creamy broth, and the egg's golden yolk pooled around the bok choy nestled beside it. She stared at her meal, as if to commit every noodle to memory.

"Are you planning on eating it or painting it?" a voice teased from behind.

Sloane turned to see Zavala standing beside her. A small laugh escaped from her lips. "I just… I've been waiting—wanting—for this for so long. Now that I have it, I… I almost don't want this moment to end."

"We know how you feel," Aisha said. 

"However, there's good news," Zavala quipped.

"What's that?"

"You can savor the next bowl too."

Sloane grinned and lifted the first noodles to her lips. She savored the umami flavors, surprised by the complexity. 

"How is it?" he asked.

"It's different. But… still good."

A look of understanding passed between them, and Zavala gave her a reassuring smile.
413901114.text_zh:
集市的噪音犹如嗡鸣的背景声，斯隆漫步在英灵日的商人之中，她的四周似乎跳动着电能。一名人类在展示复杂织物的埃里克斯尼族织工身旁贩卖着精致的陶器。包括一些放着含馅无花果的盘子和几杯乙太气泡酒。一名十夫长照看着烤架下的炉火。烧焦的肉伴着每一次翻转咝咝作响，战兽们舔着滴落在地上的肉脂。两个觉醒者海盗军分享着一个烤洋蓟，在炭烧过的瓣片上暖着手指头。人类和埃里克斯尼族的孩童们飞奔而过，欢笑和嬉闹声随风而去。

这里的一切让斯隆生出一种悲伤的陌生感，异常不和谐。她错过了太多。一名邪魔族机灵的多刺机壳飞入视野，她的悲痛仿佛因惊愕而卡在了喉咙里。她在脑海中记下了更多需要向萨瓦拉提出的问题。

前方的瑞恩佩尔醉面餐馆吸引了她的目光，这个招牌熟悉得令人欣喜，她顿时松了一口气。

艾莎和沙玉拉挥手让她坐到桌子旁。“你来了，”沙玉拉说道，声音中含着温情。

“我很高兴你们也在这儿，”斯隆说道。“你们俩都是。”艾莎把一只热气腾腾的碗递给斯隆，又把另一只碗放在一把空椅子前面。

艾莎注意到了斯隆的目光。“我们这桌永远会为里德留一个位置，”艾莎说道。沙玉拉点点头，给了一个支持但略显拘谨的微笑，而艾莎则安慰地握紧了她的手。

斯隆再次低头看向她面前的碗。漩涡状的面条和肉片浸泡在奶油肉汤里，鸡蛋的金黄色蛋黄积聚在白菜四周。她凝视着她的食物，好像是要将每一根面条都印在脑海中。

“你是打算吃它，还是画它？”一个调侃的声音从身后传来。

斯隆回过头看见萨瓦拉站在她身边，嘴角不禁露出一丝微笑。“我只是…我已经等待——也期待——这一刻很久了。现在我如愿以偿，我…都有点不想让这一刻结束了。”

“我们明白你的感受，”艾莎说道。 

“不过，我有好消息，”萨瓦拉打趣道。

“是什么？”

“另一碗也归你了。”

斯隆咧嘴一笑，把第一口面举到唇边。她品尝着鲜味，口感丰富，让她十分惊讶。 

“怎么样？”他问道。

“不一样。但…还是很好吃。”

他们四目相对，彼此心领神会。萨瓦拉给了她一个安慰的微笑。

2190356820.name: I — Eris Morn — Prolegomenon
2190356820.name_zh: I —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 序言
2190356820.text:
Verse 8:1 — The Sisters

Thoughts calcify into action, and actions calcify into being. Such is the ontology of Hive magic. Such is the Deck of Whispers that has unfolded beneath my hands.

These cards are curious objects—esoterica manifested by my power and the Guardians' tithes. They have taken on our forms: myself, Savathûn, and Xivu Arath. Our loves and fears, our memories, our desires.

Contemplate me. Contemplate the Hive.

These cards unsettle me. I did not wish to be unveiled so. But perhaps that is the consequence of my transformation: I am seen as I am, beneath my bandage. Beneath my skin.

So, too, are Xivu Arath and Savathûn unveiled. Through these cards, we have found ourselves connected. Dear devoted sisters, and I, inchoate but for the eyes I have stolen.

I have deciphered the meanings of the cards, drawn from them the shapes of their referents. The whispers ask for reflection and meditation, speaking of the paths we have taken and who we have come to be. And so my utterings, alongside those of the two surviving sisters, have taken the form of a new Book of Sorrow: a bound collection of verses sung by their gods and delivered to their brood as scripture.

Now I deliver it to my brood. Now I number among their gods. Aiat.
2190356820.text_zh:
诗节8:1 - 姐妹

思想会转化为行动，而行动则会转化为存在。这就是邪魔族魔法的存在论。我的双手之下铺开的低语卡组也是如此。

这些卡牌是由我的力量以及守护者的贡品所生成的奇异物品。它们有着我们的形态：我自己、萨瓦图恩和希乌阿拉斯。我们的挚爱和恐惧、记忆和欲望。

凝思着我。凝思着邪魔族。

这些卡牌让我感到不安。我并不希望如此暴露自己。但也许这就是我转化的后果吧：在我的绷带之下，在我的皮肤之下。我的本体被一览无遗。

希乌阿拉斯与萨瓦图恩的本体也以这种方式被揭露了。通过这些卡牌，我们发现我和我那些亲爱的姐妹们是有关联的。而我，除了我偷窃的眼睛之外，还远远没有成熟。

我从卡牌之所指的形状中破译了其含义。这些低语可引起反思与冥想，讲述我们选择的道路以及我们所成为的自己。于是我与其他两名幸存姐妹的话语，成为了新的《忧愁之书》：一本将作为虫群经文的神吟诗书。

现在我将它交给我的虫群。现在我成为其众神中的一员。阿特。

2190356823.name: II — Savathûn — Imago Unfurl
2190356823.name_zh: II —— 萨瓦图恩 —— 心象
2190356823.text:
Verse 8:2 — The Witch 

We were the last surviving siblings. That's what this has always been about for Xivu Arath. She wanted us all to survive. She would throw everything she could at us, so we could learn to survive.

Didn't quite work, did it?

My brother's greatest acts of navigation were his metamorphoses. That was his tactic: he would change everything about himself so that he could survive this universe. Meanwhile, my sister cuts the universe apart—makes it as sharp as she—until all that's left is her and her love.

I'm a little bit of both. No need to choose. I don't have my brother's fear or my sister's vanity.

Even in his infinite adaptability, Oryx could not withstand the Guardians. So Xivu Arath wants to prove she can by being as rigid and unyielding as she always has been—no need to fix what isn't broken. Overwhelming force, tactics, and intimidation.

We are who we are, and we chose our morphs carefully. I wanted life. Xivu wanted vengeance and dominion. Oryx wanted to venture out, deep in thought, and feed on the delicacies of truth.

Well, he got what he wanted. Now Oryx knows death more intimately than any of us. No bringing him back.

Poor Xivu's distraught. With all that war and ruin to hide behind, she thinks she doesn't show it. Deep down she believes Oryx must have survived through their logic. She believes he'll be conjured back just like he conjured us.

That was a long time ago. We've moved past that. Despite everything to come, I will live on. With and without them.

Should I say that I miss my siblings? That I miss the times when the threats of death and short lifespan were still with us, when we piloted our needle, when we dove and became what we became?

No. Xivu is the sentimental one. We are not who we were. Who we were no longer exists.

I sound like my brother.
2190356823.text_zh:
诗节8:2 - 女巫 

我们是最后幸存下来的同胞。希乌阿拉斯只考虑着这一点。她想让我们都生存下去。她会迫使我们经历一切困难，好让我们学会生存之道。

好像没有奏效，不是吗？

哥哥最厉害的导航之道是他的蜕变能力。那是他的战术：为了能够在这个宇宙中生存，他会改变自己的一切。同时，妹妹在不断切削着宇宙，使其变得像她一样锋利，直到剩下的只有她和她的挚爱。

我从两边都学了点。没必要选择。我没有哥哥的恐惧，也没有妹妹的虚荣。

欧里克斯虽然有无限的适应力，但他依然招架不住守护者的猛攻。所以希乌阿拉斯想一如既往地通过坚毅和不屈来证明她能挡住守护者…没必要去改变至今没出过问题的办法。毁天灭地的力量、战术和恐吓。

我们就是我们自己，而我们谨慎地选择了蜕变的形态。我想要生命。希乌想要复仇和统治。欧里克斯想要冒险，沉思，并以真理的美味为食。

他如愿以偿了。现在欧里克斯比我们任何人都更清楚死亡的滋味。他再也回不来了。

可怜的希乌悲痛欲绝。她躲在战争和废墟的后面，以为能掩藏自己的情绪。在内心深处，她坚信欧里克斯定是通过他们的守则生存了下来。她坚信他能被召唤回来，就像他召唤我们一样。

那是很久以前的事了。我们已经过了这道坎。不管将来会发生什么，我都会继续活下去。不管有没有他们。

我该说我怀念我的兄弟姐妹吗？我怀念死亡和短暂生命的威胁依然如影随形的时候，怀念我们驾驶织针飞下深渊，成为现在的样子的时候？

不。希乌才是多愁善感的那一个。我们已经不是以前的我们。以前的我们已不复存在。

我这话很像我哥哥的语气。

2190356822.name: III — Xivu Arath — Battlesong
2190356822.name_zh: III —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 战歌
2190356822.text:
Verse 8:3 — The Adherent 

What I Am —
Uttered by Xivu Arath —
God of Many Shapes — 

I AM THE GOD OF SILENCE. I slit a hundred million wailing throats. I watch as their blood scatters like precious stones. Their screams turn to sighs; their sighs turn to silence. I stand among the dead and listen to the absence of sound.

I AM THE GOD OF LOGIC. I shiver in delight to speak the truth because speaking truth is good. I speak my brother's words, the words he cut from the worm god Akka's throat.

I AM THE GOD OF LIFE. I pare dead things from truth, and in this, I find life that cannot be extinguished. I hold that life, nurture it by testing it against myself, by removing the weaknesses that bring death. In this, I embrace life and all its strength.

I AM THE GOD OF LOVE. Any life that can withstand me will be with me at the final shape. There, we will stand together. That life will know me, and I will know it: pared to our true shapes, seeing each other for what we are.

I AM THE GOD OF ALL THAT EXISTS. I have endured while others have not. I am the last surviving sibling. I will stand at the final shape and be the end. I will maintain my existence when nothing else has. I will stand alone.
2190356822.text_zh:
诗节8:3 - 拥护者 

我为何物——
出自希乌阿拉斯——
万变之神—— 

吾乃沉默之神。我已经割开了亿万哀号者的喉咙。我看着他们的血像宝石般散落一地。他们的尖叫声变成了叹息；他们的叹息变成了沉默。我站在死者中间，听着那片寂静。

吾乃守则之神。我为诉说真话而高兴得发抖，因为诉说真话是好事。我说出哥哥的话语，那是他从虫神阿卡的喉咙里割下来的。

吾乃生命之神。我从真理中剥离死物，也在其中找到了无法熄灭的生命。我握着那生命，通过亲自测试它的力量，剔除可能招致死亡的弱点来培育它。在其中，我拥抱生命及其全部力量。

吾乃爱之神。任何能够承受我的生命将以终焉之形与我同在。那时我们将携手与共。它了解我，我了解它：还原成我们真实的样子，看到彼此的本质。

吾乃万物之神。我已经存活到了今日，而其他人却没有。我是兄弟姐妹中最后的幸存者。我将化为终焉之形，成为一切的终点。我将在虚无中永远独存。

2190356817.name: IV — Eris Morn — Evocate Desire
2190356817.name_zh: IV —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 唤起欲望
2190356817.text:
Verse 8:4 — The Harbinger 

My vile transformation is complete. What was foretold, what was feared, is now true: Eris Morn has given in to the Hive's endless hunger. She has taken up the mantle of a Hive queen and leads vast armies of acolytes into war.

Inevitable. Inimitable. Who else but her? What else but this?

(Ikora believes my transformation was not necessary. It was.)

I hear whispers, but when do I not? They have been with me since the Hellmouth. This is what I am. It cannot be refuted or denied. This is the shape I have chosen for myself: my morph, the Harbinger.

(Ikora believes I will martyr myself. But what martyr walked towards oblivion with a knife in hand? I will not go so serenely.)

In my morph, I am unafraid. In my morph, I wield fear, that earliest of fears: fear of devourment. Since we ourselves were prey, we have felt terror at the gaping maw, at the hunger gazing at us with delight.

I have stared that hunger in the face. I have endured it for too long. Now, I will be the predator. I will devour. I will instill that first fear.

I hunger, but that hunger has always strained against the limitations of my Lightless body. But here, in the Witch Queen's endless hypogeum, that hunger has bloomed. This part of me has erupted from my body as from the earth, like one of those obscene, carnivorous corpse flowers—dark cores swallowing sunlight, plush petals open to death.

Ridiculous. Who would compare hunger to a flower? I do not wait passively for my prey. No—no—it is a worm. A worm I have a desperate urge to feed.

It can be nothing else.
2190356817.text_zh:
诗节8:4 - 先知 

我的邪恶转化完成了。所预言的，所担心的，现在都已成真。埃里斯·摩恩屈服于邪魔族的无尽饥渴。她披上了邪魔族女王的衣钵，带领着仆从大军投入了战争。

不可避免。命中注定。除了她，还能是谁？除了战争，还有什么？

（艾可拉觉得我没必要转化。但它是必要的。）

我听到了低语，但我何曾听不到呢？它们自从地狱深渊起就伴我身边。这就是我。无法反驳，也无可否认。这就是我为自己选择的形态：我的蜕变，先知。

（艾可拉以为我会殉道。但哪个殉道者会手握刀子走向覆灭？我不会平静地死去。）

蜕变后，我无所惧怕。蜕变后，我挥舞恐惧，那是最原始的、对吞噬的恐惧。自从我们成为猎物以来，我们对那疯狂注视我们的饥饿大嘴感到恐惧。

我直面着这样的饥饿。我已经忍受它太久了。现在，我会成为捕食者。我将要去吞噬，去散播那种最初的恐惧。

我以前很饥饿，但那种饥饿感总是与我无光之体的局限性相抵触。但在这里，在巫妖女王的无尽次元空间里，这种饥饿感被释放了出来。这种欲望从我的身体里爆发了出来，就像从地球上爆发出来的欲望一样，就像那些淫秽的、食肉的尸花…黑暗的核心不断吞噬阳光，让毛绒绒的花瓣向着死亡绽放。

荒谬。谁会把饥饿感比作花朵？我不会静候我的猎物。不——不——我说的是一只蠕虫。一只我急切地想去喂养的蠕虫。

绝非他物。

2190356816.name: V — Eris Morn — Mimesis
2190356816.name_zh: V —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 摹仿
2190356816.text:
Verse 8:5 — Blades 

What is the nature of war? Ritual.
What is the nature of ritual? Fascination.

Imitation shapes desire, and Xivu Arath has become its great mediator. She compels those she wars against to war against her, and the object over which they war is existence itself. She takes up her blade, and we take up ours. Xivu Arath cuts at us, and so do we cut at her. We bleed together, mirrored in our pain and violence.

Savathûn looked at us through a veil so that we would not see her. Xivu Arath looks at us through a dark mirror, and she only sees herself.

This is her design, her ultimate mechanism of desire: she would make us into her image. She would cut the entire universe into her image so that she is the only thing left at the end of all things.

Vain and lonely. That is Xivu Arath, bereft of her siblings.
