The sword logic is predicated on such imitation. To return Xivu Arath's violence is to embrace it and its beautiful thesis. We are forced to react, again and again, as she makes her advance. We are forced to desire existence at any cost, just as she does.

Fated? Inevitable? No. An ontological trap.

The Warmind knew this, as he could know her the most intimately out of all of us. His escalation did nothing but mirror her endlessly. His self-sacrifice put an end to that font of violence. It was a frustration in her logic that he did so, as Xivu Arath recognizes no sacrifice that does not end in a scream.

But self-sacrifice could not put an end to her war march. Only doubt can do so. And in Xivu Arath's mournful solipsism, she will be left with nothing but that.
2190356816.text_zh:
诗节8:5 - 利刃 

战争的本质是什么？仪式。
仪式的本质是什么？痴迷。

模仿塑造欲望，而希乌阿拉斯已成为了它的头号中间人。她迫使那些被她宣战的人向她宣战，为了存在本身而战。她拿起她的利刃，我们拿起我们的利刃。希乌阿拉斯砍向我们，而我们也砍向她。我们一起流血，承受相同的痛苦和暴力。

萨瓦图恩透过一层面纱看我们，让我们无法看见她。希乌阿拉斯透过一面黑镜看我们，她只能看到自己。

这是她的诡计，她最终的欲望机制：她会把我们变成她的样子。她要把宇宙变成她的样子，让自己成为万物尽头所剩下的唯一东西。

虚荣和孤独。那就是失去兄弟姐妹后的希乌阿拉斯。

邪剑守则是以这种模仿为前提的。回击希乌阿拉斯的暴力就是在拥抱这种暴力，以及它美丽的论调。我们被迫做出反应，一次又一次，跟着她的脚步起舞。我们被迫不惜一切代价渴望存续，就像她那样。

命中注定？不可避免？不，这是一个存在论的陷阱。

战争思维知道这一点，因为他在我们之中最了解她。他的升级不过是在不断反照她而已，而他的自我牺牲终止了那个暴力的源头。在希乌阿拉斯的守则中，这是一种挫折，因为不在尖叫中归于沉寂的死亡不算献祭。

但自我牺牲无法阻止她前进的脚步。只有怀疑能阻止她。在希乌阿拉斯悲哀的唯我论中，这是她仅有的东西。

2190356819.name: VI — Xivu Arath — κατολοφύρομαι
2190356819.name_zh: VI —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 哭泣之歌
2190356819.text:
Verse 8:6 — Lacuna 

My Navigation — 
Sung by Xivu Arath —
Faithful Sister to Oryx —

THE SKY GAVE OUR SISTER STRENGTH FROM FALSE SHAPES.

SHE FELL TO WHAT FELLED YOU, LONELY NAVIGATOR.

THIS IS THEIR LIE: THEIR COMPANIONSHIP IS STRENGTH.

THIS IS OUR TRUTH: THEIR COMPLACENCY DECAYS EXISTENCE.

THEIR DEAD RISE WHEN THEY DESERVE TO DIE!

THEY WILL NOT MEET OUR TRUTH WITH TRUTH!

THUS, THEY DO NOT DESERVE IT.

THEY ARE NOT REAL.

YOU WERE REAL.

YOU WERE TO LAST FOREVER,

OUR UNDYING CREATION.

I WOULD DIE AGAIN TO GIVE YOU STRENGTH.

I WOULD CUT MY WOUND SO THAT YOU MAY STEP THROUGH.

YOU WILL NOT RISE BY FALSE SHAPES,

BUT WITH OUR UNCONDITIONAL VICTORY:

SHE WHO HAS BEEN SCOURED OF THE SKY NOW BRINGS FORTH HER BROOD.

THEY HAVE TAKEN UP YOUR WEAPON, WHICH IS ALL THAT YOU ARE,

AND SHE WILL CONJURE YOU BACK WITH HER UNDERSTANDING.
2190356819.text_zh:
诗节8:6 - 缺漏 

我的航行—— 
由希乌阿拉斯吟唱——
欧里克斯忠诚的妹妹——

苍穹给了姐妹力量，让她摆脱了虚伪的形态。

她被你的夙敌击倒，孤独的领航员。

这就是他们的谎言：他们的同伴就是力量源泉。

这就是我们的真相：他们的自满会使自身衰退。

他们应死的亡者涅槃重生！

他们无法用真相面对我们的真相！

故而，他们不配得到它。

他们不是真实的。

你是真实的。

你本该永远存续，

我们不朽的创作。

我愿再次死去以给你力量。

我会切开伤口来让你踏过。

你不会以虚假的形态涅槃重生，

而是带着我们无条件的胜利：

被夺取苍穹的她如今统领虫群。

他们已经拿起了你的武器，这就是你的全部，

而她会以其理解将你带回这里。

2190356818.name: VII — Xivu Arath — Deathless
2190356818.name_zh: VII —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 不死之身
2190356818.text:
Verse 8:7 — Liminal

My Throne —
Carved to endure by Xivu Arath —
God of Love —

MY COURT IS WAR, AND YOU WILL FIND ME THERE.

I am war, and my throne is deathless.

Come. Cut the outer curtain of my fortress, and it will open its new eye in a bloodless laceration. Cut further to see inside its walls: the yellow fat, the purple viscera, the teeming rust-cut capillaries.

These are the colors of war. THESE ARE THE COLORS OF MY COURT.

My gates open to the most life. The swollen fountains run with blood and burst with arterial spray. The paths are paved with small white teeth. They gnash beneath each footfall, their roots raw and alive.

Look! I have raised cathedrals made of flesh. When a breeze caresses them, they blush and contract, fine hairs sensing the change.

They are worshipped with bare touch. MY THRONE SHUDDERS WITH JOY.

The halls of my palace are echoing throats, slick and filled with breath. Its windows are glazed with skin, opalescent and alive, latticed with blue-black veins.

The seats of my throne are fashioned with living bones. Break them, and you will see their raw, red marrow. Break them, and the wet pith will writhe. Two are knotted with scars: broken and reformed, broken and reformed.

Look out from the terrace and see the worlds we will devour to sustain us. It is a mouth, yawning black and wide and hungering. It is open in screams of base need.

MY COURT IS LOVE, AND YOU WILL MEET ME THERE.
2190356818.text_zh:
诗节8:7 - 阈限

我的王座——
由希乌阿拉斯雕刻以存续——
爱之神——

我的宫廷即是战争，你会在那里找到我。

我即是战争，而我的王座是永存的。

来吧。割开我堡垒的外帘，它将在一个不会流血的裂口中睁开一只新的眼睛。再往深处切一刀，就能看到它墙内的景象：黄色的脂肪，紫色的内脏，锈蚀铁器割伤的充血毛细血管。

这是战争的颜色。这是我的宫廷的颜色。

我的大门向大多生命敞开。鲜血在膨胀的喷泉中流淌着，在一旁的动脉中迸发着。路上铺满了小小的白牙。它们在每一个脚印下咬牙切齿，根部生机勃勃。

看！我用血肉搭起的教堂。当微风抚过它们时，它们会脸红、收缩，上面的细毛感觉到变化。

它们在触碰之中被敬拜。我的王座因喜悦而颤抖。

我的宫廷大厅是一个回响的喉腔，光滑而充满气息。它的窗户覆盖着一层布满蓝黑色血管晶格的乳白皮肤。

我王座的座位是用鲜活的骨头做成的。打断它们，你就会看到生鲜的红色骨髓。打断它们，里面湿润的骨髓会随之蠕动。有两根骨头结着疤痕：这是因为它们断了又愈合，愈合了又断。

从阳台向外看，看那些为了我们的延续而即将被吞噬的世界。它是一张黑色的大嘴，在饥饿的驱使下，伴着欲望的尖叫而张开血盆大口。

我的宫廷即是爱，你会在那里见到我。

2190356829.name: VIII — Savathûn — Swords and Lanterns
2190356829.name_zh: VIII —— 萨瓦图恩 —— 刀剑与灯笼
2190356829.text:
Verse 8:8 — Ascension 

My sorry, sad, inculcated sister. She thinks she's as honest as a knife's edge just because she never speaks a lie aloud. But she's prone to contradiction, at least since our beloved brother fell.

She could never quite understand it—someone as mighty as Oryx brought down by liars, his bloodline destroyed, his corpse left to desiccate in Saturn's orbit. Xivu Arath actually believed that Dreadnought of his was unassailable, but Oryx knew that he had limits: more than once, he took the power of our deaths to defeat something stronger than himself.

She's just bitter she wasn't there to die for him again.

She says she's the god of death, but I've seen her throne. It's a mausoleum for life with all the close, cloying comfort of a birthing room, wet and raw and filled with disgusting effluvia. I imagine it reminds her of our gardens so long ago, and all the things that grew there.

She really shouldn't be so nostalgic.

There was a game we played when we were young: Swords and Lanterns. Sathona held the lantern, while Xi Ro held the sword. Sathona would search for her hidden sister, and Xi Ro would avoid the lantern's light. If Xi Ro touched Sathona with her sword, she would win. If Sathona found Xi Ro with her lantern, she would win.

Sathona devised the rules, but Xi Ro would let her sister find her.

I still give her presents, too, of course. I gave her Torobatl! My gift to my last surviving sibling. She gobbled it up so greedily, she didn't even consider how it proved her precious logic false.

What kind of thing is a gift? The Deep doesn't like gifts. Neither does the logic. But we're sisters: I thought I'd be nice, and share.

Xivu was too busy to notice that little contradiction. She never even thanked me.

What did she say, as soon as she set foot on Torobatl? "FOR AS LONG AS YOU HAVE WORSHIPPED WAR, YOU HAVE WORSHIPPED ME." Aiat, aiat. That was Torobatl. I know a joke in a dead language: aiēbat.
2190356829.text_zh:
诗节8:8 - 飞升 

我那可怜而可悲的妹妹太过固执。她以为自己像刀锋一样诚实，只因为她从不将谎言说出来。但她经常自相矛盾，至少从我们心爱的哥哥倒下之后就是如此。

她永远无法完全理解…强大如欧里克斯竟会被说谎者打倒，血统被毁，尸体被留在土星的轨道上干枯殆尽。希乌阿拉斯真的相信他的无畏战舰是无可匹敌的，但欧里克斯知道自己有极限：不止一次，他利用我们死亡的力量来击败比他更强大的东西。

她只是因为没能在那里再度为他赴死而愤懑。

她说她是死亡之神，但我见过她的王座。那是一座生命的陵墓：拥有产房里封闭而发腻的舒适感，潮湿而原始，到处是令人作呕的液体。我想这让她想起了很久之前我们的花园，以及所有生长在那里的一切。

她真不该如此怀旧。

我们儿时曾玩过一个游戏：刀剑和灯笼。萨托娜拿着灯笼，希罗拿着剑。萨托娜会寻找躲起来的妹妹，而希罗会避开灯笼的光。如果希罗用剑碰触到萨托娜，她就赢了。如果萨托娜用灯笼找到希罗，她就赢了。

萨托娜设计了规则，但希罗会故意让她姐姐找到她。

当然，我还是会给她礼物。我给了她图罗巴特尔！那是给我最后一位活着的姐妹的礼物。她贪婪地吞下它，甚至都没想过，这证明了她宝贵的守则是错的。

礼物算什么东西？深渊不喜欢礼物。守则也是如此。但我们是姐妹：我想我会友善点，分享些东西。

希乌忙得没能注意到这个小小的矛盾。她甚至都没谢过我。

踏上图罗巴特尔后，她是怎么说的？“只要你崇拜战争，你就崇拜着我。”阿特，阿特。那就是图罗巴特尔。我知道一个已死语言中的笑话：艾埃巴特。

2190356828.name: IX — Xivu Arath — Antigone Drowns
2190356828.name_zh: IX —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 安提戈涅的溺亡
2190356828.text:
Verse 8:9 — Lament 

On Xivu's Mourning —
Sung by Xivu Arath —
Sister to a dead king —

GRIEF. There is no grief. I will not grieve.

FEAR. There is no fear. We do not fear.

PITY. There is no pity. There is nothing to pity.

GRAVE. He will have no grave. We do not dig graves.

ROT. He rots beneath the waves.
2190356828.text_zh:
诗节8:9 - 挽歌 

希乌的悲叹——
由希乌阿拉斯吟唱——
已死之王的妹妹——

悲痛。没有悲痛。我不会悲痛。

恐惧。没有恐惧。我们不恐惧。

怜悯。没有怜悯。不值得怜悯。

坟墓。他没坟墓。我们从不掘墓。

腐烂。他在腐烂。沉没于海底。

3654788876.name: X — Eris Morn — The Augur Casts Her Bones
3654788876.name_zh: X —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 用她的骨头占卜
3654788876.text:
Verse 8:10 — The Lie 

It is a dire error to see Savathûn's predictions as truths divined from some inner foresight. She did not prophesize. What we are attempting here was just one possibility in an infinite collection of possibilities, and a choice we made in an infinite collection of choices. She could not have anticipated them all. She could only cast her bones in the space between certainty and augury, and watch them fall.

(It is odd to speak of her in the past tense. Even in death, she is here with us, pulling at our strings, howling with laughter at our failings as she did years ago. But now our failings will be her sister's triumph, and Savathûn's lasting death.)

No, the Witch Queen never dealt in fate. In this, we share her understanding of the universe: every movement is a result of a meticulous application of desire. This path was carefully constructed, and we were predictable enough to place our footsteps into the imprints she made for us.

It is a truth dressed as a lie, so that we may overlook it.

But that is not fate. Fate is the purview of Xivu Arath's childish logic; the dead were destined for death, and the fall of her sword is inevitable.

We are not as easily fooled as she. That logic is a lie dressed as a truth, so that we may waste our time with it.

No. I am not here because of fate. I am here because of will and machination.

But if neither are my own, is that any more desirable?

No matter. I will take control. I possess that power.

I will cast my bones, as the Witch Queen did, between certainty and augury. I will see Xivu Arath's worm devour her. She will be struck down by her own bargain and fall like lightning. I will see Savathûn undone by my own trickery. She will behold me as I am and know that I am her ruin.

This is the path I lay for them, and they will follow it. 

Aiat.
3654788876.text_zh:
诗节8:10 - 谎言 

把萨瓦图恩的预测看成是以某种内在的预知能力而占卜出来的真相是一个可怕的错误。她没有作出预言。我们在此所尝试的只是无限的可能性集合中的一种可能性，以及我们在无数选择中做出的一个选择。她只能把她的骨头抛进确信与预言之间的空间里，看着它们倒下。

（用提及死人的口吻谈论她感觉很怪。就算死了，她也仍然在这里，和我们在一起，像几年前一样，在背后操纵我们，对着我们的失败嚎叫大笑。但现在我们的失败将会是她妹妹的胜利，以及萨瓦图恩的永久死亡。）

不，巫妖女王不会干涉命运。在这点上，她对宇宙的理解与我们相同：每个举动都是对欲望一丝不苟运用的结果。这条道路是被精心构建的，而我们太容易被猜透，以至于会把脚步放在她为我们留下的脚印中。

这是个装扮成谎言的真相，这样我们才会对其视而不见。

但那不是命运。命运在希乌阿拉斯幼稚守则的范畴之内；亡者注定要死去，她刀剑的落下无可避免。

我们不像她那样会被轻易愚弄。那守则是个装扮成真相的谎言，这样我们才会在其身上浪费时间。

不。我在这里不是因为命运。我在这里是因为意志，也是因为阴谋。

但如果两者都不是我的，那难道会更可取吗？

不重要。我会控制局面。我拥有那力量。

我会像巫妖女王所做的那样，把我的骨头抛进确信与预言之间。我会看到希乌阿拉斯的蠕虫将她吞噬。她会被自己的交易击倒，像闪电般从天上堕下。我会看到萨瓦图恩被自己的诡计毁掉。她会看到我现在的样子，知道我将毁灭她。

这是我为她们铺设的道路，而她们会沿着它走下去。 

阿特。

3654788877.name: XI — Eris Morn — They Drink Strong Poison
3654788877.name_zh: XI —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 他们喝下了剧毒
3654788877.text:
Verse 8:11 — The Truth 

The Hive are not a monolith. They have internal contradictions, strife, tensions. These threaten to engulf them. There is a fissure forming that I alone behold with open eyes. It will one day yawn and gape, and something will crawl from it that will shake the Hive's foundations.

Perhaps that thing is me.

They sense this possibility and cling to their imperative truth out of fear. To this end, Xivu Arath lies to herself continuously. With each deception she immures herself in a great fiction she must restore with each forming crack.

This is why they fear and revere their own logic. The first doubt, the oldest doubt, the entaoxuanna. It would destroy them.

To this end, Oryx's grand philosophy encompasses everything it touches. Every paradox, every conflict. Love is death, war is love, and what is at peace is sick. Even his defeat was a movement towards the final shape, as he knew that his killer would become him. In his logic, that is all his killer could become. It makes failures into proofs, so that their logic may weather them.

It will all collapse one day. I will make sure of it. I will break their truth by my becoming.

I have stolen much from the Hive. I took their eyes, their fetid magic, and now I have taken from them again. Each time I descend into the Deep, I take what I need, and take what I am owed. Just as the Taken King slew Akka to satiate his worm.

I see now. With all my years of study and strife, all my years of venturing into the dark so that I may put my eyes to good use, I have conjured him.

This is what Xivu Arath sees when she beholds my morph. Her brother, triumphant. Reborn.

In this way, I am truly loved.
3654788877.text_zh:
诗节8:11 - 真相 

邪魔族不是铁板一块。他们有内部矛盾、纷争、冲突。这些东西有可能会反噬他们。有裂缝在形成，只有我才能睁眼看清它。有一天它将张开大嘴，而里面爬出的东西会动摇邪魔族的根基。

也许那东西正是我。

他们感觉到了这一可能性，因恐惧而坚持自己重要的真相。为了这个目的，希乌阿拉斯不断地对自己撒谎。每一次欺骗，她都使自己被困在巨大的虚构之中，被迫修补上面出现的每道裂缝。

这就是为什么他们既恐惧又敬畏他们自己的守则。最初的怀疑，最古老的怀疑，超越死亡的恐惧。它会摧毁他们。

为了这个目的，欧里克斯的宏大哲学包含了它所接触的一切。每个悖论，每个冲突。爱即是死，战争即是爱，和平即是病。甚至他的失败也是走向终焉之形的步骤，因为他知道他的杀手会变成他本身。在他的守则中，他的杀手只能变成那样。它把失败变成证据，这样它们的守则就能经受得住失败。

它总有一天会彻底崩溃，我会确保这一点。我会通过我的降临击碎其真相。

我从邪魔族那里窃取了许多。我拿走了他们的眼睛，他们恶臭的魔法，而现在我又从他们那里夺取了。每一次我潜入深渊，我就夺取我需要的东西，拿走我被亏欠之物。正如邪神为满足蠕虫而斩杀了阿卡。

我现在明白了。通过多年来的学习和斗争，多年来为了用好我的眼睛而涉险踏入黑暗的举动，我召唤出了他。

当希乌阿拉斯看见我的蜕变时，这就是她所见的东西。她的兄弟，凯旋。重生。

我以这种方式被真正地爱着。

3654788878.name: XII — Savathûn — Love
3654788878.text:
Verse 8:12 — The Wish

Eris will comport herself beautifully.

I wish I could behold her morph. I can see it in my mind's eye. Her chitin will engulf her; her eyes will be uncovered. She will laugh! And what a delightful sound that will be, after everything! Genuine, full of my guile and my sister's zest for life.

I may still see her morph. There's still time. I'll be so proud of her.

It will seem like fate, something that couldn't have happened any other way. But Eris is smart enough to recognize my touch. She will realize it was me, and understand that this was what I made her for. She'll see all the intricacies of the path I have laid before her from the moment my nephew raised his sword.

Not too long ago, that understanding would have starved me. Now it's just icing on the cake.

I hope she's not too upset. Ah well. I'm sure she'll get over it.

There were contingencies, of course. It's foolish to put all your eggs in one basket. One must lay snares and set events in motion that may never quite snap into place.

But this? This was easy. Perfectly aligned.

Xivu Arath will make it clear why it had to be this way. She will do exactly what I know she will do because that is all she is ever able to do. Anything else would kill her.

Because in the end, my sister just wants someone to love, fully and completely. And she's given up on me.

So I will give her Eris Morn.
3654788878.text_zh:
诗节8:12 - 心愿

埃里斯会表现得很出色。

我希望我能观看她的蜕变。我可以在我脑海中看到那一幕。她的甲壳会裹住她；她的眼睛会露出来。她会笑！经历过那一切之后，那将是多么令人愉快的声音啊！发自内心而充满了我的狡诈与妹妹对生命的热情。

我也许还能看见她的蜕变。还有时间。我会为她自豪。

像是宿命一样，无法以另一种方式发生。但埃里斯足够聪明，能够辨认我的触摸。她会意识到那是我，理解这就是我创造她的目的。她会看到，从我侄子举起剑的那一刻起，我在她面前铺设的道路，以及其中所有错综复杂之处。

不久之前，那份理解会让我饿死。现在，它只是锦上添花。

希望她不是很沮丧。也罢。我确信她能走过那个坎。

应急方案自然是有。把赌注都押在一个地方太愚蠢。我们必须设下陷阱，触发那些可能永远不会恰当发生的事件。

但这个？这很简单。与计划一致。

希乌阿拉斯会表明为何非这样不可。她会做我预料中的事，因她只能那样做。其他做法会让她丧命。

因为归根结底，我的妹妹只是想去完全而彻底地爱某个人。而她已经放弃我了。

所以，我将把埃里斯·摩恩送给她。

3735834225.name: Process
3735834225.text:
Saint-14 and Osiris sat across from each other at the rough wooden table, focused on the array of wires, struts, and braces spread out before them. Mithrax had mentioned that his Splicer Gauntlet had been causing his arm to go numb, and Saint's overeager offer of assistance had turned into an evening of frustratingly meticulous tinkering. Mithrax had politely excused himself hours ago, but Saint and Osiris were so focused on their discussion of Savathûn's bargain they hardly noticed.

"We don't have a choice," Osiris said, threading a wire through the lacey frills of a tiny Ether converter. "The future the Witness is crafting beyond that portal is more terrible than we could dream. Anything is preferential to that."

"Anything but her," Saint grumbled.

"Even her," Osiris said defiantly. "If Savathûn knows how to pursue the Witness—and there is little reason to doubt that she does—we must work with her. There is no other way."

With an Exo's patient precision, Saint straightened a row of metal pins. "I do not know how you can say that. After everything."

Osiris raised his eyebrows. "I am a beacon of forgiveness," he said, but the words soured on his tongue.

"So you forgive her?" Saint didn't need to look up from his work.

"No," Osiris said quietly. He aligned a metal tab with its slot and pressed it into place, waiting to hear a click. It didn't come.

"The truth is," Osiris said, "I hardly think of her at all."

Saint looked at him flatly, but Osiris shrugged, his face open. "I know how it sounds. I have acknowledged what happened and… moved on, I suppose. I am here. Alive. With you. They say that's the best revenge, don't they?"

Saint coiled a stubborn spring and prepared to slide it into a support brace. "Is it revenge to allow the violator to avoid accountability?"

"The 'violator' is dead," Osiris said wryly. 

"And will live again if Eris and the Guardians fulfil this prophecy or prediction—" the spring shot from between Saint's fingers "—or whatever Savathûn wants to call this new trick!" 

Osiris heard the spring clatter in the corner near the kitchen and rose wordlessly to hunt for it. Saint sighed. "I do not know how you can be so calm," he said. "You sometimes act as though you do not remember what she did to you."

"I remember it all," he said softly, without turning away from the corner. "I remember being… helpless." The words caught in his throat. 

Saint pushed his chair back and stood, but Osiris was already back at the table, a dusty spring in the center of his palm. "There is still fury inside me," he said, "fury that I will probably carry forever. I acknowledge it, but I do not let it consume me. I control it, and I take strength from that."

Osiris placed the spring on the table and sat back down. Saint moved to his side. "Denying your emotions is not strength," Saint said carefully.

"I admit that, if I could, I'd change what happened," Osiris said. "But not if doing so changed where it led me." Osiris reached out and gave Saint a half-embrace around the hips.

"Have we finished talking about this now?" Osiris asked, and Saint heard the rawness in his voice. 

Saint kissed the top of Osiris's head and sat back down. It would have to be enough.
3735834225.text_zh:
圣人14号和奥斯里斯在粗糙的木桌前相对而坐，注视着散乱摆在他们面前的一堆电线、支杆和托架。由于米瑟拉克斯提到他的胳膊因为熔岩臂铠的缘故都麻木了，圣人很想帮忙，于是不得不花上一整晚在这木桌上慢慢捣鼓。其实米瑟拉克斯几个小时前就礼貌地告辞了，但由于圣人和奥斯里斯一直在激烈地讨论萨瓦图恩的提议，他俩都没注意到米瑟拉克斯已经不在了。

“我们没有选择，”奥斯里斯一边把电线穿过一个小乙太转换器的边缘，一边说道。“见证者在那个传送门对面设计的未来比我们想象的要糟糕得多。无论怎样都比那样好。”

“除了她，”圣人抱怨道。

“连她也比见证者好，”奥斯里斯强辩道。“要是萨瓦图恩知道如何追上见证者…再说，你也没有理由怀疑她…也就是说我们必须与她合作。别无他法。”

凭借Exo的耐性与精准度，圣人捋直了一排金属钉。“在经历了这么多事之后，我不知道你怎么还会这么想。”

奥斯里斯露出了诧异的神情。“我一向宽以待人，”他刚说到一半，那话就变了味。

“那你是原谅她了？”圣人埋着头说。

“没有，”奥斯里斯小声说道。他将一块金属板对准插槽，然后按了下去，等着一声代表完美入位的“咔擦”。然而那声音迟迟不来。

“其实，”奥斯里斯说，“我都没怎么想到她。”

圣人平淡地望着他，但奥斯里斯耸了耸肩，说：“我知道听上去有点怪。我知道发生了什么，但我觉得…我已经过了那个坎了。我现在在这里，还活着，和你在一起。这难道不算最好的复仇吗？”

圣人使劲把一根弹簧压了下去，准备将它放进一个托架里。“不让肇事者担负任何罪责能算复仇吗？”

“那个‘肇事者'已经死了，”奥斯里斯狡黠地说。 

“可她还会复活的，只要埃里斯和守护者能完成这个预言…”弹簧从圣人的手里弹飞了。“…谁知道萨瓦图恩把这个叫什么！” 

奥斯里斯听到弹簧在角落里落地的声音，于是一言不发地站起来找它。圣人叹了口气。“我不知道你是怎么保持冷静的，”他说。“你有时候好像已经不记得她对你做过什么了。”

“我都记得，”他温柔地说道，站在角落里，没有转身。“我记得…那种无助的感觉。”他哽咽了。 

圣人把椅子往后一推，站了起来，但奥斯里斯已经攥着弹簧回到了桌前。“我心里还是有怒火，”他说，“这股怒火可能会一直伴随我。我知道它的存在，但我不会让它支配我。我控制着它，从中汲取力量。”

奥斯里斯把弹簧放在桌上，然后坐了下去。圣人移到了他旁边的位置上。“压制你的感情不是力量的表现，”圣人小心地说。

“我承认，如果我可以的话，就一定会去改变所发生的一切，”他说。“但如果那样会改变现在的状态，那我就不会那么做。”奥斯里斯搂住圣人的腰，靠在他身上。

“这个话题说够了吗？”奥斯里斯问道。圣人听到了他嗓音中的直白。 

圣人吻了一下奥斯里斯的头顶，然后坐了下来。大概是说够了吧。

3735834226.name: A Matter of Distrust
3735834226.text:
As Ikora neared the console in the H.E.L.M., a voice cried out from the shadows as a figure lunged for her.

Ikora's hands moved reflexively to deflect the blow and deliver a killing strike, but she stopped after recognizing her attacker. She allowed Elsie to grab the front of her robes and shove her against the bulkhead.

"Were you even listening?" Elsie screamed, her hands shaking in frustration. "How many reports, Ikora? How many times did I tell you what I saw?" 

The pain in her voice tore at Ikora. 

She knew the stories almost as well as Elsie at this point: the Exo had traveled back from a future where Eris Morn held dominion over everything and even bent Savathûn to her will. It had not ended well.

Elsie pushed away and began to pace, furious.  

"Elsie," Ikora said gently. "I know the future you came from. But that is not this future."

"I have seen what happens when Eris Morn has unchecked power," Elsie hissed. "I have smelled the corpses." 

Ikora wanted to comfort Elsie but knew that any attempts at camaraderie would push her further away. Instead, she straightened her robes. "The Eris in your timeline was corrupted by Darkness," she said coolly. "We now understand how to wield the Darkness without becoming lost in it."

"Eris Morn was corrupted by POWER, Ikora," Elsie said. "The same power you're encouraging the Guardians to—to—" she nearly choked on the words, "—to tithe to her through Hive rituals! And you think that's somehow BETTER?!"

Ikora took a breath. "I hear you," she said with quiet authority. "And while I trust Eris, I will not lose my objectivity. If actions must be taken, I will take them."

Elsie shook her head. "I wonder if you said the same thing before your body was buried in the wreckage of the Tower."

Ikora waited. One cannot speak when the other is unwilling to listen, Osiris had once told—

"It's in her voice," Elsie said. She sounded small. She sounded truly afraid, Ikora realized. "You can hear it, even through her Hive transformation. When she speaks, she's smiling." 

Elsie took a careful breath. "When she led her troops from the Scarlet Keep. When she attacked the Traveler. When she turned us against each other and I was forced to…" 

Ikora reached out a hand to stop her from having to say it.

"To kill my sister," Elsie whispered, pleading for understanding. "To kill Ana. Eris was smiling that same smile."

Ikora laced her fingers together and looked at the floor.

"I won't watch it happen again," Elsie said, and her voice was ice.
3735834226.text_zh:
艾可拉正朝应急后勤行动中心里的控制台走去，阴影里传来一声尖叫，一个人影朝着她猛冲了过来。

艾可拉下意识地准备挡开攻击并夺走袭击者的性命，但她认出这人的身份后，就停了下来。她任凭艾尔西抓住她的法袍，将自己推向舱壁。

“你有没有在听？”艾尔西尖叫道，沮丧得连双手都在颤抖。“你还要多少份报告，艾可拉？我已经把我见到的东西告诉你多少次了？” 

她嗓音中的痛苦让艾可拉心疼。 

她现在几乎和艾尔西一样了解这个故事：这位Exo从一个被埃里斯·摩恩主宰的未来回到了现在。在那里，连萨瓦图恩也得受她的摆布。那不是什么好结局。

艾尔西把艾可拉推到一边，愤怒地来回踱步。  

“艾尔西，”艾可拉温柔地说，“我知道你来自的那个未来。但那个未来不在这个时间线上。”

“我亲眼看见了让埃里斯·摩恩获得无限的力量会发生什么事，”艾尔西嘶吼道。“我闻到过那些尸体的腐臭。” 

艾可拉想安慰艾尔西，但她知道任何试图建立情谊的做法都会把她推得更远。于是，她理了理她的法袍，反其道而行：“你的时间线上的埃里斯被暗影腐蚀了，”她冷静地说。“我们现在知道如何在不被暗影腐蚀的前提下操纵它。”

“埃里斯·摩恩是被力量腐蚀的，艾可拉，”艾尔西说。“就是你鼓励守护者们去…”她差点被这几个词噎住，“…去用邪魔族仪式进贡产生的力量！这又好得到哪去？！”

艾可拉吸了一口气。“我听到了你的想法，”她平静而权威权威地说道。“虽然我相信埃里斯，但我不会因此有失公正。如果有必要采取措施，那我不会犹豫。”

艾尔西摇了摇头。“不知道你被埋在高塔的废墟下之前有没有说过同样的话。”

艾可拉等了等。如果对方听不进去，说什么都没用。奥斯里斯以前说过…

“你可以从她的嗓音中听出来，”艾尔西说道。她听起来相当渺小…艾可拉意识到，她听起来非常害怕。“就算她变成了邪魔族，你还是能听到。她说话时，在微笑。” 

艾尔西小心翼翼地吸了一口气。“当她从猩红要塞带领部队出征时。当她攻击了旅行者时。当她让我们彼此反目成仇，而我被迫…” 

艾可拉伸出一只手，示意让她别说下去。

“杀死我的妹妹，”艾尔西低语道，乞求艾可拉的理解。“杀死阿娜时，埃里斯也那样微笑。”

艾可拉十指相扣，埋头看着地板。

“我不会眼看着这种事再次发生，”艾尔西说。她的语气冷冷的。

3735834227.name: Auspices
3735834227.text:
Drifter sidled through Eris's Athenaeum, poking at her occult doodads. Many of the unidentifiable objects were covered in one type of grime or another: wax, tallow, machine grease, or blood. He shook his head with affection, amazed that someone so sharp could be so sloppy. 

He spotted the Deck of Whispers spread haphazardly across Eris's lectern and strode across the room, gathering them into a clean pile. He'd had so many fortunes and misfortunes over his many lifetimes, he doubted another one would tip the scales either way. Drifter cut the deck fearlessly and flipped over the top card with a flourish. 

THE HARBINGER 

As he stared into the card, the magnitude of Eris's undertaking loomed large in his mind. For one dark instant, he allowed himself to consider the possibility of her failure. "Don't worry, Moondust," he muttered. "You got this."  

He casually placed the card back on top of the deck. "And when you're done, I'll be waiting."  

* * * 

Zavala eyed the Deck of Whispers warily. He had been touring Eris's base of operations when the cards caught his eye. They seemed to draw his attention with silent insistence.  

The commander had never been one to seek omens or portents. It wasn't that he chafed at the idea of cosmic forces influencing his fate; the far-reaching effects of the Traveler on his life had long put to rest his hubristic sense of self-determination. Rather, he distrusted the riddles that such oracular devices employed. He had heard too many of the Witch Queen's half-truths to trust anything but hard evidence anymore. And yet… 

Zavala picked up the deck and immediately sensed its power. It felt heavier than the weight of its materials. As he hefted it in his palm, a card slid from the middle of the deck, as if pulled by an unseen hand. Zavala watch gravely as it fell face up at his feet: 

LAMENT 

He gave a plaintive chuckle. Perhaps the oracles were not so difficult to interpret after all.  

* * * 

"Ikorakel?" Mithrax called out to the Athenaeum. He had come looking for the Warlock Vanguard on City business, but having found the space empty, he paused his search to scrutinize her latest operation. Mithrax had strong objections to Eris's use of Hive magic, but knew the Vanguard was not his House to command. 

He perused the esoteric artifacts littering the space with mild distaste. They reminded him too much of the relics of Nezarec, which had plagued his youth. As his gaze came to rest on the Deck of Whispers, he felt a familiar numbness spread throughout his chest. Though the sensation had become more prevalent in recent months, he'd told no one.  

As the Kell picked up the deck with his upper-right hand, he felt his Splicer Gauntlet pulse with energy. The cards were clearly imbued with a power beyond his experience. With his lower-left hand, he delicately withdrew a card and placed it face up on the table. 

ASCENSION 

Mithrax pondered the omen gravely. It reminded him of all the tribulations his House had suffered in coming to the Last City. Their ascension had been a violent and sorrowful one, filled with detractors. Yet the peace and security they found among the Humans had justified their risks. Now it was Eris who was walking into the sanctum of her mortal enemy to save her people. 

Mithrax shook his head in self-rebuke. Perhaps he'd been too rigid in his opinions regarding Eris Morn's mission. He owed her the same grace that the Vanguard had extended to him.  

He slid the card back into the middle of the deck and felt the numbness in his chest recede once again.
3735834227.text_zh:
浪客小心地在埃里斯的雅典娜神庙中穿行，把玩着各种各样的神秘物件。许多不明物体都被蜡、牛油、器油或是血包裹着。他深情地摇了摇头，对如此敏锐的人竟然会如此散漫感到惊讶。 

他瞥到了在埃里斯的占卜台上杂乱摊开的低语卡组，大步走到房间另一头，把它们收成整洁的牌堆。他心想，自己经历过了如此多的起起落落，再起伏一下也没什么大不了的。浪客无所畏惧地切开牌，然后用一个花哨的动作翻开了最上面的牌。 

先知 

他盯着这张牌，埃里斯的宏大任务随即在他的脑海里展开。在那阴郁的一瞬间，他放任自己去考虑失败的可能性。“别担心，小月月，”他嘟囔道。“你能行的。”  

他随意地把这张卡牌放回了卡组顶部。“我会等你回来。”  

* * * 

萨瓦拉谨慎地看着低语卡组。他在参观埃里斯的行动基地的途中注意到了这副卡牌。它们似乎在不断吸引着他。  

指挥官从没寻求过预兆或预言。但这不代表他不认为宇宙中的神秘力量会影响他的命运；旅行者带来的深远影响早已使他那“命不由天”的傲慢消失了。他所怀疑的只是这种占卜工具令人迷惑的表述方式。他已经听过太多巫妖女王半真半假的话，以至于不会再相信没有根据的东西。然而… 

萨瓦拉拿起卡组，即刻就感到了其中的力量。它似乎比其材料更重。在他把这副沉重的卡组托在手上时，一张卡牌如同被无形的手抽出一般，滑到了一旁。萨瓦拉脸色严峻地看着这张卡面朝上地掉在他的脚下。 

挽歌 

他哀怨地笑了笑。也许神谕也不是那么难以解释。  

* * * 

“艾可拉凯尔？”米瑟拉克斯朝着雅典娜神庙大喊道。他是来找术士先锋商讨圣城事务的，但发现这地方没人后，他停下搜寻，仔细地查看起她的最新行动来。米瑟拉克斯本来就强烈反对埃里斯使用邪魔族魔法，但他也知道先锋不是归他指挥的氏族。 

他略带厌恶地看着遍布这个房间的奇异物件。这些让他想起自己年轻时困扰不已的奈扎雷克圣物。当他的目光落到低语卡组上时，他感到胸中升起了一股熟悉的麻木感。虽然这几个月这种感觉越来越明显，但他还没有把这事告诉其他人。  

凯尔用他的右上臂拿起卡组，顿时感到熔岩臂铠中有能量涌动。这些卡牌显然含有一股他并不了解的能量。他用左下臂小心地抽了一张卡放在桌上。 

飞升 

米瑟拉克斯严肃地思考着这个预兆。这让他想起了他的氏族在抵达圣城前所遭受的磨难。他们的飞升充满了暴力和悲伤，而且总有诋毁者出现。但他们在人类中间找到了和平与安宁，这证明了他们的冒险是值得的。而现在，为了拯救人类，埃里斯走进了夙敌的圣殿。 

米瑟拉克斯自责地摇摇头。也许他对埃里斯·摩恩的任务的看法太一根筋了。他应该像当初先锋接纳他那样，去接纳埃里斯。  

他把卡放回了卡组中间。他胸中的麻木顿时退去了。

3735834228.name: An Invocation
3735834228.text:
Titan's methane oceans roiled. Saturn's crushing gravity caused massive tidal waves to surge across the moon's surface.  

In the comforting blackness beneath the waves, the tides swelled and contracted like the breath of a great beast. Within that churn of elemental forces, the proto-worm Ahsa slumbered. 

She was not "asleep" in any sense her bonded Guardian would understand. For the frail Humans, sleep was a frantic, uninhibited state. Their minds roamed freely between terror, ecstasy, and oblivion. It was not a condition that Ahsa recognized as "restful." 

Instead, the proto-worm's attention drifted peacefully among quantum fields unspoiled by physics or matter. Her consciousness diffused from the dense thoughtforms used by the Humans to a more expansive state of being. She was as a mist upon the face of the cosmos. Time flowed through her as a tranquil breeze. 

|Ahsa| 

Her serenity was suddenly eroded. As if a gyre had suddenly formed beneath her mind, sucking her inexorably back into her body. She felt herself sink. 

| Akka… Xita… Sel… Ahsa… Ora… Leis…| 

The crushing density of her material form suddenly weighed her down. She calmed herself as she re-identified the oppressive forces as mere physical sensation.  

| I separate the true from the dead. | 

The phenomenon pulling her back was familiar. A Human voice. The words were sharp and pointed. They smelled of putrefaction. Despair. Violence.  

| I am the many-mouthed hunger. I am the knife-edged truth. | 

The voice grew stronger, like a saprophytic fungus blossoming on a carcass. It spread its mycelial tendrils through her mind. An invocation.  

She knew intuitively that she could withdraw from this connection if she desired. The will of the unseen voice was not so strong as to enthrall her. Not yet.  

| I devour the free. I conspire with my vengeance. | 

Ahsa suppressed the urge to recoil. Beneath the ritual words, she recognized a discordant note. One of… altruism. The speaker was sacrificing themself as well. They proposed mutual tribulation for a greater purpose: the survival of the universe. 

Their reciprocal apprehension gave her solace. Ahsa opened herself up, allowing the voice to resonate within her.  

| I will take what I need. The words in my throat are the weapon in my fist. | 

The gruesome nature of the speaker's method became clear: Ahsa was to become a vessel for their harvested power. A battery for the profane logic—just like her corrupted kin.  

Waves of conflicting emotion cascaded through Ahsa as memories of her flight from Fundament resurfaced. After her escape, Ahsa had spent millennia in grief for her lost brethren. But always dormant beneath the surface of her despair was a faint gleam of hope, like buried treasure. A hope that one day, she might redeem their depravity. 

A hope which now rose to the surface wielding the very sword she once fled. 

|Aiat, aiat, aiat!| 

Upon the final invocation, Ahsa perceived the fullness of her caller's intent. They sought power not for themself, or even their species. They fought to preserve the very cosmos as they knew it. To save it from the cruel grasp of a wounded tyrant, using the only tool they could.  

The proto-worm imagined the universe swelling and contracting like the tides. Beyond the reckoning of any one being. When moved by such swells, one could only accept their impetus, making of them the best one could. 

From her bonding with Sloane, Ahsa knew this was what Humans called "fate."
3735834228.text_zh:
土卫六的甲烷海翻滚着。土星的压迫性引力导致巨大的潮汐在这颗卫星的表面涌动。  

在海浪下沉静的黑暗中，潮汐像一头巨兽的呼吸一样膨胀和收缩。在这股汹涌的元素力量之下，原生蠕虫阿莎沉睡着。 

她的“睡眠”跟与她联系的那位守护者的睡眠完全不同。对于弱小的人类来说，睡眠是一种疯狂的、不受约束的状态。他们的思维在恐怖、狂喜和忘我之间自由游走。这对阿莎来说并不算“休息”。 

相反，这只原生蠕虫的注意力在未被物理学或物质污染的量子领域中平静地飘荡。她的意识从人类那样密集的思想形式扩散到一个更广阔的存在状态。她就像宇宙表面的一层薄雾。时间像宁静的微风一样在她身边拂过。 

|阿莎| 

她的宁静突然被侵蚀了。她的意识下仿佛突然出现了一个漩涡，把她无情地吸回了她的身体。她感到自己在下沉。 

|阿卡…西塔…塞尔…阿莎…奥拉…莱斯…| 

她的物质形态的密度突然让她不堪重负。当她把这些压迫性的力量判定为单纯的躯体触感时，她平静了下来。  

|我将真实与死亡分离。| 

把她往回拉的现象让她感觉很熟悉。那是一个人类的声音。话语很尖锐，很有针对性。散发着腐烂、绝望、暴力的气味。  

|我是贪婪的渴求。我是刀锋的真理。| 

这个声音越来越强，就像在一具尸体上生长的腐生菌。它的菌丝状卷须在她的脑海中蔓延。像是一种祈祷。  

她的直觉告诉她，如果愿意，她可以从这种联系中离开。那个未知声音的意志还没有强到让她无法自拔的程度。暂时还没有。  

|我吞噬自由。我与复仇共谋。| 

阿莎压住了往后退的冲动。在这些仪式话语之下，她听到了一个不和谐的音符。为了别人…奉献自己。说话的人也在牺牲自己，承诺共同分担磨难，来达成一个更重要的目的：宇宙的存续。 

她与说话者能相互理解，这让她很宽慰。阿莎敞开自己，让声音在她体内产生共鸣。  

|我需要的必会夺下。我口中的话语就是拳中的武器。| 

说话者的残酷方法暴露无遗：阿莎会成为收割能量的容器，成为邪恶守则的电池——就像她那些被腐化的兄弟姐妹一样。  

矛盾的情绪一波又一波地涌向阿莎，她逃离虫群据点的记忆再次浮现。在逃亡后的几千年里，阿莎一直在为她失去的兄弟姐妹们感到悲痛。但在她绝望的表面下，始终蛰伏着一丝微弱的希望，像是一个被埋藏起来的宝藏。那就是有一天能救赎他们的堕落。 

这个希望现在浮出了水面，挥舞着她曾经逃离的那把刀剑。 

|阿特，阿特，阿特！| 

伴着最后一段祷告，阿莎完全领会了召唤者的意图。他寻求权力并不是为了自己，甚至不是为了他的种族。 他为保护自己所知道的宇宙而奋斗。为了使用仅有的工具，从受伤暴君的残忍之握中拯救它。  

这只原生蠕虫想象着宇宙如潮汐般膨胀和收缩。任何一个生命都无法预知未来。当被这样的浪潮推动时，只能接受，并尽自己最大的努力去利用它们。 

自从她与斯隆建立联系起，阿莎便知道这就是人类说的“宿命”。

3735834229.name: A Big Fan
3735834229.text:
Immaru floated at the edge of the large crowd, waiting for an opportune moment. He tried to remain inconspicuous.  

The Hive Ghost had snuck out of the Tower, leaving his bone-ridge shell behind to avoid unwanted attention. He filched an old Shaded Shell from an office junk drawer. The sunglasses made it perfect for sneaking around undercover. Given the gaudy shells these preening Tower Ghosts wore, Immaru was sure his new appearance would go unnoticed. 

He wandered around the Last City for a while, watching the citizens putter from one inane task to the next. Since resurrecting Savathûn, Immaru had been witness to the creation of a throne world, cosmic-level spellcraft, and interplanetary invasions. Being pent up with the Humans, watching them haggle over the price of charred carrion skewers, was maddening.   

He was nearly bored enough to return to the Tower when a stream of rowdy celebrants piqued his interest. They poured into the streets from houses, bars, and betting parlors—all making their way toward the edge of the City. Immaru floated among them.  

The crowd eventually arrived at the perimeter of an abandoned military base. Well-to-do patrons filtered past Redjacks into the base, while most of the crowd gathered around enormous screens set up outside. The screens displayed the opening salvos of a Crucible match, and Immaru could detect changes in air pressure as the Guardians bombarded each other within the facility. 

After the match's brutal conclusion, the crowd dispersed. A few die-hard fans waited around the gate to congratulate the participants. Eventually, the Crucible's boisterous announcer emerged to receive his fans' well-wishes. Once the crowd had thinned, Immaru floated up to the one-horned Guardian. 

"I love what you're doing here, big guy," Immaru effused. "I got friends who would be very into your whole kill-or-be-killed vibe."  

Immaru could sense Lord Shaxx blinking beneath his helmet, trying to place the Ghost's voice. "Well met. Perhaps your friends will join us on the field!" 

"Oh, you met some of 'em already," Immaru chuckled. "You got a lot in common, actually."  

Immaru raised his voice in imitation of the Titan's booming commentary: "'ONLY THE STRONG SURVIVE,' 'MAKE PAIN YOUR ALLY,' 'DYING IS AN ESSENTIAL ELEMENT.' That's right in their wheelhouse. You might even call it a philosophy." 

"Well, the Crucible is more than just senseless violence," Shaxx patiently explained. "It's about honor and fair play. It's about bringing the best out in one another and rising above our limitations." 

"I totally understand," Immaru said, chuckling inwardly at the Titan's canned rhetoric. "The goal is to be the sharpest we can be. And anyone who can't handle the edge gets cut. There's a certain… logic to it." 

"I'm glad you enjoyed yourself," Shaxx said as his gleaming Sparrow materialized beside him. "But remember: the Crucible is about more than just combat. More than just Guardians. It's about putting our differences aside and uniting everyone in the City. Including the Ghosts," he seemed to wink. 

"I'm a big fan," Immaru gushed. "Thank you for uniting so many different types of people. More than I could have imagined." 

"Many thanks for your support," Shaxx hollered as he revved the engines on his Sparrow. "I hope to see you and your friends again soon. Until next time!" The massive Guardian gave his admirer a brief salute and sped off into the City. 

Immaru watched the Titan recede into the distance. "Whatever tickles your trigger finger, buddy," he muttered. 

The Hive Ghost floated off toward the Tower, renewed in his purpose. At least now he knew what the Witch Queen saw in the Humans. Maybe they would come around after all.
3735834229.text_zh:
伊马鲁漂浮在一大群人的边缘，等待一个合适的时机。他不想被发现。  

这只邪魔族机灵溜出了高塔，并脱下了那套骨骼机壳，以免引起注意。他从一个办公桌的抽屉里摸走了一个遮阳外壳。太阳镜使这个外壳成了秘密潜行的完美选择。高塔的高贵机灵们一个个都披着华丽的外壳，伊马鲁确信他的新外观不会引人注目。 

他在圣城里四处溜达了一会儿，看着市民们庸庸碌碌地干着杂活。自萨瓦图恩重生以来，伊马鲁已经见识过了王座世界的创生，宇宙级的法术，以及跨位面的入侵。现在他却非得和人类为伍，看着他们为烤焦的腐肉串讨价还价，这快把他逼疯了。   

当他几乎无聊到想回到高塔时，一群喧闹的庆祝者引起了他的兴趣。他们从房屋、酒吧和投注站中涌入街道——向城市的边缘走去。伊马鲁飘荡在他们中间，一同往那边飞去。  

人群最终来到了一个废弃的军事基地附近。富裕的看客们在经过红桃杰克的检查后进入了基地，不过大多数人还是留在了基地外的大屏幕周围。大屏幕上播放着一场熔炉竞技场比赛的开局场面，而伊马鲁在这里都能感受到守护者在场地内战斗时引起的气压变化。 

在这场比赛迎来暴力的结尾后，人群也散去了。有几个铁杆粉丝站在大门旁，等候着向参赛者表示祝贺。过了一会儿，熔炉竞技场的大嗓门解说员为接受粉丝的祝愿出现了。当人群散去后，伊马鲁飞到了这位独角守护者的身旁。 

“我太喜欢你的解说了，大块头，”伊马鲁说。“我有一些朋友，他们会很喜欢你喊打喊杀的风格。”  

伊马鲁能感到领主沙克斯在头盔下眨了眨眼，试图分辨出这个机灵的嗓音。“你好。也许你的朋友可以来竞技场里玩玩！” 

“啊，你其实已经见过几位了，”伊马鲁笑着说。“你们其实有很多共同点。”  

伊马鲁提高声音，模仿着这位泰坦的大嗓门：“‘强者生存'，‘把不甘化为力量'，‘死亡是核心元素'。这几句简直太对他们的胃口了。甚至可以称之为哲学。” 

“嗯，熔炉竞技场不仅是无意义的暴力，”沙克斯耐心地解释道。“这些比赛关乎荣誉与公平竞争。让大家可以展露彼此最优秀的一面，并超越我们的极限。” 

“我非常理解，”伊马鲁一边说，一边在心里对这位泰坦充满克制的说辞发笑。“目的是去磨砺自己。任何没有能耐的人都会被淘汰。这其中遵循着…一些守则。” 

“你喜欢就好，”沙克斯说着，唤出了他闪亮的快雀。“但记住：熔炉竞技场不仅是为了战斗而存在。也不仅是为了守护者而存在。它是为了把我们的分歧撇到一边，团结圣城里的每个人而存在。包括机灵，”他似乎挤了挤眼。 

“我是你的超级粉丝，”伊马鲁兴奋地说道。“谢谢你把各种各样的人团结起来。远超我的想象。” 

“感谢你的支持，”沙克斯一边在快雀上轰着油门，一边喊道。“我希望还能再见到你和你的朋友。下次见！”这位壮硕的守护者向他的粉丝致了个敬，然后往圣城的方向飙了过去。 

伊马鲁看着这位泰坦的背影消失在远方。“只要能让你手痒想开枪就行，兄弟，”他嘟囔道。 

这位邪魔族机灵朝高塔飘去，似乎心中有了新的目标。至少现在他明白了巫妖女王看中了人类哪一点。也许他们还有救。

3735834230.name: Contingency Plans
3735834230.text:
"In the end, they'll accept your offer. The Witness won't leave them any choice." Savathûn's voice echoed throughout the empty ritual chamber. Immaru floated in the middle of the vast space, listening intently to his boss's pre-recorded instructions.  

"With the Warmind gone and the Traveler incapacitated, they'll only have one option left," Savathûn's recorded voice cooed. "They'll have to do things our way. And you'll be there to make sure they do." 

Immaru grumbled. The boss was betting a lot on the Vanguard. More than she bet on her own brood! Pride stung the edges of the First Ghost's ego. He'd been an exemplary leader in Savathûn's absence. If anything, he should be the one overseeing the war effort against Xivu Arath! 

Then again, he placated himself, maybe it wasn't a matter of competency. Maybe the Witch Queen just saw the Vanguard as more expendable than her own brood. Hell, he chuckled to himself, maybe this was all just a long con to lead the Vanguard into Xivu's waiting jaws. Only the boss knew for sure. 

Immaru initiated playback on another recording, preparing to enact whichever of the hundreds of Savathûn's contingencies came to pass. 

"If Ikora Rey is the one to accept my bargain, your job will be much easier," the recording began. "That one has a deep well of bloodthirst. She ruled the Crucible for many years, as you recall. Her eagerness to be reacquainted with death will lead her back to her convoluted ideas on 'thanatonautics.'"  

"If anything, she'll get too powerful too quickly," the absent Savathûn mused. "If that happens, just arrange for her to accidentally kill one of her own. Glint, perhaps. That should slow her down for a while. Don't worry about putting her off for good, though. Once she feels the power of the sword, she'll never stop." 

Immaru was filled with admiration and suspicion. He wondered if there was a trove of Savathûn's contingencies somewhere that involved his sacrifice. Surely not. He was too important for that. He initiated playback on another recording. 

"If the Awoken queen somehow discovers the pattern before I'm resurrected," the Witch Queen began, "the Guardians may attempt to take the heirloom by force. It won't be Mara's idea, of course. But my dear Osiris, in his cleverness, might talk them into a poor decision." 

"In that case, it won't be worth fighting them off. That would only play to Xivu's advantage. Instead, deliver the heirloom to the Cabal empress," Savathûn continued. "She has more reason than any to use it against my sister, and a protracted war of attrition will be inevitable. While those two rip each other apart, you can approach the Vanguard with a slightly modified deal—" 

Immaru cut off the recording. He hoped it wouldn't come to that. The Vanguard had already guaranteed his safety, but the Cabal had made no such assurances. Showing up on their doorstep with the heirloom was the last thing he wanted. He initiated another recording. 

"If all goes to my original plan, Eris will reach a crossroads." A hint of concern snuck into Savathûn's voice. "At some point, she'll glimpse a path to overcome my sister without resurrecting me at all. But there's only one way to gather so many tithes in so short a time: she would have to put the Vanguard to the sword. Followed swiftly by the Eliksni and Cabal. The Hive she would spare, I think, for her convenience."  

"If that happens," Savathûn concluded, "there are no more contingencies. No more fallbacks. The Hive would have a new queen… and you a new leader. Wouldn't that be interesting."
3735834230.text_zh:
“到了最后，他们肯定会接受你的条件。见证者不会留下其他选择。”萨瓦图恩的声音在空荡荡的仪式间里回荡。伊马鲁在这个巨大房间中飘荡，仔细倾听着老大预录的指示。  

“战争思维已失效，旅行者丧失了能力，他们现在只有一个选择，”萨瓦图恩的录音柔声说道。“他们只能照我们的方式解决这个问题。而你得确保他们会这样做。” 

伊马鲁有些不满。老大在先锋上押了太多。比她在自己的虫群上押得还多！这刺痛了这位第一机灵的自尊。在萨瓦图恩不在时，他一直是一个模范领袖。他才是那个应该监督对希乌阿拉斯作战的机灵！ 

然后，他又安慰自己，也许这不是能力的问题。也许巫妖女王只是认为先锋比她自己的虫群更适合当炮灰。他甚至还笑着对自己说，也许这一切只是一个把先锋引到希乌嘴里的漫长骗局。只有老大才知道真相。 

伊马鲁又播起了另一段录音，以便为萨瓦图恩做好实施上百个应急方案的准备。 

“如果艾可拉·蕾伊接受我的条件，你的工作会轻松许多，”录音开始播放了。“那个人的心中有一口深邃的嗜血之井。你可能记得，她称霸了熔炉竞技场许多年。她渴望重新认识死亡，这会带她回到‘渡灵学'的扭曲理念当中。”  

“万一她变强得太快，”萨瓦图恩的录音笑了。“万一真的发生那种事，就让她意外杀掉一个自己人。也许格林特是个不错的目标。那应该能让她慢下脚步一阵子。别担心你会扼杀她的意志。只要她尝到邪剑的力量，就绝不会停下。” 

伊马鲁充满了敬意与怀疑。他想知道，萨瓦图恩是否准备了一堆要求他牺牲自己的应急方案。应该不会有吧。他可是个很重要的角色。他又播放了一段录音。 

“若觉醒者女王在我重生之前发现了规律，”巫妖女王说道，“守护者也许会试图强行夺走传家宝。那当然不会是玛拉的主意，而是我亲爱的奥斯里斯的点子。他的聪明才智也许会使先锋做出错误的决定。” 

“那样的话，抵抗他们没什么意义。那只会使情况对希乌更有利。这种情况下，传家宝应该被送到卡巴尔女帝手上，”萨瓦图恩继续道。“她最有理由用它来对抗我的妹妹。这样一来，长时间的消耗战便不可避免。当他们试图摧毁对方时，你可以带着一份稍微不同的条件去找先锋…” 

伊马鲁中断了录音。他希望情况不会变成那样。先锋已经保证了他的安全，但卡巴尔没做那样的担保。带着传家宝上门找卡巴尔是他最不愿意做的事情。他又播放起了另一条录音。 

“如果一切按我的原计划进行，埃里斯会来到一个十字路口。”萨瓦图恩的语气里夹杂着一丁点担忧。“她迟早会找到一个在不复活我的情况下对付我妹妹的办法。但要在短时间内收集足够的贡品只有一个途径：献祭先锋。埃里克斯尼族和卡巴尔也难逃一死。而她为了自己方便，大概会放过邪魔族。”  

“要是真走到那一步，”萨瓦图恩总结道，“就没有应急方案了。也没有退路可言。邪魔族将获得一位新的女王…而你也会得到一位新的领袖。这不是很有趣吗。”

3735834231.name: A Deal's a Deal
3735834231.text:
The air still sizzled with dissipating soulfire as the Guardian and Ikora knelt beside Eris. An eruption of Light illuminated the thick smoke behind them, and Savathûn rose again, laughing.

"I suppose I had that coming," the towering god said as she rubbed her renewed throat. She slowly tilted her head. 

"Something's different," she said carefully. "I don't feel her."

Immaru darted up to Savathûn's eye level. "After she took your power, Eris called up Xivu's throne world and did something that cut her off from it." He floated to Savathûn's shoulder and glared down at Eris.

"Banished from her own throne world?" Savathûn cackled gleefully as she approached. "Eris, you overachiever, how I love you! I wound you up, and you ran right over her!"

Savathûn crouched, peering at Eris's collapsed form with intense curiosity. "I'm surprised expending that much power didn't kill you outright," she said, "though it explains why you're back in that awful little meatbody of yours."

Eris propped herself up on one elbow. Ikora moved to help her rise, but Eris waved her off. "Our bargain is complete," she said. "Your sister has been dealt with, and you live again."

"Now," Eris demanded, her uncovered eyes glowing fiercely. "Tell us how to follow the Witness."

"Tell you?" Savathûn frowned, her voice edged with disappointment. "I already showed you."

Ikora leapt to her feet, roaring Void energy distorting the air around her. She took a measured step toward Savathûn. 

"No tricks, no riddles, no lies twisted around the truth," she said, her voice firm. "Tell us now, or I don't have any reason to let you leave here alive."

Savathûn slowly drew herself to her full height and grinned down at Ikora, spreading her wings wide. "Eris may have managed an interesting sword logic stunt, but I have lost none of my power." She began to hover, her talons dragged across the ground as she floated toward the Warlock. "You're in no position to stop me."

The Guardian rose from Eris's side. 

"I am," they said.

Savathûn paused for a long moment, her ossified face unreadable. 

Finally, she sighed. 

"Just when you were starting to impress me," she said as she closed her wings and stooped to Ikora's height. Immaru bobbed awkwardly to keep level with her. 

"We both need to stop the Witness, and to that end, I have given you what I promised," she said slowly. "You will find you have it when you are ready. Like Eris said: our bargain is complete. There's no need for drama."

Ikora gritted her teeth. 

Savathûn shrugged. "Pout all you like, Ikora," she said. "It's not a trick. And if you won't take my word for it, then—" Savathûn looked around the ritual space of her throne world. 

Her eyes settled on Immaru, and she smiled. "Take him." 

"What?!" sputtered Immaru. 

Savathûn ignored him. "Take Immaru, my loyal Ghost, my connection to the Light," she continued, dropping to one knee in supplication. "I leave him with the Vanguard willingly, so if you would rather give me my final death than stop the Witness…" 

Savathûn closed her claws in a fist. "Crunch," she purred. "Capisce?"

Immaru flew between Savathûn and Ikora. "Don't I get a say in this?" he shouted. 

"No!" Savathûn laughed. "You have your orders. And the rest of you," she gestured at Ikora, the Guardian, and Eris, who had drawn herself unsteadily to her feet, "Don't mess this up. The Witness wants to sweep our pieces from the board, and we're having such a lovely game."

Savathûn turned, wings trailing like a gown, and Ikora took a half-step forward. The Guardian was at her side in an instant. Eris placed a hand on Ikora's shoulder: Don't.

"Take care of yourself, Eris," Savathûn said. "It was such fun seeing your mask slip." 

The delighted laughter of the Queen of Lies echoed through the ritual chamber as she vanished down the long hallway.
3735834231.text_zh:
当守护者和艾可拉跪在埃里斯身边时，空气中残留的灵魂之火仍在嘶嘶作响。一道光能照亮了他们身后的浓烟，萨瓦图恩大笑着从中升起。

“我猜那是我活该，”高大的邪神一边抚摸着她的新喉咙一边说道。她慢慢地歪了歪头。 

“有些不一样的地方，”她谨慎地说。“我感觉不到她。”

伊马鲁赶紧飞到了萨瓦图恩的眼前。“在她夺走你的力量之后，埃里斯召唤出了希乌的王座世界，然后不知用什么方法将她与那个世界切断了。”他飞到萨瓦图恩的肩膀上，俯视着埃里斯。

“把她从她自己的王座世界里放逐了？”萨瓦图恩一边走过来，一边咯咯发笑。“埃里斯，你太争气了，我爱死你了！我一激你，你就把她踩在了脚下！”

萨瓦图恩蹲在她身旁，以极度好奇的眼光打量着瘫倒的埃里斯。“我很吃惊，消耗那么多能量竟然没让你断气，”她说，“不过你回到那孱弱的肉体之中也就说得通了。”

埃里斯用手肘把自己支了起来。艾可拉走上前搀扶，但埃里斯示意不用。“我们的交易完成了，”她说。“你的妹妹已经被消灭，你也重生了。”

“现在，”埃里斯大声要求道。她暴露在外的眼睛闪着凶猛的光芒。“告诉我们怎样追踪到见证者。”

“告诉你们？”萨瓦图恩皱起眉头，她的声音中带着失望。“我已经展示给你们了。”

艾可拉噌的一下站了起来，虚空能量扭曲着周围的空气。她朝萨瓦图恩谨慎地迈了一步。 

“别耍花招，别说谜语，也别讲夹杂着谎言的实话，”她坚定地说。“快点告诉我们，否则我不可能留你的性命。”

萨瓦图恩慢慢地站了起来，张开了翅膀，对艾可拉露出了笑容。“埃里斯也许用邪剑守则给你表演了个精彩的节目，但我的力量一点也没减退。”她浮在半空中，爪子拖在地上，飘向了这位术士。“你阻止不了我。”

守护者从埃里斯身旁站了起来。 

“但我能，”守护者说。

萨瓦图恩停顿了很久。没人知道她那张僵硬的脸后面在想什么。 

最后，她叹了一口气。 

“我刚开始要对你刮目相看呢，”她一边说，一边俯下身来，与艾可拉齐平。为了和她待在同一个高度，伊马鲁尴尬地随着她飞动。 

“我们都需要阻止见证者，而我为此将兑现我的允诺，”她缓慢地说。“你在做好准备时便会得到它。就像埃里斯说的那样：我们的交易完成了。没必要搞出多余的事。”

艾可拉咬紧了牙关。 

萨瓦图恩耸了耸肩。“随你怎么噘嘴，艾可拉，”她说。“这不是一个花招。要是你不信我的话，那就…”萨瓦图恩环视了一下王座世界的仪式空间。 

她的目光停在伊马鲁上，然后笑了。“把他带走吧。” 

“什么？！”伊马鲁惊叫道。 

萨瓦图恩无视他的反应。“把我忠实的机灵伊马鲁带走吧，它是我与光能的联结。”她一边说着，一边单膝跪下。“我自愿将他交给先锋，要是你们宁愿让我死，而不是去阻止见证者，就…” 

萨瓦图恩握起了她的利爪。“嘎吱，”她咕哝道。“懂我意思吧？”

伊马鲁在萨瓦图恩和艾可拉之间飞来飞去。“这事我没有发言权吗？”他大叫道。 

“当然没有！”萨瓦图恩笑了。“你已经领命了。至于其他人，”她对艾可拉和守护者，以及勉强站起来的埃里斯说道，“别搞砸了。见证者想把我们的棋子扫下棋盘，可我们玩得多么尽兴啊。”

萨瓦图恩转过身去，翅膀就像长袍一般拖在她的身后。艾可拉向前走了半步。守护者一个箭步走到了她身旁。埃里斯也把手放在了艾可拉的肩膀上：别这么做。

“照顾好你自己，埃里斯，”萨瓦图恩说。“看见你脱下面具的样子太有趣了。” 

谎言女王爽朗的笑声在仪式间里回荡。她消失在了长廊的尽头。

3735834232.name: Proportionality
3735834232.text:
Savathûn flew heavily through the shifting skies of her Throne World. She struggled to build speed; her wings seemed frustratingly stiff following her resurrection. She felt slow and uncoordinated, as if her body was not yet entirely her own. She frowned and drifted to the side, favoring her right, and did not see the spinning disk of Void energy until it caught her low in the thorax and sent her tumbling to the ground.

There was a terrible noise, a flash of purple metal, and then… it was over.

Immaru materialized in a burst of Light. He looked down at Savathûn, and then up to Saint-14, who stood over her body.

"Already?" Immaru muttered in disbelief. 

Saint's face was hidden beneath his helmet. The lavender ribbons on his armor swayed and trailed with each heavy breath. It took him a moment to acknowledge the Ghost. 

"I heard you were in Vanguard custody," Saint said.

"I'm not a prisoner," Immaru sniffed. "More like an insurance policy. Anyway, I could sense something happened and Eris let me come down and check it out."

Saint nodded, his focus still on Savathûn. "Something happened, yes," he said, and nudged the pile of broken chitin and crumpled wings with his boot.

Immaru hovered close to Savathûn. "I'm not even gonna ask," he said while channeling his Light. 

Savathûn rose to her knees. She took a raspy breath, opened her eyes, and found Saint. She smiled. "For Os—"

Saint stopped her.

Immaru flew into Saint's face. "All right!" he shouted. "You've made your point!"

Saint wiped the steaming ichor from his visor with a thumb and gestured to Savathûn's remains. "Again," he said pointedly. 

"Yeah, I don't think so," Immaru replied and initiated his transmat.

Saint suddenly flared with Void energy. He threw his palms out to his sides, and a violet Ward of Dawn dome burst from him. 

Immaru felt it ripple through him like a pressure wave, disrupting his transmission. He bobbed unsteadily—he was unable to see. But he could feel, and now Saint's armored hand gripped him so tightly that a hairline split ran through his shell. 

"You will bring her back," Saint said.

"I'm getting a little tired of you people threatening to kill me," Immaru said into the muffled void.

Saint's fist loosened by a fraction. "You will bring her back, and I give my word that you and she will both leave when I am finished." 

"When you're finished?" Immaru echoed, and he felt Saint release him. He sensed for Savathûn's form hidden in the blackness. He grimaced, focused his Light, and Savathûn began to rise once more.

"Savathûn," Saint said, and killed her. 

"You are very new to resurrection as a Lightbearer."

"In the beginning, there is a weakness when you first come back."

"Like waking from a deep sleep. From a coma."

"That is why I can best you; you are still unsteady."

"You are Hive, and you know suffering. You come from death. It is nothing to you."

"But I think, maybe, you do not know how it feels to be helpless."

"I will teach you."

***

After a long, long time, Saint was finished. The dome vanished, exposing the Exo, the Ghost, and the god to the murky Throne World sky. 

Saint slowly keyed in his transport request and removed his helmet. As he transmatted out, he looked once more at Savathûn. 

"This was not for Osiris," he said, his voice hoarse and ragged. 

"This was for me."

***

When Saint returned home, Osiris met him at the door. "You were gone for a while. That must have been quite the patrol," he said. "Are you hungry?"

And Saint-14—the greatest Titan who ever lived—fell into his open arms and wept.
3735834232.text_zh:
萨瓦图恩托着沉重的身体在王座世界翻滚的天空中飞行。她仿佛没法提升速度；她的翅膀似乎在复活后变得格外僵硬。她感觉异常迟钝，动作也毫无协调，像是她还没习惯她的身体。她皱了皱眉头，向右侧偏了过去。她没能注意到正朝她飞来的、高速旋转着的虚空能量。她的胸口下方被击中，翻滚着坠落在地。

一声巨大的闷响，紫色金属闪过，然后…结束了。

伊马鲁伴着一束光能显现出来。他往下看了看萨瓦图恩，然后抬头看了看站在尸体上方的圣人14号。

“这么快？”伊马鲁难以置信地咕囔道。 

圣人的脸被隐藏在了他的头盔之下。他护甲上的紫色缎带随着每一次沉重的呼吸而摇摆和拖曳。他过了一会儿才察觉到机灵的存在。 

“我听说你被先锋关押起来了，”圣人说。

“我不是囚犯，”伊马鲁轻蔑地说。“我更像是个保险。长话短说，我能感觉到发生了什么事，所以埃里斯让我过来看看。”

圣人点了点头。他的注意力依然在萨瓦图恩身上。“确实发生了点事，”他说道，然后用靴子推了推那堆粉碎的甲壳和皱巴巴的翅膀。

伊马鲁靠近了萨瓦图恩。“我懒得问了，”他边说边汇聚起了光能。 

萨瓦图恩爬了起来。她喘着粗气，睁开眼睛，看见了圣人。她笑了。“是为了奥斯…”

圣人打断了她。

伊马鲁飞到了圣人的面前。“好了！”他大喊道。“你已经表明态度了！”

圣人用大拇指擦去面甲上蒸腾的脓水，然后指了指萨瓦图恩的遗体。“再来，”他坚定地说道。 

“想得美，”伊马鲁回答道，然后启动了传送。

圣人忽然放出了一股虚空能量。他将手掌置于身体两侧，一层黎明护罩以他为中心爆发了出来。 

伊马鲁感到这层护罩像压力波一般穿过他的躯体，干扰着他的通讯。他踉跄地上下飞动…因为他什么也看不见。但他能感觉到圣人的护甲之手已经把他牢牢地抓在了掌心里。他感觉快要裂开了。 

“你会让她复活，”圣人说。

“你们怎么老是威胁着要杀我，”伊马鲁对着黑暗的虚空说道。

圣人的拳头稍微松开了一点。“你会让她复活。我保证，等我完事之后你们俩都能离开。” 

“等你完事？”伊马鲁重复道。他感觉圣人的手松开了。他感觉到了隐藏在黑暗中的，萨瓦图恩的形态。他咧了下嘴，汇集起光能：萨瓦图恩又开始起身了。

“萨瓦图恩，”圣人话音刚落，就又把她杀了。 

“你好像还没习惯作为负光者复活啊。”

“一开始，在你刚复活时，你会感觉很虚弱。”

“就像是刚从沉眠中苏醒。从昏迷中醒来。”

“所以我才能打败你；因为你根本站不稳。”

“你是邪魔族，所以你懂痛苦的滋味。你由死亡而生。这对你来说不算什么。”

“但是我想，也许，你现在知道无助是什么滋味了。”

“让我教教你。”

***

很久很久之后，圣人结束了，护罩消失了。Exo、机灵和邪神再次暴露在了王座世界乌云密布的天空之下。 

圣人慢悠悠地输入了他的传送请求，然后脱下了头盔。在他传送的同时，他又看了萨瓦图恩一眼。 

“这不是为了奥斯里斯，”他用嘶哑的声音说道。 

“是为了我自己。”

***

圣人在家门前遇见了奥斯里斯。“你离开了好一阵子。这次巡逻肯定很不一般，”他说。“你饿了吗？”

圣人14号——有史以来最伟大的泰坦——栽进他的怀里哭了起来。

3832002135.name: Veiled Tithes Grips
3832002135.subtitle: Taking the sword in hand.
3832002135.text:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
3832002135.text_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

4067720865.name: Veiled Tithes Vest
4067720865.subtitle: Feeling the fury in your chest.
4067720865.text:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
4067720865.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什…米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

555258620.name: Veiled Tithes Cloak
555258620.subtitle: Rising above the Deep.
555258620.text:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
555258620.text_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

523074950.name: Veiled Tithes Mask
523074950.subtitle: Toiling in the dead of night.
523074950.text:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
523074950.text_zh:
埃里斯把邪魔族骑士剥光的股骨削成了一个轴，并用锇钉把它深深钉住。她用丝绒线把它包起来，附上她的印记。当她在手中转动它时，它发出了响声。

“对，弄得漂亮点，”伊马鲁翻着白眼说。“那会有帮助的。真的有用。”

“我在用我的力量附着权杖，”她调皮地说道。“你又有何‘用'？”

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

1345569657.name: Veiled Tithes Strides
1345569657.subtitle: Dancing at the edge of the Light.
1345569657.text:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
1345569657.text_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

3534173884.name: Mothkeeper's Wraps
3534173884.subtitle: Smother the lights and run.
3534173884.text:
She had tracked the infested Ogre across the Throne World, led by its trailing effluvium. Now it lay collapsed against a cracked jade pillar, its wheezing form obscured by a thick blanket of moths. 

As she approached, ripples of startling color shimmered over the Ogre as the moths flashed their vibrant underwings in warning. She pulled her hood tight against her exposed face. She would have to work quickly.

The moths on the ground shivered as she stepped carefully over them. She took a breath of the powdery air and reached into the rustling mass, shoulder deep, as quivering wings beat against her neck. She groped blindly until her fingers finally grazed against the withered Ogre, its hide yielding as old leather.

Her knife was swift and sure. The Ogre shuddered once, and it was over. As she withdrew her blade, the moths took flight with the muffled rush of a thousand zephyr-borne petals.

Then they were upon her, covering her cloak, her shoulders, landing in her hair. They smothered her with their dusty bodies, brushing against her lips as she whispered the incantation she stole from the Witch Queen's Spire. She traced the outline of a Hive rune in the air with her knife, then touched the tip of the blade to the back of her hand.

The moths fell still, hushed, bipectinate antennae quivering as they considered the offer:

Not a host, but a home.
3534173884.text_zh:
她在王座世界里追踪那个受到感染的虫瘤，寻找它身后的恶臭。现在它瘫倒在一根裂开的玉柱上，大口喘息的身影被一层厚厚的飞蛾遮住。 

她走近过去，虫瘤的头顶上闪烁着不寻常的色彩涟漪，那是飞蛾在扑闪着它们充满活力的翅膀以示警告。她把兜帽拉向露在外面的脸庞前，贴得紧紧的。她必须动作快点。

地面上的飞蛾在她小心翼翼地跨过时害怕地颤抖着。她吸了一口满是蛾粉的空气，把手伸到齐肩深、沙沙作响的蛾群中，颤动的翅膀拍打着她的脖子。她盲目地摸索着，直到触及了那个衰弱虫瘤。它的表皮就像旧皮革一样柔软。

她的刀又快又准。虫瘤颤抖了一下，一切就结束了。她拔出刀刃，蛾群带着万千和风花瓣的闷响飞了起来。

然后它们飞到她身上，遮盖她的披风，她的肩膀，落在她的头发上。它们用满是蛾粉的身体让她窒息，在她低声念着从巫妖女王的尖塔上偷来的咒语时拂过她的嘴唇。她用刀刃在空中勾勒出邪魔族符文的轮廓，然后用刀尖碰了碰手背。

飞蛾们安静缄默地落下，双栉形的触须颤抖着，思忖着这个提议：

不是宿主，而是家园。

1322406401.name: Veiled Tithes Gauntlets
1322406401.subtitle: Blades swung, lessons learned.
1322406401.text:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
1322406401.text_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

2953343703.name: Veiled Tithes Plate
2953343703.subtitle: Hope and hate share the same heart.
2953343703.text:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
2953343703.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什·米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

786695846.name: Veiled Tithes Mark
786695846.subtitle: Shield against the whispering Deep.
786695846.text:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
786695846.text_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

1524622768.name: Veiled Tithes Helm
1524622768.subtitle: Responsibility, taken in secret, proudly upheld.
1524622768.subtitle_zh: 虽秘密接受责任，必傲然将其高举。
1524622768.text:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
1524622768.text_zh:
埃里斯把邪魔族骑士剥光的股骨削成了一个轴，并用锇钉把它深深钉住。她用丝绒线把它包起来，附上她的印记。当她在手中转动它时，它发出了响声。

“对，弄得漂亮点，”伊马鲁翻着白眼说。“那会有帮助的。真的有用。”

“我在用我的力量附着权杖，”她调皮地说道。“你又有何‘用'？”

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

2817251955.name: Veiled Tithes Greaves
2817251955.subtitle: Feet steady in the midst of the madness.
2817251955.text:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
2817251955.text_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用其光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

2066430310.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
2066430310.subtitle: Reach the combustion point.
2066430310.text:
Lord Shaxx watched a Crucible match play out below his announcer's perch, but his mind was elsewhere.  

Since the Witness's assault on the Traveler, he'd become uncharacteristically anxious. He had tried to throw himself into the Crucible with renewed vigor, but his preoccupation had proven too difficult to shake. 

A sudden flash of Solar Light disrupted his fretting. He sat up and focused on a Titan who was wearing a new piece of kit: some kind of gauntlets Shaxx had never seen before.  

Shaxx leaned into the microphone. "Fought like a Titan of the First Pillar!" he boomed. "One minute left. The enemy is out of second chances!" 

While his teammates concentrated their rifle fire from under cover, the Titan instead charged directly at the oncoming team.  

Shaxx chuckled to himself. "Titans… always thinking with their fists." He waited eagerly to see how the Guardian's gambit would unfold. 

As the Titan reached the oncoming fireteam, he leapt into the air, unleashing a halo of Solar flame. When he landed, a furious wave of fire surged forward, immolating the opposing Guardians where they stood. 

Shaxx jumped up from his seat. "Look what one Guardian can do with nothing but their Ghost, their weapon, and their Light!" he thundered.  

It was the type of triumphant moment that he'd envisioned when he founded the Crucible, and the perfect diversion to take his mind off the Witness, at least for a while.
2066430310.text_zh:
领主沙克斯心不在焉地望着他的解说员看台下的一场熔炉竞技场比赛。  

自从见证者对旅行者发动袭击以来，他变得异常焦虑。他试图振作起来，投入到熔炉竞技场之中，但他仍然难以摆脱心事。 

一道突如其来的烈日闪光打断了他的苦恼。他端坐起来，望向一名泰坦。他穿着沙克斯从没见过的新臂铠。  

沙克斯靠向麦克风。“你战斗起来像是第一中坚的泰坦！”他低沉有力地说道。“还剩一分钟。敌人不能再复活了！” 

趁队友在掩体下步枪集火之际，那泰坦径直朝迎面而来的队伍冲了过去。  

沙克斯轻声笑道。“泰坦…总是用拳头思考问题。”他急切地等着看这位守护者要玩什么花招。 

就在泰坦碰到迎面而来的火力战队时，他跃入空中，释放出烈日火焰的光环。当他落地时，一股猛烈的火浪涌向前方，将敌方守护者原地活活烧死。
