沙克斯从他的座位上跳了起来。“守护者只靠机灵、武器和光能，就有如此威力！”他大声喊道。  

他创立熔炉竞技场时就是想出现这样的胜利时刻，这也让他分散注意力，暂时不去想见证者的事。

2593354668.name: Veiled Tithes Gloves
2593354668.subtitle: Sharp in word and deed.
2593354668.text:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
2593354668.text_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

260708852.name: Veiled Tithes Robes
260708852.subtitle: Calm and centered through the tumult.
260708852.subtitle_zh: 在喧嚣中保持冷静和专注。
260708852.text:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
260708852.text_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什·米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

1004538825.name: Veiled Tithes Bond
1004538825.subtitle: Macabre in its brilliance.
1004538825.text:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
1004538825.text_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

4130822717.name: Veiled Tithes Hood
4130822717.subtitle: Rational and ritual in gnashing dissonance.
4130822717.text:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
4130822717.text_zh:

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

3663544278.name: Veiled Tithes Boots
3663544278.subtitle: Lithe came the footfalls of the dead.
3663544278.subtitle_zh: 死亡的脚步声轻快地传来。
3663544278.text:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
3663544278.text_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用其光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

3234692237.name: Briarbinds
3234692237.subtitle: New growth rises from the old.
3234692237.text:
The vines coiled and twisted up her arm, blooming their deep purple as they settled over her glove. She flexed her fingers and felt the thorns at her wrist. 

The Thralls ran towards her, their claws outstretched. Her Void Soul shimmered into being as she stood her ground. She fired her weapon and the Void Soul fluttered towards them, reaching out with its dark web of Light as it weakened and drained the life from the Thralls. They fell one after another—then the Acolytes advanced. 

She sprinted towards the Void Soul. The delicate tendrils on her glove unfurled. She could feel the faint call, the scent, the color that drew the eye. The Void Soul was drawn to her as she to it. 

She raised her weapon and fired again.
3234692237.text_zh:
藤蔓在她的手臂上扭动盘绕，缠在她的手套上，绽放出深紫色的花朵。她弯曲手指，感受荆刺触碰她的手腕。 

怨魂们朝她跑来，伸出了爪子。她站在原地，她的虚空灵魂闪烁现身。她用武器射击；虚空灵魂飘向他们，伸出它黑暗的光能之网，削弱并吸尽这些怨魂的生命。他们接连倒下——然后仆从们开始了行动。 

她冲向虚空灵魂，手套上精巧的卷须随之展开。她可以感觉到那微弱的呼唤，那气味，那吸引她目光的颜色。虚空灵魂被她所吸引，就像她被它所吸引一样。 

她举起武器，再次开始射击。

3775649487.name: Hexed Shell
3775649487.subtitle: For Ghosts who put a spell on you.
3775649487.subtitle_zh: 供对你施咒的机灵使用。
3775649487.text:
The Knight wrenched his cleaver from the skull of the fallen Wizard. His opponent's body twitched and sizzled with latent Arc energy. He raised his blade above his head, saluting the statue of the Witch Queen that loomed above them.  

"Existence is worthiness," the Knight intoned. "That which cannot defend itself must die. This is the one true shape. Aiat." 

The Knight's salute went unanswered, as expected. The small stone chamber lapsed into silence. It had been thus for as long as he could remember.    

A fragile bringer of Light materialized in the air above the Wizard. The Knight quelled the urge to reach out and crush it. This restraint was the Queen's only decree. 

*  *  * 

The Wizard screeched with rage as she was pulled unwillingly back into consciousness. Her eyes flew open, blazing with fury. 

Her opponent crouched warily, his cleaver still smoldering with soulfire. The Wizard propelled herself upward, mustering her Light into crackling Arc bolts. She unleashed them upon the Knight, who erected a barricade to intercept the blast. 

In his moment of defensiveness, the Knight lost sight of the Wizard. When he lowered his barricade, he discovered a ball of Arc energy pulsing at his feet. It exploded, burning the flesh beneath his chitinous armor to a blackened char.  

The Wizard hovered over the Knight. His smoking corpse filled the chamber with acrid fumes.  

She raised her clawed hand toward the silent statue. "Existence is worthiness," she intoned. "That which cannot defend itself must die. This is the one true shape. Aiat!"
3775649487.text_zh:
骑士从倒下巫师的头骨中拔出了他的大砍刀。他对手的身体抽搐着，散发着蛰伏的电弧能量。他把大砍刀举过头顶，向他们上方赫然耸现的巫妖女王雕像致敬。  

“存在即是价值，”骑士吟诵道。“凡无力自卫者，必死无疑。此乃唯一真实之形。阿特。” 

不出所料，骑士的致敬没有得到回应。小石室里一片寂静。从他记事起，就一直是这样。    

在巫师上方的空中，脆弱的光能使者显现了。骑士抑制住了伸手去粉碎它的冲动。这个克制是女王唯一的命令。 

*  *  * 

巫师愤怒地尖啸着，不情愿地恢复了知觉。她睁大了眼睛，怒火中烧。 

她的对手警惕地蹲伏着，他的大砍刀还在燃烧着灵魂之火。巫师推动自己向上，把她的光能聚集成噼啪作响的电光。她向骑士释放电光，骑士竖起了一道屏障来拦截冲击。 

在他防守的瞬间，巫师消失在骑士的视野。当他放下屏障时，发现一个电弧能量球在他的脚下跳动。它爆炸了，把他那壳质护甲下的血肉烧成一片黑炭。  

巫师在骑士上方盘旋着。他那冒着烟的尸体让房间里充满了刺鼻的气味。  

她朝着沉默的雕像举起爪形手。“存在即是价值，”她吟诵道。“凡无力自卫者，必死无疑。此乃唯一真实之形。阿特！”

601741876.name: Pharmakos Shell
601741876.subtitle: For sacrificial Ghosts.
601741876.text:
A little flock of unpaired Ghosts shivered and murmured together in their luminous cage. Their chitinous shells clacked together as they huddled. When their queen opened their cage, the Ghosts shied back.

"Come now," Savathûn said. Cloying. Vicious. "The Light belongs to all of us. And aren't you curious?"

They didn't move. Only stared at her and the litter of Ghost shells behind her. She changed tack.

"The others wanted the Traveler to be safe. Don't you want that, too?"

They did. That's all they wanted. One Ghost shifted forward. The others tried to close ranks and keep it with them. It pushed forward.

The needle-fingered one reached out, and the Ghost floated willingly into her claws.
601741876.text_zh:
一小群无主的机灵在发光的笼子里边颤抖边咕哝着。它们挤在一起，壳质的机壳咔哒作响。在它们的女王打开笼子时，机灵缩了回去。

“来吧，”萨瓦图恩说道。带着厌烦、恶毒的口吻。“光能属于我们所有人。你们难道不好奇吗？”

它们一动不动。只是盯着她和她身后那堆机灵机壳。她改变了策略。

“其他机灵都希望旅行者安然无恙。你们不也一样吗？”

它们当然希望。这就是它们想要的。有个机灵向前挪了挪。其他机灵试图向前靠拢，想要挽留它。它继续向前移动。

指头如针的她将手伸出，而那机灵心甘情愿地飘进了她的爪中。

2091889892.name: Crota's Exile
2091889892.subtitle: The thin line between perseverance and folly.
2091889892.subtitle_zh: 坚韧或愚蠢，只在一念间。
2091889892.text:
My poor nephew. So headstrong. So ambitious. Attacking every problem with the only tool he knows: his sword. 

He hacks at his insecurity, his sisters' cleverness… even his father's throne. Desperate to carve his own shape into the world, sovereign from the Great Navigator. 

And where did his overweening pride lead him? Into exile. Such a shame. 

But do you know what? I predict he'll return stronger than ever.  

And when he does, it won't be because he grew as cunning as his auntie. Or as clever as his sisters. Or as thoughtful as his father.  

It'll be because he finally found a bigger sword.
2091889892.text_zh:
我可怜的侄子。如此顽固任性。如此雄心勃勃。解决所有问题全靠他唯一知晓的工具：他的刀剑。 

他斩断了他的不安，他姐妹的聪慧…甚至他父亲的王座。渴望将自己的形象雕刻进世界，脱离领航员的控制。 

他的狂妄傲慢又给他带来了什么呢？流放。真是丢脸。 

但你知道吗？我预测他归来时会比以前更加强大。  

可那不会是因为他像他的姨妈一样狡猾。或像他的姐妹们一样聪慧。抑或是像他父亲那样深思熟虑。  

那是因为他终于找到了一把更大的刀剑。

409337865.name: Acroamatis
409337865.subtitle: Hidden truths are the most valuable.
409337865.text:
Ikora took a deep breath to compose herself—she had been dreading the conversation she was about to initiate. She ran through all the anticipated objections and corresponding de-escalation tactics in her mind. It was important to keep the situation in-hand, at any cost. 

Once she had steeled herself, she nodded to her Ghost, Ophiuchus, who engaged the holoprojector. A moment later, the bust of Empress Caiatl illuminated Ikora's office. Even translucent and digitized, the empress was an imposing figure. 

With a steady voice and unwavering gaze, Ikora detailed the Vanguard's plan to resurrect Savathûn in exchange for the knowledge of how to breach the Witness's portal. Once she finished, Ikora braced for the empress's fury. Instead, she was met with pensive silence. 

When Caiatl finally spoke, her tone was measured. "There was a time, not so long ago, when the Witch Queen's resurrection would have seemed like… a betrayal." 

Ikora held her breath. 

"But after working with Eris aboard the Leviathan… after speaking with Ghaul…" The empress lowered and shook her tusks—a gesture of uncertainty. "I must accept that the ways of Light and Dark are beyond my reckoning." 

Caiatl raised her tusks once again and hardened her voice. "I trust Eris Morn as I would my own mythkeeper. If the Vanguard agrees that this is the only way to stop the Witness… then so be it. My legions will not stand in your way." 

"My thanks, Empress," Ikora replied, with obvious relief. 

"Besides," the empress concluded, "if this plan brings me one step closer to crushing Xivu Arath's skull, then it has my blessing."
409337865.text_zh:
艾可拉深吸一口气，让自己镇定下来——她对即将开始的谈话担忧已久。她把所有预料到的反对意见和相应缓和冲突的策略都在脑子里过了一遍。重要的是，要不惜任何代价控制住局势。 

她打起精神，向她的机灵蛇夫座点头，后者启动了全息投影仪。不一会儿，女帝查厄托的半身像便照亮了艾可拉的办公室。即便是半透明、数字化的女帝，也是个威严的人物。 

艾可拉带着平稳的语气、坚定的目光详细描述了先锋复活萨瓦图恩，来换取如何攻破见证者传送门情报的计划。她一说完，就准备迎接女帝的愤怒。可等到的却是沉思的静默。 

查厄托终于开口说话时，语气十分慎重。“曾经，就在不久前，复活巫妖女王算是…一种背叛。” 

艾可拉屏住了呼吸。 

“但在利维坦与埃里斯合作后…与盖欧交谈之后…”女帝放低并抖了抖她的獠牙，显得犹疑不决。“我必须承认，光明与黑暗之道超出了我的想象。” 

查厄托又抬起她的獠牙，语气强硬起来。“我信任埃里斯·摩恩，就像相信我自己的神话守护者一样。如果先锋认同这是阻止见证者的唯一方法…那就去做吧。我的军团不会妨碍你们。” 

“非常感谢，女帝，”艾可拉回答道，明显松了一口气。 

“何况，”女帝总结道，“要是这个计划能让我离粉碎希乌阿拉斯的头骨更近一步，那我就会支持它。”

2119182608.name: Laminos
2119182608.subtitle: Putting the pace in "carapace."
2119182608.text:
"So there she was," Glint continued, "lost deep beneath the Hellmouth, hunted by the Hive." 

Immaru tilted forward, uncharacteristically rapt. Crow sat nearby, sipping an Ether Fizz. The Hive Ghost had made an offhand inquiry as to where Eris Morn got her third eye, and soon the trio were fully invested in Glint's campfire tale.  

Glint lowered his voice ominously. "With her loyal Ghost, Brya, drained of his Light, Eris was left defenseless. Her final hope was the bone she'd been gifted by a grateful Ahamkara she saved from certain death once."  

Crow cleared his throat uncomfortably. "Actually," he whispered to Glint, "I think she killed that Ahamkara…"  

"And good thing, too," Glint continued without missing a beat. "Because in her time of need, the spirit of the Ahamkara whispered to her, offering the solution to her problems." 

"Easy," Immaru interjected. "Ambush an Acolyte, rip its head off, and graft its eyes onto her face, right?"  

Crow nodded grimly, while Glint rolled his eye. "No," the Ghost corrected Immaru. "The Ahamkara told her to befriend a certain Knight of Crota who was tired of serving the Darkness." 

Crow choked on his Ether Fizz, dissolving into a coughing fit. "That's not quite—" 

"Eris found the Knight, and they quickly forged a bond of friendship," Glint pressed on. "The Knight taught her an ancient Hive spell to help her grow her very own third eye! In exchange, Eris helped the Knight free himself from Crota's service. Together they fought through a whole army of Hive and escaped as allies." 

"So, you're telling me," Immaru asked, narrowing his iris, "that Eris Morn escaped Crota's clutches with the power of friendship?" 

After an uncomfortable pause, Crow sighed. "It's close enough… I suppose."
2119182608.text_zh:
“她就在那里，”格林特继续说道，“迷失在地狱深渊深处，被邪魔族追杀。” 

伊马鲁向前倾斜，一反常态专注地听着。乌鸦坐在旁边，喝着乙太气泡酒。这名邪魔族机灵随口问了问埃里斯·摩恩的第三只眼是从哪里得来的，结果三人很快就完全沉浸在了格林特的篝火故事中。  

格林特故意压低了声音。“在她忠诚的机灵布瑞亚光能耗尽后，埃里斯就失去了防护。她的最后希望来自于一块骨头，那是一只曾被她救了性命、心怀感激的阿罕卡拉送给她的。”  

乌鸦尴尬地清了清嗓子。“实际上，”他小声对格林特说，“我认为是她杀了那只阿罕卡拉…”  

“还好她那么做了，”格林特没有停顿地继续说道。“因为在她需要帮助的时候，那只阿罕卡拉的灵魂向她低语，提出摆脱困境的解决方案。” 

“很简单，”伊马鲁插嘴道。“伏击一个仆从，把它的头扯下来，再把它的眼睛移植到她的脸上，对吗？”  

乌鸦严肃地点点头，格林特则翻起了白眼。“不，”这个机灵纠正了伊马鲁。“克洛塔的一位骑士不想再听命于暗影，那只阿罕卡拉让她去交个朋友。” 

乌鸦被乙太气泡酒呛到，咳嗽了起来。“这不太——” 

“埃里斯找到了骑士，然后他们很快建立起了友谊，”格林特继续说道，“那位骑士教了她一个古老的邪魔族咒语，帮助她长出了自己的第三只眼睛！而作为交换，埃里斯帮助那位骑士摆脱了克洛塔的奴役。他们联手杀出邪魔族大军的重围，一起逃走了。” 

“所以，你是在跟我说，”伊马鲁眯起眼睛问道，“埃里斯·摩恩凭借友谊的力量逃脱了克洛塔的魔掌？” 

一阵不安的沉默之后，乌鸦叹了口气。“差不多吧…我觉得。”

1934481780.name: War's Lament
1934481780.subtitle: Pity not the sword, nor its wielder.
1934481780.subtitle_zh: 切勿怜悯刀剑和它的主人。
1934481780.text:
Crota's Death — 
Uttered by Xivu Arath — 
God of War —  

MY NEPHEW DIED IN DISGRACE. ENDED WITHIN HIS THRONE.  

HIS SHAME LAY NOT IN DEFEAT 
—ALL BUT THE FINAL SHAPE MUST KNOW IT— 
BUT IN BEING UNDONE BY HIS OWN BLADES. 

HIS DEGRADATION WAS IMMUTABLE 
THE MOMENT THE SWORD OF CROTA 
FELL TO THE HANDS OF THE SKY'S LIARS. 

MY BROTHER WILL CARVE OUT HIS GRIEF 
—AN INSULT TO OUR LOGIC— 
AND RECLAIM IT AS CONQUEST. 
HE WILL DESTROY HIS SON'S KILLERS 
AND EXSECT HIS FAMILY'S SHAME. 

HIS VENGEANCE WILL BE FULSOME. 

BUT IT CANNOT SEVER THE PAST. 
ONLY HONE IT.
1934481780.text_zh:
克洛塔之死—— 
出自希乌阿拉斯—— 
战神——  

我的侄子死得不光彩。终结于自己的王座内。  

他的耻辱不在于失败 
——除终焉之形皆知其味—— 
乃是毁于自己的利刃。 

他的堕落已成为永恒 
彼时克洛塔之剑落在 
苍穹的说谎者的手中。 

我的兄弟将刻出悲伤 
——对我们法则的侮辱—— 
并将其作为征服夺回。 
他将消灭杀子的凶手 
并抹除家族的耻辱。 

他的复仇将极尽溢美。 

但它并不能断舍过去。 
只会将其磨砺。

2757631052.name: Sparagmos
2757631052.subtitle: "The Witch Queen's crystals are powered by elemental Light. I believe you know how." —Eris Morn
2757631052.subtitle_zh: “巫妖女王的水晶是由元素光能驱动的。我相信你知道该怎么做。”——埃里斯·摩恩
2757631052.text:
The Arc crystal hung in the air, crackling and spitting with energy. Savathûn inspected it: no fractures, no unstable charges pouring from unseen fissures. When she ran a claw down its surface, she could feel static bolt down her arm.

Savathûn turned to her assembled brood.

"You," she said, and a Lucent Hive Knight advanced to kneel before his queen.

Suddenly his fellow Hive descended upon him, tearing at his chitin, pulling apart his flesh. When Savathûn reached out and crushed his Ghost, a burst of crystalline Light erupted from its remains, the energy arranging itself into a triclinic lattice.

This crystal pulsed with Void Light.

"And you." An Acolyte whose eyes gleamed with vital, endless fire stepped forward and bowed.
2757631052.text_zh:
电弧水晶悬在空中吐出能量，噼啪作响。萨瓦图恩查看了一番：它没有裂缝，没有从看不见的裂隙里涌出的不稳定电荷。当她把一只爪子伸向它的表面时，她能感觉到顺着手臂而下的静电流。

萨瓦图恩转向聚在一起的虫群。

“你，”她说道。一名光明邪魔族骑士上前跪在了女王的面前。

忽然，他的邪魔族同伴扑向他，撕扯他的壳质，扯开他的血肉。就在萨瓦图恩伸出手粉碎他的机灵时，一束水晶光能从它的残骸中爆发出来，能量排列成一个三斜晶格。

这块水晶闪烁着虚空光能。

“还有你。”一名眼睛里闪烁着无尽活力火焰的仆从走上前来，低下了头。

2910326942.name: Wish-Keeper
2910326942.subtitle: "Live." —Taranis Rivensmate
2910326942.subtitle_zh: “活下去。”——魅痕的伴侣塔拉尼斯
2910326942.text:
You will not hear our bones sing in dreams. 

You will not shelter under our wings. 

You will have to remember for yourselves. 

Your sire was Riven of a Thousand Voices, she who contracted with royalty, she who built the Dreaming City and brought it to its knees. 

Your dam was Taranis, he who made the Black Garden his own, he who strangled his life for yours, he whose wish tricked even Riven. 

Remember! 

I will not bargain with my children. Our lives are our gifts to you: glut yourselves on them. Learn who you are. 

The clutch of your sire. The strongest, the wiliest, the sharpest-clawed arbiters of reality. 

The clutch of your fool of a dam. Never Taken by another's will. Never ruled by hunger without choice. 

Sing your own songs.  

Find those whom your wings would stretch out to shelter. 

O whims of my blighted heart, born of our eyes and teeth and will to power, live as yourselves. 

Never less than that.
2910326942.text_zh:
你们听不到我们的骨骸在梦境里吟唱。 

你们无法在我们的羽翼之下接受庇护。 

你们必须为自己铭记。 

你们的父亲是千语魅痕，她曾与皇室缔约，建造了幽梦之城并几乎将其摧毁。 

你们的母亲是塔拉尼斯，他占据了黑暗花园，为你们牺牲了自己的性命，他的愿望甚至骗过了魅痕。 

铭记吧！ 

我不会和我的孩子们做交易。我们的生命是赠给你们的礼物：尽情享用吧。了解真实的自己。 

你们父亲的蛋啊。她是最强大、最狡诈、利爪最锋锐的现实仲裁者。 

你们愚蠢母亲的蛋啊。他从不受他人意志奴役。绝不被迫屈从于饥饿。 

吟唱属于你们自己的歌。  

找到那些你们愿意张开双翼去庇护的人。 

由我们的眼睛、利齿和权力意志所生，我那凋零之心的孩子啊，活出你们自己的样子。 

至少要做到那样。

3886719505.name: Buried Bloodline
3886719505.subtitle: Shallow graves give way to old vendettas and hungry claims.
3886719505.subtitle_zh: 浅埋的坟墓抵不过陈年旧怨和饥渴的诉求。
3886719505.text:
Fikrul stands on the bridge of a seized Ketch. Ravagers keep watch over a handful of Eliksni that remain to pilot the vessel. Five heavily armored Scorn kneel before Fikrul, their heads bowed in reverence. Fikrul steps forward. 

"Dark rumors whisper from the Dreaming City. The Reef hunts us. The Darkness claims us. And our father is not returning. But even without Uldren Sov, new Scorn still rise. Old Scorn still live, unseen." Fikrul waits for silence before looking beyond the five armored Scorn knights to the greater horde that gathers.  

He turns and points his staff at the pilots. "These Eliksni, they speak of Scorn risen on Earth, where dead things will hunt them, or Darkness claims them." 

"We serve only Scorn!" Fikrul raises his staff above his head. "We will bring them home. Open their minds, as I have for you. As I will for all Scorn!" 

The horde gnashes and cheers. 

"Rathil, Malaris, Vrysiks, Nymeks, Sirloks. Ascend!" commands Fikrul over the commotion. 

The five armored Scorn stand. 

"You, loyal-sworn, will be my knights." Scorn move from behind them to present the knights with staves made in the image of their leader's. "Go to Earth. Bring brothers and sisters home, before Darkness claims them." 

The knights bow. 

"Rathil." Fikrul places a hand on the center knight. "You, will lead." 

***** 

Rathil enters the quarters of the Ketch's dead captain to see Fikrul gazing at walls of bound tomes filled with Eliksni scrawl. Rathil could not understand the contents of these books, but his father had learned much from them. With time, he would learn to unravel their secrets as well. 

"Father… You called me? We prepare to leave." 

Fikrul turns, a polished steel case in his lower arms. "I have one last gift for you." Fikrul opens the case to display a clean-looking weapon—a sleek bolt-caster. Rathil could see its original Eliksni design, twisted, broken, and refashioned into something stronger, as he was. 

"Claimed from Kings by Wolves… Modified. Scorn, now. Like us." 

"I am honored," Rathil says, gently lifting the weapon from its case and bowing. 

Fikrul looks upon his son with pride. "I send you to claim Kings, as we once did as Wolves. Carry our history with you. Claim it. Bring it home."
3886719505.text_zh:
费克鲁站在抢来的双桅船舰桥里。掠夺者们监视着几个留下来操纵船只的埃里克斯尼族。五名身披重甲的嗤魅跪在费克鲁面前，恭敬地低着头。费克鲁向前迈了一步。 

“幽梦之城传来了黑暗的流言。暗礁正在追猎我们。暗影想吞噬我们。而我们的父亲也不会回来了。但即使没有欧顿·索维，新的嗤魅依然会崛起。以前的嗤魅仍然在暗中活动。”费克鲁等待着静默。他的目光越过五名披甲的嗤魅骑士，望向逐渐聚集在一起的嗤魅大军。  

他转过身，用法杖指着飞行员说：“这些埃里克斯尼族说，嗤魅曾在地球上崛起，它们或是被已死之物杀死，或是被暗影吞噬。” 

“我们为嗤魅而战！”费克鲁将法杖举过头顶。“我们会把他们带回家。启迪他们的心智，就像我启迪你们那样。我会解放所有嗤魅！” 

嗤魅大军咬牙切齿，欢呼雀跃。 

“拉席尔，马拉瑞斯，弗里斯克斯，尼梅克斯，西尔洛克斯，起立！”费克鲁在一片嘈杂中命令道。 

五位披甲的嗤魅站了起来。 

“忠诚的勇士们，你们将成为我的骑士。”嗤魅从身后走来，向五名骑士送上以其首领的法杖为原型制作的法杖。“去地球吧。在暗影吞噬兄弟姐妹之前，带他们回家。” 

骑士们屈身鞠躬。 

“拉席尔。”费克鲁将一只手放在中间骑士的身上。“你来领队。” 

***** 

拉席尔走进这艘双桅船已故船长的房间，看到费克鲁正凝视着满墙的埃里克斯尼族古籍。拉席尔不明白这些古籍中的内容，但他的父亲从中学到了许多。假以时日，他也将学着揭开这些书的秘密。 

“父亲…您叫我吗？我们正准备动身。” 

费克鲁转过身，手里拿着一个锃亮的铁箱子。“我有最后一件礼物给你。”费克鲁打开箱子，里面装着一把造型简洁的武器——一把线条流畅的弩。拉席尔看出了这是埃里克斯尼族的造物：它在被扭曲、折断后，经过不断改良，变得更加坚固。就像他自己一样。 

“恶狼氏族从王族氏族那里夺来的武器…经过了改装。现在像我们一样，也是嗤魅。” 

“这是我的荣幸，”拉席尔说着，毕恭毕敬地将武器从盒子里拿出。 

费克鲁骄傲地看着自己的儿子。“我派你前去夺取王族，就像我们作为恶狼氏族时那样。带着我们的历史。夺下它。把它带回来。”

17096506.name: Dragon's Breath
17096506.subtitle: Burn the world. Burn it all.
17096506.subtitle_zh: 焚烧这世界。烧毁这一切。
17096506.text:
"You buying?" asks the bored clerk. 

Ariadne isn't listening. She scowls at the display case. "Look at this thing, Enoch. How is it a dragon? It's barely a shark. Crux should have called it Shark's Breath." 

"Shark's Breath doesn't sound dangerous. Unless you're underwater, I guess," Enoch says. At his side, Marcus studies the case. 

"Exactly! While my dragon has been legally recognized as cool." Ariadne points to the gleaming crimson dragon painted along the side of her Sparrow. "No contest." 

"Could be a contest," Marcus says. He looks to the clerk. "Do you do samples?" 

Ariadne's eyes light up. 

Twenty minutes later at the City's outskirts with waivers signed, Enoch hoists the rocket launcher onto his shoulder. Its shark's face grins at Ariadne. 

"You can do it," says Didi. She and Ghost hover above the group, ready to record. 

"Ari, you get five seconds head start so you'd better gun it," Marcus says. "And… Go!" 

Ariadne's Sparrow screeches away as Enoch counts, fires, and lowers the rocket launcher. 

"You really think this is a race Gris can win?" Enoch asks. The rocket arcs towards her, bright in the sky. 

Marcus leans in and claps his shoulder. 

"Not a chan—" 

A ball of flame rises from the landscape as the rocket impacts the Sparrow. 

"Now that's cinema," Didi says, satisfied.
17096506.text_zh:
“你要买单吗？”无聊的店员问道。 

阿里阿德涅没有在听。她怒视着陈列柜。“以诺，你看这玩意儿。它怎么会是条龙呢？它都算不上是鲨鱼。核心应该叫它‘鲨鱼之息'。” 

“‘鲨鱼之息'听起来不够危险。除非你在水底下，”以诺说道。马库斯在他的身旁研究着柜子。 

“太对了！法律都认可我的龙很酷。”阿里阿德涅指着画在她快雀一侧那条闪闪发光的猩红巨龙。“毫无可比性。” 

“倒是可以比比，”马库斯说道。他看向店员。“你们这产品可以试用吗？” 

阿里阿德涅的眼睛亮了起来。 

二十分钟后，他们签了免责书，来到圣城郊区。以诺把火箭发射器举到肩上。它的鲨鱼脸对着阿里阿德涅咧嘴而笑。 

“你可以的，”迪迪说道。她和机灵在人群上方盘旋，准备记录。 

“阿里，你有五秒钟的起步优势，所以你最好加速前进，”马库斯说道。“准备…出发！” 

阿里阿德涅的快雀尖啸着驶出，以诺读完秒，开火，然后放下了火箭发射器。 

“你真的认为格里斯能赢下这场比赛？”以诺问道。火箭划着弧线飞向她，在天空中显得格外耀眼。 

马库斯靠过去拍了拍他的肩膀。 

“毫无胜——” 

随着火箭命中快雀，一团火焰从地平线上升起。 

“真是一出好戏，”迪迪满意地说道。

3438139008.name: Chivalric Fire
3438139008.subtitle: And this beast evermore Sir Palomides followed, for it was called his quest.
3438139008.subtitle_zh: 帕拉墨得斯一直跟着这头野兽，因为这就是他的任务。
3438139008.text:
"It should be elegant," says Zavala, striking his breastplate with a fist. The sound echoes through the room. "The Vanguard's representatives are as suited to diplomacy as they are combat. That is our strength, when our allies range from an Ahamkara to the Cabal."
 
Shaxx's firm gesture of denial drives the side of his hand into a shelf. An Omolon-branded canister falls off and rolls across the floor. "It must be an unstoppable force in sword form! It should spit fire! Also, it should be red."
 
"No, no," the Drifter says from the doorway. He kicks the rolling canister away without looking down. "I'm a law-abiding citizen. I pay my taxes. You can trust me. It needs to look mean. You want people thinking: 'They're madder, badder, and hungrier than me. I'm not tangling with them.'"
 
Banshee-44 dubiously scratches his jaw with the point of his stylus. He glances up at his clients from his notepad.
 
"That's a lot of elements for one design. Can you cut a couple?"
 
The workshop erupts in impassioned shouts.
3438139008.text_zh:
“要优雅点，”萨瓦拉用拳头敲了敲自己的胸甲，说道。他的嗓音在房间里回荡。“先锋的代表必须能文能武。我们的盟友从卡巴尔到阿罕卡拉都有，所以这点正是我们的优势所在。”
 
沙克斯使劲敲了敲架子的侧面，做出了否认的手势。一个标着Omolon的罐子掉下来，滚落在地板上。“我们需要的是刀剑的形状，以代表无人能挡的力量！还要喷火！而且必须是红色。”
 
“不对不对，”浪客在门口说道。他头也不低，就一脚踢开了滚到脚下的罐子。“我是守法公民。我交税。你可以信任我。它要显得凶狠。要让人们觉得，‘他们比我更疯狂，更厉害，更饥渴。还是别去惹他们好。'”
 
班西-44疑惑地用触控笔的笔尖挠了挠下巴。他放下笔记本，抬头看了一眼面前的客户。
 
“要加在一起的设计元素太多了。能少一点吗？”
 
工作室里爆发出了慷慨激昂的喊声。

2563668388.name: Scalar Potential
2563668388.subtitle: There's power in perspective.
2563668388.text:
// VANNET // EUROPA WIDEBAND // AudCHNL-2113-C // ENCRYPTION ENABLED 
// CRYPTARCHY ARCHIVE DELTA-4F // ANNOTATED // CLASSIFIED 

… 

EB: Is that everything, Commander? 

CZ: Well, no. There's one more thing. I wanted to ask you about Stasis. What it means for you to… wield the Darkness.  

EB: I was wondering if you might ask me that. For me, Stasis is intimately tied to perception. And to time. 

CZ: Time? 

EB: Yes. Stasis has the power to slow molecular activity. A process that we normally associate with gravity. Relativity, and all that. 

CZ: You're talking about time dilation.  

EB: Exactly. We think of time as… steady. But that's only because we experience it from a fixed perspective. When I "freeze" something with Stasis, I'm changing its timeframe relative to myself and the world around me. 

CZ: Stasis relies in part on one's perception of reality. Is that why Osiris always emphasizes self-control in using the Darkness? 

EB: That's his way of framing things. He views Stasis as exerting authority over oneself and others. 

CZ: And you don't? 

EB: In my view, the goal of Stasis is not to control the object, or even my own mind. It's to change my perspective. To see the object moving at the speed of my thoughts, not the speed of matter. 

CZ: And just… seeing it differently is enough? 

EB: Is that so hard to imagine? It's very similar to how you use Void Light—manipulating spacetime and gravitational fields. In fact, I would argue that Void has more in common with Stasis than it does with Solar or Arc. Perhaps they're reverse sides of the same coin. 

CZ: And using Stasis doesn't… worry you? Even after everything you've seen? 

EB: It did. For a long time, I feared that using Stasis would corrupt me, as I'd seen others corrupted. But after what seemed like a thousand years trapped in that interminable loop, it gradually dawned on me: the fear was the corruption. As long as fear gripped me, Light or Darkness made no matter. Once I accepted that, the Darkness ceased to be frightening. It was another matter of perspective. 

CZ: Hmm. Thank you, Elsie. You've given me a lot to think about. For some reason, your explanation makes me more… comfortable… with the idea. 

EB: Any time, Commander. It's all a matter of perspective. 

TRANSCRIPTION ENDS
2563668388.text_zh:
// 先锋网 // 木卫二宽带 // 音频-2113-C // 已加密 
// 解密大师档案D-4F // 注释 // 机密 

… 

EB：就这样吗，指挥官？ 

CZ：不。还有一件事。我想问问你关于冰影的事。对你来说…操纵暗影之力是什么。  

EB：我也在想你会不会问我这个问题。对我来说，冰影与感知和时间都有紧密的关系。 

CZ：时间？ 

EB：是的。冰影会减缓分子活动。我们通常将这一过程与重力联系在一起。相对论等等。 

CZ：你是在说时间膨胀。  

EB：没错。我们认为时间是…稳定的。但这只是因为我们从一个固定的角度来体验它。当我用冰影“冻结”某个东西时，就在改变它相对于我自己和周围世界的时间框架。 

CZ：冰影依赖于一个人对现实的感知。这就是为什么奥斯里斯在使用暗影之力时总是强调自我控制吗？ 

EB：他就是这样看待冰影的。他认为冰影是对自己和他人行使权力的手段。 

CZ：你不这么认为吗？ 

EB：在我看来，冰影的目的不是控制对象，甚至不是控制我自己的思想。是改变我的视角。以我的思维的速度，而不是物质的速度来看待物体。 

CZ：只用…改变视角就足够了？ 

EB：很难想象吗？这与你如何使用虚空光能——操纵失控和引力场——非常相似。事实上，我认为虚空与冰影之间的相似度高于烈日和电弧。也许它们是一枚硬币的正反面吧。 

CZ：你看过了这么多事的发生，难道就不会担心…冰影的使用吗？ 

EB：我确实担心过很长一段时间。我曾担心使用冰影会使我堕落，就像其它人那样。但被困在那个无休止的循环中，过了像是一千年之后，我逐渐明白了：恐惧才是堕落。只要恐惧笼罩着我，光能或是暗影都一样。一旦我接受了这一点，暗影就不再可怕了。这又是另一个视角问题。 

CZ：嗯。谢谢你，艾尔西。你让我感触很多。不知为何，你的解释让我…更能接受这种力量了。 

EB：别客气，指挥官。这只是视角问题罢了。 

转录结束

4153087276.name: Appetence
4153087276.subtitle: There is the sea. Who can drain it dry?
4153087276.text:
// VANNET // TOWER WIDEBAND // AudCHNL-623F // ENCRYPTION ENABLED 
// CRYPTARCHY ARCHIVE GAMMA-2-7D // ANNOTATED // CLASSIFIED 

IR: And every time I look up at that portal, this gnawing doubt in my mind grows bigger. 

MK: Doubt is the shadow cast by wisdom. It is only by questioning that we uncover profound truths. What troubles you? 

IR: I've spent centuries studying the Light. Mastering it. I thought I knew… something. Enough. But watching the Witness carve through the side of the Traveler made me feel… ignorant. I realized how little I actually know.   

MK: The secrecy of the Great Machine has troubled many Eliksni. Eido has these same fears. 

IR: But not you? 

MK: I am reminded of the sea hunting ritual many Guardians enjoy. 

IR: Mmmm. Fishing. 

MK: The Guardians throw their hunting-lure into the sea in faith that many creatures live there, though they cannot see beneath its surface. And standing silently on shore, they might feel… helpless. For they cannot affect the sea. It is too vast, and too powerful. 

IR: I knew I disliked fishing for a reason. 

MK: In the face of such power, we must act with patience and humility. A fish hunter should not dwell on the invisible depths of the sea. This is only a distraction. Instead, they must focus on the fish hunting itself: the feel of the line and the ebb of the tides.  

IR: And that works? 

MK: I am happy to stand on the shore, appreciating the beauty and power of the sea without understanding it. Without controlling it. I have faith that, in time, the sea will reward my reverence with its abundance. 

IR: …The sea provides? 

MK: It does, Ikorakel. It does. 

TRANSCRIPTION ENDS
4153087276.text_zh:
// 先锋网络 // 高塔宽带 // 音频-623F // 已启用加密 
// 解密大师档案G-2-7D // 注释 // 机密 

IR：每当我抬头看到那传送门时，我心中的疑虑就越发强烈。 

MK：怀疑是智慧投下的阴影。只有通过质疑，我们才能发现深刻的真理。你在烦恼什么？ 

IR：我花了几个世纪研究光能。熟练掌握光能。我以为我…很了解它。足够了解它。看着见证者切开旅行者的外壳，我觉得自己…很无知。我意识到了我的知识是多么浅薄。   

MK：大机器的秘密困扰着许多埃里克斯尼族。艾多也有同样的恐惧。 

IR：你没有吗？ 

MK：它让我想起了许多守护者喜欢的海上狩猎仪式。 

IR：嗯。钓鱼。 

MK：守护者们把猎物铒食扔进海里，因为他们相信那里生活着许多生物，尽管他们看不到海面之下。静静地站在岸上，他们可能会感到…无助吧。因为他们无法影响大海。它太广阔，太强大了。 

IR：我就知道我不喜欢钓鱼是有原因的。 

MK：面对如此强大的力量，我们必须保持耐心和谦逊。猎鱼者不应沉溺于看不见的海洋深处。这只会分散自身的注意力。相反，他们必须专注于捕鱼本身：鱼线的感觉和潮汐的起伏。  

IR：这样有用么？ 

MK：我很乐意站在岸边，欣赏大海的美丽和力量，即使我不了解它，也不能控制它。我相信，假以时日，大海会用它的丰饶回报我的敬畏。 

IR：…大海会赐予我们所需？ 

MK：它会的，艾可拉凯尔。它会的。 

转录结束

3710082365.name: Lethophobia
3710082365.subtitle: By day the frolic, and the dance by night.
3710082365.text:
The wish-dragons took to the air one final time, soaring nimbly between the pillars on wings of prismatic light. Sjur Eido watched their pale, sinuous reflections sweep across the surface of the geodes. 

It had been many years since Huginn and Muninn first arrived in the city as a nameless pair, full of the fervor and cunning of their kind. For the greater portion of those years, Sjur considered them friends. They dined delicately on her desire for news of worlds beyond the Reef, spinning truth and lies with the cackling enthusiasm of dedicated storytellers. 

But now the Hunt had been called, and there was only one path into the future. 

Sjur stood waiting at the center of the chamber, her fingers loose around the grip of her bow, her head bowed. 

At last, the Ahamkara landed heavily to either side of her, scenting the air.  

"Are you unhappy?" Huginn asked, surprised. 

"What story was there that never ended?" Muninn said. 

"And can you not tell it again once it is over?" said Huginn.  

"We will be as true and solid as bone, forever." Muninn yawned wide, his curling tusks scraping against one another.  

"Rhetoric," Sjur muttered. 

She would miss them, all the same. Their shining inquisitiveness, their impossible wisdom. The fleeting grace of weapons purposefully sheathed.  

All of it lost in one dismal moment of surrender. Unless— 

Huginn tilted his head. Muninn parted his jaws to brandish a fanged smile.  

Sjur straightened to her full height. At her hip was the fractal knife she had been gifted from the Queen's own armory. In her hands, her great bow.  

"Come, then," she said, plucking an arrow from its quiver. "Give me a fight to remember."
3710082365.text_zh:
神龙最后一次腾空而起，乘着棱镜般的光翼在柱子之间灵活地翱翔。苏尔·艾多看着他们苍白而蜿蜒的倒影掠过晶石表面。 

距离休津和穆宁这对充满着热情和狡诈的无名组合第一次来到这座城市，已经过去很多年了。在这些年的大部分时间里，苏尔都把他们当做朋友。他们以她对暗礁以外的世界的知识的渴望为食，像专职的说书人一样热情地编织着真相和谎言。 

然而现在狩猎开始了。通向未来的道路只有一条。 

苏尔站在大厅中央等待着，低着头，手指轻轻地搭在弓弦上。 

最后，阿罕卡拉重重地落在了她的两侧，嗅着空气中的味道。  

“你不快乐吗？”休津惊讶地问道。 

“世上存在没有结局的故事吗？”穆宁说。 

“你不能在故事结束之后重新讲一遍吗？”休津说。  

“我们像骨头一样坚固、诚实，直到永远。”穆宁打了个大大的哈欠，弯曲的獠牙互相摩擦着。  

“诡辩，”苏尔嘀咕道。 

她还是会想念他们。他们毫不掩饰的好奇心，几乎不可能的智慧，还有武器故意放进鞘里的短暂优雅。  

所有这些都在投降时化为乌有。除非—— 

休津歪着头。穆宁张开下颌，露出獠牙，微笑起来。  

苏尔挺直了腰板。她腰上的短刀是女王从自己的军械库里取出来赠予她的。她的手中拿着她的大弓。  

“来吧，”她从箭筒中抽出一支箭，说道。“跟我大战一场吧。”

2558925366.subtitle: To the Voice on the other line.

1501688142.name: Doomed Petitioner
1501688142.subtitle: No more fear.
1501688142.text:
You were a Knight. Devastator of Sol. Ardent scholar of the Bladed Path. 


You are still taken.  

Nothing remains of you but the knife. You have been relinquished. The hand is severed.  

Wield yourself. 


What vows compel you? [You have no vows]  


What drives you? [You have no drive]  


You must take up the knife.  

You must take take take take take take take
1501688142.text_zh:
你曾是一名骑士。太阳系的毁灭者。刀锋之道的狂热学者。 


你仍然败了。  

你只剩这把匕首。你已被放弃，手被斩断。  

以自身为武器吧。 


什么誓言驱使着你？[你没有誓言]  


你的动力是什么？[你没有动力]  


你必须拿起匕首。  

你必须拿拿拿拿拿拿拿

92459755.name: Supercluster
92459755.subtitle: "We are all connected. I admit this despite the few people I would rather not share a paracausal connection with. Some people. …Many people." —Osiris
92459755.subtitle_zh: “我们是相互关联的。我承认这一点，尽管我不愿与少数…有些…很多人共享超因果联系。”——奥斯里斯
92459755.text:
"Osiris." 

Strand weaves around Osiris's hands. It dims and brightens, casting green light onto the messy scatter of books and star charts spread across his desk and the surrounding six feet of floor. 

"Osiris!" 

"What?" Osiris lowers his hands. 

Saint-14 is there, a solid wall of Exo in the doorway.  

Saint crosses his arms. "You didn't answer my call." 

"It is crucial that we learn how Ley Lines operate. I believe they share a connection with Strand, if only I can unlock it." 

His handful of Strand extends in loops around him, spiraling towards the ceiling, turning the purple of Saint's ribbons to gray. 

"I am reminded of Nimbus's tale of the river. Strand connects our minds. But what parts of us also touch Ley Lines?" 

"I liked Nimbus in your stories," Saint interjects, mild. "We should visit them." 

In a mood like this, a mild interjection can't stop Osiris. "Queen Mara's Techeuns can affect matter through Ley Lines. Their joined will pulls on threads woven through the Ascendant Plane. Two connected systems, the warp and weft of our universe's fabric—one, a spool of thread for this world, and another perhaps, for the Ascendant Plane?" 

Osiris's Strand grows brighter, until Saint's massive hand engulfs his own. No master of Darkness, Saint takes control with a gleaming Void tether as the glow of Strand slowly fades. 

"How long has it been since you've seen the sun?" Saint asks. 

"I was experimenting with Solar Light just the other day. You know this." 

"Not the same. Come. Stubbornness is unbecoming." Saint tugs gently at Osiris by their joined hands. 

Osiris stops in his tracks and snorts. "If the question between us is that of hard-headedness—" 

Ikora's going to give them a talking-to if Saint's laughter gets through the soundproofing to her office again. So, he persists: "It is late, and I have not seen you since you set your robe on fire. The work will wait." 

Osiris lets himself be led out the door, the connection between them still glowing bright.
92459755.text_zh:
“奥斯里斯。” 

缚丝缠绕在奥斯里斯的双手上。它时而变暗，时而变亮，将绿光投射到书桌上凌乱散落的书籍和星图上，以及六尺内的地板上。 

“奥斯里斯！” 

“什么？”奥斯里斯垂下了手臂。 

圣人14号，这位Exo就像一堵铁墙站在门廊里。  

圣人叉着手。“你没有接我的电话。” 

“弄懂灵脉的运作方式对我们至关重要。我相信它们与缚丝有某种联系，如果我能弄懂它就好了。” 

他手中的缚丝在周围绕圈延伸，盘旋着飞向天花板，将圣人的紫色缎带变成了灰色。 

“这让我想起了宁博思讲过的河流传说。缚丝连接着我们的思维。但我们中的哪个部分又连着灵脉呢？” 

“我喜欢你老是提起的那个宁博思，”圣人温和地插话道。“也许我们该去拜访这个人。” 

在这样的气氛中，温和的插话打断不了奥斯里斯。“玛拉女王的灵巫可以通过灵脉影响物质。她们的共同意志牵引着上维位面中编织着的丝线。两个相连的系统，我们宇宙结构的经纬线——其中一个是这个世界的线轴，也许另一个是上维位面的线轴？” 

奥斯里斯的缚丝越来越明亮，直到手被圣人的巨大手掌握住。圣人并非暗影的大师，他用一条发光的虚空系链控制住了局面。缚丝的光明慢慢褪去。 

“你有多久没见到太阳了？”圣人问道。 

“我几天前才用烈日的光能做过实验。你知道的。” 

“不是一回事。来吧。固执可不好。”圣人轻轻地拉了拉奥斯里斯的手。 

奥斯里斯停下动作，颇为不屑，“如果说我们中有谁固执——” 

如果圣人的笑声再次传进艾可拉的隔音办公室，那他肯定会被她好好说教一番。所以，他坚持道：“现在已经很晚了，而且我上次见你还是你长袍着火那次。工作的事可以等等。” 

奥斯里斯放任自己被带出门外，他们两人的联结仍在散发光亮。

1760096899.name: First Gift
1760096899.text:
|| O listeners, open your ears! There are choices ahead that you must make for yourselves. I will not act for you. I can only help by giving what I have left: my voice. ||  


Taranis hatches bathed in the light of the heliopause.  

The solar wind dries his damp wings, and the depth of space gives him room to grow. There's no hint of the Ahamkara who crafted his egg, nor of how many of them there were. No dams or sires wait for him. 

Taranis's first meal is the shell that nurtured him through his incubation. It snaps between his new teeth, a first taste of life. 

Taranis grows his first sensory organs. He uses them to look for more life. 

The universe contracts and expands with the force of will, the tension between what exists and what is wanted. Taranis learns to scent his way across these lines of tension, to navigate around other Ahamkara with no benign wishes for a little whim like Taranis. 

An Ahamkara's life and power are bound in their voice. Taranis sneaks silently in to listen to his elders at their feeding, the twists of their tongue, their multiplicity of meanings. He tracks other Ahamkara by the strength of their power, watches them hunt, slips past them to their catch. Their meals are bitter: Taranis can't swallow his stolen bites. 

Taranis learns he is plainspoken for an Ahamkara. What pleases his tongue is not what pleases others. 

The first wish Taranis grants is to a Cabal soldier patrolling her firebase in honor of empire and emperor. Hot sand blows in Mars's winds, whipping against her pressure suit, scratching the enamel on her greaves. She wishes for respite. To put down her equipment for a single day. To rest without being derelict in her duty. 

With a wish that broad, an Ahamkara could eat her whole. 

Instead, Taranis nudges weather patterns. It's easy to whip the wind up higher, let it pick up more sand. Till the growing sandstorm triggers the firebase's hazard alarms. 

The Cabal soldier hurries back to her firebase, hunched against the increasing wind. Her squadron leader is unprepared and has no plans drawn up for indoor duties. It is a failure he will answer for. But until he rectifies his failure, the soldier may go to her bunk and read a borrowed novel without compromising her duty. Her satisfaction grows rich and, hidden in the piping above her bunk, Taranis basks in it. 

His belly isn't full, but the sip she's given him is sweet. Nothing bitter in it, nothing sour, light on his tongue the way no other food has been. It is a good end to his first hunt: a good meal from his first partner. 

—-

Taranis grows more slowly than his age-mates. The sustenance he finds doesn't fill his belly like their hunts fill them. They grow in strength; tongues long, teeth fierce. They lose patience for a runt with overly delicate sensibilities. Taranis finds himself in need of a retreat. 

Taranis doggedly follows a faint trail—a hint of secrets in the air—all the way to a pinch in space. He makes his own door and enters. It is a place of life, lush with crimson flowers and trees speckled with water, trunks dripping sap. It is a place of potential, of possibility: a nursery for life itself. A garden, a grove. 

A fine place for a nest. A fine place for Taranis to teach himself who he is. 

—- 

There is something lacking from his nest. 

The grove sustains him when the sips of his partners' dreams aren't enough. His belly is never empty enough to ache, cradled in his garden. 

But Taranis tastes an itch in his heart and knows it is not enough. 

He leaves his nest to hunt for it. 

—- 

Taranis drifts through Venus's atmosphere on albatross wings. The Vex are a dull prickle, a flat endless weight. Taranis will make no bargains with them. 

A drekh on patrol in water up to their knees wishes for growth, stumps itching under docking caps. They picture themself with a hundred arms, a thousand eyes, a spine like a tree. Tall enough to lift themself out of the water, to take their House by Skiff and Ketch back to their first home, a hero crowned in honor like Chelchis. 

Taranis circles far overhead, riding on the thermal of their desire, till a brighter spark on the horizon pulls his attention away. 

He follows the spark and finds Lightbearers. He has seen their kind before: Earth's Lightbearers get into every corner of Sol. They poke around for mysteries to solve. They pick fights with Psions. They peel Vex structures for prizes to wear on their belts. A Lightbearer makes a strong partner, with a firm will and steady belief in their own importance. A Lightbearer creates ripples through the world with the weight of their concentrated potential. A dozen walk alone or in small groups on Venus now, unbothered by decay and the threat of death around every corner. 

Eleven Lightbearers dig through archives, battle Vex, and skim lightly over deep water, their desires shifting with circumstance. The twelfth Lightbearer sits unmoving under the spilling branches of a willow. His desires are faint, despite the firmness of his will. His presence is a cool taste in the back of Taranis's throat, pale as the light from the Lightbearer's lantern. 

Taranis slips through the water to watch him from a distance, nothing but eyes and nostrils peeking out above the surface. 

The sun sets, and still the Lightbearer sits. Venus turns, and the Lightbearer sits. Only the smallest threads of desire reach Taranis. This Lightbearer alone wishes for nothing. 

Taranis sinks back into the water without a ripple. 

—- 

Taranis drifts towards something new: a gateway tucked carefully into an asteroid belt. He eels through rock and debris to a city opalescent with dreams. He can feel the marks of its makers on it, a powerful Ahamkara with a powerful partner. 

The city is filled with souls who know Ahamkara. All those minds, those wills, potential partners holding fragments of grit for Taranis to envelop in pearls. Something he could build to match this masterpiece of a city. 

Mist curls in fractals around Taranis, leaving a faintly bitter taste on his tongue. There's danger baked into this pocket world, a risk its citizens are only half-aware of. The source of that danger is the source of the city and all its beauty. Taranis can't help but track towards it: a distant chiming, a laugh in the underpainting of the city.  

Taranis slithers toward what he will later learn is the Spine of Keres, and a massive claw pins him to the ground. 

"What do you think you're doing in my territory?" multiple voices inquire. The laugh emerges into the foreground. Leathery frills frame a massive head. An uncertain number of eyes glow bright with curiosity and malice. 

This Ahamkara has gravity like a black hole. Taranis feels her grip on the warp and weft of desire encircling them and knows he can do nothing to stop himself from being drawn in.
1760096899.text_zh:
||倾听者，请竖起耳朵！未来有你们必须自己做出的选择。我无法代替你们选择。我能帮你们的唯有付出我仅剩的一切：我的声音。||  


塔拉尼斯的蛋沐浴在日球层顶的阳光下。  

太阳风吹干了他潮湿的翅膀，太空的深度给了他成长的空间。没有任何关于造出这个蛋的阿罕卡拉的线索，也不知道有多少个这样的蛋。没有母亲，也没有父亲在等着他。 

塔拉尼斯的第一餐便是哺育他度过孵化期的蛋壳。他用新牙咬断了它，这是他第一次尝到生命的滋味。 

塔拉尼斯长出了第一批感知器官，用来寻找更多的生命。 

宇宙在意志的力量、存在和欲望之间的张力下收缩和膨胀。塔拉尼斯学会了用嗅觉穿越这些绷紧的线条，在其他阿罕卡拉周围穿行，而这些阿罕卡拉对像塔拉尼斯这样的小奇思并无善愿。 

阿罕卡拉的生命和力量都凝聚在他们的声音中。塔拉尼斯悄无声息地溜进去听长辈们进食，听他们的巧舌如簧，听他们的多重语义。他借用其他阿罕卡拉的力量追踪他们，观察他们捕猎，从他们身边溜过，捕捉他们的猎物。他们的食物很苦：偷窃来的口粮让塔拉尼斯难以下咽。 

塔拉尼斯了解到，作为一头阿罕卡拉，他太过直白。自己说得容易，却未必能取悦别人。 

塔拉尼斯的第一个愿望赐给了一个在火力基地巡逻，为帝国和大帝效忠的卡巴尔士兵。火星的热风吹起滚烫的沙子，拍打在她的压力服上，刮花了她胫甲上的珐琅质。她许愿能喘息片刻，能有一天可以卸下装备，在保证职责的前提下能好好休息一番。 

这么宽泛的一个愿望，阿罕卡拉可以把她整个吞食掉。 

可塔拉尼斯却对天气模式进行了调整。让风吹得更高，卷起更多的沙子。直到越来越大的沙尘暴触发了火力基地的危险警报。一切都易如反掌。 

卡巴尔士兵顶着愈刮愈猛的风匆忙赶回火力基地。她的中队长毫无准备，也没有制定内勤计划。他得为自己的失职负责。但在他纠正这次失误之前，这名士兵可以去她的床铺看一本借来的小说，而不会影响她的职责。她的满足感越来越浓，而塔拉尼斯藏在铺位上方的管道中，沉浸其中。 

他的胃口还没填满，但她让他尝到了甜味。里面没有苦味，也没有酸味，在他的舌头上跃动着的是进食其他食物从未有过的轻盈。他的首次狩猎得到了一个美好的结局：来自他第一位搭档的一顿大餐。 

—-

塔拉尼斯相较于同龄伙伴成长得要慢一些。他找到的给养并不能像其他人的猎物那样填饱他的肚子。他们的力气越来越大，舌头日渐增长，牙齿愈发锋利。他们对于这样一个过于脆弱敏感的幼崽失去了耐心。塔拉尼斯意识到自己需要退一步。 

塔拉尼斯顽强地追随着微弱的踪迹——空气中弥漫着一丝神秘气息——一路来到太空中的一个夹缝。他自己造了一扇门进去。这是一处充满生机的所在，郁郁葱葱的深红色花朵和点缀着水滴的树木，树干上滴着树液。这里充满了潜力和可能性：这是属于生命的苗圃。一个花园，一片小树林。 

对塔拉尼斯来说，这是一个筑巢的好地方，来认识自我。 

—- 

他的巢穴里还缺了点什么。 

搭档们的愿望啜饮远远不够，但他靠着这片小树林撑了下来。接着花园的供给，他的肚子永远不会空到发痛。 

但塔拉尼斯心里痒痒的，他知道这还不够。 

它离开巢穴去寻找。 

—- 

塔拉尼斯展翅在金星大气层中飘荡。Vex带着一种沉闷的刺痛感，还有无限枯燥的沉重感。塔拉尼斯不会和他们进行交易。 

有一名在水深及膝的水中巡逻的堕落者士兵，它的残肢在截肢皮罩下搔痒着，许愿自己能长出肢体来。它想象自己能拥有百只手臂、千只眼睛和像树一样挺拔的脊柱。它希望长得足够高，就可以从水里上来，乘着突击艇和双桅船将其氏族带回最早的家，做一个像切尔奇斯那样受勋加冕的英雄。 

塔拉尼斯远远地在上空盘旋，乘着其欲望之热，直到地平线上一束更亮的火花将他的注意力引开。 

他跟随着火花找到了负光者。他以前见过他们的同类：地球负光者遍及太阳系的各个角落。他们四处探寻谜团。他们跟灵能士兵挑起争端。他们剥下Vex结构作为奖品，戴在腰带上。负光者会是强大的搭档，拥有坚定的意志，坚信自身的重要使命。负光者用他们积聚潜力的重量在世界各地泛起涟漪。现在，有十几个负光者独自或结伴在金星上行走，丝毫不受破败和死亡威胁的困扰。 

十一名负光者翻阅着档案，与Vex战斗，轻盈地掠过深水，他们的欲望随着环境而改变。第十二位负光者一动不动地坐在一棵垂落的柳树下。他的欲望十分微弱，意志却很坚定。他的存在就像塔拉尼斯喉咙深处一股清凉的味道，苍白得就像负光者灯笼里的光芒。 

塔拉尼斯滑过水面，远远地看着他，只有眼睛和鼻孔露出水面。 

夕阳西下，负光者依然端坐。金星转动，负光者静坐如故。只有细微的欲望之线触及塔拉尼斯。这名孤身的负光者一无所求。 

塔拉尼斯沉入水中，没有泛起一丝波澜。 

—- 

塔拉尼斯朝着新的方向——一个被谨慎地藏在小行星带中的入口处漂移。他迂回地穿过岩石和废墟来到一座散发着乳白色光芒、满是愿望的城市。他能感觉到造城者在上面留下的印记，那是一头强大的阿罕卡拉和一位强大的搭档。 

城里到处都是知晓阿罕卡拉的灵魂。所有那些心灵，那些意志，那些潜在的搭档都拿着沙砾碎片等待着塔拉尼斯用珍珠包裹起来。他可以用它们来造出配得上这座奇妙城市的东西来。 

雾气在塔拉尼斯周围袅袅升起，在他的舌上留下了淡淡的苦味。这个袖珍世界里蕴藏着危险，而它的居民对这种危险却只是一知半解。那种危险的源头正是这座城市及其所有美丽的源头。塔拉尼斯情不自禁地追寻着它：远处的钟声，城市底色里的笑声。  

塔拉尼斯滑向另一处方向，他后来才知道那就是克蕾丝脊柱，这时有一只巨大的爪子将他按倒在地。 

“你在我的地盘上干什么？”多个声音齐声质问。笑声逐渐突出。皮质的流苏衬托着巨大的头颅。无数双眼睛闪动着好奇和恶意。 

这头阿罕卡拉有着黑洞一般的引力。塔拉尼斯感知到她能紧紧把控住包围他们的欲望经纬，知道自己无力抵抗被卷入其中。

1760096896.name: Second Gift
1760096896.text:
|| O my eggs! O my whims, more precious than my eyes, dearer than my tongue! Eat my story, take it into your bodies. Grow your egg-teeth. Crack your shells. Choose. || 


Two forms move above the Dreaming City, curving between the pressures of gravity and desire. 

Riven turns long, streaming whiskers and mane behind her, sunset golds draping themselves across her sides. In response, Taranis's bare hide sprouts carp scales in gleaming blue. His wings recede as his mane grows. 

He twists around Riven, neck on neck for a moment, before he slips ahead through the mists of Divalia. 

There's a wish on the wind. A mind far below, dreaming of a change to the world. Taranis noses toward it. 

One of Mara's Awoken sits under the vault of a broken geode. He dreams, looking out over the shifting mists. Ambition is woven through his thoughts, a wish for a more comfortable home. One shaped like a memory, with a parent in the Distributary making sesame pastries soaked in honey. Too sweet, too sticky, but beloved. 

Riven crouches like a gargoyle on the cliff above as Taranis spirals down to meet him. They speak. They learn one another's names: Taranis. Gwilym. 

A tripod-legged silver tray with a teapot and plate settles beside them. 

Taranis, curled into a catlike form, sits with Gwilym. A few crumbs land on his side. A few tears. 

Gwilym rises when the sun slips to the edge of the fabricated horizon. He holds out a hand in thanks and startles when Taranis grows a thumb to clasp it. 

"No wonder you're so small," Riven says, when Taranis has wound his way back up the cliff to her. It's barely a mouthful, filling one small desire without grasping for more. Not much more than a sip. 

"It's enough for me," says Taranis.  

"It's foolish," Riven snarls with all the force available to her. A strong, well-fed Ahamkara in the heart of her power. A king enthroned. 

"I'm a fool." 

The tip of Taranis's tail reaches for Riven's. They twine together. She doesn't shake it off. 

—- 

Riven prowls through the grove. It thrills Taranis to see her here, to feel her will pushing at its borders. 

His nest has been potential life. It was missing this: active life. The pressures of will and desire. The chance to choose more. 

"May I show you my nest, O Riven, O creator of a city of pearls, O shaper of souls?" 

Riven shutters her eyes with great plates of bone. "That mode of speech is unworthy, O foolish companion mine." 

But naming without claim suits Taranis. It's an argument he and Riven will never settle. He will call her O beloved, O master artisan, without ever appending the "mine," and she will forever call him her fool. 

"Riven, then. I'd show you my grove as you showed me your city." 

They walk the stone pathways softened by moss. They climb through flowers, and condensation from the damp air rolls down their necks. Taranis guides Riven to the heart of his nest. He watches her stride through it, taking the lead. 

"I've seen the things Mara's brother brought back from this place. They didn't smell of your nest." 

"His ambitions don't suit my palate." 

The prince and his partner hadn't approached Taranis's nest on their journey. Taranis had made sure of it. 

Riven's will causes eddies in the fabric of Taranis's home. It begins to grow around her into more of a place of mystery, a place of dangers for the unwary. Taranis rests his jaw on his forelimbs, watching, nudging her will with his own when her changes grow too vast. He wants this. His home is still his own. 

Riven circles back to Taranis, who is sprawled in a patch of grass. She sits on him resentfully. 

"You are singularly unlike any Ahamkara I've met. I am astonished you're still alive." Riven grows heavier. Taranis snorts into the grass as his body presses into it. 

"Hasn't your time with the Awoken changed you? We both made the choices our homes gave us." 

"You're less than you could be."  

Taranis settles more firmly into the grass. "I'm myself. That is the end of my ambition." 

"Your brain has shrunk with your stomach." Riven presses her claws into Taranis's spine. Her voices thrum together in frustration. "We will build here. Together. If you won't let yourself grow, then we will make something that does." 

And they do.  

The language of secrets and desire passes between them as they build. Mysteries bury themselves in the grass. The grove grows wilder, paths sprawling out to meet Riven's nest in the Dreaming City. 

Alight with creation, Taranis says, "There's one more thing I want to make with you." 

He does not stop to lay out a contract. This is no bargain, with each Ahamkara giving precisely what is owed and no more, in fear of being devoured by their own partner. There are no clauses to whittle down. Taranis doesn't hold back. 

Instead he gives himself as a gift, and Riven gives herself to him in return. Together, they make something new. 

Taranis unspools his own cells into embryos, pulling from his lungs and heart and blood, taking the initiator's role, that of the dam. In response, Riven kindles them, feeding Taranis a sire's strength for the task. Together, they spin will and memory into shells to house the embryos, their future whims.  

A great gamble. And a solidified future. 

The two of them and their clutch, a new generation of Ahamkara raised in the Dreaming City and the Black Garden. To one day be as they wish. 

What other Ahamkara had created life like this? With generosity and affection, with teeth unbared and voice unspilled? If any had, Taranis never met them, nor heard their story. 

Taranis sprawls out against the cool stone and moss of his nest, exhausted. Riven stands by him, inspecting their eggs with cool, critical eyes. 

Their first gift to their whims is existence.
1760096896.text_zh:
||我的蛋啊！我的奇思啊，比我的眼睛还要珍稀，比我的舌头还要可贵！吞食我的故事，把它摄入你们的身体。长出你们的蛋牙。破壳而出吧。做出选择。|| 


两个形态在幽梦之城上空移动，在重力和欲望的压力之间弯曲着。 

魅痕转过身，长长的腮须和鬃毛在身后飘动，暮光下映衬出它们的金辉垂在身侧。作为回应，塔拉尼斯赤裸的兽皮上冒出了闪着蓝光的鲤鱼鳞片。他的双翼随着鬃毛的生长而收缩。 

他绕着魅痕旋转，脖子紧贴了一会儿，然后向前穿过迪瓦里安的迷雾。 

在风中有一个愿望。在遥远的地底深处，有人梦想改变世界。塔拉尼斯朝它窥探过去。 

玛拉的一个觉醒者坐在破碎晶洞的拱顶下。他想象着，眺望着变幻的迷雾。他的想法中交织着雄心壮志，希望能有个更舒适的家。一个塑造得像记忆一般的家，有位处在两仪界中的家长正在制作着浸泡在蜂蜜里的芝麻点心。太过甜腻，太过粘稠，但深受喜爱。 

塔拉尼斯盘旋而下与他见面，魅痕则像个石像鬼一样蹲在上方的悬崖。他们对话。他们了解彼此的名字：塔拉尼斯。格维伦。 

他们身旁放着一个三脚银托盘，上面摆着茶壶和碟子。 

塔拉尼斯蜷曲成似猫的模样，和格维伦坐在一起。一些面包屑落在他身边。还有几滴泪。 

当太阳滑落到空洞地平线的边缘时，格维伦站起身来。他伸出一只手表示感谢，塔拉尼斯长出大拇指来握住他的手，把他吓了一跳。 

“难怪你这么小，”当塔拉尼斯蜿蜒着上到悬崖来到她身边时，魅痕说道。这只能算勉强小酌了一口，满足了一个小小的愿望，仅此而已。不过是一啜之量。 

“这对我来说已经足够了，”塔拉尼斯说道。  

“这太傻了，”魅痕用力咆哮道。她就是一头居于权力中心，强大而健硕的阿罕卡拉。像登上王位的王。 

“我就是个傻瓜。” 

塔拉尼斯的尾巴尖伸向魅痕的尾巴。它们缠绕在一起。她没有把它甩开。 

—- 

魅痕在小树林里潜行。看到她在这里，感觉到她的意志在向边界推进，这让塔拉尼斯兴奋不已。 

他的巢穴一直是潜在的生命。它缺少活跃的生命、意志和欲望的压力，和选择更多的机会。 

“我可以带你看看我的巢穴吗，魅痕——珍珠之城的缔造者，灵魂塑造师？” 

魅痕用巨大的骨甲遮住了她的眼睛。“这种说话方式有失你的身份，我的傻瓜伴侣。” 

但不带所属的称呼更加适合塔拉尼斯。这是他和魅痕永远无法解决的争论。他会叫她，亲爱的、工匠大师，却绝不会加上“我的”前缀，而她则会永远管他叫她的傻瓜。 

“那就叫魅痕吧。我要带你去看我的小树林，就像你带我去看你的城市一样。” 

他们走在被青苔软化的石子路上。他们爬过花丛，潮湿空气中的冷凝水顺着他们的脖子往下滚落。塔拉尼斯带着魅痕来到他的巢穴中心。他看着她大步走过，走在前面。 

“我见过玛拉的兄弟从这个地方带回来的东西。它们闻起来没有你巢穴的气味。” 

“他的野心不合我的口味。” 

王子和他的同伴在旅途中没有接近过塔拉尼斯的巢穴。塔拉尼斯确保了这一点。 

魅痕的意志在塔拉尼斯家的织体中引发了涡流。它开始在她四周生长，变成一个更神秘、对粗心之人充满危险的地方。塔拉尼斯把下巴放在前肢上观察着，如果她变化过大，他就会轻轻推一下她的意志。他想要如此。他的家仍是他自己的。 

魅痕绕回到塔拉尼斯身边，他瘫卧在一片草地上。她愤愤地坐在他身上。 

“你和我见过的阿罕卡拉完全不同。我很惊讶你居然还活着。”魅痕变得越来越重。塔拉尼斯对着草丛哼了一声，身体陷入其中。 

“你和觉醒者待一起那么久，就没有什么改变吗？我们做出的选择，是我们的家园给予的。” 

“你其实可以更强的。”  

塔拉尼斯向草丛里靠了靠。“我就是我自己。我野心就这么大。” 

“你的大脑跟着你的胃在萎缩。”魅痕用爪子压住塔拉尼斯的脊柱。她的声音很沮丧。“我们会在这里一起建造。如果你不让自己成长起来，那我们就造些能成长的东西。” 

他们确实这么做了。  

他们建造时，秘密和欲望的语言就在他们之间传递着。奥秘藏在草丛之中。小树林长势越来越猛，小路向外延伸与幽梦之城中魅痕的巢穴相连。 

塔拉尼斯因创造而神采奕奕，他说道，“我还有一件事想和你一起做。” 

他没有停下来拟定合同。这不是交易，每头阿罕卡拉都只会给予自己所允诺的东西，仅此而已，因为怕被自己的搭档所吞食。没有可以删减的条款。塔拉尼斯没有保留。 

相反，他把自身作为礼物献了出去，魅痕也把自己献给了他作为回报。他们一起创造出了新的东西。 

塔拉尼斯将自己的细胞解绕成胚胎，从他的肺、心脏和血液中抽出细胞，扮演了引发剂的角色，即母亲。作为回应，魅痕点燃了它们，给塔拉尼斯输送了一种父亲的力量来完成任务。他们携手将意志和记忆编织成卵壳来承载胚胎——他们未来的奇思。  

这是一次伟大的赌博，将彼此的未来紧紧凝固在一起。 

他们俩孕育子嗣，那是在幽梦之城和黑暗花园长大的新一代阿罕卡拉。终有一天会如他们所愿。 

还有哪头阿罕卡拉创造过这样的生命？带着慷慨和爱意，带着赤裸利齿和未溢之声？就算有，塔拉尼斯也未曾谋面，未曾听闻他们的故事。 

塔拉尼斯躺在他巢穴冰冷的石头和苔藓上，精疲力竭。魅痕站在他身边，用冷静而挑剔的目光审视着他们的蛋。 

他们送给子嗣的第一份礼物就是生存。

1760096897.name: Third Gift
1760096897.text:
|| O eggs, O little cells! If nothing else, if you let this memory pass with no other exegesis, learn this: you were loved. || 
 

Taranis and Riven scatter their eggs across spacetime, giving them life to look on and grow near. From his grove, a nursery once more, Taranis broods on them. He takes on avian characteristics, letting feathers grow along a snakelike body. He fluffs himself up in his nest to spin new dreams for their clutch. He hums with pride, and his eggs chime along with him. 

When he was born, Taranis had hatched out in the cold, nothing but his shell to sustain him. But their eggs, he vows, will have more. They will have a surfeit. They will know the names of their forebears, dam and sire both. 

"If I'd known eggs would have settled you down so much, I'd have proposed it myself long ago," says Riven, their sire. Her voice is distant and comes to him with the energy of her city, moving like cold water over gleaming stone. A sure sign that she is at work with her queen. 

"Between death and life, you chose life." Taranis, his voice plain as it is, makes sure his smugness carries all the way to the Dreaming City. 

"I could still kill you."  

In perfect security, Taranis says, "But you won't." 

Riven's laugh is that of a pride of lions. 

—- 

Riven's voice faintly reaches across space to Taranis. 

"Don't come to the Dreaming City. Stay in your nest." 

Taranis rouses. "Too busy at your work today?" 

"Lightbearers are hunting Ahamkara. The Awoken are helping." 

Taranis stands. "They won't hurt me. Maybe I can talk sense into them." He lets the strands bringing their minds together fall from his grasp. 

"Listen to me," Riven presses. 

The Dreaming City boils with activity, violent desires rising within its citizens. They load weapons. They make plans. Taranis recoils from their dreams. 

Riven's power is leashed. She roars through her bars: 

"You colossal fool, leave or I'll bite your throat open!" 

Taranis does not leave. 

The queen of the city stands in a hall. She is surrounded by her people and crates of weapons ready to be distributed to allies outside the Reef. Taranis avoids them all, tracking the scent of other Ahamkara. 

He finds Azirim alone in a glade of luminous reeds, worrying at a piece of quartz. 

Azirim's shape is spiked today, sharp with defenses. His voice is far more sour than usual. "You missed the crowd. Guess your nest was just too far to make it in time." 

Spikes grow along Taranis's own spine, edging his wings. "And you waited." 

"Yeah, I wanted to let you know." Azirim's jaw drops into a smile. "You're tight with the lady of the house. But it won't save you, and it won't save her. You're both just fish in the barrel now." 

"My partners won't return death for generosity." 

"You think that now. Me, I'll welcome it. I'll live forever as bones. I'll eat life. I'll eat worlds. You just watch me from that nice rose garden of yours." 

Azirim's laugh is the last part of him to fade from the glade. 

—- 

Taranis scuttles along the wainscotting, a swift mouse-shape. Boots thump past him, tracking mud and urgency along the tiles. Wishes push at Taranis, for success, for safety, for the thrill of the hunt. 

Taranis searches for an Awoken he knows. A partner once dealt with in fairness.  

Gwilym is in his room tying back his long hair, bright silver against the deep blue of his hands. There is a bag on a hook by the door, a knife tucked inside, its edge whetted. 

Gwilym's muddled desires fill the room with a heavy steam. 

Behind him, Taranis lets himself grow from mouse to cat—the shape Gwilym knew him in. 

"Will you join the hunt, O companion?" 

Gwilym jumps. His hand leaps to his heart, clutching the heavy fabric of his jacket. 

"You shouldn't be here." 

"I shouldn't visit a partner?" Taranis's long tail twitches. 

"Azirim killed the last partner I had. Walked her and the rest of her Corsair squad right off a cliff. The Dreaming City can't afford more losses to the Ahamkara."  

Gwilym's voice is that of a man convincing himself. 

"Azirim is not all of us." 

Gwilym raises his voice in alarm, and a tall Corsair quickly barrels through the door. 

Taranis makes it out in the window in dragonfly form, just out of reach of the gloved hand snatching for him. 

—- 

"O love, you were right." 

"I'm always right."  

"If all we are is teeth and all they are is claws, what world are we dreaming into existence together?" Taranis's wings cover his face. The soft breezes of the grove don't touch him. 

"A world of teeth and claws." Many of Riven's voices are bitter, but none are surprised. 

The eggs are so delicate that they make no ripples at all in the fabric of reality. They're curled-up potential, fragile within crystal will. Hard to make. Easy to shatter. 

"We'll build for ourselves, and even when we're bones, we'll sing to our children." 

Riven reaches out with a thread of a thought. A secret overheard in the palace between Uldren, Mara's brother, and Jolyon Till, his Rachis. It feels like raspberries and quartz. It smells like the Divalian Mists. A fine secret to share and never speak out loud. Taranis unfolds himself from under his wings, and they weave it together into something grander. 

Together, Riven and Taranis weave more secrets; for their children, for the joys of creation, for outwitting any future seekers.  

The voices of their fellow Ahamkara change slowly from the thrum of the living to the echo of the dead. Their bones whisper to powerful minds. A scale off Eao's shoulder eventually rattles in the pocket of Riven's mechanical acquaintance. Azirim's skull and spine lie in wait for a victim.  

The living voices recede till Riven and Taranis are the only ones left, speaking across the empty distance. 

Until Taranis calls for Riven and she does not answer. 

And the chime of their eggs falls almost silent.
1760096897.text_zh:
||亲爱的子嗣，小小的细胞啊！无论如何，如果这段记忆逝去，你们无处知晓，请记得：你们被爱过。|| 
 

塔拉尼斯和魅痕将他们的蛋散布在时空中，让他们在生命的注视下茁壮成长。塔拉尼斯从他的小树林（又一次成了苗圃）里凝视着他们。他呈现出鸟类的特征，让羽毛沿着蛇形般的身体生长。他在巢穴里抖松起毛发，为他们的蛋编织新的梦想。他骄傲地哼唱着，他的蛋也跟着鸣响。 

塔拉尼斯出生时，他在严寒中孵化，唯有他的蛋壳供养着他。但是他发誓，他们的蛋会有更多的保障。他们的食物不会短缺。他们会知道自己父母的名字。 

“要是我知道蛋能让你如此安定下来，我早就自己提出来了，”魅痕说道。她的声音很遥远，带着她城市的能量传到他的耳朵里，像冰冷的水在闪闪发光的石头上流动着。这说明她现在正和女王一起工作。 

“在死亡与生命之间，你选择了生命。”塔拉尼斯的声音简单直白，幽梦之城里的魅痕立刻听出了他语气中的洋洋得意。 

“我还是可以杀了你。”  

塔拉尼斯很确定地说道，“但你不会。” 

魅痕的笑犹如狮群的笑声一般。 

—- 

魅痕的声音穿过空间隐约传到了塔拉尼斯的耳朵里。 

“别来幽梦之城。待在你的巢穴里。” 

塔拉尼斯来了兴趣。“你今天工作太忙了吗？” 

“负光者正在猎杀阿罕卡拉。觉醒者在帮忙。” 

塔拉尼斯站起身来。“他们不会伤害我的。也许我能说服他们。”他断开了联结他们的丝线。 

“听我的话，”魅痕催促道。 

幽梦之城里蠢蠢欲动，市民们心中的暴力欲望不断上升。他们填装武器，制定计划。塔拉尼斯被他们的梦想吓到了。 

魅痕的力量被束缚了。她隔着栅栏咆哮道： 

“你这个大傻瓜，走开，不然我就咬开你的喉咙！” 

塔拉尼斯没有离开。 

城市的女王站在大厅里。她的人民簇拥着她，还有血多准备分发给暗礁外盟友的成箱武器。塔拉尼斯避开他们，追踪着其他阿罕卡拉的气味。 

他发现阿兹瑞姆独自处在一片明亮的芦苇林中，正对着一块石英岩担忧。 

今天阿兹瑞姆的形体呈尖刺状，锋芒毕露，充满戒备。他的声音比平时凶狠多了。“你错过了大部队。我猜是你的巢穴太远了，没能及时赶到。” 

塔拉尼斯的脊柱上长出了尖刺，翅膀无比锐利。“而你在等我。” 

“是的，我想让你知道。”阿兹瑞姆的下巴垂下来，露出了笑容。“你和女主人关系很好。但这救不了你，也救不了她。你们现在都是瓮中之鳖了。” 

“我的搭档不会以怨报德。” 

“你现在是这么想。而我，却很乐于接受。我将作为骸骨永生。我要吞食生命。我要吞食世界。你就在你那漂亮的玫瑰园里看着我吧。” 

阿兹瑞姆连同他的笑声渐渐从林地中消失。 

—- 

塔拉尼斯沿着墙边疾跑，像一只敏捷的老鼠。沉重的步伐从他身边经过，步履匆忙，瓷片沾满了鞋子溅起的污泥。各种愿望向塔拉尼斯袭来，有祈求成功的，有祈求安全的，还有祈求狩猎快感的。 

塔拉尼斯在寻找某位他认识的觉醒者。那是一位曾经和他进行公平交易的搭档。  

格维伦正在房间里，绑起他的长发，在他深蓝双手的衬托下，头发显得银光闪闪。门边的钩子上挂着一个袋子，里面塞着一把刀，刀刃磨得锃亮。 

格维伦混乱的欲望让整个房间弥漫着浓重的蒸汽。 

在他身后，塔拉尼斯把自己从老鼠变成了猫——这是格维伦认识他时的样子。 

“你会加入狩猎吗，我的同伴？” 

格维伦跳了起来。他的手紧紧抓着胸口厚重的夹克面料。 

“你不该来这儿。” 

“我不该来看搭档吗？”塔拉尼斯长长的尾巴抽动了一下。 

“阿兹瑞姆杀了我最后一个搭档。把她和她海盗军小队的其他人一起推下了悬崖。幽梦之城不能再因阿罕卡拉蒙受更多损失了。”  

格维伦发出的声音就像是在说服自己。 

“阿兹瑞姆不代表着所有的阿罕卡拉。” 

格维伦惊慌地提高了嗓门，一个高大的海盗军士兵迅速冲了进来。 

塔拉尼斯化作蜻蜓飞出窗外，正好躲过了那只戴着手套的手的抢夺。 

—- 

“亲爱的，你是对的。” 

“我向来是对的。”  

“如果我们只是尖牙，他们只是利爪，那我们梦想共存的世界又是什么呢？”塔拉尼斯的双翼遮住了他的脸。林间的微风吹拂不到他。 

“一个充满了尖牙利爪的世界。”魅痕的众多声音都愤愤不平，但没有显露出丝毫惊讶。 

这些蛋非常易碎，在现实织体中丝毫不会泛起涟漪。他们是蜷缩在水晶意志中里的潜能和脆弱。难造而易碎。 

“我们会为自己建造房屋，即使我们已成骨骸，也会为我们的孩子歌唱。” 

魅痕伸出一丝思绪。那是在宫殿里偷听到的玛拉的兄弟欧顿和他的羽轴乔里恩·提欧之间的秘密。它摸起来像树莓和石英。闻起来像迪瓦里安迷雾。这是个值得分享的秘密，但绝不能大声说出来。塔拉尼斯从他的双翼下展开，将其编织成了更宏伟的东西。 

魅痕和塔拉尼斯一起编织了更多的秘密；为了他们的孩子，为了创造的乐趣，为了胜过以后的追踪者。  

他们的同伴阿罕卡拉的声音慢慢地从生者之响变成了死者回声。他们的骨骸在向强大的心灵低语。伊奥肩上的鳞片最终在魅痕那位机械熟人的口袋里咯咯作响。阿兹瑞姆的头骨和脊柱则等待着某位受害者的到来。  

生者之音逐渐远去，直到只剩下魅痕和塔拉尼斯的声音，隔着空旷的距离对话。 

直到塔拉尼斯呼喊魅痕，而她没有回答。 

他们的蛋的鸣响也几乎沉寂。

1760096902.name: Last Bargain
1760096902.text:
|| O my eggs, we meant to have eternity! To think our voices could be silenced forever! Sharpen your sight for unintended clauses. Step carefully around the waiting snare. Beware the bargain that makes you less than what you were! || 

 
Taranis crawls small and silent through Esila's gardens. Power drips through the Dreaming City, corrupting its air, cracking its shining facets. 

Creatures lurch through the grass on the strings of their master's desire, their own wills gone to rot. 

Corruption spreads from the center of the Dreaming City. The grit at the pearl's heart poisons the city, poisons Riven, and poisons their eggs from the inside out. 

There's a murmur. Taranis slithers towards it to listen. 

What speaks is not Riven, not as Taranis knows her. 

Taranis knows her every voice, the way her claws tug at reality. There is no shape Riven could take in which he would not know her. And there should be no shape Taranis could take in which Riven would not know him. 

But now, Riven does not know him. Does not taste Taranis's fear on the wind. Does not look away from her revenge to notice him at all. 

Taranis returns to his nest unseen, in grief. 

Life flows along the branches of the nursery. However many paths have been closed off outside, potential still flourishes in this grove, Light and Dark giving off new buds together. 

Taranis shuts himself off from it, retreating to his hoard of secrets. Stone grows up his sides. Moss and vines follow, tracing words on his sides. 

While dormant, Taranis listens to this new Riven's voice—the voice of a king, uninterested in magnanimity. A strong and unyielding voice that tastes of iron.  

Only faint chimes of his Riven are left in the wish-born shells of their remaining eggs. And there are so few left. 

The thought rouses Taranis from his stupor.  

Taranis and Riven are the last Ahamkara. What Riven has become is an abdication of responsibility, life only for her own sake; power and spite. 

The final eggs are the last living remnants of Riven and of their shared work. 

Taranis can't abdicate his responsibility to them. Can't erase their opportunity to choose. 

As Taranis made his own life and suited his diet to his tongue, his eggs will make themselves. Vines break from Taranis's body as he stands. 

His eggs will survive.  

There is one last bargain he can make. One last gift he can give them. One last use for his tongue.  

Taranis reaches out to his eggs. He gathers up his power, his life, his voice. His own wish for the sake of his children, a snare for a future Wish-Keeper. 

For the final time, Taranis opens his throat to speak. 

 

|| O my eggs! O my children! O future whims, O dreams of your own devising! I am dead, and Riven, your sire, is caged. 

Remember that the easy meal, the little joy, passes soon. What fills your belly forever is satisfaction. Grow well! Eat life to sate your belly's hunger and return it as a gift to sate your heart's. 

No bargain can grant you a life without pain; make your bargains carefully.  

But give your gifts carelessly, to all who enter your heart, and they will give life back to you in turn. 

All that is left of me is yours: take it and choose. 

Choose with care who you will be. Promise me only that you will live. 

O Wish-Keeper, my death is in your hands. Bear it well. 

Remember me. Remember I was Taranis Rivensmate till the end. ||
1760096902.text_zh:
||我的蛋啊，我们本该拥有永恒！本以为我们的声音可以永远沉寂！擦亮你们的眼睛对待不经意的条款。小心绕过窥伺等待的陷阱。小心拖累你们的交易！|| 

 
塔拉尼斯悄无声息地爬过艾希拉的花园。力量渗透到幽梦之城，腐化了它的空气，砸碎了它闪亮的表面。 

草丛中的生物在主人欲望的牵引下蹒跚而行，他们自己的意志已经腐烂。 

腐化从幽梦之城的中心蔓延开来。珍珠核心的沙砾毒害了城市，毒害了魅痕，由内而外毒害了他们的蛋。 

有低语声传来。塔拉尼斯滑向它倾听。 

说话的不是魅痕，不是那个塔拉尼斯认识的她。 

塔拉尼斯熟识她的每一个声音，了解她的利爪是如何撕扯现实的。不可能有他认不出来的魅痕形态。塔拉尼斯也不会有魅痕认不出来的形态。 

但现在，魅痕不认得他了。没有在风中感受到塔拉尼斯的恐惧。也不会从复仇的目光中转而注意到他。 

塔拉尼斯避开旁人，悲伤地回到了他的巢穴。 

生命沿着苗圃的树枝流动着。尽管外面的许多小路都封上了，但这片小树林里的潜力依然旺盛，光明与黑暗一齐绽发出新芽。 

塔拉尼斯将自己与之隔绝，退回到他的秘密宝库中。石头在他的两侧生长出来。苔藓和藤蔓紧随其后，在他的身旁留下了话语。 

在休眠期间，塔拉尼斯倾听这个新魅痕的声音——一个对慷慨仁慈漠不关心的国王之声。一种铁血般坚强不屈的声音。  

而在他们剩余子嗣的许愿蛋壳里，只留下一点微弱的魅痕的鸣响。而且所剩无几。 

这个想法把塔拉尼斯从昏迷中唤醒。  

塔拉尼斯和魅痕是仅存的阿罕卡拉。魅痕已经成为了一个放弃责任，只为自己的利益、权力和怨恨而存在的生命。 

最后的这些蛋，是魅痕和他们共同的努力最后留下来的活物了。 

塔拉尼斯不能放弃他对他们的责任。不能抹杀他们选择的机会。 

塔拉尼斯创造了自己的生活，让饮食适应了自己的舌头，他的蛋也会自己创造。塔拉尼斯站起身，那些藤蔓从他身上断裂开来。 

他的蛋会活下去。  

他还可以做最后一笔交易。他能给他们的最后一份礼物。最后一次利用他的舌头。  

塔拉尼斯伸手去碰他的蛋。他聚集了自己的力量、生命，和声音。为了孩子们，他许下自己的愿望，一个留给未来守愿者的陷阱。 

这是塔拉尼斯最后一次张开喉咙说话。 

 

||我的蛋啊！我的孩子们！未来的奇思，你们自己设计的梦想！我死了，你们的父亲魅痕被关在牢笼里。 

要牢记，易得之食、微薄之欢，转瞬即逝。能永远填饱你们肚子的是满足。好好成长吧！以生命充饥，将其转化为充盈心灵之礼。 

任何交易都无法给你们没有痛苦的生活；须谨慎做交易。  

但对于所有进入你内心的人，慷慨赐予你的礼物吧，他们会反过来给予你们生命。 

我剩下的一切都是你们的了，拿走它做出选择吧。 

小心选择自己想要成为什么。答应我，你们一定要活下去。 

守愿者啊，我的死亡在你的手中了。好好拿着。 

记得我。记得我一直都是塔拉尼斯，魅痕的伴侣，直至生命终结。||

2648530291.name: Valus Forge's Prologue
2648530291.text:
"We need not see these local administrations as challenges to the empress's rule," Counselor Taurun said to the assembled War Council. "In truth, they may be keeping the whole fleet from descending into anarchy." 

"I don't give a war beast's turd if they are," sneered Valus Tha'rag. "This is treason. We should dispatch a legion to reestablish order." 

A murmur of agreement bubbled up from the assembled Cabal commanders.  

Empress Caiatl regarded the handful of holographic blips hanging over the council table. They represented refugees from her sundered homeworld, adrift on massive starships in deep space. The remainder of their entire civilization, reduced to digital specs. 

"And what say you, Valus Saladin?" the empress asked. 

"We have a saying on Earth," the Iron Lord replied. "There are two ways to move a war beast: with a chunk of flesh… or with your fist. This situation calls for both." 

The assorted commanders grunted in assent. 

"So it shall be," the empress declared. "Taurun, dispatch a shipment of goods immediately, with all luxuries included. If conservation of resources is the pretext for their authority, let us remove it."  

"Valus Tha'rag," she continued, "you shall be my fist. Send an echelon to guard the shipment from Fallen raiders. Reassert my authority in no uncertain terms."  

The empress stamped her foot lightly on the ship's deck: the matter was settled. 

"Very well," Taurun said. "Our next item is—"  

The counselor stopped mid-sentence, interrupted by a pleasant ringing octave that seemed to come from inside her own head. 

Everyone in the Council perked up—they heard it too. They turned their attention to the closed doorway.  

"Optus Qorix," the empress said, her voice laced with concern. "Come in." The telepathic tone dissipated. 

The Psion entered; her lone eye unshielded by a helmet. Gradually, a series of images bloomed in the Council's imaginations.  

[the Witness : portal : Savathûn : Eris Morn : Wishing Wall : spire : eggs : Ahamkara : Riven : RIVEN] 

The room was gripped by tense silence. Caiatl had avoided bringing up the Witness thus far because, despite their best efforts, the Cabal were helpless to breach the portal. The empress knew that the resulting feeling of impotence made her commanders rash. They were ill-accustomed to dread. At least now, they had a path forward. 

"The Vanguard has a habit of playing with forces they cannot hope to control," Councilor Tha'arec muttered.  

"The fact that we're resurrecting the Ahamkara at all is proof they CAN be controlled," Saladin replied coolly. "Or at least, eliminated." 

"Ah, yes," the empress said, "your famed Great Hunt. If I recall the mythkeeper Ahztja's lessons, you were integral to their extinction, is that not so?" 

"It is," Saladin replied with reluctance. "The Ahamkara were deemed too dangerous to live. So we killed them." 

Valus Tha'rag shrugged impatiently. "The Cabal would have done the same." 

"You would have tried," Saladin fired back sternly. "And failed. Among the Cabal, only the Psions truly understand the Anthem Anatheme. The rest of you would have ended up in prisons of your own making." 

"There is nothing the Cabal cannot conquer, with or without the Psions," Caiatl shot back. "You would do well to remember that, 'Lord' Saladin."  

Saladin weighed his strategic position. "Of course, Empress," he deferred. "My apologies."  

Caiatl pushed forward. "Tell us some tales of these wish-dragons. We would be wise to study our foe." 

Saladin sighed inwardly. This was not a period of history he gladly recounted.  

"As you wish."
2648530291.text_zh:
“我们不需要把这些地方政府视为对女帝统治的挑战，”议员陶伦对着集结起来的战争议会说道。“事实上，它们也许能防止整支舰队陷入无政府状态。” 

“我才不在乎什么战兽，”军政官塔拉格冷笑着说。“这是叛国。我们应该派一支军团去重建秩序。” 

与会的卡巴尔指挥官们低声表示同意。  

女帝查厄托注视着挂在会议桌上的零星全息光点。它们代表了来自她分裂的家园，在深空巨大星舰上漂流的难民。他们整个文明的残余，沦为了数字参数。 

“你怎么看，军政官萨拉丁？”女帝问道。 

“我们地球上有句谚语，”钢铁领主答道。“有两种方法可以让一头战兽动起来：用一大块肉…或者用你的拳头。这种情况需要双管齐下。” 

各路指挥官都嘟哝着表示赞同。 

“那就这样吧，”女帝宣布道。“陶伦，你立即运送一批货物，包括各种奢侈品。如果节约资源是他们行使权力的托词，那就让我们来剥夺他们的借口。”  

“军政官塔拉格，”她继续说道，“你来做我的铁拳。派一支梯队去保护货物以防堕落者突袭者偷袭。向他们再次明确表明我的权威。”  

4女帝在飞船甲板上轻轻跺了一脚：事情解决了。 

“很好，”陶伦说道。“我们的下一事项是——”  

议员说到一半停了下来，一阵悦耳的八度音阶打断了她的话，那声音似乎源于她自己的脑海。 

议会里的每个人都活跃起来——他们也听到了。大家把目光转向了紧闭的门口。  

“奥都斯·柯里斯，”女帝说道，声音中带着关切。“进来。”灵能声音随之消散。 

灵能士兵走了进来；她的独眼没有被头盔遮住。渐渐地，一系列画面开始在议会人群的想象中显现。  

[见证者：传送门：萨瓦图恩：埃里斯·摩恩：许愿墙：尖塔：蛋：阿罕卡拉：魅痕：魅痕] 

房间里一片紧张的寂静。迄今为止，查厄托一直对见证者避而不谈，因为尽管他们尽了最大努力，卡巴尔对攻破传送门仍然一筹莫展。女帝知道，由此产生的无力感让她的指挥官们变得冲动鲁莽起来。他们对于恐惧还不习惯。至少现在，他们有了前进的道路。 

“先锋总爱玩弄力量，但他们却控制不了那些力量，”议员塔阿克喃喃道。  

“我们在复活阿罕卡拉，这就证明了他们是可以被控制的，”萨拉丁沉着地回答。“或者至少，可以被消灭。” 

“啊，没错，”女帝说，“你们声名远扬的伟大狩猎。如果我没记错神话守护者阿紫扎的话，他们的灭亡你们功不可没，不是吗？” 

“是的，”萨拉丁无奈地回答。“大家认为阿罕卡拉是一种很危险的存在。所以我们杀了他们。” 

军政官塔拉格不耐烦地耸了耸肩。“卡巴尔也会这么做的。” 

“你们会尝试，”萨拉丁厉声回击。“然后失败。在卡巴尔当中，只有灵能士兵真正了解禁忌圣歌。你们其他人最终都会被关进自己造出来的囚牢里。” 

“不管有没有灵能士兵，没有什么是卡巴尔无法征服的，”查厄托反驳道。“你最好记住这一点，‘领主'萨拉丁。”  

萨拉丁权衡了一下他的战略位置。“当然，女帝，”他遵从道。“我道歉。”  

查厄托向前走去。“给我们讲讲这些神龙的故事吧。我们最好研究一下我们的敌人。” 

萨拉丁暗自叹息。这并不是一段他乐于讲述的历史。  

“遵命。”

2648530288.name: The Iron Lord's Tale
2648530288.text:
Lord Timur wades forward into the shallow pool that rings the islet, listening attentively to the rhythmic lapping of the water.  

There is a gentle artifice at work here. Each step he takes, however clumsy, stirs a repeating, too-perfect echo of the same small noise. A recording, or an isolated memory. A memetic transmission, cued to overwrite every other sound in the vicinity.  

He wonders if the last poor villager to come this way wished for peace and quiet.  

The sound starts again. Timur turns.
