A week later, they have 300 signups for their new grenadeketball league, and roughly as many citations from the Praxics for alleged manipulation of betting rings.
657927352.text_zh:
诺帕莱尔的机灵正心满意足地把最后一个悬赏标记为完成。 

诺帕莱尔咕囔了一下。“已经要回家了？最近高塔里的气氛总有点不对。” 

在她身后，塔拉诺夫从长袍上抖落了许多掐丝金属碎片。那是她在飞蛾庭院里被迫打滚时粘上的。“是啊，但这里没有能用的淋浴。我们走吧。” 

“这么快？”诺帕莱尔若有所思，召唤出一个虚空光能球抛了起来。“嘿，塔拉诺夫，机灵点！” 

另一位守护者刚转过身，就撞上了迎面而来的光能球。 

“我要杀了你，”塔拉诺夫在复活后愤怒地说。 

诺帕莱尔向她招了招手。“是吗？放马过来。” 

塔拉诺夫举起她的榴弹发射器，直接向诺帕莱尔来了一发。 

诺帕莱尔的机灵复活她时，塔拉诺夫还笑得直不起腰。 

她们又互相将对方击杀了三次，敲定了新游戏的规则：发球者用榴弹发射器，回击者用光能武器。 

诺帕莱尔这次用哨兵圣盾狠狠地打飞了榴弹。塔拉诺夫看着榴弹击中了远处的破旧棚屋。过了一会儿，爆炸声传到了她们的耳朵里。 

她们的机灵一下午都在忙着复活她们。 

随着太阳落山，她们的精力也耗尽了。塔拉诺夫咕囔着放下了破晓。“你现在准备好挑战高塔了吗？” 

诺帕莱尔把一只手臂搭在她的肩膀上。“我们要修好高塔。大家都有好日子过！听着：我们可以主办一个全新的运动联赛。吃牌，投注，特许装备。搞全套的。” 

旧俄罗斯的日落很美。灌木丛中燃烧着小火苗。这样的景色温暖了诺帕莱尔的心。 

一周后，她们的全新榴弹联赛有三百个人报名参加，而因涉嫌操纵投注圈而被英勇教团传唤的人数也大致相同。

2720753042.name: Allstar Cloak
2720753042.subtitle: "How you feel is how you look, my dear. And I want you feeling your best!" –Eva Levante
2720753042.subtitle_zh: “亲爱的，你的感受决定了你的状态。而我希望你感受到你的最佳状态！”——伊娃·莱万特
2720753042.text:
The afternoon sun warms the courtyard's flagstones. Well-fed pigeons coo from balcony railings. Tree branches covered in new buds stir in the breeze. Ships hang in the air above the City where the Traveler used to sit. 

And a dozen Guardians brandish weapons and accessories at one another. 

"I don't know what you're talking about," declares a Sentinel. The chased patterns on her silver gorget match her shield. "Obviously, taking a punch is the most important thing. What else is armor for?" 

A Sunsinger in an antique tabard pulls off her glove, its fine weave covered in metallic feathers that catch the light. She shakes the glove at a Bladedancer. "Genuine batadactyl feathers. These gloves have flown in Venus's upper atmosphere. They resonate with Solar energies. That's the key." 

"Batadactyls don't have feathers. You overpaid, darling," says the Bladedancer. "When I personally slay the Witness, what my armor will need is style. And you're lacking that too–" 

A pair of Solar wings ignite on the Sunsinger's back. The temperature of the courtyard rises two degrees. The Guardians reach for their weapons. 

"Oh my. Has Lord Shaxx set up a new Crucible arena in the Tower?" 

The Guardians freeze and turn to see Eva Levante. Her crisp scarf is perfectly coordinated with her stylish-yet-practical shoes. 

A Sunbreaker shuffles over to hide a scorch mark on the ground. 

The Bladedancer speaks first. 

"Eva! You're just who we need! You can solve all our problems!" 

Perfectly calm in the face of three Gambit teams' worth of Guardians, Eva says, "Solving all of your problems might be even beyond me, my dear." 

The Sentinel's shield fades to nothing as she comes to the same realization. "You can solve our biggest problem," she says. "You're the expert!" 

Guardians speak over each other. 

"Grandmother!" 

"Auntie Eva!" 

"Ms. Levante!" 

She looks them over. More Guardians than Zavala would send after some great beast, all staring at her with pleading eyes. 

"Oh, all right. I could use a break from the holiday crowds." 

Eva raises a finger to her audience. 

"When I was in couture, I used a three-part rubric: form, function, and flair. So, one at a time, down the path and back. I want to see your look, I want to see what it can do… and, most of all, I want to see how it makes you feel to wear it." 

And the Tower's first-ever fashion show begins.
2720753042.text_zh:
午后的阳光照暖了庭院的石板。吃饱喝足的鸽子在阳台栏杆上咕咕叫着。长满新芽的树枝在微风中摇曳。曾经悬挂着旅行者的地方现在空空如也，只有几艘飞船在圣城上空飘浮着。 

十几个守护者聚在一起，向对方展示着自己的武器和佩饰。 

“我不知道你在说什么，”一位哨兵宣称。她银色胸甲上的雕金图案与她的护盾很搭。“能承受攻击很显然是最重要的一点。要不然护甲有什么用？” 

一位身着古式长袍的颂日脱下了她的精美手套，上面覆盖着细密金属羽毛，在光线下闪闪发光。她向一位舞刃晃了晃手套。“真翼手蝠羽毛。这副手套曾在金星上层大气中飞行。能与烈日能量共鸣。这才是关键。” 

“翼手蝠没有羽毛。你被坑了，亲爱的，”舞刃说。“在我手刃见证者的时候，我的护甲也必须有型。而你也缺乏这一点——” 

颂日的背上燃起一对烈日翅膀。庭院的温度上升了两度。守护者们将手伸向了武器。 

“哎呀。领主沙克斯是在高塔里建了个新的熔炉竞技场吗？” 

守护者们停了下来，转身看到伊娃·莱万特走向他们。她清爽的围巾与时尚又实用的鞋子搭配得天衣无缝。 

一位炎阳挪了挪位置，试图掩藏地上的一处焦痕。 

舞刃先开口了。 

“伊娃！我们正需要你呢！你可以解决我们的所有问题！” 

伊娃在能凑齐三支智谋队伍的守护者跟前面不改色。“恐怕连我也解决不了你们的所有问题，亲爱的。” 

哨兵的护盾逐渐消失，她明白了伊娃的意思。“你能解决我们最大的问题，”她说。“你可是专家！” 

守护者们一个比一个大声。 

“奶奶！” 

“伊娃阿姨！” 

“莱万特女士！” 

她打量着他们。萨瓦拉讨伐巨兽时也不会派这么多守护者，而他们都用央求的眼神望着她。 

“哎，好吧。节日里人满为患，我就当是抽离出来小憩一会儿吧。” 

伊娃朝着听众们比了一根手指。 

“考量时装时，我的标准由三部分组成：造型、功能和风格。所以，每次专注于一部分往下走，再回到起点。我想看看你的外观，以及看它能做什么…最重要的是，我想看看你穿上它的感觉。” 

高塔的首次时装秀就这么开幕了。

And a dozen Guardians brandish weapons and accessories at one another. 

"I don't know what you're talking about," declares a Sentinel. The chased patterns on her silver gorget match her shield. "Obviously, taking a punch is the most important thing. What else is armor for?" 

A Sunsinger in an antique tabard pulls off her glove, its fine weave covered in metallic feathers that catch the light. She shakes the glove at a Bladedancer. "Genuine batadactyl feathers. These gloves have flown in Venus's upper atmosphere. They resonate with Solar energies. That's the key." 

"Batadactyls don't have feathers. You overpaid, darling," says the Bladedancer. "When I personally slay the Witness, what my armor will need is style. And you're lacking that too–" 

A pair of Solar wings ignite on the Sunsinger's back. The temperature of the courtyard rises two degrees. The Guardians reach for their weapons. 

"Oh my. Has Lord Shaxx set up a new Crucible arena in the Tower?" 

The Guardians freeze and turn to see Eva Levante. Her crisp scarf is perfectly coordinated with her stylish-yet-practical shoes. 

A Sunbreaker shuffles over to hide a scorch mark on the ground. 

The Bladedancer speaks first. 

"Eva! You're just who we need! You can solve all our problems!" 

Perfectly calm in the face of three Gambit teams' worth of Guardians, Eva says, "Solving all of your problems might be even beyond me, my dear." 

The Sentinel's shield fades to nothing as she comes to the same realization. "You can solve our biggest problem," she says. "You're the expert!" 

Guardians speak over each other. 

"Grandmother!" 

"Auntie Eva!" 

"Ms. Levante!" 

She looks them over. More Guardians than Zavala would send after some great beast, all staring at her with pleading eyes. 

"Oh, all right. I could use a break from the holiday crowds." 

Eva raises a finger to her audience. 

"When I was in couture, I used a three-part rubric: form, function, and flair. So, one at a time, down the path and back. I want to see your look, I want to see what it can do… and, most of all, I want to see how it makes you feel to wear it." 

And the Tower's first-ever fashion show begins.
25524335.text_zh:
午后的阳光照暖了庭院的石板。吃饱喝足的鸽子在阳台栏杆上咕咕叫着。长满新芽的树枝在微风中摇曳。曾经悬挂着旅行者的地方现在空空如也，只有几艘飞船在圣城上空飘浮着。 

十几个守护者聚在一起，向对方展示着自己的武器和佩饰。 

“我不知道你在说什么，”一位哨兵宣称。她银色胸甲上的雕金图案与她的护盾很搭。“能承受攻击很显然是最重要的一点。要不然护甲有什么用？” 

一位身着古式长袍的颂日脱下了她的精美手套，上面覆盖着细密金属羽毛，在光线下闪闪发光。她向一位舞刃晃了晃手套。“真翼手蝠羽毛。这副手套曾在金星上层大气中飞行。能与烈日能量共鸣。这才是关键。” 

“翼手蝠没有羽毛。你被坑了，亲爱的，”舞刃说。“在我手刃见证者的时候，我的护甲也必须有型。而你也缺乏这一点——” 

颂日的背上燃起一对烈日翅膀。庭院的温度上升了两度。守护者们将手伸向了武器。 

“哎呀。领主沙克斯是在高塔里建了个新的熔炉竞技场吗？” 

守护者们停了下来，转身看到伊娃·莱万特走向他们。她清爽的围巾与时尚又实用的鞋子搭配得天衣无缝。 

一位炎阳挪了挪位置，试图掩藏地上的一处焦痕。 

舞刃先开口了。 

“伊娃！我们正需要你呢！你可以解决我们的所有问题！” 

伊娃在能凑齐三支智谋队伍的守护者跟前面不改色。“恐怕连我也解决不了你们的所有问题，亲爱的。” 

哨兵的护盾逐渐消失，她明白了伊娃的意思。“你能解决我们最大的问题，”她说。“你可是专家！” 

守护者们一个比一个大声。 

“奶奶！” 

“伊娃阿姨！” 

“莱万特女士！” 

她打量着他们。萨瓦拉讨伐巨兽时也不会派这么多守护者，而他们都用央求的眼神望着她。 

“哎，好吧。节日里人满为患，我就当是抽离出来小憩一会儿吧。” 

伊娃朝着听众们比了一根手指。 

“考量时装时，我的标准由三部分组成：造型、功能和风格。所以，每次专注于一部分往下走，再回到起点。我想看看你的外观，以及看它能做什么…最重要的是，我想看看你穿上它的感觉。” 

高塔的首次时装秀就这么开幕了。

2894282038.name: Commemorative Steed
2894282038.subtitle: "Who's better than us?" –Valiant Farrukh
2894282038.subtitle_zh: “谁能强过我们？”——无畏者法鲁克
2894282038.text:
Slalom left across the curb cut on 18th. A judicious boost between the supports of the Six Fronts memorial. And straight through the middle of the pack. 

District 125's streets are dark at night, the streetlights few and far between. The occasional neon sign is diffused by the running lights and exhaust trails of a dozen Sparrows jockeying for space. 

Farrukh hunkers down over his restored EV-34 Vector Infinite, his pride and joy. His whole fireteam put down the last of their Glimmer and materials to upgrade her and get a seat at this race. Without sanctioned SRL events, it's drag racing betting rings where Guardians can make their profits. 

And they need it bad.  

Farrukh's gloves creak on his handlebars. He takes a risk going tight around a corner and cuts off a Warlock on a Sharklight, aiming for the front-runners. 

The big names are here tonight: Boaz, Gris, Cron-8, even the up-and-coming Niik. Their skills might secure this win. But they don't want it the way Farrukh does. 

It gets worse every week, their debt piling up. The Spider's smirk audible even through his filters, offering worse deals, dirtier jobs. They need a clean break. Clean Vanguard work. Just one race and they can buy their way out. 

Serapion gutted his Sparrow's braking system for Farrukh's EV. Tammuz-4 pawned their first bond. It's Farrukh on the track tonight, but his team's with him. 

Streetlights flash by faster as the pack leaves the warehouses behind, drifting hard around an overpass. Farrukh's near the middle, waiting on his last boost.  

Street racing's all about calculated risks. And this is their biggest. 

He waits for the moment–waits as the Sharklight passes him again, and the racers around him slam their boosts–and hits his own for the final push. Half a block to make up. Half a block between him and his team's future. 

He weaves through the pack, pushing his boost hard just as all the others wear out, and slams into the finish with another Sparrow an inch behind his nose. 

The roar of the crowd is a physical force, slamming into Farrukh like a Sentinel's shield. 

The racer in second yanks off their helmet and points straight at Farrukh. "How did you pull that out of your antique?" 

Farrukh looks out through the crowd for Tammuz and Sera, shouldering their way over to him, looking as shellshocked as he feels. They made it. They're safe. 

He smiles, heart going 160. 

"It's not what you're racing," Farrukh says. "It's who you're racing for."
2894282038.text_zh:
斯拉罗姆从18号街的路缘开了下去。他在六方战役纪念碑的支柱之间踩下油门，直接从车队中间穿了过去。 

125区的街道夜晚漆黑一片，路灯寥寥无几。偶尔出现的霓虹灯也被十几辆挤在一起的快雀车灯和尾气所掩盖。 

法鲁克在他修复的EV-34向量无限上压低了身子。这辆快雀是他的至宝。他的火力战队全员花尽了所有微光，才改好这辆快雀，在这场赛事中搞到了席位。没了获得批准的赛雀联赛，守护者可以通过在地下竞速赛中下注赚钱。 

而他们很需要这笔微光。  

法鲁克的手套握在车把上吱吱作响。他冒险从内道超过了一位骑着海鲨光芒的术士，朝最前面的车手冲刺而去。 

今晚来的都是大人物：波资、格里斯、科隆8号，还有刚崭露头角的妮可。他们凭借车技，想赢并不是什么难事。但他们的求胜心远远没有法鲁克那么强烈。 

他们的累积债务一周比一周多。即使隔着蛛王的过滤器，他们也能听到他的笑声，被迫接受更黑心的交易和更肮脏的工作。他们必须翻身。只做干净的先锋活。赢下这场比赛，他们就能给自己赎身了。 

赛拉皮翁把他快雀的制动系统装在了法鲁克的EV上。塔姆兹-4把自己的第一个臂环给当了。虽然上赛道的只有法鲁克，但他身后是他的整个火力战队。 

当车队驶离仓库，在高架桥上漂移而过时，路灯飞逝得更快了。法鲁克在车队中央附近，等待着最后一次加速的时机。  

街头赛车的关键在于衡量风险。而这就是最大的风险。 

他静候着时机——海鲨光芒又超过了他，而他周围的其他赛车手也都启动了加速。他打算在最后的冲刺阶段再加速。他得追上半个街区的距离。这半个街区隔着他和他战队的未来。 

他在快雀群中穿梭，在所有其他车手都耗尽助推器时，他猛地加速，冲向终点。当他率先抵达时，第二辆快雀只比他的车头落后了一英寸。 

人群的欢呼声像哨兵的护盾一样撞上了法鲁克。 

位居第二的车手扯下头盔，指着法鲁克发问。“你那老古董是从哪儿挤出这么多马力的？” 

法鲁克在人群中寻找着塔姆兹和赛拉的身影。他们正朝他走来，就像他一样惊魂未定。他们成功了。他们翻身了。 

他微笑着，心率飙到了每分钟一百六。 

“关键不在快雀，”法鲁克说。“在于你为谁比赛。”

1878244597.name: Allstar Vector
1878244597.subtitle: "Do dragonflies do loop-de-loops?"
1878244597.text:
"You're telling me these…'Skimmers' just turned up?"  

Prak'kesh prods gingerly at one of the boards with his foot. It floats gently in place at the center of the storeroom.  

"A donation for the games," Spider says distractedly. "Is that unusual?"  

He grunts, displeased, and gestures sharply—Arrha moves the painting slightly left of its current position, wobbling precariously atop his chair. 

"Usually there's a bet involved," Prak'kesh explains. "Or it's official Vanguard merchandise." This almost looks like one of the Neomuna skyboards, though, and the Vanguard wouldn't be passing that around. 

"Well, then it seems we've lucked out this year. The right, Arrha!" 

Arrha grumbles but obeys, hefting the frame into position.  

"I think that did it," Prak'kesh says, squinting at the painting. He doesn't see the point of it—a series of splotchy purple flowers along a dirt path, indistinct trees—but Spider is gazing up at it like it's made of pure Ether. "Your donor leave a name, at least?" 

Spider sighs and reaches for a datapad. "Egh, let's see…two shipments…personal vehicle, Skimmer…gift to the City…Ah, here—Concordat."  

Spider looks over at Prak'kesh, who shrugs. "No idea who that is."
1878244597.text_zh:
“你是说这些…‘采集船'就这么出现了？”  

普拉凯什用脚轻轻地戳了戳其中一块木板。它轻轻地漂浮在储藏室的中央。  

“比赛捐的。”蛛王心不在焉地说。“这不寻常吗？”  

他不满地哼了一声，然后猛地做了个手势——阿尔拉把画从现在的位置往左移了一点，在椅子上摇摇欲坠。 

“通常都和赌局有关。”普拉凯什解释说。“或者是先锋的官方商品。”不过，这看起来像是内欧姆那的浮空板，先锋可不会把它传出来。 

“好吧，看来我们今年运气不错。右边，阿尔拉！” 

阿尔拉哼了一声，但还是听话地把框架举到了合适的位置。  

“我觉得这样就可以了。”普拉凯什眯着眼睛看着这幅画说道。他看不出这幅画有什么意义——沿着泥土小路开着一丛丛斑驳的紫色花朵，树木模糊不清——但蛛王正仰头凝视着这幅画，仿佛它是由纯净以太制成的。“你的捐赠者至少留下了名字吧？” 

蛛王叹了口气，伸手去拿数据板。“唉，让我想想…两批货物…私人车辆，采集船…给圣城的礼物…啊，这里——和谐派。”  

蛛王看了看普拉凯什，他耸了耸肩。“不知道那是谁。”

140839107.subtitle: "Do dragonflies do loop-de-loops?"

2372514509.name: Elsie's Rifle
2372514509.subtitle: The future is built by many hands.
2372514509.text:
Shaxx's massive hand swallowed up his pen. He effortlessly held his map in the other; the fierce wind at the highest point of the old Tower couldn't pull the paper from his hands. 

Elsie surveyed the horizon. The City, alive and vibrant stretched out before her, overlaid in her memory with its corpse. She turned and pointed. "There. The edge of Core West. That wall fell first in the Bombardment." 

As Elsie turned, Shaxx shuffled around her, still clutching his map. 

"Perimeter South, Hive sappers dug in under the wall. Botza was overrun at the old gate; it hadn't been reinforced in years… Anchor District, a Pyramid ship landed and crushed the water tower…" 

By the time Elsie finished her recitation, Shaxx's map was dark with annotations. 

He set a hand on Elsie's shoulder, gentle in his movements for all his size. 

"On my oath, these walls will not fall again."
2372514509.text_zh:
沙克斯的巨手几乎把整支笔都遮住了。他毫不费力地用另一只手拿着地图；旧高塔最高处的狂风也无法把那纸从他手中拉走。 

艾尔西眺望着地平线。圣城在她面前生机勃勃地舒展开来，在她的记忆中与它的尸体重叠在一起。她转身挥手一指。“那里。核心西区的边缘。那堵墙在轰炸中最先倒塌。” 

艾尔西转身走开，沙克斯赶紧跟上，手里依然攥着地图。 

“外围南部，邪魔族的工兵在城墙下掘出了洞。柏特扎的老门被攻陷；那堵门已经很多年没加固了…锚区，一艘金字塔飞船在那里着陆，压毁了水塔…” 

等艾尔西复述完毕时，沙克斯的地图上已经黑压压地写满了注释。 

他将一只手搭在艾尔西的肩膀上。以他的体型来说，这一动作很轻柔。 

“我发誓，这些城墙不会再次被攻陷。”

2228325504.name: Edge Transit
2228325504.subtitle: What did you trade away to secure passage to the edge?
2228325504.subtitle_zh: 为确保自己安全抵达边缘，你付出了什么？
2228325504.text:
Devrim was surrounded as soon as he arrived in Neu Turbach. Villagers patted him on the arms, children tugged at his fatigues, and homemade treats were stuffed into his pockets. Each one thanked him in their own way. 

Eventually the village leader, Joacham, led him to a small homestead. A spread of tea and sweet pastries were laid out. Devrim was honored—tea and sugar were rare commodities this far from the City. 

"We expect another offensive in the coming weeks," Devrim advised. "We suggest you start preparing immediately." 

Joacham grinned. "We have been preparing ever since the last attack. We now have trip wires, barricades, and even an auto turret!" 

Devrim's chest swelled with pride. It was not long ago that he'd taught these same villagers to defend themselves against Shadow Legion captors. At the time, he'd wondered whether they would last the winter. Now, they were stronger than ever. 

"Would you like to see the upgrades?" Joacham offered. 

Devrim beamed. "Nothing would make me happier."
2228325504.text_zh:
德弗里姆一到纽图尔巴赫就被团团围住。村民们拍他的胳膊，孩子们拽他的军装，还有人把自制零食塞进他的口袋。每个人都用自己的方式向他表示感谢。 

最后，村长乔查姆把他领到一个小宅院。那里摆满了茶和甜点。德弗里姆感到很荣幸——茶和糖在离圣城这么远的地方可是稀罕物。 

“我们预测未来几周还会有一次进攻，”德弗里姆提出。“我们建议你们立即开始准备。” 

乔查姆咧嘴一笑。“我们自从上次袭击以来就一直在准备。我们现在有拌线、屏障，甚至还有自动炮台！” 

德弗里姆胸中涌起一股自豪感。不久前他还在教这些村民如何避免成为暗影军团的俘虏。当时，他甚至不知道他们能否撑过那个冬天。现在，他们比以往任何时候都更加强大。 

“你想看看我们的升级吗？”乔查姆提议道。 

德弗里姆露出了笑容。“我求之不得。”

4043921923.name: The Mountaintop
4043921923.subtitle: "In the heat of battle, Guardian, you will know the right choice to make." — Lord Shaxx
4043921923.subtitle_zh: “守护者，当身处激烈的战斗中时，你就会知道正确的选择是什么。”——领主沙克斯
4043921923.text:
Empress Caiatl strolled between rows of Legionaries standing at attention.  

"I commend you, Valus Saladin." The empress projected her voice for the benefit of the soldiers. "Your training has made the Iron War Beasts the very tusks of the empire." 

Caiatl returned to the head of the formation and gave a nod. Saladin's gravelly voice boomed. "Armor and weapons will be stripped and stowed. Hand-to-hand training begins in two cycles. Fall out." 

Once the soldiers had dispersed, the empress's tone softened. "Your soldiers are exemplary. Yet you seem… unsatisfied."  

"Many years ago," Saladin replied, "at Twilight Gap, I gave an order that was disobeyed." 

"A rash attack?" The empress inquired.  

Saladin shook his head. "The opposite. A retreat." 

"In retrospect, it was a mistake," he continued. "If not for my soldiers' insubordination, we would have lost." 

"I drilled the Iron War Beasts on Darkness-based tactics from the Hive to Clovis Bray and back again," Saladin concluded. "I just hope that when their time comes, they have the strength of conviction to defy the Light with equal ferocity."
4043921923.text_zh:
女帝查厄托在一排排肃立的军团士兵之间漫步。  

“我要表扬你，军政官萨拉丁。”女帝提高音量，好让士兵们也能听见。“你的训练使钢铁战兽成为了帝国的獠牙。” 

查厄托回到队列的前方，点了点头。萨拉丁沙哑的声音回响起来。“把护甲和武器脱下并收好。肉搏训练将在两个周期后开始。解散。” 

士兵们散去后，女帝的语气柔缓下来。“你的士兵堪称楷模。但你似乎…并不满意。”  

“许多年前，”萨拉丁回答道，“在暮光峡谷，我下达了一道命令，但未被遵循。” 

“是冲锋陷阵的命令吗？”女帝问道。  

萨拉丁摇了摇头。“正相反。是撤退的命令。” 

“现在想来，那是个错误的命令。”他继续说道。“如果不是我的士兵抗命，我们恐怕就输了。” 

“我向钢铁战兽灌输了基于暗影的战术，从邪魔族到克洛维斯·布瑞，再倒着讲回来，”萨拉丁总结道。“我只希望，轮到他们的时候，他们有足够的信念力量，能以同样的坚毅反抗光能。”

2480074702.name: Forbearance
2480074702.subtitle: Shape: Temperance
2480074702.text:
Mara Sov stepped lightly. She knew that nothing short of gunfire could disrupt the Cryptarchs' meditation, yet she was still loathe to disturb the uncanny silence of the Hygiea Division's libraries.  

She approached a raised dais, where Cryptarch Sjalla held a glowing engram in her hands. It pulsed faintly in time with her heartbeat.  

"The queen wears a question on her face," Sjalla stated, her expression impassive. 

"You see beyond sight, as always," Queen Mara replied. "What will happen when the Darkness of the Witness comingles with the Light of the Traveler?" 

The Cryptarch set the engram aside and held her hands out, palms up. "Some believe that Light and Darkness are opposites. Contradictory. Irreconcilable." 

"But we know better." Sjalla brought her hands together in a sharp clap. "When Light and Dark merge, they form something more." Her fingers intertwined. "A synthesis. Stronger than either alone. Powerful… like the Awoken." 

"And like our people," she concluded, "its form will arise from memories of the forgotten. Those who witnessed the end…and return as a beginning."
2480074702.text_zh:
玛拉·索维轻手轻脚地走着。她知道，只有枪声级别的动静才会干扰解密大师们的冥想，但她还是不想打破健神星图书馆的静谧。  

她靠近了一个高台。解密大师斯亚拉在那里捧着一个发光的记忆水晶。它随着她的心跳微弱地脉动着。  

“女王的脸上带着疑问，”斯亚拉面无表情地说道。 

“你的洞察力一如既往地超乎寻常，”玛拉女王回答道。“当见证者的暗影与旅行者的光能交织在一起时，会发生什么？” 

这名解密大师将记忆水晶放在一边，伸出双手，掌心向上。“有些人认为，光能与暗影是对立的。相反的。不可调和的。” 

“但我们知道不是那样。”斯亚拉啪地将双手合在一起。“当光能与暗影融合时，它们会形成更多的东西。”她的手指交织在一起。“一种结合体。比单独的光能或暗影都更有力。强大…如同觉醒者。” 

“如同我们的人民，”她总结道，“它的形态将来自于被遗忘者的记忆。那些见证了终结…并作为开端回归的人。”

3757612024.name: Luna's Howl
3757612024.subtitle: "Guardians never die. But we don't forget those who do." — Lord Shaxx
3757612024.subtitle_zh: “守护者永远不会死，但我们也不会将逝者忘怀。”——领主沙克斯
3757612024.text:
Josef opened the door. Shaxx filled the hallway beyond. 

"You look tired," said the Crucible handler. "But I have just the thing to get you buzzing." 

"No time for the Crucible," Josef dissembled. "Another day." 

"I'll hold you to that. But that's not what I meant." 

Josef said nothing. 

"I was speaking with Saladin," Shaxx continued. "We were remembering all the people we left behind over the years. Your name came up." 

"Oh yeah?" 

Shaxx held out a cardboard box, perforated with large holes. "The Valus asked me to deliver this." 

Josef opened the box. At the bottom, in a nest of cloud accretions, were two sleeping war beast pups. 

"They're not replacements," Shaxx explained, "but we hope they bring some light back into your life." 

"They're perfect," Josef said, his voice tender. "Thank you." 

"See them settled. Then I expect you back in the Crucible to teach MY pups a thing or two."
3757612024.text_zh:
约瑟夫打开了门。沙克斯巨大的身躯占满了走廊。 

“你看起来很疲惫，”这名熔炉竞技场顾问说道。“但我有个东西能让你提起劲来。” 

“我没时间参加熔炉竞技场，”约瑟夫敷衍道。“改天吧。” 

“那你可要说话算数。不过，你误解了我刚才说的话。” 

约瑟夫没有作声。 

“我之前跟萨拉丁聊了下，”沙克斯继续说道。“我们回忆了这些年来淡出视野的人。我们提起了你的名字。” 

“哦，是吗？” 

沙克斯拿出一个纸箱，上面有很多大洞。“军政官让我把这个交给你。” 

约瑟夫打开了箱子。在其底部的云端积层里有两只熟睡的战兽幼崽。 

“它们不是替代品，”沙克斯解释道，“但我们希望它们能给你的生活带回一些光明。” 

“它们很棒，”约瑟夫温柔地说。“谢谢你们。” 

“好好安顿它们。然后，我希望你能回到熔炉竞技场里，教教我的那些幼崽。”

2499720827.name: Midnight Coup
2499720827.subtitle: "The conspirators were too afraid to kill me—rightly so. I am the beloved father of the people, and the glorious mob would not suffer my death. My sentence was exile." — Former Emperor Calus
2499720827.subtitle_zh: “阴谋家们太害怕杀死我了——当然如此。我是人们爱戴的家长，荣耀暴民不会判我死刑的。我的判决是流放。”——前卡鲁斯大帝
2499720827.text:
"That's awfully ruthless, no?" Lord Shaxx queried. "It's one thing to kill an enemy in combat. But executions… that's dirty business. I know from experience." 

"Hmm," Saladin grumbled, turning the elaborate hand cannon over in his hands. "I felt the same way, at the time. I was content to let Calus rot away in deep space, drinking himself into oblivion." 

Saladin furrowed his brow. "But after Neomuna; after going tusk-to-tusk with the Shadow Legion, I wonder if his exile was mercy… or weakness."  

"Careful, Valus," Shaxx quipped, "your empress might not take kindly to that sort of talk." 

Saladin passed the hand cannon back to Shaxx with an approving nod. "I doubt she feels differently. Seeing her father changed like that… had to be harder in the long run." 

Shaxx holstered the cannon. "Maybe so, but that's what sets Caiatl apart. It's what set the Vanguard apart! Acting with honor, even at great cost to ourselves." 

"Sometimes our honor IS the cost," Saladin rebutted. "And we'd better remember that on the other side of the portal."
2499720827.text_zh:
“那也太无情了吧？”领主沙克斯质问道。“在战斗中杀死敌人另当别论。但处决…那是肮脏的勾当。这是我的经验之谈。” 

“唔，”萨拉丁嘟囔了一声，翻转着手中的精致手炮。“我当时也是这么想的。我满足于让卡鲁斯在深空中糜烂，饮酒作乐，直至湮没。” 

萨拉丁皱起了眉头。“但在内欧姆那发生了那样的事情后，在与暗影军团交手后，我不清楚对他的流放是仁慈…还是软弱。”  

“当心，军政官，”沙克斯调侃道，“你的女帝可能不喜欢这种说辞。” 

萨拉丁将手炮递还给沙克斯，赞许地点了点头。“我倒觉得她会有同感。看到她的父亲经历那样的转变…从长远来说一定更难接受。 

沙克斯收起了手炮。“也许吧，不过那正是查厄托与众不同的地方。这也是先锋与众不同的地方！以荣誉为行事准则，即使自己要为此付出巨大的代价。” 

“有时我们的荣誉就是代价，”萨拉丁反驳道。“在传送门的另一边时，我们最好牢记这一点。”

211732170.name: Hammerhead
211732170.subtitle: Smash through the veil.
211732170.text:
Adit and Majjora clung to the chain link fence, well beyond the outside perimeter of the Crucible viewing area. They peered past a motionless Redjack stationed at the entrance, straining to see snippets of action on the massive viewing screens. Adit caught a glimpse of an Arc explosion as the audience roared.  

Lord Shaxx's voice boomed from the loudspeakers: "Your spirit is unrivaled. Show me more!"  

Adit glanced over at her classmate. Majjora's pinky finger was just a few centimeters away from her own, but it seemed like a kilometer. 

Adit cleared her throat, mustering courage, "So, umm, what Cryptarch Matsuo said in class today. About, like, the final shape and everything. The Witness." 

"I can't believe what I'm seeing!" Shaxx's voice rang out.  

Majjora nodded gravely. Though the visiting Cryptarch had explained the situation in the gentlest terms, the students understood the seriousness of the situation. 

"Yeah," Majjora replied. "It's… I don't know what to do." 

"Nothing we can do, I guess," Adit replied.  

Adit inched her pinky closer to Majjora's for what felt like an eternity. And then finally, they touched.  

Majjora smiled.  

A Stasis grenade detonated on the viewing screens, but neither of them heard it.
211732170.text_zh:
阿迪特和玛乔拉紧紧地抓着远在熔炉竞技场观战区之外的链条栅栏。她们的目光越过入口处静止不动的红桃杰克，费劲想要看到巨型观赏屏幕上的动作片段。阿迪特瞥见一股电弧爆炸，观众们随之沸腾。  

扩音器中传出了领主沙克斯的洪亮声音：“你的热情无人能敌。再多给我看看！”  

阿迪特瞥了一眼她的同学。玛乔拉的小指离她的小指只有几厘米远，但却仿佛有一公里之遥。 

阿迪特清了清嗓子，鼓起勇气，“对了，唔，解密大师松尾今天在课堂上说的话。关于终焉之形什么的。还有见证者。” 

“我简直不敢相信眼前的这一切！”沙克斯的声音响了起来。  

玛乔拉严肃地点了点头。虽然到访的解密大师用最温和的言辞去解释现状，但学生们都明白事态的严重性。 

“是啊，”玛乔拉答道。“我…我不知道该怎么做。” 

“我猜我们什么也做不了，”阿迪特答道。  

阿迪特的小指靠近了玛乔拉的小指，感觉像是过了很久。最后，它们终于碰到了一起。  

玛乔拉露出了微笑。  

一枚冰影手雷在观赏屏幕上爆炸，但她们都没有听见。

2533990645.name: Blast Furnace
2533990645.subtitle: Forged in the hottest fires.
2533990645.text:
"…And I'll personally produce a limited number of previously unreleased designs. An alternate version of Blast Furnace, for example," Ada-1 explained. 

"First you strong-arm us into altering our specs," the VEIST rep scoffed, "And now you come begging for the very models the Vanguard rejected." 

"They would have turned the Crucible into a graveyard," Shaxx interjected. "I don't regret—" 

"I think what Lord Shaxx means to say," Ada-1 interrupted, shooting the Titan a razor-sharp glance, "is that your prototypes were ahead of market. Their time to shine is now." 

"Can the soft sell," replied the Omolon rep. "The numbers are right, so we're in." 

"But what's the catch?" the VEIST rep asked suspiciously. 

"No catch." Ada-1 steepled her fingers. "In a year's time, we'll all be dead." 

The reps shifted uncomfortably. 

"Or, we'll have defeated the Witness," she continued. "In either case, it's time to diversify our offerings. With newly released designs… and more." 

The VEIST rep arched her eyebrow. "What do you have in mind?" 

Ada's tone warmed slightly. "Just an idea. There's an old Cosmodrome program whose revival I think could be quite useful."
2533990645.text_zh:
“…而我将亲自制作限量的，未曾发布的设计。例如，高炉的另一个版本，”艾达-1解释道。 

“你们先是强迫我们更改规格，”VEIST代表嘲笑道，“现在又来索求被先锋拒绝的那些型号。” 

“它们会把熔炉竞技场变成坟场的，”沙克斯插话道。“我不后悔——” 

“我想领主沙克斯的意思是，”艾达-1打断了他，用锐利的目光瞥了这名泰坦一眼，“你们的原型当时太过前卫。现在正是它们大放异彩的时候。” 

“软推销就省省吧，”Omolon代表答道。“数据没问题，所以我们会入伙。” 

“但是有什么花招？”VEIST代表怀疑地问道。 

“没有花招。”艾达-1并拢了手指。“一年后，我们都会死。” 

代表们不安地挪了挪身子。 

“或者，我们会击败见证者，”她接着说道。“无论是哪种情况，都是时候推进我们产品的多样化了。带来新发布的设计…以及更多东西。” 

VEIST代表抬起了眉毛。“你有什么点子？” 

艾达的语气稍微友好了些。“只是个设想。有个旧发射基地项目。我认为把它重拾起来或许会很有用。”

3851176026.name: Elsie's Rifle
3851176026.subtitle: The future is built by many hands.
3851176026.text:
Shaxx's massive hand swallowed up his pen. He effortlessly held his map in the other; the fierce wind at the highest point of the old Tower couldn't pull the paper from his hands. 

Elsie surveyed the horizon. The City, alive and vibrant stretched out before her, overlaid in her memory with its corpse. She turned and pointed. "There. The edge of Core West. That wall fell first in the Bombardment." 

As Elsie turned, Shaxx shuffled around her, still clutching his map. 

"Perimeter South, Hive sappers dug in under the wall. Botza was overrun at the old gate; it hadn't been reinforced in years… Anchor District, a Pyramid ship landed and crushed the water tower…" 

By the time Elsie finished her recitation, Shaxx's map was dark with annotations. 

He set a hand on Elsie's shoulder, gentle in his movements for all his size. 

"On my oath, these walls will not fall again."
3851176026.text_zh:
沙克斯的巨手几乎把整支笔都遮住了。他毫不费力地用另一只手拿着地图；旧高塔最高处的狂风也无法把那纸从他手中拉走。 

艾尔西眺望着地平线。圣城在她面前生机勃勃地舒展开来，在她的记忆中与它的尸体重叠在一起。她转身挥手一指。“那里。核心西区的边缘。那堵墙在轰炸中最先倒塌。” 

艾尔西转身走开，沙克斯赶紧跟上，手里依然攥着地图。 

“外围南部，邪魔族的工兵在城墙下掘出了洞。柏特扎的老门被攻陷；那堵门已经很多年没加固了…锚区，一艘金字塔飞船在那里着陆，压毁了水塔…” 

等艾尔西复述完毕时，沙克斯的地图上已经黑压压地写满了注释。 

他将一只手搭在艾尔西的肩膀上。以他的体型来说，这一动作很轻柔。 

“我发誓，这些城墙不会再次被攻陷。”

205225492.name: Hung Jury SR4
205225492.subtitle: A Scout Rifle, modified by Dead Orbit's superb technicians and specialists.
205225492.subtitle_zh: 经过死亡轨道的优秀技师和专家改造的一把斥候步枪。
205225492.text:
They called her the Roamer because she'd never lived in the City. 

In the bad old days, before Takanome's Rangers, Tamsin didn't hide behind any wall. She stood two meters high, tall enough to ride her stolen Pike. She was no Guardian, not even Awoken. She was plain Human, like you and me, they say. 

Tamsin could go toe-to-toe with a Vandal.  

Tamsin wore larger boots than Shaxx, and her coat was so big that a family of six could use it as a blanket. 

Tamsin wouldn't stay put. She'd visit for a night, spin her stories, eat everyone out of house and home, and take off again. 

When you hear a tapping outside on windy nights—so they tell the kids down in Peregrine—that's no tree branch. That's no owl. That's Tamsin looking for a traveling companion. And if you open the door to her, she'll take you to the stars. 


City Center Library Anthropology – folklore – Dead Orbit foundation myths.
205225492.text_zh:
人们称她为“漫游者”，因为她从未在圣城里住过。 

在那个苦难的旧年代，在鹰目的游骑兵组建之前，塔姆辛不会躲在任何墙后。她身高两米，足以驾驶她偷来的派克。她不是守护者，甚至不是觉醒者。她是普通的人类，据说就像你和我一样。 

塔姆辛能与一名暴徒正面交锋。  

塔姆辛的战靴比沙克斯的还大，而她的大衣宽得能让六口之家把它当毯子盖。 

塔姆辛不愿停留。她会来拜访一晚，讲述她的故事，把大家的存粮吃个精光，然后继续上路。 

当你在刮风夜晚听到外面有敲击声时——呼鹰台的人会告诉孩子们——那不是树枝的声音。那不是猫头鹰的声音。那是塔姆辛在寻找旅伴。如果你向她敞开大门，她就会带你到星星上去。 


圣城中央图书馆人类学-民俗学-死亡轨道创立神话。

570866107.name: Succession
570866107.subtitle: A single word etched inside the barrel: "Sylvie-1."
570866107.subtitle_zh: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“希尔薇-1”。
570866107.text:
Four-year-old Eld leaned into Perilla-28's side, a half-eaten cracker forgotten and crumbling in his small hands. 

"Did you know I was in the City for Six Fronts? I was already here, though I wouldn't meet your great-great-grandma for a long time yet." 

"There wasn't a City then," Eld said confidently. "It was all mud." 

Perilla-28 laughed. "No, it was a true city by the time I got here. When the walls were finished, we threw the biggest party I'd ever seen. We thought we were finally safe…" 

She paused, a hand on Eld's fine hair, lost in her memories. Eld tugged at her sleeve. "And then what?" 

"And then the Guardians protected us. Better than any wall could." 

The Traveler's departure had left a hole in the City sky. Perilla gazed up at it. 

"That's what they do. That's what they always do." 

Eld had stopped listening. He was shaking the cracker crumbs off his hands onto Perilla's dress. "Auntie," he said very seriously, "I need some juice."
570866107.text_zh:
四岁的埃尔德靠着佩里拉-28，吃了一半后被遗忘的饼干在他的小手里摇摇欲坠。 

“你可知道，六方战役的时候我在圣城？我那时就在这里了，但很久之后我才遇见了你的曾曾祖母。” 

“那时还没有圣城，”埃尔德自信的说。“都是泥巴。” 

佩里拉-28笑了。“不，我到这里时，它已经是座真正的城市了。城墙完工后，我们举办了我见过的最盛大的派对。我们以为我们终于安全了…” 

她停顿下来，用一只手摸着埃尔德细腻的头发，陷入了回忆。埃尔德扯了扯她的袖子。“然后呢？” 

“然后守护者保护了我们。比任何城墙都更管用。” 

旅行者的离去给圣城的天空留了一个大洞。佩里拉仰望着它。 

“他们所做的就是如此。一直都是。” 

埃尔德已经没在听了。他把手上的饼干碎屑扬到了佩里拉的裙子上。“阿姨，”他认真地说，“我要喝果汁。”

3098328572.name: The Recluse
3098328572.subtitle: My bite will turn your sweet flesh to vile rot.
3098328572.subtitle_zh: 你的鲜肉会因为我的撕咬而变得腐烂恶臭。
3098328572.text:
"Per your request, Lord Shaxx." The VEIST rep waved two fingers toward a nearby frame, which prompted it to open the metal suitcase on the table.  

"Similar to your original design," the rep continued, "with a few choice additions from our engineering team." She picked a speck of lint from the lapel of her couture jacket as she spoke.  

Shaxx examined the compact submachine gun, encased snugly in contoured foam. Seeing the weapon's profile stung him with memories, like an arrow through the shoulder. 

"It's magnificent," he declared softly. "She would have loved it." 

For a moment, the former Warlord seemed lost in fond reverie. The VEIST rep sat motionless at first, not wishing to disturb the legendary Titan's rare display of vulnerability. But then she decided to press her advantage. "I hear the former Queen's Wrath was an impressive woman," she prompted. 

Lord Shaxx blinked, and the tenderness vanished from his eyes. He slammed the case shut. 

"Give my compliments to your engineers," he replied gruffly.
3098328572.text_zh:
“按你的要求定制的，领主沙克斯。”VEIST代表向最近的框架挥了挥两根手指，示意它打开桌子上的金属手提箱。  

“与你原本的设计类似，”代表继续说道，“我们的工程团队还为其添加了一些精选配件。”她一边说着，一边从自己高级定制夹克的翻领上抠下了一丝棉绒。  

沙克斯端详着这把紧凑的冲锋枪，它紧紧地禁锢在轮廓分明的泡沫塑料中。看到这把武器的外形唤起了刺痛的记忆，就像是被一支箭射穿了肩膀。 

“真是无与伦比，”他轻声宣布。“她肯定会喜欢它的。” 

那一刻，这名前战争领主似乎陷入了美好的遐想之中。VEIST代表起初纹丝不动地坐着，不想打扰这名传奇泰坦难得露出的脆弱一面。但随后，这名主管决定把握优势。“我听闻前任女王之怒是个不得了的女人，”她提到。 

领主沙克斯眨了眨眼，视线中的温柔随之消失。他猛地关上箱子。 

“代我表扬你们的工程师，”他生硬地答道。

243425374.name: Falling Guillotine
243425374.subtitle: What won't be given must be taken.
243425374.text:
"THIS PLACE HAS THE BEST SAKE!" The Titan bellowed. The Warlock beside him grunted in assent. 

Araito chuckled to himself from his unseen position at the grill. His family's sake was fermented inside a discarded Servitor. The distinctive tang came from rust and Ether.   

"We should enjoy it while we can," the Warlock replied. "Might not get many more chances." 

"FEAR NOT," his dining companion declared. "We'll find a way into the portal." 

Araito thought he recognized the Titan's booming voice but couldn't place it. The cook was struck by how strained it sounded.  

"And once we do, we'll RIP THE WITNESS'S HEAD RIGHT OFF. Smoke and all. Just like I did to that carper, Felwinter!" 

Here was someone who had died many times. Who had lost countless comrades. Who produced fire from their bare hands. And yet, the undercurrent of fear beneath the Titan's voice was unmistakable.  

Araito was disquieted. The false bravado frightened him more than any admission of doubt ever could.
243425374.text_zh:
“这地方有最棒的清酒！”泰坦吼道。他身边的术士嘟哝了一声，表示同意。 

阿莱托在烤架旁不起眼的位置上笑了笑。他家的清酒是在一个废弃的魔眼内发酵的。那独特的味道来自铁锈和乙太。   

“我们应该趁现在好好享受，”术士答道。“以后可能就没多少机会了。” 

“别担心，”他的就餐同伴说。“我们会找到进入传送门的方法的。” 

阿莱托觉得自己似乎在哪里听过这名泰坦的洪亮声音，但拿不准。这名厨子被他那声嘶力竭的嗓门震住了。  

“等我们找到方法，我们就会把见证者的脑袋拧下来。一把火烧成灰。就像我当年对那个混蛋邪冬所做的一样！” 

这个人已经死过很多次了。他失去了无数的战友。他曾徒手制造出火焰。然而，这名泰坦声音中的恐惧暗流却是毋庸置疑的。  

阿莱托感到忧虑。那种虚张声势比承认自己担忧更让他害怕。

1599691027.name: Grimoire: The City—Onslaught
1599691027.text:
"Our enemies never relent. Neither will you." —Lord Shaxx 

——————

Despite the sharp breeze in the Tower, the air in Shaxx's outpost is uncomfortably still and weighted with tension. There is work to do: personal feeling must not interfere when certain doom hangs over all their heads. 

"We can't afford to play defense. Not now." Shaxx stares fixedly at the training plans drawn up for his Guardians. 

"Then offense will have to see us through this fight. That should come naturally to you." Saladin's posture is Legionary-perfect. 

"Then that's that." Teeth gritted under his helmet, Shaxx folds his arms. After a long moment, he adds, "Good talk." 

Saladin nods. "Good talk." 

They look at the screen in silence. There is nobody to rescue them.
1599691027.text_zh:
“我们的敌人从不心慈手软。你们也不会。”——领主沙克斯 

——————

尽管高塔上微风拂面，沙克斯前哨站里的空气却静得瘆人，弥漫着紧张的气氛。还有工作必须去做：当厄运笼罩在所有人的头上时，这些工作绝对不能被个人的情感干扰。 

“我们不能光顾着防御。现在不行。”沙克斯目不转睛地凝视着为他的守护者们制定的训练计划。 

“那就只能靠进攻打完这场战斗了。这对你来说应该轻车熟路。”萨拉丁摆出的姿势堪称军团士兵的模范。 

“那就这么定了。”沙克斯把双臂交叉放在胸前，头盔下的牙齿咬得咯咯作响。过了好一会儿，他补充道，“聊得不错。” 

萨拉丁点点头。“聊得不错。” 

他们默默地看着屏幕。没有人会来拯救他们。

1599691024.name: Grimoire: Eris Morn—Hive God of Vengeance
1599691024.name_zh: 魔典：埃里斯·摩恩——邪魔族复仇之神
1599691024.text:
Eris, tenacious Eris. Crota's Bane, Oryx's Sorrow. Ruin of Xivu Arath.  

To see you reduced once again to a minion of the Awoken queen. Examining a locked gate for signs of weakness. Rattling the bars to the afterlife, when you might have kicked the door in! 

This very plane could have been yours. 

What you lacked in natural talent you fashioned from scholarly genius. Your will is the thing, and I mistook yours. How you burned with it! The noble vindication of victory.  

Every sword ever raised against you—can I say, against us? Down through the long years of history. Vengeance killed Oryx, why not his sibling?  

But you threw the match. What good is a mortal blow, half-delivered? You whet your blade and threw it down. The throne of war, abandoned. A thousand, thousand races fed that glorious polyp. All that hard-won evidence. You didn't even look at it.  

I could have guided you. Don't you see that? 

What will you do now? Kick down their banners? Hope for vengeance without bloodshed? And through what realms have you stamped the proof of your cause?  

…I, too, avenged? Why would I want that?  

Wait. Come back.
1599691024.text_zh:
埃里斯，顽强的埃里斯。克洛塔的克星，欧里克斯之哀。希乌阿拉斯的毁灭者。  

你又沦为了觉醒者女王的爪牙。检查上锁的大门是否有弱点。拉扯通往来世的栅栏。而你本来可以一脚把门踹开的！ 

这个位面本来可以属于你。 

你用学术方面的天才弥补了欠缺的天赋。我误判了你的意志，而它正是关键所在。瞧你用它燃烧自己的样子！那正是胜利的崇高证明。  

每把曾对你举起的刀剑——或者该说，曾对我们举起的刀剑？在漫长的历史中徐徐落下。复仇杀死了欧里克斯，为何不把他的妹妹也杀死？  

但你放弃了比赛。半途而废的致死攻击有什么用？你磨好了你的剑，却将它扔到一边。战争王座，遭你遗弃。无数的种族育成了嘴里的那块光辉息肉。所有来之不易的证据。你看都没看一眼。  

我本可以指引你的。难道你不明白吗？ 

你现在要做什么？踢倒他们的旗帜？希望不流血就能复仇？你又通过什么领域盖上了你事业的印证？  

…我也大仇得报？为什么我会想要那样？  

等等。回来。

1599691025.name: Grimoire: The Ironwood Tree
1599691025.text:
"Not much sense memorializing anybody during the Dark Age. Anyone worth remembering, you'd hang onto them without trying."  

Drifter crouches down in front of the Ironwood tree, mindful of the offerings littering the ground. The amulet's nothing fancy—not one of those Iron Lord tokens—but handmade, and with some care. Joxer's name is easy to read. Crisp lettering. 

"Dumb heroics will get you every time. Volunteering. First one through, so the rest of us know not to try it." Drifter smirks. "He'd have had a fighting chance against a Primeval. Big payout if he made it. Cleaner death if he didn't." 

Lord Shaxx shifts his weight. His helmet cants toward the Drifter. 

"But then you wouldn't be standing there."  

There's no reply.
1599691025.text_zh:
“在黑暗纪元，纪念任何人都没有意义。任何值得纪念的人，你自然会牢牢记住。”  

浪客在铁木树前蹲下，注意着散落一地的祭品。这个护身符并不华丽——不是钢铁领主的信物——但却是某人用心手工制做的。乔科斯的名字刻得非常清晰，易于辨识。 

“愚蠢的英雄主义害人啊。自告奋勇。率先赴死，让其他人知道此路不通。”浪客假笑起来。“他本来有机会与古昧战斗。要是赢了就能得到大笔报酬。就算输了也能死个痛快。” 

领主沙克斯挪了挪重心。他的头盔向浪客那边倾斜了一下。 

“那样的话，你现在就不会站在那里了。”  

浪客没有回答。

1599691030.name: Grimoire: BRAVE Arsenal
1599691030.text:
Lord Shaxx? Oh, he's quite a craftsman. But then of course, he's a survivor—like us. 

He loves rewarding his pupils. With praise and, at times, with something more material. He invests great care in his designs. Still, sometimes a weapon has an unexpected kick. A side effect. He locks these away for special occasions. Other times, the Vanguard intervenes—you never know where you'll find the next Ghost-killer. 

But outside the Crucible, the rules of engagement shift. There's no sense in leaving perfectly good armaments in storage. 

Don't worry, Namrask. I do not intend to abandon the Loom. I am merely… consulting. 

I am surprised Lord Shaxx let Drifter contribute. His aptitude is not in question, but I thought— 

What? Oh, yes. 

Low-level radiation is to be expected.
1599691030.text_zh:
领主沙克斯？哦，他是个能工巧匠。不过他也和我们一样，是个幸存者。 

他喜欢奖励他的学生。说些表扬的话，有时则用更加物质的东西。他的设计非常用心。但是，有时一件武器会有意想不到的效果。副作用。他会将其封存，以备不时之需。有时先锋会介入——你永远不会知道下一个机灵杀手会出现在哪里。 

但在熔炉竞技场外面，交战规则会变。把好端端的武器留在仓库里根本没意义。 

别担心，拿姆拉斯克。我不打算放弃纺织机。我只是…在咨询。 

我很惊讶领主沙克斯允许浪客帮忙。浪客的能力没问题，但我以为—— 

什么？哦，对。 

预计会有低水平辐射。

1599691031.name: Article: Down on the Farm
1599691031.text:
By Ember Hadad, Senior Editor at the City Herald 

Readers might be forgiven for imagining that, after having been captured by Shadow Legion forces, EDZ residents might consider relocating to the Last City.  

I took a trip out to the famed settlement known as The Farm to talk to the civilians and FOTC officers still stubbornly posted at the edges of the world.  

"We're not fighting for one city. We're fighting for humanity," says Baishan, one of the Farm's technicians. Baishan is charged with maintaining the Farm's few precious remaining generators—and, more recently, its Ether processors. "This is our world, and we're going to keep staking a claim."  

Naomi, a pilot with Forces of the City, has been overseeing regular supply runs to the Farm in the wake of fierce bombardment by the Shadow Legion. She sees this as par for the course. 

"Humans are good at adapting to just about anything," she observes.  

For many, the true revelations have come as a result of continued cooperation with new Eliksni neighbors.  

Long-time Farm resident Carol notes, "There's a lot about Fallen tech we couldn't have guessed at. With Skiris and Riksor helping out, we've cobbled together our own solar cell network. Our energy output is five times what it used to be. The first step toward long-term projects is getting out of starvation mode." 

And the people here do think long-term. Few of the people I interviewed seemed to have much interest in returning to the safety of the city walls.  

"The Witness tore down our cities, blighted our air and water, and sent raiders and monsters after us. We're still here, waiting for the first chance we get to take it all back. The way I see it, those of us here on the Farm are just getting a head start."
1599691031.text_zh:
圣城使者高级编辑恩蓓尔·哈达著 

读者们完全有理由认为，被暗影军团占领后，欧洲无人区的居民可能会考虑搬迁到圣城。  

我前往被称为“农庄”的著名定居点，采访了仍顽固驻守在世界边缘的平民和圣城防卫军的军官。  

“我们不是为一座城市而战。我们是在为人类而战，”白山如此说道。他是农庄的一名技术人员，负责维护农庄仅剩的几台珍贵的发电机——以及，最近新增的乙太处理器。“这里是我们的世界，而我们会坚持宣示我们的所有权。”  

内奥米是圣城防卫军的一名飞行员，她一直在冒着暗影军团的猛烈轰炸监督农庄的定期补给运输。她认为这是理所当然的。 

“人类擅长适应任何情况，”她做出了这样的评述。  

对许多人来说，真正的启示来自与埃里克斯尼族的新邻居们的持续合作。  

农庄的老住户卡罗指出，“堕落者的科技之中藏着许多我们无法想象的东西。借助丝吉利斯和瑞克索的帮助，我们拼凑出了自己的太阳能电池网络。我们的能量输出是以前的五倍。实现长期项目的第一步是解决温饱问题。” 

这里的人们确实考虑得很长远。我采访到的那些人似乎都对回到安全的城墙内不感兴趣。  

“见证者拆毁了我们的城市，污染了我们的空气和水，派出突袭者和怪物追杀我们。但我们还在这里，等待机会好夺回一切。在我看来，我们这些住在农庄的人只是走在了前面。”

1599691028.name: Grimoire: Enemies—Reaver Vandal
1599691028.text:
"Death is the great mystery to us all." —Master Rahool 

——————

The question of Eliksni mortality is often discussed amongst members of the Cryptarchy. Stories of Eliksni arising in full health from a death or near-death state—as Mithrax did, some say—abound.  

The Reaver of Old Russia is attested to in dozens of Vanguard records. Experienced Guardians will swear on their Ghosts that they once killed a Reaver Vandal who was uncannily strong for his size, only to see him alive and well again the next day. They have given him a nickname, perhaps as a show of respect for another being seemingly immune to death.
1599691028.text_zh:
“死亡对我们所有人来说都是一个巨大的谜团。”——拉乎尔大师 

——————

解密大师们经常讨论关于埃里克斯尼族寿命的问题。埃里克斯尼族从死亡或濒死状态中满血复活的故事比比皆是——有些人说米瑟拉克斯就是个例证。  

在数十个先锋记录中都有记载旧俄罗斯的掠夺者。经验丰富的守护者会以他们的机灵起誓，他们曾经杀死过一个就其体型而言强壮得难以置信的掠夺者暴徒，而在第二天又看到他活蹦乱跳。他们给他起了一个绰号，也许是借此向另一种看似对死亡免疫的生物致敬。

1599691029.name: Article: A Darker Hour? Looking Back at the Great Disaster
1599691029.name_zh: 文章：一个更黑暗的时刻？回顾大灾难
1599691029.text:
By Emmanuil Utkin, Staff Writer for the City Herald 

Several lifetimes have passed since the Vanguard suffered a blow from which many felt it might never recover. For the Lightless among us, the Great Disaster has become a fable: a story of monsters and tragic heroes encompassing the worst the universe can bring to bear.  

For many of the City's Guardians, however, the events of that time are not simply part of the historical record, but personal memory.  

"I'd never seen anything like it," Odon Kolos says. "That army the Vanguard put together…" 

Emboldened by initial victory against the Hive at the site of Burning Lake, the Vanguard and Consensus ordered a full-scale assault on the Moon. An army of Guardians thousands-strong marched against entrenched Hive forces—only to fall by the hundreds to a single Hive champion.  

Odon was one of the lucky Guardians who managed to reach a transport before the Moon was abandoned in the retreat.  

"Turns out immortal doesn't mean invincible," Odon observes. "Just means you stand a better chance of living with your mistakes."  

The Disaster spelled the beginning and the end for the Vanguard's military prospects. Any hope of formally organizing the City's Lightbearers dissipated. Contemporary records show that many felt the Guardian population soon became ungovernable—even disloyal—in the wake of the Vanguard's failure.  

But events in recent years suggest that Guardians do not require loyalty to a military command to compel them to place themselves in danger on behalf of the City. Whether driven by hope for humanity or a desire for wealth, Guardians have continued to face off against increasingly dire threats.  

"I used to run with Future War Cult," Odon tells me. "I guess I started to think… maybe we win the little fights, but we're never going to do anything about the real enemies out there. That war will always be waiting."  

He laughs. "And then someone comes along and kicks Crota's teeth in."
1599691029.text_zh:
圣城使者撰稿人伊曼奴依·乌特金著 

几个世代以前，先锋遭受了重大打击，许多人认为它再也不能恢复过来。对我们当中的无光者而言，大灾难已经成为了一则寓言：那是一个关于怪物和悲剧英雄的故事，对宇宙来说太过沉重。  

然而，对于许多圣城的守护者而言，当时发生的事件不仅仅是历史记录，更是其个人记忆的一部分。  

“我从没见过那种场面，”奥登·科洛斯说。“先锋组建的那支军队…” 

在燃烧之湖取得对抗邪魔族的初步胜利之后，受到鼓舞的先锋和元老院下令向月球发起总攻。一支由数千名守护者组成的军队向据守的邪魔族部队发起远征——结果却被一名邪魔族勇士屠戮殆尽。  

奥登是在月球被抛弃之前登上了运输船的幸运守护者之一。  

“事实证明，永生并不意味着无敌，”奥登做出了这样的评述。“它只是意味着你更有可能带着错误活下去。”  

大灾难标志着先锋作为一支军队的开端和终结。任何正式整组圣城负光者的希望都随之烟消云散。当代记录显示，先锋失败后，许多人认为守护者很快就变得难以管理——甚至心生叛意。  

但近年来发生的事件表明，守护者并不需要效忠于一个军事指挥部来驱使他们为了圣城而涉险。不管是出于对人类的希望还是对财富的渴望，守护者都在不断直面着日益严峻的威胁。  

“我曾经隶属于未来战争狂热者，”奥登告诉我。“我猜我开始觉得…也许我们赢得了小打小闹，但我们永远无法应对外面真正的敌人。觉得总有战争在等着我们。”  

他笑了。“然后，有个人跑来踢飞了克洛塔的牙齿。”

1599691034.name: Grimoire: The City—Praxic Order
1599691034.text:
"They're some of the Tower's best assets. There is always the risk, of course, of… overenthusiasm." —Ikora Rey

——————

TYPE: AGENT FEED 
PARTIES: Two [2]. One [1] agent Aunor Mahal [M]; One [1] field agent, redacted [R] under Cormorant encryption 
//AUDIO UNAVAILABLE// 
//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS…/ 

[M.01] Keep cool, agent. 
[R.01] I'm steady as a Titan. 
[M.02] Steadiness means not getting cocky on the way out. 
[R.02] Oh, in that case. 
[R.03] Don't think they clocked me in this gear. Nothing but a blueberry with a nasty streak. 
[M.03] And the deal? 
[R.04] Next week! Even a new Light like me could find a better deal before then. 
[M.04] I'd rather deal with incompetent arms dealers than the reverse. 
[R.05] You and me both, ma'am.
1599691034.text_zh:
“他们是高塔的宝贵人才。当然，他们也有…过度狂热的风险。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

——————

类型：特工信号 
相关方：二[2]。一[1]名特工，阿诺尔·玛哈[M]；一[1]名外勤特工，受鸬鹚加密隐藏[R] 
//无音频// 
//转录如下…// 

[M.01] 保持冷静，特工。 
[R.01] 我和泰坦一样稳。 
[M.02] 稳，意味着不要过分自信。 
[R.02] 哦，这样的话。 
[R.03] 我穿成这样，他们应该认不出，只是把我当成了一个讨厌鬼。 
[M.03] 交易呢？ 
[R.04] 下周！就连我这样的新兵也能在那之前找到更好的交易。 
[M.04] 我宁可跟无能的军火商打交道，而不是相反的情况。 
[R.05] 我有同感，女士。

1599691035.name: Article: United in Hope—Our Neighbors in Neomuna
1599691035.name_zh: 文章：在希望中团结——我们在内欧姆那的邻居
1599691035.text:
By Emmanuil Utkin, Staff Writer at the City Herald 

Confirmation of a Human settlement on Neptune was only one of several shocking revelations over the course of recent years. Its discovery marks a sea change in our collective access to Golden Age information and technology long thought to be lost. Perhaps more importantly, it heralds potential reconnection with the rest of our people. Who are these Neomuni? Are they anything like us?   

Real-time communication between Neomuna and Earth is still stymied by the logistics of crossing enemy lines, in addition to Neomuna's communications restrictions. Data transmissions from Neomuna are strictly controlled and scrutinized for Vex corruption. Therefore, Vanguard sources provided assistance contacting Neomuni citizens; we asked willing individuals to share their perspectives on the possibilities of a long-awaited reunion with Earth. 

Despite the dangers, many Neomuna denizens are optimistic about the curtain coming down some day in the future. A brief selection of their thoughts follows: 

"I don't know how things would have shaken out if we'd stayed on Earth. Maybe we wouldn't have the CloudArk or nanotechnology. But if we make it through this fight with the Witness, I think it's only fair we send over, you know, what we have on food production, terraforming… There's a whole planet to reclaim."  

"I'd love to read some new Earth literature. I always assumed that the stories we managed to bring with us were going to be the last of their kind. Does anyone over there like detective stories?" 

"It's been interesting to see the Guardians at work. Is everyone on Earth like that? Going at Mach 12 all the time?"  

Stay tuned for continued coverage, including a guest feature from Neomuna's very own Jisu Calerondo!
1599691035.text_zh:
圣城使者撰稿人伊曼奴依·乌特金著 

确认海王星上有人类定居点只是近年来的几大震惊发现之一。长期以来，黄金时代信息和技术一直被认为已经失传，而这个发现标志着我们在此方面迎来了巨大的变化。也许更为重要的是，这预示着我们可能会与其他人类重新建立起联系。这些内欧姆那人是谁？他们和我们一样吗？   

内欧姆那和地球的实时通讯仍然受制于跨越敌方前线的后勤问题，此外还受到了内欧姆那通讯限制的影响。来自内欧姆那的传输数据仍受到严格封锁，并需检查Vex污染。因此，先锋方面协助联系了内欧姆那的居民；我们向许多乐意分享见解的居民询问了他们对与地球最终重聚的可能性的看法。 

尽管危机重重，许多内欧姆那居民仍保持乐观，觉得问题有朝一日会得到解决。以下精选了他们的部分看法： 

“我不知道如果我们当时留在地球，结果会怎样。也许我们就不会有云端方舟或纳米技术。但如果我们能挺过这场与见证者的战斗，我认为我们理应把我们在食物生产、地球化方面的技术送过去…那里有一整个星球等着我们去开垦。”  

“我很想读一些新的地球文学作品。我一直以为，我们当时设法带走的文学作品将是绝唱。那边有人喜欢侦探小说吗？” 

“看守护者工作很有趣。地球上的人都是那样吗？一直以12马赫的速度到处穿梭？”  

请继续关注后续报道，包括内欧姆那的吉舒·卡莱隆多的特邀专题！

749156569.name: Article: Hot Off the Shelf
749156569.text:
By Ember Hadad, Senior Editor at the City Herald 

My new friend is an unassuming young man in a torn flight jacket, still coated in a fine layer of dust. His Ghost, Rivet, is looking impressively smug for a small metal being.  

"They told me I'd never find my Guardian," Rivet tells me. "That I should try my luck with the Hive! But look at him. He's beautiful!"  

Like all Risen, Rivet's beautiful new Guardian has no memory of who he was, where he is, or what his purpose might be. But he nods agreeably when Rivet explains to him that Guardians protect the Last City.  

"I'm here to fight Fallen and Cabal," the Guardian says proudly. "But only the mean ones."  

"He's still figuring a few details out," Rivet says. 

It's been a very eventful past few years in the Sol system. I ask Rivet: At this point in time, how does a Ghost go about getting their new Guardian up to speed?  

"Well, you start by warning them about what threats we'll be facing in the field, right? I haven't… really gotten into the part about the end of the world just yet, though." 

Rivet's Guardian looks confused. "The world is ending?"  

Vanguard Operative Shaw Han, my escort through the Cosmodrome and local shepherd of those he calls New Lights, has similar advice.  

"It helps to focus on the basics. Let them test out their Light, learn what they're capable of. The details can come later." 

Even now?  

"Yep. Once they've got a handle on the little things, saving the world comes naturally."
749156569.text_zh:
圣城使者高级编辑恩蓓尔·哈达著 

我的新朋友是一个其貌不扬的年轻人，穿着一件破旧的飞行夹克，上面还蒙着一层细细的灰尘。他的机灵，瑞威特，身为一个小小的金属生物倒是相当得意。  

“他们说我永远找不到我的守护者，”瑞威特告诉我。“说我应该去邪魔族那边试试运气！但你瞧瞧他。他真漂亮！”  

和所有复生者一样，瑞威特漂亮的新守护者不记得他是谁，他在哪里，或他的使命是什么。但当瑞威特向他解释守护者要保护圣城时，他赞同地点了头。  

“我是来对抗堕落者和卡巴尔的，”这名守护者骄傲地说。“但只是那些坏的堕落者和卡巴尔。”  

“他还在琢磨一些细节，”瑞威特说。 

过去的几年中，太阳系里事件频发。于是我就问瑞威特：在这种时候，机灵要如何让自己的新守护者了解当前的情况？  

“嗯，你首先要警告他们，我们在战场上会面临哪些威胁，对吧？不过我还没有…跟他说世界末日的事。” 

瑞威特的守护者看起来很困惑。“世界要迎来末日了？”  

先锋特工韩潇是我在发射基地的护卫和新兵守护者的本地导师，他也有类似的建议。  

“这能帮助他们专注于基本。让他们测试自己的光能，了解自己的能力。细节可以留到以后再说。” 

即使是现在？  

“对。等他们弄清了那些小事，自然就会想去拯救世界。”

749156568.name: Article: A Consensus for the Rest of Us
749156568.name_zh: 文章：我们其他人的元老院
749156568.text:
By Leia Terazzas, Political Correspondent at the City Herald 

Chibuike Otieno, Perica Kosar, Argus McKowen—if there is anything the current slate of Consensus hopefuls have in common, it's that they offer a very different kind of representation for the mortal population of the Last City.  

Raucous political gatherings have become a staple of the City's night-life in recent months, with potential candidates vying for the chance to make their case for candidacy in the City's parks and public squares. Chief among their demands is the urgent restoration of fair representation to the City's government. Notably absent are the old trappings of long-established faction loyalties.   

"This [move away from Guardian-driven factions] speaks to a more mortal-centric framing," claims Dina Palomo, one of several enthusiastic volunteers campaigning on behalf of McKowen. "We know the Vanguard can handle the long view. But we need the short-term perspective as well as the immortal one." 

Warlock Vanguard Ikora Rey has repeatedly pledged to restore the Consensus, promising to hold civilian elections once the immediate threat is over. Not everyone is content to wait.  

"How many citizens were exiled from the City because they got on Executor Hideo's bad side?" asks one local. "I mean, how many Guardians got the boot because they wanted Guardians ruling the City? Isn't that what we have now? If things are so desperate, why don't we invite some of our people back home?"  

Others call the excitement over elections premature.  

"If we lose the war, I'm pretty sure none of us are going to be alive to do any voting." 

It is difficult to argue the point that election turnout might be poor under the current circumstances. But if the Lightless members of our community are to have a voice in the future, it's clear that there are those ready and eager to speak.
749156568.text_zh:
圣城使者政治记者莱雅·特拉扎斯著 

奇布伊克·奥蒂埃诺、佩里卡·科萨、阿格斯·麦考文——如果说目前的元老院候选人名单有什么共同点的话，那就是他们都力求以一种截然不同的方式去代表圣城的凡人。  

近几个月来，喧闹的政治集会已成为圣城夜生活的主旋律，潜在的候选人们争相在圣城的公园和广场上进行竞选宣传。他们的主要诉求是紧急恢复市政府的公平代表性。值得注意的是，长期以来形成的象征派别忠诚的旧标识已不复存在。   

“这样[远离守护者驱动的派别]才更适合以凡人为中心的框架，”迪娜·帕洛莫这样说道，她是一名宣扬麦考文的政治观点的热情志愿者。“我们知道先锋可以从长远角度考虑问题。但除了永生者的考量，我们还需要短期的视角。” 

术士先锋艾可拉·蕾伊一再保证会恢复元老院，并承诺一旦眼前的威胁结束，就举行平民选举。但并非所有人都愿意等待。  

“有多少市民因为招惹了执行者秀夫而被流放出圣城？”一名居民问道。“我是说，有多少守护者因为希望守护者统治圣城而被驱逐？我们现在不就是那样吗？如果事态如此绝望，为什么不邀请一些我们的人回家？”  

也有人觉得热衷选举还为时过早。  

“如果我们输掉了战争，我敢说我们都没法活着去投票。” 

在目前的情况下，选举的投票率应该会很低。这一点难以辩驳。但如果说我们社区中的无光者将来会拥有发言权，显然他们中的有些人已经准备好了发言，并渴望发言。

749156571.name: Grimoire: Allies—Eliksni
749156571.name_zh: 魔典：盟友——埃里克斯尼族
749156571.text:
"We have found the Great Machine." —Mithrax, after Chelchis

——————

Known on Earth for centuries as the Fallen, the Eliksni are four-armed beings from the planet Riis. They fled their home after the Traveler's departure caused a planet-wide calamity called the Whirlwind. While many Eliksni remain steadfast enemies of the Last City, others have joined as our allies and neighbors, most notably the House of Light and their leader, Mithrax. 

Eliksni rely on the inhalation of Ether to survive and grow. Processed from organic materials and energy by Servitors, Ether is highly combustible. As such, any leaks in City tanks are to be immediately reported through emergency channels.
749156571.text_zh:
“我们找到了大机器。”——米瑟拉克斯，切尔奇斯之后

——————

几个世纪以来，埃里克斯尼族在地球上被称为“堕落者”。他们是来自里斯星的四臂生物，因旅行者的离去在那里引发了一场名为“旋风”的全球灾难而逃离家园。尽管许多埃里克斯尼族仍是圣城的死敌，但也有一些已经加入我们，成为了我们的盟友和邻居，其中最著名的是光能氏族及其领袖米瑟拉克斯。 

埃里克斯尼族靠吸入乙太来生存和成长。乙太是一种通过魔眼从有机材料和能量中提取出的易燃物质。因此，圣城中的任何乙太罐泄漏都应立即通过紧急渠道报告。

749156570.name: Allies: Tower—Empress Caiatl
749156570.text:
"We eat the mountains. We drink the seas." 

——————

The former emperor, Calus, lived for joy, rejecting his empire's long military tradition. His sole heir, and a member of the coup that overthrew him, the Empress Caiatl makes for a different leader. A classic militarist, she trained in her youth as a fighter pilot. Caiatl has bent her considerable might to two goals: defeating the Witness and reclaiming her homeworld of Torobatl. 

Caiatl's empire is a sprawling one, composed of many peoples. It continues to expand even within Sol, with the empress accepting the oath of the empire's first Guardian, the Valus Saladin Forge.
749156570.text_zh:
“我们吞噬山川，我们畅饮海洋。” 

——————

前皇帝卡鲁斯大帝摒弃了帝国悠久的军事传统，终日享乐。他唯一的继承人，通过政变推翻他的女帝查厄托，是一名不同的领袖。她是一个典型的军国主义者，年轻时曾接受过战斗机飞行员训练。查厄托将她的强大力量用在两个目标上：击败见证者和夺回她的家园图罗巴特尔。 

查厄托的帝国疆域辽阔，由许多不同的民族组成。随着女帝接受太阳系的第一名守护者，军政官萨拉丁·佛吉的效忠誓言，她的势力甚至还扩张进了太阳系。

749156573.name: Article: Visitors Out of Dreams—Changing Reef Relations
749156573.name_zh: 文章：梦中来客——暗礁关系变化
749156573.text:
By Leia Terazzas, Political Correspondent at the City Herald 

Recent strategic summits between Queen Mara Sov of the Awoken and the Vanguard have provided our citizens with that rarest of honors: a glimpse of our Awoken neighbors.  

The City has hosted a small Awoken population for centuries, but Reefborn subjects of the queen were more commonly contained to Awoken settlements and outposts within their own territory. The queen's secrets were guarded zealously, and prior relations with the City often bordered on hostility. In the face of common threats, however, this isolationist policy has since softened.  

For today's citizens, the arrival of Awoken Corsairs is a minor spectacle.  

"I just know it's some sort of divine monarchy?" one local commented. "How are we supposed to keep up with everything in Sol these days? But they sure look impressive."  

Initial impressions of the Awoken Corsairs appear to be positive, with several residents describing them as disciplined, worldly, and surprisingly grounded.  

"We made a choice to help Earth long ago," said one Corsair. "I'm glad we can do so openly."  

While the imminent battle for the Traveler is foremost on everyone's minds, several Corsairs noted their hopes for continued cooperation, especially given rumors of a resurgence of the infamous Ahamkara.  

As another Corsair put it: "There's a lot we're going to have to figure out together in a hurry."
749156573.text_zh:
圣城使者政治记者莱雅·特拉扎斯著 

觉醒者的玛拉·索维女王与先锋近日举行的战略峰会，让市民们有幸一睹我们的邻居觉醒者的风采。  

几个世纪以来，圣城一直在接纳少量的觉醒者，但女王的暗礁后裔臣民通常都被限制在其领地内的觉醒者定居点和前哨站。女王的秘密受到狂热的保护，昔日与圣城的关系往往接近敌对。然而，面对共同的威胁，这种孤立主义政策近来有所缓和。  

对于今天的市民们来说，觉醒者海盗军的到访已是见怪不怪。  

“我只知道他们是某种神圣君主制？”一名市民评论道。“现今我们要怎样做才能跟上太阳系里发生的事啊？但他们确实看起来挺厉害。”  

市民们对觉醒者海盗军的第一印象似乎是积极的，几名市民形容他们纪律严明，善于处事，而且意外地脚踏实地。  

“我们很久以前选择了帮助地球，”一名海盗军说。“我很高兴我们能公开地那样做了。”  

虽然每个人都把即将到来的旅行者保卫战放在首位，但几名海盗军也指出，他们希望能在那之后继续合作，尤其是考虑到有传闻说臭名昭著的阿罕卡拉会卷土重来。  

正如另一名海盗军所说：“有很多事情我们都得共同尽快解决。”

50291571.name: Speaker's Sight
50291571.subtitle: To its Speakers, the Traveler gives dreams, and little more.
50291571.subtitle_zh: 旅行者将梦托给它的先知们，仅此而已。
50291571.text:
—I dream of a star hung low in the sky: brilliant, refractive, astigmatic. In green twilight, it was clear; in golden sunrise, it was aloof. Through day and night, it keeps me company, and from dream to dream, it is there, no matter the sky, no matter indoors or outdoors. In the heart of a deep subterranean compound, the star twinkles in the ventilation ducts. I always know where I am going. 

—I dream of a weary wolf with kind eyes, a mother with pups behind her. She knows I am no threat, but I keep respectful distance anyway. Manners are not a suggestion. She does not speak. 

—I dream of sunset, over and over. 

—I dream of spears. I trace symbology through archives—boar-hunting and defense, creativity and fire, sacrifice and martyrdom. I do not understand the dreams. They stay with me for a long, long time. 

—I dream of peace. I dream of waking with a rising sun, calm at dawn—waking to birdsong, to the sound of wings. I dream there is no fear and there are no walls, and the only trouble that meets me is I must shade my eyes when I walk out into the world. 

—I dream of dreaming. I wake from one dream into another dream. There was a time when people like me dreamed, and it was a story. Now I dream only omens, cast in the fall of bamboo and the patterns of offal. I dream that I had a dream where I knew, without question, what was being said to me, but in the waking, it is nothing but smoke. 

—I dream of patterns in the stream, fallen leaves drawing pictures for the briefest of moments before being washed down the river. Sorrow crushes me, and I do not understand why. 

—I dream I am a voice caught in a throat, a heart trapped behind ribs—the thundering life of something that can only exist in its cage. I am Light cradled in glass and wire; I am a shield dreaming of being a sky, in love with the clouds. I look back at myself, and I am so, so small. I dream— 

—And I wake, and I remember the dreams I have had before, though I do not understand them. But they  array themselves in orderly fashion, in a long queue of patience. 

I have time to cast the bones and learn their meaning.
50291571.text_zh:
——我梦见一颗星星，低垂在天：明亮灿烂，折射散光。在绿色的暮光中，它是无阻的；在金色的朝阳中，它是疏远的。无论日夜，无论何种天空，无论室内室外，无论哪个梦，它都与我相伴。那颗星星在某个地下深处核心的通风管道中闪烁着。我总是知道自己要去哪儿。 

——我梦见一匹疲惫的狼，眼神和蔼可亲，它是一匹母狼，身后跟着一群幼崽。她知道我不具威胁，但我还是敬而远之。礼貌是必要的。她一言不发。 

——我梦见日落，一次又一次。 

——我梦见长矛。我通过档案追溯象征——野猪狩猎与防御、创造与火焰、牺牲与殉难。我不理解这些梦。它们会在我心中萦绕很久很久。 

——我梦见安宁。我梦见伴着初升的太阳醒来，平静的黎明——听着鸟语和振翅声醒来。我梦见没有恐惧，没有围墙，唯一的麻烦是我走进外面的世界时必须遮住眼睛。 

——我梦见做梦。我从一个梦中醒来，进入另一个梦。曾几何时，像我这样的人会梦到故事。现在，我只梦见预兆，梦见竹子倒下，梦见内脏的纹路。我梦见我做了一个梦，我非常确定梦里有人对我说了什么，但在梦醒时分，一切都化为乌有。 

——我梦见溪流中的图案，落叶在被河水冲走之前，在那短暂的片刻里作画。悲伤压得我喘不过气来，我不明白为什么会这样。 

——我梦见自己是哽在喉中的声音，困在肋骨后的心脏——只能存在于牢笼中的雷电生命。我是被玻璃和铁丝包裹的光能；我是爱上了云朵，梦想成为苍穹的盾牌。我回望自己，我是那么那么的渺小。我梦见—— 

——随后我醒了，我想起了以前做过的梦，虽然我无法理解它们。但它们都井然有序地自行排列着，组成了一条耐心的长龙。 

我会有时间去投出占卜之骨，了解它们的含义。

1955548646.name: Mataiodoxía
1955548646.subtitle: The moment when wings and limbs are held on tenterhooks, and the pin enters the thorax.
1955548646.subtitle_zh: 羽翼和肢体被钩住，别针插入了胸腔。
1955548646.text:
The Witness has made an old friend of Darkness. It knows intimately the language of warp and weft, how to weave a spider-silk notion or slip a needle of intrusive thought into the fabric of another's mind. In its hands, the Light should be alien and inelegant, the hammer and chisel so unlike its customary tools. 

But though the Witness has never wielded the Light like this before, parts of it recall a time when they made the Gardener's tools their own. But now that power is not freely given; now every stroke of the chisel is accompanied by a distant wail. A minor annoyance, at most. 

The raw material is mediocre, but a true artist can paint on any canvas. The Witness has far more vision than the feckless sphere it has superseded.  

-|A paean to our final work.|- 

It works in broad strokes first. Cuts away the excess. Peels back the integument and lays bare the shivering, raw meat of it. In it, the Witness sees a glimpse of the sculpture trapped inside, waiting to be freed by its hand. One assistant places the pins; another wipes away the effluvia. 

-|A form to teach our enemy fear. A shadow they will dread.|- 

The rough grows restless. It thrashes, threatening to upset the delicate work done so far. The Witness spares it a sharp, quelling look, and it stills. Nothing may distract the auteur from its work. 

Onward. It refines the form, tearing wings of muscle away from bone, carving down, down, until exposed marrow steams in the cold air. Its tempo increases, its motions grow sharper, until it is slashing wildly at its canvas. Its assistants tremble. They do not see that its expression is frozen in absolute serenity. It is as calm and clear-eyed as it has ever been, discarding yards of still-living tripe to reveal… 

-|Perfection.|-
1955548646.text_zh:
见证者是暗影的老朋友。它熟知经纬语言，了解如何编织蛛丝般的念头，或将侵入性想法的针尖插入另一个人的思维布料。在它的手中，光能理应是陌生而笨拙的，与它惯用的工具大不相同的锤子和凿子。 

虽然见证者从未像现在这样操控过光能，但它的某些部分还是会不禁回想起自己曾把园丁的工具据为己有的时光。但如今，这种力量不再是慷慨给予的；现在，凿子的每一次敲击都伴随着遥远的哀鸣。这顶多算个小烦恼。 

原材料相当平庸，但真正的艺术家可以在任何画布上作画。见证者的愿景要远胜它所取代的那个软弱球体。  

-|对我们最终作品的赞歌。|- 

它先是猛地一挥。切除多余部分。剥开外皮，露出颤抖的生肉。见证者从中瞥见了困在其中的雕塑，等待着被它的手解放出来。一名助手放置了针脚，另一名助手擦去了污物。 

-|让敌人恐惧的形式。让敌人害怕的阴影。|- 

原材料变得焦躁不安。它扭动着，威胁要破坏迄今为止完成的精细工作。见证者投下锐利的抑制目光，它便安静下来。什么都不能让这名导演分心。 

继续前进。它精雕细琢，将肌肉翅膀从骨头上撕下，不断向下雕刻，直到裸露的骨髓在寒冷空气中蒸腾。它的节奏越来越快，动作愈发犀利，直到疯狂劈砍画布。助手们瑟瑟发抖，没有看到它的表情凝固在绝对的平静之中。它一如既往地镇定自若、目光如炬，丢弃一码码还活着的肚皮，露出了… 

-|完美。|-

2273643087.name: Solipsism
2273643087.subtitle: We are thinkers, daring to dream about the universe and its infinite expanse.
2273643087.subtitle_zh: 我们是思想家，敢于梦想无垠宇宙。
2273643087.text:
I see an abyss. Small and distant shapes. I'm walking in your nascent memories. Flickering motes. I sense… curiosity. You've always pondered, from the very beginning. As did we. 

I see tessellation. The pulsating hum of cosmic structure; a kaleidoscopic symphony of Light and Dark. What was the Veil to you?  

Since I woke, I've always felt like I was still dreaming. I'd like to think that's how you feel as well. Those of us that hunger for a great truth—we dream with you. 

—Unknown Warlock
2273643087.text_zh:
我看到了深渊。渺小而遥远的形状。我走在你初生的记忆里。闪烁的萤光。我感觉到…好奇。你总是在思索，自打一开始起。和我们一样。 

我看到了细分曲面。宇宙结构的脉动嗡鸣；光明与黑暗的万花筒交响曲。面纱对你来说是什么？  

自我醒来后，我总觉得自己还在做梦。我想这也是你的感受。我们当中这些渴求伟大真理的人——我们和你一起做梦。 

——不知名的术士

141134282.name: Promised Victory Bond
141134282.subtitle: "Time is called; we win. I win. One more round, just one more round."
141134282.subtitle_zh: “时间已到，我们赢了。我赢了。再来一局，就一局。”
141134282.text:
—-Warlock, you need not resist. You have died countless deaths; you have been reborn in equal measure. You comprehend the final shape as were a death sentence… to liken it to death is an underestimation, an incorrect and assumptive simplification.  

Sometimes death is violent and momentary, sometimes death is quiet, sometimes it is even dull. The Light reassembles you as it sees fit, reformed in optimal condition to fight in its endless, hopeless war. Primed to do the bidding of forces you could not hope to understand. Death, rebirth, a cycle endless and tiresome. We know you are weary. 

We hear the dominant chord of the universe, and we wish to share it with you. There is a musicality in its preciseness if you only attune yourself to it. A cacophony harmonized.  

You see this as unbearable torture… but you also know it to be transcendent ecstasy. The rush of your joyous game, the delicious heat of battle. Your guns, and even your beloved comrades, together again. That moment, you know the very one. Eternal victory. Triumph that does not wane. Break the cycle, dear Ikora. Rest.—-
141134282.text_zh:
——术士，你不必抵抗。你死过无数次，也重生过无数次。你把终焉之形理解成了死刑判决…把它比作死亡是一种低估，一种不正确而想当然的简化。  

有时，死亡是猛烈而快速的。有时，死亡是安静的，有时甚至是沉闷的。光能会在它认为合适的时候重组你，以最佳状态重整，来参加它无休止、无希望的战争。在你无法理解的力量的驱使下，你行使其意志。死亡，重生，一个无休止而令人疲惫的循环。我们知道你累了。 

我们听到了宇宙的主弦，我们希望与你分享。只要你愿意与它同调，就能感受到其精准无误中的音乐性。一种和谐的嘈杂。  

你视之为难以忍受的折磨…但你也明白，它是超凡脱俗的极乐。欢快竞赛的快感，激烈战斗的美妙。你的枪械，甚至你心爱的战友，都将重聚。在那一刻，你会意识到它的到来。永恒的胜利。永不褪色的成就。打破轮回吧，亲爱的艾可拉。该休息了。——

1183405878.name: First Ascent Gloves
1183405878.subtitle: Hold close your own.
1183405878.text:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Caiatl wonders what waits inside the Traveler. She's heard the stories from Red Legion defectors about how it swallowed Ghaul like a warbeast choking down a bone. 

"He's still in its belly," a Valus on her War Council once told her, and Saladin Forge had made a breathy sound through his nose that Caiatl interpreted as laughter. 

That was days ago. Now she stands on the bridge of her ship, wondering what of Ghaul remains, the Traveler's glow reflected in the black of her eyes and the ornamental jewelry she wears on her tusks. She does not feel the pull of it, as she imagines Ghaul did, or even Saladin's quiet reverence. It is not a thing to be conquered or worshipped, but it is important to the people who are important to her—and that is all that matters. 

When she hears footsteps behind her, she does not turn. She already knows whom they belong to. 

"I did not request your counsel," she says without reprimand. "But if you have something to say, then speak." 

"Must I always have some wisdom for you?" Saladin asks. "Can't we simply await the end together in comfortable silence?" 

"Your worth is your wisdom. It's the only reason I let you live." 

Saladin makes that noise again. He knows that isn't true. 

And so does she.
1183405878.text_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

查厄托想知道旅行者内部会有什么在等着他们。她从猩红军团叛逃者那里听说过旅行者是如何像战兽啃食骨头一样吞下了盖欧。 

“他还在它的肚子里，”战争议会上的一名军政官曾经这样告诉查厄托，而她将萨拉丁·弗吉用鼻子发出的哼哼声理解为了嗤笑。 

那是两天前的事了。她现在站在她飞船的舰桥上，琢磨着盖欧还剩下了什么。旅行者的光芒映在她的漆黑眼珠和装饰獠牙的珠宝上。她没有感受到在她的想象中盖欧对它的渴求，也没有感受到萨拉丁对它的崇敬。它不是一种该被征服或膜拜的东西，但它对那些对她很重要的人来说很重要——这才是重点。 

当她听到身后有脚步声时，她没有转身。她已经知道那是谁了。 

“我没有询问你的意见，”她说道，没有斥责的意思。“但如果你有话要讲，那就开口吧。” 

“难道我是位智慧导师？”萨拉丁问道。“我们就不能一起安静地等待终末吗？” 

“你的智慧是你的价值。那是我让你活着的唯一原因。” 

萨拉丁又发出了那种哼哼声。他知道那不是真的。 

而她也知道。

4143415290.name: First Ascent Robes
4143415290.subtitle: Oh, to read a pulpy golden age detective novel…just once more.
4143415290.subtitle_zh: 简陋通俗的黄金时代侦探小说…能再读一次就好了。
4143415290.text:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Ikora studied the strange approximation of the Tower, dust kicked up around her as the wind gusted through creaking halls. She felt the pull to explore… to find her old office. To see just how deep the recreation would go. 

But as she took a step up the stairs, her foot caught something—a small but familiar rectangular shape. She picked up the book and gently brushed dust from the cover. It was a copy of "The Spine-Tingling Adventures of Sedona Kane, P.I." The pulpy cover art told her it was the fourth installment of the series, with the subtitle "The Curious Case of Doctor Pennyworth." 

Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Darkness. In a place of such potent Light, would it be enough to manifest… everything? She flipped through the book; even the coffee stain still adorned page 95. 

Flashes of memory came back to Ikora as she studied the bold colors and heavy lines of the book's tattered jacket. She recalled kicking her feet up against the wall in her bunk one night after a particularly nasty Crucible loss… Ophiuchus's glow providing just enough visibility. Remembered cleaning the spilled drink off the pages in the mess hall and praying there was no lasting damage. And thought of other moments, of a warm hand covering her own as she read the text out loud for the thousandth time… 

The Warlock held the book to her nose. Just to take in the scent once more.  

Light forgets, Darkness remembers, and so would she.
4143415290.text_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

艾可拉审视着这座近似高塔的奇特建筑。她周围的尘土随着破败大堂中的狂风扬起。她感受到了探索的渴望…她想找到她以前的办公室。看看这个复制品到底有多像。 

但刚踏上楼梯，她的脚就碰到了一件物品——它的形状小而熟悉。她拿起那本书，轻轻拂去封面上的灰尘。这是一本《私家侦探塞多纳·凯恩的惊奇历险记》。从它俗气的封面上可以看出，这是该系列的第四部，副标题是“潘尼沃斯医生奇案”。 

光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

暗影。在光能如此充足的地方，它是否能够显现…一切？她翻了翻书；甚至第95页上的咖啡渍都还在。 

当艾可拉打量着破旧书皮上大胆的色彩和厚重的线条时，她的记忆片段又闪现在了眼前。她回想起在熔炉竞技场中大败后，有一天夜里躺床上用脚蹬着墙…蛇夫座的光刚好够亮…在食堂里清理洒在书本上的饮料，祈祷没留下永久印记。她还想起，当她反复大声阅读时，一只温暖的手覆在自己的手上… 

这位术士把书抵到自己的鼻头，再一次感受它的气味。  

光能遗忘，暗影铭记，而她也会如此。

3791868619.name: First Ascent Bond
3791868619.subtitle: There is nothing as exquisite as the feeling of doing what no one has done.
3791868619.subtitle_zh: 做别人没做过的事，感觉最美妙了。
3791868619.text:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mara Sov grit her teeth as she held the H.E.L.M. steady, straining all the while to keep the portal open with her power just long enough for the Guardian, Ikora, and Commander Zavala to slip through. 

Mara shifted her focus to watch the live feed in the viewscreen beside her as the Guardian took their first steps into the Pale Heart. 

And instantly… she remembered what it felt like to be first. 

She remembered unending emptiness, the spark of protons, cold rock against her back, and the sensation of spilling upwards eternally. She remembered glacial till veined with platinum, a forest that spread as mycelium, and alpine saddles cradling crystal clear lakes. She remembered a world so young and old, where all life was equal, meaningless and meaningful. She remembered making that memory, that place, calling it awake from the cauldron of her own imagination and raising it into matter, her lips curled on its name. The Distributary. 

Mara would never see that world again, and yet, on the grainy video stuttering before her, was its doppelganger. It was not home, but it was close. 

The video feed sputtered out. 

A roar of violet streaked past the H.E.L.M., and with a sudden silence, the ship burst from the portal into open space. The portal did not snap shut behind them—the Witness must have let go. 

Mara caught her breath. Her hands shook. There was no sign of Crow in there, or on comms, no sign he was alive other than the tug on her own heart. She glanced back to the Traveler and the Pale Heart within.  

Mara Sov thought once more of home.
3791868619.text_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

玛拉·索维咬紧牙关，拼尽全力让应急后勤行动中心保持稳定，同时用她的力量保持传送门开启，让守护者、艾可拉、指挥官萨瓦拉有机会顺利通过。 

玛拉把注意力转移到身旁的屏幕上，通过直播画面看到守护者在苍白之心中迈出了第一步。 

忽然…她记起了身为先行者的感受。 

她记起了无尽的空虚，质子的火花，抵着后背的冰冷岩石，永远向上的延伸感。她记起了被铂金缠绕的冰川，像菌丝一样蔓延的森林，还有被高山环抱的清澈湖泊。她记起了一个如此年轻而古老的世界。在那里，所有的生命都平等，没有意义，也充满意义。她记起自己创造那段记忆，那个地方，把它从自己想象的大锅里唤醒，将它升华为物质，嘴角微微翘起说出它的名字：两仪界。 

玛拉再也见不到那个世界了。然而，在她面前不断卡顿的模糊视频中，她看见了那个世界的复制品。那不是家，但已经很接近了。 

视频信号中断了。 

一道紫色的光芒席卷了应急后勤行动中心，飞船里忽然安静下来。他们通过传送门冲进了无垠的太空，身后的传送门并没有关闭——见证者肯定是松手了。 

玛拉喘过气来。她的手在颤抖。里面没有乌鸦的踪迹，也没有来自他的通讯。除了心中的牵挂，没有任何迹象表明他还活着。她回头瞥了一眼旅行者和其中的苍白之心。  

玛拉·索维再次想起了家园。

3364817839.name: First Ascent Hood
3364817839.subtitle: Choose what you will become next.
3364817839.subtitle_zh: 选择你接下来要成为什么样的人。
3364817839.text:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Once, a Ghost was heard to speak thusly. 

This one is Luzaku. Here, this one tells what is known of Sky. 

Sky is the breath taken between actions. It permits speculation. It invites doubt. It slips from sight and grasp, and yet persists. 

This one's Ghost would have us yield to certainty. He wishes us to walk the Bladed Path, to seek Hive-strength in the Witch Queen's abandoned logic, whereby all things prove themselves in slaughter. 

This one turns from simple inevitability. This one makes a choice: this one does not kill and does not die. Yet this one exists. Aiat. What follows? What other choices are to be made? 

This one must know. 

This one hides within a blade-ship of the Witch Queen's great foe. This one's Ghost is angry now, but he remains. In the hollows where a worm once coiled, this one senses our swift motion through the firmament, toward a center. 

This one seeks Sky. In the Sky, there are many paths. 

In the Sky, there is change.
3364817839.text_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

很久以前，一个机灵说过这些话。 

鄙人是鲁扎库，在此讲述鄙人对苍穹的了解。 

苍穹是行动之间的喘息。它允许猜测。它引人怀疑。它难以追踪和把握，却始终留存。 

鄙人的机灵希望我们屈服于确定性。他希望我们走上刀锋之道，寻求邪魔族的力量，遵从巫妖女王遭抛弃的逻辑，即万物需在屠杀中证明自身。 

鄙人放弃了简单的必然性。鄙人做出了选择：鄙人不杀，也不死亡。然而，鄙人仍然存在。阿特。接下来呢？还要做出什么选择？ 

鄙人必须知晓。 

鄙人躲在巫妖女王宿敌的刀锋飞船里。鄙人的机灵很生气，但他没有离去。在蠕虫曾经盘踞的深渊里，鄙人感知到我们正迅速穿过苍穹，前往中心。 

鄙人探寻苍穹。苍穹内有许多道路。 

苍穹内有变化。

2395788176.name: First Ascent Boots
2395788176.subtitle: To enter the body of a deity would be to unquestionably defile it.
2395788176.subtitle_zh: 进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。
2395788176.text:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mithrax stood at the bow of the H.E.L.M., watching as Zavala's ship vanished from view into the portal. That awful gateway pulsed and wavered, and though the H.E.L.M. was pointed straight at it, he was resolved in his decision. 

The notion of venturing inside the Great Machine was innately revolting. It reeked like a taboo as certain as cannibalism, as unthinkable as besmirching a house of worship; to enter the body of a deity would unquestionably be to defile it. He could find a way to support from afar. Surely that was plausible.  

"Father, the Queen is asking for you." 

Eido sidles up next to him, and the two look out over the Great Machine. It takes up the entirety of the window—the center of all Light punctured by the oscillating violet of the portal, and Mithrax realizes how small he feels alongside his daughter. 

"I'm not going down there without you," she says. 

Mithrax holds back his shiver and confesses, "To step inside feels like a transgression." 

"And who made that rule?" she says. Ever acute, ever wise. When Mithrax cannot answer, she continues, "The Traveler is in peril. So long as we can care, we are bound to enter and defend it. I have seen you still have fight in you, Father." 

"Would that not be worse? To wage war at the very center of Light?" 

"Only you can decide that. But I believe the Traveler would want you to enter the portal." 

"Why?" 

His daughter puts a loving hand on his own. "Because it knows you aren't there to hurt it."
2395788176.text_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

米瑟拉克斯站在应急后勤行动中心的船首，注视着萨瓦拉的飞船从视野中消失，进入传送门。那道可怕的大门在脉动和摇摆，尽管应急后勤行动中心正对着它，但他已经下定了决心。 

进入大机器内部的想法令他反感。像同类相食一般让人厌恶，像糟蹋圣堂一般难以想象；进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。他可以想办法从远处进行支援。他认为那是在理的。  

“父亲，女王在找你。” 

艾多走到他的身边。两人眺望着大机器。它填满了整个窗户——这位光能之神的中心，被传送门的震荡之紫刺穿了，米瑟拉克斯意识到自己和女儿在其身边是多么渺小。 

“没有你，我不会进去，”她说。 

米瑟拉克斯强忍着冷颤承认道，“进去像是一种亵渎。” 

“那种规则是谁定的？”她反问道。一如既往地机敏、睿智。米瑟拉克斯不知如何回答，而她还在继续，“旅行者正处于危险之中。只要我们还关爱它，我们就必须进去保护它。我知道你还有斗志，父亲。” 

“那样不是更糟糕吗？在光能的中心作战？” 

“那取决于你。但我相信旅行者会希望你进入传送门。” 

”为什么？“ 

他的女儿把一只充满爱意的手放在他的手背上。“因为它知道你不是去伤害它的。”

2933249366.name: Sublime Bond
2933249366.subtitle: We celebrate the future we will build together.
2933249366.subtitle_zh: 赞颂我们将会共同构建的未来。
2933249366.text:
Little noises catch Ikora's attention. Sounds of shifting and settling. Fidgeting. Drawn from her meditation, Ikora slits her eyes open to look accusingly across the coffee table. 

The expected culprit, Chalco, sits perfectly still. A ball of swirling, silent Void rests between the Hunter's hands. Perhaps she is innocent. 

Feeling downright restless by comparison, Ikora forces her eyes closed again. She counts her breaths; she clears her mind. The moment extends, balanced on the head of a pin. The Light in her pulses softly with her heartbeat. 

Cloth rustles. 

Ikora pointedly makes her breathing louder. She will embrace peace in this moment. She has meditated through a hundred distractions before, through the din of pitched battle and crushing heat. She will not cede this ground here and now. 

And yet when Ikora finally turns her inner gaze unflinching upon herself, ignoring the whisper-quiet sounds of a knife re-sheathing… she would simply rather be out in the sunlight with a friend. There are days, after all, when it is better to yield. She is not so proud that she cannot admit this. 

Ikora unfolds herself from her seat, eyes turned again on Chalco, who appears tranquil, shimmering faintly with the calm stillness of Void. "All right," Ikora says. "You win." 

Chalco is in motion in an instant, and the violet energy vanishes neatly as she vaults to her feet. She smiles—a little sly, a little knowing.  

It is useless to try feigning annoyance. As they leave Ikora's personal library, Ikora falls into step with Chalco, and they take the Hidden way out together. Dim artificial lighting gives way eventually to true sunlight, to a Tower decorated in gold and greenery. 

Ikora basks in warmth. The moment feels right, in a way it hadn't before. "The things I saw, in the Pale Heart," she says aloud. 

Chalco slows her steps for Ikora's lingering. "Yeah?" 

"I think I'll need the worst dumplings in the City," Ikora says. "To explain." 

Chalco laughs, and Ikora's restlessness settles.
2933249366.text_zh:
一些细微的动静引起了艾可拉的注意。有挪动和落座的声音。一阵躁动。艾可拉从冥想中回过神来，微微睁开眼睛，责备地望向咖啡桌的另一边。 

预想中的罪魁祸首，卡尔科，一动不动地静坐在那里。猎人的双手间握着一团漩涡状的无声虚空。也许她是无辜的。 

相比之下，艾可拉觉得自己简直坐立不安，她强迫自己再次闭上眼睛。她细数着呼吸；理清思绪。这一刻延展开来，仿佛悬于针尖之上。她体内的光能随着她的心跳轻轻脉动。 

衣服发出了沙沙的声音。 

艾可拉刻意地加重了自己的呼吸声。她要在此刻拥抱宁静。她曾在百般杂念中冥想，也曾在激烈的战斗和难耐的高温中凝思。此地此刻，她不会让步。 

然而，当艾可拉终于将内心的目光坚定地投向自己，无视刀刃重新入鞘时那细微到近乎耳语的声音时…她还是更愿意和朋友一起在阳光下漫步。毕竟，生活中总有些时候，放弃是更为明智的选择。她还没有自大到不肯承认这一点。 

艾可拉从座位上站起身，目光再次转向卡尔科，她显得很平静，身上微微闪烁着虚空般的宁静平和。“好吧，”艾可拉说道。“你赢了。” 

卡尔科立即行动起来，随着她快速地站起身，紫色的能量瞬间消散殆尽。她露出了微笑——既有些狡黠，又有些会意。  

假装恼怒是没有用的。艾可拉与卡尔科离开了艾可拉的私人图书馆，两人并肩前行，走的是隐秘者通道。暗淡的人造灯光渐渐褪去，阳光普照，有着金色装饰、绿意环绕的高塔映入眼帘。 

艾可拉沐浴在温暖之中。这一刻感觉很好，与以往截然不同。“我在苍白之心中看到的那些东西，”她大声说道。 

卡尔科放慢了脚步，等待艾可拉跟上。“怎么了？” 

“我想我得来点圣城里最难吃的饺子，”艾可拉说道，“才能解释这件事。” 

卡尔科大笑起来，艾可拉焦躁的情绪也随之平复。

11926187.name: Veteran Legend Gloves
11926187.subtitle: "I'll tell my children I was there. Before the battle had a name. Before it became a symbol of victory for the Titan orders."
11926187.subtitle_zh: “我会告诉我的孩子们，在那场战斗还没有名字之前，在它成为泰坦胜利的象征之前，我就在那里了。”
11926187.text:
My grandfather came to the City when it was just tents and huts. He traveled the Pilgrim Road on foot, all the way across the Panama Ravine with his entire family and was the only survivor by the end. He never talked about the journey much, not until his last years. Honestly, it helped give me perspective. I never knew the City as he did. I've only ever known the walls as a project, and watching those last stones be put into place made it feel like we were invincible.

Now, I write this journal entry from a bunker hundreds of feet below the streets. There is a battle raging outside the City walls, but I can feel it reverberating through the stone. Every time the lights flicker, I wonder, "Is this it?" The feeds say the aliens are attacking from six directions at once. I don't know if the walls will hold, if the Risen protecting us will stand. I don't know if I will see tomorrow. I just know the Traveler is here, and we are safe in its shadow.

They promised that this was the Last Safe City. We've all sacrificed too much to give up on that dream. We must survive.
11926187.text_zh:
我祖父来到圣城时，这里还只有帐篷和棚屋。他带着全家徒步走过朝圣者之路，穿过巴拿马峡谷，是最后唯一的幸存者。直到晚年，他都没怎么提起过这段旅程。说实话，这给了我很多启发。我从未像他那样了解圣城。我只知道城墙是一项工程，而看着那最后的几块石头砌放到位，让我们感到自己坚不可摧。

此刻，我正在街道下方数百英尺的地堡里写下这篇日志。圣城高墙外战火纷飞，但我能感觉到战争在石缝中回响。每当灯光闪烁，我都在想，“那一刻要来了吗？”消息称外星人同时从六个方向发动了进攻，我不知道城墙能否撑得住，也不知道保护我们的复生者能否屹立不倒。我不知道我能否活着看到明天。我只知道旅行者在这里，我们在它的荫蔽之下很安全。

他们承诺这里是“最后的安全城市”。我们都牺牲了太多，不能放弃这个梦想。我们必须活下去。

2813298149.name: Veteran Legend Robes
2813298149.subtitle: "I might not be a Guardian, but they've reminded us you don't need the Light to be a hero."
2813298149.subtitle_zh: “我也许不是守护者，但他们提醒我们，成为英雄不一定需要光能。”
2813298149.text:
My mother passed away last week. She left me the journals she'd been keeping since the days the walls were being built. She left her father's father's journals from before the City even had walls.
