The footfalls of an approaching visitor interrupted her. She welcomed the distraction. Anything to justify the hiatus she felt too guilty to grant herself. 

Variks hobbled in, his fur collar matted by the lab's humidity. The Vandal glanced surreptitiously toward Misraakskel, who was slumped on his throne nearby. Even though the troubled Kell was heavily sedated, Variks kept his voice low. 

"Variks has a new task for young Eido," he muttered. 

Eido sighed. This was not the pleasant diversion she had hoped for. "I'm too busy to take on new jobs right now," she objected. 

"There is a dispute between House Light and newcomers from House Salvation," Variks continued, breezing past her objection. "A squabble over salvage rights. The jump drive of an ancient ship, found outside the City." 

"That seems simple enough. Surely you can mediate." 

"Of course. Variks is a Scribe of House Judgment. Are you?" 

"I want to be! Eventually. But…" She gestured with exasperation to her laboratory equipment, her ailing father, and her myriad failed attempts to cure him. 

"House Judgment keeps peace for all," Variks replied gravely. "Not only one House, or one Kell. As a Scribe, your allegiance to House Light must always yield to a greater need." 

Variks ushered his young pupil from the lab. 

"Come," he encouraged her. "Help your kin. Create harmony, and it will follow you back here." It was exactly the type of advice her father would have given. 

Eido relented, letting Variks lead her outside. As they emerged, she expected the usual pangs of guilt. Instead, she was surprised to find only relief in the bustle of the City and the chill of the evening air.
4176873718.text_zh:
艾多熄灭了环境空气燃气灯。随着上方的烧杯冷却，里面的溶液化作两种独特液体。即使在高温下，它们也不互溶。她的上颚懊恼地咔嗒起来。 

一位访客的脚步声打断了她的思绪。她很乐意分下心，让自己有借口放松一下而不用感到愧疚。 

瓦里克斯跛着脚走进来，他的毛领因实验室的湿度而蓬乱着。这名暴徒偷偷地瞥了一眼旁边王座上瘫坐的米斯拉阿克斯凯尔，虽然这位陷入困境的凯尔已被注射了大量镇定剂，瓦里克斯还是压低了声音。 

“瓦里克斯有个新任务给年轻的艾多，”他低声说道。 

艾多叹了口气，这并不想为这件事分心。“我现在太忙，没法接新任务，”她反对道。 

“光能氏族与救赎氏族的新来者之间起了争端，”瓦里克斯没理会她的反对，继续说道。“是关于回收权的，圣城外发现了一艘古老飞船的跃迁引擎。” 

“听起来很简单，你肯定能调解。” 

“当然，瓦里克斯是审判氏族的文士。你是吗？” 

“我希望我是！最终会是。但…”她无奈地指着实验设备、她病重的父亲，以及治愈他的无数次失败尝试。 

“审判氏族为所有人维护和平，”瓦里克斯庄重地答道。“不仅仅是为某个氏族，或某个凯尔。作为文士，你对光能氏族的忠诚必须为更崇高的使命让路。” 

瓦里克斯引着他年轻的学徒向实验室外走去。 

“来吧，”他鼓励道，“帮助你的同胞，创造和谐，和谐就会跟着你回到此处。”这正是她的父亲会给的建议。 

艾多让步了，任由瓦里克斯引着她。走出来时，她等待着熟悉的内疚感，但出乎意料的是，在圣城的繁忙和傍晚的凉爽空气中，她只感到了轻松。

2599338625.name: Bitter/Sweet
2599338625.subtitle: The ravenous chorus sings through my veins.
2599338625.subtitle_zh: 我的血液中回荡着贪食副歌。
2599338625.text:
Tristak howls as he tears the head off the offending Vandal. The other prisoners retreat to the corners. Still-twitching mandibles drip warm fluid down his armor. 

"None of you are worthy of the House Salvation banner!" Even the other warriors flinch. The civilians sob or throw up, the hopelessness of their situation becoming clear. "We fought for FREEDOM, we fought for JUSTICE, and you cowards betrayed your House!" 

Rage boils in Tristak's throat, his fervor growing as the other prisoners pack themselves ever tighter. A rush of cold air sucks Tristak's antennae backward. He cannot feel the presence of anyone behind him, but Tristak sees the terrified eyes of his fellow prisoners  fixed far above his dripping plate.  

"RECKLESS YOUTH SMELLS SO SWEET, BUT I WILL VINT YOU TO YOUR TRUE POTENTIAL." 

Tristak does not turn. He refuses to show fear. 

His neck snaps back. 

A single chord resonates within his thorax, and every molecule attunes to its bitter pitch. This melodic intoxicant soaks through Tristak's muscles. The cacophony that follows fills him with fresh strength, writhing in harmony with its echoing pulse. 

"MY SWEET TONIC WILL BEAR YOU FORWARD. AND YOU WILL BEAR MORE, TO ME."

Tristak breathes in new life. The fog of his old ideals sloughs away as his focus is made sharp. The prisoners cry anew as he opens his slick mandibles wide to drink in their stench. Delicious.
2599338625.text_zh:
特里斯塔克咆哮着扯下惹麻烦的暴徒的头颅，其他囚犯缩到了角落里。温热的液体从仍在抽动的下颚滴到他的护甲上。 

“你们没一个配得上救赎氏族的旗帜！”即便是其他战士也发起抖来。平民们开始哭泣或呕吐，意识到了自己处境的绝望。“我们为自由，为正义而战，而你们这些懦夫出卖了氏族！” 

特里斯塔克的愤怒在喉中沸腾，囚犯们挤作一团，他的狂热也愈发猛烈。一阵冷空气向后拉扯他的触角。他感受不到身后有人，但能看到其他囚犯惊恐的视线凝聚在他滴血战甲的上方高处。  

“年少鲁莽的气味如此甜美，但我将引导你发挥真正的潜能。” 

特里斯塔克没有转身，他拒绝示弱。 

他脖子猛然后仰。 

单一的旋律在他的胸腔中回响，每个分子都与苦涩的音调同调。这令人陶醉的旋律浸透了特里斯塔克的肌肉，随后的不和谐音则让他充满了新的力量，与回响的脉搏和谐共鸣。 

“我甜美的药剂将引你前行，而你将领更多的人，来我这里。”

特里斯塔克呼吸着新的生命，曾经的理念像笼罩的迷雾般逐渐消散，焦点变得清晰。囚犯们再次开始哭泣，而他则张开湿滑的下颚，尽情吸入他们的恶臭。真是美味。

2599338624.name: Liturgy
2599338624.subtitle: It makes a circle.
2599338624.text:

2599338624.text_zh:
它压住 变异体 

颤抖的脓包 

它吟唱  

   我不相信-滴    

它切割皮肤 疼痛尖叫    

喷出 黑暗乙太 

扭动    

   无所畏惧 我不相信

   滴 滴 滴

2823644677.name: Exuviae
2823644677.subtitle: Shed your skin. Become something new.
2823644677.text:
Ekaask watched Eido bustle across the street toward Spider's bar. The young Scribe glanced over her shoulder furtively, clutching a mysterious object—a scroll of some kind—to her thorax. 

The Kell's daughter was so poor at subterfuge. Ekaask found it endearing. 

He wished he could speak to her. Remind her to walk casually. To take a breath. To think of something pleasant and innocuous. But that was not his place. 

A rude chitter sounded from underneath the half-assembled Pike nearby. "Ekaask, where's that voltage tester?" 

Ekaask started, realizing that he still held the requested equipment in his lower arms. 

Klyfiks slid out from beneath the salvaged vehicle and bristled the small hairs near his mandibles—a show of exasperation. 

"You're not smart enough to do this with just three eyes," Klyfiks quipped. 

Ekaask handed the voltage tester to his tutor. "I apologize. I was distracted." 

Klyfiks slyly intuited the cause of the novice engineer's inattention. "Not by anything in the Kell's Ketch, I hope." He gave a series of suggestive clicks. 

"Of course not," Ekaask replied, guardedly. "Just the Humans and their soft shells. So gross." 

Klyfiks chittered doubtfully. "Put them—or whoever—out of your mind. You have lots to learn before anyone finds you worthy of attention. Even the Humans. Now give me the conduit reamer." 

Ekaask wagged his head in agreement. He was a lowly Drekh for now. But he would learn. And molt. And one day, he would be important enough to speak as he desired.  

Until then, he would have to content himself with silent devotion, keeping Eido's mysterious secret as his own.
2823644677.text_zh:
埃卡斯克看着艾多匆忙穿过街道，朝蛛王的酒吧走去。年轻的文士鬼鬼祟祟地回头看了一眼，将一个像是卷轴的东西紧紧攥在胸前。 

凯尔的女儿很不擅长隐秘行动，埃卡斯克觉得她这样很可爱。 

他想和她说话，提醒她走路要自然，深呼吸，想一些愉快、无关紧要的事。但他没那资格。 

附近一个半组装好的派克下传来不耐烦的声音，“埃卡斯克，电压测试仪呢？” 

埃卡斯克猛然一惊，意识到他的下臂还拿着对方要的设备。 

克里菲克斯从回收载具底下钻了出来，无奈地晃动着位于下颚附近的绒毛。 

“你可没有聪明到能只用三只眼睛完成这项工作，”克里菲克斯讥讽道。 

埃卡斯克将电压测试仪递给导师，“对不起，我刚才分心了。” 

克里菲克斯狡黠地察觉到了这名新手工程师分心的原因，“不会是因为凯尔的双桅船里的什么吧。”他发出了一连串暗示性的咔嗒声。 

“当然不是，”埃卡斯克谨慎地回答道，“我在想人类和他们的软壳。真恶心。” 

克里菲克斯发出了怀疑的声音，“不管是谁，都别想了。要引起任何生物的注意，即使对方是人类，你也还有很多需要学的。把导管扩孔器给我。” 

埃卡斯克点头表示同意。他还只是个低等堕落者士兵，但他会学习，会蜕变。总有一天，他会变得足够重要，能说出自己想说的话。  

在那之前，他只能满足于默默地奉献，保守艾多的谜之秘密。

3830941962.name: Vantage Point
3830941962.subtitle: The most terrifying monsters are the ones you don't understand.
3830941962.subtitle_zh: 最可怕的怪物是那些你无法理解的。
3830941962.text:
Crow sat with his head in his hands, elbows resting against his knees. "I don't know. Sometimes, I feel like things were easier with the Witness."

Across the go board, Saladin choked on his drink, nearly spitting it over the table. Crow rolled his eyes. "You know that's not what I meant."

"I hope not, or we are about to have a much different conversation," Saladin retorted.

"At the end of the day, the Witness was something we could label. Identify. A being unified in a very specific purpose. And when it was defeated, it was over. Done. We could move on," Crow posited. He placed a stone on the board and Saladin quickly countered, expanding his territory.

"From the reports I've read, these Echoes are different," Saladin offered.

"Exactly. We have no idea how many there actually are—what they want. Or why. They're impossible to anticipate," Crow said.

"Tell me, have you ever faced down an enemy that exhibited no patterns, no purpose, no strategy?" Saladin asked, patiently watching Crow.

"…No. But the idea of punching wildly at shadows doesn't sit well with me either. How do you defeat something like that?" Crow replied. He made his move and grimaced with instant regret.

"Sometimes, victory is less about winning and more about not losing," Saladin said. "A matter of intent—"

"And perspective," Crow finished, his focus suddenly on the stone in his hand.
3830941962.text_zh:
乌鸦双手托头坐着，胳膊肘支在膝盖上，“真搞不懂。有时，我觉得见证者更合我的口味。”

棋盘对面，萨拉丁被饮料呛到，差点喷了一桌。乌鸦翻了个白眼，“你知道我不是那个意思。”

“最好不是，不然我们可就有得聊了，”萨拉丁嘲讽道。

“说到底，见证者是我们可以辨识的东西，为了特定目标而聚合的存在。打败了它，一切就会结束。完事。我们能翻篇了，”乌鸦说道。他在棋盘上放下一颗棋子，萨拉丁迅速反击，开疆拓土。

“从我读到的报告来看，这些回响不一样，”萨拉丁说。

“没错，我们根本不知道到底有多少——它们想要什么，为了什么。没法预测它们的行为，”乌鸦说道。

“告诉我，你有没有面对过做事没有规律、没有目的，也没有策略的敌人？”萨拉丁耐心地看着乌鸦问道。

“…没有。但我不喜欢对着影子乱挥拳。要怎样才能打败那样的东西？”乌鸦答道。他下出一步棋，马上就后悔地皱起了眉头。

“有时候，胜利不在于赢，而在于不输，”萨拉丁说。“重点在于你的意图——”

“和视角，”乌鸦接过话茬，目光突然集中在手里的棋子上。

4224667951.name: Heretic's Fervor
4224667951.subtitle: For some, the Drift never ended.
4224667951.subtitle_zh: 在某些人眼里，漂流从未结束。
4224667951.text:
Eido took a modest sip from the Ether rebreather, then passed it back to Variks.  

Though she was savoring the silent hiatus from her research, something from a previous conversation with Eramis weighed on her mind. 

"Is machine-made Ether really so different?" Eido asked. "It's chemically identical to the naturally occurring product on Riis." 

Variks shrugged his lower arms dourly. "You have been raised in machines. Fed by them. You can no longer separate their spirit from yours." 

"My mother was a Ketch!" Eido quipped. Variks responded to the familiar joke with a pensive chitter. 

"During the Long Drift, Eliksni were thankful for our machines. They were saviors in an age of grief and survival." 

"But in time," Variks continued, "Ketches became prisons. Servitors became jailers. None felt this more than Fikrul." 

"Is that why he spoke against the Servitors?" 

"He spoke against Eliksni dependency," Variks corrected her. "And against the traditions that bound us to a dead world." 

"That is why so many supported him," the Vandal continued. "Even those hatched during the Drift. A song in their blood told them that we had forgotten our natures. That we were diminished by our worship of the machines." 

Variks returned the rebreather with a slight bow.  

"Yes, machine-made Ether is chemically identical to that of Old Riis," he concluded. "But the spirit…" He trailed off into a pensive chitter. 

"I think I understand," Eido murmured.  

She took another sip of Ether, and for the first time, tasted the metallic tang she had never realized was there.
4224667951.text_zh:
艾多轻轻地吸了一口乙太呼吸器，然后把它递回给瓦里克斯。  

虽然在享受研究间隙的宁静，但之前与伊拉莫斯的对话却萦绕在她的心头。 

“机器制造的乙太真的很不一样吗？”艾多问道，“它的化学成分和里斯的天然乙太是一模一样的。” 

瓦里克斯阴郁地耸了耸下臂。“你是机器抚养长大的，你们的精神已无法分离。” 

“双桅船，我的母亲！”艾多打趣道。瓦里克斯对这个熟悉的笑话回以若有所思的咯咯声。 

“大漂流期间，埃里克斯尼族对机器心存感激，它们是那个悲痛和求生时代中的救赎。” 

“但随着时间的推移，”瓦里克斯继续说道，“双桅船变成了监狱，魔眼变成了狱卒，没有人比费克鲁对此感受更深。” 

“这就是他反对魔眼的原因？” 

“他反对的是埃里克斯尼族的依赖性，”瓦里克斯纠正道。“以及将我们束缚在无生气世界上的传统。” 

“那就是为什么有如此多的人支持他，”这名暴徒继续说道。“包括那些在大漂流期间孵化的。一种血脉中的歌声告诉他们，我们已经忘记了自己的本性，因崇拜机器而被削弱。” 

瓦里克斯微微鞠躬，把呼吸器递回去。  

“是的，机器制造的乙太与旧里斯的乙太在化学结构上是相同的，”他总结道。“但精神上…”他发出沉思的咯咯声。 

“我想我明白了，”艾多低声说道。  

她又吸了口乙太，第一次尝出了过去从未觉察到的金属味。

3423493037.name: Red Tape
3423493037.subtitle: Drink deep of the dead.
3423493037.text:
Crow adjusts his mask as he slinks along the City street. A crowd gathers around a man robed in red and gold, whose agents are distributing food. Crow's own stomach growls. A woman is torn from the line. "You have been warned before. No food for scavengers who live outside these walls. We take care of our own first." 

—— 

He returns from the memory to relay his judgment. "Whether you like it or not, these Eliksni are refugees. Regardless of previous allegiance, they are here now. We will feed them." Crow ends the holocall. 

—— 

"Please, just some seeds—" Crow turns from salvaging what he can from a destroyed Ether tank to listen in. "I am here to find the cause of this madness, not sow crops." The Titan stalks among the Eliksni, but no one comes forward with evidence. Brazen, he shouts, "If you will not help yourselves, then I can do nothing." 

—— 

"Tents are not safety. We can do better than ignoring how their presence makes us feel. Your zoning request is denied." Crow ends another holocall. 

——  

"I can't stand all that red tape." The Ace of Spades' report can be heard over the radio. "Sometimes in order to help folks, you have to let some paperwork fall off the table." 

Crow pauses. "You would prefer things lawless?" 

"The Shore is nice to visit! Can't stay long, though." 

—— 

Exhausted, Crow ignores the incoming holocalls. Eido's words echo in his thoughts.
3423493037.text_zh:
乌鸦调整了一下面具，悄悄地沿着圣城街道前行。一群人聚集在一个穿着红金长袍的男人周围，他的手下正分发食物，而乌鸦的肚子咕咕直叫。一名女子被人从队伍中拉出来，“之前已经警告过你了，食物不给墙外的拾荒者，我们得先顾自己人。” 

—— 

他从记忆中回到现实，说道，“不管你喜欢与否，这些埃里克斯尼族是难民。无论他们以前效忠的是哪个势力，他们现在来到了这里。我们会给他们食物。”乌鸦结束了全息通讯。 

—— 

“拜托，只是一点种子——”乌鸦放下自己尽力回收的坏乙太罐，聆听起来。“我来这里是为了找出这场混乱的源头，不是为了种地。”泰坦在埃里克斯尼族中间徘徊，但没有人站出来提供证据。他硬着头皮喊道，“如果你们不自救，那我也无能为力。” 

—— 

“帐篷不安全。我们能做得比忽视他们的存在带来的感受更好。你的分区请求被拒绝了。”乌鸦结束了另一个全息通讯。 

——  

“真是受不了那些繁文缛节。”无线电里传来黑桃A的报告，“有时候为了帮助别人，你得悄悄让一些文件消失。” 

乌鸦停顿了一下，“你更喜欢没有法律约束？” 

“海岸是个不错的去处！但不宜久留。” 

—— 

疲惫不堪的乌鸦不再理会发来的全息通讯。艾多的话在他脑海中回响了起来。

2913577176.name: Scavenger's Fate
2913577176.subtitle: Go where scavengers fear to tread.
2913577176.subtitle_zh: 去拾荒者不敢涉足的地方。
2913577176.text:
Arrha threw the datapad to the ground in fury. It bounced once, then settled against a crate of contraband Psion weaponry. The screen continued to flash implacably: 

CONNECTION LOST… REESTABLISHING CONNECTION… FAILED… CONNECTION LOST… 

There was nothing for it. He would have to break the news to the Spider. 

He found the crime boss at the bar, glad-handing with a bookie in an oversized fur vest. They spoke in low tones before a subtle nod by both parties let Arrha know that a deal had been closed. No doubt a sizeable adjustment to the Crucible betting odds would soon hit the tote boards.   

Arrha gave a series of subtle clicks: 

.::: .:. : .:. :. :.   trouble glimmer loss 

Arrha could sense Spider's countenance sour beneath his helmet. The elder Eliksni dismissed the oblivious Human with a curt wave and headed wordlessly to the back room. 

"Skira's anus, what now!?"  

"Another scav crew lost, the Spider," Arrha replied. "Iiraahk came under heavy fire in the Reef. Went dark minutes later." 

"That's the third this cycle," Spider fumed. "Send a replacement crew. Heavy weapons this time. I want the nav system from Iiraahk's ship back." 

Spider turned to leave, but Arrha felt compelled to stop him. "But the Spider," he blurted, "the crews… they won't go. Not until Fikrul is gone." 

"They WON'T?" Spider growled. "That sounds an awful lot like mutiny."  

"It's fear," Arrha said, hunching his shoulders. "They fear Fikrul more than the Spider." 

"I could remedy that," Spider replied menacingly. "But I can't afford to make any more examples." 

"I didn't want word to get out about that sector," he lamented, "but it hardly matters now. Time I called in a specialist." 

He picked up the fallen datapad and opened a comms channel. "Welcome to my most lucrative customer…"
2913577176.text_zh:
阿尔拉带着愤怒把数据板扔到地上，它弹了一下，然后落在一箱违禁的灵能武器上。屏幕仍在冷漠地闪烁： 

连接丢失…正在重新建立连接…失败…连接丢失… 

没有其它办法了，他必须把消息告诉蛛王。 

他在酒吧找到了正与穿着大号毛皮背心的赌注登记人握手交谈的犯罪首领。他们低声说着话，然后微微点头，让阿尔拉意识到交易已经完成。毫无疑问，熔炉竞技场的投注赔率很快就会有大幅调整。   

阿尔拉发出了微微的咔嗒声： 

.::: .:. : .:. :. :. 麻烦 微光 损失 

阿尔拉能感觉到蛛王在头盔下的表情变得阴沉。这名年长的埃里克斯尼族生硬地挥手打发走了浑然不觉的人类，然后默默走向后室。 

“简直是放斯凯拉的屁，又怎么了？！”  

“我们失去了另一支拾荒队，蛛王，”阿尔拉答道。“伊拉赫在暗礁遭遇猛烈火力，几分钟后失去了联系。” 

“这已经是这个循环里的第三次了，”蛛王怒气冲冲地说。“派一支替补队去，带上重型武器，给我把伊拉赫飞船上的导航系统弄回来。” 

蛛王转身要走，但阿尔拉不得不拦住他。“可是，蛛王，”他脱口而出，“那些船员…他们不肯去，除非费克鲁消失。” 

“他们不肯去？”蛛王咆哮道，“这听起来像是要造反啊。”  

“他们很害怕，”阿尔拉耸了耸肩说道。“比起蛛王，他们更害怕费克鲁。” 

“我能帮他们纠正这个看法，”蛛王恶狠狠地答道。“但杀一儆百只会增加损失。” 

“我本不想让那个区域的消息传出去，”他哀叹道，“但现在已经无所谓了。我该叫一位专业人士过来了。” 

他捡起掉落的数据板，打开了一条通讯频道，“欢迎我最有赚头的客户登场…”

414045521.name: Insurmountable
414045521.subtitle: Mountains must be devoured one bite at a time.
414045521.subtitle_zh: 一口吃不成胖子，一步到不了天边。
414045521.text:
Life on the outskirts of the Tangled Shore was as desolate as ever, yet the few remaining Eliksni there heard the reports and knew: it was time to leave.

"How much farther to the Ketch?" a Dreg gasped, a mountain of the crew's effects lashed to his back and balanced in his arms.

"We'd have been there by now if you hadn't destroyed our last Pike," a Vandal snarled at him.

Suddenly, a soft cry lilted into the air. Loud and desperate. Almost childlike.

The Dreg stopped in his tracks, listening. "Do you hear that?"

He rushed ahead and found a lone hatchling, crawling and wailing a song of abandonment deep within a crater.

"The hatchling is—is—surrounded by Dark Ether!" the Dreg exclaimed.

The Vandal grabbed the Dreg by the back of his neck. "You fool! We have to go!" she yelled.

But it was too late. A cluster of bloodthirsty Revenant Scorn descended on them, leaving nothing but their screams to echo across the landscape.

***

A lone Legionary clad in blue followed a sound, a cry that lilted across the barrenness of the Tangled Shore. The sound became louder and more desperate. Almost childlike.

He discovered a lone hatchling, wailing a song of abandonment deep within a crater. Carefully, the Legionary lowered himself into the fissure. He comforted the hatchling who quickly clung to him amid the Dark Ether that swirled around.

A war cry erupted from above as a cluster of Revenant Scorn descended. The Legionary quickly dispatched one and shoved a grenade in its grotesque mouth before lobbing it back up toward its brethren. As it exploded, bits and pieces of the entire pack rained down around the Legionary and the hatchling, who cowered behind him.

The last remaining Scorn attacked from behind, pinning the Legionary to the ground, sending his weapon flying. The putrid monster lashed out but stopped suddenly, howling in pain. The Legionary turned to see the chubby hatchling latched onto the Scorn's leg, teeth lodged deep in its flesh. Without hesitation, he lunged for his sidearm and placed a bullet neatly in the Scorn's head.

He lovingly scooped up the unharmed hatchling, wiped the ooze and drool from its mouth, and bellowed with laughter.

"You have just eaten the first of many mountains—a true Cabal from this day forward, little one!"
414045521.text_zh:
纷争海岸边缘的生活依然孤苦，但那里少数剩余的埃里克斯尼族听到了报告，知道是时候离开了。

“离双桅船还有多远？”一个堕落者士兵背负着小山一样的船员财物，喘气问道。

“如果不是你毁了我们的最后一辆派克，我们早就到了，”一个暴徒咆哮道。

突然，一声柔软的哭泣飘散在空气中。那声音既响亮又绝望，几乎像孩子一般。

堕落者士兵停下了脚步，侧耳倾听。“你听见了吗？”

他冲到前面，发现一个孤单的幼雏在陨坑深处，边爬边唱着被遗弃的哀歌。

“那幼雏——被黑暗乙太包围了！”堕落者士兵惊呼道。

暴徒抓住堕落者士兵的颈背，“傻瓜！我们得赶紧离开！”她喊道。

但已经太迟了。一群嗜血的亡魂嗤魅扑了过来，只留下他们的尖叫声在大地上回响。

***

一个身披蓝色战甲的军团士兵正循着回荡在纷争海岸荒凉之地的哭喊声前进。那声音越来越响亮，甚至带有些许绝望，几乎像孩子一般。

军团士兵发现了一只孤单的幼雏在陨坑深处发出凄惨的歌声。他小心翼翼地降入裂缝，安慰着在黑暗乙太的环绕中迅速依偎过来的幼雏。

随着上方传来一声战吼，一群亡魂嗤魅从天而降。军团士兵迅速解决了一个，将手雷塞进它丑陋的嘴里，然后把它扔回敌阵。它爆炸时，整个亡魂群的骨肉四散落到军团士兵和幼雏周围，幼雏害怕得躲在他的身后。

最后一个嗤魅从背后偷袭，把军团士兵按倒在地，他的武器也被打飞出去。腐臭的怪物正猛烈进攻，却又突然停下，发出痛苦的嚎叫。军团士兵转身看到胖乎乎的幼雏咬住了嗤魅的腿，牙齿深深嵌入肉中。他毫不犹豫地迅速抓起手枪，精准地将一颗子弹射入嗤魅的头颅。

他温柔地拾起未受伤害的幼雏，擦去它嘴角的粘液和口水，大笑起来。

“你刚刚征服了此生的第一座高山，从今天起，你是真正的卡巴尔了，小家伙！”

3818198556.name: Sovereignty
3818198556.subtitle: Live according to your own lights.
3818198556.text:
The first snap of rifle fire echoes wildly off the pockmarked walls of the crater. The Scorn cast around mindlessly after the source. It's the work of seconds to finish them off, one after the other.

Clean work, overall. 

Jolyon Till sits up in the narrow crevice he's wedged himself into, and scans the barren surface of the asteroid. A figure creeps out from behind a rock formation: four arms raised, cowering. Not Scorn. 

The Fallen sheltering in this corner of the Reef aren't Salvation cast-offs. Dusk, maybe. Their radiation-bleached rags are so faded and tattered it hardly matters. 

Jolyon leaves them supplies and communication codes. If they want lasting help, they'll have to ask for it.
He thinks they will. 

He sends a report to Petra, first. Then a second, abbreviated transmission, elsewhere: More refugees headed your way. 

He's nearly back to his jumpship when the message comes back in—text-only, familiar encryption: Thanks, Jolyon. C. 

Jolyon steps up into the pilot's seat. He goes where he's needed.
3818198556.text_zh:
第一声步枪射击的回音在坑坑洼洼的墙壁上疯狂回响。嗤魅茫然四顾地寻找来源，但几秒钟后，他们就一个接一个地被解决了。

整体上，任务完成得很利落。 

乔里恩·提欧从藏身的狭窄裂缝中坐起，扫视着小行星荒芜的表面。有一个人影从岩石形成物后面缓慢探出头来：四只举起的手臂，蜷缩着，不是嗤魅。 

藏身于暗礁这一角的堕落者不是救赎氏族的弃民。或许是黄昏氏族。被辐射漂白的破衣烂衫褪色严重，那已经不重要了。 

乔里恩给他们留下了补给和通信代码。如果他们想要长久获得帮助，就必须自己提出请求。
他认为他们会的。 

他先向佩特拉发送了一份报告，而后向别处另发了一份简讯：更多的难民往你那儿去了。 

快回到跃迁飞船时，他收到了答复——只有文字，用了熟悉的加密：谢谢，乔里恩。C 

乔里恩走上驾驶位，出发前往需要他的地方。

825495813.name: Noxious Vetiver
825495813.subtitle: Artisans realize the laws of nature so that they may break them.
825495813.subtitle_zh: 工匠深谙自然法则，从而能够将其打破。
825495813.text:
The weaver held his handcrafted basket close to his chest, mandibles clicking in disappointment as he surveyed the disarray of modern flasks and burettes scattered among the more traditional tools of an apothecary.

"Have you gotten lost on your way to market, weaver?" a voice called out.

Namrask turned calmly toward Eido's steely gaze. "You treat your tools with disrespect," he replied.

"I am under a deadline. Perhaps you could critique my workspace another time," she retorted.

"Velask, as I greet you in the Light," Namrask said, ignoring her barb. "I come with gifts. For you or… Slayer Baron." He held his finely woven basket, filled with dyes consisting of colorful extracts and powders, out for Eido to take. "From one artisan to another."

"I didn't ask for these." She eyed him warily.

Namrask made a show of deep ireliis toward the Kell's throne cloaked in darkness behind him. "Eia, I know. But as I told your father, quality dyes good for cloth, good for medicine. Our worlds are not that far apart."

Eido let out a soft snort of derision. "You and I are very far apart from where I'm standing."

Namrask inclined his head toward her. "As you say. But a great Kell told me once: to nurture life is the goal of weaving. Is that not yours also?" He offered the basket again and waited patiently.

"…Eia," she finally replied, and accepted the basket with hesitant gratitude.
825495813.text_zh:
编织者将他手工制作的篮子紧紧抱在胸前，打量着凌乱散落在现代烧瓶和量杯中间的传统药剂师工具，他的下颚失望地咔嗒作响。

“准备去市场但是迷路了吗，编织者？”一个声音问道。

拿姆拉斯克平静地对上艾多坚定的目光，“你不尊重你的工具，”他答道。

“我赶时间，你可以改天再来批评我的工作环境，”她反驳道。

“维拉斯克，我在光能之下问候你，”拿姆拉斯克无视她的讽刺，说道。“我带来了礼物。给你或者…杀手公爵。”他将精心编织的篮子递给艾多，里面装满了由各色提取物和粉末组成的染料，“工匠之间的礼物。”

“我没要你带给我这些。”她警惕地看着他。

拿姆拉斯克向身后笼罩在黑暗中的凯尔王座鞠了一个伊瑞利依思式的躬。“爱雅，我知道。但正如我和你父亲说过的，优质染料对布料好，对药物也好。我们世界的差异没有那么大。”

艾多轻蔑地哼了一声，“在我看来，你我的世界截然不同。”

拿姆拉斯克向她点了点头。“如你所言，但曾有一位伟大的凯尔告诉我：编织是为了抚育生命。这难道不也是你的目标吗？”他再次递上篮子，耐心等待着。

“…爱雅，”她终于回答道，犹豫地带着感激接过了篮子。

2350354266.name: Alethonym
2350354266.subtitle: I know your name.
2350354266.text:
"Oh, I've always liked this one," Petra says. She reads:

"They say Nedhi was the first to try and chart the world. Her descendants would later number among the Gensym Scribes and the Corsairs of the salt glades, but in those early days Nedhi had one reigning obsession, which was to exhort the sixth tenet of the Awoken. To know and love the cosmos, she must find and name everything within her universe.

"Nedhi held a Sanguine faith in our own crystalline and enduring perfection, and in the nobility of the observer. To record the existence of the Other must, like a mirror, reflect the Self. And so, in naming all that comprised the world she would describe how best to be Awoken.

"She gave names to flora and fauna, to tectonic forces and tidal currents. To new, immortal terrors, and to the hidden purposes of unseen actions. In the end she cultivated great fame unto herself, and visitors began to make pilgrimages. Any indescribable emotion, Nedhi could make plain for you. Your problems, your fears, your maladies—in speaking them aloud, Nedhi made them bearable. Constrained by ontology."

Eido chitters eagerly. "But this is all metaphor," she guesses.

Petra shrugs, smiling. "Hard to tell, isn't it? How can we be sure, unless someone was there to write the truth?"
2350354266.text_zh:
“哦，我一直很喜欢这个故事，”佩特拉说。她读道：

“据说内迪是第一个尝试绘制世界地图的人。她的后代后来成为了圣希姆文士和盐土海盗军，但在早期，内迪只有一个执念，那就是弘扬觉醒者的第六教条。为了认识和热爱这个宇宙，她必须找到并命名其中的一切。

“内迪坚信自身纯洁而永恒的完美，以及观察者的高贵。记录他者的存在，必须如镜子般反映自我。因此，在命名世界所有组成部分的过程中，她描述了最理想的觉醒者之道。

“她给动植物、构造力量和潮汐流命名，给新的永恒恐惧命名，给无形行动的隐秘目的命名。最终，她声名远扬，许多人前来朝圣。任何难以形容的情感，内迪都能为你解释清楚。你的疑问、恐惧、疾病——内迪会大声说出来，于是它们就受本体论束缚，变得可以承受了。”

艾多兴奋地咯咯笑着。“但这都是隐喻吧，”她猜测道。

佩特拉耸耸肩，露出微笑。“很难确定吧？除非有人在场记录真相，否则又怎能确定呢？”

1047932517.name: Slayer's Fang
1047932517.subtitle: Fear neither dreams nor teeth.
1047932517.text:
The Scorn pressed in around the pit, jostling for a view of the combatants. Oblivious, they gouged each other with unsheathed knives and stray bits of jagged armor. Torn flesh was barely acknowledged amidst the rising frenzy. 

In the pit, two Revenants circled each other. One dragged a dented mace along the ground, gouging furrows into the dirt. The other brandished a rusted glaive of Awoken origin. 

The Revenants swung their weapons in wild arcs, making no attempt to block the other's attacks. Their recent transformation had left them disoriented and uncoordinated. They knew only that they needed to destroy the once-familiar shape before them. 

After just a few seconds of haphazard swinging, the mace connected, caving in the left side of the Revenant's face with a wet crunch. The faceless combatant staggered around the ring, jabbing blindly, until their opponent brought the mace down on the back of their leg, sending them to the ground in a heap. 

The spectators roared and descended upon the fallen Revenant, stabbing them wildly and ripping off bits of flesh. Soon only chunks and a greasy mist of Dark Ether remained. 

As the frenzy abated, a sound filtered through the arena, drifting in from elsewhere in the fortress. It was light, fluid, and haunting. The Scorn slowed, and then stopped. Some swayed slightly as they tried to identify the noise. It was familiar, yet wholly novel. 

As the sound grew louder, several of the newer Revenants began to moan. Others chittered. It was a deep, visceral response to something nearly-remembered. An intimation of what they had once been. 

Soon, the whole arena was rapt. The combat forgotten. And as the crowd swayed in harmony, the mace-wielding victor died, unnoticed, in the dirt.
1047932517.text_zh:
嗤魅在搏斗场周围挤成一圈，争相观战。出鞘的利刃和尖锐的护甲互相刮蹭，他们却浑然不觉，模糊的血肉在迅速高涨的狂热中几乎无法察知。 

搏斗场中，两名亡魂对峙着，一个拖着坑洼不平的狼牙棒，在地上刮出一道道深沟，另一个挥舞着一把生锈的觉醒者偃月。 

亡魂们挥舞武器进行杂乱无章的攻击，完全放弃防御。他们刚刚经历转化，还处于困惑和迷茫之中，只知道需要摧毁眼前那熟悉的身形。 

仅仅乱挥了几秒后，伴随一声湿润的咔嚓，狼牙棒击中目标，打碎了一名亡魂的半边脸。失去半张脸的亡魂踉跄着在擂台内乱捅，直到对手的狼牙棒砸在他大腿后侧，将这名战士击倒在地。 

观众们怒吼着冲向倒下的亡魂，疯狂地刺着，撕扯下肉块。不一会儿，就只剩下几块碎肉和一团油腻的黑暗乙太雾气。 

随着狂乱减弱，从要塞某处飘来了一种声音，在竞技场内蔓延开来。这声音轻柔、流畅，却又令人心悸。嗤魅缓缓停下动作，有些还微微摇晃起身体，试图识别这熟悉又新奇的声音。 

随着声音越来越响亮，几个新生的亡魂开始呻吟，其他的则叽叽喳喳。这是一种深刻而本能的反应，源于对他们曾经身份的模糊记忆。 

不久，整个竞技场都被那声音所吸引，战斗被遗忘了。当亡魂群开始协调地摇摆时，没人注意到手持狼牙棒的胜者在烂泥里悄然死去。

1111334348.name: Ice Breaker
1111334348.subtitle: Please replace these components if use causes fatal damage: HEAT SINK. MAGAZINE. OPERATOR.
1111334348.subtitle_zh: 如果使用造成致命伤害，请更换以下组件：散热器、弹匣、操作员。
1111334348.text:
The foundry is silent now. Shell casings litter the floor. They clatter away from the bootfalls of the Warlock Shayura as she weaves between the downed chassis of combat frames branded with the sigil of the Häkke foundry.

"Security is disabled," Shayura says over an encrypted channel. She's quick to cross the foundry floor, checking the disabled frames one by one as she progresses to a sealed vault door. The door's surface is marked with a glyph unfamiliar to her. It looks like a fish hook, or perhaps an anchor. "Is this what we're looking for?"

[[Confirmed. That's the same symbol on the weapon the Vanguard recovered from Seraph Station. Golden Age, possibly older.]]

Shayura extends one arm, wreathed in Solar fire, and manifests a searing white Dawnblade that she uses to cut through the door in a single stroke. Half of the vault door crashes to the floor and falls to the side, sizzling on a glowing hot edge. Shayura then floats into the air, drifting through the partial opening.

[[We need any records you can find. Anything where BrayTech and Häkke overlap.]]

Shayura dispatches her Ghost to scan rows of server racks containing decompiled engrams. Nearby weaponry is mounted on vault walls. Prototype firearms, alien weapons, unrecognizable technology from across Sol. A sniper rifle of Human design catches her eye; a red and gray body with some kind of thermal plating on the barrel. Her fingertips brush over the serial number stenciled on it: X-032782. It's an Ice Breaker. She remembers when the Vanguard commissioned this design from Häkke, remembers when it was outlawed for being "dangerous and unfit for duty." The design was later stolen and replicated.

Hefting the Ice Breaker from the wall, Shayura turns to watch her Ghost scan and download Häkke's archives. "Find what you're looking for?"

[[Skimming. I see some interesting details. Häkke's Golden-Age predecessor had a terrestrial office in what was once the city of Chicago. They were involved in the development of gravity-based weapons. No BrayTech connections yet.]]

Shayura freezes. "Chicago?" The tombs below Old Chicago haunt her periphery. Every ambient noise in the derelict foundry becomes a threat. She pushes past the fear, past the panic. That isn't now. "What does Chicago have to do with anything?"

[[I'm not sure…]] her handler on the other end of the comms says. [[But whatever it is goes back a long, long time.]]
1111334348.text_zh:
铸造厂此刻一片死寂。弹壳散落满地。术士沙玉拉穿梭于倒下的烙有哈克铸造厂印记的战斗框架之间，弹壳在她的靴底下咔咔作响。

“安保系统已关闭。”沙玉拉通过加密频道说道。她迅速穿过铸造厂，逐一检查那些失效的战斗框架，直至来到一扇密封的保险库门前。门上有一个她不熟悉的标记，形似鱼钩，又或许是锚。“这就是我们要找的东西吗？”

[[确定。先锋在炽天使空间站找到的武器上也有这个符号。来自黄金时代，甚至可能更早。]]

沙玉拉伸出一只环绕着烈日之火的手臂，化作一柄炽热的白昼之刃，一刀斩开了门。半扇保险库门轰然倒地，跌落到一旁，边缘还冒着热气。随后，沙玉拉飘浮起来，穿过了半开的门缝。

[[我们需要一切你能找到的记录。任何布瑞科技和哈克有关联的部分。]]

沙玉拉派出她的机灵去扫描一排排装有反编译记忆水晶的服务器机架。附近有武器挂在保险库墙上。原型枪械、外星武器、来自太阳系各地无法识别的技术。一把人类设计的狙击步枪吸引了她的目光，枪身红灰相间，枪管上有某种热镀层。她的指尖拂过上面的序列号：X-032782。这是把破冰者。她还记得先锋委托哈克设计这款枪时的情景，还记得它因“危险、不适合执行任务”而被禁。后来这个设计遭窃并被复制了。

沙玉拉从墙上取下破冰者，转身看着她的机灵扫描和下载哈克的档案。“找到你要的东西了吗？”

[[正在浏览。我看到了一些有趣的细节。哈克的黄金时代前身曾在芝加哥市设有地球办公室。他们参与了重力武器的研发。但目前尚未发现与布瑞科技的关联。]]

沙玉拉愣住了。“芝加哥？”旧芝加哥底下的墓穴在她的脑海中萦绕不去。这废弃铸造厂里的的每一丝声响都让她感到威胁。她推开恐惧，克服惊慌。现在不是时候。“芝加哥和这件事有什么关系？”

[[我也不清楚……]]通讯另一端的指导官说道。[[但不管是什么，都已经是很久很久以前的事了。]]

3592158071.name: Spacewalk Grasps
3592158071.subtitle: Archival|Castor|231| —don't understand. We're all excited for successful code injection, but it's much too early for insertion into a chassis—
3592158071.subtitle_zh: 档案|卡斯托|231| ——不明白。代码注入成功我们都很兴奋，但现在就插入底架还为时过早——
3592158071.text:
Seventeen days since arrival. 

Karrho is busy all the time talking to the Vandals and Marauders too big to even look at Yaraskis. They're working together to build an Ether refinery, using old human blueprints from the station. He rarely has time for Yaraskis. 

Yaraskis would make a terrible engineer. In her cocoon she dreamed of being a Captain, not a priest. She fetches and carries and mops up the old stains nobody else wants to touch, making the station livable again. 

Day by day, their home fills up with comforting noise: the pleasant creak of cable ties stringing platforms together, the thump-click, thump-click of footwraps and claws on decking, of the arguments between the only two crewmembers who understand Servitor code. 

It's nothing like a good solid warren—but it's safe, and that's good enough. And once they have Ether flowing in, it'll be even better. 

Yaraskis tries to ignore the station-voice as she tosses a rag into the machine that is almost an incinerator. 

From behind, a hand yanks at her hood. She yells. Its owner dodges her return swipe. 

Karrho. "I need to talk to you. Something is wrong. I can't find Paskir." 

Paskir is another engineer, big for a Vandal. Big enough that his former Captain was eyeing him as a challenger, which is why he agreed to steal a Ketch with them in the first place. 

"Maybe he got lost. Or stuck in some goo." Whatever the Humans did on this station, it involved a lot of… liquids. Yaraskis disinfects her hands at least five times a day. 

"He was going to help me with the nuclear power supply and never showed up. And I heard something in the halls." At her look, Karrho adds, "Something big!" 

"Anything big would have starved long before we got here. Just wait, I bet he got stuck in one of the zero-gravity areas and he'll call for help soon." 

"You'll help me look?" 

She hooks an arm around Karrho and pulls him away from the almost-incinerator. 

"If he doesn't turn up with an embarrassing story in the morning, we'll all look for him." 

Karrho loves engineering. He should be a Servitor's priest or a Splicer. Yaraskis wants to be his Captain, assign him to the priesthood. She wants to get so tall that her head brushes the ceiling, and her arms are long enough to wrap around the whole crew. 

It's better to be here than with the Houses. 

It has to be better.
3592158071.text_zh:
抵达后十七天。 

卡霍一直在忙着和那些暴徒和狂暴劫匪交谈，他们体型大到甚至不屑于看雅拉斯基丝一眼。他们要利用来自空间站里旧人类的蓝图，合作建造一座乙太精炼厂。他很少有时间陪雅拉斯基丝。 

雅拉斯基丝成不了一名优秀的工程师。她在茧里就梦想着成为一名船长，而不是祭司。她负责跑腿、搬运、清理那些无人愿意触碰的陈年污渍，让空间站重新变得宜居。 

一天天过去，他们的家园充满了各种令人心安的声响：缆绳将各个平台绑在一起时发出的悦耳嘎吱声，裹足和爪子踩在甲板上发出的咚咚声，以及仅有的两名懂得魔眼代码的船员之间的争论声。 

这里一点也不像个坚固的杂院——但它很安全，这就足够了。而且一旦他们有了乙太，这里就会变得更好。 

雅拉斯基丝一边把抹布扔进那台差不多算是焚烧炉的机器，一边试图忽略站内系统音。 

突然，有只手从后面扯住了她的兜帽。她大叫一声。那只手的主人躲过了她的回击。 

是卡霍。“我需要和你谈谈。出事了。我找不到帕斯基尔。” 

帕斯基尔是另一位工程师，就暴徒来说体型挺大。大到足以让他的前任船长把他视为挑战者，这也是他当初同意跟他们合谋偷一艘双桅船的原因。 

“也许他迷路了。或者被什么粘液困住了。”不管人类之前在这个空间站上做什么，都跟很多的…液体有关。雅拉斯基丝每天至少要给她的手消毒五次。 

“他本来要帮我解决核电供应问题，但一直没出现。我还听到走廊里有动静。”看着她的表情，卡霍补充道，“是个大家伙！” 

“就算有大家伙，肯定也在我们来到这里之前就饿死了。等着瞧吧，我打赌他一定是困在某个零重力区里，他很快就会求救的。” 

“你会帮我一起找吗？” 

她挽起卡霍的胳膊，把他从那台近似焚烧炉的机器旁拉开。 

“如果他明天早上还没有带着尴尬的故事出现，我们就一起去找他。” 

卡霍热爱工程学。他应该成为一名魔眼祭司或熔岩军团。雅拉斯基丝想当他的船长，让他担任祭司的职务。她想变得高高的，头能碰到天花板，手臂长到能环绕整个船队。 

待在这里总比留在那些氏族里要好。 

必须得更好才行。

2436714433.name: Spacewalk Vest
2436714433.subtitle: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
2436714433.subtitle_zh: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——
2436714433.text:
Twenty-three days since arrival. 

The Ether generator is taking shape, a big ringed shell set a safe distance from the hull, cradled in wiring. Their crew's three spinners are busy all the time making more cabling. 

Except somehow it's too quiet. The older crew are a little snooty about Drekhs, and that's fine—but Yaraskis can't even find one of them to be snooty at her. 

Paskir is still missing. She and Karrho hunted for him up and down the station for hours. 

Nobody suggests going back down to the surface. They'd be killed outright. Their big plan—a hidden warren where nobody will ever bother them again—has to work. 

Yaraskis sticks to the smaller, dimly lit corridors now, where only the Drekhs fit. She doesn't like the big, open ones with their flat, bright lights, reverberating acoustics, and the feeling that something is always watching her. 

Karrho stays at his work. Yaraskis, ignoring her own, explores the station instead, hunting for their missing crewmates. She makes a tally as she goes, checking every corner of the station, and keeping an ear out for the barely audible whine of a charged scattercape. 

A full third of the crew are… gone. 

She hears a muted shriek, something under the flickering buzz of a dying light. Then the scrape of metal on metal. She hunches her shoulders deeper into her cloak against the feeling of being followed. 

The scraping sound stalks her even through her shortcuts. She turns to look back. Still nothing. 

She can't find Paskir. She can't find anyone. There's nothing to do but give up.  

Yaraskis heads back to Karrho's workshop. 

It's empty. Silent as a dead warren.  

Karrho is gone.
2436714433.text_zh:
抵达后二十三天。 

乙太发生器已初具雏形，一个巨大的环形外壳，与船体保持着安全距离，用电线裹着。船员们的三台纺纱机在忙着制造更多的电缆。 

只是不知道为什么，这里太安静了。老船员们对堕落者士兵有点嗤之以鼻，这没什么，但雅拉斯基丝却连一个对她嗤之以鼻的人都找不到。 

帕斯基尔还是下落不明。她和卡霍在空间站里上上下下找了他好几个小时。 

没有人提议返回地表。他们会被立即处死。他们的大计划——这个没人会再打扰他们的隐蔽杂院——必须成功。 

雅拉斯基丝现在喜欢呆在光线昏暗的小走廊里，那些只有堕落者士兵才能容身的地方。她不喜欢那些宽敞开阔的走廊，那里有平直明亮的灯光、回荡不绝的传声混响，以及被什么东西盯着的感觉。 

卡霍继续他的工作。雅拉斯基丝则忽略了自己的差事，转而探索空间站，寻找失踪的船员。她边走边做记录，检查空间站的各个角落，留心听着充能散射披肩那几乎听不见的鸣响。 

整整三分之一的船员…消失了。 

她听到一声低沉的尖叫，它在一盏即将熄灭的灯光闪烁的嗡鸣声中似有若无。紧接着是金属与金属的摩擦声。她紧紧地裹紧披风，耸起肩膀，抵御那种被跟踪的不安感。 

即使她抄近路走，那刮擦声还是紧随其后。她回头看了看，还是什么都没有。 

她找不到帕斯基尔。她找不到任何人。她别无选择，只能放弃。  

雅拉斯基丝回到了卡霍的工作间。 

里面空无一人。跟杂院一样死寂。  

卡霍消失了。

3219219484.name: Spacewalk Cloak
3219219484.subtitle: Tech|Notice|42| All—use of the sample decommission tool is restricted to accredited researchers. If you need to contain something, call security.
3219219484.subtitle_zh: 技术|通知|42| 全体——所有样本处理工具仅限经认可的研究人员使用。如果你需要隔离处理某物，请联系安保人员。
3219219484.text:
Time is suspended.  

All that remains is the appointed task. 

The spinners craft towropes, powerlines, and all-purpose cable, hour after hour without rest. 

The White Captain moves among them with her many limbs. She feels what they feel, knows what they know, as soon as they know it. She uses this information to align, and together, they build something new in this home they've found. 

Every Drekh yearns for more arms than their Captain allows. Every four-eyed Eliksni looks with envy upon the eight-eyed. Every Kell and Archon raises their horns as high as they dare. 

Now, together they are as no Eliksni before them. A miracle. A being of hundreds of limbs, lungs, eyes. 

The White Captain gently touches the limb previously named Yaraskis. Her appointed portion of the great diagram flowers to life in her head. 

Legs stumbling under her, she moves towards the station's prow. One limb may be unsteady, but their great shared body is strong. 

Faint noises make no sense. Words she doesn't understand. The un-Eliksni babbling of a foreign mind. 

The only mind that matters is the White Captain's. 

Hands connect circuits and power lines. The diagram is beautiful but difficult to grasp. She searches for the right shape, the right configuration that will let power flow through its appointed channels. 

The work goes on.  

Until the hands tie off the last cable.  

The eyes look up. The knees buckle in joy. The heart surges along the bright paths of the diagram. 

Somewhere in the joined crowd, a single hand throws a single lever. 

The mind rejoices. 

Orange light flares to life in the cold dark. 

It flares in hundreds of souls. Yaraskis is there. 

Somewhere.
3219219484.text_zh:
时间停滞不前。  

现在只剩下那些指定好的任务。 

纺纱机不停地编织着拖曳缆、电源线和多用途电缆，几个小时不停地工作，从不休息。 

白色船长用她那众多的肢体，在它们之间穿梭。她能够即时感知到他们的感受，知晓他们所了解的一切。她利用这些信息进行协调，一起在这个他们找到的家园里建造新的事物。 

每个堕落者士兵都渴望拥有超过其船长允许数量的手臂。每个四眼埃里克斯尼族都羡慕地望着那些八眼的同类。每一位凯尔和执政官都尽可能地高举起他们的犄角。 

如今，他们合为一体，成为了前所未有的埃里克斯尼族。这是一个奇迹。一个拥有成百上千的肢体、肺和眼睛的存在。 

白色船长轻抚着之前被称为雅拉斯基丝的肢体。她脑海中，巨大图示中分配给她的那部分瞬间鲜活了起来。 

她带着身下颤抖的腿，向空间站的船头走去。其中一个肢体可能不稳，但他们共享的庞大身躯却十分强壮。 

无意义的微弱杂音。她听不懂的词语。外来思维的非埃里克斯尼族语唠叨。 

唯一重要的是白色船长的思维。 

手连接着电路和电源线。图示虽美，却难以捉摸。她寻找着合适的形状、正确的配置，让电力在指定的通道中流动。 

工作还在继续。  

直到手将最后一根电缆系紧。  

眼睛向上看去。膝盖因喜悦而发软。心脏沿着图示中明亮的路径而激涌。 

在聚群中的某个地方，一只手拉动了一根杠杆。 

思维欢欣鼓舞。 

在寒冷的黑暗中，橙色的光芒突然亮起。 

它在数百个灵魂中闪烁着。雅拉斯基丝就在那里。 

那里的某个地方。

283230886.name: Spacewalk Cowl
283230886.subtitle: Tech|Direct|124| —ate through another container. What cleaning agents are safe to use? We can't afford another fume incident, István.
283230886.subtitle_zh: 技术|指示|124| ——蚀穿了另一个容器。哪些清洁剂可以安全使用？我们承受不起另一次烟气事故了，伊什特万。
283230886.text:
Six days since arrival. 

Metal groans. Power lines hum. Things skitter in the pipes. 

Yaraskis picks her way through rubble with a double armload of scrap. She's finally growing out of Drekh scale, lower arms regrown all the way down to her talons, but she's still slight enough to duck through the smallest shafts of their new home. 

An orbital station, ancient and damaged, but fixable, everyone thinks. The station hasn't been inhabited for a very long time, but Yaraskis catches herself looking over her shoulder repeatedly. 

Her spine prickles as an eerie mechanical voice speaks above her head; some old message for Humans, Karrho said. Nothing to worry about. But… unsettling all the same. 

It's a relief to get to the workshop. She kicks at the doorframe. "Scrap delivery." 

Karrho is smaller than Yaraskis, still true Drekh. Even so, people pay attention to him because he hatched with eight eyes. That means he's handsome, one-in-a-million lucky. And he's sharp. He was in on the plan from the beginning. Yaraskis only got tapped because she's his egg-cousin. 

Karrho gestures without looking up from his screens. "Put it anywhere." 

The workshop is one of the creepier rooms on the station, in Yaraskis's opinion. It's filled with metal tables bolted to the floor. They had had to clear out a whole pile of empty Vex bodies before the room was usable. Yaraskis tries not to touch anything as she sets down her bundle. 

"What are you working on?" 

"Analyzing some old mechanical blueprints. If we can splice into the systems, there's as much to use up here as down on the surface. And there aren't any Vex up here. No Hive. No Lightbearers." 

"No Kells," Yaraskis says firmly. 

"No Kells." Karrho adds, "Plenty of Ether if these blueprints hold true, though. There's this machine. It's in two parts—one collects energy, one uses it. We just need the collector for the Servitors, and we're set for life." 

He tilts one of the screens her way. 

Ether for life, up here in the cold dark. It makes everything worth it, the overwhelming feeling of fear as they escaped from Europa, the careful navigation around the hazards on the station as they work to make it livable. 

And yes, Yaraskis might get shooed out of engineering meetings she doesn't understand, but nobody will cut off her arms for insubordination. 

She flexes her lower hands and leans in to study their future.
283230886.text_zh:
抵达后六天。 

金属嘎吱作响。电线发出嗡鸣。管道里传来窸窸窣窣的声音。 

雅拉斯基丝揽着双臂的废料在瓦砾中艰难前行。她终于摆脱了堕落者士兵的体型，下臂已重新长出，一直延伸到利爪处，但她仍然很瘦小，小到可以穿过他们新家中最小的通风井。 

他们的新家是一座古老而破损的轨道空间站，不过还是可以修复的，大家都这么觉得。这座空间站已很久没人居住了，但雅拉斯基丝却总是不由自主地频频回头张望。 

一个阴森诡异的机械声音在她头顶上方响起，引得她的脊背一阵刺痛；卡霍说那是给人类听的一些旧广播。没什么好担心的。但…还是让人感到不安。 

到了工作间，她才松了一口气。她踢了踢门框喊道。“废料快送。” 

卡霍比雅拉斯基丝体型瘦小，仍然是纯正的堕落者士兵。即便如此，人们还是会在意他，因为他出生时长着八只眼睛。这意味着他英俊潇洒，是万里挑一的幸运儿。他还很聪明。从一开始他就参与了这个计划。雅拉斯基丝之所以被选中，仅仅是因为她是他的表亲。 

卡霍的视线没有离开屏幕，只是摆了摆手。“随便找个地方放。” 

在雅拉斯基丝看来，工作间是空间站里最让人毛骨悚然的房间之一。里面摆满了用螺栓固定在地板上的金属桌子。他们不得不清理掉一大堆Vex空壳，然后才用上了这个房间。雅拉斯基丝放下包裹时尽量不去碰任何东西。 

“你在忙什么呢？” 

“分析一些旧的机械蓝图。如果我们能入侵系统，这里能用的资源就会跟地表上一样多。而且这上面没有Vex，没有邪魔族，没有负光者。” 

“没有凯尔，”雅拉斯基丝坚定地说。 

“没有凯尔。”卡霍补充道，“不过，如果这些蓝图是真的，那这里就有很多乙太。有这样一台机器。它分为两部分，一部分收集能量，一部分使用能量。我们只需拿到魔眼用的收集器，以后就不用愁了。” 

他把其中一块屏幕转向她。 

在这寒冷黑暗的地方，有一辈子用不完的乙太。它让一切都变得值得，包括他们逃离木卫二时令人窒息的恐惧感，还有他们为了让空间站变得宜居而小心绕过各种危险的艰难过程。 

当然，雅拉斯基丝可能会被赶出她听不懂的工程会议，但没有人会因为她违抗命令而砍掉她的手臂。 

她活动着下肢的手，俯身研究他们的未来。

1105725465.name: Spacewalk Strides
1105725465.subtitle: Research|Direct|132| Pull that log. If someone sends it up the chain we're all dead.
1105725465.subtitle_zh: 研究|指示|132| 把那段日志删掉。要是有人上报，我们就全完了。
1105725465.text:
Thirty-nine days since arrival. 

Ketches and warrens are creaky things. Cables groan, steps squeak, hammocks rustle. Ether-bright eyes should glow and blink in the comfortable dark. 

Yaraskis had expected they would fill up the station, all of them, with repaired machinery and stolen comforts and familiar sounds. 

All the station's sounds are lonely now. Even the station-voice would be a comfort, almost. 

She hasn't seen Karrho in days. The remaining engineers only talk to each other, and the Servitors groan and bob in the air together in one nervous bundle. 

And something is stalking the hallways. 

It has eyes like an Eliksni, but they don't flicker like they should. They burn steadily, lit not by Ether but by something else. Even the Marauders tell her about it in whispers, so scared they ignore hierarchy. 

Yaraskis feels its presence in her spiracles. She decides to head for Karrho's workshop. She can hide there. 

Then a Marauder swings into view. His eyes are strange and he doesn't look at Yaraskis. He just says, "Come here." 

She runs. Through the halls, leaping over platforms strung together, scoring her side badly on an unexpected twist of metal. 

The missing crew loom out of corners, calling out as she runs past. She doesn't stop. 

Till a voice calls her by name. 

It's Karrho. He's braced himself in a corner of the ceiling near a broken vent grate that Yaraskis knows leads to the station hull. It's too small for anyone bigger than a Drekh. 

She leaps. Hands claw at her ankles as Yaraskis kicks her way up the wall. 

"This way," Karrho urges. They scurry through twisting passages, through the vents and under floors that long-ago Humans never meant for anyone to walk in. They run over wreckage, in and out of the gravity generators' pull, towards the Ketch. Maybe they'll be safe there. Maybe they can cast off and run. 

"What's wrong with them?" Yaraskis asks, panting. Her heart kicks hard in her chest. 

"Nothing." 

Karrho stops on a dime at the vent's exit. Yaraskis's momentum takes her clear past him, into a wide room. 

She looks far up into the bright steady glare of mechanical eyes. Filled with an alien light. 

And Karrho pushes her forward into the waiting arms of the White Captain.
1105725465.text_zh:
抵达后三十九天。 

双桅船和杂院都已破旧不堪。电缆发出嘎吱声，台阶吱吱作响，吊床沙沙有声。乙太充足的明眸应闪烁着光芒，在舒适的黑暗中眨动。 

雅拉斯基丝原本以为他们大家会用修好的机器、偷来的舒适用品和熟悉的声响，把整个空间站填满。 

可现在，整个空间站的声音都显得孤独。即使是站内系统音，也几乎成了一种慰藉。 

她已经好几天没见到卡霍了。剩下的工程师们只会互相交谈，魔眼们则一齐呻吟着，紧张地聚在空中晃来晃去。 

走廊里有什么东西在潜行。 

它有类似埃里克斯尼族的眼，却不像正常的那样闪烁。它们持续燃烧，点燃它们的不是乙太，而是别的什么。就连狂暴劫匪们也小声地跟她提及此事，他们害怕得顾不上等级制度了。 

雅拉斯基丝在她的气孔中感觉到了它的存在。她决定前往卡霍的工作间。她可以躲在那里。 

这时，有一个狂暴劫匪出现在眼前。他的眼神很奇怪，没有去看雅拉斯基丝。他只是说道，“过来。” 

她转身就跑。穿过走廊，跃过一个个串连起来的平台，被一个突然出现的金属拐角严重划伤了侧身。 

失踪的船员从各个角落里冒了出来，在她跑过时大声呼喊。她没有停下。 

直到一个声音叫出了她的名字。 

是卡霍。他靠着天花板的一个角落，旁边有个破损的通风格栅，雅拉斯基丝知道这个通风口通往空间站船体。任何比堕落者士兵块头大的人都进不去。 

她纵身一跃。卡霍用手抓着她的脚踝，雅拉斯基丝奋力踢着墙壁向上攀爬。 

“这边走，”卡霍催促道。他们匆匆穿过曲折的通道，穿过通风口和地板下，昔日的人类住民从未打算让任何人进入的地方。他们越过残骸，在重力发生器的引力场里进出，朝着双桅船跑去。或许在那里他们能够安全一些。也许他们可以搭船逃离。 

“他们有什么毛病？”雅拉斯基丝气喘吁吁地问道。她的心怦怦直跳。 

“没毛病。” 

卡霍突然停在通风口的出口。雅拉斯基丝因惯性径直冲过他，进入了一个宽敞的房间。 

她抬头看向高处那些明亮而坚定的机械眼睛。里头充满了异样的光芒。 

卡霍把她推进了前方白色船长等候着的怀抱中。

3464581845.name: Shadestalker Grips
3464581845.subtitle: Turn the shadows against themselves.
3464581845.text:
His knee had grown stiff under his desk. 

Zavala initially ignored it. Let the pain burn in the side of his knee, seize the top of his calves. His leg had grown stiff countless times before. But this time, this early in the morning, this soon after sitting down, was something else. 

He moved his chair back and considered his knee. What had he done to hurt it? He had not exercised yet, he had not gone on his usual patrol… he had done nothing. Why would a knee hurt from doing nothing? 

The riddle dissolved. He was starting to age. 

Zavala had anticipated this; part of mourning Targe was preparing himself to furiously resist the inevitable physical breakdown. He'd calculated how to negotiate with his own body, subdue it to stoicism, and make it follow his sturdy command. But what he had not anticipated was how he would feel. He ought to feel dread, terror at evidence of his mortality. But instead…  

He allows a hand to rest on his aching knee. To venerate it. He feels it solid under his palm. It is his, it is real, it is both portentous and precious. He is aging. He will age. An absurd and joyous thought warms in his chest: how fortunate, to have lived long enough to grow old. How invaluable, to make the space between himself and the horizon matter. How much time is left? And is it best spent with his knees under a desk? 

"Zavala?" 

Ikora stands in the doorway. Hundreds of years of knowing each other too well draws her to his seat. 

His expression softens, and he stretches out his knee. 

Ikora watches his readjustment, and smiles sadly, the same way she smiles when all their mortal friends grow old. 

The commander sighs, but with content assurance, not heavy resignation. He looks at his friend. "I think I'd like to go on leave for a week." 

Ikora nods, then half-smiles. "How about two?"
3464581845.text_zh:
桌下，他的膝盖僵住了。 

萨瓦拉最初选择了忽视，任由疼痛从膝盖侧面一路爬到小腿上半截。他的腿以前也这样僵过很多次，但像这样，一大清早，刚坐下不久就这样，非比寻常。 

他把椅子往后移，打量着膝盖。是做什么伤到了它吗？他还没锻炼，也没有进行日常巡逻…什么都还没做，为什么膝盖会疼？ 

答案很简单：他开始变老了。 

萨瓦拉对此早有预期。哀悼塔格的同时，他也在做准备要去奋勇对抗身体必然的衰颓。他计算过如何与自己的身体谈判，用坚忍去征服，去让它服从他坚决的命令。但他没有料到自己的感受，他本该觉得恐惧，对自己不再永生的证据感到恐慌，但正相反…  

他怀着崇敬的心，把一只手放在疼痛的膝盖上。它在他手掌下坚实又可靠，这是他的身体，真实存在，既珍贵又包含着不祥的预兆。他正在衰老，必会衰老。一个荒谬而愉悦的念头让他的胸口温热起来：能活到开始衰老是多么幸运，让自己和地平线之间的空间变得有意义，又是多么的宝贵。他还剩多少时间？真的应该用来在桌前感受膝盖的疼痛吗？ 

“萨瓦拉？” 

艾可拉站在门口，几百年来对彼此的了解引导她来到了他的座位旁。 

他的表情缓和下来，开始舒展膝盖。 

艾可拉观察着他的动作，露出带点苦涩的微笑，凡人朋友们开始衰老时她总是这样的表情。 

指挥官叹了口气，但这反应中透着安心和自信，而不是无奈地听天由命。他看向好友，“我想我会请一周的假。” 

艾可拉点点头，然后似笑非笑地说，“要不两周？”

1479557835.name: Shadestalker Vest
1479557835.subtitle: Unseen deliverance.
1479557835.text:
TYPE: REDJACK SURVEILLANCE FEED [21058] 

PARTIES: Five [5]. One [1], Guardian-type, Class Hunter [u.1]; One [1], Frame-type, Unit Combat [u.2]; Three [3], Scorn-[ERROR] Type.  

ASSOCIATIONS: Lev [Unit5003];  Scorn; Crucible; Frame; Lord Shaxx; Redjacks 

//AUDIO UNAVAILABLE// 

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS…/ 

[u.1:01] Relax, I have you. 

[u.1:02] "Relax" means stop. You're in pieces, and you're making it worse. 

[u.2:01] Hostiles still pushing from the front. Scans incomplete. 

[u.1:03] Your fireteam is gone. Scans are irrelevant if I can't get you back to the Tower to link up. 

[u.2:02] Incoming. 

[A hissing snap washes the feed with high-yield paracausal discharge, followed by the loud crack of three hard rounds.] 

[u.1:04] Stop moving. You're making this worse. 

[u.2:03] Thank you, Guardian. Spectral analysis complete. 

[u.2:04] Hunter Vanguard suppositions were correct. 

[u.1:05] Crow is usually on point. What about? 

[u.2:05] Despite being Scorn of unknown type, the hostiles were alive. Also, Traveler radiation was detected emanating from the Dark Ether in their bodies. Thus their origins may be paracausal. 

[u.2:06] Confirmation through Redjack surveillance was necessary for verification. 

[u.1:06] Quiet down. And make sure they're not sneaking up on me. 

[u.2:07] Everywhere type-Fikrul goes, Eliksni of the City are in danger. 

[u.1:07] We know. We'll find him. 

[u.2:08] Guardians have discovered no tangible means of terminating that unit type. 

[u.1:08] You're not helping. 

[u.2:09] I am encouraging you to seek confirmation through combat. 

[u.1:09] Shaxx. I know you listen to every feed. Your friend is going to give me a panic attack.
1479557835.text_zh:
类型：红桃杰克监控记录[21058] 

相关方：五[5]。一[1]名守护者，职业：猎人[未知1]；一[1]名机械仆从，战斗单位[未知2]；三[3]名嗤魅-[错误]类型。  

关联：列弗[单位5003]；嗤魅；熔炉竞技场；机械仆从；领主沙克斯；红桃杰克 

//音频不可用// 

//转录如下…// 

[未知1: 01] 放轻松，有我在。 

[未知1: 02] “放轻松”的意思是停下。你支离破碎，只会让情况变得更糟。 

[未知2: 01] 前方仍有敌人推进，扫描未完成。 

[未知1: 03] 你的火力战队已经没了。如果我不能把你送回高塔建立连接，扫描也没有意义。 

[未知2: 02] 攻击来袭。 

[伴随着强效超因果放电，监控被嘶嘶的杂音覆盖，紧接着是三发硬弹的爆裂声。] 

[未知1: 04] 别动。你只会让情况变得更糟。 

[未知2: 03] 谢谢你，守护者。光谱分析已完成。 

[未知2: 04] 猎人先锋的推测是正确的。 

[未知1: 05] 乌鸦通常都是对的。什么推测？ 

[未知2: 05] 尽管是未知类型的嗤魅，但这些敌人是活的。此外，他们体内的黑暗乙太中检测到了旅行者的辐射。因此其起源可能是超因果的。 

[未知2: 06] 需要通过红桃杰克监控进行验证。 

[未知1: 06] 安静点。确保他们不会暗中接近我。 

[未知2: 07] 在费克鲁类型出现的地方，圣城的埃里克斯尼族都有危险。 

[未知1: 07] 我们知道。我们会找到他的。 

[未知2: 08] 守护者尚未发现终结那个单位类型的有效方法。 

[未知1: 08] 说点有用的话。 

[未知2: 09] 我鼓励你通过战斗寻求确证。 

[未知1: 09] 沙克斯，我知道你会听每一条记录。你的朋友要把我给吓坏了。

4131241442.name: Shadestalker Cape
4131241442.subtitle: In history's long shadow.
4131241442.text:
Undead screeches bounce off the ruined walls of Riis Reborn, carried by blizzard winds that obscure any path to safety. The small band of Eliksni got separated from the rest at the jetty and fled down this abandoned ally. A Salvation Ketch could barely defend itself from these pale monstrosities; what chance did they have? 

A second molt is unable to hold her composure; her antennal glands leak as her mother holds her close. Her clicking purr is hushed, just enough to voice comfort. 

"I can smell your fear." 

Above them, metal creaks under the Revenant's weight. One Dreg begins to scurry away, but his knee is pinned to the ground by a spear. 

"Do not weep," it sings, so close his mandibles rake the Dreg's respirator. "Rejoice. Today you will be made whole." The undead hulk salivates as the small band huddles together. 

A neon cord catches the aberration's carapace, pulling it up into the air by an unseen hand. 

The mother shields her brood's eyes as bitter ichor erupts from the undead's throat. Two more piercing rounds, in quick succession, see him sinking into the snow, now loosed from the ephemeral thread. 

The second molt breaks away to see a Slayer Baron, as if from an ancient epic, stepping through the gale. 

"Mother!" She chitters in relief. "A fate weaver from your stories!" 

The snowdrift clears, revealing the upright figure's alien anatomy. "Not my stories. A new one."
4131241442.text_zh:
不死者的尖啸声在重生的里斯的废墟墙壁间回荡，暴风雪将它传得更远，也遮蔽了任何通向安全的路径。一小群埃里克斯尼族在栈桥和大部队走散，逃进了这条废弃的小巷。救赎双桅船都几乎无法抵御这些苍白的怪物，他们又哪有机会呢？ 

一个幼儿无法保持冷静，她的触角腺体渗出液体。她的母亲紧紧抱住她，咔嗒着用勉强能被听见的咕噜声传递着安慰。 

“我能闻到你的恐惧。” 

他们上方的金属在亡魂的重量下吱吱作响。一名堕落者士兵开始逃窜，但他的膝盖被一支长矛钉在了地上。 

“不要哭泣，”那声音唱道，他如此接近，下颚刮擦过了堕落者士兵的呼吸机。“欢欣吧，今天你会变得完整。”当他们紧紧抱在一起时，不死者巨物垂涎欲滴。 

一根霓虹绳索缠住了畸形怪物的甲壳，仿佛有无形的手将它拉入空中。 

不死者的喉咙喷出腥气的液体时，母亲遮住了幼儿的眼睛。接连两发穿甲弹之后，他倒在雪地里，从短暂的束缚中解脱了。 

幼儿挣脱开来，看到一名如同古老史诗中走出的杀手公爵，穿过狂风而来。 

“妈妈！”她安心地咔嗒道。“是你故事里讲过的命运编织者！” 

大雪渐渐平息，揭示出矗立身影的外星躯体。“不，这是一个新的故事。”

2068231004.name: Shadestalker Mask
2068231004.subtitle: Ulan-Tan was right.
2068231004.text:
[SALVATION ANNALS:: SERVITOR NIRIKS Perception Feed dump:] 

[[Filtering Highspeak]] 

ER: The call for aid is sent. This conversation is over.  

IX: You owe me answers. 

ER: You owe allegiance to your Kell. Prepare your nest for evacuation. 

IX: They will kill you. Or worse. 

ER: A cost I will gladly pay. Our people will not survive the Scorn on our own. 

IX: But in what state will we survive? 

ER: Anything is better than annihilation. 

IX: You may feel differently in a Human cage. 

ER: Leave. I have weapons to prepare. Where Scorn go, he often follows. 

IX: As ever, I walk my own path. If I don't see you again, I will know another piece of Old Riis is lost.  

[A snap-hiss. Metal groans and shakes.] 

IX: You can't lead from a cage. You can't inspire from the grave. 

ER: I do what I can. With what I have.
2068231004.text_zh:
[救赎编年史:: 魔眼尼瑞克斯感知记录转储:] 

[[过滤高等语言]] 

ER：求助请求已发出。我们没什么可谈的了。  

IX：你欠我答案。 

ER：你应该效忠你的凯尔。让你的巢穴准备好撤离。 

IX：他们会杀死你的，或者做更糟的事情。 

ER：我愿意付出这个代价。我们的族人无法靠自己对抗嗤魅。 

IX：但我们会以何种状态生存下来呢？ 

ER：任何状态都比毁灭好。 

IX：你在人类的牢笼里可能就不会这么想了。 

ER：你走吧，我得准备武器了。嗤魅去哪里，他通常就会跟到哪里。 

IX：我会一如既往地走我自己的路。若再见不到你，我就会知道旧里斯又消亡了一部分。  

[一声呲嗤，金属嘎吱作响。] 

IX：你在笼子里做不了领导者，也没法从坟墓里激励任何人。 

ER：我会尽我所能，不遗余力。

745736759.name: Shadestalker Strides
745736759.subtitle: The affordances of love do not reside in analogous exchange.
745736759.subtitle_zh: 爱的原则不是等价交换。
745736759.text:
Deep within the maze of the Bazaar, throngs of the City's residents wandered, enjoying all the market had to offer. An Iron War Beast sampled fresh fruits. Awoken haggled over the price of pastries. The smells of caramelized meat and rosemary wafted on the breeze, past every vendor and artisan.

The hum of activity was overpowering yet reassuring to Saint-14 as he stopped to watch an older Eliksni expertly weave fabric on a well-worn loom. The woven symbols were unique and unfamiliar to the Exo, but he watched in awe as an iridescent glow emerged within the vibrant cerulean cloth.

Fit for a Kell, Saint mused to himself—

Breath caught in his throat; hands shook—

Flashes of memory echoed in his mind. All he could feel in this moment… was shame.

He hurried past the weaver and through the crowd, landing squarely in front of a tea stand, a sample placed in his hand before he could open his mouth to refuse. He looked down. The opaque liquid steamed in his cup, pungent and medicinal.

Like distilled Darkness, Saint realized—

Breath caught in his throat; hands shook—

Flashes of memory filled his sight. All he could feel in this moment… was sadness.

He stumbled; apologies and hot liquid spilled all around him as the sounds of the Bazaar became a dull roar in his ears. He needed to escape. The noise, the tea, everything.

He closed his eyes and then rushed away at a fevered pace.

Daylight had waned against the City's walls when Saint found himself in a quiet area, where vibrant green vines stretched down from above, and below, the silhouette of his helmet stretched long and thin across the floor where Mithrax's weathered medical Servitor often waited. Saint breathed a sigh of relief.

He was alone.

Saint placed his favorite keepsake, a small stuffed bear, on the Kell's throne. Gently, he adjusted the lavender ribbon at its neck; the crisp satin sat in stark contrast to the bear's hazy black eyes, to its slightly worn ear and well-loved fur. A gift, once a comfort to a child of the City.

A gift, once a comfort to Saint in the face of loss, in the face of—

Breath caught in his throat; hands shook—

Flashes of memory swelled in his heart.

Osiris.

His strong laugh. His deep, soulful eyes. The warmth of his smile. Of his touch.

Memories of comfort, but all he could feel in this moment… was guilt. Intense and overwhelming, like daggers cutting through him, sharpness bleeding through sweetness. Saint breathed deeply and stared at the medical equipment around the empty throne before him.

"The cost of my joy," Saint whispered, and he wept.
745736759.text_zh:
迷宫般的集市深处，圣城居民川流不息，享受着市场的一切。一只钢铁战兽正品尝新鲜水果，觉醒者讨价还价购买糕点，肉食的焦香和迷迭香的气味随风飘散，经过每个商人和工匠的摊位。

此起彼伏的声势对圣人14号来说既具有压倒性又让人安心，他停下来观看一名年长的埃里克斯尼族熟练地在磨损的纺织机上编织。编出的符号对这个Exo来说独特而陌生，但当鲜艳的天蓝布上闪耀出彩虹般的炫彩时，他不禁瞠目结舌。

很适合凯尔，圣人心想——

呼吸一滞，他的双手颤抖——

记忆的片段在他脑海中回荡。这一刻他所能感受到的…只有羞愧。

他匆忙走过编织者，穿过人群，径直来到一个茶摊前。他还没来得及张口婉拒，手中就被塞了杯试喝。他低头看去，杯中的茶色液体冒着蒸汽，散发着浓烈的草药味。

像是提炼出的暗影，圣人意识到——

呼吸一滞，他的双手颤抖——

记忆的片段充斥他的视线。这一刻他所能感受到的…只有悲伤。

他踉跄了一下，耳边响起道歉声，滚烫的液体洒了一地，集市的喧嚣在他耳边成了低沉的轰鸣。他需要逃离喧嚣、茶，周遭的一切。

他闭上眼睛，然后急匆匆地离开。

圣人回过神，发现自己在一片安静的区域，圣城的墙壁外，白昼已在消退。鲜绿的藤蔓从上方垂下，他头盔的轮廓在地上拉得又长又细，那是米瑟拉克斯那饱经风霜的医疗魔眼常等候的地方。圣人松了一口气。

这里只有他。

圣人把他最喜欢的纪念品，一只毛绒小熊，放在凯尔的王座上。他轻轻地调整着熊脖子上的薰衣草色缎带；洁净的缎带与熊朦胧的黑眼睛、略微磨损的耳朵和饱受搓揉的毛形成了鲜明对比。这份礼物曾给圣城中的一个孩子带来过慰藉。

这份礼物曾在圣人面对失去时带来过慰藉，在——

呼吸一滞，他的双手颤抖——

记忆片段在他心中涌动。

奥斯里斯。

他爽朗的笑声，深邃的眼神，温暖的微笑，以及触碰。

是充满慰藉的记忆，但在这一刻，他所能感受到的…只有强烈而无法承受的内疚，如同匕首将他刺穿，甜美中透着锋芒。圣人深吸一口气，凝视着空荡王座前的医疗设备。

“为我的快乐而付出的代价，”圣人轻声说道，然后啜泣起来。

322173891.name: Mask of Fealty
322173891.subtitle: Leave a mark.
322173891.text:
Ghar's ex-Legion. Ex-Cabal, really, if you're getting technical about it.  

But he still recognizes the tension that permeates the cargo hold: a mix of restlessness and nerves, like that of soldiers on their first real patrol.

His new Lightbearer friends aren't green recruits. They're veterans of the end-times, same as him. But he's had much longer to come to terms with his new independence.

They're still braced for the Vanguard to come crashing in here. Waiting for some eleventh-hour betrayal on his part.

But it's a brand-new world out here.

The Lightbearers brought the goods: Weapons. Artifacts. Enough to sell, and enough to see them through whatever comes next.

Ghar's got the salvaged Harvester. And Ghar's got the plans.

"All right, you dogs." Their grasp of Ulurant is abysmal, so he speaks their tongue. "You've done your service to your Vanguard. Leave war to the Hive gods, and those that feed them."

He looks down at them, his new crew. Three Human, eager faces, three metal drones. They want to see the stars. They want a little taste of the better life.

"We've got ourselves a crew of seven seasoned killers and a great big universe out there." Ghar grunts. "Let's go get rich."
322173891.text_zh:
加尔曾是军团成员，准确地说，曾是卡巴尔。  

但他依然能辨识货舱里弥漫的紧张气氛：混合着躁动与焦虑，就像士兵们第一次真正巡逻时的感觉。

他的新负光者朋友们并非新兵。和他一样，他们都是经历过末世的老手，只不过他有更长的时间来适应自己的独立身份。

他们仍在担心先锋会突然冲进这里，或是他会在最后关头背叛。

但外面是一个全新的世界。

负光者们带来了物资：武器、神器。足够出售变卖，也足够他们应对接下来的一切。

加尔手上有回收来的收割者，并且已有计划。

“好了，狗狗们。”他们对乌鲁兰语掌握得不好，所以他用他们的语言发话。“你们已经为先锋做出了应有的贡献，把战争留给邪魔族众神和那些喂养他们的家伙吧。”

他低头看向他的新船员：三个有着热切面孔的人类和三架金属无人机。他们渴望探索星辰，渴望品味更美好的生活。

“七个资深的杀手，面对广袤的宇宙。”加尔咕哝道。“我们一起去发财吧。”

1808327005.name: Spacewalk Gauntlets
1808327005.subtitle: Archival|Castor|231| —don't understand. We're all excited for successful code injection, but it's much too early for insertion into a chassis—
1808327005.subtitle_zh: 档案|卡斯托|231| ——不明白。代码注入成功我们都很兴奋，但现在就插入底架还为时过早——
1808327005.text:
Seventeen days since arrival. 

Karrho is busy all the time talking to the Vandals and Marauders too big to even look at Yaraskis. They're working together to build an Ether refinery, using old human blueprints from the station. He rarely has time for Yaraskis. 

Yaraskis would make a terrible engineer. In her cocoon she dreamed of being a Captain, not a priest. She fetches and carries and mops up the old stains nobody else wants to touch, making the station livable again. 

Day by day, their home fills up with comforting noise: the pleasant creak of cable ties stringing platforms together, the thump-click, thump-click of footwraps and claws on decking, of the arguments between the only two crewmembers who understand Servitor code. 

It's nothing like a good solid warren—but it's safe, and that's good enough. And once they have Ether flowing in, it'll be even better. 

Yaraskis tries to ignore the station-voice as she tosses a rag into the machine that is almost an incinerator. 

From behind, a hand yanks at her hood. She yells. Its owner dodges her return swipe. 

Karrho. "I need to talk to you. Something is wrong. I can't find Paskir." 

Paskir is another engineer, big for a Vandal. Big enough that his former Captain was eyeing him as a challenger, which is why he agreed to steal a Ketch with them in the first place. 

"Maybe he got lost. Or stuck in some goo." Whatever the Humans did on this station, it involved a lot of… liquids. Yaraskis disinfects her hands at least five times a day. 

"He was going to help me with the nuclear power supply and never showed up. And I heard something in the halls." At her look, Karrho adds, "Something big!" 

"Anything big would have starved long before we got here. Just wait, I bet he got stuck in one of the zero-gravity areas and he'll call for help soon." 

"You'll help me look?" 

She hooks an arm around Karrho and pulls him away from the almost-incinerator. 

"If he doesn't turn up with an embarrassing story in the morning, we'll all look for him." 

Karrho loves engineering. He should be a Servitor's priest or a Splicer. Yaraskis wants to be his Captain, assign him to the priesthood. She wants to get so tall that her head brushes the ceiling, and her arms are long enough to wrap around the whole crew. 

It's better to be here than with the Houses. 

It has to be better.
1808327005.text_zh:
抵达后十七天。 

卡霍一直在忙着和那些暴徒和狂暴劫匪交谈，他们体型大到甚至不屑于看雅拉斯基丝一眼。他们要利用来自空间站里旧人类的蓝图，合作建造一座乙太精炼厂。他很少有时间陪雅拉斯基丝。 

雅拉斯基丝成不了一名优秀的工程师。她在茧里就梦想着成为一名船长，而不是祭司。她负责跑腿、搬运、清理那些无人愿意触碰的陈年污渍，让空间站重新变得宜居。 

一天天过去，他们的家园充满了各种令人心安的声响：缆绳将各个平台绑在一起时发出的悦耳嘎吱声，裹足和爪子踩在甲板上发出的咚咚声，以及仅有的两名懂得魔眼代码的船员之间的争论声。 

这里一点也不像个坚固的杂院——但它很安全，这就足够了。而且一旦他们有了乙太，这里就会变得更好。 

雅拉斯基丝一边把抹布扔进那台差不多算是焚烧炉的机器，一边试图忽略站内系统音。 

突然，有只手从后面扯住了她的兜帽。她大叫一声。那只手的主人躲过了她的回击。 

是卡霍。“我需要和你谈谈。出事了。我找不到帕斯基尔。” 

帕斯基尔是另一位工程师，就暴徒来说体型挺大。大到足以让他的前任船长把他视为挑战者，这也是他当初同意跟他们合谋偷一艘双桅船的原因。 

“也许他迷路了。或者被什么粘液困住了。”不管人类之前在这个空间站上做什么，都跟很多的…液体有关。雅拉斯基丝每天至少要给她的手消毒五次。 

“他本来要帮我解决核电供应问题，但一直没出现。我还听到走廊里有动静。”看着她的表情，卡霍补充道，“是个大家伙！” 

“就算有大家伙，肯定也在我们来到这里之前就饿死了。等着瞧吧，我打赌他一定是困在某个零重力区里，他很快就会求救的。” 

“你会帮我一起找吗？” 

她挽起卡霍的胳膊，把他从那台近似焚烧炉的机器旁拉开。 

“如果他明天早上还没有带着尴尬的故事出现，我们就一起去找他。” 

卡霍热爱工程学。他应该成为一名魔眼祭司或熔岩军团。雅拉斯基丝想当他的船长，让他担任祭司的职务。她想变得高高的，头能碰到天花板，手臂长到能环绕整个船队。 

待在这里总比留在那些氏族里要好。 

必须得更好才行。

1615763427.name: Spacewalk Plate
1615763427.subtitle: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
1615763427.subtitle_zh: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——
1615763427.text:
Twenty-three days since arrival. 

The Ether generator is taking shape, a big ringed shell set a safe distance from the hull, cradled in wiring. Their crew's three spinners are busy all the time making more cabling. 

Except somehow it's too quiet. The older crew are a little snooty about Drekhs, and that's fine—but Yaraskis can't even find one of them to be snooty at her. 

Paskir is still missing. She and Karrho hunted for him up and down the station for hours. 

Nobody suggests going back down to the surface. They'd be killed outright. Their big plan—a hidden warren where nobody will ever bother them again—has to work. 

Yaraskis sticks to the smaller, dimly lit corridors now, where only the Drekhs fit. She doesn't like the big, open ones with their flat, bright lights, reverberating acoustics, and the feeling that something is always watching her. 

Karrho stays at his work. Yaraskis, ignoring her own, explores the station instead, hunting for their missing crewmates. She makes a tally as she goes, checking every corner of the station, and keeping an ear out for the barely audible whine of a charged scattercape. 

A full third of the crew are… gone. 

She hears a muted shriek, something under the flickering buzz of a dying light. Then the scrape of metal on metal. She hunches her shoulders deeper into her cloak against the feeling of being followed. 

The scraping sound stalks her even through her shortcuts. She turns to look back. Still nothing. 

She can't find Paskir. She can't find anyone. There's nothing to do but give up.  

Yaraskis heads back to Karrho's workshop. 

It's empty. Silent as a dead warren.  

Karrho is gone.
1615763427.text_zh:
抵达后二十三天。 

乙太发生器已初具雏形，一个巨大的环形外壳，与船体保持着安全距离，用电线裹着。船员们的三台纺纱机在忙着制造更多的电缆。 

只是不知道为什么，这里太安静了。老船员们对堕落者士兵有点嗤之以鼻，这没什么，但雅拉斯基丝却连一个对她嗤之以鼻的人都找不到。 

帕斯基尔还是下落不明。她和卡霍在空间站里上上下下找了他好几个小时。 

没有人提议返回地表。他们会被立即处死。他们的大计划——这个没人会再打扰他们的隐蔽杂院——必须成功。 

雅拉斯基丝现在喜欢呆在光线昏暗的小走廊里，那些只有堕落者士兵才能容身的地方。她不喜欢那些宽敞开阔的走廊，那里有平直明亮的灯光、回荡不绝的传声混响，以及被什么东西盯着的感觉。 

卡霍继续他的工作。雅拉斯基丝则忽略了自己的差事，转而探索空间站，寻找失踪的船员。她边走边做记录，检查空间站的各个角落，留心听着充能散射披肩那几乎听不见的鸣响。 

整整三分之一的船员…消失了。 

她听到一声低沉的尖叫，它在一盏即将熄灭的灯光闪烁的嗡鸣声中似有若无。紧接着是金属与金属的摩擦声。她紧紧地裹紧披风，耸起肩膀，抵御那种被跟踪的不安感。 

即使她抄近路走，那刮擦声还是紧随其后。她回头看了看，还是什么都没有。 

她找不到帕斯基尔。她找不到任何人。她别无选择，只能放弃。  

雅拉斯基丝回到了卡霍的工作间。 

里面空无一人。跟杂院一样死寂。  

卡霍消失了。

514586330.name: Spacewalk Mark
514586330.subtitle: Tech|Notice|42| All—use of the sample decommission tool is restricted to accredited researchers. If you need to contain something, call security.
514586330.subtitle_zh: 技术|通知|42| 全体注意——所有样本处理工具仅限经认可的研究人员使用。如果你需要隔离处理某物，请联系安保人员。
514586330.text:
Time is suspended.  

All that remains is the appointed task. 

The spinners craft towropes, powerlines, and all-purpose cable, hour after hour without rest. 

The White Captain moves among them, her many limbs. She feels what they feel, knows what they know, as soon as they know it. She uses this information to align, and together, they build something new in this home they've found. 

Every Drekh yearns for more arms than their Captain allows. Every four-eyed Eliksni looks with envy upon the eight-eyed. Every Kell and Archon raises their horns as high as they dare. 

Now, together they are as no Eliksni before them. A miracle. A being of hundreds of limbs, lungs, eyes. 

The White Captain gently touches the limb previously named Yaraskis. Her appointed portion of the great diagram flowers to life in her head. 

Legs stumbling under her, she moves towards the station's prow. One limb may be unsteady, but their great shared body is strong. 

Faint noises make no sense. Words she doesn't understand. The un-Eliksni babbling of a foreign mind. 

The only mind that matters is the White Captain's. 

Hands connect circuits and power lines. The diagram is beautiful but difficult to grasp. She searches for the right shape, the right configuration that will let power flow through its appointed channels. 

The work goes on.  

Until the hands tie off the last cable.  

The eyes look up. The knees buckle in joy. The heart surges along the bright paths of the diagram. 

Somewhere in the joined crowd, a single hand throws a single lever. 

The mind rejoices. 

Orange light flares to life in the cold dark. 

It flares in hundreds of souls. Yaraskis is there. 

Somewhere.
514586330.text_zh:
时间停滞不前。  

现在只剩下那些指定好的任务。 

纺纱机不停地编织着拖曳缆、电源线和多用途电缆，几个小时不停地工作，从不休息。 

白色船长用她那众多的肢体，在它们之间穿梭。她能够即时感知到他们的感受，知晓他们所了解的一切。她利用这些信息进行协调，一起在这个他们找到的家园里建造新的事物。 

每个堕落者士兵都渴望拥有超过其船长允许数量的手臂。每个四眼埃里克斯尼族都羡慕地望着那些八眼的同类。每一位凯尔和执政官都尽可能地高举起他们的犄角。 

如今，他们合为一体，成为了前所未有的埃里克斯尼族。这是一个奇迹。一个拥有成百上千的肢体、肺和眼睛的存在。 

白色船长轻抚着之前被称为雅拉斯基丝的肢体。她脑海中，巨大图示中分配给她的那部分瞬间鲜活了起来。 

她带着身下颤抖的腿，向空间站的船头走去。其中一个肢体可能不稳，但他们共享的庞大身躯却十分强壮。 

无意义的微弱杂音。她听不懂的词语。外来思维的非埃里克斯尼族语唠叨。 

唯一重要的是白色船长的思维。 

手连接着电路和电源线。图示虽美，却难以捉摸。她寻找着合适的形状、正确的配置，让电力在指定的通道中流动。 

工作还在继续。  

直到手将最后一根电缆系紧。  

眼睛向上看去。膝盖因喜悦而发软。心脏沿着图示中明亮的路径而激涌。 

在聚群中的某个地方，一只手拉动了一根杠杆。 

思维欢欣鼓舞。 

在寒冷的黑暗中，橙色的光芒突然亮起。 

它在数百个灵魂中闪烁着。雅拉斯基丝就在那里。 

那里的某个地方。

2244013188.name: Spacewalk Helm
2244013188.subtitle: Tech|Direct|124| —ate through another container. What cleaning agents are safe to use? We can't afford another fume incident, István.
2244013188.subtitle_zh: 技术|指示|124| ——蚀穿了另一个容器。哪些清洁剂可以安全使用？我们承受不起另一次烟气事故了，伊什特万。
2244013188.text:
Six days since arrival. 

Metal groans. Power lines hum. Things skitter in the pipes. 

Yaraskis picks her way through rubble with a double armload of scrap. She's finally growing out of Drekh scale, lower arms regrown all the way down to her talons, but she's still slight enough to duck through the smallest shafts of their new home. 

An orbital station, ancient and damaged, but fixable, everyone thinks. The station hasn't been inhabited for a very long time, but Yaraskis catches herself looking over her shoulder repeatedly. 

Her spine prickles as an eerie mechanical voice speaks above her head; some old message for Humans, Karrho said. Nothing to worry about. But… unsettling all the same. 

It's a relief to get to the workshop. She kicks at the doorframe. "Scrap delivery." 

Karrho is smaller than Yaraskis, still true Drekh. Even so, people pay attention to him because he hatched with eight eyes. That means he's handsome, one-in-a-million lucky. And he's sharp. He was in on the plan from the beginning. Yaraskis only got tapped because she's his egg-cousin. 

Karrho gestures without looking up from his screens. "Put it anywhere." 

The workshop is one of the creepier rooms on the station, in Yaraskis's opinion. It's filled with metal tables bolted to the floor. They had had to clear out a whole pile of empty Vex bodies before the room was usable. Yaraskis tries not to touch anything as she sets down her bundle. 

"What are you working on?" 

"Analyzing some old mechanical blueprints. If we can splice into the systems, there's as much to use up here as down on the surface. And there aren't any Vex up here. No Hive. No Lightbearers." 

"No Kells," Yaraskis says firmly. 

"No Kells." Karrho adds, "Plenty of Ether if these blueprints hold true, though. There's this machine. It's in two parts—one collects energy, one uses it. We just need the collector for the Servitors, and we're set for life." 

He tilts one of the screens her way. 

Ether for life, up here in the cold dark. It makes everything worth it, the overwhelming feeling of fear as they escaped from Europa, the careful navigation around the hazards on the station as they work to make it livable. 

And yes, Yaraskis might get shooed out of engineering meetings she doesn't understand, but nobody will cut off her arms for insubordination. 

She flexes her lower hands and leans in to study their future.
2244013188.text_zh:
抵达后六天。 

金属嘎吱作响。电线发出嗡鸣。管道里传来窸窸窣窣的声音。 

雅拉斯基丝揽着双臂的废料在瓦砾中艰难前行。她终于摆脱了堕落者士兵的体型，下臂已重新长出，一直延伸到利爪处，但她仍然很瘦小，小到可以穿过他们新家中最小的通风井。 

他们的新家是一座古老而破损的轨道空间站，不过还是可以修复的，大家都这么觉得。这座空间站已很久没人居住了，但雅拉斯基丝却总是不由自主地频频回头张望。 

一个阴森诡异的机械声音在她头顶上方响起，引得她的脊背一阵刺痛；卡霍说那是给人类听的一些旧广播。没什么好担心的。但…还是让人感到不安。 

到了工作间，她才松了一口气。她踢了踢门框喊道。“废料快送。” 

卡霍比雅拉斯基丝体型瘦小，仍然是纯正的堕落者士兵。即便如此，人们还是会在意他，因为他出生时长着八只眼睛。这意味着他英俊潇洒，是万里挑一的幸运儿。他还很聪明。从一开始他就参与了这个计划。雅拉斯基丝之所以被选中，仅仅是因为她是他的表亲。 

卡霍的视线没有离开屏幕，只是摆了摆手。“随便找个地方放。” 

在雅拉斯基丝看来，工作间是空间站里最让人毛骨悚然的房间之一。里面摆满了用螺栓固定在地板上的金属桌子。他们不得不清理掉一大堆Vex空壳，然后才用上了这个房间。雅拉斯基丝放下包裹时尽量不去碰任何东西。 

“你在忙什么呢？” 

“分析一些旧的机械蓝图。如果我们能入侵系统，这里能用的资源就会跟地表上一样多。而且这上面没有Vex，没有邪魔族，没有负光者。” 

“没有凯尔，”雅拉斯基丝坚定地说。 

“没有凯尔。”卡霍补充道，“不过，如果这些蓝图是真的，那这里就有很多乙太。有这样一台机器。它分为两部分，一部分收集能量，一部分使用能量。我们只需拿到魔眼用的收集器，以后就不用愁了。” 

他把其中一块屏幕转向她。 

在这寒冷黑暗的地方，有一辈子用不完的乙太。它让一切都变得值得，包括他们逃离木卫二时令人窒息的恐惧感，还有他们为了让空间站变得宜居而小心绕过各种危险的艰难过程。 

当然，雅拉斯基丝可能会被赶出她听不懂的工程会议，但没有人会因为她违抗命令而砍掉她的手臂。 

她活动着下肢的手，俯身研究他们的未来。

4132376063.name: Spacewalk Greaves
4132376063.subtitle: Research|Direct|132| Pull that log. If someone sends it up the chain we're all dead.
4132376063.subtitle_zh: 研究|指示|132| 把那段日志删掉。要是有人上报，我们就全完了。
4132376063.text:
Thirty-nine days since arrival. 

Ketches and warrens are creaky things. Cables groan, steps squeak, hammocks rustle. Ether-bright eyes should glow and blink in the comfortable dark. 

Yaraskis had expected they would fill up the station, all of them, with repaired machinery and stolen comforts and familiar sounds. 

All the station's sounds are lonely now. Even the station-voice would be a comfort, almost. 

She hasn't seen Karrho in days. The remaining engineers only talk to each other, and the Servitors groan and bob in the air together in one nervous bundle. 

And something is stalking the hallways. 

It has eyes like an Eliksni, but they don't flicker like they should. They burn steadily, lit not by Ether but by something else. Even the Marauders tell her about it in whispers, so scared they ignore hierarchy. 

Yaraskis feels its presence in her spiracles. She decides to head for Karrho's workshop. She can hide there. 

Then a Marauder swings into view. His eyes are strange and he doesn't look at Yaraskis. He just says, "Come here." 

She runs. Through the halls, leaping over platforms strung together, scoring her side badly on an unexpected twist of metal. 

The missing crew loom out of corners, calling out as she runs past. She doesn't stop. 

Till a voice calls her by name. 

It's Karrho. He's braced himself in a corner of the ceiling near a broken vent grate that Yaraskis knows leads to the station hull. It's too small for anyone bigger than a Drekh. 

She leaps. Hands claw at her ankles as Yaraskis kicks her way up the wall. 

"This way," Karrho urges. They scurry through twisting passages, through the vents and under floors that long-ago Humans never meant for anyone to walk in. They run over wreckage, in and out of the gravity generators' pull, towards the Ketch. Maybe they'll be safe there. Maybe they can cast off and run. 

"What's wrong with them?" Yaraskis asks, panting. Her heart kicks hard in her chest. 

"Nothing." 

Karrho stops on a dime at the vent's exit. Yaraskis's momentum takes her clear past him, into a wide room. 

She looks far up into the bright steady glare of mechanical eyes. Filled with an alien light. 

And Karrho pushes her forward into the waiting arms of the White Captain.
4132376063.text_zh:
抵达后三十九天。 

双桅船和杂院都已破旧不堪。电缆发出嘎吱声，台阶吱吱作响，吊床沙沙有声。乙太充足的明眸应闪烁着光芒，在舒适的黑暗中眨动。 

雅拉斯基丝原本以为他们大家会用修好的机器、偷来的舒适用品和熟悉的声响，把整个空间站填满。 

可现在，整个空间站的声音都显得孤独。即使是站内系统音，也几乎成了一种慰藉。 

她已经好几天没见到卡霍了。剩下的工程师们只会互相交谈，魔眼们则一齐呻吟着，紧张地聚在空中晃来晃去。 

走廊里有什么东西在潜行。 

它有类似埃里克斯尼族的眼，却不像正常的那样闪烁。它们持续燃烧，点燃它们的不是乙太，而是别的什么。就连狂暴劫匪们也小声地跟她提及此事，他们害怕得顾不上等级制度了。 

雅拉斯基丝在她的气孔中感觉到了它的存在。她决定前往卡霍的工作间。她可以躲在那里。 

这时，有一个狂暴劫匪出现在眼前。他的眼神很奇怪，没有去看雅拉斯基丝。他只是说道，“过来。” 

她转身就跑。穿过走廊，跃过一个个串连起来的平台，被一个突然出现的金属拐角严重划伤了侧身。 

失踪的船员从各个角落里冒了出来，在她跑过时大声呼喊。她没有停下。 

直到一个声音叫出了她的名字。 

是卡霍。他靠着天花板的一个角落，旁边有个破损的通风格栅，雅拉斯基丝知道这个通风口通往空间站船体。任何比堕落者士兵块头大的人都进不去。 

她纵身一跃。卡霍用手抓着她的脚踝，雅拉斯基丝奋力踢着墙壁向上攀爬。 

“这边走，”卡霍催促道。他们匆匆穿过曲折的通道，穿过通风口和地板下，昔日的人类住民从未打算让任何人进入的地方。他们越过残骸，在重力发生器的引力场里进出，朝着双桅船跑去。或许在那里他们能够安全一些。也许他们可以搭船逃离。 

“他们有什么毛病？”雅拉斯基丝气喘吁吁地问道。她的心怦怦直跳。 

“没毛病。” 

卡霍突然停在通风口的出口。雅拉斯基丝因惯性径直冲过他，进入了一个宽敞的房间。 

她抬头看向高处那些明亮而坚定的机械眼睛。里头充满了异样的光芒。 

卡霍把她推进了前方白色船长等候着的怀抱中。

1121856799.name: Shadestalker Gauntlets
1121856799.subtitle: Turn the shadows against themselves.
1121856799.text:
His knee had grown stiff under his desk. 

Zavala initially ignored it. Let the pain burn in the side of his knee, seize the top of his calves. His leg had grown stiff countless times before. But this time, this early in the morning, this soon after sitting down, was something else. 

He moved his chair back and considered his knee. What had he done to hurt it? He had not exercised yet, he had not gone on his usual patrol… he had done nothing. Why would a knee hurt from doing nothing? 

The riddle dissolved. He was starting to age. 

Zavala had anticipated this; part of mourning Targe was preparing himself to furiously resist the inevitable physical breakdown. He'd calculated how to negotiate with his own body, subdue it to stoicism, and make it follow his sturdy command. But what he had not anticipated was how he would feel. He ought to feel dread, terror at evidence of his mortality. But instead…  

He allows a hand to rest on his aching knee. To venerate it. He feels it solid under his palm. It is his, it is real, it is both portentous and precious. He is aging. He will age. An absurd and joyous thought warms in his chest: how fortunate, to have lived long enough to grow old. How invaluable, to make the space between himself and the horizon matter. How much time is left? And is it best spent with his knees under a desk? 

"Zavala?" 

Ikora stands in the doorway. Hundreds of years of knowing each other too well draws her to his seat. 

His expression softens, and he stretches out his knee. 

Ikora watches his readjustment, and smiles sadly, the same way she smiles when all their mortal friends grow old. 

The commander sighs, but with content assurance, not heavy resignation. He looks at his friend. "I think I'd like to go on leave for a week." 

Ikora nods, then half-smiles. "How about two?"
1121856799.text_zh:
桌下，他的膝盖僵住了。 

萨瓦拉最初选择了忽视，任由疼痛从膝盖侧面一路爬到小腿上半截。他的腿以前也这样僵过很多次，但像这样，一大清早，刚坐下不久就这样，非比寻常。 

他把椅子往后移，打量着膝盖。是做什么伤到了它吗？他还没锻炼，也没有进行日常巡逻…什么都还没做，为什么膝盖会疼？ 

答案很简单：他开始变老了。 

萨瓦拉对此早有预期。哀悼塔格的同时，他也在做准备要去奋勇对抗身体必然的衰颓。他计算过如何与自己的身体谈判，用坚忍去征服，去让它服从他坚决的命令。但他没有料到自己的感受，他本该觉得恐惧，对自己不再永生的证据感到恐慌，但正相反…  

他怀着崇敬的心，把一只手放在疼痛的膝盖上。它在他手掌下坚实又可靠，这是他的身体，真实存在，既珍贵又包含着不祥的预兆。他正在衰老，必会衰老。一个荒谬而愉悦的念头让他的胸口温热起来：能活到开始衰老是多么幸运，让自己和地平线之间的空间变得有意义，又是多么的宝贵。他还剩多少时间？真的应该用来在桌前感受膝盖的疼痛吗？ 

“萨瓦拉？” 

艾可拉站在门口，几百年来对彼此的了解引导她来到了他的座位旁。 

他的表情缓和下来，开始舒展膝盖。 

艾可拉观察着他的动作，露出带点苦涩的微笑，凡人朋友们开始衰老时她总是这样的表情。 

指挥官叹了口气，但这反应中透着安心和自信，而不是无奈地听天由命。他看向好友，“我想我会请一周的假。” 

艾可拉点点头，然后似笑非笑地说，“要不两周？”

3983920985.name: Shadestalker Plate
3983920985.subtitle: Unseen deliverance.
3983920985.text:
TYPE: REDJACK SURVEILLANCE FEED [21058] 

PARTIES: Five [5]. One [1], Guardian-type, Class Hunter [u.1]; One [1], Frame-type, Unit Combat [u.2]; Three [3], Scorn-[ERROR] Type.  

ASSOCIATIONS: Lev [Unit5003];  Scorn; Crucible; Frame; Lord Shaxx; Redjacks 

//AUDIO UNAVAILABLE// 

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS…/ 

[u.1:01] Relax, I have you. 

[u.1:02] "Relax" means stop. You're in pieces, and you're making it worse. 

[u.2:01] Hostiles still pushing from the front. Scans incomplete. 

[u.1:03] Your fireteam is gone. Scans are irrelevant if I can't get you back to the Tower to link up. 

[u.2:02] Incoming. 

[A hissing snap washes the feed with high-yield paracausal discharge, followed by the loud crack of three hard rounds.] 

[u.1:04] Stop moving. You're making this worse. 

[u.2:03] Thank you, Guardian. Spectral analysis complete. 

[u.2:04] Hunter Vanguard suppositions were correct. 

[u.1:05] Crow is usually on point. What about? 

[u.2:05] Despite being Scorn of unknown type, the hostiles were alive. Also, Traveler radiation was detected emanating from the Dark Ether in their bodies. Thus their origins may be paracausal. 

[u.2:06] Confirmation through Redjack surveillance was necessary for verification. 

[u.1:06] Quiet down. And make sure they're not sneaking up on me. 

[u.2:07] Everywhere type-Fikrul goes, Eliksni of the City are in danger. 

[u.1:07] We know. We'll find him. 

[u.2:08] Guardians have discovered no tangible means of terminating that unit type. 

[u.1:08] You're not helping. 

[u.2:09] I am encouraging you to seek confirmation through combat. 

[u.1:09] Shaxx. I know you listen to every feed. Your friend is going to give me a panic attack.
3983920985.text_zh:
类型：红桃杰克监控记录[21058] 

相关方：五[5]。一[1]名守护者，职业：猎人[未知1]；一[1]名机械仆从，战斗单位[未知2]；三[3]名嗤魅-[错误]类型。  

关联：列弗[单位5003]；嗤魅；熔炉竞技场；机械仆从；领主沙克斯；红桃杰克 

//音频不可用// 

//转录如下…// 

[未知1: 01] 放轻松，有我在。
