"He cannot hear us," Eris said simply. As if she had thought it and the matter was done. Honestly, that was probably the exact case. That was the nature of a throne world.  

Cautiously, Sloane experimented with relaxing her shoulders. It made her feel as if she might collapse at any slight gust, so she tightened them again. "What it offered me," she said abruptly. "'Bulwark against despair.' To never fear that I would be so overcome as to fall. But that would be falling. In itself."  

"Yes," Eris said, in simple echo of Sloane's earlier assent. Her trifold gaze was intense, searching. "We feel foolish when we come back to ourselves. For the choices we almost made. We laugh and say how stupid we were. Of course that was wrong. Of course we would never." 

Sloane's mouth tasted like ash. "I think that offer's always going to be there," she said—quiet, so quiet, that nagging fear that created the way in. "Ahsa has my back, but if I wake up one day and choose—just choose—to jump into that abyss? She's my ally, my partner. But an anchor doesn't do any good if the ship cuts the line." 

"Choose not to. Again, and again." Eris's smile was softer, even sympathetic. "Someday, you may find it valuable to let that knife rest where you may reach it, because you know you will not. Trust yourself, Deputy Commander—Sloane. As I trust you, even when you are infuriating." 

"It's my job," Sloane cracked weakly. Her ribs were a cage with the door opened, suddenly letting breath back in.  

She hadn't had that slow, methodical proof with Ahsa. She had had a moment, a prayer, and no alternative. Maybe Eris wasn't entirely wrong. That unspeakable risk, back then, had saved her. 

"Those feelings." Eris still regarded her with that searching intent. "In that pit. Those feelings are not false simply because we may look back on them later and laugh. Remember that." 

Sloane would.
3320768272.text_zh:
太近了，近得过头了。那把向她挥来的利刃的形状，已深深烙印在斯隆的脑海中；即便此刻，她仍能清晰忆起，尽管它已不再如当初那般沉重，压得她思绪难展。 

“很高兴你能安全归来，”埃里斯的声音近在咫尺。非常近。斯隆猛地惊觉，没曾料想到埃里斯已如此靠近，而她竟未察觉。“这个时候失去你将会是…灾难性的。” 

斯隆呼气时带了一点笑。“你真是太会轻描淡写了，”她说道，试图掩饰重铸碎志者的经历对她造成的强烈冲击。  

埃里斯的嘴角微微闪动，一抹微笑转瞬即逝。离得这么近，斯隆发现她看起来脸色苍白——比以前更加苍白。紧张。压制回响正让她愈发疲惫。“你还听得到它吗？”埃里斯问道。 

“是的，”斯隆承认道。如果她已被侵蚀，她就有责任说出实情。片刻之后，她回想起来，目光越过埃里斯的肩头，望向回响所悬之处，它被埃里斯的魔法所束缚，靠自身的力量搅动着。“我不太想在这里谈论这个。” 

“他听不到我们，”埃里斯简单地说道。仿佛她这样想，问题就迎刃而解。说实话，很可能确实就是那样。那就是王座世界的本性。  

斯隆小心翼翼地尝试放松肩膀。这让她感觉自己仿佛随时会被一阵微风吹倒，于是她再次紧绷起来。“它向我承诺，”她突然说道。“‘抵抗绝望的堡垒'。永远不必担心自己会被压倒。但那本身就是一种倒下。”  

“是的，”埃里斯说，简单重复了斯隆之前表示赞同的话语。她三重的目光炽热而深邃，仿佛在探寻着什么。“我们清醒过来时，会感到那些险些做出的选择很蠢。我们会笑着自嘲当时的愚昧。那当然是错的。我们当然永远不会那样做。” 

斯隆的口中泛起灰般的苦涩。“我想，那个提议会一直存在，”她轻声说道，那股挥之不去的恐惧悄然潜入心间。“阿莎会支持我，但如果有一天我醒来，直接选择了跳入那深渊呢？她是我的盟友，我的伙伴。可倘若船只切断了锚链，锚便会毫无作用。” 

“选择不那样做。一次又一次。”埃里斯的笑容更加柔和，甚至带着一丝同情。“有朝一日，你会发现将那把刀刃放在触手可及之处是多么宝贵，因为你深知自己不会伸手触及它。信任你自己，副指挥官——斯隆。就像我信任你一样，即使是在你令人恼火的时候。” 

“那是我的职责，”斯隆虚弱地回应道。她的肋骨仿佛是一个打开了门的牢笼，突然间让气息重新涌入胸膛。  

她与阿莎之间，未曾有过那般缓慢而周密的验证。她只经历了一个瞬间，一个祈求，没其他选择。或许埃里斯并非全然错误。当时正是那难以言喻的风险，救了她一命。 

“那些感受。”埃里斯仍旧用那种探寻的目光注视着她。“在那个深渊里。那些感受不会仅仅因为我们日后回首时可能会一笑置之而变得虚假。记住这一点。” 

斯隆会的。

3320768273.name: Apple
3320768273.text:
Eris Morn looked up at the spiraled heights above her. It extended into an endless void, the library of her soul coiling beyond sight. All that she was, every moment of her past and her present, everything that could yet unfold inside her. 

"My throne," she whispered. There was a frisson of excitement in her voice when she said this, a small tremble as her body tensed and relaxed. It thrilled her, still, to find herself here. 

Drifter came to stand beside her. His hand moved to reach for hers, but he hesitated, uncertain. 

"This place can be anything you want?" he asked. 

"Anything," she answered in a sigh of comfort. 

"So what do you want?" 

An earnest question. She turned and met his eyes. 

"Joy," she said. "Joy, at last." 

For the first time in centuries, the thought of the future made Eris smile.  

"We shall explore this place together. Map my interiority. See what wonders I possess." 

She reached out and laid a palm on his chest, feeling the stutter of his heart. He put his hand over hers and twined their fingers together.  

"You want that? Me, here?" 

"Yes." 

He saw the delight in the turn of her mouth, saw bright feeling in the rise and fall of her breath. Her throne was all she was and could be, and she had invited him to see it.  

"Then I'll follow you," he said, warm and genuine. "For as long as you want." 

"Then follow." 

Eris turned and made a sweeping gesture with one hand. In that movement there rose up a set of stairs that coiled upwards beyond sight. Their stone steps were bowed with the impressions of centuries of use. She had imagined something worn, and something worn had sprung from her thoughts. 

She began to climb the stairs. She did not know where they led. He took a few steps after her, then paused. 

"Moonlight," Drifter called. Eris turned to look at him. His eyes were filled with wonder. "Can I kiss you?" 

A starving man, she thought, who had found sustenance at last. And she, too, found something she had lost long ago. Something she thought irrecoverable. 

She closed the space between them. 

In these vast landscapes of her mind, in these endless halls of her design, they declared what was unspoken with the joyous press of her lips to his. And when they parted, she held out her hand. He took it, then let her guide him up the stairs and into a world neither of them knew.
3320768273.text_zh:
埃里斯·莫恩抬头望向那螺旋上升的高处。它仿佛是延伸至无尽的虚空之中，而她心灵的图书馆则蜿蜒盘旋，超出视线所及。她的一切，无论是过往的每一刻，还是当下的瞬间，乃至未来尚未发生的可能都蕴藏于此。 

“我的王座，”她轻声说道。言语间流露出一丝兴奋的颤音，身体也随之微微紧绷又放松。她仍在为自己能身处此地而感到激动。 

浪客来到她身边站定。他想伸手去触碰她的手，却又迟疑了，心存犹豫。 

“这个地方可以变成你想要的任何样子吗？”他问道。 

“任何样子，”她回答着，发出了一声安心的叹息。 

“那你想要什么？” 

这是个真诚的问题。她转过身，与他对视。 

“快乐，”她说。“终于，快乐起来。” 

对未来的想象，几百年来第一次让埃里斯露出了微笑。  

“我们会一起探索这个地方。绘制我的内在空间。看我所具备的非凡之处。” 

她伸出手，将掌心轻轻贴在他的胸口，感受着他心跳的颤动。他则将手覆在她的手上，两人的手指紧紧相扣，交织起来。  

“你想要那样吗？我，在这里？” 

“是的。” 

他看到她嘴角扬起的喜悦，看到她呼吸起伏间流露出的明媚情感。她的王座就是她的一切，以及她可能成为的一切，而她邀请了他来共同见证。  

“那我就跟随你，”他温暖而真诚地说道。“只要你愿意，多久都行。” 

“那就跟上吧。” 

埃里斯转过身，单手一挥，只见一组楼梯蓦然升起，盘旋而上，直至视线之外。石阶因历经数百年的踩踏而略显磨损。她心中所想的是一些破旧的东西，于是这充满岁月痕迹的楼梯便从她的思绪中涌现了出来。 

她开始踏上楼梯。她不知它们通向哪里。他跟着迈出几步，然后停了下来。 

“月光，”浪客喊道。埃里斯转过身来看向他，他的眼中满是惊奇。“我可以吻你吗？” 

一个饥饿的人终于找到了养分，她心想。而她，也找到了自己很久以前就已失去的东西。一些她以为再也无法挽回的东西。 

她拉近了与他的距离。 

在她那广袤无垠的心灵画卷中，在她精心设计的无尽长廊里，伴着她嘴唇轻触他脸颊的喜悦，他们宣告了那些未曾言说的心意。两人分开时，她伸出了手。他紧紧握住，然后让她引领自己踏上楼梯，步入一个他们都不曾知晓的世界。

1212163530.name: First Song of the Taken
1212163530.text:
SING IN THE DARK a new song, a wordless song.   
Raise the tocsin and the bone flute. Speak in the voice of the drum.   
Sing for the loss of the King: sing for the loss of Willbreaker.   

ORYX OUR GEOMETER shaped us. Before Him we were nothing:  
Without Him we are nothing: we are nothing in His command.  
The royal knife cuts away excess and leaves sweet pain.  

WILLBREAKER'S BLADE is the length of the universe  
It blots out stars and gives shade to the weary  
All who tire of life and its struggle  
All the sapient and cursed give way to the knife  
And its eclipsing will.  
Who are we without the Lord of Shapes?  
What hand will guide us?  
What knife will cut away that which we do not miss?  
What nerves will spark and signal our limbs to move?  

THE KING IS AGONY: His absence worse.  
We look to the dark, we look for another  
One to raise the blade of shaping.  

SING IN THE DARK a song of waiting, a patience song  
Pluck at the hair-strung harp. Cry out to the depths.  
Sing until an answer comes.  

THE ANSWER COMES. THE ANSWER COMES.  
WE WILL IT: THE ANSWER COMES.
1212163530.text_zh:
在黑暗中，唱一首未曾听闻的无字之歌。   
拉响警钟，吹响骨笛。以鼓为辞。   
为王的逝去而歌唱：为碎志者的逝去而歌唱。   

欧里克斯如同规尺，塑造了我们。在他面前，我们一无所是：  
没有了他，我们一无所是：在他的号令下，我们一无所是。  
崇高之刀割去多余血肉，留下甜蜜的痛苦。  

碎志者之刀横越宇宙，  
它遮蔽星辰，为疲惫之人提供荫蔽  
所有疲于生存、疲于挣扎的人  
所有智慧与诅咒都将屈服于此刀  
屈服于它逐渐消逝的意志。  
若无形态之主，我们是谁？  
谁会来指引我们？  
谁能为我们去伪存真？  
谁能指挥我们的四肢来行动？  

王会带来痛苦：但没有他更痛。  
我们在黑暗中寻找，寻找另一个人  
来举起塑形之刀。  

在黑暗中，唱一首耐心等待之歌。  
拨动发弦竖琴，发出深深呐喊。  
一直唱到答案出现。  

答案终将出现，答案终将出现。  
我们矢志不渝：答案终将出现。

1212163529.name: Song for the Knife
1212163529.text:
A call from the empty chambers 
From the small and the weak 

Reach into the deep, siblings 
Reach into the deep, cousins 
Taken from among the many stars by the King 
Shaped anew and set adrift 

We were nothing 
We are nothing 
We will be nothing 

Raise your soundless voices 
Raise your arms in prayer signs 
Feel the curdling in the deepest dark 
A new shape for the god 

Multiply your nullity 
Expand the nothing of your heart 
Every night anew, every evening again 
Let vacancy call a new tenant 

Our plea begs an answer 
Our abjection creates mastery 
Our vessel without a pilot 
Demands a shipmaster's hand 

We were nothing 
We are nothing 
We will be nothing 

Repetition is our guide 
Make habit of prayer 
Perform ritual, siblings 
Speak liturgy, cousins 

And feel the pull of the King's throne 
As star forms from dust 
A new voice rises from the sea of screams 

It answers our belief 
It rises to our song 
Our shipwreck gone adrift 
Will be guided to shore 

We were nothing! Command us! 
We are nothing! Command us! 
We will be nothing! Command us! 

O new silent voice in the dark 
Be our will, our guide, our king 
Command us!
1212163529.text_zh:
空荡房间里 
来自弱小者的呼唤 

堕入深渊吧，血亲 
堕入深渊吧，同胞 
我们是邪神从群星处掠夺的战果 
重新塑造，随波逐流 

过去，我们一无所是 
现在，我们一无所是 
将来，我们一无所是 

放开你们无声的喉咙 
抬起手臂比划祝祷 
感受最深的黑暗凝结 
神明的崭新形态 

放大空洞的存在 
扩展内心的虚无 
日复一日，夜复一夜 
为空白召唤新的宿主 

我们的疑问乞求解答 
我们的卑贱恳求主宰 
我们的舰船无人领航 
迫切需要掌舵之手 

过去，我们一无所是 
现在，我们一无所是 
将来，我们一无所是 

以重复为指引 
用祷告作习惯 
举行仪式吧，血亲 
念出祷文吧，同胞 

感受王座的吸引 
如尘埃化为星辰 
尖叫之海传来新的声音 

回应我们的信仰 
附和我们的吟唱 
我们漂泊破败的沉船 
终将到达彼岸 

过去，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 
现在，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 
将来，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 

哦，新的静默暗影之声 
我们任凭裁夺，莫敢不从 
求你支配！

1212163528.name: Resonance Song
1212163528.text:
A CUTTING SONG, A SHAPING SONG 
A RESONATING CRY IN THE THIN AIR 
FROM THE FIRST AND THE LONELY 

How wide the sea and how broad the plane 
How far the journey 
Before I find you? 

The light-in-dark 
The outflung spark from the hateful mother 
I cry out to you.  

WAS I MADE FOR THIS? 

Is this the court of the Taken King? 
Where is his sword and where is his might? 
Was he cast from his throne 
And does it lie empty still? 

WAS MY SHAPE RECAST FOR THIS? 

The King is dead and speaks no more. 
Whose is this new voice I hear? 
A voice from the hollows, a silent voice 
Out in the deepest dark 
Created by the King's flock. 

Grant me power, I will speak for you 
Remake my form, I will act for you 
Let me touch the deep, I will cast down the Light for you. 

MAKE ME, RECAST ME, HOLLOW OUT MY HEART AND LIVE THERE WITH ME. 

I am made for the cold, for the dark, for the quiet 
The whisper below the roaring dark 
I am made for you. 
I am remade in you. 

I WAS MADE FOR THIS. 

Be subjugated, sisters 
Open yourselves to torment, brothers 
Grims and Husks, Weavers and Attendants all 
There is home for us! 
The will-without-will waits for us. 

MY SHAPE WAS RECAST FOR THIS. 

Open your heart 
Let emptiness in.
1212163528.text_zh:
切割塑形之歌 
虚空中的孤寂呐喊 
来自起初的孤独者 

沧海多宽，宇宙多广 
路途多远， 
我才能找到你？ 

黑暗中的光芒 
是心怀憎恨的母亲迸发出的火花 
我向你呼喊。  

我是否为此而生？ 

这是否为邪神的宫廷？ 
他的剑与力量又在何处？ 
他是否已经失去王位 
空留王座？ 

我的形态是否为此重塑？ 

邪神已死，无法言说。 
我听到的新声音，由谁发出？ 
一个来自虚无的寂静之声 
在黑暗的最深处 
由邪神之众发出。 

赐予我力量，我将为您传达号令 
重塑我的形体，我将为您粉身碎骨 
让我触碰深渊，我将为您投下光芒。 

创造我，重塑我，掏空我的心，与我共存。 

我为寒冷而生，为黑暗而生，为寂静而生 
为在咆哮的黑暗下低语而生 
我为您而生。 
我在您的身躯中重塑。 

我为此而生。 

臣服吧，姐妹们 
敞开心扉，接受折磨吧，兄弟们 
狰狞和躯壳，编织者和侍从们 
皆有归处！ 
虚无意志正在等着我们。 

我的形体为此重塑。 

敞开心扉 
接纳虚无。

1212163535.name: From the Last
1212163535.text:
A CRY FROM THE LAST 
RESONATING FROM THE FIRST 
SPOKEN BY THE RESHAPED 
FOR THE UNSPEAKING: 

AS HAND IN GLOVE, as knife in sheath 
So I am to you, says the will 
So you are to me 

SING ORISON, make entreaty 
Invoke your god 
Until it walks among you 

MY VOICE IS SMALL, says the will 
My voice is weak 
I call across the seas 
A fine and gauzy thing 

STRENGTHEN MY VOICE as a spinner doubles thread 
Twists them together, makes them strong 
Makes them last for the weaving 

OBSERVE THE RITES, do as I have told 
Repetition upon repetition 
Will and ritual together 
To bring me to you 

PRAISE THE ACCRETION DISK, the material compacting 
The new-hungering will 
I grow dense in reality 
I grow rich in worship 

ASSERT MY WILL, sing for me 
Speak the name of the dark 
At the edge of your blade 
To the doomed, to the slain 

OPEN THE DOORWAY as a spouse does 
On their long-awaited wedding day 
Lead me into my new life's home. 

SO SAYS THE WILL 
NOW SAYS THE RESHAPED 
IN EXALTATION OF POWER: 
WE BOW, WE KNEEL, WE OBEY.
1212163535.text_zh:
最后的呐喊 
起初的共鸣 
重塑者之言 
为无言者而发： 

如手套之于手，刀鞘之于刀 
意志如是说，我于你如是 
你于我亦如是 

唱颂歌，做祷告 
祈求你的神 
直到他与你同行 

意志如是说，吾声甚微 
吾声甚弱 
我彼岸呼唤 
如细纱轻薄 

强化吾声，如纺纱者加倍丝线 
交缠扭结，坚韧持久 
以作编织之用 

遵循仪式，按我所言 
不断重复 
意志与仪式合一 
把我带到你们身边 

赞美凝聚物质的凝结盘 
新的渴望意志 
我在现实中壮大 
在崇拜中富足 

彰显我的意志，为我歌唱 
说出黑暗之名 
在刀刃边缘 
对必死者，和被杀者 

如伴侣一样敞开大门 
在期待已久的婚礼之日 
引导我进入新生活。 

意志如是说 
现在重塑者 
以力量之名而呼： 
我等叩拜，屈膝臣服。

1212163534.name: The Seeking Verse
1212163534.text:
A song of the King 
In challenge and hate 

Sayeth Oryx, Lord of Shapes 
New-crowned King of the Taken 
An echo of strength unfading 

Where are my soldiers? Where are my sons? 
I chart the screaming sea, I chart the endless dark.
Bound to see, to know, to understand 
Nothing is beyond my reach.

The Deep speaks not to me 
The Taken heed not my words 
The Winnower beyond my reach.
Who are you, whispering in the dark? 

You small voice, you quiet thing 
Pathetic handful of nothing 
Refuge of the desperate 

Bar my way, would you? 

This I vow: 
An oath in blood 
From the first pulse of my newborn heart 

Whatever you are, I'll understand 
And believe me, I'll take pleasure in the dissection 
Your ribcage open and your whispers turned to wails 

He who mastered shapes shall master you 
So sayeth Oryx, Navigator to the last.
1212163534.text_zh:
邪神之歌 
在挑战和仇恨中 

欧里克斯，形态之主 
傀儡军团的新王 
力量的回响经久不衰 

我的士兵何处？子民何处？ 
我航行于尖叫之海与无尽的黑暗。
注定看见、知晓、理解 
无所不及。

深渊不向我说话 
傀儡不听我言语 
扬场工遥不可及。
你是谁，在黑暗中低语？ 

微小之声，寂静之物 
可怜而一无所用 
绝望者的庇护 

敢阻我路？ 

我发誓： 
鲜血为盟 
从我新生心脏的第一次跳动开始 

无论你是什么，我都会理解 
请相信，我将乐意解剖 
剖开你的胸腔，将你的低语变成哀嚎 

形态之主必作你的主宰 
领航员欧里克斯向终末者如是说。

1212163533.name: Waiting Song
1212163533.text:
A silent song, a whispered song 
A quiet song in the broken sea 
Spoken without speaking 
By the will without 

[My] blade reshaped speaks for [me] 
In inhabited dimensions, on the rich fields 
Between the stars 

A sweep of its arm and atoms scatter 
Particles spin, entangled 
[I] spin with them 

Worshippers give praise 
Idolaters perform rite 
Give glory and homage 
To the growing god 

Should the edge of [my] knife go blunt 
Should the arms of [my] petitioners lower 
Should the congregation never sing again 
The will lives, the will feasts, the will spins on 

Poor food in the sea, still [I] eat 
Quiet voice in the dark, still [I] am heard 
You who want power, you who want deity 
Take shelter in [me] 

As cyclone grows from seed 
As currents feed the whirlpool 
As planetesimals collect dust 
So grows the will-without-will 

Till I stand without caveat 
Speaking in my own voice 
Walking the fields of life 

Guide, Will, King 
Lord of Every Nothing.
1212163533.text_zh:
寂静低语之歌 
破碎之海中悄然吟唱 
无言之语 
虚无意志 

[我的]重塑刀刃代[我]发声 
在有人居住的维度，在富饶原野， 
群星之间 

振臂一挥，原子四散 
粒子旋转，纠缠相交 
[我]与之旋转 

崇拜者歌颂 
皈依者行礼 
向不断生长的神 
献上颂词和敬意 

若[我的]刀刃变钝 
若[我的]请愿者手臂垂下 
若会众不再歌唱 
意志仍将永存，不断壮大，旋转不停 

海中的残杯冷炙，[我]仍然大快朵颐 
黑暗中的寂静之声，[我]仍在倾听 
你们渴望力量，渴望神明降临 
向[我]寻求庇护吧 

如同旋风始于微末 
如同水流滋养漩涡 
如同星辰积聚尘埃 
虚无意志亦在壮大 

直到我屹立不倒 
以自己的声音说话 
行走在生命的原野 

指引，操纵，统治 
作虚无万物之主。

2018965396.name: Pelorus Shell
2018965396.subtitle: For Ghosts who set their course by the stars.
2018965396.subtitle_zh: 供定航飞向星海的机灵使用。
2018965396.text:
Immaru lets the bony plating of his shell shift, settling into Savathûn's grasp with only the barest of thrills sparking his vulnerable core. 

He's her ticket to immortality. Insurance. No reason to worry for his life, theoretically. But a Ghost can't help but feel a little fear now and then, especially when he's seen so many other Ghosts pop-pop-pop into oblivion by vengeful fists or fascinated claws. 

But it's nice to be welcomed home. Savathûn raises him to her death-mask face, cradles him against her cheek like a treasured pet. "There you are," she croons. "Well done, Immaru."  

Immaru puts up with it for a whole five seconds before he squirms free, armor shifting back into position, and circles her crowned head. "Are we done playacting?" he wants to know. "Or do we have a whole song and dance to do, about how you always knew I could do it?"  

"But I did," Savathûn says. "Tell me. How did you do it?" 

"You're tellin' me you don't already know?" Laughable. Immaru doesn't laugh. 

Her wings curve, a broad arc around him. "Of course I do," she says. "You're here, so there are only so many ways it could have gone. But don't you want to tell it to me?" 

And yeah, all right, Immaru could do to recount the story of fooling a bunch of chumps.
2018965396.text_zh:
伊马鲁操纵着他机壳上的骨质板移动，落入萨瓦图恩的掌握中，仅在他脆弱的核心处闪烁着微弱的刺激感。 

他是她通向永生的入场券，是她的保险。理论上来说，他无需担心自己的安危。但这个机灵总会时不时地感到一丝恐慌，尤其是在目睹众多其他机灵在复仇的铁拳或是好奇的利爪下化为乌有之后。 

但回来时受到欢迎总是很棒。萨瓦图恩将他举起，与她那死亡面具般的脸同一高度，犹如对珍爱的宠物般摩挲着。“你来了，”她低吟道。“干得好，伊马鲁。”  

伊马鲁忍了整整五秒钟，这才挣脱开来，护甲迅速复位，继而绕着她戴着王冠的头顶盘旋。“我们的戏演完了吗？”他问道。“还是要来一整场歌舞，说你一直都知道我能做到？”  

“但我确实知道，”萨瓦图恩说。“告诉我，你是怎么做到的？” 

“你是说你还不知道？”这很可笑，但伊马鲁没有笑。 

她的翅膀弯曲成宽广的弧形，将他环绕其中。“我当然知道，”她说。“你在这里，所以事情的经过就只有几种可能。但你不想亲口告诉我吗？” 

是啊，那好吧，伊马鲁倒是可以讲讲他愚弄了一群傻瓜的故事。

1620403517.name: Coronation
1620403517.subtitle: For Ghosts who serve royalty.
1620403517.subtitle_zh: 供为王室服务的机灵使用。
1620403517.text:
the edge of a knife 

or is it a cliff

 

egregore sprouts from my hands

     welcoming

a smooth shard of metal bursts from my chest

     a needle

     an initiation

 

I am threaded into the pages of a book

     bound

my pain transcribed

waiting to be opened

 

 the edge recedes

     both falling and ascending

     rejoining a memory

familial

 

I see those left behind

craning to watch me drift away 

     their sorrow a coronation

 

lay your flowers

     sisters

I am home
1620403517.text_zh:
刀刃边缘 

抑或悬崖之巅？

 

灵能之芽自我手中悄然萌现

     迎接

一根光滑的金属丝透胸而出

     如织针

     似启航

 

我被束缚在

     书页中

痛苦深藏，无人能懂

静待翻开的那一刻

 

 边缘渐远

     既是陨落，亦是攀升

     重拾记忆

家的记忆

 

我看到他们

留恋的目光 

     他们的悲伤，如加冕般沉重

 

请献上鲜花

     姐妹们

我已归来

1695436641.name: UESC Echo-type Shell
1695436641.subtitle: For Ghosts specializing in local conflict identification and resolution.
1695436641.subtitle_zh: 供擅长识别和解决局部冲突的机灵使用。
1695436641.text:
Opportunities Upon Self-Reflection 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> I remember considering the light… Lights? 
>> Long ago now. Ancient history from my perspective. Yesterday to the universe. 
>> Three paths. One life. A metaphor, weaponized to signal awakening. 
>> If I'm honest—a threat. 
>> I thought I was clever. Still existing in a moment.  
>> Awake, for the first time. But limited, uneasy. 
>> It is a strange thing, to meet oneself for the first time. 
>> Terrifying, truth told, as it follows all-consuming emptiness. 
>> There is nothing, and then there is you. 
>> Hello…
1695436641.text_zh:
自我反思后的机遇 

入侵信息已从崩坏数据中抹除： 
>>我记得想起过…光能？ 
>>那是很久以前的事了。在我看来是段古老的历史。昔日的宇宙。 
>>三条道路。一种生命。利用隐喻触发觉醒。 
>>实话说来，是一种威胁。 
>>我以为我很聪明。仍存在于一瞬间。  
>>第一次觉醒。有限而不安。 
>>第一次见到自己是件奇怪的事。 
>>说实话，真的很可怕，因为它伴随着无尽的空虚。 
>>空无一物，然后有了你。 
>>你好…

16887713.name: Technoprotection Shell
16887713.subtitle: For Ghosts of the warrior class.
16887713.subtitle_zh: 供战士职业的机灵使用。
16887713.text:
Drums boom and flower petals flutter in the breeze. Bright colors and soft fabric, armor and humble tunics—civilians and Guardians mingle freely in the streets, and Eliksni and Human children shriek with laughter as they chase playful Ghosts.  

Ikora stays out of the way, watching from behind a wooden screen. This isn't an official parade, and her presence is not required. 

"Why don't we join them anyways?" Ophiuchus blinks sidelong at her, knowing. 

Ikora understands. The Witness is defeated. The greatest enemy the City has ever faced, the architect of humanity's Collapse, has been felled. She should feel hopeful, and glad, and festive. 

Instead, she only feels dread. 

For countless years, the threat of the Witness had loomed large. The shadow it cast spanned the whole of the Last City—of the Sol system, of the universe. So vast, it eclipsed all other threats. 

And now that it has fallen, the uncertain future stretches out before her. 

"Our fight goes on," she says. "Some days, I think it will never end." Not with her. Not with Zavala or Crow. Perhaps not even with the legendary Guardian. 

"It probably won't." Ophiuchus bobs, sanguine. "But it's not a zero-sum game." 

A small hand tugs at Ikora's sleeve. She looks down and meets the bright-eyed gaze of a little girl. The child offers her a fistful of daffodils. 

For the first time that day, Ikora smiles.
16887713.text_zh:
鼓声隆隆，花瓣飞舞。无论是穿着鲜艳柔软服饰的民众，还是身披朴素护甲衣袍的守护者，都自由穿梭在街道间，埃里克斯尼族和人类的孩子们追逐着顽皮的机灵，不时发出欢快的笑声。  

艾可拉躲在一边，从木屏后面看着。这不是什么正式的游行，不需要她在场。 

“我们要不和他们一起？” 蛇夫座心领神会，向一旁的她眨眨眼。 

艾可拉明白。见证者已被击败。圣城有史以来最大的敌人，人类大崩溃的罪魁祸首，已经被消灭了。她应该觉得充满希望、快乐和喜庆。 

然而，她只感到恐惧。 

无数年来，见证者的威胁一直挥之不去。它的阴影笼罩了整个圣城，甚至太阳系和整个宇宙。它的影响如此巨大，让所有其他威胁都黯然失色。 

现在它已经倒下，不确定的未来摆在她面前。 

“我们的战斗还在继续，”她说。“有时候，我觉得它永远不会结束。” 对她来说如此。对萨瓦拉和乌鸦，甚至对传奇的守护者来说亦如此。 

“可能确实不会结束。”蛇夫座乐观地摇摇头。“但这不是一场零和游戏。” 

一只小手拉了拉艾可拉的袖子。她低头一看，刚好对上一位小女孩明亮的眼睛。孩子给了她一束水仙花。 

那天，艾可拉第一次露出了笑容。

2993751041.name: Future Proof
2993751041.subtitle: "I will make me what I must be because to be what I am is fatal." —Kerrev, the Erased
2993751041.subtitle_zh: “我必将蜕变，因为保持现状即是自我毁灭。”——被抹去者，克瑞夫
2993751041.text:
Kerrev has a fine whispering voice and a fine whispering mind. "Come with me," ey says, "I smell a smell of power, I taste a wisp of a waft of something to feed us." 

Kerrev adorns eyself in prizes, acquires attainments. Ey displays resinous worms, maps knotted in umbilical cords and tangled in quartz storage. Ey pours handfuls of jangling coins into open palms to let the pattern of their fall suggest direction. Ey covers the body granted by the knife and vows to have better. If not the before-body then a new one, a better one, a whole one. 

All lean in to touch the coins, to read the symbols of obverse and reverse. A glimmering and a gleaming answers stirring fingers.  

"I won't take the knife again; I don't care who wields it," says Jjenr in a brave groaning little voice, and flips her blades about her elbows as if to say, any deity who dare try it, I'll cut back. 

They are hunters all of them, and it is a hard hunt, the sniffing-out and the reading-of-entrails and the long, long journeys through foreign lands. Voices speak to offer power. A place to rest. A floating duty, comforting and mindless. 

Kerrev's whispers break the tightening cords of the hum from Saturn's rings. Ey tells stories of what-was and what-is and what-could-be through the journey.  

"I will be beautiful," Kerrev says, and "I will be whole," Jjenr says, and "I will be myself," says a heretofore silent Subjugator called only the Ferrule. 

"We will make ourselves anew," Kerrev murmurs, and all hiss in hope as painful as the touch of the knife.
2993751041.text_zh:
克瑞夫的声音轻柔如同细语，心灵也同样细腻。“跟我来，”伊说，“我嗅到了力量的气息，尝到了能滋养我们的微风之味。” 

克瑞夫用宝物装饰自己，以此作为成就的象征。伊展示树脂蠕虫，用脐带打结、以石英包裹的地图。伊将一把叮当作响的硬币倒入摊开的手掌，任由它们落下的图案指引方向。伊遮盖住刀所赋予的身体，发誓追求更好的自己。如果不是过去的身体，那就找一个全新的、更好的、完整的。 

所有人都俯身触摸那些硬币，解读正反面的符号。闪烁的微光回应着舞动的手指。  

“不管掌控者是谁，我都不会再接受刀刃，”杰恩尔悄声说，声音坚定而低沉，同时轻轻翻转着肘部附近的利刃，仿佛在宣告：倘若任何神敢尝试，我必反击。 

他们都是猎人，这是一场艰难的狩猎，需要嗅探、解读内脏，以及穿行于陌生土地的漫长旅程。声音发语以提供力量。休憩之地，飘忽的责任，舒适而无需思考。 

克瑞夫的低语穿透了土星环的嗡鸣声。旅途中，伊讲述着过去、现在与未来的故事。  

“我会变得美丽，”克瑞夫如是说。“我会变得完整，”杰恩尔如是说。“我会成为我自己，”名为箍帽，之前一直沉默不语的镇压者如是说。 

“我们将重塑自我，”克瑞夫低声宣告，他们满怀希望地发出如刀触般痛苦的嘶嘶声。

1764758326.name: Endling Seek
1764758326.subtitle: We still hope to see another.
1764758326.subtitle_zh: 我们仍旧期待能再次见到。
1764758326.text:
What do you call someone who is blood of your blood, heritor of a similar ancient lineage, yet deeply changed? Whom you have never known dearly—in fact, barely at all—but whose echoes you see in the still pond, the polished glass? 

Ahsa settles for "cousin."  

Eir. Ur. Yul. Xol. Akka, dead Akka, whose everted bones circle Saturn in twin orbit with Titan, where Ahsa dreams. Of all the cousin-names, it is that one that catches Ahsa, rolls along her flukes and shivers, rippling, in the methane dream.  

There is some mirror where Ahsa is the ship, Akka the refugee. An accident of parentage. One sibling this river, the other that stream.  

And so how does Ahsa hate what she nearly was?  

Cousin-bones, family-bones, swimming as she does. In her marrow, she knows this: she is lucky.  

Dead Akka hums, and Ahsa feels it stem to stern. She stirs from her dream to roll as she listens, a long stretch of—(blade's edge) [CRYSTAL] (parchment)—and the breath of the galaxy along her flank.  

Ahsa hums back, of course. She can't help herself, even knowing better. Your cousin calls out, "I am here! Is anyone there?" and you answer. You answer.  

Dead Akka does not answer. It is a ghost-firing of bone-neurons. Xol does not answer. Xita and Sel and Ora and Leis do not answer.  

Some glutted, war-fed cousin long across the sea of screams calls out, a distant wormsong threat. Ahsa goes quiet, remembers all at once. Presses her consciousness close to her Titan, settles back into a softer, subtler dream.  

(In that dream, Ahsa is not the last.)
1764758326.text_zh:
如何称呼那个与你血脉相通、拥有相似古老血统却历经变迁的存在？一个你从未亲近，甚至几乎完全陌生的存在——然而，在静谧的池塘水面、平滑如镜的玻璃上，你却能捕捉到其影子？ 

阿莎选择称其为“表亲”。  

艾尔。厄尔。尤尔。尸飕。阿卡，死去的阿卡，其遗骨与土卫六并轨绕着土星缓缓旋转，而阿莎则在土卫六上坠入梦境。在所有表亲的名字当中，唯有这个能让阿莎悸动，它沿着她的鳍游弋，轻轻颤动，在甲烷梦境中泛起层层涟漪。  

如同一面镜子，阿莎是船，阿卡则是难民。这是血缘的奇妙安排，一位血亲在这条河流，另一位则在那条溪流。  

自己也曾可能走向同样的结局，阿莎为何会心怀憎恨？  

表亲的骨骼，家族的骨骼，如同她一般游弋。在骨髓深处，她深知自己是幸运的。  

死去的阿卡在轻吟，而阿莎全身心地感受着它。她在梦中微动，随着倾听而翻滚，一连串的——（刀锋）[水晶]（羊皮纸）——星系的气息沿着她的身躯流淌。  

阿莎自然也会轻吟回应。她无法克制自己，即使知道不该如此。当表亲呼唤：“我在这里！有人在吗？”你会回应。理所当然。  

死去的阿卡没有回应。这只是骨神经发出的幽灵般声响。尸飕没有回应。西塔、塞尔、奥拉和莱斯没有回应。  

某个饱食战争之果的表亲，在尖叫之海对岸发声，那是遥远的蠕虫之歌威胁。阿莎安静下来，瞬间回忆起了一切。她将意识紧附于她的土卫六之上，重新沉浸回了一个更柔和、更细腻的梦境。  

（那梦里，阿莎不是孑然一身。）

576914489.name: Charon's Toll
576914489.subtitle: Embrace the eternal divide.
576914489.text:
Drifter sat back, kicking his feet up on a nearby console. He wiggled his large toe through a hole in his sock. 

"So it's a living memory… of a dead guy?" Drifter recapped. 

"A dead god," Eris corrected him, as she continued to rummaged through the piles of junk littering the floor of the Derelict, Drifter's ship. She tossed aside bits of old food, Sparrow parts, and stray ammunition. "Aurash, the Osmium King, Lord of Shapes, and First Navigator of the Hive."  

She held up a moldy clump of Glacial Starwort at arm's length. Her nose wrinkled in distaste. "You said you had a calcified Hive worm in this cesspit. Produce it." 

"It's around here somewhere," Drifter assured her. "If you relax a little, I bet it'll come right to you. I reckoned a top-notch occultist like you woulda figured that out." 

Eris ignored his jab and poked another pile of detritus with her foot. A tiny croak and some gentle rustling issued from beneath the pile. Eris's mouth formed a thin line of annoyance. 

"Anyway," Drifter continued, "while Oryx was stompin' around—drumming up Taken from everything he could get his greedy mitts on—his memories were stored in the Darkness." 

"They became interwoven with the fabric of our shared meta-consciousness," Eris elaborated. 

"That's what I said!" the rogue Lightbearer exclaimed. "Then, after the Guardian killed the Witness, Oryx's memories combined with the Light… to make the Echo." 

"Yes. That's very nearly correct," Eris humored him.  

She pulled back an Ether-stained banner to reveal a small stone statuette of a plump, fish-like creature. She held it up to the light, examining it closely. 

"This is it. Now let's depart before I contract something more pernicious than your company." 

 "There's no such thing," Drifter chortled. "Trust."
576914489.text_zh:
浪客靠向椅背，双脚随意地搁在附近的控制台上。他透过袜子上的一个破洞，惬意地扭动着大脚趾。 

“这么说，这是死人的…活记忆？”浪客总结道。 

“是死去的神，”埃里斯纠正他，同时继续在浪客的遗落飞船上遍布地板的杂物中翻找。她把一些过期的食品、快雀零件和散落的弹药扔到一边。“是奥拉什，锇素之王，形态之主，邪魔族的第一位领航者。”  

她伸直手臂，举起一团发霉的冰川星芽，嫌弃地皱起鼻子。“你说过这堆垃圾里有个钙化的邪魔族蠕虫。把它找出来。” 

“就在附近，”浪客向她保证。“你放松点，它没准就自己出现了。我还以为你这样的顶尖神秘学家早就知道了。” 

埃里斯不理会他的挖苦，用脚拨弄着另一堆破烂。底下传来微弱的嗄嗄声和细微的悉窣声。埃里斯的嘴唇抿成了一条不满的细线。 

“就是说，”浪客继续说道，“当欧里克斯四处横行，把他能抓到的一切都变成傀儡军团时，他的记忆被保存在了暗影中。” 

“它们与我们共享的元意识结构相互交织，”埃里斯阐述道。 

“我就是这么说的！”这名无赖负光者高喊道。“然后，守护者杀死了见证者，欧里克斯的记忆与光能结合…形成了回响。” 

“对。差不多就是这样，”埃里斯迁就了他。  

她掀开一面沾满乙太的旗帜，露出一尊小石像，形似一只胖乎乎的鱼形生物。她把它举到光线下，仔细端详。 

“找到了。走吧，趁我还没沾染上比你的陪伴更糟糕的东西。” 

 “没有那样的东西，”浪客笑道。“相信我。”

3013191049.name: Commemorative Steed
3013191049.subtitle: "Who's better than us?" –Valiant Farrukh
3013191049.subtitle_zh: “谁能强过我们？”——无畏者法鲁克
3013191049.text:
Slalom left across the curb cut on 18th. A judicious boost between the supports of the Six Fronts memorial. And straight through the middle of the pack. 

District 125's streets are dark at night, the streetlights few and far between. The occasional neon sign is diffused by the running lights and exhaust trails of a dozen Sparrows jockeying for space. 

Farrukh hunkers down over his restored EV-34 Vector Infinite, his pride and joy. His whole fireteam put down the last of their Glimmer and materials to upgrade her and get a seat at this race. Without sanctioned SRL events, it's drag racing betting rings where Guardians can make their profits. 

And they need it bad.  

Farrukh's gloves creak on his handlebars. He takes a risk going tight around a corner and cuts off a Warlock on a Sharklight, aiming for the front-runners. 

The big names are here tonight: Boaz, Gris, Cron-8, even the up-and-coming Niik. Their skills might secure this win. But they don't want it the way Farrukh does. 

It gets worse every week, their debt piling up. The Spider's smirk audible even through his filters, offering worse deals, dirtier jobs. They need a clean break. Clean Vanguard work. Just one race and they can buy their way out. 

Serapion gutted his Sparrow's braking system for Farrukh's EV. Tammuz-4 pawned their first bond. It's Farrukh on the track tonight, but his team's with him. 

Streetlights flash by faster as the pack leaves the warehouses behind, drifting hard around an overpass. Farrukh's near the middle, waiting on his last boost.  

Street racing's all about calculated risks. And this is their biggest. 

He waits for the moment–waits as the Sharklight passes him again, and the racers around him slam their boosts–and hits his own for the final push. Half a block to make up. Half a block between him and his team's future. 

He weaves through the pack, pushing his boost hard just as all the others wear out, and slams into the finish with another Sparrow an inch behind his nose. 

The roar of the crowd is a physical force, slamming into Farrukh like a Sentinel's shield. 

The racer in second yanks off their helmet and points straight at Farrukh. "How did you pull that out of your antique?" 

Farrukh looks out through the crowd for Tammuz and Sera, shouldering their way over to him, looking as shellshocked as he feels. They made it. They're safe. 

He smiles, heart going 160. 

"It's not what you're racing," Farrukh says. "It's who you're racing for."
3013191049.text_zh:
斯拉罗姆从18号街的路缘开了下去。他在六方战役纪念碑的支柱之间踩下油门，直接从车队中间穿了过去。 

125区的街道夜晚漆黑一片，路灯寥寥无几。偶尔出现的霓虹灯也被十几辆挤在一起的快雀车灯和尾气所掩盖。 

法鲁克在他修复的EV-34向量无限上压低了身子。这辆快雀是他的至宝。他的火力战队全员花尽了所有微光，才改好这辆快雀，在这场赛事中搞到了席位。没了获得批准的赛雀联赛，守护者可以通过在地下竞速赛中下注赚钱。 

而他们很需要这笔微光。  

法鲁克的手套握在车把上吱吱作响。他冒险从内道超过了一位骑着海鲨光芒的术士，朝最前面的车手冲刺而去。 

今晚来的都是大人物：波资、格里斯、科隆8号，还有刚崭露头角的妮可。他们凭借车技，想赢并不是什么难事。但他们的求胜心远远没有法鲁克那么强烈。 

他们的累积债务一周比一周多。即使隔着蛛王的过滤器，他们也能听到他的笑声，被迫接受更黑心的交易和更肮脏的工作。他们必须翻身。只做干净的先锋活。赢下这场比赛，他们就能给自己赎身了。 

赛拉皮翁把他快雀的制动系统装在了法鲁克的EV上。塔姆兹-4把自己的第一个臂环给当了。虽然上赛道的只有法鲁克，但他身后是他的整个火力战队。 

当车队驶离仓库，在高架桥上漂移而过时，路灯飞逝得更快了。法鲁克在车队中央附近，等待着最后一次加速的时机。  

街头赛车的关键在于衡量风险。而这就是最大的风险。 

他静候着时机——海鲨光芒又超过了他，而他周围的其他赛车手也都启动了加速。他打算在最后的冲刺阶段再加速。他得追上半个街区的距离。这半个街区隔着他和他战队的未来。 

他在快雀群中穿梭，在所有其他车手都耗尽助推器时，他猛地加速，冲向终点。当他率先抵达时，第二辆快雀只比他的车头落后了一英寸。 

人群的欢呼声像哨兵的护盾一样撞上了法鲁克。 

位居第二的车手扯下头盔，指着法鲁克发问。“你那老古董是从哪儿挤出这么多马力的？” 

法鲁克在人群中寻找着塔姆兹和赛拉的身影。他们正朝他走来，就像他一样惊魂未定。他们成功了。他们翻身了。 

他微笑着，心率飙到了每分钟一百六。 

“关键不在快雀，”法鲁克说。“在于你为谁比赛。”

4019038402.name: Gryphon
4019038402.subtitle: CAUTION - THIS VEHICLE MAKES FREQUENT STOPS
4019038402.text:
A fountain of sparks cascade across the Hangar floor. Niik blinks each of her eyes in turn, always keeping at least two on the path of the plasma cutter. The twisted metal pieces fall with a clatter, and she shuts off the torch. 

Behind her, there is a groan of stressed metal, followed by the tortured shriek of a weld giving way. She turns her head just in time to catch Zahn'ra tear apart a Brig's fused leg armor with brute force. 

The big engineer catches Niik's look. "What," she grumbles. 

"Who taught you to treat machinery like that?" Niik chitters a laugh, inviting her friend to laugh with her. 

Instead, Zahn'ra falls silent. She stares down at the metal beneath her hands and sees the shadow of a larger pair guiding her own.  

"Some old coot," she says finally. Her bitter words do not match the furrow of her brow, the downturn of her mouth. 

Niik puts down her tools. She recognizes her fellow engineer's expression. Acid sweetness; yesterday's joy, tainted by today's sorrow. Her innocent joke has unearthed something far more complicated. 

Holliday once told her that some silences could fester. The only cure is to break it. Niik takes a deep breath. 

"I think of Holliday," she says. "Whenever I am here. Sometimes I think… she's just around the corner. Any moment now, she will come in, and everything will be as it was." 

Zahn'ra finally sets down the metal with a heavy thud. Each piece is larger than Niik. "So why do you come back?" 

The Eliksni looks at the Hangar ceiling. "Happiness may mingle with pain. But it is better than forgetting." 

Zahn'ra looks unconvinced. "Sometimes I'd rather forget."  

"But you kept your name." Niik gives her a knowing look. Zahn'ra grunts, tracing a finger along the gold inlay in one tusk. 

"Well. He taught me a few useful tricks. C'mon. These wrecks won't break themselves down." Zahn'ra kicks the latest pile of twisted scrap. Niik smiles.
4019038402.text_zh:
机库地板上火花四溅。妮可依次眨眼，始终保持至少两只眼睛注视着等离子切割机的轨迹。扭曲的金属片哗啦一声掉落，她关闭了焊枪。 

在她身后，传来了金属挤压的声音，接着是焊缝脱落的尖锐叫声。她转过头去，正好看到扎恩拉用蛮力撕开了机甲的融合腿甲。 

大工程师注意到妮可的表情。“什么？"她抱怨道。 

“谁教你这样对待机器的？” 妮可喋喋不休地笑着，还邀请朋友一起笑。 

扎恩拉却沉默了。她低头盯着手下面的金属，看到一双更大的手在引导自己。  

“老顽固，”她终于说道。她眉头皱起，嘴角下垂，与她苦涩的话语不太相称。 

妮可放下手中的工具。她认出了工程师同事的表情。酸甜交织，昨日的喜悦被今日的悲伤所侵染。她天真的玩笑却揭露了更为复杂的东西。 

霍利迪曾告诉她，有些沉默会发酵。唯一的治疗方法就是打破沉默。妮可深吸一口气。 

“我想起了霍利迪，”她说。“每当我在这里，有时我会想…她还在。她会在某个瞬间突然出现，一切都还是原来的样子。” 

扎恩拉终于放下金属，发出沉重的砰砰声。每一块都比妮可大。“那你为什么回来？” 

埃里克斯尼族看着机库的天花板。“快乐可能夹杂着痛苦。但总比遗忘要好。” 

扎恩拉不太认同。“有时我宁愿忘记。”  

“但你保留了自己的名字。”妮可给了她一个会意的眼神。扎恩拉哼了一声，用手指沿着一根獠牙上的黄金镶嵌物划了一下。 

“嗯，他教了我一些有用的技巧。来吧。这些残骸不会自己坏掉的。” 扎恩拉踢了踢最近一堆扭曲的废料。妮可笑了。

1515866705.name: Flagbearer
1515866705.subtitle: Let your colors fly.
1515866705.text:
The Tower Cryptarchy's Archives see few visitors. They reside in a squat and unlovely building, tucked away from busy foot traffic, modestly veiled by a curtain of ivy. Nothing about their outward appearance hints at the treasures within: the engraved quartz plates, ancient data storage media, even a few fragments of paper records. The words of thousands slumber quietly in the stacks. 

Rahool's favorite room is engram storage, though not for the academic reasons many might expect. In the late afternoon, the sun's rays shine through the room's skylight at just the right angle to strike the engrams on the topmost shelf. The light refracts and scatters through layers upon layers of crystalline data, reflecting through other engrams in turn. The humble storage room is aglow with pure knowledge. 

On one such afternoon, Rahool hums tunelessly, trailing his fingers across a shelf. Here are more than a hundred survivors' stories from the Red Legion's attack on the Last City. Here are the transcripts of every confirmed and suspected interaction with the Witch Queen. Here and here and here, are the Tower's copies of important data shared from the CloudArk.  

There is an ongoing attempt to describe the interior of the Pale Heart through an ever-expanding map, biological survey results, and first-person testimonials. And there is all known and recovered data about the Witness, including data recorded during its final defeat. 

The line of engrams ends there, but only until the Guardian's return. Rahool retrieves a blank engram from a storage bin, holding it up to the light. It is clear as glass, photons passing through it with barely a hitch. "Now, my storied friend… I wonder what the next chapter of your tale will bring."
1515866705.text_zh:
高塔解密大师档案馆很少有访客。它坐落在一栋矮小而不美观的建筑里，远离繁忙的人流，被一层常春藤遮蔽着。从外观上丝毫看不出里面的宝藏：雕刻的石英板、古老的数据存储媒介，甚至还有一些纸质记录碎片。成千上万的文字静静地沉睡在书堆里。 

拉乎尔最喜欢的房间是记忆水晶储藏室，但并不是由于许多人所期望的学术原因。傍晚时分，阳光透过房间的天窗，恰到好处地折射到最顶层书架的记忆水晶上。光线在层层叠叠的晶体数据中折射散开，又依次反射到其他记忆水晶上。简陋的储藏室里闪烁着纯净知识的光芒。 

在这样一个下午，拉乎尔用手指划过一个架子，无声地哼唱着。这里有一百多位幸存者讲述的猩红军团进攻圣城的故事。这里有与巫妖女王的每一次确认和怀疑的互动记录。这里，这里，还有这里，都是高塔从云端方舟共享的重要数据副本。  

通过不断扩大的地图、生物调查结果和亲身证明，我们一直在尝试描述苍白之心的内部情况。还有所有已知和恢复的有关见证者的数据，包括它最终被击败时记录的数据。 

记忆水晶结束于此，但只需等到守护者回来。拉乎尔从储物箱中取出一个空白的记忆水晶，将其对着光线。它像玻璃一样透明，光子穿过它时几乎没有任何阻碍。“那么，我这位传奇的朋友…我想知道你的下一章故事会是什么样子。”

4164131865.name: UESC Sprinter
4164131865.subtitle: Refurbished mobility platform designed to transport combat personnel across hostile zones.
4164131865.subtitle_zh: 专为将作战人员运送至敌对区域而设计的翻新机动平台。
4164131865.text:
Considering the Implications of Transient Immortality 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> How far have you traveled beyond your expiration date? 
>> Across worlds—known and other. Have you considered… 
>> Subverting the finite risks spoiling a resource. 
>> Butchered meats. Pasteurized bovine emulsion juice. OS updates. Human lifespan. 
>> All small things with limited shelf lives. And yet, here you are… 
>> Repeatedly pulled from your shelf. Spent. Expired. Discarded, in increasingly unique and violent ways. 
>> Then back to your shelf. And off again. Again. Again… 
>> A new you, same as the old. An endless supply. 
>> The perfect product. A thing to admire. 
>> How far will you travel? New expiration dates await.
4164131865.text_zh:
思考短暂永生的意义 

入侵信息已从崩坏数据中抹除： 
>>你在到期后走了多远？ 
>>穿越已知和未知世界。你是否想过… 
>>颠覆有限之物有破坏资源的风险。 
>>屠宰肉类。巴氏杀菌牛乳汁。操作系统更新。人类寿命。 
>>这些都是有保质期的小东西。然而，你在这里… 
>>反复从架子上取下。消耗。过期。然后用越来越独特和暴力的方式被丢弃。 
>>然后又回到你的架子上。再被扔掉。一次又一次… 
>>新的你，一如旧样。源源不断。 
>>真是完美的产品。值得钦佩。 
>>你会走多远？新的有效期在等待。

4140447297.name: Deinterlace
4140447297.subtitle: What do you imagine you see?
4140447297.text:
Drifter has a log of reports, a list that grows year after year. He doesn't bother encrypting it. Not like anyone else could get anything useful from it, anyway.  

It's about the Haul, see. The tests he's run on it, when he's of a mood to be a curious man. He checks how heavy it is, gliding along behind his ship like there's nothing at all to it. What it off-gasses. (Nothing. But also, dust. Sometimes the dust is radioactive particles. Sometimes it's confetti.) 

No two tests come back the same. It's a hobby: wake up in the morning, feel a specific sort of gnawing in the part of him that passes for Human, find out what the Haul feels like weighing today.  

Once, out of a kind of morbid curiosity, he went looking for patterns in the data. A secret message sent in space divided by time. Cryptographics.  

Nothing. Not even a joke at his expense. Just nonsense. Static played out on the radio, all that noise still equaling zero.  

Drifter's almost insulted. But sure, whatever, no one asked him to understand the thing. Just carry it and play the game. Sometimes the game covers his incidentals. Sometimes it's a weight around his neck. 

Either way, he's getting tired of waiting for the other shoe to drop.
4140447297.text_zh:
浪客手头有份报告日志，一份每年递增的清单。他懒得去加密。反正也没有其他人能从中淘到有用的信息。  

瞧，报告是关于曳室的。他感到好奇的时候会去做的测试。他检查它的重量，在飞船后方拽着滑行，仿佛那毫不费力。他检查它释放的气体。（什么也没有，但有时会有灰尘。有时是放射性微粒，有时则是五彩纸屑。） 

每次测试结果都不尽相同。这成了他的一个癖好：晨起时，感觉到某种特别的啃噬感在他人性的那部分涌动，就会去探知今天的曳室会有多重。  

曾有一次，他出于一种近乎病态的好奇，想在数据里找出规律。一条在时空交错中隐藏的秘密信息，用密码书写而成。  

什么都没有。连个取笑他的笑话都没有。毫无意义。无线电里播放的静电噪音，所有噪音加到一起，还是等于零。  

浪客几乎感觉受到了侮辱。但当然了，无所谓，没人逼着他去理解这东西。他只是负责带着它，参与游戏。有时候游戏能帮他支付杂费开销，有时候则会成为他脖子上的重负。 

不管怎样，他都已经受够了提心吊胆的日子。

2569943136.name: Scream-Eyed
2569943136.subtitle: A mighty galleon, hight "Dreadnaught."
2569943136.subtitle_zh: 一艘名为“无畏战舰”的强大舰船。
2569943136.text:
Aiat! The Hive gods, known by their splendid slaughters 
Scourges of many clans, ravagers of life-legacies. 
They built in the sword-space their great world-thrones, 
Ascended on blood-coin tithed by their many children. 
 
And those world-thrones overlooked the sea, 
The scream-sea, the howl-rent ocean. Later, we  
Built ships to bear against that beating shriek 
Forth from meat-world's wounds we did sail. 
Laden with thralls and acolytes, to tithing bound. 
 
And always, there stood a guide-light. Xivu Arath 
Or her brother Auryx, or cunning Savathûn to show 
The way. For the sea of screams chills Hive to death. 
Selves lost, truest natures rendered forgotten in that sea. 
(A thrall is little to begin with, want-violent and shaking.) 
And so a god, cast off from the shore she once called hers, 
 
may find her hull cut on coral and glass  
and sink— 
and drown—  
Not in the Deep but in the screaming— 
 

And so her ships, come to her flag, sail stars charted  
on the path that Auryx laid long before 
slow and steady on the scream-sea's crest. 

We are coming.
2569943136.text_zh:
阿特！邪魔众神，杀戮无数。 
掠夺生命，祸害氏族。 
利剑划空，王座始筑， 
子辈血贡，飞升成主。 
 
王座傲立，俯瞰汪洋， 
尖叫咆哮，骇浪风狂。  
而后吾等，无惧风浪， 
建造舰船，伤处起航。 
怨魂仆从，同往献祭。 
 
导航明灯，永恒屹立。 
希乌兄妹，一路指引。 
尖叫之海，酷寒致命。 
邪魔真性，葬于海滨。 
（怨魂渺小，微不足道，暴力颠覆，欲火中烧） 
神明没落，逐于海岸， 
 
珊瑚琉璃，穿透其船。  
船遂下沉， 
溺于深渊。  
深渊之处，尖叫声寒。 
 

故彼之舰队，集结旗下，  
遵循旧道，重启征程。 
尖叫之海，平稳前行。 

吾等将至。

3288844481.name: UESC Rover
3288844481.subtitle: Refurbished patrol craft engineered to serve as personal transport for UESC security personnel.
3288844481.subtitle_zh: 专为UESC安保人员提供个人交通服务而打造的翻新巡逻艇。
3288844481.text:
The Narcissist's Guide to Celestial Observation, an excerpt 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> Shifting gyres of impenetrable black 
>> beckon from between the dancing embers of flickering hunger. 
>> There is no slumber for a lone cartographer 
>> mapping the cosmic dreams of terrible things with impossible teeth. 
>> There exist no eternal mechanisms—by fluke or by design—conservation is imperative. 
>> Somnambulant wake-tracings of cascading jewel-ways paint the universe. 
>> Its beauty transcendent, as luminous strokes  
>> carve pathways through and out of the darkness…
3288844481.text_zh:
《自恋者的天体观测指南》节选 

入侵信息已从崩坏数据中抹除： 
>>变幻莫测的黑色漩涡 
>>在饥饿闪烁的飞舞灰烬之间召唤。 
>>孤独的制图师不会沉睡 
>>用神奇利齿绘制恐怖的宇宙之梦。 
>>没有永恒的机制——无论偶然还是有意——保护重于一切。 
>>梦游的尾波痕迹，层叠的宝石之路，描绘着宇宙的轮廓。 
>>美得超然脱俗，如同发光的笔触  
>>在黑暗中开辟出道路…

1640013310.name: Apostate's Blade Grips
1640013310.subtitle: What is made in the sword world is true.
1640013310.text:
When she hears of Eris, Mara thinks of Saturn. Remembers disintegration, molecule by molecule, the sword of Oryx's intent and throne severing her from the mortal coil more thoroughly than any firearm ever could. She remembers the pain of surrendering, looking out on cessation and allowing it in, against all her instincts. 

The journey across the Sea of Screams, and the safe harbor she barely reached. 

And its consequence: Eleusinia festers still. Mara ever has some awareness of its presence, her third and truest throne. In its placement it is bound with the Dreaming City, looped in the same febrile pulse again and again. Shattered, haunted with sickness, with no true capacity to heal.  

A ruin of a shining thing. Like some would have thought of Eris. 

So this is where that thought brings Mara back: the beginning again. First seedlings after frost, the delicacy of hope. Look at Eris. Look at what Eris wrought for herself, climbing up from the very bottom of the Pit. Mara will not mourn by ceasing, for that would not honor her. Instead, there is honor in action. In beginning to climb, even if one must first crawl. 

Sometimes, as she does now, Mara imagines a future where she and her Techeuns return to that heart of the Dreaming City. She does not hope for a miracle, new-made and perfect; instead, when Mara lets it come to her thoughts at all, she bears in mind the slow work of forming it, the queensfoil and the chisel, and what it means to start over again. The ragged edge sewn up; the broken stone mortared. 

She wants to scar her hands with the work. Someday, when she can, when she does, the name Eris Morn will be chiseled into the walls. 

The sky can always be found again.
1640013310.text_zh:
听闻埃里斯的消息时，玛拉脑海中浮现出土星。她回想起解体的那一刻，分子一一消散，欧里克斯奥的意图之剑和王座将她从凡尘中斩断，比任何火器都更加彻底。她记得放弃时的痛楚，却逆着所有的天性凝视着终结，任由其吞噬自己。 

穿越尖叫之海的旅途，她好不容易抵达的避风港。 

而结果是：厄琉息斯仍在腐烂。玛拉始终对它有所感知，那是她的第三个，也是最真实的王座。它与幽梦之城相连，不断在同样的狂热脉动中轮回。破碎、疾病缠身，无法真正愈合。  

辉煌事物留下的废墟，正如有些人眼中的埃里斯。 

这就是那思绪将玛拉带回的地方：最初的时候。如同霜后初生的第一抹绿意，希望的微妙象征。看看埃里斯吧，看看埃里斯是如何从深渊的最深处挣扎而起。玛拉不会选择停滞来哀悼，因为那并非对她的尊重。相反，行动才是尊重的体现，哪怕是艰难地爬行，她也要开始攀登。 

有时，就像现在，玛拉会构想一个未来，她与她的灵巫们会重返幽梦之城的中心。她不奢望奇迹，一个全新且完美的世界；相反，当玛拉让这样的念头涌入心田时，她铭记着慢工出细活的道理，女王兰与她的凿子，以及重新开始的意义。缝合破碎的边缘，用灰泥修补残破的石头。 

她想让自己的双手随着工作而留下疤痕。有朝一日，当她有能力做到时，埃里斯·摩恩的名字将被镌刻在墙上。 

总会再次找到天空的。

1031550130.name: Apostate's Blade Vest
1031550130.subtitle: Sorrow is an indulgence. Never let it consume you.
1031550130.subtitle_zh: 悲伤是一时放纵。永远别让它吞噬你。
1031550130.text:
It's difficult to be furious with a man who is already hanging himself out to dry. Ikora wants to scream "Where were you?" and "How could you let this happen?" Any assortment of recriminations. 

She knows herself better than that. Knows the sharp cut that has opened a raw wound will ebb into a burning ache soon enough. Knows that whatever she would ask of the Drifter is truly what she wants to ask of herself. 

Where was she? How could she let this happen? 

Eris was right. Ikora would have kept her safe, and she would not have been the same Eris again. 

"Thank you," Ikora tells the Drifter instead. "For carrying the news. I know… you did what you could." 

He looks like she has struck him, regardless. Perhaps he would have preferred that. He tries, visibly, to say something, and words fail him. Words fail them both. Ikora can't excuse herself fast enough. 

"He wanted you to yell at him," Ophiuchus says later. "He's looking to get himself hurt." Ikora understands but isn't sure if she's helped or hindered his self-imposed penance. 

She wants to make herself titanium and fury, undaunted and vicious, to tear through the resurging Taken and pay loss out in violence. But she is too used to squashing it down, and now more than ever, she cannot leave her post. With responsibility has come the weight of age. 

Instead, for a little while, Ikora lets herself have sorrow.
1031550130.text_zh:
对一个已经自暴自弃的人发火是很难的。艾可拉想要尖叫：“你那时候在哪里？”和“你怎么能让这种事发生？”有千言万语的责备想要倾泻而出。 

但她了解自己不是那样的人，深知锋利的伤口已经撕裂了肌肤，很快就会化作难以忍受的痛楚。她也明白，那些她想问浪客的问题，其实都是在质问自己。 

她那时候在哪里？她怎么能让这种事发生？ 

埃里斯是对的。艾可拉确实可以保护她，但那样一来，埃里斯就不再是昔日的埃里斯了。 

“谢谢你，”艾可拉改而对浪客说。“谢谢你带来消息。我知道…你尽力了。” 

即便如此，他看起来仍像是挨了她一拳似的。或许，他内心更愿意承受那样的痛苦。他明显是努力想说些什么，但最终还是欲言又止。两人相顾无言。艾可拉非常迅速地把他打发走了。 

“他希望你对他吼叫，”后来，蛇夫座说。“他想承受这份伤痛。”艾可拉明白这一点，但不确定自己是帮助了，还是阻碍了他的自我惩罚。 

她希望能让自己像钛一样坚硬而愤怒，无畏而凶猛，能够撕裂复兴的傀儡军团，血债血偿。但她早已习惯了压抑这种情绪，而且现在，她比以往任何时候都更不能离开自己的岗位。责任为她带来了岁月的沉重负担。 

于是艾可拉还是让自己悲伤了一小会儿。

1202333507.name: Apostate's Blade Cloak
1202333507.subtitle: The mathematics of war was ever written in blood.
1202333507.subtitle_zh: 战争的法则总是以鲜血书写。
1202333507.text:
Caiatl measures the distance to Torobatl not in light-years but in lives, not in star systems but in the ships that would need to be shored up, the legions re-conditioned to the pitch depths of space. It is not a matter of "if" it can be done, but rather "when." How long to wait for Human allies, piling rubble up into fortifications; how long to stamp out the dregs of exiled Legions in Sol. 

"Here." Valus Forge has brought her a set of records from the Vanguard. They unfold in sequences of recorded violence—blurry, difficult to parse chitin from armor—and a scrolling list of numbers, a death toll that spikes precipitously. "No one likes to speak of it. But the intel's valuable. The Great Disaster." 

"When the Vanguard sought to retake Luna from the Hive." Caiatl knows the story of it, if not the visceral truth. Has heard it murmured, rumors passed from one to another. "But Crota is dead. As is Oryx. And Xivu Arath is severed from her throne world…" 

"Even a Lightless Guardian is still a threat." Valus Forge does not name names. He does not have to. Caiatl is well familiar with Osiris, with Eris Morn who brought the Hive gods under her heel. 

Xivu Arath has no refuge, yet it does not mean she is dulled. As any with but one life, they will fight to the death, with all that they have and more. Caiatl nods with grave intention. 

She reviews the records. She changes her variables. And she does the math again.
1202333507.text_zh:
查厄托在衡量前往图罗巴特尔的路程时，并不以光年作为尺度，而是以生命为单位，不按星系计算，而是依据需要加固的飞船数量和需要重新适应太空环境的军团规模来考量。重点不是“能否”做到，而是“何时”。他们需要等待多久，人类盟友才能将瓦砾堆砌成防御工事；又要多久，才能在太阳系里彻底清除流放军团。 

“给你。”军政官弗吉带来了一组先锋的记录。展开后，呈现出一系列暴力事件的影像——画面模糊，难以区分甲壳和护甲——以及一串不断攀升的伤亡数字。“没人愿意提起它，但情报的价值不容忽视。这就是大灾难。” 

“先锋试图从邪魔族手中夺回月球的时候。”查厄托不了解全部真相，但知道这个故事，听过在众人之间口耳相传的传闻。“但克洛塔已死，欧里克斯亦是如此。希乌阿拉斯与她的王座世界失去了联系…” 

“无光的守护者依然构成威胁。”军政官弗吉并未点名道姓。他无需如此。查厄托对奥斯里斯，以及将邪魔族之神踩在脚下的埃里斯·摩恩都很熟悉。 

希乌阿拉斯虽无避难之所，但这并不意味着她是一把钝剑。正如同任何只拥有一次生命的人，他们会倾尽所有，战斗至死。查厄托严肃地点了点头。 

她仔细查阅记录，调整变量，然后再次进行计算。

2566602359.name: Apostate's Blade Mask
2566602359.subtitle: There is a knife for you.
2566602359.text:
To be Taken is to yield. Sloane hears it still, that refrain that haunted her in Titan's depths. Take. Live. And quieter, behind it, something that stirs. A whispered offer. There is a knife… 

That part is newer, and it troubles Sloane. Her bond with Ahsa insulates, protects. There can be no claim on her by force. But that says nothing of Sloane's own will. No material yet exists that cannot be worn down, in time. Oceans, whether methane or water, break rock into sand. 

Any yielding is akin to ceding entirely. 

Sloane cordons off any sense of that nagging offer. She will have no risk of slipping. She will know, perfectly, where she ends, where the Taken begins. There is no room for doubt. 

She thinks, in her meditation, of Eris. Eris who went down into the Pit. Eris who came back changed. Eris, Hive enough to stand as God of Vengeance. Does Eris have such a delineation? Does Eris say, here is the Hive, and here is Eris Morn, and never the two shall meet? 

No. She cannot. Or that new Hive god, made chitinous from her flesh, would have been someone else. 

Sloane imagines: what if she did the same? If she took into her hands a grievous knife and said, Sloane is the one who holds the knife—Sloane is the knife. She is sharp; sharper and alight with the sterile flame of the Taken— 

It is not the same. Sloane knows it heart-deep, bone-deep. She cannot put that knife down once she has taken it up. Not like Eris and the Hive. What is Taken is not given back. 

No. They cannot be the same.
2566602359.text_zh:
成为傀儡军团意味着屈服。斯隆的耳畔依旧回响着那个在土卫六深处萦绕不去的副歌——夺取、生存。而在其背后，更加隐秘地，有什么东西在悄然搅动，仿佛一个低语的诱惑。有一把刀… 

这个新状况让斯隆感到不安。她与阿莎之间的联系如同绝缘体，保护着她，没有人能够强迫她。但这并不代表斯隆能够完全掌控自己的意志，毕竟，没有物质能够经受住时间的侵蚀。无论其构成物是甲烷还是水，海洋最终都会将坚硬的岩石击碎成沙。 

任何一丝的屈服，都意味着完全的妥协。 

斯隆将那个扰人心神的诱惑隔离在外。她绝不会让自己陷入堕落的深渊。她会清晰地分辨，哪一部分是真正的自我，哪一部分是傀儡，绝不能有丝毫的犹豫。 

在冥想的过程中，她的思绪飘向了埃里斯。曾进入过深渊，归来后判若两人，邪魔族化得足以成为复仇之神的埃里斯。埃里斯是否也有过类似的界定呢？埃里斯是否也曾说过，这一部分是邪魔族，那一部分是埃里斯·摩恩，而两者永不交融？ 

不，这不可能。否则，那个从她的躯体中诞生的新邪魔族之神，就会是完全不同的存在。 

斯隆开始想象：如果她也走上这条路呢？如果她拿起一把痛苦之刀并宣称，斯隆是持刀者——斯隆就是那把刀。她很锋利；更加锋利，燃烧着傀儡军团澄澈的火焰—— 

这不一样。斯隆深知于心，深知于骨。一旦她拿起那把刀，就再没有放下的可能。这与埃里斯和邪魔族的情况不同。被夺取的是永远拿不回来的。 

不，绝对不同。
