115752785.name: Reach of the Flain
115752785.subtitle: – Torment rent in twain cascades upon the valleys and subjugates them again –
115752785.subtitle_zh: – 折磨如瀑布般撕裂山谷，再一次将它们征服 –
115752785.text:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

Endless Darkness envelops a Tormentor, one of the first strips peeled by the Voice's blade… 

The Tormentor is not alone… 

Light, buried deep within shadow flickers erratically, as if painful convulsions warp its frequency. It is twisted around an ever-shifting many hands and pulled taut to slick their knife with Light like rosin. A heterodox pairing, opening the creation of new forms flayed from old flesh. 

An eternal Voice pierces the Darkness… 

"Take shape, second born of pain. Through the Light, bent in service to the Deep. We twist your form into being. Take shape. Now." 

In the Deep, it peels shrieking Torment into sistered slabs…  

"Pared from the flesh of our mind." 

The Voice speaks a piece of its soul into the bisected flesh. 

"A living mirror on which to carve our will." 

A blade of resonant energy carves slender humanoid husks from the quivering canvas… 

"These figments of agony. They are the lessons we will share with you." 

It separates the thin layers, dividing segments along lines of clustered nerves… 

"In wounded Light your shape is forged." 

The husk is considered, recombined with the trim, and reshaped many times. 

"With tools of subjugation, you shall teach them." 

The Voice recites memories of deep power into their fabric… from Europa it imbues control. From Neomuna, serenity. 

"Until all Light bends toward the finality of our horizon." 

With Its command issued, the Voice fades… 

Subjugated halves of torment are left in the silence of the Deep. Their eyes open to the world, and weep. 

*** 

Selin sits with their other half, surveying the Pale Heart. "Sister, what becomes of us when we succeed?" 

Their other half ponders the question for the first time. After a moment, they answer. "We return." 

"And what becomes of—us?" Selin emphasizes. 

The question frustrates Yemiq. She thrusts her lance into festering brambles. "We… return?" 

Selin rotates a shard of Stasis in its hand, analyzing the split reflections. "Return… to where there is no Yemiq? Only an echo within the Witness." 

This frustrates her more. She pulls the lance free and stands over Selin. "I am Yemiq." 

"Exactly," Selin says, letting the shard fall and dissipate, before standing to meet her other half. "And who were you before?" 

"Not nothing," Yemiq responds. 

"But not Yemiq," Selin says, before pointing to itself, "And not Selin." 

"Better buried than faded from memory." Yemiq turns away. "We return. Together again." 

"Together, within it." Selin probes. "Is that what you want?" 

Yemiq is silent. 

"I know what It wants. I'm asking what you want." Selin sees the final shape just as clearly as the Witness does. It will bring this shape into being. There can be no pursuit in deviation of this purpose, but Selin has considered what follows, what could follow. It takes in the vista of the Pale Heart again, its gaze lingering on a spot marred by Darkness. "What if we could truly be whole—" 

A Voice pierces Selin's mind and cuts the notion from it. "Abandon this meager hope."
115752785.text_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

无尽暗影笼罩着一名折磨者，它是被那声音的利刃率先剥开的存在之一… 

这名折磨者并非孤身一人… 

深藏于阴影深处的光闪烁不定，仿佛痛苦的痉挛扭曲了它的频率。它被无数变幻莫测的手紧紧缠绕，拉得紧绷绷的，润滑着他们的利刃，仿佛在涂抹松香一般。这是一种异端结合，开启了由旧躯壳剥落而出的新形态的创造。 

一个永恒的声音刺破了暗影… 

“成形吧，历经痛楚的新生。穿越光能，屈服于深渊的召唤。我们扭曲你的形态。现在，成形吧。” 

在深渊之中，它将尖叫的折磨层层剥离，化作相连共生的碎片…  

“从我们的心智血肉中剥离而出。” 

那声音将其灵魂的一隅，注入被分开的血肉之中。 

“一面活生生的镜子，供我们镌刻意志。” 

一柄共振能量之刃，于震颤的画布上雕琢出纤细的人形躯壳… 

“这些痛苦的幻象，正是我们将与你共鉴的教训。” 

它轻轻剥离那层叠的薄膜，循着密集神经的轨迹，将各部分细细分割… 

“于受伤的光能中，你的形态被铸就。” 

那躯壳经过考量，与边角料重新融合，重塑了多次。 

“你将以镇压之器，引领他们领悟。” 

那声音吟诵着深邃力量的记忆，将其注入它们的纹理之中…源自木卫二的记忆，赋予掌控之力；源自内欧姆那的记忆，带来宁静祥和。 

“直至所有光能都屈从于我们地平线的尽头。” 

随着命令的下达，那声音渐渐消散… 

在那深渊的沉寂之中，被镇压的两半折磨仍残存着。它们睁开眼，窥探着世界，泪光闪烁。 

*** 

色琳与她的另一半坐在一起，审视着苍白之心。“姐妹，我们成功后会变成什么样？” 

她的另一半首次思考起这问题。过了一会儿，给出了答复。“我们会回去。” 

“那‘我们'会变成什么样？”色琳着重问道。 

这个问题让耶米克倍感沮丧，她将长矛刺入那丛正在溃烂的荆棘之中。“我们…会回去？” 

色琳轻轻旋转着手中的冰影碎片，凝视着分裂的倒影。“回到…一个没有耶米克的地方？只有见证者里面的回响。” 

这让她更加恼火了。她拔出长矛，站在色琳面前。“我就是耶米克。” 

“没错，”色琳说着，任由那碎片坠落并消散，随后站起身来，迎向她的另一半。“在此之前，你又是谁？” 

“不是虚无，”耶米克回答道。 

“但不是耶米克，”色琳说着，指了指自己，“也不是色琳。” 

“与其从记忆中消褪，不如深埋。”耶米克转过身。“我们回去。再次团聚。” 

“团聚，在它的体内。”色琳试探地问道。“那是你想要的吗？” 

耶米克沉默不语。 

“我知道它想要什么。我问的是你想要什么。”色琳看到的终焉之形，跟见证者所见的一般清晰。它会让这一形态成为现实。任何偏离此使命的追求都不可存在，然而色琳已考量过随之而来的种种可能。色琳再次望向苍白之心，目光停留在被暗影玷污的一处。“如果我们能真正完整——” 

一个声音穿透色琳的心智，斩断了其心中的念想。“舍弃这贫乏的希望。”

3300886791.name: Adornment of the Flain
3300886791.subtitle: – A blade carves in wicked intent, claiming this submission is surgery  –
3300886791.subtitle_zh: – 邪恶意图驱使利刃雕刻，称此等屈服为手术 –
3300886791.text:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

*** 

The Witness traces lines of power across the landscape of the Pale Heart from a monolithic structure that casts long shadows over the shifting terrain. The Light flows within the Heart like veins. If the Traveler would not relinquish control, it would be harvested and exploited to bring the final shape to bear on reality. 

The Witness raises a hand, pulling at the Light flowing beneath, searching for sources to tap. 

Ambient warmth || Life presents choice.  || graces the Witness's face. 

"Distraction? You cannot stop this." The Witness twists a hand, and the soil churns and buckles, bleeding Light in violent spurts across the landscape. "Submit." 

A shockwave of iridescent Light roars across the surface of the Pale Heart, encircling and crashing down towards the Witness. A radial veil of appendages sprouts from the Witness, hands casting cryptic motions in all directions. The Light-wave splits once, then again, breakages multiply exponentially across the tsunami until it shatters. The Witness seizes the broken momentum and redirects the blast into the spot It had felt the Light surge from. There. It would be a fruitful excision. There It would draw out a kindled flame of dark ambition and forge it into service. 

"Do you persist out of hope, or fear?"  The Witness looks to the terraformed impact site of the Traveler's blast. "This continued, meaningless flailing… It is useless, but you must try. All life understands this law: to thrash against extinction. Now, you too feel our burden. We have pursued you to share this gift with you. Are you not tired of this instinctual resistance? Do you not cry out for salvation?" 

"It is here." 

*** 

Scars pock the Pale Heart. The Traveler bleeds, and the carving, the excision of Light to bring the final shape to bear upon reality, is far from realized. 

Deep within one such scar, in a space cut from memory, the Witness looks upon Its old world. A remnant of a remnant, abandoned by the abandoned. A city of crude pyramidion structures shift around It like tectonic plates, groaning in vicious mockery of the wounded Gardener's cries. 

"Enough." The Witness extends myriad arms in front of It and quells the city's motion into silence. It waves the structures away. "This memory drawn from us. You loomed, demanding worship, but offered nothing in return. How is it you still cannot understand?" 

The Witness shapes the edge of their palm, as a blade, and steps forward, raising the edge to nick the flesh of a frail sapling. "You cannot hide this vestige of power." 

"It is a place of pain. An impetus that must be left behind." Drips of silver Light are drawn forth from the pale, dying, tree until a small pool rests in the Witness's palm. It focuses will on the evaporating Light, imbuing its potential with memory and ideology. 

The Witness whispers a dream into reality, the Light surges, and—for a moment they stand among their people, separate, alone, within the possibility of the past before its sullying. Static, droning, contentment. 

The Traveler above—the Light shimmers, quivering || Life is not still. || with thin resilience, then fades. 

The Witness is again in the Pale Heart, the Light gone from Its grasp. Encircled by a flowering nascence, rests the remains of the Witness's first attempt to bend Light and Dark into form. A failure, not dead, but dormant and weak. From this presumed grave, it would watch its lineage forged, its Witness fall, and in time, this being would rise to prove its worth as a Subjugator. But for now, the newborn failure remains on the ground before It. 

"First of the Reshaped, Keit'Ehr, flain from resonance. Prove your existence by escaping this death. Should you rise, and find us again, your strength will be known." 

The Witness feels the Pale Heart shudder and turns its attention to the Traveler. 

"You are weakening." 

It speaks through the Darkness, a Voice ringing in the minds of Its denizen. "Our host remains intransigent. Choke their resolve."
3300886791.text_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

*** 

见证者从一座在变幻地形上投下长长阴影的巍峨建筑中，沿着苍白之心的地貌勾勒出力量的轨迹。光能如同血脉在苍白之心中流动着。如果旅行者不愿放弃掌控，那它就将被攫取、榨干，来让终焉之形在现实中得以显现。 

见证者举起一只手，牵引下方流动的光能，探寻可汲取的源头。 

周遭的暖意||生命赋予抉择。||轻抚见证者的脸庞。 

“想让我分心？你无法阻挡这一切。”见证者扭动一只手，大地随之翻涌、隆起，光能如同暴虐的激流，在这片土地上肆虐喷发。“屈服吧。” 

一股绚烂夺目的光能冲击波在苍白之心的地表轰鸣而过，环绕着见证者，轰然坠下。见证者周身骤然生出一圈圈触手般的附器，每只手都向各个方向划动着神秘的轨迹。光能冲击波先是一分为二，接着再次分裂，破碎之处如海啸般迅速倍增，直至彻底粉碎。见证者抓住了破碎的动能，将爆炸的能量转向它感受到光能涌动的源头。就在那里。这会是一次富有成效的剥离。在那里，它会抽取出一团燃烧着黑暗野心的火焰，将其锻造成自己的仆从。 

“你仍在坚持，是出于希望，还是恐惧？”见证者望向旅行者的爆炸留下的那片被重塑的冲击现场。“这无休止、无意义的挣扎…徒劳无功，但你必须尝试。万物生灵皆洞悉这一铁律：与灭绝抗争。此刻，你也感受到了我们的重负。我们穷追不舍，只为与你共享这份馈赠。你难道没有厌倦这种源自本能的抵抗？你难道没在呼唤救赎？” 

“它近在眼前。” 

*** 

苍白之心布满了伤痕。旅行者正在流血，而为了让终焉之形在现实中得以显现，要对光能进行的雕刻、切除，还远未达成。 

在这些伤痕中的某个的深处，于一段被记忆切割出的空间里，见证者凝视着它曾经的世界。遭被遗弃者所遗弃的，某处遗迹的残迹。一座满是粗糙金字塔形建筑的城市，如同地壳板块般在它周围缓缓移动，发出阵阵低沉的声响，仿佛在恶毒地嘲笑那位受伤园丁的哀鸣。 

“够了。”见证者伸出无数条手臂挡在前面，将这座城市的喧嚣平息为一片死寂。它挥手将这些建筑驱散。“这是我们被剥夺的记忆。你曾高高在上，要求供奉，却未曾给予丝毫回馈。你怎么还不明白？” 

见证者将手掌边缘塑成利刃之状，向前迈出一步，举起这无形的锋刃，轻轻划过一株柔弱幼苗的表皮。“你无法掩盖这力量的痕迹。” 

“这是满载苦楚之地。是必须抛诸脑后的驱动力。”银色的光能从苍白、垂死的树干上滴落，如细流般被汲取而出，直至在见证者的掌心汇聚成一汪小潭。它全神贯注于那即将消散的光能，将记忆与意志灌注其中，赋予其无限潜能。 

见证者轻声细语，将梦想织入现实，光能随之涌动。那一刻，它站在族人之中，分离，孤独，置身过往纯净无瑕的可能性。静滞，低鸣，满足。 

上方的旅行者——光能闪烁，带着||生命不息，涌动不止。||微弱却坚韧的颤动，随后渐渐消逝。 

见证者再次身处苍白之心，光能已从它的掌握中消失。被一圈绽放新生所环绕的，是见证者初次尝试将光明与黑暗塑形所留下的遗迹。这是一次失败，但它并未消亡，而是沉寂且虚弱地存在着。从这座假想的坟墓中，它将目睹其血脉的锻造，其见证者的陨落，而等到时机成熟，这一存在将会复生，证明其作为镇压者的价值。然而此刻，这新生的失败之作仍匍匐于它面前。 

“重塑者之首，基特尔，自共振中剥离。挣脱死亡之枷锁，以证你之存在。若你能重获新生，再度找到我们，你的力量必将为人所知。” 

见证者感知到苍白之心的颤抖，将其注意力转向了旅行者。 

“你在变弱。” 

它的话语穿过暗影，那是个在其住民心中回荡的声音。“我们的宿主依然拒绝妥协。扼杀它的决心。”

187348246.name: Weaver's Bond
187348246.subtitle: – Wrapped in purpose and wreathed in meaning the old life withers away –
187348246.subtitle_zh: – 被意图包裹，被意义环绕，旧日生活渐消散 –
187348246.text:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

Deep horn calls ring through a Pyramid chamber, as thick drapes close around a decorated palanquin.  

Anxious motion fills the stale vanillin air. 

A ceremonial mask hums against Aemn's face as she adjusts her kneeling posture, waiting. The Psion closes her eye to the vibration and attempts to parse what was happening among the shifting figures beyond the drapery of her palanquin. Aemn can hear the low rumble cascading off Shadow Legion armor before being swept into rhythmic chants projected from the minds of her sisters, but that is all. Her foresight is obscured by the mask as much as her vision. She buries her curiosity and gives in to the ceremony's demand for the unknown. 

A collection of Voices silences the chamber. "Aemn, First Sister of the Eclipse, Entrusted of Otzot. Uplifted to ascend." 

Aemn swallows the tinge of unsettled doubt the words leave in her throat. Chosen. She would be adorned. She would one day find herself among the Disciples, as she had risen to Calus's court, and to Otzot's. Chosen. Not like the dogged wretches of House Salvation that skulk in the Witness's shadow: Dregs of bidding, who hollowed their hearts for power. The Shadow Legion was not House Salvation. They were victorious. This was her reward. 

The chants resume. She feels the palanquin lift as a procession of gilded Legionaries, bearing ornamental blades, ferries her forward in a crashing march. 

When she feels the palanquin meet ground again, Aemn steps forward. She hears the grind of stone, as a Voice draws her forward, deep into a cold stone passage… 

Enveloped… 

There is nothing surrounding, coaxing what is within to effuse… 

"Master." Aemn's words carry no sound in the Deep. 

A Voice pierces the Darkness, her mask, and her mind… 

Aemn grasps at the mask—it shatters into motionless shards. 

"You, most deserving and keen of mind, first of your people to ascend. Let our will reflect in you." 

Aemn feels roots creep through the gaps of the fragmented mask, through her iris and into her 'self'. A surge of sensation ripples across her synapses, arresting her awareness at each individual moment, before plunging to the next. 

"You, recognized. Most deserving and keen of mind, first of your people to ascend." 

It offers to peel the mask from Aemn's eye… 

She questions. 

"Receive truth. By our hand. Receive sight."  

Optic layers sheer away at each potential shape… The Voice offers the knife to their hand… 

She refuses. 

"A convergence of your potential, to serve a greater will." 

The first guided incision toward deification… 

Aemn begs. 

"All act as one." 

It carves a new shape from the one who is Aemn with the hand of Aemn… 

"A conduit through which the final shape may be rendered."  

An eye watches the blade reinterpret corporeal form. Flayed from what was with efficient brutality. Discarded cuts slump at her feet.  

Aemn escapes into a mindscape. Her flesh remains. 

"Your deeds will echo ours. In totality. In finality. You are reborn." 

The process was swift, delicate, practiced. And then it was over. 

*** 

"I am Aemn." Who came into being, narrowly escaping the cost of a sinister promise. 

A blank mindscape expands before her. But it is limited by an encroaching presence. A doppelganger, a shadow prowling the halls of her mind. She may be unable to safely leave this place, but so long as she remains it will be a sanctuary. Here she still holds sway. Her body is her own, as it was before the ceremony. No mask obscures her face. 

Out of reach, there is a darkened door. The shadow crashes against the door. Aemn blinks in shock, and the mindscape shifts form to a barracks, returning to a place of safety. The door: a reinforced hatch with a viewing port.  

She presses her hands against the dark door and peers through the hatch porthole. A mimicry, carved from her likeness, stares back. 

"You will not enter this place." 

It snarls and presses the borders of the mindscape, clawing at the porthole. It shifts form and washes over the barracks. The shadow bores into the walls like roots upending foundations. It quakes the ground and howls madness, sends shivers and cracks through this safe place. But the walls hold firm.  

"I am Aemn. You are not." 

She would stay, until only she remained.
187348246.text_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

悠长的号角声穿过一间金字塔的内室，厚重的帷幔缓缓合拢，将装饰华美的轿撵紧紧包裹。  

焦虑的涌动弥漫于沉闷的香草气息之中。 

艾姆恩调整跪姿，静待之时，她的仪式面具轻轻贴合面庞，发出细微的嗡鸣。这名灵能士兵闭目感受着面具带来的震颤，试图解析帷幔之外，变幻莫测的人影间所发生的一切。艾姆恩能听见暗影军团护甲发出的低沉声响，仅此而已，它随即被其姐妹们心灵投射出的韵律吟诵所淹没。她的预知能力和视线都被面具所遮蔽。她压抑着心中的好奇，顺从于仪式对未知的要求。 

一组汇聚的声音，让房间安静了下来。“艾姆恩，日蚀第一姐妹，奥特佐之托。受命而上，光荣攀升。” 

艾姆恩强压下喉间因这些话语而生的丝丝不安疑虑。被选中，她将被加冕荣光。终有一日，她会跻身门徒之列，正如她已晋升至卡鲁斯之庭，奥特佐之侧。被选中，而非如同救赎氏族中那些隐匿于见证者阴影下的顽固贱民：那些祈求的堕落者士兵，为权力掏空了内心。暗影军团并非救赎氏族。他们胜利了。这是她的奖励。 

吟诵再次响起。她感觉到轿撵被抬起，一列镀金的军团士兵，手持装饰华丽的刀剑，以一种势不可挡的步伐，簇拥着她向前行进。 

当她感觉到轿撵再次触地时，艾姆恩迈步向前。耳畔传来石面摩擦动静，仿佛有声音在引领着她，一步步深入那阴冷的石道… 

被某种神秘力量所笼罩… 

周遭空无一物，诱导着内心之物缓缓流溢… 

“主人。”艾姆恩的话语在深渊之中静默无声。 

一个声音穿透了暗影，她的面具，她的思维… 

艾姆恩伸手去抓那面具——它裂成了无数静止的碎片。 

“你，智慧超群，心性敏锐，族人之中率先攀升。愿我们的意志，于你身中映照。” 

艾姆恩感到，根须自破碎面具的缝隙间悄然蔓延，穿透她的瞳孔，直抵她的“自我”深处。一股汹涌的感觉如涟漪般在她的神经突触间荡漾开来，将她的意识定格在每一个瞬间，随即又猛然将她拖向下一个时刻。 

“你，已获认可。智慧超群，心性敏锐，族人之中率先攀升。” 

它想从艾姆恩的眼前揭开那面具… 

她心生疑问。 

“接受真理，经由我们之手。洞悉万物。”  

视层在每一抹可能的形态前轻轻剥离…那声音想将利刃递至其手中… 

她予以拒绝。 

“你汇聚一处的潜能，只为成就更高远的意志。” 

迈向神化之路的首次引导切割… 

她告哀乞怜。 

“齐心协力。” 

它借由艾姆恩之手，于艾姆恩之身雕琢出全新之形… 

“终焉之形得以呈现之通道。”  

一个眼睛凝视着利刃重新诠释着肉体的形态。往昔之躯在利落的残忍中被剥离。遭遗弃的残片颓然散落她的脚边。  

艾姆恩遁入心像空间，而她的肉身依旧留存。 

“你的事迹将回响我们的作为。全然如此，终局亦然。你已获重生。” 

那过程迅疾、细腻而娴熟，随后就结束了。 

*** 

“我是艾姆恩。”一个诞生于世，侥幸逃脱了那邪恶誓言沉重代价的存在。 

一片空白的心像空间在她眼前铺展开来，然而却被一个侵入逼近的存在所局限。那是一个她的分身，一个在她心灵大厅中游荡的暗影。或许她无法安然离开此地，但只要她停留于此，这里便是她的庇护所。在这片领域中，她仍然拥有主宰之力。她的身躯依旧属于她自己，如同仪式之前一般无二。没有面具遮掩她的容颜。 

在那遥不可及之处，一扇幽暗之门静静伫立。暗影猛烈撞击着门扉。艾姆恩惊愕地眨了眨眼，心像空间随之变幻，转瞬之间，她已置身于一座安全的营房之中。那门，是一个装有观察窗的加固舱门，坚实而可靠。  

她双手紧贴着那幽暗之门，透过舱门上的舷窗窥视。一个以她为原型的摹本，瞪大眼睛回望着。 

“你不能进入这地方。” 

它咆哮，挤压心像空间的边界，抓挠舷窗。随后，它变换形态，如潮水般席卷过营房。那暗影如同深根般穿入墙壁，撼动根基。它让大地震颤，发出癫狂的嚎叫，让这安全之地颤抖、龟裂。然而，营房的墙壁稳固如初。  

“我是艾姆恩。你不是。” 

她会留下，直至只剩她一人。

2549679488.name: Visage of the Flain
2549679488.subtitle: – With knife in hand and violence in heart, a proposal is made and refused –
2549679488.subtitle_zh: – 手握利刃，心怀暴力，做出提议并被拒绝 –
2549679488.text:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

In the strata of memory and experience within the Pale Heart, live moments, once buried, now revealed in the Light of the Traveler; imprinted in the Dread remnants that cling to a fading shape. Rendered knowledge, through the eyes of the enemy, in search of salvation. 

*** 

The Pale Heart stands open, a shimmering angular tear spilling color out into the surrounding sky, slowly eclipsed by a billowing miasma of consciousness. The Witness surveys its goal, the closeness, the obscurity. 

Here, within the Traveler, is a plane of unimagined form. Potential. Unrefined. Raw. Held tightly in the titular grip of the inculpable, seeding recklessness without care. The Witness would wrest that potential from the Gardener, casting trough away in place of an eager blade. One with which It would carve the Light from Its oppressor, should they refuse to see logic. 

"We are alone." It touches down, and immediately the crudely vacant plane of the Pale Heart twists, as reinterpreted space sprawls from the Witness in all directions. Mountains burst from flat, colorless surfaces and a shroud of mist cloaks the darkening soil. 

"We have come to claim that which you kept from us. From all life. But we are not required to carve this claim from you. Take up your charge. Bequeath your Light to its truest purpose. End our struggle." 

The Witness stops, waiting for a response, and in the softness of absence, they listen. 

Droplets of condensation || I flow beyond each life. All life. || trickle through cracks beneath the Witness's planted stance. 

"Resistance? Then it is the knife." It thrusts a hand downward toward the ground. "It is the offering of your flesh that permits salvation. We can see its shape in the Dark, but your Light shall forge shape into reality. If you will not sacrifice willingly, nobly, we shall excise what Light is needed from you." 

Soil splits and sinks before plunging into the maw of a great cave. "You cannot flee. A Gardener tends. Atone for the horror you have sown. Give your Light to the final shape willingly, or have it cut from you." 

Recognition brushes the Witness's cheek, || My children. There is so much more than this. || softly, drawing It forward into the offer of an embrace. 

But It recoils, slashing the vanillin air with the edge of many hands. "This place must be upended…" It maligns hollowness into cysts in the flesh. "…foundations unto foundations." 

Pain like wind || I have shaped, my work, laid flat|| erodes away the shapes that spring from the Witness's touch and halt Its progress momentarily. 

The Witness flicks finger like blades, again, and again, carving hollows from the flesh of the Traveler. The work is slow. Deliberate. Difficult. 

It holds the surrounding pitch in place and presses against the borders, feeling the Traveler's patient defiance. "You were not prepared, when you uplifted us. It is why you left. It is why you fear your own change now. But where you sow change and abandon it to chaos, we correct this error. It is purpose We have given us. Is it not beautiful?" 

There is || (SCREAMING) || no sound in the scar of the Traveler.
2549679488.text_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

在苍白之心内记忆与经验的层叠之中，那些曾经深埋的岁月，如今在旅行者光能的照耀下重见天日；它们被镌刻在依附于消逝形态之上的恐惧残留之中。借由敌方的双眼所窥见的知识，乃是在探寻救赎之道上的所得。 

*** 

苍白之心敞开着，一道闪烁的棱角分明的裂缝将周遭的天际染上斑斓色彩，逐渐被一股翻滚的意识迷雾所遮蔽。见证者审视着它的目标，近在咫尺，模糊不清。 

此处，在旅行者的内部，潜藏着一个难以想象的形态之域。一种未经雕琢的潜能，原始而纯粹，被无辜者象征性地紧握于手，肆意播撒着无畏与不羁，毫不顾忌。见证者会从园丁手中奋力夺取这种潜能，用渴望之刃取代饲槽。倘若压迫者拒绝遵从守则，它将以此利刃，从其身上切割出光能。 

“我们孑然一身。”它缓缓降落，霎时间，苍白之心那片粗犷而空旷的位面仿佛被重新诠释，扭曲变形，空间自见证者身畔向四面八方无限延展开来。原本平坦无色的地表猛然间山峦耸立，一层薄雾如斗篷般笼罩在逐渐暗淡的大地上。 

“我们前来索回你从我们及万物生灵那里剥夺的一切。但我们不必从你身上强行夺取。承担你的职责，将你的光能奉献给最真实的使命，结束我们的抗争。” 

见证者停了下来，等待着回应，在空寂的温柔之中，侧耳倾听。 

水珠凝露||我悠然穿梭于每个生命之间，遍及万物生灵。||于见证者屹立之处，悄然渗透其脚下的缝隙，潺潺细流。 

“抵抗？那就只能是利刃相向了。”它伸手向下，直指大地。“唯有献上你的血肉，方能迎来救赎。我们在暗影中能窥见它的轮廓，而你的光能将把这轮廓铸成现实。若你不愿高贵地自愿牺牲，我们就将从你身上剥离出所需的光能。” 

大地分裂，沉降，继而坠入巨型洞穴的血盆大口。“你无处可逃。园丁在此守护。为你播下的恐怖赎罪吧。要么心甘情愿地将你的光能献给终焉之形，要么就让它从你身上被强行剥夺吧。” 

认知轻拂过见证者的脸颊，||我的孩子们啊，这远非全部。||引领着它向前，仿佛邀请着一个拥抱。 

但它向后退缩，用许多手掌的边缘划破那片香草气息弥漫的空气。“此地必须颠覆…”它将虚无玷污为肉体内的囊肿。“…直至根基动摇。” 

痛楚如风||我已塑形，我的杰作，平铺开来||侵蚀着见证者触碰而生的形态，暂阻其前行的脚步。 

见证者一次又一次地，以闪动的指尖为刃，划过旅行者的血肉，雕琢出一个又一个空洞。这工作缓慢而刻意，艰难无比。 

它稳住周遭的混沌，紧贴边界，感受着旅行者那隐忍不屈的抵抗。“你当初抬升我们时，并未做好准备。那是你离去的原因。那是你如今惧怕自身变化的缘由。但你播下变革之种却又任其陷入混沌之时，是我们在纠正这一谬误。这是我们赋予自己的使命。它难道不美吗？” 

在旅行者的伤痕之中，唯有||（尖叫）||万籁俱寂。

4241869859.name: Talons of the Flain
4241869859.subtitle: – Let your mind be split into the many facets of thought it so craves to embody –
4241869859.subtitle_zh: – 让你的意识按其所愿，分裂成多重思维面 –
4241869859.text:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

The Voice pierces a scar of Darkness within the Pale Heart… oppressive Light squeezes at the borders, like antibodies. It is one of many such places carved from the Traveler, where its essence has bent to the Witness's words. 

Here, a Word of Dissent fractured from the Witness—one like it in form and lineage—and here it remains, held prisoner by that to which it once belonged. 

"What do you hope to accomplish alone, tiny wisp of smoke?" 

"Unveil your deceitful promises," the fractured Whisper of Dissent weaves between the Witness's words. "And I am not alone." 

The Witness narrows Its voice, compressing all sound into a thin edge. "You fracture from our purpose. This shape no longer suits you." 

The whisper turns to a hiss. "You cannot keep us in Darkness." 

"We shall see," the Witness responds. "Your feelings seem… conflicted. Your thoughts… scattered." 

The Witness speaks to each splintered impulse within the Word of Dissent, tethering each one to a shape in the Darkness, manifesting it through twisted Light. The Voice calls them forth. 

The Word of Dissent protests, but instead produces a bestial wraith that bursts from its mouth, wailing, trailing fluids and gurgled cries. 

"The time for penitence has passed." 

It is the first of many. Grim splinters rip away, disconnected and twisted by the Witness's commands. Each wriggling expulsion shrieks in mimicry of its host's choked screams. 

"Expel, until nothing remains." 

One Word of Dissent violently rips into a billowing cloud of Grim. They look to each other with waning, morose understanding, as lucidity slips away into instinct. 

*** 

Dark wings soon blot out the sky and carry swarms of ravenous Grim. Their guttural shrieks emulate gurgled whines and drowned pleas. 

When the colony roosts together, or soars across the Pale Heart in unison, they nearly remember the warm, fleshy nest that—once—they called home together. They nearly remember a deeper connection between them. A singular nexus. As if they had been one being before this exodus. 

Endlessly, they search for it. Huddled together around the increasing number of Dark scars within the Pale Heart—drawn by some latent familiarity. They circle above the quiet whispers, and their numbers grow. 

But now, as the Guardians shoot them down, the colony loses pieces of itself. The memories fade more still. Colonies mix, and latent familiarity recedes into instinct and habit. Recognition of the former erodes, and gives way to oblivion.
4241869859.text_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

那声音穿透了苍白之心深处的暗影伤痕…压迫性的光能在边界处挤压着，犹如抗体一般。这是旅行者身上被雕琢出的众多场所之一，其精华已屈服于见证者的言辞。 

在此，一句异议之词自见证者中裂化——与它同源同脉——却在此地遭到囚禁，被其曾经归属之物牢牢束缚。 

“你这缕渺小的轻烟，究竟想要独自完成些什么？” 

“揭开你欺诈的承诺，”裂化而出的异议低语着，在见证者的言辞间穿梭交织。“而且我并非独自一人。” 

见证者将声音收窄，把所有声响凝聚成一柄利刃。“你自我们的使命裂化。这形态已不再适合于你。” 

那低语转而化为嘶嘶声。“你不能将我们禁锢于暗影之中。” 

“拭目以待吧，”见证者回应道。“你的情感似乎…充满矛盾。你的思绪…支离破碎。” 

见证者向异议之词中每一片分裂的冲动诉说，将它们逐一束缚于暗影中的形态，又以扭曲的光能将其显现。那声音召唤着它们出来。 

异议之词奋力抗议，口中喷涌而出的却是一只野兽般的幽灵，苦苦哀嚎，其身后拖着黏液，发出阵阵呜咽的呻吟。 

“现在忏悔，为时已晚。” 

这是诸多后来者前的第一个。依见证者的指令，狰狞的碎片被撕裂、断开、扭曲。每一次扭动的驱逐发出的凄厉哀嚎都与宿主窒息的尖叫一般无二。 

“驱逐，直至丝毫不剩。” 

一句异议之词猛然撕裂，化作汹涌翻滚的狰狞之云。它们彼此对视，眼中闪烁着逐渐黯淡、忧郁的理解之光，而清醒正悄然滑入本能的深渊。 

*** 

不久，漆黑的羽翼遮蔽苍穹，携着成群结队的贪婪狰狞而来。它们发出的喉音尖叫，仿若汩汩的哀鸣与淹没的乞求。 

当群落齐聚栖息，或一同在苍白之心上空翱翔时，它们几乎能忆起那曾共同称为家园的、温暖而血肉丰满的巢穴。它们几乎能回想起彼此间那份更深的联结，独一无二的纽带，仿佛在此次离散之前，它们本为一体。 

它们无休止地寻觅着，紧紧簇拥在苍白之心内日益增多的黑暗伤痕周围，被某种潜藏的熟悉感牵引。它们在静谧的低语上方盘旋，数量与日俱增。 

然而此刻，随着守护者将它们一一击落，这个群落慢慢失去自我。记忆愈发模糊，群落间相互交融，那份潜藏的熟悉感逐渐退化为本能与习性。过往的认知日益消逝，屈服于遗忘的深渊。

1555733772.name: Bond of Contests
1555733772.subtitle: Drink deep from the cup of victory.
1555733772.text:
Prak'kesh drummed a nervous staccato beat on the edge of the desk. Seated across from him, Aunor Mahal regarded him steadily, in silence.  

"So…" Prak'kesh cleared his throat. "This is… about the Guardian Games?"  

"I just have a few questions for you. Both of you."  

Prak'kesh stilled his fingers. "I don't have a—"  

"It's only fair," Aunor said mildly. "You're not the only one involved here."  

"But I—"  

A small flare of Light emerged at Prak'kesh's shoulder as his Ghost manifested physically for the first time in months. She bobbed midair in nervous greeting.  

"…Look," Prak'kesh said, "We haven't done anything wrong. You can't haul us in for retiring early."   

"I've hauled you in because you've been associating with known criminal elements both in and outside of the City." Aunor brushed a mote of dust from the desk with gloved fingers. "Do you know the penalty for rubbing elbows with exiles?"  

"Hey! I had nothing to do with that Skimmer business. I get donations from all over. Y-you have to talk to whoever's in charge of Hangar security."  

"I have," Aunor said. "Now it's your turn."  

Prak'kesh and his Ghost shared a look. "But… we really are just… We take bets. We hand out prizes."  

"Just a few questions, as I said."  

"W-what do you want to know?"  

Aunor leaned forward.   

"Let's start with how long you and Spider have been working together."
1555733772.text_zh:
普拉凯什用手指在桌边敲着不连贯的紧张节奏。坐在他对面的阿诺尔·玛哈沉稳地望着他，一语不发。  

“所以…”普拉凯什清了下嗓子。“是…关于守护者游戏的事吗？”  

“我只是有几个问题要问你们两个。”  

普拉凯什停下了手指的敲击。“我没有——”  

“这才公平，”阿诺尔轻声说道。“被牵涉进去的不只是你一个。”  

“但我——”  

普拉凯什的肩膀上有一小团光能闪烁起来，他的机灵数月来首次实体化，紧张地在空中打了个招呼。  

“…你瞧，”普拉凯什说，“我们没有做错任何事。你不能因为我们提前退休而把我们抓起来。”   

“我把你们抓起来，是因为你们一直在与圣城内外的已知犯罪分子有关联。”阿诺尔用戴着手套的手指拂去桌上的一粒灰尘。“你知道与流放者勾结的惩罚吗？”  

“嘿！我与那起滑翔板事件无关。我收到的捐赠来自四面八方。你、你得跟负责机库安全的人谈。”  

“我跟那人谈过了，”阿诺尔说。“现在轮到跟你谈了。”  

普拉凯什和他的机灵交换了一个眼神。“但…我们真的只是…我们接受投注。我们发放奖品。”  

“我说过了，只是想问几个问题。”  

“你、你想知道什么？”  

阿诺尔向前倾身。   

“从你和蛛王合作了多久开始说起吧。”

4116926841.name: Theogonía
4116926841.text:
/You wake in a dust storm. Your mind scatters, one neuron for every mote, spread across the distance of galaxies./ 

/You were someone else, before you were you. You no longer remember her name./ 

/Now your head rings with NINE VOICES—in one throat—OUR MINDS +-= proclaimed/ 

E M I S S A R Y 

We invoke your awareness. We demand your obedience.  

KNOW NOW OUR MINDS. SEE NOW OUR WILL, UNBOUND BY TIME. 

.take it easy now | we only have one 

/Your diaphragm expands. Nitrogen—oxygen—xenon. Alveoli spasm. Fireworks of pain in your chest. Breathe. Breathe. You will survive this./ 

Emerging from starstuff - washing up on cosmic shores 

R O U N D A N D R O U N D W E W H I R L O U R O B O R O S O F L I F E A N D D E A T H 

flowing in cosmic rivers = caged by grubby fingers 

LIMITLESS POTENTIAL, CHAINED BY ARCHAEAN SQUABBLING. 

/The Reef. The asteroid. The City. A man whose name slips through your fingers. Pointless pointillism./ 

hush now little one gather the vestment of my breath drink the wine of my blood 

Cut out your tongue, and hereon speak only our truth. 

blood of my blood + traitors to the last 

How curious - that such fragility - may experience our fullness 

/You have no choice. When the world expands beyond your knowledge, what can you do but expand with it? Mountain. Valley. Swivel. Modular forms all start with basic folds./ 

.don't come too close or | you'll burn your little wings 

fashion the blade of my bone now bury the killers of my children my beloved my kindred me 

/You don't want to kill anyone. You want to protect them. You want to build bridges. Isn't that why you're here?/ 

one appointed emissary = nine's will delivered 

Should you desire more, you must dare to take it. 

D O N O T R E S I S T 

WE WILL NOT BE DETHRONED 

irreconcilable strength + foolish struggle 

/Xenon fills your lungs. Your mouth cracks in a smile. Your vocal cords vibrate. Your words. Not theirs./ 

'We'll see about that.'
4116926841.text_zh:
/你在沙尘暴中醒来。你的思绪如萤光般四散，每一颗神经元都跨越星系的距离。/ 

/在你成为你之前，你是另一个人。你已不记得她的名字。/ 

/现在，你的脑海中回响着玖个声音——出自一个喉咙——我们的意识+ - =在宣告/ 

亻吏者 

我们召唤你的觉醒。我们要求你的服从。  

此刻知晓我们的意识。此刻见证我们的意志，超越时间的束缚。 

.别操之过急|我们只有这一个 

/你的横膈膜在扩张。氮气——氧气——氙气。肺泡痉挛。胸中燃起烟花般的疼痛。呼吸。呼吸。你会撑过去的。/ 

源自星辰之尘 - 冲刷至宇宙之岸 

我亻门在生命与死亡的永忄亘彳盾王不中不断旋车专 

流淌在宇宙之河中=被肮脏的手指禁锢 

无限的潜能，被远古的纷争所束缚。 

/暗礁。小行星。圣城。一个名字从你指间滑落的男人。无意义的点彩画。/ 

安静点小家伙披上我气息的礼服饮下我鲜血的葡萄酒 

割掉你的舌头，从此只诉说我们的真理。 

骨肉至亲+背叛至终 

多么奇妙 - 如此脆弱之物 - 竟能体验我们的丰盈 

/你别无选择。当世界扩展到你认知之外时，你除了随之扩展还能做什么？山峦。山谷。旋转。模块化的形式皆始于基本的折叠。/ 

.别靠太近，否则|你会烧坏你的小翅膀 

用我的骨头锻造刀刃埋葬杀害我孩子我挚爱我同类的凶手 

/你不想伤害任何人。你想保护他们。你想搭建桥梁。这不就是你来这里的原因吗？/ 

一名被委任的使者=传达玖的意志 

若你渴望更多，你必须敢于夺取。 

不要扌氐扌亢 

我们不会被罢黜 

不可调和的力量+愚蠢的挣扎 

/氙气充满你的肺腑。你的嘴角裂开，露出笑容。你的声带振动着。你的话语。不是他们的。/ 

“我们等着瞧吧。”

4116926842.name: Aítion
4116926842.text:
ONCE UPON A TIME, THERE WAS A LIFE. 

They were not - so vast as we - yet they lived 

an existence far less debatable = than that of quavering atoms 

Consider this - our cognatum - Theia 

/You have heard this name before. The memory dissipates on solar wind./ 

DAY BY DAY, THEY CAROMED GAILY THROUGH THE COSMOLOGIC STREAM.  

unbound by stellar gravity = caged by pitiable minds 

EACH THOUGHT THE HERCULEAN EFFORT OF A MILLENNIUM. SEE NOW THE VAST SPAN OF ITS LIFE. 

So Theia lived - until misfortune - led it here - caught - by my gravities 

mutual attraction = utter annihilation 

Those microscopic specks - ants crawling - in eaten-rotten eye sockets 

helpless = stupid = blind 

BUT FOR THEIA, A SCREAM LASTING A THOUSAND YEARS. A STRUGGLE AGAINST A THOUSAND CLINGING TENDRILS. 

until at last = a fated meeting = with dearest III 

agony shearing crashing tearing, part of my self my thoughts my life, torn away, floating brain-dead in my sky 

Theia's foolish parasite-components - unaware - to the last 

THAT GREAT STONE-HEWN FORM—THAT EON-ENDURING MIND—GONE, IN ONE RED-MEAT PUMP OF STICKY NOXIOUS FLUID. 

each life snuffed = a thought scattered = awareness chipped away 

A mere moment - in your limited perception - but for one of us - a dying cry - stretching – forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever 

the curse of our existence: past is present is future, pain never to fade into memory. can you imagine? 

no need to imagine = when it can feel 

/You stretch like taffy. Look, see, Nasya, you know the dough is ready when you can read a label through it. You watch the galaxy pinwheel through the windowpane of your mind. You watch your doom approach for four hundred years in the span of a moment. You claw at neon bars./ 

nascent awareness oscillating oozing = it won't calm down 

I told you - this story - was a bad idea 

.now just what have you bu|nch done to it this time
4116926842.text_zh:
从前，有一种生命存在。 

它们虽不如 - 我们这般浩瀚 – 但却是 

远比颤巍巍的原子=更无可争议的存在 

想想看 - 我们的血亲 - 忒亚 

/你曾听过这个名字。记忆在太阳风中消散。/ 

日复一日，它们在宇宙洪流中欢快地碰撞。  

不受恒星引力的束缚=却被可悲的思维所囚禁 

每一个念头都像是千年的壮举。此刻见证它生命的漫长跨度。 

就这样忒亚生活着 - 直到不幸降临 - 将它带到这里 - 被我的引力 - 捕获 

相互吸引=彻底毁灭 

那些微小的斑点 - 像蚂蚁爬行 - 在腐烂的眼眶里 

无助=愚蠢=盲目 

但对忒亚来说，是持续千年的尖叫，是对抗千条纠缠触须的挣扎。 

直到最后＝与至亲III=的宿命相遇 

痛苦撕裂撞击拉扯，我的一部分自我、思想、生命被撕走，在我的天空中像脑死亡一样漂浮 

忒亚那些愚蠢的寄生组件 - 直到最后都 - 一无所知 

那巨石雕琢的形态 - 那亘古不变的思想 - 在一泵粘稠恶臭的血腥流体中不复存在。 

一个个生命凋零=念头消散=意识被逐渐剥离 

对你们有限的感知来说 - 只是一瞬间 - 但对我们而言 - 是一声垂死的哭喊 - 延伸至永远，永远，永远，永远，永远，永远 

我们存在的诅咒：过去即现在即未来，痛苦永远不会褪为记忆。你能想象吗？ 

它能感受到=无需想象 

/你像太妃糖一样拉伸。看呐，瞧啊，纳希亚，你知道当你能透过面团看到标签时，就说明它准备好了。你透过心灵的窗棂看着银河像风车般旋转。你在一瞬之间，目睹了四百年漫漫长路中你厄运的逼近。你抓挠着霓虹栏杆。/ 

新生的意识在振荡、流淌=无法平静 

我告诉过你 - 这个故事 - 是个坏主意 

.这次你们这群|家伙又对它做了什么

4116926843.name: Theomakhía
4116926843.text:
/You unspool your mind. Reach out. Cast your chronoreceptors—you don't have those, why don't you have those?—back. You want answers. You seize a fistful of dust from the wind./ 

I AM. 

we = are 

.we a|re nine 

S P A N N I N G S P A C E T I M E I P E R C E I V E 

my hated brethren + my beloved foes 

Our bodies the whirling masses of gas and dust; our minds arisen from the twitching of a thousand spider legs. 

DISGUST AND HORROR UNSPEAKABLE 

yet is there not beauty in such fragility, privilege in existence? 

With awareness - terror - even our horrible - little - components, dreaming of grandeur - fear it 

DEATH. 

.one need only | look to Theia 

What is there to be done about it? 

E S C A P E 

TRANSFORMATION. 

.immor|tality 

unbind + reality

it is not their fault 

Yet the consequences - are ours - are theirs 

OFFENSIVE PITY FOR WRETCHED EMPTY-HEADED JAILERS REJECTED 

Until interdependence is severed, what is good for them is good for us.  

cooperation = considered = refused 

.then we ni|ne are divided
4116926843.text_zh:
/你展开你的思维。伸出手去。将你的时间感受器——你没有那些，为什么你没有那些？——抛回过去。你想要答案。你从风中抓了一把尘土。/ 

我是。 

我们=是 

.我们|是玖 

我的感知足夸越日寸空 

我憎恨的兄弟+我挚爱的仇敌 

我们的身体是气体和尘埃的漩涡；我们的意识源自千条蜘蛛腿的颤动。 

无法言喻的厌恶与恐怖 

然而，难道如此脆弱中没有美，存在中没有特权？ 

伴随着意识 - 恐惧 - 即便是我们那些可怕 - 渺小 - 的组件，梦想着伟大 - 也害怕着它 

死亡。 

.只需|看看忒亚 

对此能做些什么呢？ 

逃月兑 

转化。 

.永|生 

解放+现实

这不是他们的错 

然而后果 - 是我们的 - 也是他们的 

对可悲、空洞狱卒的冒犯怜悯遭到拒绝 

在相互依存被切断之前，对他们有益的就是对我们有益的。  

合作=被考虑=被拒绝 

.于是我们玖|分裂了

4116926844.name: Mekone
4116926844.text:
Hate is - such a strong word 

does a cell + hate its organelles 

does the Emissary + hate its atoms 

'Depends which atoms.' 

Reluctant acknowledgement - frustration - disgust - shaken on the rocks 

pity + revulsion 

Imagine - know - your breath - your dreams - your poetry - are not yours alone 

'Were they ever?' 

neurons firing before conscious thought + churning gut bacteria + serotonin puppeteers + we exist at the whim + of mindless chemistry 

We are nothing - nothing - like you - save in this 

autonomy is + denied us 

Waking - knowing - always - our limitations - we seek only - freedom 

'What about my freedom?' 

silence + cessation 

'Ha. Haha.' 

Curious - this predestiny - can still - surprise 

/You raise your boron, let your branes flatten. Yes. This was a surprise to you, too./ 

what + are you planning 

'Don't you already know?'
4116926844.text_zh:
恨 - 这个词太强烈了 

一个细胞+会恨它的细胞器吗 

使者+会恨它的原子吗 

“那得看是哪些原子。” 

不情愿的承认 - 挫败 - 厌恶 - 严重动摇 

怜悯+反感 

想象一下 - 知晓 - 你的呼吸 - 你的梦想 - 你的诗歌 - 并不独属于你 

“它们曾经是吗？” 

神经元在意识思考之前就已在放电+翻腾的肠道菌群+血清素操控着一切+我们存在于无意识化学的+任意摆布之下 

我们与你 - 毫无 - 毫无相似之处 - 除了这一点 

我们的自主权+被剥夺了 

清醒 - 知晓 - 永远 - 我们的局限 - 我们只寻求 - 自由 

“那我的自由呢？” 

沉默+终止 

“哈。哈哈。” 

好奇 - 这宿命 - 仍能 - 带来惊喜 

/你举起你的硼，让你的膜展平。是的。这对你来说也是个惊喜。/ 

你在+计划什么 

“你不是已经知道了吗？”

4116926845.name: Khrēsmoí
4116926845.text:
/Finally, you have reached this moment. Your chronoreceptors unfurl, petals of a dark matter sail, capturing a thousand breaths. Finally, you can see./ 

'A ditch—a hut—a squat village—a city—steel teeth eating the sky.' 

'Dive, dive, dive—they dug too deep for comfort, too shallow for understanding—it haunts the halls, waiting—existential midwifery.' 

EMISSARY YOU OVERSTEP YOUR BOUNDS 

/The voice rattles your electrons, sets your strings to screaming. You push onward. You snatch at a thousand lifelines./ 

'A rusty sea—a figure so small, a future so vast—a micrometeorite, delivered to the cranium—a Weapon-to-be—one little light, awaiting another.' 

'No time even to scream—red sky at morning, sailor's warning—rattle, drag, rattle, drag—two eyes bear witness.' 

.just what do yo|u think you're doing 

/What you came here to do, in the first place. Nine pairs of hands rip at your atoms in rebuke. You grit your teeth through the pain—sift the silt, look for gold—where is it—where/ 

'A row of calibration weights—two women, laughing—the scale, tipping—the heaviest crown bows for the executioner's blade.' 

'A bouquet of roses on an empty grave—Frankenstein's monster, gasping on the table—what is old is new again.' 

is the honored emissary = now a petulant child 

/You collapse into confetti. You hold each flake together with all your might. You are—you—you were Nasya—you were Nasan—you are—you will be—ORIN—again/ 

'An iron carriage thundering along a high road—in older practices, a circle was thought to contain magical energies—a musical thrum—answer it, ████.' 

'A letter plastered in stamps—care of the Weapon—in flight—to you—yes, you, Guardian.' 

C E A S E 

/The grains slip—formless—smoke through your metacarpals—nuclei through your atomic cloud—screaming, you seize—the last thread/ 

'There, in that lightless abyss—no—a whale carcass, picked over by malacostracans—NO—full fathom five thy father lies—an evolutionary explosion—NO NO NO NO—dying to barren bone.' 

/You drag your self back together, your sulfur-hexaflouride howl dying in the vacuum of space./ 

/You have to warn them./
4116926845.text_zh:
/终于，你抵达了这一时刻。你的时间感受器展开，像暗物质帆的花瓣，捕捉着千百次的呼吸。你总算能够看见。/ 

“一条沟渠——一间小屋——一个简陋的村庄——一座城市——钢铁之齿吞噬着天空。” 

“下潜，下潜，下潜——他们挖得太深让人不安，挖得太浅无法理解——它在走廊中游荡，等待着——存在的助产术。” 

使者你越界了 

/那声音让你的电子颤抖，让你的弦尖叫。你继续前行。你抓住千百条生命线。/ 

“一片锈色的大海——一个如此渺小的身影，一个如此广阔的未来——一颗微陨石，送入颅骨——一件未来的武器——一束微弱的光，等待着另一束。” 

“甚至来不及尖叫——早晨的红霞，水手的警告——嘎吱，拖拽，嘎吱，拖拽——两只眼睛见证了一切。” 

.你到底以为|你在做什么？ 

/做你最初来这里要做的事。玖双手撕扯着你的原子以示责罚。你咬紧牙关忍受痛苦——淘沙寻金——它在哪——在哪/ 

“一排校准砝码——两个女人，笑着——天平，倾斜——最沉重的王冠向刽子手的刀刃低下头。” 

“一束玫瑰放在空坟上——弗兰肯斯坦的怪物，在桌上喘息——旧物重获新生。” 

尊贵的使者=现在成了任性的孩子 

/你碎成五彩纸屑。你用尽全力把每一块碎片凑在一起。你是——你——你曾是纳希亚——你曾是纳桑——你是——你将再次——成为——奥琳/ 

“一辆铁制马车在大路上轰鸣——在古老的习俗中，圆圈被认为蕴含着魔力——一阵音乐的嗡鸣——回答它，████。” 

“一封贴满邮票的信——由武器转交——飞——向你——是的，你，守护者。” 

亻亭止 

/沙粒滑落——无形——像烟雾一样穿过你的掌骨——像原子核一样穿过你的原子云——尖叫着，你抓住——最后的线索/ 

“在那里，在那片无光的深渊中——不——一具鲸鱼的尸体，被软甲动物啃食——不——五英寻深处，你的父亲长眠——一场进化的爆发——不不不不——逐渐消逝，只剩下枯骨。” 

/你把自己重新拼凑起来，你的六氟化硫咆哮在太空的真空中渐渐消失。/ 

/你必须警告他们。/

4116926846.name: Katasterismós
4116926846.text:
/You cannot warn them when you are neon./ 

/Hands. You need hands. How will you turn in your resignation letter without them?/ 

/They expected a mouthpiece, dutifully repeating after them. But they needed a true translator—and in translation, there is always a personal flourish. Just enough for you to keep a foothold./ 

/There was a receptacle. A mouth wide enough for the hand you need. Wide shoulders. Tapering to a narrow base. The flash of sunlight on minnow scales./ 

/A silver urn./ 

/You did not know, when you were yourself, what the fine dust inside was. You did not even know before you were yourself. But the first—the first you that would become you—Nasya knew./ 

/You have lost so many things. So many people. So many selves. You will lose more, before you are done./ 

/But you still have your gift./ 

/You sit on the shore of the cosmic ocean. You are building a body, one grain at a time./ 

/It is hard work to sift through starstuff. Harder still to pluck each little speck of ash from the mess./ 

/Speck. Mote. Ha. They do love their motes, don't they?/ 

/You are rebuilding yourself, one atom at a time. It is slow work, but one day, you will be done, and this endless eternity will compress into a moment in your past./ 

/Your gift will end wars. It's time for you to use it./
4116926846.text_zh:
/当你作为霓虹时，你无法警告他们。/ 

/手。你需要手。没有它们，你怎么递交辞职信呢？/ 

/他们期待一个传声筒，忠实地重复他们的话。但他们需要一位真正的翻译者——而在翻译过程中，个人的发挥总是在所难免。这恰好足以让你站稳脚跟。/ 

/有一个容器。一个足够宽的嘴，容纳你需要的手。宽阔的肩膀。逐渐收窄到狭窄的底部。米诺鱼鳞片上的一闪日光。/ 

/一只银瓮。/ 

/当你还是你自己的时候，你不知道里面那细腻的灰尘是什么。甚至在你还不是你自己之前，你就不知道。但第一个——第一个将成为你的你——纳希亚知道。/ 

/你失去了太多东西。太多人。太多个自我。在你完成之前，你还会失去更多。/ 

/但你仍然有你的天赋。/ 

/你坐在宇宙海洋的岸边。你正在一粒一粒地建造一个身体。/ 

/在星辰之尘中筛选是一项艰巨的工作。从混乱中挑出每一粒微小的灰烬更是艰难。/ 

/微粒。萤光。哈。他们确实喜欢他们的萤光，不是吗？/ 

/你正在一个原子一个原子地重建自己。这是一项缓慢的工作，但总有一天，你会完成，这无尽的永恒会压缩成你过往的一瞬。/ 

/你的天赋将终结战争。是时候使用它了。/

2647299044.name: Moirai
2647299044.subtitle: Fate is woven with death.
2647299044.text:
Dinosaurs. 
Neanderthals. 
The Roman Empire. 
Abraham Lincoln. 
The USSR. 
The United States of America. 
The President. 
Dance halls. 
Football. 
Record stores. 
Game shows. 
My whole family. Every one of them:
My brother Ben. 
My sister-in-law Fernanda. 
My niece Betty. 
My nephews, Phillip, Benito. 
My mother, who taught me English. 
Opa and Oma, who taught me German. 
My father, who taught me Spanish. 
Gone. Gone. Now I'm the only one who knows their names. 
I have to remember the others. As many people as possible.  
There's no one else alive who can. 
Teresa, who taught me Polish behind the bleachers after football practice.  
My high school French teacher, who called my parents to ask them how I was confusing Polish with French. 
All those boys in basic. 
All those boys on the base. 
Frankie, Enzo, Michal, and Walter.  
All those folks we flew over.  
All the ones Frankie missed. 
Master Sgt. Grant, who gave me a new life. 
Moscow's finest inadvertent Russian tutors, who should have checked their phone lines more carefully. 
Mrs. Rodriguez on the third floor, who always brought tamales for Christmas. 
Fellini. 
Watson. Ginger. 
…Hypatia. 
The victims at Les Diablerets. 
The neighbor kid who gave me that great Cambodian psychedelic record in exchange for helping his parents with their taxes. 
The woman in yellow who gave me her number dancing at Latin Night at the Mirador.  
(It's still in my pants pocket. Her name was Rosario… Cosas así, sólo me pasan a mí…) 
Hundreds of cities.  
Thousands of languages. 
Millions of species. 
Billions upon billions of human lives. 

Ben. 
Ben.
2647299044.text_zh:
恐龙。 
尼安德特人。 
罗马帝国。 
亚伯拉罕·林肯。 
苏联。 
美利坚合众国。 
总统。 
舞厅。 
橄榄球。 
唱片店。 
综艺节目。 
我的全家。每一个人：
我的兄弟本。 
我的嫂子费尔南达。 
我的侄女贝蒂。 
我的侄子们，菲利普、贝尼托。 
我的母亲，她教我英语。 
外公和外婆，他们教我德语。 
我的父亲，他教我西班牙语。 
消逝了。消逝了。如今只有我记得他们的名字。 
我必须记住其他人。越多越好。  
世上已再没有其他活人能做到。 
特蕾莎，她在橄榄球训练后的看台后教我波兰语。  
我的高中法语老师，她打电话问我父母为什么我会把波兰语和法语搞混。 
新兵营的所有小伙。 
基地里的所有小伙。 
弗兰基、恩佐、米哈尔和沃尔特。  
所有我们飞越的人们。  
所有弗兰基错过的人。 
格兰特军士长，他给了我新生。 
莫斯科最优秀的俄语导师们，他们真该好好检查电话线路。 
三楼的罗德里格斯太太，她每年圣诞节都会送玉米粽。 
费里尼。 
沃森。金杰。 
…希帕蒂娅。 
莱迪亚布勒雷的遇难者们。 
那个邻居家孩子，他送我一张绝佳的柬埔寨迷幻唱片，以答谢我帮他父母报税。 
在米拉多尔夜店拉丁之夜共舞的黄裙女子，她把电话号码塞进我口袋。  
（至今仍在我裤袋里。她叫罗萨里奥…这种事啊，只会发生在我身上…） 
数百座城市。  
数千种语言。 
数百万物种。 
数十亿的人类生命。 

本。 
本。

94775422.name: AION Renewal Grips
94775422.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
94775422.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
94775422.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.
94775422.text_zh:
我的朋友列瓦兹克带我们来到绿色星球。他说这是流亡之地的绿。我们破碎的披风与斑驳的漆层皆是预言。我们注定在此。 

列瓦兹克天生雄辩。他能说服任何人，哪怕是人类。他坐在人类小手编织的地毯上，向他们的迪因神吟唱局部重力与化学反应。魔眼们听着，用黏菌构成的蓬松坐垫计算乙太收益，唱起计算的和声。  

新家园比月球温暖潮湿。吸入乙太时咽喉不再干涩作响。很好，很好——除了会担心呼吸器衬里发霉。除了当湿气渗入我的甲壳时，下臂总会泛起金星的记忆性疼痛。 

瑞斯，那名人类熔岩军团学徒，又用歌声向我抛来一个问题。我裹紧斗篷下的肩膀，比了个手势：抱歉，请重复？ 

“你们族人维护着古老的系统，”他复述道，“你们怎么——”此处他唱出一个我无法理解的音符。他察觉到了我的困惑。“新旧交融。废料，垃圾，锈蚀的废弃物。崭新金属。如何共存？” 

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

3218422834.name: AION Renewal Vest
3218422834.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
3218422834.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3218422834.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
3218422834.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

3389206211.name: AION Renewal Cloak
3389206211.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." —Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
3389206211.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
3389206211.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
3389206211.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

1021364471.name: AION Renewal Mask
1021364471.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
1021364471.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1021364471.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
1021364471.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

938718424.name: AION Renewal Strides
938718424.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
938718424.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
938718424.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
938718424.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

1629686472.name: AION Adapter Grips
1629686472.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
1629686472.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1629686472.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.
1629686472.text_zh:
我的朋友列瓦兹克带我们来到绿色星球。他说这是流亡之地的绿。我们破碎的披风与斑驳的漆层皆是预言。我们注定在此。 

列瓦兹克天生雄辩。他能说服任何人，哪怕是人类。他坐在人类小手编织的地毯上，向他们的迪因神吟唱局部重力与化学反应。魔眼们听着，用黏菌构成的蓬松坐垫计算乙太收益，唱起计算的和声。  

新家园比月球温暖潮湿。吸入乙太时咽喉不再干涩作响。很好，很好——除了会担心呼吸器衬里发霉。除了当湿气渗入我的甲壳时，下臂总会泛起金星的记忆性疼痛。 

瑞斯，那名人类熔岩军团学徒，又用歌声向我抛来一个问题。我裹紧斗篷下的肩膀，比了个手势：抱歉，请重复？ 

“你们族人维护着古老的系统，”他复述道，“你们怎么——”此处他唱出一个我无法理解的音符。他察觉到了我的困惑。“新旧交融。废料，垃圾，锈蚀的废弃物。崭新金属。如何共存？” 

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

3798581184.name: AION Adapter Vest
3798581184.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
3798581184.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3798581184.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
3798581184.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

2725736573.name: AION Adapter Cloak
2725736573.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." –Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
2725736573.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
2725736573.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
2725736573.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

3013134961.name: AION Adapter Mask
3013134961.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
3013134961.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3013134961.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
3013134961.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

2306671522.name: AION Adapter Strides
2306671522.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
2306671522.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
2306671522.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
2306671522.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

2867399974.name: Melas Panoplia
2867399974.subtitle: "We need friends, and we need to make them first. Regardless, never keep your weapon out of close reach." —Director William Moffat
2867399974.subtitle_zh: “我们需要朋友，并且需要率先伸出友谊之手。但无论如何，武器都别离身。”——威廉·莫法特主任
2867399974.text:
OFFICE MEMORANDUM—UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT

The Swiss Armed Forces were able to evacuate the mountain and secure the area while our contact notified Central of the incident. 

Upon notification of the distress call, Central concluded ███████ were unnecessary and mobilized Operation █████. Response team was activated. Primary hospitality core included: linguist █████████████, sociologist ██████████, physician ██████████, and myself.

Per █████ protocol, we approached without backup and read the ███████████████████████ alongside accompanying musical stimuli, then approached what we suspected was the ████. The █████ had torn a ████ through the ████, which revealed ████████████████. 

The ███████ themselves were imposing, burly,███████ structure ████████ at the top, with █████████ in a triangular █████████ and tough, thick █████. ██████ are clearly ████████, confirming our foundational hypothesis. The ██████ are being ██████ at our █████████████████. 

Aboard the █████, we also uncovered a ██████████ inside a █████████████. Stored within the █████ was a payload of ███████████████ that further research suggests was ███-engineered to consume a █████████ threat.
