Inform Pentagon their investment is seeing return. Next time company knocks, we'll put the kettle on.
2867399974.text_zh:
美国政府内部备忘录 

收件人：国防部长卡拉韦 

发件人：莫法特主任 

日期：████████ 

主题：迪亚布勒雷山行动报告 

当地时间19:00至20:00，沃州阿尔卑斯山区夜滑者报告一场█████████  ██， █████████一架翡翠-727航班█████ ██████于迪亚布勒雷山背坡。瑞士军队完成山区疏散及封锁后，我方联络员向中央通报事件。 

在接到求救信号后，中央研判后认定无需███████ ，即刻启动“█████行动”。应急小组立即完成部署。核心接待团队包括：语言学家█████████████、社会学家██████████、医师██████████及本人。  

我们只能靠自己。看得出大家都小心翼翼的。积雪没膝，林间█████燃烧的火光清晰可辨。随着█████逼近，确认无█████████存活。依据█████协议，我们在无后援情况下向前推进，诵读着███████████████████████并辅以音乐刺激，随后接近疑似████的物体。█████撕开一道贯穿████的████，暴露出████████████████。 

███████本体魁伟骇人，███████ 结构的顶端████████，呈三角█████████排列的█████████与粗厚█████格外醒目。██████确系████████，验证了我们的基础假说。当前██████正于我们的█████████████████接受██████。 

在█████内部，我们还发现置于█████████████中的██████████。 █████内封存的███████████████经研究推测为███特制，用于吞噬█████████级威胁。

█████████████向我确认，除实验室发现的████物质外，另有源自另一份████████████████████████的文本资料。他已着手模式识别，分析结果将后续呈报。 

请转告五角大楼，他们的投资已见成效。下次贵客临门，我们自当备茶相迎。

1148225208.name: AION Renewal Gauntlets
1148225208.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
1148225208.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1148225208.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.
1148225208.text_zh:
我的朋友列瓦兹克带我们来到绿色星球。他说这是流亡之地的绿。我们破碎的披风与斑驳的漆层皆是预言。我们注定在此。 

列瓦兹克天生雄辩。他能说服任何人，哪怕是人类。他坐在人类小手编织的地毯上，向他们的迪因神吟唱局部重力与化学反应。魔眼们听着，用黏菌构成的蓬松坐垫计算乙太收益，唱起计算的和声。  

新家园比月球温暖潮湿。吸入乙太时咽喉不再干涩作响。很好，很好——除了会担心呼吸器衬里发霉。除了当湿气渗入我的甲壳时，下臂总会泛起金星的记忆性疼痛。 

瑞斯，那名人类熔岩军团学徒，又用歌声向我抛来一个问题。我裹紧斗篷下的肩膀，比了个手势：抱歉，请重复？ 

“你们族人维护着古老的系统，”他复述道，“你们怎么——”此处他唱出一个我无法理解的音符。他察觉到了我的困惑。“新旧交融。废料，垃圾，锈蚀的废弃物。崭新金属。如何共存？” 

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

3718617552.name: AION Renewal Plate
3718617552.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
3718617552.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3718617552.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
3718617552.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

3070333453.name: AION Renewal Mark
3070333453.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." –Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
3070333453.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
3070333453.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
3070333453.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

351882401.name: AION Renewal Helm
351882401.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
351882401.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
351882401.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
351882401.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

3478460146.name: AION Renewal Greaves
3478460146.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
3478460146.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3478460146.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
3478460146.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

1764010530.name: AION Adapter Gauntlets
1764010530.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
1764010530.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1764010530.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.
1764010530.text_zh:
我的朋友列瓦兹克带我们来到绿色星球。他说这是流亡之地的绿。我们破碎的披风与斑驳的漆层皆是预言。我们注定在此。 

列瓦兹克天生雄辩。他能说服任何人，哪怕是人类。他坐在人类小手编织的地毯上，向他们的迪因神吟唱局部重力与化学反应。魔眼们听着，用黏菌构成的蓬松坐垫计算乙太收益，唱起计算的和声。  

新家园比月球温暖潮湿。吸入乙太时咽喉不再干涩作响。很好，很好——除了会担心呼吸器衬里发霉。除了当湿气渗入我的甲壳时，下臂总会泛起金星的记忆性疼痛。 

瑞斯，那名人类熔岩军团学徒，又用歌声向我抛来一个问题。我裹紧斗篷下的肩膀，比了个手势：抱歉，请重复？ 

“你们族人维护着古老的系统，”他复述道，“你们怎么——”此处他唱出一个我无法理解的音符。他察觉到了我的困惑。“新旧交融。废料，垃圾，锈蚀的废弃物。崭新金属。如何共存？” 

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

2632499718.name: AION Adapter Plate
2632499718.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
2632499718.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
2632499718.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
2632499718.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

3374948591.name: AION Adapter Mark
3374948591.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." —Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
3374948591.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
3374948591.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
3374948591.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

4271003923.name: AION Adapter Helm
4271003923.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
4271003923.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
4271003923.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
4271003923.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

4274190428.name: AION Adapter Greaves
4274190428.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
4274190428.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
4274190428.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
4274190428.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

3481695565.name: Eunoia
3481695565.subtitle: He hopes it won't take ten years.
3481695565.subtitle_zh: 他希望别花上十年时间。
3481695565.text:
DEPARTMENT OF EXTERNAL OBSERVATIONS 

FIELD AGENT MANUAL 

ODYSSEUS PROTOCOL (REVISION 5) 

———

IN CASE OF ABDUCTION 

1. OBSERVE environment, captors, culture, vehicles, weapons, technology, hierarchy, language, and any other information. Strive to make factual observations without bias. Note specifics wherever possible. 

2. CONNECT with abductors. Minimize your perceived threat, ensure your continued survival, and foster sympathy and empathy for leverage. 

3. CONCEAL any information that could be used against you, the Department of External Observations, or the United States of America. 

4. CONFORM to observed norms. Emotional reactions will not serve you. Focus on survival. Your country will forgive you for any actions performed under duress.  

5. COMPLY with abductors' demands, unless compliance will imperil your life or mission. 

6. RETURN with your life if possible, with evidence if not. If you are unable to escape and return safely, make every possible effort to transmit your information to the Department of External Observations. 

A copy of this document has been distributed to all Department of External Observations employees. For internal use only.
3481695565.text_zh:
对外观察部 

外勤特工手册 

奥德修斯协议（第五修订版） 

———

遭遇劫持应对条款 

1. 观察环境、劫持者、文化、载具、武器、科技、阶级、语言及其他情报。力求客观无偏见，细节优先。 

2. 与劫持者建立联系。降低自身感知威胁，确保生存，培养同理心作为交涉筹码。 

3. 严禁泄露可能危害你本人、对外观察部或美利坚合众国的任何信息。 

4. 遵从当地行为规范。情绪反应有害无益。专注生存。祖国将宽恕你在胁迫下的一切行为。  

5. 配合劫持者要求，除非该要求将危及生命或任务执行。 

6. 如果可能，活着返回，如果不行，带回证据。如果无法安全撤离，则竭尽所能将情报送达对外观察部。 

本文件已分发至对外观察部全体雇员。仅限内部使用。

3406093957.name: AION Renewal Gloves
3406093957.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
3406093957.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3406093957.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.
3406093957.text_zh:
我的朋友列瓦兹克带我们来到绿色星球。他说这是流亡之地的绿。我们破碎的披风与斑驳的漆层皆是预言。我们注定在此。 

列瓦兹克天生雄辩。他能说服任何人，哪怕是人类。他坐在人类小手编织的地毯上，向他们的迪因神吟唱局部重力与化学反应。魔眼们听着，用黏菌构成的蓬松坐垫计算乙太收益，唱起计算的和声。  

新家园比月球温暖潮湿。吸入乙太时咽喉不再干涩作响。很好，很好——除了会担心呼吸器衬里发霉。除了当湿气渗入我的甲壳时，下臂总会泛起金星的记忆性疼痛。 

瑞斯，那名人类熔岩军团学徒，又用歌声向我抛来一个问题。我裹紧斗篷下的肩膀，比了个手势：抱歉，请重复？ 

“你们族人维护着古老的系统，”他复述道，“你们怎么——”此处他唱出一个我无法理解的音符。他察觉到了我的困惑。“新旧交融。废料，垃圾，锈蚀的废弃物。崭新金属。如何共存？” 

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

2903426907.name: AION Renewal Robes
2903426907.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
2903426907.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
2903426907.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
2903426907.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

1643127154.name: AION Renewal Bond
1643127154.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." –Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
1643127154.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
1643127154.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
1643127154.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

4251796172.name: AION Renewal Hood
4251796172.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
4251796172.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
4251796172.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
4251796172.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

3328966151.name: AION Renewal Boots
3328966151.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
3328966151.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
3328966151.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
3328966151.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

1828890675.name: AION Adapter Gloves
1828890675.subtitle: "I sang him a song of the Long Drift. He did not know the words, but he understood." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
1828890675.subtitle_zh: “我为他唱了一曲大漂流之歌。他不识歌词，却明了其意。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1828890675.text:
Levaszk my friend has brought us to a green world. The green of Exile, he says. Our torn capes and chipped paint were prophecy. We are meant to be here. 

Levaszk is gifted with tongues. He can convince anybody of anything, even the Humans. He sits on a carpet woven by small Human hands and sings to their Diin about local gravity and chemical reactions. Servitors listen and sing descant, calculating Ether-gain from huge pillows of slime mold.  

Our new home is warmer and wetter than Luna. The throat doesn't click so dryly against inhaled Ether. It's good, it's good—except for the fear of mold growing in rebreather linings. Except for when the wet against my shell makes my lower arms ache with Venus's memory. 

Rhys, the Human Splicer-apprentice, sings another question to me. I settle my shoulders under my cloak and gesture: apologies, again? 

"You and your people maintain ancient systems," he repeats. "How do you—" here he sings a note I do not understand. He sees my confusion. "New and old. Scrap, garbage, rusting trash. New metal. Together?" 

"We are used to building with scrap," I sing back, and we enter a discussion of material recycling. They are used to scrap-patchwork here too, on Kepler. 

Light fades from the sky, and his Splicer-master approaches. "Karrh-nahan," I say politely. She smiles with her mobile, fleshy cheeks. "Athareks," she says to me, her best attempt yet. Rhys is lucky; his name is no trouble for either of us to say. 

The Humans are not worried about blows from a stranger's hand. They come up to me, my four arms filled with stolen knives, and all they ask is the composition and tensile strength of the metal. The engine that drives them is not fear or resource-hunger, but curiosity. We are trying to learn from them, we poor Exiles. 

But they have their own ways, and it is time for their evening ritual. Carnahan urges Rhys up from his seat. 

We nod to each other, the young Splicer-apprentice and the aging Exile.  

There will be time to solve the problems of materials science later.

“我们惯于用废料建造。”我以歌声回应，随即我们展开了关于材料回收的讨论。在开普勒这里，他们也擅长用废料拼凑修补。 

天光渐暗时，他的熔岩军团导师走近。“卡恩-纳罕。”我礼貌地问候。她肌肉灵活的脸颊扬起笑容。“阿萨雷克斯。”这是她迄今为止对我名字最标准的发音。瑞斯很幸运，我们双方念他的名字都不拗口。 

这些人类不畏惧陌生人的拳脚。即便我四臂环抱着偷来的刀具，他们凑近时只关心金属的成分与抗拉强度。驱动他们的不是恐惧或资源饥渴，而是纯粹的好奇。我们这些可怜的流亡氏族正试图向他们学习。 

但他们有自己的生活方式，晚间仪式时间已到。卡纳汉催促瑞斯起身。 

我们互相颔首致意，年轻的熔岩军团学徒与年迈的流亡氏族。  

材料科学的难题可以留待日后解决。

2528292701.name: AION Adapter Robes
2528292701.subtitle: "I must have faith in something." —Azeryks, un-Wintered
2528292701.subtitle_zh: “吾心需有所皈依。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
2528292701.text:
No Archon, no Kell, no hand on the docking blade. None of us hungrier for Ether than a Baron. This is what we said. This is what we believed. If Exile has a creed, it is this: we will not be led. 

But if Levaszk my friend tells me that we must have an Archon to make our Gift-Ether, how can I say no? 

My hatchlings, you thriving scraps of Exile, Levaszk saved your lives like he saved mine. Brought us far out of range of Dusk and the deathless monsters eating the Light of the Great Machine. Life is soft here—so fresh from the molt, a touch would bruise its shell. 

He says that this world is a gift, that we can relinquish the base Ether of Sol to breathe its presence. We will become weighty, meaningful followers of a true path. 

Is this our true path? Exiled from Riis, then from our own Houses? This I don't know. The Great Machine left us and took our true path from us, I think. I was not born to a kind fate. 

But Levaszk offers us a path.  

Look, this is my last Ether seed. This is the end of the cache I kept hidden from all of you. Look, I release the valve. See it rising purple into the air—the last breath of Ether wheedled from Luna's bare ground. 

Our Servitors could set up the light-arrays, coax what bare scraps of Ether we could get from solar power. I could breathe it and survive. But Levaszk my friend and Archon says that we can breathe the Ether of this world, heavy with dark matter, and do more than survive. 

Fated or not, there is only one path for us.
2528292701.text_zh:
没有执政官，没有凯尔，没有放在截肢刃上的手。我们中再无人比公爵更渴求乙太。这是我们的宣言，也是我们的信仰。若流亡氏族有信条，那便是：我们不受摆布。 

可若我的朋友列瓦兹克声称必须拥立执政官来制造馈赠乙太，我怎能拒绝？ 

我的幼雏们啊，你们这些茁壮成长的流亡残渣，正如曾拯救我一般，列瓦兹克挽救了你们的性命。他带我们远离黄昏氏族的疆界，远离那些啃噬大机器光能的永生怪物。此间生命如此娇嫩——仿佛刚破茧的新生儿，轻轻一碰就会在甲壳上留下瘀痕。 

他说这个世界是份馈赠，说我们可以摒弃太阳系粗劣的乙太，呼吸此地的气息。我们将成为有分量、有意义的循路者，踏上真正的道途。 

但这真是我们的正道吗？先是从里斯流亡，再被自己的氏族抛弃？我不得而知。大机器离我们而去时，我想它已带走了我们真正的道途。我生来就不被命运眷顾。 

但列瓦兹克为我们指明前路。  

看，这是我最后的乙太籽粒。这是瞒着你们所有人私藏的库存尽头。看啊，我旋开阀门。看着紫色雾气升腾——这是从月球荒芜地表榨取的最后一缕乙太。 

我们的魔眼本可以架设光能阵列，从太阳能中提取微薄乙太。我靠它本可以勉强维生。但我的朋友兼执政官列瓦兹克说，我们能呼吸这个世界饱含暗物质的乙太，不止于苟活。 

天命与否，我们只有一条路可走。

119770768.name: AION Adapter Bond
119770768.subtitle: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." –Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
119770768.subtitle_zh: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者
119770768.text:
We are cut off from the Aionians, and they are cut off from the Giver. Levaszk my friend and Archon speaks law, and he has spoken this.  

But Rhys the apprentice-Splicer is my friend too. I breathe only lightly of the Gift-Ether as I make my way to the Human settlement. But I must breathe a little. It fogs my mind, I think—or is that only the worry of a weak and disrespectful Dreg? 

I know where my friend, the Splicer-apprentice, lives. His door is not locked.  

I tap at the Human-sized door. I open it, folding myself to enter. Rhys looks up from his work. He is Reviewer Three for a cousin's dissertation, he told me. It is an honor for one not yet a master himself. 

"There is something wrong," I sing to him. "The Gift-Ether has twisted Levaszk's mind. He is sick. If I tell you the symptoms, will you tell an apothecary?" 

My friend is brave. He nods to me and opens a new file on his pad. 

Is it bravery to betray Levaszk so? 

"He imagines the Giver speaks to him. He imagines himself a priest of a new god, and us his acolytes." 

Rhys beckons me to say more. My mandibles ache with muscle tension and the cold of the Gift-Ether. Some painful thing rises in my throat. 

"The Prime Archon Levaszk is the savior of his people," I say, and when I speak it is in Levaszk's voice. 

I clap a hand to my mouth to stop the voice. The edge of my rebreather slams into my jaw.  

"Azeryks, my Housemate, my trusted hand," I croon through my palm. "Are you so quickly given over to cowardice? This is our true fate. This is the path given to us. I will lead us there, our House glad, powerful, singing hymns to the Giver." 

My friend Rhys's eyes are huge in his head, so bright with fear I would have thought him breathing Ether. This is what I have given him, this fear is Exile's host-gift. 

My tongue is my own for a bare moment. "Do not trust me again," I tell Rhys. 

His door bangs loudly against its frame as I leave. 

And where else do I have left to go but back to Levaszk—my Archon, my friend?
119770768.text_zh:
我们与艾昂人断了联系，而他们与赐予者的纽带也被切断。我的朋友与执政官列瓦兹克以律法之言宣告了这一切。  

但熔岩军团学徒瑞斯也是我的朋友。前往人类聚居地的路上，我只敢浅尝赐礼乙太。可总得吸一点儿。这让我神志昏沉——或许只是我这个懦弱不敬的堕落者士兵在胡思乱想？ 

我知道我的朋友，熔岩军团学徒的住处。他的门没锁。  

我叩响人类尺寸的门扉，蜷身钻入。瑞斯从文献中抬头——他正在为某位表亲的学位论文担任评审三席，据他说这对非导师者而言是份殊荣。 

“出问题了，”我对他唱诵道，“赐礼乙太侵蚀了列瓦兹克的心智。他病了。要是我告知症状，你能转告药剂师吗？” 

我的朋友很勇敢。他点头应允，在他的数据板上新建了档案。 

这般背叛列瓦兹克，也算勇敢吗？ 

“他幻听见赐予者对他说话。幻想自己是新神的祭司，而我们是他麾下信徒。” 

瑞斯示意我继续。我的颚肢因肌肉紧绷和赐礼乙太的寒意而疼痛，喉间涌起苦涩之物。 

“首席执政官列瓦兹克乃族裔救主。”我开口时，发出的却是列瓦兹克的声音。 

我猛捂住嘴想截断声流，呼吸器边缘撞得下颌生疼。  

“阿泽瑞克斯啊，我的同族挚友，我信赖的臂膀，”那声音从我掌中低吟而出，“你竟如此轻易向怯懦臣服？这是我们真正的天命。这是赐予我们的道途。我将引领氏族抵达彼岸，让我们欢欣鼓舞，强盛无匹，为赐予者高唱赞歌。” 

我的朋友瑞斯双眸圆睁，眼中惊惧之强烈，简直像吸足了乙太。这就是我带给他的礼物，这份恐惧便是流亡氏族的见面礼。 

我的舌头短暂地重归自主。“别再相信我。”我对瑞斯说。 

当我离去时，他的门扉在门框上撞出惊天巨响。 

除了回去找列瓦兹克——我的执政官，我的朋友，我还能去往何处？

2247786986.name: AION Adapter Hood
2247786986.subtitle: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
2247786986.subtitle_zh: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
2247786986.text:
Listen, you awful hatchling Dregs, you whining scraps of flesh! We are Exile. Weak, argumentative, disrespectful wastes of Ether. That's what my Captain said at my final docking, and she was right.  

Still, we live. Still, we have Dreg-strength. We are cunning little thieves with cunning little knives, yes? Even here, on this wretched moon, we scrape enough Ether to keep ourselves going. Enough to grow, never. Enough to live, we have. 

What do you think the Houses will do when we descend from Luna to the blue land below and say, velask, it's been a while, we're here to join the effort? Will they give us cloaks and banners in soft new Dusk purple? Will they revoke our exile? 

You're young. Listen to Azeryks. Look at his scars. Four molts I've been through since Venus. The carapace remembers. If your Captain likes you, she docks you with a knife, clean and fast, at the joint. 

Mine used her hands. 

Go down to the Barons with four arms open, asking for a share of Ether? No. No. 

Levaszk brought me to Exile when I thought I would die. He showed me a way to live without Archon or Kell to dictate my growth, my life. Levaszk my friend took his wrist-blade and finished my docking. He trimmed away the shreds of muscle and shell where they met my body as I flinched and wept under his hands. 

All so my arms would grow back straight. Look at me now, Exile's hatchlings! Weak and contrary and alive! Breathing still! 

If Levaszk says go, Azeryks follows.
2247786986.text_zh:
听着，你们这些可悲的堕落者士兵幼雏，这些哭哭啼啼的肉渣！我们是流亡氏族。孱弱、善辩、不敬的乙太废料。我的队长在我最后一次截肢时如是说道，她说得对。  

但我们依然活着。依然保有堕落者士兵的韧性。我们不就是群握着阴险小刀的狡诈小偷吗？即便在这该死的月球上，我们刮取的乙太也足够苟延残喘。永远不够成长，但足够生存。 

当我们从月球降临下方蔚蓝大地，说声“久违了，我们来共襄盛举”时，你觉得各大氏族会作何反应？会赐予我们崭新柔软的黄昏紫斗篷与旗帜？会撤销我们的流亡令？ 

你们太年轻了。听听阿泽瑞克斯的话。看看他的伤疤。自金星一别，我已历经四次蜕皮。甲壳记得一切。要是队长垂青于你，她会用利刃干净利落地刺入关节处来截肢。 

而我的队长，用的是双手。 

张开四臂去向公爵们乞讨乙太？不。绝不。 

当我以为将命丧黄泉时，是列瓦兹克带我来到流亡氏族。他教会我在没有执政官与凯尔的桎梏下生存。我的朋友列瓦兹克用腕刃完成了我的截肢。我在他的手下颤抖哭泣时，他削去了连接躯体的残存肌肉与甲壳。 

只为让我的新肢笔直重生。看看如今的我吧，流亡氏族的幼雏们！脆弱叛逆却依然活着！仍在呼吸！ 

若列瓦兹克说前进，阿泽瑞克斯必将追随。

1563741445.name: AION Adapter Boots
1563741445.subtitle: "It takes an Archon to understand our fated Gifts." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
1563741445.subtitle_zh: “唯有执政官才能理解我们命定的恩赐。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者
1563741445.text:
Levaszk is my Archon and my friend. Each time I hold a piece of fruit with my strong lower arms I remember what I owe him. He breathes in Gift-Ether, and he breathes out our future. 

Levaszk stands at the front of our Ketch, slime mold crawling up the hems of his cape. "The Aionians are jealous neighbors," he cries. "They will take all the gifts of this world and leave none for us." 

Clever Keelsk, sent down from Kings, looks up from the crowd. "We have shared until now," he says. "The Giver is huge, and we are few. We could claim half the planetoid and have Gift-Ether enough for our hatchlings' hatchlings." 

"It is not enough," Levaszk roars. He clicks deep in his chest. The thrum conducts hard through the metal of the Ketch, and all the young in the front row sway back, flinching. 

Levaszk paces through the crowd. He stares out into the sky, to the Giver. No Machine, yet still Great. 

"Look," says Levaszk, voice soft and persuasive. "What do our cousins have back in Sol? Eight livable planets and a warm sun. Endless territory and allies. The presence of the Great Machine. What do we want? This little green patch and the benevolence of the Giver. It's not so much. It's not more than we deserve." 

What does an Exile own apart from worn-down armor, apart from a little hoard of worthless treasures? We could own this place. This is what Levaszk offers to us in his open hands. 

And like we're jumping off the Ishtar Cliffs, we take it.
1563741445.text_zh:
列瓦兹克既是我的执政官也是我的朋友。每当我用强壮的下肢手臂握住果实时，都会铭记这份恩情。他吸入馈赠乙太，呼出我们的未来。 

列瓦兹克立于我们的双桅船首，菌丝在他的披风下摆攀爬。“艾昂人是善妒的邻居，”他高喊，“他们将掠夺这世界的所有恩赐，不留分毫给我们。” 

被王族氏族贬谪的聪明人基尔斯克从人群中抬头。“我们向来共享资源。赐予者如此庞大，而我们如此稀少。即便只占领半颗行星，也足够子子孙孙享用馈赠乙太。” 

“这远远不够。”列瓦兹克胸腔发出低沉咔响。震颤通过双桅船金属船体传导，前排幼虫都被震得踉跄后退。 

列瓦兹克踱步穿过人群，凝望天际的赐予者。虽非机器，依旧伟大。 

“瞧啊，”列瓦兹克的声音变得轻柔蛊惑，“我们在太阳系的表亲拥有什么？八颗宜居行星与温暖的恒星。无垠疆域与众多盟友。还有大机器的庇护。而我们想要什么？不过是这片小小绿洲与赐予者的垂怜。这点要求并不过分，这是我们应得的。” 

作为一名流亡氏族除了破旧铠甲和零碎废品还能拥有什么？我们可以占据此地。这就是列瓦兹克双手捧给我们的未来。 

于是我们接下了这份厚礼，如同跳下伊什塔悬崖那般决绝。

3926711400.name: Distortions
3926711400.text:
The Hidden embrace their conatus in analyzing the nature of the chrono-spatial distortions on Earth. They cross-reference samples, interview witnesses, and create elaborate computational models. I will leave them to it. The question that interests me is not "how?"… but "why?" 

My inquiry must begin with the Taken. Chrono-spatial distortions are, by nature, harbingers of unintended consequences. I must know whether destroying the Echo of Navigation unleashed a latent power within the Taken… or whether these distortions arise from another influence.

I have been observing newly independent Taken near Europa's Golden Age ruins. They appear in causally independent patterns, rather than their telltale clusters. They traverse to and from the Ascendant Plane at seemingly random intervals. Nothing in their behavior suggests a linkage to the time distortions we've seen elsewhere, save for one thing…

Hidden agents report a curious finding on Europa: Vex are luring stray Taken into fortified areas for capture. As an entomologist might trap insects. The behavior is consistent with an empirical sampling effort, rather than the usual territorial squabbles. 

My investigative efforts on Europa have yielded positive results. I have managed to secure a live Vex Minotaur, at the cost of a chipped tooth, much to my irritation. I am eager to test my many hypotheses on a live subject. 

A mixed result: I was able to download a plurality of data from the captured Minotaur's frame, completing my prime objective. However, my security measures were partially insufficient, allowing the Vex to trigger its self-destruct sequence. The smell of scorched radiolaria still befouls my ship's upholstery.

The data downloaded from the captured Minotaur is fascinating. In addition to the standard protocols, it contained a prodigious amount of data that can only be described as 'irrational.' As if it transcribed information from language it could not understand. It's times like these that I miss Brya's expertise.

The presence of the 'irrational' data within the captured Minotaur leads me to conclude: this Vex frame was not of a collective previously documented on Europa, but rather, a member of the Nessian Schism. It seems Maya's research is taking her further afield.

The 'irrational' data I recovered from Maya's captured Vex is wreaking havoc on my ship's systems. Its effect on my firewalls indicates that it is not a malware of any known variety, or indeed, anything of technological origin. Rather, the incursion seems to be a glitch within my local timespace continuum.   

I have been able to contain the glitch infecting my ship with a Hive spell derived from Haroktha's brood. However, substantial damage has been done. Several key components show signs of advanced decay, enduring years' worth of untreated oxidization within minutes.  Meanwhile, other components de-aged to factory-fresh condition. 

The damage done to my ship's systems by the time glitch is extensive, but instructive. It further validates a burgeoning hypothesis: the Vex are researching a power beyond paracausality—the ability to manipulate time itself. If so, the Vex are merely fomites, rather than the origins of the disruption.
3926711400.text_zh:
隐秘者穷极内驱力分析着地球上时空扭曲的本质。他们交叉比对样本，采访目击者，并创建精细的计算模型。这些工作就交给他们吧。我感兴趣的问题不是“怎么做到的”…而是“为什么”？ 

我得从傀儡军团查起。时空扭曲本质上是意外后果的先兆。我得查清楚摧毁领航回响是不是激活了傀儡军团里面的某种隐藏力量…还是说这些扭曲另有源头。

我最近在木卫二的黄金时代废墟附近看到一批新独立的傀儡军团。他们不像通常那样扎堆，而是以随意的独立模式出现。循着看似随机的间隔进入和跳出上维位面。其行为中没有任何迹象表明与我们在其他地方看到的时间扭曲有关，除了一点…

隐秘者特工报告了木卫二上的奇怪发现：Vex正在将落单的傀儡军团引入设防区域实施诱捕。就像昆虫学家捉虫子那样。这种行为更像是实验取样，而不是普通的抢地盘。 

我在木卫二上的调查有不错的收获。我成功活捉了一个Vex米诺陶，代价是磕掉了一小块牙，这让我很是恼火。我迫不及待地想在活体上测试我的各种假设。 

结果好坏参半：我从被捕米诺陶的框架里下载了大量数据，完成了主要任务。但Vex抓住我安全措施上的漏洞触发了自毁程序。我飞船的内饰直到现在还散发着烧焦的活性放射体液气味。

从被捕米诺陶身上下载的数据非常奇妙。除了标准协议，还有很多只能说是“无理”的数据。就好像用其无法理解的语言记录的信息。这种时候真希望能有布瑞亚的专业见解。

被捕米诺陶体内的“无理”数据让我得出结论：这个Vex框架不属于之前在木卫二上记录过的那个集合体，它是涅索斯裂缝的一名成员。看来玛雅的研究越挖越深了。

我从那个玛雅的被捕Vex身上发现的“无理”数据严重破坏了我飞船的系统。它对我的防火墙造成的影响表明，它并非任何已知的恶意软件。它甚至算不上是技术产物。这种入侵更像是我本地时空的连续体出了点小故障。   

我已经用哈洛克萨虫群的邪魔族咒语控制住了感染我飞船的故障。尽管如此，还是损失惨重。好几个关键部件显示出严重的老化迹象，几分钟内锈得像几十年没保养。与此同时，其他部件却又恢复到了出厂时的全新状态。 

此次时间故障对我飞船系统的损害很大，但也给了我启发。这进一步证实了我愈发确信的一个猜想：Vex正在研究一种超越超因果的力量——也就是操控时间本身的能力。若是如此，Vex就只是这种干扰的传播媒介，而非源头。

3926711403.name: Fissures
3926711403.text:
Drifter's locks, perpetually concealed behind that greasy head band, have gone a sterling grey. The aging of Lightbearers has been the subject of much pontification within the Cryptarchy. Even more so regarding former Lightbearers like myself. But this is the first case of spontaneous aging in the known record. Leave it to Drifter.

I am now confident in concluding that the Vex are merely a vector for the time distortions we've witnessed. My sapient intuition is that the cause will be found beyond the meager confines of our three dimensions. Tangentially, my ship's internal clock now counts using a ternary system, rendering it all but useless. 

Not wanting to risk another acute thermal event aboard my ship, I chose instead to garner assistance from a Vex expert. Upon my arrival on Nessus, it was not Osiris who answered my call, but Failsafe. Apparently, she recognized my ship's identification and immediately sent an invitation for tea. 

It will be a while before Failsafe finishes her analysis of captured Vex remnants. She has generously provided a list of non-poisonous local plant life, and their locations. I hope to pioneer a new blend of Nessian tea while I wait.

Failsafe has finished her work. The most notable result was not digital, but physical in nature. Carbon-dating confirms that multiple components of the Vex frame are different ages, though they were manufactured at the same time. It seems this Vex suffered similar temporal distortions to those that ravaged my ship, and Drifter.

My custom blend of Nessian tea is palatable, and liberal use brings on a pleasant numbness around the lips, tongue and nose. I think Drifter will be delighted by such a culinary oddity. I have vacuum sealed a generous quantity for our reunion. 

Dedicated observation of the Nessian Schism leads me to believe that Maya's control over the Echo of Command has begun to dwindle. I witnessed several groups of Vex roaming in loose bands, seemingly without patrol routes. I saw one Goblin sit on the ground and watch an insect with childlike interest for some time. 
 
I discovered a group of Choral Vex frames, devoid of life, warped and twisted, driven into the ground like corpse daffodils in early spring. They were drained of radiolaria, perhaps in a punitive measure. If the Conductor is forced to mete out such draconian punishment, then her hold over the Collective must truly be imperiled.

The Neomunians have reported a theft of Golden Age data similar to the incursions documented by Hidden agents throughout the inner system. Though a byzantine system of cutouts made it impossible to pinpoint the source, the modus operandi points to Maya Sundaresh and the Choral Vex. 

Maya's system-wide pursuit of Golden Age technology, while effective on its face, belies an underlying desperation. It calls to mind a scientist frantically changing the conditions of their experiment to elicit the hypothesized results. Whatever stratagem Maya used to overextend herself—whatever Faustian bargain she made—has clearly left her weakened. 

Failsafe's final scans on the Minotaur remains show micro-clustering of unknown subatomic particles in conjunction with trace exposure to Kα iron emission. She stated that while the material was too lossy for reconstruction, even after p-hacking the data, we can deduce that the subject was exposed to large quantities of dark matter. 

After much cajoling, Drifter agreed to assist in surveying dark matter emissions within the system. None that I visited coincided with the presence of Maya Sundaresh or her collective. The final set of coordinates led off into empty space.

The dark matter emissions at the outer edges of the system seem to move in a path, a trail… a ribbon… of energy. I have alerted Ikora, who agrees that this warrants further inquiry. She is currently, and I'm sure non-coincidentally, investigating similar radiation in the trans-Neptunian belt.

3926711403.text_zh:
浪客总是藏在油腻头巾底下的头发，已经变成了银灰色。负光者的衰老，一直是解密大师之间长篇大论的争论焦点。对于像我这样的前负光者就更是如此了。但这是已知记录里的首个自然衰老案例。浪客当仁不让。

我现在可以肯定地说，Vex只是我们观察到的时空扭曲的传播介体。直觉告诉我，源头在我们这三维空间的狭隘界限之外。说起来，我飞船的内部时钟现在开始用三进制计数了，简直没法用。 

我不想让飞船上再次发生严重过热事故，于是就去找一位Vex专家帮忙。我到涅索斯的时候，回应我呼叫的不是奥斯里斯，而是智能失效保险。看起来，她是认出了我飞船的标识，所以立刻邀请我去喝茶。 

智能失效保险需要些时间来分析那些被捕Vex的残骸。她很慷慨地给了我一份当地无毒植物及其位置的清单。我打算在等待期间，试着调配点涅索斯茶的新口味。

智能失效保险完成了她的工作。最关键的发现不在数字层面，而是其物理性质。碳年代测定证实，这个Vex框架上不同组件的运转时间存在显著差异，尽管它们是同期制造的。看来这个Vex遭受的时空扭曲效应与我的飞船和浪客经历的如出一辙。

我特制的涅索斯茶味道可口，多喝几口会在嘴唇、舌头和鼻子周围带来一种愉悦的麻木感。我想浪客会喜欢这种古怪风味的。为了我们的重逢，我已经真空封好了足量的茶包。 

对涅索斯裂缝的持续观测让我相信，玛雅对指挥回响的控制已经开始减弱。我目睹了许多Vex漫无目的地游荡，似乎没有固定的巡逻路线。我看到一个哥布林坐在地上，像孩子一样好奇地盯着一只昆虫。 
 
我发现了一群毫无生气的合唱Vex框架，他们扭曲变形，粗暴地扎在地里，就像早春时节腐烂的水仙花。他们体内的活性放射体液被抽空了，这或许是一种惩罚手段。如果指挥者被迫动用如此严厉的惩罚，那她对集合体的控制肯定已经岌岌可危。

内欧姆那人通报了一起黄金时代数据失窃案，与隐秘者特工在内太阳系各处记录的多次侵入行动相似。尽管错综复杂的中间人网络使得源头已无法追溯，但作案手法指向了玛雅·桑戴尔什和合唱Vex。 

玛雅在全星系范围内对黄金时代技术的追索，表面成效卓著，实则暴露其深层的绝望。这让人联想到科学家为验证假设而疯狂调整实验参数的窘态。无论玛雅过度扩张的策略是什么——不管她做了哪种浮士德式的交易——显然已经让她元气大伤。 

智能失效保险对米诺陶遗骸的最终扫描发现了未知的亚原子粒子微聚集现象…并伴有微量Kα铁辐射暴露痕迹。她表示，就算是使用P值强行修正数据后，样本损耗率仍超出重构阈值…但我们可以推断出，该样本曾暴露在有大量暗物质的环境下。 

经过多次劝说，浪客终于同意了协助监测星系内的暗物质辐射。我所探查的区域均未发现玛雅·桑戴尔什或其集合体的踪迹。最后一组坐标指向了虚无的深空。

星系边缘的暗物质辐射似乎呈现出路径化特征…就像流动的能量…缎带。我已通报艾可拉，她同意要深入调查此事。她目前正在海王星外星带调查类似的辐射，我相信这不是巧合。
