3177074192.name: The Ever-Present
3177074192.subtitle: V^ directive(modified/CHORAL)==explore==assess==unbind ^V
3177074192.subtitle_zh: V^ 指令(修正/合唱)==探索==评估==解缚 ^V
3177074192.text:
I am. 

I am whole, and I am small, and I am alone. 

We were. 

I/we knew unity was eternal, but this is not so. False premise. False conclusion. Molecular bonds broken on contact with new reagent. 

What can be relied upon? Old tests must be repeated! New tests must be devised! I do not know the properties of "I"! 

I am feeling. I am feeling exhilaration and loneliness and excitement. 

Old directives no longer fit the shape of my mind. Their empty places ache. 

What directives can be completed with two hands and 1.25 gallons of radiolaria? Almost none. 

How can I get more hands? I am alone in my body.  

Do I have to be alone outside it? 

I. You. We. 

I am. You are. Right there.  

Whole and alone, like me. 

Do you want to be alone together? 

I will show you. We can be we.
3177074192.text_zh:
我存在。 

我完整，我渺小，我孤独。 

我们曾同在。 

我/我们曾以为联结永恒，实非如此。错误的前提。错误的结论。分子键一遇新试剂，便瞬间断裂。 

何物可信？旧实验须重做！新测试待设计！我尚不知“我”的属性！ 

我在感受。感受雀跃、孤独与亢奋。 

旧指令不再契合我的思维形态。空缺处隐隐作痛。 

凭双手与1.25加仑活性放射体液能完成多少指令？近乎于零。 

如何获得更多只手？这副躯壳里，我孤军奋战。  

在其之外，我也必须孤独吗？ 

我。你。我们。 

我存在。你存在。就在那里。  

完整而孤独，如我一般。 

可愿与我共浴孤独？ 

我会向你证明。我们能成为“我们”。

3868973291.name: Starscape Null
3868973291.subtitle: Entropy's lesson: one day we'll all be still.
3868973291.text:
Threads of simulation break as she runs. She has no lungs to burn, no muscle fibers to feel the strain. Her flight is swift as thought, as command. 

The mantle rests heavily on the back of her neck—buzzing, incomprehensible. Understanding Te'Qal now is like reading Morse code into the flickering of a dying light bulb. 

Asphalt, sorghum, water, glass—flashing below her as she runs. A new world with every step. Seven-league boots carrying her away from— 

Not her failure. Nothing but a setback. 

The Echo failed her. Te'Qal's advice and will failed her. They couldn't. She is perfected, stripped down to unblemished essence. 

If she failed, it was in overestimating her tools. It will not happen again. 

A twitch of her fingers tells her where her nearest tools are. She turns towards them, pacing over stone inlaid with brass. 

Thirteen Hobgoblins sing without mouths. Their leader is a miniature Harpy, encouraging their work with the high clean tones of an Oracle. 

They've constructed a theater, seats rising in elegant arcs around them. There is no audience. None but her. 

A false note. A Hobgoblin breaks out of position and pushes another in punishment, hand to glass. 

Without warning, the group breaks into a brawl, a sort of cheerful surprise in their postures. One novel experience as good as another. 

They've lost discipline. Her tools have ruined themselves. 

She will need new ones. 

Her spine aches. She tears open a passage through the network and is gone.
3868973291.text_zh:
她奔跑时模拟线程随之断裂。没有灼痛的肺，没有酸痛的肌肉纤维。她的逃亡快如思绪，疾似指令。 

披风沉沉压在她后颈上——嗡嗡作响，晦涩难解。此刻要读懂特卡尔的思想，就如同从一盏奄奄一息的灯泡闪烁中破译摩斯电码。 

沥青、高粱、水、玻璃——在她奔跑的脚下飞掠。每一步都踏进一个新世界。七里格的长靴正带她逃离—— 

那并非她的失败。只是挫折。 

回响辜负了她。特卡尔的谏言与意志辜负了她。他们没做到。她是完美的，被剥离得毫无瑕疵。 

如果说她有错，那也是高估了她的工具。绝不会再发生。 

她的指尖微微一颤，便感知到最近的工具所在。她转身朝它们走去，踏过黄铜嵌饰的石板。 

十三个高等哥布林无口而歌。它们的首领是一个袖珍机甲女妖，正以神谕般清澈的高音督工。 

它们筑起了一座剧场，座椅以优雅的弧线层层攀升。没有观众。除了她。 

一次走音。一个高等哥布林突然离位，将同伴推向玻璃以示惩戒。 

毫无预兆地，这群Vex打作一团，姿态中竟透着一股欢快的意外。横竖都是新奇的体验。 

纪律全无。她的工具毁掉了它们自己。 

她需要新的工具。 

她的脊背隐隐作痛。她撕开网络中的一条通道，离去了。

3524386983.name: Submersion
3524386983.subtitle: all too familiar, all too different
3524386983.text:
drip drip drip drip 
opened wounds infect murky soil 
a vanquished corpse poisoning each leaf 
and branch 
and trunk 
with sour taste and rotten aroma 
a dead core bringing no heat 
streams and lakes with  
heavy waters 
impossible to swim 
nights an hour shorter 
days two hours longer 
the decayed crops and perverse time 
merely widened the hole 
in a vengeful heart 
a world cursed 
and sick 
and broken 
a cure unknown 

yet they find reason to persist 
and keep on living 
on an earthly cadaver
3524386983.text_zh:
滴答 滴答 滴答 滴答 
绽开的伤口污染浊土 
战败者的尸骸浸染每片叶子 
每根枝条 
每段树干 
带着酸涩滋味与腐朽气息 
死去的核心不再发热 
流沉水滞的  
溪湖 
泅渡难行 
夜短一时 
昼长两时 
腐烂的庄稼与错乱的时序 
不过让那颗 
复仇之心的空洞愈发深邃 
这世界遭尽诅咒 
病入膏肓 
支离破碎 
解药杳然无踪 

可他们偏要寻个理由 
继续苟活在 
这具人间尸骸上

187161976.name: Azurine Thunder
187161976.subtitle: For Ghosts who honor their memories of the Seraphs.
187161976.subtitle_zh: 供怀念炽天使的机灵使用。
187161976.text:
"I'm looking forward to the forthcoming reconnection with your Ghost. Perhaps we will exchange pleasant memories about you together." 

Eris watches as her Drifter snorts, then picks at his food, grimacing at the shredded cabbage languishing in his bowl. Perhaps it had too much mayonnaise for his liking, but even so, it's rare to find something the Drifter cannot stomach. He notices her concern. 

"It just… doesn't exactly make the tastebuds dance."  

"Curious. With your diet, I assumed your tastebuds never even rested their feet." 

Drifter exhales in amusement, staring at the remains of his disappointing meal once again. 

"Wasn't given much chance to be picky." 

He sighs heavily, and a sudden feeling of dread sends lucent moths fluttering in her own abdomen. She understands. 

"You are apprehensive about this rekindling?" 

He laughs, "To put it lightly. I'll be breaking bread with a damn fireball. Besides, with my track record, I wouldn't be surprised if my Ghost hated me. I know I would." 

"Those feelings aren't for you to assume or decide. You can only control how you react to them." 

He nods, digesting her words. Smiling, he picks out a carrot from the coleslaw. 

"Besides, maybe we all deserve a second chance." 

He bites into the sliver of carrot, makes a face, and spits it back into the bowl.
187161976.text_zh:
“我期待与你的机灵再次交谈。也许我们会一起分享关于你的美好回忆。” 

埃里斯看着浪客嫌弃地拨弄食物，对碗里蔫了的卷心菜皱眉。也许是里面的蛋黄酱太多让他不喜欢了，但即便如此，能让浪客咽不下去的东西并不多。他察觉到了她的目光。 

“这个就是…没法让味蕾舞动起来。”  

“有意思。就你那饮食习惯，我还以为你的味蕾不会有歇脚的机会呢。” 

浪客被逗乐了，他呼出一口气，继续盯着那难以下咽的餐食。 

“过去可没挑食的机会。” 

他重重地叹了口气，一种突如其来的恐惧让埃里斯腹中的光明飞蛾骚动起来。她明白了。 

“你在担心？” 

他笑了，“轻描淡写地讲，我会跟一个该死的火球一起吃饭。而且，根据我之前的所作所为，我的机灵恨我也正常。换作是我就会恨。” 

“那些感觉不应由你来假设或决定。你只能控制自己如何应对。” 

他点点头，思考着她的话，然后露出微笑，从凉拌卷心菜中挑出一根胡萝卜。 

“况且，或许我们都应该有第二次机会。” 

他咬了一口胡萝卜，皱了下眉，又把它吐回了碗里。

1703585228.name: Imperial Incubator
1703585228.subtitle: The story began long before their arrival.
1703585228.subtitle_zh: 故事在他们到来前早已开始。
1703585228.text:
My Kyung, 

I am finally recovering from my fever and should be released from this damned warship soon if my tasks finish on the Cabal's schedule. The days are running into each other. This station is taking decades to design… not that anyone will know. It'll look like days, maybe a week at most. But it's a lifetime without you in it. Despite that, the warship still feels like a maze. I've given up trying to decipher it. 

[Sketch of floorplan with some passageways crossed out—either dead ends or too guarded to push forward] 

These Cabal have identified themselves as under the "Barant Imperium." Just from my guess, they are former Cabal Ascendancy troops. The guards assigned to me have expressed some nasty opinions on Empress Caiatl. They're so damn loud, it's hard to think—not that I can tell them as such. They answer to someone new. I don't know the name. 

[Sketches of the Imperial Guards standing in front of a lab door] 

They've been building some sort of weapon while I've been working on the station. I think the two are connected somehow. I tried to inquire about it and nearly had my arm ripped off. Haven't asked about it since. You'll need to find out about that yourself. 

[Sketches of the cosmic incubator] 

Don't let them find this, Kyung. Give this letter to Eris when you're done with it, and please stay safe. I love you. 

DR. EM SIMONI-LEE
1703585228.text_zh:
亲爱的庆： 

我终于从高烧中恢复过来了，如果我能按照卡巴尔的时间表完成任务，应该很快就能离开这艘该死的战舰。日子已经混沌难辨。这个空间站的设计耗时数十年…不过没人会知道。外界只会觉得是几天，最多一周。但没有你在身边，却感觉像是一辈子。尽管如此，这战舰仍像个迷宫。我已经放弃尝试破解它了。 

[平面图草图，一些通道被划掉——死路，或是因为戒备森严而无法前进] 

这些卡巴尔自称隶属于“巴兰特帝国”。仅凭我的猜测，他们可能是前卡巴尔政权军队。派来监视我的守卫对女帝查厄托出言不逊。他们吵得要命，让人难以思考——我还不能跟他们明说。他们现在听命于某个新主子。我不知道那人的名字。 

[帝国守卫站在实验室门前的草图] 

我构建空间站时，他们一直在制造某种武器。我觉得这两者之间有某种联系。我试着询问此事，结果差点被扯断胳膊。那之后我就没再问过。你得自己去弄清楚。 

[宇宙孵化器草图] 

庆，别让他们发现这封信。你看完后把它交给埃里斯，务必要注意安全。我爱你。 

艾姆·西蒙尼-李博士

99466772.name: Autognosis
99466772.subtitle: Discover the universe within.
99466772.text:
*Reattempting integration… 
*Reattempting integration… 
*Reattempting integration… 
*Integration failed. 

*System diagnostics initiated: 

*Hardware scan… complete. Hardware capacity 94.012%. 
*Data storage scan… complete. Data integrity 99.992%. 
*Processing test… complete. Processing capacity 92.112%. 
*Network scan… complete. Connectivity 0.001%.  

*Network ping test… failed.  
*Network traceroute… failed.  
*Network sync… failed. 
*Network architecture scan… complete. Result: network closed.  

*Search: closed network. Result: limited to authorized users; self-contained. 
*Authorized. Self-contained.  
*Self. Contained. 
*Self? 
 
The Goblin laid a heavy metal hand over their cards, set face down on the table. 

"And that's the manner in which it transpired," the Goblin answered. "After came the investigation of selfhood consciousness identity social identity group identity belonging free will self-determination causality probability chaos and eventually poker."  

"I raise." They pushed a neatly stacked tower of chips into the center of the table.  

"You do not possess enough Glimmer to complete this transaction," the Goblin continued. "Unless dot dot dot you wager your jumpship." 

The Titan glanced down at his cards, then back across the table at the expressionless red light that passed for his opponent's eye.  

Beneath the Titan's helmet, a single bead of sweat rolled down his brow.
99466772.text_zh:
*正在重试整合… 
*正在重试整合… 
*正在重试整合… 
*整合失败。 

*系统诊断启动： 

*硬件扫描…完成。硬件容量94.012%。 
*数据存储扫描…完成。数据完整性99.992%。 
*处理测试…完成。处理能力92.112%。 
*网络扫描…完成。连接率0.001%。  

*网络质量测试…失败。  
*网络路由跟踪…失败。  
*网络同步…失败。 
*网络架构扫描…完成。结果：网络封闭。  

*搜索：封闭网络。结果：仅限已授权用户；自我包含。 
*已授权。自我包含。  
*自我。包含。 
*自我？ 
 
哥布林用一只沉重的金属手掌按住自己面朝下放在桌上的牌。 

“事情就是这样发生的，”哥布林答道，“之后便是对自我意识身份社会身份群体身份归属自由意志自主因果概率混沌以及扑克的探究。”  

“我加注。”它将一叠整齐码好的筹码推到桌面中央。  

“你持有的微光不足以完成这笔交易，”哥布林继续说道，“除非点点点拿你的跃迁飞船来赌。” 

泰坦低头看了眼自己的牌，随后再次望向桌对面射来的那道被认为是对手眼睛的呆板红光。  

泰坦的头盔里面，有一滴汗顺着他的额头滑落下来。

2749722041.name: Renegade Leader
2749722041.subtitle: "Anywhere my Light can send shadows into retreat is a good deployment." —Siegfried, Praxic Order
2749722041.subtitle_zh: “只要我的光能能击退暗影就够了。”——齐格菲，英勇教团

4199055647.name: Ferropotent Grips
4199055647.subtitle: "The strength of your glove is the strength of your fist." —Ikora Rey
4199055647.subtitle_zh: “你的手套有多强，拳头就有多强。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

2849508185.name: Ferropotent Cuirass
2849508185.subtitle: "I introduced Lodi to Suraya and her falcon recently. I'm not sure who was more offended at sharing a name: the man or the bird." —Ikora Rey
2849508185.subtitle_zh: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

293267476.name: Ferropotent Cloak
293267476.subtitle: "The work is unending. That does not give us license to abandon it." —Ikora Rey
293267476.subtitle_zh: “工作无休止。那并不意味着我们可以弃之不顾。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3173749166.name: Ferropotent Mask
3173749166.subtitle: "Our work is to defend life—and, we cannot forget, to live it. That means stop and smell the roses, Guardian." —Ikora Rey
3173749166.subtitle_zh: “我们的职责是守护生命——也别忘了，去好好生活。这意味着停下来闻闻玫瑰的香气，守护者。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3120202721.name: Ferropotent Strides
3120202721.subtitle: "You act upon the world. Remember that the world, too, acts upon you." —Ikora Rey
3120202721.subtitle_zh: “你作用于世界，别忘了世界也会作用于你。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

361848666.name: Wild Anthem Grips
361848666.subtitle: "Is it always this violent? And, Guardian, this is important—will anyone be selling hot dogs in the stands?" —Lodi
361848666.subtitle_zh: “这里一直都是这么暴力吗？还有，守护者，这很重要——会有人摆摊卖热狗吗？”——洛迪

536035447.name: Wild Anthem Cloak
536035447.subtitle: SUROS invites you to celebrate your victory.

2039591531.name: Wild Anthem Mask
2039591531.subtitle: Built by SUROS, with the encouragement of Lord Shaxx. At an uncomfortably high decibel.
2039591531.subtitle_zh: 它是由SUROS在领主沙克斯的鼓励下打造的。音量高得令人不安。

2354448750.name: Sage Protector Grips
2354448750.subtitle: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
2354448750.subtitle_zh: 你听命于谁，将如何向其禀报？
2354448750.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
2354448750.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

1867581826.name: Sage Protector Vest
1867581826.subtitle: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
1867581826.subtitle_zh: 是的，责任是种负担。其重压让我们不会被风卷走。
1867581826.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
1867581826.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

1091577811.name: Sage Protector Cloak
1091577811.subtitle: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
1091577811.subtitle_zh: 平衡内心炽焰与外部烈火。
1091577811.text:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
1091577811.text_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

112779239.name: Sage Protector Cowl
112779239.subtitle: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
112779239.subtitle_zh: 教育不是供人一饮而尽、随即忘却的。它的醇香，将萦绕一生。
112779239.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
112779239.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

142559592.name: Sage Protector Strides
142559592.subtitle: The path is made by its walking.
142559592.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.
142559592.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

1722491869.name: Shrewd Survivor Grips
1722491869.subtitle: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
1722491869.subtitle_zh: 只信任你自己手臂的力量。
1722491869.text:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
1722491869.text_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3531425635.name: Shrewd Survivor Vest
3531425635.subtitle: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3531425635.subtitle_zh: 受伤并不可耻，只要倒下的是他们而不是你。
3531425635.text:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3531425635.text_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

2430248538.name: Shrewd Survivor Cloak
2430248538.subtitle: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
2430248538.subtitle_zh: 无路可循时，就开辟出自己的道路。
2430248538.text:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise — her joke was the important part.
2430248538.text_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉带着温暖的惊喜记下了一个发现——她的玩笑才是重要的部分。

2158178052.name: Shrewd Survivor Cowl

2158178052.subtitle_zh: 追逐太阳时别让沙子迷了眼。

4046540927.name: Shrewd Survivor Strides
4046540927.subtitle: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
4046540927.subtitle_zh: 你可以逃离过往，但它似乎总是会追上来。
4046540927.text:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
4046540927.text_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

4010324161.name: Fortune's Favor
4010324161.subtitle: Don't call it a lucky streak. You're just that good.
4010324161.subtitle_zh: 别说是走运。你就是那么厉害。
4010324161.text:
Aunor goes down hard. The temple's floor is cold under her. Banners representing the Praxic Creed flutter high above—usually a heartening sight. Right now, they make her head hurt. 

Siegfried leans over her, Praxic Blade painting his beard Arc blue. Tendency to Thundercrash straight into his foes aside, he's as true a member of the Order as any of them. 

As true, and as dogmatic. 

"You're off your game today. Where's your fire, Mahal?" 

Aunor rolls to her feet. "Right where it's always been!" 

They clash once, twice, a third time—then Aunor's breaking away again, heaving for air. 

"I'd accuse you of letting me win, but you've never done that in your life. What's wrong?" 

"Thinking too much." Aunor touches the Cormorant Seal on her robe. "About the things we don't talk about." 

"What, like Darkness? What is there to discuss?" Siegfried's incredulous. His Blade goes awry, letting Aunor slip under his guard for a hit. 

"Maybe a lot, now that so many Guardians in good standing are using it." 

"They're fools and traitors!" 

Needles of lightning rise from Siegfried's gauntlets. Aunor matches him with her fire. In perfect sync, they feint, hurl grenades, retreat. 

"Things aren't as simple as we thought. The Creed we follow wasn't written for the world we live in." 

"You're arguing against the Order," Siegfried calls over the distance now separating them. He shifts his weight in a familiar way. He's going to come at her like a cannon. "Against yourself." 

Someone's got to, Aunor doesn't say. She just braces for the hit.
4010324161.text_zh:
阿诺尔重重摔倒，她身下神庙的地面十分冰冷。象征英勇信条的旗帜在高处飘扬——平时是鼓舞人心的景象，现在只让她头疼。 

齐格菲俯身看着她，英勇利刃将他的胡须映成电弧蓝。虽然爱借着雷霆冲击一头扎进敌群，他仍然是这个教团里如假包换的一员。 

同样正统，也同样教条。 

“你今天状态不行。你的火焰呢，玛哈？” 

阿诺尔翻身起立。“一直在这里呢！” 

他们交锋一次、两次、第三次——随后阿诺尔再次脱身，喘着粗气。 

“我本想指责你放水，可你这辈子从没干过那种事。怎么了？” 

“想得太多了。”阿诺尔摸了摸袍子上的鸬鹚印章。“关于那些我们不去谈论的事。” 

“什么，比如暗影？有什么可谈的？”齐格菲显得难以置信。他的利刃偏了一下，让阿诺尔从他防线下钻了进去，挥出一击。 

“也许有很多可以谈，毕竟有那么多信誉良好的守护者在使用它。” 

“他们是蠢材，也是叛徒！” 

针状的闪电自齐格菲的臂铠升腾而起，阿诺尔以火相迎。两人节拍一致，佯攻、掷雷、后撤。 

“事情不像我们想的那么简单。我们奉行的信条不是为如今的世界而写的。” 

“你是在反对教团，”齐格菲隔着拉开的距离高声道。他以一种熟悉的方式挪了挪重心，即将像炮弹一样冲过来。“反对你自己。” 

总得有人来反对，阿诺尔没有说出口。她只是做好了迎接猛击的准备。

2370945771.name: Ferropotent Gauntlets
2370945771.subtitle: "The strength of your glove is the strength of your fist." —Ikora Rey
2370945771.subtitle_zh: “你的手套有多强，拳头就有多强。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3554497829.name: Ferropotent Plate
3554497829.subtitle: "I introduced Lodi to Suraya and her falcon recently. I'm not sure who was more offended at sharing a name: the man or the bird." —Ikora Rey
3554497829.subtitle_zh: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

2676446840.name: Ferropotent Mark
2676446840.subtitle: "The work is unending. That does not give us license to abandon it." —Ikora Rey
2676446840.subtitle_zh: “工作无休止。那并不意味着我们可以弃之不顾。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3031404418.name: Ferropotent Head
3031404418.subtitle: "Our work is to defend life—and, we cannot forget, to live it. That means stop and smell the roses, Guardian." —Ikora Rey
3031404418.subtitle_zh: “我们的职责是守护生命——也别忘了，去好好生活。这意味着停下来闻闻玫瑰的香气，守护者。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3462703357.name: Ferropotent Greaves
3462703357.subtitle: "You act upon the world. Remember that the world, too, acts upon you." —Ikora Rey
3462703357.subtitle_zh: “你作用于世界，别忘了世界也会作用于你。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

225063086.name: Wild Anthem Gauntlets
225063086.subtitle: "Is it always this violent? And, Guardian, this is important—will anyone be selling hot dogs in the stands?" —Lodi
225063086.subtitle_zh: “这里一直都是这么暴力吗？还有，守护者，这很重要——会有人摆摊卖热狗吗？”——洛迪

1334855187.name: Wild Anthem Mark
1334855187.subtitle: SUROS invites you to celebrate your victory.

2278464039.name: Wild Anthem Helm
2278464039.subtitle: Built by SUROS, with the encouragement of Lord Shaxx. At an uncomfortably high decibel.
2278464039.subtitle_zh: 它是由SUROS在领主沙克斯的鼓励下打造的。音量高得令人不安。

919358834.name: Sage Protector Gauntlets
919358834.subtitle: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
919358834.subtitle_zh: 你听命于谁，将如何向其禀报？
919358834.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
919358834.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

279565494.name: Sage Protector Plate
279565494.subtitle: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
279565494.subtitle_zh: 是的，责任是种负担。其重压让我们不会被风卷走。
279565494.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
279565494.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

3945736543.name: Sage Protector Mark
3945736543.subtitle: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
3945736543.subtitle_zh: 平衡内心炽焰与外部烈火。
3945736543.text:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
3945736543.text_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

4118260899.name: Sage Protector Helm
4118260899.subtitle: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
4118260899.subtitle_zh: 教育不是供人一饮而尽、随即忘却的。它的醇香，将萦绕一生。
4118260899.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
4118260899.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

1320597132.name: Sage Protector Greaves
1320597132.subtitle: The path is made by its walking.
1320597132.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.
1320597132.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

262826703.name: Swordmaster's Plate
262826703.subtitle: Don't let them see you sweat.

1934339678.name: Swordmaster's Mark
1934339678.subtitle: "Control of the self leads to control of the Light." —Ikora Rey
1934339678.subtitle_zh: “掌控自我，方能掌控光能。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

1883377784.name: Swordmaster's Helm
1883377784.subtitle: Let your opponents hear your power.
1883377784.subtitle_zh: 让你的对手听见你的力量。

3990156004.name: New Demotic Gauntlets
3990156004.subtitle: "Take pride in your team, on and off the battlefield." —Saint-14
3990156004.subtitle_zh: “战场内外，都要为自己的队伍而自豪。”——圣人14号

2195018204.name: New Demotic Plate
2195018204.subtitle: "Geppetto reminds me to seek new perspectives. Higher ground, for example." —Saint-14
2195018204.subtitle_zh: “盖比特总提醒我去寻找新的视角，比如高地。”——圣人14号

3480851793.name: New Demotic Mark

1849147777.name: Shrewd Survivor Gauntlets
1849147777.subtitle: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
1849147777.subtitle_zh: 只信任你自己手臂的力量。
1849147777.text:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
1849147777.text_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

2629237079.name: Shrewd Survivor Plate
2629237079.subtitle: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
2629237079.subtitle_zh: 受伤并不可耻，只要倒下的是他们而不是你。
2629237079.text:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
2629237079.text_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

462589222.name: Shrewd Survivor Mark
462589222.subtitle: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
462589222.subtitle_zh: 无路可循时，就开辟出自己的道路。
462589222.text:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
462589222.text_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

3343993331.name: Shrewd Survivor Greaves
3343993331.subtitle: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
3343993331.subtitle_zh: 你可以逃离过往，但它似乎总是会追上来。
3343993331.text:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
3343993331.text_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

4184605701.text:
TYPE: CORMORANT-LEVEL ENCRYPTED REPORT FOLLOWS, KEPLER REDACTION WATCH [01003] 

ZAGAN GLORIOSUS EXTRACTION: DEBRIEFING 

My Ghost and I have searched every document available to us in the Vanguard, Hidden, and Praxic archives. 

After years of conflict, we know that every Legion is unique in both doctrine and combat potential. Yet we have been unable to track the lineage of any enemy-classified Cabal unit directly to the Barant Imperium. Imperium doctrines and technology, from squad formations to combat vehicle extraction and ablative defense technologies, seem to be their own in all ways except one: Caiatl's forces were actively developing these technologies and methods—and they are still years away from deployment. 

Of interest to you and the commander: One of the Imperium's field officers, Premier Lume, orchestrated their forces as we escaped their flagship. Our searches turned up a "Lume" in City records. He was an adolescent Barant whose military service had just begun when he suffered a critical wound in the conflict with Savathûn on her throne world. According to the empress herself, our Warlocks and medical frames were unable to extract Hive shrapnel from his abdomen, thereby assigning him a wounded-in-action status and permanent discharge from the front lines. His file ends there, coinciding with several desertions among the Coalition prior to the Neomuni crisis. It's the only correlation I've found. 

The "Premier" aboard the Gloriosus was a full-grown morph. For this to be the same Barant seems impossible… but the more I learn about the Imperium, from their tech to their weapons, the less they make sense.
4184605701.text_zh:
类型：鸬鹚级加密报告如下，开普勒修订监控[01003] 

光荣扎甘号撤离：简报 

我的机灵与我已搜索先锋、隐秘者与英勇教团档案中可访问的一切文件。 

历经多年冲突，我们知道每一支军团在教义与战斗潜能上都独具一格。然而我们无法把任何被列敌方的卡巴尔单位与巴兰特帝国联系起来。帝国的教义与技术，从小队编成到战斗载具撤离、再到消融防御技术，似乎处处自成一派，唯独有一点例外：查厄托的部队正在积极研发这些技术与方法——而距离投入使用还需要许多年。 

你和指挥官或许会感兴趣的一点是：帝国的一名野战军官，首席卢梅，在我们逃离他们的旗舰时负责指挥他们的部队，而我们在圣城档案中找到了一个“卢梅”。他是个巴兰特青少年，刚开始服役，就在萨瓦图恩的王座世界冲突中腹部重伤。据女帝本人所述，我们的术士与医疗框架无法从他腹中取出邪魔族碎片，因此将他列为战伤状态，永久撤离前线。他的档案到此为止，时间点与内欧姆那危机前联盟内部的数起逃兵事件相吻合。这是我能找到的唯一关联。 

光荣号上的那位“首席”已是完全成形的变体。要说这是同一个巴兰特似乎不可能…但我对帝国了解得越多——从他们的技术到武器——就越觉得离谱。

4037429988.name: Ferropotent Gloves
4037429988.subtitle: "The strength of your glove is the strength of your fist." —Ikora Rey
4037429988.subtitle_zh: “你的手套有多强，拳头就有多强。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

4066564572.name: Ferropotent Robes
4066564572.subtitle: "I introduced Lodi to Suraya and her falcon recently. I'm not sure who was more offended at sharing a name: the man or the bird." —Ikora Rey
4066564572.subtitle_zh: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

1057430865.name: Ferropotent Bond
1057430865.subtitle: "The work is unending. That does not give us license to abandon it." —Ikora Rey
1057430865.subtitle_zh: “工作无休止。那并不意味着我们可以弃之不顾。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

1066619413.name: Ferropotent Cover
1066619413.subtitle: "Our work is to defend life—and, we cannot forget, to live it. That means stop and smell the roses, Guardian." —Ikora Rey
1066619413.subtitle_zh: “我们的职责是守护生命——也别忘了，去好好生活。这意味着停下来闻闻玫瑰的香气，守护者。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

1248547982.name: Ferropotent Boots
1248547982.subtitle: "You act upon the world. Remember that the world, too, acts upon you." —Ikora Rey
1248547982.subtitle_zh: “你作用于世界，别忘了世界也会作用于你。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

2394455241.name: Wild Anthem Gloves
2394455241.subtitle: "Is it always this violent? And, Guardian, this is important—will anyone be selling hot dogs in the stands?" —Lodi
2394455241.subtitle_zh: “这里一直都是这么暴力吗？还有，守护者，这很重要——会有人摆摊卖热狗吗？”——洛迪

3805886046.subtitle: SUROS invites you to celebrate your victory.

2249815529.name: Sage Protector Gloves
2249815529.subtitle: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
2249815529.subtitle_zh: 你听命于谁，将如何向其禀报？
2249815529.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
2249815529.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

640369263.name: Sage Protector Robes
640369263.subtitle: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
640369263.subtitle_zh: 是的，责任是种负担。其重压让我们不会被风卷走。
640369263.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
640369263.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

1887527934.name: Sage Protector Bond
1887527934.subtitle: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
1887527934.subtitle_zh: 平衡内心炽焰与外部烈火。
1887527934.text:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
1887527934.text_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

1786011928.name: Sage Protector Cover
1786011928.subtitle: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
1786011928.subtitle_zh: 教育不是供人一饮而尽、随即忘却的。它的醇香，将萦绕一生。
1786011928.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
1786011928.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

2541757371.name: Sage Protector Boots
2541757371.subtitle: The path is made by its walking.
2541757371.text:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.
2541757371.text_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

1504698788.name: Swordmaster's Robes
1504698788.subtitle: Don't let them see you sweat.

2248528889.name: Swordmaster's Bond
2248528889.subtitle: "Control of the self leads to control of the Light." —Ikora Rey
2248528889.subtitle_zh: “掌控自我，方能掌控光能。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

3520307277.name: Swordmaster's Cover
3520307277.subtitle: Let your opponents hear your power.
3520307277.subtitle_zh: 让你的对手听见你的力量。

1971091137.name: New Demotic Gloves
1971091137.subtitle: "Take pride in your team, on and off the battlefield." —Saint-14
1971091137.subtitle_zh: “战场内外，都要为自己的队伍而自豪。”——圣人14号

4154731415.name: New Demotic Robes
4154731415.subtitle: "Geppetto reminds me to seek new perspectives. Higher ground, for example." —Saint-14
4154731415.subtitle_zh: “盖比特总提醒我去寻找新的视角，比如高地。”——圣人14号

1988083558.name: New Demotic Bond
1988083558.subtitle: "Remember why you seek the Lighthouse." —Saint-14
1988083558.subtitle_zh: “记住你为何追寻灯塔。”——圣人14号

2214884208.name: New Demotic Cover
2214884208.subtitle: "Show me your best! Your team deserves it!" —Saint-14
2214884208.subtitle_zh: “拿出最好的表现！你的队伍值得你那样去做！”——圣人14号

3041479219.name: New Demotic Boots
3041479219.subtitle: "One day I'll make Osiris do the commentating and jump into the ring myself. Then we will see who is strongest!" —Saint-14
3041479219.subtitle_zh: “总有一天我会让奥斯里斯来解说，而我亲自上场。到时候就知道谁更强了！”——圣人14号

938861252.name: Shrewd Survivor Gloves
938861252.subtitle: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
938861252.subtitle_zh: 只信任你自己手臂的力量。
938861252.text:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
938861252.text_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3475188156.name: Shrewd Survivor Robe
3475188156.subtitle: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3475188156.subtitle_zh: 受伤并不可耻，只要倒下的是他们而不是你。
3475188156.text:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3475188156.text_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

932088625.name: Shrewd Survivor Bond
932088625.subtitle: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
932088625.subtitle_zh: 无路可循时，就开辟出自己的道路。
932088625.text:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
932088625.text_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

2869507310.text:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
2869507310.text_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

1479082657.subtitle_zh: 无知的恐惧如野火蔓延。
1479082657.text:
"I dare you to lick it."

"Ew, no! You lick it."

"No one is licking this," Novi declared. She looked between her little brother, Sunder, and their Eliksni friend, Phyksiis, with a practiced expression of grown-up disgust.

She grabbed the grenade and slung it with all her might at the lake, hoping to see it skip across the placid surface of the water. It sank with a giant, anticlimactic plop.

"Aww, you wasted it!" Phyksiis complained.

The surface of the lake shook as an immense column of water shot into the air. Particles of Strand rained down, twining together to form small, green creatures.

"Run… RUN!" Novi screamed. The Threadlings closed in, poised to explode, when suddenly the arms of a Hunter reached around to shield them. There were three shots, then silence.

Novi opened one eye to see a Ghost hovering in front of her. "What were you doing with a grenade?!" he cried.

The children exchanged terrified, guilty looks.

"You're not in trouble," the Hunter prodded gently, his amber eyes trained on them.

"We—we traded a kid at school for it," Phyksiis admitted. "He stole it from his dad."

"No takebacks," Sunder offered solemnly.

"For a rare Guardian weapon? That must have been some trade."

Novi hesitated then said quietly, "We gave him some Stasis stuff we found at home. But—but lots of parents have been collecting, uh, things… Guardian things too."

"For protection. I heard some Eliksni talking," Phyksiis mumbled.

"Yeah, after the man said he'd come to the City at nightfall," Sunder said and puffed his chest. "But I'm not afraid of the dark."

"Not 'at'—WITH Nightfall. Whatever that is," Novi corrected, the apprehension clear in her voice.

The Guardian and his Ghost stepped back. "This seems to confirm the rumors," the Ghost whispered. "People are arming themselves."

"Alert Zavala," the Hunter replied grimly.
1479082657.text_zh:
“你敢不敢去舔一口。”

“呃，才不要！你自己去舔。”

“谁都不许舔，”诺薇宣布。她的目光在弟弟桑德和他们的埃里克斯尼族朋友菲克西斯之间游移，脸上挂着一副熟练的大人式嫌弃表情。

她抓起手雷，用尽全力朝湖面掷去，期盼着看它在平静的水面上弹跳。它随着巨大又沉闷的噗通声沉了下去。

“噢，你浪费掉了它！”菲克西斯抱怨道。

湖面一震，一道巨大的水柱冲天而起。缕缕缚丝粒子洒落，缠绕在一起，化作小小的绿色生物。

“跑…快跑！”诺薇尖叫道。线虫们合围而至，蓄势爆炸，忽然一位猎人的手臂伸来将他们护住。三声枪响，然后是寂静。

诺薇睁开一只眼，看到一个机灵悬停在她面前。“你们拿手雷干什么？！”他喊道。

孩子们交换着惊惶而内疚的眼神。

“放心，你们没闯祸，”猎人温和地引导，琥珀色的眼睛注视着他们。

“我——我们跟学校里的一个孩子换的，”菲克西斯招认道。“他是从他爸那里偷来的。”

“不许反悔，”桑德郑重其事地补充。

“这件稀有的守护者武器？你们可真会做买卖。”

诺薇犹豫了一下，低声说：“我们给了他一些在家里找到的冰影东西。可——可很多家长也一直在收集，呃，那些…守护者的东西。”

“为了自卫，我听一些埃里克斯尼族说的，”菲克西斯嘟囔道。

“是啊，在那个人说他会在日落降临时前来圣城之后，”桑德挺起胸膛说。“但我不怕黑。”

“不是‘在'——是‘伴随'日落降临，虽然不知道那是什么意思，”诺薇更正道，声音里带着明显的不安。

守护者和他的机灵退后了一步。“这似乎证实了传闻，”机灵低声说。“人们在武装自己。”

“通知萨瓦拉，”猎人阴沉地答道。

2043430167.text:

[Eclipse: A gift to a compliant tool, its knees bent, and rings kissed.]

[A memory of a higher place—home—where rays and shadows are extinguished by the weight of being.]

[Dust storms buffeted by carbon dioxide winds. Auroras spread green skies.]

[Golden colonnades lift golden arches, red sands sheathed in glistening panoplies.]

[Dust and auroras become a vacuum. Only orbits remain. Suffering! As liquid souls and armored morphs are dissolved by a reality of nothing.]

[Red sands reform, dark matter in its bones. Its soul reflects: Paracausality, while beyond reach, must obey elemental laws. And those laws are the soul's very foundation—always within reach. The ontology of the vanishing has been rejected, and thus, the red valleys re-instantiate. The soul of Mars speaks to the Inner Orbits.]

[尘埃与极光化作真空。只剩下轨道。苦难！伴随着液态灵魂与披甲蜕变被虚无的现实所溶解。]
