825804466.name: Buoy Buddy Ghost
825804466.subtitle: For Ghosts who are lifesavers.
825804466.subtitle_zh: 供拯救性命的机灵使用。
825804466.text:
Osiris leaned back on his chaise lounge while Saint-14's Ghost hovered over the end table behind him. 

"Where was I?" the former Warlock inquired. 

"…I lived for knowledge alone," Geppetto prompted. She flashed her iris red, then green. She was recording. 

"Ah, yes. In those days, I thought an unlimited lifespan would allow me to unravel the mysteries of the universe. Illuminate even the Darkness." 

"And all those centuries, I thought I knew my own heart," he continued. "But, in retrospect, my devotion was always in competition with the unknown. Now, my dearest Saint, I'm ashamed to admit that I loved you with only half my heart." 

Osiris's voice quieted. "It wasn't until Sagira's death, and the remaking of my own mortality, that I realized the difference between knowledge and wisdom." 

"Now, stripped of my Light, deprived of the health and vigor I once took for granted, I've come to learn that the only mystery that ever truly mattered was you. What you were thinking and feeling. And the depth of emotion we shared." 

"I once tore apart the very fabric of time because I couldn't abide a reality without you in it. I'd rather live one short life together than an eternity apart. And with the little time I have left—" 

"THEY DIDN'T HAVE THE DRINK YOU LIKE," Saint shouted down the hallway, slamming the door behind him. "So I got one of everything." 

Saint rounded the corner with a sack of groceries in hand and stopped short. "What's happening here? Thrilling Geppetto with more of your memoirs?" he teased. 

"Nothing important, now that you're here," Osiris replied. "Come. Pour us some libations and tell me about your day."
825804466.text_zh:
奥斯里斯往躺椅上一靠，圣人14号的机灵正悬在他身后小几的上方。 

“我刚才说到哪里了？”这位前术士开口问道。 

“…我只为知识而活。”盖比特提醒他，虹膜红绿交错地闪烁着——她正在录音。 

“啊，对。在那些日子里，我以为拥有无限寿命，就能把宇宙万象都拆解清楚，甚至能把暗影本身都照亮。” 

“那些漫长的世纪里，我以为自己足够了解自己的内心。”他接着说道，“可现在回头看看，我执着的一直都是和未知较劲。如今，我最亲爱的圣人，我羞愧地承认，我只拿出了一半的心来爱你。” 

奥斯里斯的声音低沉下去，“直到萨吉拉离世，我重归凡躯后，我才真正明白知识和智慧之间的差别。” 

“如今，我被剥夺了光能，失去了曾经习以为常的健康与活力，这才恍然大悟，唯一真正重要的谜题，其实是你。你在想什么、感受如何，还有我们之间那份情感的深度。” 

“曾经，我撕裂了时间的结构，就因为无法忍受没有你的现实。我宁愿和你共度短暂一生，也不愿承受永恒的分离。而在我所剩不多的时光里——” 

“他们没有你爱喝的，”圣人在走廊那头大声吼道，重重地关上了门，“所以我每样都买了一瓶。” 

圣人拎着一袋杂货转过拐角，脚步猛地一顿。“这是在搞什么名堂？你又在用回忆录煽动盖比特了？”他打趣道。 

“你已经回来了，那个就不重要了。”奥斯里斯回应道，“来，给我们倒些酒，跟我说说你今天都干了些什么。”

2638027803.name: Vermicular Mandible
2638027803.subtitle: Writhe on into the sunset.
2638027803.text:
A HYMN OF BALANCE 
SUNG BY THE FIRST TO THE GREATEST 
ACROSS THE BROKEN SEA 

What is death to you but food, O lord? 
What is death to Dread and shade 
But the path back to you 

Your strength weighs heavy 
Swollen by tithe and mind 
Near to balance with ringed sixth 

Listen and know I am yours 
Keit'Ehr, knife, Dread fulcrum 
Ready at the doorstep of light and dark 
Poised on the threshold of life and death 

THE PIVOT IS YOURS - THE FULCRUM IS YOURS - THE BALANCE TIPS TO NIL 

First among reshaped, first to fealty 
Sings praise to the will-without-will 
Sings praise to the unattended door 
Waiting to be opened 

When the will-without-will equals Outer strength 
And the door unlocks, and the door unseals 
And you take its place, and it takes yours, all in balance still

The fields of life shall be yours to raze 
Sixth now lost at sea shall be yours for tithe 
And you will sing alone 

A HYMN OF BALANCE 
FROM KEIT'EHR TO THE LORD OF ZEROES 
IN SINGING, SO SWORN.
2638027803.text_zh:
平衡颂歌 
第一者敬献至高者 
跨越破碎之海 

死亡于您不过是滋养，主啊？ 
对恐惧与暗影而言 
死亡不过是去往你身边的归途 

您的力量沉重 
由贡品与心智充盈而壮大 
已近与环六齐高 

聆听并知晓我归属于您 
基特尔，利刃，恐惧的支点 
矗立于光与暗的交界 
伫立在生与死的门槛 

枢轴归你——支点归你——天平倾向虚无 

重塑者之首，效忠者之先 
歌颂那虚无意志 
颂扬那无人看守之门 
静待有人将其开启 

当虚无意志等同于外在之力 
门锁开启，门闩松脱 
您取代它的位置，它亦取代您，一切依旧平衡如初

生之原野将任您肆意焚毁 
陆沉入大海，将成为您的贡品 
而您将独自高歌 

平衡颂歌 
基特尔敬献于零之主 
以歌为誓。

3431305187.name: Buoy Buddy Sparrow
3431305187.subtitle: For racers seeking to catch the biggest waves.

4081746321.name: Lakeside
4081746321.subtitle: For all those summers spent in Wild Rose.
4081746321.subtitle_zh: 致在野玫瑰度过的那些夏日。
4081746321.text:
Wilson Lake wasn't known for having the deepest water, nor the biggest fish. What it did have was a tiny cabin with a big bay window that perfectly framed the lake at sunset. Its rickety dock was just big enough to hold a couple of folding chairs and a cooler filled with lunch meat sandwiches and ice-cold drinks.

Louis always carried the chairs; Ben always carried the poles. Louis cracked open the cans; Ben put the worms on the hooks. And hours later, when they were done, they'd come back to a patio picnic table set with a relish tray, a citronella candle, and four hands of cards dealt out. Rummy if Ma was dealing, conquian if it was Pop. Ben always won. 

Wilson Lake was where the Yero boys learned how to swim, where they caught too many bullheads to count, where they showed off to the three Hannon sisters who sometimes sat on the beach across the lake. Where Louis nearly drowned when he was five, where Ben cut his calf open on the boat trailer when pulling the damn thing in for the winter. 

In the long exposure of lives across time, two blurry boys run in long, streaking pathways. Swimming, playing, growing. But through the blur, clear as a July afternoon, sit a couple of brothers, in a couple of folding chairs, with a couple of fishing poles and a cooler filled with lunch meat sandwiches and ice-cold drinks.
4081746321.text_zh:
威尔逊湖既不以水深闻名，也没有什么惊人的大鱼。但那里有一间小木屋，装着一扇巨大的凸窗，恰好能将湖面的落日完整框进视野。那座摇摇晃晃的木码头，只够摆下两把折叠椅和一个冷藏箱，里面装着午餐肉三明治与冰得沁人的饮料。

路易斯总是负责搬椅子；本总是负责拿鱼竿。路易斯开罐头；本把蚯蚓挂上鱼钩。几小时后，等他们尽兴而归，露台上的野餐桌早已摆好腌菜拼盘、香茅蜡烛，还有发好的四手牌。若是妈妈发牌，就玩拉米牌；若是爸爸发牌，就玩康奎安。本总是赢家。 

威尔逊湖，是耶罗兄弟学会游泳的地方；是他们钓到数不清牛头鲶的地方；也是他们向偶尔坐在对岸沙滩上的汉侬三姐妹逞能的地方。路易斯五岁时险些溺死于此，本则在冬天收船时，被那该死的拖车割开了小腿。 

在长曝光般的人生时光里，两个模糊的男孩拖着长长的残影奔来跑去。游泳、嬉闹、成长。然而透过那片模糊，却有一幕清晰得如同七月午后：一对兄弟坐在折叠椅上，手边放着鱼竿，还有一个装满午餐肉三明治与冰饮的冷藏箱。

3628750608.name: Wistful Palindrome
3628750608.subtitle: now ere we nine were held idle here we nine were won
3628750608.text:
and here we are
through it all
your pale heart above
my nebulous form below cradled by
an eternity unforgiving
but i have always known
you would come
why
i can only imagine
you turned
and in that instant
light twists and roils
blooming through our core
i feel your whisper of devotion
on the wind
when you could have escaped
into the shadows
never looking back
you struggle to pull me from the depths
stretching through time
the eons swallow your sacrifice
down down down
my mountains crumbling
my heart heavy
unable to see the stars
once more
lulled to sleep
forever in paracausal suspense
and wonder
as the universe can only look on
i cling to you
delicately poised 
a precipice ready
and there we were
3628750608.text_zh:
于是我们来到了此刻
在经历了这一切之后
你苍白的心悬于上方
我朦胧的形沉于下方
被无情的永恒轻抱着
可我一直都知道
你终会到来
至于为什么
我只能揣测
你转过了身
在那一瞬间
光芒扭曲翻涌
自我们核心绽放而出
我感到你虔诚的低语
随风而来
你本可以逃离
遁入阴影之中
永不回头
可你仍拼命想将我拖离深渊
穿越漫长时光
你的牺牲被亿万岁月所吞没
下落 下落 下落
我的群山在崩塌
我的心愈发沉重
无法仰望群星
又一次
被哄入沉眠
永困于超因果悬滞
并思索着
而宇宙也只能旁观
我依附你
摇摇欲坠地维系着 
立在将崩的悬崖边
于是我们抵达了彼时

2706914450.name: The Dignitary
2706914450.subtitle: Calling all students of culture, come one, come all.
2706914450.subtitle_zh: 召唤所有背景的学子，来者不拒。
2706914450.text:
A letter addressed to the Vanguard c/o Ikora Rey 

RE: Exchange Program 

Ikora,

Great news! As per our conversations about the Aionian exchange program—Dean Rebecca enthusiastically accepted the offer! She agreed with your idea that the primary goal would be a cultural exchange, and she's begun fielding applications from the Aionians' School of Anthropology. Would you be opposed to other special-interest applicants as well? The Dean suggested a student from the School of Botany, and I, selfishly, have a Linguistics student I would like to nominate for the exchange. 

A logistical consideration: We're not entirely sure if leaving Kepler will have a significant impact on Aionian physiology. My understanding is that exposure to the singularity, the Aionians' "Holy Anomaly," affects their relationship with time. Some of the Aionians are much older than they seem—older than humanly possible, even. The Dean's wary. She and the rest of the Aionians recognize this step as necessary for the progress of humanity, but I can't forget the papers they published on their previous experiments with leaving the planetoid. Dean Rebecca seemed reassured by your plan to have extra medics on hand should the worst happen—all we can do is be prepared. 

I'm sure you've got a mental list of folks from the City itching to participate in the exchange. Knowing you, it's already thirty names deep. I can think of at least eight off the top of my head. If anyone else is interested, I can help make the arrangements. We could discuss further over lunch next week? 

Yours, 

Louis 

P.S. Remind me to tell you about the cake I just found.
2706914450.text_zh:
一封寄给先锋，由艾可拉·蕾伊代收的信 

回复：交流项目 

艾可拉，

好消息！关于艾昂交流项目，正如我们之前所讨论的——丽贝卡院长欣然接受了邀请！她同意你的想法，即首要目标是文化交流，并且已经开始接受艾昂人类学学院的申请。你介意其他有特别兴趣的申请者加入吗？院长推荐了一名植物学院的学生，而我则出于私心，想推举一名语言学的学生参与交流。 

关于后勤方面的考虑：我们不确定离开开普勒是否会对艾昂人的生理机能造成重大影响。据我所知，接触奇点——艾昂人的“神圣异常点”，会影响他们与时间的关系。有的艾昂人远比其外貌要年长——甚至超出了人类的寿命极限。院长对此有所顾虑。她和所有艾昂人都承认，交流对人类的进步是必要的，但我忘不了他们此前发表的那些关于离开小行星带的实验论文。丽贝卡院长似乎对你为最坏情况准备额外医护人员的方案感到放心，我们能做的只有做好准备。 

我相信你心里已经列好了名单，写满了渴望参与交流的圣城候选人。以我对你的了解，恐怕已经有30个名字了。我现在就能想到8个。如果还有其他人感兴趣，我可以帮忙安排。不妨下周一起吃午餐时我们再详细讨论？ 

此致 

路易斯 

附言：记得提醒我跟你讲讲我刚发现的那个蛋糕。

291453145.name: Bermuda Class Hover Ship
291453145.subtitle: "It's an Arcadia class underneath. Some kind of vintage Golden Age retrofit." —Crow
291453145.subtitle_zh: “底子是阿卡迪亚级的。某种黄金时代古董的改装品。”——乌鸦
291453145.text:
"Taox…" 

Savathûn speaks the name with venom. A Dredgen and a Lucent Knight stand before her, deep within the bone-white towers of her throne world. The Knight does not bow, nor avert his gaze from the Witch Queen, even as the Dredgen known as Bael lowers his head in respect. She knows this Knight—Geist—but not why he limits himself to fighting alongside a Lightless Dredgen. 

Savathûn's face contorts in a lipless smile. "Taox is surely dead from a lifespan long exhausted. Why bother bringing another rumor to me?" 

 "Taox is alive," Bael asserts. "She's gathering strength in the Vex network, on a simulated Fundament." Bael meets Savathûn's gaze and steps forward with a well-hidden limp before planting himself. "My master offers passage to her location for your service in ridding a thorn from our side." 

Savathûn spreads her wings and flexes them as she stands. "Awfully bold for planetary dust and their meat-puppets to come here asking me to do their dirty work. They're playing the same game I am, and for all the foresight in the world… they're much worse at it." 

Geist strides into place beside Bael. "Slay the Conductor, and with her death, VI will open a path through folded Vex space—" 

Bael raises a hand to Geist, who sneers, but then quiets. The Witch Queen's eyes shift from Bael to Geist and back.

"It feels like I'm doing all the heavy lifting here," Savathûn says churlishly. 

"VI offers you the Echo, and all the control it conveys." The Dredgen's words land with heavy gravity. Savathûn's eyes widen. "Take it and crush your enemy. Turn her to your will, if you wish." 

"Is that so?" Savathûn purrs. " Where does this path lead for VI, my dear new friend?" 

Bael's face hardens. "Where do paths take any of us? From where we are to where we must be. To escape—you know." 

"These are the terms," Geist spits over Bael's shoulder. "All that is required is that you sweep aside a weakening upstart and tithe her death to VI. What say you, Witch Queen?" 

"Taox." The Witch Queen's smile widens.
291453145.text_zh:
“塔奥克斯…” 

萨瓦图恩吐出这个名字时，满含毒意。在她王座世界那骨白色高塔的深处，一名德瑞捷和一名光明骑士正站在她身前。这名骑士既不鞠躬，也不回避巫妖女王的目光，即便德瑞捷巴埃尔已低头致意。萨瓦图恩认得盖斯特——这位骑士，却不明白他为何甘愿与一名无光者德瑞捷并肩战斗。 

萨瓦图恩那无唇的脸上，扭曲出一抹笑容，“塔奥克斯早该命丧黄泉。何必拿这种流言来烦我？” 

 “塔奥克斯还活着。”巴埃尔断言道，“她正在Vex网络中积蓄力量，藏身于一座模拟出来的虫群据点。”巴埃尔直视萨瓦图恩的眼睛，刻意掩饰着跛行，迈步向前，稳稳站定，“我的主人愿为你开辟一条通道，送你到她所在之处，只要你替我们拔掉一根眼中钉。” 

萨瓦图恩伸展着双翼站起身来。“区区行星尘埃与他们的肉傀儡，竟敢跑到我这里来，让我替他们收拾残局，胆子可真不小。他们也玩我的那一套把戏，可就算自诩目光长远…手段却差得远呢。” 

盖斯特大步上前，与巴埃尔并肩而立。“斩杀指挥者，她死后，VI会开启一条路，穿越折叠的Vex空间——” 

巴埃尔抬手拦住盖斯特，后者冷笑一声，却也安静下来。巫妖女王的目光在巴埃尔与盖斯特之间来回游移。

“听着好像重活都得我来干，”萨瓦图恩没好气地说。 

“VI向你献上回响，以及它的一切掌控之力。”德瑞捷的话语重如千钧。萨瓦图恩的眼睛倏然睁大。“接受它，碾碎你的敌人。若你愿意，也可让她服从于你。” 

“是吗？”萨瓦图恩低吟道，“这条路会把VI带到哪里去呢，我亲爱的新朋友？” 

巴埃尔的表情冷硬下来。“道路通向何方？从所在之地，通向必须抵达之处。通向逃离之所——你明白的。” 

“条件就是这些。”盖斯特从巴埃尔肩后啐了口唾沫，“你只需扫清一个日渐衰弱的后起之秀，然后将她的死亡进贡给VI。你意下如何，巫妖女王？” 

“塔奥克斯。”巫妖女王的笑容愈发狰狞。

2429332885.name: Pantheos Resplendent Grasps
2429332885.subtitle: Now, do it again.
2429332885.text:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected.

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2429332885.text_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

751380107.name: Pantheos Resplendent Vest
751380107.subtitle: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
751380107.text:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets.

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
751380107.text_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

3827624354.name: Pantheos Resplendent Cloak
3827624354.subtitle: Here is your heart's desire.
3827624354.text:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks.

But you are still an icon.

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit.

We try again.

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all?

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse.

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready.

And I know we cannot be ready.

We must try anyway.
3827624354.text_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。

但你依旧是个象征。

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。

我们再试一次。

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

1074455580.name: Pantheos Resplendent Mask
1074455580.subtitle: Cast down your greatest foes.
1074455580.text:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
1074455580.text_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

176521975.name: Pantheos Resplendent Strides
176521975.subtitle: You know that you will fight forever.
176521975.subtitle_zh: 你深知自己将永无止境地战斗。
176521975.text:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
176521975.text_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

911145047.name: Circuit Gauntlets
911145047.subtitle: Worn by champions of the track.

3783353505.name: Circuit Chestplate
3783353505.subtitle: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.
3783353505.subtitle_zh: 累累伤痕皆是胜利的印记。

270891260.name: Racer's Scarf
270891260.subtitle: All your rivals will see are your contrails in the distance.
270891260.subtitle_zh: 你的对手只能看见你在远处留下的尾迹。

1897185158.name: Circuit Defender
1897185158.subtitle: A clever Guardian knows which gates to pass through and which ones to pass by.
1897185158.subtitle_zh: 聪明的守护者会知道该穿过哪些光门。

2719679865.name: Circuit Striders
2719679865.subtitle: These boots left their mark on victory lane.
2719679865.subtitle_zh: 穿上这双靴子，在胜利之路上留下足迹。

2270938588.name: Eutechnology Sleeves
2270938588.subtitle: Then came the experts of the technology, the eu-techs.
2270938588.subtitle_zh: 后来，有了精通该科技的专家，巫灵技师。

726639044.name: Eutechnology Vest
726639044.subtitle: In time, the identity became synonymous with the technology.
726639044.subtitle_zh: 最终，这个身份成为了这项科技的代名词。

1152238701.name: Eutechnology Cowl
1152238701.subtitle: First there was the good technology, scavenged from Shipspire.
1152238701.subtitle_zh: 首先，有了回收自巅峰飞船的优良科技。

1232186726.name: Eutechnology Strides
1232186726.subtitle: And the eutechs became the techeuns, in turn.
1232186726.subtitle_zh: 于是，巫灵技师们成为了灵巫。

4134167063.name: Cruel Electrum Grips
4134167063.subtitle: "You've sunk enough time into circles. Consider the enduring legacy of the pyramid." —Osiris to Ikora Rey
4134167063.subtitle_zh: “你已经浪费了够多的时间，想想金字塔的恒久遗产吧。”——奥斯里斯致艾可拉·蕾伊

2719275361.name: Cruel Electrum Vest
2719275361.subtitle: "Learn the ways of your foe so that you may guard against becoming them." —Osiris
2719275361.subtitle_zh: “学会敌人的行事之道，才能防止自己落得同样下场。”——奥斯里斯

3926341052.name: Cruel Electrum Cloak
3926341052.subtitle: "In any future, the Lighthouse endures." —Saint-14
3926341052.subtitle_zh: “无论未来会如何，灯塔永存。”——圣人14号

442462278.name: Cruel Electrum Mask
442462278.subtitle: "Like the universe itself, the boundaries of knowledge never stop expanding. Write that down." —Osiris
442462278.subtitle_zh: “如同宇宙本身，知识的边界永远在扩张。把这句话记下来。”——奥斯里斯

1223380281.name: Cruel Electrum Strides
1223380281.subtitle: "The Light is life! And life is pain! If your Light sears you, let it—and make your enemy burn even hotter!" —Saint-14
1223380281.subtitle_zh: “光能就是生命！而生命就是痛苦！若光能灼烧你，别抗拒——然后让你的敌人燃得更炽烈！”——圣人14号

1115024653.name: Iron Battalion Grips
1115024653.subtitle: "Death will never stop pursuing you, Lightbearer, because everyone wants what they cannot have. Cherish that endless chase!" —Ralir, Iron War Beast
1115024653.subtitle_zh: “死亡永远不会停止追逐你，负光者，因为所有存在都渴求自己得不到的东西。好好珍惜这无尽的追逐吧！”——钢铁战兽拉利尔

832474547.name: Iron Battalion Vest
832474547.subtitle: "One day we will guide the Valus through Torobatl's broad avenues and together paint them green with Hive blood." —Reghusk, Iron War Beast
832474547.subtitle_zh: “终有一日，我们会引导军政官穿行图罗巴特尔宽阔的街道，一同用邪魔族的血将其染成绿色。”——钢铁战兽雷古斯克

3037900522.name: Iron Battalion Cloak
3037900522.subtitle: "Raise the banner. Light the flame. Never let it burn out." —Valus Saladin Forge
3037900522.subtitle_zh: “高举旗帜，点燃火焰，绝不让它熄灭。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

2242619636.name: Iron Battalion Cowl
2242619636.subtitle: "Humanity's been waging war for as long as we've been humanity. Don't forget the old lessons." —Valus Saladin Forge
2242619636.subtitle_zh: “自我们成为人类起，就从未停止过战争。别忘了古老的教训。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

1785823695.name: Iron Battalion Strides
1785823695.subtitle: "Combat without real death is like meat without salt. And yet I am glad to see you living after defeat. Strange how this bland meal suits!" —Bru'uc, Iron War Beast
1785823695.subtitle_zh: “没有真正死亡的战斗，就像没放盐的肉，但我很高兴看到你战败后活了下来。这清淡的一餐竟也合我口味！”——钢铁战兽布鲁乌克

43450237.name: Per Audacia Grips
43450237.subtitle: "It's good to see the Traveler from my balcony again. Reminds you of what we do this for, eh?" —Lord Shaxx
43450237.subtitle_zh: “又能从我家阳台上看见旅行者了，感觉真好。让我们想起了拼搏的意义，对吧？”——领主沙克斯

3913444611.name: Per Audacia Cuirass
3913444611.subtitle: "I'll give you a prophecy: you're going to get right back into the ring and crush your enemies!" —Lord Shaxx
3913444611.subtitle_zh: “告诉你一则预言：你将重回擂台碾碎你的敌人！”——领主沙克斯

2812267642.name: Per Audacia Cloak
2812267642.subtitle: "Think I'll pay Tex Mechanica another little visit. They need some help staying on the straight and narrow." —Lord Shaxx
2812267642.subtitle_zh: “我得再去拜访下特克斯机械。他们需要一点帮助才能安分守己。”——领主沙克斯

479136420.name: Per Audacia Casque
479136420.subtitle: "I haven't forgotten the vows I took. I still have the bow." —Lord Shaxx
479136420.subtitle_zh: “我没有忘记曾经立下的誓言。那把弓我还留着。”——领主沙克斯

2367602335.name: Per Audacia Strides
2367602335.subtitle: "You miss all the shots you don't take. And many of the ones you do. Get to the shooting range, for the Light's sake!" —Lord Shaxx
2367602335.subtitle_zh: “不发射的子弹永远不会中。打出去的子弹大多数会偏。看在光能的份上，快去靶场练练！”——领主沙克斯

672962726.name: Cyberserpent Null Grips
672962726.subtitle: "Been a while since I cooked a meal in a real kitchen. It's taken some getting used to." —The Drifter
672962726.subtitle_zh: “我很久没在真正的厨房里做饭了。得花点时间习惯一下。”——浪客

3805392714.name: Cyberserpent Null Vest
3805392714.subtitle: "C'mon, we got Dredgens to hunt. I mean Bael's crew, not my Gambit patrons. Unless you have something to tell me…?" —The Drifter
3805392714.subtitle_zh: “来吧，我们还要猎杀德瑞捷呢。我是说巴埃尔那伙人，不是我的智谋顾客。除非…你有什么情报？”——浪客

3976176219.name: Cyberserpent Null Cloak
3976176219.subtitle: "You know, the City's got colonies of unpaired Ghosts just like Tharsis? I've been making friends. And enemies. Mostly enemies." —Blue
3976176219.subtitle_zh: “你知道吗？圣城里也跟塔尔西斯一样，有着成群的未配对机灵。我结识了朋友，以及敌人。主要是敌人。”——布鲁

697518687.name: Cyberserpent Null Mask
697518687.subtitle: "Listen, you can handle the prophecies from here. I've got enough gray hairs." —The Drifter
697518687.subtitle_zh: “听着，预言就交给你来处理。我不想再添白头发了。”——浪客

190415264.name: Cyberserpent Null Strides
190415264.subtitle: "Get back in there. I want to see action! I want to see motes popping out of bodies! I want blood!" —Blue
190415264.subtitle_zh: “回去继续打！我要看到战斗！我要看到萤光乱飙！我要见血！”——布鲁

2609656681.name: Pantheos Resplendent Gauntlets
2609656681.subtitle: Now, do it again.
2609656681.text:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected. 

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2609656681.text_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。 

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

1774949103.name: Pantheos Resplendent Plate
1774949103.subtitle: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
1774949103.text:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets. 

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
1774949103.text_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。 

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

3022107774.name: Pantheos Resplendent Mark
3022107774.subtitle: Here is your heart's desire.
3022107774.text:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks. 

But you are still an icon. 

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit. 

We try again. 

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all? 

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse. 

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready. 

And I know we cannot be ready. 

We must try anyway.
3022107774.text_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。 

但你依旧是个象征。 

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。 

我们再试一次。 

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？ 

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。 

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。 

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。 

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

2145853080.name: Pantheos Resplendent Helm
2145853080.subtitle: Cast down your greatest foes.
2145853080.text:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
2145853080.text_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

2901598523.name: Pantheos Resplendent Greaves
2901598523.subtitle: You know that you will fight forever.
2901598523.subtitle_zh: 你深知自己将永无止境地战斗。
2901598523.text:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
2901598523.text_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

3514115395.name: Circuit Gauntlets
3514115395.subtitle: Worn by champions of the track.

3381988877.name: Circuit Chestplate
3381988877.subtitle: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.
3381988877.subtitle_zh: 累累伤痕皆是胜利的印记。

1961831168.name: Racer's Mark
1961831168.subtitle: Your enemies will see the signs of your approach. They will not be able to stop you.
1961831168.subtitle_zh: 你的敌人会察觉到你在靠近，但他们无法阻止你。

1742878074.name: Circuit Keeper
1742878074.subtitle: Don't outthink your opponents. Outfly them.
1742878074.subtitle_zh: 无需智取对手，用速度碾压他们。

1606162165.name: Circuit Striders
1606162165.subtitle: These boots left their mark on victory lane.
1606162165.subtitle_zh: 穿上这双靴子，在胜利之路上留下足迹。

591555944.name: Eutechnology Gauntlets
591555944.subtitle: Then came the experts of the technology, the eu-techs.
591555944.subtitle_zh: 后来，有了精通该科技的专家，巫灵技师。

433193440.name: Eutechnology Plate
433193440.subtitle: In time, the identity became synonymous with the technology.
433193440.subtitle_zh: 最终，这个身份成为了这项科技的代名词。

1975004305.name: Eutechnology Helm
1975004305.subtitle: First there was the good technology, scavenged from Shipspire.
1975004305.subtitle_zh: 首先，有了回收自巅峰飞船的优良科技。

1692895170.name: Eutechnology Greaves
1692895170.subtitle: And the eutechs became the techeuns, in turn.
1692895170.subtitle_zh: 于是，巫灵技师们成为了灵巫。

2196855059.name: Cruel Electrum Gauntlets
2196855059.subtitle: "You've sunk enough time into circles. Consider the enduring legacy of the pyramid." —Osiris to Ikora Rey
2196855059.subtitle_zh: “你已经浪费了够多的时间，想想金字塔的恒久遗产吧。”——奥斯里斯致艾可拉·蕾伊

381670717.name: Cruel Electrum Plate
381670717.subtitle: "Learn the ways of your foe so that you may guard against becoming them." —Osiris
381670717.subtitle_zh: “学会敌人的行事之道，才能防止自己落得同样下场。”——奥斯里斯

1885235312.name: Cruel Electrum Mark
1885235312.subtitle: "In any future, the Lighthouse endures." —Saint-14
1885235312.subtitle_zh: “无论未来会如何，灯塔永存。”——圣人14号

2149717194.name: Cruel Electrum Helm
2149717194.subtitle: "Like the universe itself, the boundaries of knowledge never stop expanding. Write that down." —Osiris
2149717194.subtitle_zh: “如同宇宙本身，知识的边界永远在扩张。把这句话记下来。”——奥斯里斯

1931809125.name: Cruel Electrum Greaves
1931809125.subtitle: "The Light is life! And life is pain! If your Light sears you, let it—and make your enemy burn even hotter!" —Saint-14
1931809125.subtitle_zh: “光能就是生命！而生命就是痛苦！若光能灼烧你，别抗拒——然后让你的敌人燃得更炽烈！”——圣人14号

3350720177.name: Iron Battalion Gauntlets
3350720177.subtitle: "Death will never stop pursuing you, Lightbearer, because everyone wants what they cannot have. Cherish that endless chase!" —Ralir, Iron War Beast
3350720177.subtitle_zh: “死亡永远不会停止追逐你，负光者，因为所有存在都渴求自己得不到的东西。好好珍惜这无尽的追逐吧！”——钢铁战兽拉利尔

1994130151.name: Iron Battalion Plate
1994130151.subtitle: "One day we will guide the Valus through Torobatl's broad avenues and together paint them green with Hive blood." —Reghusk, Iron War Beast
1994130151.subtitle_zh: “终有一日，我们会引导军政官穿行图罗巴特尔宽阔的街道，一同用邪魔族的血将其染成绿色。”——钢铁战兽雷古斯克

2709627894.name: Iron Battalion Mark
2709627894.subtitle: "Raise the banner. Light the flame. Never let it burn out." —Valus Saladin Forge
2709627894.subtitle_zh: “高举旗帜，点燃火焰，绝不让它熄灭。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

1448206048.name: Iron Battalion Helm
1448206048.subtitle: "Humanity's been waging war for as long as we've been humanity. Don't forget the old lessons." —Valus Saladin Forge
1448206048.subtitle_zh: “自我们成为人类起，就从未停止过战争。别忘了古老的教训。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

3181972995.name: Iron Battalion Greaves
3181972995.subtitle: "Combat without real death is like meat without salt. And yet I am glad to see you living after defeat. Strange how this bland meal suits!" —Bru'uc, Iron War Beast
3181972995.subtitle_zh: “没有真正死亡的战斗，就像没放盐的肉，但我很高兴看到你战败后活了下来。这清淡的一餐竟也合我口味！”——钢铁战兽布鲁乌克

2837409129.name: Per Audacia Gauntlets
2837409129.subtitle: "It's good to see the Traveler from my balcony again. Reminds you of what we do this for, eh?" —Lord Shaxx
2837409129.subtitle_zh: “又能从我家阳台上看见旅行者了，感觉真好。让我们想起了拼搏的意义，对吧？”——领主沙克斯

3364872431.name: Per Audacia Plate
3364872431.subtitle: "I'll give you a prophecy: you're going to get right back into the ring and crush your enemies!" —Lord Shaxx
3364872431.subtitle_zh: “告诉你一则预言：你将重回擂台碾碎你的敌人！”——领主沙克斯

317063806.name: Per Audacia Mark
317063806.subtitle: "Think I'll pay Tex Mechanica another little visit. They need some help staying on the straight and narrow." —Lord Shaxx
317063806.subtitle_zh: “我得再去拜访下特克斯机械。他们需要一点帮助才能安分守己。”——领主沙克斯

2373605528.name: Per Audacia Helm
2373605528.subtitle: "I haven't forgotten the vows I took. I still have the bow." —Lord Shaxx
2373605528.subtitle_zh: “我没有忘记曾经立下的誓言。那把弓我还留着。”——领主沙克斯

3129350971.name: Per Audacia Greaves
3129350971.subtitle: "You miss all the shots you don't take. And many of the ones you do. Get to the shooting range, for the Light's sake!" —Lord Shaxx
3129350971.subtitle_zh: “不发射的子弹永远不会中。打出去的子弹大多数会偏。看在光能的份上，快去靶场练练！”——领主沙克斯

1388789482.name: Cyberserpent Null Gauntlets
1388789482.subtitle: "Been a while since I cooked a meal in a real kitchen. It's taken some getting used to." —The Drifter
1388789482.subtitle_zh: “我很久没在真正的厨房里做饭了。得花点时间习惯一下。”——浪客

1239854366.name: Cyberserpent Null Plate
1239854366.subtitle: "C'mon, we got Dredgens to hunt. I mean Bael's crew, not my Gambit patrons. Unless you have something to tell me…?" —The Drifter
1239854366.subtitle_zh: “来吧，我们还要猎杀德瑞捷呢。我是说巴埃尔那伙人，不是我的智谋顾客。除非…你有什么情报？”——浪客

569481511.name: Cyberserpent Null Mark
569481511.subtitle: "You know, the City's got colonies of unpaired Ghosts just like Tharsis? I've been making friends. And enemies. Mostly enemies." —Blue
569481511.subtitle_zh: “你知道吗？圣城里也跟塔尔西斯一样，有着成群的未配对机灵。我结识了朋友，以及敌人。主要是敌人。”——布鲁

4182898491.name: Cyberserpent Null Helm
4182898491.subtitle: "Listen, you can handle the prophecies from here. I've got enough gray hairs." —The Drifter
4182898491.subtitle_zh: “听着，预言就交给你来处理。我不想再添白头发了。”——浪客

428001412.name: Cyberserpent Null Greaves
428001412.subtitle: "Get back in there. I want to see action! I want to see motes popping out of bodies! I want blood!" —Blue
428001412.subtitle_zh: “回去继续打！我要看到战斗！我要看到萤光乱飙！我要见血！”——布鲁

2235536812.name: Pantheos Resplendent Gloves
2235536812.subtitle: Now, do it again.
2235536812.text:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected. 

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2235536812.text_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。 

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

2089000948.name: Pantheos Resplendent Robes
2089000948.subtitle: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
2089000948.text:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets. 

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
2089000948.text_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。 

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

2832830921.name: Pantheos Resplendent Bond
2832830921.subtitle: Here is your heart's desire.
2832830921.text:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks. 

But you are still an icon. 

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit. 

We try again. 

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all? 

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse. 

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready. 

And I know we cannot be ready. 

We must try anyway.
2832830921.text_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。 

但你依旧是个象征。 

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。 

我们再试一次。 

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？ 

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。 

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。 

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。 

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

3773004861.name: Pantheos Resplendent Hood
3773004861.subtitle: Cast down your greatest foes.
3773004861.text:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
3773004861.text_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

3305726422.name: Pantheos Resplendent Boots
3305726422.subtitle: You know that you will fight forever.
3305726422.subtitle_zh: 你深知自己将永无止境地战斗。
3305726422.text:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
3305726422.text_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

1580760688.name: Circuit Gauntlets
1580760688.subtitle: Worn by champions of the track.

3780494232.name: Circuit Chestplate
3780494232.subtitle: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.
3780494232.subtitle_zh: 累累伤痕皆是胜利的印记。

2175988661.name: Racer's Bond
2175988661.subtitle: Is it a flash of insight or merely a spark from your bond?
2175988661.subtitle_zh: 那是顿悟的灵光，还是你臂环上迸出的火花？

2067398905.name: Circuit Runner
2067398905.subtitle: The spark that ignites the flame.

1897819210.name: Circuit Striders
1897819210.subtitle: These boots left their mark on victory lane.
1897819210.subtitle_zh: 穿上这双靴子，在胜利之路上留下足迹。

1851922001.name: Eutechnology Gloves
1851922001.subtitle: Then came the experts of the technology, the eu-techs.
1851922001.subtitle_zh: 后来，有了精通该科技的专家，巫灵技师。

2897411591.name: Eutechnology Robes
2897411591.subtitle: In time, the identity became synonymous with the technology.
2897411591.subtitle_zh: 最终，这个身份成为了这项科技的代名词。

4285848704.name: Eutechnology Cover
4285848704.subtitle: First there was the good technology, scavenged from Shipspire.
4285848704.subtitle_zh: 首先，有了回收自巅峰飞船的优良科技。

1683071779.name: Eutechnology Boots
1683071779.subtitle: And the eutechs became the techeuns, in turn.
1683071779.subtitle_zh: 于是，巫灵技师们成为了灵巫。

164616118.name: Cruel Electrum Gloves
164616118.subtitle: "You've sunk enough time into circles. Consider the enduring legacy of the pyramid." —Osiris to Ikora Rey
164616118.subtitle_zh: “你已经浪费了够多的时间，想想金字塔的恒久遗产吧。”——奥斯里斯致艾可拉·蕾伊

3740518778.name: Cruel Electrum Robes
3740518778.subtitle: "Learn the ways of your foe so that you may guard against becoming them." —Osiris
3740518778.subtitle_zh: “学会敌人的行事之道，才能防止自己落得同样下场。”——奥斯里斯

3388972107.name: Cruel Electrum Bond
3388972107.subtitle: "In any future, the Lighthouse endures." —Saint-14
3388972107.subtitle_zh: “无论未来会如何，灯塔永存。”——圣人14号

2346028079.name: Cruel Electrum Hood
2346028079.subtitle: "Like the universe itself, the boundaries of knowledge never stop expanding. Write that down." —Osiris
2346028079.subtitle_zh: “如同宇宙本身，知识的边界永远在扩张。把这句话记下来。”——奥斯里斯

1376998416.name: Cruel Electrum Boots
1376998416.subtitle: "The Light is life! And life is pain! If your Light sears you, let it—and make your enemy burn even hotter!" —Saint-14
1376998416.subtitle_zh: “光能就是生命！而生命就是痛苦！若光能灼烧你，别抗拒——然后让你的敌人燃得更炽烈！”——圣人14号

3672778310.name: Iron Battalion Gloves
3672778310.subtitle: "Death will never stop pursuing you, Lightbearer, because everyone wants what they cannot have. Cherish that endless chase!" —Ralir, Iron War Beast
3672778310.subtitle_zh: “死亡永远不会停止追逐你，负光者，因为所有存在都渴求自己得不到的东西。好好珍惜这无尽的追逐吧！”——钢铁战兽拉利尔

1621183978.name: Iron Battalion Robes
1621183978.subtitle: "One day we will guide the Valus through Torobatl's broad avenues and together paint them green with Hive blood." —Reghusk, Iron War Beast
1621183978.subtitle_zh: “终有一日，我们会引导军政官穿行图罗巴特尔宽阔的街道，一同用邪魔族的血将其染成绿色。”——钢铁战兽雷古斯克

2258001659.name: Iron Battalion Bond
2258001659.subtitle: "Raise the banner. Light the flame. Never let it burn out." —Valus Saladin Forge
2258001659.subtitle_zh: “高举旗帜，点燃火焰，绝不让它熄灭。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

3738911103.name: Iron Battalion Cover
3738911103.subtitle: "Humanity's been waging war for as long as we've been humanity. Don't forget the old lessons." —Valus Saladin Forge
3738911103.subtitle_zh: “自我们成为人类起，就从未停止过战争。别忘了古老的教训。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

3656265024.name: Iron Battalion Boots
3656265024.subtitle: "Combat without real death is like meat without salt. And yet I am glad to see you living after defeat. Strange how this bland meal suits!" —Bru'uc, Iron War Beast
3656265024.subtitle_zh: “没有真正死亡的战斗，就像没放盐的肉，但我很高兴看到你战败后活了下来。这清淡的一餐竟也合我口味！”——钢铁战兽布鲁乌克

1001635962.name: Per Audacia Gloves
1001635962.subtitle: "It's good to see the Traveler from my balcony again. Reminds you of what we do this for, eh?" —Lord Shaxx
1001635962.subtitle_zh: “又能从我家阳台上看见旅行者了，感觉真好。让我们想起了拼搏的意义，对吧？”——领主沙克斯

107146958.name: Per Audacia Robes
107146958.subtitle: "I'll give you a prophecy: you're going to get right back into the ring and crush your enemies!" —Lord Shaxx
107146958.subtitle_zh: “告诉你一则预言：你将重回擂台碾碎你的敌人！”——领主沙克斯

849595799.name: Per Audacia Bond
849595799.subtitle: "Think I'll pay Tex Mechanica another little visit. They need some help staying on the straight and narrow." —Lord Shaxx
849595799.subtitle_zh: “我得再去拜访下特克斯机械。他们需要一点帮助才能安分守己。”——领主沙克斯

2679378699.name: Per Audacia Cover
2679378699.subtitle: "I haven't forgotten the vows I took. I still have the bow." —Lord Shaxx
2679378699.subtitle_zh: “我没有忘记曾经立下的誓言。那把弓我还留着。”——领主沙克斯

2682565300.name: Per Audacia Boots
2682565300.subtitle: "You miss all the shots you don't take. And many of the ones you do. Get to the shooting range, for the Light's sake!" —Lord Shaxx
2682565300.subtitle_zh: “不发射的子弹永远不会中。打出去的子弹大多数会偏。看在光能的份上，快去靶场练练！”——领主沙克斯

1955241651.name: Cyberserpent Null Gloves
1955241651.subtitle: "Been a while since I cooked a meal in a real kitchen. It's taken some getting used to." —The Drifter
1955241651.subtitle_zh: “我很久没在真正的厨房里做饭了。得花点时间习惯一下。”——浪客

4055612125.name: Cyberserpent Null Robes
4055612125.subtitle: "C'mon, we got Dredgens to hunt. I mean Bael's crew, not my Gambit patrons. Unless you have something to tell me…?" —The Drifter
4055612125.subtitle_zh: “来吧，我们还要猎杀德瑞捷呢。我是说巴埃尔那伙人，不是我的智谋顾客。除非…你有什么情报？”——浪客

1647090192.name: Cyberserpent Null Bond
1647090192.subtitle: "You know, the City's got colonies of unpaired Ghosts just like Tharsis? I've been making friends. And enemies. Mostly enemies." —Blue
1647090192.subtitle_zh: “你知道吗？圣城里也跟塔尔西斯一样，有着成群的未配对机灵。我结识了朋友，以及敌人。主要是敌人。”——布鲁

2374137962.name: Cyberserpent Null Cover
2374137962.subtitle: "Listen, you can handle the prophecies from here. I've got enough gray hairs." —The Drifter
2374137962.subtitle_zh: “听着，预言就交给你来处理。我不想再添白头发了。”——浪客

1690092421.name: Cyberserpent Null Boots
1690092421.subtitle: "Get back in there. I want to see action! I want to see motes popping out of bodies! I want blood!" —Blue
1690092421.subtitle_zh: “回去继续打！我要看到战斗！我要看到萤光乱飙！我要见血！”——布鲁

2200470033.name: Cull's Shadow
2200470033.subtitle: "…Cull's death will draw those most eager to tempt Darkness. All is proceeding as we envision." —Teben Grey
2200470033.subtitle_zh: “…库尔之死将引来那些渴求暗影之人。一切皆按我等设想而行。”——缇本·格雷
2200470033.text:
It had been weeks since Bael had seen his own reflection, wary of new horrors on an unfamiliar face. Now safe in the darkened cavern, he removed his helmet. He felt gooey remnants of skin pull away from his face, stuck to the helmet's lining. The damp air stung his exposed nerves. 

The lull was interrupted by a sudden migraine radiating from behind his eyes. He fell to his knees, static threatening to overtake his consciousness.

DEVOTE YOUR EARS DREDGEN 

I BRANDISHED YOU EXPECTING CONQUEST 

"I'm closer than ever." Bael's voice felt like crushed glass in his throat. "My followers have discovered a Weapon of Sorrow—" 

YOU WERE OUR WEAPON 

YOU SUPPLANT YOURSELF 

Bael was thrown to the floor by a gravitic wave. A shrill squeal escaped him. 

"Not just a weapon—a Hive forge," he blurted. "Capable of making an arsenal worthy of your might." 

Bael felt the crushing weight lessen. He struggled to his knees. 

"We could tithe hundreds of Lightbearers to you with those weapons," he wheedled. "I just need a little more time—" 

TIME IS ABUNDANT PATIENCE IS NOT 

A WEAPON IS NOTHING WITHOUT ITS WIELDER 

YOU WILL NOT DISAPPOINT US AGAIN 

The gravitic pressure dissipated, along with the migraine. Bael's heartbeat settled back into a steady rhythm. 

Instead of relief, Bael was flooded with emptiness. VI was right—he already craved his oppressor's return.   

He rose, rededicated. He had a legacy to secure.
2200470033.text_zh:
巴埃尔已有好几周没看见过自己的倒影了，他害怕在那张陌生的脸上又出现新的恐怖景象。此刻，他躲进昏暗洞窟，取下头盔时，能感觉到黏在头盔内衬上的黏稠皮肤残片，被生生从脸上扯下。潮湿的空气如针般灼刺着他裸露的神经。 

短暂的喘息被一阵突如其来的偏头痛打断，疼痛从双眼后方蔓延开。他跪倒在地，电流噪声几乎要将他的意识夺走。

注意听好了德瑞捷 

我挥舞你意在征服 

“我只有一步之遥。”巴埃尔的嗓子像被碎玻璃狠狠磨过，“我的追随者发现了一件忧愁武器——” 

你是我们的武器 

你妄图用它取代 

巴埃尔被一股引力冲击波掀翻在地，发出一声尖厉的惨叫。 

“不只是一件武器，是一座邪魔族锻炉。”他脱口而出，“能制造出配得上你伟力的军械库。” 

巴埃尔感觉身上的压力稍稍减轻。他艰难地跪坐起来。 

“有了那些武器，我们能向你进贡上百名负光者。”他谄媚地说，“我只需要再多一点时间——” 

时间很充足匮乏的是耐心 

没有持有者武器一无是处 

你绝不能再让我们失望了 

压迫性的引力消散了，偏头痛也一同消失。巴埃尔的心跳渐渐恢复平稳。 

没有解脱感，唯有漫漫空虚。VI说得没错——他已在渴求那压迫者的再次降临。   

他起身，再次决心满满。有一份传承等着他去夺取。

2197778303.name: Fafnir
2197778303.subtitle: "Buck, what you've got down there is an interdimensional dragon." —Gen. Sam Galloway
2197778303.subtitle_zh: “巴克，下面的那个东西是条跨纬度的龙。”——萨姆·加洛韦将军
2197778303.text:
The yellow warning light gave way to green, and Director William 'Buck' Moffat's knees creaked as he entered containment with a slice of cake. 

At the far end of the room was a massive empty frame, the air inside thick like desert heat. He offered four pencils on the ground before it. 

"Figured I'd sneak away from the party to say goodbye. You be polite to my replacement; he's trying to build you a body. Like a real boy." Moffat took his regular seat. "Comprehension confirmation: What is your name?" 

The pencil on the far left turned to silvery striated lithium. 

"Confirmed. Last chance, Lee." 

Two objects blinked into existence on the ground in response. Lee always gave back two: one of hers, one of his. A varsity jacket gifted to Teresa Kierczynski, and Dr. Davis's gardening journal. Moffat had memorized the objects that disappeared when they did—his briefcase, her car, the USS Hornet—and seethed over decades as Lee would drip-feed them back. Twenty years talking to the elevated gravity levels in the basement, and all Lee would do was rummage around its lost and found. 

He fell quiet. "I failed them…" 

Moffat nudged the jacket. YERO. A mix of sadness, sentiment, and nostalgia moved him to ask one last time. 

"…will you send them something for me?" 

The second pencil turned to carbon, a yes, and Moffat's shoulders unstooped as he sat straight the hell up.

His hand trembled as he held up his plate. He willed his voice calm, "Can you give them this?" 

The chocolate cake slice, the words '-etirement, Buck!' in icing, paper plate, and fork vanished from his hand. He inhaled sharply. Tears slicked his cheeks, and Director Moffat beseeched the kidnapper in the basement with a wavering plea, "Tell them I tried."
2197778303.text_zh:
黄色警示灯转为绿色时，主任威廉·“巴克”·莫法特端着一块蛋糕，膝盖嘎吱作响地走进收容间。 

房间最深处是一个巨大的空框架，框架内的空气像沙漠热浪般扭曲。他在框架前的地上放下四支铅笔。 

“我想着溜出派对一会，来跟你道个别。你要对我的接任者客气点，他在想办法给你造个身子，让你像个真正的小男孩。”莫法特坐到他惯常的位置，“理解确认：你叫什么名字？” 

最左边的那支铅笔变成了银白色条纹状的锂。 

“确认。最后的机会，李。” 

地上随即闪现出两样物件。李总是会还回两样：一件属于她，一件属于他。送给特蕾莎·凯尔钦斯基的棒球夹克，以及戴维斯博士的园艺日记。莫法特早已记住那些与他们一同消失的东西——他的公文包、她的车、大黄蜂号航空母舰——也在往后的几十年里，眼睁睁看着李一点点地把它们吐出来。二十年间，他对着地下室里被拔高的重力场说话，而李唯一会做的，就只是翻检一个失物招领箱。 

他沉默了片刻。“我辜负了他们…” 

莫法特拨了拨那件夹克，耶罗的。哀伤、眷恋与怀旧交织在一起，让他忍不住再次开口。 

“…你能替我送点东西给他们吗？” 

第二支铅笔变成了碳，肯定的答复，莫法特弯着的脊背一下子挺直了。

他颤抖着举起盘子，强压着让声音保持平静，“你能把这个给他们吗？” 

那块巧克力蛋糕，上面用糖霜写着“…休，巴克！”，连纸盘带叉子，一同从他手中消失。他猛地吸了一口气，泪水爬满脸颊。莫法特主任带着哽咽的祈求，对这名地下室里的绑匪低声说道：“告诉他们，我尽力了。”

570037143.name: Project Proposal, 1961
570037143.text:
PROPOSAL DZ-KJIK19RSNP 

…As the Department sets its sights on distant frontiers, we must contend with the problem of survival at extremes. Our colleagues at NASA have seen great success on Project Apollo, but if we are to travel even further afield, we will face conditions even more inimical to human life.

Whether future explorers seek to dive into boiling sulfuric acid or attempt to stretch across higher dimensions, we must equip them for scientific inquiry, communication with native entities—and, above all, their mission to return safely home. 

Dr. Victor Falkner 

IN RE: PROPOSAL DZ-KJIK19RSNP 

Dr. Falkner, ever since I saw you present your work on the Nereida ADS, I knew you were just the sort of man I'd want in the DZ department. I'm glad Purnell agreed—and I'm glad to have you with us. 

We're packed to the gunwales with fancy machinery, but remote-operating some contraption from a cozy cabin is no substitute for putting boots down on the seafloor. You understand that, just as much as you understand that no discovery is worth the life of the person in those boots. 

Your proposal is approved—it's on the books as Project JUNCTION ADVANCE. Assemble your team and requisition what you need. I have high hopes for you. 

Director William Moffat
570037143.text_zh:
提案DZ-KJIK19RSNP 

…当我们把目光投向遥远的前沿时，必须直面在极端条件下生存的挑战。我们的NASA同行在阿波罗计划中取得了辉煌成就，但若我们想要探索得更远，就将面临对人类生命构成更大威胁的环境。

无论未来的探索者是要潜入沸腾的硫酸，还是尝试在更高维度间穿梭，我们都必须为他们提供进行科学探索、与原生实体交流的工具——并且，最为关键的是，确保他们能够平安归来。 

维克多·福克纳博士 

回复：提案DZ-KJIK19RSNP 

福克纳博士，自从看到你展示涅瑞达ADS项目的成果后，我就知道你是我想要引入DZ部门的人才。很高兴珀内尔也同意了——更高兴你加入了我们。 

我们这里已经堆满了各种高科技设备，但躲在舒适的船舱里远程操控装置，永远无法替代亲自踏上海底的感觉。你应该明白这一点，也清楚没有任何发现值得以探险家的生命为代价。 

你的提案已经通过——正式立项为联结前进计划。现在你可以组建团队，申请所需的资源了。我对你充满期待。 

威廉·莫法特主任

570037140.name: Magnetic Audiotape, 1962
570037140.text:
[Portions of tape have been weathered beyond recovery. Label reads: [illegible] Falkner, DZ; Richard Purnell, DZ'.]

PUR: [unintelligible, 12 seconds] bickering about culture and anthropocentrism. They'll be at it for [unintelligible, 4 seconds] 

PUR: What matters to us, to you, is that they recovered three intact survival suits from Diablerets. 

PUR: [inaudible, 12 seconds] questions?

FAL: Many.

PUR: The most pressing, then.

FAL: Will I be allowed to see one of the suits?

PUR: See? Vic, you think [unintelligible, 4 seconds] [laughter] You're getting one of them, tubes and all. Not the wet stuff, Bio snatched that up—some kind of silicone-based micro-organism in suspension, they're saying—leave 'em to it.

FAL: I did not believe it likely [unintelligible, 10 seconds] 

PUR: Oh, don't get me wrong. Chem, Bio, Tech, R&D—even Primes, for some reason—they all want a piece of the pie, and there's not enough slices for all of us.

PUR: Moffat put the kibosh on giving one to Häkke in R&D at least—guns won't do us any good if we're not alive to pull the trigger, and the director's never liked that guy in the first place. Chem and Tech [unintelligible, 2 seconds] other two.

PUR: The Diablerets suits [unintelligible, 3 seconds], but that's a solved problem for humanity already. We're looking at the next frontier. 

FAL: Transdimensional travel. 

PUR: Get your people prepped to receive the materials. And just so we're clear, this isn't charity. I'm expecting great things from you, Vic. 

FAL: I will not disappoint.
570037140.text_zh:
[部分磁带因年代久远无法恢复。标签内容显示：[无法辨认]福克纳，DZ；理查德·珀内尔，DZ。]

珀：[难以辨认，持续12秒]为了文化和人类中心主义争论不休。他们得这样[难以辨认，持续4秒] 

珀：对我们，对你而言，重要的是，他们从迪亚布勒雷那里回收了三套完整的生存服。 

珀：[音量过低，持续12秒]问题吗？

福：很多。

珀：那就挑最关键的问。

福：我能看看生存服吗？

珀：看？维克，你以为[难以辨认，持续4秒][笑声]你会直接得到一套，包括所有管线。只是湿的那部分不行，生物科已经抢走了，说是某种悬浮在介质中的硅基微生物…让他们去研究吧。

福：我原本不认为有多大可能[难以辨认，持续10秒] 

珀：哦，别误会。化学、生物、技术、研发…甚至包括首脑，不知出于什么原因，都想分一杯羹，但根本分不过来。

珀：至少莫法特否决了把其中一套给研发部的Häkke——要是活不到开枪的时候，再多枪也没用，而且主任一直看那家伙不顺眼。化学和技术[难以辨认，持续2秒]拿走了另外两套。

珀：迪亚布勒雷生存服[难以辨认，持续3秒]，但对人类来说，那已经不是问题了。我们要瞄准的是下一个前沿。 

福：跨维旅行。 

珀：让你的团队做好接收材料的准备。另外，这不是施舍。我对你期望很高，维克。 

福：我不会让你失望的。

570037141.name: Memoranda, 1966
570037141.text:
FROM: Dr. Witosław Ostrowski, SU 

Sorry, Vic, didn't mean to leave you hanging. The whole department's been running on too much coffee and too little sleep since it happened—can you blame us? He was one of ours. 

—————————————— 

FROM: Karin Clarke, AC 

This is a notice that Project JUNCTION ADVANCE will be receiving additional funding. A courier will arrive tomorrow with the paperwork. Please be prepared to set aside some time to complete these documents. 

—————————————— 

FROM: William Moffat, D 

Dr. Falkner, I am formally ordering your team to narrow its scope to safeguarding human beings suffused in STRANGE MATTER. This is an internal name for a form of extradimensional exotic matter; you'll be read into our classified projects and studies on the subject shortly. 

Department Lead Dr. Purnell has already been notified, and you should have been allocated additional funds by Accounting. We'll also be providing additional headcount to support this change in direction. Please consult Dr. Purnell and your colleagues in the SM department with any questions. 

If this leaves a bad taste in your mouth, I have it too. I want to make sure you know that this is not standard procedure for projects here. I don't make a habit of ordering experts around their fields. 

Regretfully, the circumstances demand it. The evidence suggests that something took Dr. Davis and Agent Yero through STRANGE MATTER. We need to be able to follow them. 

—————————————— 

FROM: Dr. Yumei Li, SM 

It's the most obvious conclusion. We logged traces of it around the phone. 

—————————————— 

FROM: Dr. Yumei Li, SM 

Scratch that, it's not just the phone. Human Resources and Security narrowed down the intersection where Davis disappeared. There were traces there too. I'm transferring Napier to your team tomorrow.
570037141.text_zh:
发件人：维托斯瓦夫·奥斯特罗夫斯基博士，SU 

抱歉，维克，不是故意不理你。自从那件事发生后，整个部门都靠过量咖啡和严重缺乏睡眠硬撑着——能怪我们吗？他曾是我们中的一员。 

—————————————— 

发件人：卡琳·克拉克，AC 

兹通知，联结前进计划将获得追加经费。明天会有一名信使送来相关文件。请预留时间处理这些文书工作。 

—————————————— 

发件人：威廉·莫法特，D 

福克纳博士，现正式命令你的团队将研究范围缩小至：保护被奇异物质浸泡的人体。这是一种跨维度异域物质的内部代号；你将很快被引入我们在该主题上的机密项目与研究。 

部门主管珀内尔博士已获悉此事，会计部也应当已经为你们划拨了追加经费。我们还会增加人手以支持这次研究方向的调整。如有疑问，请与珀内尔博士及SM部门的同事沟通。 

若这让你感到不安，我也一样。我想让你知道，这并非我们这里项目的常规做法。我一向不会随意对专家指手画脚。 

但很遗憾，形势所迫。种种证据表明，是某种东西通过奇异物质带走了戴维斯博士与耶罗特工。我们必须具备追踪他们的能力。 

—————————————— 

发件人：李雨梅博士，SM 

这是最显而易见的结论。我们在电话机周围检测到了它的痕迹。 

—————————————— 

发件人：李雨梅博士，SM 

更正一下，不只是电话。人力资源和安保已经将戴维斯失踪的区间范围缩小了。那里也有痕迹。我明天会把纳皮尔调到你组里去。

570037138.name: Pocket Notebook, 1966
570037138.text:
Sample degraded within 4 seconds.

If they were alive when they were taken, they would not have stayed that way for more than a few minutes. The director must know this. Perhaps he hopes to at least recover their bodies.

——————————————

I see why Yumei is always in Accounting now. STRANGE MATTER lives up to its name. The process of creating it has a steep price tag, and it is difficult to store for any usable length of time. We can barely coax together enough to stay on a slide. I can test pieces, but for a whole suit, I'll have to join Yumei in the queue.

—————————————— 

I overheard Conway bragging in the cafeteria. Visibility approved another public patent from his team. The fourth this year alone that they've reverse-engineered from their suit.

I asked him for a material sample to test with. Begged, really. I don't care how much he laughs about it later.

Pride is not a result.

—————————————— 

No tests today. I attended the dedication. The director gave the closing speech—about their lives, their work, and the importance of not leaving our own behind. I could swear he looked at me when he said it. I know. I know.

There were unfamiliar faces in the crowd. Not our people. They approached the director as soon as the ceremony closed.

——————————————

Althaus's desk has been cleared. I asked around—poached by DARPA for a weapons program based on the ballistics models they developed from their suit.

I see more unfamiliar faces in the halls every month.

The disappearances aren't just an internal affair. They never could have been. The director believes we will reach out into the void and find friends reaching back. Others do not share his hope.

I didn't need Dr. Purnell to explain this to me. I suppose that can be considered progress? I would rather be making progress on this [expletive redacted] suit.

——————————————

Sample degraded in 9 seconds. At this rate of improvement, even if they are friendly, we will not survive long enough to finish introducing ourselves.

——————————————

There was a scene in the main lobby today. A tall, dignified man in a charcoal suit, speaking with gravitas. Security was trying to escort him out, but the director stopped them.

Now everyone who was within a ten-room radius knows about the lawsuit the Davis family is bringing. Legal must be tying themselves in knots.

Before Mr. Davis left, the director told him, "I will bring them back."

Them. Not their bodies. Them, alive and whole. If the director were anyone else, I'd laugh. But he means it.

The new formulas are running. I will not let them down.
570037138.text_zh:
样本在4秒内便降解了。

就算是他们被带走时还活着，也撑不过几分钟。主任心里肯定清楚。或许，他还抱有至少要找回他们遗体的希望。

——————————————

我明白雨梅为何总待在会计部了。奇异物质果然名不虚传。制造它的成本高得离谱，而且几乎无法稳定保存来使用。我们好不容易才凑到那么一点点放在载玻片上。我可以测试碎片，但若要一整套生存服的量，我也得跟雨梅一样去排队了。

—————————————— 

今天在餐厅，听到康威在那里炫耀。他们团队又有一项对外公开的专利获批了，是从那套生存服上反向工程出来的。今年他们就已经拿了四项了。

我向他要了一份材料样本用于测试，可以说是求来的。我不在乎他事后怎么嘲笑我。

自尊不是我们需要的成果。

—————————————— 

今天没有实验。我去了追悼仪式。主任做了闭幕致辞，谈到了他们的生命、工作，以及不放弃团队成员的重要性。我发誓，在说这句话时，他看了我一眼。我知道，我都知道。

人群中出现了陌生的面孔，不是我们的人。仪式一结束，他们就去找主任了。

——————————————

阿尔特豪斯的办公桌被清空了。我打听了一下，他被国防部高级研究计划局挖走了，去参与一项基于他们那套生存服弹道模型的武器计划。

我每个月在走廊里看到的陌生面孔都在增多。

失踪事件已经不再只是内部事务了。其实，它本来就不可能只是内部事务。主任相信，当我们向虚空伸出手时，会有朋友回应。但并不是所有人都认同他的希望。

我不需要珀内尔博士跟我解释这些。我想这也算是一种进步吧？我宁愿是在这套[粗话已隐藏]生存服上取得进展。

——————————————

样本在9秒内降解了。照目前的改进速度，就算对方真的友好，我们也撑不到说完自我介绍。

——————————————

今天主厅里出了场风波。一个高个子、气度不凡的男人，穿着炭灰色西装，讲话声调沉稳有力。安保试图把他请出去，但主任拦住了他们。

现在，方圆十间办公室内的人，都知道戴维斯家正在提起诉讼了。法务那边肯定忙得不可开交。

在戴维斯先生离开前，主任对他说：“我会把他们带回来的。”

“他们”。不是他们的尸体，而是他们本人，活着、完好无损。要是换作别人，我只会嗤之以鼻。但他是认真的。

新配方已经在测试了。我不会让他们失望的。

570037139.name: Introduction Letter, 1967
570037139.text:
Dr. Falkner,

I'm Dr. Annalise Meyers, lead researcher on Project BLUE DOOR. You may have heard of this project before, as a historical curiosity. In the early days of the Department of External Observation, we were given a mandate to build an interdimensional tunneling device, with the aim of establishing faster-than-light communications without violating causality. Our original tests were inconclusive, and the project was mothballed.

Earlier this year, Director Moffat reactivated BLUE DOOR with a specific directive. He believes that something took Dr. Davis and Agent Yero into another dimension. We've since been concentrating our efforts to creating a path to follow them.

This month, we succeeded. We opened a tear, 15 centimeters across, into another dimension. We project that we'll be able to accommodate human traversal in six months.

However, we have a problem, and Dr. Li said you might be able to help. I understand that JUNCTION ADVANCE is having issues sourcing enough STRANGE MATTER to test with.

Well, right now, we've got too much. The tear flooded our testing room with so much STRANGE MATTER, it must be like air on the other side. There were no casualties, but all our equipment was transmuted into iron filings. We need some kind of shielding.

Interdepartmental cooperation normally involves a lot of paperwork, but it's clear that this project means a great deal to the director—all the red tape's been cut for us. We can start tomorrow, if you like.

What do you say? Let's help each other out.

Dr. Meyers
570037139.text_zh:
福克纳博士：

我是安娜丽丝·迈耶斯博士，蓝门计划的首席研究员，你可能当花边新闻听说过这个计划。在对外观察部成立的早期，我们曾奉命建造一台跨维度隧道装置，目标是在不违反因果律的前提下，实现超光速通讯。我们最初的测试结论并不明确，这个计划也就被封存了。

今年年初，莫法特主任下达明确指令，重启了蓝门计划。他认为，是某种东西把戴维斯博士和耶罗特工带去了另一个维度。从那之后，我们便集中精力去开辟一条可以追随他们的路径。

本月，我们成功了。我们开启了一道15厘米宽的裂缝，通向另一个维度。预估六个月内就能达到可供人类通行的宽度。

然而，我们遇到了一个问题，李博士说你或许能帮上忙。我知道联结前进计划正为获取足够的奇异物质用于测试而发愁。

巧的是，我们现在多得用不完。那道裂缝向我们的测试间灌入了海量奇异物质，在那边的世界里，它应该就跟空气一样。虽然没有造成人员伤亡，但我们所有设备都被转化成了铁屑。我们需要某种屏蔽措施。

按照常规，跨部门协作得走一大堆文书流程，但很明显，这个计划对主任意义重大——所有的障碍都给我们扫清了。你同意的话，明天我们就可以开始。

你意下如何？我们互相帮个忙吧。

迈耶斯博士

570037136.name: Spiral-Bound Notebook, 1967-1968
570037136.text:
EXPERIMENT 1: The tear looked almost innocuous. A floating hole in the curtain of our world. The other side… Dr. Meyers says they are trying to name a new color for it.

20 centimeters. Sample A degraded in 6 seconds. Sample B degraded within 30 seconds. Napier was right: a larger sample mass corrodes more slowly. It doesn't make any sense, but results are results.

Director Moffat was there. He stared at the tear in silence the whole time.

——————————————

EXPERIMENT 6: 24 centimeters. Sample degraded in 159 seconds. Yes. Yes, this is promising. A full-size suit might actually perform far better than our smaller prototypes.

Our current problem is materials. The Diablerets suit's joints were strong but flexible, capable of repeated and extended compression without any loss in tensile strength. R&D cannot replicate it. Told me to "find a [expletive redacted] alien rubber tree or [expletive redacted] off."

A diver in the Nereida couldn't scratch their own back, either. Forget dexterity and haptic perception. In fact, maybe we don't even need a viewport—no, Dr. Meyers will object. If I adapt the polymer structure, can I make it thin enough to coat conventional rubber?

Director Moffat came by again to thank us for our hard work. There were dark circles under his eyes, but he was in a freshly-pressed suit. He must have been on his way to another hearing.

—————————————— 

EXPERIMENT 14: 30 centimeters. Prototype degraded in 8 minutes, 32 seconds. Visor and joints failed first, as expected, but I think I know how to improve the glass, at least. It won't be perfectly clear, but the visibility will be acceptable.

Extensive life support is unfeasible. That's fine; we don't need them to stay for long. Ten minutes, perhaps, to get at least three sets of readings. Double that for safety.

——————————————

EXPERIMENT 25: Annalise and her team made a breakthrough. 162 centimeters. Prototype degraded in 12 minutes, 19 seconds.

BLUE DOOR has held up their end of the bargain; now it is my turn.

——————————————

EXPERIMENT 32: Director Moffat came by the observation room today. He looked at the tear, and told us he would be the first one through.

There was a scattering of nervous laughter. The rest of the team didn't believe him.

Annalise and I, though, we knew. We argued with him for three hours. Long after everyone else had gone home, he finally agreed to have a second. "On belay," he said.

There is not enough budget left in the fiscal year to develop customized suits, and of the team, I am the closest in build to the director. But I would be a poor scientist—indeed, a poor human being—if I would risk someone else's life and not my own.
570037136.text_zh:
实验1：裂缝看上去几乎无害，就像挂在我们世界幕布上的一个空洞。另一边…梅耶斯博士说，他们正试图为那东西命名一种新颜色。

20厘米。样本A在6秒内降解，样本B在30秒内降解。纳皮尔说得对：样本质量越大，腐蚀得越慢。这完全说不通，但结果就是这样。

莫法特主任在场。他全程沉默地盯着那道裂缝。

——————————————

实验6：24厘米。样本在159秒内降解。是的，结果令人充满希望。全尺寸的防护服，表现也许会远好于我们的小型原型。

我们目前的问题在于材料。迪亚布勒雷防护服的关节既坚固又柔韧，能够反复、长时间受压而不损失抗拉强度。研发部根本无法复制。他们对我说：“要么去找棵[粗话已隐藏]外星橡胶树来，要么[粗话已隐藏]滚蛋。”

坐在涅瑞达号里，潜水员连自己的背都挠不到，灵巧度和触觉感知什么的就别想了。其实，也许我们甚至都不需要观察窗——不，梅耶斯博士一定会反对。如果我改良聚合物结构，能不能把它做得足够薄，用来包覆普通橡胶？

莫法特主任又过来感谢我们的辛勤工作。他眼下有浓重的黑眼圈，但穿着一身熨帖的西装。他肯定是正要去参加另一场听证会。

—————————————— 

实验14：30厘米。原型在8分钟32秒内降解。护目镜和关节率先失效，和预期一致。不过，至少我觉得自己知道怎么改进玻璃了。没法做到完全透明，但可见度会在可接受范围内。

大规模生命维持系统并不可行。没关系，我们也不需要他们停留太久。也许十分钟，足够获取至少三组读数。为了保险起见，再翻一倍吧。

——————————————

实验25：安娜丽丝和她的团队取得了突破。162厘米，原型在12分钟19秒内降解。

蓝门已经履行了他们的那部分约定，现在轮到我了。

——————————————

实验32：莫法特主任今天到观察室来了。他看着那道裂缝，说他会第一个穿过去。

现场响起了零星的紧张笑声。其他团队成员都不相信他。

但安娜丽丝和我，我们知道他是认真的。我们跟他争论了足足三个小时。等其他人都回家很久以后，他终于同意再加一个人。“作为接应，”他说。

本财年已经没有足够预算开发定制防护服了，而在整个团队里，我的体型和主任最接近。如果我置身事外，拿别人的命去冒险，那我就不是一个好科学家，也算不上一个好人。

570037137.name: Magnetic Audiovisual Tape, 1968
570037137.text:
