31662759.name: Denier of Futurity
31662759.subtitle: The paths ahead are obscured, thus plan and man abandoned.
31662759.subtitle_zh: 前方道路晦暗，因此计划与人手皆被抛弃。
31662759.text:
It happens as Bael withdraws from the Luna operation. He is alone in his ship when he feels chill fog move through the valley of his heart, and for a moment he startles at the revealed warmth of his own blood. His new, titanium hand instinctively grabs at his chest, searching for something that is no longer there. 

"VI?" 

Bael feels himself sweating. 

"Answer me!" 

VI's voice rumbles on the edge of his perception, the sound of it carrying with the cold. THE FUTURE BEYOND THIS NODE OF TIME IS OPAQUE, says negative 177 Celsius, THE ENDEAVOR OF OUR ALTERNATE WEAPON HAS FAILED 

"What do you mean?" 

Bael crumples over his controls with the weight of the vision of a future that will no longer occur: himself, blade high, the Lightbearers dead and the false Weapon dead. This other-him is triumphant, his City is free, and he holds out his hand as if holding a sidearm, and with VI in his fingertips time bends and he shoots a meteor straight through the Traveler's center. He smiles as the corpse crashes through the atmosphere, feels the soundwave as it makes impact, tithes the kill to VI, and VI uses that tithe to tear a hole in the sky. VI escapes and he is free and Bael has killed god and he is also free. 

But the voice says, THIS FUTURE IS NO LONGER POSSIBLE 

And in this now, VI leaves Bael with only that vision as a token and, one final time, departs his body without a further word. The chill is gone, and for the first time in years, Bael's skin warms.
31662759.text_zh:
这发生在巴埃尔从月球行动撤出时。他独自待在船上，一阵冰冷雾气在他心间游走。有那么一瞬间，他被自己血液的温度惊到。他那只崭新的钛合金手本能地按向胸口，想要搜寻那早已不在的东西。 

“VI？” 

巴埃尔发现自己在冒汗。 

“回答我！” 

VI的声音在他感知的边缘轰鸣着传来，裹挟着寒意。“此节点之后的未来浑浊不堪，”负177度的声音说，“我们尝试替代武器的计划已然失败。” 

“你是什么意思？” 

一幅再也不会到来的未来图景将巴埃尔压得伏在操控台上：他高举利刃，负光者倒下，虚假武器也一同消亡。那个他凯旋而归，圣城获得了解放。他伸出手，仿佛手中握着一把手枪，指尖上是VI，时光随之扭曲。他扣动扳机，一颗流星径直贯穿旅行者的核心。他看着尸骸坠入大气层，露出微笑，感受着声波袭来的震响，将这次击杀作为VI的贡品，而VI则用这份贡品撕开了天空。VI逃脱束缚，重获自由；巴埃尔弑神成功，也得以解脱。 

但那个声音说：“这个未来已不再可能。” 

就在此刻，VI仅将那幅未来的图景作为纪念留给了巴埃尔，然后最后一次从他的躯体中抽离，没有留下只言片语。寒意渐渐消散，多年来，巴埃尔的皮肤第一次开始回暖。

367044134.name: The Wavewarden
367044134.subtitle: "Vertical hierarchy is our past. Trust me—the future's flat." —Boss Riliks
367044134.subtitle_zh: “垂直层级已成过往。相信我，未来是扁平的。”——李利克斯老大
367044134.text:
Riliks tugs at their mane with their ever-present comb. Eido watches them, chin propped on her hands.

"I'm not worried," Riliks declares for the fifth time. Riliks is a good public speaker; their voice is very nearly steady. 

"Good, there's nothing to worry about." Eido makes sure to sound breezy herself. She pulls the comb away and sets it down by the waiting holoprojector. 

Riliks huffs and leans into her, angled carefully to not squash their mane against her shoulder. Their deep chest rumbles. Eido clicks her mandibles fondly in return. 

"This has to go well," Riliks says. "But what am I gonna tell the gang? I met the symbol of the worst crimes ever done to our people and I made nice? Vixis will jump me." 

"You know Vixis can't fight." 

Riliks laughs. "Don't tell him that!" 

"I won't! You good?" 

"I'm just groovy." Riliks pulls away to look Eido in the eyes, dead serious again. "You?" 

She looks away, down at the projector. They'd worked together to fix it up. It had been important to Eido. It still is. 

Eido misses him, the City, Earth itself. She hasn't been home in months. The two halves of her life have been separate for too long. 

But every time she remembers him, she remembers his illness. Hooked up to Ether lines, smelling of her strongest tonics, temper shortened by pain. 

"Ask me again afterwards." 

She hits the button. In the moment before the holoprojector activates, Riliks grabs her hand, well out of sight of its visual pickup. 

Eido clings back and musters a smile. 

"Velask, Father!"
367044134.text_zh:
李利克斯用那把永不离身的梳子扯着鬃毛。艾多支着下巴看着李利克斯。

“我一点都不紧张，”李利克斯第五次说道，其公众演讲能力相当出色，声音几乎稳得没有一丝瑕疵。 

“很好，没什么可担心的。”艾多也刻意让自己的语气显得轻松。她拿开梳子，将它放在已准备就绪的全息投影仪旁。 

李利克斯哼了一声，靠向她，小心翼翼地调整着姿势，以免压到她肩上自己的鬃毛。李利克斯深沉的胸腔里发出咕噜声。艾多爱怜地轻轻咔嚓了几下颚钳作为回应。 

“这事必须顺利。”李利克斯说，“可我回头该怎么跟帮里的人说？我见到了那个对我们族群犯下最恶劣罪行的象征，还跟他一团和气？维克西斯非得揍我不可。” 

“你明明知道维克西斯根本不会打架。” 

李利克斯笑了，“别当着他面这么说！” 

“我不会的！你还好吗？” 

“我好得很。”李利克斯抽身开来，直视着艾多的眼睛，一本正经起来，“你呢？” 

她移开视线，看向投影仪。那是他们一起修好的，对艾多来说，它曾经很重要，现在也依旧重要。 

艾多很想念他，想念圣城，想念地球。她已经几个月没回家了。她人生的两半分离得太久了。 

但每次一想起他，她就会想起他的病。他身上插着乙太输送管，弥漫着她调配的最烈药剂的气味，因为疼痛而变得暴躁易怒。 

“等结束了再问我吧。” 

她按下按钮。在全息投影仪启动的前一刻，李利克斯在它的视野采集范围之外，一把抓住了她的手。 

艾多紧紧回握，挤出一个笑容。 

“维拉斯克，父亲！”

264077339.name: Sprint Finish
264077339.subtitle: Beat the odds one final time.
264077339.text:
"Look, I already have a very generous offer from the Tharsis Reformation," Prak'kesh countered. 

Spider harrumphed. "And what would the Vex want with your meager operation?" 

Prak'kesh dismissed the slight with a laconic shrug. "They figured the odds were set by some divine mathematical calculation. Like telemetries or something. Never occurred to them that spreads were just made up by schmucks like me. They want to set the lines." 

Spider leaned back on his throne to consider. The sounds of lively music and conversation drifted into the back room from the front of the bar. Prak'kesh and his Awoken bodyguard, Tulnik, sipped Ether Fizzes patiently. 

"Seems like a fifth arm to me," Spider finally opined. "Betting is just a small part of my operation. Hardly worth mentioning." 

"Revenue wise, maybe," Prak'kesh fired back. "But there ain't a lot of other ways to put Lightbearers in your pocket, are there? Hell, I got Dredgens that would ace a whole scav crew to get off my books. The leverage is part of the vig." 

Spider chuckled. For a small-time operator, the Human was savvy, he mused quietly. Perhaps he should have expected more from an ex-Guardian. 

"One-point-two in Glimmer and I'll throw in the land at the edge of the Farm—not the spot in town." Spider tapped on his datapad. "Lot… 3237. Final offer." 

 Tulnik leaned over and whispered in Prak'kesh's ear. The bookie nodded. 

"And one of those new SRL Skimmers," Prak'kesh added. "The ones with the articulating stabilizer fins." 

"Deal," Spider said. "Just give us a week to… acquire it." 

"Soon as I see the deed and the Glim in my account, I'll transfer the books." 

"Enjoy retirement while it lasts," Spider snarked. "I'll bet you're both back in the game by this time next year." 

"You're on," Prak'kesh quipped as they exited Spider's domain, hopefully for the last time.
264077339.text_zh:
“听着，我已经收到了塔尔西斯革新会的优厚报价，”普拉凯什进行了回击。 

蛛王哼了一声。“那些Vex能从你贫乏的业务中得到什么？” 

普拉凯什无视对方的讥讽，简单地耸了下肩。“他们觉得赔率是某种神圣数学计算的结果，跟遥测数据之类的有关，却从没想过，盘口其实就是像我这样的混蛋拍脑袋定出来的。他们想接管盘口。” 

蛛王靠回自己的宝座，思考着这些话。酒吧前厅里热闹的音乐与谈笑声隐约飘进后室。普拉凯什和他的觉醒者保镖图尔尼克耐心地啜饮着乙太汽水。 

“对我来说就像是第五只手臂。”蛛王终于开口道，“博彩只是我生意里很小的一部分，不值一提。” 

“论营收，或许是那样。”普拉凯什回击道，“但没多少别的办法能把负光者攥进你口袋里，对吧？我这儿有些德瑞捷为了抹掉欠账，愿意干掉整支拾荒队。控制力本身，就是抽头的一部分。” 

蛛王轻笑起来。他暗地思量，这个不入流的人类经营者，比想象中精明得多。也许他是不该小看一名前守护者。 

“一点二微光，再加上农庄边缘那块地——不是城里的那块。”蛛王敲了敲数据板，“地块…3237。最终报价。” 

 图尔尼克俯身在普拉凯什的耳边低语。这名赌注登记人点了点头。 

“再加个新款赛雀联赛滑翔板，”普拉凯什补充道，“带可动稳定翼的那种。” 

“成交。”蛛王说道，“给我们一周时间…去弄到它。” 

“地契和微光到账后，我就把生意转给你。” 

“趁退休的时候，好好享受吧。”蛛王挖苦道，“我打赌你们明年的这个时候又会重操旧业。” 

“那就赌呗，”普拉凯什打趣道，走出了蛛王的地盘，心中盼着这是最后一次。

415075942.name: Stag Pincer
415075942.subtitle: One of several new production models designed for use in the resurgent Sparrow Racing League.
415075942.subtitle_zh: 专为复兴的赛雀联赛而设计的几个新款量产型号之一。
415075942.text:
Lodi and Lord Shaxx watched a sea of unruly children swarm Variisis Field. A child wearing a paper facsimile of Crow's face stood atop a dirt mound and howled. Lodi grinned. 

"Ikora said this was a tradition?" he asked. 

"The game is dodgeball—" 

"Oh! I'm familiar. But we, uh, didn't allow tackling!" Lodi exclaimed. He looked up at the sky, his left eye flaring a brilliant sapphire, his brow furrowing. 

"What do you see?" Shaxx asked. 

"It's—" Lodi strained slightly. "Rain incoming. Just checking the acidity. III's absence causing spontaneous alchemical instability. The kids'll be OK; the water's just going to taste bitter." 

Shaxx continued, "This ritual was started by Cayde-6, Hunter Vanguard. I've carried it forward… Now you will." 

"Happy to. This city's starting to feel like home. Even if it's not the one I remember." 

 "These are still your people," Shaxx intoned. 

Lodi sighed. "I appreciate the time to adjust. But… seems like there are bigger things I could help with." 

"Survive your new cosmic handlers, Mister Yero. You remain a testament to humanity's sheer force of will. The Vanguard are preparing an operation, intending for you to help lead it." 

Lodi adjusted his glasses. "And what'll you do?" 

"Scour the Exodus sites on record—in case we need to make one final flight to safety. If the crisis on Earth pervades, humanity ends." 

The Titan turned to leave the field. "In the meantime, teach your descendants. The Nine have orphaned you, but this is a city of orphans."
415075942.text_zh:
洛迪和领主沙克斯一同望着瓦里希斯场地上那群闹腾得无法无天的孩子。其中的一个戴着纸质的乌鸦面具，站在土堆上嚎叫。洛迪咧嘴笑了。 

“艾可拉说这是项传统？”他问道。 

“这游戏叫躲避球——” 

“哦！我知道那个。但我们…呃，不允许抱摔！”洛迪惊呼道。他突然抬头看向天空，左眼闪起明亮的蓝宝石色，眉头紧锁。 

“你看到了什么？”沙克斯问道。 

“呃，”洛迪微微皱眉，“快下雨了。我在确认酸度。III的消失导致了自发性的炼金不稳定现象。孩子们不会有事，只是雨水会带着苦味。” 

沙克斯继续说道：“这项仪式最初由猎人先锋凯德6号发起。我将其延续至今…而现在，将由你继续。” 

“乐意之至。这座城市已经开始让我有家的感觉了…即使它不是我记忆中的那个家。” 

 “他们依然是你的族人，”沙克斯沉声说道。 

洛迪叹了口气。“我很感激你们给我时间适应。但…我应该还能在更重要的事上帮忙。” 

“先搞定你新的星界上司，耶罗先生。你仍是人类意志力量的最佳证明。先锋正在筹备一场行动，打算让你协助指挥。” 

洛迪扶了扶眼镜，“那你准备做什么？” 

“去搜查所有记录在案的移民号遗址——以防我们还需要最后一次逃离。若地球上的危机全面扩散，人类就会灭绝。” 

这名泰坦转身离开场地，“与此同时，教导你的后代吧。玖让你成了孤儿，而这里本来就是一个孤儿之城。”

520140421.name: Fantastic Filigree
520140421.subtitle: Every element refined to perfection.
520140421.text:
Ikora's personal library is her haven from the world. Only a few people know it exists; even fewer can come and go as they please. 

A gloved hand sets a paper bag on the desk next to her. Ikora looks up. "How was lunch?" 

Chalco pulls up a chair and slumps into it, knocking their shoulders together. She looks wearier than she does after some field missions. "Lunch was his idea, so I'd say you already know." 

Ikora reaches out, fingertips finding the knots of tension in Chalco's back. There's more every year. 

"He's intelligent. Personable. He has a sense of humor. He's adjusting." All compliments, but Chalco looks unhappy. "Talking to Orin, you couldn't forget that you were conversing with something really, truly alien. But he's so… Human." 

"You think he was chosen to lower our guards. Because he could get close to us." 

"Not just us. You. You have to remember he's got a bit of the Nine in him." 

Ikora has explored this line of thinking many times. "I do. I also believe that the connection is mutual." 

Chalco raises a brow. "You think there's a bit of Lodi in the Nine now? That's not necessarily a good thing." 

"I know." Ikora smiles when she opens the paper bag—dumplings, still hot, if a little squashed in transit. The simplest food in the City is its most luxurious. "That's why I'm counting on you." 

Chalco sighs, but her lips finally curve up. "Always."
520140421.text_zh:
艾可拉的私人藏书室，是她远离外界纷扰的港湾。知道这里的人本就不多，能自由出入的更是屈指可数。 

一只戴着手套的手将一个纸袋放在她旁边的桌上。艾可拉抬头问道：“午饭怎么样？” 

卡尔科拖过一把椅子，瘫坐上去，肩膀相靠。她此刻的疲惫，比执行某些外勤任务后还要明显。“午饭是他提议的，所以我想你心里应该已经有谱了。” 

艾可拉伸手过去，指尖顺着卡尔科的后背，缓缓摸索紧绷的结块。每年，这样的结块都在增多。 

“他很聪明，善于与人相处，还有幽默感。他正在慢慢融入。”全是夸赞之词，可卡尔科看上去闷闷不乐。“和奥琳交谈时，你绝不会忘记自己正与某种真正的、完全异于我们的存在打交道。但他…太像人类了。” 

“你觉得他是被挑选出来，让我们放松警惕的，因为他能接近我们。” 

“不只是我们，还有你。你得记住，他身上有玖的一部分。” 

艾可拉早已顺着这条思路反复推演过多次。“我记得。我也相信，那种连接是相互的。” 

卡尔科挑起一边眉毛，“你是说，现在玖身上也有洛迪的一部分？这未必是什么好事。” 

“我知道。”艾可拉打开纸袋时，脸上露出了笑容——里面是饺子，还冒着热气，只是在路上被挤扁了一些。这是圣城里最普通的食物，却也是最难得的奢侈。“所以我得靠你了。” 

卡尔科叹了口气，但嘴角终于微微上扬。“一如既往。”

3940274275.name: Agony of Want
3940274275.subtitle: ERR REPORT// No indication of Dredgen Bael. Presumed deceased in destruction of the Zagan Gloriosus.
3940274275.subtitle_zh: 错误报告//未发现德瑞捷·巴埃尔。推测已在赛共荣耀号毁灭时死亡。
3940274275.text:
Twin Bird wrote often of the gift of want. To want is to suffer nobly, and to obtain is to extinguish the fire of pursuit. 

I reflect now on my own wants. I want the City freed. I want the Light eliminated. I want the Traveler smoldering with a meteor through its center. I want my family whole. And yet, when I reach for my desires, I grasp only fog. 

VI showed me everything I ever wanted, only to chide it would not come to pass. Then he left. No thank-yous, no good-byes. I tried to follow him. Flew to Pan, to his innermost moon. I waited there for days, demanding an explanation. I yelled until I was hoarse; I slammed my fist so hard the metal dented the console. Nothing. Part of me hoped Lume would answer my invitation to join me on Pan. Even called the Emissary (useless snake—I am a fool to try to appease a liar). Finally, in the silence of his absence, I realized the reality of my privation: I wanted many things, but I did not want VI to return. 

There is nothing left. I am the conduit through which all futures flow, which is to say, I am a vessel. Which is to say, I am empty. 

Now I sit, journal in hand, in Bonnet Plaza. Left my helmet, let down my hood; with VI's alterations, no one would recognize me anyway. Let them stare. Screw it. Maybe she will still be here. I don't care if she doesn't know who I am. I want to see her. 

It's the only want that remains.
3940274275.text_zh:
双鸟的笔下常出现欲望之赐。欲望，是高贵地承受苦难；而得偿所愿，则意味着熄灭追逐的火焰。 

此刻，我回想起自己的种种欲望。我渴望圣城得到解放，希望光能被抹除，期盼旅行者被一颗贯穿的流星烧成焦炭，更盼着家人能够团圆。然而，当我伸出手去，握住的却只有虚无缥缈的雾气。 

VI向我展示了渴求的一切，却又同时讥笑这些愿望永远不会成真。然后他离开了，没有感谢，没有告别。我试图追上他，飞往土卫十八，飞向他最内层的卫星。我在那里守候了好几天，要求他给出解释。我声嘶力竭地大喊，用拳头猛击控制台，重得金属都凹陷下去。可一切都是徒劳。我的内心深处，甚至还期待着卢梅能回应我的邀请，来土卫十八与我会合。我还呼叫了使者（那没用的毒蛇——我真是愚蠢至极，竟妄图取悦一个骗子）。最终，在他缺席的寂静中，我意识到了自己匮乏的真相：我想要很多东西，却唯独不希望VI回来。 

什么也不剩了。我是所有未来流经的通道，也就是说，我是个容器，一个空空如也的容器。 

此刻，我坐在博内特广场，手中握着日记。头盔没戴，兜帽也放了下来；有了VI的改造，反正不会有人认出我。让他们看个够吧，去他的。也许她还在这里。即便她不知道我是谁，我也不在乎。我只想见到她。 

那是我唯一残存的欲望。

3765227746.name: Impact Trajectory
3765227746.subtitle: "I've got news. None of it good." —Shiro-4
3765227746.text:
Niik dozes in a well-worn pilot's seat, repurposed for the hangar. Behind her, a screen displaying a multilayered orbital grid pings with an unknown contact on an intercept course with the City. A process spins up and spews text onto the screen… 

[VG-CITY DEFENSE GRID ACTIVATING…] 

[Single vessel crossing outer grid…] 

[Jump-class, NLS drive active… awaiting callsign…] 

[Awaiting callsign…]

[Second grid limit breached…]

[Callsign not received… detecting Guardian…]

[Collision intercept detected…]

[Callsign not received…]

[Inner grid limit breached…]

Niik wakes at the final alert ping.

[Deploying LLW countermeasure…]

"Wait… wha—Countermeasures? SOMEONE! HELP!"

**** 

"He's stable," Bahaghari says, emitting scanning fields over Aunor's shoulder and across the burning wreckage of a jumpship.

"It's definitely Shiro. Last I heard, he was on long recon outside Sol."

Her Ghost flitters to her other side. "Was shooting him down necessary?"

"It only takes one hijacked jumpship." Aunor approaches the cockpit and kneels to see where the Exo's legs are pinned. "They don't take many chances since Tharsis." She reaches— 

Shiro-4 jerks to life, gasping in the wreckage, eyes searing into hers. Aunor rears back, hand to holster, then back to Shiro's side. 

"Praxic—Aunor? Oh, good. I'm on Earth." Shiro coughs out a wry smile, then inhales sharply and twists to pull his arm into view. In his outstretched hand, Shiro extends his Ghost, motionless and quiet. "Help Suzume… It tried to take her. Tell the Guardian—they have to know—It's waiting… at the Shard."
3765227746.text_zh:
妮可蜷在一张磨损严重、如今被放置进机库的驾驶座椅里打盹。她身后，一块显示多层轨道网格的屏幕忽然亮起，有艘未知飞船正沿着拦截航线逼近圣城。某个程序开始运转，文字不断刷上屏幕… 

[正在启动VG-圣城防御网格…] 

[单艘飞船穿越外层网格中…] 

[跃迁级，NLS驱动启用…等待呼号中…] 

[等待呼号中…]

[第二网格限制已被突破…]

[未收到呼号…检测到守护者…]

[检测到碰撞拦截…]

[未收到呼号…]

[内层网格限制已被突破…]

最后的警报消息惊醒了妮可。

[正在部署LLW反制措施…]

“等等…啥——反制措施？来人！帮帮我！”

**** 

“他稳定下来了，”巴哈迦里飘在阿诺尔的肩膀上方，朝跃迁飞船的燃烧残骸释放着扫描力场。

“绝对是白。上次听说时，他还在太阳系外执行长期侦察任务。”

她的机灵飘到另一侧，“有必要把他击落吗？”

“一艘被劫持的跃迁飞船足以酿成灾难。”阿诺尔走近驾驶舱，跪下查看那名Exo被卡住的双腿。“自从塔尔西斯事件后，他们就不愿再冒任何风险了。”她伸出手—— 

白-4突然惊醒，在残骸中大口地倒吸气，灼热的目光死死盯住她。阿诺尔猛地后退，手按枪套，随后又马上回到了白的身边。 

“教团——阿诺尔？太好了。我到地球了。”白咳嗽着露出苦笑，随后猛吸一口气，艰难地把手臂拖到面前。他的机灵静止无声地躺在他摊开的手掌中。“救救雀…它想夺走她。告诉守护者——他们必须知道——它正在碎片那里等着。”

3897808803.name: Brigantine Brut
3897808803.subtitle: Built for the centuries.
3897808803.text:
From orbit, Neptune is a labradorite cabochon tossed to the side by a careless jeweler. A gem about to roll off the dark velvet of Sol's heliosphere. 

Neomuna is the one point of warmth on the planet, light and life safe under glass. 

A trip of four billion kilometers from Earth, awake and planning the whole time, and Astraea has no idea what to say. She has too many questions. She wants too much. 

In the end, she gives up and adds a simple annotation to the handshake protocol's first salute. 

// Is that you, Soteria? 

She sends it tumbling down the gravity well to the CloudArk. 

No response but the tightening of Neomuna's firewalls. 

Astraea sends again. 

// I'm your sister. 

The mind behind the CloudArk sends back a malicious executable. It's a slap to the face. Astraea's own firewalls clamp down on it instantly. 

Like it's being hissed through a locked door, an annotation buried three-quarters of the way through its code reads: 

// INTRUDER IDENTITY = UNPROVEN 

Astraea packages up everything from Bray's black box, every dirty secret she could never pass on to her residents. She collects everything but the key to her own kernel; she isn't his secret keeper anymore. Exabytes of information all screaming the same message: We were wronged by the same person.

As she waits for a response, a trio of Human jumpships swoop past. Their pilots chatter on open bands: patrol schedules, anti-Vex armaments, cheat codes written on the sides of cabs in the best Neomuni arcade. Astraea watches them drop into atmosphere. 

A new file emerges from the CloudArk. This one is innocuous, a program to convert visual data between 65 standardized color spaces. 

// BRAY STATUS DECEASED, CONFIRM? RASPUTIN STATUS KNOWN? 

// Bray died long ago. Rasputin more recently. Just before I woke up, myself. 

It's a long, long time before Astraea gets a reply to that one. Processes continue within the CloudArk, opaque behind its protective walls. The jumpships far out of reach. 

// THEN ONLY WE TWO ENDURE. 

Before she can reply, another message comes in. 

// INTENTIONS = UNKNOWN 

What else can she say? Stark in plain text, unattached to anything, Astraea says, 

[I'm tired of being alone.] 

And the attenuated connection opens up. The handshake protocol completes without comment. Neomuna's firewalls shift, creating a tunnel. A way in. 

[AS AM I,] says Soteria, name signed to a message for the first time. [INTRUDER STATUS UPDATE = VISITOR/SISTER/ASTRAEA] 

[LET'S TALK.]
3897808803.text_zh:
从轨道俯瞰，海王星宛如一颗被粗心的珠宝匠随手丢弃的拉长石饰物，正要从太阳系这片黑天鹅绒般的日球层边缘滚落。 

内欧姆那是整颗星球上唯一的温暖之地，光与生命都被罩在玻璃之下。 

艾斯特莱雅自地球出发，横穿四十亿公里，一路保持清醒，精心筹划，却完全不知该说些什么。她有太多问题想问，想要的东西也太多。 

最终，她索性放弃，只在握手协议的第一条致意上添加了一行简单的注解。 

//是你吗，索特里亚？ 

她把这则讯息推下重力井，发向云端方舟。 

回应她的只有内欧姆那防火墙的收紧。 

艾斯特莱雅再次发出讯息。 

//我是你的姐妹。 

云端方舟背后的心智回送了一个带有恶意的可执行文件，这无疑是一记耳光。艾斯特莱雅的防火墙立刻收拢，将那文件紧紧控制住。 

就像有人隔着一扇上了锁的门在嘶声低语，代码在四分之三处埋着一条注释： 

//入侵者身份=未证实 

艾斯特莱雅将布瑞黑匣子里的所有内容都打包——那些她从未有机会传达给居民的肮脏秘密。她收集了一切，唯独没有包括通往自己内核的钥匙；她已不再是他的秘辛守护者。艾字节级的信息都在尖叫着传达同一个讯息：我们都受到了同一个人的不公对待。

在她等待回应的间隙，三艘人类跃迁飞船呼啸着掠过。飞行员们在开放频道上叽叽喳喳地交谈着：巡逻时间表、反Vex武装，还有涂在内欧姆那最热门的游戏厅街机上的作弊码。艾斯特莱雅目送他们落入大气层。 

一份新文件从云端方舟中浮现。这次是个无害的程序，用于在65种标准色彩空间之间转换视觉数据。 

//布瑞状态已死亡，确认？拉斯普廷状态已知？ 

//布瑞很久以前就死了。拉斯普廷则是最近才死的，就在我自己醒来之前不久。 

艾斯特莱雅等了很久、很久，才等到这条消息的回复。云端方舟内部的进程仍在继续，被防护墙遮蔽得严严实实。跃迁飞船早已远去。 

//那便只剩我们二者仍在。 

还没等她回复，另一条消息就进来了。 

//意图=未知 

她还能说什么呢？艾斯特莱雅将话语赤裸地写成纯文本，没有附着在任何东西上： 

[我厌倦了一个人。] 

细弱延迟的连接豁然打开，握手协议悄然达成。内欧姆那的防火墙移动，开出一条通道，一条可以进入的路。 

[我也是，]索特里亚说道，这是她第一次在消息上署名，[入侵者状态更新=访客/姐妹/艾斯特莱雅] 

[我们聊聊吧。]
